name: Morning run preparation and heading to the meeting point
description: At 5:30 a.m., his biological clock woke the user right on time. He put on the windbreaker, compression tights, and running shoes prepared in advance, did some simple dynamic stretches in the living room, and drank a few sips of warm water. Then he walked about 15 minutes to Xiaokunshan Health Park and met his running partner Chen Jie on time at the entrance. They exchanged New Year greetings, talked about their plans and physical condition for the day, and confirmed they would complete a 10-kilometer run at a pace of 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer.
location: Room 201, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai; and the entrance of Xiaokunshan Health Park (40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Highway)

name: The 10K New Year run with Chen Jie.
description: At exactly 6 a.m., the user and Chen Jie started running from the park entrance, jogging 10 km along the fitness trail in Xiaokunshan Health Park. The winter morning light was dim and the air was crisp. The two maintained a steady pace of about 5:50 per kilometer, with breathing and cadence in good sync. Chen Jie occasionally reminded him to keep his core stable and increase cadence. They completed the 10 km at 7:05. The user's average heart rate was 152 bpm, and he felt strong legs and smooth breathing.
location: Trail in Xiaokunshan Health Park, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Post-run rest and recovery, data review, and half marathon registration
description: After the run, the two rested on a park bench. The user took off his sports watch and reviewed his 2024 running data: total mileage about 800 km and average pace of 6:05 per km. Chen Jie encouraged him, saying the numbers were good; with systematic training, he had a good chance of breaking two hours in the Sheshan Half Marathon. The user decisively took out his phone, opened the registration page on the Sheshan Half Marathon official website, entered his personal information, emergency contact (father Yin Jianguo), and running data, and completed registration via WeChat Pay. After receiving the confirmation text, he turned the phone screen to Chen Jie and said with a smile that his goal was to finish within 2 hours 10 minutes. The two high-fived.
location: Lakeside leisure benches and the entrance of Xiaokunshan Health Park, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Returning home, breakfast, and sending New Year wishes
description: After saying goodbye to Chen Jie, the user walked home at a relaxed pace (about 15 minutes). At home, he took a quick warm shower and changed into clean loungewear. Then in the kitchen he fried two eggs and toasted two slices of whole wheat bread, preparing a simple but protein-rich New Year breakfast. At 8:15, sitting at the dining table, he ate fried egg toast while using his phone to send personalized New Year WeChat messages to his parents, older brother, and a few close comrades-in-arms. His mother quickly replied with a voice message, telling him not to make do and to eat well. The user smiled and replied 'Got it.' After the meal, he played soft instrumental music and briefly washed and hung up his running shoes and sportswear.
location: Room 201, Building 3, Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reading and certification plan
description: The user sat on the living room sofa, brewed a cup of hot tea, opened the January issue of Runner's World, and read about New Year training plans and race recommendations. At the same time, he wrote down the consultation phone number and official website address for the senior CNC technician exam in his phone's memo app, planning to ask for details in a few days.
location: Living room, Building 3, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Purchase New Year supplies and cook lunch
description: The user cycled to the fresh supermarket at Xingang New Village to shop. At the supermarket entrance, he happened to meet Master Chen from the nearby Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair shop. They chatted for a bit, and Master Chen encouraged the user to study hard, saying that obtaining the senior technician certificate was a real skill. The user bought greens, pork, and a carton of milk, then cycled home. Once home, he cut the pork belly into chunks and blanched them, heated oil in a pan, stir-fried sugar to make caramel color, added scallions, ginger, and star anise, and stewed a pot of Shanghainese braised pork. While the meat was simmering, he stir-fried lettuce with garlic, rinsed rice and cooked it, and the kitchen filled with the aroma of meat.
location: The fresh supermarket at Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the kitchen in Building 3, Xingang Community.

name: Enjoying New Year's Day lunch.
description: At 12 o'clock sharp, he brought out braised pork and garlic lettuce and filled a bowl of rice. While eating, he watched a video analyzing the Sheshan Half Marathon course on his phone, silently planning future long-distance training routes. After the meal, he cleaned up the dishes and walked around a bit to aid digestion.
location: Canteen, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon nap
description: The user drew the bedroom curtains and lay down on the bed. Because of the heavy exercise in the morning and feeling somewhat sleepy after lunch, he quickly fell into a nap. Around 30 minutes of deep sleep effectively restored his energy for the afternoon.
location: Bedroom, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Exam preparation study and race route research
description: After the nap, the user sat at the desk in the study feeling refreshed. He opened the laptop and first looked up the 2025 exam syllabus and reference textbooks for the Senior CNC Machine Tool Operator Technician Certificate, and made simple PDF notes and a study schedule. Then he opened the half-marathon course map, marked every point where the slope changed with a highlighter, and wrote down his initial pace plan based on feel in his running diary.
location: Study, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Visit the gym and talk with running friends.
description: The user cycled to Vitality Fitness Center where Chen Jie works. There were quite a few people working out at the gym on New Year's Day. Chen Jie was instructing a client. After Chen Jie became free, the two chatted in the equipment area for about half an hour, specifically discussing next week's tempo run plan. Afterward, the user walked slowly on the treadmill for 15 minutes to cool down.
location: Vitality Fitness Center, No. 1-10, Lane 1255, Xinsongjiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Chatted with colleagues on the way home
description: On his way home from the gym by bike, he ran into Liu Zhiqiang, a programming colleague and fellow townsman from Jiangsu, outside the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road; Liu had just packed half a roast duck to take out. The two chatted by the roadside for a while. When Liu heard that the user was preparing for the senior technician exam, he said he could ask him anything about programming. They also agreed to play games together online in the evening. Then the user rode home.
location: At the entrance of Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, No. 232 Xingang Road, Dagang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare dinner for himself
description: After returning home, the user reheated the leftover braised pork from lunch. Then he took frozen dumplings out of the fridge, cooked a bowl of hot sour soup dumplings, and ate them with the braised pork, feeling satisfied.
location: Kitchen, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with family
description: Just after finishing dinner, Mom's video call came right on time. The user leaned back on the sofa and told Mom about this morning's run and signing up for the half marathon, and also showed her the braised pork he had stewed. Mom beamed with laughter and told him to dress warmly in the cold weather and to eat well and keep warm. Dad also talked a bit about work and said he was proud of his son. After chatting for half an hour, they hung up, and the user was in a good mood.
location: Living room, Building 3, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening gaming and group chat interaction
description: His phone vibrated; colleague Wang Lei sent a gaming invitation in the WeChat group. The user immediately came online and formed a five-person ranked team with Liu Zhiqiang, Wang Lei, and two old gaming buddies, Li Gang and Zhao Qiang. They coordinated well, chatted and laughed, and won four games in a row. During the break between games, he also exchanged running tips with Chen Jie in the group and sent him the half marathon course map he had organized that afternoon.
location: Bedroom/living room, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for tomorrow.
description: After the game, I turned off the computer and went to the bathroom to take a hot shower, washing away the day's sweat and fatigue from exercise. Then I took out tomorrow's clothes and running gear, checked the condition of my running shoes, filled the thermos with warm water, and placed it on the bedside table.
location: Bathroom and bedroom in Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reading and relaxing before bed
description: Leaning against the headboard, I looked through the morning running photos and the successful registration screenshot on my phone, feeling fulfilled. Then I flipped through Runner's World magazine and mainly read an article about how beginners should prepare for their first half marathon, and I felt I gained a lot.
location: Bedroom, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: At 22:30, I turned off the desk lamp on time. Recalling the good state of this morning's run and the decisiveness of signing up, I felt satisfied with the first day of the new year. Silently reciting the recovery run plan for tomorrow morning, I soon fell into a deep sleep amid the occasional distant sound of fireworks outside the window.
location: Bed in the bedroom, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Early morning strength training
description: At 6 a.m., the alarm went off. I did 30 minutes of strength training in the living room of the rental apartment, including push-ups, squats, resistance band rows, and planks, laying the foundation for maintaining a healthy body in the new year.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Xingang Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning washing and breakfast.
description: After strength training, he showered and changed into work clothes. He heated up yesterday's leftover egg fried rice and mixed it with Lao Gan Ma for breakfast, along with hot milk. While eating, he checked the weather forecast and the day's to-do list, including talking to a master about certification, going to the supermarket in the afternoon, and calling his mother.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute to work and prepare for starting work
description: At 7:30, I drove out from the rented apartment, listened to traffic radio, and arrived at Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. about 17 minutes later. In the changing room, I changed into work clothes, put on a safety helmet, went to the workshop to confirm the night shift production task sheet, and prepared for the day's work.
location: Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., from Guangfulin Road to Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning production and pre-shift briefing.
description: Before officially starting the machine, he checked with team leader Wang Lei about the batch of precision parts to be processed that day. Wang Lei asked about his New Year's Day run, and then he meticulously set parameters, checked the cutting tools, and got down to production work.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai)

name: Planned senior technician certification with his mentor.
description: During a work break, he found his master Sun Jianguo in the workshop office and formally proposed his plan to obtain the senior CNC machine tool operator technician certificate. Master Sun stressed seriously that both theory and hands-on practice required effort and that at least half a year of preparation was necessary. He recommended the textbook CNC Machine Tool Programming and Operation (Advanced) and arranged regular practical assessments. Yin Hao carefully took down the key points, and his master was gratified and agreed to provide guidance.
location: Workshop office, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

name: Continue production and study planning.
description: Returned to his workstation and continued operating the machine. While working, he thought about the master's advice and, during the tool change interval, drafted a preliminary study plan on the back of his work notebook: theory study from 19:00 to 20:00 on weekdays, hands-on practice from 9:00 to 11:00 on Saturdays, and note sorting on Sundays, laying the foundation for the year-end certification exam.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

name: Lunch and exchange with colleagues
description: Had lunch with mentor Sun Jianguo and fellow townsman Liu Zhiqiang in the cafeteria, chatting while eating about Liu Zhiqiang's experiences when he went back to his hometown during New Year's Day. After the meal, walked around the workshop to aid digestion, used the phone memo app to take a photo of the study schedule, and set a reminder alarm for 7 p.m. every night.
location: Canteen at Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

name: Afternoon production tasks
description: In the afternoon, he focused on completing the remaining precision parts machining, operating the machine tool with full concentration. Before leaving work, team leader Wang Lei notified that there would be a production scheduling meeting tomorrow morning. Yin Hao noted it down and planned that the evening study could proceed as usual.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

name: Shopping after work
description: Got off work at 17:30 and drove home, stopping by the Xingang New Village fresh supermarket on the way to buy ingredients: tomatoes, eggs, greens, rice, and Lao Gan Ma. He passed the seafood section and considered buying clams but did not buy any.
location: Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket (Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai) and commuting route

name: Preparing and eating dinner
description: After arriving home and putting away the groceries, I cooked: stir-fried tomatoes and eggs, made a soup with the lion's head meatball packed from the cafeteria, and served it with rice. While eating, I played pop music on my phone to relax and enjoyed the quiet after work.
location: Kitchen and living room of the rental apartment in Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Senior Technician theory study
description: At 7 p.m., when the alarm went off, I took out the textbook CNC Machine Tool Programming and Operation (Advanced) borrowed from Master Sun. At my desk, I studied Chapter 1, 'Fundamentals of CNC Machining Technology,' highlighting key points with a marker and noting down key definitions. Although it was abstract, I persisted and finished it, laying a theoretical foundation for the certification exam.
location: At the desk in the rental apartment, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Video call with mother.
description: After studying, I made a WeChat video call to my mother, Wang Xiuying, to share the news that I officially started my certification exam plan today. She was very happy but reminded me not to overwork myself and to get enough rest. We asked about each other's weather and health and talked for more than half an hour, which warmed my heart.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Xingang Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Honor of Kings casual team-up play
description: After hanging up the video call, he saw Wang Lei calling for teammates in the group chat to play Honor of Kings, so he formed an online team with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang and played two ranked matches together, winning some and losing some. They chatted on voice during the games, venting and relaxing.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Xingang Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organizing the study plan and today's reflections
description: Before bed, he took out his new notebook and neatly copied down the key points from his discussion with Master Sun and the study plan he had made. He also wrote a reflection: 'The road to certification has officially begun. What matters is not how far you have run, but that you have taken the first step.' After that, he prepared his clothes and work badge for the next day, charged his phone, and set the alarm.
location: At the desk in the rental apartment, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Evening washing up and going to bed
description: Brushed my teeth, washed my face, and soaked my feet in hot water to relieve fatigue. After tidying up, I turned off the light and lay down, reviewing tomorrow’s schedule: get up early, strength training, go to work, study in the evening. I felt at ease and fell asleep at around 11 p.m.
location: Bedroom and bathroom of the rental apartment in Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning tempo run.
description: The 6:00 alarm went off, and Yin Hao got up immediately, put on his running shoes and windbreaker, and ran west along Guangfulin Road to the area near Songjiang University Town, then turned back. The total distance was 5 kilometers, with a pace of about 5 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer. After the run, he did static stretching in the roadside green belt, including the front thighs, calves, and hip flexors, for 10 minutes. He nodded in greeting to the elderly people doing morning exercise, then walked back to Xingang Community.
location: Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (the section from the east side of Xingang Residential Area to Songjiang University Town) and Xingang Residential Area.

name: Shower, change clothes, and breakfast
description: After finishing his morning run and returning home, Yin Hao took a hot shower for about 10 minutes and changed into clean work clothes. Then he cooked a bowl of tomato and egg noodles and heated a cup of soy milk, checking the weather and WeChat messages on his phone while eating. After the meal, he washed the dishes and checked his commuter bag, confirming his phone, power bank, keys, work badge, and other items.
location: Inside the rental apartment at Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving to work and studying during the commute
description: Yin Hao drove out of the underground garage of Xingang Residential Community, headed east on Guangfulin Road, turned onto Jiasong South Road, then onto Huatianjing Highway. During the roughly 15-minute drive, he used his phone's Bluetooth to play the segment 'Macro Variables and Loop Instructions' from the audio course 'CNC Machine Tool Programming and Operation', silently memorizing it as he listened. He arrived at the company at 8:05, parked, then picked up his safety helmet and gloves and went to the workshop locker room.
location: During commute from Guangfulin Road to 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-shift preparation and meeting up with colleagues
description: After arriving at the company parking lot, Yin Hao went into the changing room, put on his work clothes and safety goggles, then went to the workshop office to find squad leader Wang Lei and master worker Sun Jianguo to learn about the day's production scheduling tasks. After a quick exchange of opinions, the three went together to the meeting room on the second floor for the production scheduling meeting.
location: Machining workshop locker room and office, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning work (including scheduling meeting and machining K43 valve body)
description: At 8:35, attended the production scheduling meeting chaired by workshop director Liu Zhiqiang, who emphasized the urgent orders for the K43 valve body and F52 flange and reminded about equipment maintenance. After the meeting ended at 9:15, Yin Hao returned to his workstation, started the gantry machining center, clamped the blank, calibrated the tool, and began trial-cutting the K43 valve body. After measuring, he fine-tuned the program, and Master Sun guided him on-site to optimize the tool path and reduce vibration. At 10:05, while the machine was running automatically, he went to the rest area for water and chatted with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang. Wang Lei complained about his losing streak in games last night, Liu Zhiqiang suggested playing badminton on the weekend, and Yin Hao said he was free on Saturday afternoon. At 10:15, he returned to his post and continued machining, completed the first piece, measured it as qualified, filled in the machining records, adjusted the coolant, and machined the third piece. At 11:35, with the machine in automatic operation, he organized the inspection reports and prepared to go to the cafeteria.
location: Second-floor meeting room and workshop workstation, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cafeteria lunch and conversation
description: Yin Hao went to the cafeteria with Sun Jianguo and Liu Zhiqiang. He chose braised pork chop, stir-fried greens, and tomato and egg soup for 12 yuan in total. The three sat together eating and chatting about new process treatment and the weekend badminton plans. Yin Hao asked Master Sun if he could help review materials in the evening, and Master Sun agreed to send the link during the lunch break. After finishing at 12:15, he cleared his tray.
location: Canteen on the east side of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Noon break
description: After returning to his workstation area, Yin Hao filled his thermos with hot water, leaned back in the recliner, and rested with his eyes closed for 25 minutes, with his phone on silent and not looking at the screen. At 12:45 he got up to stretch his shoulders and neck, and after recovering his energy, checked the tools for the afternoon work.
location: Workshop rest room, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work (machining F52 flange and gathering materials)
description: At 12:50 he officially started work and continued machining F52 flange parts, adjusting the clamping method and roughing and finishing parameters. At 14:00 he completed the first batch, measured and recorded quality data, with a 100% pass rate. During this time, Wang Lei handed him the next day's shift schedule, and he signed to confirm. At 14:35, during a tool-change break, Yin Hao went to the rest area and borrowed Wang Lei's laptop to go online. He quickly searched for the exam syllabus for the Senior CNC Machine Tool Operation Technician Certificate and the textbook Modern CNC Technology, saved the relevant page tabs in his phone memo, and took screenshots. At 14:50 he returned to his post and continued machining. At 16:00 he completed all F52 flange tasks; together with the K43 valve body, he completed 120% of the day's planned output. He filled out the production daily report and wiped down the machine panel. At 16:45 he discussed weekend study arrangements with Master Sun, and Master Sun agreed to take him to see an imported five-axis machine next week. At 17:00 the end-of-shift bell rang; he shut down the machine, took off his gloves, and said goodbye to his colleagues.
location: Workshop station and rest area, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute after work and shop along the way.
description: After work, Yin Hao drove away from the company and reached Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket in about 15 minutes. He went in and bought spinach, carrots, tofu, and ground pork, spending 22 yuan in total, then drove about 1.4 minutes back to Xingang Community.
location: Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket and surrounding roads

name: Go home to cook and eat dinner
description: After arriving home, Yin Hao boiled water and cooked noodles, prepared ingredients such as spinach and tofu, and made a bowl of soup noodles with vinegar and chili oil. While eating, he scrolled through group messages on his phone, saw fellow runner Chen Jie share a route, and only liked it without replying. After the meal, he washed the dishes and tidied up the kitchen.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the rental unit at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Xingang Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with Mom.
description: Yin Hao made a video call to his mother on WeChat, talked about how work had gone smoothly that day, and mentioned his plan to organize certification exam materials in the evening. His mother told him to go to bed early, and as they hung up, the sounds of cooking came from her end.
location: Sofa in the living room of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Systematically searched for certification exam study materials.
description: Yin Hao turned on his laptop, connected to WiFi, and searched Baidu and Bilibili in turn for the exam syllabus of the Senior CNC Machine Tool Operator Technician Certificate, and downloaded the PDF. He searched for Modern CNC Technology, 3rd edition, and placed an order on JD.com. He bookmarked the Bilibili course CNC Programming in Practice and the imooc course Fundamentals of CNC Machining Technology. He found a WeChat official account for past exam questions and saved three sets of mock tests. Finally, he organized the web page tags in his phone's memo app into categories. Everything was completed by 19:50, and he created a Certification Prep 2025 folder on the computer with clear subdirectories.
location: At the bedroom desk in the rental apartment at Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Team up for games.
description: Yin Hao closed the computer browser, opened Honor of Kings on his phone, and teamed up for ranked matches with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang who were online. He chose Zhao Huaizhen as the jungler, lost the first game then won, and the comeback in the second game felt great; Wang Lei laughed loudly in voice chat. The two matches took about 40 minutes in total. After finishing, he exited the game and stretched his fingers.
location: Sofa in the bedroom of a rental apartment, Xingang Residential Area, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Clean up the computer disk and organize resources into categories.
description: Yin Hao returned to the computer, used Disk Cleanup to delete temporary files and empty the Recycle Bin, and manually deleted outdated files in the Downloads folder. He then categorized the video links, courseware screenshots, past exam PDFs, etc., in the "Certification Prep" folder and created a subfolder called "Study Notes." At 21:15, after the computer speed improved, he also backed up exercise screenshots and work photos from his phone gallery to the computer. At 21:35, he tidied up the desk.
location: At the bedroom desk in the rental apartment at Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Read the textbook and adjust the plan
description: Yin Hao made a cup of hot tea, opened the textbook CNC Machine Tool Programming and Operation (Advanced), and read Chapter 2, "Macro Programs and Variable Applications." As he read, he used a highlighter to mark key points and drew simple diagrams in his notebook. During the session, he checked his phone calendar and adjusted tomorrow morning's run time to 6:30. At 22:05, he had read about 20 pages and felt his thoughts were clear.
location: At the bedroom desk in the rental apartment at Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Washing up and preparing tomorrow's gear
description: Yin Hao went to the bathroom for a thorough wash: brushing his teeth, washing his face, and washing his feet. Then he returned to the bedroom, took out the work clothes and morning running gear for the next day (running shoes, quick-dry shirt, windbreaker, sports watch), charged his phone, set a 6:00 alarm, and took off his outer clothes and got into bed at 22:35.
location: Bathroom and bedroom of the rental apartment in Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Before-bed review and reading
description: Yin Hao leaned against the pillow, used the small desk lamp to read the terminology explanations in the auxiliary app "CNC Machine Tool Programming and Operation" on his phone. At 22:55 he turned off the light, closed his eyes and reviewed today's learning gains: he had saved the exam syllabus, ordered the textbook, and bookmarked the video course links. He confirmed that he would get up at 6:00 tomorrow morning for a morning run and play badminton in the afternoon. He gradually fell asleep, entering sleep around 23:00.
location: On the bed in the rented apartment, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Natural wake-up and early-morning preparation.
description: The sound of the drizzling rain outside the window helped you switch off the preset 6:30 alarm. You opened your eyes, had no thought of staying in bed, stretched lazily, drew open the curtain, and looked at the gray sky. You silently noted to yourself: today is a good day to stay home and study, and to have a good chat with the guys in the evening.
location: Bedroom, Room 403, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Indoor Morning Stretching and Wake-Up
description: On the living room floor, you spread out the yoga mat and completed a 15-minute full-body stretch and core-strength activation session. The soreness in your thighs after yesterday's tempo run is noticeable—a sign that the muscles are adapting and growing. You plan to skip running today and let your body rest fully.
location: Living room, Room 403, No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Nutritious Breakfast and Neighborhood Warmth
description: You boiled two eggs, made a large bowl of steaming oatmeal, and ate it with the dried radish strips your mother sent, feeling very satisfied. After breakfast, you cleaned up the kitchen waste and carried it down to the garbage station at the building entrance. At the stairwell entrance, you ran into Aunt Chen, who was returning from her morning exercise. She told you that the door lock had been sticking again last night, and you immediately agreed to go over with your tools in the afternoon. This set the afternoon lock-repair time earlier than originally planned.
location: Room 403, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Tidying up and confirming the evening plan.
description: After going back inside, you quickly tidied up the bedroom and living room, putting everything back in place. At exactly 8 o'clock, you sat down at the desk, opened your phone, and @everyone in the "Songjiang Three Brothers" group: "Brothers, tonight at 6:30, I've decided the place — Northeast Big Skewers (Wenhui Road) over by Songjiang University Town. I checked the map; walking there takes 20 minutes, just right for digesting. Whoever arrives first, go grab seats!" Gao Zhiyuan instantly replied "No problem," and Ma Xiaofeng also replied with an OK emoji.
location: Room 403, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Core theory learning: G-code and macro programs
description: Outside the window, the rain kept falling; inside, it was so quiet that only the sound of turning pages and the pen tip moving across the notebook could be heard. You opened the CNC Machine Tool Programming and Operation (Advanced) Tutorial that you had prepared yesterday and focused on the practical application of the G68 coordinate rotation and G16 polar coordinate commands. As you read, you drew simple schematic machining path diagrams on scratch paper. Around 10 o'clock, you picked up your phone and opened the bookmarked Bilibili video explaining macro programs. You skipped through half an episode on variable loops, felt it did not quite match your current progress, and turned it off, deciding to study the textbook thoroughly first. All morning, you systematically reviewed the core G-code and M-code instructions and, comparing them with the exam syllabus, ticked off the chapters you had reviewed today.
location: At the desk in Room 403, No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bring-your-own lunch and lunch break
description: After hanging up, he was in a very good mood. He put on his earphones and used a music app to play the light music playlist he had collected. At the same time, he turned the paper textbook Fundamentals of Financial Markets to Chapter 3, Money Market, and, in combination with the online course content he had listened to during the daytime commute, carefully read through the sections on short-term financing bills and repurchase agreements again, marking them with a highlighter.
location: Room 403, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Free-form extended learning: trying Python scripts.
description: Waking up from the afternoon nap feeling refreshed. Instead of continuing to study theory, you opened your laptop and remembered the Python knowledge from the online course. "The boss always makes me manually modify macro program parameters. Why not try writing a small tool to generate them automatically?" You opened PyCharm with interest and started trying to write a small script that could automatically convert part parameters in an Excel spreadsheet into FANUC system macro variable code. Although you kept getting stuck and constantly searched for answers on Stack Overflow, every time you solved a small bug, your interest in automation programming grew stronger. This hour of "homework" was not finished, but it made you very happy.
location: At the desk in Room 403, No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare tools and leave early
description: You checked the time, took out the heavy full tool kit from the storage room (flathead and Phillips screwdrivers, needle-nose pliers, rust remover, motor oil), and went downstairs 10 minutes early. Since you had promised someone, arriving a bit early is your principle.
location: On the way from Room 403, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Building 8.

name: Helped neighbor Aunt Chen repair the door lock
description: You knock on Auntie Chen's door on the first floor right on time. The lock cylinder is indeed badly stuck. You deftly remove the door handle, pull out the lock cylinder, and find it is a bit dry and dusty inside. You carefully clean it with fine wire, spray in rust remover, turn it repeatedly, and then add a few drops of sewing machine oil. After you reassemble it, you test it with the key five or six times, and it turns as smoothly as new. Auntie Chen is overjoyed and insists on giving you a box of her homemade osmanthus glutinous rice cakes. You cannot refuse, so you thank her and accept them, then stand and listen to her chat for a few minutes about neighborhood matters.
location: Room 102, Building 8, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Went home to organize and study theory.
description: After returning home, you put the toolbox back in its proper place and washed your hands. With nearly two hours left before going out, you decided not to sit idle. You took out your phone and opened the advanced certification study materials you had saved earlier, focusing on a case diagram about the application of macro programs in tool compensation and coordinate offset. Using the memo app on your phone, you copied down the key logic and formulas.
location: Room 403, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Confirm route and weekend clean-up
description: At 16:30, you opened Amap and confirmed the walking route from Xingang Community to Northeast Big Skewers (Wenhui Road Branch): about 1.6 km, 20 minutes on foot. After that, you began your weekly routine of thoroughly cleaning the room. You wiped the living room glass windows and cleaned the shelves of the bookcase and desk. This habit makes you feel that life is full of order.
location: Room 403, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Walk to the dinner venue
description: At 5:20 PM, you changed into clean casual pants and a dark blue jacket, grabbed your phone, keys, and a folding umbrella, and left on time. The light rain had stopped, and the road was wet. You walked east along Xingang Road, crossed Songhui West Road, and turned north onto Wenhui Road with light steps. The occasional college student appeared on the way, and the air was filled with the fresh smell after the rain.
location: Along the route from Lane 224, Xingang Road to Lane 338, Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Arrived at the restaurant and met up with friends
description: When you arrived, Ma Xiaofeng was already sitting in a booth on the first floor, scrolling through his phone and waiting for you two. The two of you hit it off right away and went upstairs to get a small private room. As soon as you sat down, Gao Zhiyuan pushed the door open, holding a bottle of baijiu. "What a traffic jam! But I made it after all!" The three of them hit it off like old friends and patted each other on the shoulders. Yin Hao took out his e-cigarette and handed one to each of his brothers.
location: Northeast Big Skewers (Wenhui Road Branch), Lane 338, Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: First gathering of the New Year: barbecue dinner and hearty conversation.
description: The three of them ordered a table full of food: large portions of lamb skewers, beef tendon, grilled chicken wings, scallops with vermicelli and garlic, plus a big plate of peanuts and several bottles of iced beer. The conversation started with their jobs and then branched out. Ma Xiaofeng complained about his company's year-end layoffs — two colleagues in his department had been cut. Gao Zhiyuan excitedly took out his phone and played a short sunrise video he had shot with his newly purchased DJI Mini 4 Pro drone when the company went camping at Dianshan Lake on New Year's Day. In the video, morning light broke through the clouds, and the imagery was stunning. Yin Hao and Ma Xiaofeng watched intently, praising it again and again. Gao Zhiyuan urged Yin Hao to get one too, saying prices had dropped a lot. Yin Hao took a sip of beer, shook his head, and said with a smile, “You know my situation — rent has gone up, and I also need to spend on study materials and certifications. I have no money and no free time for now, but send me the model number, I'll note it down, and I'll think about it when I have spare money.” He also told Ma Xiaofeng, who studied computer science, about his progress on writing a Python script today. Ma Xiaofeng was very interested and said he would send him a practical script library he had put together tomorrow. The three of them chimed in and settled on a plan to go hiking at Sheshan together in the spring.
location: Private room on the second floor of Northeast Big Skewers (Wenhui Road Branch), Lane 338, Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Post-dinner walk and return trip
description: At 9 pm, after a good meal, the three of them waved goodbye at the store entrance. You politely declined Gao Zhiyuan's offer to drive you home, saying a walk would help with digestion. On the way home, the air after the rain was especially fresh. You walked slowly, replaying the drone video from just now in your mind, and actually felt a bit drawn to it. When you reached the community gate, you saved the "DJI Mini 4 Pro" model and reference price that Gao Zhiyuan had just sent into your phone memo.
location: En route from Lane 338, Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Lane 224, Xingang Road

name: Washing up, tidying up, and evening review
description: After getting home, you took a hot shower, washing off the smell of barbecue and fatigue. Sitting at your desk, you quickly flipped through today's review notes to make sure nothing was missed. Then you saved the half-finished Python script and wrote the note "needs debugging: loop logic" in your notebook. You opened WeChat, replied to the greeting your mother had sent during the day, told her you had eaten plenty, and reassured her.
location: Room 403, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep peacefully.
description: At 22:30, you turned off the living room main light, leaving only a small bedside night light. You lay in bed and set your phone alarm back to 7:30 (it's Sunday, so you can sleep a bit longer). Today was fulfilling: you consolidated the theory, helped your neighbor, and chatted freely with your brothers about the future. The seeds of drones and Python have been planted, and you feel a full and pleasant calm in your heart. Occasionally a car returning late passed by outside the window, and you soon drifted off to sleep. Final status: mood pleasant, weight 71.3 kg, bedtime 23:00, fell asleep around 23:15.
location: Bedroom, Room 403, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Early morning preparation and breakfast
description: The alarm went off at exactly 7 o'clock. After washing up briefly, I sent my mother a WeChat message to let her know I was safe. I made the bed, checked and prepared the tool box and the old floor fan for the repair shop today. I took the crispy sweet and sour pork and milk out of the fridge, heated them up, made a bowl of oatmeal, and had a simple breakfast to store up energy for the day's activities.
location: Room 302, No. 8, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Visit the repair shop and learn home appliance repair
description: He left at 8:00, bought a cup of hot soy milk at the convenience store at the entrance to the residential community to warm his hands, then walked along Xingang Road to the Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop at No. 888 Wencheng Road. When he arrived, Master Chen Jianguo was already working, and he handed him a pork bun bought on the way as breakfast. Under Master Chen's guidance, he disassembled an old floor fan, measured the motor windings with a multimeter, determined that the starting capacitor had failed, deftly replaced the capacitor, added lubricating oil to the bearings, and fixed the fan. He also helped repair a broken-solder problem on an induction cooker and asked Master Chen about techniques for detecting weak current interference with an oscilloscope. Combining hands-on practice with theoretical learning throughout, he gained a great deal.
location: Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, 888 Wencheng Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return trip, grocery shopping, lunch, and lunch break
description: At 11:50 I left the repair shop and walked home. Passing by Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket, I bought ingredients such as Shanghai bok choy, tomatoes, eggs, soft tofu, spring onions, and small yellow croakers on special offer. After arriving home, I quickly made oatmeal with milk, ate a meat bun and an apple as lunch. While eating, I looked through the photos of the morning's fan repair and noted the key points of replacing the capacitor and bearing maintenance in my phone's memo app. Then I leaned back on the sofa and rested with my eyes closed for about 15 minutes to regain energy for the afternoon cleaning.
location: Room 302, Building 8, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (passing by Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road)

name: Year-end deep cleaning and personal hygiene
description: At 1 p.m., the year-end deep cleaning officially began. I put on rubber gloves and an apron, then organized the wardrobe in turn, rehanging winter clothes by thickness and folding old T-shirts that no longer fit to give to my father. I used a heavy-duty grease cleaner to deep-clean the kitchen stovetop and range hood, and cleared out and sorted the plastic bags and waste paper boxes that had accumulated under the sink. I wiped the balcony glass clean and put yesterday's curtains into the washing machine. Finally, I tidied the desk, neatly arranging the CNC textbooks, drawings, and the repair tool storage box. After the cleaning, I took a hot shower, hung the washed curtains back on the balcony to dry, changed into clean loungewear, and sat on the sofa drinking water and resting, scrolling through my phone for a while to reward myself for the afternoon's hard work.
location: Room 302, No. 8, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Researching drones and studying certification materials.
description: After a rest, he took out his phone and carefully researched the DJI Mini 4 Pro drone, watching review videos on Bilibili, focusing on nighttime image quality, transmission stability, and obstacle avoidance. He wrote down the model specifications and latest price in his memo, but thinking about the rising rent and exam preparation costs, he decided to postpone the purchase. He then opened the textbook CNC Machine Tool Programming and Operation (Advanced), reviewed the programming cases for G68 and G16 instructions, drew a few simple macro-program flowcharts on scratch paper, and warmed up for the in-depth study in the evening.
location: Room 302, No. 8, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: When I felt hungry, I started preparing dinner. I cleaned the small yellow croakers, dusted them with a thin layer of flour, and pan-fried them until golden, then braised them with ginger, garlic, soy sauce, and sugar. Scrambled eggs with tomatoes and stir-fried Shanghai greens were also finished in turn. I sat alone at the small dining table, enjoying this steaming home-cooked meal, playing Wu Bai's "Sudden Self" on my phone while eating, feeling satisfied with the day's steady life.
location: Room 302, No. 8, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Handled programming scripts and had a video chat with family.
description: After putting away the dishes, he proactively sent a WeChat message to his colleague Ma Xiaofeng to urge him to share the Python scripts. A few minutes later, he received a Baidu Netdisk link, quickly browsed the automated script library Ma Xiaofeng had written, downloaded it to his computer, and planned to study it later. At 7:30, he made a WeChat video call to his parents. His mother, Wang Xiuying, was very happy to see the tidy desk. Yin Hao reported in detail on his progress toward certification and the interesting things he learned from Master Chen. His father, Yin Jianguo, urged him to be patient with repair techniques and to maintain his tools well. The call lasted about half an hour, and they cared about each other's health in a warm atmosphere.
location: Room 302, No. 8, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening study, entertainment, and review.
description: After the video call, he continued studying. Drawing on the day's appliance repair practice, he studied the electrical schematic diagrams of CNC machine tools in the textbook and figured out the control logic of several common sensors. When he got tired of studying, he arranged a game of Honor of Kings with his friends Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang in a WeChat group. The three cooperated well and won the ranked match, then chatted briefly about the next day's work arrangements. He started washing up at 21:00. While brushing his teeth, he went over in his mind the day's technical study, the results of the deep cleaning, and family communication. Then he briefly recorded the fan repair steps in his notebook and checked off that all learning tasks were done. Finally, he set the alarm for 6:30 the next day and placed his work clothes and meal card on the shoe cabinet, making sure everything was ready for work.
location: Room 302, No. 8, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: Got into bed at 9:40 and spent 15 minutes reading a column article on improving PLC skills on the phone, maintaining the daily learning habit. Then he turned off the phone and reviewed the day's fulfilling schedule in his mind: he had learned repair techniques, done a thorough cleaning, cooked for himself, and kept in touch with family and friends. He felt grounded and satisfied, and soon fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 8, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning preparation and morning jog
description: The alarm went off. Yin Hao quickly got up and did chest expansion exercises in the rental apartment. After changing into sportswear, he drank a few sips of warm water and did dynamic stretching in the living room (high knees, lunge stretches). Then he drove to Xiaokunshan Health Park, arriving around 7:05. He ran 5 kilometers in the park at a steady pace of 6 minutes per kilometer, and his right knee felt good. After the run, he carefully did post-run static stretching, relaxing his calves and quadriceps, then walked back to his car.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and Xiaokunshan Health Park (40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Highway)

name: Shower and breakfast
description: After returning to the residential community, Yin Hao went upstairs to take a shower and changed into clean pajamas. He took out the white porridge cooked last night from the fridge, heated it, fried two fried eggs, and had them as breakfast. While eating, he browsed the "CNC China" forum on his phone and read technical posts about the Siemens 828D system.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute and preparations for starting work
description: Yin Hao left on time at 8:00 and drove to Shanghai Jingong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. On the way, he connected his phone via Bluetooth and played the audio course "CNC Machining Center Programming and Operation" to learn the practical application of parametric macro programming. He arrived at the factory at 8:15, parked the car, and changed into work clothes and a safety helmet. At 8:20, he went to the production workshop office to find his master Sun Jianguo and the programmer Liu Zhiqiang, attended the brief meeting, received the process card for the day's K43 valve body, and listened to instructions about bore tolerance and fine-tuning the program.
location: Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning workshop work
description: Returned to my workstation at 8:30, powered on the machine, checked the coolant and lubricating oil, then clamped the K43 valve body blank. Strictly followed Liu Zhiqiang's new program for tool setting and first-piece trial cutting. Completed the first part at 9:30, and its dimensions passed inspection completely on the coordinate measuring machine. Team leader Wang Lei gave recognition during his inspection. Spent the whole morning focused on machining, with a 10-minute break for water in between.
location: Production workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cafeteria lunch and noon break
description: At 12:00 noon, Yin Hao went to the staff canteen with Master Sun and Wang Lei. Lunch included braised pork chop, garlic lettuce, and tomato egg soup. While eating, Wang Lei complained about last night's ranked games, and Master Sun occasionally advised the young people not to get too addicted. After finishing at 12:25, Yin Hao returned to the car alone, reclined the seat, put on an eye mask, and rested quietly for 20 minutes.
location: Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai: employee cafeteria and inside a car in the parking lot.

name: Afternoon workshop work
description: At 12:45 returned to the workshop and continued machining the K43 valve body, performing finishing and final inspection. Meticulously used a dial bore gauge and an outside micrometer to measure every critical dimension, removed burrs, and recorded the data. At 16:30 completed the day's production tasks and assisted Liu Zhiqiang in verifying the tool path of a new program. At 17:25 shut down the machine and filled out the equipment inspection checklist and work log.
location: Production workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute after work and supermarket shopping
description: Left work at 17:30 on time, changed into a down jacket, and drove out of the factory. On the way, I sent a WeChat voice message to my mom, telling her I wasn't working overtime, was going to buy groceries, and would video call later. Following the navigation on the new road, I arrived at Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket at 17:45. In the supermarket I picked ingredients including Shanghai bok choy, tomatoes, scallions, pork tenderloin, pork ribs, and silken tofu. The bill came to 52.3 yuan, paid via mobile.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Make dinner and check messages.
description: At 18:15 drove home and carried the groceries upstairs. First blanched the pork ribs and peeled the Chinese yam, then began simmering yam and rib soup while also cooking rice. While preparing Shanghai greens and shredded pork, received a WeChat message from colleague Ma Xiaofeng with supplementary notes about the Python script. Yin Hao quickly replied that he would study it later. At 18:45, while the rib soup was simmering on the stove, he started stir-frying shredded pork with Shanghai greens.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and watching Man vs. Wild
description: At 18:50 the food was served. Yin Hao ate pork rib soup, shredded pork with stir-fried Shanghai bok choy, and rice while playing an episode of Bear Grylls' Man vs. Wild on his tablet. After the meal, he cleared the table and washed the dishes and utensils.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Residential Area, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Added Lin Yue on WeChat and had their first chat.
description: At 19:10, his comrade-in-arms Zhang Jianguo sent Lin Yue's WeChat contact card. Yin Hao sent a friend request and was quickly added. Sitting on the living room sofa, he first sent a handshake emoji, and Lin Yue replied Hi. As planned, he asked whether she was busy with work and about the weather in Hangzhou. After she gave brief replies, the conversation stalled. Yin Hao then asked about her dinner. Lin Yue replied that she had just gotten back from overtime, had eaten some fruit, and was getting ready to rest. The atmosphere felt awkward, so Yin Hao had to end the conversation, and she replied with a goodnight emoji. He put down his phone, feeling frustrated and powerless, and sat blankly on the sofa. Then he got up and went to the kitchen to drink some cold boiled water to calm down.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Review certification exam materials and take a short break.
description: Yin Hao set aside his negative emotions, sat down at the desk, took out the textbook Senior CNC Machine Tool Operator Technician, and began studying Chapter 4, 'Machining Center Tools and Automatic Tool Changer System.' He marked key points with a highlighter, repeatedly studied the structure diagram of the robotic tool changer and drew simplified diagrams, completed the exercises after the chapter, and checked the answers with an accuracy rate of 82%. At 20:50 he closed the book, stretched his shoulders and neck, saw the code logic explanation Ma Xiaofeng had sent, replied that he understood, and arranged to discuss it over lunch in the cafeteria tomorrow, thanking him with milk tea.
location: Desk in the rented apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Voice chat and team games with childhood friend Zhang Wei
description: At 21:00, childhood friend Zhang Wei called on WeChat voice, venting about the trouble with a customer picking up a car today and the new game season. Yin Hao talked about work and mentioned the awkward conversation with Lin Yue. Zhang Wei advised him to be proactive and not too nervous. Then the two teamed up for ranked matches in Honor of Kings. Yin Hao played Dian Wei in the jungle, Zhang Wei played Hou Yi as the marksman. They coordinated well, and finally grabbed the Storm Dragon King, wiped out the opposing team, and won. Zhang Wei cheered excitedly, and Yin Hao's mood completely improved.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for tomorrow.
description: At 22:00 he quit the game. Yin Hao went to the bathroom to brush his teeth and wash his face, then applied facial cream. After coming out, he hung the work uniform for tomorrow on the back of a chair and placed his keys, wallet, and work badge on the shoe cabinet by the door. Then he sent a voice message to Ma Xiaofeng saying he had understood the nested loop logic in the script and would see him in the cafeteria tomorrow.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Residential Area, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Video call with parents and pre-bed preparations.
description: At 22:30, Yin Hao made a WeChat call to video chat with his parents. His mother was watching TV in the living room and asked about his diet and keeping warm; his father also asked about his work. Yin Hao casually mentioned that he had made new friends and told his parents not to worry. After the call ended at 23:00, he turned off the light and lay in bed, reviewing the day: work went smoothly, study made progress, and although the chat had not gone well, gaming and comfort from his childhood friend had improved his mood. He decided to proactively contact Lin Yue again tomorrow. Finally, he set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning and fell asleep at 23:10.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment at Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning 6 km run and stretching
description: In the early morning, with the sky just getting light and the temperature near 2°C, Yin Hao wore compression clothing and a windproof jacket and walked 10 minutes from home to Xiaokunshan Health Park. He ran a planned 6-kilometer tempo run, maintaining a pace of about 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer. The cold wind stimulated his nerves. While running, he thought about how to improve the conversation with Lin Yue from last night, but he still couldn't make sense of it. After the run, he stretched in the park's fitness area, focusing on relaxing his calves and iliotibial band.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, Songjiang District, Shanghai (40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Highway)

name: Shower, breakfast, and tidying up
description: After the run, Yin Hao walked home and took a hot shower to ward off the chill. He cooked oatmeal porridge and boiled eggs for breakfast. While eating, he checked his phone; there was no new message from Lin Yue, and his heart sank a little, but he quickly pulled himself together. Then he changed into clean work clothes, checked and brought his work badge, keys, phone, notebook, and pens.
location: No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Community).

name: Commute to work by car
description: Yin Hao drove from Xingang Community, turned from Xingang Road onto Songhui West Road and Huatianjing Road to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, the whole trip taking about 17 minutes. Along the way, he played audio from a CNC programming course via Bluetooth, trying to fill his thoughts with study. He arrived at the factory parking lot at 7:42 and walked to the workshop.
location: No. 360, Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory)

name: Pre-job preparation
description: After arriving at the workshop, Yin Hao changed into a gray antistatic work uniform and safety shoes in the locker room, walked to his machining center, checked the coolant level and air pressure gauge, and after confirming everything was normal, stood at the operation panel waiting for the morning meeting.
location: No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory workshop)

name: Morning meeting and task assignment.
description: In the team rest area, team leader Wang Lei briefed today's production tasks, focusing on machining a batch of high-precision valve body parts, emphasizing dimensional tolerance requirements and reminding everyone to pay attention to the spindle speed. Master Sun Jianguo walked over to Yin Hao and said in a low voice, "It's not a big job, but don't take it lightly." Yin Hao nodded in agreement and resolved to get himself in the right state.
location: No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (rest area of the workshop team at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Plant)

name: Morning workpiece machining (including a distraction episode)
description: The morning machining task began. Yin Hao clamped the workpiece, loaded the program, and watched the tool path. Around 10 o'clock, as he was about to enter the tool radius compensation value, the image of last night's conversation with Lin Yue ending abruptly flashed through his mind, and his fingers paused on the keyboard. Master Sun Jianguo noticed the distraction, immediately stopped the machine, and sternly reminded him: 'Xiao Yin! Machines don't run on emotions. A minute of distraction means scrapped parts in no time!' Yin Hao snapped back to focus, apologized, took a deep breath, rechecked the parameters, and started machining. After that he was highly focused, keeping his eyes on the cutting process, until the first part was successfully finished at 11:45.
location: 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (CNC machine workstation in the workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory)

name: First article submitted for inspection
description: Yin Hao wiped the finished first article with rust-preventive oil and sent it to the quality inspection station. While waiting, he stood by the window looking at the gray sky, thinking about how to adjust at noon. A few minutes later, the inspector reported, 'The dimensions are all within tolerance,' and he felt a bit more at ease.
location: No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Quality Inspection Area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory)

name: Cafeteria lunch and short technical meeting.
description: Yin Hao sat down in a corner of the cafeteria with his tray, eating braised pork belly and stir-fried greens. His colleague Ma Xiaofeng came over with his tray and asked whether the common variable call script he had posted last night had run successfully. The two quickly discussed several technical points. Yin Hao pointed out a small issue in the program logic, and Ma Xiaofeng suggested doing remote debugging together in the evening. Yin Hao agreed, wanting to use technical issues to dilute his gloom.
location: 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory Canteen)

name: Midday rest in the car
description: After the meal, Yin Hao did not go back to his workstation. Instead, he went to his car in the parking lot, laid the seat back, covered his face with his jacket, and forced himself to rest with his eyes closed. The residual warmth of the engine and the silence outside the car briefly let him escape his inner turmoil, and he took a 20-minute nap.
location: No. 360, Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (inside a car in the parking lot of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory).

name: Steady work in the afternoon.
description: After the lunch break, his mental state improved significantly. Yin Hao focused fully on machining the subsequent valve bodies, strictly following the process card at every step, and repeatedly measuring key dimensions with calipers and micrometers. The afternoon pace was steady, and he caught up on the progress he had fallen behind on in the morning due to distraction. At 17:25, he turned off the machine tool power, cleaned up his workstation, and filled out the day's production report.
location: 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (CNC machine workstation in the workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory)

name: Shopping after work
description: After work, Yin Hao drove away from the factory, turned from Huatianjing Road onto Xingang Road, and stopped by Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket along the way. He bought Shanghai bok choy, a tomato, three eggs, and a bundle of dried noodles, planning to simply cook a bowl of noodles for dinner. At the checkout, the braised duck leg in the deli counter looked tempting, but after hesitating, he didn't buy it.
location: Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket)

name: Dinner
description: Back at his home in Xingang Community, Yin Hao quickly washed the vegetables, cut the tomatoes, and beat the eggs. He boiled water for noodles, and in another pan stir-fried the tomatoes and eggs. Finally, he scooped the noodles into a bowl and topped them with the stir-fried mixture. He sat at the dining table with the steaming noodles, eating while scrolling through his phone. He saw that Lin Yue had updated her Moments with a costume drama screenshot captioned 'So addictive.' His heart stirred, but he didn't reply right away.
location: No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (kitchen and dining table at home, Xingang Community)

name: Rest and preparation
description: After finishing the noodles, Yin Hao washed the bowls and chopsticks. He sent Ma Xiaofeng a message on his phone: 'I'm home. Shall we get online at eight?' The other party quickly replied OK. To change the scenery, he moved his laptop from the bedroom to the coffee table in the living room, plugged it in, connected the mouse, and prepared for the evening's remote debugging.
location: 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (living room at home in Xingang Community)

name: Certification exam and technical seminar (online)
description: Yin Hao turned on his computer, launched the remote desktop software, shared his screen with Ma Xiaofeng, and began debugging the macro program script. He pointed out that there might be a logical conflict in the variable assignment step. Ma Xiaofeng investigated the code on his side while Yin Hao verified it on the simulation software. After more than an hour of effort, they successfully fixed two bugs and optimized a piece of loop logic. Afterward, Yin Hao gained a deeper understanding of one of the subroutines and felt fulfilled.
location: 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (living room at home in Xingang Community)

name: Try chatting with Lin Yue again (awkward silence)
description: The sense of accomplishment from wrestling with a difficult technical problem gave Yin Hao a bit of courage. He picked up his phone and sent Lin Yue a message: "Good evening, busy at work today?" She quickly replied, "Not really." Yin Hao asked about her hobbies, and she just said she watched some costume dramas. Yin Hao mustered his courage and recommended a Shanghainese restaurant, but the chat fell silent for nearly twenty minutes. He felt frustration rising and silently put down his phone.
location: 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (living room at home in Xingang Community)

name: Emotional calming and diary review.
description: Yin Hao leaned on the sofa, staring at the ceiling chandelier, feeling suffocated. He opened the music app on his phone, played a soothing piano piece, turned down the volume, closed his eyes, and let his emotions settle. A few minutes later, he wrote in his diary app: 'The conversation with Lin Yue died again; I can't find a common topic. Maybe I really am not good at chatting. Tonight Ma Xiaofeng and I got the script working — that was the only highlight of the day. I need to think about how to improve myself.' After writing, he felt some of the tightness in his chest ease.
location: 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (living room at home in Xingang Community)

name: Theory study and simulation for the certificate exam.
description: Yin Hao forced his attention back to studying and opened Chapter 4 of the textbook Advanced CNC Machine Tool Operator Technician, the section on macro program application. Combined with the discussion with Ma Xiaofeng this evening, he quickly finished the remaining chapters. Then he opened the CNC simulation software, called up the optimized macro program case, ran the simulation from beginning to end, observed the tool path, and verified the parameter settings. Near 10:30, he completed the scheduled learning task.
location: At the desk at home in Xingang Residential Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up, replying to messages, and getting ready for bed
description: Yin Hao got up and went to the bathroom to wash up, using hot water to wash his face in an attempt to wash away the fatigue. Back in the bedroom, he saw a WeChat message from his mother, Wang Xiuying: “Son, how was your day? Did you eat on time?” His heart warmed, and he replied simply: “Mom, I'm fine, I ate, and I'm about to go to sleep. You should rest early too.” Then he set the alarm for 6 a.m. the next morning and checked the items he needed to bring to work. At exactly 11 o'clock, he turned off the desk lamp and lay down in the darkness, hoping tomorrow would be a better day.
location: No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (bathroom and bedroom at home in Xingang Community)

name: Morning run, breakfast, and morning study
description: The 6:00 alarm went off. Yin Hao silenced the phone, thought about the awkward conversation with Lin Yue last night, took a deep breath, and decided to go out for exercise. He drove to Xiaokunshan Health Park and started a 5 km morning run at 6:20, finishing in 28:48, with a pace of 5:45 per km, feeling good. After the run, he did some light stretching in the park's exercise area. At 7:00, he drove home, stopping on the way at Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket to buy hot soy milk and two steamed buns, spending 5.5 yuan in total. He arrived home at 7:10, quickly showered and changed into work clothes, and while having breakfast he watched two course videos on a learning app about the application of macro programs in surface machining, to warm up for the evening's systematic study.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai; Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road; Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road

name: Commuting to work
description: At 7:10, Yin Hao checked his phone, wallet, and work badge, grabbed his car keys, and left. He drove to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory and tuned the car radio to a local music station. He arrived at the factory parking lot around 7:30, half an hour earlier than usual, so he sat in the car for a while, looked at the morning light over the factory area, collected himself, then got out, swiped his card, and entered the factory.
location: During the drive from Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to No. 360 Huatianjing Highway

name: Morning workshop work
description: Arrived at 7:40, changed into safety shoes and work cap. At 8:00, attended the team morning meeting on time; team leader Wang Lei assigned tasks: continue finishing the K43 valve body and start a new batch of blanks. Yin Hao operated strictly according to the process card—loading material, aligning tools, debugging the program—and was fully focused at every step. When machining the first piece, he checked the parameters three times before pressing the start button. At 10:20, the first piece was completed; after inspection, quality inspector Xiao Zhou confirmed all dimensional tolerances were acceptable. He breathed a slight sigh of relief, returned to his post, and continued working. The morning passed safely, and he completed 9 finished pieces.
location: Production workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and lunch break
description: At 11:40 the cafeteria began serving lunch, offering braised chicken pieces, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and winter melon soup. Yin Hao took his tray and sat with Master Sun Jianguo and squad leader Wang Lei. Programmer Ma Xiaofeng also came over to complain about an error in the post-processing program, and Wang Lei joked that Yin Hao should take care of it. The four of them ate and chatted until 12:20. After the meal, Yin Hao did not return to the workshop. He smoked a cigarette in a corner of the factory area, then went back to his car, adjusted the seat back and down, set an alarm for 13:00, and closed his eyes to rest for 20 minutes.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory canteen and parking lot, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon workshop work and wrap-up.
description: In the afternoon, he continued machining the K43 valve body. At around 14:30, a problem occurred with the surface finish of the machined part. Yin Hao consulted his master, Sun Jianguo. After inspection, they found that the cutting insert was worn, and Master Sun suggested replacing it with a new one and making slight adjustments to the spindle speed. After Yin Hao did this, the problem was solved. At 17:00, he completed the machining, self-inspection, and record-keeping of all 12 products for the day, cleaned up his workstation, and turned off the machine power.
location: Production workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After work, went shopping and then returned home.
description: After work, Yin Hao drove out of the factory. Remembering the fridge was empty, he stopped by Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket on the way. He pushed a cart and picked out tomatoes, Shanghai greens, eggs, dried noodles, and a 1.5L bottle of Nongfu Spring water. At checkout, he added a pack of Ningbo-style glutinous rice balls, spending 32.7 yuan in total. After paying, he drove 1 minute back to Xingang Community.
location: No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (factory); Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road; Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road

name: Dinner preparation and dining.
description: After getting home, Yin Hao changed into loose loungewear and quickly cut tomatoes and washed greens in the kitchen. At 18:25, a steaming bowl of tomato and egg noodles was ready. He carried it to the computer desk in the bedroom, opened a video platform, and ate dinner while listening to an outdoor fishing blogger's vlog. After eating, he washed the pots and dishes and tidied the kitchen.
location: Rented room at No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Chatting online with Lin Yue.
description: After tidying up, Yin Hao sat on the bed and decided to try once more to communicate with Lin Yue. He forwarded an article from a Shanghai food WeChat public account on WeChat with a note: "This Shanghai-style braised pork looks good; want to give it a try next time?" Half an hour later, Lin Yue replied, "Looks all right." Yin Hao followed up about weekend plans, and the other side only answered, "Working overtime." He had no choice but to reply, "Thanks for your hard work," and there was no further communication. Putting down his phone, Yin Hao once again felt his lack of social skills.
location: Bedroom of the rented apartment at No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Studied the certification exam textbook
description: After taking a deep breath, Yin Hao stopped dwelling on the chat, sat down at the desk, took out the textbook Advanced CNC Machine Tool Operator Technician, a notebook, and a pen, and began studying Chapter 5, 'Multi-Axis Machining Center Programming and Operation', as planned. He carefully highlighted key points, worked out the macro program calculation paths on paper, and used a calculator to verify the coordinate data several times.
