location: Bedroom of the rented apartment at No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Set up regular fund investment.
description: To distract himself and put his savings plan into practice, Yin Hao opened the fund section in Alipay and found the CSI 300 ETF feeder fund he had been following. After browsing the details and confirming that the investment strategy was sound, he set up a monthly automatic investment plan of 500 yuan deducted on the 15th and linked his salary card. After confirmation, the page showed it had been enabled successfully. He took a screenshot to save it and felt a little more grounded.
location: Bedroom of the rented apartment at No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening free time and preparation for tomorrow
description: After completing the scheduled investment, Yin Hao spent some time browsing technical posts and news about the machinery industry on his phone. At 21:15, he got up and went to the bathroom to wash up. While brushing his teeth, he made an encouraging expression at himself in the mirror. After washing up, he neatly placed the work clothes and sports gear for the next day on the chair by the bed, and checked his phone charger and commuter bag, confirming that his wallet and work badge were all there.
location: Rented room at No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: The game received criticism and was uninstalled.
description: At 21:45, Yin Hao tried to relieve his emotions through Honor of Kings and chose the jungle position he was good at. However, because he was upset, he kept making mistakes, and the randomly matched teammate scolded him in voice chat, "Do you know how to jungle? If you can't play, don't ruin the game." This made him doubt himself even more. Even though he voted to surrender, the match still ended in defeat. After going offline, in a fit of anger he long-pressed the game icon and chose to uninstall the app, deciding to stay away from the virtual world for a while and focus on reality.
location: Bedroom of the rented apartment at No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Diary reflection
description: After uninstalling the game, Yin Hao sat down at the desk, took out his diary and pen, and carefully wrote down today's work situation, study progress, and the content of his chat with Lin Yue. In the reflections section, he wrote: 'Socializing has always been my weak spot, and I messed up again today. Maybe I should start with what I'm good at, such as earning certifications and saving money. Uninstalling the game is a good thing after all. The auto-investment plan is set; I hope I can stick with it. Summary: there were setbacks today, but also new attempts. Take it slow — that's right.'
location: Bedroom of the rented apartment at No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparations and lights out
description: After finishing his diary, Yin Hao turned off the desk lamp and lay down on the bed. He checked that the alarm on his phone was set to 6:30, then put the phone into Do Not Disturb mode and placed it farther away to charge. Thinking about tomorrow's plan, he felt a bit calmer than last night, and after turning off the light, he quickly fell asleep.
location: Bedroom of the rented apartment at No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Get up, wash up, and have breakfast
description: The alarm went off, and Yin Hao turned over and got out of bed. Outside the window, the sky was gloomy with a fine drizzle. After washing up quickly, he reheated the leftover rice porridge from last night and ate breakfast with pickled vegetables and a boiled egg. Considering that his shoulder and neck were sore from yesterday, he did a few simple stretches and gave up his morning run because the roads were slippery.
location: Rental apartment at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Walking to work and stopping at the supermarket on the way
description: Putting on a dark coat and holding an umbrella, Yin Hao went out. He walked along Guangfulin Road for about 8 minutes, turned into the Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket on the roadside, bought a bottle of Nongfu Spring and a pack of Qingfeng tissues, spending 4.5 yuan, and prepared to use them during the afternoon overtime. Then he continued walking for about 15 minutes to reach the factory.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China, then walked to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road.

name: Arrived at work to attend an emergency order meeting.
description: Yin Hao clocked in at the workshop early, changed into safety shoes, and put on goggles. His mentor Sun Jianguo was already studying the drawings. Team leader Wang Lei gathered everyone in the workshop office for a short meeting, announcing an urgent order for a batch of 24 precision shaft parts, with an accuracy requirement of 0.005 mm, surface roughness Ra0.4, and delivery by the afternoon of the day after tomorrow. The four immediately discussed the machining plan. Yin Hao proposed using a G71 rough turning cycle with a 0.3 mm allowance followed by G70 finishing, which was approved by his mentor. They finally decided to use ceramic inserts and adjust the cutting parameters.
location: Workshop office, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: Morning machine tool debugging and rough machining production
description: After the meeting, Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang returned to the machine tool, wrote and debugged the CNC program, and carefully checked the tool compensation parameters. At 9 o'clock they began the first-piece trial cut. He was fully focused, pausing the machine after every few operations to measure the outer diameter and inner bore dimensions with a micrometer and a bore gauge, and fine-tuning the tool compensation. By 11:30, they had successfully completed rough machining and part of the finish machining for 8 parts.
location: Production workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Cafeteria lunch and short rest
description: Yin Hao went to the cafeteria with his mentor Sun Jianguo and Liu Zhiqiang. Lunch was braised pork chop, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and seaweed egg drop soup. They chatted briefly while eating. After the meal, Yin Hao leaned back in his chair and rested with his eyes closed for 15 minutes, mentally planning the afternoon's processing steps.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory company cafeteria, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: Afternoon focus: precision machining and quality inspection.
description: In the afternoon, processing continued. Yin Hao operated the machine tool, with Liu Zhiqiang assisting. After finishing each part, he first used an air gun to blow off the iron chips, then checked it with a micrometer and a roughness tester. When two workpieces were sized toward the upper limit, he calmly adjusted the tool offset by -0.01 mm, successfully stabilizing the dimensions in the center of the tolerance zone. The quality inspector's three spot checks all passed. By 17:30, a total of 18 parts had been finished, and the most critical stage was smoothly passed.
location: Production workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Worked overtime to finish the remaining parts, performed final inspection, and put them into storage.
description: After the shuttle bus left, only the emergency order team remained in the workshop. The three of them simply ate the boxed meals Wang Lei had helped bring back and continued working. The last six pieces needed batch tapping and deburring, and Yin Hao operated steadily. At 18:30 the last batch was finished, and the three sent all parts to the quality inspection room for final inspection. At 19:00, all 24 precision shaft parts passed inspection; they issued the warehouse entry form and smoothly moved them into the finished goods warehouse.
location: Production workshop and quality inspection room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Clean up the workstation and change clothes to prepare for the dinner gathering.
description: After the handover, the four returned to their workstations to clean the machine tools, sweep up metal shavings, and put tools back in place. Wang Lei suggested going near the university town to have a celebratory meal. Yin Hao agreed while wiping off sweat, and everyone went to the locker room to change into clean casual clothes and take their umbrellas.
location: Changing room and workshop at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Drive to the dinner venue
description: Yin Hao drove, Wang Lei sat in the passenger seat and gave directions, while Sun Jianguo and Liu Zhiqiang sat in the back. The drive took about 12 minutes, along Huatianjing Road, turning onto Guangfulin Road, and then entering Wenhui Road. It was drizzling, and condensation formed on the car windows.
location: Drive from 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China, to Bashi Sichuan Cuisine, No. 48, Lane 1000, Wenhui Road.

name: Team dinner after working overtime.
description: The four arrived at Bashi Sichuan Restaurant and ordered boiled fish, twice-cooked pork, hot and sour shredded potatoes, cold cucumber salad, and a large bowl of egg drop soup. Wang Lei ordered several bottles of ice-cold beer. After a few drinks, the atmosphere became lively. Master Sun Jianguo asked Yin Hao about his progress in preparing for the certification exam. Yin Hao honestly admitted that he was still stuck on the macro program logic in Chapter 5. The master encouraged him to stay patient, drawing on his own experience. Wang Lei mentioned teaming up to play Honor of Kings over the weekend, but Yin Hao just smiled and didn't respond. Liu Zhiqiang joked about a programming blooper, making everyone laugh. Yin Hao felt the warmth of the team and gained a clearer sense of direction for the future. The dinner ended at 21:30.
location: Bashi Sichuan Cuisine, No. 48, Lane 1000, Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Gave a colleague a ride to the subway station on the way.
description: Yin Hao drove and, since Liu Zhiqiang lived farther away, gave him a ride along the way to Songjiang University Town Station on Metro Line 9. The two chatted briefly in the car, remarking on the tension of the day and the relief of smoothly completing the order. After dropping Liu Zhiqiang off at the station entrance, Yin Hao drove back alone.
location: Drove from Lane 1000, Wenhui Road to the entrance of Songjiang University Town Station on Metro Line 9.

name: Drove home.
description: Turn from Wenhui Road onto Guangfulin Road; the drive takes about 10 minutes. After arriving home, Yin Hao parked the car downstairs from his rental apartment.
location: Downstairs of the rental apartment at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Took a relaxing shower and was rejected when first asking Lin Yue out
description: After getting home, Yin Hao took a hot shower to wash away the fatigue and grime, changed into pajamas, and lay down on the bed. After hesitating for a long time, he picked up his phone, opened Lin Yue's WeChat chat, and composed a message: 'Are you free this weekend? I know there's a well-reviewed Shanghainese restaurant near the university town. If you're free, we could go try it together.' After editing and deleting several times, he mustered up the courage to send it. His heart racing, he waited. About five minutes later, Lin Yue replied: 'I'm pretty busy this week. Let's talk about it later.' Yin Hao's expectation suddenly cooled, and he barely managed to reply, 'No problem, get busy then,' and disappointedly tossed his phone aside.
location: Bedroom in a rental apartment, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Feeling low, played mobile games and lost several in a row
description: A wave of frustration from being gently turned down washed over Yin Hao. Feeling restless and upset, he reinstalled Honor of Kings, which he had uninstalled the previous night, and tried to play a couple of rounds to vent. But with his mind unsettled, his moves were full of mistakes, and he lost three games in a row. His teammates even called him a "thrower." Furious, he almost threw his phone, quit the game directly, and opened his music playlist to loop some soothing old songs.
location: On the bed in the rental apartment at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: Severe insomnia, tossing and turning, unable to sleep.
description: Even though music was playing, his mind was in a mess: the day's fatigue, the disappointment of rejection, the pressure of technical learning, and confusion about the future all intertwined, leaving Yin Hao tossing and turning, unable to fall asleep. He lay staring at the ceiling, feeling the night was exceptionally long. It was not until around 1 a.m., when his eyelids could no longer stay open, that he fell asleep in a daze.
location: On the bed in the bedroom of the rental home at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Morning run icebreaker and WeChat interaction with Lin Yue.
description: After the alarm went off in the morning, despite feeling a bit tired, Yin Hao still changed into his workout gear and walked about 10 minutes to Xiaokunshan Health Park, which was close to home, for a 5 km morning run. Around 3 km into the run, he took photos of the pines and cypresses in the morning mist in the park and the rice cooker he had fixed yesterday, and sent them via WeChat to his new friend Lin Yue, with a message sharing his small achievements in running and repairing. While stretching, he received a reply from Lin Yue with photos of her morning run by West Lake. The two chatted briefly about outdoor sports and handicrafts. The atmosphere was much more natural than before, and their relationship had warmed up.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home, wash up, and have breakfast
description: After finishing the run, I walked home and took a hot shower to relieve fatigue. Took out the steamed buns and soy milk bought yesterday from the fridge, heated them in the microwave, and quickly finished breakfast with some pickled vegetables. Checked the commuter bag, confirmed the work badge, keys, and phone were all there, and got ready to leave for work.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to work by car
description: Carrying his thermos, he went downstairs, drove from Guangfulin Road to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, listened to the radio on the way, and mentally reviewed the part drawings and key dimensions to be processed that day. About 17 minutes later, he arrived at the factory parking lot.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Rushing to produce urgent valve body parts
description: After changing into work clothes, checked the overtime plan with master worker Sun Jianguo and started machining a batch of urgent valve body parts. Strictly followed the process of loading material, calling up the program, trial-cutting the first piece, repeatedly measuring the bore diameter and surface roughness, and fine-tuning the tool offset. Midway, I solved a chip removal problem. During this time, shift leader Wang Lei notified us that equipment maintenance would take place in the afternoon and reminded us to be prepared.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch at the cafeteria with colleagues
description: He had lunch at the factory canteen; that day it served braised pork chop, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and garlic stir-fried greens. He sat at the same table as Master Sun Jianguo and colleague Liu Zhiqiang. Liu Zhiqiang mentioned a new script that could automatically generate toolpath macro programs, which caught Yin Hao's interest, and the two agreed to study it together after work.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Resting in the car during lunch break and listening to music
description: After eating, he didn't go to the break room. He went straight to his car, reclined the seat, lowered the volume, played soothing piano music, and rested with his eyes closed for about 20 minutes to conserve energy for the afternoon work and overtime.
location: Parking lot, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon machining and assisting with equipment maintenance
description: In the afternoon, he continued processing the remaining parts. Around 3 p.m., the equipment maintenance technician came as scheduled to service the machine tool, replacing the coolant filter and checking the leadscrew clearance. Yin Hao cooperated by shutting down the machine and cutting off power, while learning from the technician. After the maintenance, he deburred the parts processed in the morning and arranged them neatly. Today's progress was faster than expected, and he estimated that overtime hours could be reduced.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Quick meal during overtime and continuing to machine parts
description: Since he planned to work overtime until 8 p.m., he first went to the convenience store at the factory gate and bought a chicken rice ball and a bottle of energy drink, eating quickly to replenish his energy. Then he returned to the workshop and continued working with Master Sun on the critical thread turning and inspection of the last few parts. At about 20:00 all parts were finished and passed sampling inspection; the two cleaned the machine tools and work area together, then turned off the lights and left.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After work, shop for weekend fishing and daily groceries.
description: On the way home by car, he went to the Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket and bought food needed for tomorrow's fishing trip to Dianshan Lake (mineral water, sliced bread, ham sausages), as well as ingredients for cooking tonight and tomorrow morning (soft tofu, Shanghai bok choy, eggs, dried noodles, pickled mustard), spending 43.6 yuan in total.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home, rest up, and research commercial insurance
description: Drove home from the supermarket, put the groceries into the fridge by category, then checked the fishing gear bag, confirmed the fishing line, hooks, and everything else were in order, and placed it by the door. After showering and changing into pajamas, he sat down at the desk, opened Ant Insurance on his phone, carefully compared two million-yuan medical insurance plans and one comprehensive accident insurance plan, read the health declaration and exclusions carefully, saved screenshots of the key information, and planned to buy accident insurance before going out the next day for extra protection.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with family and studying CNC textbooks.
description: Called his mother Wang Xiuying via WeChat video call, answered her questions about meals and staying warm or cool, told her about the weekend plan to go fishing to reassure her, and chatted for more than ten minutes. After hanging up, he took out the textbook Advanced CNC Machine Tool Operation Technician, studied the chapter 'Macro Programs and Variable Applications', and simulated the program logic in his mind. Since he had to get up early to go fishing the next day, he closed the book after forty minutes.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and falling asleep
description: He set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning and checked the fishing gear bag and keys again. Lying in bed recalling his brief exchange with Lin Yue that day, his mindset gradually became more laid-back. After turning off the light, he listened to the occasional sound of cars outside the window and fell asleep looking forward to tomorrow's fishing.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run, breakfast, and a deep conversation
description: The 6:00 alarm went off, and Yin Hao drove to Xiaokunshan Health Park. After stretching, he started a 5 km morning run at a pace of 5 min 30 sec per km. On the way, he happened to meet his running buddy Chen Jie, and they chatted about training plans while running. After the run, he stretched on a bench and took a photo of the running path in the morning light. At 7:00 he drove home. After showering, he warmed up milk and ate whole wheat bread and boiled eggs. While eating, he sent the morning run photo to Lin Yue, and she replied with a photo of her own morning run by West Lake. The two chatted about morning running routes and then about their favorite breakfasts. Yin Hao sent a photo of frozen xiaolongbao and soy milk, and Lin Yue responded with a photo of pian er chuan, a Hangzhou specialty breakfast. The atmosphere was relaxed and natural, and the exchange lasted until just after 8 o'clock.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China; and the rental house in Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road.

name: Online insurance purchase and document organization
description: After breakfast, Yin Hao opened the Ant Insurance app, carefully reviewed the terms of the million-yuan medical insurance and accident insurance he had studied the night before, confirmed the coverage and deductible, filled in his personal information, completed the health declaration, and paid the 650-yuan annual fee. He then saved a screenshot of the electronic policy to his phone gallery, backed it up to the “Important Documents” folder on Baidu Netdisk, and finally set a renewal reminder for next year in his phone calendar.
location: Rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Studying and organizing fishing gear
description: Yin Hao studied the textbook "Advanced CNC Machine Tool Operation Technician" at the living room desk, focusing on the chapter "Application of Macro Programs in Complex Surface Machining," researched turning-milling composite programming cases, and supplemented the notes he had organized yesterday. After about 45 minutes of study, he got up and went to the balcony to check the fishing gear, confirmed that the rod sections and guide rings of the 2.7-meter and 3.6-meter hand rods were intact, packed red worms and strong fishy bait into small boxes, and organized spare fishing line, floats, hooks, and other accessories, preparing for the afternoon fishing.
location: Rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At noon, Yin Hao made himself a steaming bowl of tomato egg noodles with tomatoes and eggs. While the noodles were cooking, he replied to Lin Yue's photos of shopping in Hangzhou. After eating and washing the dishes, he set an alarm for 13:15 and lay on the bed for a half-hour nap to recharge for the afternoon's work and fishing.
location: Rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Delivered parts at the factory and received praise
description: Yin Hao drove to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. Together with his master Sun Jianguo, he used a trailer to move the 200 precision shaft parts that had been completed overtime yesterday to the quality inspection area, and all of them passed inspection. The two then sent the parts to the warehouse for storage. When shift leader Wang Lei saw them at the warehouse, he praised the master and apprentice on the spot for completing the urgent order one day ahead of schedule and said the workshop would record a merit. Yin Hao felt a strong sense of achievement.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Winter fishing at Dianshan Lake
description: Yin Hao drove to his old fishing spot at Dianshan Lake in Qingpu to meet his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang. He set up his tackle box in a sheltered cove, used strongly fishy bait mixed with bloodworms to chum the spot, and patiently waited for bites. In winter the fish bite lightly; the two exchanged techniques on winter float selection and jigging. Brother Wu shared the tip of 'slowly lifting the rod with small movements,' and Yin Hao noted it down in his phone memo. When he packed up at 17:30, he had caught four palm-sized crucian carp and one small carp. After taking photos, he released the small carp and took the four crucian carp home.
location: Fishing spot on the shore of Dianshan Lake, Jinze Town, Qingpu District, Shanghai, China

name: Shopping and dinner preparation.
description: Yin Hao packed up his fishing gear, said goodbye to Wu Ge, and drove back to Songjiang. On the way, he bought two pork ribs, a section of lotus root, a piece of ginger, and a bunch of spring onions at the Xingang Xincun fresh food supermarket. After getting home, he kept the crucian carp in a basin of water, blanched the ribs, cut the lotus root into chunks, put them all into the rice cooker and simmered them slowly using the soup mode, while tidying up the room.
location: Xingang New Village fresh food supermarket at Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China; and the rental house in Xingang Community at No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road.

name: Dinner and video chat with family
description: After the soup was ready, Yin Hao ladled out a bowl and also stir-fried Shanghai bok choy. While eating dinner, he made a WeChat video call to his mother Wang Xiuying, showed her the photos of the catch, and reported that the insurance had been bought and work was going smoothly. His mother told him to keep warm and avoid catching a cold, and said the cured meat and clams from home she had sent should arrive tomorrow. Yin Hao asked about his father's health and learned that everything was fine. The call lasted about 20 minutes in a warm atmosphere.
location: Rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Free time.
description: After the video ended, Yin Hao leaned back on the sofa and scrolled on his phone. He watched a few Bilibili CNC machining technology videos, visited a fishing forum to learn tips on new fishing spots, and then gave the jacket and running shoes he had worn today a simple scrub.
location: Rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Online entertainment and rest
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, Yin Hao logged in to Honor of Kings at 21:00 and queued for ranked matches with his teammates Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng. Using the jungler hero Kai, he was in excellent form, earning MVP for three consecutive matches, with voice chat filled with triumphant cheers and banter. He played until 23:00, then suggested logging off. After saying goodbye to his teammates, he washed his face, set the alarm for 8:00 the next day, checked the doors and windows, and noted down tomorrow's plan in his phone memo. At 23:30, he turned off the lights and went to sleep on time, ending a fulfilling day.
location: Rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The alarm went off at 6:30. After getting up, I did a simple stretch on the bed, drank a large glass of warm water, and changed into quick-dry running clothes, shorts, and running shoes. After using the bathroom, I put on my sports armband and earphones, took my house keys, and got ready to leave.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the park and completed the long-distance run training.
description: Drove to Guangfulin Country Park. After arriving, met up with running partner Chen Jie and did a full 10-minute warm-up together. Then we started a 14 km run along the lakeside greenway at an average pace of about 6:08 per kilometer. For the first 10 km we chatted while running. At the 11th kilometer, the back of my thigh felt sore and swollen, so I slowed down a bit to adjust. On the final kilometer we encouraged each other and sprinted to the finish. During the run, we enjoyed the morning-mist view of the underwater structures at the Guangfulin Ruins.
location: Guangfulin Country Park, 3488 Chenta Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Post-exercise relaxation and recovery, and breakfast
description: After returning home, I immediately applied the pre-frozen ice packs to my knees and ankles, lay still for 15 minutes, then used a foam roller to massage the front and back of my thighs and calves. After relaxing, I took a hot shower, fried a sunny-side-up egg for myself, toasted whole wheat bread, and heated milk. While eating breakfast, I saw the logistics message from my mom and replied that I would pick up the package in the afternoon.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Household tidying and insurance document filing.
description: Collected the clothes washed yesterday, folded them, and put them back in the wardrobe. Then I sat at the desk, opened my laptop, logged into Baidu Netdisk, created folders for the million-yuan medical insurance and accident insurance taken out on January 11, and uploaded the electronic policies and payment screenshots as backup.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Walking to lunch

location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

When the water came to a boil, he cut a few slices and tasted them; the familiar hometown aroma filled the air. He took a close-up photo and sent it to the Songjiang Three Brothers group chat. Lao Gao and Xiao Ma both replied, and they agreed to find time to get together next week.

While reading, he drew diagrams and took notes in his notebook. When he came across something he did not understand, he took a photo of the page with his phone and planned to ask Master Sun the next day.

His understanding of how to establish the coordinate system of a CNC machine tool became clearer.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

I edited the photos taken while running and posted a Moments post: “Sunday LSD check-in complete, new books in place, exam prep mode officially on! Life is blazing, the future is promising!”

He chatted with Old Gao and Xiao Ma about working hard to get certificates and buy a house, then the three of them played a game of Honor of Kings. He picked his favorite jungler hero Kai and smoothly destroyed the enemy's crystal in just 15 minutes.

name: Lights out, bedtime
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Got up early and drove to the hospital.
description: The phone alarm rang at 6:00 sharp. Today was cloudy, and it was also the Monday annual physical examination day. You quickly got up, folded the quilt, took the pre-prepared ID card and physical examination form, and went out on an empty stomach. Then you drove along Xingang Road, Guangfulin Road, and Jiasong South Road to Songjiang District Central Hospital. The morning traffic was good, taking about 16 minutes, and you arrived at the hospital parking lot before 6:45.
location: Songjiang District Central Hospital, 748 Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Completed the annual health checkup.
description: The health check center began receiving people at 7 a.m. sharp. You were near the front of the line and quickly checked in. Under the nurse's guidance, you efficiently completed blood draw (complete blood count, liver and kidney function), abdominal ultrasound, electrocardiogram, height and weight measurement (178 cm / 70.8 kg), and routine medical and surgical examinations. The process went smoothly, and by about 8:30 a.m. almost all items were finished.
location: Second Floor, Physical Examination Center, Songjiang District Central Hospital, No. 748 Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Received the preliminary physical examination results and left the hospital.
description: At exactly 9 o'clock, the physical examination doctor interpreted the results of the ultrasound, electrocardiogram, and other tests, told him that all major indicators were normal, and advised maintaining his current routine and exercise habits while controlling dietary fat intake. After carefully noting this down, he left the hospital reassured.
location: Songjiang District Central Hospital, 748 Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to work after breakfast
description: Having not eaten since early morning, you drove away from the hospital, quickly bought a cup of hot soy milk, a tea egg, and a meat bun at the breakfast stall at the hospital gate, and ate them all. Then you drove along Jiasong South Road and Huatianjing Road for about 20 minutes, arriving at the company before 9:50.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Report for duty and rough-machine parts in the morning.
description: Parked the car, swiped the card to enter the factory area, changed into blue work clothes in the locker room, and put the medical examination form into the cabinet. Walked to the workshop, greeted Master Sun Jianguo and team leader Wang Lei, took the K43 valve body part drawing and process card handed over by Wang Lei, quickly confirmed the machining parameters and tool selection, then started the CNC machine tool for rough machining. Focused on work in the morning and successfully completed the rough machining task for 3 parts.
location: Processing Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bringing a healthy homemade lunch and chatting with colleagues
description: At noon in the staff break room, you took out your own lettuce and chicken breast salad with multigrain rice, drizzled with homemade vinaigrette. Colleague Wang Lei came over and teased you. You told him your physical exam results were good and that you had decided to adjust your diet to less oil and salt. He said enviously that he wanted to follow suit, but today he still ate his own braised pork rice bowl.
location: Break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Midday rest in the car
description: After lunch, you went to the company parking lot, reclined the driver's seat, set an alarm for 13:10, and rested with your eyes closed in the quiet car on the cloudy day, storing up energy for the afternoon's work.
location: Parking lot, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon finish machining and end-of-shift cleanup
description: After the alarm went off, he returned to the workshop, put on protective gloves, and began the afternoon finishing, deburring, and self-inspection processes. He operated the control panel to adjust the spindle speed and feed rate, and from time to time measured dimensions with a vernier caliper and a micrometer. When he noticed slight dimensional deviations, he asked Master Sun Jianguo, who was passing by, for advice, and under his guidance slightly adjusted the tool compensation values to solve the problem. By 17:30 he had completed all of the day's machining tasks, producing 8 qualified finished parts. He then shut down the machine tools, cleared away the metal chips, put away his tools, and filled in the production records.
location: Processing Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Went shopping after work and returned home.

location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing and enjoying dinner

Once the meal was on the table, he opened Bilibili to watch a practical video on five-axis machining centers, enjoying his after-work relaxation while eating.

name: Video call with mother.

He smiled and told her everything was normal and healthy, and mentioned that he had just stir-fried garlic sprouts with the cured meat she sent, and it tasted especially good. His mother was very happy to hear that and told him not to be too frugal while living alone. They chatted for more than twenty minutes in a warm atmosphere.
location: Room 501, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

location: Room 501, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

description: Woken by the alarm clock, feeling a bit groggy because he had only fallen asleep after 2 a.m. the night before. He lingered in bed for two minutes, then forced himself to sit up. Picking up his phone, he saw the lease renewal contract sent last night by his landlady Li Xiuying. The rent had increased by 200 yuan. Helpless, he carefully read the terms, signed and scanned it with WPS on his phone, sent it back via WeChat, and added a message asking her to confirm receipt.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 1 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (bedroom)

name: Wash up and prepare lunch
description: In the bathroom, I washed my face with cold water to wake up. Then I went to the kitchen, took out the chicken breast thawed last night and the washed lettuce and cherry tomatoes from the fridge, and quickly made lunch for the day: mixed-grain rice preset in the rice cooker with chicken breast salad, packed in a glass lunch box. I also put multivitamin tablets into the pocket of my work clothes.
location: Bathroom and kitchen, Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute by car
description: He changed into work clothes, took an umbrella and a lunch box. Seeing the light rain outside and the north wind blowing the drizzle, he opened his umbrella and walked quickly to the ground-level parking space in the residential complex, then started his older-model Volkswagen Lavida. The road was slippery in the rain, so he drove slower than usual and reached the factory in about 20 minutes.
location: No. 1, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to No. 360 Huatianjing Highway

name: Arrival at post and equipment inspection
description: At 7:35 arrived at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. After parking, I went directly into the workshop, changed into work shoes, and at my workstation followed the procedure to check the CNC machine's lubricating oil, coolant, and air pressure, then started the machine to warm up. Wang Lei arrived late, and the two of us exchanged a few words about the weather.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (Workshop), No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning work and fund automatic investment deduction
description: Master Sun assigned today's task: machine a batch of connecting flanges for central air-conditioning ducts with a tolerance requirement of 0.1 mm. Under the guidance of the program sheet provided by Engineer Liu, he entered the parameters, clamped the blank, and started machining, repeatedly measuring dimensions with calipers during the process. At exactly 10 a.m., his phone vibrated: Alipay automatically deducted 500 yuan for the fund investment plan, and the first purchase of the CSI 300 ETF feeder fund was successful. Seeing the notification, he thought to himself that it was time to start saving money, took a screenshot, and continued to focus on work.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (Workshop), No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and taking medication
description: After the lunch break bell rang, I took out my own glass lunch box and heated it in the microwave. I ate mixed grain rice and chicken breast salad in the workshop break room, and took a multivitamin tablet with water from the pocket of my work clothes.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (workshop rest room)

name: Noon break
description: After eating quickly and washing the lunch box, because he had not slept enough the night before, he lay on the desk with his coat over his head and caught up on sleep for about 40 minutes.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (workshop rest room)

name: Afternoon work and quality inspection
description: Continued machining the batch parts from the morning and properly handled several equipment parameter adjustments. Near the end of the shift, Master Sun used a vernier caliper to spot-check the finished flanges and nodded in approval, affirming that his work was meticulous.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (Workshop), No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After work and supermarket shopping
description: Left work right on time at 17:15, tidied up the workstation, then drove out of the factory area. On the way, he made a detour to Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket and bought a few apples and a bunch of bananas to supplement vitamins.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Taking a shower, cooking, and video calling with Mom.
description: After arriving home, I first took a hot shower to ward off the chill and changed into loungewear. Using the cured meat, eggs, and newly bought vegetables my mother had sent last week, I cooked a pot of vegetable, cured meat, and egg noodle soup. While waiting for the noodles to cook, I made a WeChat video call to my mother Wang Xiuying and told her that because it was raining today, I drove slowly and wasn't late.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 1, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (kitchen, living room)

name: Dinner, family video call, and emotional support
description: In the video call, his mother, Wang Xiuying, was washing dishes in the kitchen while Yin Hao ate noodles and chatted about everyday life. His father, Yin Jianguo, also leaned into the camera to ask about his work. After hesitating, he pointed the camera at the obvious water stain on the living room ceiling and complained that it couldn't be repaired. His father was silent for a moment, then said if it really couldn't be fixed, he should move somewhere else, and offered to help put together a down payment. His nose tingled, and he quickly turned the camera back, saying he would think about it. After a few more exchanges, they hung up. He finished the noodles and washed the dishes.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 1, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (living room)

name: Financial inventory and home purchase planning
description: He sat down at the desk, opened the budgeting app, and tallied up all income and expenses for 2024, finding that the average monthly surplus was less than 1,000 yuan and total savings for the year were only about 10,000 yuan. Then he opened a real estate app and filtered for Shanghai suburban listings under 1.5 million yuan, looking at Songjiang Old Town, Qingpu, and other areas. A 60-square-meter two-bedroom with a total price of about 1.4 million yuan would require a down payment of about 420,000 yuan. After comparing that with his bank card balance, he felt the huge gap. He created a new Excel spreadsheet with columns recording the savings goal of 420,000 yuan, current progress of 10,000 yuan, and the gap of 410,000 yuan, then saved a screenshot.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 1 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (bedroom)

name: Professional study
description: Putting down his phone, he opened the Theoretical Examination Guide for Senior CNC Technician and forced himself to focus on reading for half an hour, highlighting several key points. Knowledge helped calm his restless thoughts about buying a home.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 1 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (bedroom)

name: Gaming relaxation and socializing with teammates
description: Feeling gloomy, I opened Honor of Kings and was pulled into a team by my battle buddies Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng to play three ranked matches, winning one and losing one. In the lost match, my play was too hasty, and Zhang Jianguo teased “missing your wife?” I laughed and cursed back a few words, feeling a bit lighter.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 1 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (bedroom)

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and self-reflection
description: After quitting the game, he washed up and brushed his teeth, turned off the light and lay in bed, repeatedly calculating the huge down payment gap and the shabby living environment in his head. The pressure was enormous, and he felt he was going to have another sleepless night. He set the alarm for 6:30 the next day and, in the dark, reminded himself to work first and save money.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 1, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (bedroom, bathroom)

name: Waking up and basic preparations
description: Last night I couldn't fall asleep until 2 a.m., and this morning the alarm went off three times before I dragged myself out of bed. Even though my head felt heavy, I still made myself sit up at 6:30 sharp. I washed my face with cold water to force myself awake, then changed into the workout clothes and windbreaker I had prepared last night to get ready for my morning run.
location: Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run to Xiaokunshan Health Park
description: After a brief stretch, I left at 6:45. The weather was cloudy, with a north wind of force 3-4 and temperatures around 4-5 degrees. I jogged west along Guangfulin Road with a steady cadence, keeping the pace at 6:20 per kilometer. After reaching Xiaokunshan Health Park, I did 10 minutes of stretching in the fitness area, focusing on relaxing my tight back and leg muscles. After the run, I felt much more energetic.
location: Songjiang District, Shanghai: from Xingang Community along the western section of Guangfulin Road to Xiaokunshan Health Park (40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Highway)

name: Take a shower, get changed, and prepare a lunchbox
description: Got home at 7:35, took off the workout clothes that were slightly damp with sweat, quickly took a hot shower, and changed into clean work clothes: thermal underwear and a jacket. Then I prepared a lunch box: I put the multigrain rice (cooked on the preset timer) into an insulated lunch box, pan-fried the marinated chicken breast in olive oil, cut it into pieces, and put it into a salad bowl along with washed lettuce and cherry tomatoes. I also took a multivitamin tablet.
location: Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive to work
description: Left at 8:00 on time, carrying his commuter bag and lunch box. He went downstairs, started the car, drove out from Xingang Road, and turned onto Huatianjing Highway. Morning rush-hour traffic was steady, and he arrived at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory about 15 minutes later, parking in the employee parking lot.
location: On Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, on the way from Xingang Residential Community to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory.

name: Machined shaft parts in the morning
description: Arrived at the post at 8:15. As usual, checked the machine tool's lubricating oil and coolant levels, and preheated the spindle. Took out the drawing sent by Liu Gong, carefully reviewed the tolerance requirements for the shaft parts, and after confirming everything was correct, clamped the workpiece, aligned the tool, and entered the G-code. During machining, he was exceptionally focused, keeping his eyes on the tool tip under the cutting fluid and the instrument panel. After each part was completed, he measured it with a micrometer to ensure it was within tolerance. Midway, Liu Gong came over to ask about the machining progress, and the two briefly exchanged views on the new tool path parameters.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and casual chat with colleagues
description: After the machine tool was shut down, Yin Hao took his lunchbox from the break room refrigerator and heated it in the staff canteen microwave. He ate with shift leader Wang Lei and colleague Liu Zhiqiang in the canteen. Wang Lei talked about his Spring Festival plan to take his girlfriend to Shanghai Disneyland and asked everyone for tips. Liu Zhiqiang said he was not interested in crowded places. Yin Hao ate mixed-grain rice and chicken breast while occasionally joining the conversation; the lunch atmosphere was relaxed.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Researched property information during lunch break
description: After finishing lunch, I leaned back in the lounge chair and rested my eyes for a while, then took out my phone and opened the Beike and Lianjia apps. I went through the favorited listings one by one for new developments and recently built second-hand homes around Taicang and Kunshan with total prices around 1.5 million yuan, carefully comparing total price, down payment ratio, and estimated monthly payment. I screenshotted and saved several listings close to my budget, planning to use Excel for detailed calculations at home in the evening.
location: Break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Continue machining parts and finishing up in the afternoon
description: After the lunch break, he returned to his workstation and continued machining the remaining shaft parts strictly according to operating procedures, regularly checking tool wear and replacing one of the worn blades. At 17:00, the last part was finished and passed measurement. He shut down the machine tool, carefully cleaned the workbench and the metal chips on the floor, put the tools back in place, and prepared for tomorrow's production.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Buy groceries after work
description: Punched out at 17:00, drove away from the factory, and stopped by Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket on the way. Pushing a shopping cart, I picked broccoli and spinach for tomorrow in the vegetable section, grabbed a box of blueberries and a few kiwis in the fruit section, and bought a new bottle of light soy sauce in the condiment section.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home for dinner
description: Got home at 17:25 and put the purchased vegetables and fruits into the fridge. Because of last night's insomnia and the afternoon's hard work, decided to make dinner simple. Boiled a pot of frozen dumplings, chopped some scallions and seaweed, and made a hot bowl of seaweed soup to go with them. While eating, listened to a podcast on his phone, enjoying a relaxing time.
location: Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reviewing the home purchase plan
description: After cleaning up dinner, he opened his laptop and created a new Excel spreadsheet. He first recorded in detail the housing listing information gathered during the lunch break, then opened the banking app to check the salary credited in January and the recurring fund investment records. Next he listed monthly expenses item by item (rent, utilities, transportation, food, etc.), and based on the current savings progress of 10,000 yuan, simulated how long it would take to save for buying a home at different down payment ratios (30%, 35%, 40%). The goal of a 420,000 yuan down payment was stressful, but it strengthened his determination to act.
location: Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Self-study CNC programming and consult with the master worker.
description: At 19:30, he switched to study mode, took out Chapter 3 of CNC Programming and Machining Technology, and began learning G-code compound cycle commands. While reading, he drew command format and machining path diagrams in his notebook. When he had questions about parameter settings, he sent a voice message to his master Sun Jianguo on WeChat. A dozen or so minutes later, Master Sun replied with a detailed voice message explaining the usage of the command and how to avoid common mistakes. Yin Hao listened carefully and added notes to his notebook, and his thinking became much clearer.
location: Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Playing Honor of Kings with comrades-in-arms
description: After a study session, he closed the book to relax. He opened Honor of Kings on his phone, saw his teammates Zhou Xiaofeng and Zhang Jianguo online, and invited them to play three ranked matches. I was in good form tonight, and the three of us coordinated well, winning two and losing one. The communication and victory in the game eased the anxiety about the mortgage, and he felt much better.
location: Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Talked with my father.
description: After the game, he called his father, who was far away in his hometown of Nantong, via WeChat. The father and son talked briefly. His father asked about the weather in Shanghai and about his meals and housing. Yin Hao reported that everything was fine: "Work is going well, food and housing are good, don't worry." His mother chimed in to remind him to keep warm, and he acknowledged each one. After hanging up, he felt a lot more settled.
location: Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: At 22:15, he put down his phone and went to the bathroom to brush his teeth, wash his face, and wash his feet. Back in the bedroom, he set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, laid out tomorrow's clothes at the head of the bed, and made sure his phone was in Do Not Disturb mode. He turned off the main light, leaving only a small night light.
location: Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Try to fall asleep
description: The day was packed with exercise, work, and study, leaving both body and mind exhausted. I closed my eyes and recalled what I had done today: feeling refreshed after the morning run, understanding a programming puzzle, winning a game in the evening... My mind gradually calmed, my breathing became steady, and I hoped to fall asleep soon, not suffer insomnia like last night.
location: Bedroom, Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Early morning wake-up and preparation
description: The phone alarm rang. Yin Hao turned over and sat up. Although he had been researching housing information late into the night, he was full of energy at the thought of going to Disneyland with his friends today. He opened the Disney app to confirm that the ticket QR code and ID card were in the backpack's inner pocket, and deliberately brought the Dove chocolate he bought yesterday and two bottles of mineral water. While washing up, he sent a voice message in the 'Songjiang Three Brothers' WeChat group reminding everyone to bring their ID cards. He also glanced out the window; the weather was sunny with some clouds, 5-9 degrees, so he decided to wear a thick down jacket. Then he quickly heated two slices of whole wheat bread, drank a cup of warm milk, put on his black backpack, and double-checked that his car keys, phone, power bank, tissues, wallet, and other items were all there.
location: Room 302, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Met up with brothers at the entrance of the residential community.
description: Yin Hao went downstairs early and walked to the west gate of the residential community. Gao Zhiyuan was already waiting by the roadside on his electric bike, with a thermos filled with hot water in the basket. Shortly after, Ma Xiaofeng also got out of a taxi, yawning, holding three cups of hot coffee bought from a convenience store. In the cold morning wind, the three met up, laughing and joking.
location: West Gate, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive to Shanghai Disneyland
description: Yin Hao started the silver Hyundai Elantra. Gao Zhiyuan sat in the passenger seat, and Ma Xiaofeng sat in the back. The navigation was set to "Shanghai Disney Resort Parking Lot." From Xingang Road they turned onto the G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway heading east, then took the S1 Yingbin Expressway all the way. Traffic on the expressway was light, and the warm air blew steadily. Gao Zhiyuan talked about the "least walking route guide" he had seen last night, while Ma Xiaofeng commented from the back seat on which attractions were most worth queuing for. The three chatted and laughed.
location: Starting from Xingang Community, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, via G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway and S1 Yingbin Expressway to the Shanghai Disney Resort parking lot

name: Park, enter the park, and visit Tomorrowland.
description: Just after 8 o'clock, they drove smoothly into the Disney parking lot, parked, and walked about 8 minutes to the security checkpoint. Although they were among the first batch, dozens of people were already queued ahead. The park opened on time at 8:30. After entering with ID card scans, the three headed straight for Tomorrowland. They queued about 40 minutes for TRON Lightcycle Power Run. During his first ride, Yin Hao screamed the whole time from the thrill of the launch and the sense of rushing through light and shadow. After getting off, Gao Zhiyuan patted his shoulder and teased, "Where's your military training? You've already lost your voice?" Yin Hao replied with a smile, "That's called showing true emotion!" The group took a photo together with their phones in the park.
location: Shanghai Disney Resort Parking Lot, 753 Shendi West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and Tomorrowland at Shanghai Disney Resort

name: Visited Adventure Isle
description: After leaving Tomorrowland, they moved on to Adventure Isle and queued for nearly 60 minutes to experience "Soaring over the Horizon". When the dome screen rose and they flew realistically over the Great Wall and the Eiffel Tower, even smelling the grassland, Yin Hao felt it was worth the ticket price. Ma Xiaofeng marveled repeatedly, and Gao Zhiyuan wanted to secretly record a video as a souvenir.
location: Adventure Isle, Shanghai Disney Resort, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch at Barbossa Barbecue
description: The project ended close to 12, and the three had lunch at the nearby Barbossa BBQ. Yin Hao rushed to scan the QR code, ordered three different set meals, and spent 256 yuan in total. Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng wanted to transfer him money, but Yin Hao wouldn't let them, saying, 'This meal is on me, to celebrate our first time here!' As they ate, they discussed the afternoon route; the pirate ship set outside the window fit the occasion perfectly.
location: Barbossa's Bounty, Adventure Isle, Shanghai Disney Resort, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Visit Treasure Cove and Fantasyland.
description: In the afternoon, they headed straight for Pirates of the Caribbean: Battle for the Sunken Treasure. The immersive underwater raft ride and the big-screen effects thrilled all three of them. Next, they went to Fantasyland and queued for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. While in line, Ma Xiaofeng took out rain ponchos, saying the forecast had mentioned possible light rain in the afternoon. Sure enough, a few drops of rain began to fall, and the three quickly put on their ponchos and kept waiting in line. The gentle roller coaster became a bit more fun in the rain.
location: Treasure Cove and Fantasyland, Shanghai Disney Resort, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Gardens of Imagination: free exploration and photography
description: After the rain stopped, the three of them strolled around Gardens of Imagination, bought three Mickey ice cream bars, and sat on a bench eating while looking at the castle in the distance. Gao Zhiyuan took quite a few photos of Yin Hao and Ma Xiaofeng with his phone and also took a group photo for them. Ma Xiaofeng got everyone to check the wait times on the app, wanting to ride another less popular ride.
location: Gardens of Imagination, Shanghai Disney Resort, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Visited Toy Story Land
description: Decided to try Rex's Racer in Toy Story Land; this U-shaped roller coaster had a queue of about 40 minutes. After the ride, he stopped by the Abu Shop nearby, where Yin Hao picked out a strawberry-scented Chip plush toy, planning to hang it on his car keys.
location: Toy Story Land, Shanghai Disney Resort, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Dinner at Star Terrace Restaurant.
description: It was getting dark, and the three of them decided to have dinner first. They chose the Starlight Terrace Restaurant near Tomorrowland and ordered burgers, fries, and Coke. After eating their fill, they found a bench and sat down to recover their strength. After walking all day, Yin Hao's legs were already feeling sore; the step count must have exceeded 20,000 steps.
location: Stargazer Grill, Tomorrowland, Shanghai Disney Resort, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waiting at the Gardens of Imagination and watching the fireworks show
description: At around six o'clock, the three arrived early at the Gardens of Imagination, found a spot with a wide view directly in front of the castle, spread out the plastic bags they had brought in the morning, and sat on the ground. Gao Zhiyuan scrolled through his phone looking at night scenery photos, Ma Xiaofeng sorted through photos, and Yin Hao leaned against the bench armrest watching the castle's changing lights. At exactly 8 p.m., the light show and fireworks went off right on time, and the castle seemed to come alive. With the sky full of fireworks and classic music playing, Yin Hao felt as if he had returned to his childhood. Seeing the two brothers beside him also stunned with their mouths open, he patted them hard on the shoulders, and they all laughed knowingly.
location: Gardens of Imagination, Shanghai Disney Resort, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drove back to Songjiang.
description: Once the fireworks ended, the three of them followed the crowd to the parking lot. They started the car and navigated back to Songjiang. The excitement hadn't worn off yet, and they spent the whole trip reviewing the attractions they had experienced, talking enthusiastically about who had been the most chicken and which ride was the most thrilling. There wasn't much traffic, and they arrived at the community gate in less than an hour.
location: From the Shanghai Disney Resort parking lot, returned to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Returning home, resting up, and going to sleep
description: After parking the car, Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng took a taxi home at the entrance of the residential community. Yin Hao went upstairs and into the apartment, kicked off his shoes, and collapsed on the sofa. He opened his phone album, selected a few group photos taken in front of the castle, and sent them to his parents with the message "Had a great time today!" Then he put together a nine-grid post with the caption "A dream come true—let's go, bros!" and posted it to his Moments. He took a quick hot shower, and while brushing his teeth, thought that in the future he might bring his parents or girlfriend here. He blow-dried his hair, hung up his down jacket, put the items in his backpack back in place, and set the alarm for 7:30 the next day. He turned off the main light, left a night light on, and lay in bed looking through the photos, feeling warm inside. Although his body was tired, the satisfaction of a thoroughly enjoyable trip made him fall into a deep, exhausted yet contented sleep.
location: Room 302, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up, washing up, and stretching.
description: Naturally woke up on Saturday morning and lay in bed for two minutes, feeling the leg soreness from the previous day's trip to Disney. Got up at 7:35 and opened the curtains. After washing up briefly, I did 10 minutes of stretching on the living room carpet, focusing on relaxing my calves and lower back to relieve muscle fatigue.
location: Bedroom and bathroom, Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Tidying up the house and exporting Disney photos
description: Hung up the backpack and softshell jacket that had been left on the chair after returning home yesterday, and tidied the room. Then I turned on the computer, exported the photos and videos taken at Disneyland the day before from my phone, selected a few group photos in front of the castle and with the characters, and a 15-second fireworks video, ready to share with family.
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Had breakfast and shared photos with family
description: Heated two frozen steamed buns and brewed a cup of instant soy milk for breakfast. While eating, he sent four selected photos and a video to the 'Yin Family' WeChat group, with the message 'Went there with the brothers yesterday, it was quite fun,' and then sent a separate copy to his mother.
location: Kitchen and dining table, Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Met Aunt Chen, a neighbor, downstairs by chance and took a walk around the neighborhood.
description: He went downstairs to take out the trash and planned to take a walk in the community. Just as he left the building entrance, he ran into Aunt Chen Xiuying, a neighbor returning from grocery shopping. Aunt Chen mentioned that her old rice cooker sometimes didn't heat up when cooking rice and she was planning to call a repairman. Yin Hao remembered he had a multimeter and a soldering iron in his toolbox and offered to take a look. Aunt Chen thanked him repeatedly. Afterwards, he walked for 20 minutes in the community's central garden to stretch his limbs.
location: Stairwell and central garden of Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Replying to messages and previewing the CNC course.
description: After returning home, he checked WeChat and saw his father reply with a “not bad” emoji in the group. His brother asked about the cost, so he replied and chatted for a bit. In the “Songjiang Three Brothers” group, Gao Zhiyuan suggested going to a newly opened barbecue restaurant in the evening, Ma Xiaofeng agreed, and Yin Hao replied that he had something to do in the evening (going to help Aunt Chen fix things) and asked them to check it out first. Afterwards, he flipped through the textbook “Numerical Control Programming and Machining Technology” in advance to preview the chapter content for the evening's study.
location: Living room and desk at Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch: simple soup noodles
description: I took the leftover scrambled eggs with tomatoes and multigrain rice from the night before out of the fridge, and cooked a simple bowl of soup noodles for lunch. While eating, I remembered that Lin Yue hadn't replied to messages last night, and planned to contact her after finishing the repairs.
location: Kitchen, Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go to Aunt Chen's house to diagnose the rice cooker fault
description: After resting for 20 minutes after the meal, I took a multimeter, a screwdriver set, and a soldering iron to Auntie Chen's home across the hall. After explaining why I had come, I unplugged the rice cooker in the kitchen, removed the bottom cover, and used the multimeter to test the power board; the circuit was normal. I found that the contacts of the magnetic temperature limiter (temperature-sensing element) had slight oxidation and burn marks, and judged this to be the cause of the poor contact. I plan to buy the replacement part and replace it.
location: Kitchen at Aunt Chen's home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the hardware store to buy a temperature controller
description: Noted down the old part model (KSD301, normally open type, 105), explained it to Aunt Chen, then drove to the nearest Laoquan Hardware and Building Materials Store, about a 12-minute drive. After arriving, gave the model number and bought the same thermostat for 8 yuan.
location: Laoquan Hardware and Building Materials Store, Songjiang District, Shanghai (near Yinze Road/Guangfulin Road)

name: Replace the thermostat and test the rice cooker.
description: Returned to Aunt Chen's home, replaced the old thermostat with a new one, and carefully soldered it with a soldering iron. After checking that everything was correct, he put the housing back on, powered it on, added water, and did a test boil. The indicator light came on normally, and after a few minutes the water began to steam. Aunt Chen praised his craftsmanship. Yin Hao reminded her to be careful not to let soup or water overflow into the base in the future.
location: Kitchen at Aunt Chen's home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Chatted with Lin Yue on WeChat
description: While waiting for the rice cooker test, the phone vibrated. Lin Yue took the initiative to send a WeChat message asking what I was doing. I took a photo of the rice cooker being tested and sent it over, saying, "I helped the neighbor aunt fix a rice cooker. It was quite fun." Lin Yue asked in surprise that I could fix this too. After a modest reply, we talked about her weekend plans, and she said she was taking a walk with friends by West Lake. Then I naturally brought up what I had seen at Disneyland the day before and said we could go together sometime. The two chatted for about half an hour in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
location: The living room of Aunt Chen's home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Helped Aunt Chen prepare the ingredients and chatted
description: The rice cooker test passed perfectly, and Aunt Chen insisted on keeping him for dinner. Unable to refuse her kindness, he went to the kitchen to help, washing vegetables, peeling garlic, and slicing ginger. As Aunt Chen made her signature dishes, Shanghai-style braised pork and steamed sea bass, she asked with concern about how he was doing living and working alone in Songjiang and whether he had a girlfriend. As he worked, Yin Hao shared his past experience in the military and his current work and life. The atmosphere was warm and pleasant.
location: Kitchen at Aunt Chen's home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Had a warm dinner with Aunt Chen
description: The table was set with braised pork belly, steamed sea bass, sweet and sour spare ribs, and tomato and egg soup. As they ate and chatted, Aunt Chen recommended a seafood stall at the nearby market and advised him to order less takeout, saying that cooking at home was both cleaner and more economical. Yin Hao felt the warmth of the neighborhood.
location: Dining room at Aunt Chen's home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washed the dishes, cleaned up, and said goodbye to Aunt Chen.
description: After the meal, he proactively washed the dishes and wiped the stove clean. Before leaving, Aunt Chen packed a lunchbox of homemade dried radish for him, saying it goes well with porridge in the morning. He thanked her and returned to his place.
location: Aunt Chen's kitchen and hallway, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Learned compound cycle instructions for CNC programming.
description: Opened the notebook and the textbook "CNC Programming and Machining Technology" and continued studying the G-code compound cycle instructions in Chapter 3. Combining the notes from Master Sun Jianguo's explanations on WeChat yesterday, he worked through the tool paths for the G71 and G72 instructions on scrap paper, deepening his understanding of compound cycle instructions and studying with great focus.
location: At the desk, Room 402, No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Play online games with comrades and friends.
description: Just as I closed the book, Zhou Xiaofeng called for people to play ranked games in the comrades-in-arms group. After logging into the game, I found Zhang Jianguo and Gao Zhiyuan were also there. Four people were short of one, so they pulled in another online friend to form a five-person ranked team. They played for over an hour, winning two of three games, with good teamwork. Gao Zhiyuan complained in voice chat that the newly opened barbecue restaurant today was mediocre, and everyone agreed to try another one next week.
location: On the sofa at Room 402, No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wash up and make a plan for tomorrow
description: After finishing the game, I went to the bathroom to wash up. Returning to the bedroom, I set the alarm for 8 a.m. tomorrow and planned to go running in the morning at Xiaokunshan Health Park, and at noon go to Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket to stock up on vegetables and milk.
location: Bathroom and bedroom of Room 402, No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Scrolled through WeChat Moments before bed and went to sleep.
description: Lying in bed, he casually scrolled through his Moments and saw a photo of the night view by West Lake that Lin Yue had posted, and gave it a like. Recalling the satisfaction of helping Aunt Chen repair her rice cooker today and the warm dinner, he felt at ease. At 22:30 he switched off the desk lamp and got ready to fall asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 402, No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Early Morning Preparation
description: The sky was still dark; his biological clock woke him naturally. Yin Hao lay in bed for two minutes to let his mind clear, then got up and opened the curtains to check the frost in the early morning. After a quick wash, he changed into the quick-drying long-sleeve shirt, windproof jacket, and compression pants he had prepared, and put on his heart rate strap and GPS running watch, fully ready for the morning run.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-race energy replenishment and setting off by car
description: In the kitchen, Yin Hao drank 200 ml of warm water to moisten his throat and wake up his digestive system, then ate half a banana and a slice of whole wheat bread as light energy. He put another energy gel and a small bottle of electrolyte water into his running waist pack, took his car keys, checked his gear, then went downstairs and started the car. He drove along Xingang Road, turned onto Guangfulin Road, and headed east; the morning roads were clear.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the meeting point and warmed up.
description: Yin Hao drove about 10 minutes to the starting point near Wenhui Road in Songjiang University Town, where he had agreed to meet his running buddy Chen Jie, and parked in a roadside parking space. After getting out, he did dynamic warm-ups by the roadside, including joint rotations, high knees, and butt kicks, to activate muscles and prevent strains. Chen Jie arrived on time at 6:20, and the two briefly discussed today's pace plan, confirming that they would first cruise at a steady pace of 6:15 per kilometer.
location: Starting point at Songjiang University Town, Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: 15 km long-distance training (LSD)
description: At 6:30, they started running on time. Yin Hao and Chen Jie ran side by side at a steady pace along the loop road in the university town where traffic was sparse, keeping a consistent pace of 6:15 per kilometer and maintaining good cadence and breathing rhythm. At the 7.5-kilometer mark, the two paused briefly and quickly replenished electrolyte water at a roadside hydration station. When he reached 12 kilometers, Yin Hao felt slight soreness at the old injury on his right ankle.
