He proactively adjusted his landing posture, shifting his center of gravity slightly outward, and the discomfort soon eased. He completed the 15 kilometers in 1 hour 33 minutes 45 seconds.
location: Songjiang University Town Ring Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Post-run stretching and conversation
description: After the run, the two walked slowly for a few minutes to bring down their heart rates, then did 10 minutes of detailed static stretching on the lawn beside the track, focusing on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. During the stretching, Chen Jie shared race experience and suggested that for the half marathon, be aware of hitting the wall at the 17-18 km mark and take an energy gel every 5 km; Yin Hao asked about techniques for adjusting pace to road conditions. Both felt more confident that Yin Hao could finish his first half marathon in under 2 hours.
location: Lawn beside the running track at Songjiang University Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive home and shower
description: After saying goodbye to Chen Jie and agreeing to do an 18-kilometer pace run at the same time next week, Yin Hao drove back along the same route to Xingang Community and parked in his space. The first thing he did when he got home was take off his sweat-soaked workout clothes and take a warm shower to thoroughly relax his tired body, then changed into a set of dry loungewear.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and adjusting the training plan
description: Yin Hao made breakfast: he mixed oatmeal with milk, boiled an egg, and cut up an apple. While eating, he opened the fitness app to confirm that the 15 km run data had synced successfully, and shared a screenshot of the running route to the Songjiang runner friends group, tagging Chen Jie to express thanks. After breakfast, he sat at his desk and, based on Chen Jie's advice and today's running feel, rearranged his preparation plan for the next two weeks in his phone calendar: add an 8 km interval run on Wednesday, adjust the weekend LSD to 18 km, set the half marathon target pace at 6 min/km, and noted in his memo to apply an ice pack to his right ankle for 15 minutes that evening.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Walk to the supermarket to shop and go home.
description: Yin Hao changed into casual clothes, took his eco-friendly shopping bag, and walked to Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket near his neighborhood. He went straight to the vegetable and meat/poultry sections with a clear goal, buying enough ingredients for three days: broccoli, spinach, tomatoes, eggs, a box of chicken breast, a bag of whole-wheat steamed buns, and also grabbed blueberries and light soy sauce. After shopping, he carried his bags and walked back home.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: After returning home, Yin Hao first prepped the ingredients: he cut the chicken breast into pieces and marinated it, and washed the vegetables clean. Then he made a simple, nutritious lunch — tomato and egg noodles with stir-fried broccoli. He enjoyed it thoroughly on his own.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and cold compress on the ankle.
description: After the meal, while clearing the dishes, Yin Hao felt drowsy. He took a pre-frozen ice pack from the refrigerator, wrapped it in a dry towel, and applied it to his right ankle, which had been uncomfortable during the morning run. Then he leaned against the headboard, set a 30-minute alarm, closed his eyes, and rested to recover.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Hone professional skills
description: After the lunch break, he regained his energy. Yin Hao brewed a cup of tea, sat down at his desk, and took out CNC Programming and Machining Technology and a notebook. The afternoon focus was on conquering the compound cycle instructions for G-code in Chapter 3, including the format, parameters, and application scenarios of instructions such as G70, G71, and G73. As he read the examples in the book, he copied the code and drew diagrams to understand the tool path trajectories. He marked the difficult parts to ask his master next week.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Break-time rest and relaxation
description: After studying for an hour and a half, Yin Hao got up to stretch, watered the pothos on the windowsill, then put on earphones and played soft music on his phone. Standing by the window, he watched children playing and residents taking walks in the community below, letting his mind relax.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Interleaved study: introductory programming.
description: Yin Hao opened his laptop, clicked on his saved introductory Python online course, and studied loop statements (for loops). Following the tutorial, he typed code and practiced in the programming environment by calculating the sum of integers from 1 to 100 and writing a simple 9x9 multiplication table. Although different from CNC programming, the joy of logic made him feel fulfilled.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare dinner
description: Yin Hao turned off the computer and started preparing dinner. He cooked multigrain rice in a rice cooker, pan-fried the marinated chicken breast with little oil in a frying pan, and stir-fried the spinach he had bought that morning with garlic. It made a healthy, low-fat dinner.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner time
description: While enjoying his homemade nutritious dinner, Yin Hao scrolled through the news on his phone and checked the CNC technology forum he followed for new posts, savoring his simple and regular life.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Second ice therapy for ankle and evening stretching
description: After a half-hour rest following the meal, Yin Hao took out the ice pack again and applied cold therapy to his right ankle for 15 minutes. Then he got out a foam roller and did 15 minutes of active full-body relaxation on the floor, rolling especially the calves and quadriceps used in today's run to relieve muscle tension.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Programming consolidation and hands-on practice
description: After taking a shower, he felt refreshed, turned on his computer again, and instead of watching the lesson, he tried to write a small program that automatically calculates the area and circumference of a circle based on the input radius. He encountered issues with variable definitions and input/output and debugged it three or four times before getting it to run successfully, which gave him a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing for tomorrow and relaxing
description: Knowing Monday was a workday, Yin Hao took out his work uniform and leather shoes from the wardrobe in advance and hung them up, then packed the pan-fried chicken breast and multigrain rice lunchbox and put it in the fridge. Once everything was ready, he leaned back on the sofa, opened the battle pass system in Honor of Kings to claim rewards, and replied to messages in the runner's group chat. He did not start a ranked game, saving his energy for the next day's work.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: Yin Hao lay on the bed, applied some hand cream, then picked up his phone and sent the questions he had marked in today's reading about the G71 Type II composite cycle instruction as a text message to his master Sun Jianguo for advice. After putting down the phone, he recalled the solid and regular day: the 15 km went smoothly, his ankle was fine, and his study had been productive. He set the alarm for 6:20 tomorrow, turned off the light, listened to the occasional sound of passing cars outside, and quickly fell asleep.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning waking up and preparation
description: At 6:30 in the morning, he was woken by the alarm and felt lingering soreness in his thighs and right ankle from yesterday's long run. After a quick stretch, he got up and washed up, then checked the weather on his phone: Shanghai cloudy turning overcast, 5-9°C. He took the lunch prepared last night (mixed grain rice + stir-fried chicken breast) from the fridge and packed it into his commuter bag, and also put two apples and multivitamin tablets into the backpack's inner pocket. Before leaving, he checked his work ID and employee badge in the pockets of his work clothes.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuted to work by car.
description: Went downstairs and drove at 7:15; the drive took about 15 minutes. Arrived at the factory parking lot at 7:30, parked, and walked to the workshop.
location: Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to No. 360, Huatianjing Highway (commuting route)

name: Pre-shift preparation and morning briefing
description: Arrived at the post early and changed into work clothes. Started the machine tool to preheat for 15 minutes, checked the coolant level and tool wear. Then attended the pre-shift meeting, where team leader Wang Lei briefly explained the urgency and process requirements of today's flange order.
location: CNC machining workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Precision machining of flanges in the morning
description: Back at the workstation, I carefully checked the dimensional tolerances on the drawings, pulled up the machining program, and ran a simulation. At 8:40 I began formally machining the precision flanges. I stayed fully focused during the operation, and after each piece I measured the key dimensions with a vernier caliper and recorded the data. Around 10:30, I ran into a question about the thread relief groove. I pulled up the drawing, studied it carefully, confirmed the program was correct, and continued machining.
location: CNC machining workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Asked my master about programming problems during lunch.
description: He brought his lunchbox to the cafeteria to heat it up. Seeing Master Sun, he took the initiative to sit next to him and chat while eating. Yin Hao reported the difficulties he had encountered the night before while studying the loop jump program in Chapter 3. Master Sun used chopsticks dipped in soup to draw a simple diagram on the table and suggested that he manually enter a G71 compound cycle command on an idle machine tool in the afternoon to verify it in practice—just reading books was not enough. The two also talked about weekend plans; Master Sun planned to go to Songjiang Old Town to browse the antique market.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: During the lunch break, discussed ankle recovery with running friends
description: After the meal, he returned to the break room, leaned back in his chair, and rested with his eyes closed for half an hour. During that time, he sent a message to his running buddy Chen Jie on his phone: "After yesterday's 15 kilometers, my ankle still feels a bit tight. I'll ice it once more tonight. Is next week's 18-kilometer pace run okay?" Chen Jie replied: "No problem, it's just lactic acid buildup and a reaction from the old injury. Just stretch more and you'll be fine." After reading the message, he set the alarm for 13:10.
location: Employee break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon machining tasks and hands-on practice with the G71 command
description: In the afternoon, he continued machining flanges. Around 16:00, he completed the last finished product of the day's batch, and after passing self-inspection, placed it neatly. Remembering the master's advice during the lunch break, he walked to an idle training machine, turned on the power, manually entered a G71 compound cycle command following the textbook example, and ran a simulation. Through the CNC screen, he observed the tool path trajectory and successfully verified the loop jump logic, feeling much more at ease.
location: CNC machining workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After work, drove to the supermarket for shopping.
description: Back in the locker room, I changed out of my work clothes and organized my personal belongings. I clocked out at 17:30 and drove home. On the way, I stopped at the Xingang Xincun fresh food supermarket, went in, and bought a bag of fresh greens and a bottle of iced black tea. Then I continued driving back to Xingang Community.
location: From No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, via Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket at Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, return to Xingang Residential Area.

name: Dinner preparation and household chores
description: After getting home, he took out the greens, washed them, and cooked a bowl of noodles with greens and egg. While eating, he browsed short videos on his phone for half an hour. After finishing, he took out the clothes he had put in the washing machine that morning and hung them up to dry.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening CNC programming study and exercise practice.
description: At 19:00 he started the evening study session, took out the textbook "CNC Programming and Machining Technology", focused on the exercises in Chapter 3, and, drawing on the experience of the successful verification that afternoon, independently wrote a loop jump program with subroutine calls, marking key instructions with a red pen. When he encountered a question about tool radius compensation, he left a message on WeChat to ask Teacher Liu Jianjun. About 10 minutes later, Teacher Liu sent a voice message explaining the principle in detail and praised the hands-on approach from the afternoon. After listening, Yin Hao carefully recorded it in his notebook and added the question and answer to the exercise book.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (at the desk).

name: Online chat with girlfriend sharing life updates
description: After tidying up his books, he opened his phone and chose a photo of the TRON Lightcycle Power Run light effects taken at Disney yesterday, sending it to Lin Yue with the message: 'Rode this yesterday — super thrilling!' Lin Yue replied that the photo looked great. The two started a voice chat. Yin Hao asked about Hangzhou's weather and told Lin Yue to bundle up; Lin Yue said the air conditioner was already on. Yin Hao shared his 15 km run from yesterday and his half-marathon training plan, and Lin Yue sent an encouraging emoji. They chatted for about half an hour before hanging up.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (on the living room sofa)

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and applying an ice pack to the right ankle
description: After hanging up the phone, he took an ice pack out of the fridge, wrapped it in a towel, and sat on the sofa applying it to his right ankle for 15 minutes. While icing, he listened to a few rock songs to relax. After icing, he used a foam roller to gently roll out his thigh and calf muscles. Then he washed up and brushed his teeth, and laid out tomorrow's work clothes and underwear on the bedside table.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (bathroom, bedroom).

name: Pre-sleep review and bedtime
description: Before turning off the lights, he used the memo app on his phone to quickly review the day's key study points and the next day's work to-dos, confirming that everything was going as planned. He turned off the lights and went to sleep right at 22:30.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (bedroom)

name: Woke up, applied ice, and went for a morning run in the rain
description: He got up after the alarm had rung twice. The sky outside was gloomy and rainy. Because the 15-kilometer long run the previous day had left his right ankle sore and swollen, he hurried to the kitchen, took out an ice pack, wrapped it in a towel, and applied it to the ankle. After 15 minutes of icing, it felt better. At 5:50 he changed into a dark blue quick-dry shirt and black shorts, put on a rain jacket, and went out. He ran east along Xingang Road, turned onto Kungang Road, and did a tempo run at a pace of about 5:50 per kilometer. He turned back at the 2.5-kilometer mark, covering about 5 kilometers in total, and returned home at 6:10 in the drizzle.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Kungang Highway (from the intersection of Xingang Road and Kungang Highway to the turnaround point)

name: Morning chores, breakfast, and getting ready to go out
description: After the run, I took a quick hot shower to wash off the dampness, then pan-fried the marinated chicken breast in the kitchen. I packed the multigrain rice cooked on a timer last night and some greens into separate compartments of a lunchbox. For breakfast, I had two slices of whole-wheat bread and a cup of hot oat milk. Then I checked my commuter bag for my work badge, Bluetooth earbuds, and keys, and stuffed two extra carbide inserts into the tool box in case of an urgent tool change in the afternoon. I left the house at 7:10 sharp to drive.
location: Room 502, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Commuting by car and getting ready for work
description: At 7:10 he started his used Volkswagen and arrived at the Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory via Chenta Road and Huatianjing Highway at 7:25. After swiping his card to enter the factory, he changed into gray work clothes and attended the 7:30 workshop morning meeting. Team leader Wang Lei assigned an urgent order for 20 precision shaft sleeves to be delivered before 9:30. After the meeting, he walked to the CK6136 lathe, pressed the start button to preheat the spindle, and checked the cutting fluid and lubricating oil to prepare for work.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Urgent machining of precision shaft sleeves
description: After receiving the urgent order from team leader Wang Lei, he immediately loaded the material according to the drawing, set the tool, and entered G71 and G70 rough and finish turning commands. The machine ran efficiently for precision bushing machining. After each piece was completed, he used a micrometer to measure the outer diameter, inner diameter, and length, ensuring the tolerance stayed within 0.02 mm. At 9:20, all 20 bushings were completed, all dimensions were qualified, and senior colleague Sun Jianguo nodded in approval after inspection.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Flange rough turning and technical discussion with colleagues
description: After the urgent job was finished, I started the rough turning process for a batch of flanges, lowering the spindle speed and increasing the feed rate to improve efficiency. Around 10:30, my colleague Liu Zhiqiang brought a drawing of a special-shaped part to ask for help with a programming problem. The two of us discussed it in front of the computer for more than ten minutes, and finally I suggested using the G73 pattern repeating cycle combined with macro variables to simplify the tool path. Liu Zhiqiang patted me on the shoulder and praised my rapid progress. Then I continued with the flange rough turning task.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch delivery
description: Because of the wind, he didn't want to run errands, so he used his phone to order takeout of scrambled eggs with tomatoes over rice from the Sun Island Ancient Village Farmhouse Restaurant and quickly finished it in the workshop rest area. The taste was average, but it was hot.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: During the lunch break, browsed home-buying information and dealt with the landlord's rent increase notice
description: Lying on the chair in the break room, he opened the Beike Zhaofang app, set the location to Huaqiao, Kunshan, Suzhou, and filtered listings with a total price within 1.5 million yuan, mentally calculating the down payment and monthly mortgage. At that moment, the landlord, Sister Li, sent a WeChat message notifying that next month's rent would increase by 200 yuan. Though he had expected it, he still felt frustrated. After briefly replying to agree, he saved screenshots of several two-bedroom floor plans in Huaqiao, then looked out the window at the factory buildings and let out a long sigh.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon ventilation duct flange drilling work
description: Continued drilling holes for a batch of ventilation duct flanges in the workshop. After adjusting the drill bit speed and feed rate, placing the workpiece on the worktable, and marking the locating points, I started the program, and the holes came out neatly and uniformly. While the machine was running, I mentally reviewed the morning's shaft sleeve machining path and thought about how to further shorten the cycle time.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Tidying up the workstation and preparing for tomorrow's work
description: At 16:30 began cleaning the workstation, using an iron hook to remove metal chips from the machine tool, and wiped it inside and out. Then spread the drawings needed for the next afternoon on the desk to check them, confirmed there were no ambiguities, and prepared for the handover.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving home and dinner.
description: Punched out at 17:00 on time. The weather cleared up, and he drove back to Xingang Community along Huatianjing Highway and Chenta Road. After arriving home, he reheated the lunchbox he had brought at noon, made seaweed and egg drop soup, ate quietly by himself, then washed the dishes and wiped down the stove.
location: Room 502, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Evening jog and feeding stray cats
description: After the meal, still feeling a bit down, I changed into sportswear and jogged 3 kilometers in the community without chasing speed, just to break a sweat. The air was fresh after the rain. After the run, I met a familiar orange cat by the flower bed. The cat came over and rubbed against my legs, so I went to the Baishi Linli convenience store at the community entrance and spent one yuan to buy a ham sausage to feed it. Watching it wolf down the food, most of my gloom dispersed.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai; and Best Neighbor Convenience Store (Dagang Store) on Zhenzhong Road.

name: Shower and relax
description: After returning home, I took a comfortable hot bath. After drying my hair, I connected my phone to a small speaker via Bluetooth and played soothing light music, and my whole body completely relaxed.
location: Room 502, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Video call with mother.
description: He called his mother on video. She was picking vegetables and her eyes crinkled into a smile when she saw him. He shared that the precision bushing he had made was praised by colleagues during the day, and also mentioned that the landlord was raising the rent. His mother, feeling sorry for him, advised him to rent a cheaper single room. He smiled and reassured her that his job was stable and she didn't need to worry, then changed the subject to ask whether the sausages he had sent had been received. After half an hour of chatting, he felt warm inside.
location: Living room, Room 502, No. 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: CNC macro program study
description: After hanging up, he went to the kitchen and took out the chicken breast for tomorrow's lunch to thaw in the refrigerator. Then he sat at the desk, opened the macro program chapter of CNC Programming and Machining Technology, forced himself to calm down, and worked through the special-shaped part program that Liu Zhiqiang had brought during the day on draft paper using macro variables. After confirming the details were feasible and writing them down in his notebook, he persisted with half an hour of focused study.
location: Desk in the bedroom, Room 502, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Teamed up with colleagues to play games.
description: When tired of studying, comrade-in-arms Zhang Jianguo invited me to play "Honor of Kings", so I teamed up with Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng in voice chat for two ranked matches, winning one and losing one. The hearty battle effectively relieved stress.
location: Sofa in the living room, Room 502, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Pre-sleep preparations and browsing housing listings.
description: After gaming, his mood fully calmed down. He took out a clean white T-shirt and camouflage shorts and placed them by the bed, set an alarm for 6:10 the next day, and planned a 6-kilometer easy run. Then he turned off the main light, leaving only the desk lamp, leaned against the pillow, opened the Beike Zhaofang app again, zoomed in on the floor plan of the 89-square-meter compact three-bedroom unit in Huaqiao that he had saved at noon, and browsed community reviews until he felt sleepy.
location: On the bed in Room 502, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: He turned off the desk lamp. Outside the window, cars occasionally passed on the water-covered road. He took a deep breath and exhaled distracting thoughts about the landlord raising the rent. Thinking about tomorrow's sound of machine tools and a controllable life rhythm, he felt reassured and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning washing up, breakfast, and browsing rental listings
description: At 6:40, the phone alarm went off. Realizing there was no morning run planned today, he stayed in bed for another ten minutes. After getting up, he threw on a jacket and went to the bathroom to wash his face with cold water, and much of the drowsiness from last night's rent increase faded. After washing up, he went to the kitchen, where the multigrain porridge prepared with the timer the night before was already cooked. He filled a bowl and ate it slowly with pickles, feeling warm in his stomach. After washing the dishes and chopsticks, he checked the work badge and access card he needed to bring to work. Before leaving, he remembered the landlord's rent increase news from yesterday, opened a rental app on his phone, quickly scanned the two-bedroom rents in several nearby communities, jotted down the approximate prices, and planned to look more closely on the weekend.
location: Room 303, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Commute to work by car
description: Put on my work jacket, grabbed the keys and car key, and went downstairs. I drove my car from Xingang Road, heading south along Kungang Highway, then turned right onto Huatianjing Highway. Traffic was normal, and I arrived at the gate of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory in about 15 minutes.
location: Along the route from Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road.

name: Arrival preparation and programming study exchange
description: After parking the car, I quickly walked into the workshop, clocked in, and changed into safety shoes and a safety helmet. I walked to the CNC machine tool I was responsible for, turned on the power, waited for the system self-check, inspected the cutting edge of the tool replaced yesterday, confirmed there were no chipped or worn edges, then started preheating the machine spindle. I also went to the material area to pick up the precision flange blanks to be processed today. During this time, I saw Team Leader Wang Lei assigning tasks, and Master Sun Jianguo guiding new apprentices beside him. During the spindle warm-up gap, I took the machining drawings and the programming draft drawn last Friday to Master Sun's workbench, pointed out a parameter in the G71 compound cycle command, and asked about optimizing the cutting depth to avoid chatter marks. Master Sun put on his reading glasses, looked at the drawings, analyzed two feed strategies based on his experience, and suggested being more conservative for the first trial cut. I carefully noted the key points.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Morning: precision flange machining.
description: After the machine tool finished warming up, he officially began machining. This batch of flanges had extremely high tolerance requirements (0.05 mm). He stayed fully focused while operating, and after completing each part, he immediately measured it with a vernier caliper and micrometer to ensure dimensional stability. Midway, his programming colleague Liu Zhiqiang passed by, and they chatted a bit about the new single-player game he was playing, S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2; he himself said he recently only played Honor of Kings. By around 11 o'clock, he had successfully completed the rough turning of the 15th flange, and the product pass rate was very high.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and midday entertainment and rest
description: At 11:30, he stopped the machine tool, briefly cleaned the chips, and asked Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang to go ahead to the cafeteria to save seats. He then went to the tool room for hot water, and ordered braised pork chop, tomato and egg, and greens with free soup in the cafeteria, costing 15 yuan. The three chatted while eating; Wang Lei complained that he had to go to his mother-in-law's house on the weekend to install cabinets. After the meal, they returned to the workshop rest area and quickly teamed up for ranked matches in Honor of Kings. In the first game, he played Hou Yi as the marksman, performed steadily, and won easily. In the second, they lost after meeting a strong enemy jungler. The two games ended around 12:48. Afterward, sipping water from his thermos, he leaned back in a recliner in the rest area and rested with his eyes closed for ten minutes.
location: Canteen and workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Afternoon flange machining and finishing
description: In the afternoon, when the work bell rang, he returned to the machine tool full of energy and continued machining the remaining flanges. With the morning's experience, the pace was smoother, and he figured that the batch could be finished that day. By around 16:30, all 25 flanges were completed. He measured the last few parts one by one, and after confirming that all dimensions were up to standard, he neatly stacked the finished products on the transfer rack. Then he cleaned the machine tool and carefully removed the chips, getting ready for the next day's work.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: After-work commute, supermarket shopping, and dinner.
description: At 17:00, clocked out from work on time. After driving out of the factory, remembering there was not much vegetable and eggs at home, he took a detour to the Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket. Parked, went inside, picked fresh Shanghai bok choy in the vegetable section, grabbed a box of eggs, and decided to buy a pack of frozen shrimp on promotion. The total came to 32 yuan. Arrived home at about 17:35, put things away, and started preparing dinner, deciding to make stir-fried noodles with greens and shrimp. Boiled water for noodles; in another pan, sautéed minced garlic, added the chopped Shanghai bok choy, stir-fried with light soy sauce and oyster sauce until soft, then mixed in the noodles. Finally topped the noodles with shrimp and scrambled eggs. While eating the noodles, he scrolled through short videos on his phone and also watched some CNC programming tutorials.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China, and Room 303, No. 6, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xingang Residential Area

name: Evening leisure in the living room.
description: After washing the dishes and chopsticks, he sat down on the living room sofa and turned on the TV to play a documentary at random. He picked up his phone and played a ranked solo match in Honor of Kings, using Luban No. 7 but ultimately losing.
location: Living room, Room 303, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Video chat with girlfriend Lin Yue and making a checklist for the trip home.
description: At 7:50 he walked into the bedroom, turned on the desk lamp, and adjusted the phone stand. At 8:00 sharp, Lin Yue's video call came in on time. He complimented her newly done glitter nail art. The two chatted about the weather and his sense of achievement in machining that day, and she also shared funny things that happened at the hot pot restaurant. He mentioned that he might run another long-distance run before the New Year. Lin Yue encouraged him as usual, and he asked about her customs for the Chinese New Year in Hangzhou. She enthusiastically introduced them and invited him to visit Hangzhou after the New Year. After about 40 minutes, Lin Yue hung up because she needed to prepare work materials for the next day. In a good mood, he opened the desk drawer, took out sticky notes and a pen, and carefully listed the things to bring home for the Spring Festival: thermal underwear for Dad, a scarf for Mom, Suzhou pastries for his older brother, and two cartons of cigarettes for his uncle. He also thought about whether to bring a toy for his little nephew. He stuck the list on the headboard as a reminder for weekend shopping.
location: Bedroom, Room 303, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: Washed up and relaxed his feet before going to bed.
description: After finishing the checklist, I got up and went to the bathroom to brush my teeth, wash my face, and wash my feet, then took off my work clothes and changed into pajamas. Remembering that my right ankle had been a bit sore and swollen the night before, I took an ice pack from the fridge and applied it for 10 minutes while sitting on the edge of the bed. Then I used a foam roller to gently roll out my calves and felt much more relaxed.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 303, No. 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Playing online games with comrades.
description: Just as he lay down in bed and picked up his phone, he saw Zhang Jianguo in the comrades-in-arms group saying they were short of players, so he replied to join. He teamed up with Zhang Jianguo, Zhou Xiaofeng, and a friend Zhou had brought for a ranked match. The early game was against them, but a perfect team fight in the mid game turned the situation around. They successfully staged a comeback and he took MVP, which put him in a great mood. After the match, he said he had to work the next day, exchanged goodnights, and quit the game.
location: Bedroom, Room 303, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: Relaxing before bed, reviewing the day, and going to sleep
description: After quitting the game, he turned off the main light and left only the bedside lamp on. He picked up his phone and glanced at the calendar—there was still some time before Spring Festival. He also opened the Shanghai Drifting Youth official account he followed and browsed an article about renting in Shanghai, thinking that he should look at more rental listings on the weekend. At 10 p.m. he set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning and put the phone on the nightstand. Turning on his side, he saw scattered lights from the residential complex outside the window and thought of today's video chat with Lin Yue, feeling calm. At 10:30 p.m. he switched off the bedside lamp, took a deep breath, and soon fell asleep with anticipation for Spring Festival and a sense of everyday contentment.
location: Bedroom, Room 303, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: Morning workout preparation and going to the sports center
description: After the 05:30 phone alarm rang, got up, drank some warm water, and did dynamic stretching warm-up in the living room. Then took the car keys and phone, went downstairs, and drove to Songjiang Sports Center.
location: From Room 306, Building 5, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Songjiang Sports Center, No. 145 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Interval run training at Songjiang Sports Center
description: After arriving at the track, completed warm-up exercises such as high knees and jumping jacks. At 06:00, started 6 sets of 800 m interval runs, each at a pace of about 5:30 per kilometer, with 2 minutes of slow walking rest between sets. After finishing, jogged to cool down and stretched. Total distance was about 8 km.
location: Track and Field at Songjiang Sports Center, No. 145 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove home, took a shower, and changed clothes.
description: After finishing training, drove back to Xingang Community. Once home, took a hot shower, changed into work clothes, and put the phone, work badge, keys, folding umbrella, etc. into the commuter bag.
location: Songjiang Sports Center, No. 145 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Room 306, Building 5, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Ate breakfast and packed a lunchbox for work.
description: Quickly finished the reheated multigrain porridge, two pork buns, and a boiled egg. At the same time, packed the lunchbox prepared last night (stir-fried pork with garlic sprouts, fried egg, rice) into an insulated lunch bag and put it into my commuter bag.
location: Room 306, Building 5, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving to the factory
description: Drove along Xingang Road and Guangfulin Road, then turned onto Huatianjing Road, arriving at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory in about 25 minutes. After parking in the parking lot, swiped a card to enter the workshop.
location: Lane 224, No. 1-246, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, Xingang Residential Community to No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory

name: Workshop pre-shift preparation and equipment inspection
description: Started the machine tool to warm it up, went through the inspection checklist item by item, and paid special attention to the spindle oil circuit and coolant tank. Found the coolant level was low. Went to the warehouse to get backup coolant and noted it on the equipment inspection record form.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Precision Flange Machining and Spindle Overheating Troubleshooting
description: At 08:30, he began precision machining of flanges according to the program. By 11:00, he had completed 7 pieces with acceptable dimensions. While machining the 8th piece, the machine tool alarmed that the spindle was overheating. He calmly investigated and found that the coolant level had dropped to the lower limit, causing insufficient circulation. After adding spare coolant and restarting the machine, the alarm cleared. Master Sun Jianguo happened to pass by and witnessed the whole process. He praised Yin Hao's independent problem-solving ability and added some precautions. Yin Hao then continued machining until the lunch break.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and informal chat with colleagues, plus a short midday rest
description: At 12:00, went to the cafeteria with team leader Wang Lei and master Sun Jianguo, shared the morning's troubleshooting experience, and Master Sun added his experience with cooling systems. After lunch, returned to the rest area, sent a message to girlfriend Lin Yue on his phone: "Today I fixed the machine tool independently and was praised by my master!" Received a happy emoji reply, then closed his eyes and rested for 10 minutes.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai: canteen and workshop rest area.

name: Continue flange machining, quality inspection, and workstation cleanup.
description: In the afternoon, he continued machining the remaining flanges and completed all 20 tasks. Each piece was checked for dimensional accuracy and passed. Then he cleaned the machine tools, tidied the workshop, filled in production reports, placed the finished products on the material shelf, and completed the shift handover records.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After work, went to Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop to hunt for second-hand tools.
description: At 17:00 he clocked out and drove along Huatianjing Road onto Rongle Middle Road, arriving at Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop at about 17:15. After explaining the purpose of his visit to Master Chen Jianguo, he found a secondhand soldering iron and paid 20 yuan for it. Master Chen gave him an old temperature controller and a small capacitor cabinet, and reminded him of soldering precautions. The two also spent half an hour talking about audio amplifier circuits over an old radio, and Yin Hao took his leave at 18:00.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, No. 138 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove home from the repair shop
description: Drove along Rongle Middle Road, turned onto Xingang Road, and returned to Xingang Residential Community after about 12 minutes.
location: Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, No. 138 Middle Rongle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Heated up dinner and browsed rental listings
description: I heated up the lunchbox prepared at noon in the microwave and made some seaweed and dried shrimp soup for dinner. While eating, I browsed rental listings in Songjiang New City on a rental app and marked 2 properties to visit in person on the weekend.
location: Room 306, Building 5, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Test the tools and organize the tool list for returning to the hometown.
description: Used a multimeter to test the new soldering iron and the old temperature controller that came with it, confirming they worked properly. In his phone notes, he listed the tools to take back to his hometown, including the soldering iron, solder wire, multimeter, etc., and added remarks.
location: Room 306, Building 5, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Contact friends and play online games
description: In the WeChat group “Songjiang Three Brothers”, he sent a message: “Brothers, who is free this weekend to go with me to look at houses in Songjiang New City? I just shortlisted two properties on the app.” Gao Zhiyuan replied that he had to work overtime on the weekend, and Ma Xiaofeng agreed to go together on Saturday. Afterward, he logged in to Honor of Kings and teamed up with friends to win a match, with Guan Yu performing outstandingly.
location: Room 306, Building 5, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video chat with girlfriend Lin Yue
description: During the video call, he shared the excitement of independently fixing the machine tool and showed the newly purchased electric soldering iron. Lin Yue shared funny stories from work and reminded him to keep warm as the temperature would drop over the weekend. They agreed to talk again on the weekend.
location: Room 306, Building 5, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: After washing up and soaking his feet to ward off the cold, he opened the rental app and carefully compared the layouts, amenities, and other details of the two listings, gradually making up his mind. He set an alarm for 5:30 the next morning, then briefly browsed a machine tool technology forum and local news.
location: Room 306, Building 5, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: Turned off the light, lay down, and quickly fell asleep with a sense of fulfillment and contentment.
location: Bedroom, Room 306, Building 5, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The alarm rang on time at seven. Yin Hao had not scheduled a morning run, so he stayed in bed a few more minutes to shake off drowsiness. After getting up, he quickly washed up and changed into gray work pants and a blue factory uniform jacket. Today was the last working day before Spring Festival, and he mentally planned to finish all the remaining work to make sure nothing was missed.
location: Room 203, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and departure.
description: Went out to the breakfast stall at the community entrance, bought two pork buns and a cup of hot soy milk, and quickly ate them while standing by the stall. Then walked to where the white Volkswagen Lavida was parked on the roadside, checked the tire pressure of all four tires, and after confirming everything was normal, started the car at 7:40 and drove to the factory.
location: Breakfast stall and roadside parking space at the intersection of Xingang Road and Sizhuan South Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute to work.
description: Yin Hao drove from Xingang Road via Sizhuan South Road onto Huatianjing Highway, heading to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. Traffic was light along the way. He listened to the morning news on a local radio station and learned that a cold front was about to move south, reminding himself to wear more clothes tomorrow. Fifteen minutes later, he arrived smoothly at the factory gate.
location: Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (inside a vehicle)

name: Deep maintenance of workshop equipment
description: Yin Hao arrived at the workshop early, changed into anti-smash safety shoes, and began deep maintenance on the machine tools before the holiday. First, he cut off the main power supply and thoroughly wiped the machine housings and control panels with cotton yarn. Then he used a brass brush to clean iron chips off the guide rails and lead screws. Finally, following standard procedures, he filled each lubrication circuit with new oil and checked the coolant level and filter. The whole process was meticulous, ensuring the equipment would run normally after the holiday.
location: No. 1 Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Tool organization and work wrap-up.
description: After the maintenance was finished, Yin Hao tidied his personal tool cabinet, putting wrenches, calipers, and blades back one by one. He also picked out badly worn blades, labeled them, and planned to replace them after the holiday. During this time, team leader Wang Lei came over to ask about the train home, and colleague Liu Zhiqiang talked about how his wife had prepared snacks for him to bring back to his hometown in Anhui. The work atmosphere was relaxed, and everyone chatted while finishing up.
location: No. 1 Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and short break.
description: Yin Hao and his mentor Sun Jianguo went to the employee cafeteria for lunch. That day there was braised pork chop and tomato scrambled eggs, and he piled his plate high. During the meal, Yin Hao offered his mentor early New Year greetings and thanked him for his guidance over the past year. Sun Jianguo reminded him to stay safe on the way home and also mentioned the possibility of an order for special-shaped air ducts after the holiday. After lunch, Yin Hao went back to the workshop rest area and sat on a chair with his eyes closed for twenty minutes.
location: Employee cafeteria and workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-holiday safety meeting and picking up New Year goods.
description: At the start of the afternoon shift, the workshop director called all operators to a pre-holiday safety meeting. He emphasized cutting off water and electricity during the holiday, fire and theft prevention, and personal travel safety. Yin Hao listened carefully and took notes. After the meeting, everyone lined up at the warehouse to sign and collect the company's New Year gifts. Each person received a bottle of non-GMO corn oil and a delicate dried-goods gift box, which was just right to bring back to his hometown.
location: Factory headquarters meeting room and warehouse, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Said goodbye to his mentor.
description: After picking up the New Year's goods and returning to Workshop No. 1, Yin Hao saw his mentor Sun Jianguo shutting down the machine tool. He solemnly shook hands with his mentor to say goodbye, thanked him again for his care over the past year, and agreed to treat him to a meal after the holiday. Master Sun also patted him on the shoulder and asked him to pass on his regards to his family. After saying goodbye, Yin Hao packed up the New Year's goods and got ready to leave work.
location: No. 1 Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the supermarket after work
description: After greeting his workshop colleagues, Yin Hao started the car and navigated to Tesco supermarket. The route followed Huatianjing Highway, turned onto Songzheng Highway, then passed Chenta Road, Minta Road, and Yunjian Road, taking about 28 minutes. He arrived at the supermarket parking lot at nearly 2:50 p.m.
location: Parking lot of Legou Wang Life Supermarket, No. 1, Lane 118, Yunjian Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Purchasing New Year goods, local specialties, and daily necessities.
description: Pushing a shopping cart, Yin Hao shopped according to his phone memo: first he picked up a Shanghai-style braised pork gift box and two boxes of time-honored Shanghai pastries, then found the dried Nantong clams his father wanted in the dried goods section, and chose butter cookies for his little nephew. At checkout, he ran into his colleague Wang Lei, and they recommended to each other osmanthus cakes and creamy spiced broad beans. He spent 420 yuan on New Year goods and local specialties. Although it exceeded his budget, he felt it was worth it. After checking out, he also grabbed a roll of trash bags and a 1.5-liter bottle of mineral water from the supermarket's household goods section, for his rental apartment and to drink on the way.
location: Tesco Wang Life Supermarket, No. 1, Lane 118, Yunjian Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai - food and grocery section, local specialties section, and household goods section

name: Returned home after shopping
description: Yin Hao put two large bags into the trunk. After checking that there were no new messages on his phone, he drove back to Xingang Community along Yunjian Road, Chenta Road, and Minta Road. As dusk deepened, the radio played Spring Festival travel news, and he looked forward to tomorrow's trip home. Arrived at his residence twenty-five minutes later.
location: Room 203, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Packing up and confirming transportation.
description: After returning to the rental apartment, Yin Hao changed out of his work clothes, laid out the New Year goods, toolbox, and clothes to take home, and sorted them into packages: he stuffed his work clothes and shoes into the suitcase, wrapped the fragile pastries in clothes and put them into the canvas backpack, and placed the tool bag separately. While packing, he opened the 12306 app to confirm the information for tomorrow's train G8282 again (Shanghai Hongqiao 7:48 to Nantong West 8:54), and sent the itinerary screenshot to his girlfriend and mother.
location: Living room and bedroom, Room 203, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Interacting with the friends group
description: Packing was temporarily done. Yin Hao sent a voice message in the "Songjiang Three Brothers" WeChat group, telling his friends that the stuff was packed, he would set off tomorrow morning, and after the New Year he would come back and treat them to a meal. Ma Xiaofeng instantly replied "Got it," and Gao Zhiyuan teased him not to eat all the local specialties. Yin Hao smiled and replied with stickers, feeling the warmth of friendship.
location: Living room, Room 203, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and video call preparation
description: Feeling hungry, Yin Hao took out the leftover stir-fried noodles with shredded pork and green peppers from the previous night, heated them in the microwave, and had them as dinner. While eating, he checked the packed luggage again; after confirming everything was in order, he sent a message to his girlfriend Lin Yue asking if she was free, and arranged to have a video call later.
location: Kitchen and living room, Room 203, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call parents to let them know he is safe.
description: Yin Hao made a WeChat video call home. His mother, Wang Xiuying, answered and, seeing the suitcase behind him, told him to dress warmly because it would get colder tomorrow. Yin Hao pointed his phone at the packed New Year goods, showing dried clams and pastries, and his mother laughed happily. His father, Yin Jianguo, leaned into the frame and his first question was whether Yin Hao had brought his tools, saying the water pump in the yard didn't sound right. Yin Hao smiled and replied that all the tools were in the toolbox, promising to fix it when he got home. Only then did his father nod in satisfaction.
location: Living room, Room 203, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video chatting with my girlfriend
description: Just as he hung up the phone call with his parents, a video call invitation from Lin Yue popped up. Yin Hao showed her the gifts he had prepared for his family. Lin Yue shared what happened at the company's annual meeting, confirmed the train time again, and reminded him to leave two hours early for Hongqiao Station the next morning. They talked for more than forty minutes, said goodnight, and agreed to get in touch after he arrived in Nantong the next day.
location: Bedroom, Room 203, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: After hanging up the video call, Yin Hao felt sleepy, so he went to the bathroom and took a hot shower to wash away the day's fatigue. Then, according to his usual habit, he checked that the main gas valve in the kitchen was off and the living room windows were locked, and dead-bolted the front door. Finally, he set the alarm for 5:30 the next morning and plugged his phone into the charger.
location: Bathroom and living room, Room 203, No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go to bed and sleep
description: Before 10 p.m., Yin Hao was already lying on the bed in the bedroom, turned off the lights and prepared to sleep. In the darkness, he thought about going home tomorrow to eat his mother's braised pork, feeling both excited and at ease. Everything had been completed according to plan with no mistakes. He felt content and soon fell asleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Room 203, No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wake up, wash up, and get ready
description: At 6:30 on Saturday morning, the alarm clock rang right on time. Although the sky outside the window was still dark, the weather forecast said it would be a nice day. After getting up, I went to the bathroom and splashed cold water on my face to wake myself up, changed into the quick-drying running T-shirt and shorts I had prepared last night, carefully checked my sports watch and earphones, and confirmed they had sufficient battery, getting ready for the morning run ahead.
location: Room 402, Building 6, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning run to maintain fitness
description: I set off at exactly 7:00 and jogged along Xingang Road to warm up, arriving at Xiaokunshan Health Park about 10 minutes later. There were not many people exercising in the park, and the air was fresh. I ran one out-and-back route as planned, about 8 kilometers in total, with a steady pace of around 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. After the run, I did several sets of stretches in the pull-up bar area. The soreness in my right ankle had completely disappeared, and I felt great. Finally, I jogged home, taking about 1 hour and 5 minutes in total.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, Songjiang District, Shanghai (running route: round trip from Xingang Residential Community to the park)

name: Breakfast and simple washing up.
description: After returning home, he first took a quick warm shower and changed into clean loungewear. Then he went into the kitchen, boiled two eggs, warmed a glass of milk, and took out the meat buns he had bought at the supermarket the day before and heated them in the microwave. While eating breakfast, he tossed the T-shirt and shorts he had worn for exercise into the washing machine and set the quick wash program to save time for tidying up the room later.
location: Room 402, Building 6, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Room tidying and second luggage check
description: After breakfast, started a deep cleaning before returning home. Used a mop to carefully mop the bedroom and living room floors, and wiped the bedside table, desk, and windowsill with a cloth. Watered the pothos on the windowsill, checked that all windows were tightly closed and the main gas valve was off. Then opened the suitcase that had been packed long ago, and checked item by item against the list Mom sent via WeChat last night: the special tool kit for repairing the water pump that Dad needs, a gift box of pastries from Shanghai, and several thick clothes for changing. After confirming everything was correct, zipped it back up.
location: Room 402, Building 6, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Researching Hangzhou trip details
description: Canteen and workshop rest area, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai
location: Room 402, Building 6, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Handle chores and reply in group chats
description: After resting for a while, I took out my phone to check WeChat. There were over 40 messages in the 'Songjiang Three Brothers' group. Lao Gao confirmed in the group that we would meet near Fozi Bridge Residential Community at 3 p.m. I replied 'Got it' and said I would bring a box of butterfly pastries. Ma Xiaofeng asked in the group whether we wanted to go practice driving together after the Spring Festival. I replied: 'Let's talk about it after the New Year. I'm going back to Nantong first. When I'm back, we'll arrange the practice venue.' After handling the group messages, I plugged both my phone and power bank in to charge, making sure the battery was sufficient.
location: Room 402, Building 6, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Clean-out-the-fridge lunch
description: At noon he took care of lunch by himself. He took out the leftovers from last night stored in the fridge—shredded pork with green peppers and half a plate of scrambled eggs with tomatoes—and boiled a handful of noodles, mixed everything together, and ate it all up, broth and all. After eating, he washed the dishes and chopsticks, and also wiped the kitchen stove clean, so that there would be no cleaning blind spots before returning home.
location: Room 402, Building 6, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Noon break
description: After lunch he felt a little drowsy, so he set an alarm for 2:45 p.m., drew the curtains, and slept on the bed for about 50 minutes. After waking up, he felt much more refreshed and had enough energy for the afternoon meeting with Lao Gao.
location: Bedroom, Room 402, Building 6, Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Get ready to go out and set off by bus.
description: In the afternoon, he changed into a clean jacket and jeans, and put on the pair of casual shoes that don't tire the feet on long walks. Before leaving, he took out the butterfly pastry gift box he bought last night from the fridge and put it into a paper bag. After checking the Amap, he walked from Xingang Community to the bus stop and took the Songjiang 16 bus (toward Songjiang Bus East Station). After riding for about 45 minutes, he got off at Guyang South Road Station.
location: From Xingang Road Bus Stop to Guyang South Road Bus Stop, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Songjiang Bus Route 16)

name: Walk to Lao Gao's home.
description: After getting off the car, I walked south along Guyang South Road. There were old plane trees along the roadside, giving it a strong sense of everyday life. After about a 10-minute walk, I arrived at Foziqiao Community, the old neighborhood where my old classmate Gao Zhiyuan lives. I called him downstairs, and he told me to go straight up; the address was Room 502, Unit 3, No. 40 Guyang South Road.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Foziqiao Community, No. 40 Guyang South Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner with Gao Zhiyuan to catch up
description: Lao Gao opened the door. His hair was a bit long, and he looked a little heavier than the last time we met. I handed him the butterfly pastries and said: Here, your sister-in-law's favorite. He smiled and gave me a punch on the arm. We sat on his old sofa, brewed a pot of tea, and caught up. He mentioned that he had been driving for Didi, with business up and down, and planned to switch to a better EV after the New Year. I also shared my plans to return to my hometown tomorrow and the good news that I was now with Lin Yue. We chatted until a little after 4 p.m., when he suggested trying the newly opened Anhui restaurant downstairs, and I gladly agreed.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Foziqiao Community, No. 40 Guyang South Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Have dinner with Gao Zhiyuan.
description: We came to the newly opened Anhui-style restaurant "Wannan Family" at the entrance of the community, ordered two signature dishes: stinky mandarin fish and diguo chicken, and also ordered a few bottles of beer. The two of us ate and chatted, from military careers to the TV dramas we had watched recently, and the atmosphere was lively. When it came to paying, Lao Gao insisted on covering the bill. I couldn't talk him out of it, so we agreed that next time I'd treat when back in Shanghai.
location: Wannan Renjia Restaurant near Foziqiao Community, South Guyang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returning to Xingang Residential Community and shopping
description: After saying goodbye to Lao Gao, he walked to the bus stop on Guyang South Road and took Songjiang Line 16 back to Xingang Community. After getting off, he stopped by the Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket near the community entrance on the way and bought tomorrow's breakfast — two bags of toast and a carton of milk. He got home at exactly 18:40.
location: From Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Community

name: Free time and preparation
description: After returning home, I put the bought food in the refrigerator. I opened my phone, organized the Hangzhou travel information and screenshots I had found today, and sent them all to 'File Transfer Assistant' on WeChat for easy access. I also checked the weather forecast again and confirmed that tomorrow in Nantong would be sunny, which put me in a great mood.
location: Room 402, Building 6, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Video call with Lin Yue
description: At 7:20 p.m., I initiated a WeChat video call. Lin Yue answered quickly, and her background was the bay window at her home. She smiled and said, "Are you planning your Hangzhou trip again?" I pointed my phone at the notebook on the table and showed her the draft itinerary I had made: "Preliminary plan is Saturday, February 15. At 7:47 a.m., I'll take the G7301 high-speed train and arrive at Hangzhou East at 8:52 a.m. Will you be free to pick me up?" She happily said no problem at all and asked how many days I planned to stay. We chatted for a full hour, from the itinerary to the TV series she had been following and the books she was reading. The atmosphere was relaxed and sweet.
location: Room 402, Building 6, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Finalized Hangzhou trip details
description: After the call ended, I felt content. I took out my phone and added the details of the Hangzhou trip that Lin Yue and I had just agreed on—the outbound train departure, the general sightseeing route, several lesser-known cafés she recommended, etc.—to my memo. Then I opened the calendar app and set an all-day reminder for February 15 with the title "Hangzhou Date". Before turning off the computer, I checked the 5:30 a.m. alarm for tomorrow once more.
location: Room 402, Building 6, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Wash up and final check.
description: First, put the clothes to wear tomorrow—jeans, a hoodie, and a soft-shell jacket—in the most convenient place in the wardrobe. Went to the bathroom and took a nice hot shower. After showering, turned off the main circuit breaker at home, leaving only the refrigerator powered. Checked the front door to make sure it was dead-bolted, ensuring the home was secure.
location: Room 402, Building 6, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Pre-sleep review and falling asleep
description: Turned off the lights and lay in bed. Reviewing the day: morning run, cleaning, planning, dinner with Lao Gao, video call with Lin Yue... All plans were completed, and I felt grounded. Tomorrow I'm heading back to Nantong, feeling both anticipation and a little reluctance. But I'm full of anticipation for the first formal date with my long-distance girlfriend. I closed my eyes amid the swirl of thoughts and gradually drifted off to sleep, ready for tomorrow's new journey.
location: Bedroom, Room 402, Building 6, Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wash-up and breakfast
description: At 7 a.m., Zhou Zheng was woken by his internal clock. The sky outside was gray, and the northeast wind moved the branches. He stepped barefoot on the cold floor, put on a padded jacket, and went to the bathroom to wash up. Then in the kitchen he toasted whole wheat bread until golden and fragrant, paired it with a glass of milk, and sat at the dining table eating while quickly browsing the day's weather forecast and traffic information on his phone, especially checking the expressway conditions toward Nanjing, to prepare for travel after the holiday.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving to the factory for work
description: Zhou Zheng put on his work jacket, picked up the canvas bag containing his work badge, charger, and a simple lunchbox, got his car from the ground parking lot at the community entrance, and drove the white family sedan he had owned for several years. He headed north on Xingang Road, turned left at the intersection with Guangfulin Road, drove west along Guangfulin Road, turned left at Chenta Road and drove south about 8 kilometers, then turned right onto Huatianjing Road. The whole trip took about 20 minutes. The sky was overcast and the roads were slippery, so he drove more steadily than usual.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-holiday equipment cleaning and sealing work
description: After arriving at the workshop, Zhou Zheng changed into clean work clothes and safety shoes. He first inspected the appearance and operating records of the 5632 CNC milling machine and, after confirming no one had operated it the night before, began sealing it up. He connected a water hose and carefully rinsed the chips and oil stains from the worktable surface and guide rails, used a small brush to clean the hard-to-reach corners, and wiped the spindle taper bore and tool holders with a lint-free cloth. Then, with the help of team leader Wang Lei, he fitted the dust cover evenly over the machine and sealed the edges with tape. Next, he opened his personal tool box, wiped clean each measuring tool such as calipers, micrometers, and ring gauges, applied anti-rust oil, and arranged them neatly. During this time, team leader Wang Lei and Master Sun Jianguo supervised from the side, while team member Xiao Liu assisted beside another machine.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Discussing post-holiday plans with Master Sun Jianguo
description: Master Sun Jianguo walked over with a file folder, and the two found a quiet corner. Master Sun spread out the drawings and pointed at the new batch of parts, explaining their tolerance grades and material changes, and reminded him to think about the clamping method and tool path in advance after the holiday. Zhou Zheng listened attentively and took down key points in his phone notes, such as "special fixture" and "coolant type," adding them to his electronic work log, and confirmed the list of special tools that needed to be prepared first when work resumed on February 5.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch at the factory canteen.
description: One by one, the machines in the workshop stopped. Zhou Zheng locked his tool box and went to the company canteen. That day it offered braised pork chop, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and sautéed seasonal vegetables. He got some rice, found a seat by the window, and ate quietly. The canteen was filled with a relaxed pre-holiday farewell atmosphere, with colleagues' laughter and chatter from time to time. After eating, he returned his tray to the collection point.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and route confirmation.
description: After the meal, Zhou Zheng walked to the rest area beside the workshop and sat down on a bench. He checked tomorrow's route in the navigation app on his phone, confirmed that some road sections had temporary detour notices due to construction during the Spring Festival, and marked them in his memo. Then he opened the WeChat chat with his girlfriend Lin Yue, saw the goodnight message she had sent last night, and replied with a red packet emoji. Next he tapped into the 'Songjiang Three Brothers' group chat and browsed the morning chatter; there was nothing special. Finally, he opened the running friends group, planned to send greetings later in the evening, then locked the screen and rested with his eyes closed for 10 minutes.
location: Rest area of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Workshop closeout and power confirmation
description: Back in the workshop, team member Xiao Liu was moving a ladder. Zhou Zheng went over to help, and together they closed and locked all the workshop windows. Then, holding a flashlight, he and electrician Master Li checked the main power switches, the main circuits of each machine tool, the lighting circuits, and the distribution box along the walls one by one, confirming that all non-essential power had been disconnected. Finally, he closed the lock on the main distribution box and signed the ‘Holiday Power-Off Confirmation Form’ at the door.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the auto repair center.
description: After informing the team leader in advance, Zhou Zheng changed back into his coat and drove away from the factory. Exiting onto Huatianjing Highway, he drove west along Shenzhuan Highway, turned onto Zhaochong Highway, and then onto Jiasong Middle Road. The whole trip was about 18 km. On the last day before the holiday, traffic was heavier than usual, but road conditions were still acceptable. He arrived at Zhiqiang Auto Care Center after nearly 30 minutes.
location: Zhiqiang Auto Maintenance Center, Jiasong Middle Road, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Full vehicle safety inspection
description: The car was put on the lift. Brother Wu did it himself, checking and inflating all four tires with a tire pressure gauge, and using a flashlight to confirm the front and rear brake pad thickness was normal. He pulled out the dipstick; the oil level and condition were good. He checked the coolant and washer fluid levels and added antifreeze washer fluid. He also did a full inspection of the chassis, lights, and battery voltage. While waiting, Zhou Zheng sat in the lounge reading a car maintenance manual, focusing on the parts related to tomorrow's long trip. After the inspection, Brother Wu said everything was normal. He paid an 80 yuan inspection fee, thanked him, and left.
location: Zhiqiang Auto Maintenance Center, Jiasong Middle Road, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Stop at the supermarket for groceries on the way
description: After leaving the auto repair center, Zhou Zheng drove back to Songjiang. The navigation guided him to pass by Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket on the way. He temporarily parked at the supermarket entrance, walked in quickly, and headed straight to the food section. He picked up two large bottles of mineral water, a bag of sliced white bread, a few ham sausages, and two packs of soda crackers, and also grabbed a bottle of energy drink to prevent drowsiness on the long drive. After paying, he put them on the passenger seat.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returning home and doing final packing of luggage
description: Drove back to the residential compound, parked the car, and Zhou Zheng carried the groceries and a tool bag taken from the car upstairs. After entering, he put things down; the suitcase in the living room was almost fully packed. He unzipped the side pocket of the suitcase and carefully placed in the car charger, driver's license, vehicle license, and ID card, then folded a spring jacket and put it in the main compartment. Then he squatted by the bed, took the auto insurance policy and spare battery for the highway ETC from the bedside table drawer, and tucked them into the inner pocket of his shoulder bag.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Rest and interact with running buddies.
description: After packing his luggage, Zhou Zheng felt sore all over and sat down on the living room sofa to rest for a while. He opened WeChat and saw that Chen Jie had sent a Spring Festival blessing red envelope in the 'Songjiang Runners Club' group. After he grabbed one, the group became lively. He privately messaged Chen Jie: "Happy Spring Festival! It's cold in my hometown. I plan to keep jogging, but my pace will probably drop to 7 minutes per kilometer. What about you?"
