Chen Jie quickly replied that he had many social engagements but reminded him to watch his diet, and agreed to run a 20-kilometer recovery run together on the first weekend after the holiday. Zhou Zheng sent a clenched-fist emoji to show his agreement.
location: Living room of Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Clean out the refrigerator and prepare dinner
description: He tied on an apron and began cleaning out the fridge. There was still half a pack of dried noodles in the cabinet, and in the refrigerator he found leftover greens, a ham sausage, and an egg. He cooked a pot of "bottom-of-the-barrel mixed noodles": after the water boiled, he added the noodles, and once they softened, he added the chopped greens and sliced ham sausage, then finally poured in the beaten egg, turned off the heat, and drizzled in sesame oil and light soy sauce. He carried a big steaming bowl of noodles to the table and slurped them up, feeling warm all over. After the meal, he washed the dishes and utensils, and wiped down the kitchen counter.
location: Kitchen, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Check the vehicle exterior and add windshield washer fluid
description: He took the car key and a clean cloth, went downstairs to his parking space. Zhou Zheng walked around the car and wiped the dust off the windows and side mirrors. He opened the door, started the engine, and saw the fuel gauge at three-quarters, enough to drive to Nantong tomorrow. He turned off the engine, opened the trunk, took out the newly bought antifreeze windshield washer fluid, and topped it up at the front of the car. He pressed each tire by hand and felt the pressure was normal. After confirming everything was fine, he locked the car and went upstairs.
location: Xingang Community Parking Lot, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with mother.
description: Zhou Zheng leaned against the headboard and made a WeChat video call to his mother, Wang Xiuying. On the screen, his mother was busy in the kitchen. She told him to be careful on the road and not drive too fast, and said that the quilts at home had been aired and that the Shanghainese braised pork he loved was already simmering. He told her he would arrive around noon the next day, and they also talked about the weather in his hometown and his elder brother's situation. His mother asked whether the pastries she had sent home yesterday had arrived, and he confirmed the package had been signed for that afternoon. They chatted for about half an hour until his father urged her to make dinner. His mother repeatedly reminded him to eat something before leaving.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Plan driving route and check the weather
description: After hanging up, Zhou Zheng used a weather app to check the three-day forecast for Nantong: sunny turning cloudy, temperature 1-8°C, with a northerly wind of force 4-5. He then opened the navigation app and entered the destination "No. 88 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province." The system recommended the Shenhai Expressway (G15) route, about 160 kilometers in total. He carefully checked the distribution of service areas along the route and marked the Rugao Service Area as the main rest stop. He also noticed a navigation alert that a section of the Shenhai Expressway had temporary construction and required a short detour on a national highway, so he saved a screenshot of the reminder.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wash up and sort out personal belongings.
description: He plugged his phone into the charger, went to the bathroom to take a shower, and put on clean thermal underwear. He neatly laid out the thick jacket, sweater, jeans, and a pair of lightweight sneakers he would wear the next day on the bench at the foot of the bed. From the desk drawer he took out a spare power bank and charging cable and put them into his shoulder bag. Then, in the living room, he opened the suitcase again and confirmed item by item by category: the tool kit for repairing the water pump was at the bottom, two boxes of Shanghai pastries were on top, clothes to change into were on one side, and documents and chargers were in the shoulder bag. Only after checking everything did he zip up the suitcase and lock it.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and pre-sleep confirmation.
description: Set the alarm for 5:30 tomorrow morning and put the phone into Do Not Disturb mode. Turned on the bedside lamp, did a final check that the doors and windows were closed and the gas valve was tightly shut, then turned off the living room and kitchen lights, leaving only the small night light in the bedroom on. Lying in bed, he felt the reassuring sense that everything was ready. He went over the morning's driving route in his mind and fell into a deep sleep a few minutes later.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waking up and a light meal
description: At 07:30 the alarm went off. Following the habit he developed in the military, he didn't lie in bed. He first did a set of push-ups and stretching to wake up his body. Then he washed up and shaved clean. In the kitchen, he used a steamer to heat up two pork buns bought yesterday, fried a soft-boiled egg in a frying pan, and paired it with a glass of hot milk. He finished eating within fifteen minutes and quickly washed the dishes and chopsticks.
location: Room 503, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Final luggage check and home safety inspection
description: Take out the prepared suitcase and backpack, and check item by item against the list in the phone memo: thermal clothing for parents, Nantong local specialties, ID card, car key, power bank, etc. Then carry out the "leaving-home check procedure": close and lock the windows in all rooms, unplug unused appliances such as the router and TV, and check that the water valve and main gas valve are off. Finally, combine kitchen waste and household waste into one garbage bag and place it at the door to take downstairs.
location: Room 503, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Neighbor New Year greetings and getting ready to go out
description: At 09:10, sent a New Year's greeting to my landlord Li Xiuying via WeChat: “Sister Li, happy New Year! I’m heading back to my hometown to celebrate the New Year now. I’ve checked the apartment and closed the doors and windows and turned off the water and electricity. I wish you and your family all the best in the new year!” Then I also sent greetings to Aunt Chen across the hall: “Happy New Year, Aunt Chen! I wish you good health and a smile that never fades!” I was in a great mood after receiving their replies. At 09:20, I put on my backpack, pulled my suitcase, and left home carrying a trash bag. After throwing out the trash in the bins downstairs, I stopped by the Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket at the entrance to the residential complex and bought a bottle of mineral water and a pack of gum in preparation for the trip.
location: Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road

name: Check the vehicle, load up, and set off
description: At 09:45, he arrived at the black sedan parked in a surface parking space in the residential complex. He first walked around the car to check the tire pressure and appearance, confirming that yesterday's maintenance at the repair shop was fine. He opened the trunk and neatly and securely placed the gifts for his parents, Nantong local specialties, and luggage. He got into the driver's seat and checked that the vehicle license, driver's license, and other documents were all in order. At 10:00, he started the engine and let it idle for two minutes to warm up while adjusting the navigation. At 10:05, he slowly drove out of the Xingang Residential Community gate and officially began his trip home.
location: Ground parking space, Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, Shanghai

name: Drive to Hongqiao Transportation Hub
description: At 10:05, he entered Xingang Road and, after a few traffic lights, entered the G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway from Songjiang Interchange at 10:20. Traffic was good today, slightly heavier than weekdays but not congested. Yin Hao turned on the FM radio and listened to music. Forty minutes later, he smoothly turned onto Hongyu Elevated Road following the navigation instructions. At 11:15, he arrived at the P9 parking lot entrance of Hongqiao Station and, following signs, drove to the long-term parking area. Since he had booked a long-term parking package on his phone, he paid by scanning a QR code at the exit and drove out smoothly, taking only five minutes longer than expected.
location: From Xingang Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai, via G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway and Hongyu Elevated Road, to P9 Parking Lot, Hongqiao Transportation Hub, Minhang District, Shanghai

name: Waiting for the train and lunch at Hongqiao Station.
description: At 11:40, he put the car keys securely into the inner pocket of his backpack, dragged his suitcase and backpack, and followed the signs for about 10 minutes to find the entrance to Hongqiao Station. He queued for security checks and identity verification, and walked into the spacious, bright departure hall around 11:55. On the electronic board he confirmed train G1676, departing at 13:30, at gate 15A. At 12:10, he found a Yonghe King and ordered a beef brisket rice set. He sat in a quiet spot, eating lunch while scrolling on his phone, and when he saw a gathering photo posted in the group chat by his childhood friend Zhang Wei, he gave it a like.
location: Departure level of Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station, southwest of the intersection of Shenhong Road and Yonghong Road, Minhang District, Shanghai

name: Ticket check and boarding.
description: At 13:10, the broadcast announced the start of boarding. Yin Hao followed the crowd through the ticket gates one by one, went down to the platform, and quickly located Car No. 6. At 13:25, he easily found his window seat, put his luggage on the luggage rack, sat down, and fastened his seat belt.
location: Shanghai Hongqiao Station, Gate 15A, and Carriage 6 of Train G1676

name: Returned home by high-speed rail.
description: At 13:28, the train departed on time. Yin Hao sat by the window, watching the view outside transition from dense city buildings to vast fields and scattered villages, his heart filled with the warmth of going home. There were not many passengers on the train. He put on noise-canceling earphones and listened to a few old songs, then took out the technical manual "CNC Machine Tool Programming and Operation" that he carried with him and read through two chapters in the quiet time. At 14:45, his phone vibrated. It was a WeChat message from his mother: "Son, are you almost here? Your dad has already driven to the station." He immediately replied: "Okay, Mom, I'll be there in about twenty minutes."
location: Train G1676 (Shanghai Hongqiao to Nantong West)

name: Station pickup and return home.
description: At 15:08, the train arrived at Nantong West Railway Station on time. Yin Hao followed the crowd through the underground passage to the exit. In the crowd, he spotted his father Yin Jianguo looking around outside the fence at a glance. He stepped forward quickly and called out, "Dad." His father took his suitcase, looked him up and down with a smile, and said, "A bit tanned, but more spirited." The father and son walked toward the P2 parking lot while chatting. His father drove an SUV, taking him along the Tongxi Expressway and Qiyang Expressway toward Rudong County. On the way, Yin Hao talked about his work in Shanghai and the vehicle machining tasks he had completed before the new year, while his father talked about the loquat tree in the old home's yard having bloomed quite a lot this year.
location: On the way from the exit and pick-up area of Nantong West Railway Station (Pingchao Town, Tongzhou District, Nantong City) via Tongxi Expressway and Qiyang Expressway to Juegang Town, Rudong County.

name: Arrive home and prepare the New Year's Eve dinner.
description: At 16:00, the car stopped in front of the family's two-story house with a yard. As soon as he walked in, his mother Wang Xiuying came out of the kitchen to greet him, wiping her hands on her apron and saying with a smile, “You’re finally back! Dinner will be ready soon.” Yin Hao gave his mother a warm hug, then carried his luggage up to his room on the second floor. At 16:30, he changed into comfortable loungewear and went downstairs to the kitchen. His mother was preparing a sea bass weighing more than two catties, and he willingly helped her peel garlic, trim scallions, and do odd jobs. His father laid out sunflower seeds, peanuts, and fruit on the living room coffee table. The aroma of braised pork drifted out of the kitchen, full of the flavor of the New Year.
location: First-floor living room and kitchen at home, No. 38 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Shared a reunion dinner.
description: 17:30, dinner was served. The table was full of rich dishes: steamed sea bass, braised pork belly, sweet and sour pork ribs, clams steamed with egg, garlic broccoli, and a steaming pot of free-range chicken soup. Yin Hao took out the Shikumen yellow rice wine he had brought back from Shanghai and poured some for his father, while he poured himself a glass of cola. His father asked about the specific details of his work, such as the model upgrade of the CNC machine tools and the payment of the year-end bonus, and Yin Hao answered each one in detail. His mother kept putting food on his plate, saying, “Eat more; you don’t eat well when you’re away.” The family chatted while eating, in a warm atmosphere.
location: First-floor dining room at home, No. 38 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Rest and gift-giving after the meal.
description: At 18:45, after dinner, Yin Hao voluntarily cleared the table, sorted the leftovers into containers and put them in the fridge, then washed the dishes and chopsticks clean and put them back in the cupboard. At 19:00, he opened his suitcase and took out gifts for his parents: a fleece-lined thermal vest for his father, and a plain cashmere scarf and a pair of soft-soled cotton slippers for his mother. His father said, “What a waste of money—I’m not short of clothes,” but he couldn’t hide the smile on his face and immediately tried it on. His mother quickly put on the scarf and looked at herself in the mirror again and again, saying, “It’s warm and pretty.” After that, the three of them curled up on the sofa watching TV and chatting about relatives back home.
location: Living room on the first floor of home, No. 38 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province

name: Online communication and New Year greetings
description: At 19:45, Yin Hao returned to his room on the second floor and first sent a WeChat message to his childhood friend Zhang Wei: 'Wei, I've arrived home safely. Let's get together after the New Year!' Zhang Wei replied instantly: 'No problem, we'll catch up over a good drink then!' Afterwards, he sent a voice message in his comrade-in-arms group: 'Brothers, happy New Year! I've arrived safely in Rudong, so I'm wishing you an early New Year!' Then he sent private red envelopes to his fellow soldiers Zhang Jianguo and Lao Gao and Da Liu, and both immediately replied with thanks and blessings. At 20:20, he sent a message to his elder brother Yin Tao, who was in Suzhou: 'Bro, I'm home. Mom and Dad are both fine, don't worry.' His brother replied: 'Got it. I plan to bring your sister-in-law and Xiaobao back on the second day of the New Year.'
location: His own room on the second floor of the house at No. 38 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province.

name: Settling in and preparing to rest
description: At 20:45, Yin Hao took out his toiletry bag from the suitcase and went to the bathroom to enjoy a hot shower, washing away the fatigue of the day's journey. He changed into dry pajamas, returned to his bed with fresh sheets, and the familiar warm scent relaxed him. Lying in bed, he turned on his phone and sent a message to his friend Lin Yue: “Home at last! Happy New Year!” Then he set the alarm for 9 a.m. tomorrow (January 28) and plugged his phone into the charger. At 21:15, he turned off the lamp, closed his eyes, listened to the faint sound of firecrackers outside the window, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: His own room on the second floor of the house at No. 38 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province.

name: Get up, do morning exercise, and wash up
description: Waking up in the early morning, he did push-ups and stretching exercises on the bedroom floor on the second floor of his hometown home in Rudong, maintaining his military habit. Then he went to the bathroom on the first floor to wash up, splashing cold water on his face to refresh himself, ready to start a new day.
location: Second-floor bedroom and first-floor bathroom at home, No. XX Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Help mother dust and clean the windows.
description: Helped mother Wang Xiuying with the Spring Festival Eve cleaning. First swept up the fallen leaves and dust in the courtyard, then carefully cleaned the glass windows of the main hall using a damp cloth and dry newspaper, making the windows look as good as new. Through the clean glass, the loquat tree in the corner of the courtyard was visible, as preparations for the New Year were made.
location: The courtyard and main room at No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province.

name: Inspect and repair the water pump
description: Yin Hao noticed an odd noise from the old water pump in the corner of the yard. Inspection showed the seal ring had aged and the impeller had sediment, causing poor water flow. He found a new oil seal from the toolbox, skillfully disassembled the pump casing, cleaned the impeller, replaced the seal, and reassembled it. With help from his father Yin Jianguo, he connected the power and tested the pump; it resumed normal operation with smooth water flow. Neighbor Uncle Li passed by and praised Yin Hao for being clever with his hands.
location: At the water pump in the family courtyard, No. XX Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Organized tools and called his father to talk.
description: After finishing the repair, Yin Hao put the tools away and returned them to the bedroom on the second floor. Then, in the main room, he called his older brother Yin Tao, who was in Suzhou, and confirmed his plan to bring his family home on the second day of the Chinese New Year. His father, Yin Jianguo, sat nearby. Yin Hao reported that the water pump had been fixed, and his father was very pleased. During the conversation, his father mentioned examples of people in the village selling their houses to buy homes for their children. Yin Hao said he could handle it himself and told his father not to worry. They also talked about plans to prune the loquat tree in the yard.
location: Ground-floor main hall of the home at No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Helped my mother prepare the New Year's Eve dishes
description: In the kitchen, he helped his mother, Wang Xiuying, prepare ingredients for the New Year's Eve dinner. His mother was chopping meat filling to make dumplings and wontons, and also frying tofu balls. Yin Hao helped peel garlic and trim scallions. His mother, feeling for him not eating well outside, let him taste the just-fried balls. The seasoning was just right. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of food and family warmth.
location: Home Kitchen, No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province

name: Simple lunch
description: We had a simple meal at noon. Mother cooked chicken noodle soup with freshly fried tofu balls. The family of three ate in the kitchen or the main hall, saving room for the New Year's Eve dinner. After the meal, Yin Hao voluntarily washed the dishes to share the household chores.
location: Home kitchen/main hall, No. XX Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Noon break
description: Returning to the second-floor bedroom, he drew the curtains and lay down on the old wooden bed for a nap. Sporadic firecrackers from outside and the sound of his mother chopping vegetables downstairs created a reassuring atmosphere. He set an alarm, slept soundly through the afternoon nap, and saved energy for the afternoon's activities.
location: Second-floor bedroom of the home at XX Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province.

name: Putting up Spring Festival couplets and tidying the courtyard corner
description: After the lunch break, Yin Hao and his father put up Spring Festival couplets together. They brought over a ladder, brushed paste on the courtyard gate and the main hall door frame, and his father aligned the couplets. They put up the couplet reading 'The spring breeze enters the home to announce peace; auspicious air fills the door to add a hundred blessings' along with the 'fu' character. The black characters on red paper added a strong festive atmosphere. Afterwards, the two neatly arranged the clutter left from repairing the water pump and swept the courtyard, making the home tidy for the New Year.
location: The front door of the family hall and the courtyard, No. XX Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Helping in the kitchen by wrapping wontons
description: Yin Hao washed his hands and entered the kitchen to make wontons with his mother. His mother taught him hand by hand how to fold ingot-shaped wontons, and it took him a few tries before they looked right. While wrapping, he listened to his mother tell stories about celebrating the New Year when she was a child. In the kitchen, the red-braised pork simmering in the clay pot bubbled and gave off a rich aroma, making the New Year atmosphere even stronger.
location: Home Kitchen, No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province

name: Went to the town to buy firecrackers and fireworks.
description: As the sky grew dark, Yin Hao put on his down jacket and rode his father's electric bike to the Rudong County Supply and Marketing Cooperative fireworks specialty store in the middle section of Renmin Road, Juegang Town. He picked out a string of long firecrackers, a few double-bang firecrackers, and some sparklers, spending more than 70 yuan in total to prepare for staying up on New Year's Eve.
location: Middle Section of Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (Rudong County Supply and Marketing Cooperative Fireworks and Firecrackers Specialty Store)

name: Change clothes and rest
description: After buying the firecrackers, he went home and placed the firecrackers and fireworks in a dry corner of the yard. He went upstairs to the second-floor bedroom, changed into a clean dark jacket, tidied himself up, rested for a while, and waited for the New Year's Eve dinner.
location: Home at No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province

name: Father and son having a drink at the New Year's Eve dinner
description: It was completely dark outside, and the house was brightly lit. The large round table in the main room was covered with a sumptuous New Year's Eve dinner: braised pork, steamed sea bass, fried tofu meatballs, cold dressed jellyfish, chicken soup, and wontons made by the whole family. His father Yin Jianguo opened a bottle of Rudong old wine and poured a small half glass for Yin Hao. Yin Hao toasted his father and talked about learning five-axis machining at the factory. After a few rounds of drinks, his father brought up selling the old house to help subsidize buying a new one. Yin Hao seriously stated that he could save up to buy a house on his own and that his parents did not need to worry. The New Year's Eve dinner lasted nearly an hour and a half, and the atmosphere was warm and candid.
location: Home main hall, No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Helped my mother tidy up the kitchen.
description: After the New Year's Eve dinner, Yin Hao volunteered to take on the cleanup. He put on an apron, collected the dishes and chopsticks into the kitchen, washed the dishes, and wiped the stove, moving quickly. His mother watched nearby, reminded him to be careful with a pleased look, and enjoyed the moment of her son sharing the housework.
location: Jiangsu Province, Nantong City, Rudong County, Juegang Town, No. XX Renmin Road, home kitchen and main room

name: Watching the Spring Festival Gala and chatting with my mother.
description: A family of three sat on the sofa in the main room watching the Spring Festival Gala. His mother, Wang Xiuying, took the opportunity to ask Yin Hao about his relationship status in Shanghai. He hinted that he had just met a girl and they got along well. When his mother pressed for details, Yin Hao shyly changed the subject, took out his phone to send greetings to his comrades, and deftly avoided further questioning.
location: Home main hall, No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Sending New Year greetings and interacting with friends on the phone
description: With the Spring Festival Gala playing in the background, Yin Hao used his phone to send New Year greetings to family and friends. First, he sent red envelopes in the childhood friends group; Zhang Wei and other childhood friends replied by voice message about getting together after the New Year. Then he sent blessing messages to his comrades-in-arms, including Zhang Jianguo, Lao Gao, and Da Liu. At 9:30, he returned to the bedroom on the second floor and sent New Year wishes and a sticker to Lin Yue, a girl he had recently met, and received a reply. After that, he scrolled through the lively WeChat group chats, waiting for midnight to arrive, feeling the mix of modern and traditional ways of ringing in the New Year.
location: Jiangsu Province, Nantong City, Rudong County, Juegang Town, No. XX, Renmin Road, family main hall and second-floor bedroom

name: Staying up late on Chinese New Year's Eve, setting off firecrackers, then washing up and going to bed
description: Near midnight, Yin Hao and his father Yin Jianguo went to the center of the courtyard. When CCTV's countdown reached zero, they lit a long string of firecrackers, and the crackling sound rang through the night sky. Then they set off double-bang firecrackers and fireworks, and the colorful light illuminated the old house and his parents' faces as the family welcomed the New Year together. After setting off the firecrackers, Yin Hao washed his face and brushed his teeth with cold water, returned to his second-floor bedroom, and fell asleep with the warmth of family reunion and thoughts about the future.
location: Home courtyard, first-floor bathroom, and second-floor bedroom at XX Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province.

name: Got up, exchanged New Year's greetings, and had breakfast
description: After the phone alarm went off, Yin Hao woke up and went downstairs, first paying New Year greetings with auspicious words to his mother, who was busy in the kitchen, and his father, who was smoking in the yard. His mother handed him a piece of kai kou gao, to bring the good omen of rising step by step. Then Yin Hao helped his mother scoop out two bowls of shepherd's purse and pork wontons; the soup base had lard, chopped scallions, and light soy sauce. The family sat around the square table in the main room eating breakfast and chatting about the day's plans.
location: Kitchen and main hall of the old home, No. XX Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Morning jog and a chance encounter with a childhood friend
description: After breakfast, Yin Hao returned to his room, changed into dark sportswear and running shoes, put on fleece-lined cycling gloves, and did some simple joint exercises and stretching in the yard. He then jogged along the familiar country lane at a steady pace. After running about 2 kilometers, he met his childhood friend Zhang Wei at the fork in the road leading to town. Zhang Wei was riding an electric bicycle to buy breakfast. Yin Hao encouraged him to get off and run together to lose weight. Zhang Wei locked his electric bicycle and reluctantly followed for about 2 kilometers. The two chatted about how they had been doing while running, and agreed to have lunch together today. After the run, Yin Hao returned home.
location: Village roads and the town-link road in XX Village, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Returning home to stretch and preparing to go out
description: After finishing his run, Yin Hao returned home, washed his face at the faucet in the courtyard, and went back to the main room, where he stretched and relaxed his calves while chatting with his mother about encountering Zhang Wei. Afterwards, he went upstairs, took a quick hot shower, changed into clean dark casual pants and a down jacket, checked his phone, wallet, and handbag, and double-checked the gift list his mother had reminded him of: cigarettes for his uncle, chocolates for his female cousin, and a souvenir gift for Zhang Wei.
location: Main hall and second-floor room of the old family home, No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Gift shopping at the supermarket
description: Yin Hao drove about 10 minutes to Juegang South Market and parked in the parking lot. The market was bustling with people. He pushed a shopping cart through Haorunduo Supermarket and made purchases as planned: bought a pack of "Red Nanjing" cigarettes for his uncle, got a box of Ferrero Rocher chocolates and a pack of local dried clams for his cousin, and picked out a purple clay tea canister in the premium section as a gift for Zhang Wei. Waiting in line to check out took nearly half an hour, and the total came to about 380 yuan.
location: Juegang South Market, Renmin South Road, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (Haorunduo Supermarket)

name: Return trip and kitchen help
description: Yin Hao drove home and carried the purchased gifts into the main room. Seeing his mother busy picking vegetables and preparing braised dishes, he rolled up his sleeves to help: he brought over a small stool to peel garlic cloves, and also arranged the fried tofu balls made yesterday on a plate. Near 11 o'clock, he sent Zhang Wei a WeChat message asking about the lunch location and time.
location: Kitchen of the family home, No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province.

name: Meet a childhood friend for lunch
description: After receiving Zhang Wei's reply, Yin Hao said goodbye to his parents, took the gifts, and drove his father's van. Ten minutes later, he arrived at the 'Xianghe Xiaocai' restaurant at the crossroads in Juegang Town. At the meal, the four of them ordered braised lamb, stir-fried shrimp, garlic pork slices, and clay-pot stewed mixed fish. Halfway through the meal, Zhang Wei announced that he would get married on the sixteenth day of the twelfth lunar month at the end of the year, and invited Yin Hao to be his best man. Yin Hao agreed immediately, then opened the memo app on his phone and roughly discussed the route and process for picking up the bride with Zhang Wei, noting down a few key practical matters.
location: The small private room on the second floor of 'Xianghe Xiaocai' on Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Post-meal walk, photo taking, and returning home
description: After the meal, a group of young people strolled around the small square in the town center. Zhang Wei talked about embarrassing childhood stories, and everyone laughed and playfully punched one another. Yin Hao took a group photo and sent it to the childhood-friends group chat, then said goodbye to his friends and drove home.
location: Central square of Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province, and the way home.

name: Noon break
description: After returning home, Yin Hao took off his jacket, leaned against the bed, and scrolled through short videos on his phone for a while, then fell into a deep sleep and took a short nap.
location: Room on the second floor of the old family home, No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: At home, welcomed neighbors paying New Year visits and dealt with being urged to get married.
description: At a little past two in the afternoon, neighbor Aunt Zhang and her husband came over for a New Year visit. Mother warmly received them, and the conversation quickly turned to Yin Hao's personal life. She lamented that at 24 he was still single in Shanghai. Yin Hao smiled helplessly and changed the topic by offering tea and sunflower seeds. Later, neighbor Uncle Chen happened to pass by, and Father invited him in for tea. Everyone then talked about work and buying a house. Yin Hao responded politely, and though he felt somewhat troubled inside, he understood his parents. In the evening, after the guests left, Yin Hao helped his parents clean up the ashtrays and nut shells.
location: The old family house's main hall and small courtyard at XX Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Helped mother prepare dinner
description: Yin Hao put on an apron to help his mother in the kitchen. He trimmed a handful of tender spinach and re-steamed the leftover shepherd's purse wontons from breakfast as the staple for dinner. While cutting vegetables, his mother reminded him that his cousin would call tonight, and Yin Hao said he remembered.
location: Kitchen of the family home, No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province.

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was a simple meal of four dishes: spinach mixed with vermicelli, braised beef, clear simmered young hen soup, and steamed shepherd's purse wontons. At the table, Father asked about the afternoon chat with Zhang Wei. Yin Hao half-jokingly mentioned being a groomsman, and Father reminded him that when a friend gets married, you should contribute money and effort and not lose face.
location: Old family home main hall, No. XX Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province.

name: After-dinner activities and watching dramas
description: After helping his mother clear the table, Yin Hao returned to his second-floor room and sent a 30-yuan lucky red packet in both the childhood-friends group and the comrades-in-arms group. The groups immediately became lively, with everyone exchanging New Year greeting messages. Then he opened a popular police drama and watched two episodes in a row to relax.
location: Room on the second floor of the old family home, No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Answered a phone call from my older female cousin.
description: The phone rang; Cousin Chen Xiaowen made a video call to wish him a Happy New Year. After exchanging New Year greetings, they talked about their respective jobs. Yin Hao invited her to meet for lunch in the county town the next day. Chen Xiaowen readily agreed, and they arranged to meet at 11:00 the next morning. After hanging up, Yin Hao was in a good mood—his plans for the next day were settled.
location: Balcony of the second-floor room of the old home, No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Personal time (budget tracking and planning)
description: Yin Hao opened the mobile bookkeeping app and recorded today's expenses for buying gifts and his share of the lunch gathering. While browsing his memos, he reorganized the key points of being a groomsman at Zhang Wei's wedding and noted that he needed to buy formal wear and arrange the wedding car in advance. Afterwards, he sent a text message saying 'Happy New Year' to his Shanghai landlord, Li Xiuying.
location: Room on the second floor of the old family home, No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Washing up and body relaxation
description: Before washing up, Yin Hao soaked his feet in a basin of hot water for ten minutes to relieve the fatigue of the day. Then he carefully brushed his teeth, washed his face, applied face cream, and changed into clean cotton pajamas.
location: Bathroom at the old family home, No. XX Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Checking doors and windows and getting ready for bed
description: After getting into bed, Yin Hao set his phone alarm (wake up at 7:30) and turned off the bedside lamp. In the quiet rural night, listening to the occasional distant barking of dogs, he gradually fell asleep.
location: Room on the second floor of the old family home, No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Wake up, wash up, and have breakfast
description: Yin Hao woke up at his hometown home, No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province. After washing up briefly, he went downstairs. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared breakfast, including hot porridge, home-pickled radish, and meat buns steamed the night before. His father, Yin Jianguo, was sorting out gifts at the courtyard gate. Yin Hao had two bowls of porridge and one bun, and chatted with his parents about the New Year atmosphere in the village.
location: No. XX Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Check the gifts and get ready to leave
description: After breakfast, Yin Hao and his mother checked the gifts prepared the day before: Red Nanjing cigarettes and a purple clay tea caddy for his maternal uncle Chen Zhigang, and Ferrero Rocher chocolates for his cousin Chen Xiaowen, making sure the packaging was intact. His mother gave Yin Hao a jacket and told him not to catch cold. At exactly nine o'clock, his father started the car, and the three prepared to leave.
location: No. XX Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Drove to his maternal uncle's house.
description: Yin Hao set out from his hometown with his parents and drove to his maternal uncle's home. His father drove an old-model Santana along Renmin Road and Jianghai Middle Road, about 7 kilometers in total. There was not much traffic on the road. Yin Hao sat in the back seat looking at the street outside the window. His mother mentioned that his aunt had already prepared dishes, and his father reminded him to talk less and listen more when the elders chatted at the relatives' home. Passing a lively convenience store on the way, Yin Hao remembered that the fireworks were still in the trunk.
location: On the way from Renmin Road to Renmin South Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province

name: Arrive at maternal uncle's home to pay New Year's greetings and exchange pleasantries.
description: Yin Hao's family arrived at Uncle Chen Zhigang's home at No. XX, Renmin South Road. Uncle and cousin Chen Xiaowen greeted them at the door. Yin Hao handed over gifts and paid New Year's greetings to his uncle and aunt, wishing them good health. After going inside, Aunt Li Fang served melon seeds, fruit, tea, and snacks, and everyone sat down to chat. The uncle asked about his father's agricultural machinery station, and the cousin asked about Yin Hao's CNC machine tool work in Shanghai.
location: Uncle's home at No. XX, Renmin South Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Family reunion dinner and a deep conversation between siblings
description: Lunch was held at the restaurant in his uncle's home, with a rich spread of Nantong specialties including braised Langshan chicken, steamed clams, puffer fish in white sauce, and stir-fried swimming crab. Yin Hao sat next to his cousin Chen Xiaowen, while his father and uncle drank yellow wine. During the meal, Chen Xiaowen asked in detail about Yin Hao's CNC machine tool work, and Yin Hao revealed his intention to pass the senior technician certification. His cousin shared her promotion experience from a grassroots position to project manager, advised him to study CNC programming and intelligent manufacturing technology more deeply, and recommended online learning platforms. Yin Hao felt enlightened and benefited greatly.
location: Uncle's Home (restaurant), No. XX, Renmin South Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province.

name: After-dinner tea chat and responding to family concern
description: After dinner, Yin Hao helped his older female cousin clear the tableware, and then everyone went back to the living room for tea. His father and maternal uncle talked about the demolition of their hometown and the fact that Yin Tao's family would be coming back tomorrow. His aunt Li Fang and his mother wanted to introduce Yin Hao to the daughter of a teacher in town. Yin Hao politely declined, citing his preparation for the senior technician certification exam, and his cousin supported him, agreeing that career should come first. While the aunt and mother went to the kitchen to get fruit, the cousin quietly asked Yin Hao about his WeChat profile picture being changed to a cartoon image of a girl. Somewhat embarrassed, Yin Hao admitted he had just met a girl from Hangzhou and it wasn't settled yet, and asked his cousin to keep it a secret.
location: Uncle's home (living room), No. XX, Renmin South Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Tea chat ended, returned home.
description: At 3:30 p.m., Yin Hao's family said goodbye, and his uncle and cousin saw them off. His cousin added Chen Xiaowen on WeChat and they agreed to stay in touch after returning to Shanghai. On the drive back, his father asked Yin Hao what he thought of his cousin's advice, and his mother was very pleased and told her son to learn more from her. Yin Hao felt he gained a lot and was in a good mood.
location: On the way from Renmin South Road to Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Resting at home and organizing career plans
description: After returning home, Yin Hao went back to his bedroom on the second floor but didn't rest right away. He opened the memo app on his phone and organized his cousin's advice into notes: Goal — sign up for the senior technician vocational skill certification exam in the second half of the year; Path — study FANUC system programming and macro programs in depth and follow industrial robot integration cases; Platform — register an account on the mechanical community forum and follow relevant WeChat official accounts. He felt his career plan was becoming clearer.
location: Old home (second-floor bedroom), No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Dinner and family time
description: Mother made a simple dinner with the dishes brought back at noon and ingredients at home. After dinner, the family of three sat in the living room watching a rerun of the local Spring Festival Gala. Father talked about whose child in the village had passed the civil service exam, while Mother calculated the dishes to prepare for the return of older brother's family tomorrow. Yin Hao, while watching TV, sent a WeChat message to his brother Yin Tao to confirm that he would arrive home around 3 p.m. tomorrow.
location: Hometown home at No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (dining room, living room)

name: Plan best man duties and personal study
description: After watching TV, Yin Hao went upstairs to his bedroom. Remembering his childhood friend Zhang Wei's wedding, he created a new memo titled 'Best Man Plan' and wrote down: plan to have the formal suit custom-made in Shanghai, with a budget within 1,500 yuan; reserve 2,000 yuan for the cash gift; confirm with Zhang Wei the times for the bridal procession and rehearsal. Then he opened a professional learning website, registered as a member, and browsed several free introductory programming courses, feeling motivated.
location: Old home (second-floor bedroom), No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Wash up, record thoughts, and go to bed.
description: At nine in the evening, after washing up, Yin Hao wrote his thoughts in his diary, expressing confidence in his plan to take the senior technician exam, his preparations for being a best man, and his expectation of his older brother's family returning home tomorrow. At ten, he turned off the light and went to bed, falling asleep to the sound of sporadic fireworks outside the window.
location: Old family home, No. XX Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: The 06:30 alarm went off on time. Yin Hao got up briskly, splashed his face with cold water to refresh himself, and put on a navy blue down jacket. Then he went downstairs to the kitchen, where his mother, Wang Xiuying, had already prepared rice porridge. Yin Hao served himself some porridge, along with pickled vegetables and shredded radish buns. While eating, he told his mother he would be meeting a childhood friend in the afternoon, and she softly urged him not to drink too much.
location: Yin Residence, Shuanggang Village, Hekou Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Helping with food preparation and household chores
description: After breakfast, Yin Hao took the initiative to help his mother prepare ingredients for his elder brother's return tomorrow. He slaughtered the free-range chicken, trimmed and washed baby greens and spinach, and also wiped the living room window glass. During a break, he checked the weather on his phone and confirmed there would be no rain in the afternoon.
location: Yin Residence, Shuanggang Village, Hekou Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Confirm the itinerary in the childhood friends group chat
description: Yin Hao sent a message in the 'Iron Triangle' WeChat group to confirm the afternoon gathering arrangements: arriving at Zhang Wei's home at two o'clock, then picking up Li Qiang. The KTV and dinner were already booked. Zhang Wei replied 'OK', and Li Qiang confirmed with a sticker.
location: Yin Residence, Shuanggang Village, Hekou Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Career planning study and note organization
description: Back in his bedroom, Yin Hao went over the learning path his older female cousin had suggested and decided to sign up for the senior technician exam in the second half of the year and study FANUC system programming in depth. He searched technical forums and bookmarked tutorial links, planning to study systematically after returning to Shanghai.
location: Second-floor bedroom, Yin Residence, Shuanggang Village, Hekou Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Had lunch early and contacted his older brother.
description: Because the afternoon schedule was tight, Yin Hao and his mother had lunch early, including braised fish and stir-fried pork with garlic sprouts. During the meal, he sent a WeChat message to his elder brother Yin Tao to let him know he would be going out for a gathering in the afternoon, and felt reassured after receiving a reply that his brother had already set off and expected to be home by 3 p.m.
location: Yin Residence, Shuanggang Village, Hekou Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Afternoon preparation and gift wrapping.
description: After the meal, Yin Hao changed clothes, checked his phone, power bank, wallet and other belongings, and packed the shredded radish spring rolls his mother had fried, planning to bring them to his childhood friend.
location: Yin Residence, Shuanggang Village, Hekou Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: I walked to Zhang Wei's home and had a conversation.
description: At 12:30 Yin Hao left the house and walked ten minutes along the village road to Zhang Wei's home. The two chatted over tea in the living room, and Yin Hao offered fried spring rolls. Zhang Wei explained in detail the best man duties: picking up the bride, door-blocking games, the hotel ceremony, and the process of helping him drink toasts at the dinner. Yin Hao noted everything down and asked about the wedding rehearsal. Zhang Wei patted him on the shoulder and said that with the two of them working side by side, the wedding was sure to go smoothly.
location: Zhang Wei's home, Shuanggang Village, Hekou Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Pick up Li Qiang and go to KTV
description: Zhang Wei rode an e-bike with Yin Hao as a passenger. On the way, they stopped at the town supermarket to buy snacks such as cola and potato chips, then went to Fumin Lane to pick up Li Qiang. Afterward, the three rode e-bikes together to Ailedi KTV in the town center, arriving before 14:30.
location: Ailedi KTV, Zhongxin Street, Hekou Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: KTV gathering: singing, catching up, and making plans
description: The three entered the reserved private room, and Yin Hao adjusted the song selection machine. Li Qiang opened with "Hair Like Snow," and Yin Hao sang a military song. Half an hour later, they sat down to talk. Li Qiang shared his experience in e-commerce operations and his plan to open an online store; Yin Hao also talked about his FANUC study plan and intention to take the senior technician exam, and Li Qiang encouraged him. Zhang Wei once again emphasized the details of the wedding process and agreed to keep communicating online. In the evening, the three sang "Friends" together, deepening their friendship.
location: Ailedi KTV, Room 205, Center Street, Hekou Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Dinner: group meal at Old Goose Restaurant
description: After KTV, the three walked to Old Shop Goose Restaurant. Yin Hao ordered a large portion of old goose stewed in an iron pot, a marinated platter, cold dishes, and peanuts, along with two bottles of local baijiu. During the meal, Zhang Wei, face flushed, patted him on the shoulder and said he would give a big red envelope when he got married; Li Qiang said how their friendship would never change. Yin Hao shared his initial idea of buying a house around Shanghai, and both supported him.
location: Old Goose Restaurant on Old Street, Hekou Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province

name: After-dinner walk to see someone off
description: After dinner, Li Qiang called a designated driver, and Zhang Wei walked home. Yin Hao walked with Zhang Wei to the streetlight on the town's main street to say goodbye. Zhang Wei reminded him to choose a suit when he returned to Shanghai, and they agreed to talk online next time. Then Yin Hao walked home alone along the village road, sending a voice message to his brother on the way saying he would be home in half an hour. The night breeze was cool, and the effects of the alcohol gradually faded.
location: Yin Residence, Shuanggang Village, Hekou Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Reunited and chatted with my brother and family
description: Arrived home at 20:30; my older brother's family had already arrived. Yin Hao greeted his brother and sister-in-law and played with his nephew. The family sat around together, and the parents asked how the brother's trip had gone. Yin Hao briefly mentioned the afternoon gathering. His father brewed tea, and everyone talked about the family dinner plan for the fourth day of the Lunar New Year, with a warm atmosphere.
location: Yin Residence, Shuanggang Village, Hekou Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Evening washing up, diary writing, and going to sleep
description: At 21:30, Yin Hao took a hot shower, changed into pajamas, and went back to the bedroom. At 22:00, he started writing in his diary: recording the details of being a groomsman, Li Qiang's e-commerce ideas, his female cousin's career study advice, and his older brother's talk about the current state of the auto industry. After finishing the diary, he canceled the phone alarm, checked the windows, and lay down on the bed. Firecrackers sounded occasionally outside the window. He recalled the melodies and conversations of the afternoon and fell asleep with slight tipsiness and a sense of satisfaction.
location: Yin Residence, Shuanggang Village, Hekou Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Morning wake-up and morning run with the brothers
description: The alarm went off, and Yin Hao got up nimbly. The weather outside was sunny but not warm, so he quickly put on a long-sleeved athletic shirt. While stretching in the living room, his brother Yin Tao also came out full of energy. The two slipped out quietly and ran along the familiar route toward the east side of the town, passing by Juegang South Market, where vegetable vendors were already busy and the air was filled with the smell of fresh vegetables and seafood. Then they turned east, ran past the gate of Juegang Senior High School in Rudong County, and entered a cement village road between wheat fields and fish ponds. Yin Hao kept a steady pace of about 6:35/km and chatted with his brother as they ran. Yin Tao talked about the sales situation at the new BYD new-energy showroom in the 4S dealership where he worked, while Yin Hao mentioned an industrial automation exhibition he had seen in Shanghai, saying that the combination of CNC machine tools and smart factories was the big trend. Yin Tao also remarked that traditional sales models were being disrupted by livestreaming.
location: Jiangsu Province, Nantong City, Rudong County, Juegang Town, starting from No. 58 Renmin Road, passing Juegang South Market, along the rural road to Juegang Senior High School on Donghuan Road

name: Wash up and have breakfast after the morning run
description: After running home, Yin Hao took a warm shower and changed into comfortable home T-shirt and sweatpants. While drying his hair with a towel, he heard the sound of his mother Wang Xiuying turning on the stove in the kitchen. Then the two brothers went to the dining room. Their mother had already cooked steaming hot rice cake soup with cabbage and shredded pork, and each bowl had a poached egg, accompanied by homemade preserved radish. Their father Yin Jianguo also came out and asked who would go to the county town today to buy dishes for hosting relatives in the evening. Yin Hao and his brother wolfed down their food. Yin Hao praised his mother's cooking as even better than the old shop in town. His mother smiled and said she had added small river shrimp to enhance the umami. The family had breakfast together in a warm atmosphere.
location: Dining room at parents' home, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Family care and preparation for skill learning
description: After breakfast, Yin Hao helped his father to the sofa, skillfully wrapped the cuff of his father's electronic blood pressure monitor and took a measurement. The result showed high pressure 145/92 mmHg and low pressure 91 mmHg. Yin Hao frowned and told his father to control his diet, eat less salted fish and peanuts, and asked his mother to keep an eye on him. His father agreed verbally but kept glancing at the holiday candy box, so Yin Hao smiled and put the candy box directly into the TV cabinet drawer. After that, he used the "CNC Programming Simulator" app (Lite version) on his phone and quickly browsed a few cases about macro program calls to warm up for the new year's work.
location: Living room at parents' home, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province

name: Assisting in the kitchen and learning to cook.
description: Yin Hao put on an apron and went into the kitchen to help his mother prepare a hearty lunch — besides his favorite braised pork, there were braised prawns and stewed lamb. Yin Hao was responsible for trimming and washing vegetables, slicing ginger and scallions, and asked his mother for the secret to making braised pork. As she demonstrated slowly caramelizing sugar, she stressed using an iron wok and controlling the heat, adding the meat as soon as the sugar turned date-red and bubbly. Yin Hao took out his phone memo to carefully observe and record each step. His mother also mentioned that his cousin's child would be taking the high school entrance exam this year and that she planned to give a big red envelope after the New Year.
location: Parents' home kitchen, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: A warm family reunion lunch.
description: In the kitchen, the rich aroma of lamb soup and braised pork wafted through the air. The family of six sat around the round table, where six dishes and one soup were laid out. Yin Hao poured plain water for his father and brother, and his sister-in-law picked food for her little nephew. During the meal, the lively nephew chattered about funny things at school, making the whole family laugh. Yin Hao and his brother talked about their childhood friend Zhang Wei's wedding, while his sister-in-law asked about housing prices in Songjiang, Shanghai. Yin Hao shared online information he had seen about new homes suitable for first-time buyers around Shanghai. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Dining room at parents' home, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Midday rest and preparations to go out.
description: After lunch, Yin Hao took the initiative to help his mother clear the dishes, wipe the table, and wash the dishes. When everything was tidied up, he returned to his room on the second floor, opened the curtains, and set an alarm for half an hour later to take a nap. He sent a voice message to his childhood friend Zhang Wei asking what time he would be free in the afternoon. Zhang Wei replied immediately, saying that he and Li Qiang would drive to the alley entrance to pick him up at two o'clock. When the alarm went off, Yin Hao got up full of energy, washed his face with cold water, and changed into clean jeans, a dark jacket, and a black cotton-padded coat. He grabbed a handful of Jiangmi strips from home and put them in his pocket, planning to bring them for his childhood friends to taste.
location: Parents' home, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province.

name: Meeting up with a childhood friend
description: A car horn sounded from outside the door. Yin Hao hurried out, opened the back door of Zhang Wei's white Volkswagen SUV, and got in. The heater was on, and the stereo was playing festive New Year songs. Yin Hao took out some glutinous rice strips and shared them with the two. Zhang Wei stepped on the gas and drove toward the county town. The three chatted casually, and the atmosphere was relaxed.
location: At the entrance of the alley, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province.

name: KTV singing session to catch up with old friends
description: The three arrived at the “Jingehui” KTV in the center of town; Zhang Wei had already booked a small private room. Zhang Wei skillfully operated the song-ordering console, starting with “My Good Brothers” to warm up the atmosphere. Yin Hao confidently took his turn and chose “Unity Is Strength”, belting it out with his powerful, sonorous voice, instantly igniting the mood. The three sang from military songs to Jay Chou and then to Lao Lang; when they got tired of singing, they paused to take sips of cola to soothe their throats. Li Qiang shared the bizarre customers he had encountered while doing e-commerce livestreaming in Hangzhou, while Zhang Wei reviewed the best man process for the wedding in detail with Yin Hao, including what time to arrive at the groom's house and what door-blocking tricks to prepare for the bridal pickup.
location: Jingehui KTV, No. 18 Qingyuan Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province

name: Hot pot dinner and wedding planning discussion
description: After singing, the three walked out of the KTV, crossed the street, and arrived at the "Bashu Small Town" hot pot restaurant across the road. They ordered a steaming nine-grid hot pot with bubbling red oil, accompanied by beef tripe, goose intestine, fatty beef, and a vegetable platter. While cooking the ingredients, Zhang Wei once again explained in detail to Yin Hao his role in the bridal pickup process—hiding the bride's wedding shoes and later handing out red envelopes to the bridesmaids as "road tolls." Yin Hao nodded while eating and promised to go back to Shanghai right after the New Year to have a well-fitted suit custom-made. Li Qiang also shared his plan to open his first physical store after the New Year. The three encouraged each other, and the atmosphere was lively.
location: Bashu Town Hotpot Restaurant, 12 Qingyuan Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Returned home.
description: After eating and drinking their fill, Zhang Wei drove Yin Hao back to the entrance of his parents' alley. Yin Hao agreed with them to keep in touch anytime the next day via WeChat, and watched the taillights disappear into the night before turning around and going home.
location: On the way from Bashu Small Town Hotpot Restaurant at No. 12 Qingyuan Road to No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Family evening activities
description: After arriving home, Yin Hao saw his mother tidying up in the kitchen. He told his family that he had already eaten out, then went to his room and changed into clean loungewear. He went to the kitchen to help his mother reheat leftovers and set the table. His father and elder brother were watching the CCTV news program Xinwen Lianbo in the living room. Then Yin Hao went to the living room, sat down in a corner of the sofa, and listened to his father commenting on the recent international situation while watching the news. His little nephew pestered his mother and uncle to watch cartoons, so Yin Hao watched the children's channel with him for a while, and then chatted with his brother about his son's academic performance and extracurricular classes, urging him to strike a balance between work and rest. When his mother finished her chores, she came in and handed Yin Hao a peeled apple and a small plate of peanuts.
location: Parents' home, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province.

name: Voice greeting from a comrade-in-arms
description: In the living room, as the atmosphere was warm and pleasant, Yin Hao's phone rang—it was a WeChat voice call from his comrade-in-arms Zhang Jianguo. He stood up and went to a room on the second floor to answer. Zhang Jianguo's familiar hearty voice came through, and the two exchanged New Year greetings. Seeing Yin Hao's morning run in his Moments, Zhang Jianguo asked with concern about his knee. Yin Hao smiled and said it was fine, explaining that the two brothers had run together at a not-too-fast pace. They chatted about their enjoyable moments during the New Year holiday, and Zhang Jianguo carefully reminded him to warm up thoroughly before every run, emphasizing that post-run stretching is even more important than the run itself. Finally, they agreed to get online together for some Honor of Kings ranked games on a weekend evening after the holiday.
location: Yin Hao's bedroom on the second floor of his parents' home, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Free time and diary writing
description: After the phone call, Yin Hao opened the notes app on his phone and started recording today's key points: the wedding car arrangement time, door-blocking red envelopes need to be prepared in advance, the detailed cooking secrets for braised pork (especially the heat control for caramelizing sugar), and the warm-up moves Zhang Jianguo emphasized. He then went through the senior technician exam materials he had previously saved on his phone, and under the "FANUC system macro programs" category wrote a note: "During the Spring Festival, I can watch some hands-on videos on Bilibili." After writing, he lay in bed and scrolled through a few more short technical videos about industrial robots.
location: Yin Hao's bedroom on the second floor of his parents' home, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Video call with girlfriend
description: At nine o'clock, Yin Hao made a video call to his girlfriend Lin Yue on time. When the screen lit up, Lin Yue's round face appeared. She was sitting on her bed at home in a cute plush pajamas. Yin Hao first asked what she had eaten at home today, then excitedly showed her the braised pork recipe saved in his phone memo, proudly promising that when Lin Yue returned to Shanghai, he would cook it for her himself and it would be no worse than a restaurant's. Lin Yue told him she had gone to the West Lake today and bought a handmade teddy bear pendant, planning to bring it to Shanghai next week to give him. They chatted for half an hour, and finally Yin Hao urged her to rest early and they said good night.
location: Yin Hao's bedroom on the second floor of his parents' home, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After hanging up the phone, Yin Hao went to the bathroom to wash up. Looking at his energetic, slightly tanned face in the mirror, he felt very satisfied with the day's arrangements. After washing up, he lay back on the bed and plugged in his phone. He flipped through the Runner's World magazine on the nightstand and read half an article. Then he turned off the light, listened to the occasional sound of wind outside the window, reviewed the fulfilling day in his mind, and felt that the slow pace of the holiday was wonderful. He closed his eyes and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Parents' home, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province.

name: Morning exercise and washing up
description: At 7:00 a.m. the alarm clock rang. Keeping my military habit, I didn't stay in bed. I did 20 push-ups and a set of simple stretches on the bedroom floor to wake up my body. Then I went to the bathroom to wash up, shaved carefully, and prepared to go to my maternal uncle's home to pay New Year's greetings.
location: Parents' home at No. 128 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province: second-floor bedroom and first-floor bathroom.

name: Family breakfast and morning conversation
description: After going downstairs, his mother had already prepared breakfast: white congee, fried eggs, stir-fried vegetables, and homemade pickled radish. She reminded Yin Hao to watch his words when paying New Year visits at his uncle's house, listen more to the elders, and talk less about work troubles. Yin Hao responded, praised the pickled radish, and took the initiative to have another bowl of congee.
location: First-floor dining room of his parents' home at 128 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province

name: Count the New Year greeting gifts and load them into the car.
description: After breakfast, Yin Hao and his father counted the prepared gifts: two cartons of "Red Nanjing" cigarettes, a box of West Lake Longjing tea, and two boxes of Rudong specialties, "Drunken Snails" and "Yizhulou" pastries. They then carefully placed them into the trunk of his father's Volkswagen Lavida, while his mother reminded them about etiquette.
location: Living room and front door on the first floor of the parents' home, No. 128 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Drove to his maternal uncle's house.
description: His father drove, Yin Hao sat in the front passenger seat, and his mother sat in the back. They turned left from Renmin Road onto Qingyuan Road and drove toward Jinshuiwan Community. Along the way, Yin Hao asked about his father's blood pressure and told him a home remedy for lowering blood pressure he had heard from his childhood friend Zhang Wei. His father said he would consider it but insisted on mainly relying on medication and diet control.
location: On the way from Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province, to Jinshuiwan Residential Community, 18 Qingyuan Road.

name: New Year visit to maternal uncle's home and family dinner
description: After arriving at his maternal uncle Chen Zhigang's home, everyone exchanged New Year blessings and sat around in the living room drinking tea, with nuts and candies filling the coffee table. Yin Hao and his older cousin Chen Xiaowen sat on the rattan chairs on the balcony. His cousin asked about his CNC programming progress, and Yin Hao showed her his FANUC macro program notes. His cousin suggested using XMind mind maps to organize the knowledge, and demonstrated the basic operations. Meanwhile, his uncle and his father talked about the old family house in the village. The lunch was very sumptuous, with braised lamb, steamed white fish, spring rolls, seasonal vegetables, and more. Bearing his mother's advice in mind, Yin Hao proactively took vegetables and fish and drank only one small bowl of lamb soup. During the meal, his uncle asked about buying a house in Shanghai. Yin Hao frankly admitted that housing prices in Songjiang were not cheap, and that he wanted to first obtain the Senior Technician certificate. His cousin also agreed with the viewpoint of building a career on technical skills.
location: Uncle's home, Room 303, Building 12, Jinshuiwan Community, No. 18 Qingyuan Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu

name: Taking a walk with my older female cousin after the meal, picking up packages, and going to the supermarket
description: After lunch, Yin Hao took a walk with his cousin along the Rutai Canal trail. The river breeze was slightly cool, and they chatted as they walked. His cousin again encouraged him to keep working toward his technical certificate and recommended watching more videos about industrial robots and smart manufacturing cases on Bilibili. When they got excited, they took photos of each other by a decorative river rock. After returning to the residential complex, he accompanied his cousin to the Hive Box locker at the entrance to pick up a package, a neck massage device. Then they went into Haorunduo Supermarket, where his cousin bought sugar-free cola and potato chips for tonight's online gaming session, and Yin Hao grabbed two bottles of sports drinks.
location: The Rutai Canal Footpath in Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (section from the west gate of Jinshuiwan Community to Renmin Bridge), and the Hive Box lockers and Haorunduo Supermarket at the entrance of Jinshuiwan Community, No. 18 Qingyuan Road, Juegang Town

name: Returned to parents' home for a brief rest
description: After saying goodbye to uncle and aunt, the family drove back. After arriving home, Yin Hao went to his second-floor bedroom, changed into a hoodie, lay on the bed, and replied to comrade-in-arms Zhang Jianguo's voice message, telling him that he would be gaming with family tonight and would arrange another day.
location: Bedroom on the second floor of parents' home, No. 128 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Helping father research new features of the blood pressure monitor
description: While resting in the living room, he saw his father measuring blood pressure and noticed that the "Arrhythmia Detection" function was grayed out. After consulting the manual, Yin Hao found that it needed to be activated by holding down the settings button for three seconds. He immediately demonstrated it successfully, and wrote the steps on a sticky note and stuck it next to the blood pressure monitor. His father was very pleased.
location: First-floor living room of parents' home, No. 128 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Help mother prepare dinner ingredients
description: Mother started preparing dinner. Yin Hao helped peel garlic, peel potatoes, and trim the tips of green beans. While busy, she kept nagging about the hometown specialties he should bring back to Shanghai in a couple of days: sanzi, dried clams, and homemade sausage. Yin Hao chimed in and told her not to worry too much, saying the cafeteria food was pretty good.
location: First-floor kitchen of parents' home, 128 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province

name: Browse industry videos and follow current affairs.
description: His father watched TV news on the sofa, while Yin Hao beside him opened Bilibili on his tablet, searched for the video 'FANUC Robot Basic Operation' recommended by his older female cousin, watched 15 minutes of the preview, captured key programming interface screenshots, and planned to ask for more detailed guidance after returning to Shanghai. Outside the window it was getting dark, and the room was lit with warm light.
location: First-floor living room of parents' home, No. 128 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: Dinner was simple and heartwarming: shredded pork with garlic sprouts, stir-fried spinach, tomato and egg soup, and braised lamb packed from my uncle's home. Yin Hao ate two small bowls of rice and listened to his parents talk about interesting anecdotes from visiting relatives. After the meal, he proactively cleared the table and washed the dishes.
location: First-floor dining room of his parents' home at 128 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province

name: Family online game: Honor of Kings
description: Back in the bedroom, Yin Hao sent a message in the family group to form a team. His older brother Yin Tao and his cousin Chen Xiaowen responded. He checked Di Renjie's and Yu Ji's runes and item builds, and then three ranked matches began: in the first, using Di Renjie with his brother's Li Bai in the jungle and his cousin's Sun Bin, he won easily; in the second, the game started unfavorably, but with good vision and perfect team fights they turned it around, and the voice chat was full of cheers; in the third, he picked Yu Ji and was targeted early, but ultimately won through macro play and kiting. Laughter never stopped, and the session ended happily.
location: Parents' home, second-floor bedroom, No. 128 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (connected via WeChat voice call).

name: Game review and exchange with comrades-in-arms
description: After the game ended, he left the voice chat and rested with a drink of water. Seeing that his comrade-in-arms Zhang Jianguo had sent a video of fireworks from his hometown and asked how the battle went, Yin Hao replied that he had won all three matches, and showed off a screenshot of Yu Ji's highlight quadra kill. The two chatted for a while and agreed to play online together again after returning to Shanghai.
location: Bedroom on the second floor of parents' home, No. 128 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Recording today's gains and plans for the future
description: Took out the notebook and recorded key items: 1) Organize the usage of the XMind mind-mapping software recommended by my cousin; 2) Note down keywords for the FANUC robot video on Bilibili; 3) Confirm the arrangement for the 2,000 yuan best-man gift at my childhood friend Zhang Wei's wedding; 4) Set a phone memo to remind me to resume morning running after returning to Shanghai, and prepare a bear keychain for Lin Yue, who may be coming to Shanghai.
location: Desk in the second-floor bedroom at parents' home, No. 128 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province

name: Washing up and going to bed.
description: Took a hot bath and changed into clean pajamas. After lying in bed, I habitually scrolled through numerical control technology posts for a while. Gradually feeling sleepy, I plugged in my phone and turned off the bedside lamp. Listening to the sound of my parents turning off the TV downstairs, I fell into a deep sleep with the satisfaction of being reunited with my family.
location: Second-floor bedroom and bathroom at parents' home, No. 128 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: Yin Hao woke up naturally in the second-floor bedroom at his parents' home. It was cloudy outside, with a temperature of 3–9°C. After getting out of bed in his cotton pajamas, he first did 10 minutes of basic stretching, including shoulder and neck circles and lunge stretches, then did 20 push-ups and 15 squats to keep his muscles active and prepare for tomorrow's long drive. After stretching, he opened the window for ventilation, checked the weather on his phone, and confirmed it was suitable for travel.
location: Second-floor bedroom at parents' home, No. 15 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: Yin Hao went downstairs to the first-floor dining room. His mother had prepared cabbage-and-pork buns, millet porridge, fried eggs, and pickled vegetables. His father drank his porridge while looking at his phone, and the three chatted as they ate. His mother reminded him to pack his luggage and not leave anything behind, and his father reminded him not to rush on the drive the next day. Yin Hao proactively put a bun on his mother's plate and mentioned that he would repair the radio in the afternoon. The breakfast had a warm atmosphere and lasted about 25 minutes.
location: Dining room on the first floor of parents' home, No. 15 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Packing his bags for the trip home
description: Yin Hao began packing his luggage in the second-floor bedroom to prepare for returning to Shanghai the next day. He laid the 24-inch suitcase flat on the bed.
