First, he wrapped the local specialties his mother had portioned out — vacuum-sealed braised pork, steamed clams kept fresh with ice packs, and Nantong crispy crackers in plastic bags — in plastic wrap and placed them at the bottom of the suitcase. Then he folded in cargo pants, sweaters, and other clothes. After that, he put his charger, ID card, driver's license, etc. into his backpack. During this time, his mother knocked on the door twice to bring him homemade sesame candy and drunken snails. Yin Hao put them all away properly, and finally checked the suitcase zippers and wheels to make sure they were secure.
location: Second-floor bedroom at parents' home, No. 15 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Check vehicle condition
description: Yin Hao put on his jacket and walked to the garage. He opened the hood of his Volkswagen Lavida, pulled out the dipstick and checked that the oil level was normal, then unscrewed the coolant reservoir cap to confirm the coolant level was sufficient. Next, he used the key to check tire pressure and kicked the tire sidewalls to check for bulges and abnormal wear. When his father came out to take out the trash and looked over, Yin Hao pointed out to him that the brake pads were in good thickness. Finally, he started the vehicle and turned the steering wheel in place, hearing no abnormal noises, then closed the hood and finished the inspection. The whole process reflected the vehicle management habits he had developed in the military.
location: Open space in front of the garage at the parents' home, No. 15 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Learning with FANUC industrial robot videos
description: Yin Hao returned to the living room on the first floor, opened Bilibili on his phone to watch a FANUC robot basic tutorial video recommended by his cousin Chen Xiaowen. The content was 'Introduction to FANUC Industrial Robots — Point Teaching and Motion Modes', 32 minutes long. He sat upright on the sofa and watched carefully, pausing to note key terms such as 'joint coordinate system', 'linear motion', and 'teach pendant operation'. Afterwards, he quickly previewed two short videos and screenshotted key interfaces, saving them in his phone memo, planning to use XMind to organize the knowledge system after returning to Shanghai.
location: Ground-floor living room of parents' home, No. 15 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province

name: Assisted his mother in preparing lunch ingredients
description: Yin Hao went into the kitchen to help his mother prepare lunch. His mother was trimming chives to make dumplings. Yin Hao volunteered to peel garlic, wash cucumbers and tomatoes, and was in charge of slicing the tomatoes. His mother chatted about family matters and mentioned that his older brother would be coming back from Suzhou tomorrow. Yin Hao replied that his brother would probably go to work the day after. His mother praised him for being more skillful with the knife than before. Finally, Yin Hao helped his mother mix the filling and put it in the fridge to marinate.
location: First-floor kitchen of his parents' home, No. 15 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province.

name: Lunch and a short lunch break.
description: Lunch was in the dining room on the first floor. Mother freshly wrapped chive and pork dumplings, served with sliced pork with garlic sauce and garlic lettuce. Yin Hao ate 12 dumplings with vinegar. His father drank the dumpling soup, and his mother kept urging him to eat more. The three of them discussed tomorrow's return route. Yin Hao planned to take the Qiyang Expressway and then switch to the Shanghai-Shaanxi Expressway, expecting to reach Songjiang, Shanghai in 3.5 hours. His father reminded him to switch drivers at the service area. After the meal at 12:10, Yin Hao cleared the dishes and wiped the table. At 12:20 he went upstairs for a nap and set a 13:00 alarm on his phone.
location: Dining room on the first floor of parents' home, No. 15 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Repair the vintage radio and organize the tools
description: After the 13:00 alarm went off, Yin Hao woke up and went downstairs. In the living room on the first floor, he repaired the old Red Flag radio with his father. Yin Hao first used a multimeter to check that the power circuit was continuous and normal, then measured the capacitors and resistors one by one and found that the fifth 470F electrolytic capacitor had an abnormal reading. He found a spare part of the same specification in his father's tool drawer, carefully desoldered the old capacitor with a soldering iron, cleaned the solder pads, and soldered on the new part. When powered on, the radio produced clear sound again, and his father tuned to Nantong Traffic Radio and China National Radio. His father patted him on the shoulder approvingly and said, ‘You haven't lost your touch.’ Afterwards, Yin Hao took the initiative to clean the tools with a rag, put the multimeter back in place, sorted the scattered resistors and screws by category, and tidied up the items on the living room coffee table. In between, he also found time to @Zhang Wei in the ‘groomsmen group’ to ask about wedding supply needs, and Zhang Wei replied with an OK emoji.
location: Ground-floor living room of parents' home, No. 15 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province

name: Walking and chatting with father on the village road.
description: Yin Hao suggested going out for a walk. With his father, who had changed into cloth shoes, he walked west along Renmin Road to the village road beside a tributary of the Rutai Canal. An old man was fishing by the river. His father told Yin Hao that a new concrete road had been built to the west and was finally paved this year. As they walked, they talked about Yin Hao's work at the factory. His father asked whether he needed to sign up for a class for the senior technician exam. Yin Hao said he would first watch videos to build a foundation. His father mentioned that a colleague who had taken the technician exam years ago still had the textbooks at home and could send them to Yin Hao. The father and son walked slowly, covering about 1.5 kilometers round trip in about 40-plus minutes.
location: Village road along the Rutai Canal tributary near Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Personal Free Time
description: After returning from the walk, Yin Hao changed into a clean T-shirt in the second-floor bedroom. Leaning against the headboard, he opened XMind and created a new mind map named "FANUC Robot Learning Path", recording the keywords he had learned in the morning. At 16:20, he sent a WeChat message to his friend Lin Yue: "I'll set off from Rudong tomorrow morning and arrive in Shanghai around noon. Are you free this weekend to meet up?" He then browsed Lin Yue's Moments and saw an article about a new exhibition. At 16:40, he went downstairs to drink some water, looked at the packaging of the Nantong crispy biscuits recommended by his mother, and noted the shelf life. From 17:00 to 17:30, he returned to the living room on the first floor to help his mother pick wood ear mushrooms, prepare for dinner, and tidy up the clutter on the dining table.
location: Second-floor bedroom and first-floor living room at the parents' home, 15 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province.

name: Preparing dinner with the home assistant
description: Mother tied on an apron and started cooking. Yin Hao helped out: he sprinkled shredded ginger and chopped scallions over the thawed steamed sea bass and put it into the steamer, mixed the sweet-and-sour pork rib sauce according to his mother's recipe (two spoonfuls of light soy sauce, three spoonfuls of vinegar, and sugar), and arranged the bowls and dishes for use. At 18:00, his older brother Yin Tao sent a message saying he would be home around 18:20. Yin Hao replied that the dishes were almost ready. He first brought the cold dishes, preserved egg tofu and sauced beef, to the table, then took out his father's treasured Jinfeng brand five-year aged yellow wine and prepared it.
location: First-floor kitchen of his parents' home, No. 15 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province.

name: Family dinner and farewell
description: At 18:30, his older brother Yin Tao came home. Their mother served steamed sea bass, sweet and sour pork ribs, braised pork, soup dumplings, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables — five dishes and one soup. Their father poured yellow rice wine for the brothers, and their mother drank a soft drink. Their father raised his glass to wish Yin Hao a safe journey, and their mother put fish on his plate. During the meal, the conversation ranged from Yin Tao's car sales plan to the newly built road in their hometown. Yin Hao said he planned to take the technician certificate exam this year. His father supported him, and his brother suggested reviewing with videos and offered to help look up materials. After 19:00, both brothers had second helpings of rice, and their mother looked happy at the sight. At 19:25, Yin Hao toasted each of his parents, saying he would go to Beijing East Road if he had time, and his mother smiled in response. Finally, Yin Hao took photos of the dishes with his phone to keep a record.
location: Dining room on the first floor of parents' home, No. 15 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Living room conversation after the meal
description: After clearing the table, the family moved to the living room. Yin Hao refilled his father's tea, and his mother brought out apples, oranges, peanuts, and melon seeds. The conversation centered on Yin Hao's certification plans. He shared the confidence he had gained from talking with his older female cousin the day before and said he would use XMind to organize his knowledge. Yin Tao talked about his plan to open a new exhibition and sales window in Suzhou this year and invited Yin Hao to go see the exhibition together on the weekend. Their mother told them to dress warmly in the cold weather and required at least four video calls per month. Their father asked whether online shopping with delivery was convenient in Shanghai and planned to send homemade pickled vegetables in a couple of days. At 21:00, Yin Tao got up to return to his own place. Yin Hao walked him to the door, and the brothers agreed to play online games together the evening after tomorrow. After seeing him off, Yin Hao helped his parents tidy up the coffee table.
location: Ground-floor living room of parents' home, No. 15 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province

name: Evening washing up and getting ready for bed
description: After going upstairs, Yin Hao first checked WeChat and saw that Lin Yue had replied, "Sure, let's chat on WeChat over the weekend. No rush on the road," with an encouraging emoji. He screenshotted it and saved it in his memo, labeled "Lin Yue - Weekend". Then he updated tomorrow's departure checklist in his memo: ID and charger in the backpack, suitcase, and items to take in the car (thermos, snacks, driver's license), and added the dried jujubes his father had just given him. At 21:20 he folded tomorrow's clothes and placed them on the chair. Since he didn't need a morning run, he noted that he would make up the run after arriving in Shanghai and warm up for 5 minutes. At 21:30 he went to the bathroom and took a hot shower for about 10 minutes, brushed his teeth carefully, applied moisturizer, changed into pajamas, and packed tomorrow's socks and underwear into the suitcase. He also organized the power bank and charging cable so he could take them directly in the morning.
location: Parents' home, second-floor bedroom and bathroom, No. 15 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: Yin Hao made his bed, confirmed the next day's 6:20 alarm, and lay down. He played soothing guitar music randomly on his phone for about 5 minutes to relax and reviewed the day's accomplishments: luggage ready, car condition checked, radio repaired, farewell dinner done, Lin Yue's message replied, everything on schedule. Though reluctant to leave, he felt calm. At 22:18 he turned off the phone screen, placed it on the nightstand, and switched off the light. At 22:30 he fell into sleep with steady breathing.
location: Second-floor bedroom at parents' home, No. 15 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Morning workout and a cozy breakfast.
description: After the 7:00 alarm went off, I spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and did 15 minutes of full-body stretching, focusing on the shoulders, neck, and lower back. Then I did two sets of push-ups, 30 in total, to warm up my body. After a quick wash-up, I changed into a comfortable gray fleece hoodie and dark sweatpants, went down to the first-floor dining room, and had breakfast with my parents. My mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared steaming millet porridge, homemade shredded radish and pork buns, boiled eggs, and Zhenjiang pickles. We chatted while eating. My father, Yin Jianguo, reminded me to take breaks during the long drive, and my mother kept saying to send a WeChat message when I arrived and reminded me that the fruit was in the front passenger seat.
location: Bedroom and dining room at home, No. XX Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Final luggage packing and saying goodbye to parents
description: After breakfast, I checked the luggage and local specialties packed the night before once again. I carefully sorted and loaded into the car the 5 boxes of clams, 3 portions of braised pork, a big bag of Nantong crispy crackers, and a box of lion's head meatballs that my mother had prepared. The braised pork was wrapped in two layers of plastic wrap before being put into a Lock & Lock container to ensure it was sealed and leak-proof. I brought my power bank, thermos, and a USB drive for listening to on the road. Then I went to the garage, started the Volkswagen Lavida, and checked the oil dipstick, tire pressure of all four tires, and coolant level, confirming everything was normal. Around 8:45 I went back inside for a final chat with my parents. Sitting on the sofa in the living room, we talked about this year's work plan and my plan to take the Senior Technician certificate. My mother then took a bag of cut apples out of the fridge for me to eat on the way. At about 9:15, we took a group photo in front of the door using a phone stand, leaving the last Spring Festival photo of the three of us in front of the old house. When we hugged goodbye, my mother's eyes were reddening. Yin Hao promised to video call at least four times a month and to come back to see them in two months. Then he got in the car and left.
location: Home and garage at No. XX, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province, and the street in front of the house

name: Drove back to Shanghai.
description: Set off from home at 9:32, entered the Rudong Toll Station, and drove along the Shenhai Expressway (G15) toward Shanghai. There was heavy return traffic on the expressway, but conditions were basically steady. I set the cruise control to around 110 km/h, and the car radio played 90s golden oldies. When passing the Sutong Bridge, traffic was heavy and slow, but I kept going without stopping. Around 12:30 I pulled into the Sutong Bridge Service Area to rest, washed my face with cold water in the restroom to refresh myself, bought a hot American coffee at the convenience store, ate two Nantong crispy crackers that my mother had brought, sitting in the car, relaxed for 15 minutes, and sent a WeChat message to my older brother Yin Tao to let him know I was safe. He replied instantly, telling me to drive slowly. At 12:45 I continued on the road. When passing through the Taicang and Jiading sections, I hit about 20 minutes of severe slow traffic on the Jiaxi section of the G15 Shenhai Expressway, so I stayed patient and followed the flow. Then I turned onto the Hujia Expressway, then connected to the Jiamin Elevated Road, and drove all the way to the Songjiang New City toll gate, getting off the expressway at nearly 16:15.
location: Shenhai Expressway (G15) from Rudong to Songjiang New City toll station in Shanghai, passing the Sutong Bridge service area.

name: Unloading at home and initial sorting of belongings.
description: At 16:30, he parked the car downstairs and began carrying luggage and local specialties from the trunk upstairs. It took two round trips to carry the suitcase, several large bags of local specialties, and his backpack up to the 3rd floor. After entering the room, he immediately opened all the windows for ventilation and spent 20 minutes sorting the local specialties. He carefully portioned some of the braised pork and clams his mother had made into food storage containers, planning to give them to his neighbor, Aunt Chen, and put the rest aside.
location: Home at Room 301, Building 3, Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the downstairs parking area

name: Deep cleaning at home
description: After changing into comfortable home clothes, he started a thorough cleaning. First, he vacuumed the living room, bedroom, and kitchen floors carefully, then mopped twice with a wet mop. He wiped down the bedside table, desk, windowsill, and TV cabinet with a damp cloth, and finally scrubbed the kitchen and bathroom countertops and faucets. Watching the sunlight shine on the clean floor, the whole room became fresh and tidy.
location: All around the home at Room 301, Building 3, Xingang Residential Community, 15 Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare dinner and rest briefly
description: After cleaning, I felt hungry. I took the lion's head meatballs my mother had brought out of the fridge and steamed them in the rice cooker, and made a simple seaweed egg drop soup with eggs. While eating, I scrolled through the phone news and replied to the message from my comrade-in-arms Zhang Jianguo, who had sent it at noon. I told him I had arrived in Shanghai in the afternoon, had just finished tidying up, and asked about his vacation.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Room 301, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Deliver hometown specialties to neighbor Aunt Chen
description: After dinner, he took out two portioned food containers (one with braised pork, one with clams), carried them in a reusable bag, walked across to the opposite door, and knocked gently. When Aunt Chen opened the door, Yin Hao smiled and said Happy New Year, explaining that he had just returned from his hometown in Rudong and that his mother had specifically asked him to bring some hometown dishes, thanking her for always looking out for him. Aunt Chen was pleasantly surprised and thanked him again and again, giving him two homegrown oranges and a few sugar tangerines in return. The two chatted for a while at the door about how they had been doing.
location: At the door of Room 302, Building 3, Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 123 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with parents to reassure them I'm safe.
description: After delivering the local specialties and returning home, he immediately video-called his mother on WeChat. Once connected, he showed her the tidy room and the reheated lion's head meatball dinner, told her the specialties had been given to Aunt Chen, and reassured her. His mother smiled and told him to rest early and not be late for his first day of work tomorrow. The call lasted about 10 minutes; after hanging up, he felt full of energy.
location: Home living room at Room 301, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing for tomorrow's return to work
description: After ending the call, he sat down at the desk to prepare for returning to work tomorrow, the eighth day of the first lunar month. He took out his work badge, phone charger, and factory access card and placed them on the tray in the entryway, then checked the work clothes he needed to wear and made sure they had no wrinkles. He opened his notebook and wrote down tomorrow's to-do list: attend the workshop morning meeting at 8:00 sharp, check the post-holiday maintenance records for CNC machine No. 2, and reply to the drawing revision comments sent by client Engineer Liu before the Spring Festival. After that, he set his phone alarm for 6:20 the next morning.
location: Home desk at Room 301, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Phone call with a comrade-in-arms
description: Took a carton of milk out of the fridge, sat on the sofa, and made a WeChat voice call to his comrade-in-arms Zhang Jianguo. The two chatted for nearly half an hour. Zhang Jianguo complained about the annoyance of being urged by his parents to go on blind dates after returning to his hometown, and Yin Hao shared the traffic jam he encountered on the road today and how delicious the clams he brought back were. They also agreed that if the weather was good next weekend, they could go fishing at Dianshan Lake or play Honor of Kings together.
location: Home living room at Room 301, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Targeted body stretching and relaxation
description: Long-distance driving plus the afternoon's thorough cleaning left my lower back a bit sore. I insisted on laying out the yoga mat on the bedroom floor and did 15 minutes of targeted lower back stretching and shoulder-neck relaxation exercises. Afterward, I opened a podcast on my phone and listened to a story about World War II history, letting my mind relax as well.
location: Bedroom at home: Room 301, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: At 21:30, went to the bathroom to brush teeth and wash face, took a comfortable hot shower, and changed into pajamas. Neatly placed the shoes and coat to wear tomorrow at the entryway by the door. Before going to sleep, used the memo app on his phone to briefly list the small work and study goals for the first week after the Lunar New Year.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Room 301, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lights out and sleep
description: At 22:00, he turned off the bedside lamp on time, put his phone aside to charge, and put on his eye mask. The room was very quiet, with only the faint glow of the neighborhood streetlights outside the window seeping through the curtains. He took a few deep breaths. Although his body was slightly tired, he felt well prepared mentally for returning to work the next day. He closed his eyes and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home: Room 301, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: After the alarm went off, Yin Hao got up immediately. Remembering the lower back soreness from the long drive the day before, he did 5 minutes of military boxing stretching exercises on the living room mat, focusing on the shoulders, neck, and lower back, making sure his body was warmed up and he was full of energy for the first day back at work.
location: Room 604, Building 5, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare breakfast and commuting essentials
description: Yin Hao simply reheated two meat buns his mother had given him and made a cup of instant coffee for breakfast. At the same time, he checked his commuter bag to make sure his work badge, thermos, power bank, notebook, and pen were all packed. He then took out the braised pork, clams, lion's head meatballs, and other local specialties brought from home, divided them into portions, and set some aside to share with colleagues at lunch and the rest for dinner.
location: Room 604, Building 5, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to work and did shopping on the way.
description: Yin Hao drove his Volkswagen Lavida to work. He first stopped at the Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket at the east gate of the community and bought a bag of frozen dumplings to eat on the weekend. He then turned from Xingang Road onto Huatianjing Road and headed to the company, listening to local traffic radio on the way to learn about the road conditions on the return-to-work day.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Return-to-work check-in and workstation preparation
description: Yin Hao arrived at the company, parked the car, and entered the machining workshop. He exchanged New Year greetings with team leader Wang Lei and programmer Liu Zhiqiang, who had arrived early. He changed into his work clothes, checked the status of his CNC machine tool (turn-mill machining center), confirmed that there was no abnormality, and looked at the day's production schedule.
location: Processing Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Team morning meeting
description: The team held a brief morning meeting to resume work. Team leader Wang Lei emphasized production safety and discipline on the first day of the new year and announced the urgent tasks for the week. Mentor Sun Jianguo patted Yin Hao on the shoulder and quietly said he had something to talk to him about in the afternoon. Yin Hao understood without needing further explanation.
location: Team meeting room of the workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: First-piece machining and wages credited.
description: After the morning meeting, Yin Hao got to work and chose to machine the first part (a precision flange). He carefully checked the drawings, aligned the tool, entered fine-tuning parameters, started the machine tool for cutting, and focused intently. The first-piece inspection was completed successfully and passed quality inspection. During the machine's automatic operation gap, his phone vibrated. He took off his protective gloves, saw a bank SMS notifying him that his after-tax salary of 8500 yuan had arrived, quickly confirmed the amount was correct, put the phone back, and continued working.
location: Processing Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Batch production and work exchanges.
description: He continued to devote himself to batch production of parts. At around 10:30, Yin Hao discussed an optimization idea for programming a special-shaped part with programmer Liu Zhiqiang. Liu Zhiqiang suggested using a macro program to simplify the operation. Yin Hao thought it was feasible, wrote it down in his notebook, and planned to work through it during the lunch break.
location: Processing Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Midday break: tracking expenses, sharing food, and relaxing
description: At noon, Yin Hao got off work and sat down in the cafeteria. He first opened mobile banking and an expense-tracking app, and skillfully allocated his salary according to his financial plan: 3,000 yuan into the rent e-wallet, 1,000 yuan reserved for regular fund investment, 2,500 yuan for daily expenses, and the remaining 2,000 yuan transferred to a savings card. Then he heated up the braised pork and clams he had brought from home, sharing a taste of hometown with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang, while he bought rice and stir-fried greens for himself. After lunch, he returned to the workshop break area, quickly browsed the Metalworking WeChat official account, saw an article on the basics of five-axis machine tools, saved it, and then leaned back in his chair to rest his eyes.
location: Employee cafeteria and workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Routine afternoon work
description: The afternoon production plan was drilling and tapping for several batches of regular parts. Yin Hao operated the machine to change tools and adjust parameters, keeping a steady work pace. During this period, one machine triggered an alarm, and he followed the procedures to investigate and solve the problem.
location: Processing Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Joined the five-axis machine tool evaluation team.
description: Master worker Sun Jianguo asked Yin Hao to go with him to the small meeting room on the second floor to meet with Manager Zhang from the Equipment Department. Master Sun formally recommended Yin Hao for the newly introduced "Five-Axis CNC Machine Tool Evaluation Group." Manager Zhang briefly introduced the evaluation task: they needed to investigate the processing bottlenecks and upgrade requirements of the existing four-axis machine tools within two weeks. Yin Hao took careful notes and proactively asked about material access permissions and the research direction. Manager Zhang said he would send a research outline to Yin Hao's email so he could familiarize himself with it first.
location: Small meeting room on the second floor of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Post-shift work wrap-up.
description: After returning to the workshop, Yin Hao cleaned the machine and filled in the equipment operation log. He briefly noted the macro program ideas discussed with Liu Zhiqiang today and the research task assigned by Manager Zhang in the notebook he carries with him, preparing for tonight's study.
location: Processing Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuted home from work and picked up packages.
description: Yin Hao left work on time and drove home. When returning to the residential community, he picked up a car sunshade he had bought online before the Spring Festival at the Cainiao Station at the west gate.
location: Cainiao Station at the West Gate of Xingang Community, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and household chores
description: After returning home, Yin Hao heated half of the braised pork and clams for dinner and left the other half for the next day. He cooked white rice and stir-fried lettuce with garlic, and quickly scanned phone news while eating. After the meal, he washed the dishes, wiped down the stove, and opened the window a crack for ventilation.
location: Room 604, Building 5, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Personal learning: focus on evaluation group tasks
description: Yin Hao turned on his computer to check company email and downloaded the Five-Axis Machine Tool Evaluation and Research Outline sent by Manager Zhang. Then, following the directions in the outline such as spindle performance, tool magazine capacity, thermal compensation system, and pain points of the existing four-axis machines, he did targeted searches on technical forums, bookmarked two systematic articles from the Five-Axis Linkage Machining Center Maintenance Guide, and found a post analyzing common problems in upgrading from four-axis to five-axis. He used XMind to create a simple mind map and recorded the key points.
location: Desk at Room 604, Building 5, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Short break and relaxation
description: After studying for an hour, Yin Hao stood up, walked around, and drank a glass of water. Through the window, he saw the dim streetlights downstairs and the damp, cold weather. He switched to the music app and played Xu Wei's "Blue Lotus" to let his mind relax for a moment.
location: Living room, Room 604, Building 5, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with girlfriend
description: Since the video call time was approaching, Yin Hao took out tangerines from the refrigerator, washed them, and placed them on the coffee table. He also put the five-axis machine tool materials and mind map he had just studied beside him, ready to share with Lin Yue. At 20:40 he started a WeChat video call on time, and the two talked for over half an hour. Yin Hao proactively shared the progress of returning to work, his salary being credited, and joining the evaluation team, and enthusiastically talked about the key points he had learned about five-axis machine tools. Lin Yue confided the pressure of the first project meeting after the holiday. Yin Hao listened quietly and encouraged her. name: After work, stopped to shop on the way home
description: After work, Yin Hao drove to Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket, picked out a box of Dandong strawberries and a carton of plain milk, and then drove home.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home and prepare dinner
description: Yin Hao arrived home, parked the car, changed into loungewear, then steamed the braised pork and clams taken from the freezer on the stove, and washed strawberries and arranged them on a plate.
location: Kitchen, Room XXX, Building X, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Neighbor brings sweet rice balls
description: Aunt Chen Xiuying, the neighbor across the hall, knocked on the door and brought steaming hot sesame tangyuan. Yin Hao took them with both hands and thanked her repeatedly, feeling a surge of warmth in his heart.
location: Stairwell, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Giving hometown dishes in return and chatting with neighbors.
description: Yin Hao packed the reheated braised pork and clams into fresh-keeping boxes and gave them back to Aunt Chen. The two stood at the door chatting about returning home for the Spring Festival and the topic of finding a partner, in a warm atmosphere.
location: Stairwell, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Enjoying tangyuan and dinner
description: After washing Aunt Chen's bowls, Yin Hao sat at the dining table and enjoyed black sesame tangyuan, along with braised pork and rice sent by his mother, spending a warm Lantern Festival dinner.
location: Dining room, Room XXX, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: The alarm went off right on time. Yin Hao felt good, weighed himself at 73.2 kg, and then washed up. He took the two boiled eggs and a slice of whole-wheat bread he had prepared last night from the fridge, and made a cup of warm honey water for breakfast. To ensure the blood donation went smoothly, he followed the doctor's advice and avoided strenuous exercise. He changed into loose sportswear and running shoes, went downstairs, and walked two slow laps around the residential area, enjoying the morning air as his body warmed up. After the walk, he went home, took a warm shower, and changed into a clean T-shirt and shorts. He checked his ID card and blood donation certificate once more, put them in the inner pocket of his work jacket, and checked his car keys before leaving.
description: After dinner, Yin Hao enjoyed the night view on the balcony. He sent Lantern Festival greetings to his girlfriend Lin Yue, sent a voice message to his brother Yin Tao, and had a video call with his mother Wang Xiuying, sharing the dinner and interactions with neighbors. His family was very happy.
location: Balcony, Room XXX, Building X, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Evening study of five-axis programming
description: Yin Hao studied Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming in his study, and, using what he had learned during the day, wrote a multi-coordinate system calling program in simulation software. After encountering a G54.1 P1 prefix command error, he repeatedly consulted references to debug it, and finally the program ran successfully, giving him a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Study, Room XXX, No. X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Laundry and shower
description: Yin Hao put the accumulated clothes into the washing machine, then took a shower to relax. After showering, he hung the clean clothes one by one on the balcony.
location: Balcony, Room XXX, Building X, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Pre-bed preparation and casual chat.
description: Yin Hao returned to the bedroom, set the alarm for the next day, exchanged WeChat messages with Lin Yue to share the day's gains and interesting stories, then read a few pages of the Machine Tool Maintenance Manual and felt sleepy.
location: Bedroom, Room XXX, No. X, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Yin Hao turned off the light and lay down. Reviewing the busy and fulfilling day, he fell into a deep sleep, feeling grounded and satisfied.
location: Bedroom, Room XXX, No. X, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and knee rehabilitation exercises
description: At 6:40 a.m. the alarm went off. Yin Hao got up, felt slight stiffness in his right knee, and immediately did rehabilitation exercises by the bed: 2 sets of straight-leg raises (15 reps each) and a 60-second wall sit, then applied a hot towel to his knee to promote blood circulation.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast preparation and meal
description: After a rehabilitation heat compress, Yin Hao went into the kitchen, toasted two slices of bread with the toaster, heated some milk, and ate a boiled egg. While eating, he checked the weather on his phone and decided to drive to work to avoid the cold wind irritating his knees.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai — home kitchen

name: Driving to the factory
description: After breakfast, Yin Hao changed into his work uniform, put on thick sports socks to protect his knees, grabbed his car keys and shoulder bag, and went downstairs. He drove the family car along Guangfulin Road, turned onto Huatianjing Road, and arrived at the factory at 7:55 after about 25 minutes.
location: From 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Plant, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning work and online shopping for knee pads.
description: After arriving at the factory, he changed clothes, clocked in, and started the day's work. This was the last day of the five-axis machine tool operation evaluation survey. Yin Hao first checked the dimensions of the finished flanges processed yesterday; after confirming they were qualified, he placed them in the pending inspection area and reported the day's plan to team leader Wang Lei. During the work break (around 9:30), because of knee discomfort, he opened an e-commerce app on his phone and searched for 'sports running knee pads.' After careful comparison, he ordered a pair of knee pads with support strips and anti-slip design. He continued focusing on completing his tasks and exchanged work-related thoughts with colleague Liu Zhiqiang and mentor Sun Jianguo.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and hands-on learning during the lunch break
description: When the lunch break bell rang, Yin Hao went to the canteen with Liu Zhiqiang and Wang Lei. Lunch included braised chicken pieces, celery with dried tofu, and seaweed egg drop soup. While eating, he listened to Wang Lei complain about a game, reviewed the morning's operations, and asked Engineer Liu about the application of tool radius compensation in five-axis linkage machining. After eating quickly, he returned to the workshop. Under the guidance of Master Sun Jianguo, he used an idle five-axis machine to trial-cut a small aluminum block: he clamped and aligned the workpiece, manually performed tool setting on the X, Y, and Z axes, and ran a self-written three-axis linkage program to machine a 15-degree bevel. The machine ran smoothly for about 10 minutes, and the finished surface was smooth. Master Sun measured it, gave his approval, and suggested increasing the feed rate. Yin Hao took careful notes. Then he cleaned up the aluminum chips, wiped down the workbench, went back to the rest area for water, and wrote in his phone memo: next week's optimization—increase feed rate by 10-15%. He then closed his eyes and rested until 13:00.
location: Canteen and workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work
description: In the afternoon, continue processing flange parts, strictly following the drawings for turning, milling, and drilling. Pay attention to cutting fluid and tool condition, try adjusting the feed rate, and experience optimization of the cutting process. Focus on work amid the roar of machinery until the 17:30 off-work bell, then complete production records and clean the workstation.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: On the way home after work, stopped for shopping
description: After work, Yin Hao drove away from the factory and went on the way to the Xingang Xincun fresh supermarket. He picked out bok choy, tomatoes, spring onions, and a pack of frozen dumplings, and also grabbed a carton of plain milk. After shopping, he drove back home on Guangfulin Road, arrived at the community underground garage around 18:21, and carried the shopping bags upstairs.
location: From the factory at 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, via the Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket at Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, returned to the home at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner preparation and dining.
description: After returning home, he changed clothes and washed his hands. He first applied a hot towel to his knee for 5 minutes, then boiled noodles, washed the greens and tomatoes, and made a pot of tomato and egg noodles. While eating the noodles, he watched a technical explanation video about five-axis machine tool post-processing settings on his tablet.
location: Home kitchen/dining room at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organizing study notes
description: After dinner, I cleaned up the kitchen, sat down at the desk, opened the laptop, launched OneNote, and entered the handwritten study notes from February 9 to 12 (coordinate system settings, tool compensation, A/C axis definitions, etc.) into an electronic document. I also specially recorded Master Sun's suggestion from noon and marked a red question mark next to "RTCP parameter settings" for later consultation.
location: Study at home, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Called his comrade-in-arms and searched for knee rehabilitation information
description: After finishing organizing his notes, Yin Hao sent a voice message to his comrade-in-arms Zhang Jianguo to ask about knee discomfort. Zhang Jianguo called back via WeChat voice and shared his rehabilitation experience from his time as a fitness trainer. He suggested persisting with wall sits and single-leg glute bridges, and recommended sports knee pads. The two agreed to play online games over the weekend. After the call, Yin Hao searched for 'patellar tendinitis rehabilitation exercises' and 'running knee pad reviews', and saved useful articles and videos.
location: Home: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up, bedtime preparation, and going to sleep
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai - bathroom and bedroom at home.

name: Morning preparation and package pickup
description: After the alarm went off, he got up and did 10 minutes of morning knee rehabilitation exercises (straight leg raises, wall sits). He felt the stiffness ease, then applied a warm compress for 5 minutes and washed up. For breakfast, he had oatmeal with milk and sliced bread. Checking his phone, he saw that the knee brace he bought online had arrived at the community parcel locker. He packed the gifts and a change of clothes into the backpack, watered the potted plants on the windowsill, went down to the community parcel locker to pick up the new knee brace, and put it on.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai — rental residence and community parcel lockers.

name: Drive to work
description: Drove from Xingang Residential Area to the factory via Guangfulin Road, arriving at the parking lot of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory at 7:20.
location: Parking lot, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning work and leave request
description: Swiped my card to enter the factory, changed into work clothes, took over from the night-shift colleague, and checked the machine tool status. Then I started machining flanges. I proactively explained to team leader Wang Lei that I needed to go to Hangzhou in the afternoon to handle personal matters, and successfully got half a day of leave approved. Afterwards, I focused on adjusting production parameters.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Seeking advice on a five-axis CNC RTCP issue
description: During a work break, I showed Master Sun Jianguo the video recorded last night and asked about the spindle orientation error caused by RTCP parameters. Master Sun demonstrated on the machine and pointed out that the A-axis positive direction setting was opposite to the machine's actual travel. Suddenly realizing the issue, I noted down the key points in my phone memo.
location: Beside the five-axis CNC machine in the workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Browsing home-buying information
description: In the rest area, I opened the Beike Zhaofang app and searched for new developments and second-hand homes in Songjiang, Shanghai, as well as Huaqiao and Jiashan. I found that properties around 90 square meters generally had total prices above 1.5 million yuan. After calculating the down payment gap, I felt pressure and saved a few low-total-price small units to look at in detail on the weekend.
location: Rest area of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Continue morning production
description: After the work break, I returned to the machine tool and adjusted the rough machining program for the small trial-cut workpiece according to Master Sun's explanation. Within two hours, the flange and the trial-cut workpiece were successfully machined, and all measured dimensions met the drawing requirements.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch, midday rest, and pre-departure preparation.
description: Had lunch with Wang Lei and Master Sun in the cafeteria, and confirmed that the afternoon leave OA application had been approved. After the meal, cleaned the machine tool and workbench, and packed up personal belongings. At 13:00, went to the parking lot, checked the tire pressure around the car, recorded the vehicle condition, and confirmed there was enough fuel, preparing for the long drive.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory canteen and parking lot, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to Hangzhou
description: Set off from the factory and headed for Hangzhou via the G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway. Stopped at the Jiaxing Service Area for 15 minutes, took off the knee pads and stretched his knees. Smoothly entered the Hangzhou urban area at 15:50.
location: From Songjiang District, Shanghai, via the G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway to Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.

name: Hotel check-in and rest
description: Arrived at Home Inn Plus, checked in, and after putting away luggage, soaked a towel in hot water and applied it to his right knee for 5 minutes. He sent a WeChat message to his cousin Chen Xiaowen to let her know he had arrived in Hangzhou, and made plans for lunch tomorrow.
location: Home Inn Selected (Hangzhou Wen'er Road Shentangqiao Metro Station Branch), No. 28, Wen'er Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Exploring the Surroundings and Dinner Arrangements
description: After putting on knee pads, I took a walk around the hotel to get familiar with the area and found a convenience store and a Hangzhou-style restaurant. At 16:30 I sent Lin Yue a WeChat message telling her I had settled in and asking when she got off work. Back in the room, based on Lin Yue's preferences, I searched for well-reviewed Hangzhou-style restaurants nearby, chose one that was an 8-minute walk away, took a screenshot and sent it to Lin Yue for confirmation, then lay down to rest and relax.
location: Surroundings and room at Homeinns Selected Hotel, 28 Wen'er Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: First in-person date dinner with Lin Yue.
description: At 17:30, walked from the hotel to the agreed restaurant; at 17:40, met Lin Yue at the entrance. After sitting down, ordered steamed sea bass and Longjing shrimp, chatting about work anecdotes while eating, and the atmosphere gradually became warm and pleasant. Gave her the carefully prepared gifts (Bluetooth earbuds and an interesting book on CNC technology), and Lin Yue was very pleasantly surprised. At 19:30, after dinner, accompanied Lin Yue on foot to the Garden New Village bus stop, told her to dress warmly, and watched her get on the bus and leave.
location: A Hangzhou-style restaurant on Wen'er Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, and Huayuan Xincun Bus Stop

name: Return to the hotel and chat.
description: Walked back to the hotel, took off his jacket and knee pads. Checking his phone, he saw that Lin Yue had sent a WeChat message saying she was safe and sharing a West Lake sightseeing guide. He replied and skimmed through the guide, feeling relaxed and happy.
location: Room at Home Inn Plus, 28 Wen'er Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Evening rehabilitation and organizing plans
description: After washing up, he applied a hot towel to his knee again for 10 minutes. Sitting at the small table, he opened the memo app on his phone, noted the key points of the RTCP parameter settings explained by Master Sun, wrote down today's reflections, and planned tomorrow's itinerary: visit West Lake in the morning, have lunch with his cousin, and drive back to Shanghai in the afternoon depending on the time.
location: Room at Home Inn Plus, 28 Wen'er Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Bedtime greetings and sleep
description: After getting into bed, I sent a goodnight message to Lin Yue and received a moon emoji reply. I also sent a WeChat message to my father Yin Jianguo, who is far away in Nantong, reminding him to remember to measure his blood pressure. At 22:30 I turned off the light and fell into a deep sleep, looking forward to tomorrow.
location: Room at Home Inn Plus, 28 Wen'er Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Morning wake-up and recovery.
description: Around 7 a.m., Yin Hao's phone alarm went off. After waking up, he lay in bed and moved his ankle and right knee, feeling that the soreness from climbing Baoshi Mountain was still there but lighter than last night. He picked up his phone and sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend, Lin Yue, telling her he had just woken up and about his knee condition, and agreed to meet at Broken Bridge at 9:30. Then he opened the mobile banking app, confirmed the 1,000 yuan automatic index fund investment had been deducted successfully yesterday, and checked his current account balance and fund holdings gains, silently calculating the gap to the down payment for a house. After that, he got up to boil water and did knee rehabilitation exercises: 8 minutes of straight leg raises, wall squats, and resistance band side leg raises, with standard and controlled movements. Then he applied a hot compress to the front of his right knee and patellar tendon for about 10 minutes, took a shower, put on a black thin windbreaker and sweatpants, and carefully put on his supportive knee brace.
location: Guest room, Home Inn Plus (Hangzhou Wen'er Road Shentangqiao Metro Station Branch), No. 28, Wen'er Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Breakfast and itinerary confirmation
description: Yin Hao, wearing knee pads, walked about 27 minutes from the hotel to the FamilyMart on Jiaogong Road. He picked out a tuna sandwich, a bottle of milk, and a tea egg as breakfast and quickly ate them in the store's dining area. Meanwhile, he sent a WeChat message to his cousin Chen Xiaowen, telling her that he and Lin Yue would arrive at Zhiweiguan around 10 o'clock, and agreeing to go there directly. His cousin quickly replied to confirm.
location: FamilyMart (Jiaogong Road Store 4), Jiaogong Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Visiting West Lake with Lin Yue
description: After breakfast, Yin Hao ordered a ride-hailing car on his phone and arrived at the Broken Bridge and Remnant Snow scenic area around 9:08. Lin Yue was already waiting there. After meeting up, considering Yin Hao's knee condition, they decided not to climb the hill and instead walked slowly along Bai Causeway and through Gushan Park. In the early spring, a gentle breeze blew across West Lake; they chatted while walking and stopped to take photos whenever they came across a nice view. When they got tired, they rested on a bench beside Bai Causeway and shared the chocolate Lin Yue had brought and the milk Yin Hao had bought. Around 10:20, Lin Yue bought two cups of hot milk tea at the 'Huyin' tea shop on the roadside, and they continued along the northern section of Su Causeway to the Spring Dawn at Su Causeway monument. The round trip was about 4 kilometers in total. Yin Hao deliberately slowed his pace, and his knee felt okay, with no obvious limp.
location: Hangzhou West Lake Scenic Area (section from Broken Bridge with Remnant Snow to Su Causeway in Spring Dawn), Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Had lunch with my older female cousin and took a rest after the meal.
description: Yin Hao and Lin Yue took a taxi from Su Di Chun Xiao to Zhiweiguan, arriving about 15 minutes later. His cousin Chen Xiaowen was already waiting at a window seat on the second floor. Chen Xiaowen dressed casually and warmly greeted Lin Yue. When ordering, she specially catered to Yin Hao's taste, ordering soup dumplings, Dongpo pork, steamed sea bass, West Lake water shield soup, and scallion pancakes. During the meal, his cousin shared fun stories about UI design at an internet company, Lin Yue talked about daily work at a medical device company, and Yin Hao told fresh stories about working with five-axis CNC machines at the factory. When Lin Yue went to the restroom, Yin Hao handed his cousin a stomach pill and told her to drink less and eat more. After the meal, his cousin paid the bill. The three sat drinking tea at the table; Yin Hao sent a voice message to his mother to let her know they were safe, texted his father on WeChat to ask about his blood pressure, and sent a photo of the dishes.
location: Zhiweiguan (Hubin Main Store), 83-1 Renhe Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Longjing and Jiuxi hiking
description: After lunch, considering that Yin Hao's knees were not suitable for high-intensity cycling, his cousin suggested changing to a slow-paced hike at Longjing and Jiuxi. The three took a taxi from Zhiweiguan to Longjing Village and took a group photo at the tea garden viewing platform at the village entrance. Then they walked slowly along Nine Creeks in Mist toward Nine Creeks and Eighteen Brooks. Yin Hao walked in the middle with a light pace, while Lin Yue and his cousin walked on either side, chatting and taking photos. The scenery was serene, with babbling streams and mountain breezes. They rested for 10 minutes in front of the waterfall at Nine Creeks in Mist, and Yin Hao bought three bottles of water. The whole hike was about 3.5 kilometers, taking about 1 hour 40 minutes on gentle terrain, with little pressure on his knees.
location: Road section from Longjing Village, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, to Nine Creeks and Eighteen Streams.

name: Preparing dinner at my cousin's house
description: At 4 p.m., the three of them took a taxi from the exit of Nine Creeks and Eighteen Ravines to the cousin's rental apartment on Wensan Road, about half an hour by car. After arriving at the cousin's home, Yin Hao proactively took the apron and helped out, quickly washing vegetables, cutting tomatoes, and blanching pork ribs; Lin Yue helped set the bowls and chopsticks; the cousin did the cooking. The three of them squeezed into the small kitchen and worked together in a warm atmosphere, finally making scrambled eggs with tomatoes, braised pork ribs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and steamed a sea bass.
location: Cousin Chen Xiaowen's home, a residential building next to Huaxing Technology Building, 478 Wensan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Warm dinner and farewell.
description: Dinner proceeded in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere. The three of them chatted while eating, sharing travel tips and fun stories from their trip to Changsha. His cousin quietly told Yin Hao that Lin Yue was a nice girl and that he should treat her well. Lin Yue also took the initiative to add the cousin on WeChat. After dinner, Yin Hao rushed to do the dishes while Lin Yue helped wipe the table. Around 8 p.m., Yin Hao and Lin Yue got up to leave, thanking the cousin for her hospitality throughout the day.
location: Cousin Chen Xiaowen's home, a residential building next to Huaxing Technology Building, 478 Wensan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Returned to the hotel and did knee care.
description: He took a taxi from his cousin's home and returned to the hotel in about 15 minutes. After entering the room, Yin Hao boiled a pot of hot water and carefully applied a hot compress to his knee and did gentle stretching for 15 minutes. While applying the compress, he recalled the day's activities and felt that the overall pace had been well controlled and his knee had not noticeably worsened. Afterwards, he took out his phone and booked a regular orthopedic outpatient appointment at Songjiang District Central Hospital, Shanghai for 8:30 next Monday (February 17), planning to get checked as soon as he returned to Shanghai.
location: Guest room, Home Inn Plus (Hangzhou Wen'er Road Shentangqiao Metro Station Branch), No. 28, Wen'er Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Evening communication and wrap-up with Lin Yue.
description: After the hot compress, Lin Yue sent a WeChat message, and Yin Hao invited her to come sit with him at the hotel. The two had a heart-to-heart talk in the room, mainly discussing how to coordinate sleep schedules in a long-distance relationship. Lin Yue frankly said that her habit of staying up late would be difficult to change immediately, but she was willing to try putting down her phone before 11 PM; Yin Hao expressed understanding and patience, and they agreed to arrange video call times flexibly. They also initially worked out a plan to meet at least once a month. This communication made them understand and trust each other more. Around 10 PM, Lin Yue left, and Yin Hao started packing: he folded the windbreaker and knee pads into his backpack, sent a thank-you WeChat message to his older female cousin and confirmed tomorrow's route back to Shanghai, set an alarm for 8 AM, and finally sent 'Good night' to Lin Yue and received a bear-hug emoji sticker in reply.
location: Guest room, Home Inn Plus (Hangzhou Wen'er Road Shentangqiao Metro Station Branch), No. 28, Wen'er Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Going to bed
description: After checking all items, Yin Hao turned off the light and lay down. Although his waist and back were a little sore from the day's activities, thinking about the emotional connection and family warmth he had gained today, and that his knee had no major issues, he felt relaxed, turned over, and soon fell asleep.
location: Guest room, Home Inn Plus (Hangzhou Wen'er Road Shentangqiao Metro Station Branch), No. 28, Wen'er Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Morning at the hotel and checkout preparations
description: After waking up early in the morning, my girlfriend Lin Yue and I exchanged good mornings via WeChat, shared the joy of yesterday's mountain climb and the knee discomfort, and confirmed our agreement to video-call at 9 p.m. every night. Then I organized my suitcase, neatly placed the gift boxes and clothes, put on the knee brace to protect my right knee, checked all my luggage, and checked out online.
location: Guest room, Home Inn Plus (Hangzhou Wen'er Road Shentangqiao Metro Station Branch), No. 28, Wen'er Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Drove to the fitness club in Binjiang District
description: After checking out, I drove from the hotel along Wensan Road and the Zhonghe elevated road to the ep Fitness Club on Binsheng Road in Binjiang District. I played music on the way and was in a good mood.
location: En route from No. 28 Wen'er Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province to No. 2248 Binsheng Road, Binjiang District.

name: Fitness training and rest with fellow soldiers.
description: After arriving at EP Fitness Club, met up with fellow soldier and coach Zhang Jianguo. He gave me a tour of the club. We changed into workout clothes, started with a 10-minute jogging warm-up and joint mobility exercises, and shared knee injury rehab experience. Then we did strength training, focusing on bench press, seated row, and crunches, while avoiding knee-stressing exercises like squats. After the workout, we took a group photo in front of the full-length mirror in the gym. Afterwards, we sat on a bench in the small plaza outside the club and chatted about how our fellow soldiers were doing and our future plans.
location: EP Fitness Club, 2248 Binsheng Road, Binjiang District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, and the small square outside

name: Had lunch with a comrade-in-arms.
description: After training, we went to the Hangzhou cuisine restaurant Longtang Li near the club. I ordered West Lake Fish in Vinegar Gravy, Dongpo Pork, and Cong Bao Hui. Zhang Jianguo congratulated me on establishing a relationship with Lin Yue, we shared about our work and lives, and agreed to meet again next time.
location: Nongtangli Restaurant near Binsheng Road, Binjiang District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Drive back home in Shanghai.
description: After saying goodbye to my comrades, I drove back to Shanghai along the G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway. On the way, I stopped at Jiaxing Service Area for about 15 minutes to rest, and bought mineral water and nuts. I arrived at the residential complex at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai at 3:50 p.m.
location: Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province to No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, via G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway and Jiaxing Service Area

name: Return home, get organized, and do knee rehabilitation training.
description: After getting home, I put away the Hangzhou specialties I had brought back, started the washing machine to clean the dirty clothes, then took a hot shower and changed into loungewear. After a short rest, I did knee rehabilitation exercises on the living room mat: 3 sets of straight-leg raises and 2 sets of wall sits, then applied a hot water bottle brought back from Hangzhou to my knee for 15 minutes.
location: Home, 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Takeout dinner and information processing
description: I ordered the "Shanghai-style braised pork set meal" through a food delivery app, and it arrived half an hour later. While eating, I handled phone messages: replied to colleague Wang Lei about tomorrow's work, liked my mother Wang Xiuying's Moments post, and shared photos and status of arriving home with my girlfriend Lin Yue.
location: Home, 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening leisure at home and waiting for the video.
description: After dinner, I washed the dishes and folded the dried clothes. I set up the phone stand in the living room to prepare for the evening video call. I contacted my brother Yin Tao to confirm the video call time and learned that he would only get home a bit later. While waiting, I lay on the sofa browsing fishing forums, paying attention to spring fishing tips and conditions at Dianshan Lake, and brewed a cup of Longjing tea I brought back from Hangzhou to enjoy.
location: Home, 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Had a video call with my brother Yin Tao.
description: At 8 PM sharp, I had a video call with my older brother Yin Tao. I shared the story of the Hangzhou date and the good news that Lin Yue and I had become a couple. My brother reminded me to watch the expenses of a long-distance relationship and asked how my work was going. We talked about what we had both been up to and agreed to go back to our hometown in Rudong together during the Qingming Festival to visit our parents.
location: Home, 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Teamed up with my brother to play Honor of Kings
description: After the video call ended, my brother suggested playing a game. I opened Honor of Kings and accepted his ranked match invitation. I used Di Renjie, and he used Zhang Fei as support. We coordinated well and won a game smoothly, and we agreed to team up again before the Qingming Festival.
location: Home, 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparations and saying goodnight.
description: After gaming, thinking of the 9 p.m. video call agreement with my girlfriend and the workday schedule, I decisively uninstalled Honor of Kings. Then I went to the bathroom to wash up and put on my pajamas. Lying in bed, I had a brief video call with my girlfriend Lin Yue, and we said goodnight to each other.
location: Home, 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going to bed
description: Reviewing today's fulfilling experiences, after turning off the light I adjusted my sleeping position and quickly fell asleep, recharging for Monday's work and the orthopedic clinic.
location: Home, 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wake up, morning run (stopped due to injury), and knee cold compress
description: At 6:30 in the morning, the alarm went off and he woke up naturally. Although his right knee still felt sore and swollen, he still wanted to try a slow recovery run. He put on his running shoes, did some simple stretching, and went out, jogging along his usual morning running route on Guangfulin Road. About 1 kilometer in, at the intersection of Guangfulin Road and Longyuan Road, a sharp pain suddenly shot through the front of his right knee. He stopped immediately and limped home. Once home, he took an ice pack from the refrigerator, wrapped it in a towel, and sat on the sofa applying cold compresses to his knee for 15 minutes. Feeling frustrated and alert, he opened the running app on his phone and recorded the data as “stopped due to injury.”
location: Near the intersection of Guangfulin Road and Longyuan Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (residence: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai)

name: Washing up, breakfast, and gear preparation
description: After taking a warm shower, he changed into clean work clothes. Breakfast was oatmeal with milk and two boiled eggs. While eating, he checked the weather on his phone: sunny, 3-10°C, northwest wind force 3. He packed the textbook *Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming*, a notebook, a power bank, and the Longjing cakes brought back from Hangzhou into his backpack, and got ready to leave.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Drove to the hospital.
description: Put on his coat and knee pads, then set off in the family car. During the morning rush hour, traffic on Guangfulin Road was heavy and slow; about 15 minutes later he arrived at Songjiang Hospital affiliated with Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine, found a spot in the parking lot, and parked.
location: Along the way from Lane 123, Guangfulin Road to Songjiang Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine

name: Orthopedics outpatient visit and examination
description: At 8:00, he registered for orthopedics through the self-service registration machine and went to the third floor to wait. At 8:30, he was called. He described in detail to the doctor the sharp pain in the front of his right knee while running that morning. After the doctor performed the drawer test and the McMurray test, he made a preliminary diagnosis of early patellar tendinitis and recommended an MRI of the knee joint to confirm the diagnosis. After paying the fee, he scheduled the examination and was told that a regular MRI appointment required a wait of 2-3 days. He booked Thursday (February 20) at 8:30 a.m. The doctor prescribed oral anti-inflammatory painkillers (diclofenac sodium sustained-release tablets) and a topical plaster, and told him not to run or do strenuous exercise, and to take the stairs less. While waiting in line at the pharmacy window, he sent Lin Yue a WeChat message saying that he had seen a doctor about his knee, it was not a big deal, he had gotten medicine, and an MRI was scheduled for Thursday.
location: Songjiang Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine, 748 Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Paid the fee, picked up the medicine, and drove to the company.
description: At 9:35, after picking up the medicine at the pharmacy, I put it in my bag. Then I drove out of the hospital, followed the navigation along Songhui Middle Road onto Huatianjing Road, and after about a 28-minute drive, arrived at the workshop entrance of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory at 10:00.
location: Along the way from Songjiang Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory

name: Morning workshop work: hands-on operation of a five-axis machine tool.
description: At 10:00, I arrived at the post and changed into work shoes. Master Sun Jianguo was already waiting by the new five-axis machine tool that had been debugged yesterday, and handed me a rough machining program drawing for a precision impeller part. I put on safety goggles, started the machine, loaded the program, and confirmed that the tool and workpiece were clamped correctly. After completing the first rough machining pass on the datum surface, I used a micrometer and found a 0.02 mm deviation in the Z-axis dimension. Master Sun came over and guided me to fine-tune the tool length compensation value on the machine panel. I recorded as I worked, and before stopping at 12:00, I independently completed the trial cutting of the second batch, and the results were fully qualified.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch break: canteen lunch and chatting
description: At 12:00, he met colleagues Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang at the cafeteria. The cafeteria was serving braised chicken pieces and stir-fried greens. After sitting down, he brought up the fact that he had gone to orthopedics in the morning because of knee pain from running. Wang Lei, being outspoken, said, “Old Yin, you'd better take it easy with that leg. Don't end up wrecking yourself for the sake of running. Let's skip the run this weekend and go play a few rounds of CS:GO at that newly discovered internet cafe?” Liu Zhiqiang chimed in, “Right, balance running with rest. I have an acupoint chart for rehabilitation therapy here—I'll send you a photo later.” He smiled in response, opened the Longjing tea pastry he had brought, and shared it with everyone.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Afternoon workshop work: fixture optimization and hands-on operation.
description: In the afternoon, as soon as work started, he took out the drawings and the morning's notes and discussed the root cause of the Z-axis deviation found in the morning with Master Sun. Master Sun judged that the Y-direction positioning block of the fixture was slightly worn. Together they used a lever dial indicator to align it, fine-tuned the positioning block's position, and locked it in place. Then, following the drawings, he independently operated the five-axis machine tool to machine a second, more complex part. While operating, he recalled the coordinate system concepts from Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming. At 4:30 p.m., he finished machining the part, and it passed inspection. At 5:30, he cleaned the workstation, shut down the machine, turned off the lights, and left work.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: After work, drove home and picked up a package
description: He got off work at 17:35 and drove about 20 minutes home. After parking, he stopped by the Kuainiao parcel station at the community entrance and picked up a package—the fishing bait (musk wine rice) he had ordered online a few days earlier. Once home, he took the braised pork left by his mother out of the refrigerator, thawed it, and heated it in the microwave together with potato chunks, while quickly cooking rice in the rice cooker.
location: Community Kuainiao parcel station along the route from Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory to No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road

name: Dinner and a brief rest
description: 18:10, the braised pork with potatoes and rice are ready. While eating, I scrolled through a fishing forum on my phone and saw fishing buddy Brother Wu sharing today's catch from Dianshan Lake in the group chat, so I replied with an envious emoji. After the meal, I cleared the table, opened the window for ventilation, then sat on the sofa and applied a hot towel to my right knee for 15 minutes, feeling relaxed.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Evening self-study: Deep dive into five-axis programming
description: At 19:00, he sat down at his desk and opened "Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming." Drawing on the hands-on practice at the machine tool during the day, he focused on tackling the chapter "Coordinate System for Inclined Surface Machining." He drew a simple blade model in SolidWorks and then tried running coordinate transformation code in the simulation software. When he came across an unfamiliar G68.2 code, he took a photo and planned to ask Master Sun about it the next day. Sitting for a long time caused some soreness in his lower back, so he stood up and moved around for a while, then continued studying until 21:00.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Search and calculate residence permit points
description: Opened the official website of the Shanghai Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau and went to the Residence Permit Points Simulation Scoring page. Carefully checked each item: age (30 points), education (secondary specialized school, 0 points), skills (intermediate worker certificate, can add 4 points), social insurance (3 years in Shanghai, about 15 points in total), years working in Shanghai (3 years, 3 points). The estimated total score ranged from 95 to 105 points, still clearly far from 120 points. He sent the screenshot to his alternate WeChat account and bookmarked the Senior CNC Technician Training Registration page in his browser, silently resolving that he must obtain the senior technician certificate this year.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Video call with Lin Yue
description: At 21:30, he initiated a WeChat video call. Lin Yue answered; she was reading at home. He told her in detail the whole story of his knee injury this morning and his visit to the doctor. She said seriously, "Listen to the doctor, don't push yourself. Tell me when the test results come out on Thursday." Feeling warm inside, he also casually mentioned looking into the Shanghai home-buying points system, and sighed, "I feel so far from 120 points." Lin Yue encouraged, "Take it one step at a time. Pass your senior technician certificate first and save up some money. When the time comes for a loan, I can help you think of ideas too." After 15 minutes, they said goodnight and hung up.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Evening wrap-up and bedtime preparation
description: After hanging up the video call, he sent a WeChat message to his mother Wang Xiuying to let her know he was fine: "Mom, I went to the hospital for my knee today. The doctor said it's a minor problem and prescribed some medicine. Don't worry." Then he took out his father's blood pressure log from the bedside table and recorded today's data: systolic 132, diastolic 85, normal. Then he charged his phone and poured half a glass of warm water into the bedside cup. At 22:00, he washed up briefly and changed into pajamas. Lying in bed, he reflected on the day: although the knee problem was worrying, he had made progress at work, studied in the evening, and clarified his goals. He set an alarm for 6:30 the next morning. At 22:30, he turned off the light and fell asleep feeling a little tired but fulfilled.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China
