name: Morning knee rehabilitation exercises and breakfast
description: After getting up, he boiled water with an electric kettle, applied a hot water bottle to his knees for 15 minutes, and did rehabilitation exercises such as side-lying leg raises and hamstring stretches. After washing up, he heated red bean buns and brewed instant coffee for breakfast, and weighed 71.1 kg.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting by car to the factory
description: After checking his belongings, he drove from home to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, along Longyuan Road, Chenhua Road, and Huatianjing Highway, deliberately slowing down to pay attention to how his knee felt, arriving in about 23 minutes.
location: No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-shift preparation and morning meeting.
description: After arriving at the factory, he changed into safety shoes and a work cap, clocked in, checked the five-axis machine tool's status and lubricating oil level, and cleaned the workbench. At the morning meeting held by team leader Wang Lei, it was confirmed that today they would continue machining flanges; he was responsible for programming and debugging, Sun Jianguo for technical guidance, and Liu Zhiqiang for quality inspection.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: In the morning, he did five-axis machine tool programming and debugging and exchanged ideas with colleagues.
description: Clamped the blank, powered on the machine, and wrote the G-code for the flange. During the first dry-run simulation, I found the tool feed path was too fast. I asked Master Sun, who happened to be passing by. He explained the trochoidal milling feed strategy and adjusted the parameters, and the second simulation succeeded. During the break, I discussed Bilibili programming videos and PLC ladder logic issues with Wang Lei, and we agreed to study forum cases together in the evening.
location: Five-axis machine tool workstation in the workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360, Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: During lunch, asked Master Sun for advice on machining techniques
description: At the company cafeteria lunch, asked Sun Jianguo about part surface roughness. Master Sun patiently explained the effects of stepover and feed rate on surface finish, and used his phone to draw a sketch to illustrate; I recorded the key points in detail.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon flange machining and wrap-up work
description: In the afternoon, I continued machining flanges. After each one was completed, I inspected it with a vernier caliper and a roughness tester to ensure it met specifications. Halfway through, I got up and moved around to relieve stiffness in my lower back. I eventually finished 6 parts, all with qualifying parameters. I cleaned the iron chips off the machine tool, oiled the guide rails, and recorded the program numbers and debugging notes in the work log.
location: Five-axis machine tool workstation in the workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360, Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove home after work and bought vegetables and fruit.
description: After work, he drove away from the factory and went to Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket to buy apples, bananas, bok choy, and strawberries. Then he drove back to the Guangfulin Road residential community, parked in the underground garage, and carried the groceries upstairs. He hit a brief traffic jam on the way; the whole trip took about 37 minutes.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner at home and applying a hot compress to the knee
description: After arriving home, washed hands and heated up the electric hot water bag. For dinner, made a vegetable salad and red bean buns, and replied to WeChat messages while eating. After the meal, used the hot water bag on the right knee and sat resting.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening rehabilitation training and study
description: Because of lower back soreness, he lay in bed listening to the audio of a Bilibili programming tutorial video, while doing supine back stretches and lower back relaxation movements. Later, he got up and used OneNote at his desk to record the feed rate points Master Sun had explained and the afternoon debugging issues.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening leisure and relaxation
description: After brewing tea, he curled up on the living room sofa and scrolled on his phone, checking feedback from anglers on the fishing forum about Dianshan Lake and planning the weekend fishing trip; he liked runner friend Chen Jie's morning run post and left a comment explaining his knee injury, agreeing to arrange another run after recovery.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with girlfriend Lin Yue
description: Had a WeChat video call with girlfriend Lin Yue, sharing the sense of achievement from successfully debugging the program today, talking about back and waist soreness and rehabilitation training, listening to her worries about wrapping up a project at her company, and comforting and encouraging each other for about 20 minutes.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Went downstairs to take out the trash and chatted with the neighbors.
description: Before washing up, I went downstairs to take out the trash. At the garbage disposal point, I met my neighbor Aunt Chen walking her dog. She asked with concern about my knee recovery. After a brief chat, I went back upstairs.
location: Community waste drop-off point at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: After returning home, I took a hot shower to relax, lay in bed, and used my phone's memo app to note: Thursday — confirm the hospital MRI appointment, and tomorrow — continue asking Master Sun about cycloidal milling details. I set the alarm for 6:30 tomorrow morning, switched to Do Not Disturb mode, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning knee care and rehabilitation knowledge search
description: After the alarm clock rang, Yin Hao felt a dull pain in his right knee. Following the plan, he fetched hot water, wrung out a hot towel, and applied it to his right knee for about 15 minutes. During this time, he used his mobile browser to search for runner's knee pain patellar tendinitis early rehabilitation and read a popular science article on sports rehabilitation. He learned that his symptoms closely matched patellar tendinitis and decided that he must consult his running friend Chen Jie in the evening. After the hot compress, he did several sets of non-weight-bearing quadriceps isometric contractions and straight leg raises and felt good.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Simple breakfast and getting ready to go out.
description: Because of right knee discomfort and the overcast weather, Yin Hao did not go out to buy breakfast. He took out the whole wheat steamed buns and milk left from the previous night from the fridge, heated them briefly, and ate. He checked his phone battery, packed the red bean paste buns given by neighbor Aunt Chen last night into his backpack, planning to bring them to colleague Wang Lei. At 7:30 he changed into his work clothes, took his folding umbrella, and left.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute by car
description: Yin Hao drove to the factory. The road was slippery, so he controlled his speed. Amap navigation showed the route as Guangfulin Road - Jiasong South Road - Huatianjing Road, with an estimated time of 22 minutes. Along the way, he played the “Five-Axis Programming” audio he had downloaded the night before, but because he was focused on the road conditions and thoughts about his knee injury, he didn't really take it in.
location: Songjiang District, Shanghai, en route from Guangfulin Road to Huatianjing Road

name: Pre-shift meeting and task confirmation.
description: After arriving at the factory, I changed clothes. At 8:00 I attended the pre-shift meeting, where team leader Wang Lei assigned today's tasks: continue the finishing batch on the new five-axis machine tool, with more attention to surface finish than yesterday. After the meeting, Yin Hao shared a red bean bun with Wang Lei, who smiled and accepted it. He then confirmed the fixture drawings and tool parameters for today's machining with Master Sun Jianguo.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning work: note organization and precision machining practice
description: During the machine warm-up, Yin Hao returned to the office, opened his laptop, and transcribed yesterday's notes on tool-path optimization corrections from Master Sun and programming insights from his handwritten notebook into a digital file, adding process sketches. At 10:00, machine warm-up finished; he started the first trial cut, focusing intently on the feed parameters. After the first piece was done, he checked it with calipers; all key dimensions passed. At 10:30, he stood up to stretch his sore lower back from sitting too long, did two sets of neck relaxation and waist twists beside the workstation, drank water, and rested. At 11:00, he continued precision machining and completed and passed inspection on the second and third parts. At 11:40, he recorded the shift work order, cleaned the workbench, and got ready to go to the cafeteria.
location: Workshop office and operating console, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360, Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and exchange
description: Yin Hao, Sun Jianguo, Wang Lei, and Liu Zhiqiang sat at one table. The canteen served braised pork and scrambled eggs with tomatoes. Yin Hao proactively brought up the rehabilitation knowledge he had searched for in the morning. Master Sun said he supported him in pausing running, and Wang Lei joked that once his knee healed, he would treat him to spicy hot pot. After the meal, Yin Hao walked slowly along the factory path for ten minutes to exercise his knee.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai - canteen and factory paths.

name: Lunch break and learning outcome report
description: After the lunch break, Yin Hao took his laptop to the technical office to find Master Sun Jianguo. He opened his organized electronic notes and clearly reported the day's learning insights and the problems he had encountered in practice. Master Sun looked carefully at the screen, affirmed the process key points he had summarized, and pointed out a potential risk in a coordinate offset setting in the program, then demonstrated on the spot how to optimize it. Yin Hao carefully noted it down on a sticky note at the desk.
location: Workshop Technical Office, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work: batch processing and rehabilitation issue review
description: After returning to his post, Yin Hao readjusted the tool parameters and began formal batch machining. While operating, he mentally sorted out the questions he wanted to ask Chen Jie later. During breaks in the operation, he took out his phone and quickly listed a series of questions in a notes app: Can I do wall sits in the early stage of patellar tendinitis? What angle? Besides wall sits, what other exercises can strengthen the quadriceps? What are the criteria for judging improvement? After listing them, he continued focusing on the operation and completed 4 qualified parts.
location: Workshop workbench, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wrap-up work and preparation to leave
description: Near the end of the shift, Yin Hao neatly stacked the parts processed that day and filled out the shift work order. He cleaned the machine table and blew down the guide rails with compressed air. At 16:50 he went to the changing room to take off his work clothes, greeted Wang Lei, who told him not to worry too much when consulting Chen Jie in the evening.
location: Workshop and changing rooms, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Purchase ingredients
description: Driving home, Yin Hao stopped by the Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket on the way. As planned, he bought greens, two boxes of silken tofu, a box of eggs, and half a jin of pork belly, planning to make steamed egg with minced pork and garlic lettuce for dinner. After checking out, it was already dark.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive back home.
description: Driving home from the Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Amap navigation showed it would take about 21 minutes. I played light music along the way to let my mind go blank.
location: Songjiang District, Shanghai, en route from Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket to No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road

name: Dinner preparation and dining.
description: After returning home, I washed my hands and turned on the fan heater. I quickly minced and marinated the pork belly, cracked an egg over it, and put it in the steamer; boiled water to blanch the lettuce, and made the sauce. The rice had been cooked on a timer before I left in the morning. At around 18:25, the meal was on the table: steamed egg with minced pork, garlic lettuce, and half a bowl of rice. I replied to work group messages on my phone while eating.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening rest and knee care
description: After clearing the dishes, first walked slowly a dozen or so laps in the living room to aid digestion. Then did tonight's knee care: first applied a hot compress for 10 minutes, then completed a set of unweighted straight-leg raises and supine cycling motions. Felt much more relaxed in the knee.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Check housework and running plan
description: He put the sportswear he changed out of yesterday and the coat he took off today into the washing machine. He sat on the sofa, opened the Iranshao app, and looked at the paused running plan, feeling a little unsettled. Then he browsed Weibo while waiting for the laundry to finish.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Consulted running buddy Chen Jie via WeChat
description: Contacted Chen Jie on WeChat on time. First sent the questions prepared in advance, then sent a voice message describing how the knee felt today. Chen Jie replied quickly and confirmed it as typical symptoms of patellar tendinitis. He suggested that static squats could start from 30 degrees, keeping the knees from going past the toes, and doing more straight-leg exercises. Most importantly, running must be stopped for at least two weeks, and he should go to the hospital for an MRI as soon as possible. Chen Jie also sent a link to a collection of rehabilitation exercises.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Adjusting Half-Marathon Training Plan and Finding a Swimming Pool
description: After the consultation, he opened the iRanshao app and deleted all long runs, tempo runs, and interval runs from the last two weeks of the half-marathon training plan, replacing them with swimming and core strength training. Following Chen Jie's advice, he added specific exercises for each training day: wall sit (30 degrees), resistance band side leg raises, plank, and so on. Then he searched for swimming pools in Songjiang District in the map app, found three, and saved screenshots. After finishing the changes, he sighed softly, then encouraged himself that taking care of his knee first was more important than anything.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with girlfriend
description: As planned, he had a video call with Lin Yue. Yin Hao related in detail the outcome of his consultation with Chen Jie that day and his decision to adjust the plan, and also confided his inner anxiety. Lin Yue comforted him, telling him not to worry and to listen to the professionals. If running didn't work out, she could teach him exercises online to maintain his figure, and on Saturday she would have some free time, so they could do them together via video. Yin Hao felt warmth in his heart and his mood relaxed considerably. They also agreed that she would come to Songjiang to see him next weekend.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Log journal and plan for tomorrow
description: After the call ended, he recorded in his phone memo: 2.19, Wednesday. Consulted Chen Jie and was diagnosed with patellar tendinitis. Modified the half marathon plan and stopped running for at least two weeks. Planned to make an appointment for a hospital check-up tomorrow. Current weight is 71.3 kg (after dinner), so I need to control carbs. Set the alarm for 6:30 tomorrow and opened the map navigation route to Shanghai Songjiang District Central Hospital.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Stretching before bed and going to sleep.
description: He finished the final 10 minutes of back stretching, then turned off the lights and lay down. Outside the window, the sound of rain gradually faded. He steadied his breathing. Though he had some worry about tomorrow's examination, he felt more of the calm that came from having carried out the plan. Closing his eyes, he ran through tomorrow's routine: go to the hospital on an empty stomach, eat breakfast after the MRI, and then go to work. With the plan clear, he fell into a deep sleep.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wake-up and morning rehabilitation
description: The alarm went off on time. Yin Hao didn't get up immediately. He first moved his right knee in bed, feeling that the slight pain from yesterday had already eased a lot. As planned, he did 15 minutes of rehabilitation training: applied a hot towel to his knee, then did straight leg raises and wall sits. His knee felt more supportive again. After washing up, he put on clean work clothes, brought his medical insurance card and ID card, and got ready for the hospital appointment.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute and missed morning video call
description: Yin Hao drove from Guangfulin Road to Songjiang Hospital Affiliated with Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine. The traffic on the way was not too heavy. At 7:40, while waiting at a red light, he made a video call to his girlfriend Lin Yue to remind her not to forget breakfast. But the ringtone rang until it hung up automatically, and no one answered. He sighed helplessly, guessing that she had stayed up late drawing again last night. After hanging up, he sent Lin Yue a gentle voice message: "Yueyue, did you stay up late again? Remember to get up and eat something. Don't always let me worry. I'm on my way to the hospital for a check-up now; I'll tell you when the results come out." He felt a little disappointed, but knowing they could have a good talk in the evening, he focused on the matter at hand.
location: En route from Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Songjiang Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine

name: Hospital MRI scan.
description: Arrived at Songjiang Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine, picked up the appointment number at the self-service machine, and then registered at the radiology department. Around 8:20, Yin Hao was called into the examination room. Following the doctor's instructions, he lay down and completed the right knee MRI scan amid loud noise; the process took about 30 minutes. Afterward, the doctor said the routine report would take about 2 hours and could be printed at the self-service report machine.
location: Songjiang Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine, No. 2180 Rongle East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive to the company
description: After leaving the hospital, the sunshine was nice. Yin Hao drove to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory at No. 360 Huatianjing Road. On the way, he checked his phone; Lin Yue still hadn't replied. He didn't send another message, to avoid putting pressure on her. He thought to himself that he would call at lunch break to ask whether the report was ready.
location: On the way from Songjiang Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine in Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory.

name: Workshop work and five-axis machine tool evaluation
description: After arriving at the company, Yin Hao changed into work clothes. Team leader Wang Lei told him that today's primary task was to assist Master Sun Jianguo in completing the performance evaluation of the new five-axis machine tool. Following the test procedure, he operated the machine to process a standard test piece and recorded key data such as machining time and surface roughness in detail. Master Sun used a laser interferometer to measure the positioning accuracy of the machine tool, and Yin Hao assisted with recording. The morning's work was very focused; his knee felt slightly swollen after standing for a long time, so he sat down and moved it around while drinking water.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break: light lunch and ordering study materials.
description: At noon, Yin Hao and his colleague Liu Zhiqiang went to the cafeteria together. He deliberately ordered a serving of stir-fried broccoli, a serving of poached shrimp, and a bowl of rice, trying to keep it light and low in oil. While eating, he opened the shopping app on his phone, searched for five-axis CNC programming advanced, carefully compared several textbooks and an online course named Five-Axis CNC Programming: From Beginner to Mastery, and after confirming the reviews and suitability, decisively placed the order. It cost about 500 yuan in total. After payment succeeded, it showed that books including Five-Axis CNC Machining Technology and Programming Examples would arrive in three days, and the activation code for the online course had been sent to his phone.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Quickly activate the online course
description: After lunch, Yin Hao returned to his workstation and, using the last bit of his lunch break, opened the link in the text message, entered the activation code, and successfully activated the online course. He quickly glanced through the course catalog and found that it covered exactly the core modules he wanted to learn, such as coordinate systems and tool path planning. He felt excited about the advanced study ahead.
location: Workstation in the workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon workshop work and data sorting
description: In the afternoon, he continued to stay focused in the workshop. Yin Hao entered the five-axis machine tool evaluation data collected in the morning into a computer spreadsheet, and rechecked several key positioning accuracy parameters together with Master Sun Jianguo. During this time, shift leader Wang Lei came over to ask about the data and reminded him not to forget to pick up the report. During a break, Yin Hao chatted with Master Sun for a bit. Master Sun said he should take the effect of the MRI results on his body seriously. Yin Hao nodded in agreement, thinking about asking for leave before work ended to go pick up the report.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: After-work commute and fresh food shopping.
description: After getting off work at 16:30, Yin Hao drove home and, as planned, stopped by Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket on the way. Inside, he quickly picked up ingredients for the weekend: a bunch of fresh greens, three tomatoes, a carton of eggs, and a pack of dried noodles, thinking he would cook a light vegetable-and-egg noodle soup for dinner. After paying, he drove back home on Guangfulin Road.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Shanghai, and along the way from Xingang Road to Guangfulin Road.

name: Dinner and online course study
description: After getting home, he changed out of his work clothes and washed his hands briefly. While boiling water, he washed and cut up the greens and tomatoes. After the water boiled, he added the noodles and cracked in an egg. When the noodles were cooked, Yin Hao carried the bowl to his desk, opened the mobile app, and began the first lesson of the online course, "Five-Axis Coordinate System and Machine Tool Motion Principles." He ate while watching, listened attentively, paused at key points to think, and took screenshots to save to his phone notes.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening rest and social interaction
description: After finishing dinner and cleaning up the dishes, Yin Hao opened his phone and saw Gao Zhiyuan calling out in the "Songjiang Three Brothers" WeChat group. Gao said he had found a new wild fishing spot near Dianshan Lake in Qingpu and asked whether Yin Hao wanted to try it on the weekend. Wang Lei also joined in. Yin Hao replied, "If my knee cooperates, I'll go check out the spot this Sunday!" The three chatted a bit more in the group and agreed to talk in detail at the weekend.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with Lin Yue to discuss daily schedule
description: Yin Hao saw that it was about time and proactively sent a video invitation to his girlfriend Lin Yue. When the call connected, Lin Yue looked a bit tired and quickly apologized for what happened in the morning, saying she had been working on design drafts until 3 AM. Yin Hao did not blame her; instead, he calmly discussed it with her: "I understand you're busy, but we need to have a fixed time to communicate, otherwise I feel uneasy. How about this — let's adjust our original video time, say, set it at 9:30 PM. If you're really busy, just let me know on WeChat in advance. What do you think?" Lin Yue agreed and promised to try to keep a regular schedule. After the call, Yin Hao felt that the little misunderstanding between them had completely cleared up.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep habits: browsing housing listings and doing rehab
description: After the video call ended, Yin Hao lay in bed, opened the Beike app, and began comparing some one-bedroom, one-living-room compact listings in Songjiang New City and the old city sections. He focused on homes priced around 1.5 million yuan, picked out three, and sent screenshots to his older brother Yin Tao with the note: "Bro, help me take a look at these three, what do you think?" Then he got out of bed and did a set of rehabilitation exercises: two sets of wall sits, 30 seconds each. Then he took out the massage gun, put on the newly bought massage head, and loosened up the muscles on the front and back of his right leg.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Writing journal and getting ready for sleep.
description: Yin Hao took out his phone and recorded in his memo: today's weight 71.0 kg, knee condition (the dull pain after getting up in the morning was gone, but there was slight swelling after standing for a long time). He murmured to himself, “The MRI results can be picked up tomorrow, Friday, and my study plan has to proceed step by step. Let me first review today's online course. Okay, time to sleep.” He set the alarm for 6:50 tomorrow morning and turned off the bedside lamp.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lights out and sleep
description: Yin Hao adjusted his sleeping position and closed his eyes. He thought back on the day: although the knee examination result was still a bit on his mind, work had gone smoothly, his study plan had a good start, and communication with Lin Yue had also become easier. Every day is a steady step forward, and it felt great. Soon, he fell fast asleep.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning preparations
description: The alarm went off. Yin Hao moved his right knee a little and felt it was better than yesterday. He applied a hot towel to his knee for 15 minutes and did a set of straight-leg raises and wall-sit exercises. Then he washed up and had whole-wheat bread, boiled eggs, and warm water for breakfast. While eating, he checked his phone and replied to Gao Zhiyuan's weekend fishing invitation in the 'Songjiang Three Brothers' group chat, saying that due to his knee problem he could only watch. After the meal, he changed into his work clothes, grabbed his car keys and commuter bag, and got ready to head out.
location: Home, 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute by car
description: Yin Hao drove from Guangfulin Road, turned onto Huatianjing Highway via Jiasong South Road, and headed to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. Friday morning rush-hour traffic was normal; he listened to traffic radio and arrived at the factory parking lot about 18 minutes later, locked the car door, and walked toward the workshop.
location: Along the way from Lane 123, Guangfulin Road to No. 360, Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Worked in the morning.
description: Yin Hao attended the workshop pre-shift meeting, then continued machining precision parts customized for a client. Based on the optimized parameters suggested by Master Sun Jianguo the day before, he adjusted the tool path of the five-axis machine tool. At about 10:30, he checked the first-piece part together with Liu Zhiqiang; the dimensions and surface finish both met the standards, and he nodded with satisfaction.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch
description: At lunchtime, Yin Hao and his colleagues Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang went to a farmhouse restaurant in Sun Island Ancient Village. They split the bill and ordered braised pork ribs, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and seaweed egg drop soup. During the meal, Wang Lei asked about the knee MRI results. Yin Hao said he would pick them up after work in the afternoon and that it should not be a big problem.
location: Sun Island Ancient Village Farm Stay, beside the East Gate of Sun Island Tourist Resort, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work and notification that the scheduled group run is suspended
description: In the afternoon he continued machining parts, staying highly focused and strictly following the procedures. When Master Sun Jianguo made his rounds, he approved of the parts Yin Hao had machined, and Yin Hao took photos of the finished parts for later use. During the 16:00 work break, he sent a WeChat message to his running buddy Chen Jie to formally notify him that he was pausing their runs because his knee still hurt, and asked Chen Jie to pass the word along in the running group chat. Chen Jie replied suggesting he get an MRI as soon as possible. After Yin Hao said he would arrange it, he set the running group chat to Do Not Disturb. Then he cleaned the machine, filled in the work log, handed over with Master Sun and Wang Lei, and left work on time at 17:40.
location: Workshop and rest area of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Went to the hospital to pick up the MRI report.
description: Yin Hao drove from the factory to Songjiang District Central Hospital. It was rush hour, so the traffic was a bit congested; he arrived 30 minutes later and parked in the underground parking garage. He quickly walked into the outpatient hall. At the self-service imaging report printer, he scanned the code and entered his ID number, and the system indicated that the report was ready. The machine printed out the report and a film bag. He nervously glanced at the diagnostic impression: “No definite organic abnormal signal is seen in the right knee; mild edema of the infrapatellar fat pad is considered.” He was half relieved.
location: Self-service area in the outpatient lobby, Shanghai Songjiang District Central Hospital, No. 746 Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returned home, shopped for groceries, and prepared dinner.
description: His mood was much lighter as Yin Hao drove back along the old town roads of Songjiang. Passing the Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, he stopped and went in to buy shrimp, greens, and tofu, planning to cook a light dinner. After arriving home, he changed into loungewear, washed the vegetables, and made blanched shrimp, garlic lettuce, and clear soup noodles. He took photos and posted them in the family group, drawing a complaint from his mother: “Eating so plain again.”
location: Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai — Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, and the kitchen at home, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road.

name: Study the five-axis programming course.
description: After putting away the dishes and chopsticks, Yin Hao opened his laptop at the study desk, logged into the online course platform, and began studying Lesson 1 of Five-Axis CNC Programming: From Beginner to Mastery: Software Interface and Basic Operations. Wearing headphones, he focused intently on the video explanation, familiarizing himself with the interface layout and toolbar functions while taking notes in his notebook and creating a simple part model in simulation on the computer.
location: Home study, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Knee rehabilitation exercises and hot compress.
description: After the class, Yin Hao did 15 minutes of knee rehabilitation exercises on the yoga mat in the living room, including straight-leg raises, clamshells, and wall sits. Afterward, he wrapped a hot water bottle in a towel and applied it to his right knee for 15 minutes, feeling his leg muscles and joints noticeably relaxed.
location: Living room at home, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Play online games with comrades and discuss
description: Yin Hao logged in on time and teamed up with his comrades Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng to play Honor of Kings. He chose the marksman role, and with good coordination they secured the victory. During hero selection, Zhang Jianguo suggested using strength training to maintain physical fitness, but Yin Hao politely declined, explaining that the report showed infrapatellar fat pad edema and that he needed to rest quietly for two weeks first. Zhou Xiaofeng suggested swimming or cycling. Near the end of the game, the three discussed their plan to go to Qingdao for National Day. Yin Hao checked the high-speed rail tickets, found the prices had risen, and suggested grabbing the tickets a month in advance. They agreed to discuss the details later.
location: Living room at home, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and record
description: After the game ended, Yin Hao washed up, changed into pajamas, and made a video call to his girlfriend Lin Yue. He told her the results of the knee report. Lin Yue was relieved, and they said goodnight to each other. After hanging up, he recorded today's knee condition in his phone notes, decided to rest for two weeks and not run, and recorded his weight as 71.4 kg. Finally, he set an alarm for 8:30 the next morning.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Yin Hao turned off the bedside lamp and thought back over the day's experiences. Although his knee still needed time to recover, the report results were reassuring, and getting in touch with his comrades-in-arms also relaxed him. He fell into a deep sleep with a calm mind.
location: Home bedroom, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: The alarm went off, and a light rain was falling outside. Yin Hao rubbed his right knee, which felt stiff but better than yesterday, got up and made a cup of instant coffee. After checking the weather, he still had the fishing plan at Dianshan Lake on his mind. Then he changed into a thick coat and slip-resistant shoes, applied a warm patch to his knee, carefully checked his fishing gear bag, raincoat, and thermos, confirmed that his phone, wallet, and driving license were all with him, and got ready to go out.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Got into a rear-end collision while driving, handled it, and canceled the fishing plan.
description: Yin Hao drove out of Xingang Community and headed along Jiasong South Road. The road was slippery in the rain, so he did not drive fast. While stopped at the intersection of Jiasong South Road and Xinsongjiang Road waiting for a red light, his car was rear-ended by a Roewe sedan, causing the left side of the rear bumper to be dented and the paint to crack. The other driver had a good attitude and admitted full responsibility. Yin Hao calmly called the police and took photos. After contacting the insurance company, Traffic Officer Li and claims adjuster Zhang arrived to handle the matter, issued an accident confirmation document, and took photos as evidence. After the accident was handled, Yin Hao called his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang (Brother Wu), told him he could not make the appointment at Dianshan Lake, and canceled the fishing plan. Brother Wu comforted him, saying the important thing was that no one was hurt, and they agreed to meet again after the car was repaired. The whole process left Yin Hao feeling down, and looking at the fishing gear in the trunk, he felt very disappointed.

participant.name: Wang Ming
participant.relation: The other driver in the rear-end collision.

participant.name: Officer Li
participant.relation: Traffic police officer handling the accident

location: Intersection of Jiasong South Road and Xinsongjiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Sent the vehicle to the repair shop for repairs.
description: Following the insurance company's recommendation, Yin Hao drove to a certified repair shop near Songjiang Wanda Plaza. After inspecting the car, the mechanic said the rear bumper needed to be replaced, and the car would be ready in about three days. Yin Hao completed the authorization procedures and took personal belongings such as the fishing gear bag and backpack out of the car. Looking at the car that needed repairs, he sighed helplessly.
location: No. 209 Meijiabang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (certified repair shop near Songjiang Wanda)

name: Returned home by public transportation.
description: After leaving the repair shop, the depressed Yin Hao waited by the roadside for public transportation. He first took the tram to Songjiang University City Station, then transferred to Songjiang No. 15 bus. During the nearly 50-minute, bumpy ride back, he watched the rainy street scenes outside the window, his mind full of the repair costs and lost time.
location: Starting from the Repair Shop Bus Stop at No. 209 Meijiabang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, transferring at Songjiang University Town Tram Station to Bus Songjiang 15, and finally arriving at Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Simple lunch and processing emotions
description: Back home, Yin Hao was famished. He took the leftover egg fried rice from last night out of the fridge, heated it in the microwave, and wolfed it down. He still felt a tightness in his chest; the planned fishing trip had fallen through, and he also had to pay the insurance deductible out of his own pocket, leaving him in low spirits.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Financial planning and contacting the landlord
description: Yin Hao made a cup of tea, sat down at his desk, and opened the expense-tracking app on his phone. He carefully calculated his current savings of about 355,000 yuan and compared them with the down payment requirement of at least 500,000 yuan for a small apartment in Songjiang. He wrote down the principle of increasing income and cutting expenses in large letters in his notebook, resolved to cut all non-essential expenses, and made a new mandatory monthly savings plan. Then he sent a WeChat message to his landlady, Sister Li, saying that next month's rent would be transferred on time on March 1. Sister Li replied with confirmation and said she was relieved.
location: At the desk at home, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Tidying the room and knee physical therapy.
description: To take his mind off his restless feelings, Yin Hao started tidying up the house. He sorted and folded seasonal clothes and cleared the clutter from the balcony. Then he sat on the sofa, used a massage gun to relax the muscles around his right knee, and browsed the e-book 'Sports Injury Rehabilitation Guide' to learn ways to relieve medial bursitis, performing knee physiotherapy.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Rest and mobile entertainment
description: After tidying up, Yin Hao rested on the sofa or bed. He replied to his mother's WeChat message from the morning, briefly describing the day's unlucky experience but reassuring her that he was safe. Then he scrolled through Douyin for a while, watching several videos about fishing and running recovery to relax.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing and enjoying dinner
description: Yin Hao took frozen chicken legs, tomatoes, and eggs out of the fridge. After thawing them, he prepared dinner, deciding to reward his unlucky self today. He made scrambled eggs with tomatoes and cooked a bowl of noodles. The steaming hot meal gradually calmed him down, and he felt that life still had to go on.
location: Kitchen and dining table at home, Xingang Community, Nos. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with girlfriend Lin Yue
description: After washing the dishes, while Yin Hao was lying on the sofa resting, his girlfriend Lin Yue sent a WeChat message asking how the fishing went that day. The two had a video call, and Yin Hao gave a detailed account of the rear-end collision. Lin Yue comforted him, saying the important thing was that no one was hurt, called it 'losing money to ward off disaster,' and joked that she would be his 'safety charm' from now on. The call lifted Yin Hao's spirits considerably.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going out for a walk and shopping at the convenience store
description: The rain had stopped and it was getting dark. Yin Hao decided to go out for some fresh air. He walked along Xingang Road to the FamilyMart at the entrance of the residential complex, bought a bottle of water and a pack of cookies, and took the opportunity to stretch his legs and clear his mind.
location: FamilyMart (Cangxuan Road Store), Lane 177, Cangxuan Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the surrounding area of Xingang Residential Community

name: Study five-axis programming and review planning
description: Back home, after calming down, Yin Hao opened his laptop and began studying the paid online five-axis programming course. Following the video, he skillfully performed basic operations in the UG software: identifying toolbar icons, creating a new milling project, adjusting view settings and the work coordinate system. Although his proficiency was still lacking, he persisted and completed the basic environment practice. Then, referring to the course catalog, he wrote down "coordinate system" as the focus of the next lesson. Considering his knee problem, he completely rested from running this week, and decided to switch running to swimming or elliptical training next week. He sent a message to his running buddy Chen Jie asking about a suitable swimming pool nearby.
location: At the desk at home, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wash up and prepare for bed
description: Yin Hao took a shower, brushed his teeth, and changed into pajamas. Considering that no vehicle would be available the next day, he planned to sleep in and not make any special arrangements, and he connected his phone to charge.
location: Home bathroom in Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Video call with Lin Yue before bed and agreeing on next week's plan
description: Yin Hao had a bedtime video call with his girlfriend Lin Yue on time, and again shared the day's frustrations and his progress in cooking and studying. Lin Yue encouraged him to keep up his momentum, and the two agreed that on the coming weekdays they would get up early to say good morning to each other and go to bed early at night. After saying goodnight, they hung up.
location: In bed at home in Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reading and getting ready for bed
description: After the video call, Yin Hao did not go to sleep immediately. Instead, he read about knee strength training in the "Sports Injury Rehabilitation Guide" on his phone. Then he turned off the desk lamp, tried to empty his mind, and gradually fell asleep feeling slightly regretful but determined.
location: In bed at home in Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting up, washing up, and morning rehabilitation
description: Woke up naturally at 8 a.m. on Sunday. After moving around, he felt the soreness and swelling in his right knee was less than yesterday. He completed 15 minutes of knee rehab exercises and full-body stretching in bed, including quadriceps stretches and ankle pump exercises. Then he got up to wash up, weighed 71.6 kg, and felt happy remembering the sausages his mother had sent.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Argued with girlfriend Lin Yue at a café
description: After changing into loungewear, he went downstairs and retrieved two packages from the Hive Box locker in the community using the pickup code. Inside were the newly purchased Five-Axis CNC Machining Technology and Programming Examples and Advanced Practical Five-Axis Programming. Back home, he tore off the shrink wrap, quickly flipped through the table of contents and some diagrams, and saw many examples of coordinate transformation and tool compensation. He felt it was worth the money and would help with that evening’s online class.
location: Hive Box parcel locker at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the living room at home

name: Brunch and organizing best-man task notes.
description: He placed the new book in a conspicuous spot on the desk, then prepared brunch: he cooked the dried noodles his mother had sent, poached an egg, and added two drops of clam sauce. While eating, he opened the notes app on his phone and systematically organized the key points from the afternoon video call with his childhood friend Zhang Wei, listing core issues such as the color and rental of the best man suit, division of duties for the wedding games, the procedure for keeping the rings safe, the details of the address-changing ritual, and the final rehearsal time.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Previewed five-axis programming books
description: After tidying up, I opened Advanced Five-Axis Programming Practice at my desk. Following the online course outline, I previewed the 'Coordinate System' chapter that would be taught that evening, studied the diagrams to understand concepts such as the workpiece coordinate system, machine coordinate system, and reference points, and made marks with a pencil. This warmed me up for more in-depth learning and strengthened my sense of control over the afternoon video call and the evening class.
location: In front of the desk at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Check equipment to prepare for a video call
description: Take out the tablet and phone in advance, check the camera, microphone, and network connection, and make sure the charging cable is secure. Place the tablet on the sofa in the living room where the light is good, review the previously organized notes and question list, and confirm nothing is missed. After everything is ready, pour some water, lean back on the sofa, and rest for a bit.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Lunch and a short lunch break.
description: At noon, he reheated leftover rice in the rice cooker and had a simple meal with garlic lettuce. After eating, he leaned on the sofa looking at his phone, watched a few short videos on CNC machine operation, then closed his eyes and rested for 20 minutes to recharge for the important matters in the afternoon.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with childhood friend Zhang Wei to discuss wedding preparations.
description: He proactively called his childhood friend Zhang Wei via video half an hour early. Zhang Wei, at his hometown in Rudong, showed the wedding venue renderings and the bridal procession route. They went through item by item: the groomsmen's dark blue suit rentals, the ring handover procedure, the escort vehicles for the whole route, and the tea ceremony details. Zhang Wei complained about the high wedding-planning fees, and Yin Hao patiently comforted him and promised to help wholeheartedly. The two also chatted about changes in their hometown and recent updates, in a relaxed and lively atmosphere.
location: Sofa in the living room of the home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organize call notes and search for suit rental
description: After hanging up the video call, I immediately returned to my desk and organized the confirmed points from the call into a clear timed task list, specifying the person in charge and deadlines. I set calendar reminders for myself and Zhang Wei for the final deadline for suit size alterations and marked the priority. Then I searched Taobao and local life apps for best man suit rentals, filtered for well-reviewed shops near Songjiang, and saved links and quotes to a newly created Wedding Preparations folder.
location: In front of the desk at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go to the Cainiao station to pick up the package.
description: After receiving the pickup code, he put on his jacket and walked to the Cainiao Post Station at the entrance of the residential community. On the way, he ran into Aunt Chen, a neighbor, who asked why he hadn't gone fishing on the weekend. Yin Hao smiled and briefly recounted yesterday's minor incident, and Aunt Chen expressed some concern.
location: Along the route from Xingang Community, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Cainiao Station, No. 235 Xingang Road.

name: Returned home from Cainiao Station.
description: Took a heavy cardboard box from Cainiao Station and walked quickly home.
location: Cainiao Station, 235 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road

name: Opened the hometown specialty foods and shared them with my mother and girlfriend.
description: After returning home, he opened the cardboard box, which contained sausages, cured meat made by his mother, and two jars of Nantong clam sauce. He immediately took photos and sent them to the family group chat, sent his mother a voice message to thank her, and his mother reminded him to store them in the refrigerator. He also forwarded the photos to his girlfriend Lin Yue, telling her that he would live-stream steaming the sausages in the evening, and Lin Yue replied with a drooling emoji.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Prepare and cook dinner
description: In high spirits, he decided to reward himself with hometown ingredients. He took out some cured pork and a sausage link, washed them, and placed them in a steamer over high heat. While the meat was steaming, he washed vegetables, sliced shiitake mushrooms, and sliced ginger. After the sausage had steamed for 20 minutes, he stir-fried the mushrooms and vegetables in another wok and cooked rice in the rice cooker. The kitchen filled with the mixed aroma of sausage and rice.
location: Home kitchen, Xingang Xiaoqu, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Enjoying dinner
description: Sliced and plated the steamed sausage and cured meat, and served it with stir-fried mushrooms and greens and white rice. Took a bite; the sausage was rich but not greasy, full of the taste of home. While eating, he took photos of the dinner and posted them on Moments with the caption "Happy Sunday, a child with a mother is like a treasure," feeling content and warm.
location: Dining table at home, Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with girlfriend Lin Yue
description: After clearing the dishes, he curled up on the sofa and video-called Lin Yue. The two talked about their day. Yin Hao shared his joy at receiving the local specialty foods and details of the wedding preparations, and told her that yesterday's car accident had been handled smoothly. name: Morning work and five-axis machining practice.
description: After arriving at the factory early, he first parked and locked his e-bike in the bike shed, then entered the workshop and changed into anti-smashing safety shoes. At the five-axis machining center he was responsible for, he performed routine checks of the coolant level, air pressure, and lubricating oil quantity, and verified the new tool path parameter program debugged the day before. At 8 o'clock, he officially started the machine. After warming up the spindle, he installed the tool and began machining the first batch of test samples, closely watching the cutting process, listening to the spindle sound, and observing chip evacuation. After finishing the first part, he measured it with a caliper and a roughness tester. The surface finish improved to Ra0.8, and he recorded the data in his notebook. After completing one batch, he used the 5-minute break between tasks to do lower back stretches beside the machine, including a seated torso twist and a cat stretch while holding the workbench, to relax his stiff lower back from standing for a long time. After stretching, he continued finish-machining the rough-machined parts and optimized the feed rate. The final parts had an almost mirror-like surface. Master Sun Jianguo passed by and said approvingly, “You're making progress — this parameter combination is good.” Yin Hao felt very pleased and recorded all the finishing data in detail.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Brief midday meeting and lunch
description: After the morning work ended, held a brief meeting in the workshop rest area with Master Sun Jianguo, team leader Wang Lei, and colleague Liu Zhiqiang. Yin Hao took out the fixture improvement sketch he had drawn last night and proposed using support blocks and auxiliary locating pins to reduce the time spent on clamping and aligning irregular workpieces. Wang Lei thought it was a good idea, and Master Sun gave supplementary suggestions from a force perspective, encouraging him to run a simulation first. After the meeting, Wang Lei invited Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang to the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road for lunch. Each of them ordered a set meal of rice with toppings. While eating, they talked about the riding experience after the electric bike was repaired and about morning rush-hour traffic congestion in Kunshan.

location: Workshop break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

He tried switching to a harder cutter to machine a part with a complex curved inner cavity and noticed slight chatter at a certain corner. He analyzed that the stepover might be set too large, causing uneven cutting forces. He then adjusted the key parameters and regenerated the tool path. On the next test cut, the chatter disappeared and the machined surface became smooth again. At 3 PM, he paused work and did lower back stretches by the machine, including seated twists and cat-cow stretches, plus wrist and ankle exercises, to relieve the physical fatigue from continuous work.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

Whenever he encountered something he didn't understand, he paused, drew diagrams in his notebook to analyze, and recorded key parameter formulas. He hummed along while tidying up the messy desk, arranging the programming books in order of study and wiping off the dust. Then he noticed the dusty CD rack, squatted down, and opened a cardboard box at the very bottom, finding treasures from his high school years—two well-preserved CDs: Dao Lang's 'The First Snow of 2002' and Phoenix Legend's 'Above the Moon'. He placed the two CDs side by side on the clean desk, took a photo with his phone from an angle, and posted it on Moments with the caption 'A nostalgic night, almost forgot these old pals.' Soon, friends including Zhang Wei, Chen Ming, and Gao Zhiyuan liked and commented. Chen Ming left a message: 'Wow, I had that too! That reveals my age, haha!' He smiled and typed back: 'Can't deny getting old, it's all youth.' Interacting with old friends made him feel great.

He spent the whole morning focused on machining the first test piece, and the process went smoothly.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and a casual get-together with colleagues
description: At 11:30 the lunch bell rang, and colleague Wang Lei invited Yin Hao to Sun Island Ancient Village Farmhouse for lunch; Liu Zhiqiang also went along. The three walked to the parking lot to get Wang Lei's car and drove there in less than 10 minutes. Yin Hao ordered a pickled fish casserole with rich broth and tender fish. During the meal, Liu Zhiqiang shared his son's great results at the school sports meet, Wang Lei complained about a bad gaming experience the previous night, and Yin Hao listened quietly, feeling relaxed. After lunch, they returned to the workshop break room at 12:20 and leaned back in their chairs for a 10-minute nap.
location: Sun Island Ancient Village Agritainment, beside the East Gate of Sun Island Tourism Resort, Shentai Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work and making a massage appointment by phone
description: In the afternoon, continued processing the second test piece, concentrating fully on adjusting machine tool parameters and monitoring tool wear. At 14:30 the workpiece was finished; used a coordinate measuring machine to inspect key points, and the dimensional accuracy met tolerances. Still feeling some soreness in the lower back, remembered the massage parlor recommended by a colleague, and while going to the break room searched for 'Kangyuetang Tuina Center' on Amap; after reading reviews, decided to go. At 14:45 called to book a one-hour full-body Chinese massage for 8 PM that evening. After the other party confirmed the reservation, felt a bit more anticipation.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Work wrap-up and fixture plan finalized
description: After hanging up the phone and returning to the workshop, Master Sun Jianguo called Yin Hao aside. Using the sketch and the workshop whiteboard, he explained in detail his suggestions for improving the fixture, such as adding M8 threaded holes to the base to secure the pneumatic lines. Yin Hao listened while marking key dimensions and positions on the sketch. He then returned to his workstation, compiled the machining data, parameter adjustment records, and measurement results of the two test pieces into an electronic document, saved it in the work folder, and wrote detailed handover notes for the next shift. At 17:25 he turned off the machine tool and computer, cleaned his workstation, and got ready to leave work.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the massage parlor
description: After changing out of his work clothes, he drove his just-repaired car from the factory, via Rongle Middle Road and Songhui East Road, and arrived about 20 minutes later at the Kangyuetang Tuina Clinic on Zhongshan East Road, Songjiang District. He parked in the paid parking space at the entrance (7 yuan/hour). He pushed open the glass door, and after the front desk confirmed his reservation, he was led to a private room where mugwort incense was burning.
location: Kangyuetang Massage Clinic, 128 Zhongshan East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Chinese-style full-body massage
description: After changing into a bathrobe, I lay flat on the massage bed. A skilled massage therapist first used her elbow to focus on kneading my stiff shoulders and lower back. While applying pressure near my left shoulder blade, she noted that the muscle tension was caused by prolonged sitting. During the massage, she taught me several stretching exercises that can be done at a workstation, such as seated torso twists. After an hour of treatment, my upper body felt much more relaxed, the previous stiffness almost disappeared, and at the end I felt my qi and blood flowing smoothly.
location: Kangyuetang Massage Clinic, 128 Zhongshan East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return trip and recording the massage experience
description: After changing clothes, I paid 198 yuan at the front desk and walked out of the tuina clinic. The evening breeze was refreshing. I drove back to my home in Xingang Community. After entering, I hung up my coat, sat on the sofa, opened my phone memo and wrote: "Kangyue Tang. Professional technique, obvious relaxation effect on shoulders, neck, and lower back. Plan once a month as an investment in body maintenance." Then I remembered that next Tuesday I need to go to the Sixth Hospital for a knee follow-up and planned to ask about the auxiliary role of tuina physiotherapy in recovery.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Simple dinner
description: After the massage, he felt hungry. In the kitchen, he boiled water and cooked a bowl of clear noodle soup, added two poached eggs, a few slices of braised beef, and a handful of greens. He ate it simply and contentedly, washed the dishes and chopsticks, and replenished his energy.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Online course study on five-axis programming
description: When his energy was good, he sat at the desk, opened his laptop, logged into the five-axis programming online course, and focused on completing the 15 after-class practice questions from the first two chapters. Whenever he came across uncertain concepts or formulas, he went back to the teaching videos to confirm. In the end, he answered 13 correctly, an accuracy rate of about 87%. He analyzed the reasons for the two wrong questions in detail, copied them into his notebook with notes on the correct approach, and prepared to review them again on the weekend.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Core training and shower.
description: After the massage, his body felt relaxed. He appropriately reduced the intensity of his core training and followed a phone app to complete a 20-minute workout: 6 sets of planks (each set to failure), 4 sets of crunches (20 reps per set), and 3 sets of Russian twists (30 seconds per set). After the workout, he was slightly sweaty all over and felt a good sense of strength. Then he took a shower and blow-dried his hair.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening communication and rest
description: While lying in bed, I first sent my mother a voice message to let her know I was safe, telling her that I felt much better after the massage, and also sent her a photo of the new laptop. Then I had a video chat with my girlfriend Lin Yue for about ten minutes, sharing how each other's day had gone. She was working overtime too, and we encouraged each other and agreed to talk more in depth over the weekend. At 22:30 I put down my phone, turned off the light, and fell asleep, replaying the day's work progress and relaxing experience, soon drifting into a dream.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning preparations and commute.
description: At 6:20 a.m., the alarm rang, and Yin Hao turned it off. The damp cold of the rainy day seeped in through the window cracks. He moved his right knee; it felt okay, but he decided to follow the original plan and not run in the rain. After washing up, he weighed himself: 72.5 kilograms, slightly lower after three days without running. He put on a waterproof shell jacket, wore a helmet, and rode his electric bike out. Passing by the "Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant" on Xingang Road, he stopped to pack two meat buns and a cup of hot soy milk for breakfast. Then he continued riding in the rain, raindrops mixed with cold wind hitting his face. He tightened his jacket zipper. At 7:20, he arrived at Shanghai Lianfeng Air Duct Processing Factory, five minutes later than usual. He parked the bike, shook the water off his jacket, and walked into the workshop, ready to start the day's work.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, via Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, No. 232 Xingang Road, Dagang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-shift machine inspection and warm-up
description: At 7:35, Yin Hao changed into his work clothes and walked to the CNC machine tool he was in charge of. He first checked the handover logbook to confirm that yesterday's parameters were all normal. Then he manually started the spindle to warm it up. The familiar humming sound made him feel reassured. He also checked the tool magazine and the fixture status in advance to ensure a seamless transition to production tasks at 8:00.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Five-axis prototype parts machining and quality inspection in the morning
description: At exactly 8 a.m., the machine tool officially ran at full speed, and Yin Hao concentrated on the finishing of the last batch of five-axis trial parts. His colleague Wang Lei was debugging another machine nearby, and the two occasionally exchanged cutting parameters. Yin Hao kept an eye on the machine's alarm prompts and cutting sounds. At 10 a.m., the phone's scheduled vibration reminded him to do stretching during the work break. He put down his work and did 5 minutes of lower back stretching and shoulder-neck rotations in the corner of the workshop. He felt that the relaxation from yesterday's massage was still there, but the stiffness from prolonged sitting had quietly crept back a bit. After stretching, he returned to his workstation and continued working. Around 11 a.m., the last part was finished. According to the process requirements, he used a caliper and a roughness tester to make a preliminary measurement of the key dimensions, then sent it to the quality inspection station and got confirmation that the accuracy met the standard. After that, he returned to his post and briefly recorded the data from this trial batch in his notebook, planning to consult Master Sun later.
location: Workshop and quality inspection station of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Lunch during the lunch break and discussion of weekend plans.
description: At noon, Yin Hao shut down the machine tool and went to the factory canteen with his colleague Wang Lei to get food. He got a steaming bowl of braised beef noodles. As they ate and chatted, Wang Lei mentioned that the weekend plan was to go fishing at Dianshan Lake, but considering it would rain tomorrow, the lakeside would be damp and cold and the fish wouldn't bite. Yin Hao nodded in agreement and suggested canceling the fishing trip and going to the badminton hall at Songjiang Sports Center instead. He mentioned that his colleague Chen Jie might have a discount connection, and Wang Lei said he could go ask. They finally agreed to play badminton on Saturday afternoon. After lunch, Yin Hao leaned back in his chair and rested for 15 minutes, took out his phone to browse the CNC forum, saw a post about new inserts combined with five-axis machining, and forwarded it to his own WeChat to read carefully in the evening.
location: Canteen and rest area of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work: handover and tidying, and fixture plan revision
description: At 1 p.m., Yin Hao returned to the workshop to wrap up. He first organized the tool wear records and machine tool operation logs from the morning, wrote clear notes, and ensured a smooth handover next week. Then he took out the fixture improvement sketch he had drawn a few days earlier and, based on the deformation of the thin-walled part during today's actual machining, began modifying annotations in CAD on the computer. While editing, he thought about it and decided to add two auxiliary supports to the design and adjust the clamping position. At 5 p.m., he printed out the revised drawing draft, clipped it into the drawing folder, and prepared to discuss it in depth with Master Sun next week.
location: Workshop Office, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wrap up work and clock out
description: At 5 p.m., Yin Hao turned off the computer, packed up his tools, and checked the workshop power supply. After a brief handover with colleagues, he clocked out on time at 5:30.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute after work and simple dinner
description: The rain had stopped, but the roads were still wet. Yin Hao rode his e-bike back to his home in Xingang Community in a few minutes. He changed out of his work clothes into loungewear. Using the leftover pork rib soup from yesterday in the fridge, he cooked a bowl of dried noodles, adding a few leafy greens and two eggs that had been boiled yesterday. Around 6 o'clock, after the steaming-hot noodles went down, warmth spread through his stomach.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Post-meal relaxation and information browsing.
description: After washing the dishes, Yin Hao rested on the sofa for 10 minutes. Then he opened his phone, browsed the CNC forum post he had forwarded in the morning, and watched an introductory video on Bilibili about the new version of the post-processing software. Feeling his eyes a little tired, he got up and tidied the somewhat messy desk.
location: Living room and study at home, Xingang Residential Quarter, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Five-axis programming stage review and study
description: At 7 p.m., Yin Hao sat down at his desk, opened his notebook and textbook, and made a stage summary of his five-axis programming study. Without looking at the book, relying only on memory and notes, he spent a full hour and a half drawing a mind map on paper with colored pens, sorting out core topics such as coordinate transformation principles, rotary axis linkage, and basic tool path planning. He also redid two classic coordinate transformation problems and checked the answers; he got them both right. Looking at the clearly structured mind map, he confirmed that he had mastered the essentials of the first two chapters and felt greatly encouraged.
location: Home study at Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: February financial review and savings plan formulation
description: After closing the textbook, Yin Hao turned to a bookkeeping app and online banking, and checked every February income and expenditure item by item: rent 3,000 yuan, books and online courses 500 yuan, out-of-pocket vehicle repair 200 yuan, Kangyuetang massage 198 yuan, daily food, drinks, commuting, and so on. After summing up, he found that the special home purchase savings had only increased by 1,800 yuan that month, with a total balance of 356,800 yuan. He stared at the screen in silence, feeling pressured. Then he tore a sticky note from the drawer and wrote forcefully: 'Extreme saving plan: starting in March, cut out takeout and drinks; entertainment spending capped at 200 yuan; skip all non-essential purchases. Goal: force savings of at least 4,500 yuan a month!' He stuck it onto the lamp base of his desk.
location: Home study at Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: End-of-month video call with girlfriend Lin Yue
description: At 9:15 p.m., Yin Hao made a video call to his girlfriend Lin Yue. She had just finished showering and her hair was still wet. Without much preamble, Yin Hao straightaway told her the results of his financial review and his plan to save money. Lin Yue was taken aback at first, but she quickly understood and supported him without complaining. She even suggested that they go to shopping malls less often; on weekends they could go to parks or stay at home to cook and watch shows, or even reduce their travel back and forth by mailing each other packages or having video dates. They also talked about their routines. Lin Yue said she had been staying up late to catch up on work, so Yin Hao suggested that starting in March they set a schedule for the following week every Sunday evening and keep each other on track. Lin Yue smiled and agreed.
location: Home study at Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Right knee hot compress before bed and setting March goals
description: After hanging up the video call, Yin Hao walked into the bedroom, filled a basin with hot water, and applied a hot towel to his right knee. The knee gradually relaxed in the warmth. He opened a note on his phone and wrote down four core goals for March: 1. See the doctor on time and address the hidden problem of the knee injury; 2. Keep studying five-axis programming for at least 1 hour every day; 3. Strictly follow the saving plan and review at the end of the month; 4. Have in-depth communication with Lin Yue at least once a week. He set his alarm for 8:00 AM the next morning, ready for a relaxing Saturday. The sound of rain outside the window gradually stopped, and he felt extremely calm inside.
location: Home bedroom, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep review and bedtime
description: At 10:20 p.m., Yin Hao turned off the desk lamp and reviewed the day in the darkness: wrapping up work, modifying the fixture, summarizing what he had learned, reviewing finances, Lin Yue's understanding... Every task had been carried out for real; no time was wasted. He said to himself, 'Alright, Yin Hao, you did a good job today.' At 10:30, he closed his eyes, listened to the low chirping of night insects in the neighborhood, and fell into a deep sleep.
location: Home bedroom, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning knee injury rehabilitation training
description: On Saturday morning the alarm went off on time. After getting up, Yin Hao's first concern was the recovery of his right knee. The knee was still a bit stiff and sore. He laid out a yoga mat by the bed and followed a rehabilitation video on his phone to complete the training carefully: first 3 sets of wall sits, each held for about 45 seconds until failure, then 4 sets of straight-leg raises, 15 reps per set. After training, his knee felt somewhat more stable, but he knew clearly that full recovery would still take time.
location: Home bedroom, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Tried morning run but turned back due to knee pain
description: Unwilling to be limited by his knee injury, Yin Hao changed into his running shoes and went out, jogging from Xingang Community along Xingang Road toward Guangfulin Road. The first 1.5 km brought only slight discomfort, but at the 2 km mark, a sharp needle-like pain suddenly struck the outside of his right knee. He immediately stopped, leaned against a camphor tree by the roadside, and gasped for breath. A strong sense of frustration surged over him, and he could only limp slowly back home.
location: Workshop office, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Back home: icing, breakfast, and the day's plan
