description: After returning home, Yin Hao immediately wrapped an ice pack in a towel and applied it to his knee for 20 minutes, then took a photo of his knee and sent it to his running buddy Chen Jie, telling him that he had failed again. Afterwards he washed up briefly, cooked a bowl of plain noodle soup in the kitchen, and added two poached eggs as breakfast. While eating the noodles, he looked at a map on his phone to plan the day's itinerary, noticed that the Zhenxing Street Hardware Store was only a 10-minute walk from home, and wrote down the toggle switch and solder wire he needed to buy. He also checked the battery level of his electric bike and packed all his gear for the afternoon ball game to make sure everything was in order.
location: Living room and kitchen at home in Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go to the hardware store on Zhenxing Street to buy repair parts.
description: Yin Hao walked to the hardware store on Zhenxing Street. The sunlight was just right, and he deliberately lightened the landing of his right foot to protect his knee. In the store, he carefully compared toggle switches of different specifications. The boss, in his fifties, warmly came over to help, so he took the opportunity to ask how to use a multimeter to quickly diagnose cold solder joints in a circuit. The boss demonstrated with gestures, and Yin Hao benefited a lot.
location: Hardware store on Zhenxing Street, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bought steamed buns for breakfast on the way.
description: Coming out of the hardware store, Yin Hao went around to the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road downstairs and ordered 5 meat buns to take away as tomorrow's breakfast, and also bought two cups of iced soy milk. He strictly followed his saving plan and did not buy anything extra.
location: Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, 232 Xingang Road, Dagang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Immersive repair of an old desk lamp
description: Yin Hao dug out an old desk lamp from the storage cabinet, put on reading glasses at the living room desk, and took out the newly purchased toggle switch and solder wire. Using a multimeter, he found that the internal positive and negative solder joints had come loose, so he skillfully re-soldered them with a soldering iron and replaced the aged switch. During reassembly, the lamp holder's clip was loose; he trimmed it with a file and it snapped into place perfectly. After plugging it in to test, the lamp gave off a steady, bright light, temporarily making him forget the troubles of his morning run.
location: At the desk in the living room at home, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Simple lunch and studying a CNC tutorial
description: After finishing a repair session for the time being, Yin Hao reheated the two baozi left over from the morning, made a cup of instant coffee, and had them with iced soy milk as lunch. While eating, he opened his phone and watched an excerpt of a tutorial on Bilibili about five-axis programming post-processing, building up knowledge for the afternoon's free time.
location: Home dining room, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break, games, and preparing to go out for badminton
description: After lunch, Yin Hao saw his gaming friend Dafei online and invited him to play two ranked matches of Honor of Kings. Because of the persistent dull pain in his knee, his performance suffered, and they ended up winning one and losing one. After the second match, he felt tired, quit the game, set an alarm, and rested with his eyes closed for half an hour. When he got up at 1:30 p.m., he changed into a sports T-shirt and shorts, carefully checked the racket strings, filled a large water bottle, put his keys, phone, access card, and 20 yuan in change into his bag, put on his sports backpack, and got ready to ride his e-bike to the badminton hall.
location: Bedroom and entrance hall at home, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Played badminton with friend Wang Lei
description: Yin Hao arrived on time by bike at the badminton hall of Songjiang University Town Sports Center. His friend Wang Lei had already booked a court. He explained to Wang Lei that his knee was uncomfortable, and they decided to focus on doubles that day. After a few games, his knee still reacted slightly, so he tried to play more drop shots at the net, relying on precise placement to score, while Wang Lei smashed hard from the backcourt. The two chatted while playing; although they were not fully satisfied, they both felt much better after exercising.
location: Badminton Hall, Songjiang University Town Sports Center, 2000 Wenxiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Purchased fresh produce on the way back
description: After playing ball, Yin Hao cycled home and stopped by the Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket on the way. He deliberately picked out discounted spinach (1 bunch for 3 yuan), a tray of eight discounted eggs (10 yuan), two tomatoes, and a small piece of lean meat, spending less than 30 yuan in total. He also noticed a promotion on facial tissues and planned to stock up next week.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Installing the desk lamp shade and taking a short break
description: After arriving home, Yin Hao first put the groceries away, then installed the lampshade on the desk lamp he had repaired in the morning and tightened the screws. When he switched it on, the warm yellow light illuminated the desk. Satisfied, he took a photo and sent it to his girlfriend Lin Yue with the caption: “Today’s trophy, fixed.” After that, he took a quick shower and changed into clean loungewear.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Meal prep, dinner, and evening leisure.
description: Yin Hao started preparing dinner: he washed the rice and cooked it, minced the lean meat, blanched the spinach and made spinach egg drop soup with eggs, and cut tomatoes into pieces to make scrambled eggs with tomatoes. He deliberately made two dishes today to reward himself. While eating, he played a classic rock playlist on the Bluetooth speaker, and as he ate, he browsed Taobao on his phone looking for discounted professional running knee pads. But considering the tight budget at the end of the month, he quietly closed the app. After dinner, he quickly cleared the dishes, washed his face, changed into a clean T-shirt, set up his phone on the bedside with good lighting, and waited for the video call with Lin Yue.
location: Home kitchen, dining room, and bedroom, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with girlfriend Lin Yue
description: After the video call connected, Yin Hao first reported in a somewhat dejected tone about failing his morning run again. Lin Yue patiently comforted him, telling him not to worry, and shared that she had found an affordable vegetarian restaurant near her school. Yin Hao excitedly showed her the repaired desk lamp. When the conversation turned to the saving plan, he told Lin Yue that his only weekend entertainment was playing ball. Lin Yue expressed understanding and said she would bring some of her mother's pickled vegetables when she came to visit next week.
location: Home bedroom, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wash up and apply a warm compress to the knees before bed.
description: After hanging up, Yin Hao went to the bathroom to wash up. He made a point of boiling a pot of hot water, soaking the towel, wringing it out, and applying a hot compress to his right knee. Meanwhile, he played soothing piano music on his phone, letting the heat gradually seep into his skin as the pain slowly eased. He planned to go to the Songjiang Branch of Shanghai Sixth People's Hospital the next morning, hoping to solve his knee injury at the root.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Recording expenses and relaxing before bed
description: After the heat compress, Yin Hao applied medicated oil to his knee and gently massaged it. Then he leaned against the headboard, took out his phone, and recorded every expense of the day in his notebook: breakfast (food stored at home), lunch of steamed buns and soy milk for 10 yuan, groceries for 29.5 yuan, and court fee split evenly at 15 yuan per person, totaling 54.5 yuan, which did not exceed the budget. He felt the day had been fulfilling; although the morning run was a bit disappointing, fixing the desk lamp and playing ball had both gone as planned.
location: In bed at home in Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Browsing CNC forums and gradually falling asleep.
description: At 22:00 Yin Hao opened the CNC technology forum, browsed several new posts about five-axis simultaneous machining, and saved the technical discussion post titled 'Cradle Angle Indexing' for study tomorrow. At 22:30 the alarm went off. He turned off the light and lay down. The sound of wind occasionally came from outside the window, and his right knee still felt a little uncomfortable. He silently hoped for a good result at the hospital tomorrow. Due to the knee injury and frustration, his mind was racing, and he did not finally fall asleep until around 23:30.
location: In bed at home in Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning rehabilitation exercises and simple breakfast.
description: After getting up, I did right knee rehabilitation exercises, including wall sits, straight-leg raises, and glute bridges, controlling the range of motion of each movement to avoid re-injury. After the workout, I took a shower, microwaved the leftover meat buns and soy milk from yesterday for breakfast, and while eating, I read rehabilitation materials on my phone and organized today's schedule.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go to Songjiang University Town to meet Chen Jie and join the rehabilitation group
description: I rode an e-bike to Songjiang University Town and met my running friend Chen Jie at Shanghai University Students Sports Center at 2000 Wenxiang Road. Chen Jie examined my right knee and performed movement tests, diagnosing iliotibial band syndrome, and advised stopping running for at least three weeks, along with cross-training options such as swimming and cycling, as well as stretches for the gluteus medius and IT band. I recorded the details in my phone's memo. Afterwards, Chen Jie added me to the "Songjiang Runners Rehabilitation Exchange Group". After observing the discussions in the group, I asked about the frequency of cross-training, and received experience sharing and encouragement from group members, which relieved some of the anxiety caused by the injury.
location: Shanghai University Students Sports Center, No. 2000 Wenxiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Sports Medicine Clinic, Shanghai Sixth People's Hospital
description: Drove from the university town to the Department of Sports Medicine at Shanghai Sixth People's Hospital (Xuhui Campus). After getting the appointment number from the self-service machine, I waited about 20 minutes. When the doctor received me, he looked at the palpation video taken by Chen Jie and performed a physical exam himself. He confirmed iliotibial band syndrome, and to be safe, ordered an MRI, prescribed anti-inflammatory medication, and provided a QR code for medical rehabilitation training videos. I asked the doctor in detail about the recovery period (about 4–6 weeks). The doctor advised me to stop running and said I could do water walking and core strength training within a pain-free range. After the visit, I felt more confident.
location: Shanghai Sixth People's Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine (Xuhui Campus), No. 600 Yishan Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai

name: Returned home and stopped by the supermarket to shop on the way
description: After the medical appointment, I drove from the hospital back to Songjiang and stopped by Yonghui Supermarket on Guangfulin Road to buy healthy food. Following the advice from the doctor and Chen Jie, I picked chicken breast, eggs, broccoli, milk, olive oil, and oats, which came to 128 yuan at checkout. After shopping, I continued driving for about 22 minutes and returned home in Xingang Community.
location: Yonghui Supermarket (Shanghai Songjiang Wanda Plaza store), Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and creating a knee recovery plan
description: After arriving home, he first sorted the purchased ingredients into the refrigerator, then made a simple bowl of tomato and egg noodles for lunch. After the meal, he organized the information gathered that day and created a memo on his computer named Knee Rehabilitation Plan 20250302, covering how long to stop running, the frequency of swimming and cycling, illustrated daily stretching exercises, medication reminders, and the follow-up appointment at the Sixth People's Hospital next Saturday. He felt that the day's running around had produced concrete results.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Studying the five-axis CNC programming online course
description: After pulling himself together, he turned on the computer and continued the online course on five-axis CNC programming, focusing on compound operations of coordinate rotation and translation. This part was difficult; he paused the video multiple times, drew diagrams on scratch paper, and worked through formulas until he fully understood.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycled to Xiaokunshan Health Park for cross-training
description: After studying, my head felt tight and my knees needed movement, so I changed into sports pants and took out my mountain bike for some cross-training cycling within the pain-free range. I rode slowly along the lanes near home to Xiaokunshan Health Park, controlling cadence and resistance throughout to ensure my knees felt no discomfort. After about 40 minutes I worked up a light sweat and felt great.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Walk and relax at Xiaokunshan Health Park
description: After arriving at the park, he sat on a bench by the lake, relaxing as the evening breeze blew. He used his phone to take photos of the unknown wildflowers in the park and sent them to his girlfriend Lin Yue. Then he took two slow laps around the lake, and his mood had clearly improved compared to the morning.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home and prepare dinner
description: Rode his bike from the park back home to Xingang Community. After showering and changing into dry clothes, he took the chicken breast and broccoli he had just bought from the supermarket out of the fridge to get ready for dinner.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepared a healthy dinner and browsed rehabilitation articles.
description: He marinated the chicken breast with black pepper and salt, then pan-fried it with a little oil until cooked. He blanched the broccoli and stir-fried it with olive oil and minced garlic, serving it with half an ear of corn as the staple. While eating dinner, he scrolled through his phone and saved an article about strength training for runners from the recovery group. After the meal, he cleaned up the pots and dishes.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with mother Wang Xiuying
description: My mother Wang Xiuying called on video right on time. To avoid worrying her, I only mentioned casually that my old knee problem had flared up and the doctor told me to rest for a few weeks, hiding the specific condition and the failed morning run. On the video, she told me to apply a hot towel, and said she would mail me the family's traditional medicated plaster from home. I agreed while feeling relieved inside.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video-called girlfriend Lin Yue to confirm plans for next week.
description: After I finished the call with my mother, my girlfriend Lin Yue's video call came in right away. I sent her a screenshot of the rehabilitation plan to reassure her. Then we agreed on a routine to supervise each other: a video check-in at ten every night. I promised to finish dinner and rehabilitation training before seven o'clock, and Lin Yue promised to study English for one hour every day. She also said she would bring me a heat pack, which warmed my heart.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Late-night gaming to vent emotions
description: After the video ended, the fatigue of the day and the frustration of my knee being limited surged up, so I opened Honor of Kings and teamed up with my friend Dafei for ranked matches. After winning two in a row, my restlessness eased a bit, and I continued game after game without realizing how late it had become. In the middle, my mother sent a voice call, but I didn't answer. I ended up with a record of 5 wins and 2 losses, venting the pent-up emotions, and gradually calmed down while immersed in reviewing my gameplay.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wash up, hot compress, and go to sleep
description: He forced himself to go to the bathroom to wash up, and used hot water to rinse his knee as a warm compress, feeling the discomfort ease somewhat. Back in bed, the thought of uninstalling the game flashed through his mind, but in the end he just placed his phone face down on the nightstand. Outside the window the night was deep; the faint discomfort in his right knee and lingering anxiety kept him tossing and turning, and only after a while did he fall into a deep sleep.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wake-up and knee rehabilitation training
description: After the alarm went off, he struggled to get up, spread out the yoga mat, and did the first round of knee rehabilitation training: 3 sets of wall sits (45 seconds each), 4 sets of straight-leg raises (12 reps each), and used a foam roller to massage the iliotibial band on the outside of his right leg to relieve soreness.
location: Room 304, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and checking personal items
description: After training, he took a shower and washed up, changed into work clothes, and checked the essential commuting items such as the power bank, keys, and work badge. Noticing the gloomy weather outside, he brought a folding umbrella along.
location: Room 304, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute and breakfast
description: Rode an electric bike to the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road, bought two pork buns and a cup of hot soy milk for breakfast, finished eating while riding, then arrived on time at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, parked, clocked in, and entered the workshop.
location: Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, 232 Xingang Road, Dagang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-work preparations
description: Arrive early, turn on the five-axis machine tool control panel to let the system warm up, and carefully check the coolant, tools, and fixtures against the previous day's records to make sure everything is normal and fully prepare for the morning's work.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning shift: a close call and realigning focus.
description: In the morning, he was somewhat distracted due to lack of sleep. When changing the tool for a precision part, he nearly entered the wrong tool number. Master Sun Jianguo gave a cough to warn him, and he snapped out of it, quickly apologized, and rechecked the program. Afterward, he concentrated on the operation and made no more mistakes.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and family contact
description: During the lunch break, went to the cafeteria with master Sun Jianguo and colleague Wang Lei to eat braised pork chop noodles, and took the initiative to ask Master Sun how to stay focused when tired. Meanwhile, used his phone to reply to his mother's WeChat message from the previous night, told her everything was fine, and took a photo of lunch to send, reassuring the family.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Short break.
description: After lunch, instead of going back to the workshop, I leaned back on the bench in the break room with Sun Jianguo and Wang Lei, resting with my eyes closed and clearing my mind to build up energy for the afternoon work.
location: Break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon shift: finish machining the trial piece.
description: In the afternoon, his spirits improved, and he focused on machining a batch of small-batch trial parts. He strictly clamped, set the tool, and started the program according to the drawings. After each piece, he measured key dimensions with calipers, keeping tolerances within 0.02 mm, making up for the morning's shortcomings with precise operation.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Get off work and head to the next place.
description: After clocking out from work, changed into sportswear and rode the electric bike straight to Songjiang Swimming Pool, going directly there to complete today's cross-training to save time.
location: Songjiang Swimming Pool, No. 143 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: First swimming cross-training session
description: Arrived at the swimming pool, bought a ticket and entered. First warmed up in the shallow water, then alternated between freestyle and breaststroke, paying special attention to how the right knee felt underwater. After 40 minutes of swimming, there was no pain in the knee at all, and I felt reassured.
location: Songjiang Swimming Pool, No. 143 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Check in to the rehabilitation group
description: After swimming, took a shower and changed clothes, took a photo of the swimming pool sign and sent it to the "Songjiang Runners Rehabilitation Exchange Group" to check in, recording 40 minutes of swimming with no knee discomfort. He received a like and a private message of encouragement from Chen Jie: "Not bad! Keep it up." He felt that today's training had been affirmed.
location: Locker room, Songjiang Swimming Pool, No. 143 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Supermarket shopping and returning home
description: After leaving the swimming pool, I stopped by the Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket on the way, picked out chicken breast, broccoli, and scallions. At the checkout, I hesitated over the iced Coke but gave it up and cycled home.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reflections on dinner and the gaming bill
description: After getting home, took a shower first, then marinated the chicken breast and blanched the broccoli, making pan-seared chicken breast and stir-fried broccoli for dinner. While eating, he scrolled through the past three months of WeChat Pay bills and found that he had recharged a total of 1,850 yuan into Honor of Kings since January. With less than 800 yuan left at the end of the month and still far from the house-buying goal, he felt deeply regretful and annoyed. He immediately opened the phone settings, disabled the payment function for the game, and removed the password-free payment authorizations for Alipay and WeChat, as the greatest restraint he could currently exercise.
location: Room 304, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Five-axis programming study.
description: Forcing myself to stop thinking about gaming expenses, I sat down at my desk, opened my laptop to take an online course on five-axis programming, focused on reviewing the coordinate transformation chapter, drew diagrams of rotation and translation in my notebook, and recorded key formulas. I felt I had made progress and that the day was not wasted.
location: Room 304, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Second round of knee rehabilitation training
description: He did the second round of rehabilitation training before bed, mainly stretching with the aid of a resistance band. After training, he took an ice pack from the fridge and applied it to the outside of his right knee for 15 minutes, timing it with his phone and quietly enjoying the soothing feeling of the cold compress.
location: Room 304, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with Lin Yue (minor disagreement)
description: After the ice compress ended, Lin Yue started a video call. She first asked about his knee. When she learned that he had gone swimming, she immediately became anxious and scolded him for not taking care of his body. Because he had just come out of the negative mood caused by the game bill, he snapped back a few lines impatiently. Their tones turned cold, and Lin Yue hung up in disappointment.
location: Sofa in the living room, Room 304, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Received heartwarming care.
description: After the video call ended, he was sitting on the sofa sulking when his phone vibrated with a screenshot from Lin Yue showing the logistics information of the knee pads and calcium tablets she had just ordered. He felt both guilty and warm inside, and immediately sent her a voice message to apologize and thank her, and finally sent a hug emoji.
location: Sofa in the living room, Room 304, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and getting ready
description: He got up to wash up. While brushing his teeth, he deliberately rinsed his knee with hot water. Back in the bedroom, he put out the work clothes and socks he would wear tomorrow, put the charger and earphones into his commuter bag, and prepared everything for the next day.
location: Room 304, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Browsing before bed
description: After getting into bed, browsed technical threads on a CNC forum, and in the rehab group saw someone share a new stretching video, so I saved it.
location: Room 304, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Set alarm and fall asleep
description: Sleepiness surged over him. He set the alarm for 6:50 the next day, switched his phone to Focus mode, turned off the desk lamp, let out a long breath, and said to himself, "Tomorrow is a new day," then fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room 304, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning preparations
description: The alarm went off right at 6 a.m., and it was drizzling outside. After getting up, I first moved my right knee and did 5 minutes of knee flexibility stretching, including straight-leg raises and quadriceps stretches, to warm up the joint. Then I confirmed the weather was light rain and 8°C, and decided to ride as planned. After washing up, I put on a quick-drying long-sleeve sports top and cycling shorts, wore a hardshell jacket over them, and found the fluorescent green raincoat and new helmet, and put on cycling glasses. Downstairs, I checked the mountain bike: tire pressure was sufficient, the chain was oiled, and everything was ready.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Early morning cycling training.
description: Riding my bike to the Songjiang Central Park greenway in light rain; there was almost no one in the park. I kept a low gear ratio and a high cadence, focused on making circular movements with my right foot to avoid knee strain, and kept my heart rate around 140. I rode about 15 kilometers in 1 hour. Although my T-shirt inside the raincoat was a little damp, my right knee felt more flexible than in the morning and there was no pain, which strengthened my confidence in recovery.
location: Songjiang Central Park Greenway, Renmin North Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home, shower, have breakfast, and prepare lunch.
description: After returning home, he immediately took a hot shower and changed into dry clothes. He followed the high-protein diet plan: fried two eggs and made skim milk. Then he prepared his lunch bento box by slicing the chicken breast cooked last night into strips, mixing it with lettuce, cherry tomatoes, and corn kernels, drizzling vinaigrette over it, and packing it into the lunch box.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Commuting to work
description: Put the lunchbox, raincoat, and charging pack into the backpack, put on work clothes, and set off on the electric bike. The path was wet and slippery, so I rode carefully, reached the factory about 15 minutes later, and clocked in at the workshop entrance.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Worked in the morning.
description: After arriving, I preheated the CNC machine and reviewed the carbon steel part drawings. Because I had been absent-minded and almost entered the wrong code earlier, today I stayed focused and operated with full concentration. During the work, Master Sun Jianguo came around and asked about my knee. I replied, 'Much better—I rode my bike for a while this morning.'
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break, catching up with colleagues, and handling errands
description: During the lunch break, he brought his homemade chicken breast salad to the staff break room to eat. Colleagues Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang saw it and asked jokingly if he had started a health regimen. While eating, he told them about his knee problem, including the doctor's diagnosis and the requirement to stop running. Wang Lei shared his recovery experience after spraining his ankle, and Liu Zhiqiang again suggested sticking with swimming. Yin Hao said he had tried it yesterday and it worked well, and thanked him. After the meal, he cleaned up his lunch box, sent his mother a WeChat voice message reminding her that it was raining in Shanghai and to keep warm, and told her that his chronic knee problem was being treated and not to worry. Then he checked the delivery app and saw that Lin Yue's package was out for delivery, expected to arrive at 3 p.m., so he planned to pick it up on his way home after work. He confirmed once more that game payments were disabled and breathed a sigh of relief.
location: Employee break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360, Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work
description: Continued the afternoon work, finished machining two small-batch trial parts, and carefully checked the finished dimensional tolerances to ensure they met the drawing requirements.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After work: pick up the package, unbox it, and give thanks.
description: After clocking out, he went to the guard room and saw that a cardboard box bearing the SF Express logo had been delivered. He felt warm inside after signing for it. At home, he couldn't wait to open the package. Inside were a pair of professional patellar strap knee pads, two large bottles of calcium tablets, and a pink sticky note that read, "Get better first, nothing else is urgent." A warmth surged in his heart, and the earlier quarrel vanished. He immediately put on the knee pads, took a mirror selfie, sent it to Lin Yue on WeChat, and attached a voice message: "Got it, fits well, thank you. I've already started rehabbing as planned today, don't worry."
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Prepare a healthy dinner
description: In a good mood, carefully prepared dinner. Stir-fried broccoli with the leftover half chicken breast from lunch, and half a corn cob as the staple, strictly following the carb-reduction plan.
location: Kitchen at home, Xinguang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing rehabilitation equipment and tidying the room.
description: After dinner, dug out a dusty foam roller from the bottom of the cabinet and wiped it clean with a damp cloth. Also found a resistance band and placed it together with the yoga mat in a prominent spot beside the bed, creating a "recovery corner" to ensure he could start training early tomorrow morning.
location: Room at home, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drafted an initial diet plan.
description: At the desk, opened the phone memo and listed high-protein foods: eggs, chicken breast, beef, fish, and shrimp. Planned a daily meal framework for the next four weeks: breakfast fixed as two eggs and a glass of milk, lunch with homemade salad or chicken breast, dinner mainly vegetables and high-quality protein, using boiling, steaming, and pan-frying instead of braising whenever possible.
location: At the desk at home, Xingang Residential Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Had a video call with Chen Jie to develop a rehabilitation plan and refine the diet plan.
description: At 8 p.m., Chen Jie started a WeChat video call right on time. He first asked about the condition of my knee, then explained in detail the anatomy of the iliotibial band, pointing out that the root problem was insufficient strength in the gluteus medius. He then demonstrated two exercises: side-lying clamshells with a resistance band, and standing foam rolling on the outer thigh. I followed his guidance and did several sets of the standard movements. Finally, he helped me put together a progressive four-week home rehabilitation training plan and sent it by photo. After the video call, based on Chen Jie's suggested "anti-inflammatory diet" (adding antioxidant foods such as blueberries and broccoli), I refined the diet list in my phone memo and saved a screenshot. Then I used the foam roller on my outer thigh for 5 minutes to get familiar with it in advance.
location: At the desk at home, Xingang Residential Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Self-study and wash-up preparations
description: As planned, studied five-axis programming for 30 minutes, reviewed yesterday's content, and drew coordinate axis transformation diagrams on paper using the printed coordinate transformation PPT to deepen understanding. Afterward, took a hot shower, brushed teeth, washed face, and applied lotion. Placed the clothes to wear tomorrow and the electric bike keys on the shoe cabinet by the door.
location: At the desk and in the bathroom at home, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video check-in with Lin Yue.
description: He called Lin Yue via video ten minutes early. She smiled when she saw him wearing a knee brace. The two chatted about the day's routine. He described in detail the whole process of the video call with Chen Jie and his future rehabilitation plan to reassure her. She also shared amusing stories from work. They agreed to check in by video every night at 10 PM from now on, to supervise each other's daily routine and rehabilitation progress.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening review, bedtime relaxation, and falling asleep
description: After hanging up the video call, he checked off today's plan in the memo on his phone and planned tomorrow's priorities: do the first day of rehabilitation training at 6:30 a.m., have a high-protein breakfast, and prepare lunch. He set the alarm for 6:30 a.m. After lying flat, his right knee felt comfortable. He turned off the ceiling light, kept the night light on, opened a white noise app to play soft rain music, closed his eyes, and used abdominal breathing to relax his whole body. Near 11 p.m., he grew drowsy, turned off the music and the night light, and soon fell asleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning rehabilitation training and high-protein breakfast preparation
description: The alarm went off. Lu Tao got up, opened the curtains, and it was cloudy outside. He drank a glass of warm water, then laid out the yoga mat on the floor. Following the four-week home rehabilitation plan that Chen Jie had sent last night, today was lower-body stability training: he did 3 sets of side-lying clamshells (15 reps per set), 2 sets of straight leg raises (12 reps per leg), and 1 set of glute bridges (15 reps). After finishing, he rolled the outside of his right thigh with a foam roller; the iliotibial band area was still a bit sore, but much more flexible than last week. After showering, he opened the fridge, took out the chicken breast that had thawed overnight, patted it dry with paper towels, sprinkled it with black pepper, sea salt, and olive oil, and put it in the air fryer set to 200°C for 12 minutes. Meanwhile, he boiled two eggs and washed a handful of broccoli. During the roasting time, he took out the calcium tablets that Lin Yue had sent, poured two into the bottle cap, and reminded himself to take them in the evening.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to work and buying breakfast.
description: Lu Tao packed the baked chicken breast into a lunch box, put it in the meal bag along with eggs and broccoli, changed into his work uniform and put on his helmet. He rode his e-bike, first stopped at the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road, called out to the boss Uncle Li for two meat buns and a cup of soy milk to take away, scanned the QR code to pay, then continued riding for about 10 minutes to reach Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory.
location: Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, No. 232 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-shift preparation and equipment inspection
description: Lu Tao arrived at the factory early, parked his car, and walked into the five-axis machining workshop with breakfast, clocking in. He first went to his five-axis machine tool, powered it on for a self-check, checked the coolant and lubricating oil levels, and wiped the key tools in the tool magazine with a clean flannel cloth. Team leader Wang Lei also arrived, patted him on the shoulder, and asked, 'Well, no chafing behind your knee?' Lu Tao replied, 'It's fine. I've been swimming regularly this week, so it's rock solid.'
location: Five-axis machining workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning production work
description: After the shift team morning meeting, Lu Tao returned to his machine tool workstation. Today he needed to machine a batch of turbine housing samples made of high-temperature alloy. He pulled up the machining program sent by Liu Zhiqiang from the programming team, carefully checked the tool path and feed parameters, clamped the blank, closed the protective door, and pressed the start button. The machine roared, and cutting fluid washed over the workpiece. During a 10-minute break, he did several standing forward bends next to the workstation to stretch his hamstrings.
location: Five-axis machining workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and socializing with colleagues
description: Today the canteen served braised pork ribs and scrambled eggs with tomatoes. Lu Tao took half a portion of rice, chose the ribs, and added a serving of stir-fried greens. Wang Lei came over with his tray, and Liu Zhiqiang also joined. Wang Lei mentioned wanting to go fishing at Dianshan Lake on the weekend and asked Lu Tao if he wanted to go. Lu Tao said his knee hadn't fully recovered, and he was mainly swimming now, so he'd skip it this time. Liu Zhiqiang said his son had the high school entrance exam coming up and he'd need to accompany him doing practice problems over the weekend. The three chatted about their lives. Lu Tao also ate the egg from the chicken breast bento he'd brought, making up enough protein.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Walk during work break and interaction in the rehab group
description: After eating, Lu Tao did not go back to the workshop to rest right away. Instead, he slowly walked two laps along the small paths in the factory area, about seven or eight minutes. His right knee felt okay, with no obvious stiffness. He took out his phone and sent a message in the rehabilitation exchange group: "Did 2 sets of squats this morning, no knee pain, feels like I'm recovering." Someone soon replied "Keep it up," and another group member asked, "Swimming, or going to Songjiang Swimming Pool?" He replied, "Yes, the one at the University Student Sports Center."
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon production work and task handover
description: In the afternoon, he continued machining the remaining workpieces. Because the high-temperature alloy was hard, Lu Tao lowered the spindle speed and increased the chip-blowing frequency. Master Sun Jianguo came over, looked, and pointed at a feed rate parameter on the screen, saying in Shanghainese: "This place is rough. Slow down, take a finishing cut, and it will be safe." Lu Tao understood what he meant and changed one line of code. At around 4:30, the first batch of sample parts was all off the machine. He took them to the measurement room for coordinate measuring machine inspection. The dimensions were all within tolerance, and only then did he breathe a sigh of relief. Before leaving work, he organized the machining program and processing records and handed them over to the night-shift colleague.
location: Five-axis machining workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting off work and going home to change into swim gear
description: After clocking out, Lu Tao rode his electric bike straight home and did not detour to the supermarket, because the food he bought last night was enough for another day. The trip took about 15 minutes. After arriving home, he opened the fridge and saw that broccoli and chicken breast were still left, so he took out the ingredients he needed for tonight. Then he quickly changed into his swimming gear: goggles, swim cap, quick-dry towel, and waterproof bag, and put on a long-sleeved jacket to keep from getting cold.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Swimming cross-training
description: He turned off the desk lamp, and the room went completely dark. With the satisfaction of reviewing today’s running route and the new textbook, he soon fell into even breathing and slept peacefully.
location: Swimming pool, Shanghai University Student Sports Center, No. 2000 Wenxiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Post-swim stretching and rehabilitation check-in
description: After taking a hot shower, Lu Tao did a set of active stretches in the corner of the locker room—hamstrings, hips, and calves all got stretched. Then he took out his phone and sent the swimming data to the rehab group: "1,000-meter freestyle, 28 minutes 30 seconds, average heart rate 156, no knee pain." He also attached a screenshot of the swimming data from his wristband. Soon someone asked how warm the pool was kept, and he replied, "Around 26 degrees."
location: Changing room of the swimming pool at Shanghai University Students Sports Center, 2000 Wenxiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Went home after swimming.
description: Lu Tao cycled for 10 minutes back to his rented room. He was sweating all over, and when the wind blew, his pores tightened, making him feel completely refreshed.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cooked and enjoyed dinner
description: After returning home, he first washed and cut the vegetables. He preset the air fryer to 200°C, put the fresh chicken breast and corn bought last night into the fryer basket, and set it for 12 minutes. After blanching the broccoli, he removed it and drizzled it with light soy sauce and sesame oil. In the meantime, he also ate a boiled egg. Once the chicken breast was cooked, he arranged it with the corn and broccoli on a plate, made a vinaigrette for dipping, and finished dinner in 15 minutes.
location: Kitchen, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Calculate gaming expenses and cut them off
description: After the meal, Lu Tao sat at the living room table and opened the Alipay and WeChat Pay transaction records on his phone, filtering by the "game top-up" category. From March 2024 to March 2025, in the span of a year, he had spent nearly 5,000 yuan in total — the worst month was last December, when he topped up 1,850 yuan on Honor of Kings alone. Without hesitation, he opened the Honor of Kings app, went to "Settings > Payment Center", and manually turned off all monthly cards and battle passes under "Password-Free Payment / Auto-Renewal", cancelling 4 services in total. Then he went back to Alipay and WeChat Pay, and under "Payment Management" he also removed the quick-payment authorizations for these games. After that, he took a screenshot and saved it to a new album called "Quitting Record".
location: Living room, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Ordered rehabilitation equipment
description: After exiting the game payment interface, he opened the JD.com app and searched for "foam roller and resistance band set", picked a four-piece set: high-density foam roller, resistance band, therapy ball, and stretching strap, total price 178 yuan, expected delivery on March 7. After reading the comments saying the quality was good, he placed the order. After ordering, he sent a WeChat message to Chen Jie: "Lao Chen, I bought that foam roller and resistance band set, it'll arrive on Saturday, I'll confirm the rehab exercises with you then."
location: Living room, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Mood journal and professional study.
description: He opened the memo app on his phone and created a new folder called "Daily Mood." The first entry read: "03-05, Wednesday. I was focused at work during the day, and made progress in swimming; my average pace was faster than before. In the evening I turned off all game auto-renewals and deleted quick payment, drawing a line with my old self. 178 yuan of equipment in exchange for 5,000 yuan a year in game spending—not a bad deal. My right knee still feels a bit tight, but better than last week." He set a phone alarm reminder for nine o'clock every night with the label "Write Mood." After finishing the diary, he took out "Five-Axis CNC Programming and Machining Examples," turned to the coordinate transformation chapter he read yesterday, and reviewed for 30 minutes while underlining.
location: Living room, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Household chores and washing up.
description: After studying, he washed all the dishes and chopsticks in the kitchen and wiped the counter clean. Then he took out the work clothes he would wear tomorrow and hung them on a chair. Next, he went to the bathroom to wash up: brushing his teeth and washing his face, and also applying a hot towel to the outer thigh near his right knee.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with mother and girlfriend
description: He first made a video call to his mother, Zhang Xiulan. His mother was in the kitchen. She asked how his knee had been lately. He said he had been swimming and it was no big problem, and told her not to worry. She urged him not to catch a cold. After hanging up, at exactly 22:00, his girlfriend Lin Yue's video call came in on time. She had the bedside lamp on and was wearing loungewear, asking how his day had gone. He reported in detail about his swimming results, his process of quitting gaming, and buying equipment. When Lin Yue heard that he had cancelled all auto-renewals, she gave him a thumbs-up emoji. After chatting for about ten minutes, Lin Yue sent an image: a screenshot of a high-speed rail ticket order from Hangzhou East to Shanghai Hongqiao at 10:18 on the morning of March 8. His heart warmed at the sight, and he typed back: "I'll pick you up. We'll go to the Sixth Hospital for the follow-up first, then I'll take you somewhere nice to eat." Lin Yue replied with a "finger heart" emoji. They agreed on the meeting time for the day after tomorrow.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep review and bedtime preparation.
description: After hanging up the video call, Lu Tao lay in bed and briefly ran through tomorrow's to-do list in his head: go to work, continue rehabilitation training in the evening, follow-up appointment the day after tomorrow in the morning, pick up Lin Yue in the afternoon. Then he set two alarms — one for 6:30 tomorrow morning, and one for 10:30 tomorrow morning to remind himself to bring his ID card to the Sixth Hospital. He put his phone on the nightstand, turned off the bedroom light, leaving only a small night light. He felt quite at ease — today he had done everything he wanted to do, and tomorrow would be a fresh start.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: First at-home rehabilitation session
description: After the alarm went off at 6:30 in the morning, I got up and weighed myself barefoot; the scale showed 72.0 kg. Then I turned on my phone and played the rehabilitation video sent by Chen Jie, laid out the yoga mat in the living room, and started the day's rehab training. First, I slowly rolled the outside of my right thigh with a foam roller. Although it felt sore, I persisted for 10 minutes. Then I used a resistance band to complete 3 sets of glute bridge abductions (12 reps per set). After training, I posted a screenshot of the video to the runners' rehab supervision group, with the caption: 'Day 3 foam roller + resistance band check-in, persistence is victory!'
location: Room 401, Unit 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and getting ready to go out
description: After taking a shower, I fried two eggs with an electric griddle, toasted two slices of whole wheat bread, and heated a glass of milk. At the dining table, I took the calcium tablets with the milk. After breakfast, I cleaned up the dishes and chopsticks. I checked my work uniform and work badge, and unplugged the fully charged power bank for the electric bike key. Before going out, I glanced at my phone and mentally reviewed the things I needed to do in the morning.
location: Room 401, Unit 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting and running into a neighbor
description: At 7:35 he pushed out his electric bike and met Aunt Chen, a neighbor returning from grocery shopping, at the community gate. He took the initiative to nod and greet her. Aunt Chen smiled and responded. He then rode the electric bike and arrived at the factory in about 10 minutes.
location: From Xingang Residential Community, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory

name: Machine tool inspection and preheating
description: At 7:45, clocked in and changed into work clothes, walked to his workstation in front of the five-axis machining center, checked the coolant level, listened in turn to the sounds of the spindle, tool magazine, and each axis under the warm-up program, and confirmed everything was normal. Then he neatly arranged the part drawings and program sheets for the day at the workstation.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Ask the master for advice on programming optimization
description: After the pre-shift meeting, I took the USB drive containing the optimized macro program to my mentor Sun Jianguo and asked for advice on the feed route for five-axis drilling. After reviewing the program, Master Sun pointed out two areas for improvement in the tool path and depth-of-cut layering strategy. Sitting beside him, I quickly noted down the details of his explanation in my phone's memo app, along with the practical tip he casually mentioned: "For machining this type of material, using conventional milling is more efficient." The two of us discussed for nearly half an hour.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Independent machining operations in the morning
description: Following Master Sun's guidance, he imported the optimized program into the machine tool and started machining today's first batch of parts. During the automatic machining intervals, he repeatedly checked the dimensions on the drawings to ensure error-free machining.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and casual chat about career topics
description: In the factory canteen, he got a serving of braised pork chops, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and stir-fried greens, then carried his tray to sit across from team leader Wang Lei. Wang Lei ate while complaining about slow salary increases and hesitating over whether to change jobs. He kept his head down eating, but inwardly pondered the issue of a raise, realizing that relying only on basic operations and ordinary programming would make it hard to get ahead in Shanghai. The educational gap needed to be addressed; otherwise, even if he obtained the senior technician certificate, promotion and pay raises would remain difficult.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break walk and short rest.
description: After eating, I didn't go straight back to my workstation. Instead, I walked slowly around the factory area for ten minutes, enjoying the warm early spring sun. During that time I sent a WeChat message to my girlfriend Lin Yue, telling her that the canteen had braised pork ribs today, and received a cute sticker pack from her. After returning to my workstation, I rested my head on the desk with my eyes closed for twenty minutes.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon machining and tool data recording
description: In the afternoon, he continued operating the machine tool and machined parts according to the optimized plan, with a noticeable improvement in efficiency. During the automatic machining interval, he browsed this week's Tool Wear Record Sheet and entered the data for the newly installed 10 mm diameter carbide end mill, finding that the tool wore out faster than expected. He took photos of the tool and its wear condition, planning to write an analysis report over the weekend and submit it to Master Sun.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-work walk on the greenway at Songjiang University Town
description: After getting off work at 5:30, he met Wang Lei at the bike shed, and the two walked together along the Songjiang University Town greenway for nearly forty minutes, talking about practical issues such as job-hopping and rent. In the sunset, several light-footed runners came toward them. He couldn't help but take a few extra looks, slowed his pace, and felt nostalgic for the feeling of flying on the road in the past. He sighed that despite his hard work in swimming, the pleasure of running was ultimately irreplaceable.
location: Songjiang University Town Greenway, at the intersection of Guangfulin Road and Longteng Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bought cold dishes on the way home
description: After saying goodbye to Wang Lei at the entrance to the greenway, he cycled home alone. On the way, he passed the Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant and bought a portion of cold dish on the way, planning to have it as a side dish for tomorrow.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Sorting through old belongings and resuming the running plan
description: After returning home, he felt a bit low. He opened the wardrobe, took out the sports watch he used for running last year, and plugged in the charging cable. Swiping through the phone app, he looked at past summer running records; those pace, route, and total mileage data seemed to carry the smell of sweat from back then. In the phone memo, he created a new goal: “Recovery goal: return to the track before June.” Then he dug out the fishing rod bag that had not been used for a long time and carefully checked the fishing gear.
location: Room 401, Unit 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Contact fishing buddies to arrange a weekend fishing trip.
description: After exiting the memo, I immediately sent a WeChat message to fishing buddy Brother Wu, asking whether, since the weather was nice this weekend, we could go fishing at Dianshan Lake. Brother Wu quickly replied, sending a few photos of big crucian carp recently caught at Lanlu Harbor, and readily agreed to meet up on Saturday morning. Looking at the fish photos, my mood improved a lot.
location: Room 401, Unit 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and search for academic qualification information
description: Marinated the thawed chicken breast from the fridge with black pepper and salt, pan-fried it until cooked, and served it with lettuce, cucumber, and cherry tomatoes, drizzled with vinaigrette as a salad for dinner. While eating, I turned on my phone and searched for “National Open University, Mechatronics, Shanghai, enrollment brochure”.
location: Room 401, Unit 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Look up enrollment information for the Open University of China.
description: He searched carefully for half an hour and basically figured out the situation of the Electromechanical Integration major at the Open University of China: admission without exams, a 2.5-year program, and tuition of about 3,000-plus yuan per semester. This mode is the most suitable for on-the-job study. He found the phone number of the learning center in Songjiang District and saved it to his phone contacts, planning to call for consultation during a work break the next day. At the same time, he moved the screenshot of the 'Payment Failed' notification from the 'Withdrawal Record' album on his phone to the 'Positive Encouragement' subfolder.
location: Room 401, Unit 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and applying a hot compress to the knee.
description: After clearing the dishes and chopsticks from the dining table, went to the bathroom to wash up. Before brushing my teeth, soaked a towel in hot water, wrung it out, and applied it to the outside of my right knee, feeling the heat penetrate; kept it on for fifteen minutes, and the knee felt much more comfortable.
location: Room 401, Unit 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with girlfriend Lin Yue
description: At almost 9 PM, Lin Yue's video call came right on time. Lying in bed, he reported to her everything he had done that day: checking in on his rehab training, asking Master Sun for programming advice, his thoughts while walking, agreeing to go fishing on the weekend, and looking up information about the Open University of China. Lin Yue was very happy to hear it and encouraged him, saying it was good to have a direction. She was looking forward to seeing him tomorrow and claimed she might lose sleep over it tonight.
location: Room 401, Unit 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep preparation and review
description: After hanging up the video call, I got out of bed, drank some water, and set my phone alarm. Added a reminder in my notes: 'Tomorrow at 3 PM, ask the class monitor for leave in advance, leave at 4:30 PM to pick up Lin Yue.' At the same time, I mentally ran through the ID card and fishing gear bag I need to bring on Saturday morning.
location: Room 401, Unit 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Relaxation and falling asleep
description: After turning off the lights, set the phone to airplane mode and leave only the night light on. Take a few deep breaths, feel the warmth coming from the right knee, and the whole body relaxes. Closing my eyes, the image of casting a fishing rod by Dianshan Lake on Saturday comes to mind. Tonight should be a good night's sleep, and the direction for the future becomes increasingly clear.
location: Room 401, Unit 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning rehabilitation exercises
description: The alarm rang on time. After waking up, Yin Hao first did 5 minutes of ankle pumps and quadriceps activation in bed. After washing up, he spread out a yoga mat in the living room and carefully rolled his right outer thigh and iliotibial band with a foam roller for 10 minutes. Then, using a resistance band, he completed 3 sets of side leg raises and glute bridges, feeling that his knee felt better than yesterday.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Yin Hao's bedroom and living room)

name: Prepared breakfast and checked commuting gear
description: In the kitchen, Yin Hao fried two sunny-side-up eggs, made a whole-wheat sandwich with lettuce and ham, and brewed a cup of black coffee. While eating, he checked his commuter bag: ID badge, gloves, noise-cancelling earplugs, and collapsible umbrella were all there. He also deliberately placed the prepared swim kit (swim trunks, goggles, bath towel, waterproof bag) in a conspicuous spot by the door so he wouldn't forget it after work.
location: Xingang Residential Complex, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (kitchen)

name: Commute by car
description: Yin Hao drove his private car along Xingang Road to Huatianjing Road and headed to the factory. Traffic was good today; he didn't stop at the convenience store in Wangjin Village and drove directly into the gate of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, parking in the employee parking area.
location: Xingang Road to Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (during commute)

name: Morning meeting and equipment inspection
description: Changed into the blue work uniform and clocked in. At the pre-shift meeting, team leader Wang Lei emphasized the precision requirements for today's new batch of parts, with very tight tolerances. After the meeting, Yin Hao and his partner Liu Qiang walked together to the machine tool he was responsible for, checked the coolant level, lubricant condition, and verified the tool magazine, confirming that everything was ready.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (workshop team area).

name: Focused on machining parts for the new project
description: Production officially started. Yin Hao strictly followed the operating procedures and precisely fixed the blank in the machine vise. He stayed fully focused the entire time, monitoring every cutting pass according to the program written by Liu Qiang. During the critical finishing process, he stopped the machine several times to measure, ensuring dimensions accurate to the micron level. The workshop was filled only with the roar of machine cutting and the sight of metal chips flying.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (CNC machine operation station in the workshop)

name: Lunch and phone reservation for a welcome dinner.
description: Yin Hao, Master Sun Jianguo, and Team Leader Wang Lei drove to the Shaxian Snacks outside the factory area for lunch, ordering three portions of steamed dumplings and duck leg rice. While waiting for the food, he called the Old Shanghai Flavor restaurant, a local Shanghainese eatery, and successfully booked a table for two for tomorrow evening. He specifically asked for a window seat and verbally confirmed signature dishes such as braised pork belly and steamed sea bass. Master Sun teased him about having something going on, and Yin Hao smiled awkwardly.
location: Shaxian Snacks (Sijing Branch), No. 326 Gulang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Midday nap
description: After driving back to the company, Yin Hao leaned back in a chair in the break room, put on his earphones, listened to some light music, and rested with his eyes closed for fifteen minutes to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon production and workstation organization.
description: In the afternoon, he continued processing the remaining parts. After finishing all the machining, he and Liu Qiang did spot checks on the finished products, and all data passed. Half an hour before the end of the shift, he began cleaning the machine tools, carefully sweeping up metal chips, oiling the guide rails, and neatly returning all measuring tools and unused cutters to their places, completing a clean handover.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (Workshop), No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After work, drove to the swimming pool.
description: Changed into casual clothes and packed his swimming bag. Yin Hao drove out of the factory and set his navigation directly for the swimming pool at Songjiang Yongsheng Sports Center.
location: From Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Jiufeng Road (during commute).

name: High-quality swimming training
description: After changing into his gear, he entered the pool. Yin Hao first swam 300 meters of breaststroke as a warm-up, then began executing the day's 40-minute swimming plan. He tried a 200-meter fast front crawl, and his right knee felt no pain throughout, which put him in a great mood. After swimming, he took a shower, took out his phone and filmed a video of himself kicking in the water, then posted it to the knee injury recovery group with the caption: "Daily check-in, 40 minutes, tried fast swimming, knees no pain!" Soon after, group member Chen Jie gave a like with the comment "remarkable progress."
location: Swimming pool, Songjiang Yongsheng Sports Center, No. 2 Jiufeng Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive home and buy groceries on the way
description: Yin Hao drove home. Passing the Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket near the neighborhood, he stopped and went in to shop. He bought the cherry tomatoes Lin Yue liked, and picked two cucumbers and a bunch of scallions, planning to make two more refreshing cold dishes tomorrow.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and rest
description: Back home, he used the cherry tomatoes he had just bought and whatever ingredients were at hand to cook a simple steaming bowl of tomato egg noodles. After eating, he washed the ingredients needed for the next day and put them in the fridge. After tidying up the kitchen, he sat on the sofa and rested for a few minutes, reflecting on how the day had gone.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (kitchen, living room)

name: Resolved to implement the three principles for quitting gaming
description: Sitting at his desk, Yin Hao opened the memo app on his phone and seriously wrote down the "Three Principles for Quitting Gaming": 1. Immediately delete Honor of Kings and all mobile games from his phone; 2. Turn off mobile network before 11 PM every night, replacing it with paper books or study; 3. Exchange a fixed amount of weekly gaming time for Python study or outdoor fishing. He took a deep breath, long-pressed the Honor of Kings icon, and selected "Delete App". Then he sent a WeChat message to his gaming friend Zhang Fei: "Dafei, I've decided to take a break from gaming for now. The reasons are long; I'll tell you in detail another day. Don't stay up too late either. Take care." Pressing send, he felt an unprecedented sense of ease and relief.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (at the desk)

name: Had a video call with my brother Yin Tao.
description: Yin Hao made a WeChat video call to his older brother Yin Tao. The two brothers chatted for more than half an hour. Yin Hao described in detail his knee injury recovery, his decision to quit gaming, and his plan to continue his education and learn Python. Yin Tao was very supportive of these changes and suggested that he apply for the mechatronics program at the Open University of China. He also proposed that they go back to their hometown of Rudong together for the three-day Qingming Festival holiday and stay with their parents for two days. Yin Hao happily agreed and said he would take charge of booking the high-speed train tickets.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (living room sofa)

name: Evening study plan
description: After ending the video call, Yin Hao was in a good mood. He opened his laptop, browsed online recommendations for Python basic tutorials and beginner books, and decided to go to the nearby library the next day to borrow a copy of Learn Python the Hard Way for systematic study.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (at the desk)

name: Reading and bedtime preparation
description: He took out the book Automate the Boring Stuff with Python that he had bought a few days earlier and carefully read the first chapter, learning about variables and basic data types. He set his phone to Do Not Disturb mode, put it on the bedside table, and read for about an hour in a quiet environment.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (on the bed in the bedroom)

name: Washing up and falling asleep peacefully
description: He washed up before bed and prepared the change of clothes to wear tomorrow. Lying in bed, he reviewed everything that had gone perfectly today: rehabilitation, work, swimming, quitting gaming, communication — everything was in order and moving in a better direction. He turned off the desk lamp with peace of mind and fell into a deep sleep.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (bathroom, bedroom)

name: Morning cycling training
description: After the alarm went off, he quickly changed into quick-dry sportswear, got on his Giant mountain bike, and set off from Xingang Residential Community, riding west along Guangfulin Road, then turning onto Longyuan Road and entering the Songjiang University Town greenway. Today the bending angle of his right knee increased significantly, with no soreness, and he felt in excellent condition. He stopped at the riverside viewing platform on Wenhui Road, took photos of the campus in the morning sun, and sent them to his running buddy Chen Jie, adding that his knee was in good shape. At 7:40 he returned to the community and pushed the bike into the stairwell.
location: From Xingang Residential Complex, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, along Guangfulin Road and Longyuan Road to the Songjiang University City Greenway

name: Shower, breakfast, and getting ready to go out
description: After a quick shower, he changed into a dark blue hoodie and casual pants and had milk oatmeal and two boiled eggs for breakfast. He checked the items needed to pick up the guest: phone, power bank, a bottle of water, and a pack of Lin Yue's favorite mint candies. When going out, he met Aunt Chen from the opposite door in the corridor and they exchanged greetings. At 8:10, he took his car keys and backpack and went downstairs.
location: Room 401, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Vehicle wash
description: To make a good impression on Lin Yue, drove to the Sinopec Songzhuan Gas Station and used the automatic car wash. After buying a car wash voucher, drove the car into the equipment, where it went through high-pressure water mist, foam, and roller brush washing. After it finished, used a chamois cloth to carefully dry the water stains on the rearview mirrors and door handles, ensuring the car was clean and bright as new.
location: Sinopec Songzhuan Gas Station, No. 3391 Husong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive to Hongqiao Railway Station to pick someone up.
description: Starting from the gas station, he took Husong Road onto the G15 Shenhai Expressway, then turned onto Songze Elevated Road toward Hongqiao Railway Station. Traffic was smooth on the weekend morning, so he set the cruise control and listened to radio music. At 9:40 he parked in the P9 underground parking lot, confirmed via the mobile app that train G123 was on time, and then went to the arrival-level exit to wait.
location: P9 underground parking lot at Shanghai Hongqiao Station, Shenhong Road, Minhang District, Shanghai

name: Picked up Lin Yue and went home to rest.
description: Just after 10, Lin Yue walked out of the gate pulling her suitcase. They smiled at each other and hugged tightly, and the earlier estrangement vanished. After taking her luggage, they returned to Songjiang, chatting freely about their recent lives along the way in a relaxed and happy atmosphere. At 11 they arrived home at Xingang Residential Community. After putting down the luggage and Lin Yue touching up her makeup, the two went out again.
location: Room 401, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Tasted soup dumplings in Songjiang Old Town.
description: He took Lin Yue to Caolu Dim Sum, a century-old shop recognized by locals, and ordered two baskets of pork xiaolongbao, a bowl of chicken and duck blood soup, and a bowl of small wontons. He introduced these as classic Songjiang delicacies. After tasting, Lin Yue praised the savory soup. While eating and chatting, he mentioned that he had uninstalled the game; Lin Yue smiled and picked up a xiaolongbao for him, her eyes showing relief.
location: Caolu Dim Sum, No. 58 Renmin North Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: In-depth tour of the Guangfulin Cultural Ruins.
description: After the meal, they strolled to Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site, visited the core underwater museum as planned, and took a group photo at Zhiye Chan Temple. On the way, they bought two bottles of sports drinks from a vending machine. At about 3:30 p.m., while resting in the corridor at Jixianfang, Lin Yue said seriously that Yin Hao had recently become more energetic. Yin Hao put his arm around her shoulder in response, feeling reassured.
location: Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site, Lane 3260, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Visited Guangfulin Country Park.
description: They walked from the core area of the heritage site along the water system to the adjacent country park and strolled on the path beside the flower fields. While Lin Yue was not paying attention, Yin Hao quickly used his phone's memo to double-check the list of ingredients he needed to buy for dinner. Lin Yue saw it and joked that it looked like he was on a mission. Yin Hao replied that the quality of life had to be guaranteed.
location: Guangfulin Country Park, 3488 Chenta Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Buy healthy ingredients at the supermarket
description: He drove five minutes to the Yonghui Superstore at Guangfulin Road, pushed a shopping cart, and bought according to the list: two boxes of chicken breast, a bag of broccoli, a tray of eggs, a large carton of fresh milk, and two boxes of vitamin C effervescent tablets. He hesitated at the snack section but did not buy potato chips. The total came to 132 yuan. Yin Hao stopped Lin Yue, who was rushing to share the cost, and said this was today's stock-up.
location: Yonghui Supermarket (Guangfulin Road Store), No. 1, Lane 1788, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Went home to put away the groceries and sign for the delivery.
