description: Back at the entrance of the community, he took two parcel boxes (a foam roller and resistance bands) from the Hive Box locker. After going upstairs, he quickly sorted the groceries into the refrigerator and put the foam roller beside the sofa. Lin Yue curiously unpacked the packages and studied the newly arrived rehabilitation equipment.
location: Room 401, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Shanghai local cuisine dinner and deep conversation
description: Left early and arrived at 18:00 at the reserved window seat on the second floor of the Old Shanghai Taste, a local-Shanghai-cuisine restaurant, ordering braised pork belly, sizzling eel shreds, and wine-scented clover. The atmosphere at the table was good. Yin Hao took the initiative to bring up the previous argument over a video call, earnestly promising to train scientifically and not act recklessly anymore. Hearing this, Lin Yue put some food into his bowl. Finally, the two agreed to meet at least once a month.
location: No. 68, Xinlongmen, Lane 1292, Xinsongjiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, Old Shanghai Flavor Local Cuisine Restaurant

name: Tried out rehabilitation equipment and recorded a video.
description: After dinner, walked home. In the living room, took out the foam roller and resistance band, and demonstrated to Lin Yue the calf posterior relaxation and thigh anterior stretching movements. Lying on the yoga mat, I asked Lin Yue to help record a 35-second foam roller relaxation video, posted it to the knee injury rehabilitation group with the note "Step Two of Functional Recovery". Afterward, I did several sets of side leg raises with the resistance band and felt good activation in the right glute.
location: Living room, Room 401, No. 15, Xinguang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Openly uninstall the game to show determination.
description: After putting away the equipment, he returned to the bedroom, took his phone from the nightstand, called Lin Yue to his side, unlocked the screen, found the Honor of Kings icon, long-pressed it, tapped delete, and entered his password to confirm. When Lin Yue saw the app icon disappear, she smiled, applauded, and then hugged him tightly.
location: Bedroom in Room 401, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Evening relaxation and planning for next week
description: Turned on the TV to play a documentary as background sound. Lin Yue leaned against his shoulder looking at photos on her phone. Yin Hao briefly listed next week's key points in his notebook: increase right-leg strength training, contact the district library to check Python books, confirm with his brother the date for returning home for Qingming, and put a checkmark next to the item about quitting gaming.
location: Living room, Room 401, No. 15, Xinguang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: The two washed up one after another. Yin Hao looked in the mirror and saw that he was in good spirits, and his knee also felt relaxed. Before going to bed, he set the alarm for 7:30 the next morning and switched his phone to Do Not Disturb mode.
location: Room 401, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Chatting before bed and falling asleep in each other's arms
description: Lying in bed, Lin Yue rested her head on Yin Hao's arm, chatting about trivial things like next week's work schedule and the new running shoes she wanted to buy. The two were immersed in a long-missed tranquility. Around 23:00, they fell asleep in each other's arms.
location: Bedroom in Room 401, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning washing up and preparing breakfast together
description: At 7:30 in the morning, the alarm went off. Yin Hao habitually moved his right ankle and felt it was in good shape, then quickly washed up and changed into loose sportswear. Walking into the kitchen, he found his girlfriend Lin Yue already washing cherry tomatoes. Yin Hao sliced the thawed chicken breast into even thin pieces and marinated them with salt, black pepper, and a little olive oil; Lin Yue prepared the lettuce, endive, and purple cabbage. The two worked in perfect coordination. Yin Hao pan-fried the chicken breast until both sides were golden, then plated it, drizzled with vinaigrette, took a photo, and finished a refreshing and delicious pan-seared chicken breast salad.
location: Room 601, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast time and farewell preparations
description: Sunlight streamed through the curtains onto the dining table as Yin Hao and Lin Yue chatted over salad. Yin Hao checked the wheels and zippers of Lin Yue's suitcase for her, making sure everything was in order. The warm atmosphere carried a touch of parting sadness; Lin Yue told him not to keep eating instant noodles.
location: Room 601, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Saw my girlfriend off as she returned to Hangzhou.
description: Yin Hao put the suitcase into the trunk of the car and drove along Husong Road onto the Jiamin Elevated Road toward Hongqiao Railway Station. Traffic was light, and they chatted about work arrangements and plans for the next meeting. After arriving at the departure level, he helped Lin Yue take out her luggage. Outside the security checkpoint, Lin Yue gave him a hug, told him to keep up with his rehabilitation training on schedule, and they agreed that he would go to Hangzhou to see her next month. Yin Hao watched as she swiped her ID card to enter the station, until her figure disappeared. Soon he received a message from her: "I'm on the train, G7351, don't worry."
location: Departure level, Hongqiao Railway Station, 1500 Shengui Road, Minhang District, Shanghai.

name: Stopped at a fishing tackle shop on the way back
description: After the farewell, Yin Hao felt a little empty inside. He drove home, but on the way decided to stop by his favorite fishing tackle shop. At the Shihudang Fishing Tackle Shop, he chatted with the owner, Old Li, about the latest fishing conditions and handled the newly arrived lure baits. However, because he was saving up to replace his fishing rod, he did not buy any. In the end, he only bought some common fishhooks and float stops, spending 25 yuan.
location: Shihudang Fishing Tackle Shop, No. 30 Dongzha Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home and have a light meal.
description: After coming out of the fishing tackle shop, his mood improved. He drove home along Songzheng Highway and arrived in 9 minutes. Once home, he cooked for himself, making a bowl of clear Yangchun noodle soup with eggs and dried noodles, and adding chopped scallions and seaweed. It was light and refreshing.
location: Room 601, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break, rehabilitation training, and desk tidying.
description: After lunch, feeling slightly tired, Yin Hao lay down on the yoga mat in the living room and used a foam roller to relax the front and outer side of his right thigh and his calf, following the video recorded by his girlfriend, for 15 minutes. He then returned to the bedroom for a 45-minute nap. After waking up, he was refreshed, sat at his desk, cleared the desktop files, sorted and filed the work drawings and software installation packages, wiped the desk clean, and prepared to study.
location: Room 601, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Setting up the Python learning environment and writing the first line of code.
description: After tidying up the desktop, Yin Hao downloaded version 3.10 from the Python official website and checked Add to PATH. Then he installed VS Code and configured the Python extension. He downloaded the PDF of Python Programming: From Beginner to Practice. Once everything was ready, he created a new first.py file and solemnly typed print("Hello rehab"). Seeing the successful terminal output, he felt a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Room 601, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Rest and stretching on the balcony
description: After studying for more than an hour, Yin Hao's eyes felt sore. He got up and went to the balcony to stretch, moving his neck and shoulders, and rested his eyes by looking at the green plants downstairs.
location: Room 601, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going for a walk to buy ingredients and cooking dinner
description: Feeling stuffy after sitting too long, Yin Hao changed into sneakers and walked 2 minutes to the Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket next to the north gate of the residential complex. He bought eggs, rice, carrots, soft tofu, pork belly, and green peppers, spending 73 yuan. Seeing yogurt on promotion, he bought a pack for his girlfriend. After returning home, he cut the meat into strips and mixed them evenly with cooking wine and starch, shredded the green peppers, heated the wok with cold oil, and quickly stir-fried everything. The fragrant shredded pork with green peppers was ready, and he cooked rice in the rice cooker.
location: Room 601, No. 15, Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai; and Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road

name: Dinner time: video call with mother
description: Yin Hao enjoyed shredded pork with green peppers and rice by himself, feeling content. During the meal, he made a video call to his mother, Wang Xiuying. She asked solicitously about seeing her off at the station and about his weekend. He showed her the dish he had cooked and his computer screen, and told her he had started learning programming. His mother told him to take care of his health. After chatting for more than ten minutes, he felt warm inside after hanging up.
location: Room 601, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening Python study
description: After putting away the dishes, Yin Hao returned to his desk, opened the PDF, and followed Chapter 2 to learn about variables and simple data types. He practiced in VS Code, creating variables and working with strings and numbers. The progress was slow, but he took notes.
location: Room 601, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening work communication and exchange with running buddies
description: After a study session came to an end, Yin Hao communicated by voice message with his colleague Liu Zhiqiang about a new part to be processed on Monday. They discussed fixture efficiency and CNC programs, and Liu Zhiqiang promised to send the new program. He also asked his mentor Sun Jianguo about special process preparation matters. Then he sent a voice message to his running buddy Chen Jie, talked about knee recovery, and agreed to go for a 5 km easy jog at Sijing Sports Center next Friday if it didn't rain.
location: Room 601, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Shower and pre-bed stretching
description: After the conversation ended, Yin Hao went to the bathroom to take a hot shower to relax. After changing into pajamas, he did 15 minutes of full-body stretching on the yoga mat, focusing on relaxing his lower back and right leg after sitting for a long time.
location: Room 601, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime reading and mood journaling
description: Lying in bed, he opened the WeChat Reading app and continued reading the chapter 'Core Strength and Running Efficiency' from 'The Running Bible,' thinking about training methods suitable for his recovery. Before falling asleep, he jotted down the day's feelings in his memo: reluctance at seeing his girlfriend off, excitement at learning his first line of code, and the grounded feeling of life getting back on track. He set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, turned off his phone, and went to sleep.
location: Room 601, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning rehabilitation training.
description: In the early morning with light rain, did indoor static stretching and foam roller relaxation in the living room, focusing on the right knee and hip muscles. After finishing, checked in briefly via phone in the knee injury recovery group, recording the morning rehabilitation status.
location: Living room, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Breakfast and communication
description: In the kitchen, he cooked a simple bowl of egg noodles with soy sauce and chopped green onions. While eating the noodles, he sent his mother a good-morning greeting on WeChat and quickly glanced through work group messages.
location: Kitchen, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute by car
description: Packed his work bag, checked the car keys, and set off early because the roads were slippery from rain. He drove along Huatianjing Road and arrived at the factory parking lot.
location: Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (on the way from Xingang Community to the factory)

name: Team morning meeting and start-of-work preparations.
description: After changing into work clothes, they gathered in the workshop. Team leader Wang Lei led the morning meeting, emphasizing this week's production tasks and safety matters. After the meeting, he confirmed today's high-precision valve body CNC milling task with his partner Liu Qiang and checked the machine tool's lubricating oil and coolant.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning CNC machining work
description: I focused on debugging the CNC machine tool parameters and verified the programming code with Liu Qiang. When I had questions about feed speed, I proactively asked master worker Sun Jianguo for advice. After confirming the plan, I conducted first-piece inspection and started machining.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and exchange with colleagues
description: During lunch break, he went with his mentor Sun Jianguo and shift leader Wang Lei to the Sun Island Ancient Village farmhouse restaurant for lunch. They ordered shredded pork with green peppers over rice and chatted about the part parameter issues from the morning processing. Wang Lei teased him about learning programming on Sundays, asking whether he planned to change jobs. Yin Hao laughed and denied it, explaining that he just wanted to learn more things.
location: Sun Island Ancient Village Farmhouse Restaurant, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break in the car and sorting out plans.
description: After eating, he returned to his car in the factory parking lot, reclined the seat, closed his eyes, and rested for 20 minutes. When he woke up, he checked the afternoon work plan on his phone to make sure nothing was missed.
location: Parking lot, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon workshop machining and handover
description: Continued the afternoon's work with high concentration, monitoring the machining process of the machine tools and handling a fine adjustment caused by tool wear. After completing the final batch of parts, filled out the daily production report and handed over work matters to the colleague on the next shift.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After work, changing clothes and commuting to the swimming pool
description: After work, I went to the locker room, changed out of my work clothes, and put on sports shorts and a T-shirt. I drove from the factory, went along Huatianjing Road and turned onto Rongle Middle Road, heading to the swimming pool at Songjiang Sports Center.
location: Huatianjing Highway and Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (on the way from the factory to the swimming pool)

name: Medley swimming training
description: At the Songjiang Sports Center swimming pool, before getting into the water, stretched at poolside, then warmed up with 200 meters of breaststroke, then switched to 200 meters of freestyle to feel how the right knee responded under different strokes. There was no discomfort throughout, and confidence soared. After swimming for 40 minutes, took a shower.
location: Songjiang Sports Center Swimming Pool, No. 143 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Clock in and drive home
description: In the locker room, I took a photo of the swimming pool water with my phone, checked in on the knee injury recovery group, and added a message reporting that I had completed the 400-meter medley and that my knee felt good. Afterward, I drove about 18 minutes back to my home in Xingang Community.
location: From Rongle Middle Road to Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (on the way back from the swimming pool to the residential community).

name: Cooking and dinner
description: After getting home, he changed out of his wet clothes, made a bowl of tomato and egg noodles with tomatoes and eggs, and had them with frozen dumplings for dinner. While eating, he watched short videos on mechanical processing technology on his phone.
location: Kitchen and living room, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Clearing up gaming merchandise
description: Began clearing out video game-related items. He opened the large cardboard box containing esports equipment, counted and wiped down the esports headphones, mouse, keycaps, controller case, and so on, neatly stored them in a large storage bin, pushed it to the bottom of the wardrobe, and covered it with old clothes. Then he checked the computer to confirm that the Honor of Kings client, shortcuts, and leftover folders had been completely deleted, leaving only work software and the Python environment.
location: Living room and study, Xingang Residential Quarter, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reading and professional study
description: After putting the game away, he sat down at his desk, took out Fundamentals of Mechanical Manufacturing Technology and a big notebook, continued reading from where he left off yesterday, highlighted key points, and wrote down his understanding and thoughts, thinking about how to apply them to everyday machining details. He felt very focused and fulfilled.
location: Study room at Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening stretching and hot compress for the knees.
description: After studying, he did a pre-sleep relaxation. First, he placed a hot towel on his right knee for 15 minutes, then did 20 minutes of full-body stretching, including the backs of the legs, hips, and back, with soft music playing on his phone. His body gradually relaxed.
location: Living room, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Free time and career reflections
description: After stretching, he leaned back on the sofa and scrolled through his phone, watching Python beginner tutorials and CNC senior technician videos on Bilibili. He thought about the date to return home for Qingming Festival and planned to call his elder brother Yin Tao on the weekend. He also browsed job-search websites to assess his market competitiveness.
location: Living room, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: He got up and went to the bathroom to wash up, then returned to the bedroom and set the alarm for 6:30 tomorrow morning. Reflecting that he had completed swimming, cleaning the surrounding area, and his study plan today, he felt grounded and in control. After reading a few pages of The Running Bible, he turned off the lights at 23:00 and prepared to sleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning cycling & encouragement from running friends
description: Yin Hao got up at exactly 6 o'clock, changed into his cycling gear and went out. In the cloudy weather, he cycled along the Songjiang University City Greenway (Longcheng Road to Guangfulin Road section), breathing fresh air. On the way, he met fitness coach Chen Jie, who was leading a morning running group. Chen Jie asked with concern about Yin Hao's right knee. After learning that cycling was painless, he suggested trying slow jogging next week, starting from 1 kilometer to observe the reaction. This advice made Yin Hao more confident in his recovery. He continued cycling for another half hour and then returned to Xingang Community.
location: Greenway in Songjiang University Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Longcheng Road to Guangfulin Road section) and the area around Xingang Community.

name: Return home, wash up, have breakfast, and organize equipment
description: After cycling, I took a quick shower and changed into work clothes. I cooked a bowl of noodles with a poached egg using the dried noodles bought last night at Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket as breakfast. After eating, I checked my backpack to make sure my work ID, car keys, phone, and other items were all there, and got ready for work.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute by car
description: Drove a silver sedan from Xingang Residential Area along Huatianjing Highway to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. Traffic was smooth that day; arrived at the factory parking lot at 7:58, two minutes earlier than usual.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning workshop work (1)
description: After attending the team morning meeting, accepted the stainless steel flange machining task assigned by team leader Lao Wang. Together with partner Liu Zhiqiang, carefully checked the drawings and debugged the newly replaced fixture, while master worker Sun Jianguo guided the optimization plan for cutting depth, ensuring the quality of the first workpiece was foolproof.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Work break and Open University of China registration payment
description: During a work break, he took out his phone and logged into the Open University of China website, carefully checked his personal information, uploaded photos of his ID card and bank card, and successfully submitted an application for the electromechanical integration associate degree program. When paying the first semester tuition of 3,000 yuan, he waited patiently for the system to process it; finally it showed payment successful. He screenshotted and saved the electronic admission notice page and sent it via WeChat to his mentor Sun Jianguo to share the good news.
location: Workshop break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning workshop work (2)
description: After the first piece passed inspection, small-batch production began. Yin Hao kept a close eye on the CNC panel and spot-checked dimensions with vernier calipers and micrometers every few pieces. Working with his partner Liu Zhiqiang, he made sure every product strictly met the precision requirements.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and mentor-apprentice exchange
description: After getting off work at noon, his mentor Sun Jianguo suggested eating out. Yin Hao, his mentor, and team leader Wang Lei drove less than 10 minutes to the Sun Island Ancient Village Farm Restaurant. They ordered the usual shredded pork with green peppers over rice and tomato and egg soup. While eating, Yin Hao told Master Sun that he had successfully registered for the Open University of China. Master Sun encouraged him, saying, 'Study hard; only theory combined with practice can make you succeed.' Team leader Wang Lei mentioned a complex impeller order they might take on next month, filling Yin Hao with anticipation for new technical challenges.
location: Sun Island Ancient Village Farmhouse Restaurant, beside the East Gate of Sun Island Tourism Resort, Shenzhuan Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Return to the company and take a lunch break in the car.
description: After lunch, he returned to the company. Instead of going straight into the workshop, Yin Hao reclined the driver's seat and took a 15-minute nap in the car to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: Parking lot, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon precision machining in the workshop
description: The afternoon procedures were more precise, requiring smaller cutting tools for finishing. Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang coordinated seamlessly, with Yin handling operation and measurement and Engineer Liu handling program fine-tuning. During the work, the machine gave a minor alarm; the investigation found that coolant pressure was insufficient. The two quickly cleared the clogged line and resumed normal production.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Tidying up the workstation after work
description: After finishing the last product and confirming the data were correct, Yin Hao turned off the machine tool, thoroughly cleaned the metal chips, oiled the guide rails, and put all measuring tools back in place. This is a habit he developed during military service: always keep the work site clean after finishing.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving home
description: At 17:35, he left the company and returned along Huatianjing Road to Xingang Community. He was in a good mood and looked forward to the evening online class.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Quick dinner and online course preparation
description: After returning home, he washed his hands first, cooked a bowl of egg noodles in 10 minutes using dried noodles from the fridge, and quickly ate them with the shredded pork with green peppers packed from the farmhouse restaurant at noon. At 18:00 sharp, he opened the laptop, downloaded and set up the online course platform software, tested the headset, and opened programming environments like VS Code in advance to ensure everything was foolproof.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Attended a live online Python course.
description: The online class started on time. The teacher explained from variables to conditional statements. Yin Hao stayed highly focused throughout, typing code in VS Code while listening. When the teacher covered "if...else", he thought of using it to simulate "tool offset condition judgment" and tried to implement it in code. Although the first run reported an error, he quickly found the logic error and fixed it. He took two full pages of notes during the lesson and gained a more intuitive understanding of logic control.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Home rehabilitation training
description: After the online class ended, he took a short break and got out the foam roller and resistance band. First he used the foam roller to release the outer and front of his right thigh, five minutes each, feeling the soreness in the iliotibial band. Then he did 3 sets of resistance band glute bridges (15 reps each) and 2 sets of clamshells. After the workout, the tension around his right knee was noticeably relieved, and he checked in and logged it in the rehabilitation group.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Review code and contact family.
description: While applying a hot compress to his knee, he opened his laptop and retyped the code examples from today's online class, also trying modifying the trigger conditions to observe the results and deepen his understanding. At 10 p.m., he sent a WeChat message to his mother Wang Xiuying telling her he had successfully registered, and she replied with a thumbs-up emoji; he also sent a voice message to his brother Yin Tao in Suzhou, agreeing to discuss in more detail tomorrow evening the matter of returning to their hometown for Qingming.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wash up and get ready for bed
description: After brushing teeth and washing face, soaked feet in warm water and listened to light music to relax body and mind, preparing for sleep.
location: Home bathroom in Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Sleep
description: Turned off the lights and lay down on time. Reviewing the day: he had completed a key step in advancing his education, learned a new skill, and made steady progress in knee rehabilitation. He soon fell asleep with a satisfied feeling.
location: Home bedroom, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up
description: At 7 a.m., the alarm went off right on time, and Yin Hao got up decisively without lingering in bed. He first poured himself a glass of warm water and stretched his body on the balcony. The new medicated patch he had put on his knee last night felt warm and comfortable.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning rehabilitation training and washing up.
description: After finishing basic stretches, Yin Hao took out the foam roller and focused on relaxing his calves and hamstrings, which had felt somewhat tight after yesterday's run, rolling each area for 2 minutes. When washing up, he moved briskly and also put his swim trunks, swim cap, goggles, and waterproof bag into his commuter bag, preparing for the evening swimming training.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and getting ready to go out.
description: Yin Hao heated the buns bought yesterday at the fresh food supermarket downstairs in the microwave, and with a glass of hot milk, had a simple and quick breakfast. Meanwhile, he saw a WeChat message from his mother sent in the early morning, saying the package would arrive at the Cainiao Station on Xingang Road in the afternoon, and the crisp crackers were already sealed. He replied and sent a hug emoji. After eating, he did a final check of his commuter bag: work badge, phone, keys, and swimming gear. Confirming everything was there, he put on his work jacket and left.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the factory.
description: Yin Hao started his car and drove out of Xingang Community. The weather was clear today, and traffic was slightly heavier than yesterday. He drove along the familiar Huatianjing Highway while the radio played morning news. After passing the Wangjin Village intersection, he turned right and saw the company's factory building. He parked in the employee parking area; the clock had just passed 8:12.
location: Route from Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory.

name: Workshop work and programming practice
description: Yin Hao changed into his work clothes and entered the workshop. He first met up with his partner Liu Zhiqiang to confirm the day's tasks, and continued machining the batch of stainless steel flanges from yesterday. Master Sun Jianguo came over, pointed to the tool path that had been optimized on the screen the night before, and reminded him to watch for changes in chip color and adjust the coolant. Yin Hao started the machine for warm-up and calibration. During a gap in the automatic machining, he tried opening the macro program editing interface, applied the conditional logic he had learned in last night's Python class to the program, and wrote a simple finish-machining compensation code. Although it reported errors several times, after repeated revisions he finally got the logic to work, and he felt a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Picked up the package sent by mother during the lunch break and had lunch with colleagues
description: The lunch break bell rang. Yin Hao called his master Sun Jianguo and his team leader Wang Lei, and the three of them drove together to pick up the package on the way. A few minutes later, they arrived at the Cainiao Station at 235 Xingang Road. Yin Hao gave the pickup code and took a cardboard box wrapped tightly in tape, putting it in the trunk. Then they drove to the Sun Island Ancient Village farmhouse restaurant, where each of them ordered a rice bowl and chatted about workshop minutiae while eating. Wang Lei teased Yin Hao into sharing the crispy cookies his mother had sent, and Yin Hao agreed with a smile. Sun Jianguo, in the meantime, discussed with Yin Hao how to optimize the morning's macro program.
location: Cainiao Station at 235 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and Sun Island Ancient Village Farm Stay beside the East Gate of Sun Island Tourist Resort

name: Return trip during lunch break and rest between work periods.
description: After lunch, Yin Hao drove back to the company. In the parking lot, he arranged the package in the trunk, planning to take it after work. Back in the workshop, he made a cup of tea, sat on a stool next to the machine tool, closed his eyes, and rested for ten minutes to build up energy for the afternoon's work.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon workshop work and wrap-up.
description: Afternoon workshop work went on as usual; Yin Hao kept watching the machining status, occasionally using measuring tools to sample-check product precision. He found that the compensation logic written in the morning worked well in small-batch testing. Although there was still room for optimization, it greatly encouraged him. Near the end of the shift, he started cleaning the machine tools, tidying up tools, and filling in the day's equipment inspection checklist at 16:50 to get ready for leaving work.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After work, drove to the swimming pool.
description: As soon as work ended, Yin Hao quickly changed clothes, grabbed the package from the trunk, and drove to the swimming pool at Songjiang Sports Center, thinking about today's goal: 1,500 meters freestyle—he had to make it.
location: Songjiang Sports Center Swimming Pool, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Swim training: broke through the 1,500m freestyle
description: Yin Hao parked the car, changed into swimming trunks, did some simple stretching, and got into the water right on time at 17:20. He adjusted his breathing and started freestyle at his own pace. The first 500 meters felt easy, but by 1000 meters his arms began to ache; he gritted his teeth and kept going. In the end, he completed the 1500-meter goal in 38 minutes. Holding onto the pool edge, gasping for air, his muscles were sore but he felt a strong sense of accomplishment. He used the phone in his waterproof pouch to take a photo of the lane and a wet selfie, posted them to the recovery group with the caption “1500m freestyle done! Got it in 40 minutes!” Chen Jie quickly replied with praise.
location: Songjiang Sports Center Swimming Pool, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home, take a shower, and change clothes.
description: After swimming, Yin Hao drove home, feeling completely relaxed, though his legs were a bit weak. Once home, he took off his wet swimsuit, took a nice hot shower, and changed into comfortable loungewear, feeling revived.

Amid the roar of the machine, he concentrated fully on the tool path and cutting parameters. The four of them sat down at a table by the window. Yin Hao ordered braised beef noodles, and Wang Lei ordered big-plate chicken. As they ate and chatted, Wang Lei complained about catching nothing while fishing at Dianshan Lake yesterday, and they also talked about fishing in nearby rivers. Yin Hao seized the opportunity to ask about learning practical repair skills and whether there was a skilled master in Songjiang who was good and willing to teach. Wang Lei thought for a moment and recommended "Jianguo Electrical Repair" in Sijing. The owner, Chen Jianguo, was an old hand with good skills and an easygoing manner, and he could go on weekends. Yin Hao immediately noted it down in his phone's memo. Master Sun praised him from the side, saying the younger generation was formidable. name: Afternoon work and Python script demonstration
description: After returning to the workshop, he continued operating the machine to process the valve body parts from the morning. Taking advantage of the tool-change gap, Yin Hao told Liu Zhiqiang that he would need Master Sun for half an hour in the afternoon to demonstrate the script. Liu Zhiqiang said no problem and that he could help watch the machine, joking that after his skills improved he would follow him. Around 14:30, when there was a slight lull in workshop tasks, Yin Hao invited Master Sun to the workshop's public computer. He opened a Python script and, starting from reading the drilling position data, demonstrated step by step how to automatically generate a G-code drilling program using for loops and if statements. Master Sun watched very attentively. When he saw the program successfully output standard drilling commands, he nodded approvingly and suggested taking tool wear in actual machining into account, adding the tool wear amount as a variable in the judgment logic to make the program more practical and safe. Yin Hao immediately took out his pocket notebook and wrote down “tool wear judgment”. After the demonstration, he returned to the machine and, applying the idea just discussed, optimized the feed rate for the last batch of parts on the control console. Fifteen minutes before the end of the shift, he shut down the machine, carefully cleaned the metal shavings from the machine, lubricated the guide rails, and tidied up the tools to prepare for next Monday.

name: Go fishing at Dianshan Lake and catch a big carp
description: After arriving at the fishing spot, I exchanged greetings with Wu Zhiqiang, who had arrived earlier, and we each set up our gear. Adjusting the float, casting bait, and hooking earthworms—all done in an orderly manner. For the first hour or so, the fish were biting lightly, so we chatted about work and fishing conditions while fishing. Around 9:50, the float gave a sudden sharp jerk and then slowly sank. I lifted the rod and hooked a fish; the rod tip bent into a full bow. After patiently playing the fish for nearly 10 minutes, a golden carp, estimated at over three jin, was successfully scooped into the net. Excitedly, I asked Wu Zhiqiang to take a photo, and I sent the photo to the family group and the friends group.
location: A wild fishing spot on the north side of Rainbow Bridge on the west bank of Dianshan Lake, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Lakeside lunch and watching drone aerial footage
description: Cycling club loop around Sheshan
location: A wild fishing spot on the north side of Rainbow Bridge on the west bank of Dianshan Lake, Qingpu District, Shanghai

While watching the float, I asked Wu Zhiqiang in detail about the drone's endurance, operation, and price. Wu Zhiqiang joked that it was a money pit, and I smiled and noted the model. Around 3 p.m., the sky turned cloudy and the wind picked up a bit, so I decided to pack up. Except for the big carp, I released the other small crucian carp back into the water, cleaned up the litter around the fishing spot, and agreed with Wu Zhiqiang to go again next week.
