description: After eating and clearing the dishes, you sit at the desk and open your laptop. Referring to the logic diagram drawn during the day and the G-code format in the machine tool operation manual, you write the Python program line by line. The main logic of the program is: read the current tool wear value, determine whether it exceeds the threshold, and if so, call the G-code offset subroutine. During writing, you encounter a variable scope issue, consult a Python tutorial for 15 minutes, and revise the code structure. Then you use open-source G-code simulation software to import the generated G-code path. Observing the tool path, you find an extra idle cut when the tool enters, and immediately add a conditional judgment to optimize it.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Programming review and note organization.
description: After saving the program and closing the simulation software, you took out your notebook, wrote down the pitfalls encountered during tonight's debugging and the solutions, and added a note next to the logic diagram: "Add tool radius compensation variable declaration." Then you opened WeChat, sent a voice message to your mom to let her know you were safe, told her your knee was recovering well, and said the birthday banquet cake would be ordered by tomorrow noon, asking her not to worry.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Relaxation before bed: reading and stretching.
description: You left the desk and did 10 minutes of full-body static stretching on the yoga mat in the living room, focusing on relaxing the hips, knees, and shoulders. Then you leaned back on the sofa and used WeRead on your phone to read the chapter on 'file reading and writing' in Python Crash Course for about 20 minutes.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Set the alarm and turned off the lights to go to bed.
description: You returned to the bedroom and set the alarm for 5:50 tomorrow morning. You put your phone on the nightstand, savoring the morning breeze during today's ride, the refreshing feeling of swimming, and the sense of accomplishment from completing a macro program. Though your body was tired, you felt at ease. After turning off the light, you soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Xingang Residential Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and chores.
description: The 6:30 alarm went off, and Yin Hao didn't lie in. He first checked his right knee; it felt fine with no soreness. Considering yesterday's high-intensity training, he skipped the morning run and instead did 15 minutes of core activation training and full-body stretching. Then he quickly washed up, put on his work clothes, and put the USB drive with last night's draft macro program into his commuter bag.
location: Room XX, No. XX, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and task planning
description: He took two slices of whole wheat bread and a bottle of milk from the refrigerator and quickly finished breakfast. While eating, Yin Hao mentally reviewed the budget details of the birthday banquet he would discuss with his elder brother later, and noted in his phone memo the final amount to transfer: 1,500 yuan.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuted to work by car.
description: Yin Hao drove from Xingang Community to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. Along the way, he listened to local traffic radio and confirmed that the morning rush-hour traffic was fairly smooth. According to Amap navigation, the trip would take about 15-17 minutes, and he arrived at the factory around 7:32 on time.
location: Driving route from Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning workshop work (first half)
description: Arrived at the workshop at 7:32, about half an hour earlier than usual. Yin Hao first checked the coolant and tool inventory of the gantry machining center that would be the first one to run today. At 8:00, work officially started. He skillfully called up the machining drawings and operated the machine tool to mill a batch of newly arrived duct flanges. During the work break at about 9:45, he walked outside the workshop and prepared to call his brother.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Discussing the birthday banquet arrangements with his older brother
description: Yin Hao called his older brother Yin Tao on WeChat voice to discuss matters related to their mother's birthday banquet. He proposed a total budget of 3,000 yuan, with himself covering 1,500 yuan (including the cake). Yin Tao agreed and would be responsible for booking the hotel. Yin Hao also mentioned that he wanted to buy a foot bath basin for their mother as an extra gift, and Yin Tao agreed. After hanging up, Yin Hao immediately transferred 1,500 yuan to Yin Tao via WeChat, noting "Mom's birthday banquet expenses", and then deleted the transfer record, feeling at ease.
location: Passage outside the workshop at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning workshop work (latter half)
description: Back at his workstation, he became more focused. Master Sun Jianguo came over to check the machining of the new workpiece, and they discussed a chamfer tool path issue. Yin Hao took the opportunity to mention the macro program he had written last night in Python that could automatically convert Excel parameters into variables. Master Sun was very interested and asked him to finish it and bring it over, which greatly encouraged him.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Yin Hao drove alone to the nearby Sun Island Ancient Village farmhouse restaurant, ordered a rice bowl with shredded pork and green peppers, and ate it quickly. He then drove back to the factory parking lot, reclined the seat in the car, and took a 20-minute nap to recharge for the afternoon.
location: Sun Island Ancient Village Farm Stay, beside the East Gate of Sun Island Tourist Resort, Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and then return to the parking lot of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory.

name: Return to the factory and prepare for work
description: After a short rest, I returned to the workshop refreshed, checked the cutting tools and drawings needed for the afternoon in advance, and prepared for the machining work.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon workshop work
description: In the afternoon, I continued operating the machine tool and inspected the first batch of workpieces machined in the morning; all precision measurements passed. During the machine's automatic operation gap, I quickly browsed the programmer discussion group on my phone. Someone shared a code snippet for processing text files. I thought it was a good approach and saved it immediately, planning to compare and study it after tonight's online course.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After work and cycling preparations.
description: He left work right at 5 o'clock. Yin Hao went back to the workshop, changed into his cycling clothes, and checked his helmet and gloves. Before setting off, he sent Lin Yue a WeChat message: “Got off work early today. Going for a ride. I have class tonight.”
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Leisurely bike ride after work
description: Starting from the factory, I rode along Huatianjing Road and turned onto Guangfulin Road, heading west all the way. The breeze brushed my face, and riding the road bike was very pleasant. My right knee felt no strain while pedaling, and I felt in great shape. I deliberately detoured to the outskirts of the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage site, stopped by the lake, enjoyed the waterscape at sunset, and took a photo.
location: Cycling route: No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site, Lane 3260, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Share in the stretching and rehabilitation group.
description: Did 5 minutes of static stretching on a bench in the park outside the Guangfulin Cultural Relic Park, focusing on relaxing the quadriceps and hamstrings. Then sent the sunset waterscape photo just taken to the rehabilitation group with the message: "Today's 15 km easy ride, knees feel light, the sunset at Guangfulin is truly beautiful, one step closer to running the track again!" After sending, received likes and encouragement.
location: The outer area of the Guangfulin Cultural Site, near the intersection of Guangfulin Road and Longyuan Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Returning home and preparing dinner
description: After cycling home, I quickly took a warm shower and changed back into loungewear. Then I opened the fridge, took out the leftover braised pork from last night and a bunch of greens, and prepared to cook a steaming bowl of noodles with shredded pork and greens.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and relaxation
description: While eating steaming hot noodles, I scrolled through two latest news items about Python on my phone and felt very satisfied. After the meal, I put away the dishes and chopsticks, and double-checked that the online course link and the test Excel file on my computer were ready.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Python online course study
description: He entered the online classroom on time. Tonight's course topic was "File Reading and Writing and String Processing." He stayed focused throughout, followed the instructor Liu Jianjun's explanation, and step by step completed the hands-on exercise from reading Excel spreadsheet data to generating CNC program code. When he saw his own code successfully convert the part dimension data into macro variables, he felt excited and one step closer to his goal.
location: Study/bedroom at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: After-class practice and code testing
description: After class, he didn't rest immediately. Yin Hao opened the script framework he had written before and, combining the file reading and writing methods he had just learned, rewrote a more complete script targeting the 'parts parameter entry' problem mentioned by Master Sun. He tested several sets of data locally, and all successfully generated the correct macro variable code.
location: Home study at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening relaxation and family communication
description: Spent 10 minutes using a foam roller to relax the thigh and glute muscles; it felt sore but good. Afterwards, sent a WeChat message to my parents to let them know I was safe: "Mom and Dad, today was fine. I discussed Mom's birthday plans with my brother, so don't worry." Glanced at my phone again; Lin Yue had replied with a "keep it up" sticker. I smiled and put it down. Finally, copied the test script program I need to bring to Master Sun tomorrow morning to the root directory of the USB drive.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: Set the alarm for 5:50 tomorrow morning. Since I didn't run today, I can get up early and run 5 km. Lying in bed, I briefly reviewed the day: smooth phone calls, a refreshing bike ride, and tackling coding difficulties. Life feels full and under control. I turned off the light and fell asleep around 22:50.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: At-home morning exercise, breakfast, and preparations
description: The alarm rang and the sun was shining brightly outside the window. Considering the macro program test run in the afternoon, Yin Hao decided not to go for a morning run. Instead, he did 15 minutes of resistance band rehabilitation exercises in the living room, including single-leg deadlifts, side leg raises, and clamshells, and felt that the stability of his right knee had recovered well. After the workout, he took a shower, heated whole-wheat bread in the microwave, made a cup of milk, and quickly finished breakfast. Before leaving, he checked the backpack: the USB drive containing the Excel parameter-to-macro variable script, the printed macro program, a notebook and pen, and a portion of jasmine tea prepared for his master.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Commuted to the company and consulted a senior colleague in the cafeteria.
description: Yin Hao put on his backpack and work clothes, left the building promptly at 7:15, and drove to the company. Driving the silver Volkswagen Lavida along Xingang Road and then turning onto Songhui West Road, he reached Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory on Huatianjing Highway in about 15 minutes. After parking in the factory area, he walked to the company cafeteria. Master Sun Jianguo was sitting in his usual seat drinking soy milk. Yin Hao handed him jasmine tea, took out the macro program printout, and explained in detail the design approach and objectives of the script. Master Sun sketched a diagram on the table, pointed out that the feed rate F value was on the conservative side and that there was a risk of tool interference when entering the R corner, and gave recommendations for better parameters and safe avoidance code. Yin Hao quickly noted the key points in his notebook.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning workshop production and program modifications during work breaks
description: After thanking Master Sun, Yin Hao quickly walked to the workshop and clocked in at the entrance with shift leader Wang Lei. Once inside, he went to CNC machine No. 3 to check the hydraulic, pneumatic and lubrication systems, then started the equipment to warm up. The morning task was a batch of connecting flanges. He skillfully loaded and unloaded workpieces, called up the general program and started production, measuring the first-piece dimensions every half hour to ensure precision. During the break, he went alone to the workshop rest area, opened his laptop and revised the program according to Master Sun's guidance: he adjusted the roughing feed rate from F400 to F480, modified the tool entry/exit path, added a safe Z-axis retract code after the G01 command, and ran the simulation software to confirm the tool path perfectly avoided interference. Before the lunch break, he took a USB drive to Master Sun again and showed him the simulation results. After Master Sun approved, Yin Hao felt reassured.
location: No. 3 machine tool area and rest area, CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and confirm the machine test arrangement with the team leader.
description: After the morning work came to a pause, Yin Hao walked out of the factory gate and went to the snack shop next to the Wangjincun convenience store across the street, where he ordered a bowl of noodles with pickled greens and shredded pork plus a fried egg. Wang Lei, the team leader, came over with his noodles and sat down. Yin Hao mentioned that at 2 p.m. the new program was going to be test-cut on machine No. 3 and invited Team Leader Wang to help review it. Wang Lei readily agreed, saying that the master had said the program was fine and he would take the opportunity to learn. The two chatted about workshop matters while eating.
location: A small eatery next to the Wangjincun convenience store on Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and study in the workshop
description: Back in the workshop, Yin Hao pulled over a folding chair and took a 20-minute nap against the wall. After waking up, he took out his phone to browse the question bank for senior technician certification, did ten multiple-choice questions on CNC system fault diagnosis, and got an acceptable accuracy rate. Later, he chatted with his programming colleague Liu Zhiqiang about the afternoon trial-cutting plan and discussed how to promote it within the team if the test passed.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Preparations before the machine trial
description: At 1 p.m., Yin Hao ended his lunch break early. He first went to the tool room to pick up 10 test blanks, installed new carbide inserts, and then meticulously checked the machine's three-axis return-to-zero accuracy. He inserted a USB flash drive into the control panel, copied the modified macro program to the system directory, and rechecked the tool numbers and coordinate offsets. After confirming everything was correct, he waited for the shift leader to arrive.
location: No. 3 Machine Tool Area, CNC Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Macro program trial run succeeded.
description: At 2 p.m., team leader Wang Lei arrived at the machine tool on time. Yin Hao started the program, and the spindle rotated at high speed. He stared at the coordinates on the display and the cutting status, keeping his hand on the feed hold button just in case. When the first workpiece was finished, the dimensions fully met the requirements. He continued to machine the remaining 9 parts, and the entire process was smooth, with no abnormal vibration or tool collision. After all were completed, Yin Hao calculated that the machining time per piece had been reduced from 150 seconds to 132 seconds, an efficiency improvement of 12%. He excitedly recorded the results in his notebook.
location: No. 3 Machine Tool Area, CNC Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reporting the trial cutting results and communicating with the team
description: After the machine test succeeded, Yin Hao compiled a detailed comparative data report, including old and new code, parameters, per-piece time comparisons, and dimension inspection records. He gave both written and verbal reports to team leader Wang Lei. Wang Lei carefully reviewed them and randomly sampled finished products, confirmed that quality met standards, and patted him on the shoulder with satisfaction, saying, "Xiao Yin, well done! We'll promote it at next week's pre-shift meeting." Yin Hao felt a strong sense of accomplishment. Then he discussed with Liu Zhiqiang how to adapt the script to other part models.
location: CNC workshop office and rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon production and end-of-shift wrap-up
description: Returning to his workstation in a good mood, Yin Hao finished machining all the remaining connecting flange tasks for the day. As he worked, he thought about how to demonstrate the program optimization results at the team meeting. Near the end of the shift, he cleaned the chips from the machine tool, lubricated the guide rails, turned off the air valve and power, filled in the production log, and properly archived the new program.
location: No. 3 Machine Tool Area, CNC Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After work, going to the swimming pool for swimming rehabilitation training.
description: At exactly 17:00, Yin Hao left work on time, changed out of his work clothes into a sports T-shirt and shorts, took his swimming gear, and drove 15 minutes to Songjiang Gymnasium. He parked in the underground garage, swiped his citizen fitness card to enter the swimming pool. After changing, he did shoulder and neck warm-ups, then got into the water and swam 2,000 meters, alternating 500 meters of freestyle with 500 meters of breaststroke. While swimming breaststroke, he deliberately controlled the strength of his leg kicks and felt the range of motion of his right knee in the warm water. He finished in about 35 minutes, with no obvious discomfort in his right knee. While resting at the poolside, he sent a voice message sharing his feelings in the WeChat group “Knee Rehabilitation Mutual Help Group,” and his fellow runners encouraged him one after another.
location: Songjiang Sports Center Swimming Pool, No. 38 Ledu Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Showering at home and a simple dinner
description: After leaving the swimming pool, Yin Hao drove home. After arriving, he took a quick shower and changed into loungewear. He boiled a pot of noodles with the baby bok choy and eggs from the fridge, added a few slices of marinated beef, and enjoyed a simple and satisfying dinner.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Went to Wanda Plaza to pick out a birthday gift for my mother.
description: At 7 PM, Yin Hao drove to Songjiang Wanda Plaza. He entered the 'Lao Feng Xiang' gold store on the first floor and explained that he was choosing a bracelet for his mother as a birthday gift. On the recommendation of the sales clerk, he compared three solid gold bracelets and finally chose one that weighed 37 grams with a simple and elegant design, priced at 2,800 yuan, and paid by credit card. The clerk put the bracelet in an exquisite red gift box and tied it with a gold ribbon. Yin Hao carefully placed it at the bottom of his backpack.
location: Lao Feng Xiang Gold Store, 1st Floor, Songjiang Wanda Plaza, 658 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive home and video call with mother
description: After buying the gifts, Yin Hao drove straight home; the roads were clear. Back home, he made a video call to his mother, Wang Xiuying. She was very happy and asked all sorts of questions. Yin Hao smiled and said, "Mom, the weather in Shanghai has been great these days. Tomorrow is your birthday. I brought you something nice. Guess what it is?" His mother guessed for a long time but couldn't figure it out, and said with feigned annoyance, "You child, always keeping me guessing. Don't waste your money." Yin Hao laughed it off and said he had brought some Shanghai specialty pastries, telling her to wait until tomorrow to come back and taste them. The mother and son chatted about hometown trivialities for half an hour, in a warm atmosphere.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Evening study, rehabilitation training, and leisure activities
description: After hanging up, Yin Hao returned to his room and reviewed the day's work in his notebook: he recorded key macro program optimization parameters, test run data, and Wang Lei's feedback, and wrote an outline for a promotional presentation. Then he spent 15 minutes on his phone doing practice questions from the CNC senior technician question bank, focusing on servo motor alarm code questions, and his accuracy rate rose to 85%. Afterwards, he laid out the yoga mat in the living room and did a second 15-minute resistance band rehabilitation session to strengthen the small muscles around his right knee. After training, he opened his phone and played a ranked match of Honor of Kings to relax.
location: Study and living room at home, Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Since he had to get up early the next day to drive back to his hometown in Rudong, Yin Hao set the alarm for 5:30. He went to the bathroom to wash up, brushed his teeth and washed his face, and checked in the mirror what he needed to bring the next day. Back in the bedroom, he put the backpack with the gold bracelet in a conspicuous spot by the bed. After lying down, he dimmed the lights, went over the route home in his mind, listened to the breeze outside the window, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Woke up, washed up, and prepared for the trip
description: Woken up by my biological clock as it was just getting light. After a quick wash-up, I put on a dark gray hoodie and black sweatpants. I carefully inspected my backpack: confirmed the red gift box containing the gold bracelet was intact and wrapped it in a soft cloth; packed a change of clothes, a toiletry bag, and a 1.5L bottle of water. I went downstairs to the residential complex's ground parking lot, walked around my silver-gray Volkswagen Lavida, kicked the tires, and confirmed the car was in good condition, ready for a long drive.
location: Room 402, No. 4, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove back to his hometown in Rudong, Nantong
description: Starting from Xingang Community, he headed east along Xingang Road, took Chenta Road onto the G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway, and then switched to the G15 Shenyang-Haikou Expressway heading north. He maintained a cruise speed of 100–110 km/h while listening to the morning news on the car radio. At about 7:30, he pulled into the Shaxi Service Area in Taicang, filled the tank with 92-octane gasoline, went to the restroom, and stretched his neck and shoulders for a 10-minute rest. Continuing on, after entering Nantong, familiar fields and villages flashed by outside the window. At about 10:05, he called his mother, Wang Xiuying, to say he was almost there, and learned that his father and brother had bought his favorite sea bass. After hanging up, a smile lingered on his face, and he continued toward Juegang Town.
location: From Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, via G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway and G15 Shenyang-Haikou Expressway, to Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province, with a stop at Taicang Shaxi Service Area (Taicang City, Suzhou City, Jiangsu Province).

name: Arrived in his hometown and reunited with his family.
description: Parked the car in the open area in front of the yard. Father Yin Jianguo (52, dark blue work clothes) and older brother Yin Tao (28, black jacket) came out to greet him. His father patted his shoulder and said, "A bit thinner, but looking spirited," and his brother helped carry his backpack. Mother Wang Xiuying (50, wearing an apron) walked out of the kitchen drying her hands, and Yin Hao stepped forward to hug her. The family sat around the light green fabric sofa in the living room drinking tea and chatting about their lives and work over the past month.
location: No. 58, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (self-built two-story house in the hometown).

name: Walked to Ruyi Restaurant
description: The family got up and headed to the reserved restaurant. His mother locked the courtyard gate. His father and older brother walked ahead, talking about the newly built concrete road in the village, while Yin Hao and his mother walked side by side behind. She asked him how he had been eating in Shanghai. As they passed a fruit stall, Yin Hao bought a bunch of bananas his mother liked.
location: Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province: walk from No. 58 Renmin Road along Qingyuan Road to Ruyi Restaurant (No. 88 Qingyuan Road).

name: 2025-04-05 18:20:00 to 2025-04-05 19:20:00
description: In the Ruyi Xuan private room on the second floor of Ruyi Restaurant, the large round table was filled with Nantong specialties, including braised Langshan chicken, steamed knife fish, white-braised hui fish, and clam cakes, with a two-tier cake bearing the word 'longevity' in the center. Yin Hao took out the gold bangle gift box, stood up, walked over to his mother, and said, 'This is a token of appreciation from my brother and me. May your fortune be as boundless as the Eastern Sea, and happy birthday!' He opened the lid to reveal the pure gold bangle. His mother was stunned, her eyes slightly red. Encouraged by everyone, Yin Hao clumsily and solemnly put the bangle on her. She held his hand tightly. During the meal, Yin Hao drank a little local Shuiminglou baijiu with his father and his maternal uncle Chen Zhigang, and chatted with his cousin Chen Xiaowen about her children's schooling. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: The Ruyi Xuan private room on the second floor of Ruyi Restaurant, No. 88 Qingyuan Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: After the birthday banquet, returned home to rest and chat.
description: After the banquet, the family of four walked home. Mother packed up the pastries and fruit given by relatives and invited everyone to have some snacks. Father pulled Yin Hao to sit under the pomegranate tree in the yard and pointed at the newly planted roses, saying Mother liked them. Yin Hao looked at the loquat tree in the corner and the fallen leaves, feeling calm. His brother leaned against the kitchen doorframe using his phone to handle work messages, occasionally chipping in.
location: Old family courtyard and living room, No. 58 Renmin Road, Jugang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Helped family prepare dinner
description: Yin Hao put on his mother's floral apron and went into the kitchen to help pick celery, peel garlic cloves, and wash the sea bass, assisting his mother by handing her seasoning plates as she cooked. His father set up a charcoal brazier in the yard and skewered beef and chicken wings for barbecue, while his brother brought out cold beer and drinks. The kitchen and yard were filled with the aroma of home-style cooking and the smoky smell of charcoal. The family chatted about daily life while working, and laughter kept ringing out.
location: Kitchen and courtyard of the family home at 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: The family sat around the square table. His mother served braised sea bass, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and pork rib and radish soup; his father's grilled beef skewers were arranged on a large plate. Yin Hao reported to his father his small achievement of optimizing macro programs at the factory to improve efficiency, and his father nodded in approval. They drank beer with the meal, enjoying a simple yet precious family reunion.
location: Old family main hall, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Cleared the table and transferred the birthday banquet cost to my brother
description: After dinner, Yin Hao and his brother cleared the dishes and took them to the kitchen to wash. Yin Tao washed the dishes, while Yin Hao wiped the stove, wrapped the leftovers in plastic wrap, and put them in the fridge. Taking advantage of his brother drying his hands, Yin Hao opened WeChat, found the chat with his brother, transferred 1,500 yuan and wrote, "Brother, here's my share of the AA for the birthday banquet and cake. Accept it, thanks for your hard work." Yin Tao patted Yin Hao on the shoulder and said, "Okay, we brothers know what's what." Then he quickly accepted the payment.
location: Kitchen and main hall of the hometown home, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Watching TV with parents and chatting about family matters
description: After cleaning up, Yin Hao poured a cup of hot tea, sat down on the living room sofa, and watched a news program on Jiangsu Satellite TV with his parents. His mother kept raising her wrist to look at her new bracelet, her face full of smiles, and again brought up his marriage prospects. Yin Hao smiled and gave a vague response, saying he wanted to pass the certification he was working on first. His father reminded him not to get distracted while driving and to stay safe at work. Yin Hao agreed while peeling an orange and handing it to his mother.
location: Hometown living room, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province.

name: Late-night heart-to-heart talk with his older brother.
description: His parents were watching TV on the first floor. Yin Hao and his older brother went upstairs to Yin Hao's old room. The room was now used as a guest room, with yellowed high school sports meet certificates and a Yao Ming poster still on the wall. The two sat side by side on the edge of the bed, talking late into the night under the small desk lamp. Yin Tao talked about the new car loan of more than 3,000 yuan a month and the pressure of supporting his family. Yin Hao frankly shared his anxiety when he had to stop running due to his right knee injury, his regret over spending money on game recharges, his determination to keep learning programming and prepare for the junior college entrance exam, and the occasional loneliness he felt while waiting at red lights alone in Shanghai. Yin Tao patted him on the shoulder and said, "If you can't hold on out there, come home and rest. Home is always here. But I know you, kid — you've got this." Yin Hao's nose tingled, and the tension he had been holding for so long finally loosened.
location: Yin Hao's room on the second floor of his hometown home, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Applied for a credit card installment plan and washed up.
description: After the late-night talk ended, Yin Tao went back to his own room. Yin Hao sat on the edge of the bed, opened the China Merchants Bank app to check his credit card statement, and confirmed the 2800 yuan purchase had been posted. He tapped 'Apply for Installments,' chose 6 installments, about 476.67 yuan per installment (including fees), and submitted after checking. Then he went to the bathroom to wash up. Looking at his slightly flushed face in the mirror, he felt a rare sense of ease.
location: Second-floor room and bathroom at the old family home, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province.

name: Pre-bedtime activities.
description: Lying in bed, I checked WeChat Sports and saw about 12,800 steps. I opened the 'CNC Programming Study and Exchange Group', bookmarked a turn-mill composite programming case to study after returning to Shanghai, and liked a discussion about equipment maintenance in the group. Outside the window came the sound of dogs barking and loquat trees rustling in the wind—peaceful and reassuring.
location: Room on the second floor of the old family home, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Falling asleep
description: Turned off the desk lamp, and the room fell into darkness. Turning over, images flashed through his mind of the day's bustle, his mother's smiling face wearing the bracelet, and his brother's words. The pressure of the future was still there, but wrapped in family affection, he felt full of courage and strength. In the quiet night of his hometown, he gradually fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Room on the second floor of the old family home, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Morning ride and recovery declaration.
description: The phone alarm went off right on time. Yin Hao moved his right knee in bed, feeling it flexible with no abnormal sounds. He changed into sports clothes, washed up briefly, drank a glass of warm water, wheeled his mountain bike out of the front yard, and rode about 12 kilometers along the rural cement road. His right knee felt no discomfort throughout the ride. On the way, he stopped by the field ridge to take photos and sent the text to the “Ride Together Joyfully” recovery group, announcing that the running suspension period was over and he looked forward to returning to the track after a follow-up examination.
location: No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province, China, and the surrounding rural roads

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: After returning from cycling, he took a shower. His mother had already prepared breakfast: white rice porridge, scallion pancakes, pickled dried radish, and crab roe buns. She kept putting food on his plate and urging him to eat more. Yin Hao chatted with his parents about the return route and reminded them to take care of their health.
location: Old home dining room, No. 58 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province, China

name: Saying goodbye to parents and loading the car.
description: After breakfast, his mother brought a canvas bag full of hometown specialties, and Yin Hao carefully put it in the trunk. At the entrance to the courtyard, he waved goodbye to his parents and reminded his father to take his blood pressure pills on time and his mother to be careful with the air conditioning.
location: In front of the gate of No. 58, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province, China.

name: Driving back to Shanghai
description: Yin Hao drove from his hometown, heading south along the G15 Shenyang-Haikou Expressway. About two and a half hours later, he arrived at Taicang Shaxi Service Area, got out to stretch his legs, bought a bottle of water at the convenience store, and after resting for about 15 minutes, continued on the road. After another hour-plus drive, he arrived at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai at 12:35 PM.
location: From Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu, China to Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, via the Shaxi Service Area in Taicang on the G15 Shenhai Expressway

name: Lunch at home and online rehabilitation socializing
description: Back at his rented apartment, Yin Hao sorted the ingredients brought from his hometown into the refrigerator, cleared out expired food, and simply pan-fried glutinous rice cakes with pickled clams for lunch. After the meal, he sent a WeChat message to his running buddy Chen Jie to book tomorrow's rehabilitation assessment, confirming 10 o'clock at Vitality Fitness Center (No. 1, Lane 258, Wencheng Road, Songjiang District). Then he posted a long post about his three-week recovery experience in the rehabilitation group, thanked the group members, and interacted with Zhang Xin, Liu Jun, and others. Zhang Xin suggested a run next week.
location: Home, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Household tidying and cleaning
description: Yin Hao started cleaning up. He took off the sheets and duvet cover and put them in the washing machine, carefully wiped down the bedroom desk and kitchen counter, cleaned out the tool bag he would use for work the following week, and checked the machining drawings and documents.
location: Home, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Study review and physical relaxation
description: Yin Hao opened his laptop, logged into the Python online course platform, reviewed notes on file operations and string processing, previewed the overview of functions and modular programming, and prepared for next week's study. Then he unrolled his yoga mat and used a foam roller for 15 minutes of relaxation, focusing on the fascia around his right knee and his hamstrings.
location: Home, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Strolling in the park and relaxing
description: Seeing that the weather was nice, Yin Hao walked to Xiaokunshan Health Park near the residential area and took two slow laps around the park to enjoy the spring atmosphere. He sat on a bench and watched some popular-science videos about CNC machining, and sent a WeChat message to his comrade-in-arms Zhang Jianguo, suggesting they get together sometime next week.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China (40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road)

name: Homemade hometown-style dinner
description: After returning home from the park, Yin Hao started preparing dinner. He stir-fried the baby bok choy brought from his hometown, cooked a pot of clam soup with ginger slices, and steamed the glutinous rice cakes. A simple dinner full of hometown flavor was served.
location: Home, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Evening professional reading
description: After dinner, Yin Hao sat on the sofa, opened WeChat Reading, and studied the chapter on macro program applications for complex surface machining in "CNC Machine Tool Programming and Operation," visualizing the process in his mind as he read.
location: Home, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Video call with girlfriend
description: Yin Hao received a video call request from his girlfriend Lin Yue and happily shared what he had seen and heard on his hometown visit, how moved his mother was to receive the bracelet, and the good news of his knee recovery. Lin Yue encouraged him to gradually resume running, and they agreed to meet next month.
location: Home, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Relaxing with running friends by playing games
description: After hanging up the video call, Yin Hao opened the game and teamed up with online running buddy Zhang Xin for two ranked matches. They won in a row with tacit cooperation, joked with each other over voice chat, and felt happy.
location: Home, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Evening tidying up and going to sleep.
description: Yin Hao turned off the game, took a hot shower, and changed into loungewear. He placed his work clothes and safety shoes for tomorrow at the head of the bed and put the resistance band and water for his rehabilitation follow-up into his sports bag. Then he lay in bed, shared the field photos he had taken during the day on Moments with an encouraging caption. Finally, he set Do Not Disturb mode, turned off the light, and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: At 6:45 a.m., the phone alarm went off. Today is Monday, a workday and also the day of the rehabilitation assessment, so per the doctor's advice I did not go for a morning run. After getting up, I weighed myself; the electronic scale showed 71.3 kg. Then I washed up briefly, changed into loungewear, took out the glutinous rice cakes my mother gave yesterday from the fridge, heated two pieces in the microwave, and had them with a glass of hot milk for breakfast. With the morning rehabilitation assessment on my mind, I felt both nervous and expectant. After the meal, I packed the gym gear needed for the fitness center—athletic shorts, a quick-dry T-shirt, towel, and water bottle—into my backpack and checked to make sure nothing was missing.
location: Room 504, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute to company
description: Left at 7:15, went downstairs and started the silver-gray Volkswagen Lavida. The weather was sunny with occasional clouds and the temperature was comfortable. Drove along Xingang Road and onto Huatianjing Highway for about 15 minutes. On the way, connected the phone via Bluetooth and sent a voice message to girlfriend Lin Yue: “Morning, I have a rehabilitation assessment this morning, hope I can pass. I'll work with peace of mind in the afternoon.”
location: On the drive from Xingang Road to Huatingjing Highway in Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reporting for duty, requesting leave, and preparing before starting work
description: Arrived at the factory at 7:40, parked the car, changed into work clothes, and headed to the workshop. Seeing shift leader Wang Lei starting up a computer, he went over to ask for leave: 'Team leader, I'd like to take half a day off this morning. I have an appointment at ten at Vitality Fitness Center for a rehab assessment. Is that okay?' Wang Lei readily approved. He then said hello to Master Sun Jianguo, who was debugging equipment, and explained he would be going for the assessment in the morning. Master Sun told him to come back as soon as the assessment was done, because there was a job in the afternoon whose parameters he wasn't sure about and needed his help. After agreeing, he returned to his workstation, performed the daily machine inspection on the CNC machine, checking the coolant, lubricating oil level, and spindle running sound, and confirmed everything was normal.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Heading to Vitality Fitness Center
description: Left the company at exactly 9 o'clock and drove to Vitality Fitness Center in Songjiang Old Town. Navigation showed the destination was near Wuyue Life Plaza (Feihang Store). Taking Huatianjing Highway, then turning onto Songhui Middle Road and then into Yushu Road, the traffic was normal and the trip took about 23 minutes.
location: During the drive from Huatianjing Highway to Yushu Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Rehabilitation evaluation
description: At 9:25 he parked the car, walked into Wuyue Life Plaza, took the elevator to B1, where Coach Chen Jie was already waiting at the front desk of Vitality Fitness Center. Before the assessment, he did some simple joint warm-ups. The formal assessment proceeded as follows: first, he was asked how he felt after yesterday's 12 km bike ride and the condition of his knees in the morning; next, a mobility test was conducted—lying on his back, flexing, extending, and rotating his right leg to check range of motion and any pain; then a stability check was performed, using a resistance band to apply lateral pressure to test the side stability of the knee joint; afterward, a manual strength assessment was done, with resisted knee flexion and extension to test the strength balance of the hamstrings and quadriceps; finally, a single-leg squat test was performed—he completed 8 reps holding the wall, with the right knee stable throughout and no wobbling. After the assessment, Coach Chen Jie smiled and said, 'You've recovered well. Starting this week, you can gradually resume jogging. But in the first week, don't run more than 3 kilometers per session, keep the pace around 8 minutes per kilometer, make sure to warm up and stretch sufficiently, and don't stop strength training.' He felt relieved and noted all the advice in his phone's memo.
location: B1, Vitality Fitness Center, Wuyue Life Plaza (Shanghai Feihang Store), No. 2559 Yushu Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and sharing the good news
description: After the assessment ended, he felt relaxed. He left the fitness center at 10:55 and walked to the 'Authentic Lanzhou Beef Noodle Restaurant', about 25 minutes away. The sun was just right on the way. As he walked, he sent messages via WeChat to his parents and his girlfriend Lin Yue: 'The assessment is passed! I can start jogging now!' His parents quickly replied, 'Good, just don't overdo it.' Lin Yue sent a confetti emoji. After arriving at the restaurant, he ordered a bowl of beef pulled noodles with extra meat and a side dish. Eating the hot noodles, he felt much better.
location: Authentic Lanzhou Beef Noodle Restaurant, B-1B-2, 1st Floor, Building 9, No. 19 Yuxiu Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Return to the company
description: At 11:40, finished the noodles, left the noodle shop, and walked back to the Wuyue Life Plaza parking lot to pick up the car. At 11:50, drove back to the company, feeling relaxed and humming along to the radio on the way.
location: From Yuxiu Road to the Yushu Road parking lot in Songjiang District, Shanghai, then along Songhui Middle Road and Huatianjing Road on the way back to the company.

name: Afternoon work and sharing good news about recovery.
description: He returned to the workshop at 12:10 and, after changing into his work clothes, was full of energy. The afternoon task was to machine a batch of flange connectors. He operated the CNC machine with full concentration, performing tool setting and alignment, monitoring the cutting process, and checking workpiece accuracy with a vernier caliper every hour to ensure the error was within 0.02 mm. During the break at 2 pm, he strolled over to his mentor Sun Jianguo and shared the good news of passing the morning assessment. Master Sun patted him on the shoulder and said, 'Great! You've finally made it through. But take it easy—don't think about ramping up the intensity as soon as you're back and forget why you stopped running that day.' He nodded in agreement and also discussed the parameter approach for Master Sun's task. Shift leader Wang Lei passed by and heard, and teased, 'Aren't you going to run ten kilometers tonight to celebrate?' He smiled and replied, 'No way. I have to listen to the coach. An easy three kilometers first.'
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Leaving work and buying ingredients
description: Clocked out on time at 17:00. After starting the car, instead of going straight home, I made a detour to the Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket. Considering there was still some glutinous rice cake from my mother yesterday, but eating it too often isn't good, I decided to make a nutritious meal to reward myself. So I bought some greens, a piece of soft tofu, and a live bass, and had the vendor clean the fish. The total cost was less than 30 yuan.
location: From No. 360 Huatiangjing Highway to Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing and having dinner
description: Arrived home at 17:30, changed into loungewear, and started making dinner. First he rinsed the sea bass inside and out, made a few diagonal cuts on the fish, rubbed it with salt and cooking wine, and let it marinate. Then he cut the tofu into pieces and washed the greens. He boiled water in a steamer, and when it came to a boil, steamed the fish over high heat for 8 minutes. While the fish was steaming, he started another pot of water for seaweed and egg drop soup. After the fish was done, he sprinkled it with shredded scallion and ginger, drizzled hot oil and steamed fish soy sauce over it, and finished the steamed sea bass. Dinner was ready at 18:10. He ate rice while watching Bilibili, viewing an explanation video about the RTCP principle of multi-axis CNC machine tools, and felt his understanding of the machining process deepen.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Room 504, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Make a running recovery plan for April
description: After putting away the dishes, I sat at the desk at 6:40 p.m. and opened my laptop. I created a new Excel spreadsheet and, based on Chen Jie's advice and how my body felt, made a detailed April running recovery training plan. The plan was divided into four phases with a weekly cycle: jogging on Mondays and Wednesdays (3 km per session in the first week at a pace of 8 minutes/km, then adding 0.5 km to the weekly mileage each week); LSD jogging on Saturdays (4-5 km); core strength and resistance band rehabilitation training at home on Tuesdays and Thursdays (30 minutes); Friday and Sunday were full rest days. I also set a jogging reminder for 6 p.m. every Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday in the phone calendar. After finishing the plan, looking at the clear table, I felt everything was starting to fall into order.
location: Home study, Room 504, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Video call with family and chat with girlfriend
description: At 7:40 p.m., he remembered he hadn't video-called home yet, so he called and his mother answered. She was very happy to hear that he passed the assessment and repeatedly told him to be careful not to have trouble with his chondritis again. They talked for 10 minutes and hung up. Then he saw a WeChat message from his girlfriend Lin Yue asking how things went, so he called her for a voice call and briefly told her about the assessment and his running plan for the evening. Lin Yue was happy for him too, and said she would treat him to a nice meal to celebrate next time they met. They chatted for more than ten minutes and hung up.
location: Home study and living room, Room 504, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Home rehabilitation training
description: At 20:20, he changed into athletic shorts, took out a resistance band and a yoga mat, and did 20 minutes of home rehabilitation exercises according to Coach Chen Jie's guidance. The routine consisted of resistance band clamshells (3 sets of 15 reps on each side), supine glute bridges (3 sets of 15 reps), single-leg quadriceps stretches (3 sets of 30 seconds per side), and using a foam roller to relax the front and outer thighs. He completed the whole session with focus and could feel the soreness in his muscles.
location: Living room at home, Room 504, Building 2, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and evening reading
description: At 20:40 he finished the workout and went to take a hot shower. After changing into pajamas, he picked up the book "CNC Machine Tool Programming and Operation" from the bedside table and turned to the complex surface macro program chapter he had been reading yesterday. Tonight's reading was about the algorithm logic of non-circular curve fitting; although it was brain-burning, he found it interesting. After reading for about 40 minutes, feeling that he had mostly digested the knowledge points, he closed the book.
location: Bathroom and bedroom of home, Room 504, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep wrap-up and rest
description: At 21:20, he turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside lamp, and lay in bed to review the day: the assessment was passed, work went normally, and the plan was ready. He felt fulfilled and calm. He used his phone to check tomorrow's weather, planning to go for a short 3-kilometer run in the morning to test the waters. He set the alarm for 5:50, put his phone on the nightstand, and turned off the light at exactly 22:00. He closed his eyes and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Room 504, Building 2, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: After the alarm went off, Yin Hao woke from sleep and deliberately moved his right knee to confirm there was no stiffness. After using the bathroom, he weighed himself at 71.2 kg and recorded it. While washing up, he moved his knee in front of the mirror, feeling more confident about the recovery run plan. Then he boiled eggs with an electric cooking pot, made oatmeal, and browsed today's workshop processing order to understand the finishing task and tolerance requirements for the flange coupling parts.
location: Room 502, Building 2, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting and 'ear training' for knowledge
description: Yin Hao put on his work clothes, went downstairs, started his second-hand Volkswagen Polo, and drove to the factory. On the way, he played the audiobook "CNC Machine Tool Programming and Operation" through the car's Bluetooth, learning about "the application of macro programs in elliptical contour machining," and thought along with his own machining approach.
location: From Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road.

name: Start-of-work preparations and morning meeting.
description: Yin Hao arrived at the factory at 7:30, changed into work clothes, and put on a safety helmet and goggles. After entering the workshop, he inspected the CK6150 CNC lathe, checked the coolant and lubricating oil, and ran it idle to confirm it was normal. He went to the tool room to pick up inserts and threading blades. At 8:00, at the morning meeting, team leader Wang Lei emphasized the urgency and quality requirements of the flange order, and Yin Hao took careful notes.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning focused operations
description: After the morning meeting, Yin Hao started debugging the machining program, adjusting the feed rate and spindle speed based on parametric programming ideas. After starting the machine, he focused entirely on monitoring the cutting process and the panel coordinates. At 9:45 he completed the first piece and checked it with a vernier caliper and an outside micrometer, all within tolerance. Around 10 o'clock, Master Sun Jianguo inspected the workpiece dimensions and surface finish, gave him affirmation and encouragement, and Yin Hao was full of drive.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and relaxation
description: The morning tasks were finished early, and Yin Hao drove 5 minutes to Sun Island Ancient Village Farmhouse Restaurant. He ordered braised beef noodles with a fried egg and, sitting by the window, checked the weather while eating (cloudy turning overcast, 13–19°C). After the meal, he took a 10-minute stroll along the tree-lined path beside the restaurant to aid digestion, and sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend Lin Yue sharing the good condition of his knee and his training plan.
location: Sun Island Ancient Village Farm Stay, beside the East Gate of Sun Island Tourist Resort, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Efficient afternoon homework and study
description: In the afternoon, he continued machining flanges. Yin Hao stayed focused and did a self-inspection every few parts. At 15:00, programmer Master Liu Zhiqiang came over to discuss the programming approach for the next batch of special-shaped threaded parts, introducing the G32 threading compound command and macro programs to implement thread start point offset compensation. Yin Hao took careful notes and agreed to discuss using scripts to help calculate trigonometric function parameters after he finished learning Python in the evening. At 17:00 he stopped work, cleaned the chips, wiped the guides, added lubricating oil, arranged the workpieces neatly, and wrapped up the day.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-work commute, meal prep, and pre-training preparation
description: Got off work at 17:00. Yin Hao drove out of the factory and bought tomatoes, scallions, and tender tofu at the Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket near the community gate. After returning home, changed into sportswear and cut up the chicken breast marinated last night and whole-wheat bread. Then laid out the yoga mat in the living room, drank water and ate a slice of bread to prevent hypoglycemia, put on the heart-rate watch, turned on the computer, logged into the Tencent Meeting for the Python online course, and prepared notes.
location: No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (factory) to Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, then to Room 502, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road

name: Core strength training and relaxation.
description: Training started at 18:10. Completed 4 sets of planks (50 seconds each), 4 sets of supine leg raises (15 reps each), 4 sets of single-leg glute bridges on each side (12 reps each, with an extra 3-second peak contraction on the right leg), and 3 sets of side planks on each side (30 seconds each). He focused on core engagement throughout and monitored his right knee for any discomfort. After training, he used a foam roller to relax the front and back of his thighs and calves, giving special attention to the muscles around his right knee for about 8 minutes. Then he washed his face, put on his glasses, and moved his computer to the desk to get ready for class.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 2, Xingang Residential Compound, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Python learning and hands-on practice
description: At 19:00, he attended Liu Jianjun's Python online class, learning about classes and objects in object-oriented programming and understanding encapsulation through the analogy of a machine tool. Yin Hao followed along and wrote code in PyCharm, encapsulating the flange machining parameters into a class. After class, while the iron was hot, he rebuilt the machine tool class framework and encapsulated the G32 thread compound cycle command and macro program logic mentioned by Liu Zhiqiang in the afternoon into a subclass called Thread Machining Assistant. It ran successfully and output the preset commands, giving him a sense of accomplishment from combining theory and practice.
location: Study room, Room 502, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening relaxation, washing up, and bedtime preparation
description: After studying, Yin Hao took a hot shower to relieve fatigue. Lying in bed, he reviewed the day: his core training and right knee were in good condition, and he had basically mastered Python class concepts. He sent his parents a message confirming he was safe, then scrolled through Bilibili to watch and interact with short videos on CNC macro program machining. At 22:30, he set the alarm for 5:40 the next day and checked the Wednesday morning run plan and the recorded-course link. Ten minutes later, his breathing was steady and he fell asleep peacefully.
location: Room 502, Building 2, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning core rehabilitation training
description: The alarm went off at 6:30, and he got up decisively. The rain had stopped, and the road was wet. He spread a yoga mat on the floor and focused on completing a 15-minute resistance band rehabilitation routine, including ankle pumps, straight-leg raises, and side shuffles. Then he did two sets of planks and one set of glute bridges to activate his core muscles, preparing for the afternoon recovery run.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast, changing clothes, and getting ready to go out
description: After showering, changed into dark gray work clothes. Breakfast was frozen soup dumplings and fresh milk, heated in the microwave. While eating, watched a video on Bilibili about repairing machine tools, and reviewed the loop logic from last night's Python course. After eating, packed running shoes and a cold spray can into the commuter bag, checked the work badge and earphones, and got ready to leave for work.
location: Living room and bathroom at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to work
description: He drove from Xingang Community to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. On the way, he listened to the audiobook CNC Programming and Operation, focusing on the application of macro programs in machining special-shaped threads, while also looking forward to the recovery run after getting off work in the afternoon.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road

name: Pre-work preparations
description: Arrived at the factory and clocked in at 7:45. First went to the tool room to return the dial bore gauge borrowed the day before and pick up a new T-slot cutter. Returning to his CNC lathe, he performed routine checks: spindle warm-up, coolant pressure, and lubrication status. Everything was normal, and he was ready to start work.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning work: flange finish machining and programming communication.
description: I attended the morning meeting at 8. Team leader Wang Lei emphasized the precision requirements for the flange order. After the meeting, I operated the machine with full focus and carefully adjusted the feed rate. During the 10:30 break, my colleague Liu Zhiqiang came over and drew on the whiteboard to discuss a G32 variable approach for programming irregular-shaped parts. I thought the idea was creative and suggested he run a simulation test first. At 11:25, the first flange passed inspection, which made me feel much more confident.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Went to the Wangjincun Convenience Store at the factory gate to buy a teriyaki chicken thigh fillet bento and oolong tea, then returned to the car to eat. While eating, he replied to his mother's message on his phone, 'I've eaten, don't worry,' and checked the discussion on stretching exercises in the rehabilitation group. After the meal, he leaned back in the seat and rested with his eyes closed for 20 minutes, setting an alarm for 12:25.
location: At Wangjincun Convenience Store, opposite the Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory at No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and inside the car.

name: Afternoon work: complete the flange task and prepare for study
description: In the afternoon, continued machining flanges; everything went smoothly. At 15:00, team leader Wang Lei said Liu Zhiqiang's programming plan was feasible and planned to try it that night, asking me to keep an eye on it. So I focused even more on finishing the work on hand to ensure leaving on time. At 16:30, all flanges were machined. I filled in the work hour sheet, cleaned the workstation, removed the chips, and turned off the power.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparations before leaving work
description: He changed out of his work clothes, put on his backpack, and filled his thermos with water. He planned his route in advance: first go to Songjiang Sports Center for a run, then go to the supermarket to buy groceries. His heart was full of anticipation for his first recovery run.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

description: Drove to Songjiang Sports Center, arrived at the parking lot at 17:12, and changed into running shoes. The track was slightly wet but had little resistance. Strictly following the plan, I completed a 3 km jog at a pace of 7 minutes 45 seconds per kilometer. My right knee had no pain throughout, only normal muscle soreness. After running, I did 15 minutes of stretching and sprayed cold spray on my right knee. I sent a screenshot of the running data to the rehabilitation group and received likes from group members and a reply from the coach saying 'Well done!' I felt very excited.

Wang Lei proposed celebrating, so I took the opportunity to suggest calling Liu Zhiqiang and going to Haoledi to sing that evening. Wang Lei readily agreed, said he would notify Liu Zhiqiang, and meanwhile booked a mini private room at Songjiang Haoledi on Meituan for 19:30-22:00.

name: Go home to rest and have dinner.

While eating, confirmed the meeting time with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang on WeChat, and they decided to meet directly at the KTV.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Transition and preparation
description: After dinner, washed the dishes, changed into a clean black T-shirt and jeans, and checked his wallet, keys, and phone. He sat on the sofa browsing technical posts about tool parameter optimization, feeling relaxed and happy.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

description: After walking about 10 minutes, they arrived at Haoledi KTV's Songjiang branch. Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang were already there, and the three teased each other when they met. They booked a mini private room and ordered two dozen beers, a fruit platter, and fried chicken nuggets. First, Yin Hao sang 'Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies' solo to vent the pressure of the past three weeks; then he sang 'Really Love You' as a duet with Wang Lei, and Liu Zhiqiang sang several Jay Chou songs. During the break, they clinked glasses to celebrate recovery and chatted about fun events at the factory and new programming ideas. At 22:00 the server reminded them that time was up. The three sang 'Friends' together as a finale and split the bill, each paying 92 yuan.
location: Haoledi KTV (Songjiang Branch), No. 241, Lane 12, Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returning home and evening wrap-up
description: Walked home with a slight buzz and a cheerful mood. The evening breeze was pleasant. After getting home, he first sent a WeChat message to his parents to report that he was safe, telling them that he had started running that day and his knees were fine. He also replied to a voice message from his girlfriend, Lin Yue. After washing up, he briefly recorded the day's data in his phone notes: a 3-kilometer run at a pace of 7'45", and the key points of Liu Zhiqiang's programming ideas.
location: On the way from Haoledi KTV (Songjiang Branch), Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, and at home

name: Relaxing before bed
description: Lying in bed, he felt only a slight warmth in his right knee, well within the acceptable range. He set the alarm for 6 a.m. the next morning. Reflecting on the full and smooth day, he felt grounded and relaxed, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: After a fulfilling and pleasant day, I fell into a deep sleep with a sense of satisfaction.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wake-up, weighing, and rehabilitation training
description: My biological clock woke me up a few minutes earlier than the alarm, and I was awake exactly at 6:30. After getting out of bed, I weighed myself first: 71.5 kg, 0.3 kg heavier than yesterday. I concluded it was caused by the beer and fried chicken I had at KTV last night, and silently noted to control my diet tonight. Then I spread the yoga mat in the living room and used a resistance band and foam roller for 15 minutes of right knee rehabilitation training, focusing on relaxing the muscles around the hip and knee. The feeling of tightness was somewhat relieved.
location: Bedroom and living room at home in Xingang Community, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up, breakfast, and schedule confirmation
description: After washing up, I fried two sunny-side-up eggs, made a glass of milk, and had them with two slices of whole-wheat bread for breakfast. While eating, I checked the day's weather and the factory's work orders on my phone, confirmed the deadline for the flange order, and bookmarked the link for the evening Python online course.
location: The kitchen and bathroom at the home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Car commute and audiobook learning
description: He put on his jacket, took his thermos cup, went downstairs at 7:15, and drove to the factory. There was not much traffic on the road. After connecting to Bluetooth, he continued listening to the audiobook CNC Machine Tool Programming and Operation. Today's chapter covered advanced techniques for macro program calls, and he listened very attentively, silently comparing it with the approach he and Liu Zhiqiang had discussed yesterday.

name: Arrival at the factory, machine tool inspection, and morning meeting

Checked the CNC machine at his workstation, added coolant, and dry-ran last night's roughing program. At 8:00 attended the morning meeting. Team leader Wang Lei stressed the urgency of the flange order and the trial production arrangement for the new special-shaped parts. Yin Hao recorded the key points in his notebook.

description: After the morning meeting, he immediately started machining the flange, skillfully clamping the workpiece, calling up the program, and monitoring the machining process. Around 10 o'clock, he found time to go to the programming room to see Liu Zhiqiang. The two refined the programming plan for the irregular part against the drawings. Yin Hao, based on the audiobook content, suggested variable compensation. Liu Zhiqiang thought it was feasible and decided to test-run the program in the afternoon.
location: Workshop and programming room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and short break.
description: He drove alone to the Sun Island Ancient Village farmhouse restaurant he often went to, deliberately keeping calories in check, and ordered stir-fried shredded pork with celery, tomato and egg soup, and a bowl of rice. After the meal, he took a 15-minute walk on the ridge behind the farmhouse, then took out his phone and sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend Lin Yue, saying that he had an online class in the evening and they would talk properly on the weekend.
location: Sun Island Ancient Village Farm Stay, beside the East Gate of Sun Island Tourist Resort, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work: finishing up the flange.
description: Returned to the workshop and continued machining flanges, placing each finished piece on the inspection table for self-checking; all met precision standards. At 17:00, shut down the machine tool on time, cleaned the workstation and metal chips, packed up personal belongings, and clocked out.
location: Workshop and quality inspection area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: After-work commute and fresh food shopping

location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

According to the training plan, he did 40 minutes of core training, including dynamic plank (4 sets of 45 seconds each), supine bent-knee crunches (3 sets of 20 reps each), and side plank (3 sets of 45 seconds per side). location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Relaxation and shower

location: Living room and bathroom at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Simple dinner and preparation for class
description: After washing, he used the freshly bought vegetables and eggs to cook a simple bowl of plain noodles in clear soup as dinner. After finishing, he felt warm in his stomach. At 18:50, Yin Hao was already sitting in the study, opened his laptop, adjusted the camera and microphone, and logged into the online course platform waiting for the class to start.
location: Kitchen and study at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening comprehensive Python practical online course
description: The class started on time at 19:00. Tonight was a comprehensive hands-on class, and the task was to write a part machining program generator. He remained highly focused throughout, followed the instructor's train of thought, and built the code step by step using functions, file reading and writing, and object-oriented knowledge. When he encountered a bug while writing the roughing path calculation logic, he debugged it himself for 5 minutes, then posted a screenshot in the discussion area for help. After a hint from the instructor, he quickly fixed it.
location: Home study at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-class consolidation and script saving.
description: After the course ended, he did not turn off the computer immediately. He spent 20 minutes reviewing tonight's code, organized all the functions and classes clearly, added comments, and finally solemnly named the script "part_maker.py" and saved it, feeling a great sense of accomplishment for being able to write a small tool that automatically generates code.
location: Home study at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Contacted girlfriend and family
description: Leaning back on the sofa, he first made a video call to his girlfriend Lin Yue, excitedly sharing tonight's programming results and sending her a screenshot of the “part_maker.py” run. Lin Yue was happy for him. The two talked about their respective work and life and agreed to video call on the weekend. After hanging up, he sent several voice messages to his parents' family group, asking about their health and letting them know he was safe.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Evening relaxation: playing Honor of Kings
description: With a while to go before bed, he opened Honor of Kings on his phone, saw his childhood friend Zhang Wei and comrade-in-arms Zhang Jianguo online, and teamed up for two ranked matches. He played jungle and set the pace, winning both matches. Everyone chatted over voice while playing, and he felt relaxed.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Reading and falling asleep

location: Study and bedroom at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai
