He then went to the bathroom and weighed himself, which showed 71.6 kg. Back in the bedroom, instead of doing his usual stretching, he first downloaded the "Suishouji" expense-tracking app and completed registration. Then he did 15 minutes of static lower-body stretching in the bedroom, focusing on relaxing the right knee. Next, he went to the kitchen and cooked a bowl of plain noodle soup for breakfast. While eating breakfast, he entered the month's major income and expenses into the app one by one based on payment records and memory, including rent and the cash gift for his mother's birthday banquet. Seeing the total spending chart, he felt guilty.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting by car and learning CNC knowledge

Along the way, he used the car stereo to listen to the chapter on macro program optimization from the audiobook CNC Machine Tool Programming and Operation, making use of the commute to study professional knowledge.
location: From Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road.

At work, he coordinated with his mentor Sun Jianguo and coworkers.

After hanging up, he glanced at the charts in his expense-tracking app and once again sighed that saving money is not easy.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

He enjoyed a simple dinner alone, thinking about how to further control expenses while eating.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Unit 3, Room 501, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

location: Home study, Room 501, Unit 3, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Write CNC script for shaft parts
description: In the study, the user opened a laptop, connected to the virtual machine, and began writing the Python script shaft_macro_gen.py. Drawing on previous experience, they turned the rough turning and finish turning process flows for common stepped shafts into logic. By inputting the blank diameter and the dimensions of each finished section, and using conditional statements and loops, the script generates G-code macro programs, and a machining time estimation module was added. Midway, an error occurred due to the declaration order of variables; it was resolved after consulting Python online course notes.
location: Home study, Room 501, Unit 3, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Script testing and result verification.
description: After the script was completed, the user opened the machine tool simulation software, copied the generated macro program code into it, and simulated machining a shaft with a diameter of 50 mm. The simulation succeeded, and the estimated machining time per part was reduced by about 6% compared with manual programming, bringing a long-lost sense of accomplishment. He happily saved the script and uploaded a backup to the cloud drive.
location: Home study, Room 501, Unit 3, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

Lin Yue didn't understand it well, but she sensed the user's sense of accomplishment and joked, 'Master Yin is going to become a programmer,' which warmed the user's heart.
location: Living room at home: Room 501, Unit 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

location: Living room and bedroom at home, Room 501, Unit 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

Though the bank balance was still a headache, he had taken the first step toward taking control of his finances and consolidated his skills. He told himself, 'One step at a time, things will get better,' and then fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Room 501, Unit 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting up, weighing, and washing up
description: Saturday morning, the alarm went off at exactly 7:28. Yin Hao got up and went to the bathroom first, then stepped on the electronic scale, which showed 71.8 kg, 0.2 kg heavier than yesterday. He decided to watch his diet today and thought the slight weight gain was because he had not done any formal exercise yesterday. After washing his face with cold water, he quickly brushed his teeth and started a new day.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (bedroom, bathroom)

He checked the socket and the leakage protector, both were normal, and confirmed that this second-hand washing machine, which had been used for three years, had completely broken down. Yin Hao called Master Chen Jianguo at the repair shop and described the fault in detail. The repairman said the repair cost was high and the parts were hard to find, and replacing the main board was not worth it, so he suggested buying a new machine directly. Yin Hao reluctantly accepted. After hanging up, he noted down "Buy a washing machine" as a to-do item in his phone memo.

Based on the rental situation and a budget of about 2,300 yuan, compared mainstream brands such as Haier and Little Swan, carefully reading more than 50 user reviews, focusing on noise level, wash ratio, and after-sales service. After nearly an hour and a half of screening, finally selected a Haier 10 kg front-loading washing machine. After confirming the model, warranty policy, and same-day delivery service, paid 2,300 yuan with Alipay. Immediately after payment, opened the Suishouji app to record the expense with the note "emergency replacement".
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (living room)

He first cleared away the clutter and laundry detergent stacked around the old washing machine on the balcony, and swept the dust from the corners with a broom. Then he sorted the dirty clothes accumulated over the past week by color and material, temporarily placing them in a storage basket, planning to wash them next week. During the tidying, he noticed a few mechanical manuals scattered on the sofa that he had brought back from his hometown last weekend, and put them back on the bookshelf.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (balcony, living room)

location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (kitchen, dining room)

He took out his phone, opened a CNC programming forum, and spent half an hour browsing posts about how to optimize machining parameters for shaft parts. He bookmarked a highly upvoted reply that mentioned macro program variable compensation. After that, he leaned back on the sofa and rested with his eyes closed for about 20 minutes to conserve energy for the afternoon activities.

During the test run, the new motor rotated smoothly and made little noise. Yin Hao was very satisfied and signed to confirm receipt. He stood by and watched the whole process, thinking to himself that in the future when he moves, he could also connect this kind of piping himself.

When the alarm went off, he changed into a clean black T-shirt and dark casual pants, put his phone, wallet, and keys into his pockets, checked the accounts in his SuiShouJi app, and went out after confirming there were no errors.

The three ordered boiled fish, spicy chicken, skewers, and a few bottles of iced beer, chatting while eating. Yin Hao complained about the frustrating washing machine repair and his grim financial situation. His friends comforted him, saying money lost wards off disaster, and shared their recent workplace stories. The gathering was relaxed and ended after about 2 hours, with an average cost of 80 yuan per person. Yin Hao immediately recorded the expense in Suishouji.
location: Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, No. 232 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

After changing into clean loungewear, he sat on the living room sofa and turned on the TV, but didn't watch it—just listened to the background sound while browsing the technical articles he had saved on the forum earlier.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (bathroom, living room).

His determination to buy a house within five years grew even stronger.

He reported that he was fine, that the washing machine had been replaced, and that he had had a meal with friends in the afternoon. His parents told him to take care of his health and not be too frugal. He asked whether his mother had felt unwell over the past two days, and also chatted with his father a little about repairing farm machinery. The call lasted about 20 minutes. Feeling his family's care, he felt more at ease.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (living room)

He took out pen and paper and wrote a simple plan for tomorrow (Sunday): do laundry in the morning, review the video recording of the CNC training online course in the afternoon, and have the routine call with his parents in the evening. Then he checked his phone alarm to make sure the 7:30 a.m. wake-up reminder for tomorrow was set. He opened the book 'CNC Machine Tool Programming and Operation' beside his bed and reviewed the key points of the macro program chapter.

name: Sleep

Though he felt helpless about the overspending, the habit of budgeting and planning gave him a sense of control over his life. He took a deep breath and told himself that tomorrow was a new day and he needed to keep working toward his five-year goal of buying a house. Before 23:20, he fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (bedroom)

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The phone alarm went off on time. It was Sunday, so I got up a little later than on workdays. After getting up, I weighed myself first; it showed 71.9kg, similar to yesterday, which I guessed was the effect of last night's barbecue dinner with Wang Lei and others. I pulled open the curtains; the weather was fine and sunny, suitable for a thorough cleaning. Then I went to the bathroom, drank a glass of warm water, washed up briefly, changed into a short-sleeved T-shirt, sports shorts, and running shoes, and got ready for a morning run.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run, then home for a shower and breakfast preparation.
description: Drove to Sijing Sports Center at 351 Sizhuan South Road, Sijing Town, Songjiang District, about a 10-minute drive. The track at the sports center is spacious, and there were few people on the weekend morning. I ran 5 kilometers along the track at a pace of about 5:40 per kilometer. After the run, I sweated a little and felt the stale air accumulated in my lungs was cleared out. I did 10 minutes of stretching in the stretching area. Then I drove back to Xingang Community, took a warm shower, and changed into clean loungewear. Then I scooped out the millet porridge that had been preset in the soymilk maker the night before, and served it with two boiled eggs and a dish of pickled vegetables, preparing a simple and nutritious breakfast.
location: Sijing Sports Hall, 351 Sizhuan South Road, Sijing Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai; and Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road.

name: Breakfast and news browsing
description: Sitting at the dining table in the living room eating breakfast, he scrolled through Bilibili's recommended CNC technology videos on his phone, and also browsed the "Shanghai Songjiang Release" official account to learn local news.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Housework and seasonal deep cleaning
description: After breakfast, I first put the few clothes left in the washing machine from yesterday (a T-shirt and a pair of shorts) into the washer, poured in laundry detergent, and started the quick wash mode. Then I began the spring cleaning and seasonal reorganization: I rolled up the thick quilt and electric blanket from the bedroom and stuffed them into vacuum compression bags, used the vacuum cleaner to suck out the air, then stored them on the top shelf of the wardrobe and swapped in the thin quilt for spring and autumn; folded the heavy coats and down jackets into the suitcase, and hung out the hoodies, jackets, and long-sleeved T-shirts; used the vacuum cleaner to carefully clean under the bed, under the sofa, and in every corner; also cut the Velcro insect-proof mesh bought online and installed it on the screen windows of the bedroom and living room, getting ready for the transition from spring to summer. After the quick wash finished, I took the clean T-shirt and shorts to the balcony to dry, and also took in the dry clothes that had been left out since yesterday, folded them, and put them in the wardrobe. The whole room immediately felt much fresher.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch preparation and dining
description: Because I had expended a lot of energy in the morning, I decided to make a hearty lunch. I took out the greens and eggs bought yesterday from the fridge, cooked a pot of noodles with greens and eggs, and added two slices of ham sausage. The hot noodles were very satisfying.
location: Kitchen and dining table, Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Midday rest and entertainment.
description: After lunch, leaned back on the living room sofa and rested for half an hour. During that time I scrolled through Bilibili, watched a practical video by a CNC machining expert, learned a new thread machining technique, and felt greatly inspired.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Study and material organization
description: He sat down at the desk and entered study mode. First, he organized the Python textbooks, CNC programming materials, and notebooks on the desk, and packed the useful courseware into Baidu Netdisk. Then he took out the notes from last Thursday's online course. For the example of designing the 'Machine Tool' class in 'Object-Oriented Programming', he walked through it again in the local Python environment, tried modifying several parameters, and the program ran correctly, giving him a sense of achievement. Finally, he opened the official website of the National Open University, downloaded the upcoming course schedule and textbook previews, and focused on reading the tables of contents of 'Mechatronics System Design' and 'CNC Technology', gaining a clear plan for future study.
location: At the desk in Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Free time and relaxation
description: After studying for more than two hours, my brain felt tired. I stood up and moved around, went to the balcony to check the clothes drying, patted and tidied them. Then I sat on the sofa and flipped through Chinese National Geography magazine to let my eyes and mind relax.
location: Balcony and living room of Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Contact and video calls with girlfriend Lin Yue
description: He sent his girlfriend Lin Yue a WeChat message asking if she was free for a video call, and she quickly sent back an invitation. During the call, they shared what happened during their week. Hao complained about the cost of the new washing machine and his financial anxiety, and Lin Yue shared a small achievement from her project in Hangzhou and gently comforted him. They agreed to meet in Hangzhou on the weekend after the Qingming Festival, and Lin Yue would take Hao to visit West Lake. The call lasted about 50 minutes, and he felt better after hanging up.
location: On the living room sofa, Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Lin Yue remotely in Hangzhou)

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: Feeling better, he had more motivation to cook. He reheated the leftover noodle soup from noon, found two cucumbers and half a carrot in the fridge, shredded them into a cold salad, and fried two fried eggs. Dinner was simple and refreshing. While eating, he used the Suishouji app on his phone to record the detailed expenses for buying vegetables and eggs that day, and checked the week's spending curve. Although he was over budget overall, logging expenses one by one made him feel less anxious.
location: Kitchen and dining table, Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Financial review and budget planning for next month
description: I put down my phone, took out paper and pen, and carefully sorted out this week's income and expenses. I focused on analyzing the two large expenditures from yesterday: the dinner gathering and the washing machine replacement. Then I began making a detailed budget for April, listing fixed expenses such as rent, utilities, transportation, and food, and planned to force-save 4,000 yuan into Yu'e Bao. On the budget sheet I wrote, 'April goal: strictly follow the budget, do not spend unless necessary!' I felt a stronger sense of control over my finances.
location: At the desk in Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening relaxation and reading
description: After planning the budget, his head was full of numbers and he needed to relax. He walked to the balcony, looked at the quiet night view of the neighborhood outside the window, and turned on the floor lamp to dim the light. After washing up, he leaned back against the headboard, opened the WeChat Reading app, and continued reading the last few chapters of Becoming Steve Jobs. When he reached the chapters about Jobs returning to Apple and launching the iMac and iPod, he was inspired by Jobs's extreme pursuit of product detail. After finishing the book, he sent a WeChat message to his parents, telling them that he had spent the day deep-cleaning the house and studying, and that he was doing well.
location: Balcony and bedside of bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: He put down his phone and did a simple set of stretches on the bed to relax muscles that might have become tense during the big cleaning, especially the lower back and legs. Then he opened the calendar on his phone and briefly planned Monday's work: check the inventory of consumables for the machine tools due for maintenance in the workshop and submit the requisition form in advance, then set the alarm for 5:40 tomorrow morning. After turning off the light, he closed his eyes and reviewed the gains of the day: the room was tidy, the study tasks were done, he had chatted with his girlfriend, and finances were planned. It felt fulfilling. With peace of mind, he soon fell asleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Residential Community, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Woke up, weighed himself, and prepared for the morning run.
description: At 6:30 a.m., the alarm went off right on time. Zhou Qiang got up, stood barefoot on the electronic scale on the bedroom floor, and it showed 72.0 kg. He frowned, noted the number, and resolved to control his weight in April. Then he drank half a glass of warm water, changed into running gear, and got ready to go out for a morning run.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Recovery jogging workout.
description: At 6:40, I left the residential complex and jogged warmly to the track at Songjiang Sports Center, 2 kilometers away. I ran 3 kilometers at a steady pace of 7:40 per kilometer. My right knee felt fine with no pain, but my cardiorespiratory fitness seemed to have declined slightly. After the run, I stretched carefully for 15 minutes in the pull-up bar area beside the track and synced the running record to the exercise notes section of the expense-tracking app.
location: Track at Songjiang Sports Center, No. 2 Jiufeng Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returning home for a shower and breakfast.
description: He jogged back home, quickly took a warm shower, and changed into clean work clothes. Breakfast was millet porridge he had cooked himself, a boiled egg, and some pickled vegetables. He ate quickly and got ready for work.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive to work.
description: At 7:35, he grabbed his commuter bag and car keys and left. Driving the silver sedan along Xingang Road, he turned onto Huatianjing Highway. Traffic was not too congested, and he arrived at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory about 15 minutes later.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning workshop work
description: Arrived at the workshop at 7:50. After changing into work clothes, he first checked the tool wear on the CNC machine and the inventory of important consumables, then went to the material area and filled out a request form for the blade models and drill bit specifications that needed restocking, and asked team leader Wang Lei to sign off, to prevent production gaps. Then he operated the machine to machine a batch of flange parts, focusing on the screen parameters to ensure dimensional accuracy.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Chatted with colleagues during the lunch break
description: When the lunch break bell rang, he washed his hands and went to the cafeteria with his colleagues. The cafeteria served braised pork and stir-fried greens. Carrying his tray, he sat down next to Wang Lei and Master Sun. He brought up the plan to go fishing at Dianshan Lake next weekend. Wang Lei was very interested and they agreed to go if the weather was good. He also told Master Sun that the macro script he had written in Python was working, significantly improving efficiency. Master Sun praised him repeatedly.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon workshop work
description: After lunch, I skipped the midday break and went straight back to the workshop to continue working. The afternoon task was finish-machining a batch of parts, which required more careful tool setting and self-inspection. I worked until around 4 p.m., pausing only to sit at my workstation and drink a few sips of water. Before finishing, I carefully organized the equipment operation logs and shift handover records, made sure the workstation was tidy, and laid a good foundation for tomorrow's colleague.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After work, drive to the supermarket to shop.
description: Punched out at 4:30 PM on time, drove home and on the way stopped by the Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket. In the seafood section, picked a live sea bass, and also bought greens, tofu, scallions, and ginger, planning to cook dinner in the evening.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing dinner and relaxing
description: He carried the groceries home, washed and prepared the ingredients. Steamed sea bass: score the fish, stuff ginger slices into the cuts, drizzle with cooking wine, steam over high heat for 8 minutes, then sprinkle with shredded scallions and pour hot steamed-fish soy sauce over it. While the fish was steaming, he used seaweed and eggs to make a pot of seaweed egg drop soup. Around 5:30 p.m., he set the dishes out on the coffee table, opened Bilibili on his phone, and watched a video about a new five-axis machine tool machining process while eating, thoroughly enjoying it.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Post-meal cleanup and light activity.
description: After the meal, I cleared the table, washed the dishes and utensils, and wiped the stove. I paced back and forth in the living room to stretch my limbs, then opened Taobao, saved a screenshot of the order for the washing machine I bought two days ago for 2,300 yuan, and kept it for bookkeeping.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Financial review and April budget planning.
description: He sat back down at his desk, opened the Suishouji app, and checked the monthly report. In March, total income was about 10,000 yuan, while total expenses were as high as 13,500 yuan, including fixed and unexpected expenses such as rent of 2,500 yuan, a new washing machine for 2,300 yuan, the first installment for a gold bracelet at 476 yuan, and a 1,500 yuan red envelope for a relative's birthday banquet in his hometown. After careful analysis, he circled non-essential expenses such as KTV and dinners with friends, totaling about 600 yuan. Then he created an April budget, setting forced savings at 4,000 yuan, rent at 2,500 yuan, cutting living expenses to 1,500 yuan, and slashing the entertainment budget to 200 yuan. In his phone's memo app, he solemnly wrote the theme for April: "April: Don't spend unless necessary; keep jogging and learning Python; get ready for community college classes."
location: In front of the desk at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video calls with family and sending messages to his girlfriend
description: Made a video call to his family and reported in detail to his parents about the day's work and his plan for a financial review, telling them that he had set a strict budget to reassure them. His mother urged him to take care of his health and not to be too frugal. After hanging up, he switched to WeChat and sent a message to his girlfriend Lin Yue, sharing the route screenshot from his morning 3-kilometer jog and asking whether she had been busy at work recently; they chatted briefly.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Bedtime reading and mood reflection
description: After washing up, changed into pajamas and leaned against the headboard, opened WeChat Reading and continued reading the tool compensation examples in "CNC Machine Tool PMC Programming and Application" and simulated them in my mind several times. After finishing the book, closed the app, opened the phone memo app, and flipped through the records starting from March 16 page by page, recalling the anxiety over the knee injury, the depression under financial pressure, and the relief of getting back into rhythm, sighing at this path of self-discipline.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Xinguang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Deep breathing exercises and falling asleep.
description: Put down his phone, adjusted his sleeping position, did 3 minutes of abdominal deep breathing exercises, felt the flow of breath, and calmed the thoughts of the day. Set the alarm for 6:30 tomorrow morning and silently recited the plan for the next morning: get up and weigh himself, check the weather to decide whether to resume morning running. Then closed his eyes and soon fell asleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Xinguang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning rehabilitation training and weigh-in
description: At 5:40 the alarm went off on time. After getting up, Yin Hao weighed himself (72.0 kg). He spread a yoga mat in the living room and did a 15-minute dedicated rehabilitation routine: first, he used a foam roller to focus on releasing the front of his right thigh and the iliotibial band, relieving the previous day's muscle tension; then he used a resistance band to complete 3 sets of clamshells and standing kickbacks, fully activating the gluteus medius in preparation for the run ahead.
location: Room 207, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Recovery jog to Xiaokunshan Health Park
description: After training, Yin Hao changed into running shoes and went out, jogging along Xingang Road to Xiaokunshan Health Park, about 4 km in total, with pace controlled at around 7 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. During the run, he focused on the feedback from his right knee on landing and pushing off, and his confidence grew after confirming there was no pain. After arriving at the park, he did 5 minutes of quick stretching using the park's fitness equipment.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home, stretch, and have breakfast.
description: After jogging home, Yin Hao did 5 minutes of static stretching, focusing on relaxing his calves and quadriceps. Then he took a shower and changed into his work clothes. He prepared breakfast for himself: a bowl of instant oatmeal, a boiled egg, and half an apple.
location: Room 207, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to work
description: After checking his commuter bag, Yin Hao set off by car at 7:20 sharp for the factory. On the way, he listened to the audiobook CNC Machine Tool Programming and Application over the car's Bluetooth, focusing on the chapter about thread machining to prepare for the work he might encounter today.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning work: machining bearing seats
description: After arriving at the factory, Yin Hao first changed into his work uniform in the locker room, then went to his workstation to check the coolant and lubricant levels and the tool magazine of the CNC machining center. He carefully reviewed the drawings for the parts to be processed today—a batch of stainless steel bearing housings with tight tolerance requirements. At 8:00 he attended the team morning meeting, where team leader Wang Lei emphasized the delivery date and quality of this order. After the meeting, Yin Hao began operating the machine tool, clamping the workpieces, and calling up the pre-programmed routines, focusing on finishing. After machining each piece, he performed spot checks with a vernier caliper and micrometer to ensure the dimensions were within tolerance.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and work exchange
description: When the lunch break bell rang, Yin Hao went to the factory canteen with colleagues Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang. He got a serving of braised pork, a serving of stir-fried greens, and rice. While eating, Liu Zhiqiang brought up the problem of surface finish not meeting requirements during yesterday's trial machining of a new fixture. Based on his own experience, Yin Hao analyzed that it might be caused by blade wear or improper feed rate settings, and suggested they could adjust the parameters together in the afternoon and give it a try.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work: Fixture adjustment and precision machining
description: In the afternoon, as soon as work started, Yin Hao found Liu Zhiqiang, and the two worked together on debugging the new fixture. Yin Hao carefully observed Liu Zhiqiang's trial-cut piece and program, and suggested modifying the finishing allowance and feed rate for the last cut. After the adjustment, they completed a trial cut, and the surface finish improved significantly. Afterward, Yin Hao returned to his own position and continued finishing the bearing housing that had not been completed in the morning. Before getting off work, he neatly arranged the finished parts and filled out the machining routing sheet.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-work commute back home
description: Yin Hao left work on time at 17:00 and drove home. Feeling a bit tired on the way, he slowed down slightly and thought about what groceries to buy for dinner.
location: Room 207, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Buying groceries on the way
description: Near home, Yin Hao parked the car by the roadside and walked into the Xingang New Village fresh food supermarket. He bought beef brisket for soup, a tomato, a bunch of bok choy, and also restocked eggs and a carton of pure milk, spending about 70 yuan in total.
location: Room 106, Unit 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (next to Northwest Gate 1 of Xingang New Village)

name: Dinner preparation and household chores
description: After getting home, he changed out of his work clothes into loose loungewear. He first cut the beef brisket into pieces and blanched them, then put them into the electric pressure cooker with tomatoes, ginger slices, and seasonings, and pressed the soup mode button. While the soup was simmering, he threw the work clothes and socks he had changed out of last night into the washing machine.
location: Room 207, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner
description: After the tomato beef brisket soup was done simmering, Yin Hao ladled out a big bowl, paired it with the half apple left over from the morning, and sat at the dining table eating while browsing the news on his phone. After the meal, he washed the bowls and chopsticks and tidied up the kitchen.
location: Room 207, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Researching half-marathon running shoes
description: Yin Hao sat down at the desk in his study, opened the Dewu and Shihuo apps on his phone, and began seriously studying half-marathon running shoes. He focused on comparing several models, including Xtep 160X 3.0, Li-Ning Feidian Challenger, Bmai 42K Pro Qianneng, and Saucony Kinvara 14. He checked each shoe's midsole technology, rebound rate data, and long runner-test reviews one by one, and recorded the core pros and cons and reference prices in his phone's notes, planning to narrow the selection to 2-3 models before deciding.
location: Room 207, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Online gaming and socializing.
description: After finishing his running shoe research for now, Yin Hao opened Honor of Kings and saw his comrade Zhang Jianguo and childhood friend Zhang Wei online, so he invited them to join a ranked match. The three turned on their mics and chatted while playing. Yin Hao complained about the little annoyances he had encountered at work that day, Zhang Jianguo shared funny stories from his side, and they played several intense but easygoing rounds, which helped him relax a lot.
location: Room 207, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reading and pre-bedtime contact
description: After the game, Yin Hao washed up, changed into his pajamas, and leaned back against the headboard. He took out the magazine Modern Manufacturing and flipped through the article on development trends in CNC cutting tools, reading attentively for about 20 minutes. Before turning off the light, he sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend Lin Yue, briefly telling her that his knee felt good today and that he planned to choose running shoes, and asked her not to worry.
location: Room 207, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: Yin Hao set the alarm for 5:40 tomorrow morning, then confirmed the core training plan for tomorrow morning. He turned off the desk lamp and lay down, ready to sleep.
location: Room 207, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning rehabilitation exercises and household chores
description: The alarm went off on time. First, spread the yoga mat on the living room floor and use the foam roller to carefully release the iliotibial band on the outside of the right leg and the gluteal muscles, rolling each for about 2 minutes. Then complete 3 sets of banded clamshells and side leg raises, 15 reps per set, focusing on hip drive to build stability for the knee. After the workout, throw last night's workout clothes into the washing machine and set the 30-minute quick wash program.
location: Room 603, Unit 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up, breakfast, and commute preparation
description: I took a hot shower to wash off the sweat from the morning workout. While listening to the online course "Python Basics" on loop statements downloaded last night, I quickly ate two boiled eggs I had cooked and a cup of black coffee. I packed the stir-fried pork with green peppers lunchbox prepared last night into an insulated bag, and checked my belongings again: phone, power bank, work gloves, thick notebook, and a newly bought 1.5L bottle of mineral water.
location: Room 603, Unit 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to work
description: Drove out from the underground garage of the residential community. On the way, he stopped briefly at the Laiyifen convenience store at the intersection of Guangfulin Road and Xingang Road, buying a whole wheat sandwich as an afternoon snack and a bottle of 1.5L plain boiled water. He arrived at the factory area around 7:45 and ran into his colleague Wang Lei in the parking lot. They nodded and greeted each other.
location: Songjiang District, Shanghai, from Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, passing the Laiyifen convenience store at the intersection of Guangfulin Road and Xingang Road

name: Pre-shift preparation
description: Changed into work clothes, put on safety goggles and a work cap. First he went to the locker room to fill his water bottle, then walked quickly to his No. 3 CNC machine. He carefully checked the machining records, tool list, and tooling condition left by the night-shift colleague, and confirmed that the machine was in normal condition.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning workshop work
description: Officially started work. Today I mainly machined a batch of valve body parts with an accuracy requirement of 0.02 mm. When machining the first part, I found that the allowance after rough machining was more than expected, so I paused the program first and went to Master Sun's workstation to discuss how to adjust the tool compensation. Master Sun came over and took a look, suggested increasing the compensation value for tool No. 1, and reminded me to pay attention to the coolant spray angle. Afterward, I returned to my post, focused intently on the machine tool's cutting condition, measured the parts at regular intervals, and kept good inspection records.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Chatted with Master Sun during the lunch break
description: He took out the packed lunch he had brought and heated it in the microwave in the break area. Today Master Sun had also brought braised hairtail, so the two sat together and ate. While eating, Yin Hao reviewed the problems he had encountered during the morning's machining. Master Sun explained in detail the importance of cutting fluid concentration and cooling methods when cutting martensitic stainless steel. Yin Hao took out his notebook and carefully wrote down the key points.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon workshop work and wrap-up.
description: In the afternoon, processing continued. Thanks to the parameter adjustments made at noon, the subsequent machining of the valve body parts went very smoothly and efficiency improved noticeably. Around 15:30, Engineer Liu came over to discuss ideas for optimizing a complex macro program. Yin Hao shared an auxiliary calculation script he had written in Python. Engineer Liu found it very interesting and suggested he organize it into a document for everyone's reference. At 16:45, he began cleaning the machine tool, tidying his workstation, filling out the day's Production Daily Report, and checking the arrival status of tomorrow's blanks.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

location: Songjiang District, Shanghai, from No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, to Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket

name: Evening chores and financial organization

Then he quickly put the groceries he bought into the refrigerator and rearranged the remaining ingredients in the fridge. While waiting for his swim bag to charge, he used the expense-tracking app on his phone to add the 45 yuan expense from yesterday's shared barbecue with Wang Lei, and also looked at last month's salary transactions, silently calculating in his mind the spending for the Qingming Festival.
location: Room 603, Unit 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Swimming cross-training
description: After driving about 25 minutes, he arrived at the swimming pool. He changed into swim trunks and did some simple shoulder and waist stretches before getting into the water. As planned, he first swam 500 meters of freestyle to keep his breathing rhythm, then 400 meters of breaststroke at a relaxed cruising pace, keeping his heart rate around 130. After swimming, his knee joint's range of motion felt smooth, with no discomfort.
location: Sijing Sports Hall Swimming Pool, 351 Sizhuan South Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returning home to rest and dinner
description: Drove home. Took a nice, comfortable hot shower and changed into dry loungewear. He heated a few sausages bought from the supermarket in an air fryer, paired them with a cup of sugar-free yogurt and a whole-wheat sandwich, and had a simple yet satisfying dinner.

name: Comparative study of running shoe models

description: Opened the laptop and, referring to the Dewu app and Shihuo app on his phone, started building a spreadsheet in Excel. He entered the core parameters of the four shoes one by one: Xtep 160X 3.0 Pro, Li-Ning Chitu 6 Pro, ASICS Kayano 29, and Bmai 42K Pro Potential, including official midsole rebound rate, single-shoe weight in US size 9, heel-to-toe drop, and outsole wear index. He also watched videos from several running shoe reviewers, especially paying attention to feedback from flat-footed runners, and made detailed notes in red pen in his notebook. He initially decided to make the Xtep 160X 3.0 Pro the first choice and the ASICS the conservative backup.

He packed the Nantong dried clams prepared in advance, checked the power bank, tissues, and mineral water, and put in a folding umbrella. In the kitchen, he quickly drank two glasses of milk and ate whole wheat bread. He went down to the underground garage, started his white Volkswagen Lavida, checked the tires, engine oil, and windshield washer fluid, and confirmed the car was in good condition. As he was about to leave, he received a call from his mother, Wang Xiuying. She reminded him about Qingming Festival customs and to treat his girlfriend well. Yin Hao made a few perfunctory replies and hung up. As soon as he hung up, he ran into Aunt Chen, a neighbor, who smilingly asked whether he was going to pick up his girlfriend. Yin Hao nodded and smiled in response.

name: Went to Hongqiao Station to pick up Lin Yue.
description: At 08:05, Yin Hao drove out of the community and headed toward Hongqiao Railway Station along the G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway, a drive of about 42 minutes. Before 09:00, he arrived at the P9 parking lot of Hongqiao Station, parked, and walked to the east exit on the arrival level. There was still over an hour before Lin Yue's train G123 arrived, so he found a spot and stood against the wall waiting. At about 09:20, he ran into his childhood friend Zhang Wei, who was transferring through to Suzhou with a colleague. They chatted briefly; Zhang Wei teased him about waiting for his girlfriend and then left. At 10:10, the train arrived on time. Yin Hao recognized Lin Yue in a white hoodie, they hugged, and he took her backpack and walked together to the parking lot.

On the way, Lin Yue looked out the window curiously, and Yin Hao introduced the landmarks; the atmosphere was relaxed. Around 10:45 they arrived at a public parking lot near the Bund. The two strolled on the observation deck, admired the Lujiazui skyline, Lin Yue took photos, and Yin Hao helped find angles. When they reached the Peace Hotel, they asked a tourist to take a photo of them together.
location: The Bund Scenic Area, No. 1 Zhongshan East Second Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai, China

name: City God Temple tour and snacks
description: After visiting the Bund, the two walked about 15 minutes through Gucheng Park to the City God Temple. First they fed koi on the Nine-Turn Bridge, and Lin Yue was very happy. Then they went to Yuyuan Bazaar, and at a handmade accessories shop, Yin Hao bought a sandalwood bracelet for Lin Yue. After that, they went to Nanxiang Steamed Bun Restaurant, queued to buy two baskets of signature xiaolongbao and a bowl of crab roe soup dumplings, and the two shared them. After eating, each bought a cup of iced soy milk and sat down to rest in the Bagua Pavilion rest area. While chatting, Lin Yue mentioned that her mother hoped she would find a local from Shanghai, saying the pressure of life would be smaller. Yin Hao's heart sank, his smile froze, and afraid of being noticed, he lowered his head to drink his soy milk and gave a vague response, changing the subject.
location: Shanghai City God Temple and Yuyuan Bazaar, No. 249 Fangbang Middle Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai, China

name: Take Lin Yue to Hongqiao Station.
description: After resting, Yin Hao suggested setting off. He drove from the parking lot near the City God Temple to the departure level of Hongqiao Station, about a 20-minute drive. On the way, the atmosphere was quieter than when they came. Yin Hao tried to make conversation but kept thinking about what the "locals" had said. After arriving at the departure level, he helped Lin Yue with her luggage. Lin Yue turned around, smiled, and said, "I really had a great time today, thank you." Yin Hao watched her swipe her ID card to enter the gate until her ponytail disappeared.
location: Departure level, Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station, 1500 Shengui Road, Minhang District, Shanghai, China.

After arriving home at 15:50, he put down his backpack, took out the empty thermos, undressed and showered, then changed into a gray T-shirt and lounge shorts, feeling a bit more relaxed.
location: Room 601, Building 2, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

Then he took out frozen cabbage and pork dumplings from the fridge, boiled 12 of them, and had a simple dinner in the kitchen with vinegar and chili sauce. While eating, he subconsciously scrolled through his phone.
location: Room 601, Building 2, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China, and the corridor

location: Living room, Room 601, Building 2, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.
