description: Yin Hao poured Zhang Wei a glass of plain water and turned on the TV to play a variety show as background noise. Zhang Wei curled up on the sofa, very interested in Yin Hao's new running shoes and fishing gear, and the two chatted about embarrassing childhood stories and mutual friends.
location: Living room, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening stroll and heading to the restaurant
description: The two changed their shoes and went out, strolling east along Xingang Road. The sun was setting and the temperature was pleasant. Yin Hao pointed to a roadside shop and said, 'A barbecue place just opened over there; let's come next time.' After walking about 15 minutes, they arrived at the reserved old Shanghai restaurant.
location: Old Shanghai Shanghai Cuisine, Xingang Road and Songhui East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Shanghainese dinner and catching up
description: Found a seat by the window. Yin Hao casually ordered braised pork belly, steamed sea bass, scallion-oil noodles, four-joy braised gluten, and Indian aster with dried bean curd. When the dishes arrived, the two ate and chatted. Zhang Wei talked about the blind date he went on in his hometown last month, and Yin Hao talked about his progress with Lin Yue, deliberately skipping over the pressure of household registration and housing.
location: Old Shanghai Shanghainese Cuisine, Songhui East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Post-dinner walk to aid digestion
description: After paying (Yin Hao insisted on picking up the bill), the two strolled home along Xingang Road. When they passed the Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Zhang Wei said, "Your neighborhood is really nice, good for a stroll." Yin Hao smiled, and the lingering unhappiness about the house gradually faded.
location: Around Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, returning to Xingang Community.

name: Online gaming and time with the brothers
description: After arriving home, Zhang Wei turned on Yin Hao's computer, and the two teamed up to play a match in Honor of Kings. Zhang Wei's gameplay was still average, but he was fully engaged. After one win and one loss, they started another round. Yin Hao took care of his mood and, although a bit tired himself, played a full three rounds with him.
location: Living room, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wash up and get ready for bed.
description: After the game ended, Yin Hao pulled out the sofa bed and made it up, then took out a clean blanket. Zhang Wei went to wash up first, and Yin Hao quickly tidied the desk and bathroom counter. The two said goodnight to each other, and Yin Hao turned off the light and went back to the bedroom.
location: Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep review and bedtime
description: Lying in bed and scrolling on his phone, he looked at the next morning's work schedule. In his mind he calculated: despite Zhang Wei's visit drawing a few remarks about how small the apartment was, it still felt pretty good to drink and play games face-to-face with an old buddy. With subtle satisfaction and a hint of pressure about the future, he slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Get up early, weigh myself, and go to Sijing Sports Center
description: After the alarm went off, he got up immediately, put on athletic shorts, went to the electronic scale in the living room, and weighed 72.8 kg. Then he splashed cold water on his face to wake up. He quietly went downstairs, started the car, drove along Xingang Road and Sizhuan South Road for about 20 minutes, and parked in a free spot at the entrance of Sijing Sports Hall.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Sijing Sports Center, No. 351, Sizhuan South Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: 10K test run and half marathon registration.
description: He met his running partner Chen Jie at the track of Sijing Sports Hall, and after a brief stretch, they did a 10 km test run at a pace of 5 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer, completing it in 56 minutes 15 seconds with no knee problems. During a break, he paid 130 yuan on his phone to register for the Sheshan Half Marathon, and sat with Chen Jie at the track side to plan the next two weeks of training: a 15 km LSD on the weekend and an interval run next Wednesday.
location: Track and field of Sijing Sports Hall, 351 Sizhuan South Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home, wash up, and prepare breakfast.
description: Drove back home, put the sweaty clothes into the washing machine for a quick wash, took a quick shower, and changed into a clean T-shirt and shorts. Using eggs, toast, and milk, he fried three fried eggs on the gas stove, toasted two slices of bread, made hot milk, ate while leaning against the kitchen counter, and washed the dishes.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wake up Zhang Wei and plan the itinerary
description: He woke Zhang Wei, who was sleeping soundly on the living room sofa, and used a screenshot from Amap to explain the day's sightseeing route: take Line 9 to Century Avenue, transfer to Line 2 to East Nanjing Road, covering the Bund, Nanjing Road, and the City God Temple. After Zhang Wei agreed, Yin Hao prepared his crossbody bag, power bank, and two bottles of mineral water.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive to the parking lot and take the subway to the city center.
description: After the two got ready, they went downstairs and drove five minutes to the surface parking lot of Songjiang Sports Center, parked in an empty spot in the northwest corner, and took a photo for the record. Then they used Alipay on their phones to enter the metro station, first taking Line 9 to Century Avenue Station and transferring to Line 2 to East Nanjing Road Station. The morning rush had just ended, but the car was still quite crowded. The two stood talking, and Zhang Wei remarked on how busy the Shanghai Metro is.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Songjiang Sports Center Metro Station (No. 118 Jiufeng Road), then take the metro to Nanjing East Road Station

name: The Bund sightseeing tour
description: After exiting Nanjing East Road Station, they walked seven or eight minutes to reach the Bund observation platform. The river wind was strong, and the tourists were not too crowded. The two admired the Lujiazui skyscrapers across the river along the riverside railing, and Zhang Wei gasped in admiration again and again. In front of the Chen Yi statue, they asked a passerby to take a group photo. Yin Hao introduced to Zhang Wei the green spire of the Peace Hotel and the history of the Shanghai Bund.
location: The Bund observation deck, No. 49 Zhongshan East 1st Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai

name: Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street sightseeing, lunch, and shopping
description: Walked along East Nanjing Road to Shen Dacheng, queued for about 15 minutes, then ordered double-stuffed rice balls, vegetable noodles, pork mooncakes, and egg drop soup. They ate at a window seat on the second floor. Zhang Wei commented that the food was delicate but the portions were small. After the meal, they entered Hualian Commercial Building, where Yin Hao picked out a white T-shirt printed with Shanghai landmark buildings for Zhang Wei and paid directly. Zhang Wei declined but was firmly refused, showing the bond between brothers.
location: Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, Huangpu District, Shanghai: Shen Dacheng (No. 636 East Nanjing Road) and Hualian Commercial Building (No. 340 East Nanjing Road)

name: Walked to the City God Temple and visited the snack square and the Nine-Bend Bridge.
description: They walked about 20 minutes from Nanjing East Road to the City God Temple. At the snack square, they queued to buy crab roe soup dumplings and pork rib rice cakes, then sat on a bench by the pond to enjoy them. Zhang Wei recorded a short video and posted it on WeChat Moments, praising how rich the soup was. The two then walked across the crowded Nine-Bend Bridge, and Zhang Wei remarked that there were as many people in Shanghai as at a market fair.
location: No. 168 Fuyou Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai, City God Temple Snack Plaza and Jiuqu Bridge

name: Yuyuan Garden periphery tour
description: Without buying tickets to go inside Yu Garden, they strolled along the garden's outer walls and around the Mid-Lake Pavilion. Zhang Wei kept taking photos of the buildings with upturned eaves and flying corners. They walked another loop on the Nine-Bend Bridge, then leaned on the railing to watch koi fish compete for food. Yin Hao bought two bottles of salty soda water at a stall to quench their thirst.
location: The outer area of Yu Garden, 218 Anren Street, Huangpu District, Shanghai

name: On the way back, walk to the metro station and take the metro back to Songjiang.
description: After shopping, they walked about 15 minutes to East Nanjing Road Station, took Line 2 to Century Avenue, and transferred to Line 9 toward Songjiang. By then it was evening rush hour, and the carriage was crowded. Zhang Wei was sweating profusely and muttered about how many people there were in Shanghai and how high the cost of living was. Yin Hao turned sideways to protect his crossbody bag and comforted him, saying he would get used to it.
location: From Fuyou Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai, to East Nanjing Road Metro Station, then take the metro to Songjiang Sports Center Station

name: Pick up the car and buy groceries on the way
description: After leaving the station, he found the car in the parking lot. On the way back, passing the Xingang New Village fresh food supermarket, Yin Hao pulled over and asked Zhang Wei to wait. He quickly went into the store and bought scallions, eggs, and live shrimp to add to dinner.
location: From the parking lot of Pinggao Plaza, No. 118 Jiufeng Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road

name: Prepare dinner
description: After arriving home, Zhang Wei went to wash his hands first. Yin Hao took frozen dumplings and shaomai out of the refrigerator and cleaned the fresh shrimp. He first boiled water to cook the dumplings and shaomai, and in another pan sautéed scallions and ginger to make blanched shrimp. In the spare time, he hung the clothes that had finished washing in the machine out to dry on the balcony.
location: Kitchen and balcony, Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Residential Complex, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner with Zhang Wei
description: At the living room coffee table, the two enjoyed blanched shrimp and pastries with a dipping sauce of light soy sauce, vinegar, and chili oil. Zhang Wei ate while browsing through today's photos, saying his Moments post had gotten nearly 50 likes. Yin Hao responded casually, but in his mind he was thinking about checking the class schedule later that evening.
location: Dining table in the living room, Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Zhang Wei took a shower, Yin Hao checked the course schedule and equipment testing, and then the two chatted.
description: Zhang Wei went to take a shower first. After clearing the table, Yin Hao went into the study, turned on the old desktop computer, logged into the National Open University platform, and found the course schedule for the Mechatronics major: classes every Tuesday and Thursday evening from 7:00 to 8:50 PM. He took a screenshot and saved it to his phone, then put on headphones and used Tencent Meeting to test the microphone and speakers; everything worked fine. When Zhang Wei came out of the shower, the two slumped on the sofa chatting. Zhang Wei mentioned that he would take the high-speed train back to Nantong at a little past 8 AM the next morning, and Yin Hao said he would ask for leave to see him off. Zhang Wei remarked that it was not easy for Yin Hao to work and study at the same time. Yin Hao changed the subject and asked Zhang Wei about his blind date.
location: Study and living room, Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with parents
description: Yin Hao walked into the bedroom, closed the door, and called his mother and father via WeChat video. His mother asked about the day's outings; he shared what he had seen at the Bund and City God Temple. His father reminded him not to work too hard and to take care of his health; he replied that his knee was fine and he was in good health. The call lasted more than ten minutes.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Stretched before bed and checked tomorrow's high-speed rail information.
description: Back in the living room, he did more than ten minutes of stretching and foam rolling on the yoga mat, focusing on relieving the thigh and calf muscles. Then he washed up, lay on the bed, and used his phone to check tomorrow's bullet train schedules from Shanghai Hongqiao to Nantong Station, picked the one departing at 8:55 a.m., and saved a screenshot.
location: Living room and bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Final chat with Zhang Wei and getting ready for bed.
description: When he came out of the bathroom, he saw Zhang Wei still on the sofa scrolling through Douyin. The two chatted for a while, and Zhang Wei said he wanted to sleep early so he would have energy for the return trip tomorrow. Yin Hao chatted with him until past ten, until Zhang Wei yawned and said he was sleepy. Then Yin Hao checked the windows and gas, spread a quilt for Zhang Wei on the sofa, left a small night light on, went back to the bedroom to check the screenshot of tomorrow morning's 8:55 train, set the alarm for 6:30 the next day, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: Living room and bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning exercise and breakfast
description: I woke up naturally a little after five, got out of bed quietly, and didn't turn on the main light so as not to wake Zhang Wei, who was sleeping on the sofa. After changing into workout clothes, I did 30 minutes of core training on the living room carpet: 3 sets of planks, 3 sets of side planks, and 100 glute bridges, then used a foam roller to relax my calves and back. Then I washed up and shaved, trying to stay as quiet as possible. At 6:30 I turned on the light and woke Zhang Wei. He grumbled about having gone to bed too late last night. We simply boiled some dried noodles with poached eggs and ate breakfast with pickled mustard stems, chatting about Zhang Wei's plan to bring a local jellyfish specialty next time. After the meal, I quickly checked my wallet, phone, and car keys, confirmed the route to the station, and got ready to leave.
location: Room 203, Building 15, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Saying goodbye to a friend and commuting to work
description: At a quarter past seven, he carried Zhang Wei's luggage downstairs, with Zhang Wei following behind carrying a small backpack. He drove the gray Ford Focus out of Xingang Community, took the Jiamin Elevated Road to Shanghai Hongqiao Station, and, with traffic gradually increasing, arrived at the north departure level after about 38 minutes. He pulled over, helped take out the luggage, said a brief goodbye, and watched him enter the waiting hall. Then he turned around and headed straight to the company, taking the Jiamin Elevated Road, then the Shanghai-Kunming Expressway, then turning onto Huatianjing Road, about 25 kilometers in total. While driving, he listened to the morning news and planned the day's flange machining schedule. At around 8:25, he parked in the open-air parking lot at the factory entrance, locked the car, and entered the factory.
location: From Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to the North Departure Level of Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station, Shenhong Road, Minhang District, Shanghai, and then to Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning work: flange machining and equipment maintenance
description: After entering the workshop, he first went to the changing room to put on the blue work clothes, safety glasses, and gloves. At 8:45 he arrived at the vertical machining center workstation, turned on the machine, checked yesterday's machining records, and began milling a batch of flanges. Half an hour into the work, he noticed that the coolant nozzle's water flow had become noticeably weaker. He immediately removed the nozzle with an Allen wrench, cleared the iron chips and coolant crystals from it with a thin wire on the workbench, reinstalled it, and confirmed the flow returned to normal. He then adjusted the cutting parameters and continued machining smoothly. At 11:45 he paused the machine, used a caliper and plug gauge to self-check the finished flanges—all dimensions were within tolerance—and signed the work order. His colleague Wang Lei passed by and greeted him, and they agreed to meet at the cafeteria at noon.
location: Workshop No. 3, Shanghai Precision Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch Break and Technical Discussion
description: At noon, Yin Hao went to the staff canteen with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang, getting braised pork chop and scrambled eggs with tomatoes. Just as they sat down, Master Sun Jianguo came over with a bowl. Remembering that he had mentioned the issue of stainless steel tool wear yesterday, Yin Hao took the initiative to ask whether it would be appropriate to set the feed rate (F value) to 0.08 mm/r when machining the stainless steel valve body in the afternoon. Master Sun gestured with his chopsticks as he explained: for 304 stainless steel, 0.08 is fine, but the coolant must be applied generously and the spindle speed should not exceed 1,800. He suggested making a test cut tomorrow and stopping to check the tool tip wear before fine-tuning. The two chatted for a few more minutes about the new equipment in the workshop, then at 13:00 they cleared the tableware, washed their hands, and prepared for the afternoon work.
location: Staff canteen of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work: stainless steel valve body processing and technical exchange
description: At 13:10, I returned to my workstation, installed a brand-new coated carbide tool, clamped the stainless steel valve body blank, and, following Master Sun's advice, set the spindle speed to 1,700 rpm, feed rate to 0.08 mm/r, and coolant flow to full, then started the program. Throughout the process I closely watched the chip color and chip evacuation, and everything was normal. Around 15:30, product programmer Liu Zhiqiang brought a 3D drawing of a complex curved surface part and said the customer required a five-axis linkage program, asking whether we could find a solution on the existing equipment. The two of us discussed for over an hour in front of the computer, and proposed a plan using an indexing head with multiple setups. Liu Zhiqiang approved and offered to help optimize the post-processing program. At 17:00, I shut down the machine and got off work, organizing the measuring tools and drawings.
location: Workshop No. 3, Shanghai Precision Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-work shopping and rest at home
description: At 5:05 p.m., he took off his work clothes, put on a jacket, and drove away from the company. On the way, he stopped at Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket to pick a small bunch of Shanghai bok choy, three tomatoes, and a carton of free-range eggs, spending 28.5 yuan in total, planning to cook tomato egg noodles for dinner. After shopping, he drove back to the residential area and arrived home at about 5:35 p.m. He parked, carried the plastic bags upstairs, and went inside. He first put the groceries in the kitchen, then took a hot shower and changed into clean loungewear, feeling refreshed. He walked to the desk, tidied up the odds and ends, opened his laptop and plugged it in, logged in to The Open University of China platform to view the Mechanical Drawing course page, copied the Tencent Meeting ID in advance, tested the microphone and camera, set his phone to Do Not Disturb, poured a cup of hot water, and sat down to wait for class.
location: Company parking lot, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai / Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai / Room 203, Building 15, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Open University of China 'Mechanical Drawing' live course
description: The course started on time at 7 PM. The instructor's voice was steady. He first introduced the course syllabus and assessment methods, then taught Chapter 1, "Basic Knowledge and Skills of Drafting." While listening, I noted key points such as drawing sheet sizes, scales, fonts, and line-drawing conventions. The instructor used 3D models to demonstrate thick solid lines and thin dashed lines, and I immediately followed along by sketching on A4 paper. At 8:30 PM, there was an online quiz; I answered all 5 multiple-choice questions correctly, which boosted my confidence. At 8:50 PM, the course ended. I closed the meeting, reviewed my notes once more, and gave the instructor's course a thumbs-up.
location: Room 203, Building 15, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with girlfriend
description: Just as he closed the laptop, Lin Yue's video call popped up. She was leaning against the headboard in her pajamas and asked how his day had gone. He told her in detail about seeing Zhang Wei off to the train and Zhang Wei's complaint that the apartment was small, then half-jokingly said that once his skills improved he would change to a bigger apartment and invite her over, which made her laugh. He also shared about fixing the cooling nozzle at work and studying tool parameters with Master Sun. He excitedly told her he had signed up for the Sheshan Half Marathon and that he had understood the entire first live session of the National Open University class and got all the quiz questions right. Lin Yue's eyes lit up and she kept saying awesome, and also sent him a stretching photo of herself doing yoga. After saying goodnight to each other, they hung up, and he was in an especially good mood.
location: Room 203, Building 15, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-class review, relaxation, and bedtime preparation
description: After the call ended, he returned to the desk, reorganized his class notes, marked important definitions such as “linear dimension marking symbols” with a red pen, and saved screenshots of the example problems from the teacher's courseware to his phone for easy review on the way tomorrow. At 22:00 he got up and did a set of pre-bedtime stretches to relax his shoulders, neck, and lower back. Then he checked the ingredients in the refrigerator and confirmed there was enough milk and bread for tomorrow's breakfast. He took out the clean work clothes and T-shirt for the next day and draped them over the back of a chair, checked the battery levels of his phone and power bank, and plugged in the charging cable. He checked one by one that the living room windows and the gas valve were tightly closed, set the alarm for 6:00 tomorrow morning, used the bathroom, brushed his teeth, and washed his face. At 22:40 he turned off the light and lay down. Reviewing the day's events—seeing off a friend, solving work problems, attending a good class, and having a sweet call with his girlfriend—he felt at ease and soon fell asleep.
location: Room 203, Building 15, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning core training and cool-down
description: At 6:00 a.m., the alarm went off on time. Yin Hao got up and opened the window to let in fresh air. He spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and began his daily morning core routine: 3 sets of planks (1 minute each), 3 sets of side planks (45 seconds per side), and 3 sets of glute bridges. Afterward, he used a foam roller on his front thighs and around his knees to ease any tightness left over from yesterday's run.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and commute preparation
description: Yin Hao went into the kitchen and boiled two eggs. While the eggs were cooking, he took a quick shower and changed into dark blue work pants and a jacket. He made instant coffee with hot water. When the eggs were done, he cooled them in cold water, shelled them, and ate them with the coffee. He checked his phone and sent a screenshot of last night's perfect score on the Open University of China quiz to Lin Yue.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to work
description: At 7:15, Yin Hao put on his jacket, grabbed his commuter bag and water bottle, and left. He got on the electric bike parked in the community bike shed, turned from Xingang Road onto Huatianjing Road, and headed west toward the company. Morning traffic was smooth. He arrived at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory at 7:45, parked the electric bike in the shed to charge, and clocked in on time at 7:50.
location: From Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Precision parts machining in the morning
description: At 7:55, punched in and entered Workshop No. 3. Yin Hao checked the machine lubricating oil and coolant, opened today's stainless steel valve body drawing, and adjusted equipment parameters: spindle speed 1,800 rpm, feed rate 0.08 mm/r, strictly following Master Sun's method. After loading the workpiece and starting the machine, he closely observed the cutting fluid spray. He stayed highly focused all morning and smoothly completed rough and semi-finish machining of two key surfaces. At 11:50, he stopped the machine and used a vernier caliper to self-check three key dimensions, all within tolerance.
location: Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and work discussion
description: At 12:00, Yin Hao called Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang to go to the cafeteria together and ordered braised pork and stir-fried greens. While eating, they chatted about the afternoon's work. Engineer Liu suggested optimizing the dividing head clamping procedure to save two clamping steps, and everyone agreed. Yin Hao casually invited everyone to go singing at Haoledi KTV in the evening, saying, "By the way, I have arranged to go singing with Gao Zhiyuan and the others tonight. Why don't you all come? My treat." Wang Lei could not go because of a family dinner, but Engineer Liu readily agreed.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break
description: At 12:35 he returned to the workshop, sat down in the rest area, and played on his phone: opened Honor of Kings to claim daily rewards, and watched some Bilibili fishing videos for a while. At 12:55 he put away his phone, refreshed, and prepared to start the afternoon shift.
location: Rest area of Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon machining in coordination with the dividing head
description: Work started at 13:00. Yin Hao was responsible for machine changeover and fixture clamping, and Liu Zhiqiang adjusted the program. The two operated the dividing head according to the plan discussed at noon, machining complex curved-surface parts with multiple clamping setups. The process went smoothly, finishing half an hour earlier than expected, with everything completed by 16:00. Afterwards, they carefully cleaned the machine guide rails and chips, applied rust-preventive oil, and tidied up the workstation. Then he sent Gao Zhiyuan a message on his phone: "Meet at the Haoledi entrance at 6:30?" The other party instantly replied, "Got it."
location: Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute after work and swimming preparation
description: Leaving work on time at 16:30, Yin Hao changed into casual sportswear and rode his electric bike directly from the company to Songjiang Swimming Pool in the old town of Songjiang. On the way, he pulled Zhang Wei into a group chat on WeChat and sent a voice message: “Wei-ge, we're doing karaoke tonight, Lao Gao and Xiao Ma are both coming. Head over after work, don't dawdle!”
location: From 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to 143 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Swimming to relax
description: At 17:10, arrived at Songjiang Swimming Pool. Yin Hao bought a ticket and changed. At 17:20, got into the water. First did a relaxed 600-meter breaststroke warm-up in the shallow area, felt his knee comfortable, then switched to freestyle and swam about 800 meters at low-to-moderate intensity, 35 minutes in total. At 18:00, finished showering, changed into dry clothes, and stretched all over.
location: Songjiang Swimming Pool, No. 143 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Arrived at the KTV gathering.
description: At 17:55, after leaving the swimming pool, Yin Hao rode his e-bike for about 15 minutes and arrived at Haoledi KTV (Songjiang store) on Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District. After parking, he met Gao Zhiyuan at the entrance, and the two went in together. At the front desk, they booked a medium private room and ordered a dozen beers, a fruit platter, and a plate of fried chicken wings. Then they went into the room to wait for Zhang Wei and Ma Xiaofeng.
location: Haoledi KTV (Songjiang Branch), Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Four-person KTV singing session.
description: Around 18:40, Zhang Wei and Ma Xiaofeng arrived one after the other. The four of them teased each other, and the atmosphere was lively. Yin Hao first ordered Jay Chou’s “Sunny Day” to warm things up, and then they took turns singing. Around 21:00, Yin Hao and Ma Xiaofeng sang a duet of “Old Boy” while Gao Zhiyuan cheered and filmed from the side and Zhang Wei clapped along to the rhythm, bringing the atmosphere to a climax. Yin Hao drank some beer and felt relaxed. During a break, he opened the notepad on his phone and seriously wrote: “Important: running habit update — before and after every run you must complete: 1. Foam roller full-body relaxation (focus on the front and back of the thighs); 2. Resistance band strength training (side leg raises, glute bridge).” as a permanent fixed routine. At 21:55, after Ma Xiaofeng, the karaoke king, sang the final note, Yin Hao suggested ending the session. Everyone agreed, paid the bill, and left the KTV.
location: Room 203, Haoledi KTV, Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returning home and getting a friend settled
description: At 22:00, because Zhang Wei was going to sleep on the sofa tonight, the two went back to Yin Hao's place together. Each rode a bike or took a taxi back to the building entrance of Xingang Community. After getting home, Yin Hao washed his face with cold water to sober up, made up the sofa bed for Zhang Wei, got out clean clothes for him, and drank half a glass of plain water himself.
location: From Haoledi KTV, Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and planning.
description: At 22:40, Yin Hao prepared for the next day: he took clean work clothes from the wardrobe and put them on the bench at the foot of the bed, placed an instant coffee pack in a prominent spot on the dining table, and set the alarm for 6:00 a.m. the next morning. Lying in bed, he sent Lin Yue a WeChat message: “Finished the last part today; the feel was great. Went singing with the guys tonight and just got back. Good night.” At 23:00, he turned off the lights and went to bed, and he could hear Zhang Wei’s snoring from the living room.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wake up, weigh in, and morning core training.
description: The alarm went off promptly at 6. Yin Hao got up quietly to avoid waking Zhang Wei, who was sleeping soundly on the sofa. He stepped onto the scale, which showed 73 kg, the same as yesterday. He then spread out a yoga mat in the bedroom and did 25 minutes of core training, including three sets of planks (1 minute each), side planks (45 seconds per side), and glute bridges. Finally, he used a foam roller to relax his calves and knees and felt his joints were in good condition.
location: Bedroom, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Repair Zhang Wei's mini speaker.
description: Yin Hao woke up Zhang Wei, who complained that the stereo had completely lost sound. Yin Hao took out a multimeter and a soldering iron, skillfully opened the back cover of the stereo, and after testing found that a key audio wire had a broken solder joint. He quickly re-soldered it. When the power was turned on, music played again, and Zhang Wei jumped up from the sofa and praised him repeatedly.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai – living room

name: Breakfast and discussion of Zhang Wei's itinerary
description: Yin Hao made a simple breakfast of fried eggs, milk, and bread. While the two were eating at the living room table, Zhang Wei said he would return to Nantong in the afternoon and take the high-speed train from Hongqiao Station on his own, so there was no need to see him off. Yin Hao reminded him not to disturb the evening live class; Zhang Wei readily agreed and said he would tidy up the sofa before leaving.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai – living room

name: Commuting to the factory
description: Yin Hao changed into his work clothes, grabbed his helmet, and left on his electric bike at exactly 7:35, going along Guangfulin Road, turning onto Wenxiang Road, and then onto Huatianjing Road. With a gentle breeze on the way, he thought over the plan for discussing tool parameters with Master Sun in the morning and arrived at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory at 7:55.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to 360 Huatianjing Highway

name: Attend the team morning meeting
description: Yin Hao attended the pre-shift meeting in Workshop No. 3. Team leader Wang Lei briefly assigned the day's work priorities, emphasizing the yield rate issue in stainless steel valve body machining. Yin Hao organized yesterday's trial cutting records at his workstation to prepare for subsequent optimization.
location: Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Optimized cutting tool parameters together with Master Sun
description: Yin Hao found Master Sun Jianguo in the break room. After offering him a cigarette, the two pulled up yesterday's cutting data on the computer. Regarding the problem of rapid tool wear, Master Sun suggested reducing the spindle speed and feed rate. They made a three-round trial cutting plan: spindle speed lowered from 2000 to 1600, and feed rate lowered from 0.12 mm/r to 0.08 mm/r. Yin Hao operated the machine. The first round gave a decent surface finish; after fine-tuning in the second round, tool wear improved significantly; the third round had the most ideal data, with estimated tool life extended by more than 20%. Master Sun patted him on the shoulder and praised his accurate data tracking.
location: Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and online textbook shopping
description: Yin Hao wiped the oil off his hands, sat down in the workshop rest area, took out his phone, and opened the JD.com app. He searched for and compared the designated textbooks Mechanical Drawing and Fundamentals of Electrical and Electronic Technology, chose the store with a better price and next-day delivery, and placed the order for 79 yuan. While doing this, he saw Lin Yue's good-morning greeting and replied.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Heading to a farmhouse restaurant for lunch
description: After greeting Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang, Yin Hao rode his electric bike alone to his usual Taiyang Island Ancient Village farm restaurant and ordered shredded pork with green peppers over rice and tomato and egg soup. While eating, he scrolled through his phone, replied to Lin Yue's good-morning message, and said he had solved a major problem.
location: Sun Island Ancient Village Farmhouse Restaurant, beside the East Gate of Sun Island Tourist Resort, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Continue trial cuts and data organization.
description: After lunch, Yin Hao returned to the workshop. Using the optimized parameters from the morning, he machined two workpieces. He took comparison photos with a tool wear detector and recorded detailed data. The surface roughness met the Ra1.6 process requirement. He organized all the data and photos into a clearly structured Word document.
location: Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Submitted the optimization proposal and it was adopted.
description: Yin Hao took a USB drive and knocked on the door of Engineer Li, the technical supervisor. He briefly reported on the tool parameter optimization plan for the stainless steel valve body that he and Master Sun had completed, showing the data and comparison charts in the document. Engineer Li looked it over carefully, made the decision on the spot to include the plan in the standard process documents, and praised their initiative.
location: Technical Supervisor's Office, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Daily machine tool maintenance and preparation for tomorrow
description: Yin Hao returned to his workstation and performed routine maintenance on the CNC machine tool used that day according to procedure: wiped the guide rails, added lubricating oil, cleaned the chip tray, and checked the drawings and blanks to be machined the next day to ensure everything was ready.
location: Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-work commute and grocery shopping
description: Yin Hao packed up his personal belongings, clocked out, and rode his electric bike home. Passing Xingang Road, he stopped by Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket on the way to buy some greens and eggs, spending 15 yuan. He arrived home at 17:10 and found that Zhang Wei had left. On the coffee table was a note thanking him for fixing the stereo and inviting him to Nantong for seafood next time; the sofa had also been tidied up.
location: From No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, via the Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket at Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, to No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road

name: Take a shower, prepare dinner
description: Yin Hao took a shower and changed into loose loungewear. He washed the greens he had bought, heated them together with the leftover braised pork from the fridge, and fried an egg, making a simple dinner.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, bathroom and kitchen

name: Dinner and after-dinner rest
description: After dinner, Yin Hao washed the dishes, then sat on the sofa and scrolled through short videos to relax, while sending a message to Lin Yue to let her know he had finished a big project and would meet her after class in the evening.
location: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai – living room

name: Pre-class preparation.
description: Yin Hao sat at his desk half an hour early, opened his laptop, logged into the National Open University platform to confirm that tonight's live class was normal, then opened Tencent Meeting to test the microphone and camera, and finally flipped through yesterday's Mechanical Drawing notes for a quick review to warm up for the new lesson.
location: Study, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Attended the live course Fundamentals of Electrical and Electronic Technology
description: The live stream class started on time at 7 p.m. The teacher explained the basic laws of circuits and Kirchhoff's laws. Yin Hao listened attentively and quickly noted down key formulas and example solutions in his notebook. During the class, the teacher asked a question about parallel circuits. He typed the correct answer in the chat box and was praised by name by the teacher.
location: Study, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-class homework and note organization
description: After the course ended, Yin Hao spent half an hour completing the homework assigned by the teacher: calculating the total resistance of two complex circuits and drawing the current directions. After checking them with a red pen, everything was correct. He then recopied the messy notes from class, added details, and saved screenshots of the key circuit diagrams.
location: Study, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with girlfriend
description: Yin Hao walked to the balcony and made a video call to his girlfriend Lin Yue. Excitedly, he shared the success of today's tool optimization and his supervisor's praise. Lin Yue smiled and said he was getting more and more impressive. They chatted for more than 20 minutes. Lin Yue said she was busy preparing a group PPT, and Yin Hao felt much of the day's fatigue melt away.
location: Balcony, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: After hanging up, Yin Hao did a pre-sleep stretch, using a foam roller to focus on relaxing his calves and lower back, which had been tense from standing for a long time. Then he prepared his work uniform and helmet for the next day, checked the doors, windows, and gas, and set the alarm for 6 a.m. the next morning.
location: Bedroom, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lights out and sleep
description: Yin Hao turned off the light and, in the darkness, recalled the fulfilling experiences of the day: helping a brother, solving a technical problem, learning new knowledge, and sharing happiness. With a sense of satisfaction, he soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning core training and body relaxation
description: Woke up naturally at 6:00, with a glimmer of light outside the window; it was overcast turning to partly cloudy. First went to the bathroom to weigh himself in light clothing and got 72.0 kg, comparing it with yesterday's 73.5 kg measured during the physical exam in heavy clothing so as to have a clear picture. After washing up, he laid out the yoga mat in the living room and completed core training according to the habits he had developed in the military: 3 sets of 1-minute planks, 1-minute side planks on each side, and 3 sets of 15 glute bridges. Then he used a foam roller to relax the front of his thighs, the back of his calves, and focused on the glutes from sitting too long. The whole process lasted about 45 minutes, injecting a rhythm of discipline into the new day.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and preparation for the physical examination.
description: After training, he took a 3-minute hot shower to wash off the sweat. In the kitchen, he boiled two eggs and had a simple breakfast with the leftover steamed rolls from yesterday and a glass of warm milk. Before the meal, he organized the documents needed for the physical examination at the dining table — social security card, ID card, and medical record booklet — put them all into his crossbody bag, and checked the e-bike key and phone battery to ensure a smooth trip to the physical examination.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute to the hospital
description: At 7:15, I set off on time on the black-and-white electric bicycle, heading east from Xingang Road along Songhui West Road, turning into Yushu Road, then into Zhongshan Middle Road. Traffic was steady on the way. After about 25 minutes, I arrived smoothly at Songjiang Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine, parked and locked the bike at the designated non-motor vehicle parking area, and walked into the Physical Examination Center building.
location: Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine Affiliated Songjiang Hospital, 748 Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Annual physical exam and health alerts
description: He arrived at the physical examination center a little earlier than the appointment time of 8:00, registered, and got the examination form. Then, following the procedure, he completed routine items in order: fasting blood draw, abdominal ultrasound, electrocardiogram, chest X-ray, internal medicine and surgery, and vision check. During the ultrasound, the doctor reminded him that he had mild fatty liver and needed to pay attention to diet and exercise; his blood pressure was measured at 135, and the nurse also said it was at the borderline. By about 10:00, all items were basically completed. He received some preliminary reports including the blood routine and ultrasound, and was told that the remaining results would be available in the app two working days later. During the examination, he weighed 73.5 kg wearing a coat and shoes, and decided to use his morning weight of 72 kg as the baseline for fat loss.
location: Physical Examination Center, Songjiang Hospital Affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine, 748 Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home and make a preliminary record.
description: Rode the e-bike back along the same route, replaying the doctor's reminder over and over, feeling a bit conflicted. After getting home, I took a photo of the physical examination report and saved it, then created a new document in my phone memo named Health Rebuilding Plan to prepare for the next steps.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Develop a healthy fat-loss plan
description: Sitting on the sofa, with a morning weight of 72.0 kg as the starting point for fat loss, he seriously wrote down the goal of reducing to 68 kg within two months and eliminating the fatty liver warning. Specific measures include: diet — dinners mainly of chicken breast, broccoli, steamed fish, and brown rice; no takeout or sugary drinks from Monday to Friday; exercise — run at least three times a week, no less than 5 km each time, and add swimming or core training on weekends; habits — replace all drinks with mineral water, and drink at least 2 liters of water daily. He set the screenshot of the plan as his phone lock screen to remind himself at all times.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Purchasing fat-loss ingredients.
description: He rode his e-bike to Guangfulin Farmers' Market first, picked out three chicken breasts at his usual meat stall, bought broccoli, tomatoes, cucumbers, baby greens, and scallions at the vegetable stall, and grabbed a bottle of olive oil at the condiment shop. Then he rode to the Lianhua Huichuang Life Supermarket on Guangkang Road nearby. He first went to the stationery section to pick out a notebook for recording daily meals and expenses, then went to the drinks section and loaded two cases of bottled water onto the footboard of the e-bike. At checkout, he passed the freezer and saw iced tea, hesitated for a few seconds, but ultimately followed his plan and did not buy it.
location: Shanghai, Songjiang District, Guangfulin Road, Guangfulin Farmers' Market, and Lianhua Huichuang Life Supermarket on Guangkang Road

name: Put away ingredients and make a simple lunch
description: After returning home, he put the chicken breast and greens in the refrigerator and placed the mineral water on the balcony. He made a simple lunch: boiled buckwheat noodles mixed with soy sauce, vinegar, and a little olive oil, plus a plate of stir-fried greens. While eating, he opened the work group chat to reply to messages and learned that the workshop only had equipment maintenance in the afternoon, with no other urgent matters.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Noon break
description: Because he got up early today, and with the running around for the physical exam and shopping, he felt tired. He closed the curtains, dimmed the lights, set a 30-minute alarm, and lay down on the bed. Within less than 5 minutes he fell into a deep nap. After the alarm went off, he dozed for another 5 minutes before getting up, feeling much more refreshed.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Unpacking the delivery packages and previewing the course
description: After receiving a call from the JD courier, he went downstairs to pick up the textbooks he had bought online: 'Mechanical Drawing' and 'Fundamentals of Electrical and Electronic Technology'. He opened the package, and the two brand-new books gave off the scent of printer ink. He brewed a cup of tea, sat on the sofa, and opened 'Mechanical Drawing', focusing on Chapter 1, 'Basic Knowledge of Mechanical Drawing'. Combining this with notes from the April 8 livestream class, he marked important symbols and dimensioning rules to preview for the class next Tuesday (April 15).
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Plan next week's diet and exercise regimen
description: Took out a newly bought notebook, wrote 'Health Rebuilding Plan' on the first page, and then planned in detail the meal menu and exercise schedule from April 14 to 20. For example, Monday dinner was chicken breast salad with mixed-grain rice, Wednesday dinner was steamed basa fish with broccoli and sweet potato, Saturday morning run 9 kilometers, and Sunday swim for 1 hour. After finishing the plan, he felt much clearer about the goals for the coming week.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Outdoor aerobic jogging at a low heart rate
description: After changing into running shoes and workout clothes and stretching, I set off. Today I didn't focus on pace; the goal was a low-heart-rate jog to sweat. From the residential community I jogged along Guangfulin Road to Sijing Sports Hall, about 2 km away, then ran 3 km on the synthetic track at the hall, keeping my heart rate around 140 and pace about 6:30 per kilometer. After running, I stretched for 10 minutes beside the track and used a resistance band to relax, continuing the post-run stretching habit established on April 9.
location: Sijing Sports Center, No. 351 Sizhuan South Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Showering and preparing a low-fat dinner
description: After running home, I was drenched in sweat, so I first took a warm shower and changed into dry loungewear. Then I went into the kitchen and began preparing a fat-loss dinner: steamed egg custard (with only salt and a little light soy sauce), stir-fried broccoli, and half a bowl of multigrain rice preset in the rice cooker. It took about 40 minutes from prepping to finishing.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and handling phone messages
description: At 6 PM, dinner started. Sitting at the dining table, I ate dinner while replying to various messages on my phone. I saw that Gao Zhiyuan, who had gone singing with us on April 9, had posted photos in the group of everyone singing last night, so I replied with a like emoji. In the comrades-in-arms group, Zhang Jianguo shared a video of coaching trainees doing deadlifts in Hangzhou, and I gave it a like too. Fishing buddy Brother Wu sent a message asking whether I wanted to go to Dianshan Lake this weekend, and I replied that I needed to rest and recover this week, and would meet up next week. I also cleared all the red dot messages on WeChat.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Previewed textbooks and did bookkeeping
description: After dinner, he cleaned up the kitchen, sat down at the desk, opened the textbook Fundamentals of Electrical and Electronic Technology, and read Chapter 1, 'Basic Concepts and Laws of Circuits', comparing the key points explained by the teacher during the live class, such as Ohm's law and Kirchhoff's laws, with the textbook to deepen his understanding. After the preview, he took out his expense notebook and clearly recorded today's expenses: 79 yuan for the textbook and about 135 yuan for ingredients purchased at the farmers' market and supermarket, keeping his finances clear.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with girlfriend Lin Yue
description: At 7:30 p.m., my girlfriend Lin Yue sent a video call invitation. When I answered, I saw her on the screen practicing yoga at home. I took the initiative to tell her about today's physical examination results and the process of making a health plan. Lin Yue gently comforted me: “You're a 24-year-old young man. As long as you start paying attention now, you'll be fine soon. I've also been taking yoga classes recently, and I feel much lighter. We can keep each other accountable.” She also shared a creative dish she had eaten at a newly opened vegetarian restaurant in Hangzhou, and joked that she could take me to Hangzhou to eat grass in the future. In the video call, the two of them agreed to work hard for their health and said good night to each other amid warm laughter.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Emotional processing and relaxation
description: After hanging up, much of the pressure from the physical exam results dissipated. He opened the "Health Reshaping Plan" in his phone memo and added a line below: "April 11: Lin Yue's understanding and encouragement put me at ease. I must persist in fat loss." Then he opened the music app, searched for the "piano stress relief" playlist, put on earphones, lay on the bed with eyes closed, and listened attentively. As the soothing piano music played for 15 minutes, his mind gradually calmed down.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Writing a diary and preparing for sleep.
description: He tore a sheet of paper from his notebook and briefly wrote down today's mood and events, including the physical exam results, the start of the health plan, the purchasing process, and Lin Yue's encouragement. After writing, he tucked the paper into the notebook. Then he went to the balcony to check that the doors and windows were locked, turned off the living room lights and router. Finally, he set tomorrow morning's alarm for 6 o'clock, planning to invite his running buddy Chen Jie to Sijing Sports Center for a morning run on Saturday and chat about his new plan along the way.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep stretching and going to bed.
description: Back in the bedroom, he did a 5-minute pre-sleep stretch on the bed, including child’s pose and leg stretches, letting his body fully relax. After lying down, he turned off the bedside lamp, closed his eyes in the darkness, and reviewed the fulfilling experiences of the day: the wake-up call from the health checkup, the decisiveness of the shopping, the flow while studying, and the warmth of exchanging messages with his girlfriend. He felt grounded. At 10 p.m. sharp, he turned off the lights and fell asleep.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wake up, weigh in, and morning core training.
description: The alarm went off, and I got up quickly. First I went to the bathroom to weigh myself; the scale showed 73.2 kg, the same as the previous day. To avoid disturbing Zhang Wei, who was sleeping on the sofa in the living room, I quietly spread out a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and began my daily morning core workout: 3 sets of plank (60 seconds each), side plank (45 seconds each side), and 3 sets of glute bridges (15 reps each). After finishing, I used a foam roller to slowly roll out and relax my calves and back muscles, staying quiet the whole time.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Morning run with running buddy Chen Jie.
description: I changed into a quick-dry T-shirt and running shoes, put my phone in my pocket, turned the lock, and slipped out quietly. After a five-minute walk, I reached the track outside Sijing Sports Center. At 6:50, my running buddy Chen Jie showed up on time at the track entrance. After a brief warm-up, we ran 6 kilometers along the track at a pace of 5:40 per kilometer, slightly faster than yesterday. After the run, we stretched on a bench by the track. I told him that yesterday's physical exam had found mild fatty liver and about the “Health Rebuilding Plan” I had made. Chen Jie is a fitness trainer; he suggested adding swimming as cross-training, reminded me not to let my core strength drop during the early fat-loss phase, and also recommended a body fat scale brand he thought was good.
location: Outdoor track of Sijing Sports Hall, 351 South Sizhuan Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Go home to shower, prepare picnic supplies and breakfast, and drive off
description: After running home, I found Zhang Wei still sleeping like a log on the sofa. I took a cold shower and changed into clean loungewear. In the kitchen, I took out the bottled water, multigrain steamed buns, a bag of pickled mustard stems, and several vacuum-packed marinated eggs that I had bought yesterday. Then I dug out the cooler and ice packs, packed the food and water in, and stuffed in a few packs of wet wipes and garbage bags. Once everything was ready, I patted Zhang Wei on the shoulder and said, “Weizi, get up. Today I'm taking you to catch some big fish. If you sleep any longer, the sun will be scorching your butt.” Zhang Wei mumbled a reply and turned over. After Zhang Wei slowly finished washing up, we ate steamed buns with pickled mustard stems and marinated eggs. I downed a large glass of warm water, and Zhang Wei drank a carton of milk. After breakfast, I put on the backpack with the picnic supplies, picked up the fishing gear bag and the folding chair, and Zhang Wei followed behind empty-handed. We went downstairs and stuffed everything into the trunk of my silver SUV. I checked the car keys and phone navigation, set the destination, shifted into gear, and set off toward Dianshan Lake.
location: Home at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China, and the parking space downstairs

name: Driving to Dianshan Lake
description: We got onto the Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway, and the drive took about 25 minutes. As I drove, I chatted with Zhang Wei about fishing stories, such as the time I caught a big soft-shelled turtle and another time when I saw a water snake swimming near its den. Zhang Wei leaned back in the passenger seat, listening with great interest, and remarked, "You really have a lot of places to go around Shanghai."
location: The Songjiang to Qingpu section of the Huyu Expressway, Shanghai, China

name: Fishing trip to the west shore of Dianshan Lake
description: When we arrived at the fishing spot, my fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang had already set up his tackle box and rod holder under a crooked willow tree. We exchanged a few pleasantries, and Wu Zhiqiang pointed at a backwater bend and said, "Right there. I chummed the spot with wine-soaked rice this morning, so the crucian carp signals should be good." I helped Zhang Wei adjust his float, baited the hook with an earthworm, and taught him hand by hand how to read the float. It was Zhang Wei's first time fishing properly; he cast the rod and stared at the float intensely. I cast next to the reeds and landed a wild crucian carp of about 150 grams within ten minutes. Zhang Wei exclaimed, "Whoa, there really are fish!" After that, we each guarded our own spots and chatted from time to time, including Wu Zhiqiang's plan to go boat fishing in the depths of Taihu Lake next week. By around 10:30, I had caught four crucian carp (the largest nearly 250 grams), Wu Zhiqiang had caught two small topmouth culter, and Zhang Wei, finally under my guidance, also caught a palm-sized crucian carp and shouted excitedly.
location: Wild fishing spot near the reed marshes, on the west bank of Dianshan Lake, south of the Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway, Jinze Town, Qingpu District, Shanghai, China

name: Lakeside picnic with grilled fish
description: Wu Zhiqiang took a portable electric grill and a folding table out of the trunk, and I laid out the bags of steamed buns and braised eggs. Zhang Wei volunteered to go wash a few fish by the lake, and came back with his pant legs soaked a good deal. Wu Zhiqiang was in charge of gutting and scaling the fish, while I set up the grill and marinated the fish with the cooking oil, salt, and cumin powder we had brought. After about 15 minutes, the grilled fish was sizzling with oil. The three of us sat by the lake eating the fish with steamed buns, pickled mustard, and mineral water. Wu Zhiqiang also poured hot tea from his thermos and shared it with the other two. It tasted much better than eating at a restaurant.
location: Open ground beside the fishing spot on the west bank of Dianshan Lake, Jinze Town, Qingpu District, Shanghai, China

name: Driving home on the return trip
description: The afternoon sun was blazing. Wu Zhiqiang said he wanted to stay until evening, while Zhang Wei and I decided to head home. After packing up the catch and gear, I drove home. Zhang Wei leaned back in the rear seat, scrolled on his phone, and soon fell asleep. The car drove smoothly back to Songjiang Xingang Community. After parking, we carried the fishing gear bags and cooler upstairs.
location: Section of the Shanghai–Chongqing Expressway from Qingpu District to Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Go home to rest and take care of the catch.
description: After entering the house, Zhang Wei collapsed on the living room sofa and turned on the TV to watch variety shows. I poured the crucian carp I caught today into the sink, gutted and scaled them, washed them clean, divided them into portions with fresh-keeping bags, and put them in the freezer. Then I cleaned up the remaining picnic garbage and took it downstairs to the trash can. I poured myself a glass of plain boiled water, wiped the sweat off my face, and changed out of the jacket that smelled of fish.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Python programming study
description: Zhang Wei was lounging on the sofa watching a variety show with the volume turned down low. I opened my laptop and first reviewed the conditional statements and loop syntax I had previewed yesterday, then started writing a small project: a number guessing game. I first built the framework in the text editor, from randomly generating an integer between 1 and 100, to receiving user input, to comparing the numbers and looping feedback. Whenever I hit a bug, I searched for tutorials on CSDN. After about half an hour, the program ran. I then tried nesting a for loop to print the multiplication table and successfully got the output after debugging twice. In my study notes, I recorded all the core code, error causes, and solutions.
location: Home study and bedroom, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Prepare and eat a fat-loss dinner
description: After closing my laptop, I started preparing my fat-loss dinner. I took a digital scale, measuring cup, and steamer out of the cabinet, rinsed the brown rice twice, and cooked it in the rice cooker with a 30-minute countdown. I took the chicken breast out of the fridge to thaw, patted it dry with paper towels, cut it into strips two fingers wide, added a little cooking wine, black pepper, and light soy sauce, mixed it well, and let it marinate. I broke the broccoli into florets, soaked them in salt water for 10 minutes, then drained them. Next, I heated a nonstick pan, sprayed a little oil, spread it with a kitchen brush, and pan-fried the marinated chicken breast strips for 3 minutes on each side until golden and slightly charred, then set them aside. In another pot, I brought water to a boil, added a little salt and two drops of oil, blanched the broccoli for 2 minutes, and drained it. The brown rice was just cooked as well. Using the kitchen scale, I weighed out 180 g of chicken breast, 200 g of broccoli, and 150 g of brown rice, and arranged them neatly on a square plate—about 420 kcal in total. I set Zhang Wei's takeout fried rice and cola on the table. Zhang Wei picked up a piece of broccoli with his chopsticks and tasted it, then frowned and said, "This is way too plain." I smiled and replied, "You'll get used to it. I'm counting on this to lose fat." Then I carefully recorded the ingredients and calories of the meal in my newly bought health journal.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

Zhang Wei picked Hou Yi, and I filled the support role with Zhang Fei. We formed a team, matched with random players, and played three games in a row. Midway, I got up to pour a glass of water, while Zhang Wei grumbled about teammates as he played. We won two out of three. During the games, we talked about the tricky cases Zhang Wei had encountered at the auto repair shop, and I told him I had signed up for the Sheshan Half Marathon two months later.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

After drying my hair, I sat at my desk, took out the health diary, and recorded today's three meals (breakfast: steamed bun + marinated egg; lunch: grilled fish + steamed bun + pickled mustard tuber; dinner: 180g chicken breast + 200g broccoli + 150g brown rice) and activity level (morning run 6 km, about 6,000 steps while fishing) one by one, then gave myself a score of "execution: 98%". Then I opened WeChat and sent a voice message to my girlfriend Lin Yue: "Today's fat-loss dinner is done, chicken breast and brown rice, you supervise. I learned Python this afternoon and felt in good shape." After a while, Lin Yue replied with "Awesome! Keep it up!" and sent a rose emoji.
location: Bathroom and study at home, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

I pulled up tomorrow's rough plan from my phone memo, listed a few items, and turned off the main living room light. 'You should go to bed early. The sofa blanket is in the cabinet.' I checked the doors, windows, and gas valve, then returned to the bedroom.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

I reviewed today's life: morning run, fishing, learning programming, eating a fat-loss meal — very fulfilling. At this rate, the half marathon and a healthy lifestyle are both within reach. At exactly 22:00, I quickly fell asleep.

location: On the bed in the bedroom, No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep review and falling asleep
description: After closing my eyes, I quickly reviewed today's key moments in my mind: the determination after being criticized by my master, the wrong questions from lunchtime practice, and the first use of the Kindle; I briefly planned that on Wednesday I could invite Wang Lei and Engineer Liu to play a few rounds of Honor of Kings in the evening, and then fell asleep with a calm mind.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Natural wake-up and getting ready
description: Woke up 10 minutes before the alarm and turned off the preset 5:30 alarm. Noticed slight soreness in the leg muscles, a result of yesterday's strength training and the ongoing fat-loss routine. Quickly checked the weather on the phone: cloudy, 18–25, suitable for running. Then got up, drank a glass of warm water, and changed into the short-sleeved quick-dry shirt and running shorts prepared the night before.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run of 5 km along Guangfulin Road, out and back.
description: Left the neighborhood at 5:35, warmed up and jogged to the intersection of Guangfulin Road and Chenta Road, and ran at a steady pace along Guangfulin Road toward Dingyuan Road. The first kilometer had a pace of about 6 minutes as a warm-up; by the third kilometer, the soreness in his legs gradually faded and his condition improved. He finally completed 5.01 kilometers at an average pace of 5 minutes 28 seconds per kilometer, taking 28 minutes 07 seconds. He stopped next to a roadside trash can to stretch his calves, then jogged back.
location: Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (section from Chenta Road to Dingyuan Road)

name: Morning stretching, fat-loss breakfast preparation, and shower
description: After returning to my place, I first laid out the yoga mat and did 5 minutes of full-body static stretching, focusing on the front of the thighs and calves. Then I went into the kitchen, measured 50 grams of oats with a measuring cup, added 250 ml of hot milk, and microwaved on high for 2 minutes. At the same time, I boiled two eggs and set a timer for 8 minutes. In the meantime, I weighed myself: 73.0 kg, the same as yesterday, showing that the fat-loss diet and training volume were maintained well. After the eggs were done, I cooled them in cold water, peeled them, took a shower, and changed into clean short-sleeved work clothes and dark trousers.
location: Kitchen and bathroom at Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and getting ready before going out
description: At the dining table, ate oatmeal with milk and boiled eggs while flipping through the last chapter of The Biography of Chu Shijian on an e-book reader. Took a photo of the breakfast with his phone and completed the 'breakfast check-in' in the fat-loss check-in app. Checked the commuter bag: ID badge, power bank, umbrella, and e-reader were all in place. Placed the bag on the shoe cabinet by the door and took the car keys.
location: Dining room, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute by car.
description: At 7:15, drove out of the neighborhood on time, connected Bluetooth and played a cached introductory audio lecture on “Five-Axis Programming”. The route went via Songhui West Road onto Huatianjing Highway, about 12 kilometers in total, with good road conditions, taking 28 minutes. He encountered two red lights on the way, and used the time to silently memorize the “RTCP compensation” concept he had just heard.
location: Driving from Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to No. 360, Huatianjing Highway

name: Arrived at work, prepared, and attended the team morning meeting
description: Arrived at the factory at 7:45, parked the car, clocked in, and went to the workshop changing room to put on work clothes. At the workstation, I turned on the machine tool and checked the day's work order: a batch of shaft-type parts with a precision requirement of 0.01 mm. After getting a clear picture, I attended the team morning meeting promptly at 8:00. Team leader Wang Lei briefly stressed the need to pay attention to quality and takt time for this urgent order, and informed us that a fire drill would be held at 4:30 p.m.
location: Workshop changing room and workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Precision shaft parts machining in the morning
description: He plunged into work right after the morning meeting. Following the drawings and the process flow card, he picked up blanks from the material rack, calibrated the fixture, and called up the finishing program numbered CNC-07. He started the machine at 8:20. The first piece took 40 minutes to machine; he self-checked it with a coordinate measuring machine, and all key dimensions met the requirements. He then began batch production, staying fully focused on the sound of the machine and the condition of the cutting fluid, and did a spot check every 5 pieces. At 10:00, his master Sun Jianguo came by on a routine inspection, looked over the program and the workpiece, nodded without saying a word, and silently approved. At 11:20, he completed 20 pieces as planned and stacked them neatly.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360, Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Before the lunch break, arranged a gaming session with the shift leader
description: During a work break, Yin Hao found Wang Lei looking at his phone in the next office. He poked his head in and asked if he wanted to organize an Honor of Kings team match tonight, suggesting they set up a session at 8 p.m. tomorrow to gain points. Wang Lei smiled and agreed, mentioning that they should call Engineer Liu, saying Liu had recently practiced Guan Yu and was quite powerful. Yin Hao made an OK gesture and noted the arrangement.
location: At the entrance of the workshop office of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Lunchtime discussion with Master about exam preparation and plan revision
description: At 11:50, carrying exam preparation materials, he hurried to the cafeteria. Seeing Master Sun Jianguo eating in a corner, he took his tray and sat at the same table, saying bluntly that he had figured things out and brought questions. The two talked deeply for about 40 minutes over lunch about the key points of the senior technician exam, practical difficulties, and study pace. Master Sun explained in detail the traps in the "Comprehensive Equipment Maintenance Questions" in the theory section and "Precision Fault Elimination" in the practical section, suggested thoroughly studying the three textbooks "NC Technology", "Electrical Control", and "Mechanical Fundamentals", setting aside two fixed hours every Wednesday afternoon and Saturday morning for review, and promised to produce a mock exam after two weeks. After the meal, Yin Hao drafted a new weekly study plan with pen and paper in a corner of the cafeteria.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunchtime study and social interaction
description: Returning to the workshop break area, he first used his phone's memo app to turn the key points of the discussion with his master into an electronic version. Then he sent a WeChat message to his fishing buddy Brother Wu, asking if he was free to go fishing at Dianshan Lake on Saturday afternoon, and asking for advice on the performance of his new fishing rod. While waiting for the reply, he spent about 15 minutes continuing to study Chapter 1 of Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming on the e-reader.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon production and equipment inspection
description: At 13:20, he started the afternoon work, continuing to machine the remaining shaft parts and preparing for the subsequent flange processing. Around 15:00, the production task came to a temporary pause, and he strictly carried out equipment inspection: checked the guide rail lubricant level, added new coolant to the coolant tank, used an air gun to clean residual chips inside and outside the tool magazine, confirmed the tool changer arm operated smoothly, and signed the inspection record sheet. At 16:15, the last workpiece was completed with a 100% pass rate. He locked the machine and tidied up the workstation.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360, Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Fire drill
description: At 16:30 the fire alarm sounded in the factory area, and everyone quickly evacuated along the fire escape route to the open space of the west yard. Under the guidance of the safety officer, Yin Hao took part in a practical fire extinguisher drill: he pulled out the safety pin, aimed at the base of the flame, pressed the handle, and dry powder sprayed out. After the drill, team leader Wang Lei called roll and confirmed everyone was present.
location: Open ground of the factory of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai
