name: Clean the workstation and clock out.
description: Returned to the workshop, used an air gun to clean the workstation and floor, took off work clothes, put the day's work log in his personal locker in the changing room, and clocked out on time at 17:00.
location: Workshop and changing room, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove home by car.
description: Drove back from the factory to Xingang Community. On the way, sent a voice message via Bluetooth to his brother Yin Tao in Suzhou, asked how he was doing, and invited him to join an online gaming session with Wang Lei and others on Saturday night, saying there was also something he wanted to consult him about.
location: Driving from No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Lane 224, Xingang Road

name: Prepared and ate a fat-loss dinner
description: After a short rest at home, I went into the kitchen, marinated the chicken breast with salt and black pepper, then pan-fried it until both sides were golden brown. At the same time, I blanched the broccoli, and the pre-scheduled brown rice was already cooked. At 18:00, a standard fat-loss dinner was served: 120g pan-seared chicken breast, 200g boiled broccoli, and 150g brown rice. While eating, I recorded the day's food in my diary and estimated that the total calories were kept within 1,800 kcal.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening study and entertainment arrangements
description: After the meal and cleanup, I sat down at the desk. First, I replied to Brother Wu on WeChat, confirming the fishing appointment at 2 p.m. on Saturday, and got his promise to teach me fishing techniques. Then I sent a message in the 'Songjiang Three Brothers' WeChat group, reminding Engineer Liu about the 8 p.m. King's Canyon meetup tomorrow, finalizing the arrangement. After that, I turned on the e-reader and, together with the afternoon's notes, formally began studying Chapter 1, 'Tool Axis Control Principles,' of Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming, and drew an RTCP compensation schematic in my notebook.
location: At the bedroom desk, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening shower and review
description: At 19:30, closed the book and went to take a shower. The hot water washed away the fatigue of the day, but his mind was still working on a five-axis programming example he hadn't fully understood. After showering, he changed into a home short-sleeve T-shirt and shorts, sat on the edge of the bed, completed today's exercise record in a phone app, and set a sleep schedule reminder.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Five-axis machining study and family greetings.
description: Returned to the desk, opened the laptop, and searched the video platform for a teaching video on “Five-axis RTCP compensation principle.” Found a detailed 15-minute explanation. After watching it, my earlier confusion suddenly cleared up. Then spent 15 minutes organizing all of today's study notes into the notebook. Afterwards, sent my mother a voice message to let her know I was safe, briefly told her about the day's diet and exercise, and asked about my father.
location: At the bedroom desk, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Plan for tomorrow and relaxing reading
description: At 21:30, he used his pocket notebook to plan the next day's to-dos: bring a fat-loss bento box, submit the equipment inspection form at work, continue doing practice questions at noon, and contact Wang Lei before 7:30 p.m. to finalize the time for playing games together. After that, he leaned against the headboard and read The Biography of Chu Shijian on his e-reader for 20 minutes, feeling the resilience he showed in adversity.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going to bed
description: At 22:00, turned off the bedside lamp on time, set the phone to Do Not Disturb mode, and placed it on the nightstand. Reviewed the day: morning run accomplished, work went smoothly, proactively consulted my mentor, revised exam preparation plan completed, fat-loss meals executed well. Although five-axis programming study has just started and pressure remains, I felt full of fulfillment. Closed my eyes and adjusted my breathing; by around 22:10, breathing was steady and I fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and body log
description: At 5:30 in the morning the alarm went off. I got up immediately, washed my face with cold water to refresh myself, then stepped on the electronic scale and weighed myself. The reading was 72.9 kg, which remained stable, and I felt satisfied. I took a photo of the scale with my phone to save it, and wrote down the Day 5 weight data in my diary, boosting my confidence for the weekend's 10 km run.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Fat-loss breakfast.
description: In the kitchen, he cooked oatmeal with milk in a small pot and boiled eggs in an egg cooker. Meanwhile, he checked the lunchbox and lunch bag prepared last night, and confirmed the work badge and access card in the commuter bag. Then he sat at the dining table and ate the hot oatmeal porridge and boiled eggs. While eating, he checked the "Songjiang Three Brothers" group chat and thought about adjusting the gaming time after the evening live-streamed class.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organize commuting gear
description: Put the fat-loss lunch box (boiled broccoli, pan-fried chicken breast, brown rice) into the lunch bag, and check the commuter bag again: work badge, access card, charged Kindle, and keys; also fill the water bottle. Turn off the lights, put on a long-sleeved T-shirt, take all your belongings, and head out.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting by car and online learning
description: At 7:10 I started the car, connected my phone via Bluetooth, and continued playing the audio course Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming, studying the difficult points of coordinate transformation and simulating tool paths in my mind. While waiting at a red light, I reviewed the program flow that I needed to help Liu Zhiqiang debug in the morning.
location: On the drive from Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to No. 360 Huatianjing Highway

name: Punched in at work, changed clothes, and attended the morning meeting.
description: After arriving at the company, he clocked in, changed into dark blue work clothes, and greeted his mentor Sun Jianguo. At 8:00, he attended the team morning meeting on time. Team leader Wang Lei assigned the day's production tasks, emphasized that the new batch of valve body programs Liu Zhiqiang was responsible for required coordinated debugging, and reminded everyone about the machining accuracy of the connecting plates.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Assisting with valve body program debugging and planning exam preparation during work breaks
description: After the morning meeting, Liu Zhiqiang asked for help with the valve body program simulation issue. I went with him to the F3 CNC machine tool to analyze it together, and we found that the finishing path contained idle tool passes. I suggested modifying the entry point and the tool retraction route. After he made the adjustments, the simulation efficiency improved by about 5%, and he praised me. During a break, I opened the memo app on my phone and refined the new schedule for the senior technician exam preparation, ensuring that I could report to my master on Friday.
location: CNC machine operation area No. F3, workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Plant, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and social adjustment
description: I went to the cafeteria with my colleagues and ate the fat-loss bento I had brought. Wang Lei teased me about eating healthy meals every day, and I replied that I was managing my weight. In the middle of the meal, I sent a message in the “Songjiang Three Brothers” group chat, postponing the evening gaming session to after 9:10, and my friends understood. After the meal, I took a multivitamin tablet.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break: study for the exam and do practice questions.
description: After the meal and chatting with colleagues, I sat down in a corner of the company rest area and spent about 25 minutes on my phone working through the senior technician theory question bank, focusing on the fault diagnosis section. When I felt mentally tired, I stood up and moved my wrists and ankles to prepare for the afternoon work.
location: Rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Connecting plate machining and quality self-inspection.
description: In the afternoon, he machined a new batch of connecting plates. Strictly following the process card, he clamped the blanks, set the tool, and set the coordinates. While the machine was running, he focused on monitoring the feed and the sound of the spindle. For each operation, he used a caliper and thread gauge to self-check the hole diameter and thread depth. All workpieces for the day were completed, with a 100% self-inspection pass rate.
location: CNC machine operation area No. F3, workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Plant, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Equipment maintenance and checking tomorrow's tasks
description: After machining is completed, use an air gun and rag to clean the machine tool's iron chips and cutting fluid, and fill in the 'Daily Equipment Inspection Checklist'. After checking tomorrow's tasks on the dispatch board, change out of work clothes, pack up personal belongings, and get ready to leave work.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving home from work.
description: Drove away from the company at 17:00. On the way, recalling the evening live course content, he felt that Kirchhoff's Current Law in Fundamentals of Electrical Technology was a bit hard to understand, and decided to review it again before class.
location: On the drive from 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Road

name: Shopping at the Xingang Xincun fresh food supermarket
description: On the way, he parked at the entrance of Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket and bought chicken breast, broccoli, and eggs. At checkout, he spotted a newly stocked sugar-free yogurt and grabbed a carton as a snack during his fat-loss period.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing and enjoying a fat-loss dinner
description: After getting home, I quickly marinated the chicken breast, blanched the broccoli, and cooked brown rice. Half an hour later, I enjoyed a high-protein, low-calorie dinner and recorded the approximate calories of the meal in a memo on my phone.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preview before the live class
description: After putting away the dishes and chopsticks, I cleaned the desk, opened the laptop, and logged into the National Open University learning platform. I found the course entry for Electrical Engineering Fundamentals, quickly browsed the printed course outline, and focused on previewing the chapter on Kirchhoff's laws.
location: At the desk in Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Attended the livestream course "Fundamentals of Electrical Technology"
description: The live class started on time. The teacher explained basic concepts and formulas online. While listening, I took notes and jotted down questions I didn't understand in the blank spaces of the book. Before class ended, I completed the online test and got 85% correct. I also took screenshots of the wrong questions and marked them as weak areas.
location: At the desk in Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Finalized the weekend running plan with running buddies.
description: After class, I received a WeChat message from fellow runner Chen Jie. He suggested a warm-up run at 6 a.m. on Saturday in Songjiang Central Park. I agreed readily and reminded him to pay attention to knee warming-up and dynamic stretching. We exchanged recent training insights and said goodnight to each other.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Teaming up with friends to play games
description: In the "Songjiang Three Brothers" group, he started a voice call, logged into Honor of Kings with Gao Zhiyuan and Xiao Ma, played two ranked matches, and won both. Although still wanting more, considering work the next day, he rationally ended the game and said goodnight to each other.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and bedtime review
description: After showering and changing into pajamas, I sat on the bed and took out my theory notes for the senior technician certification, focusing on reviewing the weak points highlighted in red from that day's live class, and looked back at screenshots of the wrong answers to deepen my memory.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: Picked up the Kindle and read the chapter on tool parameters for difficult-to-machine materials from CNC Machining Technology and Programming. Feeling sleepy, I turned off the device and went to sleep. Reflecting that the day had gone smoothly and fully, I set the alarm for 5:30 the next morning and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run and body data recording
description: Your body clock wakes you up ten minutes before the alarm goes off. You step barefoot onto the electronic scale by the bed, and the screen shows 72.8kg, a number that makes the corners of your mouth curl up. You change into a quick-dry T-shirt and athletic shorts, push open the window, and the 17°C morning air rushes in, carrying the fresh scent of plants. You jog along Kungang Highway to Xiaokunshan Health Park, maintaining a 5:20 pace, breathing evenly, feeling better than you did midweek. After the run, you do 12 minutes of stretching in the park's fitness area, and the tightness in the back of your thighs eases.
location: Round trip from near Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, along Kungang Road to Xiaokunshan Health Park

name: Make a fat-loss breakfast and prepare a lunchbox for lunch.
description: After showering, I followed the fat-loss plan in the kitchen: I brewed oatmeal with boiling water, covered it, and let it sit for three minutes, served with two boiled eggs (eating only the egg whites), and washed blueberries sprinkled on top. At the same time, I patted the thawed chicken breast dry, seasoned it with salt and black pepper, and marinated it for eight minutes. I sprayed olive oil in a frying pan and pan-fried it until golden, cut it into thick slices, and arranged it in a lunchbox with blanched broccoli and chilled brown rice. Throughout the whole process, I only drank plain water, and I was aware of the calories in every ingredient: breakfast about 380 kcal, lunchbox about 520 kcal.
location: Kitchen of the rental house in Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the office.
description: Carrying his lunch bag and commuter bag downstairs, he started the silver-gray car. The navigation showed 8.6 km and about 15 minutes. Connecting to the car's Bluetooth out of habit, he opened the audio course Five-Axis Machining Center Programming Techniques downloaded last night, focused on the principle of RTCP tool-tip following, and tried to relate Kirchhoff's laws from last night's electrical class to the machine tool's electrical control logic.
location: Parking lot, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-Shift Preparation and Attending Morning Meeting
description: After clocking in on time, you went to the locker room, changed into navy blue work clothes, and walked into the workshop with a notebook. Team leader Wang Lei was already in front of the whiteboard; he clapped his hands to announce that the flange order was urgent, requiring a chamfer finish of Ra1.6 and a drilling perpendicularity deviation no more than 0.02mm. You silently noted it down. After the meeting, you went to the blank area to check the specs of the 45# steel bars, then to the tool room to check out carbide reamers and thread gauges.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Precision machining of a flange
description: Started the machine tool and warmed it up, set the fixtures according to the process card, used an edge finder to accurately locate the workpiece origin, entered the G54 coordinate system, and performed tool setup one by one. During the first workpiece cutting, he stood in front of the protective glass the whole time listening; the spindle sound was steady with no vibration. He repeatedly self-checked with a vernier caliper and thread gauge, and only after everything passed did he begin batch processing. Midway, he stopped the machine for 20 minutes to change tools, took out his Kindle and opened CNC Machine Tool Fault Diagnosis and Repair, highlighting three common causes of servo motor overload. At 11:30, the first batch of flanges was completed, and a piece-by-piece inspection yielded a 100% pass rate.
location: Beside CNC machine tool No. 3, Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Lunch and vocational skills practice questions
description: In the noisy cafeteria, he found a corner seat with his own lunch box. While eating chicken breast and broccoli, he opened the "Vocational Skill Certification" question-practice app on his phone and completed 25 single-choice and true/false questions on CNC programming and technology during lunch, getting 3 wrong. The questions involved thread machining command formats, cutting fluid selection principles, and heat treatment process arrangement. He took screenshots and saved them to ask the master tomorrow. He did not watch any videos on his phone the whole time and only drank the free plain water from the cafeteria.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Master-apprentice technical Q&A exchange
description: After dinner, he found Master Sun drinking tea in the rest area, opened the notes from last night's electrical engineering course on his Kindle, and asked about the application of Kirchhoff's current law in variable-frequency circuits. Master Sun used the actual working condition of the spindle motor accelerating and decelerating during the morning flange machining as an analogy to explain the current distribution relationship, and he also recalled an accident years ago when a capacitor was soldered incorrectly and caused a frequency converter to explode. He listened carefully and quickly wrote down the key points and the lesson from the case in his notebook.
location: Round table by the window in the rest area of the canteen at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Leave request and work handover.
description: Back in the workshop, he went straight into Wang Lei's office and asked for two and a half hours of personal leave that afternoon. Wang Lei checked the shift schedule and readily agreed, instructing him to take over the shell machining job and complete the equipment daily inspection before leaving. After acknowledging, Yin Hao finished the precision machining and self-inspection of the last shell, carefully cleaned away the chips, wiped the guide rails, applied anti-rust oil, and filled in the equipment daily inspection record sheet.
location: Workshop Office, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Midday rest and preparation for departure
description: After finishing the handover, he sat down on the old sofa in the corner of the rest area and closed his eyes for 15 minutes to relieve the slight swelling in his temples caused by prolonged concentration. Then he took out his Kindle and quickly flipped through the servo motor overload troubleshooting case to be discussed in the afternoon, and used Baidu Maps on his phone to preview the driving route from the company to Liu Fang's old residence in Pudong: take the G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway and switch to the S20 Outer Ring Expressway, with an estimated travel time of 1 hour 10 minutes.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Drove to Pudong to help a classmate move.
description: Changed into clean sweatpants and a T-shirt, said goodbye, and left the workshop. Traffic was smooth in the afternoon; he kept cruise control at 100 km/h on the highway while silently planning the rest of his schedule. Arrived at Zuchongzhi Road, Pudong at 15:25, 5 minutes earlier than the agreed time.
location: At the entrance of an old residential community, Lane 2277, Zuchongzhi Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Helped a classmate move, which triggered housing anxiety.
description: Liu Fang was already waiting at the entrance of the unit, surrounded by cardboard boxes and woven bags. The three of you, plus the two Lalamove movers, worked together to move the luggage. The stairwell was narrow and cramped, and the air was mixed with the smell of cooking oil and dust. You carried a heavy book box down from the third floor, your back slightly damp, and caught a glimpse of her old room, less than 20 square meters, with mottled walls. After moving to the new apartment at Zhangjiang Road Technology Park, the environment was clean and the elevator was spacious, but the physical labor of moving everything up to the 12th floor still made your arms sore. While arranging the luggage, standing in the empty living room and looking through the window at the residential complex below and the buildings in the distance, an uncontrollable thought came to mind: "When will I ever have a space like this?"
location: Floor 12, Building 15, Zhangjiang Road Technology Park Apartment, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (moved in from the old residence at Lane 2277, Zuchongzhi Road)

name: Had dinner with classmates
description: After finishing work, Liu Fang insisted on treating him to a meal to express her gratitude, and the two walked into the Shaxian Snacks restaurant at the entrance of the neighborhood. She ordered two portions of steamed dumplings, one portion of soup dumplings, and two bowls of wontons. She sighed that she had finally settled down in Zhangjiang; although the rent was expensive, the environment was much better. You nodded, picked up a steamed dumpling, and looked out the window at the neighborhood lights dimming in the twilight, feeling a subtle envy and anxiety in your heart. She asked about your recent situation, and you only vaguely replied, 'Not bad, same as usual,' without mentioning the apartment viewing.
location: Inside the Shaxian Snacks restaurant on the ground floor of the Science Park Apartments on Zhangjiang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drove back to the rental apartment in Songjiang
description: After saying goodbye to Liu Fang, he got into the car. The evening rush hour had just ended, so the road conditions on the way back were good. He did not listen to the audio course; the car was quiet. His mind kept replaying the contrast between Liu Fang's old and new residences, the view outside her new apartment window, and his own dim, cluttered rental room. His right hand tapped on the steering wheel unconsciously, and he felt a lump in his chest. At 19:10, he drove into the familiar Xingang Community. After parking, he sat in the car for two minutes before opening the door.
location: Underground parking garage, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare a fat-loss dinner
description: After entering the door, the stuffy and cramped air made you feel a bit irritable. You didn't turn on the TV and went straight into the kitchen. You took out the other piece of chicken breast and broccoli left over from lunch, boiled them, and sprinkled black pepper on top. Sitting at the table, the chicken was dry and the broccoli bland. You didn't have much appetite, but you managed to eat most of it, drank half a glass of water, rinsed the dishes, and placed them on the drying rack.
location: Kitchen of the rental house in Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Called mother to ask about house prices
description: After washing the dishes, sat back on the sofa, the anxiety like a stone pressing on my chest. Sent a voice message to Mom on WeChat, first talking about helping a classmate move, keeping the tone light, saying the new rented place is quite bright and spacious. Then changed the subject and casually asked how much per square meter second-hand homes cost in a newly launched development in the county town back home. Mom quickly replied with the price and asked in return whether I planned to buy a house. I laughed and said I was just asking, then added a question about my brother's monthly mortgage payment for his apartment in Suzhou.
location: On the sofa in the living room of the rental house in Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Late-night online house viewing and financial calculations
description: After the call ended, his nerves were even more strained. Taking a deep breath, he opened the Lianjia app and for the first time carefully set the filter conditions: Songjiang District, total price 1.5–2 million yuan, unit price below 30,000 yuan per square meter. He scrolled through listings one by one and saved three properties: a two-bedroom unit in Sijing from 2005 with a total price of 1.78 million yuan, a small two-bedroom nearly new home in the Sheshan area with a total price of 1.95 million yuan, and a simply decorated home in Jiuting with a total price of 1.63 million yuan. Using the calculator to roughly estimate with the current LPR rate and down payment ratio, even if he scraped together a 600,000-yuan down payment, the monthly mortgage payment would exceed 7,000 yuan, more than 60% of his current monthly income. He repeatedly switched through the photos of the saved properties until the low battery warning lit up on his phone.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wash up and tidy up before bed.
description: He turned off the phone screen and rubbed his brow, his mind still full of housing prices and monthly payment figures. He walked into the bathroom, looked at his tired reflection in the mirror, and mechanically squeezed toothpaste, brushed his teeth, and washed his face. Back in the bedroom, he took out a sticky note and wrote two reminders: tomorrow at 6:00 at Xiaokunshan Health Park to find Chen Jie for a 10K pace run, and on Sunday at the Dianshan Lake fishing spot for Brother Wu's fishing meetup. He stuck the note on the bedside lampshade, laid out tomorrow's running clothes and shoes, and plugged in his phone charging cable.
location: Bathroom and bedroom of the rented apartment in Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Reflection before bed and falling asleep.
description: He turned over on the 1.2-meter-wide single bed, the mattress bouncing up and down. He picked up his phone again and opened Lianjia, instinctively zooming in on the photos of that two-bedroom apartment in Sijing, carefully examining the kitchen cabinets and the bay window. Then he looked up at his own room cluttered with stuff and yellowed ceiling. The sharp contrast made it hard to breathe. He turned off his phone and forced himself to close his eyes, but in his mind the housing prices his mother had mentioned, the monthly mortgage he had calculated, and the view from the window of Liu Fang's new apartment were all intertwined, like crackling TV static. Amid anxiety and exhaustion, his breathing gradually became steady. The faint sound of traffic from the elevated road outside in the distance drifted in, and he finally fell into a deep sleep.
location: On the bed in the rental room, Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning stretching and core training
description: The 7 a.m. alarm went off; hearing the sound of rain outside the window, I knew the planned 10 km outdoor run had to be canceled. After getting up, I did some simple stretches for my sore lower back from yesterday's move, then opened the window to feel the damp air. I unrolled the yoga mat, opened the Keep app, and started with a 10-minute dynamic warm-up, followed by core training: 5 sets of 1-minute planks, 4 sets of 15 resistance band glute bridges, and 3 sets of mountain climbers. Finally, I did a 15-minute full-body deep stretch, focusing on relaxing the legs and shoulders that were overused during the move. Sweat soaked my vest, and my body felt loosened up.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: High-protein breakfast for fat loss
description: After exercising, he went into the kitchen, heated a bowl of instant oats in the microwave, added milk, and paired it with two boiled eggs and a few washed cherry tomatoes, quickly preparing a high-protein, fat-loss breakfast. While eating, he checked the weather on his phone and confirmed that the light rain would continue until noon.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Weekend chores, shopping, and meal prep
description: After breakfast, I cleaned the house, carefully scrubbed the kitchen stove and the grease on the range hood, then opened up and flattened the scattered cardboard boxes from express deliveries in the living room, tied them together, and prepared to discard them. Then I changed into a coat, took an eco-friendly shopping bag, and walked five minutes to Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket. Following the memo on my phone, I bought fat-loss ingredients: two chicken breasts, one broccoli, a carton of eggs, a bag of whole-wheat bread, and two bottles of sugar-free yogurt. After going home, I washed the cutting board and kitchen knife, cut the chicken breasts into small pieces, divided them into meal portions in fresh-keeping bags, and froze them for later. I broke the broccoli into small florets, washed and drained them, and refrigerated them.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road

name: Video call with mother.
description: After finishing the housework, he sat on the sofa and made a video call to his mother, Wang Xiuying, on WeChat. His mother was sitting in the living room of their hometown home. They talked about the weather in Shanghai, and he asked about his father's lower back pain. His mother said that yesterday she went to the town clinic to get medicated plasters again, but they didn't work well; there was too much farm work and he just wouldn't stay idle. Yin Hao's heart sank. He knew his father was stubborn and couldn't be talked out of it, so he could only repeatedly tell him to avoid heavy work. His mother, in turn, was worried about him being exhausted from the move and told him to be willing to spend money on better food. They chatted about family matters for half an hour before hanging up, and a slight anxiety about the future stirred again in his heart.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning relaxation and lunch
description: After the phone call, I sat on the sofa and opened Bilibili, watched a few popular science videos on five-axis programming and CNC machining tool selection, letting my brain switch away from housework and family conversations. Then I began preparing lunch. Strictly following the fat-loss plan, I boiled the chicken breast that had been portioned in the morning, shredded it, paired it with blanched broccoli, sliced cherry tomatoes, and lettuce, and drizzled it with vinaigrette, making a refreshing boiled chicken breast salad. While eating, I went over the afternoon study plan in my mind.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Noon break and phone browsing
description: After lunch and cleaning up the dishes, he felt tired because he had not slept well the night before due to anxiety. Lying in bed, he scrolled through Bilibili videos about five-axis programming for a while, and also replied to messages in the "Songjiang Three Brothers" group, chatting about where to go on Sunday. After about half an hour, he put down his phone and rested with his eyes closed for about an hour, which relieved some of the fatigue.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon Python study and short break
description: At 1:30 pm, I sat down at my desk and opened my laptop and textbooks. Today's core task was to write a "Student Information Management System" project by comprehensively applying variables, lists, dictionaries, loops, and conditional statements. After creating a new Python file, I started typing code. Midway, I ran into a list index out-of-range bug. I checked line by line and found that the loop condition was written incorrectly. After fixing it, the program ran smoothly and implemented the add, delete, modify, and query functions for student information. I saved the code and recorded in my study notes the pitfall I encountered and the solution in detail. After studying continuously for more than two hours, I walked to the balcony and looked into the distance at the green space to relax my eyes, breathing the fresh air after the rain and giving my body and eyes a short rest.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Review for the senior technician exam.
description: Returned to the desk, switched my mindset, took out the exercise book for the CNC Machine Tool Setup and Maintenance Worker (Senior Technician) exam, and started a timed practice session on the multiple-choice questions in Chapter 1. Completed 50 questions in 45 minutes with 78% accuracy. Circled all the wrong questions in red pen, wrote down the reasons for mistakes and the correct knowledge points beside them, and for difficult problems involving complex calculations and design principles, reopened the corresponding chapters of the textbook to review and highlighted them with a marker.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Light meal and free time
description: After studying, I cooked myself a bowl of tomato and egg noodles as a simple dinner. While eating the noodles, I checked WeChat. Wang Lei, a colleague from whom I had secretly learned a new debugging technique, sent a message, and the two of us chatted on WeChat for about ten minutes about that technical detail. After dinner, I cleaned up the kitchen, curled up on the sofa, opened Bilibili, and casually watched a video about the selection of CNC machining tools.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Confirming tomorrow's plan with fishing buddy Brother Wu
description: Fishing buddy Brother Wu called to confirm the plan to go fishing at Dianshan Lake tomorrow and asked about the preparation of fishing rods and bait. Yin Hao replied that everything was ready. The two agreed to meet at the community gate at 6:30 tomorrow morning. They also talked about the recent fishing conditions. Brother Wu mentioned a newly discovered river bend that was said to have big fish, which made Yin Hao look forward to tomorrow's outing a little more.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening gaming and socializing.
description: After hanging up, he felt a little more relaxed. He sent a WeChat message to Liu Fang, the classmate who had helped him move the day before, and she said she would bring him the items he had left behind on Monday. Then he surfaced in the 'Songjiang Three Brothers' group chat. Gao Zhiyuan and Xiao Ma were talking about playing games together in the evening. Yin Hao joined in, and the three connected via voice and played ranked matches in Honor of Kings, winning two and losing one. They chatted and laughed, which temporarily eased his anxiety.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep preparation and mindfulness meditation
description: After finishing the game, he went to the bathroom to wash up and take a shower, then changed into pajamas. He then took out his phone, connected it to a Bluetooth speaker, and did a 10-minute mindfulness meditation with the 'Tide' app, closing his eyes and focusing on his breath, trying to temporarily push worries about the mortgage and his father's health out of his mind and calm down.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime reading and planning for tomorrow
description: After meditation, he felt much calmer inside. He picked up the Kindle on the bedside table and flipped through Peak, reading the chapter on building mental representations, which mirrored his experiences learning Python and preparing for CNC certification. After putting down the Kindle, he mentally planned tomorrow's schedule: get up at 6:00, pack the fishing gear, and wait at 6:25 for Brother Wu to pick him up to go fishing at Dianshan Lake. He set the alarm and turned off the desk lamp.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: The rain outside the window had long stopped; the night in Songjiang was very quiet. He closed his eyes, carrying a bit of anticipation for tomorrow's fishing and a lingering unease. His breathing gradually calmed, and he fell asleep peacefully.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning preparations and meeting up before departure
description: The alarm rang right on time, and he got up promptly. After washing up, he changed into his racing outfit and checked his race bib, energy gels, salt tablets, and sports earphones. He ate whole-wheat bread and a banana and drank warm water. After packing his gear, he went out and met his fishing buddy Brother Wu at the community gate. Brother Wu handed him a Red Bull, and they exchanged small talk.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the Sheshan race venue
description: Riding in Wu Ge's car, they set off from Xingang Residential Community, heading along Songhui West Road and Chenta Road to Shanghai Sheshan National Forest Park. On the way, the two talked about the race route and Wu Ge's previous fishing catch; the drive took about 27 minutes.
location: Parking lot of Sheshan National Forest Park, No. 9258 Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Parked and walked to the starting area.
description: Arrived at the Sheshan National Forest Park parking lot. Brother Wu helped find a parking space. After getting out of the car, Yin Hao followed the crowd to the starting area. There were many runners around and the atmosphere was lively.
location: Sheshan National Forest Park, 9258 Waiqingsong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bag storage, warm-up, and final checks
description: Arrived at the starting area, which was lively and crowded. After storing his change of clothes and extra belongings, he jogged about 800 meters in an open area to warm up, then did dynamic stretches such as high knees, side lunges, torso twists, and jumping jacks, focusing on loosening up his hips and knees. Finally, he carefully checked that his shoelaces were tied tight.
location: Starting area, Sheshan National Forest Park, 9258 Waiqingsong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waiting for the start in the starting area
description: Waiting in the finisher assembly area for 1 hour 50 minutes to 2 hours, surrounded by runners. Adjusting breathing, putting on earphones and playing music, reminding myself to control the pace, not sprinting before the 15 km mark.
location: Assembly Area, Sheshan National Forest Park, 9258 Waiqingsong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Completed the Sheshan Half Marathon
description: At 7:30 the starting gun went off, and I rushed out of the arch with the crowd. The first kilometer was run at a pace of 5 minutes 25 seconds, and I held the pace as planned. The first 10 km went smoothly; at the 8 km and 15 km aid stations I took energy gels and drank water. At 17 km there was a gentle slope challenge; I adjusted my cadence and increased my arm swing to power through. In the last kilometer I sped up and crossed the finish line, finishing in a net time of 1 hour 52 minutes 08 seconds and getting the medal.
location: Course at Sheshan National Forest Park, 9258 Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Post-race recovery and supplies pickup.
description: After crossing the finish line, he walked slowly for a few hundred meters to lower his heart rate. Volunteers hung the finisher medal around his neck and handed him the finisher bag (mineral water, banana, energy bar, quick-dry towel). On the lawn, he wiped sweat with the towel while stretching the front and back of his thighs and his calves.
location: Finish area of Sheshan National Forest Park, 9258 Waiqingsong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Social media sharing and reporting that one is safe.
description: He rested on the lawn at the finish line, using his phone to take pictures of the medal, the finish arch, and selfies. He sent the results screenshot to his running buddy Chen Jie: “Brother Jie, I did it! 1 hour 52 minutes!” Then he sent a selfie and voice message to the “Songjiang Morning Running Group,” announcing that he had finished the race safely and praising the course scenery. Everyone in the group congratulated him.
location: Lawn at the terminal area of Sheshan National Forest Park, 9258 Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Brother Wu drove me back to Xingang Residential Community
description: After finishing the race and picking up his bag, Brother Wu was already waiting at the exit. After getting in the car, he showed the medal to Brother Wu, who admired it and suggested celebrating in the evening. On the way, he replied to congratulatory WeChat messages and arranged to play games with Wang Lei at night. Brother Wu dropped him off at the entrance of the residential community.
location: Today Yin Hao got up at 06:15, weighing 74.2 kg. In the morning, he did a 5 km recovery run with an average pace of 6 min/km. His total steps for the day were about 11,000. He paid attention to a healthy diet; lunch and dinner were both low in oil and salt and high in protein. In the evening, he reviewed the National Open University course and began trying a pre-sleep relaxation exercise. He would go to sleep at 23:15.

name: Returning home for a shower and lunch
description: Returned to the rented apartment, took off the soaked clothes, took a hot shower, and changed into dry loungewear. For lunch, made a sandwich with whole wheat bread, ready-to-eat chicken breast and lettuce, paired with a protein shake, to quickly replenish protein and carbs.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Emotional reflection after finishing the race.
description: After eating his fill, he lay on the sofa, repeatedly running his fingers over the finisher medal, with a strong sense of achievement. But seeing the small rented room and remembering the new apartment he had helped colleague Liu Fang move into, the pressure of reality surged up. He decided to officially put apartment hunting on the agenda.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Systematic browsing of second-hand housing listings and financial calculations
description: Opened the real estate app and filtered for properties in Songjiang District with a total price of 1.5 to 2 million yuan, 60–80 square meters, and built after 2000, focusing on the three areas of Jiuting, Sijing, and Songjiang Old Town. I saved 7 listings. Then I took out my calculator and worked out the financial gap: assuming a total price of 1.8 million yuan, a down payment of 540,000 yuan, and taxes and agency fees of 50,000 yuan, the total needed is 590,000 yuan. Current savings are 345,000 yuan, leaving a hard shortfall of 245,000 yuan. I listed the borrowing channels: older brother Yin Tao (50,000–80,000 yuan), parents (30,000–50,000 yuan), and available credit card limit.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go out for a walk and buy fresh groceries
description: Feeling chest tightness, he went out for a walk along the neighborhood greenway to get some fresh air. To also prepare dinner ingredients, he walked to Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket and bought sea bass, water spinach, soft tofu, tomatoes, and unsweetened yogurt.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket and surrounding area, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Prepare and enjoy a fat-loss dinner.
description: After getting home, he started cooking. Steamed sea bass (with ginger slices and scallion segments, steamed for 10 minutes, then drizzled with steamed fish soy sauce and hot oil), stir-fried water spinach with minced garlic, and tomato and tofu soup. A single-person meal with two dishes and one soup; while eating, he still couldn't help scrolling through his saved house listings.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with mother and financial organization
description: After dinner, he had a video call with his mother, Wang Xiuying, told her the good news of finishing the half marathon, showed her the medal, and asked about his father's lower back pain. He did not mention the pressure of buying a house. After hanging up, he took out his notebook, recopied a brief financial gap statement listing the gap of 245,000 yuan, his own savings, and the amount he could borrow, and wrote out a comparison plan for a combined loan.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Casual gaming on Honor of Kings
description: To release stress, he opened Honor of Kings and teamed up in a three-person squad with gaming friends including Wang Lei and Gao Zhiyuan. They played three rounds, chatting about the marathon and the new hero while playing.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Mindfulness meditation and reading.
description: After washing up, he dimmed the lights, sat cross-legged on his bed, and used a meditation app for 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation, focusing on his breath to relieve anxiety about buying a home. He then read Deliberate Practice for 15 minutes, reflecting on the connection between mental representations and marathon pacing.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Review and preparation before bed
description: In the phone memo, he jotted down two key things: half marathon finish 1h52min, and the house-viewing plan started, confirming a funding gap of about 245,000 yuan. Then he browsed advanced technician exam questions and scrolled through Douyin to look at guides for avoiding pitfalls when buying a first home in Shanghai. The gap kept running through his mind, but he told himself to take it one step at a time.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Turned off my phone, put on a sleep mask, and set the alarm for tomorrow at 5:40. My body was extremely tired, and I soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning recovery swimming
description: The alarm went off, and the soreness in the front of his thighs from yesterday's half marathon reminded Ahao of his body's fatigue. He put on his swim trunks and quick-dry T-shirt, and drove to Songjiang Swimming Pool at 6 a.m. It took about 15 minutes on the road, arriving at 6:15. There weren't many people at the morning session. Ahao swam slowly along the lane for 40 minutes, mainly freestyle, deliberately reducing his kicking force to let his leg muscles relax in the water. After swimming, he rinsed with warm water in the locker room and spent 15 minutes doing thorough stretches, focusing on his sore calves and quadriceps. He felt much more relaxed overall.
location: Songjiang Swimming Pool, No. 143 Rongle Middle Road, Yongfeng Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Go home, wash up, have a nutritious breakfast, and prepare meals
description: After swimming, A Hao returned home and quickly took a shower. Breakfast was the overnight oats cup prepared last night (milk + oats + chia seeds + blueberries) and a boiled egg. While eating, he stuffed his prepared fat-loss lunch box (stir-fried chicken breast with broccoli, corn kernels, brown rice) into his backpack. He casually opened the running group chat and saw his running buddy Chen Jie @ him, congratulating him on yesterday's half marathon. He replied with an emoji, but the thought of the pressure of buying a house weighed on his mood again.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinbang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Commuting and fragmented browsing of real estate information
description: Ah Hao set off with his bag, first walking to the subway station and taking Line 9 to Sijing Station. The carriage was crowded, so he held the handrail and opened a property app, looking only at the average community prices and listings with the same floor plan in the areas where his saved homes were located. He took screenshots of 2 new listings. He deliberately avoided total prices and only analyzed basic data. When the subway signal got worse, he put away his phone, got off at Sijing Station, and walked to the company shuttle stop.
location: Shanghai Metro Line 9 carriage, China (from Songjiang Xinbang Station to Sijing Station)

name: Focused on production and quality control in the morning
description: A Hao arrived at work, changed into his work clothes, and attended the team morning meeting. The workshop director reported a minor fault in one piece of equipment yesterday and reminded everyone to inspect before starting up. Today’s task was rough machining a batch of stainless steel gear blanks for an urgent order from an overseas client. After starting the machine tool, he carefully checked the tool compensation and fixture accuracy, and only loaded the material after confirming they were correct. From 9:00 to 11:00, he operated with full concentration, performing a first-piece inspection with a roughness tester every 5 parts to ensure precision. His master, Sun Jianguo, passed by and praised him for doing an excellent job, saying the surface finish was fine, which made him feel much more reassured.
location: A3 Workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch break: bring-your-own fat-loss meal and loan estimate
description: When the lunch bell rang, colleague Wang Lei invited Ahao to try the newly opened braised chicken restaurant. Ahao, saying he needed to eat clean for recovery after running, took out his own lunchbox. The two sat together; Wang Lei ate a chicken leg while Ahao ate his fat-loss meal. But he couldn't resist opening another real estate platform and, based on the listing he had screenshotted in the morning, used a calculator to estimate a loan plan: he calculated the monthly payment based on a 30% down payment and an average price of 2.5 million yuan. After mentally calculating his income and housing fund, his expression turned grave. Then he took a hard bite of broccoli and told himself to get to work first and think about it after work.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Continuous work in the afternoon and improved efficiency
description: At 1 p.m., A Hao returned to the machine tool on time and first spent 15 minutes resting with his eyes closed. After recovering his energy, he continued processing the remaining gears. With five years of experience, he knew the machine tool's performance inside out, and even fine-tuned the robot's loading and unloading rhythm, reducing auxiliary time by about 8 seconds. By 2:30 p.m., he completed rough machining of all 36 pieces, with a 100% pass rate. He skillfully filled out the equipment inspection checklist and the workpiece transfer card. With time remaining before the end of the shift, he took out 'Deliberate Practice' in the break room and read for 10 minutes, gaining new understanding of how to improve operational skills.
location: A3 Workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Team safety meeting
description: The workshop director called the team together for a safety meeting. He reported an accident in which a machine collision was caused by a wrench not being removed according to procedure, stressed that safety must not be relaxed while rushing work before the holiday, and specifically named the rules for tool clamping and safety door operation in rough machining. Ahao listened carefully and noted new safety check items in his phone memo, reminding himself to check the spindle tool gripper again before starting work tomorrow.
location: Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. A3 Workshop Team Area, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: After-work commute and urban observation
description: Ahao clocked out and got on the company shuttle bus, chose a window seat, and watched the evening rush-hour traffic outside. After transferring to the subway, he no longer looked at real estate listings, but instead observed the various people in the car — office workers leaving work, middle school students after school, and parents holding children. The crowded city made him yearn even more for a corner of his own. About 40 minutes later, he returned to Xingang Residential Community.
location: Carriage on Line 9 of Shanghai Metro, Shanghai, China (Sijing Station to Songjiang Xinbang Station), and the company shuttle bus

name: Dinner and meal log.
description: After washing his hands when he got home, Ahao baked a thawed basa fillet in the air fryer, sprinkled it with black pepper and lemon juice, and stir-fried lettuce to go with brown rice for dinner. While eating, he opened the Health app to record ingredient portions, keeping today's intake within 1,500 kcal.
location: Kitchen, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinbang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Talked with elder brother Yin Tao on the phone about buying a home.
description: A Hao called his older brother Yin Tao via WeChat video. His brother was bathing his nephew, and the screen was all a flurry. After they talked about work and their father's back pain, A Hao naturally steered the conversation toward buying a house. He said that looking at second-hand houses in Shanghai made him feel a lot of pressure, without revealing his exact budget. He just asked how his brother had scraped together the down payment when buying a house in Suzhou, and whether the family had helped. Yin Tao dried his hands and seriously advised him to first find out how much he could borrow, have a regular bank calculate his cash flow, and not be misled by agents. This conversation calmed A Hao down, and he noted in his memo: consult the bank about the loan amount.
location: Living room, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinbang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: At-home core and stretching workout
description: To speed up recovery, Ahao changed into sports shorts and laid out the yoga mat on the living room floor. He first did 5 minutes of plank (in two sets), then 20 glute bridges and 30 side-lying leg raises (15 each side). Finally, he focused on static stretching of the hamstrings, hip flexors, and calves, holding each area for 20 seconds, which relieved the tightness caused by prolonged sitting.
location: Living room, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinbang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Washing up, mindfulness meditation, and reading.
description: A Hao took a comfortable hot bath and changed into pajamas. At 9 p.m., he sat cross-legged on the bed, set a 10-minute meditation timer, and followed the app's guidance to focus on breathing. When anxious thoughts drifted by, he silently repeated 'observe it, let it go' and gently pulled his focus back. After meditation, he felt much calmer. He picked up his e-book reader and read the last 10 pages of Chapter 3 of 'Deliberate Practice', highlighting notes on mental representations.
location: Bedroom, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinbang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Tomorrow's planning and going to bed
description: Ahao opened the memo on his phone and wrote down three goals for tomorrow: ask Wang Lei during the lunch break which bank and interest rate he used for buying his house; drive to work tomorrow to avoid the subway rush hour and check the car ahead of time; and find some five-axis programming study materials. He set an alarm for 5:50 a.m. (he could sleep 20 more minutes tomorrow since he wouldn't be swimming). At exactly 10 p.m., he turned off the light, lay down, listened to the traffic outside, and drifted into sleep with the new goals.
location: Bedroom, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinbang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Relaxing morning bike ride
description: After getting up in the early morning, his leg muscles were still slightly sore, so he decided to do a low-intensity recovery ride. He wheeled his mountain bike downstairs, headed north along Xingang Road, then took Tamin Highway to the Songjiang Central Park greenway. He rode for about 40 minutes at low resistance and high cadence, keeping his heart rate around 120, focusing on moving his knee and ankle joints. After the ride, the stiffness in his legs was noticeably relieved.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Songjiang Central Park Greenway

name: Shower and breakfast preparation
description: After riding home, I immediately took a shower, rinsing my muscles with warm water and flushing my legs with cold water to promote recovery, then changed into a clean work T-shirt and work pants. After that, I prepared breakfast: scrambled two eggs with black pepper and mixed two scoops of protein powder — a simple and efficient way to replenish protein.
location: Room 304, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Self-Drive Commute and Pre-Work Preparation
description: Put on my jacket, grabbed my keys and lunch bag, and went downstairs. I drove along Chenta Road, turned onto Huatianjing Highway, and arrived at Shanghai Precision Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. 15 minutes later. After entering the factory area, I changed into anti-static work clothes in the locker room, put on goggles and earplugs, organized my workstation, and got ready for the day's work.
location: Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Team morning meeting and urgent-order mobilization
description: The entire team held a morning meeting. Team leader Wang Lei relayed the urgent task of delivering precision valve body parts within three days. Yin Hao voluntarily applied for overtime and discussed process optimization with his mentor Sun Jianguo and programmer Liu Zhiqiang. He suggested modifying the clamping and positioning method, which was affirmed by Sun Jianguo.
location: Team study room, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning routine work and process preparation for urgent orders
description: Returned to the machine tool to handle the daily quota workpiece processing tasks, strictly following the process card to ensure a good yield rate. Around 10 o'clock, held a 15-minute stand-up meeting with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang next to the air compressor in the workshop, finalizing the process parameters and division of labor for the evening overtime: Yin Hao was responsible for core machine tool operation, Liu Zhiqiang fine-tuned the program and monitored the cutting tools, and Wang Lei handled clamping and measurement.
location: CNC Machining Area, Workshop 1, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and loan information inquiries
description: Brought his own fat-loss bento (mixed grain rice, pan-fried chicken breast, blanched broccoli) and ate with team leader Wang Lei in the employee cafeteria. He asked Wang Lei if he knew anyone in banking, hoping to consult about a loan. Wang Lei agreed to refer Manager Zhang, who specializes in personal loans. Yin Hao felt that his goal of buying a house was one step closer.
location: Employee cafeteria, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and technical study
description: In a quiet corner of the employee lounge, he put on earphones and used his phone to browse introductory materials on five-axis simultaneous machining programming, search for Heidenhain system basics, quickly scan technical forums and short video tutorials, and jot down key concepts and research directions in the memo app.
location: Employee rest area, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon routine work and checking home-buying policies.
description: Returned to the workstation and continued machining the workpiece. Around 15:30, chatted with Liu Zhiqiang in the smoking area. Liu Zhiqiang mentioned Kunshan's housing purchase subsidies for technical talent and suggested Yin Hao also check Shanghai's relevant policies. Inspired, Yin Hao immediately searched on his phone for “Shanghai technical talent housing purchase subsidy” and saved the relevant webpages.
location: Workshop Processing Area/Smoking Area, Shanghai Precision Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Having a meal before overtime work and obtaining a loan contact
description: After work, Yin Hao went with Wang Lei to the Laodifang fast-food restaurant across from the factory area and had rice with toppings to build up energy for night overtime. During the meal, Wang Lei shared the WeChat business card of Manager Zhang from the bank. Yin Hao thanked him sincerely, feeling that the home loan was beginning to look promising.
location: Old Place Fast Food, opposite No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Overtime at night: rough machining of precision valve body
description: The three-person team used the workshop's most efficient five-axis machining center for rough machining of precision valve bodies. Yin Hao started the machine and loaded the optimized program, Wang Lei handled lifting and clamping, and Liu Zhiqiang monitored the program and cutting tools. They worked seamlessly, rotated tasks, and efficiently completed the first batch of machining work.
location: Machining center in Workshop 1, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Finishing work and driving home
description: After finishing overtime, I cleaned the iron filings off the machine tools, neatly stacked the parts, and clocked out. Dragging my tired body, I drove back to Xingang Community along Huatianjing Road and Chenta Road, rolling down the window to let the breeze blow away the fatigue.
location: From 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road.

name: Washed up and went to bed
description: After entering the house, he immediately took a hot shower; the hot water relieved his fatigue, and he changed into a loose T-shirt and shorts. In the bedroom he set the alarm, turned off the light and lay down. The strong sense of exhaustion quickly sent him into a deep sleep.
location: Room 304, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning rehabilitation exercises.
description: The 6 a.m. alarm went off, and rain was pattering softly outside the window. You stretched in bed and felt soreness in the front of your thighs. You unrolled the yoga mat and started a 30-minute rehabilitation session: using a foam roller to focus on loosening the quadriceps and iliotibial band, rolling each side for 3 minutes; doing 3 sets of gluteus medius activation exercises with a resistance band; and completing 20 standard push-ups and a 1-minute plank. Your body was slightly sweaty, and you felt good.
location: Room 303, Building 5, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Added the bank manager on WeChat and prepared breakfast.
description: After training, you leaned against the kitchen counter and opened WeChat. From your contacts, you found "Bank of Shanghai - Manager Zhang", clicked to add him as a friend, and wrote a note saying you wanted to consult about personal housing loans. After sending the request, you took an egg out of the fridge and boiled it, and made a cup of oatmeal with instant oatmeal and fresh milk.
location: Room 303, Building 5, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast, washing up, and getting changed
description: Sitting at the dining table, he browsed the Lianjia app while eating breakfast. He found that a two-bedroom apartment in Qibao he had been following had dropped another 50,000 yuan, so he took a screenshot and saved it. He quickly finished the oatmeal and boiled eggs and washed the dishes. Then he brushed his teeth, washed his face, shaved, changed into dark blue work pants and a gray T-shirt, put on a light jacket, and took his meal card, phone, and car keys. Before going out, he looked in the mirror and felt in good spirits.
location: Room 303, Building 5, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to work by car
description: Go downstairs into the basement garage and start your silver-gray car. The windshield wipers wipe away the water droplets on the windshield. You turn on the car radio to listen to a machining technology podcast. Along Xingang Road, turn onto Huatianjing Highway. The traffic is smooth, and you arrive at the company in about 15 minutes. After parking, you walk toward the workshop.
location: From Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360, Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Team morning meeting
description: After changing into work clothes, he held a brief morning meeting in the team rest room with team leader Wang Lei, programmer Liu Zhiqiang, and others. Wang Lei emphasized the delivery deadline for the urgent valve body order and asked about last night's overtime work. You reported on last night's rough machining progress; Wang Lei was satisfied and assigned today's semi-finishing tasks.
location: Workshop break room, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning semi-finishing work
description: After the morning meeting, he started the CNC machine, checked the rough machining allowance of the previous batch against the process drawings, and then began semi-finish machining the valve body. Coordinating with Liu Zhiqiang, he fine-tuned the cutting parameters from time to time to ensure machining accuracy. The sound of machine cutting continued in the workshop as he was fully absorbed in the work.
location: Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Finishing Area 1 Workshop, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: At lunch, asked colleagues for advice on buying a house and downloaded a mortgage calculator
description: After getting food in the cafeteria (braised pork chop, stir-fried tomato and egg, green vegetables), he sat down next to Wang Lei. After Wang Lei finished discussing stocks, you lowered your voice and asked for advice on buying a house. Wang Lei shared his experience of using temporary credit card limits for cash flow and borrowing from relatives to make up the down payment. He mentioned that the 89-square-meter small two-bedroom in Qibao, Minhang had cost over 50,000 yuan per square meter back then, and might have dropped a bit now. He also said the commute from Qibao to Songjiang took half an hour, and shared the QR code of the "Shanghai Home Buying Exchange Group." You listened carefully and also asked about first-home mortgage interest rates. After returning to your workstation, you immediately downloaded and opened a mortgage calculator app, entered the total price and down payment ratio, and mentally calculated the monthly payment.
location: Canteen and workstation, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Short rest in the afternoon
description: He rested his head on the desk at his workstation and dozed for 10 minutes to give his brain and eyes a break. He got up to get some hot water, organized the self-inspection records for the morning's machined products, and prepared for the afternoon's work.
location: Workstation at Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon semi-finishing work.
description: In the afternoon, I continued operating the machine tool meticulously. When machining a batch of valve bodies with excessive machining allowance, I called Liu Zhiqiang over to verify the programming parameters together, and only began cutting after confirming they were correct. During this period, in the workshop corridor, I exchanged tips on tool selection with Master Sun Jianguo. Completely focused, I finally completed the semi-finishing process for all valve bodies before 17:00.
location: Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Finishing Area 1 Workshop, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Overtime dinner.
description: He went to the workshop rest area to get the company-provided overtime meal box, choosing steamed chicken leg, stir-fried zucchini, and rice, along with a bottle of mineral water. He ate quickly, recalling the turnover technique Wang Lei had mentioned at noon while eating, and threw away the meal box after finishing.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Worked overtime in the evening to finish the fine machining of the valve body.
description: After dinner and a short rest, you gathered with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang again in the workshop. After Wang Lei assigned tasks, you operated the machine tool to finish the valve body, with extremely high requirements on surface finish and dimensional tolerance. You strictly followed the program, watching the display data and tool wear at all times. Liu Zhiqiang helped verify the program and tested a new tool path to improve efficiency. At 21:10, the last valve body was successfully finished and deburred.
location: Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Finishing Area 1 Workshop, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Drove home after working overtime
description: Took off his work clothes, rubbed his sore shoulders, said goodbye to Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang, then walked to the parking lot. The drive was smooth all the way, and he parked in the community underground garage at about 21:40.
location: From Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: After returning home, I washed up and relaxed.
description: After getting home, first charge the phone and check WeChat. Manager Zhang still hasn't accepted the friend request; I keep this in mind. Then quickly took a hot shower, washing away sweat and fatigue, feeling much fresher.
location: Room 303, Building 5, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After blow-drying my hair, I lay in bed, set the alarm for 6 a.m. tomorrow, and turned off the desk lamp. Feeling that all of today's important tasks were done, I felt at ease and fell asleep in less than 5 minutes.
location: Room 303, Building 5, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up, fat-loss breakfast, and morning exercise.
description: At 6 a.m., the phone alarm went off on time. Yin Hao didn't linger in bed. After getting up, he went to the bathroom first, then stood barefoot on the electronic scale. Seeing his weight at 72.2 kg and that his fat-loss progress was continuing, the corners of his mouth curled up slightly. Then in the bathroom he washed his face with cold water, brushed his teeth, and shaved. After washing up, he took whole wheat toast, skim milk, and eggs from the refrigerator. In the kitchen he sprayed olive oil in a frying pan, fried one egg and two slices of bacon, heated the toast in the oven, and made a fried egg and bacon sandwich with a cup of warm milk. He ate breakfast quietly by the window in the morning light. After eating, he didn't leave immediately. He spread a yoga mat on the floor and did 15 minutes of targeted stretching and foam roller relaxation, focusing on the front of his thighs and the iliotibial band to consolidate recovery after the half marathon. After training, he took a shower, changed into his work clothes, and checked the items he was carrying: the lunch bag with his homemade fat-loss lunch, work badge, phone, power bank, and keys. He also put CNC Machining Technology and Programming into his backpack. Finally, around 7:10, he locked the door and left.
location: Attic of a unit in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Drove to work and listened to property listings.
description: Yin Hao went downstairs to his undesignated parking space in the residential complex, started the silver-gray Volkswagen Lavida, and drove out into the morning rush-hour traffic. He connected his phone to the car stereo via Bluetooth and, instead of playing music, opened the voice broadcast feature in the Lianjia app. The system automatically played listing and price-drop information for communities he had saved. He listened attentively while crawling along in traffic, paying special attention to the Qingpu New Town area trends that Master Sun mentioned last time.
location: While driving in Songjiang District, Shanghai, from Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road

name: Arrived at the company, changed clothes, and prepared for shift handover.
description: It took 25 minutes to get to the company. Yin Hao parked in the designated area of the factory, carried his lunchbox and backpack into the workshop changing room, changed into the faded blue work clothes and safety shoes, and put on goggles and earplugs. He glanced at the team whiteboard and saw the handover record left by Wang Lei: all parts for the urgent valve body order had finished precision machining; today only deburring and cleaning were needed, which put his mind at ease.
location: Workshop changing room at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Attend the crew morning meeting
description: At exactly 8 a.m., team leader Wang Lei held a brief morning meeting, praising the three-person team of Yin Hao, Wang Lei, and Liu Zhiqiang for their hard work in staying late until 9:30 last night to complete all finishing processes of an urgent valve body. He then assigned today's tasks: in the morning, Yin Hao was responsible for deburring and cleaning parts before sending them to quality inspection, while Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang debugged the newly arrived automated fixtures. After the meeting, Master Sun patted Yin Hao on the shoulder in encouragement.
