location: Team area, Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Focused on finishing deburring and cleaning of parts
description: After the morning meeting, Yin Hao picked up protective gloves and special tools and walked to the workbench. The precision valve body parts finely machined the night before were neatly arranged on the bench. He picked up a pneumatic grinding pen and focused on deburring the edges, openings, and grooves of each part, with steady hands and attentive eyes. After deburring, he blew surface debris off with a high-pressure air gun, then thoroughly cleaned the parts with a special industrial cleaning agent and an ultrasonic cleaner. The whole process lasted more than 3 hours, with only one break to drink water.
location: Workbench, Workshop No. 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Sending parts for inspection and communication
description: At 11:30, Yin Hao neatly placed all the cleaned, shiny parts into a dedicated inspection tray, pushed the cart to the Quality Inspection Department, found the senior quality inspector in charge of the project, Engineer Gao, and explained that the urgent-order valve bodies had all been processed and asked him to arrange inspection. After randomly sampling two or three with a vernier caliper and a roughness tester, Engineer Gao gave him a thumbs-up, praised him for being reliable, and told him the report would be issued in the afternoon.
location: Quality Inspection Department Office, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and browsing mortgage loan information
description: After leaving the quality inspection department, Yin Hao went straight to the cafeteria. Instead of queuing at the strong-flavored food counter, he went to the light food counter and got a serving of steamed fish, a serving of lettuce with minced garlic, and a boiled egg, with multigrain rice as the staple. He found an empty seat by the window and, while eating, opened the mortgage calculator app on his phone, entered the reference total price of about 2.5 million yuan for the residential community that Master Sun had mentioned, combined his down payment budget of about 500,000 yuan with funds that his family might be able to support, repeatedly calculated the monthly payments for different loan terms, and wrote down the total price and monthly payment figures in his memo.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break garden walk and reading.
description: After lunch, Yin Hao did not immediately return to the workshop. Instead, he took a walk in a quiet little garden in the factory area to aid digestion. The afternoon sun broke through the clouds and felt warm on his body. He sat on a bench beside the flower bed, took out CNC Machining Technology and Programming from his backpack, and turned to the place marked by the bookmark to read carefully. During this time, he thought of his mother's package and felt a little concerned, but remembering that he could see it after work, he focused on his book again.
location: Small garden in the factory compound of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Routine maintenance of machine tools
description: At 1 p.m. he returned to the workshop. Wang Lei said the quality inspection report would be out at the earliest around 2 o'clock. Yin Hao used this free time to perform comprehensive routine maintenance on the five-axis machining center he was responsible for. He carefully cleaned the tool magazine and spindle taper hole, checked the coolant level and concentration, applied new lubricating oil to the guide rails and lead screws, and recorded a maintenance log. This not only ensured the stability of the equipment, but also reflected his rigorous work habits. During this time, Liu Zhiqiang was nearby debugging a new fixture, and the two occasionally exchanged a few words.
location: Operation Area, No. 3 Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Learned that the quality inspection passed and the work team praised me.
description: At 2:30 in the afternoon, Wang Lei walked into the workshop with the quality inspection report and announced that the senior engineer had confirmed all valve body precision and roughness data were 100% qualified, and the customer was very satisfied. The workshop broke into cheers. Wang Lei praised everyone for their hard work during overtime, particularly acknowledged Yin Hao for doing a great job on the final check, and told them that he had applied to the workshop director for an extra 5 points for the team's performance this month. Master Sun smiled and nodded at Yin Hao. The fatigue from days of overtime was swept away, replaced by a sense of steadiness and satisfaction.
location: Team area, Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Parts warehousing and auxiliary programming.
description: After the good news, Yin Hao and his colleague carefully packed and stored the parts that had passed inspection, completing the final step of the urgent order. Then he returned to his workstation to handle the remaining work: putting tools back, cleaning the workbench, and filling out the equipment inspection checklist. While studying the programming of the new fixture, Liu Zhiqiang ran into a question about the linkage axis calculation. He called Yin Hao over to discuss it. The two spent half an hour in front of the computer, comparing drawings and simulation software, and finally settled on the optimal solution.
location: Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After work, had a detailed talk with my mentor about buying a house.
description: At 5 p.m., when the end-of-work bell rang, Yin Hao and Master Sun walked into the locker room together to change. Yin Hao brought up the monthly mortgage payment he had calculated for Qingpu New Town at noon. Master Sun seriously reminded him that focusing only on the total price wouldn't work; he also had to look at the floor area ratio, property management, and the actual walking distance to the subway station. The two chatted as they walked all the way from the locker room to the bus stop outside the company gate. Master Sun described the pros and cons of the properties he knew, the developer backgrounds, and again reminded him to check the remaining property rights years of second-hand homes. Finally, he patted Yin Hao on the shoulder and told him to look at more and compare more.
location: From the changing room at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to the bus stop at the company gate.

name: While driving home, refuel and check housing listings.
description: After parting with Master Sun, Yin Hao walked to the parking lot, started the car, and turned into the Sinopec Tongsan gas station at the G1503 Xiaokunshan Service Area near the company to fill up the tank. While driving, he used the voice assistant to open the Lianjia app, which intelligently recommended the nearly new residential community in Qingpu New Town that Master Sun had just mentioned. He quickly browsed images and floor plans for several listings with total prices around 2,600,000 yuan, felt they looked good, and decided to go see them in person on the weekend.
location: G1503 Xiaokunshan Service Area Sinopec Tongsan Gas Station and the drive passing Huatianjing Highway to Xingang Road

name: Received hometown food sent by mother
description: After parking the car downstairs, Yin Hao walked as usual to the parcel locker and entered the pickup code. The bottom compartment door popped open, revealing a solid postal cardboard box with his mother's familiar handwriting on it and the words Sent from Rudong. He pulled the box out with effort and carried the heavy box up to the attic step by step. After unlocking the door, he set it on the floor and opened it with scissors. Inside were vacuum-packed braised pork, clams in plastic bags, and several jars of homemade pickles. The taste of home instantly filled the little attic.
location: The parcel locker downstairs at Xingang Community, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the attic of a unit in the community.

name: Organizing food, making dinner, and cleaning up after the meal.
description: Yin Hao looked at the crowded refrigerator, made room to put the braised pork and pickled vegetables into the refrigerator section, divided the clams into fresh-keeping boxes and placed them in the freezer, then took a photo of the full refrigerator and sent it to his mother, thanking her for the package and asking about his father's back pain. His mother quickly replied with a voice message urging him to eat more and reassuring him that all was well. After his mood settled, he began preparing dinner: he heated the vacuum-packed braised pork his mother had sent, blanched spinach and drizzled it with soy sauce and sesame oil, thawed the clams and steamed them with shredded ginger and chopped scallions, and served them with brown rice, savoring the taste of home. After dinner, he put the remaining half bowl of braised pork and clams into fresh-keeping boxes and stored them in the freezer for later, then quickly washed the bowls, chopsticks, and pot, wiped dry the stove and countertop, and kept the small apartment tidy.
location: Attic kitchen in a unit of Xingang Community, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with parents and financial estimate
description: At 8 PM, Yin Hao made the video call to his parents on time. Seeing that they were in good spirits, he first asked about his father's back pain. After chatting a bit about family matters, he took a deep breath and brought up the topic of buying a house, asking if the family could help with the down payment. His father, Yin Jianguo, was silent for a moment, then said they could discuss it once he had found the right place and that the family would do their best to help. His mother, Wang Xiuying, lovingly urged him not to put too much pressure on himself. After hanging up, Yin Hao sat at his desk, opened his notebook and calculator, and recalculated: his own savings were 450,000 yuan; if the family could support 100,000 to 150,000 yuan, the down payment would be about 600,000 yuan. Combined with the previously viewed property priced at 2.6 million yuan, a 2-million-yuan loan would mean a monthly payment of around 10,000 yuan, which put enormous pressure on him as someone earning 8,000 to 9,000 yuan a month. Still, he remained hopeful and noted down the new budget ceiling and monthly payment range.
location: A unit in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai — attic bedroom with a desk

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After finishing the financial estimate, Yin Hao got up, went to the bathroom to wash up, and splashed his face with cold water to calm down. Back in the bedroom, he opened the Tide app and chose a 10-minute breathing meditation session. Wearing earphones, he lay in bed following the guidance to regulate his breathing, temporarily setting aside the day's achievements, stress, and uncertainty about the future. After the meditation, he felt much more relaxed. He picked up Deliberate Practice from the bedside, but before he had read even 10 minutes, drowsiness set in. He turned off the desk lamp and, in the dark, briefly planned the next day: ask Master Sun to view apartments over the weekend, contact the bank about loan details, and run 5 km on Friday evening for recovery. Then he set the alarm for 6 a.m., plugged in his phone, turned on his side, and soon fell into a deep sleep, ending a full and complex day.
location: Attic bedroom in a unit of Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving back to his hometown in the early morning.
description: At 3:15 a.m., Yin Hao got up on time. He had packed his luggage the night before. He drank a glass of warm water and checked the condition of the car. At 3:30, he set off from Xingang Community, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, heading north along the G15 Shenhai Expressway. In the darkness, he listened to the navigation and thought about his father's birthday. He took a short 5-minute break at a service area along the way. He arrived downstairs at XX Community on Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province at around 5:20. After parking the car, he went upstairs quietly and found his mother already busy in the kitchen.
location: From Xingang Residential Community on Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to XX Residential Community on Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province.

name: Morning recovery run and preparation
description: After arriving home, Yin Hao felt a dry throat. In the morning, he weighed himself and was 72.1 kg. Because he felt unwell, he changed the planned 3 km morning run to a relaxed 2 km jog. He put on his running shoes and jogged on the fitness trail in the community, controlling his pace at 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer while warming up his muscles and observing how his knees and throat reacted. After the jog, he stretched for five minutes. His knees were fine, but the throat discomfort remained. Back home, he washed up and started preparing a simple breakfast and today's fat-loss bento box.
location: Fitness trail at XX Community, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province.

name: Prepare a birthday breakfast.
description: After washing up, Yin Hao put on an apron. He cooked a pot of white rice porridge, fried two eggs, and reheated two meat buns his mother had steamed. At the same time, he packed his fat-loss lunch in a lunchbox (stir-fried broccoli, boiled chicken breast, and half a corn cob). When his mother Wang Xiuying got up and saw her son in the kitchen, she smiled and said she would cook the birthday noodles today. They worked together, and the kitchen felt warm and cozy.
location: XX Residential Community, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (home, kitchen)

name: Father-son breakfast and shopping trip
description: After his father Yin Jianguo got up, the family sat around and ate breakfast. Yin Hao served his father the bowl of hand-rolled noodles. His father, for once, praised that they were chewier than his mother's. During the meal, they discussed going to the farmers' market in the morning to buy fresh ingredients, and his father wanted to have a couple of drinks.
location: XX Residential Community, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (home, restaurant)

name: Tidying up and starting birthday planning
description: After breakfast, Yin Hao quickly cleared the dishes. His mother began to list the birthday banquet menu: braised pork, steamed sea bass, blanched shrimp, garlic lettuce, and so on. Yin Hao opened the memo app on his phone to note down the dish names and ingredients. Considering that his father needed to regulate his stomach and intestines, he suggested also buying Chinese yam and pork ribs to make soup, and his mother readily agreed.
location: XX Residential Community, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (home, living room)

name: Big shopping trip at the farmers' market
description: Yin Hao and his mother walked to the Rudong Agricultural Trade Center Market, about a ten-minute walk from home. On Friday morning, the market was bustling. They went straight to a familiar meat stall and picked out pork belly with alternating layers of fat and lean. At the seafood section, they bought live shrimp and a sea bass weighing nearly two jin. Passing a dried goods shop, Yin Hao remembered his father's habit of brewing tea, so he bought him a pack of high-quality goji berries. His mother chatted warmly with the vendors, while Yin Hao quietly carried the groceries behind her.
location: Rudong Agricultural Trade Center Market, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Family teamwork in preparing lunch
description: Back home, Yin Hao and his mother immediately started preparing the meal. Yin Hao was in charge of washing vegetables, cutting vegetables, and peeling garlic, while his mother did the cooking. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of sautéed scallions and ginger. His father was watching the news in the living room. While cutting vegetables, Yin Hao told his mother about a two-bedroom apartment in Qingpu New City that he had liked on Lianjia the night before. His mother dried her hands, looked at the photos, and said the community environment looked decent.
location: XX Residential Community, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (home, kitchen)

name: Birthday lunch banquet
description: The table was filled with dishes; the braised pork was bright red and glossy, and the sea bass was steaming hot. Yin Hao poured a cup of Shaoxing rice wine for his father and a small cup for himself, raised his glass to wish his father a happy birthday and good health. His mother smiled from ear to ear, and a rare smile appeared on his father's face. The family was warm and harmonious. As they ate, Yin Hao asked his father about his work at the agricultural machinery repair station.
location: XX Residential Community, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (home, restaurant)

name: Midday rest and personal planning
description: After lunch, Yin Hao took the initiative to wash the dishes and tidy up. Feeling a sore throat, he made himself a glass of vitamin C effervescent tablet drink. His father took a nap, and his mother watched TV. Returning to his own room, he opened his laptop to prepare a home purchase financial plan, created a new Excel spreadsheet, and began calculating the monthly payments and future impact on life for three down payment combination options.
location: XX Community, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (home, own room)

name: In-depth financial planning and interpersonal communication
description: Yin Hao carefully calculated against the listings he had saved on the Lianjia app: Option 1 (an old, small, run-down unit with a total price of 2.5 million yuan, down payment 320,000 yuan, commercial loan monthly payment about 9,200 yuan), Option 2 (a small two-bedroom with a total price of 2.9 million yuan, down payment 400,000 yuan, commercial loan monthly payment about 11,000 yuan), Option 3 (a combined provident fund and commercial loan, lowering the monthly payment to 8,000 yuan). Halfway through the calculation, his phone rang. His friend Wang Lei sent a WeChat message asking whether he wanted to play ranked games in the evening. Yin Hao replied that he had to keep his parents company. He continued to focus completely on the Excel spreadsheet, and during that time he also took a vitamin C tablet and measured his temperature at 36.8.
location: XX Community, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (home, own room)

name: Rest and family chat.
description: Yin Hao closed his laptop, feeling his eyes sore and dry. He walked to the living room and chatted with his father, who was already awake. He brought up the topic of buying a house, relayed Master Sun's words, and said that the down payment shortfall would need support from the family. His father was silent for a moment, then agreed that the family would pool 200,000 yuan, and urged him not to put too much pressure on himself. Yin Hao nodded hard, feeling a lump in his throat.
location: XX Residential Community, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (home, living room)

name: Dinner preparation and a light meal
description: A sore throat made Yin Hao decide to eat something light in the evening. He used the leftover Chinese yam and pork rib soup from lunch to cook a small bowl of noodles and blanched some greens. His mother wanted to reheat the leftovers but was persuaded not to. After eating the plain noodle soup, he felt very comfortable. After the meal, he cut oranges, arranged them on a plate, and put them on the coffee table for his parents.
location: XX Residential Community, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (home, kitchen, dining room)

name: Video call with elder brother
description: Yin Hao picked up his phone and called his older brother Yin Tao via video. Yin Tao was at home in Suzhou. Yin Hao turned the camera toward their parents, who were sitting on the sofa. His father said into the phone, “Don’t work too hard.” Yin Tao wished his father a happy birthday and said he would try to come back on Saturday. The four family members chatted across the screen for over ten minutes in a warm atmosphere.
location: XX Residential Community, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (home, living room)

name: Family movie time
description: After hanging up the video call, Yin Hao suggested watching a movie. He turned on the TV and found the war film My 1919 that his father had liked when he was young. Although Yin Hao was not very interested, seeing his father fully absorbed and his mother knitting a sweater, he felt the time was precious. During the film, Yin Hao coughed occasionally, and his mother got up and made him a cup of honey water.
location: XX Residential Community, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (home, living room)

name: Evening rehabilitation training and washing up.
description: After the movie, his parents got ready for rest, and Yin Hao returned to his room. He changed into a T-shirt and shorts, opened Keep, and followed a video for 20 minutes of stretching and relaxation training, focusing on rubbing his right knee and back, and felt his circulation improve. Then he went to the bathroom to take a hot shower.
location: XX Residential Community, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (home, own room, bathroom)

name: Pre-sleep preparation and mindfulness meditation
description: After showering and lying in bed, Yin Hao felt that his dry, sore throat had eased slightly. Reviewing the day: the morning run was completed, the birthday celebration went smoothly, and the house-buying plan had been initially completed. He spent 10 minutes on mindfulness meditation, repeatedly recalling his parents' advice and the details of the family dinner, letting his anxiety gradually settle.
location: XX Community, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (home, own room)

name: Lights out and sleep
description: Yin Hao turned off the lamp and lay still in the dark. He thought about tomorrow being Saturday, with more family activities waiting for him, but today had been satisfying enough. He had managed to balance filial duty and personal plans, and slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: XX Residential Area, Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (home, on the bed in my own room)

name: Early morning rest at home.
description: Woke up at 7 in the morning. My sore throat was more obvious than last night, and it was hard to swallow. I used my phone to measure my temperature: 36.8, confirmed no fever, and decided to cancel my morning run. My mother, Wang Xiuying, knocked on the door and brought warm honey water, telling me to put on more clothes. Leaning against the headboard, I slowly drank the honey water, felt my throat ease, and decided to rest at home all day.
location: Bedroom in a self-built house, No. XX, Qingyuan Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Browsing outer suburban housing listings and settling accounts
description: Half-reclining in bed, I browsed one-bedroom listings under 2 million yuan in areas such as Jinshan New City and Nanqiao in Fengxian, Shanghai, using the Lianjia app on my phone, and used Amap to calculate commuting routes. I found that subway plus bus rides generally exceeded 1 hour 45 minutes. Then I opened Alipay and WeChat statements, checked my monthly fixed expenses, and after estimating all my savings plus the 200,000 yuan down payment from my father, I found there was still a considerable gap from my target.
location: Bedroom in a self-built house, No. XX, Qingyuan Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Welcoming older brother and family lunch gathering
description: At 11:40 he heard a car engine shut off in the courtyard. His older brother Yin Tao had returned from Suzhou, carrying several boxes of Suzhou specialties into the house. Because his throat was sore, he greeted him in a hoarse voice. The whole family sat around the dining table; his mother had made steamed sea bass, oil-braised prawns, plain congee, and garlic broccoli. At the table, his father and brother talked about the auto market, while his mother kept picking up food for him and urging him to drink more congee and eat less greasy food.
location: Living room and dining room of the self-built house at No. XX Qingyuan Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province

name: Discussed buying a home with a childhood friend on WeChat
description: After lunch, feeling uncomfortable in my throat and not wanting to talk, I chatted with my childhood friend Zhang Wei on WeChat via text. I sent him screenshots of several properties in Jinshan and Fengxian that I had liked that morning, and mentioned that my father would support me with 200,000 yuan. Zhang Wei replied with a long voice message, suggesting I shouldn't put too much pressure on myself and could save for another two years. He also jokingly asked about my relationship status and my concerns about buying a home in a different city. I replied that the relationship was still developing, that I hadn't thought that far ahead, and that I was determined to strive in Shanghai. After the conversation, I became even more hesitant about the home-buying decision.
location: Bedroom in a self-built house, No. XX, Qingyuan Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Python programming study
description: In a fairly good mental state, he opened his laptop and logged into the online learning platform to complete the last Python course of the month. He focused on learning the open() function for file reading and writing, the with statement, and CSV data processing. Following the tutorial, he wrote a script to read a simulated CSV file of machine tool operating parameters and calculate the average spindle speed and cutting temperature. The first run reported an error. After checking, he found that the data type had not been converted. After fixing it, the result was output successfully. He saved the code and recorded the function call error in his study notes.
location: Bedroom in a self-built house, No. XX, Qingyuan Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Casual family chat in the living room
description: After studying, he went to the living room and sat on the sofa listening to his father and brother chat. His brother talked about closing a big client in Suzhou and signing a fleet order. He was envious inside, but didn't say much, just listened.
location: Living room of a self-built house at No. XX, Qingyuan Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province

name: Review the Senior Technician question bank
description: Back in the bedroom, he took out the paper practice test from the senior technician theory question bank and reviewed Chapter 2. He read the explanations for each question carefully, and when encountering new knowledge about hydraulic systems, he used a red pen to record key points in the wrong-answer notebook. After completing 35 multiple-choice questions and checking the answers, the accuracy rate was about 80%. He circled several wrong questions on PLC control logic and planned to ask Master Sun for advice after returning to Shanghai.
location: Bedroom in a self-built house, No. XX, Qingyuan Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Helped prepare dinner and interacted with family.
description: He took the initiative to help his mother in the kitchen, peeling garlic and trimming cilantro. His mother made a soup with fresh pork ribs and Chinese yam, and the whole house was filled with a rich aroma. At dinner, he still mainly had porridge and light vegetables. His brother suggested playing a mobile game together in the evening, but he shook his head and declined because of his sore throat and fatigue from studying, saying he could watch them play. While ladling out the soup, his mother reminded him to rest well and not stay up too late after returning to Shanghai.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the self-built house at XX Qingyuan Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Review the technician exam questions I got wrong.
description: After dinner, he returned to the bedroom, took out his mistake notebook, and reviewed the several wrong questions he had encountered that afternoon while reviewing advanced technician theory, so as to consolidate his memory.
location: Bedroom in a self-built house, No. XX, Qingyuan Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Video call with girlfriend
description: Had a video call with his girlfriend Lin Yue, briefly sharing his weekend life at his parents' home. He mentioned that his mother had made a lot of delicious food and that his older brother had also come back. He deliberately did not mention his sore throat or the pressure of buying a house. His girlfriend mentioned the newly released movie 'My Regret Is About You' and said they could go see it together when she returns to Shanghai next week. After the call, he felt more relaxed.
location: Bedroom in a self-built house, No. XX, Qingyuan Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Taking medication and preparing for bed
description: He went to the bathroom, rinsed his mouth with warm salt water, took a packet of Banlangen granules and two vitamin C tablets. Then he soaked his feet in hot water for 15 minutes and felt warm all over. Lying back in bed, he opened the memo app on his phone, copied and organized the information of several listings he had liked today, and noted the commute time and the need to leave early and return late.

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: Picked up "Peak" from the nightstand and read the chapter on mental representations, recalling his experiences learning Python and studying CNC technology. After reading for about 40 minutes, he turned off the light, set the alarm, spent a few minutes doing deep breathing to clear his mind, and gradually fell asleep before 22:30 with thoughts about the future.
location: Bedroom in a self-built house, No. XX, Qingyuan Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: At 7 a.m., Ahao was woken by the sunlight. His throat no longer hurt at all; there was only slight nasal congestion, and his strength had mostly recovered. He stepped on the scale: 71.9kg, lighter than yesterday, so he was in a good mood. After washing up briefly, he changed into a sports T-shirt and shorts and got ready to go out.
location: Room 502, No. 19, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinbang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Strolling around the neighborhood and researching policies
description: Ah Hao went out for some air and walked slowly around Xingang Community for about 15 minutes, enjoying the spring morning breeze. Then he bought a cup of unsweetened soy milk and a boiled egg from a breakfast stall at the community gate and ate them on the way. After returning home, he sat at his desk and used his phone to search for information such as 2025 Shanghai home purchase restriction policies and home purchase conditions in Shanghai for non-local household registration applicants, carefully comparing his four years of social insurance records. When he saw the requirement of having paid continuously for 5 years, his heart skipped a beat. He also searched for G60 Science and Innovation Corridor talent apartment application requirements, found that his company was on the list of key enterprises, saved several key application URLs and contact phone numbers in his phone notes, and planned to talk with HR in detail on Monday.
location: Room 502, No. 19, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinbang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning rest and lunch preparation.
description: After researching the policy, Ah Hao felt thirsty and drank a glass of warm water, mentally calculating what to do about being one year short on his social security contributions. To keep from falling into anxiety, he decided to distract himself and started preparing his fat-loss lunch early. He took the thawed chicken breast out of the fridge, tenderized it with the back of a knife, and marinated it with cooking wine, light soy sauce, and black pepper. Then he washed the broccoli and baby carrots and cut them up for later. Once everything was ready, he opened his Kindle and continued reading the last few chapters of Deliberate Practice.
location: Room 502, No. 19, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinbang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Review the Senior Technician question bank
description: There was still some time before lunch. Ahao took out the senior technician review materials, reopened Chapter 2, and focused on conquering the PLC programming problems he had circled yesterday. He carefully analyzed the ladder diagram, drew the execution process on scratch paper, and finally understood the logic that had stumped him earlier. To improve accuracy, he did another set of 10 practice questions. This time he got them all right and felt a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Room 502, No. 19, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinbang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and afternoon preparation
description: Ahao pan-fried the marinated chicken breast in a frying pan until both sides were golden, while blanching broccoli and carrots. He prepared a hearty weight-loss lunch: pan-seared chicken breast, sautéed broccoli and carrots, with a small serving of multigrain rice. Eating slowly, he bought a ticket on the Taopiaopiao app on his phone for the 14:45 rerelease screening of Interstellar at Songjiang Wanda Cinema. After the meal, he washed the dishes and tidied up the room.
location: Room 502, No. 19, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinbang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Noon break
description: In order to have better energy in the afternoon, A Hao lay on the sofa with his eyes closed and rested for half an hour. Although he didn't completely fall asleep, his body got relaxed and rested.
location: Room 502, No. 19, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinbang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon outing: go to Wanda Plaza to watch a movie and browse the bookstore.
description: At 14:00, A Hao left on time, walked 5 minutes to the Xingang Road bus stop, took the Songjiang 16 bus (toward Guangfulin Road Guangxing Road, fare 2 yuan), and got off at Guangxing Road Guangfulin Road Station about 25 minutes later, then walked 3 minutes to Wanda Plaza. He picked up his ticket at the self-service ticket machine in the hall and redeemed a sugar-free cola with phone points. At 14:45, he sat alone in the middle-back of the theater, immersed in the grand cosmic narrative and stunning audiovisual effects of "Interstellar". After the movie ended around 17:00, he went downstairs to the Xinhua Bookstore on the 3rd floor, stopped in front of the mechanical technology bookshelf, browsed "Detailed Examples of Five-Axis Machining Center Programming" and "CNC Technology in Intelligent Manufacturing," learned about the latest process trends, and took out his phone to photograph the covers and key table of contents pages of the two books.
location: Wanda Plaza, 658 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go to the sports center to run and exchange ideas with fellow runners.
description: After leaving the bookstore, A Hao walked to the Guangxing Road - Guangfulin Road station, took Songjiang No. 14 bus (toward Songjiang Sports Center, fare 2 yuan), about a 35-minute ride. On the way, he sent a message to his running friend Chen Jie: "I'm here, stretching and waiting for you at the entrance." At around 18:00, he met up with Chen Jie at the entrance of the Sports Center, and they warmed up together by the track. Feeling in good shape, he suggested running 6 kilometers. The two ran 15 laps around the track at a pace of about 6:05 per kilometer. After finishing, they stretched by the track and chatted. Chen Jie said he had just paid the down payment on the apartment in Hangzhou and felt great pressure from the monthly mortgage payments, but he advised getting on the property ladder sooner. A Hao sighed and talked about how he was one year short of the social insurance requirement and still over 100,000 yuan short on the down payment. Chen Jie patted him on the shoulder and encouraged: "It's okay, take it step by step. The conditions will be met eventually."
location: Songjiang Sports Center, 100 Jiufeng Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returning home and dinner
description: After parting with Chen Jie at the entrance of the sports center, Ahao walked to the bus stop and took Songjiang Bus 53 (toward Xinbang, fare 2 yuan). After about 42 minutes, he got off at Xingang Road stop and walked home. Once home, he took a quick shower, then made dinner: a chicken breast and vegetable salad using the leftover marinated chicken breast and the vegetables from lunch, dressed with vinaigrette. While eating, he sent his mother a WeChat voice message saying he was feeling better, that Sunday had been very fulfilling, and telling her not to worry.
location: Room 502, No. 19, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinbang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening: organizing policies and future plans
description: A Hao sat at his desk, systematically organizing the key policy URLs and application conditions noted in his phone memos during the day, along with the gains from his chat with Chen Jie, into a new notebook. He listed the 3 core questions he planned to ask HR on Monday: 1) Does the company have talent apartment quotas or related subsidy policies? 2) For insufficient social insurance years, can the company provide any help or proof? 3) Does the company have recommended cooperative bank loan channels? He clearly wrote down the key points of each question and imagined the answers HR might give.
location: Room 502, No. 19, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinbang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Relaxing and reading before bed
description: After finishing his business, feeling tired, A Hao took out his Kindle, leaned on the bed, and continued reading the ending section of Peak, thinking about how to apply these theories to learning CNC technology. After reading for about 30 minutes, he felt sleepy, turned off the light, and did a 10-minute mindfulness meditation in the dark, focusing on his breathing, trying to let his worries fade away.
location: Room 502, No. 19, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinbang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-Bedtime Preparations
description: Ah Hao got up and went to the bathroom to brush his teeth and wash his face, and set an alarm for 6:30 the next morning. Lying back in bed, he took a last look at the several apartments he had saved on the Lianjia app. Thinking about the social security payment years, he still felt somewhat heavy-hearted. At 23:00, he turned off the desk lamp and closed his eyes to sleep.
location: Room 502, No. 19, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinbang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting up and indoor stretching
description: The alarm went off on time, and Yin Chuan didn't linger in bed. The rain outside the window had not stopped, so the morning run plan fell through. He spread out a yoga mat on the living room floor, did 15 minutes of full-body stretching, and did several sets of wall sits to protect his knees. He was slightly sweaty, weighed himself, and the scale read 71.8 kg, the same as yesterday.
location: Room 602, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and preparing a lunchbox
description: Yin Chuan took last night's braised pork and stir-fried vegetables out of the fridge and packed them into a lunch box. He warmed a glass of milk, fried two eggs sunny-side up, and ate breakfast with two slices of whole-wheat bread. Then he opened the Suishenban app and checked the photos of his electronic credentials; they were all clear. After that, he sent a WeChat message to Sister Zhang in HR, wanting to consult her about the company's talent housing purchase policy.
location: Kitchen, Room 602, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Tidying up and morning preparation
description: After breakfast, Yin Chuan ran through the list of tools and drawings he needed to bring today in his mind. He put on a light jacket, picked up an umbrella and his lunch bag, confirmed he had his keys, phone, and access card, and got ready to leave.
location: Room 602, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting by shared bicycle.
description: It was drizzling, and Yin Chuan didn't drive his own car for fear of traffic jams. He walked to the entrance of the residential complex, scanned a shared bicycle, put on a rain poncho, and rode toward the factory. Traffic on the road was slightly slower than usual, and it took him 20 minutes to reach Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory.
location: Cycle from Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Arrival preparation and morning meeting
description: After arriving at the factory, Yin Chuan first went to the tool room to prepare the vernier caliper, micrometer, and drawings. At 7:40, team leader Wang Lei called a brief morning meeting, emphasized that the workshop floor was slippery due to rain and to pay attention to safety, and assigned today's precision turning tasks for the stainless steel parts.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning routine machining and first-aid training registration
description: After the morning meeting, Yin Chuan returned to the machine tool and began warming it up, clamping the workpiece, and aligning the tool, concentrating hard to keep tolerances within 0.02 mm. During the automatic machining cycle, he noticed a QR code on the workshop bulletin board for Red Cross first aid training. He scanned it, logged on to the official website, and carefully reviewed the course. Feeling it was useful for both his work and running group, he uploaded an ID photo, filled in his personal information, and paid 180 yuan to successfully register.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Consulted HR about the talent housing purchase policy.
description: The first batch of mass-produced parts was almost done. Yin Chuan walked to the rest area and saw that Sister Zhang had replied saying she was free, so he made a WeChat Work voice call. He told Sister Zhang about the talent policies he had researched and his own thoughts. Sister Zhang said the company was indeed on the G60 Science and Technology Innovation Corridor key enterprise list, and that employees applying for talent apartments or housing purchase subsidies needed to meet the requirements of a college degree or above and an intermediate professional title or above. She suggested he scan his diploma, skill certificates, labor contract and other materials into electronic copies and send them to her for review.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Continued morning work and workshop communication
description: After hanging up the phone, Yin Chuan felt more sure of what to do. He returned to his workstation and continued working, thinking that his secondary vocational school diploma was not enough: he would have to wait until next year to obtain an associate degree from the Open University, and whether the Senior CNC Operator certificate could count as an intermediate professional title still needed to be verified. During processing, the machine made a slight abnormal noise. He called Master Sun Jianguo over to check it together, and they found that chips had wrapped around the tool. After cleaning, it returned to normal. The two chatted briefly about the machining parameters of the new program.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and organizing materials
description: When the lunch break bell rang, Yin Chuan did not queue up at the cafeteria. He took out the bento box he had brought in the morning and heated it in the microwave for 3 minutes. While eating, he opened the memo app on his phone and wrote down the conditions Sister Zhang had just mentioned, creating a new folder called "Talent Policy Preparation." After the meal, he used his phone to take photos of the key pages of his secondary vocational school diploma, senior CNC operator certificate, and labor contract, and saved them to his phone.
location: Canteen and workstation at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon routine processing and e-book purchase
description: The afternoon work pace was steady. Yin Chuan strictly followed the process card and carefully measured each part after finishing it to ensure precision. During work breaks, he opened the e-book platform and ordered two e-books, Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming and PLC Programming Examples, to prepare for the senior technician certificate exam.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Policy research during work breaks
description: During break time, Yin Chuan did not scroll through short videos; instead, he opened the official website of the Shanghai Songjiang District Talent Service Center in his mobile browser, carefully read the official document on G60 Science and Innovation Corridor Talent Housing Purchase, and took screenshots of key information such as application requirements and required materials. The document mentioned that those who obtain National Level 2 vocational qualification (technician) or above can enjoy benefits, which strengthened his determination to pursue the Senior Technician certificate.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Finishing processing, quality inspection, and work handover
description: Yin Chuan made a final push and finished machining the last batch of stainless steel parts before the end of the workday, and performed his own quality inspection, all of which passed. At 17:40, he shut down the machine, cleaned up his workstation, and briefly handed over the next day's work arrangements to team leader Wang Lei. He went to the locker room, changed back into his own clothes, and picked up his bag.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory workshop and changing room, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive to the swimming pool.
description: The rain had basically stopped, and the sky was overcast. Yin Chuan drove his Volkswagen Polo out of the industrial zone and headed along Songhui West Road toward Songjiang Old Town. There was little traffic, and he arrived at Songjiang Swimming Pool in 20 minutes.
location: From Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Songjiang Swimming Pool, No. 143 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Indoor swimming workout
description: The swimming pool was not crowded. Yin Chuan quickly changed into his swim trunks. After getting into the water, he first swam 200 meters of freestyle as a warm-up and felt no discomfort in his throat. Then he completed 40 minutes of low-intensity swimming as planned, mainly freestyle with breaststroke interspersed for recovery, keeping his heart rate around 130. After finishing, he felt relaxed all over; he was completely over his cold. He took a hot shower and changed into dry clothes.
location: Songjiang Swimming Pool, No. 143 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Picked up groceries on the way home.
description: After leaving the swimming pool, Yin Chuan drove and dropped by the Xingang Xincun fresh food supermarket on the way. He bought a box of eggs, a bunch of bok choy, a box of soft tofu, and also picked out two cucumbers, spending less than 20 yuan. After paying, he walked two minutes back home.
location: Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, then walk to Room 602, No. 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cooking dinner
description: After returning home, Yin Chuan quickly washed and chopped the vegetables, made a green vegetable and tofu soup, mixed a plate of cucumber salad with Lao Gan Ma, and reheated the leftover braised pork from lunch. It was a simple but nutritious meal. As he ate, he mentally went over the key points he wanted to discuss with his parents.
location: Kitchen and dining room at Room 602, No. 3, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video-called parents to discuss house-buying plans.
description: At exactly 8 o'clock, Yin Chuan made a WeChat video call to his father. His father Yin Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying appeared on the screen. Yin Chuan formally brought up the matter of buying a house in Shanghai. He clearly laid out the social insurance contribution years he had looked up, the company's talent policy, his savings, monthly savings, and the approximate down payment gap. His father was silent for about ten seconds, and his mother worried that the pressure was too great. Yin Chuan patiently explained that this was a well-considered decision. Finally, his father said he could provide 200,000 yuan in support, but asked him to look carefully and be sure, and not act impulsively. Yin Chuan felt both hopeful and heavy-hearted, and quickly agreed.
location: Video call: Yin Chuan is in the living room of Room 602, Building 3, Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai; parents are in their hometown.

name: Organizing home-buying plans and viewing properties online.
description: After hanging up the video call, Yin Chuan sat on the sofa for a while, with mixed feelings. Then he opened the memo app on his phone and created a new folder called "Shanghai Home-Settling Plan," subdivided into three subdocuments: "Housing Information," "Policy Summary," and "Financial Budget." He recorded the HR's reply, the official website screenshot, and his father's support of 200,000 yuan (marked as a loan). Next, he opened the Lianjia app, set the area to Songjiang New City and Jiuting, browsed several small two-bedroom units of 60-80 square meters sorted by total price from low to high, and saved the ones he liked.
location: Living room, Room 602, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and reading an e-book before bed
description: Yin Chuan took a shower, changed into pajamas, and lay down on the bed. Instead of turning off the light immediately, he opened his phone and read the e-book "Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming" purchased that afternoon, starting from Chapter 1, "Five-Axis Machining Basics and Coordinate Systems." Although some content was hard to understand, he believed persistence would pay off. He read until 22:00, his eyes grew sore, and he closed his phone.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 602, Building 3, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organize health records and go to bed
description: Before turning off the light, Yin Chuan opened the Health and Notes apps on his phone and quickly recorded today's exercise (swimming for 40 minutes), diet (breakfast: eggs and milk; lunch: homemade bento; dinner: vegetable and tofu soup + cucumber salad + a small amount of braised pork), and weight (71.8 kg). After completing his habitual logging, he set the alarm for 6 a.m. the next morning and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at Room 602, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run 5 kilometers.
description: Yin Hao woke up naturally at 5:30, did some simple stretching downstairs, put on his running shoes, and warmed up in front of the building in Xingang Residential Community. To keep to the Guangfulin Road route, he drove about 5 minutes to the agreed section. He jogged 5 kilometers along Guangfulin Road at a steady pace of around 6:20 per kilometer, with steady breathing, and his cold had fully recovered. After the run, he walked for 5 minutes to cool down, bought a bottle of water by the roadside, and then drove home.
location: Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (section from Renmin North Road to Longyuan Road)

name: Morning stretching, shower, and making breakfast
description: After getting home, Yin Hao did 15 minutes of systematic stretching in the living room, focusing on relaxing his calves and quadriceps. He then took a warm shower and changed into clean work clothes. For breakfast he had two slices of whole-wheat bread, two boiled eggs with black pepper, and a glass of hot milk. While eating, he checked the weather forecast on his phone and confirmed it was overcast today, so there was no need to bring an umbrella.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organize materials and get in touch with Sister Zhang from HR.
description: After breakfast, Yin Hao organized the scanned copies of his academic certificates and CNC intermediate-level skill certificate, sent them to Sister Zhang in HR via WeChat Work, and left a message asking whether he met the conditions for applying for a talent apartment. After sending, he turned off his phone and prepared to leave.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving commute to the factory
description: Yin Hao took his commuter bag and set off by car. There was little traffic on the road. After about 15 minutes following the navigation, he arrived at the factory parking lot and parked in an inner spot to avoid being blocked in after work.
location: Parking lot, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Change clothes, attend the morning meeting, and check equipment
description: After entering the workshop, Yin Hao changed into work clothes, put on safety goggles and cut-resistant gloves. He attended the 10-minute morning meeting led by team leader Wang Lei, where the day's task was clarified as milling 500 fixing parts with an accuracy requirement of 0.02mm. After the meeting, he checked the lubricating oil and cutting fluid levels of the CNC machine in advance and arranged the cutting tools and measuring instruments neatly according to his habit. When he saw his mentor Sun Jianguo also checking the equipment, he greeted him.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Batch parts milling
description: Yin Hao started the machine tool and, strictly following the work instruction, clamped the workpiece, set the tool, and entered the machining code to begin processing. After the first piece was completed, he used a vernier caliper and micrometer for self-inspection; it passed, and he then began batch production, keeping an eye on chip evacuation and cutting fluid conditions throughout. During a break, he confirmed with passing programmer Liu Zhiqiang the special tool holder positioning needed for the afternoon equipment maintenance.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Take a work break and confirm the first aid training.
description: During the work break, Yin Hao went to the rest area to drink water and check his phone. He received a text message from the Songjiang District Red Cross confirming that he had successfully signed up for the 5th Basic Rescuer Training, scheduled from 8:30 to 17:00 on May 10-11, at the Red Cross Affairs Center, No. 7, Lane 36, Zhongshan West Road. He took a screenshot and saved it, noted in his memo that he needed to arrange a shift change in advance, and also sent a WeChat message to Sister Zhang in HR to ask about the matter.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Continue batch part milling
description: Yin Hao went back to the lathe to continue machining, adjusted his attitude, and kept a steady pace to complete the remaining tasks.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and researching talent apartment information
description: At lunchtime, Yin Hao and his team colleagues went to the cafeteria and ordered braised pork chop, stir-fried greens, and rice. While eating, he used his phone to browse the official website of the Songjiang District Talent Service Center and rental apps, carefully studying the real photos, surrounding amenities, rent, and floor area of talent apartments such as China Resources Youchao and Chengjia Apartment. Wang Lei asked if he planned to buy a house; Yin Hao smiled and said he would first look at talent apartments to solve his housing.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon workshop processing and maintenance preparation.
description: After the lunch break, Yin Hao continued operating the machine tool and finished the day’s 500-piece machining task around 2:00 p.m., with all pieces passing quality inspection. He then prepared for equipment maintenance with Wang Lei: they cut off the power to the old CD6140A lathe, shut down the hydraulic system, and got wrenches, hex keys, cleaning agent, and rags ready.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Clean the cooling system of the old lathe
description: Yin Hao and Wang Lei cleaned the cooling system of the old lathe, removed the filter screen that had accumulated iron filings and oil sludge, cleaned it with a special cleaning agent, and unclogged the pipes with fine wire. During this time, he asked Wang Lei about the reputation of talent apartments. Wang Lei recommended "Youchao International Apartment" and suggested paying close attention to it.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Buy groceries on the way home from work
description: After maintenance, Yin Hao cleaned up the tools, wrote the handover record, and left work at 17:35. Driving home, he stopped by Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket on the way and bought greens, tomatoes, dragon beard noodles, eggs, and apples. While checking out, he looked at his phone; Sister Zhang from HR still hadn't replied.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home to make dinner and prepare training materials
description: After arriving home, Yin Hao put the ingredients in the refrigerator, then cooked clear soup with dragon whisker noodles, stir-fried greens with garlic, and tomato salad for dinner. While eating, he printed the first responder training confirmation text message on his tablet and put his ID card and one one-inch photo into a document bag, placing it by his backpack at the entrance.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparation and preview before class
description: After preparing the items for next day's work, Yin Hao sat at his desk 25 minutes early, set up the computer camera and microphone, and logged into the Open University of China online platform to confirm the live course link was working. Then he picked up the e-book Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming and quickly flipped through the chapters he had taken notes on the night before to warm up for the class.
location: In front of the desk at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Attended the livestream course "Fundamentals of Electrical Technology"
description: At 7 p.m., the second live lesson of Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering Technology began. The lecturer explained AC circuit analysis, power calculation, and other content. Yin Hao followed along the whole time, drawing circuit diagrams in his notebook, writing down formulas, and noting common mistakes. During the break, he correctly answered the teacher's question about power factor and received verbal praise.
location: In front of the desk at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After class, relaxed and read professional books.
description: After class, Yin Hao stood up to stretch, made a cup of hot tea, and continued reading "Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming" on his iPad, focusing on the "Tool Compensation Parameters" chapter. Combining it with the daytime tool-setting process, he worked out a tool compensation calculation problem on scratch paper. His thinking gradually became clearer, and he took brief notes.
location: On the sofa at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wash up and prepare for tomorrow.
description: After studying, Yin Hao washed up and dried his hair, hung the next day's work uniform in front of the dressing mirror, and placed his car keys and work badge in their designated spots. He also set the next day's weather forecast reminder and alarm on his phone, and confirmed the handover time for the morning and evening shifts.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep check and reading
description: After lying down in bed, Yin Hao opened the notes app on his phone and checked today's to-do items one by one: morning run completed, materials sent to Sister Zhang (no reply), first aid confirmation screenshot taken, equipment maintenance completed, evening class finished, book read. All were confirmed. Then he browsed an e-book for a while, felt sleepy, set the alarm for 5:30, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting up, weighing himself, and reflecting on fat loss
description: Woke up a few minutes before the alarm and, as usual, immediately got up and turned on the light. Standing on the digital scale in the corner of the bedroom, the screen showed 71.0 kg. My feelings were mixed—it was both the result of losing 2.5 kg of fat and a reminder that I hadn't slept well the night before because of anxiety over housing prices. Looking out the window, it was cloudy with a gentle breeze, suitable for morning exercise.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, home bedroom

name: Morning run and stretching on the way back
description: Changed into a dark gray quick-dry T-shirt and athletic shorts. After a brief warm-up, I jogged five laps on the rubberized track at Xiaokunshan Health Park, about 4.2 kilometers, focusing on my breathing and stride while trying to put aside worries about the house, down payment, and future for now. After the run, I did 5 minutes of serious stretching in the park's stretching area, loosening my calves and hips. Then I walked home; on the way, I saw the camphor tree at the community entrance with leaves gleaming green, and felt much calmer.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and on the way back to Xingang Community

name: Showering, breakfast, and replying to Mom's message.
description: After a quick shower, he changed into work clothes, took two eggs, two slices of whole wheat bread, and a bottle of milk from the fridge, and skillfully fried a sunny-side-up egg and ate it sandwiched between the bread. He opened WeChat on his phone and saw the voice message his mother had sent last night. His heart ached. He typed a reply saying he would not go back for the May Day holiday because he had some things to take care of, and would return once he had some free time in a while, telling his parents to take care of themselves.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai; kitchen and living room at home

name: Organize the briefcase and prepare for the commute.
description: After breakfast, he checked the tools, drawings, and measuring instruments he might need for the day's work and placed them neatly in his messenger bag. He then checked his phone, keys, and work badge one last time, and once everything was verified, he left.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai; home living room

name: Driving to work
description: Started his car. The April wind blew in through the half-open window, carrying the damp smell of soil. Traffic on the road was smooth. Listening to the radio traffic tips about the May Day holiday, he quietly planned tonight's task list after taking the day off.
location: On the way from Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to No. 360 Huatianjing Highway.

name: Shift handover and morning work
description: After arriving at work, I changed into work clothes and had a brief handover with the night-shift colleague. I found that one machine tool had a spindle temperature alarm. After troubleshooting with Master Sun Jianguo, we found that the coolant pipe was blocked. It took half an hour to clean it and restore normal operation. Then I began machining a batch of urgent air-duct flange fittings, setting parameters strictly according to the process card and performing multiple self-checks.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: The cafeteria served braised pork chops, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. To control calories, he only got scrambled eggs with tomatoes and stir-fried greens, plus a portion of plain white rice. While eating, he scrolled through industry news on his phone and didn't bring up the house-buying topic again. After the meal, he leaned back in his workstation chair and rested with his eyes closed for 15 minutes.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work
description: After the lunch break, he continued working. The production tasks were relatively steady, and he continued machining the flange parts from the morning. While changing tools and adjusting the program, he encountered a code issue and asked Liu Zhiqiang for help to confirm it. At around 4:30, all orders for the day's batch were completed, with a 100% pass rate.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organize and check tomorrow's materials before leaving work.
description: Shut down the machine, cleaned up the chips, cleaned the workstation, put the tools back in place, and wrote the shift handover record. Then he went to the material area and checked the blanks and tool inventory needed for tomorrow morning’s planned production. He found that one type of tap was insufficient in stock and made a note in the handover log as a reminder.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive home from work and shop at the supermarket.
description: After getting off work, I drove to the Xingang Xincun fresh food supermarket not far from home. Pushing a shopping cart, I picked broccoli, lettuce, and tomatoes, took two boxes of chicken breast and one box of tenderloin, and also picked up a case of milk. After queuing to check out, I spent about 82 yuan in total, stocking up for the holiday.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Putting away ingredients, resting, and making dinner
description: After getting home, I first sorted the ingredients I bought and put them in the refrigerator. I drank a glass of water, sat on the sofa and scrolled through my phone for a while, replied to a few WeChat messages, and the weight record was synced to the fitness app. Then I started preparing a fat-loss dinner: cut the chicken breast into pieces, marinated it with salt and black pepper, and pan-fried it with little oil; at the same time, I blanched broccoli and lettuce; for the staple food, I steamed a corn cob. While eating, I recorded the dinner expense in the Shark Accounting app.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, at home

name: Month-end financial management: review, budget, and reserve fund.
description: He sat down at the desk and opened the Shark Accounting app to check the April monthly statement: salary income was 8,000 yuan; expenses included 2,800 yuan for rent, 799 yuan for running shoes, 800 yuan for a Kindle, 299 yuan for accident insurance, 750 yuan for vehicle expenses, about 1,450 yuan for meal card top-ups and daily expenses, plus a holiday allowance for his parents. The actual total expenditure was 7,898 yuan, exceeding the budget by 898 yuan. He then set the May total budget to 7,200 yuan in the app, cut the entertainment budget from 800 yuan to 500 yuan, the takeout budget from 400 yuan to 300 yuan, capped daily non-essential shopping at 200 yuan, and scheduled a weekly budget review on Friday evenings. Finally, he opened mobile banking and transferred 5,000 yuan from his salary card to Yu'ebao, with the note 'emergency reserve fund'. Watching the Yu'ebao balance increase, he felt somewhat more at ease.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai - at the desk in the living room at home

name: Organize application materials
description: Took out two document folders from the bedroom drawer. The first contained materials for the first-aid attendant training on May 10-11: original ID card, one-inch white-background photo, pen, and notebook. The second contained application materials for the talent apartment: copy of ID card, academic certificate (secondary vocational school), copy of labor contract, and copies of skill certificates prepared at the unit. After carefully checking all documents, put them into the folders and placed them in a prominent position on the desk, ready to submit after the May Day holiday.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai — bedroom and living room at home.

name: Video call with family
description: He made a cup of tea and dialed his mother on WeChat video. As always, his mother asked about his meals and health, and his father listened on the side. He reported that his job had been stable and he was in good health, and formally explained that he would not be going back to Nantong for the May Day holiday, because he wanted to use the break to tidy up the apartment, and planned to look at houses and apply for a talent apartment after the holiday. His mother nagged a little, saying, "Even when you're alone, you should celebrate the holiday properly." His father reminded him, "Take your time with the house matter." He only said, "I can handle it, don't worry," without mentioning his anxiety about rising house prices.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai; home living room

name: Monthly review and May goal setting
description: After hanging up, he opened the memo app on his phone and created a new note, writing: “Key gains in April 2025: 1. Finished the half marathon in 1 hour 58 minutes; 2. Lost fat successfully, from 73.5 kg down to 71.0 kg; 3. Kept up Python study 4 times and the Guokai course started smoothly; 4. Completed the April financial review.” Then he wrote: “May to-do list: 1. Start in-person apartment viewings after the May Day holiday, at least 3-5 apartments; 2. Complete basic first-aid training (May 10-11); 3. Accelerate preparation for the senior technician certificate, at least 8 hours per week; 4. Keep the May budget strictly within 7,200 yuan.”
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, home bedroom

name: Anxiety about house hunting before bed, decision-making, and falling asleep
description: Lying in bed, he told himself not to think about it anymore, but his hand unconsciously opened the Lianjia app and saw that the previously saved two-bedroom unit in the old town of Songjiang was now shown at 2.75 million yuan (another fluctuation from yesterday's 2.72 million). His heart skipped a beat. He did the math: his own 120,000 + parents' 200,000 + maybe 50,000 from friends = 370,000. To buy a house under 2.8 million yuan, a 35% down payment would be 980,000 yuan — a huge shortfall, unless the total price came down. Anxiety washed over him again. He sent a message in the veteran group chat: 'Brothers, looking at houses is giving me a headache.' Wang Lei replied, 'The troubles of the rich,' and Zhang Jianguo sent a 'fist and palm salute' emoji. He decided to stop worrying helplessly, pulled up the 'Action list after May Day' in his memo and read it twice: '1. Contact HR Zhang Jie to confirm the progress of the talent apartment; 2. Visit 3–5 houses in person; 3. Follow up on social security status.' After reading, he felt much more settled. He put his phone on the nightstand, turned off the light, and got ready to sleep. After tossing and turning for more than 20 minutes, he fell into a deep sleep, conserving energy for tomorrow and for the May Day holiday.
location: At home, in bed: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run at Xiaokunshan Health Park
description: Woke up at 6:30 in the morning, changed into running shoes and quick-dry sportswear, and walked to Xiaokunshan Health Park. On the park's fresh-air running track, he ran 5 kilometers at a pace of 6 minutes per kilometer. After finishing, he stretched in the exercise equipment area. He returned home at 7:20.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Kungang Highway and Qinghe Street, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning washing up and breakfast.
description: After running home, he immediately weighed himself: 71.2 kg, the same as yesterday, so his fat-loss results were maintained. Then he took a shower, washed up, and changed into loungewear. For breakfast, he made oat milk with a few cherry tomatoes, and while eating, he checked the Shanghai RenShe App on his phone to confirm his social security status was normal.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: PLC theory study and organization
description: First, I entered the study, neatly arranged the PLC programming manual, notebook, pen, and calculator, and wrote down the day's study plan in the notebook: finish the first three basic chapters in the morning, and work on ladder diagrams and timers in the afternoon. Then I began focused study. From 8:30 to 11:30, I concentrated on studying the first three chapters of PLC, covering working principles and basic logic instructions such as normally open, normally closed, and self-locking. I copied key concepts with a blue pen, underlined key points with a red pen, and personally simulated the signal flow of a self-locking circuit on paper until I understood it thoroughly. During this period, I refilled my water twice, and my efficiency was high.
location: Home study at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Homemade fat-loss lunch and lunch break
description: Finished studying on time at 11:30, used the air fryer to cook the pre-marinated chicken breast, paired it with a lettuce salad and mixed grain rice, and completed a fat-loss lunch. While starting to eat at 12:00, received a voice message from mother Wang Xiuying asking where he was; he replied that he was studying at home and had a brief chat. After eating, he cleaned up, sat on the sofa, set an alarm for 13:00, and took a half-hour nap.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Study PLC ladder diagrams and timers.
description: After lunch break, full of energy, he continued his PLC study. He focused on the ladder diagram chapter and hand-drew multiple sequential start circuit diagrams on A4 paper while referring to the manual. When he encountered a tricky problem about combining timers and counters, he stuck a sticky note beside the manual with the question: "How can a counter be used to implement N cycles?" He planned to ask his master after the holiday. Midway, at 15:30, he stood up and did 10 push-ups to loosen up, then continued studying in depth until 17:00.
location: Home study at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Chatted with comrades-in-arms.
description: After studying, while resting in the living room, he contacted his fellow soldier Gao Zhiyuan. He sent a WeChat message joking that he was chewing on the PLC bone.
