Gao Zhiyuan replied that he was hiking in Hangzhou with friends. The two chatted for more than ten minutes and agreed to play an online game together another day.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Light meal and monthly budget setup
description: After chatting with his former comrade-in-arms, he felt hungry but decided to keep dinner simple. He cooked tomato and egg noodles and ate them after reheating. While eating, he opened the Shark Accounting app and, based on the experience of overspending in April, set May's budget at 6,000 yuan, with a takeout cap of 800 yuan and entertainment cap of 500 yuan. There was no spending that day, so he logged 0 yuan and noted 'studying at home.'
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Building a PLC knowledge mind map
description: Back in the study, I didn't learn new content, but focused on review and organization. Took out a large blank sheet of paper and, referring to the manual's table of contents and notes, drew a mind map of PLC knowledge. Branching from the PLC overview to modules such as ladder diagrams, timers, and counters, I circled the afternoon's difficult points in red and marked the scan cycle principle in orange, making the knowledge framework clearer.
location: Home study at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with mother to say hello
description: After tidying up his study materials, he made a video call to his mother, Wang Xiuying. He reported to her that he had been learning new skills at home today and had not gone out during the May Day holiday. His mother repeatedly urged him to rest and not overwork himself. Listening to her nagging made him feel warm, and they agreed to get in touch again in a couple of days.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Shared learning progress with Lin Yue
description: After hanging up with his mother, he sent a voice message to his prospective girlfriend Lin Yue in Hangzhou, sharing his excitement about cracking the PLC problem and his idea of getting a senior technician qualification. Lin Yue replied that she had walked around West Lake with her best friend today and sent photos of West Lake. The two chatted for half an hour. Lin Yue encouraged Yin Hao and praised him as dependable.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Planning tomorrow's schedule and going to sleep.
description: At 22:00 set the alarm for the next day. Lying in bed, I reviewed that everything today was completed as planned and felt at ease. Did not look at the phone again, maintained a regular routine, and around 22:30 felt sleepy and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning routine: get up, weigh in, check running shoes and do chores
description: Woke up naturally at 7:30 AM. The first thing I did was go to the bathroom to weigh myself: 72.2 kg, 1 kg more than yesterday. Then I checked the new cushioned running shoes that arrived yesterday, confirmed the laces, insole, and midsole elasticity were fine, and changed into running gear. After a quick wash-up, I had a banana and two slices of whole wheat bread for breakfast. After eating, I washed and put away the dishes, put the workout clothes and work clothes into the washing machine separately, and mopped the bedroom and living room floors to keep the place tidy.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning: reading at home and Python preview.
description: Sitting on the living room sofa, I read 'Python Crash Course' on a Kindle, learning variables, strings, lists, and more. I used the memo app on my phone to jot down basic functions like print() and input(), as well as the for loop structure. While studying, I occasionally got up and looked out at the quiet neighborhood street, feeling fulfilled.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Prepared lunch at noon, had lunch, took a walk around the neighborhood, took an afternoon nap, and replied to WeChat messages.
description: At 11:10, he started preparing lunch: steamed cod, boiled soba noodles, and oil-free dressed lettuce. After eating, he changed into slippers and went downstairs for a slow walk around the neighborhood to aid digestion, enjoying the gentle afternoon breeze. At 12:10, he returned home, set an alarm, and took a nap. When the alarm went off, he checked WeChat. Colleague Wang Lei @'d him in the group to confirm the time and place for the evening murder mystery game; he replied to confirm and asked for the list of participants.
location: Kitchen at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the community area

name: Preparation before departure and planning the running route
description: After waking up from the afternoon nap, wash face with cold water, change into running suit and new running shoes and lace them tightly, check sports bottle and fill with electrolyte drink. Before going out, use Amap to navigate to Songjiang University Town Sports Center - Badminton Hall, showing about 22 minutes by car, take car keys and phone and set off.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Specialized running shoe testing and data recording at University City Stadium
description: After driving to the Songjiang University Town Sports Center badminton hall, he first did a 10-minute dynamic warm-up by the track (high knees, butt kicks, lunges). Then he pressed the button on his sports watch to start the test: first, a 3 km tempo run at 5:30/km pace to feel the cushioning and support; after a 2-minute rest, he did 3 sets of 100 m sprints to test high-speed grip and feedback. Afterward, he did 15 minutes of static stretching in the shade to relax the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. In the sports app, he noted that the new shoes had good forefoot rebound, good wrapping, no chafing, and a soft midsole suitable for long distances. After drinking enough electrolyte drink, he changed into a dry T-shirt.
location: Badminton Hall, Songjiang University Town Sports Center, 2000 Wenxiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home, take a shower, relax, and prepare to go out
description: After driving back to Xingang Community, he immediately took a hot shower to wash away the smell of sweat. He changed into dark casual pants and a clean polo shirt, and tidied his hair. Then he sat on the sofa browsing military news, shared his running record with the runners' group, and stored up energy for the evening socializing.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go to the murder mystery game store and immerse yourself in the holographic game experience.
description: At 5:30 p.m., Yin Hao set off by car and sent Wang Lei a voice message on the way to confirm the arrival time. He arrived at Xixiangji Holographic Light-and-Shadow Murder Mystery Performance Theater at 5:55 p.m. and met up with Wang Lei and three other players (two men and one woman). After the DM handed out scripts, he drew the detective role. At first he was a bit unused to the acting-and-immersion mode, but later he used logical analysis to sort out the timeline, studied the clue cards, and worked with everyone to reason things through. The 3.5-hour game was a fun mental exercise, and he had a great conversation with the new friends.
location: Xixiangji Holographic Light-and-Shadow Murder Mystery Performance Theater (Songjiang University City Branch), 955 Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Steamed seafood hot pot gathering
description: After the script murder game, still not wanting to leave, the group drove to Zhengcheng Shiyi Steam Seafood Hotpot. During the meal, they ordered steamed seafood and grilled skewers. Yin Hao, having had a large amount of exercise that day, relaxed his dietary control a bit and drank two or three bottles of beer. Everyone chatted while eating about the game's plot and their own lives. The atmosphere was relaxed and lively, until they dispersed at nearly 23:30.
location: Zhengcheng Shiyi Steam Seafood Hot Pot (Panyu Road Branch), 818 Panyu Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai

name: Drove home, washed up, and reflected before sleep
description: After the dinner gathering, he drove back to Xingang Community while slightly tipsy, and insisted on taking a shower after getting home. Before bed, he stepped on the scale and found his weight had risen to 73.3 kg. Annoyed that his weight had rebounded by more than 2 kg over the three-day holiday, he used the Shark Accounting App to record the dinner expense, resolved to strictly control his diet on the last day of the holiday and resume morning running the next morning, and then fell into a deep sleep around 00:30.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Early morning preparation and breakfast
description: At 5:30 in the morning, his biological clock woke him up on time. After washing up, he weighed himself: 73.3 kg, the same as yesterday. He loaded the fishing rod bag, live bait box, landing net, folding chair, and outdoor jacket he had prepared the night before into the trunk of the car downstairs. For breakfast he had protein powder, whole wheat bread, and a banana.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to pick up fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang
description: Set off by car at 6:10. The roads were clear on the early morning of Labor Day, and he arrived at the entrance of Wu Zhiqiang's residential complex in about 20 minutes. He had already messaged Wu on WeChat that he was there, and Wu showed up right on time. The two chatted excitedly in the car about race tactics and fish conditions.
location: Entrance of the residential community at Lane 401, Canghui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Heading to the competition venue and checking in
description: Drove along Huqingping Highway toward Dianshan Lake in Qingpu. There was some holiday traffic congestion, but it was overall manageable. Arrived at Jinguidao Fishing Center at 7:20, parked and headed straight to the registration desk, verified the registration information, received the competition credential and a commemorative fisherman hat, and was assigned to fishing spot A-15 by drawing lots.
location: Golden Turtle Island Fishing Center, Dianshan Lake Scenic Area, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Pre-match preparation and the early part of the morning competition
description: After finding the fishing spots, we began setting up. I was responsible for adjusting the float and mixing bait, using a mixed sweet-and-fishy bait to target large bottom fish. Brother Wu set up the umbrella, fishing chair, and landing net. A light drizzle began to fall, so I put on my hardshell jacket. At 7:55 the referee's whistle sounded and the competition began; I cast my first rod precisely into the spot. The fish were inactive for the first two hours, so I stayed focused and fine-tuned my technique according to the current and wind speed. Brother Wu passed me bait and gave suggestions in low-voiced exchanges. The few small crucian carp I caught during this period were released, and I kept my composure, believing the big fish were still to come.
location: Fishing spot No. 15, Area A, Jingui Island Fishing Center, Dianshan Lake Scenic Area, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Morning competition climax and wrap-up
description: At 10:15, the rod tip suddenly sank, and the feel was unusually heavy. I arched the rod and fought with the big fish underwater for nearly 10 minutes. Brother Wu stood by with a landing net, and finally a 4.2 kg black carp was worn out and scooped into the net, drawing cheers from everyone. Then Brother Wu used a drone to capture a spectacular aerial shot of me and my prize, overlooking the magnificent lake view, which made me want to buy a drone. After the morning competition ended, I was temporarily at the top in total weight. Satisfied, I discussed the power of the black carp with Brother Wu, and he sent me the original aerial footage.
location: Fishing spot No. 15, Area A, Jingui Island Fishing Center, Dianshan Lake Scenic Area, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Lunch replenishment and rest
description: During the noon break, Brother Wu and I bought boxed meals and bottled water from a food cart next to the competition venue. We specifically chose sets with more vegetables and resisted the urge to drink carbonated drinks. While eating, we exchanged information on fish activity with nearby fishing buddies. After eating, we stretched our arms and legs on the spot to prepare for the afternoon competition.
location: Food truck area, Jingui Island Fishing Center, Dianshan Lake Scenic Area, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon competition and wrap-up
description: In the afternoon, the rain stopped and the fish bites clearly became less frequent. We played it steady and adjusted the bait consistency, switching to smaller bait balls to attract cautious fish. The process was dull, but we kept casting patiently. At 3 p.m., the float showed a clear downward jerk; I decisively lifted the rod and hooked a carp of about 1 kilogram. At 3:30, the final whistle blew. We reeled in, weighed the catch, and the total weight was 11.8 kilograms.
location: Fishing spot No. 15, Area A, Jingui Island Fishing Center, Dianshan Lake Scenic Area, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Award ceremony and post-competition exchange.
description: The results were announced at 4 p.m. Thanks to the big black carp caught in the morning, I won third place in the amateur group, with a prize of 800 yuan. When I went on stage to receive the award and take photos, I pulled Brother Wu aside and asked in detail about drone models and his experience with the DJI Mini series. Brother Wu enthusiastically shared the pros and cons and recommended models for beginners. Offstage, I exchanged contact details with several fishing buddies I got along well with, and we agreed to go fishing together next time.
location: Main stage and rest area at the Golden Turtle Island Fishing Center in the Dianshan Lake Scenic Area, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Celebration dinner gathering
description: After the award ceremony, the organizers arranged a dinner for the participants at a restaurant in the venue. Brother Wu dragged me along with him. Glasses clinked back and forth and the atmosphere was lively. Unable to resist the hospitality, I ate quite a lot of braised pork and farmhouse dishes and drank two bottles of beer. Although I knew this messed up my meal plan, it was rare to have such fun, so I let myself relax.
location: Restaurant inside the Golden Turtle Island Fishing Center, Dianshan Lake Scenic Area, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Return trip to see off a friend and pay a visit along the way
description: After the banquet ended, he drove Brother Wu back to Songjiang city center. On the way, they revisited the highlights of the evening, and Brother Wu again encouraged him to buy a drone. Around 18:10, he dropped Brother Wu off at the entrance of his residential compound. On his way back to Xingang Community, he passed the Jianguo Electric Appliance Repair Shop at the community entrance, stopped, and went in to see Master Chen. He mentioned that he wanted to help out with odd jobs on weekends to earn extra money to buy a drone. Master Chen readily agreed, saying there was an old electric fan renovation job that he could help with.
location: Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, No. 228 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (via Lane 401, Canghui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai)

name: Returning home to rest and weigh in
description: After returning home, he rinsed and dried the fishing rod, fish bag, and other gear on the balcony, took a hot shower, and changed into loungewear. Stepping on the scale showed 73.8 kg. Because his weight had risen due to the banquet, going up for three consecutive days during the holiday, he decided to tighten control tomorrow.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Research drones and financial planning
description: After washing up, he sat down at the desk, opened the Shark Accounting app, and recorded the 800 yuan bonus as 'unexpected income.' Then he began researching drones: browsing DJI's official website, comparing the specifications and prices of the Mini 4 Pro and Mini 3, watching beginner review videos on Bilibili, and paying attention to image quality, portability, and difficulty of control. He noted down key information in his memo and initially planned a total budget of 2,500 yuan, with the 800 yuan bonus as the starting capital and the remaining gap to be covered by helping Master Chen with work and next month's allowance.
location: At the desk in the bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video sharing with girlfriend Lin Yue
description: Video-called his girlfriend Lin Yue, excitedly sent her the aerial video, and animatedly described the process of catching the big black carp and how stunned he was by the drone's perspective. Lin Yue was infected by his excitement, smiled, and encouraged him to develop the new hobby, joking that they could use the drone to shoot sunsets by West Lake in the future. After chatting for half an hour, he hung up feeling very good.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Free time and mobile phone entertainment.
description: He relaxed and scrolled through short videos for a while. Seeing that “Honor of Kings” had a new event, he logged in to claim the reward. After that, he browsed the residential community owners' group and a fishing enthusiast forum to learn about new fishing spots.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Pre-sleep stretching, reading, and preparation
description: I spread out a yoga mat and did 15 minutes of static stretching to relax my lower back and leg muscles. After stretching, I picked up “Python Crash Course” and read to Chapter 3, keeping up my studies. At 10 p.m., I went to the bathroom to wash up, and in the Shark Ledger app I retroactively recorded the expenses for the boxed lunch and the evening banquet. A quick diet review: breakfast and lunch were well controlled, but the pork and beer at the banquet pushed calories over the limit. I told myself to resume the morning run and normal eating rhythm tomorrow. I set my alarm for 6:30, thought back on the wonderful day, and fell asleep feeling satisfied.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wake-up and weigh-in
description: At 6:40 in the morning, the phone alarm woke Yin Hao. After getting out of bed, he stepped barefoot onto the electronic scale in the corner of the bedroom. The screen showed his weight at 74.0 kg, a slight increase from yesterday, and he realized it was probably due to overeating at yesterday's fishing competition celebration dinner. He then washed his face with cold water and reminded himself in the mirror that the holiday was over and he needed to get back into work mode.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run 5 kilometers.
description: Put on running shoes and headed out, walking 5 minutes to Xiaokunshan Health Park. While stretching at the entrance, met running buddy Chen Jie (A Jie). After exchanging greetings, the two started a recovery morning run along the park trail, pace lowered to 6 minutes 10 seconds per kilometer, chatting about half marathon training plans while running. After completing 5 kilometers, he was slightly sweaty but felt refreshed.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Walk home, have a fat-loss breakfast, and wash up
description: After the morning run, Yin Hao walked slowly home from the park to relax his leg muscles. On the way, he bought a tea egg at the breakfast stall at the entrance of the residential community. After arriving home, he took a shower and washed up, then started preparing a fat-reducing breakfast: chicken breast marinated with black pepper and olive oil and pan-fried over low heat, simultaneously blanching broccoli, and half a bowl of oatmeal porridge. The breakfast was light; although the taste was plain, considering the mild fatty liver found in the physical examination, he insisted on finishing it.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the surrounding area of the community

name: Tidying up the house and sorting through old belongings
description: After breakfast, he began tidying up the house: washing dishes, sweeping, and mopping the floor, putting yesterday's scattered snack bags and fishing gear parts back in place, and putting the fishing clothes into the washing machine with a scheduled wash for the afternoon. Then he started sorting the old clothes, old appliances, and express boxes piled up on the balcony, categorizing the clutter: recyclable waste was packed up, old appliances still usable were to be listed on Xianyu, and some old clothes were set aside for donation. He reflected on the comfort of a simplified life.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Disposed of old items at the flea market.
description: He used a handcart to take the sorted cardboard, plastic bottles, and several old appliances to the recycling point at the entrance of the residential community. After talking with Master Li, the waste recycler, he sold the recyclables for 15 yuan. At the same time, he put a few old clothes in good condition and a small electric fan on a temporary stall at the community-designated flea market, hoping to find buyers.
location: Temporary stall at the intersection of Xingang Road and Gangxing Road in Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the community waste recycling point.

name: Morning study: National Open University course planning and Python resource download
description: Returned home, opened the laptop at the desk in the bedroom, logged in to the Open University of China learning platform, carefully checked the May live class schedule for the mechatronics associate degree program, confirmed the classes from 19:30-21:00 every Tuesday and Thursday evening, synced the course links and reminders to his phone calendar, and wrote in his notebook that this week he would focus on the introductory chapters of Circuit and Electronic Technology. Then he opened his Bilibili favorites, found the Python basics tutorial he had favorited last night, watched a few minutes, felt the pace was right, and downloaded it locally. Next, he searched on the JD.com app for Python Crash Course (3rd Edition) and Fundamentals of Mechatronics, used a coupon for 10 yuan off purchases over 99 yuan, paid 64.8 yuan, and expected delivery on Wednesday.
location: At the bedroom desk, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Midday break, shopping, and lunch
description: After studying, he moved to the living room sofa, opened Taobao, and ordered a transparent kitchen scale with 0.1 g precision. After applying a coupon, he actually paid 29 yuan. Then he took out his physical examination report and the dietary recommendations from a health app, and carefully wrote out a fat-loss menu on paper: add sweet potato or corn for breakfast; for lunch, only choose steamed dishes and light meats in the cafeteria; for dinner, mainly chicken breast, fish, and leafy green vegetables. At noon, he made a simple tomato and egg noodle dish for lunch. While eating, he leaned back on the sofa and scrolled through his phone to check Yonghui Superstores' special offers. After the meal, he set an alarm and napped for 20 minutes. After waking up, he washed his face, put on a casual jacket, brought his car keys and shopping bags, took a photo of the shopping list and saved it to his phone, confirmed the supermarket's opening hours, and went out.
location: Living room and all rooms of Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Drive to Yonghui Supermarket to buy fat-loss ingredients.
description: Yin Hao drove his second-hand Volkswagen Polo along Xingang Road and Songjiang Renmin North Road to Songjiang Wanda Plaza. On the way, he listened to Shanghai Traffic Radio FM105.7. He arrived after about 15 minutes, entered the B1 floor of Yonghui Supermarket, pushed a shopping cart straight to the fresh produce and grain-oil sections, and bought according to his list: three boxes of chicken breast, two heads of broccoli, carrots, purple sweet potatoes, sweet potatoes, brown rice, and extra virgin olive oil. He also carefully compared salad dressing ingredient lists and chose a low-fat vinaigrette, spending 96.3 yuan in total.
location: Yonghui Supermarket, B1, Songjiang Wanda Plaza, 1788 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive home and pack the ingredients into portions
description: After shopping, he drove directly back to Xingang Community. On the way, while waiting at a red light, he saw the new season trailer for Honor of Kings and planned to play a game with friends when he got home. After arriving, he spread all the ingredients on the kitchen counter, rinsed the vegetables under running water, cut the chicken breast into 120-gram portions per meal, bagged them in plastic bags, and put them in the freezer along with the washed broccoli and carrot chunks. He poured the brown rice into a sealed jar, and wrapped the purple sweet potatoes and sweet potatoes in foil for tomorrow's breakfast. Looking at the neatly organized ingredients, he felt grounded.
location: Kitchen, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon leisure: playing guitar and researching drones.
description: Took the guitar out from under the bed, tuned it, and practiced for about 40 minutes. Reviewed the intros and chord changes of Little Grass and Chengdu, and felt that the rustiness from last week had somewhat recovered. Then he lay back on the sofa, opened his phone to compare the performance and prices of the DJI Mini 3 and Mini 4 Pro, estimated his saving progress (800 yuan bonus plus weekend part-time work and next month's allowance), and felt he could likely buy one before the end of the year.
location: Living room, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare a fat-loss dinner
description: He walked into the kitchen to prepare dinner. Tonight's plan was garlic-sautéed lettuce, half a boiled corn, and two pieces of air-fried salmon with just a light spray of olive oil. It took 40 minutes to finish, and the aroma was tempting.
location: Kitchen, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Dinner and after-dinner leisure.
description: I ate dinner attentively and cleaned my plate, then put the dishes and chopsticks in the dishwasher. Sitting on the sofa, I scrolled through short videos. I especially watched a few about ladder diagram programming tips and forwarded one of them to my mentor Sun Jianguo.
location: Living room, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with parents
description: Around 6 p.m., Yin Hao proactively made a video call home. His mother Wang Xiuying answered, and his father Yin Jianguo was also there. He told them in detail about the mild fatty liver found in his physical exam and explained the fat-loss plan he would strictly follow starting tomorrow. His mother lovingly told him to watch his nutrition, while his father calmly reminded him to keep a balanced diet and jokingly said that his mother also needed to adjust her cooking, so Yin Hao should learn to cook. Yin Hao agreed with a smile, told his parents he had already bought fat-loss ingredients, and said he felt physically at ease.
location: Sofa in the bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Playing Honor of Kings in a team
description: After hanging up, called colleagues Wang Lei and comrade-in-arms Zhang Jianguo on WeChat, and the three teamed up for two ranked matches. Yin Hao chose his best jungle position and cooperated well with Wang Lei's support, winning both matches. During the game they chatted about holiday experiences, and Wang Lei said he would also start losing weight tomorrow.
location: Sofa in the living room, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-bed study and plan preparation.
description: Leaning against the headboard, he took out his PLC notebook, focused on reviewing the set and reset instruction logic, drew a signal light control flowchart, and circled two questions to ask Master Sun tomorrow. Afterward, he went to the bathroom to wash up, rinsed his lower back with hot water to relieve fatigue, changed into pajamas, spread a yoga mat on the floor, did a 10-minute full-body stretch, and tried abdominal breathing to relax. Then he took out his phone, set the alarm for 6:10 the next morning, checked that the weather would be cloudy with no rain, confirmed in the work group that there was no overtime scheduled, and finally used his tablet to quickly browse the table of contents of the e-book Fundamentals of Mechatronics to warm up for tomorrow. Then he turned off the light and went to sleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom of Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and fat-loss breakfast
description: After the alarm sounded, I got up and weighed myself: 73.8 kg, down 0.2 kg from yesterday. Then I fried an egg in a pan without oil, toasted two slices of whole wheat bread, and made unsweetened soy milk. While waiting, I checked machinery industry news on my phone and reviewed the questions I had gotten wrong in the vocational qualification question bank about machining center principles.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Car commuting and audio learning of CNC programming
description: Carrying my commuter bag and water bottle, I set off from home and drove to the factory. On the way, I connected Bluetooth and played the audio course Advanced CNC Programming Examples, thinking about the precision bushing to be processed today and considering optimizing the tool path to improve efficiency.
location: Driving route from Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Huatianjing Highway.

name: Morning work: precision bushing machining and morning meeting
description: After arriving at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, I clocked in by card, changed into work clothes, confirmed the precision bushing production schedule with team leader Wang Lei, and showed him the tool path sketch I had drawn last night. Then I checked the warm-up status of CNC machine No. 3, installed the fixtures and tools, loaded the machining program, and verified the first-piece parameters. After starting the machine, I stayed focused on machining throughout, using a caliper to measure key dimensions in real time to ensure tolerances were controlled within 0.01 mm. After the first piece was completed, I invited Master Sun Jianguo, who was on inspection, to check it, and received his approval.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Canteen lunch break and professional qualification practice questions
description: On the way to the cafeteria, I walked and chatted with my colleague Wang Lei. For lunch, I strictly followed the fat-loss plan and chose steamed sea bass, garlic greens, and a small amount of rice. After eating quickly, I sat in a corner of the cafeteria and worked through PLC module practice questions from the professional qualification question bank on my phone, with 70% accuracy, and saved screenshots of the wrong questions to my mistake notebook.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work: shaft sleeve machining and PLC consultation
description: In the afternoon, continued machining precision shaft sleeves, with steady progress through the process. At the 3 PM workshop rotation break, I found Master Sun Jianguo in the rest area and asked him about the edge trigger instruction and scan cycle issues in the PLC ladder diagram reviewed last night. Master Sun gave an in-depth explanation using real machine tool cases for over ten minutes, and I noted all key points in my notebook.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Checked the Mother's Day package tracking after work
description: After completing the processing tasks and cleaning up the workstation, he clocked out and left work. Once in the car, he opened Taobao immediately to check orders. The logistics information for the Mother's Day bouquet and Nantong crispy biscuits showed they had arrived at the Nantong transit center, expected to be delivered on time. He took a screenshot to save the logistics status.
location: Parking lot, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Buying groceries at the supermarket and walking home
description: Drove to Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, selected half a jin of shrimp, two cucumbers, a bunch of scallions, and a small amount of brown rice according to the fat-loss menu, spending over 30 yuan. After shopping, walked about two minutes back home in Xingang Community.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cooking a low-fat dinner
description: After changing into loungewear, I went into the kitchen. First I cooked brown rice, then prepared the prawns and cucumber. Half an hour later, blanched prawns, cucumber salad, and brown rice were ready. I estimated the total calories at about 400 kcal and recorded the day's meals on a sticky note on the refrigerator.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Learning Python programming basics.
description: Sat down at the desk, opened the laptop, and followed a Bilibili tutorial to install Anaconda and VS Code. After configuring the environment variables, successfully ran print('Hello world') in the command line. Then tried simple variable assignment exercises; though typing was slow, it felt interesting.

name: Video chat with girlfriend Lin Yue

name: Before bed: recorded expenses, washed up, and relaxed.

Leaning against the bed with earphones on, played soft music on repeat, reviewed the day's work and study, and thought through PLC interrupt techniques. Around 23:00, closed my eyes in the dark, silently said the Saturday half marathon preparation was complete, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Room X, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning recovery run
description: The alarm went off at 5:30. He quickly washed up and changed clothes. He left at 5:40, walked about 5 minutes to the community gate, and, to avoid wasting time, jogged 1.5 kilometers directly to Xiaokunshan Health Park. At 6:00, he started a recovery jog, running 4 kilometers along the park track at a pace of 6:30 per kilometer, focusing on loosening the sore thighs from yesterday's tempo run. After the run, he stretched for 10 minutes by a park bench and used the mini foam roller he had brought to roll out his calves.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, Songjiang District, Shanghai (40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Highway)

name: Return home and weigh yourself on an empty stomach.
description: Jogged home at 6:10 and got home at 6:25. The first thing after entering the door was to step on the old scale, which showed 74.2kg. Seeing this number, I felt a bit disappointed. After 12 days of fat loss, my weight has barely moved. I know that looking only at weight is inaccurate, so today I must buy a body fat scale.
location: Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up, breakfast, and getting ready to go out
description: Took a quick shower and changed into work clothes. Breakfast had been prepared the night before: two slices of whole-wheat bread, one boiled egg, and a glass of warm milk. While eating, he checked the weather forecast for tomorrow's Sheshan Half Marathon on his phone: clear turning cloudy, with comfortable temperatures. He checked his belongings: phone, work badge, and car keys. He deliberately put the energy gels and salt tablets he had prepared in advance into his commuter bag.
location: Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to work by car
description: At 7:35, went downstairs and got into my car. The route is fixed: starting from Xingang Road, turn right along Dingyuan Road onto Huatianjing Highway. Traffic was moderate. I listened to the local traffic radio and let my mind go completely blank.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Worked in the morning.
description: Punched in at the workshop at 7:55, attended the team morning meeting at 8:30, and then started production. Today's task was still machining a batch of precision locating pins. Focused on operating the machine tool at work and guided intern Xiao Zhao on a parameter fine-tuning issue during tool setting.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Buy a body fat scale during the tea break
description: At 9:30, during the tea break, drove to Yifeng Pharmacy near the company. Picked out a multifunctional home body fat scale, paid, and put it in the trunk. Then quickly returned to the workshop and continued working.
location: Yifeng Pharmacy (Yukun Community Zone B Branch), Songjiang District, Shanghai (Address: No. 96-10)

name: Stretching during work break and sorting out study notes
description: Packed a shredded pork and green pepper rice bowl from the cafeteria and returned to the workshop. After lunch, at 12:00, in the material stacking area, found an open spot, laid out a foam mat, and did a 10-minute full-body stretch, focusing on loosening the shoulders, neck, and waist. Then took out a personal notebook, quickly reviewed the PLC interrupt program difficulties that Master Sun explained yesterday, and made notes of my own understanding and associations in red pen next to the key logic.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon work
description: Continued machining the locating pins and finished the batch of 50 around 3 p.m. After all self-inspections passed, I proactively reported for inspection and cleaned the chips out of the machine. I confirmed tomorrow's race arrangement with Team Leader Wang, and he patted me on the shoulder and said, "Run a good race tomorrow." Then I helped a colleague troubleshoot a small tool-wear alarm issue and clocked out on time at 17:00.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Picked up groceries on the way home from work
description: After work, he drove home and stopped by the Xingang New Village fresh food supermarket on the way. He parked, went in, bought fresh lean beef and a bunch of spinach to prepare for the evening's high-carb dinner. He arrived home at 17:45.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing and enjoying the pre-competition dinner.
description: He changed into loose loungewear. While boiling the pasta, he cut the lean beef into strips and marinated it with black pepper. He brought a pot of water to a boil and cooked the pasta. In another pan, he stir-fried the beef and spinach until cooked, then tossed them with the cooked pasta. At 18:00 he enjoyed a dinner high in carbohydrates, moderate in protein, and low in fat.
location: Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening study and competition equipment organization.
description: After a short rest after the meal, I took out the body fat scale manual, studied it, and set up the user info. Then I started preparing tomorrow's race gear: pinned the race bib onto the race jersey with safety pins, and checked the energy gels, salt tablets, sports watch, and waist pack. I took a 'family photo' of the gear and sent it to my girlfriend Lin Yue on WeChat. She instantly replied with a 'Go go go!' sticker pack.
location: Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Contact the real estate agent to schedule a house viewing.
description: Opened the Lianjia app and directly called Manager Zhang of the Songjiang Ledu Road store I had contacted before. I explained that I would have free time after tomorrow's competition and hoped to move the apartment viewing to 10 a.m. on May 18 (originally scheduled for Sunday). The other party said it could be arranged. Then I confirmed the specific address for the viewing and the materials that needed to be prepared. After hanging up, I took out my ID card and the last 6 months of bank statements from the document folder, organized them, and put them in the side pocket of the waist bag I would use for tomorrow's competition.
location: Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening leisure and event information confirmation
description: Opened the race assistant on my phone and did a final check of tomorrow's race-day temperature, humidity, wind, start time, cutoff time, and aid station locations. Sent a message to my running buddy Chen Jie to talk about tomorrow's pacing strategy. Then lay on the sofa and listened to some instrumental music on the phone speaker to fully relax my body and mind.
location: Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Final equipment check and relaxation before the race
description: Spread out all the gear for tomorrow's race (race bib, timing chip, race shirt, running shoes, socks, energy gels, salt tablets, sports watch, waist pack) on the living room sofa, double-checked each item, and pinned the race bib onto the race shirt. Also checked the body fat scale bought from the pharmacy to make sure it had enough battery.
location: Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: Boiled a pot of hot water and soaked his feet for 15 minutes to promote blood circulation and help sleep. While soaking his feet, he used his phone to briefly note down today's expenses (pasta, beef, spinach, groceries, etc. totaling about 40 yuan, and the body fat scale costing 120 yuan). Set the alarm for 5:30 tomorrow morning. To save time in the morning, he also placed the power bank and charging cable for tomorrow's trip to the race start in the entrance in advance. Turned off the light and lay down.
location: Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wake up, quantify health metrics, and prepare breakfast.
description: As soon as the phone alarm went off, I got up immediately and, on an empty stomach, used the new body fat scale to measure my weight at 74.2 kg and body fat percentage at 25.5%, and carefully recorded them in my phone notes. After washing up, I changed into my race uniform and shorts, noticing that the sky outside was already bright and the birdsong was clear. The weather forecast said sunny, 22 to 31°C. I quickly cooked oatmeal and had it with a banana as a pre-race breakfast, eating until about 70% full. At the same time, I pinned the race number bib onto my uniform, stuffed energy gels and salt tablets into my waist pack, checked the battery level of my sports watch, put on my Xtep 160X 3.0 running shoes that had already covered more than 200 kilometers, and, as usual, double-checked all my gear before leaving.
location: Room 602, Building 18, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to Sheshan and checked in and warmed up
description: It was already broad daylight. He drove along the familiar route to Sheshan; the roads were clear in the early morning, and about 15 minutes later he arrived at the Sheshan National Tourist Resort parking lot. After depositing his bag, he did dynamic stretching and a jogging warm-up at the main venue. During the warm-up he met Chen Jie, a fellow runner who was also competing; they briefly discussed pace strategy, agreed to meet after the race, and then split up to check in. By then the sun was already somewhat strong, so he prepared for the upcoming half marathon.
location: Sheshan National Tourist Resort, 1999 Linyin New Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Participating in the Sheshan Half Marathon
description: The starting gun went off at 8 o'clock sharp. He kept a steady pace strictly according to the plan, controlling the pace for the first 5 km at about 5 minutes 55 seconds per kilometer, with smooth breathing. After 10 km, he felt good and accelerated appropriately. The last two kilometers were tough, but he gritted his teeth and crossed the finish line. The watch showed 2 hours 8 minutes 0 seconds, nearly 3 minutes faster than his last half marathon, successfully setting a new personal best. When he received the medal, his palms were sweaty and his heart was full of joy.
location: Sheshan National Tourist Resort Half Marathon Course, No. 1999 Linyin New Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Post-race recovery, exchange, and training advice
description: Walked to the stretching area to systematically relax his muscles. His colleague Wang Lei suddenly appeared and warmly congratulated him on his PB, immediately asking him to create a running plan. So he opened Keep and designed a beginner program for him: jogging 3 times a week, 20 to 30 minutes each session, without requiring a specific pace, to first build the habit. Running buddy Chen Jie then joined the stretching. After observing his knee posture, Chen Jie suggested adding cycling cross-training to balance muscle groups and reduce knee pressure, recommending starting with short rides on shared bikes. He took the suggestion seriously and wrote it down.
location: Stretching area at the half marathon main venue, Sheshan National Tourism Resort, 1999 Linyin Xin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving home and purchasing fresh groceries
description: After saying goodbye to his friends, he drove home, making a detour to the Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket on the way. He bought fresh vegetables, a box of chicken breast, original-flavored potato chips, and a few bottles of electrolyte drinks, planning to refuel during the afternoon break. It took him 2 minutes on foot from the supermarket to get back to the community.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket and surrounding area, at Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Stretching to relax, showering, and lunch
description: After getting home, he immediately used a foam roller to thoroughly roll out his thighs, calves, and buttocks, enduring the soreness but making sure his muscles were relaxed. Then he took a hot shower and changed into loose loungewear. For lunch, he simply cooked a plate of pasta with tomato sauce and the chicken breast he had just bought, and after eating he felt completely relaxed.
location: Room 602, Building 18, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon rest and sharing the joy of the competition.
description: Collapsed on the sofa and browsed through the race photos, picked out the finish-line close-ups and the medal photo and sent them to the family group, with the caption "Successful PB, 2 hours 8 minutes". His mother immediately replied with several voice messages, urging him to eat something and rest well. He then sent the photos to his girlfriend Lin Yue, who replied with a thumbs-up emoji and suggested going out for a nice meal together tomorrow afternoon to celebrate, so they chatted a bit and agreed on a specific time.
location: Room 602, Building 18, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organizing race items and browsing running gear
description: After resting, he got up and cleaned up the waist pack, race bib, and sports watch used in the race. Then he sat at the computer and browsed a running gear shopping app, checking new cushioned running shoes and hydration waist pack styles. He considered getting new gear for the next race but did not place an order yet.
location: Room 602, Building 18, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Snack time and watching esports replays
description: Feeling hungry, took out original-flavor potato chips and an electrolyte drink, sat in front of the TV and watched a replay of yesterday's League of Legends Pro League playoff game on the sports channel, to get familiar with the match situation in advance for the esports final discussion in the group chat that evening.
location: Room 602, Building 18, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Packed up dinner, ate, and watched a recovery video
description: Changed into casual clothes, walked to the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road opposite the residential complex, ordered a serving of stir-fried pork, a serving of dry-fried green beans, and rice to take away. The owner, who knew him, threw in an extra serving of peanuts. After returning home, he plated the dishes, opened a sugar-free cola, and while eating watched videos on his tablet about marathon recovery and cycling cross-training, gaining a more concrete understanding of Chen Jie's advice.
location: Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, No. 232 Xingang Road, Dagang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and home

name: Responding to the esports match-watching proposal and organizing house-viewing materials
description: Seeing Wang Lei's suggestion in the company WeChat group to go to Jing'an Sports Center on May 24 to watch the East China regional e-sports final, he immediately replied, “Count me in.” Colleague Ma Xiaofeng also responded. The three discussed seats and tickets and agreed to book them in the next few days. Then he remembered that he had arranged to view an apartment with a Lianjia agent at 2 p.m. the next day. He found his ID card, printed out his bank statement, carefully put them in a document folder, and made sure he wouldn't forget anything when going out tomorrow morning.
location: Room 602, Building 18, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Soak feet to relax and prepare for bed.
description: Boiled hot water and added foot soak powder, soaked feet to relieve fatigue, while browsing news on mobile. After soaking, set the alarm for 10 a.m. the next morning, and placed the prepared house-viewing folder on the shoe cabinet by the door. Though tired, felt fulfilled.
location: Room 602, Building 18, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going to bed
description: Went to bed at 22:00 sharp and reviewed the day's key events: set a new half marathon personal record, received recognition from friends, and made plans for weekend activities and tomorrow's house viewing. Sleepiness set in, and I fell into a deep sleep around 23:00.
location: Room 602, Building 18, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning routine and financial management
description: Yin Hao woke up naturally in the overcast weather, feeling soreness in both legs after the half marathon. He picked up his phone to check the weather, then opened the banking app to confirm the 500-yuan savings plan that had been automatically transferred to Yu'ebao at 7 a.m. that morning. He reviewed yesterday's half-marathon results and pace chart, and used the new body fat scale to weigh himself and recorded the data in his phone's memo app. His weight was 73.9kg.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning stretching and simple breakfast
description: Because of yesterday's high-intensity exercise, Yin Hao did not schedule a run today. He spread out a yoga mat on the floor and did 15 minutes of full-body static stretching, focusing on relaxing the front and back of the thighs and the ankles. Afterward, he cooked oatmeal and paired it with two boiled eggs for a simple breakfast.
location: Living room of Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparation and confirmation of house-viewing materials
description: After breakfast, Yin Hao checked again the materials to bring for the afternoon house viewing: ID card, proof of income, and bank statements. He used his iPad to do a final confirmation on the Lianjia app of the VR videos and floor plans of the two listings at Lane 118, Ledu Road, and planned the driving route on his phone. He placed the materials in his personal bag and brought a folding umbrella in case of showers.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Went to Jianguo Appliance Repair Shop to learn earphone repair.
description: Yin Hao drove about 15 minutes to Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop at No. 78 Rongle Middle Road and told Master Chen about the poor contact problem with his sports earphones. Master Chen checked and found that the solder joint inside the plug was loose. He immediately re-soldered it and insulated it with heat-shrink tubing. Yin Hao seriously studied the repair technique, helped sort out a batch of used electrical appliances waiting for repair, and listened as Master Chen demonstrated how to identify common small appliance parts, taking careful notes throughout.
location: Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, No. 78 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returned home for a simple meal and determined the key points for viewing houses.
description: After finishing the repair, drove about 15 minutes back to the Xingang Residential Area home. Took out the yuxiang shredded pork packed last night from the fridge, and cooked a bowl of noodles as lunch. While eating, he listed in his phone memo the key issues to focus on during the afternoon house viewing: wall cracks, bathroom water seepage, kitchen smoke exhaust, and noise from outside the window.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Midday rest and departure preparation
description: After dinner, Yin Hao took a 20-minute rest on the sofa. After waking up, he tidied himself, changed into a clean T-shirt and sports pants, checked the phone navigation again, and planned to set out before 13:00.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to Ledu Road to view a house
description: Yin Hao drove for about 15 minutes to the residential community at Lane 118, Ledu Road, and parked on the roadside. At the community gate, he met Manager Zhang, an agent from Lianjia. After a brief exchange of pleasantries, he learned about the owners of that day's two property listings.
location: Entrance to the residential community at Lane 118, Ledu Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Visit two second-hand houses in person.
description: Manager Zhang first showed Yin Hao a 42-square-meter fifth-floor walk-up unit. Yin Hao assessed the physical effort required to climb the stairs, carefully checked the walls and ceiling for mildew stains, opened and closed windows to test soundproofing, and used his phone to film the lighting in each room and record the road noise outside the balcony. Next they viewed a 45-square-meter third-floor unit with an elevator, which had obvious advantages. He focused on checking the bathroom and kitchen ventilation and water pressure, and tapped lightly on non-load-bearing walls. For every detail, he recorded brief comments using the memo app on his phone.
location: Inside the residential compound at Lane 118, Ledu Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Consulted about mortgage policies at a Lianjia store.
description: After viewing the apartment, he went to the Lianjia store on the first floor at No. 200 Ledu Road. Manager Zhang, based on Yin Hao's annual income of 120,000 yuan, savings of about 500,000 yuan, and housing provident fund base, used a total price of 1.5 million yuan as an example and calculated in detail the down payment of 30%—about 450,000 yuan—as well as the application conditions and interest rates for a combination loan (provident fund + commercial loan). Yin Hao noted the key figures and conditions in his notebook and set a goal of saving 500,000 yuan by the end of 2026.
location: Lianjia store, 1st floor, No. 200 Ledu Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving back home
description: After finishing the store consultation, Yin Hao drove about 15 minutes from Ledu Road back to Xingang Community, focusing on the road while comparing the pros and cons of the two properties in his mind.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organize house-viewing materials and create a comparison table
description: After coming home, opened the laptop and organized the floor plans, lighting videos, noise recordings, and self-recorded pros and cons of the two listings into a clear comparison table, highlighting key factors such as whether there was an elevator, area, floor level, and the 150,000 yuan difference in total price.
location: Study, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video-called family to exchange opinions about buying a house.
description: Yin Hao sent the comparison table and photos to the family WeChat group, then had a video call with his older brother Yin Tao, explaining in detail the loan plan and future savings plan. Yin Tao suggested prioritizing apartments with elevators and shared his home-buying experience. After that, he video-called his parents; his mother asked about his health, and his father advised him to look at more properties and not rush. The family's support strengthened Yin Hao's determination to buy a home.
location: Living room of Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparation before the appointment
description: After hanging up the video call, Yin Hao changed into comfortable clothes, dug out the damaged computer mouse, and planned to ask Master Sun to take a look at it during dinner. After tidying up, he walked to the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road for the appointment.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner with Master Sun at the Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant.
description: Yin Hao walked about 5 minutes to the Sichuan restaurant at No. 232 Xingang Road and ordered poached pork slices in chili oil, hand-torn cabbage, and steamed egg with clams with Master Sun Jianguo. During the meal, Yin Hao asked in detail about property management fees in old residential communities, renting or buying parking spaces, soundproofing, and aging water and electrical lines. Master Sun gave practical advice on each issue based on his own experience and suggested checking the noise at night again. Yin Hao listened and took notes in his phone memo, and his thinking gradually became clearer. After the meal, he took the initiative to pay the bill.
location: Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, 232 Xingang Road, Dagang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Made a nighttime visit to Ledu Road residential area while passing by.
description: After dinner, Yin Hao drove about 15 minutes to Lane 118, Ledu Road. Following Master Sun's advice, he parked on the roadside, walked to the building of the 42-square-meter walk-up apartment, stood for 5 minutes to experience the nighttime environmental noise, and then went to the area of the elevator apartment to observe the community's nighttime parking and patrol situation.
location: Around the residential community at Lane 118, Ledu Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Returned home and organized the house-buying research log
description: After the night visit, he drove back to Xingang Community, brewed a pot of warm tea, and, under the desk lamp, combined the afternoon's apartment-viewing notes, Master Sun's advice, and his impressions from the night visit into a systematic "May 18 Home-Buying Inspection Log," recording the key points of the combined loan and updating the savings progress table.
location: Study, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and pre-sleep relaxation
description: Soaked feet in hot water to relieve the day's fatigue, then lay in bed browsing Xiaohongshu for half an hour for small-apartment renovation, storage, and remodeling ideas, and saved related posts.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare for tomorrow's work and go to sleep
description: Set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, briefly went over tomorrow's work machining tasks in my mind, and reviewed the gains from the day's house-buying inspection. Though the pressure remained, my motivation was even stronger, and I turned off the lights and went to sleep on time at 23:00.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wake up and morning routine
description: At 06:15 the alarm went off right on time and he got up immediately. First, he stepped on the scale and recorded his weight of 73.8 kg and body fat percentage of 25.4% in his phone memos. It was gloomy and muggy outside, so he put an umbrella into his commuter bag. After washing up, he had oatmeal with milk, a boiled egg, and half a banana for breakfast. After getting ready, he felt energetic.
location: Bedroom/bathroom/kitchen at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Commute to company
description: After putting on my work clothes and grabbing my work badge, bag, and umbrella, I went downstairs and drove from Xingang Residential Community, along Xingang Road and onto Huatianjing Highway. The route was smooth with no traffic jams, and I arrived at the company in exactly 15 minutes. On the way, I listened to the morning news and went over the drawing of the thin-walled sleeve to be machined that day in my head.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Pre-shift meeting and equipment inspection
description: After clocking in at the factory, I changed into safety shoes. At 7:30, I attended the pre-shift meeting of Production Department One. Team Leader Wang assigned the task of machining a batch of high-precision thin-walled sleeves. After the meeting, I checked the oil pressure, air pressure, and coolant level of the machine I was responsible for; everything was normal, and I felt reassured.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Focused on machining tasks.
description: In the morning, full of energy, he focused entirely on machining thin-walled sleeves. He carefully checked the drawings and adjusted the program. For the first piece, he repeatedly measured with calipers and a micrometer, and after confirming that the 0.008 mm tolerance was acceptable, he started batch production. He changed the cutting tool once midway; progress was steady with no abnormalities.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and review of PLC notes.
description: At 11:30 the lunch break bell rang. I went to the cafeteria and got a tomato-and-egg rice bowl. While eating, I flipped through my PLC notebook, quickly reviewed the ladder diagram questions I had circled during last night's preview, and annotated my thoughts next to them in red pen, preparing for the evening online class.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Midday break and mentoring interns
description: After the meal, he returned to the workshop rest area, leaned back in a chair, and rested with his eyes closed for about 20 minutes. When he woke up, the intern Xiao Zhao came to ask about yesterday's fixture setup and adjustment problem. He explained it in an easy-to-understand way until Xiao Zhao nodded that he understood.
location: Workshop rest area at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Afternoon machining tasks
description: In the afternoon, continued processing the sleeve, strictly following the process card and staying focused. Completed the entire batch of parts around 3:30, and all parts passed comprehensive self-inspection for precision. After finishing work, tidied the workstation and filled out the daily production report.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Assist with equipment maintenance
description: Master Sun came over for the routine monthly equipment maintenance. Together they cleaned the chips inside the machine tool and replaced the coolant filter. During the chat, Master Sun brought up yesterday's house viewing, saying the 45-square-meter apartment with an elevator was good value for money, but the down payment gap was still considerable. He patted Yin Hao on the shoulder and encouraged him: 'Take it steady, young man, it's no big problem.'
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Wrap-up work and preparation to leave
description: After the maintenance, he moved tomorrow's blanks to be processed to the pending processing area and checked the tool magazine. After 4:30, he organized the day's work records and cleaned the machine tool. He clocked out on time at 17:00, feeling good.
location: Workshop/workstation, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Change clothes after work
description: Changed into my own T-shirt and sweatpants, took the folding bike out of the car, and unfolded it. Today I deliberately didn't drive; instead I cycled to the repair shop — convenient and no need to worry about traffic jams.
location: Changing room / entrance, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Cycled to the repair shop.
description: Starting from the company, I rode south along Huatianjing Highway, turned right onto Rongle Middle Road. The ride took about 15 minutes, actually around 20 minutes with red lights. The cool breeze blew away the fatigue of work.
location: Section from Huatianjing Road to Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Helping at the repair shop and practicing skills
description: Arrived at Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop. Master Chen had accumulated three jobs: a mini washing machine with poor drainage — he determined there was a foreign object in the drain pump, opened it up, removed a coin, and repaired it; a microwave oven not heating — after testing the door switch, he confirmed the door interlock switch was damaged, replaced it, and it worked normally; and finally an induction cooker with an error code — under Master Chen's guidance, he tested step by step, identified that the fuse and IGBT power tube were burned out, replaced them, and the power-on test succeeded. Master Chen praised that his skills had not gotten rusty and that he was improving quickly, and gave him 150 yuan for labor.
location: Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, Middle Rongle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Have dinner with Master Chen
description: After the work was done, Master Chen, as usual, asked him to stay for a meal at the Old Place Shanghai Cuisine Restaurant next to the repair shop. They ordered braised pork, steamed pomfret, and garlic water spinach. While eating, they chatted about what was going on in the repair circle, and Master Chen shared a few tricks for diagnosing tricky appliance problems, which were fascinating to hear.
location: Old Place Shanghainese Restaurant, Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Return home and handle WeChat group ticket booking
description: Biked home after saying goodbye to Master Chen and arrived at 20:15. In the WeChat group 'Honor of Kings: Three Waiting for One', Wang Lei and Ma Xiaofeng were discussing buying tickets for the esports final on May 24. After quickly comparing sessions and seating areas, he picked the most cost-effective third-class seat option and posted it to the group: 'Then let's go with the afternoon session on the 24th, choose Section 366, total price 183 per person. If you want it, I'll place the order now? Pay me first.' The two instantly replied and agreed, then transferred the money. He placed the order and paid, and sent a screenshot to the group.
location: Home, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Confirmed the cycling cross-training plan.
description: After buying the ticket, he remembered that Chen Jie had suggested yesterday to try cycling to protect his knees, and thought it was reasonable. He opened the chat with Chen Jie and sent a message: "Jie, I've thought about the cycling you mentioned yesterday. I really should add it. For a beginner, should I get a mountain bike first? Are there any reliable shops or brands?" He added: "The weather is getting warmer. Starting next week, I plan to arrange a night ride once a week to get used to it."
location: In the study at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: Preview the OUC online course.
description: After taking care of daily chores, he took out his PLC textbook and notebook. Tonight's online course topic was "Function Instructions." He browsed the courseware in advance based on the questions he had marked at noon, highlighted key points in the book, and wrote down his own understanding.
location: In the study at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: Evening tidying and preparation
description: After studying, I got up and moved around, went to the kitchen and cut a plate of fruit. While eating, I used mobile banking to record expenses: dinner was treated by Master Chen, spending 0 yuan; the 366 yuan advanced for tickets had been fully recovered. I put the clothes for tomorrow by the head of the bed and set the alarm for 6:10.
location: Kitchen/bedroom at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Washing up and relaxing with a foot soak
description: Take a comfortable hot shower, then fill a bucket with hot water and soak your feet on the living room sofa while browsing a repair forum and reading technical cases shared by others. After soaking your feet, your whole body feels relaxed and your mood is uplifted.
location: Bathroom/living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Getting ready for bed
description: Took a sip of water, turned off the light, and lay down. Reviewing the day: the work went well, maintenance skills improved, and matters with friends were settled clearly. Feeling at ease, he soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Getting Up and Morning Preparation
description: The alarm rang right on time at 6:15. Yin Hao didn't linger in bed and sat straight up. He glanced at his phone and confirmed that the ticket money Wang Lei and Ma Xiaofeng had transferred last night had arrived. He put on the quick-dry T-shirt and shorts prepared in advance, drank a few sips of warm water, did a simple stretch of his legs and shoulders, and got ready to go out for a morning run.
location: Bedroom at home, Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: 4 km morning run
description: Rode a shared bike to Xiaokunshan Health Park. The weather was cloudy and felt comfortable. He deliberately controlled his pace, keeping it around 5:30, with his heart rate stable around 145. After the run, he did 5 minutes of targeted stretching in the park's stretching area, opening up his hip joints and Achilles tendons, then rode home.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Shower, breakfast, and getting ready to go out
description: After getting home, he quickly took a shower and changed into his work clothes. Breakfast was boiled eggs, whole wheat bread, and a glass of milk. While eating, he put the preview notes for today's PLC course and a few pens into his commuter bag. After confirming his phone, work badge, and keys were all there, he put on his watch and left on time at 7:50.
location: Home at No. X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute to the factory
description: He got on his electric scooter, rode along Xingang Road and turned onto Huatianjing Road, covering about 4.5 kilometers in 15 minutes. After entering the factory area, he parked the scooter in the designated non-motor vehicle shed and swiped his card to enter the workshop.
location: Along Xingang Road to Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning work: focused on machining parts.
description: Put on his safety shoes and attended the pre-shift meeting. Today's main task was to machine a batch of high-precision mold guide pillars with strict tolerance requirements. Yin Hao focused intently, set up the machine tool according to the procedure, and after each piece carefully used a micrometer to self-check, ensuring every dimension was within the range required by the drawing. Midway, Team Leader Wang came over to ask about progress, and he reported the current situation truthfully.
location: Workshop work station at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and a short break
description: At 11:30 he went to the cafeteria for lunch. Today the cafeteria had braised pork chop and stir-fried tomatoes and eggs. He got a serving and sat down in a corner. He ate quickly to get ready for the ticket rush ahead.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Noon break and rushing to buy tickets
description: After the meal, he found a quiet spot in the rest area and sat down. At exactly 12:15, he quickly opened the official ticketing app for the Honor of Kings Professional League, skillfully selected three adjacent third-class seats for the final on May 24, and successfully paid 549 yuan via WeChat Pay. He then sent a screenshot of the e-ticket to the 'Songjiang Engineering Brothers' WeChat group with the message: 'Tickets secured! I'll check the transfer in a bit.' Then he put on headphones and used the remaining time to review the 'Branch Current Method' chapter for the evening livestream class, marking a few confusing points in his notes to ask during the lesson.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon work: equipment maintenance and wrap-up.
description: In the afternoon, he continued the morning's parts machining tasks. Around 3:30, Master Sun asked Yin Hao to join him in routine third-level maintenance on the CNC machines in the workshop, mainly adding lubricating oil to the lead screws and guide rails and checking the coolant level. During the maintenance, Master Sun reminded him again that when buying a house, he should consider commuting and surrounding amenities, and Yin Hao listened carefully as he worked. At 4:30, the maintenance ended. He went to the tool room to return the special wrench, returned to his workstation to fill out that day's Processing Daily Report and Equipment Inspection Checklist, and cleaned up his workstation.
location: Workshop work station at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting from work and heading to the repair shop
description: Clocked out at 17:00, got on the electric bike and went to Master Chen's repair shop. On the way, he stopped at a convenience store by the roadside and bought a bottle of 1.5L mineral water. The factory was about 5 kilometers from the repair shop, and the ride took 20 minutes.
location: Along Huatianjing Road to Renmin North Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Repair shop practice and drone learning
description: Arrived at the repair shop at 17:30. Master Chen was repairing a vacuum cleaner for a customer. After greeting him, Yin Hao took the rusty old telephone that Master Chen handed him. He carefully opened it with a small screwdriver and used alcohol and an eraser to clean the oxidation layer off the contacts, his movements very steady.
