After cleaning, Master Chen asked him to help replace a potentiometer with a loose knob inside an old radio. Standing beside him, Yin Hao watched Master Chen work and noted the soldering techniques. When the work was done, he eagerly asked Master Chen for beginner knowledge about drones. Master Chen took an old copy of Introduction to Remote Control Models and several blueprints from under the counter and handed them to him. "Take them back and read them first. Once you understand the principles, we'll talk about assembly." Finally, Master Chen paid him 40 yuan for today's helper work.
location: Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, No. X, Renmin North Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Going home and having a simple dinner
description: After leaving the repair shop, I rode my bike home in 12 minutes. On the way, I bought a bunch of leafy greens and a few tomatoes at the fresh produce store at the entrance of the community. After getting home, I washed my hands, boiled a pot of water, and cooked a small handful of dried noodles. Using the leftover shredded pork from yesterday and the greens and tomatoes bought today, I made a steaming bowl of noodles with greens and shredded pork. After eating, I washed the dishes and utensils and wiped the kitchen clean.
location: Kitchen at home, Unit X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Attend the Open University of China's live-streamed mechatronics course.
description: At 7:45, he opened the laptop in his study, logged into the Open University of China learning platform, and entered the mechatronics classroom. Tonight was Teacher Liu Jianjun's "DC Circuits" class. Halfway through the class, Yin Hao typed a question in the discussion area: "Teacher Liu, regarding the branch current method, when there are controlled sources in the circuit, are there any special points to pay attention to when writing the equations?" Teacher Liu soon called his name and had him connect his microphone, then answered his question in detail. After class, he downloaded the courseware for that day's lesson and, as required by the teacher, used Multisim to build a simple circuit for simulation, then submitted screenshots of the assignment.
location: Study in his home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Search for cycling basics
description: After the course ended, he did not turn off the computer immediately. Instead, he opened several well-known cycling forums. In the search bar, he entered "beginner road bike recommendations," "cadence training," and "heart rate zones," carefully browsed several featured posts, and bookmarked the two he found most useful: one was "A Guide to Choosing a Road Bike on a 3,000 Yuan Budget," and the other was "How Beginners Can Build a Sense of Cadence." He also took screenshots of several key data points, such as a target cadence of 90-100 and the models of entry-level bikes, and saved them to his phone's photo album.
location: Study in his home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: At-home core training and personal management
description: He turned off the computer, took out the yoga mat, and did 3 sets of planks (each held to exhaustion) and 4 sets of crunches (20 reps each). After training, he went to the bathroom to wash up and soaked his work clothes in water. Back in the room, he took out his ledger and recorded the day's main expenses: breakfast (ignored), lunch (15 yuan), groceries (8 yuan), repair shop income (+40 yuan). Then he carefully clipped the materials he got from Master Chen today into his study folder.
location: Living room at home, No. X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Pre-bed preparation and rest.
description: Set the phone alarm for 6:15 tomorrow morning, checked tomorrow's weather forecast, confirmed it would be cloudy with rain, and took a waterproof jacket from the wardrobe and placed it on the commuter bag. Finally, he glanced at the "Songjiang Engineering Three Brothers" WeChat group. Wang Lei and Ma Xiaofeng had already transferred their 183 yuan ticket money, along with a thumbs-up sticker. He accepted the red envelopes and replied, "Got it, done." At 22:50 he turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully within a minute.
location: Bedroom at home, Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: He got up, washed up, and splashed cold water on his face to refresh. Stepping on the body composition scale, it showed 73.6 kg, 0.1 kg less than yesterday, and he felt satisfied with his diet control and exercise results. He then made milk oatmeal and added a banana as breakfast. While eating, he checked the work group messages; no one had @-mentioned him, so he marked last night's unread group chats as read. After the meal, he changed into work clothes, checked his work badge, keys, and phone, and put his swimming gear bag (swim trunks, goggles, towel) in the car ahead of time, preparing to go straight to swimming after work.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting by car to the factory
description: Drove from Xingang Community to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, listening to local traffic radio along the way. The trip took about 15 minutes with smooth traffic, and he arrived on time and parked the car.
location: From Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning workshop processing and preparation
description: After arriving at the workshop, I first inspected the machine tools I was responsible for, checking whether the hydraulic pressure and air pressure were normal. Then I turned on the computer and looked at the day's machining drawings — a batch of stainless steel flanges. I confirmed the parameters and cutting tools, silently resolving to ensure a 100% first-pass yield. At 8 o'clock sharp I started the machine, and strictly followed the procedures for clamping, tool setting, and calibration. I focused on machining the first piece and sent it to the self-inspection room for measurement. Only after the precision fully met the standard did I start batch production. At 9:30 I took a 10-minute tea break, stretched, and went to the water room to get water. I greeted Master Sun, who reminded me that this batch of flanges had high precision requirements and that I should pay more attention to the depth of cut. After that, I operated more carefully. During this period I also instructed intern Xiao Zhao on precautions for stainless steel cutting, and continued machining until 11:30.
location: Workshop work station at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At 11:30 the machines stopped, and I headed to the company canteen with Master Sun, Xiao Zhao, and other colleagues. Lunch was braised pork chops, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and stir-fried greens. I got the pork chop and the scrambled eggs with tomatoes, plus a free bowl of soup. While eating, I talked with Master Sun about the confusion I had while reviewing PLC last night and got a few pointers. After lunch, I returned to the workshop rest area. Instead of resting right away, I opened the shopping app on my phone and searched for riding gear, browsing half helmets, full-face helmets, long-sleeved and short-sleeved riding jerseys, and riding gloves. I noted the prices and looks of several candidates in my memo app and added two helmets and a summer riding suit to the cart. Then I sent a WeChat message to my running buddy Chen Jie, asked for helmet and riding gear recommendations, and sent a screenshot of the cart. After that, I put my head on the desk and dozed for 20 minutes to recharge.
location: Canteen and workshop rest area of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory.

name: Afternoon work and post-shift meeting
description: In the afternoon, he continued machining the flanges, paying special attention to the feed rate Master Sun mentioned, and staying focused. At 16:00, he began wrapping up and finished machining the last few pieces. At 16:30, he shut down the machine, cleaned the machine tool, tidied the workstation, neatly stacked the qualified finished products, and entered the day's machining log and self-inspection data into the computer; all products passed. Afterwards, Team Leader Wang called a 10-minute team meeting and reminded everyone that several urgent batches would need priority processing tomorrow. After the meeting, he returned to his workstation, changed out of his work clothes, picked up his swim bag, and when he checked his phone, he saw Chen Jie's WeChat reply recommending the entry-level Specialized 299 helmet and half-finger gloves. He replied that he had received it and planned to go to a physical store over the weekend to try them on before deciding.
location: Workshop and office, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive to the swimming pool.
description: After clocking out, he drove from the factory to the Songjiang Swimming Pool at No. 143 Rongle Middle Road. While waiting at a red light, he pondered Chen Jie's advice and decided not to place an order today, but to go to a physical store this weekend to try it on first.
location: From No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Songjiang Swimming Pool, No. 143 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Swimming training
description: After arriving at the swimming pool, he changed into his swim trunks and did a set of stretches by the poolside. Once in the water, he did a planned 45-minute mixed swim training, combining freestyle and breaststroke, focusing on stroke efficiency and breathing rhythm. He swam about 20 laps in the 25-meter pool, feeling his whole body relax and his mood lighten. After swimming, he showered and changed back into his clothes, feeling refreshed and invigorated.
location: Songjiang Swimming Pool, No. 143 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Drove to the restaurant to pick up takeout dinner
description: After leaving the swimming pool, he felt hungry and remembered that the braised pork chop at the canteen at noon had tasted good, so he decided to drop by the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road to pick up dinner. He drove about 15 minutes to the restaurant and asked the owner for a portion of shredded pork in yuxiang sauce and rice to go. While waiting, he scrolled through his phone and saw Team Leader Wang asking in the group chat about the details of meeting at Shanghai Gymnasium on Saturday. He replied '1' to confirm. After picking up the food, he drove back to Xingang Community, and the entire trip home was less than a minute.
location: From No. 143 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, No. 232 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and then back to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road.

name: Dinner and rest at home
description: After getting home, I took a quick shower and changed into loungewear, then sat at the coffee table, opened the takeout yuxiang shredded pork and rice, and ate while watching videos. After the meal, I cleaned up and threw away the containers, watered the pothos I had bought two days ago, then leaned back on the sofa and scrolled through short videos for 10 minutes, letting my body fully relax.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening focused review of PLC
description: He walked into the study on time, turned on the computer, launched the PLC simulation software, and spread out the textbook and notebook. First he reviewed the notes on the 'branch current method' discussed earlier with the teacher, then focused on overcoming the 'self-locking and interlocking circuits.' Following the examples in the textbook, he drew ladder diagrams on paper and entered them into the simulation software to verify the operating logic. When he hit a difficulty in understanding the reverse interlock protection, he read the textbook repeatedly until he figured it out. He immediately wrote down his insights and the easily confused wiring methods in his notebook, marking key points with a red pen. He studied very efficiently, and then practiced two more small example routines, feeling clear-headed.
location: Home study at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening wrap-up and relaxation
description: After finishing review, he turned off the computer, took out his phone, opened the memo app, and made a simple plan for tomorrow: remember to bring the newly issued operation manual. Then he opened the expense-tracking app and recorded the day's expenses: swimming (May card) and takeout dinner (18 yuan). He prepared hot water to soak his feet, and while soaking, scrolled through the fishing forum to see whether Brother Wu had posted any new catch. After soaking his feet, he lay on the bed and played two casual matches of Honor of Kings with his childhood friend Zhang Wei; although he lost one game, the mood was pleasant. At 22:45, he quit the game, took the T-shirt and pants for the next day out of the wardrobe and laid them ready, drew the curtains, and at 23:00 turned off the light and fell asleep on time.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning routine: waking up, core training, washing up, and breakfast
description: I woke up on time to my alarm, then went to the bathroom to weigh myself. The scale showed 73.5 kg, and I was pleased to see I had lost 0.1 kg compared with yesterday. I then spread a yoga mat on the living room floor and did 15 minutes of core training, including 3 sets of planks, 1 set each of left and right side planks, and 30 crunches. Afterward I used a foam roller to relax my calf muscles and wake up my body. Next I took a warm shower and changed into my dark blue work uniform. Breakfast was the multigrain porridge that had been pre-cooked on the timer, a boiled egg, and a small dish of pickled mustard, which filled me up. After eating, I checked my work badge, phone, power bank, notebook, marker, and other items, put my folding umbrella into my commuter bag, and glanced out the window before leaving. The ground was dry but the sky was gloomy, and I silently hoped it wouldn't rain on my evening ride.
location: Room 502, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute by car
description: Driving on the road, with the pre-downloaded audio of 'Key Points for the Low-Voltage Electrician Practical Exam' playing in the car, listening and noting key points. While waiting at red lights, he was still silently memorizing the circuit diagrams. About 15 minutes later, he arrived at the company parking lot.
location: From Xingang Road to Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Changing clothes, pre-shift preparation, and morning meeting
description: Change into protective shoes and work clothes, and put on safety goggles. After arriving at the workshop, first check your CNC machine, check the coolant and lubricant levels, and run a warm-up cycle. At 8:00 sharp, Shift Leader Wang called a morning meeting and stressed that there were two urgent jobs today: one was a batch of high-precision stainless steel flanges for auto parts; the other was a batch of guide bushings for a military project, with a precision requirement of 0.005mm, to be prioritized. He quickly confirmed with Master Sun and Shift Leader Wang that they would do the flanges this morning and tackle the guide bushings in the afternoon. Master Sun also reminded them to watch for tool wear.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning work: machining flanges
description: According to the morning meeting plan, he started machining the first batch of stainless steel flanges. After machining the first piece, he carefully self-inspected with an inside micrometer and a roughness tester, and only after confirming the data were qualified did batch production begin. During the process, Master Sun passed by and gave tips on optimizing the feed speed, improving the surface finish. Yin Hao focused on the operation, stopping every 5 pieces for a spot check to make sure everything was foolproof.
location: CNC machine workstation at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch, midday break, and equipment checklist organization
description: Went to the canteen for lunch. Today's menu had braised pork, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and stir-fried greens, and I got a serving of rice. While eating, I took out my phone and browsed the "Fishing Home" forum, read a post about "choosing a spot for summer night crucian carp fishing", and bookmarked several tips shared by fishing buddies. Then I scrolled through some short videos about electric bike repair for a while, just to relax. After lunch, I leaned back in a chair in the lounge and rested with my eyes closed for twenty minutes. After waking up, I opened the cycling gear information I had collected earlier in my phone memo, combined it with the WeChat advice and budget from my running buddy Chen Jie last night, and reorganized a more detailed shopping list, noting brands, models, and initial budget. I highlighted the entry-level road bike and helmet models from Specialized, took a screenshot, and saved it, planning to send it to Chen Jie for final confirmation before leaving work.
location: Canteen and rest room at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon work: tackling guide bushing machining.
description: In the afternoon, he started machining guide bushings with higher precision requirements. Because the material was very hard, he slowed down the machining speed and was careful at every step. Midway, he changed the insert once and adjusted the coolant spray angle. Around 4:00 PM, he successfully completed both roughing and finishing of all guide bushings, and the final self-inspection passed completely. Squad leader Wang came over to check, then gave a thumbs up and praised, 'Xiao Yin, solid!' Yin Hao felt much more at ease.
location: CNC machine workstation at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wrap-up work and preparation to leave
description: After filling in the day's work log and equipment inspection records, I cleaned the iron filings from the machine tool and applied lubricating oil to the guide rails. I went to the locker room, changed back into my own clothes, and picked up my bag. At the door, I checked the weather; the ground was still dry. I was delighted: the planned 18 km greenway ride looked like it could go ahead as usual.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to Songjiang Central Park
description: Drove out of the company to near Songjiang Central Park, parked in the public parking lot near the start of the greenway (Yuanzhong Road Parking Lot), and prepared for the upcoming ride.
location: Parking lot of Songjiang Central Park, Yuanzhong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening aerobic training: 18 km outdoor cycling
description: He took out the old mountain bike from the back, put on his helmet and gloves, and adjusted the heart rate strap. He opened the sports app (Keep) on his phone and started riding along the greenway. He felt good, maintained a steady cadence, and kept his heart rate in the aerobic zone of 140-150 beats per minute. Along the way, he passed a small bridge, riverbanks, and woods, with fresh air. Halfway through the ride, a few drops of drizzle fell from the sky, but it soon stopped, and it actually felt a bit cooler. In the end, he recorded the data with the app: 58 minutes, average speed 18.6 km/h, and about 640 kcal burned. He stretched for a few minutes at the finish point.
location: Songjiang Central Park Greenway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove home and picked up the package
description: Rode the bike back to the parking spot, folded it and put it in the trunk. Drove home, feeling cheerful on the way, as if the day's fatigue had disappeared. After arriving home, I first went to the first-floor parcel locker to pick up a package and saw the box my mother had sent.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Opening packages and talking with mother.
description: Carrying the box home, he opened the package. Inside were vacuum-packed dried clams and hometown sausages wrapped in oil paper, along with a note: “Son, take care of yourself.” Yin Hao felt a warmth in his heart. He took a photo of the local specialties and sent it to the family group, then sent his mother a voice message: “Mom, got it. It looks delicious! You and Dad should take care of yourselves too.” His mother’s delighted voice came through in the voice message.
location: Room 502, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Shower and simple dinner
description: He took a quick shower and changed into loungewear. For dinner, he simply cooked a bowl of noodles, added a fried egg and two slices of hometown sausage, and felt especially satisfied.
location: Room 502, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Attend the Guokai Electromechanical live-streamed course.
description: After washing the dishes and utensils and making a cup of tea, Yin Hao opened his tablet at the desk and entered the livestream for the Mechatronics program at The Open University of China right on time. Tonight’s course was AC Circuit Analysis, and the teacher began explaining the phasor representation of sinusoidal alternating current. Yin Hao listened while taking notes in the textbook. During the interactive session, he got the microphone and asked, “Professor, in RLC series resonance, what are the negative effects of an excessively high quality factor Q?” The teacher answered in detail and gave examples. After class, the teacher assigned several exercises on impedance calculation and power factor correction.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Complete the live course homework.
description: After class, instead of resting immediately, he opened the homework file and, using class notes and the textbook, began calculating the equivalent impedance, active power, and reactive power of an AC circuit. When he encountered a difficult problem, he pulled out his PLC notes from a few days earlier and used the logical reasoning methods there to better understand the relationships between circuit parameters, finally solving it smoothly. He copied the answers into his homework notebook, took a photo, and uploaded it to the system.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Teaming up in Honor of Kings and keeping in touch with childhood friends and brother
description: He closed the book and stretched his neck. Seeing the message 'Get on! Get on!' from his childhood friend Zhang Wei on WeChat, he picked up his phone and logged into Honor of Kings. He teamed up with Zhang Wei and his older brother Yin Tao, who was far away in Suzhou, for two ranked games. He was in good form today; playing his signature hero 'Arthur', he successfully dictated the game's pace. He chatted and played with his brothers, relaxing for more than half an hour.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organizing Cycling Checklist and Planning the Weekend
description: Morning core workout completed
location: Room 502, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Soaking feet and family bookkeeping
description: Boil a pot of hot water, pour it into the foot-soaking bucket, and take out the ledger while soaking my feet. Record today’s expenses: commuting fuel, cafeteria lunch 15 yuan, and no extra cycling costs. After updating the ledger, I feel that all of the day’s plans have been completed, and I feel very at ease.
location: Room 502, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and reading
description: Set the phone alarm and watered the pothos by the bedside. After turning off the light, he opened the e-book on his phone and read a few pages about the basics of electronic circuits, growing drowsy.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Sleep
description: Turned off the phone, closed my eyes, and fell asleep, ending a fulfilling day.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning Run and Weight Record
description: At 6:15 in the morning the alarm went off. Yin Hao quickly got up, washed up, put on his running shoes and running shorts. At 6:25 he left the house and walked to Xiaokunshan Health Park. In comfortable 25-degree weather, he completed a 5 km morning run at a pace of 5 minutes 25 seconds per kilometer, taking 27 minutes 10 seconds. After the run, he returned home, used a body fat scale to measure on an empty stomach: weight 73.4 kg, body fat percentage 24.1%, down 1.7 kg compared with May 4. He recorded this with satisfaction in his phone memo. Then he took a warm shower and prepared for the day's work.
location: Room 502, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and Xiaokunshan Health Park (40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road)

name: Breakfast purchase and work preparation.
description: After a quick shower and changing into work clothes, Yin Hao grabbed his bag and went out. At the jianbing stall at the entrance of Xingang Residential Community, he ordered a jianbing guozi with two eggs and crispy cracker, plus a cup of freshly ground soy milk. While waiting, he browsed the day's valve body part drawings on his phone and recalled the feed parameters Master Sun had taught him. After getting his breakfast, he ate on the go and finished quickly.
location: Jianbing stall at the entrance of Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute by car
description: Yin Hao drove his own car from Xingang Residential Community along Xingang Road, turned onto Huatianjing Highway, drove smoothly for about 13 minutes, arrived at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, parked in the employee parking space, and clocked in before entering the workshop.
location: On the way from Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning work: trial machining of valve body parts
description: After arriving at his workstation, Yin Hao began machining the valve body parts left from last Friday, trying the new feed parameters taught by Master Sun. At 8:00, he retrieved the program and checked the parameters before making a trial cut. After the first piece was completed, he used a micrometer for self-inspection, and the precision was qualified. Shift Leader Wang Lei approved it during acceptance. Then he moved into batch production, monitoring the cutting status throughout. At 10:00, he used the automatic tool change interval to drink water and do simple shoulder and neck stretches.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Contact running friends to ask about buying a car.
description: During the 9 a.m. tea break, Yin Hao used WeChat on his phone at his workstation to contact his running buddy Chen Jie and ask about entry-level road bikes. Based on Yin Hao's height of 178 cm, Chen Jie recommended a certain Giant model, reminded him to choose a size M frame, and advised keeping the budget within 3,500 yuan. He said he could accompany him to a physical store to look at bikes on the weekend. Yin Hao recorded the key points in his notebook.
location: Beside the workstation in the workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break stretching and reading.
date: According to last night's plan, I went to the Songjiang Branch of Shanghai Sixth People's Hospital to address the knee injury.
description: During the lunch break, Yin Hao did not go to the cafeteria. Instead, he spread out a yoga mat in the workshop rest corner and did lower back stretches for 10 minutes to relieve the muscle stiffness caused by standing at the machine in the morning. Afterwards, he used his Kindle to read the chapter "Begin with the End in Mind" from The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People, using a highlighter to mark his thoughts about personal mission statements. After 15 minutes of focused reading, he put away the device, rubbed his eyes, and prepared for the afternoon work.
location: Workshop rest corner, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work: wrapping up and final checks.
description: In the afternoon, he continued processing the unfinished valve body parts, doing the finishing, deburring, and full inspection. Yin Hao strictly followed the process. At 15:30, he completed all the parts, filled out the quality tracking card, and handed it to Team Leader Wang Lei for review. Wang Lei spot-checked, approved, and signed. Afterward, Yin Hao cleaned the metal chips off the machine tool and performed routine equipment maintenance.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After work, researched buying a car online while in the car.
description: After work, Yin Hao packed up his things, changed out of his work clothes, drove out of the factory and pulled over by the roadside. While waiting at red lights, he used the JD app on his phone and a bicycle forum to search for the Giant models recommended by Chen Jie, compared prices and reviews, and noted the models, price ranges, and other details in his memo.
location: In the car at the entrance of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving home
description: Yin Hao drove along Huatianjing Road, turned onto Xingang Road, smoothly returned to Xingang Residential Community, and parked the car properly.
location: En route from Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Packing dinner and watching videos
description: Yin Hao walked to the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road, ordered a takeout of shredded pork in garlic sauce and rice, went home, turned on the computer, and watched an episode of a road bike maintenance short video while eating, finishing the meal quickly.
location: Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, 232 Xingang Road, Dagang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and home in Xingang Community

name: Core training
description: After resting for half an hour after the meal, Yin Hao did a 15-minute core workout on the yoga mat in the living room: 4 sets of 20 crunches, 3 sets of 1-minute planks, and 3 sets of 15 lying leg raises. He felt soreness and tightness in his abdominal core, and did some simple stretching afterward.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 2, Xingang Residential Compound, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Take a shower and prepare items for tomorrow's trip.
description: After training and sweating, he immediately took a shower and felt refreshed. Then Yin Hao prepared items for Saturday's trip to Hangzhou in the bedroom: he put a change of clothes, a power bank, and an umbrella into a black backpack, and carefully placed the wireless earphones gift prepared for his girlfriend Lin Yue on the top. He checked the route from Metro Line 9 transferring to Line 10 to Hongqiao Station and the earliest high-speed train time and memorized them.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 502, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Teamed up with his childhood friend and older brother for gaming.
description: Yin Hao opened Honor of Kings on the sofa in the living room, invited his childhood friend Zhang Wei and his older brother Yin Tao to team up, and played two ranked matches in a row. They turned the first match around from a disadvantage and won the second overwhelmingly, chatting enthusiastically in voice. During the games, they also talked about the plan to go to Hangzhou tomorrow to see his girlfriend and the esports final. Zhang Wei teased him, and Yin Tao told him not to get too tired.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 2, Xingang Residential Compound, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Soaking feet and planning tomorrow’s itinerary
description: After the game, Yin Hao got hot water to soak his feet while browsing a WeChat official account about Hangzhou travel guides, saving the hiking routes at Yuhu Bay and Maojiabu. He then set an alarm for 6:00 the next day and wrote a time plan in his memo: get up at 6:00, leave at 6:30, take the metro, and arrive at Hongqiao Station before 9:30. After soaking his feet for about 20 minutes, he dried them and relaxed his whole body.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 2, Xingang Residential Compound, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and checks
description: Yin Hao returned to the bedroom, checked again that the backpack zippers and gift bag were intact, and placed the casual clothes he would wear tomorrow beside the bed. After confirming nothing was left out, he turned off the living room light, lay down in bed, and closed his eyes to review the day's gains: his morning run performance, recognition at work, plans for the new car, and weekend arrangements. He felt a sense of peace.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: At 21:30, Yin Hao turned off the bedroom ceiling light, leaving only the bedside night light, adjusted his sleeping position, stopped looking at the phone, and fell asleep within 10 minutes, resting up for a busy and wonderful weekend.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Room 502, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting up, weighing in, and morning preparations
description: On Saturday morning, he woke up naturally before 7. He went to the bathroom first and weighed himself on the body composition scale. His weight was 73.5 kg, another slight decrease from yesterday, which made him feel a great sense of accomplishment. After washing up quickly, he changed into a light sports T-shirt and shorts and got ready to go downstairs to the park for a walk and some stretching.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Park walk and stretching
description: Drove 10 minutes to Xiaokunshan Health Park and briskly walked four laps along the park trail, about 3 kilometers. After exercising, he did more than ten minutes of serious stretching in the equipment area under the trees, paying special attention to the recovery of his right knee. He had kept up this habit for over half a year. He worked up a light sweat and felt comfortable all over.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Went home, took a shower, and got ready to leave.
description: Drove back home, took a cold shower, and changed into a dry T-shirt. It was Saturday and the repair shop opened late, so there was no rush. He warmed a glass of milk and had two slices of whole wheat bread with ham as a simple breakfast to fuel up for the morning part-time repair work.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the repair shop.
description: After a 15-minute drive, I arrived at Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop in Shihudang Town. Master Chen hadn't arrived yet, so I parked in the shade by the entrance, opened my phone, and browsed messages in the local fishing group while waiting to start work.
location: Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, No. XX, Shihu New Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Arrive at the repair shop and prepare to start work
description: Master Chen arrived on time on his electric bike, and the two of them pulled up the roller shutter door together. Master Chen carried two faulty machines collected from the community yesterday onto the workbench: an old vacuum cleaner and an electric pancake griddle, ready to start repairs.
location: Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, No. XX, Shihu New Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Focused on repairing the vacuum cleaner and electric griddle
description: He put on gloves and first repaired the vacuum cleaner. After checking, the motor was burned out. He found a used motor of the same model from Master Chen's parts box, cleaned the air duct and filter, rewired it, and the vacuum cleaner worked again. Next, he repaired the electric griddle. The problem was that it powered on but did not heat. Using a multimeter, he found the thermostat was damaged. He found a universal thermostat from the spare parts and replaced it. When powered on, the heating plate quickly got hot, and the electric griddle was also fixed. Master Chen watched from the side, occasionally handing him a screwdriver, and praised Yin Hao for being quick and neat.
location: Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, No. XX, Shihu New Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Counting income and saying goodbye
description: After the work was done, Master Chen was very satisfied. He counted out 100 yuan from the drawer and handed it to Yin Hao as the final payment, and agreed to contact him if there was new work next month. Yin Hao took the money, opened the memo app on his phone, and wrote down: "This month's repair income totals: 550 yuan." Then he packed up his things and prepared to go home.
location: Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, No. XX, Shihu New Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returning home to prepare a low-fat lunch
description: After a 10-minute drive home, I changed into loungewear. I took the chicken breast marinated last night out of the fridge and steamed it, and blanched the broccoli. Lunch was ready in 15 minutes, with a small bowl of mixed-grain rice on the side. While eating, I updated my dietary notes on my phone: "Steamed chicken breast + broccoli + mixed-grain rice, about 450 kcal in total."
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing for and confirming the gathering.
description: Put away the dishes and chopsticks, checked the dried clams to bring to Lin Yue tomorrow, and the packaging was intact. Then sent a message in the “Iron Triangle” group: “I've arrived. This afternoon's activities are arranged. Have you two set off? Let's meet downstairs from my place at 1 p.m. and go over directly.” Confirmed the gathering itinerary.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Met up with friends and drove to Jing'an Sports Center
description: At exactly one o'clock, Gao Zhiyuan arrived by car first, parked in front of Yin Hao's community, and then got into the passenger seat of Yin Hao's car. Ma Xiaofeng arrived a few minutes late on a shared bicycle. After the three met up, Yin Hao drove onto the Jiamin Elevated Road. Jay Chou's songs were playing in the car, and everyone discussed the teams in today's final. The atmosphere was relaxed.
location: From Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Jing'an Sports Center, 116 Wenshui Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai

name: Parking and entering
description: Parked the car in the underground parking lot of Jing'an Sports Center. The three walked to the spectator entrance, showed their e-tickets, and entered smoothly. The atmosphere was electric; many spectators wore team jerseys, and some held up cheering light boards.
location: Jing'an Sports Center, No. 116 Wenshui Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai

name: Attending the game in person and recording the highlights.
description: They found seats in Section A of the stands and sat down; the match started on time. The three of them quickly got into it and cheered together at impressive plays. Yin Hao took out his phone, enabled 4K 60fps mode, and recorded the key team fights and the players' clutch moves in the deciding game. Gao Zhiyuan was excitedly analyzing tactics beside him, while Ma Xiaofeng occasionally teased the players' mistakes. The atmosphere was electric.
location: Jing'an Sports Center, No. 116 Wenshui Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai

name: Walk to the hot pot restaurant.
description: After the match ended, still not wanting it to be over, they followed the crowd out of the gymnasium. Ma Xiaofeng took out his phone to check the navigation and confirmed they were going to "Longmenzhen" Chongqing old hot pot, about a ten-minute walk from the sports center. The three walked while savoring the game, arguing over who should have been the MVP of that team fight.
location: Jiangning Road Pedestrian Street, Jing'an District, Shanghai

name: Hot pot gathering (including waiting in line and ordering)
description: When they arrived at the restaurant, people were already queuing. They took a number and waited 15 minutes. After being seated, Ma Xiaofeng took the lead and ordered a spicy beef tallow hot pot base, and Yin Hao added a double-flavored pot. Everyone ordered duck blood, tripe, luncheon meat, lamb, wide vermicelli, and more. Once the broth was boiling, they started cooking. They chatted while eating, and the topic shifted from the competition to work pressure: Ma Xiaofeng said his company had been laying off people recently, while Gao Zhiyuan complained that the client for the new project had too many requirements. Yin Hao enjoyed the food thoroughly, but kept in mind that he had to drive the next morning, so he resolutely avoided alcohol and only drank iced sour plum juice. Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng also drank beverages with him. The three chatted until almost 9:30.
location: Longmenzhen Chongqing Old Hot Pot, No. 78 Jiangning Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai

name: Paying the bill and preparing for the return trip.
description: The dinner gathering ended and the bill was split, 125 yuan per person, which felt very reasonable. The three of them walked to the parking lot. Gao Zhiyuan's home is in Pudong, so he took a taxi and left first. Yin Hao gave Ma Xiaofeng a ride, planning to take him back to Minhang.
location: At the entrance of Longmenzhen Chongqing Old Hotpot, No. 78 Jiangning Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai

name: Drove Ma Xiaofeng back to Minhang
description: With no traffic at night, Yin Hao drove south along the North-South Elevated Road and reached the intersection of Qixin Road and Baochun Road that Ma Xiaofeng had mentioned in 20 minutes. Before getting out of the car, Ma Xiaofeng turned back and said, "Brother Hao, we had such a great time today! Have a smooth trip to Hangzhou tomorrow!" Yin Hao nodded with a smile, then turned around and drove toward Songjiang.
location: Intersection of Qixin Road and Baochun Road, Minhang District, Shanghai

name: Return home to Songjiang
description: At night, traffic on the Jiamin Elevated Road was sparse. Yin Hao drove steadily while listening to a late-night music program on the radio. Half an hour later, he arrived downstairs at home, relaxed in body and mind, feeling the day had been fulfilling.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Packed luggage in preparation for tomorrow's trip to Hangzhou
description: Feeling happy, I took out the backpack and put in what I needed for tomorrow: a change of T-shirt, a power bank, and an umbrella. Then I took the bag of dried clams out of the fridge, wrapped it carefully, and stuffed it into the bag as well. I sent Lin Yue a voice message: "Today's competition was exciting, and we had hotpot too! Everything is packed! I'll tell you before I set off tomorrow, wait for me!" I set the alarm for 7 a.m. tomorrow.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Review and bedtime preparation.
description: Lying in bed, he briefly reviewed the day: he had made money from repairs, watched a game and ate hotpot with his buddies, and packed his luggage. Everything felt solid. Without scrolling on his phone, he closed his eyes, relaxed his body, and gradually let his mind and body calm down.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going to bed
description: A good night's sleep is the guarantee for tomorrow's long drive. Outside the window gradually quieted down, and I soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning weigh-in and savings reminder
description: After the alarm went off at 6 a.m., he got up and stood barefoot on the body fat scale. He recorded his weight as 73.5 kg and body fat percentage as 23.8%, both down from last week, and felt good. He logged the data in his phone notes and reviewed yesterday's calorie intake record. Then he washed up, changed into a white T-shirt and athletic shorts. While getting his cycling gear ready, he received a savings reminder that 500 yuan had been automatically transferred from his bank card to Yu'ebao, and felt reassured.
location: Home, Xingang Residential Community, Songjiang Science and Technology Park, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycling to the Giant bicycle shop
description: He rode his old mountain bike, starting from Xingang Community, turned onto Wenhui Road from Xingang Road, and went to Giant Bicycles (Songjiang University Town Store). In the early morning sunlight filtering through the plane tree leaves, there were few cars and people on the road. The ride was about 4.7 kilometers and took 21 minutes.
location: From Lane 224, Xingang Road to Lane 656, Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, via Xingang Road and Wenhui Road

name: Test-rode and purchased a road bike
description: At Giant Bicycle (Songjiang University City store), confirmed with the staff the entry-level road bike he had looked at last week (about 3,500 yuan). After carefully checking the derailleurs and brakes, he test-rode about 2 km on the non-motorized lane in front of the store; handling was smooth. Then he went inside, paid by card, and the owner gave him a helmet and a bike lock as gifts and helped adjust the seat height.
location: No. 101, Lane 656, Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, Giant Bicycle (Songjiang University Town Store)

name: Picked up the car, drove home, and stored it.
description: Riding the newly bought road bike back to Xingang Community, it felt light and fast. He arrived downstairs in less than 10 minutes, locked the new bike in the designated bike shed, looked it over repeatedly, then went upstairs to get his backpack and prepare for the following trip.
location: Bicycle shed, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast at home and cycling to the metro station
description: Had a simple breakfast at home: two slices of whole wheat toast with peanut butter, a glass of hot milk, and a boiled egg. During that time, confirmed the high-speed rail ticket from Shanghai Hongqiao to Hangzhou East at 10:00 on the Railway 12306 app. Then locked the door, put on his backpack, and rode his new road bike to Songjiang University Town Metro Station, ready to start the Hangzhou trip, feeling both excited and a little nervous.
location: At home, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai; then cycled to Songjiang University Town Metro Station

name: Commuted by subway to Hongqiao Station.
description: Took Line 9 from Songjiang University Town Station to Xujiahui, then transferred to Line 10 to reach Hongqiao Railway Station. Standing on the subway, he played Honor of Kings, claimed the daily check-in reward, and checked the WeChat message from Lin Yue. She told him she was almost at Hangzhou East Station and would wait at the exit.
location: Shanghai Metro Line 9 (Songjiang University Town to Xujiahui), Line 10 (Xujiahui to Hongqiao Railway Station)

name: Waiting at Hongqiao Station and taking the high-speed railway to Hangzhou
description: After arriving at Hongqiao Station, he quickly went to the ticket gate in Area B, passed through with his ID card, and sat down in a window seat. The 10:00 train departed on time. Along the way, he enjoyed the fields and city scenery outside the window, listened to music with earphones, and flipped through the book National Open University Mechanical Design he had brought, but his mind had already flown to West Lake. The train arrived at Hangzhou East Station on time at 11:35.
location: Shanghai Hongqiao Station B-area ticket gate and G7301 high-speed train car, terminating at Hangzhou East Station

name: Meet up with Lin Yue at Hangzhou East Railway Station
description: At the arrival-level exit of Hangzhou East Station, he spotted Lin Yue in a light-colored dress at a glance. She smiled and waved. He hurried over and took her hand; her palm was slightly sweaty. He softly told her he would take her to eat something delicious, and they smiled at each other.
location: Exit at the arrival level of Hangzhou East Railway Station, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Heading to the Broken Bridge at West Lake.
description: Lin Yue and I took Metro Line 1 from Hangzhou East Railway Station to Fengqi Road Station. After exiting the station, we walked along Beishan Street, chatting easily under the shade of plane trees. Lin Yue showed photos of clouds she had taken in the morning. When we reached Broken Bridge, the lake and mountain scenery of West Lake came into view, and we both couldn't help marveling at the view.
location: Broken Bridge and Remnant Snow scenic spot, Beishan Street, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.

name: Walked along Bai Causeway at West Lake and had lunch at Mingjian Tower
description: Strolling along Bai Causeway to Gushan Road, they found a window seat at Mingjianlou Restaurant, with the shimmering West Lake outside. They ordered Longjing shrimp, water shield soup, and Pian'er Chuan noodles. As they ate and chatted, Lin Yue shared photos of kittens on her phone, and I gave her the dried clams my mother had sent. She thanked me happily.
location: Mingjianlou Restaurant, Gushan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Walking on Bai Causeway, going public with relationship, and call from fellow veteran
description: After the meal, I put up the parasol and strolled slowly with Lin Yue along Bai Causeway, chatting about her work next week. I mentioned the pressure of the down payment for the house, and she warmly said we could take things slowly together. When we reached the bench by Broken Bridge, we sat down, took a selfie together, and posted it on WeChat Moments with the caption "The weather is really nice today." Lin Yue liked it right away. Soon, my comrade-in-arms Zhang Jianguo saw the post and called to congratulate me. We caught up on the phone and agreed to meet up next time; the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Area around Broken Bridge with Remnant Snow and Bai Causeway, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Having tea and strolling around Lakeside in77 with Lin Yue
description: As the weather was getting hot, Lin Yue and I followed Amap's directions to a teahouse near Hubin in77, ordered pre-Qingming Longjing tea, and shared the details of today's road bike purchase while sipping tea. Lin Yue joked that next time she could ride her bike to Hangzhou. After tea, we strolled around Area A of Hubin in77, went into a blind box store, and drew blind boxes. Lin Yue drew a hidden edition and jumped with joy.
location: Zone A, Hubin in77, No. 7 Dongpo Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, and nearby teahouses

name: Dinner at Louwailou and phone interaction with Lin Yue's father
description: After getting tired from shopping, we went to Louwailou (Hubin Branch) to taste time-honored Hangzhou cuisine. We ordered Longjing shrimp, osmanthus sugared lotus root, and Dongpo pork. During the meal, Lin Yue got a call from her father. She laughed and talked about our relationship, and I took the opportunity to say, "Your dad is quite humorous." The atmosphere was warm. After she hung up, I served her food, and we felt natural and sweet together.
location: Lou Wai Lou (Hubin Branch), Yan'an Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.

name: Said goodbye to Lin Yue and took the metro to Hangzhou East Railway Station
description: After dinner, I insisted on going to the station alone and asked Lin Yue not to see me off. She walked me to the entrance of Ding'an Road Metro Station. I ruffled her hair, told her to take care, and promised to visit her again next week. She nodded in agreement. I turned and went into the station; when I looked back, she was still standing there.
location: Ding'an Road Metro Station entrance, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Waiting and strolling at Hangzhou East Railway Station
description: After arriving at Hangzhou East Railway Station and collecting the paper reimbursement voucher, there was still some time before the 20:00 train. He bought a lemonade from Mixue, found an empty seat to charge his phone, and looked through the afternoon group photos, unable to keep from smiling. To stretch his legs, he took a stroll through the commercial street inside the station.
location: Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province: Hangzhou East Railway Station waiting hall and commercial area

name: Return to Shanghai by high-speed rail
description: Took high-speed train G7376 from Hangzhou East Station back to Shanghai Hongqiao Station. The train departed on time. Leaning against the window and watching the city lights, he savored today's sweet date. He received a message from Lin Yue saying 'I'm home, good night' and replied with a smiley face.
location: G7376 high-speed train (Hangzhou East Railway Station to Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station)

name: Took the metro back to Songjiang University Town.
description: After arriving at Hongqiao Station, I transferred to Line 10 to Xujiahui, then switched to Line 9 to Songjiang University Town Station. The evening subway was not crowded. Leaning against the carriage wall, I scrolled through WeChat Moments. Seeing that the group photo from earlier in the day already had more than thirty likes, with comrades Zhang Jianguo, Wang Lei, and other friends teasing in the comments, I replied one by one with a smile.
location: Shanghai Metro Line 10 (Hongqiao Railway Station to Xujiahui), Line 9 (Xujiahui to Songjiang University Town Station)

name: Cycling home
description: After arriving at Songjiang University Town Station, he saw the new bike safely parked in the shed, then rode his road bike home with relief. Opening the door, the house was quiet as usual. He put down his backpack, sat at the desk, and saved today's photos into a newly created folder named "0525".
location: Cycling segment from Songjiang University Town Metro Station, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road

The questions covered CNC programming, mechanical technology, PLC, and five-axis machining. He hesitated for a long time on the parallel PLC instruction and five-axis tool path calculation questions. After 90 minutes, he submitted the paper. The system displayed 82 points, and he immediately took a screenshot of the detailed score report.

I opened a blank document, referred to the textbook table of contents, and made a two-week targeted review plan: read the corresponding chapters and do 20 practice problems every day, organize the wrong-answer notebook on weekends, and decided to ask Master Sun for dedicated tutoring next Saturday. Then I opened WeChat, sent the screenshots of the wrong questions to Master Sun, and made a voice call. We talked for 35 minutes. In very plain language, he explained the pitfalls of the PLC 'set/reset' instructions, and also taught me a mnemonic for judging the positive/negative sign of the five-axis swing angle. I listened while quickly taking notes, and it all clicked.
location: Study, Room 202, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

Following the video, he dug an old phone charger out of the drawer and used a multimeter to measure the pin polarity of its rectifier diode. The measured forward voltage drop was about 0.72V, which deepened his understanding of the theory.
