description: Lying in bed, he browsed technical forum posts about CNC machine tool troubleshooting, and scrolled through pet and fishing videos on Bilibili to relax. After 22:15, he turned off his phone, reviewed the day, and fell asleep satisfied.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning routine and breakfast.
description: After dismissing the 6:15 alarm, he immediately checked his phone and found a message sent in the early morning by his older brother Yin Tao in the family group: he had welcomed a son, and both mother and child were safe. His parents had already replied to the thread. Yin Hao felt warmth in his heart. He congratulated his brother in the group and also sent him a private message, agreeing to bring Lin Yue to visit on the weekend. While washing up, he looked in the mirror and felt he looked well-rested. He stepped on the scale and weighed 73.9 kg, showing that his weight was stable. He changed into a quick-dry T-shirt and sports shorts, planning to head out after breakfast. He took out the Jiaxing meat zongzi bought the day before from the fridge, heated two in the microwave, and made a cup of soy milk. While eating, he planned the day's itinerary: watch the dragon boat race on Suzhou Creek, pick up Lin Yue, visit the botanical garden, and have dinner.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go to Suzhou River to watch the dragon boat race
description: Left at 7:25, walked 8 minutes to Songjiang University Town Station on Metro Line 9, and took the subway to the city center. On the train, while scrolling on his phone, he saw Lin Yue's birthday wishes sent at 7:00 and her anticipation of meeting; he felt warm and replied. He transferred to Line 13 at Changshou Road Station and arrived at Jiangning Road Station at 8:45. After exiting, he walked about 10 minutes to the Tian An 1000 Trees section along Suzhou Creek and found a spot with a wide view. At 9:00, the dragon boat race started on time. Drums echoed across the river as multiple dragon boats raced. Yin Hao stood in the spectator area, soaking in the lively atmosphere, filming several videos with his phone, focusing on splashes and dragon-head decorations. After the race, he picked the most exciting clip and sent it to Lin Yue, with a voice message marveling at the atmosphere. Then he bought a freshly steamed pork zongzi from a temporary stall and enjoyed the festive vibe.
location: Ocean Crystal Tian An 1000 Trees section by Suzhou Creek, Moganshan Road, Putuo District, Shanghai (via Shanghai Metro Line 9 from Songjiang University Town Station to Line 13 Jiangning Road Station).

name: Return to pick up the car and go to Hongqiao Station to pick up my girlfriend
description: After watching the race, he took the subway back to Songjiang. On the way, he shared the dragon boat race video in the family group chat, and transferred 888 yuan to his elder brother Yin Tao via WeChat with the note “A welcome gift for my little nephew!” His brother accepted the transfer instantly and thanked him. At around 11:35, he returned to Xingang Community and went to the ground parking lot to get his car. After starting the car, he set navigation to the P10 parking lot at Hongqiao Railway Station and drove along Guangfulin Road - Jiasong South Road - G50 Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway, playing songs Lin Yue liked on the way, feeling expectant. At around 12:00, he arrived at the P10 parking lot, parked, and walked to the arrival pickup area.
location: From Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to P10 Parking Lot, Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station, 1500 Shengui Road, Minchang District, Shanghai.

name: Picking someone up at the station and having lunch together
description: At the arrival level of Hongqiao Station, he met Lin Yue. She had cut her hair short and looked even more spirited; both were delighted to see each other. Lin Yue handed him a birthday gift — a drone filter kit — explaining that she noticed the backlighting in his previous aerial shots wasn't good, so this might help. Yin Hao was touched and accepted it. He took her suitcase and they headed together to the nearby Hongqiao Tiandi Shopping Center. They ate at a Shanghainese noodle shop on the lower ground floor. Lin Yue ordered scallion oil noodles and xiaolongbao, while Yin Hao ordered spicy meat noodles. During the meal, Yin Hao told her about watching the dragon boat race that morning and the happy news of his brother's family having a new baby. Lin Yue was pleased too, and they discussed going to Suzhou on the weekend to visit the newborn.
location: The arrival level of Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station, 1500 Shengui Road, Minhang District, Shanghai, and the Shanghai-style noodle restaurant on the basement level of THE HUB Shopping Center, 688 Shenchang Road

name: Aerial photography outing at Chenshan Botanical Garden
description: After lunch, he drove to Chenshan Botanical Garden via Songze Elevated Road, Jiamin Elevated Road, and Chenhua Highway. After entering the park, he found a wide-open lawn, installed the filter Lin Yue had given him, and flew the drone. The color layering was significantly enhanced, and he filmed the Quarry Garden, the greenhouse complex, and the hydrangea flower sea. Yin Hao taught Lin Yue how to use the remote control to adjust the gimbal, and she had fun. They took several group photos with the drone, with Chenshan and the sea of flowers in the background. During a break, they sat on a lakeside bench, shared the snacks and bottled water they had brought, and enjoyed a leisurely afternoon.
location: Shanghai Chenshan Botanical Garden, 3888 Chenhua Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Restaurant birthday celebration and in-depth conversation
description: After leaving the botanical garden, he drove to the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road in the old town of Songjiang. They arrived around 16:45 and ordered signature dishes including steamed sea bass, braised pork belly, and sizzling eel shreds. When all the dishes were served, Lin Yue suddenly took out a small heart-shaped cake, placed candles forming the number 28 on it, and asked the waiter to light them to celebrate Yin Hao's birthday. Yin Hao closed his eyes, made a wish, and blew out the candles; the atmosphere was warm. But then Lin Yue said dejectedly that her father was again urging her to go on blind dates, thinking that a long-distance relationship between the two was unrealistic. After a moment of silence, Yin Hao replied honestly that he was working on the senior technician certificate and had a down payment savings plan, planning to buy an apartment in Songjiang by the end of next year to give their future a clear commitment. The two talked deeply about the hardships and plans of a long-distance relationship and finally decided to maintain the status quo, but the issue still weighed on their minds.
location: Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, No. 232 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Saw off his girlfriend and sorted out his feelings alone
description: The atmosphere after the conversation was somewhat heavy. Yin Hao settled the bill (280 yuan in total, including the cake). Lin Yue insisted that he not escort her too far; she took a taxi by the roadside back to the hotel she had booked in Putuo District. Yin Hao accompanied her while waiting for the taxi until it drove away. Then he walked back alone to Xingang Community, sitting for a while on a roadside bench along the way to calmly sort through his complicated feelings — happy about the birthday and reunion, yet worried about the pressure of the future.
location: Near No. 232 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and Xingang Residential Community

name: Video call with mother.
description: After returning home, he washed his face and made a video call to his mother on WeChat. As soon as his mother answered, she wished Yin Hao a happy birthday and asked about his daytime activities. Yin Hao adjusted his mood and smilingly shared the happy events of the dragon boat race, receiving gifts, and eating cake, but did not mention the heavy conversation that evening. His mother told him to take good care of himself and visit his sister-in-law and nephew when he had time. After hanging up, Yin Hao felt a little lighter.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Bookkeeping and Planning
description: Opened the laptop, first imported the day's aerial footage into the hard drive and simply categorized it. Then started Shark Ledger to record expenses: 15 yuan for snacks at the dragon boat race, 40 yuan for parking, 60 yuan for lunch, free admission to the botanical garden (annual pass), 280 yuan for dinner, 888 yuan for a red envelope, with total expenses of about 1283 yuan. Looking at the two large expenses, the red envelope and dinner, and thinking back to the evening conversation, Yin Hao wrote a self-motivating note in his memo: “There is still a long way to go to the goal; keep working hard every day.”
location: Home study at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Playing online games with friends.
description: After changing into loose loungewear, he lay on the sofa and opened Honor of Kings. Seeing his friend Wang Lei online, he invited him to form a team for a match. Yin Hao chose Xiahou Dun for the clash lane, and Wang Lei used Li Bai as the jungler. The two chatted while playing over voice. Yin Hao complained a bit about his complicated mood that day. Wang Lei did not ask much, only comforted him with a line: 'Men just have to carry it.' They went one win and one loss in two games. By the time it was nearly 8:30, Yin Hao felt much better and logged off.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: CNC technology study
description: Sitting in the study, I opened CNC Machining Center Programming and Operation and my notebook, focusing on reviewing the macro program application of tool radius compensation, which is a difficult point in the senior technician certificate exam. I operated step by step on the simulation software and ran the examples from the book, gaining a deeper understanding of the relationship between the compensation direction (left/right compensation) and the tool radius value, preparing for the year-end assessment.
location: Home study at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wash up before bed
description: Closed the book, went to the bathroom to take a hot shower, and washed away the day's fatigue. After changing into pajamas, he did a set of pre-sleep stretches. Lying in bed looking at his phone, Lin Yue sent a message at 21:30: "Good night, Hao. I had a great day today. The road is still long, let's walk it together." Yin Hao felt warm inside and replied, "Good night, sweet dreams. Let's walk it together."
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep review and plan for tomorrow
description: Turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside lamp, and reviewed the special experiences of the day: the joy of getting a promotion and becoming an uncle, the festive dragon boat and fireworks atmosphere, the sweetness of reuniting with my girlfriend, and the heavy conversation brought by reality. Although the long-distance relationship issue was not completely resolved, at least we had an open and honest talk. I set the alarm for 6:15 the next morning and silently planned to make up the machine maintenance records after work, and to contact Master Sun at noon to confirm this week's tutoring time. Turned off the light at 22:45 and slowly fell asleep amidst my thoughts.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting up, weighing in, and preparing for morning exercise
description: At 6:15 a.m., the phone alarm went off. After getting up, Hao went to the bathroom first to weigh himself: 73.8 kg. Then he drank a glass of warm water to wake up his body. Afterward, he changed into a quick-dry short-sleeved shirt, athletic shorts, and running shoes, put on a fitness band and Bluetooth earphones, and prepared for his morning run. Since the weather was turning from cloudy to overcast and felt muggy, he specifically chose a breathable tank top. During this time, he saw the drone filter set that his girlfriend Lin Yue had given him yesterday, felt a little complicated, but quickly adjusted his mindset.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run and returning home to wash up
description: Brother Hao drove from Xingang Residential Community, turned right onto Kungang Highway along Xingang Road, and arrived at Xiaokunshan Health Park in about 10 minutes. He jogged 5 kilometers on the tree-lined path in the park, with a pace of about 5:50 and a heart rate maintained around 140bpm, focusing on aerobic relaxation. After the run, he did 10 minutes of static stretching in the park's stretching area, focusing on relaxing his calves and knees to relieve the soreness from standing for a long time the day before. Then he drove back home, took a warm shower, changed into clean work clothes, and put the changed clothes into the washing machine for a pre-wash.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and commute to work.
description: Hao had a simple breakfast at home: whole wheat bread and milk bought the night before. Meanwhile, he checked his commuter bag and made sure to bring his work badge, car keys, power bank, and drawing tools. Knowing that the evening live class required drawing isometric views, he deliberately sharpened two extra pencils. Then he drove off. On the way, he stopped at the steamed bun shop outside the factory area and bought two pork buns and a cup of soy milk. While driving, he listened to the local traffic radio to learn about road conditions and recalled the urgent special-shaped flange parts he needed to handle in the morning.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (departing via Xingang Community)

name: Morning work and mentoring
description: Brother Hao clocked in on time at 7:55, changed into his work clothes, and put on his safety helmet and goggles. At the workshop entrance, he confirmed the morning's urgent task with team leader Wang Lei. Master Sun Jianguo patted him on the shoulder and said they'd talk about the digital project over lunch. The new colleague Xiao Chen was a bit nervous, and Brother Hao told him not to worry. At 8:00, he started operating the CNC machine, performing the warm-up self-check while explaining key points such as tool offset adjustment and handwheel inspection to Xiao Chen. During processing, he found that a part's dimensions were out of tolerance, so he guided Xiao Chen to re-measure with a micrometer and revise the program. 10:00-10:15 was a work break; Brother Hao drank some water in the rest area and politely declined the cigarette Wang Lei offered (he had quit smoking to prepare for the race). Colleague Liu Zhiqiang asked about his birthday, and Brother Hao answered briefly and mentioned his weekend plans. After 10:15, he continued working on the remaining flange parts, personally walking Xiao Chen through the first-piece setup and letting him independently complete the measurement and tool change. Xiao Chen did well and was praised. The morning tasks were completed successfully.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and digital project discussion
description: At lunch, Brother Hao got braised pork (in controlled portions) and stir-fried greens in the cafeteria, while Master Sun Jianguo ordered steamed small yellow croaker. As they ate, they discussed the workshop digitalization renovation project. Master Sun gestured with chopsticks, planning to deploy sensors in the workshop to transmit real-time machine tool vibration and temperature data to the central control screen to warn of faults in advance. Brother Hao asked whether the data transmission protocol should use Modbus TCP and PLC acquisition. Master Sun agreed and asked Brother Hao to give it more attention, and that they first produce a preliminary research plan. Brother Hao readily agreed.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Noon break
description: After the meal, Brother Hao returned to the workshop break area and took a 20-minute nap with his head resting on his safety helmet, storing up energy for the afternoon's work and evening study.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon work and study records
description: The afternoon shift began, and Brother Hao continued handling routine production orders. In the meantime, he sketched the digital project ideas he had discussed with Master Sun at noon into a simple architecture diagram and recorded it in his notebook. At the same time, the new colleague Xiao Chen performed machining operations independently, while Brother Hao occasionally checked the process. Before 15:30, all production tasks were completed smoothly. Brother Hao helped Xiao Chen put the finished products into storage, and together they cleaned the machine tools and workstations.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting off work and preparing the work handover.
description: Before leaving work, Hao confirmed the initial research direction for the digitalization project with Master Sun Jianguo, and planned to contact several sensor suppliers for quotes before next week. Then Hao handed over the day's production report. Master Sun encouraged him to study hard in the evening. Hao smiled and agreed, preparing to leave work.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Swimming cross-training
description: Hao left the factory and drove to Songjiang Swimming Center. On the way, he sent a WeChat voice message to his girlfriend Lin Yue, telling her that the evening live class would last until 9 o'clock, and asking about the specific schedule for the weekend Suzhou trip. He had already selected the G7301 high-speed train at 8:37, and Lin Yue replied that she would check hotels. After arriving at the swimming center at No. 35 Yongfeng Road, he changed into his swimsuit, warmed up briefly for 5 minutes, and got into the water for a 45-minute swimming training session. He swam mainly freestyle, mixing in breaststroke to relax, keeping his heart rate at about 135 bpm, which effectively relieved the fatigue in his legs. After getting out of the water, he did additional stretching and recorded the swimming duration and how he felt.
location: No. 35 Swimming Pool, 35 Yongfeng Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pick up groceries along the way
description: After finishing swimming, Brother Hao drove back. On the way, he stopped at the Xingang Xincun fresh food supermarket at Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, and bought soft tofu, tomatoes, Shanghai bok choy, some pork ribs, apples, and bananas to restock for the week.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and preparation for the mechanical drawing class.
description: After Hao Ge got home, he first handled the pork ribs, blanched them, and put them in the rice cooker with corn and carrots to make soup. While the soup was simmering, he quickly made scrambled eggs with tomatoes and stir-fried Shanghai bok choy. He started eating around 18:00, while watching a replay of a teaching video on isometric drawing on Bilibili on his tablet, previewing the live stream content for the evening. After the meal, he cleaned up the dishes, neatly arranged his drawing tools, A3 drawing sheets, tablet, and textbooks on the desk, logged into the Open University of China live streaming platform, confirmed the network was working, prepared pencils and eraser, and waited for class to begin.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: National Open University live course: Mechanical Drawing (Axonometric Drawing)
description: He logged into the Open University of China's online live classroom on time. Teacher Liu Jianjun was lecturing on The Projection Principle of Axonometric Drawings and the Drawing of Isometric Drawings. Hao Ge listened attentively, following the teacher in practicing drawing a circle's isometric view on A3 paper. In the interactive area, he uploaded his sketch and asked how to remember the method for determining the direction of the ellipse's major axis, and the teacher answered and guided him. After class, the teacher assigned homework to draw an isometric view from three-view drawings. Hao Ge took a screenshot to save it and raised his hand in the live room to ask a question about the representation of intersection lines.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Nos. 1-246, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (online participation)

name: After-class organization and family contact
description: After the live stream ended, Hao first sorted out his mechanical drawing notes, focusing on the steps for drawing a circle in isometric projection and the key points from the teacher's Q&A, then put away his drafting tools. Afterward, he sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend Lin Yue to confirm the high-speed rail time and hotel budget for the weekend trip to Suzhou. Lin Yue sent back two hotel options. Next, he made a video call to his mother in Nantong. His mother asked whether work was tiring. Hao said today was fine and he had learned something new; after a few casual words, he set her mind at ease.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wash up, review the day, and plan for tomorrow
description: Hao took a warm shower to wash away the day's fatigue, changed into pajamas, and used a foam roller to briefly relax the muscle groups used in today's running and swimming, especially the front of the thighs. Then he recorded expenses in the Shark Ledger: 65 yuan for groceries, and one swim session deducted from the swim card. Afterward, he leaned against the headboard, opened Turning Technology, reviewed the correspondence between the axonometric drawing from the live lesson and the three-view drawings he had learned before, and wrote down tomorrow's to-do items in his phone memo: finish the mechanical drawing homework and research sensor suppliers.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Light leisure activities before bed and going to sleep
description: Hao turned off the desk lamp, lay in bed scrolling through Douyin for a while, and watched videos about fishing and drone repair, still having mixed feelings about the camera filter Lin Yue gave him yesterday. Then he took deep breaths, cleared his mind, set his phone alarm for 6:15 the next morning, and prepared to sleep.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning preparation and heading out for a morning run
description: The 06:15 alarm went off. After getting up, he weighed himself at 73.9 kg, washed up, changed into a quick-dry athletic short-sleeved shirt and shorts, and did some simple stretching. At 06:30 he went downstairs and drove to Xiaokunshan Health Park, about a 10-minute drive. The weather was cloudy, suitable for running.
location: Room 402, Unit 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning jog in the park.
description: Completed an easy 3 km run on the Xiaokunshan Health Park trail, with a pace of 6 min/km, followed by 5 minutes of stretching by the lake.
location: 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, Xiaokunshan Health Park

name: Going home to rest and commuting
description: Drove home, took a shower, changed into the dark blue work uniform, and checked the work badge, keys, and power bank. Then drove to work, stopping on the way at the entrance of the Sun Island Ancient Village Farmhouse Restaurant to buy meat buns and soy milk, and ate them in the car.
location: Room 402, Unit 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning meeting at work.
description: Punched in at the factory and changed into safety shoes. At the morning meeting, team leader Wang Lei assigned production tasks and emphasized the precision requirements for the flanges.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning production and work-break discussion
description: Returned to the CNC machine station, checked the lubricating oil and coolant, and started the equipment to machine 304 stainless steel flange parts. During operation breaks, guided new employee Xiao Chen on tool compensation issues. During the 09:50-10:10 break, discussed the digital transformation plan with Liu Zhiqiang by the water dispenser. Liu Zhiqiang strongly promoted the quick conversion method; I proposed a compatibility plan considering the stability of old equipment, and he thought an initial plan could be made first. Then continued working until 11:45, adjusting parameters to handle surface finish deviation issues.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Went to the cafeteria to get food and sat with Master Sun Jianguo. While eating, we discussed the morning meeting with Liu Zhiqiang. Master Sun suggested considering both sides and said he would think of a plan in the afternoon. After lunch, I took a 20-minute nap in the workshop break room.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Plant, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon production and wrap-up
description: In the afternoon, he continued machining flange parts and took time to demonstrate the tool compensation correction process to Xiao Chen. At 15:50, the last batch of parts came off the line; he turned off the equipment, cleaned the iron chips, applied oil, and filled in the work log and shift handover record.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Buying groceries after work and preparing for exercise.
description: Punched out from work and drove home. Passing by Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket, he parked and bought sea bass, green vegetables, scallions and ginger, and chatted with the shopkeeper about fish-selection tips. After arriving home, he put the groceries in the fridge, changed into running shorts and a singlet, and took his heart rate strap and water bottle.
location: Room 402, Unit 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Coached Wang Lei on interval running
description: Drove to the track at Songjiang University Town and contacted Wang Lei via WeChat on the way. After arriving, first led Wang Lei on a 1 km jog to warm up, then did 4 x 400 m interval runs with a target pace of 5 min/km and 2 minutes of rest between sets. During the third set, Wang Lei's breathing became erratic, so I slowed the pace and encouraged him; he gritted his teeth and finished. After training, we did 15 minutes of full-body stretching, and I reminded Wang Lei to eat more carbs before training.
location: Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, Songjiang University Town sports field

name: Returning home and having dinner
description: Drove home, took a shower, and changed into loungewear. Cleaned the sea bass, steamed it, stir-fried some greens, ate dinner alone, and drank ice water.
location: Room 402, Unit 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Clean up after meals and review the National Open University course.
description: After washing the dishes and wiping down the kitchen counter, I watched drone aerial videos on Bilibili on my phone to relax a bit. At 20:00, I started reviewing the National Open University course "Programmable Controller Applications", using TIA Portal simulation software, focusing on timer and counter instructions, building simulation circuits for "motor delayed start" and "workpiece counting", and completing after-class exercises.
location: Room 402, Unit 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening contact and bedtime preparation
description: At 21:30, contacted girlfriend Lin Yue via WeChat, reported on the day's completed tasks, confirmed that the weekend trip to Suzhou was unchanged, and she agreed to bring local pastries. Afterwards, washed up, used Shark Ledger to record expenses (vegetables and steamed buns), set an alarm for 06:15 the next day, and checked his commuter bag.
location: Room 402, Unit 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Relaxing before bed
description: Lying in bed listening to soft music, reflecting on the day's exercise and study gains. At 23:00, put the phone on the nightstand, closed his eyes, and went to sleep.
location: Room 402, Unit 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The phone alarm rang on time. He reached over, turned it off, and sat up. He got out of bed barefoot, stepped on the scale, and it showed 74.0 kg, the same as yesterday. He pulled open the curtains and found the sunlight outside already somewhat glaring, a sign of another hot day. He went to the bathroom to wash up, using cold water on his face to help wake up quickly.
location: Bedroom at home, Building 5, Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Indoor resistance band training.
description: Considering today's high of 35 degrees, outdoor running could easily cause heatstroke, so I followed the plan and did indoor training. I found resistance bands from the cabinet, opened the workout app on my phone, and followed a video to complete a 20-minute session: squats, glute bridges, and shoulder presses. I broke a light sweat, but wasn't as out of breath as running, which made up for the lack of cardio.
location: Living room at home, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Shower, change clothes, and pre-departure checks
description: After the training session, he took a shower and changed into clean work clothes. Before going out, he checked his commuter bag again: the PLC materials he had reviewed last night, the part drawings he needed to look at today, his wallet, keys, as well as a power bank and earphones.
location: Home, Building 5, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Commute and breakfast
description: Went downstairs at 7:05, warmed up the car, and set off. As usual, I stopped by the Sun Island Ancient Village Farmhouse Restaurant on the way, bought two steamed buns (one with vegetables, one with meat) and a cup of soy milk for breakfast, costing 8 yuan. I finished breakfast while driving and arrived at the factory about 25 minutes later.
location: Songjiang District, Shanghai, China. Drove from Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360, Huatianjing Road, stopping on the way at the Sun Island Ancient Village farmhouse restaurant beside the East Gate of Sun Island Resort to buy breakfast.

name: Workshop work (including break time, lunch, and midday rest)
description: Clocked in at 7:30, changed into work clothes, and entered the workshop. First checked the shift handover log. Today's flange machining tasks were fairly full, but not stressful. In the morning, I operated the CNC machine the whole time, focusing on machining. At 10 o'clock during the work break, I smoked and chatted with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang at the workshop entrance. The union happened to hand out salted soda drinks. Wang Lei offered cigarettes, and we talked about weekend plans. Yin Hao said he was going to Suzhou on Saturday to see his newborn nephew. Wang Lei teased him to treat everyone to a meal, and he smiled and replied, "We'll talk about it when I get back." Meanwhile, I took a glance at the cycling club group chat on my phone and saw a preview of an event at Dianshan Lake on the weekend. Since I couldn't go on Saturday, I thought I'd pay attention to it next week. At noon, I had lunch with Master Sun in the cafeteria, ordering braised pork chop, stir-fried water spinach, and half a bowl of rice. Master Sun asked about the digital transformation project. Yin Hao told him about yesterday's disagreement with Liu Zhiqiang. Master Sun suggested making a compatibility plan first, and they discussed it a bit while eating. After lunch, I rested my head on the table and dozed for 20 minutes. In the afternoon, I continued machining. Brother Wu quickly replied suggesting Wednesday evening or after work on Thursday, and said they could get in touch then. The two arranged the time for their next fishing outing.
location: Home, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Yin Hao washed up in the bathroom in the evening and checked his condition in the mirror. After returning to the bedroom, he set his phone alarm for 6:00 the next morning and checked his work clothes and folder again. Only when he had confirmed everything was ready did he lie down with ease. Outside the window the night was deep, and a new day was about to begin.
location: Home, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Reflect before sleep.
description: After turning off the light, Yin Hao found it hard to fall asleep for a while. His mother's worry and Lin Yue's understanding intertwined in his mind. He silently calculated his savings progress and firmly resolved to obtain the senior technician certificate, while continuing his hobbies of running and fishing. Thinking that although life is stressful, as long as he moves forward steadily he can always find a way out, he gradually calmed down and grew sleepy.
location: Bedroom at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Weigh yourself after getting up, wash up, and change clothes
description: The alarm rang 5 minutes early. Since he had a morning run planned for today, he needed a more relaxed pace. After getting up, he weighed himself: 74.3 kg, up 0.1 kg from yesterday. He drank a glass of warm water, quickly washed up, changed into running gear, and checked the weather forecast. It was cloudy and 24 degrees, good for running. He put on his sports arm pouch and put his phone and keys inside.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the sports field at Songjiang University Town and warmed up
description: He drove off and stopped by FamilyMart (Longyuan Road branch) on the way to buy a bottle of sports drink. Then he set the navigation to the Songjiang University Town track, and on the way messaged Wang Lei on WeChat: "I'm on my way. Are you there yet? Don't be late." When he arrived at the track entrance, Wang Lei was already stretching. They met up and did a dynamic warm-up together to prepare for the training. Yin Hao noticed that Wang Lei was in good shape.
location: Songjiang University Town sports field, Longteng Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Leading Wang Lei through a 4-kilometer tempo run and stretching exchange.
description: Started running on time, with Yin Hao setting the pace at 5:45 per kilometer. Wang Lei kept a steady rhythm for the first two kilometers, but his breathing became irregular in the third. Yin Hao signaled him to use a rhythm of two steps inhaling and two steps exhaling, and slowed the pace by 10 seconds per kilometer to help him settle. Wang Lei finished the 4 kilometers in 22:50. After the run, Yin Hao guided Wang Lei through 10 minutes of static stretching, focusing on loosening the front and back of his thighs, and commented, 'Today's pace control was good, and you managed to hold steady in the last two kilometers. Your heart and lungs still need training—next time try interval running.' He recorded the time on his phone and gave Wang Lei an encouraging pat on the shoulder. As they stretched, they chatted, and Wang Lei said he'd see him online tonight; Yin Hao agreed.
location: Songjiang University Town sports field, Longteng Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home, take a shower, eat breakfast, and review technical materials
description: I drove home, and the morning breeze on my sweat-soaked clothes felt refreshing. After getting home, I took a shower first and changed into clean work clothes, while reviewing the key points from today's kickoff meeting in my mind. I took two eggs out of the fridge, put them in cold water to boil, and made a glass of milk. When the eggs were done, I peeled them and quickly ate breakfast with the milk. Meanwhile, I took out my phone and quickly browsed the preliminary technical proposal for the stable compatible module and peripheral interfaces sent by Liu Zhiqiang, making notes on a few key parameters.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive to work and arrive early for inspection
description: Left at 8:15 and drove to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. Traffic was gradually increasing on the way, and I listened to the morning news. Arrived at the plant at 8:30 on time, parked the car, swiped my card to enter the workshop. There were still 15 minutes before official work started, so I walked to the machine tool I am responsible for and did a routine inspection: checked the oil level, air pressure, and coolant, and checked the drawings and programs for the day's workpieces. After confirming everything was correct, I organized the materials related to the digitalization project.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Attended the launch meeting for the CNC workshop digital transformation project and refined the division of tasks
description: At 8:45, Yin Hao, Liu Zhiqiang, and Sun Jianguo met in the corridor outside the meeting room and entered together. Liu Zhiqiang said with a smile, "Old Yin, your idea about the external interface is interesting; let's talk about it in detail later." At 9:00, the kickoff meeting officially began, hosted by VP Wang, the deputy general manager for technology. The goal was made clear at the meeting: complete the scheme design within two weeks. Liu Zhiqiang was responsible for the core algorithm and efficiency optimization, Yin Hao for the stability and compatibility module and external interfaces, and Sun Jianguo for overall technical direction. Yin Hao elaborated on his initial concept, from hardware selection to a compatibility solution for legacy systems. Sun Jianguo added key points on shock resistance and heat dissipation. After the meeting ended at 11:00, the three did not leave. At a workbench in a corner of the workshop, they refined the division of labor: Yin Hao listed the equipment that needed to be connected, Liu Zhiqiang drew a preliminary algorithm flowchart, and they agreed to have another technical meeting tomorrow morning.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Had lunch in the cafeteria and chatted with colleagues.
description: At lunchtime, Yin Hao went to the canteen with Sun Jianguo and Wang Lei. While getting food, Wang Lei came over and asked about the morning meeting. Yin Hao said it had gotten off to a good start and that they needed to keep tackling hard problems in the afternoon, and encouraged Wang Lei to play well in the evening game. Wang Lei grinned in response, and Sun Jianguo teased, "You two are more eager to play games than to work."
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and a walk around the factory area to aid digestion.
description: After lunch, he closed his eyes and dozed for 20 minutes on the sofa in the break room. After waking up at 12:30, he took a 15-minute slow walk on the factory road outside the workshop to aid digestion and relax his eyes and mind, recharging for the afternoon's work.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon routine machining tasks and in-depth project work
description: In the afternoon he officially started work, first handling two routine machining tasks that needed to be completed that day to ensure production progress. He then organized the morning meeting content into electronic notes and began to read the "Stable Compatible Module Technical White Paper" in depth, studying how several solutions performed under different working conditions. During this time, he went to the adjacent workshop to observe the automated production line that the sister factory had upgraded and took photos for reference. At 16:30, he helped Liu Zhiqiang debug an I/O interface program that had a bug. At 17:00 he got off work, shut down the computer, cleaned the machine tool table and tool cabinet, and felt that his work condition was good that day and the project was advancing smoothly.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive home after work and buy groceries on the way.
description: Drove home and on the way stopped by Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket. As planned, bought scallions, ginger, garlic, dried chili peppers, and a bundle of dried noodles. While queuing at the checkout, also picked up a box of discounted fresh eggs.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road (next to Northwest Gate 1 of Xingang New Village).

name: Make dinner after getting home
description: After arriving home, he sorted the groceries into the refrigerator, washed his hands, changed into casual shorts and a T-shirt, and relaxed. Then he started making dinner: he cut scallions into sections and slowly fried them over low heat to make golden scallion oil, while boiling fine dried noodles in another pot. After cooking, he rinsed the noodles in cold water, topped them with sliced cucumber and chopped scallions, drizzled with hot scallion oil and soy sauce, and fried a soft-boiled egg with a runny yolk, serving it with pickled vegetables as scallion oil noodles.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Had dinner and scrolled on phone for entertainment
description: While eating noodles, he scrolled through his phone. He watched today's basketball game highlights, scrolled through fishing and running videos, and also saw a repair video dismantling an old CNC motor. Finding it useful, he tapped to save it.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After dinner, cleaned up the kitchen and had a voice call with mother.
description: After eating, he washed the dishes and wiped down the kitchen. Then he picked up his phone and sent a voice message to his mother: 'Mom, have you eaten? I'm doing well. The project just started today and everything is going smoothly. How are things in Suzhou? Don't worry too much.' After sending that, he sent a text message to his older brother Yin Tao: 'Bro, I told Mom not to worry. If you and sister-in-law are free this weekend, bring the nephew to Shanghai. I learned a new dish.'
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organize project notes and to-do items
description: Back in his room, he opened his laptop, organized the notes from today's kickoff meeting and the questions he needed to confirm with Liu Zhiqiang tomorrow into a clear to-do list, and saved it to his phone's memo app.
location: Home study at Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Played Honor of Kings online with friends.
description: Yin Hao had just finished sorting his notes when Wang Lei sent an invitation in the game group chat. Yin Hao put on his earphones and joined. Tonight was a five-player squad game. Besides Yin Hao, Wang Lei, and Liu Zhiqiang, Zhang Jianguo also came online. The four of them coordinated well and won both matches. During the games, Wang Lei talked about how his morning runs felt while playing, and Liu Zhiqiang complained about bugs at work; the atmosphere was relaxed.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and stretching to relax.
description: After the game ended, he stood up and stretched his body. Feeling the soreness from the morning run, he spread out his yoga mat and spent 15 minutes stretching and relaxing his leg and back muscles. Then he went to the bathroom to wash his face and brush his teeth.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Studying CNC technology in bed, planning the weekend, and relaxing before sleep
description: Lying in bed, he first browsed the forum for the CNC advanced certificate exam, saw a few discussion posts on milling programming, and bookmarked them. Then he watched a popular science video on Bilibili about the application of digital twin technology on production lines and found it very interesting. At the same time, he thought of the plan to go fishing with Brother Wu on the weekend. Seeing a newly opened wild pond near Dianshan Lake, he left a message asking Brother Wu whether they could finalize the specific time on Friday evening. Then he browsed news about Shanghai's talent settlement policy, mentally calculating his own eligibility. With everything ready, he turned off the light and went to bed at 22:15, feeling that the day had been solid and fulfilling.
location: Home bedroom, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wake up, weigh myself, wash up, and go out for a morning run
description: At 06:15 in the morning, the alarm went off. After getting up, he first weighed himself; the reading was stable at 74.2 kg. Then he washed up, changed into a dark blue quick-dry short-sleeved shirt and black shorts, and put his phone and keys into a waist pack. At 06:30, he left home and jogged to Xiaokunshan Health Park. Going south along Xingang Road and then turning onto Kungang Road, he reached the park's circular trail in about 15 minutes. He ran 5 km at a recovery pace, keeping his heart rate below 140, mainly to stretch out his shoulders and neck from overtime work. After the run, he did leg stretches in the fitness area. At 07:20, he walked slowly back to Xingang Community, buying three steamed buns and a cup of soy milk for breakfast on the way.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and then back to Xingang Community.

name: Eating breakfast at home and handling messages
description: After getting home, took a warm shower and changed into work clothes. For breakfast, chose fried eggs, whole wheat bread, and skim milk, and while eating watched part of the 'Electrical Technology Basics' course on the phone. Around 07:45, contacted friend Liu Fang via WeChat to apologize for standing her up yesterday due to overtime, and proposed treating her to Japanese food on Saturday evening as compensation.
location: Dining room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Drove to work and listened to technical audio on the way
description: Drove the silver-gray Volkswagen Lavida from Xingang Community to the company, about a 15-minute drive. On the way, he played the explanatory audio of Digital Workshop Communication Protocol via Bluetooth, focusing on learning the application of the OPC UA protocol in retrofitting old equipment.
location: Commute route from Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning work: workshop handover and plan refinement.
description: At 08:15 I swiped my card to enter the workshop, changed into safety shoes and work clothes, had a brief handover with Master Dong, the night shift leader, and checked the operation log of the CNC gantry milling machine. Starting at 08:30, together with Master Liu Zhiqiang and Master Sun Jianguo, I checked the peripheral interface dimensions of the stable compatibility module against the parameters at the whiteboard in the workshop office area. We found a handwritten annotation that did not match the electronic file. Relying on his experience, Master Sun recalled the on-site modification situation and confirmed the original data, avoiding a rework of the plan. After 11:00, I returned to my gantry milling station and, based on the confirmed results, adjusted the tool compensation parameters in the valve body machining program and started the first-piece trial cutting.
location: Workshop and office area of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and health reflection
description: In the employee canteen, he chose the chicken breast salad set meal and a multigrain rice ball to maintain a healthy diet. He happened to meet Master Chen Jianguo, who praised his strong ability to get things done; Wang Lei also joked that he had mended his ways. After the meal, he sat for a while in the small garden in the factory area, looked up fat-loss meal recipes on his phone, and reviewed his electronic physical examination report. He was deeply worried about the fatty liver and high triglyceride indicators, which strengthened his determination to adjust his diet.
location: Employee cafeteria and small factory garden of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Catching up on sleep at the workstation during the lunch break
description: Returned to my station in the workshop rest area, put in earplugs, folded my jacket as a pillow, and rested my head on the desk for a short nap to regain energy for the afternoon's work.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon work: finalizing the proposal and technical study.
description: In the afternoon, I continued checking the stability and compatibility module parameters with Liu Zhiqiang and Sun Jianguo, and the three parties signed to confirm the stage documents. After that, I returned to the gantry milling machine console and monitored the dimensional accuracy of the valve body rough machining process. Starting at 16:00, I reviewed the OPC UA chapter of the Digital Workshop Communication Protocol White Paper on the computer in the office area, and with the morning parameters in mind, my understanding went deeper. From 16:20, I carried out the daily machine inspection, removed metal chips, checked the cutting fluid, filled in the work log, noted the next day's material follow-up plan, and left a sticky note for Engineer Liu.
location: Workshop and office area, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting after work and buying healthy ingredients.
description: He left work by car at 17:00 and stopped by Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket on the way. In the supermarket, he picked out chicken breast, broccoli, carrots, and scallions, and grabbed a box of skim milk at checkout. The drive took about 14 minutes, and he arrived at the supermarket around 17:20.
location: Commute route from Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and inside the supermarket.

name: Arrived home, prepped ingredients, and took a shower

Then he took a shower and changed into loose shorts and a T-shirt to prepare for dinner.
location: Kitchen and bathroom at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare and enjoy a healthy dinner
description: At 18:00, started cooking: blanched broccoli and carrots, pan-fried chicken breast in olive oil until golden, then simmered until cooked, served with multigrain rice. While eating, watched the video of a new fishing spot at Dianshan Lake shared by Brother Wu on my phone.
location: Kitchen and dining table at home, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cleaned the kitchen and talked with mother

He reported that he had started cooking and paying attention to his diet, listened to his mother's health reminders, and chatted about amusing neighborhood stories from his hometown.
location: Kitchen and balcony at home, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organized fishing gear.

location: In front of the bedroom storage cabinet at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

location: In front of the desk at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

During the open Q&A session, he explained two of my questions with diagrams, and everything became clear. After class, I completed 20 multiple-choice questions and 2 calculation questions in 15 minutes, with an accuracy rate of 85%.

location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Xinguang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waking up, washing up, and morning preparations

Yin Hao weighed himself at 74.0 kg, washed up, changed into running shoes and sports shorts, and put on earphones. He used his phone to reply to messages his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang had sent in the early morning, confirming the weekend plans to go fishing at Dianshan Lake.

After eating, I checked my commuter bag: work ID, notebook, power bank, and two packs of tissues.

He preheated the CNC lathe that would be the focus of today's operations and performed routine checks, confirming that the lubricating oil and coolant were at normal levels.

During machining breaks, Yin Hao kept listening for any abnormal sounds from the machine tools, highly concentrated.

He specifically listed next week's lunch combinations and took photos to save them.

Yin Hao smiled and showed him the diet plan he had made, saying he wanted to be responsible for his body.

After adjusting, Wang Lei's pace improved. After the workout, Yin Hao led Wang Lei through 10 minutes of core training: 1 min 30 sec plank, and 3 sets of 15 squats. The two sat by the track stretching and reviewing the session. Wang Lei said his breathing felt smooth after the arm-swing adjustment. Yin Hao shared his decision to eat a healthy diet.

name: Bedtime relaxation ritual
description: At 21:15 sharp, he put down his phone and went to the bathroom to get ready. After returning to the bedroom, he put on headphones and played soft music, then lay in bed doing deep abdominal breathing: inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 4 seconds, exhale for 6 seconds, repeated 15 times. He felt the muscles throughout his body gradually relax, and drowsiness came faster than expected.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting sleepy and falling asleep
description: Turned off the music, took out the earphones, and fell asleep about 35 minutes after lying down, 10 minutes faster than before. Drifted off around 22:20, feeling satisfied with a good start to the health plan.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wake-up and indoor core training
description: At 6:15 in the morning, the alarm went off on time and you got up quickly. The sky outside was gloomy and the air felt damp, so you decided it was not suitable for a morning run. Instead, you spread a yoga mat in the living room and spent 15 minutes completing a stable combination of push-ups, sit-ups, and squats, about 100 reps in total, working up a slight sweat. After that, you stretched carefully, relaxing every muscle, storing up energy for the day's work.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Shower, healthy breakfast, and meal prep.
description: After training, you took a quick shower and then prepared breakfast and a lunch box in the kitchen. You made a bowl of oatmeal with milk, topped it with a few blueberries and a small handful of nuts, and quickly finished breakfast. Meanwhile, you took out the chicken breast that had been thawed overnight, cut it into pieces, marinated it with a little black pepper and olive oil, blanched the broccoli, and packed everything neatly into a lunch box along with the cooked quinoa rice as today's lunch. The whole process was efficient and healthy, in line with your low-fat diet principles.
location: The kitchen and bathroom at the home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to work by car
description: Bring the bento box and work bag, go downstairs, start the car, and drive along the Jiasong South Road auxiliary road onto Huatianjing Highway toward the factory. The whole trip takes about 15-18 minutes. You play steady, light music in the car and silently go over the core arguments you plan to present at today's review meeting, building momentum for the upcoming proposal review.
location: Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (while driving)

name: Reporting for duty and pre-shift preparation
description: Arrived at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory 12 minutes before work time. You first checked the status of the CNC machine tools you were responsible for, confirming there were no alarms and the coolant was sufficient. Then you briefly met with Master Sun Jianguo and team leader Wang Lei, and learned that this morning's review meeting would be held on time. You returned to your workstation, flipped through the stability plan materials printed last night again, underlined several key data indicators with a red pen, and made final preparations for the upcoming meeting.
location: Workshop and workstation of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Attend the digital transformation project proposal review meeting.
description: The meeting was held in the second-floor conference room of the factory area, chaired by the project manager. As the first presenter, you elaborated on your renovation plan based on equipment stability, emphasizing the importance of compatibility with existing systems and reducing downtime risk. Then Liu Zhiqiang proposed an aggressive efficiency optimization plan, advocating for upgrading to more advanced software and hardware. The two of you argued starting from technical parameters, gradually becoming agitated, with voices rising, and the exchange filled with accusations like “Your plan will bring the production line to a standstill” and “You're giving up eating for fear of choking.” The meeting atmosphere at one point dropped to freezing, forcing a 10-minute break. Master Sun Jianguo frowned throughout but did not express an opinion, silently taking notes.
location: Second-floor meeting room of the Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Calming emotions and daily work.
description: After the break, you did not stay in the meeting room. Instead, you walked into the workshop, stood in front of your machine for a while, took several deep breaths, and forced yourself to calm down. Master Sun Jianguo found you, patted you on the shoulder, and said, "Technical matters can't be rushed. The 'compatibility' in your proposal is something everyone agrees on, but improving efficiency is also a hard requirement. Think about how to combine the two this afternoon." You nodded silently, returned to your workstation, and digested the confrontation from the meeting while working on the part programming task at hand.
location: Workshop and office, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Having lunch alone and adjusting his mood.
description: At lunchtime, you didn't go to the cafeteria. Instead, you sat alone in a corner of the factory rest area, opened your lunchbox, and heated it in the microwave. While eating the bland broccoli and chicken breast, you were still replaying the morning's argument. You deliberately didn't look at your phone or talk to anyone, and just wanted to be alone for a while. After eating, you leaned back in your chair and rested with your eyes closed for fifteen minutes, letting your body and mind recover a little.
location: Rest room at the plant of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work and stretching at work breaks
description: During the afternoon work period, you first spent half an hour with colleagues confirming several data handover issues pointed out in the morning meeting. Meanwhile, team leader Wang Lei informed you that management had decided to merge the two proposals into a compromise plan that “prioritizes stability while balancing efficiency.” Although you were somewhat dissatisfied with this outcome, as a veteran, following orders is your duty, so you accepted the task and began thinking about how to combine the strengths of both sides under the new framework. Around 4 p.m., during a break to get water, you did some simple neck, shoulder, and waist stretches by your workstation to relieve the fatigue of sitting for a long time.
location: Workshop and office, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving home from work.
description: Tidied up the workstation, wiped down the machine, and clocked out. You drove out of the factory area and returned to Xingang Residential Complex along Huatianjing Road. Your mood was much calmer than in the morning, but still somewhat depressed, so you decided to cancel tonight's cycling plan and go straight home to rest.
location: Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (while driving)

name: Pick up groceries along the way
description: Drove to the entrance of the residential community, parked the car, and walked into the Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket on the way. With a clear goal, you went straight to the seafood and vegetable sections, picked out a fresh sea bass (asked the staff to clean it), a few ripe tomatoes, and a bunch of scallions to prepare for dinner. The shopping was simple and quick, with no unnecessary lingering.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Stroll around the neighborhood to relax
description: After getting home and putting down the groceries, you changed into loose sweatpants and a T-shirt, then went downstairs and walked two laps around the neighborhood. Circling the central garden, you watched neighbors walking dogs and children playing. In the early summer evening air, mixed with the scent of grass and soil, you emptied your mind and let your tense nerves slowly relax.
location: Main road and garden inside Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cooking a healthy dinner
description: After walking home, you felt much better. You skillfully washed the fish, scored it, stuffed it with ginger slices, and steamed it. Meanwhile, you made a bowl of soup from eggs and tomatoes, and also made a cucumber salad. The whole cooking process was simple and focused, fully in line with your low-fat diet requirement.
location: Home kitchen, Xingang Xiaoqu, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner, cleanup, and pre-class preparation
description: You quietly enjoyed a light dinner at the dining table. After eating, you cleared the dishes and wiped the kitchen counter. Then you sat at your desk, opened your laptop, entered the Open University of China course platform in advance, browsed the courseware, and prepared for the 19:30 live class.
location: Living room and study at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Attend the Open University of China mid-term live course
description: The livestream class started on time; this was the course's mid-term review. Teacher Liu Jianjun gave a key review of chapters including DC and AC circuits, semiconductor devices, and mechanical drawing. In the second half of the class, the teacher assigned an open-ended major assignment: design a simple light-controlled delayed switch circuit and draw its parts diagram. While listening, you wrote down the key requirements and grading criteria in your notebook, and also asked two questions about component selection, receiving detailed answers from the teacher.
location: Home study at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Had a video call with my brother Yin Tao.
description: After class, you video-called your older brother Yin Tao. When he answered, Yin Tao first shared the good news that he was about to be promoted to sales supervisor, which made you genuinely happy for him. Then you told him about the stress from a conflict with a colleague at a meeting during the day. As someone who had been through it, your brother advised you not to take it too hard, saying disagreements at work are common; the key is to solve problems and learn something. He also encouraged you to accumulate more experience in projects. Finally, you confirmed plans to go fishing in the countryside outside Suzhou at the end of the month, and agreed to notify each other in advance once the exact date was set.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Course discussion and assignment submission.
description: After talking with your brother, you felt much more relaxed. You reopened the Open University of China course platform, browsed other students' posts in the discussion area, and started a discussion thread about your initial idea for the major assignment (using a 555 timer chip), receiving suggestions from several classmates. Then you packaged all the chapter assignments you had completed and uploaded them to the system to complete the submission.

participant.name: Classmates from the Open University of China.

location: Home study at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Nightly routine and falling asleep
description: After the class ended, you went to the bathroom to shower and brush your teeth, changed into loose pajamas, dimmed the bedroom lights, leaving only a bedside lamp, drew the curtains, and set your phone to Do Not Disturb mode. Then you lay flat on the bed, put on Bluetooth earphones to play soft piano music, adjusted your breathing, and focused on deep abdominal breathing, releasing the day's quarrel and the stress of the big assignment with every exhale. At around 22:45 you took off the earphones, adjusted your sleeping position, and successfully fell asleep at around 22:55, ending a busy and fulfilling day.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Get up early and drive to the stadium.
description: The phone alarm vibrated right on time, the sky outside was overcast, and the weather forecast said it would be cloudy with light rain and temperatures of 23 to 27°C. After a simple stretch, he did a set of wake-up exercises and quickly reviewed the day's key tasks: run 5 km with Wang Lei, handle Master Sun's talk, and release his emotions by cycling in the evening. He changed into running shoes and quick-dry shirt and pants, checked the car keys, and brought a small waist pack filled with electrolyte drink. After checking traffic via navigation on his phone, he drove east along Guangfulin Road, turned right onto Longteng Road, and arrived at Songjiang University Town Stadium five minutes later.
location: Building 1, Xingang Community, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Songjiang University Town Stadium

name: Coached Wang Lei on his first 5 km endurance run
description: He arrived at the track early, and Wang Lei was already waiting by the track, looking both nervous and excited. As planned, he led the first 3 km at a steady pace of 6 min/km, using breathing rhythm and arm-swing demonstrations to stabilize Wang Lei's pace throughout, and kept encouraging him to adjust his steps to the rhythm of inhaling through his nose. From the fourth kilometer on, he deliberately slowed to 6 min 15 sec/km, letting Wang Lei take a slight lead to fuel his will to win and urge to sprint. In the end, Wang Lei crossed the 5 km finish line in 29 min 15 sec. The two stopped their watches at the same time. Yin Hao patted Wang Lei on the shoulder and recorded a short high-five commemorative video with his phone. Then he led him through 10 minutes of stretching by the track and reminded him to ice his knees when he got home in the evening. Wang Lei nodded repeatedly in thanks.
location: Songjiang University Town Stadium, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive home, take a shower, and have breakfast
description: After saying goodbye to Wang Lei, he went to the vending machine by the sports field and bought a bottle of water, then drove home. Once home, he immediately showered and changed into work clothes. He took the marinated chicken breast and blanched broccoli from the fridge, quickly heated them in the microwave, and had them with two slices of whole-wheat bread and a glass of milk. He finished the meal within three minutes and cleaned up the kitchen waste.
location: At home, Building 1, Xingang Community, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute to the factory
description: Checked the backpack (packed lunchbox, work card, work badge, and power bank) and confirmed the car keys were in his pocket. Drove from Xingang Community on Guangfulin Road, turned from Guangfulin Road onto Huatianjing Highway, and encountered a red light on the way. Out of habit he used the voice memo on his phone to note a sentence: "Today I need to take the initiative to yield to Master Sun. Technically it's a compromise, but I have to show sincerity in my attitude."
location: From Xingang Residential Area, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to No. 360 Huatianjing Highway

name: Arrived at work and prepared to privately reconcile the conflict with Master Sun.
description: Arriving at work early, he first completed the equipment handover with the night-shift colleague and checked whether the CNC machine spindle was normal. After putting on his work cap, shift leader Wang Lei, holding a thermos cup, smiled and patted him on the shoulder. Sun Jianguo also happened to walk out of the office with yesterday's review meeting minutes in hand, and called Yin Hao to a corner of the workshop rest area. Master Sun handed him a cup of warm water and got straight to the point about yesterday's conflict with Liu Zhiqiang, proposing a compromise: use Liu Zhiqiang's efficiency-boosting approach for the core workstations, keep Yin Hao's stable architecture for the secondary workstations, and add two extra redundant sensors. Yin Hao, recalling his elder brother's advice from last night, nodded in agreement and proactively said he was willing to curb his temper. Master Sun smiled and said he would later arrange a written communication process with Liu Zhiqiang, and with that, the matter was closed.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning CNC Machining and Inspection
description: After returning to the workstation, his mood was noticeably lighter and he focused on operations. That morning, the main task was machining a batch of municipal air duct connecting flanges with high precision requirements. Every 20 workpieces, he manually spot-checked the dimensional deviation, and all were controlled within 0.01 mm. Around 10:00, Liu Zhiqiang came over to adjust parameters. Although the two did not talk much, their coordination was smooth—Liu Zhiqiang deliberately unfolded the drawing the other way when handing it over, and Yin Hao used the handheld controller to point at the preset tool alignment point on the display.
location: Processing Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and a relaxing walk
description: He put his own lunchbox in the microwave to heat it up. The main dish was grilled chicken breast with broccoli salad, and the staple was quinoa multigrain rice. Wang Lei came over with a cafeteria tray, eating braised pork while reviewing the morning's running techniques. Yin Hao listened and searched for 'light-controlled delay switch 555 circuit diagram' on his phone browser, saving three related posts to his notes. After eating, he didn't rush back to his workstation but walked slowly along the green walking path outside the factory for ten minutes, listening to the latest update of the podcast channel 'Electromechanical Relativity,' which was about the structural principle of the laser tool setter. After listening, he took two deep breaths and walked back to the workshop with a light step.
location: Rest room and external green walking path of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon CNC machining and wrap-up.
description: The afternoon production tasks were still tight. He replaced a coated carbide blade for the finish machining of the bevel and chamfer areas. Liu Zhiqiang came by midway to confirm the program, and the two worked together very smoothly. At 16:15, he completed all the day's workpieces on time, cleaned the chips out of the machine, signed the maintenance record book, and wiped down the control panel. He checked tomorrow's machining drawings and made two annotations in pencil on the edge of the drawing so that the next shift colleague could see them directly.
location: Processing Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Change clothes after work and go for a solo bike ride to relax
description: I quickly changed out of my work clothes into cycling kit and cleat shoes, and wiped my face with a quick-dry headband. At the factory bike shed, I took out my road bike and checked that the tire pressure was normal. Before leaving, I sent a WeChat message to Brother Wu: "Brother Wu, I got off work early today. If it doesn't rain, I'll go for a ride. Tomorrow Saturday afternoon, shall we meet at the wild pond?" By then the drizzle under the cloudy sky had stopped, and golden sunlight was leaking through gaps in the clouds. The road was dry. I turned from Longteng Road on the outskirts of Songjiang University Town into the greenway, cycling a total of 15 kilometers at an average pace of about 26 km/h. Midway, I stopped for 3 minutes at the Central Park observation deck, took a photo of the lakeside dusk, and posted it in the "Songjiang Three Brothers" group chat with the caption: "The rain has stopped; what a comfortable ride." Then I rode the rest of the familiar route to completion.
location: Longteng Road and the Central Park Greenway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Buying ingredients and going home to prepare dinner.
description: Cycled to the entrance of Xingang Community, then turned into Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket. He needed to restock eggs and greens for tomorrow morning, and also grabbed a box of tomatoes and a bottle of dark soy sauce. At checkout, he saw the live crucian carp nearby and on a whim picked one up, thinking he would add it to tomorrow's lunch. After scanning the QR code to pay, he tied the groceries to the soft basket on the back of the bike and walked home pushing it. Once home, he pushed the road bike into the hallway, locked it against the wall, and carried the groceries upstairs. He first steamed rice in the rice cooker, then put the fish in the sink to rinse off the slime, and cleaned the bass he had bought yesterday, preparing to steam it, paired with tomato and egg drop soup and cold cucumber salad. While cooking, he took the quick-dry clothes from the morning run out of the washing machine and hung them up to dry.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and home, Building 1, Xingang Community, Guangfulin Road

name: Dinner and kitchen cleanup
description: While eating, he scrolled through his phone, browsing the homework discussion in the Open University of China course group. A classmate asked, 'What size delay capacitor should be chosen for the light-controlled delay switch?' Yin Hao noted it in his memo and planned to look it up in detail after the meal. After eating, he rinsed the bowls and chopsticks clean, wiped down the stove, packed and sealed the kitchen waste, and placed it by the door.
location: Home dining room, Building 1, Xingang Community, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organize ideas for the National Open University assignment.
description: He took out his tablet, opened the course assignment requirements, and used mind-mapping software to draw a Functional Breakdown Diagram of a Light-Controlled Delay Switch, which clarified that a 555 timer chip, a photoresistor, and an adjustable potentiometer were needed. He also spent 10 minutes looking at two complete reference circuits on a forum and bookmarked a design with a low-voltage alarm function.
