location: Desk at home, Building 1, Xingang Community, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Played online games with friends
description: After closing his study tablet, Wang Lei happened to send a message in the WeChat group: 'Anyone want to play?' Yin Hao took out his phone from the bedside table, connected his Bluetooth earphones, and teamed up with Wang Lei and Zhang Fei to play two rounds of Honor of Kings. The first round was a smooth stomp, and the second round they were pushed back and lost, but everyone was in good spirits. Zhang Fei asked Yin Hao in voice chat whether he wanted to go fishing on the weekend. Yin Hao said he had arranged to go to a wild pond with Brother Wu on Saturday afternoon and might go running on Sunday.
location: Living room at home, Building 1, Xingang Community, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep preparation and checking fishing gear
description: First, I took a hot shower and changed into short-sleeved pajamas. The clothes washed yesterday were completely dry, so I sat on the floor and folded them one by one into the wardrobe. Then I pulled the fishing bag out from under the bed, checked the rod guides and the tackle box, and found that the No. 3 main line used last time had slight fraying, so I replaced it with a new spool. I packed the digital scale, live bait box, and sunscreen into the bag and placed it by the shoe cabinet near the door so I could just grab it tomorrow morning. I spent 5 minutes replying to Brother Wu on WeChat, confirming that we would meet at the wild pond in Xijinggang at 2 p.m. tomorrow.
location: Bedroom and balcony at home, Building 1, Xingang Community, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Music relaxation and abdominal breathing
description: Set the phone to Do Not Disturb mode, lay flat on the bed, propped the pillow up a bit, opened a white noise app on the phone and played a "rain + light music" mix. Closing his eyes, he began abdominal deep breathing: inhale through the nose, expanding the belly to the limit (silently counting 4 seconds), hold the breath for one second, then exhale slowly through the mouth (silently counting 6 seconds), repeating about 15 cycles. At about 21:30, drowsiness set in, and he turned off the music.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Building 1, Xingang Residential Area, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: Took off the earphones, glanced at the air conditioner temperature (set to 24), and pulled the quilt up to his chin. In his mind, he reviewed the day's events: Wang Lei's 5 km run was completed, Master Sun's mediation went smoothly, the bike ride brought his mood back, and the assignment had started to take shape... He felt much more grounded than yesterday. Gradually, his breathing slowed, and he fell into deep sleep around 22:45.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Building 1, Xingang Residential Area, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning weigh-in and cycling preparation.
description: Woke up naturally in the early morning. It was overcast outside, but it felt comfortable. When I got on the scale, I weighed 74.1 kg, and my weight was stable. After washing up, I laid out the yoga mat in the living room and did jumping jacks and dynamic stretches to wake up my body. Then I changed into professional cycling clothes and cleated shoes, prepared energy gels and electrolyte drinks, and checked my helmet, gloves, and other gear. I received a message from Brother Li of the cycling club confirming that we would meet at Sheshan at 8 o'clock.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to Sheshan to meet up and warm up
description: Starting from Xingang Residential Community, I drove along Kungang Road, turned onto Shenzhuan Road, and headed north. After 20 minutes, I arrived at the ground parking lot of the Sheshan National Tourist Resort police station. In the parking lot, I found the cycling club team and met Brother Li (a middle-aged man with a beer belly but a very strong rider). He introduced a few new members. While the group was not yet complete, I rode slowly around the parking lot and did further stretching to ensure my body was fully warmed up.
location: Ground parking lot of the Sheshan National Tourist Resort Police Station, Songjiang Branch, Shetiankun Road, Sheshan Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name:
Servo system fault diagnosis:
- Common fault codes: E001 (overcurrent), E002 (overvoltage), E003 (encoder fault)
- Troubleshooting process: check power supply → check encoder connection → measure motor winding resistance → view drive alarm codes
- Key points: first rule out external wiring problems, then check internal parameter settings
description: Set off promptly at 8 am, riding along the mountain-loop route via Waiqingsong Road, Shebei Road, Shetiankun Road, and others. The weather was overcast but cool. The group rode in a single line to break the wind at about 28 km/h, and he stayed close to the group to feel its rhythm. Along the way, he exchanged workout tips with the middle school PE teacher next to him and added a young software developer on WeChat. The whole ride was about 26 kilometers. Sweat soaked his cycling jersey, and he felt exceptionally happy.

participant.name: Wang Jianhua
participant.relation: Cycling club teammate, middle school PE teacher.

location: Around Sheshan National Tourist Resort, Songjiang District, Shanghai (mountain loop route: Waiqingsong Road - Shebei Road - Shetiankun Road, etc.)

name: Drove back home
description: After saying goodbye to club friends and agreeing to meet again next week, he drove back along the same route to Xingang Community. Along the way, he listened to radio music and savored the pleasure of the morning ride.
location: From Shetiankun Highway, Sheshan Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, via Shenzhuan Highway and Kungang Highway

name: Shower, laundry, and a simple lunch
description: After getting home, I threw the soaking-wet cycling clothes and towel into the washing machine, took a nice hot shower, and changed into home clothes. Then I washed the cycling water bottles and cleated shoes and hung them on the balcony to dry. At noon, not wanting to make a fuss, I cooked a small handful of noodles in the leftover tomato and egg soup from last night, added an egg, and quickly finished lunch. After eating, I took out the whole fishing gear bag for the afternoon, checked all the floats, fishhooks, and lead seats to make sure nothing was missing, then tidied the bag and placed it by the door.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon rest and conceptualizing a plan
description: With one hour left before departure, he lay on the living room sofa scrolling through his phone and browsing CNC technology forums. In his mind he began to formulate the compromise plan Master Sun had mentioned, drawing a sketch on his tablet to mark how to embed Liu Zhiqiang's code module into his own architecture and reserve sensor interfaces. He also replied to his mother with a WeChat voice message saying he was doing fine recently, telling her not to worry about sending clams.
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the wild pond in Xijinggang.
description: Left on time at 1 p.m., drove south along Kungang Road and turned onto Xijingang Road. The road conditions were good, and he arrived at Xijingang Wild Pond in about ten minutes.
location: From Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to the wild pond on the southwest side of the intersection of Xijinggang Road and Songzheng Highway in Songjiang District, via Kungang Highway and Xijinggang Road

name: Fishing at the wild pond in Xijinggang.
description: Arrived at the wild pond agreed upon with Brother Wu; he had already arrived and was leisurely smoking. They each set up their rods and started fishing. The bites were good, and Yin Hao caught a bream weighing over one jin. While fishing, Brother Wu complained that a water-damaged Mercedes had come to his auto repair shop, and he had been disassembling it so much that his back couldn't straighten. Yin Hao then mentioned how he had quarreled with his colleague Liu Zhiqiang two days ago and then made up. Brother Wu thought it was normal for colleagues to have disputes; as long as they can work together, it's fine. Time passed quickly in small talk.
location: Wild pond southwest of the intersection of Xijingang Road and Songzheng Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove home and processed the catch.
description: After saying goodbye to Brother Wu, I drove home. Once home, I took the few small crucian carp and bream I'd caught to the kitchen sink, skillfully scaled, gutted, and cleaned them, then marinated them with salt and cooking wine for dinner. After tidying the kitchen, I washed my hands and got ready to get down to business.
location: Kitchen, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Draw a sketch of the compromise plan.
description: He sat down at the computer in the study and opened AutoCAD. Using the framework he had conceived in the afternoon, he began drawing the redundant interface layout. He outlined Liu Zhiqiang's efficiency-boosting module with a dashed box, added sensor interfaces and corresponding signal lines on the main control board, and labeled dimensions and interface types. The base drawing was basically complete; he planned to go to the factory on Monday to add detailed notes.
location: Study, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing dinner and coordinating before playing games together.
description: He made dinner right away: steamed bream, stir-fried lettuce with minced garlic, and leftover rice — simple and healthy. While eating, the “Songjiang Three Brothers” WeChat group started buzzing; Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng were clamoring to game together. Yin Hao replied with a sticker saying “getting online now,” quickly finished his meal, and put the bowls in the sink to soak.
location: Kitchen, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Online gaming and socializing
description: Logged in on time and teamed up with Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng to play Honor of Kings. The three were average at the game but had fun, complaining about their day in game voice chat while playing: Lao Gao said the water-damaged Mercedes module in his shop gave him trouble all afternoon; Xiao Ma said the logistics station lost another package and he had to pay compensation; Yin Hao shared the relaxing moments of meeting new friends while cycling and going fishing. Each team won one game and lost one, but the relaxation from chatting outweighed the game results.
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Free time and home appliance repair.
description: After the game ended, I felt sticky all over, so I took a quick shower, then hung up the cycling clothes from this morning that were in the washing machine. I was in good spirits, so I took out the old radio I'd picked up at the flea market last week and tinkered with it. After checking the circuit board, I found that a capacitor might have aged. I plan to go to Jianguo Electrical Repair next week to borrow tools from Master Chen and give it a try.
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Study and relaxation
description: Turned on the TV and played a deep-sea submarine documentary as background sound, while scrolling through the National Open University assignment forum on my phone to find new ideas for the "light-controlled delay switch circuit". Then went back to the study to recheck the CAD drawings made in the afternoon to make sure there were no omissions.
location: Living room and study, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime ritual and falling asleep
description: Back in the bedroom, he set his phone to silent, turned off the main light, and left only a warm yellow nightlight on. He put on earphones and played the sound of rain as white noise, then lay in bed doing deep abdominal breathing to relax. Near 23:00, he took off the earphones, turned off the nightlight, savored the day's full yet calm experiences, and quickly fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The alarm went off at exactly 7:00. After getting up, he first sent a WeChat greeting to his father Yin Jianguo: 'Good morning, Dad! Happy Father's Day!' Then he washed up, weighed himself (74.2kg), and drank a glass of warm water. After changing into his work uniform, he confirmed again that the USB drive with the CAD drawings was ready.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute to the factory
description: At 7:40, Yin Hao set off from Xingang Community by car on time and drove to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. Along the way, he listened to traffic radio while silently going over the key points for today's coordination meeting in his mind.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Arrival at work and internal communication before the meeting
description: Arrived at the factory at 7:56. After adjusting his mindset at the workshop entrance, he met with Master Sun Jianguo and colleague Liu Zhiqiang in the workshop rest area at 8 o'clock. Master Sun proposed a compromise framework: use Liu Zhiqiang's high-efficiency solution for the core modules, retain his own stable architecture for the secondary stations, and add redundant interfaces. He showed the layout sketch of the redundant interfaces drawn in CAD, and the three discussed the details.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Relationship repair: contacting Liu Fang
description: While Liu Zhiqiang went to fetch the drawings, I contacted Liu Fang via WeChat to sincerely apologize for postponing the meeting due to last-minute overtime, and clearly promised to treat her to Japanese food next Saturday (June 18) evening and book a table in advance. Then I ordered on Meituan the tiramisu cake she had mentioned, chose morning delivery, and added the message: 'Sincere apologies, see you next week.'
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Tripartite coordination meeting.
description: At 9:20 the tripartite coordination meeting officially began. I first presented the CAD sketch and used data to demonstrate the necessity of redundant design for the secondary stations; Liu Zhiqiang then introduced an efficiency improvement plan with unique advantages for the core stations. Master Sun Jianguo controlled the pace, and after discussing item by item, a consensus was reached: use Liu Zhiqiang's plan for the core stations, and keep a stable architecture for the secondary stations with added redundant interfaces. The plan was preliminarily finalized, and the project entered the development stage.
location: Meeting Room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break, Father's Day interaction, and course registration
description: After the meeting, he first had a video call with his father Yin Jianguo in a corner of the conference room, wished him a happy Father's Day, and told him that he had bought a foot massager which was expected to arrive tomorrow. Then he went to the cafeteria for lunch (rice topped with celery and shredded pork) and chatted with Master Sun Jianguo about work schedules and course matters. After lunch, he used his phone to enroll in and pay 2,800 yuan for the Siemens PLC advanced programming online course (course period June 15 to August 15). Finally, in the open area of the factory, he confirmed that the massager order had been shipped and sent a screenshot to his father.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Work wrap-up: plan implementation and drawing revisions.
description: At 13:00 returned to the office, used the computer to sort out the consensus reached at the morning meeting, produced the first draft of the meeting minutes, and clarified key technical details and responsible persons. Then went to his workbench in the workshop, opened CAD software, and implemented the specific design of the redundant interfaces according to the meeting plan, making multiple annotations and corrections.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Collaboration and confirmation of drawing details.
description: Printed out the initially revised drawings and spent half an hour confirming specific integration points with Liu Zhiqiang, including sensor selection and interface waterproof rating. After adopting several of Liu Zhiqiang's suggestions, I revised the drawings on the spot, and by 16:30 the drawing revisions were basically complete.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Tidying up workspace and preparing to leave work
description: Filed the revised drawings, turned off the computer and the machine tool power, and cleaned the workbench and desk. After saying goodbye to Master Sun Jianguo and my colleague Wang Lei, I got ready to leave work.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the supermarket
description: I left work right at 5 PM and drove a detour to Lianhua Supermarket on Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District, planning to buy an insulated lunch box for bringing meals.
location: Lianhua Supermarket, 678 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Shopping for an insulated lunch box.
description: In the daily necessities section of the supermarket, he carefully compared several insulated lunch boxes and finally chose a 750 ml double-layer stainless steel insulated lunch box with good sealing and a separate compartment for chopsticks and a spoon, spending over 60 yuan.
location: Lianhua Supermarket, 678 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Driving home and cleaning.
description: At 18:00, checked out and left the supermarket, then drove back to Xingang Community. After arriving home at 18:23, he immediately washed the newly bought lunch box and set it out to dry.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Plan a healthy menu
description: After cleaning his lunch box, he sat at the dining table, opened the low-fat recipes in his phone memo, and planned the lunch menu for the next two weeks based on the ingredients at home and supermarket promotions. He stuck a sticky note with combinations like 'mixed grain rice + chicken breast + broccoli' on the refrigerator, took a photo, and shared it in the fitness group.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Simple dinner and rest.
description: Feeling hungry, he cooked a bowl of buckwheat noodles and a fried egg, accompanied by half a serving of vegetable dish packed from the cafeteria at noon. While eating, he scrolled through several short videos about CNC machining technology on his phone.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Knowledge Sharing: Publish Study Notes
description: In the study, he turned the screenshots of his previously organized study notes for Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming into a long image, added a title, and posted it to his WeChat Moments, mentioning his colleague Wang Lei. He then interacted with Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, Zhang Wei, and others who liked and commented.
location: Study, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Skill improvement: study planning and course start
description: After posting on Moments, he logged into the page for the Siemens PLC advanced programming online course he had signed up for, browsed the course outline, and watched the first video, forming an initial plan for subsequent study. At the same time, he organized his thoughts for the Open University of China major assignment and drew a draft of a simple circuit diagram for a light-controlled delay switch.
location: Study, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Leisure, relaxation, and family interaction.
description: Feeling tired after studying, leaned back on the sofa and played soft piano music on a music app. At the same time, sent a Father's Day red envelope in the family WeChat group. After Mother Li Xiuying claimed it, she sent a string of caring voice messages, and he smiled and replied to each one.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime relaxation ritual
description: At 10 p.m. sharp, he washed up, changed into pajamas, got into bed, and turned on the night light. He put on earphones and played white noise (the sound of waves hitting the beach), closed his eyes, and did abdominal deep breathing for 15 minutes, feeling his whole body relax.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: At 22:40, he gradually grew drowsy, took off his earphones, turned off the night light, quickly reviewed in his mind the ingredients for tomorrow's bento, and then fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and meal preparation
description: Woke up naturally at 05:40, weighed 74.2 kg, and felt calm. After washing up quickly, he took out the marinated chicken breast, washed broccoli, and multigrain rice from the fridge prepared last night as planned. He deftly pan-fried the chicken breast and blanched the broccoli, then packed them with the multigrain rice into a new double-layer insulated lunch box. He then changed into a quick-dry T-shirt and running shoes, checked the sports watch was fully charged, and took his water bottle and towel. He sent Wang Lei a WeChat message: 'Up yet? Same place, 5:50 pace, let's go.' Thinking about the project proposal being finalized last night, he was in good spirits today.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (home)

name: Morning run and post-run stretching.
description: Jogged about 7 minutes to Xiaokunshan Health Park and met up with Wang Lei, who had already finished warming up. After some stretching, the two started a 5 km tempo run along the park's riverside trail. Yin Hao deliberately kept the pace at 5 min 50 sec per kilometer, coaching Wang Lei on breathing rhythm while running ("three steps inhale, two steps exhale"), and they finished in 29 min 15 sec. After the run, they used the newly purchased foam roller on the park lawn for deep relaxation of thighs and calves, and Yin Hao taught Wang Lei the correct usage and key points of knee icing after running. The two chatted about weekend plans; Wang Lei said he would go back to his hometown on Saturday, and they agreed to train together again next week.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Shower, breakfast, and heading out
description: After jogging home, he quickly showered, changed into clean work pants and a polo shirt, and put the insulated lunch box with lunch, phone, work badge, keys, and e-bike keys into his backpack. His breakfast was simple but nutritious: two slices of whole wheat bread, a cup of skim milk, and a banana. While eating, he quickly browsed industry news, saw a push alert about industrial automation, and saved it. At 07:35, he shouldered his backpack and left.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (home)

name: Cycling commute to the factory
description: He got on the electric bike parked in the community bike shed, rode south along Xingang Road, then turned onto Huatianjing Highway. There was not much traffic, and after about 15 minutes he arrived smoothly at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory.
location: From Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning work: morning meeting, R&D coding, and project coordination
description: At 07:50 I changed into work clothes and reported to my post, first checking the condition of the machine tools I was responsible for. At 08:00 I attended the workshop morning meeting on time. Shift leader Wang Lei assigned the day's tasks: focus on ensuring precision flange production and cooperating with the digitalization project commissioning; Master Sun Jianguo was present. After the meeting, I exchanged a brief nod with programmer Liu Zhiqiang and agreed to verify the interface parameters at 10:00. Back at my workstation in the digital project area, I turned on the computer and opened the CAD drawings, then began writing the code framework for the peripheral redundancy design. My thoughts were clear, and I went to the break room a bit early to get water. At 10:00 Liu Zhiqiang arrived on time with his laptop. The two of us checked the redundant interface item by item, including the communication protocol, data frame format, trigger conditions, and so on. The communication was professional and efficient; although we each occasionally held firm, we were always able to reach agreement through compromise. Yin Hao noted down the three key parameters that needed adjustment, and they agreed to sync the revised code in the afternoon.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (workshop and workstation)

name: Midday wrap-up and lunch break.
description: Returned to my workstation to handle routine machine tool inspection, and turned the morning's communication notes into a document and sent it to the project group. At 11:50, went to the break room early and used the microwave to heat up my homemade fat-loss lunch: mixed grain rice, pan-seared chicken breast, and stir-fried broccoli. At 12:00, started eating while watching the first lesson of the offline-downloaded Siemens PLC Advanced Programming Course on my phone; politely declined the braised food Wang Lei shared. After eating, leaned back in the chair and rested with eyes closed for 15 minutes. Then, while the sky was overcast and before rain fell, took a slow lap around the workshop corridor to loosen up, and sent Lin Yue a WeChat message asking how her busy work was going.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (rest room and corridor)

name: Afternoon R&D and routine machining
description: In the afternoon, with focused concentration, he continued writing core code for the stable architecture at his workstation. During the process, he encountered an issue where trigger signals were delayed during high-speed operation. After checking the project documentation and Principles of Automatic Control, he preliminarily judged it to be a scan cycle conflict, with no solution for now. He recorded the problem in detail in the development log. At 16:00, a light rain began outside. Team leader Wang Lei notified him that some regular flanges needed urgent work, so he switched back to operator mode, started the machine, and processed parts strictly according to the drawings. At 17:00, he completed the last batch of workpieces, saved the code and problem records, cleaned the machine and workstation, changed into casual clothes, and got ready to leave.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (workstation and workshop).

name: Commute after work and supermarket shopping
description: Put on a raincoat, rode an electric bike out of the factory, and on the way stopped by Xingang Xincun fresh food supermarket to buy whole-wheat bread, lettuce, eggs, asparagus, and button mushrooms, then returned to his home in Xingang Community.
location: From No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, via Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket at Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road

name: Cooking a nutritious dinner
description: After returning home, he changed out of his rain-soaked clothes and started preparing dinner: steamed the fresh sea bass bought yesterday, made blanched vegetables with asparagus and button mushrooms, and heated up the extra multigrain rice cooked in the morning. The meal was on the table at 18:00.
location: Home kitchen, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and Relaxation
description: While eating dinner, watched an episode of the food documentary "Once Upon a Bite." After the meal, cleared the table, washed the bowls, and scrubbed the pots. Paced around the living room for a few minutes to aid digestion, and used his phone to confirm that the delivery of the foot massager for Father's Day showed as signed for.
location: Xingang Community, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (home dining room)

name: Pre-class review and National Open University live course
description: First, I reorganized the homework for the course 'Electrical Control and PLC Technology' — the design idea for a light-controlled delay switch, drew the functional block diagram, and set aside the notes on flip-flop signal delay issues related to the course. At 19:30, I logged into the National Open University online platform on time and attended the live course 'Fundamentals of Mechatronics System Design'. The teacher mainly explained the application of flip-flops in digital circuit fundamentals, which faintly echoed the work problem I encountered in the afternoon. I listened attentively and asked a question about signal holding in the chat box, received the teacher's answer, and gained a deeper understanding of the issue.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (home study)

name: Note sorting and family video call
description: After class, he spent 15 minutes organizing his class notes, connecting the newly learned knowledge points with the afternoon's work problems, and felt much clearer. At 21:15 he made a video call to his parents to ask whether the foot massager he had bought for Father's Day had arrived. His mother laughed and answered first, saying his father really liked it. The father and son then exchanged a few words about technical issues at work, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (home)

name: Wash up before bed and relax to fall asleep
description: After hanging up, he took a shower, changed into pajamas, and lay down on the bed. He checked the message from Liu Zhiqiang in the project group asking about tomorrow's meeting time and replied to confirm, then set his phone to Do Not Disturb and placed it on the nightstand. At 22:00 he turned off his phone, dimmed the lights, played soft music, and lay flat for 15 minutes of abdominal deep-breathing relaxation exercises. Although he could still feel work pressure and sleep anxiety, he persisted until the end. After finishing, he turned off the music and closed his eyes. His thoughts occasionally drifted to the signal delay issue and course content from the day, but he no longer felt anxious, and gradually fell asleep before about 23:00 to the sound of the rain outside the window gradually subsiding.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (home bedroom)

name: Early morning wake-up, morning run, and breakfast preparation
description: The alarm clock rang, light rain was pattering outside, and the scale showed 74.0 kg. He put on a waterproof windbreaker and shorts. After drinking warm water in the kitchen, he felt tightness in his lower back and decided to jog only 3 km while paying extra attention to stretching. Holding an umbrella, he warmed up at the entrance of Xingang Community, then jogged west along Xingang Road, keeping the pace at 6:40 per kilometer, and turned back at the intersection with Kungang Road, covering the full 3 km in 20 minutes. Back home, he took a hot shower, changed into work clothes, and packed multigrain rice, chicken breast, and broccoli into an insulated lunch box for lunch. For breakfast, he had milk oatmeal, boiled eggs, and blueberries. While eating, he opened the OUC app and browsed the courseware for "Assembly Drawing," noting the key points of section view labeling and view selection.
location: Room 602, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the area along Xingang Road

name: Driving Commute and Work Check-In
description: Backpack with notebook and insulated lunch box, holding an umbrella, he walked to the parking lot. He started the gray Wuling Hongguang, turned on the traffic radio, and drove along Huatianjing Road. The road was slippery; the 6 km trip took 15 minutes. Arriving at the factory early, he changed into work clothes and first inspected the workshop, focusing on the CNC machine tool guide rails, coolant level, and last night's maintenance records. After confirming everything was normal, he reviewed the day's flange workpiece drawings, which required a tolerance of 0.05 mm.
location: From Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Attended the workshop morning meeting
description: Team leader Wang Lei emphasized this week's production task of preparing materials for next month's large order, and reminded everyone to watch out for slippery roads in the rain. Master Sun Jianguo specifically pointed out that the new employee Xiao Zhang's operation was not standard enough and asked the team to pay more attention. Programmer Liu Zhiqiang mentioned that the digital project code was about to undergo joint debugging and hoped the workshop would cooperate with testing. Yin Hao silently noted the key information.
location: Workshop meeting room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning: project code optimization and log cleanup.
description: Focused on handling the digital project code. For the trigger signal delay issue, consulted the Siemens PLC technical manual and adjusted the filter parameters. Around 11 a.m., sent the modified code to Liu Zhiqiang via the internal chat software, explaining that the expected delay could be reduced to within 2 ms, and asked him to perform joint debugging and verification. Afterwards, spent half an hour updating the development log in detail, recording the reasons and effects of the changes. During this time, because his back was stiff from sitting too long, he stood up twice to get water and stretch his waist.
location: Workstation at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-lunch activities and studying while eating lunch in the cafeteria
description: After finishing the morning's work and cleaning up his desk, he saw a voice message from his mother in the family group chat and learned that his father was very satisfied with the massager with hot compress function; he replied with a thumbs-up emoji. He took his insulated lunch box to the cafeteria, heated up the chicken breast, multigrain rice, and broccoli he had brought, and while eating used his phone to review PLC course notes, focusing on the application of flip-flops in digital circuits. He ran into Master Sun Jianguo and sat over to chat with him about needing to reduce the feed speed for the hard material to be machined tomorrow.
location: Workstation and canteen, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Noon break and social gaming
description: Back in the rest area, team leader Wang Lei called for a ranked match, and they teamed up with three other co-workers. Although they lost due to coordination mistakes, Yin Hao took MVP of the game using the jungler character "Lan," and he was in a good mood. Wang Lei joked that they would definitely win next time.
location: Rest area of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon discussion on drawing standards and follow-up organization.
description: Prepared drawings, materials, and notes in advance, and brewed Tieguanyin tea. Held a two-hour discussion with Sun Jianguo and Liu Zhiqiang in the small meeting room, focusing on the interface specification between mechanical drawings and digital models. Yin Hao raised the issue of seamless correspondence between dimensioning and geometric tolerances in CATIA and CAD, and Liu Zhiqiang answered from the software perspective. Halfway through the meeting, due to soreness in his waist and back, he stood up and did chest expansion exercises by the window. After the meeting, he further confirmed key parameters such as the naming of tolerance-transfer fields with Liu Zhiqiang, recorded them in the project notes, and decided to do joint debugging tomorrow.
location: Small Meeting Room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Machine tool maintenance, work inspection, and driving home before leaving work
description: Before finishing work, I used the spare time to tidy up the machine workstation, checked the guide rails and coolant according to the procedures, and replaced the worn cutting tools. I looked at tomorrow's production task list on the computer, confirmed that the feed rate had been lowered, and wrote a brief plan in the work log. After changing out of my work clothes and packing my backpack, I saw that my fishing buddy Brother Wu had sent an invitation to go fishing at Dianshan Lake on the weekend, and I replied 'No problem.' On the drive home, I had a Bluetooth call with my older brother Yin Tao. He said there might be a new project with a new energy vehicle company in Suzhou at the end of the month, and invited me to have a video chat over the weekend to discuss it in detail.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and drive to Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Prepare and enjoy a fat-loss dinner
description: After getting home, he took the sea bass and lettuce out of the fridge, skillfully scaled the fish and removed the innards, washed the vegetables, steamed the sea bass with garlic lettuce, and cooked a small bowl of brown rice. While eating, he used his phone to reply to his mother's message in the family group chat. He sent a photo of dinner and got a thumbs-up response. He also confirmed with his fishing buddy Brother Wu to meet at the old fishing spot at Dianshan Lake at 6 a.m. on Saturday.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 602, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: After-meal cleanup and pre-class rest and entertainment
description: After clearing the dishes and wiping down the stove, he went into the study, opened his laptop, and logged into the Open University of China live-streaming platform. He tested his earphones and webcam and found that the lecture notes had a newly added case analysis, so he prepared his notebook and pen. There was still time before class, so he lay in the living room browsing Hupu fishing gear posts. He closed his eyes and rested for 10 minutes to relax his lower back. In the “Songjiang Three Brothers” group chat, Gao Zhiyuan sent a photo of tools, Ma Xiaofeng complained about the logistics backup, and he replied with a “Come on” emoji.
location: Study and living room, Room 602, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Attended the live online course "Assembly Drawing" at the National Open University.
description: Teacher Liu Jianjun systematically taught the drawing methods for assembly drawings, including view selection, section view labeling, dimensioning, and technical requirements. Yin Hao focused on taking notes throughout the class. During breaks, he looked out the window to stretch his sore neck and waist, and asked a question on the public screen: "the rules for arranging part numbers in assembly drawings," receiving an immediate answer.
location: Study room, Room 602, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (online course)

name: After-class relaxation, review, and washing up
description: After the class, he laid out a yoga mat in the living room and used a foam roller to massage the lower back and hips, while chatting in the "Songjiang Three Brothers" group and learning that Gao Zhiyuan was working overtime and Ma Xiaofeng was at home taking care of the kids. Then he returned to the study to review twenty minutes of the class recording, focusing on absorbing the annotation technique explanations and writing additional notes. Then he went to the bathroom to wash up, brushed his teeth, washed his face, and changed into pajamas.
location: Living room, study, and bathroom, Room 602, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime relaxation ritual and going to sleep
description: Turned off the main light and kept only the bedside lamp on, lay in bed doing diaphragmatic breathing. Thoughts calmed, and the soreness in the lower back eased. Quickly reviewed today's key work and study points: clear direction for fixing the code delay, consensus on drawing specifications, and fruitful lessons from the course; felt satisfied with efficiency. After confirming tomorrow's adjustments to feed speed and integration testing priorities, turned off the light and fell asleep quickly. Dreamed of catching a big black carp in Dianshan Lake, with Wu Ge giving a thumbs up beside me.
location: Bedroom, Room 602, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Early morning fat-loss lunch preparation and getting ready to go out
description: Woken up by the sound of rain, two minutes earlier than the alarm, turned off the 5:42 alarm. After washing up, made a fat-reducing lunch in the kitchen: patted dry the skinless chicken thighs that had been thawed overnight with paper towels, seasoned with black pepper and sea salt and marinated for 10 minutes; meanwhile put the soaked mixed grains (black rice, brown rice, millet) into the rice cooker to steam. Sprayed olive oil in a frying pan, pan-fried the chicken thighs over medium-low heat until golden and cooked through on both sides, then removed and cut into pieces. In another pot, blanched spinach, then quickly stir-fried it with minced garlic and light soy sauce. Layered the mixed grain rice, pan-fried chicken thighs, and garlic spinach into a 750ml stainless steel insulated lunch box, then washed an apple and a small cup of sugar-free yogurt as a mid-morning snack. Made oatmeal with hot milk for myself, paired with a boiled egg, and ate breakfast by the window. After that, checked the weather, confirmed the rain would stop in the evening, packed the running gear (quick-dry T-shirt, shorts, running shoes) separately in a bag, checked phone, wallet, and keys, put on a water-repellent jacket, grabbed a folding umbrella, and got ready to go out.
location: Room 302, Building 17, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the company.
description: Left on time at 07:00, walked with an umbrella to the community parking lot. Considering the rainy day and carrying running gear, he decided to drive to work. He drove along Xingang Road–Huatianjing Road. Road conditions were moderate in the rain, and he arrived at the company parking lot at 7:20.
location: Along the route from Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory.

name: Arrival morning meeting and production preparation
description: Arrived at the post at 07:20, changed into work clothes and safety shoes, and first went to the workshop and control room for a detailed handover with the night shift colleagues to learn about last night's equipment operation and processing progress. Then checked the coolant level and lubrication system status at the CNC machine tool in charge, and verified the program parameters for the day's workpieces. At 08:00 attended the team morning meeting; team leader Wang Lei reported today's production tasks, emphasizing that the sheet material is hard, so attention must be paid to tool wear and feed rate. Master Sun Jianguo privately reminded him to reconfirm the interface parameters with programmer Liu Zhiqiang before the joint commissioning. After the meeting, Yin Hao had a brief meeting with Liu Zhiqiang to confirm the 9 o'clock joint commissioning process, then returned to his workstation to preheat the machine tool.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Core project code integration testing and work-break flash sale
description: At 09:00, as planned, he carried out interface joint debugging between the core module and the stability module of the digitalization project with Liu Zhiqiang on the workshop test platform. Initially, there was a data delay issue. Yin Hao investigated and found that the buffer size configured in his stability module did not match the data packet sending frequency of Liu Zhiqiang's core module. After adjusting the parameters, data transmission returned to normal, and multiple function points were subsequently debugged smoothly. During the joint debugging, because of lower back discomfort, Yin Hao frequently changed his standing posture or supported his waist with both hands. Around 10:00, during a program run interval, he quickly used his phone to complete the last batch of 618 Shopping Festival purchases: two sets of quick-drying sports clothes (one long-sleeved and one short-sleeved), a box of electrolyte effervescent tablets, and added a medical-grade lumbar support to the cart. The joint debugging lasted until 11:30.
location: Workshop test platform of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch during the midday break and lower back relaxation.
description: After the integration testing ended, Yin Hao returned to his workstation to sort out the test logs, then took his insulated lunch box to the break room and microwaved the fat-loss lunch he had brought. While waiting, he washed his face and stretched his stiff neck and shoulders. At 12:00, he had lunch with Master Sun Jianguo. The pan-fried chicken thigh and garlic spinach in his lunch box were praised. As they ate, they talked about the morning's integration testing issues and hands-on experience working with hard materials. After lunch, instead of sitting down as usual, Yin Hao paced alone in the workshop corridor for 10 minutes, frequently pressing his hands against his lower back to relieve stiffness.
location: Break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Online course study during lunch break.
description: After coming back from a walk, he leaned back in a chair and rested with his eyes closed for 20 minutes. When he woke up, he logged into the Siemens PLC advanced programming online course platform on his phone and watched the first teaching video of the course he had previously enrolled in — an overview of the Siemens S7-1200 communication protocol. While watching, he noted several key terms in the memo app on his phone.
location: Break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Safety operation training
description: At 13:50, he left the break room early, took his pen and notebook, and headed to the company's third-floor training room. At 14:00, the factory-wide safety operation training began, with the safety supervisor lecturing on the latest machinery operating procedures and workplace injury first aid knowledge. Yin Hao listened carefully and took notes. In the first aid section, he paid special attention to the emergency treatment steps for waist and back sprains, and mentally compared them with the methods Wang Lei had recommended earlier. After the training, he also asked the supervisor to copy the PPT, planning to review it when he got back and prepare for a possible safety competition.
location: Training Room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return to regular work and ease the lower back.
description: After the training ended, returned to the workshop workstation; the soreness in my lower back was more noticeable than during the lunch break. Yin Hao took an unopened 500ml mineral water bottle and placed it between the chair back and his lower back to press against the sore spot, which brought slight relief. In the afternoon, he mainly handled routine drawing checks and maintenance log updates. Taking advantage of the relatively relaxed time, he also recorded his insights from the morning's joint debugging into the project development log.
location: Workshop work station at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Change clothes after work and head to the running spot.
description: Finished the last task, carefully wiped down the machine tool control panel, and tidied up the workstation. At 16:30 he went to the locker room and changed into the running gear he had brought (quick-dry short-sleeve shirt, shorts, and running shoes), and put his work clothes and work shoes into his bag. Walking out of the workshop, the rain had completely stopped and the air was fresh. He met his running buddy Wang Lei at the company gate, and the two drove to the Songjiang University Town Sports Center. On the way, Yin Hao asked Wang Lei for stretching and relaxation tips for lumbar muscle strain, and Wang Lei taught him a few simple standing stretches while driving.
location: On the way from Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory to Songjiang University Town Sports Center (No. 2000, Wenxiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai)

name: Evening interval running training
description: At 17:25 he arrived at the sports field of Songjiang University Town Sports Center, did some simple joint movements and a light jog for a 5-minute warm-up. Then he started the 5-kilometer variable-pace run plan: alternating 6 sets of 400-meter fast runs (pace about 4 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer) with 400-meter slow jogs (pace about 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer). His lower back felt a clear burden during the fast segments, but Yin Hao gritted his teeth and completed the whole plan. After the run, the two walked a lap to cool down. Wang Lei carefully pressed his quadratus lumborum and erector spinae muscles, pointed out that his running form was slightly leaning forward, and suggested doing “Child's Pose” and “Cat-Cow Pose” stretches every night to relax his back. The training ended at 18:30.
location: Sports ground at Songjiang University Town Sports Center, 2000 Wenxiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Return home to rest and then head to Pudong.
description: After training, Yin Hao immediately drove home. As soon as he got home, he took a hot shower to wash off the sweat. Knowing he had to go to Pudong in the evening, he mixed a scoop of protein powder and quickly replenished his energy with two slices of whole wheat bread. Then he took a small screwdriver set, a pry bar, and a newly bought phone battery from the toolbox and put them into a portable tool bag. He left the house on time at 19:00, walked to Songjiang University Town Station on Metro Line 9, took Line 9 (toward Caolu) to Century Avenue Station, transferred within the station to Line 2 (toward Pudong International Airport), and rode to Jinke Road Station. The whole trip took about 40 minutes. Around 19:50 he exited from Exit 3 of Jinke Road Station and prepared to walk to Liu Fang’s residence.
location: From home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, via Metro Line 9 and Line 2 to Jinke Road Station, Pudong New Area

name: Repaired a swollen-battery phone for Liu Fang and chatted with her
description: He arrived at Liu Fang's residence in a Zhangjiang residential community before 20:00. Liu Fang took out a phone with a swollen battery and a glass of water to receive him. Without much small talk, Yin Hao put on finger cots and skillfully disassembled the phone. He used a spudger to carefully separate the back cover and cables, removed the old battery that was clearly deformed, and replaced it with a new battery of the same model he had brought. The whole process went smoothly. After powering on, he tested charging, fingerprint, camera, and other functions, and all were normal. The two chatted about recent news. When Liu Fang learned that he had a bad back, she took a half-used box of 'Salonpas' heat patches out of a drawer and recommended them to him. After chatting for nearly half an hour, Yin Hao politely declined the offer to stay for dinner and took his leave. He left Liu Fang's home at 21:25 and walked back along the same route to Jinke Road Metro Station.
location: Liu Fang's residence in a residential complex in Zhangjiang Hi-Tech Park, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return trip, buying heat patches, and evening relaxation before sleep
description: At 21:25, he entered Jinke Road Station, took Metro Line 2 back, transferred to Line 9 at Century Avenue Station, and rode to Songjiang University Town Station. After exiting the station, he took a detour to a 24-hour pharmacy near home and bought a box of heat patches of the same kind recommended by Liu Fang. Then he walked home and arrived around 22:10. He changed into loose pajamas, took out the foam roller, laid out a yoga mat, and, following the method Wang Lei taught, did deep pressing and relaxation on the lower back, buttocks (piriformis), and hamstrings, rolling each area for about 2 minutes. Then he tore open a heat patch and applied it to the sorest spot on the left side of his lower back, and the warmth slowly seeped in. At 22:40, he performed his bedtime ritual: standing by the window with his eyes closed, he did 10 deep abdominal breaths. After that, he quickly washed up and put the clothes he had changed out of into the washing machine, setting the timer. At 22:55, he set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, lay down in bed, and quickly reviewed the day's experiences: successful joint debugging, snapping up equipment, serious training, variable-speed running, and helping Liu Fang. He felt fulfilled and that everything had gone smoothly. Sleepiness came around 23:10, and about 20 minutes later he fell into a deep sleep.
location: Took the metro from Jinke Road Station in Pudong to Songjiang University Town Station, then via a nearby pharmacy returned to home at Room 302, Building 17, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Getting up and indoor stretching
description: The alarm went off on time. Looking out the window, the sky was overcast and a fine drizzle was falling. Because of the poor weather during the rainy season, I gave up the morning run and laid out a yoga mat in the living room for indoor stretching. First I completed 10 minutes of full-body dynamic stretching, then 15 minutes of specific lower-back warm-up exercises, including cat-cow, child's pose, glute bridge, and superman, to activate the lower back muscles. Finally I put on the newly purchased medical-grade lumbar support, felt my waist supported, and the soreness was somewhat relieved.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, bedroom and living room

name: Breakfast and preparation
description: While preparing breakfast with the toaster in the kitchen, he packed the fat-loss lunch prepared last night (mixed grain rice, pan-seared chicken breast, and stir-fried spinach) into a bag. Breakfast was toast, two boiled eggs, and a cup of warm milk, which he ate quickly. He checked his laptop bag to confirm it contained the USB drive and soft keyboard pad for the afternoon presentation, and that his phone was fully charged.
location: Songjiang District, Shanghai, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xingang Residential Community, kitchen

name: Commuting to work
description: Walked with an umbrella to the underground garage, drove the white Volkswagen Lavida along Waiqingsong Road, turned onto Huatianjing Road, and headed to the company. The rain was light, traffic was orderly, and he arrived in about 20 minutes. En route, he connected via Bluetooth and listened to the morning news.
location: Drove from Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-work preparation and meeting up with colleagues.
description: Changed into work clothes, dropped my backpack at the workstation, and laid out the new soft keyboard pad I had bought. Then I went to the parts staging area of the workshop and found my colleague Liu Zhiqiang, who was checking equipment. Liu Zhiqiang handed over the transmission shaft sample adjusted yesterday. I checked the chamfer and surface finish, confirmed it met the drawing requirements, and added physical evidence for the afternoon report.
location: Production workshop office area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning: organizing report materials
description: Back at the workstation, I turned on the computer and organized the PLC control redundancy design logic into clear key points based on last night's thinking. Combined with this week's code commit records and test data, I sorted out the report PPT and detailed data support tables for the afternoon regular meeting. Filed the documents at hand according to regulations. During the process, using the lumbar support's sitting posture reminder function, I stood up and moved around twice to relieve the pressure of prolonged sitting.
location: Workstation at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and socializing
description: He took out his own fat-loss lunch from the insulated bag and sat down in a corner of the company cafeteria. While eating, he used his phone to reply to a WeChat message from his mother: "During the plum rain season, be careful about dampness and drink more hot water." His colleague Liu Zhiqiang came over with a tray, and the two briefly went over the process for the afternoon report and wished each other good luck.
location: No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, company canteen

name: Lunch break and pre-meeting rehearsal
description: After the meal, walked along the corridor outside the workshop for 5 minutes to aid digestion. Returning to the workstation, put on earphones and closed his eyes for a rest. After waking up, grabbed a notebook and USB drive and went to the empty small meeting room downstairs, softly rehearsing the entire afternoon presentation process facing the empty chairs, especially the redundant design part that might be asked about, and ran through it completely until the logic was clear and the rhythm was smooth.
location: Workstation and small meeting room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-meeting confirmation and encouragement
description: Back at his workstation, he did a final check of the PLC control flow chart. Just then Master Sun Jianguo passed by and took the initiative to stop him, quickly confirming the interpretation of a key data point in the afternoon presentation. Sun Jianguo nodded in approval, patted him on the shoulder, and said, "You've prepared thoroughly. Just speak freely this afternoon." These words greatly boosted his confidence.
location: Workstation at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: At 9:00 a.m., he returned home. He and his mother spread the water-soaked books and magazines out to dry. Yin Hao contacted the repairman recommended by the community and made an appointment for him to come tomorrow to check the leaking pipes and damaged electrical circuits.
description: The weekly meeting started right on time. When it was his turn to report, he stood in front of the projection screen, first presented the overall project progress, then focused on the stability architecture module he was responsible for. Using photos of the actual equipment and test data charts, he clearly explained the PLC control logic optimization and performance test results. Facing Sun Jianguo's question about the “reliability of the dual-PLC interlock logic,” he answered calmly with well-prepared comparison diagrams and logic derivation diagrams. After the meeting, Sun Jianguo was the first to praise him: “Solid data, clear logic, well done!”
location: Company meeting room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organizing meeting minutes and updating plans
description: While the meeting content was still fresh, I immediately opened the document and organized the recorded interface debugging tasks and next week's key work (such as the joint debugging test milestones with Liu Zhiqiang's module) into meeting minutes, and updated the shared progress sheet. Sun Jianguo passed by again and asked with concern about my lower back, and emphasized the importance of persisting with the superman exercise.
location: Workstation at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Handling daily work and wrapping up
description: Sent the meeting minutes email to relevant personnel. Went to the workshop to inspect the afternoon machine tool operation logs, and returned today's used tools and fixtures to their places according to regulations. Back at the workstation, briefly planned tomorrow's work schedule and submitted a purchase requisition in the system for a standard part needed next week.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai — workshop and workstation.

name: After-work commute
description: Cleaned up the desk, took the insulated lunch box and laptop bag, and walked with an umbrella to the garage to get the car. Played soft, relaxing music on the way back to slowly ease the tense nerves.
location: Driving from Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Dinner and relaxation
description: After getting home, he changed out of his work clothes and put on loose athletic wear. He took the leftover chicken breast from lunch out of the fridge, stir-fried some greens, microwaved the multigrain rice, and quickly got dinner done. Meanwhile, he browsed the running group on his phone app; the group was quiet because of the weather, so he enjoyed some solitary relaxation.
location: Kitchen and living room, Xingang Community, 224 Lane Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening lower back strengthening workout
description: In the living room, I spread out the yoga mat and did lower back strengthening training. First, 5 minutes of full-body warm-up, then 20 minutes of core training: 4 sets of plank (45 seconds each), 3 sets of Russian twists (15 reps per side), and 3 sets of dead bugs (12 reps per side). Then 15 minutes of targeted lower back training: 3 sets of superman stretches (15 seconds each) and 4 sets of bridges (12 reps each). After training, I did 5 minutes of stretching and abdominal breathing. My lower back felt thoroughly activated, comfortably warm, and the soreness was mostly gone.
location: Living room, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Take a relaxing shower
description: He worked up a sweat during training, took a warm shower, and changed into dry loungewear. He felt completely refreshed, and the fatigue from the past few days had largely dissipated.
location: Bathroom, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: PLC course study.
description: Moved the laptop to the coffee table, brewed a cup of hot tea, opened the purchased PLC online course, and studied Chapter 2, Basics of Ladder Diagram Programming. While listening to the instructor's explanation, I opened virtual simulation software on the computer and practiced basic logic gate circuits (such as self-locking and interlocking). When I came across the difficult "set/reset" instructions, I paused the video, opened the textbook for comparison, and drew logic diagrams to deepen my understanding. Afterward, I independently completed the after-class exercises and used the simulation software to debug a simple motor start-stop control program. After debugging twice, it ran successfully, and I felt a sense of accomplishment.
location: Living room/desk, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Keeping accounts and contacting family
description: After finishing the study session, I opened the expense-tracking app on my phone and quickly recorded a few small expenses for today (no large expenditures, no change in financial status). Then I texted my mother on WeChat to let her know I was safe and shared the good news that today's work report went smoothly.
location: Desk, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime routine and falling asleep
description: Turned off the main light and turned on the night light. First applied a hot towel to the lower back for 5 minutes, then lay back in bed and did abdominal breathing relaxation. In his mind, he savored the success of the afternoon report and the comfort after the evening training. His body gradually relaxed and he felt clearly drowsy. Accompanied by soft music, he quickly fell asleep, fully asleep before 22:30.
location: Bedroom, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: After the alarm went off, I got up. First I glanced out the window; the ground was slightly wet and the rain was fading. The weather forecast said the rain would stop around 6. After washing up briefly, I changed into a quick-dry short-sleeved sports top and shorts, and drank a glass of warm water. My back felt fine (only slight soreness), I did not wear the lumbar brace, and I spent an extra 5 minutes on dynamic stretching, focusing on the lower back and knee joints.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Early morning 5 km run training
description: Seeing that the rain had mostly stopped, he decided to drive to the track at Songjiang University Town to meet Wang Lei, about a five-minute drive. After meeting by the bleachers, the two did a full 10-minute warm-up, including dynamic stretches and two sets of 30-meter acceleration runs. Then they started the 5K test. Yin Hao ran at his own steady pace, while Wang Lei went all-out and recorded a good time of 27 minutes 18 seconds. After the test, Yin Hao led Wang Lei through static stretching, focusing on loosening the hamstrings and hip muscles.
location: Sports field, Shanghai International Studies University (Songjiang Campus), No. 1550 Wenxiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Return home, bathe, and have breakfast
description: After saying goodbye to Wang Lei, he drove home. On the way, he sent his mother a WeChat voice message, briefly reporting the good news that his lower back was getting better, and mentioned that he would be participating in the company skills competition today. After getting home, he took a quick shower and changed into clean work clothes. For breakfast, he reheated two whole-wheat buns and drank a glass of hot milk to replenish energy after the run.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to work
description: He drove his own car to the company. On the way, he listened to an audio course on PLC ladder diagram programming in the car to warm up for the upcoming study. The route was Xingang Road, then Shenzhuan Road, then turning onto Huatianjing Road, about 20 minutes in total.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Arrival preparation and safety knowledge competition
description: After arriving at the factory, he first clocked in at his workstation and checked today's machining task list. Then, using the time before the competition, he quickly reviewed the error-prone and weak areas in the safety knowledge competition question bank, and briefly discussed a few questions with Master Sun Jianguo from his team, coordinating the team's answering strategy. The factory-wide safety knowledge competition started on time. Yin Hao's team worked well together, especially in the fast-answer round, where they performed excellently. Thanks to their familiarity with actual workshop safety regulations and memory of the question bank, they answered many difficult questions in a row. Yin Hao won second prize (200 yuan bonus), and his team also won the group award (300 yuan bonus). Master Sun praised him highly.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Automatic fund investment and adding friends from the cycling group.
description: During the break after returning to his workstation following the competition, Yin Hao took out his phone, opened the bank app, and saw that his salary had arrived. He subscribed for the first time to a bond fund with medium-low risk for 2,000 yuan, and set up a plan to automatically invest 500 yuan on the 20th of each month, completing the first step of saving and investing. Afterwards, he found the WeChat contact card of Brother Li, whom he had met during the cycling event on June 14, recommended and added him to his "Songjiang Cycling Exchange Group," and sent a simple welcome and introduction message.
location: Machining team workstation, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunchtime fat-loss meal and rest
description: Go to the company break room, heat up the weight-loss lunch you brought in the microwave: multigrain rice balls (with crushed seaweed and sesame), boiled shrimp, and cold okra salad. During the meal, I felt my energy had recovered well and there was no obvious soreness in my lower back, so I decided not to wear the lumbar support in the afternoon and put it into my work bag.
location: Employee rest area of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work, study, and social matters.
description: After returning to his workstation in the afternoon, he handled two routine CNC machine tool part machining jobs and finished up the production tasks. During spare time, he opened the PLC simulation software on his phone and practiced several ladder diagram programming examples learned in last night's online course to consolidate the knowledge points. Then, in his work log book, he recorded in detail the results of the morning safety knowledge competition, key answering insights, and team cooperation experience, planning to summarize the experience into a written piece and save it as a learning outcome. During a break, he searched on the Meituan app and booked a deluxe medium private room at Haoledi KTV in Songjiang urban area for the next evening from 19:30 to 23:30. After confirming the reservation, he notified Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng in the "Songjiang Three Brothers" WeChat group and arranged a specific meeting time. He continued the afternoon work, during which he discussed tool-path optimization for one of the parts with programmer Liu Zhiqiang. Before leaving work, he typed up the competition insights completed today on his office computer and saved them to his personal work folder as a backup.
location: Machining team workstation, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting off work and preparing to head to the dinner gathering.
description: Left work on time and drove home. After arriving home, he changed out of his work clothes into a clean dark long-sleeved T-shirt and casual trousers, ready to go out for a meal. Following the address recommended by Gao Zhiyuan, he drove to the newly opened 'One Pot Clear Broth Hotpot Restaurant' on Renmin North Road in Songjiang, and notified Old Gao and Xiao Ma in advance that he had set off, agreeing to meet directly at the restaurant.
location: Yiguo Qingtang Hot Pot Restaurant, Renmin North Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Hotpot dinner with friends and KTV plan finalized
description: Met Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng at a hot pot restaurant. Yin Hao ordered a clear broth pot, a large vegetable platter, and a small amount of soybean products to stay on track with his fat-loss plan. The three chatted while cooking, touching on Yin Hao's competition award today, Wang Lei's progress in running, and Ma Xiaofeng's recent project updates. Yin Hao also shared some amusing stories from his lower back rehabilitation training. At the table, they finally settled on the meeting time and place for tomorrow evening's KTV.
location: Yiguo Qingtang Hot Pot Restaurant, Renmin North Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home after the gathering
description: After the dinner gathering, he said goodbye to his friends and drove back home in Xingang Community. On the way, he felt relaxed and felt that the day had been very fulfilling.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime preparation
description: Back home, first drank a glass of warm water. Then followed the pre-sleep relaxation micro-habit: sitting on the edge of the bed, used a foam roller to gently relax the calf muscles that were a little tight after the run. The lower back felt basically back to normal, no need for extra heat therapy. After a quick wash, set the alarm for 7:30 tomorrow morning, turned off the lights at 22:30 on time and lay down to sleep.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returning after the gathering and before bed.
description: The private room time was up, and the three of them walked out of the KTV still wanting more. They said goodbye at the entrance and agreed to meet again next time. Zhiyuan and Xiao Ma left on shared bikes, while Yin Hao used a ride-hailing app to call a taxi and got in about 5 minutes later, returning to Xingang Community. Once home, he folded the clothes that had been dried in the washing machine and put them back in the wardrobe, then brushed his teeth, washed his face, and changed into pajamas. Lying in bed, he reviewed the full and happy day, sent an "I'm home" message in the group chat, and briefly reviewed the wrong questions and knowledge points on his phone, then put down his phone and soon fell asleep.
location: From the entrance of Haoledi KTV (Songjiang branch) on Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to the bedroom of Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: Woke up naturally at 6 a.m. The sky outside was slightly light, and the overcast day felt comfortable. First did 10 minutes of core training in the living room, including planks and bird dogs, confirming the lower back was relaxed and pain-free. Then washed up, changed into cycling clothes, and drank a glass of warm water to wake up the body. Then carefully checked the road bike's tire pressure, chain, and derailleur, confirming the brakes were responsive. Quickly prepared breakfast: two slices of whole wheat bread with fried egg and lettuce, paired with hot milk, and filled the cycling water bottle with electrolyte water, fully preparing for the morning ride.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycled to the meeting point and made new friends.
description: At exactly 7:00 he took out his road bike, set off from Xingang Community, and rode north along Jiasong South Road for about 20 minutes. Traffic was steady along the way, and he arrived at the KFC entrance beside Songjiang University Town Metro Station at 7:25. He met five or six members of the cycling club and greeted each other. One rider named Chen Kai was joining for the first time, and Yin Hao took the initiative to talk with him about road bike configurations and shared his experience of protecting his lower back through core training. The atmosphere was pleasant, and they got ready for the upcoming ride.
location: In front of KFC (University Town branch), 818 Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Club cycling trip to Zhujiajiao
description: The group set off in an orderly line along Huqingping Highway toward Zhujiajiao Ancient Town. It was cloudy without rain, and riding felt wonderful. Yin Hao stayed in the middle of the group with a steady cadence, chatting with nearby fellow riders about their work and riding experiences, feeling relaxed and happy. They passed through Songjiang and Qingpu city areas along the way and finally arrived at Zhujiajiao Ancient Town.
location: Huqingping Highway (from Songjiang District, Shanghai, through the urban area of Qingpu to Zhujiajiao)
