name: Visit Zhujiajiao Ancient Town.
description: After arriving at the ancient town, everyone gathered near Fangsheng Bridge. Yin Hao walked his bicycle along the stone-paved street and took several photos of the water town scenery with his phone, including the reflection of Fangsheng Bridge, the old riverside houses and teahouses, and students sketching by the water. Immersed in the peaceful and leisurely atmosphere of the ancient town, he enjoyed his leisure time.
location: Shanghai Zhujiajiao Ancient Town Tourist Area, 555 Kezhiyuan Road, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Return cycling and purchases on the way
description: After returning freely with the club's main group, Yin Hao was the first to head back. Riding back along Huqingping Highway, he detoured to the Sam's Club Qingpu store. Inside, he picked up ingredients for dinner and tomorrow's brunch: beef chuck, salad greens, cherry tomatoes, and sugar-free yogurt, then paid quickly via the app's self-checkout and left. He then rode south on Jiasong South Road for about 30 minutes back to Xingang Community, put away the groceries, screenshotted his ride record and sent it to the club group chat, then drank a large glass of electrolyte water and used a foam roller to relax his calf muscles for 15 minutes.
location: Sam's Club (Qingpu Store), No. 1-26, Lane 483, Yejin Road, Zhaoxiang Town, Qingpu District, Shanghai, and along the way

name: Lunch and a quick shower

name: Encountered a fraudulent phone call and took security measures
description: Yin Hao habitually opened mobile banking, saw the message that Yu'ebao had automatically transferred 500 yuan to savings, and recorded it in his bookkeeping app. Just as he was about to put down his phone, an unfamiliar call starting with +86 claimed to be from Officer Liu of the Jiading Branch of the Shanghai Public Security Bureau, saying that a bank card under his name was involved in a money laundering case and demanding that he cooperate with the investigation. He immediately recalled the community anti-fraud campaign and the 96110 text messages, and calmly asked for the officer's badge number and the police station address. The other side faltered and then hung up directly. Afterwards, he called the 96110 anti-fraud hotline; the officer on the line confirmed it was impersonation fraud and urged him not to transfer money or provide verification codes. After hanging up, he spent 30 minutes changing all his bank card, Alipay, and WeChat Pay passwords to more complex combinations, and enabled two-step verification for login and payments one by one. Then he wrote a detailed anti-fraud reminder on his Moments, clearly describing the call's tactics, to remind friends not to be fooled. Finally, he took out the prepared 800 yuan cash red packet, checked the silver bracelet and baby toy for his nephew, and carefully packed them into his backpack after confirming they were intact.
location: Room 203, Building 5, Xingang Community, No. 31, Lane 1599, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

Initially, the network latency dropped to around 180 ms, but occasional packet loss caused data interruptions. Sun Jianguo analyzed that it might be a mismatch between the packet size and the cache queue, so he adjusted the parameters and asked a colleague in the technical department to modify the interface handling logic at the same time while observing the stability of the waveform graph.

During this time, I poured two cups of water and ate an orange handed to me by a colleague.

Every time I changed a set of parameters, I started the controlled PLC simulator and observed changes in latency, packet loss, and throughput. The test results fluctuated, but I recorded all the data neatly in my notebook. After nearly three hours of effort, I finally locked in two parameter sets with the best performance and the lowest packet loss rate, and labeled them as 'Group 1 for tomorrow' and 'Backup plan'.

If he changed to the circular queue read method... He immediately sketched a simple cache configuration diagram in his class notebook. He spent the entire class break refining the diagram, and felt that combining this solution with the alternative parameter set he had tested that afternoon had a high likelihood of solving the packet loss problem, which greatly boosted his confidence.
location: Home study at Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Independently tackled the MES interface latency issue.
description: Swiped his card to enter the workshop and went to his workstation (beside No. 3 CNC machine tool). He turned on the computer, launched the test environment software, and made a cup of green tea. Following last night's idea, he began modifying the cache parameters of the PLC protocol conversion module. He first reproduced yesterday's high-concurrency test scenario; latency was still around 180ms, with occasional packet loss. Then he located the three suspicious registry items he had marked, and using his new circular queue idea, began adjusting the cache pre-allocation size and replacement strategy one by one. When he adjusted the second set of parameters, log data showed the packet loss rate beginning to drop significantly.

During the meal, he briefly mentioned that he was dealing with the interface latency issue and felt he was on the right track, but he didn't go into detail. Wang Lei teased, “You've really been at odds with this interface lately.” Yin Hao smiled and didn't reply.

name: Noon break

name: Final verification and root cause identification
description: After waking up, he continued working with high spirits. He modified the last parameter, adjusting the cache pool size from 256 bytes to 512 bytes, and optimized the replacement strategy. He conducted a 30-minute stress test simulating a full-load production data stream. The log files output smoothly, and he stared at the latency readings on the screen. Finally, starting from the data at the 5th minute, the latency stabilized at around 50ms, and there was no packet loss throughout. After reviewing the logs repeatedly, he confirmed that the root cause was exactly what he had predicted last night: "the cache preallocation was too small, causing frequent replacement under high concurrency, resulting in packet loss."
location: Workstation and testing area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Plant, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Master Sun's acceptance inspection and praise
description: Yin Hao excitedly invited his master, Sun Jianguo, to accept the inspection. The data interactions were stable and smooth, with latency consistently below 50 ms. Master Sun patted Yin Hao on the shoulder and said approvingly, "Xiao Yin, great progress! Your ability to diagnose and solve problems independently has clearly reached a new level. That was a job well done!" Then Master Sun designated Yin Hao on the spot as the person in charge of the subsequent integration of the MES system and the machine tool.
location: Machine tool workstation No. 3 at 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory)

To be honest, I've actually been thinking about it recently. I'm going to try, within the next six months, to use this technical achievement to go for a senior technician rating or a job promotion. Tell Uncle to rest assured—I know what I'm doing, and I have a plan.” After the conversation, a subtle sense of pressure and mutual understanding lingered between them.

name: Video call with mother Wang Xiuying
description: After hanging up with Lin Yue, he adjusted his mood and made a WeChat video call to his mother. His mother had already packed her luggage and was very excited. He confirmed tomorrow's high-speed rail information for his mother again (G7305, arrives at Shanghai Station at 7:20), and urged her to bring her ID card and be safe on the way. He said with a smile: "Mom, I bought your favorite clams and green vegetables, and the fridge is packed full. When you arrive tomorrow, I'll make you something delicious." His mother was so happy she couldn't stop smiling.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 3, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening washing up and relaxing before bed
description: Hung up the phone and went to wash up. While brushing my teeth, I took out tomorrow's clothes from the wardrobe, hung them at the head of the bed, and plugged in my phone. After washing up, I got back into bed. Feeling a bit tired, I put on Bluetooth earphones, opened the white noise app on my phone, chose a "Rain on Banana Leaves" sound, and relaxed in the patter of the rain. In my mind flashed the steady 50ms latency curve on the screen from today's successful debugging, and the faces of my mother and Lin Yue. I let out a long sigh, stopped thinking about it, and fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning core strength training
description: On Saturday morning, Yin Hao did indoor core strength training in his rented apartment, including push-ups, planks, and squats, to maintain his fitness. After the workout, he took a shower and changed clothes, preparing to welcome his mother.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to Shanghai Railway Station to pick up my mother.
description: Yin Hao set out from his rental apartment and drove along the Jiamin Elevated Road to Shanghai Railway Station, about 25 kilometers in total, with an estimated driving time of 35 minutes. On the way, he turned on the air conditioning, confirmed the arrival time of the G7305 train his mother was taking, and prepared to meet her.
location: From No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Shanghai Railway Station, No. 303 Moling Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai

name: Picked up his mother and had breakfast together
description: Yin Hao picked up his mother Wang Xiuying at the exit of Shanghai Railway Station. She brought hometown specialties: dried clams, free-range eggs, and a hand-knitted sweater. Then the two had breakfast at Yonghe King inside the station, ordering soy milk, xiaolongbao, and youtiao. Mother and son chatted while eating. She asked about Yin Hao's life in Shanghai, and the atmosphere was warm and cozy.
location: Yonghe King inside Shanghai Railway Station, No. 303 Moling Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai

name: Taking mother home, getting her settled, and shopping at the supermarket
description: Yin Hao drove his mother back to his rental apartment in Songjiang District. On the way, his mother asked about Yin Hao’s work situation and promotion opportunities, and Yin Hao reported his progress in tackling the MES interface latency issue. After arriving home, Yin Hao helped his mother put away her luggage and told her he had prepared new bed sheets and turned on the air conditioner in advance. After a short rest, the two went to Yonghui Superstores to buy groceries and household items. They bought chicken breast, whole wheat bread, vegetables, eggs, and other ingredients for the coming week, and also chose a bamboo mat for his mother to cope with the high temperatures. After returning home, Yin Hao sorted and put away the items, while his mother took out the clams and pork belly she had brought and began preparing lunch.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and Yonghui Supermarket (Shanghai Songjiang Wanda Store)

name: Learning circuit repair at Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop.
description: Yin Hao drove to Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop at No. 168 Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District, to help Master Chen Jianguo repair an air conditioner main control board. Master Chen taught the fault tree troubleshooting method on site. Yin Hao replaced two bulging capacitors himself and wrote down key points in his phone memo. He learned practical circuit maintenance skills from this, which helped him inspect vehicle circuits and machine tool circuits later.
location: Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, 168 Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home to enjoy the lunch his mother made and take a midday rest.
description: Yin Hao returned home from the repair shop, and his mother had already made steamed clams with eggs, braised pork, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. Mother and son had lunch together and talked about the recent situation of relatives in their hometown. After the meal, Yin Hao washed the dishes and watched TV with his mother. At around 13:10, his mother went to her room for a nap. Yin Hao rested on the living room sofa and set an alarm for 16:00 to conserve energy for the evening run.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Check the night run schedule and organize your gear
description: After waking from his nap, Yin Hao confirmed that the company union's glow night run would gather at 18:00 at Songjiang Sports Center, with a 5-kilometer route around the venue. He replaced the insoles of his running shoes, prepared a quick-dry T-shirt, running shorts, and glow sticks, checked the battery of his running watch, and made full preparations for the night run.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to Songjiang Sports Center
description: Yin Hao changed into his night running gear, brought his water bottle, and drove from Guangfulin Road to Songjiang Sports Center. After about a 20-minute drive, he arrived at the parking lot, ready to participate in the union activity.
location: From No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Songjiang Sports Center, No. 145, Middle Rongle Road, Songjiang District

name: Pre-run warm-up and chatting at the sports center.
description: Yin Hao arrived at the track and field of Songjiang Sports Center and found the gathering point for the company's 'Songjiang Machinery Running Club'. As the department's pace leader, he chatted with cross-department running buddies such as Zhao Yang from the technical department and Sister Chen from the purchasing department about their recent running habits and paces. Everyone encouraged each other and the atmosphere was lively.
location: Track and Field at Songjiang Sports Center, No. 145 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Company union glow night run
description: After the starting gun fired, Yin Hao led at a steady pace of 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer, with stable strides and even breathing. While observing the team, he used short commands to encourage the members. The full 5-kilometer out-and-back run took about 34 minutes. After crossing the finish line, he walked slowly to adjust his breathing, his sweat soaking through his team uniform.
location: Track and Field at Songjiang Sports Center, No. 145 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Post-night-run dinner with colleagues
description: After the run, the department dinner was at Laozhaotou Folk Cuisine, a Shanghainese restaurant next to the sports center. Everyone sat around two tables in a relaxed atmosphere. Yin Hao, Wang Lei, and others talked about the pace and their running insights while enjoying the food and bonding with colleagues.
location: Laozhaotou Folk Cuisine, No. 150 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Had a heated argument with girlfriend Lin Yue on the phone.
description: During the dinner gathering, his girlfriend Lin Yue called, and Yin Hao stepped outside to answer. Lin Yue was upset and demanded to know why he wasn't actively responding to the marriage pressure from his family in Hangzhou, accusing him of "not being proactive, not solving things, and showing no future." Yin Hao tried to explain the financial pressure and his plan to get a professional certificate, but she wouldn't listen, and the two argued fiercely for about 15 minutes. After hanging up, Yin Hao sat alone on the steps outside the restaurant, scrolling through old photos, feeling extremely depressed, and posted a WeChat Moment visible only to himself: "The speed of making money can't keep up with the pace of being pushed to marry." It wasn't until his colleague Wang Lei came out to find him that he managed to pull himself together and return to the table.
location: Steps outside Laozhaotou Folk Cuisine Restaurant, 150 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After the dinner gathering, drove home.
description: After the dinner gathering ended, Yin Hao politely declined his colleagues' invitation to go singing and drove back alone to the rental apartment in Songjiang District. The car was silent along the way, and the content of the quarrel kept replaying in his mind with many thoughts churning.
location: From No. 150 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District

name: Went home to wash up and calm his emotions
description: After arriving home, his mother had already fallen asleep. Yin Hao washed up quietly and changed out of his sweat-soaked team uniform. Lying in bed, he looked at the chat window with Lin Yue but ultimately didn't send a message, and began seriously thinking about the future of their long-distance relationship and the possibility of settling down in Shanghai.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep review and going to bed.
description: Yin Hao lay in bed unable to fall asleep, replaying the day's training, study, dinner, and argument, physically and mentally exhausted. To force himself to sleep, he put on headphones, listened to white noise, silently recited tomorrow's to-do list, and eventually fell into a deep sleep amid complicated emotions.
location: Bedroom in the rental apartment at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Xingang Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning routine and getting ready to go out
description: The alarm went off, and Yin Hao got up gently. Because his mother was resting in the guest bedroom, he moved quietly. He first did 10 minutes of indoor stretching to wake up his body, then took a shower and changed into clean loungewear. After that he tidied the apartment, putting the clothes folded on the sofa the night before back into the wardrobe and straightening the documents on the desk. Around 07:15, a mobile banking notification showed that 500 yuan had been automatically transferred into Yu'e Bao. He opened his expense tracking app to record this as “Week 28 Savings” with the note “Mom is coming to Shanghai; be frugal,” and also checked WeChat work groups to confirm there were no urgent messages. For breakfast he simply had milk and bread. Before leaving, he muted Lin Yue's messages, determined to greet his mother in the best condition possible, then took his umbrella and car keys and quietly closed the door behind him.
location: In the rental apartment at No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Residential Community)

name: Drive to pick up my mother and return.
description: Yin Hao drove a sedan in the light rain along Guangfulin Road and Jiasong South Road for about 15 minutes, arriving at Songjiang Passenger Station (at the intersection of Jiasong South Road and Meijiabang Road), and parked near the exit. At exactly 8:00, among the crowd at the exit, he spotted his mother Wang Xiuying carrying two heavy large bags, and quickly stepped forward to take the luggage. His mother had brought crispy crackers, dried clams, and the pickled vegetables he loved. Yin Hao, feeling protective, held an umbrella for his mother and led her to the parking lot. On the drive back, he chatted with his mother and asked about the long-distance bus; his mother looked out the window at the Shanghai street scene and marveled at the tall buildings and wide roads, while Yin Hao briefly introduced the sights along the way. They returned to Xingang Community about 20 minutes later.
location: Songjiang Passenger Station, Jiasong South Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (and driving round trip).

name: Mother visited the rental apartment and had a heart-to-heart talk.
description: After getting home, Yin Hao helped his mother change into slippers. Looking around the living space of less than 30 square meters but neatly organized, she worriedly urged her son to take care of himself. Yin Hao changed the subject, took out the senior technician exam materials, pointed at key points and said, "Mom, I'm working hard, and my salary can still go up in the future." His mother gently patted his shoulder with her calloused hand, her eyes full of relief and concern.
location: In the rental apartment at No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Residential Community)

name: Went to the food market with my mother to buy groceries.
description: After the rain lightened, Yin Hao walked with his mother about 3 minutes to the Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket. His mother skillfully picked out clams, chives, and green peppers at the stall, while Yin Hao carried the groceries beside her. He also pointed out the roadside pharmacy and bus stop, telling his mother that daily life was very convenient. His mother nodded in satisfaction.
location: Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket)

name: Prepared lunch together, had lunch, and took a lunch break.
description: Mother put on an apron and insisted on cooking. She soaked the dried clams she had brought and prepared the fresh clams. Yin Hao helped by washing vegetables and chopping garlic. The sound of stir-frying rose from the kitchen, and Mother made steamed clams with garlic, stir-fried fresh local vegetables, and braised chicken pieces. At lunch, Yin Hao wolfed down his food while Mother kept putting food on his plate. After the meal, Yin Hao rushed to wash the dishes and tidy up, then told Mother to take a nap in the guest bedroom, saying, “You've been sitting in the car all morning, rest for a while, and we'll go out after you wake up.” Mother agreed and went to rest.
location: In the rental apartment at No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Residential Community)

name: Organizing technical notes and tidying up.
description: After his mother rested, Yin Hao took out yesterday's technical notes and his computer. He opened Excel and systematically organized the fault tree troubleshooting method taught by Master Chen Jianguo into an electronic document according to his own understanding. As he entered the content, he mentally simulated the troubleshooting steps to ensure the logic was clear. After finishing, he backed up the photos of his mother and home-cooked dishes taken this morning to the cloud.
location: In the rental apartment at No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Residential Community)

name: Take a walk around the community and interact with neighbors
description: At 3 p.m. the rain stopped and turned cloudy. Yin Hao woke his mother and went downstairs together. In the residential complex, he showed his mother the location of the property management service center and the parcel locker, then walked slowly along Guangfulin Road. They happened to meet Auntie Chen, a neighbor who was going out to buy groceries. Auntie Chen greeted warmly, "Oh, is this your mother? What a filial young man!" His mother happily chatted briefly with Auntie Chen about everyday matters.
location: Inside Xingang Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the walking path on Guangfulin Road

name: Free time and rest
description: After walking home, Mother rested briefly and used her phone to video call Father back home to share what she had seen and heard. Yin Hao, meanwhile, studied next week's work schedule and planned a light morning running route for tomorrow.
location: In the rental apartment at No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Residential Community)

name: Yin Hao cooks a filial dinner.
description: At five in the afternoon, Yin Hao put on an apron and took the initiative to cook dinner. He made the garlic broccoli his mother had taught him, cooked braised chicken pieces his own way, and finally steamed a plate of clams his mother had brought. The kitchen was filled with inviting aromas.
location: In the rental apartment at No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Residential Community)

name: Dinner and Heartwarming Evening Chat
description: During dinner, his mother tasted the chicken pieces and praised that his cooking had improved. At the table, she cautiously asked about Lin Yue. Yin Hao responded vaguely: "Mom, I've been under a lot of work pressure lately. Let's set our matter aside for now; we'll talk after I pass the certification exam." His mother didn't ask further, only patted his head and told him not to be too tired. After the meal, the two sat on the sofa watching a CCTV family program. His mother talked about how relatives in their hometown were doing, and Yin Hao listened quietly, enjoying the companionship.
location: In the rental apartment at No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Residential Community)

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: At 9 p.m., Yin Hao urged his mother to wash up and rest first, while he helped make the bed in the guest bedroom and smoothed the corners of the newly replaced straw mat.
location: In the rental apartment at No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Residential Community)

name: Reply to Girlfriend and Daily Summary
description: After his mother fell asleep, Yin Hao returned to his room and, after hesitating for a moment, sent a short message to his girlfriend Lin Yue: "My mom is here today, so I'll call you on the weekend." After sending it, he put down his phone, recorded the day's expenses in his notebook, and wrote down his plan for tomorrow: get up early for morning exercise, then go help at the Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Department in the afternoon. He set the alarm, turned off the light, and fell asleep in the reassuring feeling of his mother's sound sleep.
location: In the rental apartment at No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Residential Community)

name: Morning core training.
description: Woke up naturally two minutes before the alarm went off, changed into athletic shorts and a tank top, laid out a yoga mat on the living room floor, and started a 20-minute core workout including push-ups and planks. He tried to keep the movements quiet, completing three sets of 15 reps each. Afterward, he drank warm water and wiped off sweat, feeling loosened up all over.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Have breakfast with mother and confirm the itinerary.
description: Mother had already cooked millet porridge, served with pickled vegetables and fried eggs. Over breakfast, mother and son discussed the day's plans and decided to drive to the Guangfulin Cultural Relics Park and use a drone to take photos of his mother. His mother reminded him to drive slowly and not to spend money recklessly.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Departure preparations and drive to Guangfulin
description: I quickly checked the backpack: the drone battery was fully charged, spare folding umbrella, bottled water, and tissues. Mother changed her shoes and put on a sun hat. I locked the door and went downstairs, then drove about 22 minutes along Xingang Road to Lane 3260, Guangfulin Road. On the way, mother remarked how much Songjiang has changed.
location: Along the route from Xingang Community to Guangfulin Cultural Relics Site, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Visited the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site
description: Parking cost 15 yuan, and entrance and sightseeing bus tickets together cost 120 yuan. We first took the sightseeing bus around the park, then focused on visiting the underwater museum and the ancient building complex. My mother was fascinated by the history of Shanghai's earliest inhabitants. At the square in front of Zhiye Zen Temple, I used the drone to take aerial photos of her. She was nervous at first, but under guidance she gave a natural smile, and I took more than twenty photos. Afterward, we continued to visit Qinwang Mountain and Jixian Archway.
location: Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site, Lane 3260, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Enjoyed a lunch of Songjiang local dishes.
description: Drove to Wenhui Hotel near the university town and ordered braised pork belly, fresh pork xiaolongbao, dry-fried green beans, and seaweed egg drop soup. The braised pork belly melted in the mouth. His mother praised that the sweetness was just right, and Yin Hao took the opportunity to urge her to stay a few more days, promising to take her out to eat every day.
location: Wenhui Hotel (Songjiang University Town Branch, Shanghai), No. 955 Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Walked in the country park and decided to extend the stay.
description: After the meal, drove 5 minutes to Guangfulin Country Park and walked slowly for about 20 minutes along the tree-lined riverside path near the entrance to aid digestion. During this time, Yin Hao sincerely urged his mother to stay a few more days, and she finally agreed to postpone her return ticket to the 21st. Yin Hao immediately used his phone to refund the ticket on 12306 (with a 20% service fee deducted), and sent a WeChat message to company HR to apply for the following annual leave.
location: Guangfulin Country Park, 3488 Chenta Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bought fruit on the way.
description: On the way back from the park, he stopped by Xianfeng Fruit Store and picked a large watermelon and a bunch of Summer Black grapes, specifically choosing full, plump grapes. His mother tried to stop him, but Yin Hao had already paid by scanning the QR code and said they would eat them while watching TV in the evening.
location: Xianfeng Fruit (Shanghai Songjiang Wanda Store), Lane 658, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home to rest and organize photos
description: Drove home. His mother returned to her room for an afternoon nap. Yin Hao cut the watermelon, put half in the refrigerator, and cut the other half into pieces; then he imported the videos and photos taken by the drone into his laptop, selected the few where his mother had the best expressions, and did simple color grading with Lightroom, brightening her skin tone and increasing saturation.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Residential Area, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Taught my mother how to use a smartphone.
description: After his mother woke up from her afternoon nap, Yin Hao taught her hands-on how to use WeChat video calls, find the payment page, bring up the health code, and specifically how to send the photos just processed to Moments as 'original images.' Wearing her reading glasses, his mother studied seriously and successfully posted her first Moments entry with original images, receiving likes and comments from relatives back home—she was overjoyed.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare dinner
description: He tied on an apron and started cooking. From the refrigerator he took out the dried clams and eggs his mother had brought, along with the thawed sea bass. After soaking the dried clams and blanching them to remove the fishy smell, he steamed them with eggs; he scored the sea bass, stuffed it with shredded scallion and ginger, steamed it, and drizzled it with steamed-fish soy sauce and hot oil; then he stir-fried a plate of seasonal vegetables. A delightful aroma drifted from the kitchen.
location: Kitchen of the rental house in Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and video call with father
description: At the dinner table, mother and son were happy and harmonious. After the meal, Yin Hao quickly washed the dishes, then made a WeChat video call to his father. His mother shared the day's experiences with his father, praised how beautiful the drone photos were and how skilled her son was at editing them, and decided to stay for a few more days. The father showed a relieved smile on the video call.
location: Living room and dining room of the rental unit, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Relaxing in the living room and organizing accounts
description: Watched the national evening news with my mother and chatted about the latest news of relatives in our hometown. Took out the ledger and mobile payment records, and wrote down the day's expenses item by item: tickets 120, lunch 150, fruit 60, refund fee 30, totaling 360 yuan. At the same time, packaged the day's aerial footage and photos and uploaded them to the cloud drive, and told my running friends on WeChat that I wouldn't run tomorrow.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and reading
description: Mother washed up first. Yin Hao checked the drone battery (50% remaining, no need to charge) and confirmed the photos had been backed up. After Mother returned to her room, he took a quick shower, then lay in bed using his phone's memo app to review the day's feelings and plan the next day's itinerary. Satisfied, he turned off his phone and set the alarm for 6:30.
location: Bedroom and bathroom of the rented unit, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going to bed
description: Summer insects chirped outside the window; the room was quiet, and from the next room came the faint sound of his mother snoring. Yin Hao felt a rare inner peace, and with contentment he soon fell asleep and slept till dawn.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment at Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning walk and core training
description: The sky outside the window was already bright, and it felt very comfortable, about 26 degrees. I gently woke my mother, and after a quick wash, we walked out of the house together. On the circular path in the community garden, I pointed to a path lined with camphor trees ahead and said to my mother, "Mom, I usually run three laps around here on my morning runs." My mother was wrapped in a thin jacket she had brought, muttering, "The dew is heavy; your short sleeves won't do," as she reached out and touched my arm. After two laps, about 1.5 kilometers, I walked my mother to the entrance of our building. She went upstairs to prepare breakfast, and I turned and walked to the exercise equipment area beside the basketball court. I did three sets of rotator cuff activation with a resistance band, then did a 15-minute core workout of planks and crunches. Sweat soaked my collar.
location: Fitness equipment area beside the basketball court, Xingang Community Garden, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up, breakfast, and getting ready to leave
description: I returned home, took a cold shower, and changed into dark blue work clothes. The familiar aroma of rice porridge drifted from the kitchen, along with a plate of pickled vegetables and two golden fried eggs. Mother ladled out the porridge while muttering that the greens at the vegetable stall downstairs were five mao more expensive than in our hometown. I murmured in agreement, ate quickly, and put the dishes in the sink. I checked my work badge, keys, and phone, then tucked my notebook and two pens into my work clothes pocket. I needed somewhere to write down the key technical points I would record today.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the company.
description: I went downstairs, got into my white Volkswagen Lavida, drove west along Xingang Road for about 500 meters, then turned right onto Shenzhuan Highway. The whole ride took about 15 minutes. There weren't many cars on the road today. While waiting at a red light, I sent a WeChat message to my mother's phone: 'Mom, there's milk and bread in the fridge. Heat them up yourself for lunch.'
location: On the drive from Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Work: quarterly preventive maintenance of Machine Tool No. 3 (Phase 1).
description: I changed into non-slip safety shoes and a safety helmet in the changing room. When I entered the workshop, Master Sun was already standing in front of the No. 3 machining center. The checklist on the tool cart was ready: cleaning cloths, guide rail oil, a new coolant filter element, a micrometer, and a set of hex keys. We first started the equipment to warm it up, then powered it off and locked it out with a safety lock. Master Sun watched from the side while I followed the standard operating procedure: first I scraped the old grease and chips piled up on the X/Y-axis guide rails with a cleaning cloth, then wiped them with a non-woven cloth dipped in guide rail oil, and finally applied new oil. Next, we shut off the coolant pump. I squatted down, carefully loosened the screws on the base oil pan, drained the old fluid, removed the filter, and replaced it with a new one. After cleaning, I refilled it with new emulsion. During the test cycle, the coolant flowed smoothly, and Master Sun gave an approving "Hmm".
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch: simple meal at the canteen
description: When the lunch break bell rang, the four of us sat at one table. Wang Lei, while eating, started egging us on again: "How about a couple rounds of Honor of Kings tonight? New season." I smiled and shook my head: "My mom is waiting at home; I need to go back and have dinner with her. You guys play." Liu Zhiqiang mentioned that the MES system was a bit laggy again yesterday, and I discussed it with him for a bit. Today's cafeteria food was braised pork chop and scrambled eggs with tomatoes, which tasted pretty good.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and self-study.
description: After lunch, I didn't go straight back to my workstation. I found an empty seat in the rest area at the corner of the workshop. Using my phone connected to the company Wi-Fi, I opened a column article on "Machinist Encyclopedia" about adjusting the preload force of machine tool spindles, and took screenshots of a few calculation formulas I hadn't fully understood, saving them to my album, planning to write them down in my notebook when I had time in the evening.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Work: Learning and hands-on practice of spindle precision calibration.
description: The highlight of the afternoon was spindle calibration. Master Sun deliberately left this opportunity to me. He took out that magnetic dial indicator from his toolbox and demonstrated how to attach it to the spindle and adjust the contact surface of the probe. I held my breath and, following his instructions, slowly turned the spindle by hand, watching the needle on the dial. The first reading was 0.01 mm, the second was 0.014 mm, and the third was 0.009 mm. Master Sun asked me to control the radial runout within the tolerance of 0.003 mm by fine-tuning the preload nut at the bearing. I tried three times repeatedly until the last reading stabilized at 0.003 mm, and then I breathed a sigh of relief. Master Sun patted me on the shoulder and said, 'Not bad, you have a good feel for it.' I neatly copied all three readings into my notebook.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Work: maintenance wrap-up and filling in the maintenance log
description: In 15 minutes, I finished the final oil lubrication and cleaning of the machine tool's exterior, and confirmed that no tools were left on the workbench. Afterwards, Master Sun and I went to the workshop office and filled in the entire process of this quarterly maintenance (including the batch numbers of replaced parts, lubrication cycle, and fine-tuning data) item by item in the equipment maintenance log. Master Sun signed first. As today's "main operator," I solemnly signed "Yin Hao" in large characters at the bottom of the form. The date was July 15, 2025.
location: Workshop Office, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Work: routine production tasks and closing out.
description: Although today was mainly maintenance, I still used my free time in the afternoon to help Xiao Wang at the next workstation adjust the tool change offset on the No. 2 machine tool he is responsible for, because the coordinates on that axis were always off by a few hundredths of a millimeter. After getting it done, I organized the tools scattered around my workstation today and browsed through tomorrow's production plan sheet.
location: Precision Machining Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Plant, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-work commute
description: After clocking out, I started the car. Through the window, the sky was still a clear blue. I didn't rush to turn on the music. Instead, while waiting at a red light, I called my mother: "Mom, I'm off work and heading back. Have you bought the groceries? Need me to bring anything?" From the other end of the line came her smiling voice: "I've bought everything, you don't need to bring anything! I've been craving braised pork, and I already bought the pork belly!"
location: During the drive from Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Mother and son preparing dinner together
description: As soon as I opened the door, the familiar aroma of scallions, ginger, and soy sauce rushed over. My mother was busy at the stove, and the rice cooker beside her was filled with the fragrance of rice. I washed my hands, took the green vegetables she handed me, and picked them clean at the sink. As she parboiled the cut pork belly cubes in the heated oil pan, she chatted with me: "I went to the Xingang New Village fresh food supermarket today. The old vegetable seller gave me two extra scallions, saying I looked kind... There were so many people buying groceries. On the way back, I also mopped the floor at home." We chatted while preparing the ingredients. She scooped out the meat and put it into the pressure cooker to caramelize the sugar and add seasonings. Meanwhile, I served the stir-fried seasonal vegetables that had been steamed on the adjacent burner.
location: Home kitchen, Xingang Xiaoqu, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Mother and son had dinner together.
description: At the dining table, the plate of Shanghai-style braised pork was glossy red, rich but not greasy, and melted in the mouth. There was also sautéed seasonal vegetables and a bowl of seaweed egg drop soup. Seeing how I wolfed down my food, my mother kept putting meat in my bowl, saying, "Look how thin you are. Eat some more." I poured her a glass of warm water and, while eating, told her about learning spindle calibration with Master Sun today, and said that Master Sun had praised me. My mother was delighted, and the wrinkles on her face smoothed out.
location: Dining table at home, Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-dinner walk and smartphone tutorial
description: After clearing the dishes and chopsticks, my mother and I walked along Xingang Road toward the university town to the east. The evening breeze blew, and on the road there were parents walking their dogs and students riding shared bikes. I asked my mother to open her camera and taught her how to enable the rule-of-thirds grid to compose a shot: "Mom, when you photograph that streetlight, put it at the intersection of the thirds of the frame, and the effect will be much better." She tried clumsily while taking pictures of the roadside lawn, the distant teaching buildings, and the sunset clouds in the sky. When we got near the Songjiang University Town Innovation and Entrepreneurship Cluster, I helped her pick three clearer photos and taught her to add a simple caption: "Taking a walk with my son in Songjiang, so beautiful." Then I guided her to post it in the family group. Likes from my father and eldest brother immediately appeared in the group.
location: Along the route from Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to the Innovation and Entrepreneurship Cluster of Songjiang University Town (Lane 1000, Wenhui Road)

name: Mother and son evening chat time.
description: Back home, my mother sat on the sofa, took out the small yarn basket and crochet hook she carries with her, and began knitting little socks for my future little nephew (my brother's child). I lay on the sofa beside her with my hands behind my head and chatted with her about my recent running plan. "Mom, this weekend I plan to try the greenway at Xiaokunshan Health Park, about 15 kilometers, to build endurance." At the same time, I briefly mentioned how Lin Yue has been doing lately, without going into details about the quarrel, only saying, "She's busy with work too; we're all tired." My mother changed the subject and told me, "When looking for a partner, be down-to-earth. Our family doesn't ask for much money, but you need to find someone good." Moonlight streamed in through the gauze curtain, and time seemed to slow down.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: Mother saw it was getting late and went back to her small room to sleep first. After washing up in the bathroom, I boiled some water with the electric kettle, filled my thermos, and put it on the nightstand. Then I lay down on the bed, opened my phone, pulled up the "spindle preload force formula" I had screenshotted in the rest area, and copied it into my notebook twice to make sure I fully absorbed it.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Recording expenses and going to sleep
description: I opened the bookkeeping app on my phone and recorded today's living expenses: lunch at the cafeteria 15 yuan, parking 0 yuan (the company provides a monthly pass), no other expenses. Total spending today: 15 yuan. Last month's automatic savings through Yu'ebao had already taken effect. Watching the number in the account increase little by little gives a very real feeling of security. I turned off the main light in the room and left only a night light. Closing my eyes, I ran through today's machine parameters and my mother's smile in my mind, and fell asleep peacefully. Estimated time of falling asleep: 22:30.
location: On the bed at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning core training.
description: The alarm went off on time. Because his mother was in Shanghai, he chose to train indoors to avoid making too much noise. He laid out a yoga mat in the living room and used a foam roller to carefully loosen his calves and the backs of his thighs, five minutes each, to relieve the previous day's fatigue. Then he did three sets of side leg raises with a resistance band, followed by four sets of planks, holding each for 50 seconds. The weather was muggy, and he soon worked up a light sweat.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Washing up and breakfast
description: After training, took a shower and changed into clean work clothes. Mother had already set breakfast on the table: steaming millet porridge, two boiled eggs, and five soup dumplings. Mother mentioned that pork at the market was cheap and she wanted to buy more to make dumplings. Yin Hao ate while responding in agreement, praising the millet porridge for being cooked just right. After finishing, he put the dishes and chopsticks into the kitchen sink.
location: Dining room and bathroom at home, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to work
description: Take the car keys, work badge, and the lunchbox prepared by your mother, and tell her you won't be back for lunch. After going downstairs, drive along Xingang Road from south to north, turn right onto Huatianjing Highway, and arrive at the factory in about 15 minutes.
location: On the way from Xingang Road to Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-shift meeting and daily work
description: After changing into work clothes, he attended the pre-shift meeting on time. Team leader Wang Lei stressed that they needed to rush out a batch of high-precision valve body parts that day. After the meeting, Yin Hao went to No. 3 CNC machine tool to check the coolant level and verify the clamping plan and tool parameters. Around 9 o'clock, the machine started automatic cutting. He stood by, carefully observing the shape of the chips and the coolant spray angle, confirming everything was normal.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Digital transformation project team meeting
description: The meeting was held in the small conference room on the second floor of the factory. Programmer Liu Zhiqiang demonstrated the new host computer interface. Based on the data he had organized, Yin Hao reported on the progress of the MES interface document, noting that 90% of the data point mapping had been completed, but a delay of about 1.5 seconds was found in the spindle load data upload. He discussed with Master Sun Jianguo, and they thought it might be caused by the PLC scan cycle or network packet loss, and decided it must be resolved within the week.
location: Small meeting room on the second floor of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Workshop operations and quality spot checks
description: After the meeting, he returned to Machine No. 3, where the first batch of 20 parts had finished machining. Yin Hao used a vernier caliper and an air gauge to spot-check 5 critical dimensions. He found that one inner-hole dimension was 0.01 mm below the lower limit. He then fine-tuned the tool compensation by 0.005 mm on the control panel, machined one more part to confirm it was qualified, and allowed the parts to flow to the next process.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At noon, he went to the factory cafeteria with Master Sun Jianguo and Wang Lei. Wang Lei ordered braised pork chop, while Yin Hao ate the lunchbox he had brought, which contained garlic stir-fried water spinach made by his mother and leftover braised pork ribs from the previous day. Master Sun got a vegetable dish and shared a cooling technique for machining stainless steel using minimum quantity lubrication (MQL). Yin Hao listened attentively and kept it in mind.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon routine work.
description: After the lunch break, he returned to the machine tool and continued machining valve body parts, maintaining stable cutting. During this time, Xiao Zhang, a worker at the neighboring station, came over to ask for help because he had miscalculated the tool change offset. Yin Hao recalculated the tool length compensation for him and demonstrated the standard operating procedure. Around 16:30, the workshop temperature soared, and the workshop director handed out iced mung bean soup to cool everyone down. Taking advantage of the break, Yin Hao used a hex wrench to tighten the clamping plates on the workbench fixture to ensure machining stability.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-work commute and shopping on the way.
description: After punching out from work, he drove and stopped by Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket on the way, quickly bought a bunch of scallions, a piece of ginger, and two heads of garlic, spending 7.5 yuan, then continued driving back home in Xingang Community.
location: Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai — Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket, and on the way home

name: Mother and son prepared dinner together and had a meal
description: As soon as he entered the door, he smelled the savory aroma wafting from the kitchen. His mother was dealing with the clams, using a slotted spoon to scoop out the ones with opened shells and set them aside. Yin Hao washed his hands and helped by chopping the scallions and ginger he had bought, and rinsing the sea bass his mother had bought that morning, scoring it with a few cuts. His mother did the cooking, making clam soup and steamed sea bass, while Yin Hao was in charge of stir-frying garlic water spinach. At about 19:00, mother and son sat down to eat. Yin Hao took a sip of the clam soup and exclaimed, "Mom, this is exactly the flavor! It's fresher than any restaurant's!"
location: Kitchen and dining room, home, Xingang Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-dinner rest and family topics.
description: After the meal, Yin Hao took the initiative to clear and wash the dishes, while his mother made a video call to his father in their hometown. After drying his hands, Yin Hao took the phone and asked about his father’s back, telling him not to do heavy work, and also talked about the amusing story of his nephew from his elder brother Yin Tao’s family learning to swim recently. His mother took the opportunity to urge him to get married, and Yin Hao laughed and changed the subject, saying, “My fate hasn’t arrived yet.”
location: Living room and balcony at home, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Walked with mother in the park.
description: The two of them went out for a walk to aid digestion. Yin Hao wore sneakers, and his mother wore cloth shoes. They walked two slow laps along the trail in Songjiang Central Park. The park has water and trees, with cool benches under the willow trees. His mother happily showed him short videos she had taken with her phone, including the cooking process, stray cats in the neighborhood, and the sunset glow from the balcony. Yin Hao watched carefully and praised his mother for her good composition and how fluently she used CapCut.
location: Songjiang Central Park, Yuanzhong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going home and diving into technical research
description: After the walk, his mother went to take a shower first. Yin Hao returned to his bedroom, opened the technical notes "Spindle Preload Force Calculation Formula" on his computer, and, in connection with the MES delay issue mentioned in the daytime meeting, drew a signal flow diagram of "sensor-PLC-host computer" in his notebook, sorting out the transmission paths and nodes that might cause delays, and wrote down his analysis.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and recording expenses
description: After his mother finished showering, Yin Hao went to take a shower and wash up. Then, wearing shorts, he sat on the edge of the bed, opened the expense tracking app on his phone, and entered today's spending: 7.5 yuan for the green onions, ginger, and garlic bought in the afternoon. He checked yesterday's balance and confirmed how much of the grocery money his mother had given him was left.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: He turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside night light on, and leaned against the headboard playing with his phone. In the childhood friends' group chat, he shared a photo of the clam soup he had that evening, which drew envious comments, and chatted with his childhood friend Zhang Wei about the pace plan for running at Xiaokunshan on the weekend. At 23:10 he heard snoring from his mother's room. Yin Hao set his alarm, put down his phone, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning exercise and breakfast preparation
description: Woke up naturally at 5:50. Because I had squatted for a long time in the workshop yesterday, my shoulder blades were sore and swollen, so I decided not to go out for a morning run. In the living room, I laid out a yoga mat, first used a foam roller on my back and hips, then did three sets of resistance-band lateral leg raises and single-leg stands—25 minutes of core training in total, and my muscles felt much looser. After showering, I went to the kitchen and saw my mother already busy, so I told her to rest and took over. I packed last night's braised pork and sauce into a lunchbox and stir-fried some vegetables for lunch. For myself, I had two slices of whole wheat bread, a glass of milk, and a banana. My mother kept telling me to eat more at noon and not to save money.
location: Home, Room 402, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Commute and pre-shift preparation.
description: At 7:10, after checking his phone, work badge, and car keys, he said goodbye to his mother and drove along Xingang Road, turning onto Huatianjing Highway, to the factory, arriving at the plant 12 minutes later. After changing into work clothes in the workshop, he went to the three-axis CNC milling machine to check the coolant and lubricating oil, and preheated the machine. At 7:40, the team morning meeting was held. Team leader Wang Lei emphasized the key tolerances for today's valve body parts and distributed the latest drawings. Master Sun reminded everyone to pay attention to yesterday's MES data delay issue and to be extra careful during production.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Morning data comparison and machining.
description: After starting work, he focused on the vehicle model data comparison task assigned by Master Sun. On the computer, he called up tool compensation data for different vehicle models and carefully compared it using the FANUC system maintenance software, hand-drawing the key differences on A4 paper. When he was puzzled by inconsistent measurement datums, he took the drawings to Master Sun and discussed them on site for five minutes, and after receiving some guidance, everything became clear. Returning to the machine tool, he fine-tuned the finishing tool cutting parameters based on the comparison conclusions and began machining a new batch of valve body parts. After each part was completed, he spot-checked it with a micrometer and a roughness tester, recording the data in his notebook to ensure that everything was within tolerance.
location: Workshop and office of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Signed up for voluntary blood donation during a work break.
description: At 10:20 the break bell rang. I took off my hard hat and walked to the union office on the west side of the factory grounds, explained to the staff member Xiao Wang why I had come, and filled out the Voluntary Blood Donation Registration Form. In the "intended donation date" field, I checked July 25. Xiao Wang reminded me to eat light and get enough sleep before donating blood. After carefully checking the information, I signed to confirm.
location: Trade Union Office of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: Lunch and study during the midday break
description: At noon, he went to the canteen with Master Sun and Wang Lei, and took out the braised pork and stir-fried seasonal vegetables from his packed lunch. The tempting aroma of the hot meat attracted some coworkers, and Wang Lei teased, "Your mom gave you special treatment again." He smiled and shared some with everyone, and was very satisfied eating it with the canteen's rice and free soup. After the meal, he sat on a bench in the workshop rest area and did 15 simulated questions on spindle servo system fault diagnosis on his phone, focusing on the explanations of two error-prone questions. At 13:00, he got up and went to the bathroom to wash his face, preparing for the afternoon work.
location: Canteen and rest area of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Afternoon work and break activities
description: In the afternoon, continued inspecting machined parts. Found that the inner hole surface finish of one part was slightly below standard. Judging that the insert might be slightly worn, he immediately stopped the machine, replaced the insert with a new one according to the operating procedure, re-set the tool offset, and resumed production. At 15:00, he received a WeChat voice message from his mother asking whether the typhoon would affect the next day's train. He walked to a quiet corner to reply, confirmed via 12306 that the train was running normally, and reassured his mother, then returned to his post to continue working. At 16:00, the canteen auntie pushed a cart over with iced mung bean soup. He took a bowl, drank it standing next to the machine, enjoying a moment of coolness, and meanwhile checked whether the tool changer arm and the spindle drawbar mechanism were abnormal. At 17:00, he tidied his workstation, had a brief handover with the evening shift colleague, and left work.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Swimming workout after work
description: After finishing the handover at 17:00, changed into casual clothes, drove to Songjiang Natatorium. Traffic was smooth in the early evening rush hour and arrived in about 15 minutes. Changed into swim trunks in the car, locked the car after putting spare clothes and toiletries in a waterproof bag, swiped in, warmed up briefly, then jumped into the lane. Swam freestyle for 45 minutes at a moderate pace, about 1.5 kilometers, with two breaks to catch my breath. The buoyancy of the water greatly relieved the soreness in my shoulders. After swimming, took a shower and tidied up.
location: Songjiang Swimming Pool, No. 143 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Buying groceries on the way and helping prepare the meal.
description: After swimming at 18:20, drove home and stopped by the Xingang Xincun fresh food supermarket at the entrance of the residential community. Paid 5.2 yuan by mobile phone for half a kilogram of fresh cucumbers and two scallions. When I got home, I smelled the aroma of braised pork, quickly washed the cucumbers and handed them to my mother, then rolled up my sleeves and chopped the scallions. As mother and son bustled about the kitchen chatting, I mentioned to her that I had signed up for blood donation today, and she kept telling me to eat more pig liver to replenish my blood.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China; and home at Room 402, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road.

name: Dinner and evening family time
description: Dinner was hearty: my mother's braised pork belly, my garlic stir-fried water spinach, freshly mixed cucumber salad, and tomato egg drop soup. At the table, my mother again brought up the typhoon and tomorrow's train. I reassured her while eating that the ticket was confirmed and that I would take her to the station in the morning, and I proactively picked several lean pieces of meat for her. After dinner, we went downstairs and took a walk around the neighborhood. The evening breeze was pleasant, and my mother happily showed off her newly learned WeChat "poke" feature and self-made stickers. I patiently taught her how to add individual stickers, and then we took a sunset photo together and sent it to the family group chat. After getting home, I helped my mother open her suitcase and asked her to check everything against the list: ID card, train ticket, newly bought clothes, cream cake squares and pear syrup candy for the neighbors, and a change of clothes. I used my phone to confirm the 8:00 a.m. train ticket information again and set a 6:00 alarm on her phone.
location: Room 402, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China, and the surrounding community area

name: Before-bed expense tracking and relaxation
description: After his mother finished washing up, Yin Hao returned to his own room. He opened his ledger and wrote down today's grocery expense of 5.2 yuan. Then he opened his technical notebook and carefully recorded the baseline discrepancy found in the morning data comparison and the results of the discussion with Master Sun, and also drew a simple logic diagram. At 22:30 he turned off the main bedroom light and left only the night light. After lying down, he sent a message to his childhood friend Zhang Wei: "My mom is going back tomorrow; I can definitely finish the 15 km run on Saturday." Zhang Wei replied with an encouraging emoji. Thinking of the typhoon his mother had mentioned, he silently decided to bring the asparagus fern on the balcony into the room tomorrow morning, then closed his eyes and prepared to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Room 402, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Woken up by the typhoon and handled the situation of his mother being stranded.
description: At 6:20 a.m., Yin Hao was awakened by the howling wind and rain outside the window. He learned that Typhoon In-fa had caused railway suspension, and his mother Wang Xiuying's train originally scheduled to return to her hometown at 8 a.m. had been canceled. He immediately got up to check the notifications on his phone, then went to the living room to tell his mother the news and reassure her to stay a couple more days and leave after the typhoon passed. Although worried, she reluctantly accepted.
location: Bedroom, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Home emergency preparedness and morning exercise
description: Unable to go out due to the typhoon, Yin Hao completed a 15-minute core workout in the living room using a foam roller and resistance bands, including planks. He then braved the wind to move the asparagus fern from the balcony indoors and checked all the window locks to prepare for the typhoon.
location: Living room and balcony, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to work in the rain
description: Rain was pouring down. Yin Hao changed into his work clothes and rain boots, then drove from Xingang Community to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. With the windshield wipers at full speed and extremely poor visibility, he reached the factory at 7:25 after about 15 minutes.
location: From Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Workshop work and wrapping up to leave early.
description: Yin Hao met team leader Wang Lei and Master Worker Sun Jianguo in the workshop and inspected the two machine tools under his responsibility. At 9 o'clock, a broadcast announced that all employees would leave work early at 11; he immediately sent a WeChat message to his mother. After that, he focused on inspecting the last batch of processed parts, confirmed the dimensions were correct, cleaned the machine tools, and clocked out on time.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returning home during the typhoon
description: After getting off work at 11:00, Yin Hao drove home to Xingang Community through the rain. The rain was getting heavier, but he stayed focused and arrived safely, taking 16 minutes.
location: From No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reinforced the house against the wind with my mother and had lunch
description: After returning home, his mother had already moved the flower pots and chairs from the balcony into the house. The two of them worked together to seal the window gaps with wide tape, dug out an old power bank to charge, and filled large plastic bottles with tap water for backup. Once everything was ready, his mother cooked a pot of noodles and they had a simple lunch.
location: Living room and balcony, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Moved furniture out of the rain and replied to his girlfriend's text
description: After dinner, Yin Hao worried that the broken window might affect the sofa and TV cabinet, so he moved them inward together with his mother. At that moment, he received a caring text message from his girlfriend Lin Yue, and he replied: "Everything is fine at home. Stay safe on your end."
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Emergency response to severe ceiling leakage in the living room.
description: In the afternoon, the wind and rain reached their peak. Around 14:00, water seeped through the ceiling seam in the living room and soon formed a stream, pouring directly onto the sofa. Yin Hao and his mother hurriedly moved the sofa and coffee table aside and used a vegetable basin and mop to catch the water. The leak got worse, and large pieces of wall paint peeled off. His mother, with reddened eyes, complained about the poor living conditions, while Yin Hao handled the situation and comforted her.
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Called the landlord to negotiate and recorded audio as evidence.
description: After taking photos of the leaking scene, Yin Hao called the landlord Li Xiuying, calmly explained the situation, and demanded repair and compensation. Li Xiuying made excuses citing the typhoon as force majeure, even saying, "If you're not satisfied, you can cancel the lease." Yin Hao suppressed his anger, pressed the record button, and told her: "What you said has been recorded. Under the law, you are obliged to ensure the normal use of the house. If you do not take responsibility, I will take legal action." The other side fell silent and then hung up.
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Ask Master Chen Jianguo to inspect the electrical safety.
description: Worried that the leak might seep into the electrical circuits and cause danger, Yin Hao contacted Master Chen Jianguo, who runs an electrical appliance repair shop. Master Chen rushed over despite the wind and rain, used a multimeter to test all indoor sockets and switches, and confirmed there was no risk of leakage. The two then used flashlights to check the corridor meter boxes floor by floor and wrapped two damp wiring terminals with waterproof tape. Yin Hao tried to pay, but Master Chen firmly refused.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the hallway

name: Helped the neighbor across the hall, Chen Xiuying, with emergency water drainage.
description: Just after seeing Master Chen off, Aunt Chen Xiuying, the neighbor across the hall, asked for help in a panic. The sliding door to her balcony had been blown open by the wind, and rainwater was pouring into the living room. Yin Hao and Master Chen immediately went over to help. The three of them worked together to raise the sofa and TV cabinet and desperately drained the water out with mops and brooms. After more than an hour of hard work, the accumulated water was finally cleaned up. Aunt Chen kept thanking them with reddened eyes.
location: Room 403, Building 3, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Do chores around the house and call his parents.
description: After returning home, Yin Hao and his mother poured out the standing water and mopped the floor repeatedly. His mother called his father Yin Jianguo and choked up as she described the leak. After a moment of silence, his father said, "We have some savings at home. We'll help you put together a down payment later—stop renting." Yin Hao's nose tingled and he held back tears, saying, "Dad, I can do it on my own." His father urged him to take good care of his mother first and said everything could wait until after the typhoon.
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Had a video call argument with my girlfriend Lin Yue.
description: Just after hanging up with his father, his girlfriend Lin Yue sent a video request. Seeing the messy plastic sheeting and buckets behind Yin Hao, she asked with concern. Days of stress made Yin Hao lose his temper, and he said irritably, "What's the use of telling you!" Lin Yue burst into tears, saying he always carried everything on his own, and the two had a fierce quarrel. In the end Yin Hao said, "I'm very tired. I don't want to argue. Let me be alone for a while." Then he ended the video call.
location: At the temporary mattress in Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Set up a temporary bed and have dinner together
description: Feeling low after the quarrel, Yin Hao forced himself to calm down. He took an old sheet and quilt from the cabinet and set up a temporary bed on the dry floor of the bedroom. His mother brought over a bowl of reheated noodles with a poached egg in it. Yin Hao ate it silently. His mother sat with him for a while, then went back to her room to rest.
location: Bedroom, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Organize evidence, plan rights protection, and express thanks.
description: Lying in bed, Yin Hao transferred 100 yuan to Master Chen via WeChat to express his thanks and left a message saying he would thank him in person later. He saved the recording with the landlord under a proper name, organized a written record of the water leakage situation, found the phone number of the community legal service station, and planned to consult about the matter tomorrow.
location: Temporary bed, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Listening to light music to calm down
description: His mood was still heavy. He turned on his phone and played soft music. Listening to the wind and rain outside the window, he thought about how awful today had been, but he had done everything he could: comforted his mother, eliminated electrical hazards, kept leverage over the landlord, and helped a neighbor. He glanced at the apology WeChat message from Lin Yue, did not reply, and locked the screen.
location: Bedroom, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Washed up and went to sleep.
description: He got up and took a warm shower in the bathroom to wash away the day's fatigue. Returning to the temporary bed, he listened to the dripping sound and thought about thoroughly cleaning the room tomorrow before going to the community service station. Gradually, he fell asleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 402, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waking up, washing up, and light stretching
description: He was woken by sunlight coming through the curtains and birds outside the window. His shoulders were still a little sore from carrying heavy things the day before. After getting up, he washed in the bathroom and splashed cold water on his face to freshen up. Then, on the living room floor, he did five minutes of deep breathing and simple shoulder and neck stretches, and moved his waist and back.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Having breakfast with mother
description: His mother had cooked small wontons and fried two eggs. Yin Hao took out the pickled mustard he had bought last night from the fridge. The two sat at the table, eating and chatting. His mother said she slept okay last night, but was a little worried about the ceiling. Yin Hao comforted her, saying it would be taken care of today.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Checking messages and emergency preparedness
description: After breakfast, Yin Hao returned to the bedroom to check his phone. Seeing that his girlfriend Lin Yue's last message last night was "I'm in a bad mood, going to sleep first," he sighed and replied, "Good morning. I'll be at home dealing with the water leak today and will contact you later." Then he opened the Tide app, browsed meditation and yoga courses, and thought about trying them in the evening.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Received neighbor Aunt Chen's thanks
description: Hearing the doorbell, Yin Hao quickly tidied up the books that had been left on the floor since yesterday, signaled to his mother to sit tight, and went to open the door.
