Aunt Chen Xiuying from across the hall came in carrying a plate of steaming zongzi and a box of local mung bean cakes, repeatedly thanking Yin Hao for helping drain the water from her home yesterday. Yin Hao's mother politely took them and invited Aunt Chen to sit down for tea. The three chatted for about ten minutes. Aunt Chen asked with concern about the ceiling and said to call her anytime if help was needed. Yin Hao expressed his thanks, and Aunt Chen took her leave.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Going to the legal service station to seek consultation
description: Yin Hao imported the water leak video saved from last night, the chat records with the landlord, and the call recordings into his phone, changed into a clean polo shirt, and walked about 8 minutes to the legal service station inside the community affairs service center. He showed all the evidence to Lawyer Wang, who was on duty, and described in detail how the landlord had been shifting responsibility. After taking notes, Lawyer Wang advised him to formally notify the landlord in writing (via registered express mail) to fulfill the repair obligation and compensate for the losses, and to keep all the evidence. Yin Hao listened carefully and seriously wrote down the key points and the list of materials to prepare in his pocket notebook.
location: Legal service station of the Xingang Road Subdistrict Community Affairs Reception Center, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: On the way home, contacted Master Chen and informed his mother.
description: Leaving the legal service station and walking back to the community, Yin Hao made a WeChat voice call to his mentor Chen Jianguo. He described the condition of the ceiling in detail. Master Chen gave clear emergency guidance: first scrape off the loose plaster, apply quick-drying waterproof coating, then smooth it over with wall repair paste, and recommended buying the "Jintang Bulou" brand waterproof coating. The call lasted about 8 minutes. After getting home, he briefly told his mother about the legal consultation results and Master Chen's suggestions, and listed a shopping list in his phone memo: waterproof coating, sealant, scraper, brush, gloves, etc.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch preparation and midday rest
description: His mother made a simple lunch with the zongzi and mung bean cakes Aunt Chen had brought, along with the leftover tomato and egg soup from last night. Yin Hao ate two meat zongzi and drank a bowl of soup. After the meal, he asked his mother to rest in the bedroom, while he lay on the living room sofa for half an hour with his eyes closed to rest his mind.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the building materials market
description: He changed into an old T-shirt, took his phone and car keys, and drove to “Haojiajia Building Materials and Home Furnishing Mall,” located at No. 318, Lane 12, Middle Rongle Road, Songjiang District, about a 10-minute drive away.
location: Haojiajia Building Materials and Home Furnishings Mall, No. 318, Lane 12, Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Purchase repair materials.
description: He went straight to the hardware and waterproofing section. At one store he bought “Jintang Bulou” quick-drying waterproof coating (25 yuan/bucket) and a matching brush; at another store he bought a scraper, sealant, and gloves (35 yuan total). In all, he spent about 260 yuan. After paying with his mobile phone, he deliberately asked one of the stores for a receipt stamped with an official seal, as evidence for claiming compensation from the landlord.
location: Haojiajia Building Materials and Home Furnishings Mall, No. 318, Lane 12, Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving home
description: Drove about 15 minutes back to Xingang Community and carried the purchased tools and materials upstairs.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Repaired the ceiling himself, then did a deep clean and organized storage.
description: Back home, he changed into an old T-shirt and put on a hat and gloves. His mother helped hold the ladder. Yin Hao first turned off the main circuit breaker inside the apartment, then used a scraper to remove all the loose paint from the water-seeping area on the ceiling and wiped away the dust with a dry cloth. Next, he used a brush to carefully apply waterproof coating evenly over the exposed concrete and cracks. After letting it sit for half an hour, he applied a thin second coat and filled the corner gaps with sealant. When he finished, he opened the windows for ventilation and turned the circuit breaker back on to check that the lights and appliances worked. Afterward, his mother used disinfectant and clean water to carefully wipe down the corners, baseboards, and furniture surfaces that had been soaked. Yin Hao thoroughly cleaned up the water on the floor and put all the moved furniture back in place. The two worked well together—Yin Hao moved heavy items while his mother did the detailed cleaning. About two hours later, apart from a freshly dried patch of waterproof coating on the ceiling, the room was basically restored to its pre-typhoon tidiness.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Personal organizing and replying to messages
description: Yin Hao took a hot shower and changed into clean loungewear. He sat down at his desk and, following Lawyer Wang's advice, drafted a demand letter in his notebook, planning to buy registered mail tomorrow to send it out. Then he replied to the caring WeChat messages from his friends Zhang Wei and Wang Lei, telling them everything at home had been taken care of.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner together
description: Yin Hao walked into the kitchen, saw his mother trimming vegetables, and took the initiative to help wash and cut the vegetables. Mother and son chatted while they worked and together cooked stir-fried water spinach with garlic and stir-fried pork with chili peppers, and heated up the rice dumplings Aunt Chen had sent. The two sat at the dining table, with the TV on as background noise, eating and chatting. His mother mentioned she wanted to go back to her hometown for a visit. Yin Hao reassured her that he would check the train tickets for her tomorrow. During dinner, she repeatedly praised him for being like a man who could take on responsibilities today. Yin Hao just smiled and put food into her bowl.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Family leisure, social contact, and personal relaxation
description: Mother was watching a TV drama in the living room. In the bedroom, Yin Hao made a video call to his father on his phone, reporting on the progress of today's water leak repair and the results of the legal consultation. His father expressed support. Afterwards, he sent a long text message to his girlfriend Lin Yue, explaining that he had been in a bad mood last night because of the leak but had dealt with it today, and asked how her weekend had been. After sending the message, he did a few squats to relax. Then he turned off the room lights, set his phone to Do Not Disturb mode, opened the 'Tide' app, and followed the guide for a 15-minute breathing meditation. After that, he spread a blanket on the floor and did about 10 minutes of simple yoga stretching, focusing on relaxing his previously sore shoulders, neck, and lower back. After finishing, his body felt much better.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening rest and preparation for bed.
description: After exercising, he felt a bit hungry. He went to the kitchen, poured a glass of warm water, and ate half of the leftover mung bean cake from the morning. Back in the bedroom, he organized the receipts from today's building materials market, the lawyer's notes, and other documents, and put them back in the file folder. Lying in bed, he picked up "CNC Machine Tool Fault Diagnosis" and read for a while. At about 22:20, he set the alarm for 7:30 the next morning and reminded himself to buy a train ticket for his mother. Then he turned off the light, listened to the night sounds outside returning to quiet, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Early morning wake-up and preparation
description: The alarm went off at 6 a.m. as usual. After waking up naturally, I went to the bathroom first, then drank a glass of warm water. I changed into the running shorts and vest I had prepared the night before, checked the battery levels of my sports watch and earphones, and made sure they worked properly.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycled to the Guangfulin Ruins and ran 10 km in the morning
description: He took his car keys and road bike helmet downstairs, scanned a Hellobike, and rode along Xingang Road to Chenta Road, then turned onto Guangfulin Road, arriving at the entrance of the Shanghai Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site in about 15 minutes. After meeting up with his running buddy Chen Jie, they warmed up and started running at 6:40 sharp along the lake loop trail in the park, keeping a steady pace of 5:20 per kilometer while enjoying the morning light by the lake. They finished 10 kilometers at 7:28, then did 10 minutes of static stretching together.
location: Shanghai Guangfulin Cultural Relics Park, Lane 3260, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: 25 km road cycling and back home
description: After stretching and saying goodbye to Chen Jie, he took his road bike out of the trunk and expertly put on his helmet and gloves. At 7:40 he rode alone along Shetiankun Highway toward Chenshan Botanical Garden for 25 kilometers. The road was rolling; he pushed through climbs with his thighs and kept an average speed of about 28 km/h. At 8:30 he returned to the Guangfulin parking lot, folded up the bike, then drove back to Xingang Residential Community, arriving home around 8:50.
location: Shetiankun Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the surrounding area of Chenshan Botanical Garden

name: Post-workout replenishment and breakfast
description: After getting home, I took a quick shower and changed clothes, then made a large cup of protein powder smoothie with a banana mixed in. My mother Wang Xiuying had prepared porridge, steamed buns, and boiled eggs. The two of us sat at the table eating and chatting. I shared today's plan to move things out to dry in the sun, and my mother agreed enthusiastically.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Air-dry damp furniture and clothing in one batch
description: After breakfast, together with his mother, he carried the water-soaked mattress from the bedroom and the wooden cabinet from the living room down to the concrete open area downstairs, placing them in a sunny spot to air out. Then he loaded the soaked clothes and sheets into the washing machine in batches, set the quick wash mode, and hung out the first load of laundry. Some damp books were spread flat on the living room floor to air out.
location: The open space downstairs of Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the interior of Room 502

name: Handle rights-protection matters: send a demand letter and purchase mother's return ticket
description: Drove to Xinqiao Post Office in Songjiang District, arriving in about 15 minutes. At the counter, sent the demand letter to landlord Li Xiuying by registered mail, paid a 5.4 yuan handling fee, and safely kept the receipt. Then, at the entrance of the post office, logged into the 12306 app, bought his mother a train ticket for the next day (July 21), train D2212 departing at 14:23 to Rudong, saved a screenshot and sent it to her, then drove home.
location: Xinqiao Post Office, 350 Xinnan Street, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing and having lunch together
description: After arriving home, I prepared lunch with my mother. I warmed up the zongzi and mung bean cakes given by the neighbor, stir-fried tomatoes and eggs, and boiled a pot of mung bean soup. We started eating at 12 o'clock, chatting while we ate. My mother was especially happy when she saw the screenshot of the purchased return ticket.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and personal finance check.
description: After clearing the dishes and letting his mother rest, he lay down on the sofa in the living room and rested for about 45 minutes. Waking up at 13:15, he felt refreshed. He used the mobile banking app to confirm that the 500 yuan automatic investment in the bond fund had been successfully deducted, then, according to the forced savings plan, transferred the 2,000 yuan remaining this month from his salary card to Alipay Yu'e Bao.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon remote skill learning
description: Feeling energetic in the afternoon, he sat at the desk in the bedroom and flipped through the senior technician exam textbook, focusing on the case studies in the spindle accuracy calibration chapter. He made many marks in the book with a pen, and combined the circuit troubleshooting approach Master Chen taught yesterday, connecting the two knowledge points in his mind.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Playing games to relax and spending the afternoon with his mother
description: First, he opened Honor of Kings and teamed up with friends Wang Lei and Gao Zhiyuan for three ranked matches. Although they only won one, complaining and shouting "push" together cheered them up. At 14:40, he went downstairs with his mother to flip the mattress and cabinet that were airing out to continue drying, and checked that the clothes were basically dry. At 15:00, he went back inside, made tea, and chatted with his mother. She said she wanted to bring some Songjiang pastries to her father back in the hometown, so he searched on his phone for her and noted it down.
location: Downstairs of Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and Room 502

name: Finishing housework and preparing dinner
description: At 15:30, I moved the sun-dried mattress and cabinets back to their original positions indoors with my mother. With plenty of sunlight, the aired mattress was dry and warm, and the musty smell had mostly dissipated. At 16:00, we started preparing dinner. My mother washed and chopped the ingredients, while I did the cooking. We stewed a pot of winter melon and pork rib soup and stir-fried a plate of water spinach.
location: The downstairs of Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the kitchen of Room 502

name: Video call with father.
description: Before dinner, he made a video call to his father Yin Jianguo in his hometown, reporting that he had sent out the demand letter today and bought his mother's train ticket for tomorrow, reassuring him. His father said little, just told him to take care of his health and to discuss things more when problems arose.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Warm family dinner time.
description: He sat facing his mother at dinner. The winter melon and pork rib soup was delicious, and the water spinach was tender. They chatted about family matters at the table; he mentioned seeing a striking sports car while cycling, and his mother laughed that he would always be a child.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening leisure walk and contacting girlfriend
description: After clearing the table, he accompanied his mother on a walk through the neighborhood and the surrounding streets to help digest the food, teaching her along the way how to adjust the lighting when taking photos with her phone. When they got home, his mother watched TV in the living room, while he went back to his bedroom. After hesitating for a moment, he sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend Lin Yue asking how her day had been and inviting her to dinner the day after tomorrow. After sending it, he felt a bit nervous.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and surrounding streets, as well as the bedroom in Room 502

name: Evening study and recharge.
description: I made myself a cup of tea, sat down at the desk in the bedroom, opened the CNC technology textbook, and started doing the practice problems at the end of the book to prepare for the upcoming certification exam.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing for mother's return trip the next day and summarizing the accounts
description: 20:30 helped mother do a final check of the luggage for her trip back to her hometown tomorrow, confirming that ID card, ticket screenshot, pastries, water cup, etc. were all ready. 20:45 returned to my room, used the expense-tracking app to record today's expenses: registered mail 5.4 yuan, groceries (pork ribs, water spinach) 45 yuan. Then opened the technical notebook and briefly noted my reflections from today's reading of the textbook.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime meditation and relaxation
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, he turned off the main light and left only the bedside lamp on. Sitting cross-legged on the bed, he followed the guidance of the Tide app. First he did 5 minutes of abdominal breathing, feeling his breath steady, then closed his eyes for 5 minutes of mindfulness meditation, focusing on the calm of the present moment.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting ready for bed
description: After meditation, both mind and body were relaxed. I set an alarm for 6 a.m. the next day, planning to rest and not do any high-intensity exercise. At 22:00 I turned off the lights and lay down. Reviewing that I had enough exercise and handled things in an orderly way today, I felt at peace and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run training
description: The alarm rang on time at 6 AM. Yin Hao did not stay in bed. He washed up quickly, splashed his face with cold water to fully wake up, and changed into a quick-dry sports T-shirt and shorts. After confirming his mother's ticket information for returning to Rudong, he walked about 10 minutes to Xiaokunshan Health Park. At 6:20, he arrived at the park gate and met up with Chen Jie and other runners from the Songjiang Machinery Running Group. At 6:30, they started running on time. The weather was sunny but felt hot, so everyone adjusted their pace and ran steadily along the tree-lined paths in the park. Yin Hao completed 10 km as planned, with a pace of about 5 minutes 25 seconds per kilometer. After the run, everyone stretched together and exchanged recent training experiences. He then walked home slowly to let his heart rate settle, returning to Xingang Community at 7:20.
location: 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Xingang Road and Kungang Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xiaokunshan Health Park)

name: Shower and breakfast
description: After arriving home, Yin Hao took a quick shower to wash off the sweat, then changed into a clean T-shirt and casual pants. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had already cooked breakfast — wontons made yesterday and homemade dried radish. The mother and son chatted while eating. His mother reminded Yin Hao not to forget to take her to the supermarket to buy pastries, and also mentioned that they should tidy up the books and furniture that had been aired out yesterday. The two discussed their schedule for later at the dining table.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Scheduling a repair and putting away aired items
description: Yin Hao first called Master Chen, recommended by the community, to discuss the water leakage and the damaged wall surface. They agreed that Master Chen would come to the door for repairs at 9 a.m. the next day (July 22) with tools. Afterwards, Yin Hao noted the appointment time in his phone memo. Then, together with his mother, he put the books and furniture that had been dried the day before in the ventilated areas of the balcony and living room back in place: he returned the completely dry books to the bookshelf by category, used tools to straighten the cabinet doors slightly deformed by water damage, and pressed them with heavy objects to hold their shape.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Accompanied his mother on shopping and headed to Songjiang Station
description: Yin Hao drove his mother to the Xingang New Village fresh food supermarket near the entrance of the residential community. His mother, familiar with the place, picked out two boxes of Songjiang traditional pastries, a basket of free-range eggs, and a bunch of fresh vegetables, saying they were for his father. After shopping, they drove directly to Shanghai Songjiang Railway Station via Husong Highway, arriving in about 25 minutes. Yin Hao carried the things and walked his mother to the station entrance, handed her the ticket and ID card, and told her to be careful on the way and to send a message when she got home. His mother also told him to eat well and get along well with his girlfriend, then swiped her ID card to enter the station. Yin Hao watched until her figure disappeared past the security checkpoint before leaving.
location: Shanghai Songjiang Station, Songjiang District, Shanghai (passing by Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road)

name: Returned to the factory and reported to work early
description: Drove from the Songjiang Station parking lot back to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, listening to the radio for a while along the way. After arriving at 10:30, Yin Hao changed into clean work clothes and safety shoes in the locker room, put on his work badge, and went to the workshop to check the afternoon production schedule. There was still half an hour before the official work shift began, so he talked in advance with Master Sun Jianguo about the afternoon processing tasks—there was a batch of high-precision valve bodies with strict requirements. With a clear picture in mind, he first went to maintain the machine tool.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon shift work and lunch break
description: Work officially started at 11:00. Yin Hao, Master Sun Jianguo, and Wang Lei teamed up to process valve bodies, with Yin Hao operating the CNC machine and performing first-piece self-inspection. After noticing a slight deviation in one machining parameter, he discussed it with Master Sun and fine-tuned the tool compensation to ensure machining accuracy. At 12:00 they took a lunch break. The three went to a farmhouse restaurant in Sun Island Ancient Village next to the factory and had a bowl of noodles with shredded pork and green peppers, chatting about the newly introduced measuring equipment while eating. Work continued in the afternoon. Yin Hao kept an eye on the machine to complete the final batch of valve bodies. Before leaving work, he carefully checked the workstation, tidied the tools, and jotted down the technical details discovered during the day's machining in his notebook, planning to study them further in the evening.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (lunch break at the nearby Sun Island Ancient Village farmhouse restaurant)

name: After work, shopped for groceries and returned home
description: After work, Yin Hao drove home. Remembering that there were no eggs left at home, he stopped by Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket on the way and bought a carton of eggs, a bunch of scallions, and a pack of noodles. He got home at 17:35 and changed into loungewear.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (via Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road)

name: Tidying up the sun-dried items and preparing dinner.
description: Yin Hao straightened up the books and furniture he had put back in place that morning, took a photo, and sent it to his mother with the message: “Mom, everything is tidied up. Don’t worry. Dad will definitely like the pastries.” Then he started preparing dinner: he washed vegetables, cut tomatoes, fried eggs, boiled noodles, and made a simple bowl of tomato and egg noodles.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening solitude and study
description: After dinner, Yin Hao did not immediately contact his girlfriend, Lin Yue. He first sat on the sofa and played a favorite song on his phone to completely relax. After reviewing the reasons for the three-day cold war with Lin Yue, he went over what he wanted to say in his mind again. At 18:40, he sent Lin Yue a message: 'Are you busy? Is it convenient to video call now? There are some things I want to talk to you about.' While waiting for her reply, he opened the MES app on his phone to review the interface documents he needed to read the next day, and also flipped through relevant chapters of the Senior Technician exam textbook 'Machine Tool Fault Diagnosis and Maintenance' to prepare for the exam.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reconciled with girlfriend over a video call.
description: Lin Yue quickly replied, "Sure." After the video connected, Yin Hao took the initiative to apologize for hanging up last time, admitting that he had lost control of his emotions because of the water leak at home and work pressure. After a moment of silence, Lin Yue also poured out her longing for him over the past three days and the pressure at home. The two talked candidly about the difficulties of a long-distance relationship and their expectations for the future. Yin Hao said seriously, "Give me one year. Before next year's Spring Festival, I will give you an answer." She smiled through her tears: "I'll wait for you. I'm waiting for you to be willing to bear it with me." When the call ended, the heavy stone in Yin Hao's heart finally landed.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep reflection and bedtime
description: After hanging up, Yin Hao calmed down, sent Lin Yue a goodnight message, and then wrote his thoughts in his phone memo: 'In the future, I need to share stress more proactively; the two of us should carry it together, and I can't always bottle it up alone.' He then reviewed 'Machine Tool Fault Diagnosis and Repair' for half an hour. At 21:45, he went to the bathroom to wash up, changed into pajamas, turned off the main light, and left only a small night light. Lying in bed, he did 5 minutes of abdominal breathing exercises to quiet his mind. At 22:10, feeling an unprecedented sense of steadiness and ease, he closed his eyes and soon fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waking and Getting Up
description: The alarm went off on time. You pushed back the thin quilt and sat up; the soreness in your left knee had lessened compared with yesterday. Picking up your phone, you quickly checked the weather forecast, which showed sunny turning cloudy, 29-36°C. You filled your water cup with warm water, and while drinking, changed into running shorts and a tank top, put on your sports watch, and got ready to go out for a morning run.
location: Room 303, No. 19, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run and core training
description: Left home at 6 o'clock and jogged west along Xingang Road to Xiaokunshan Health Park. The air in the park was fresh and there were few people. Ran 5 kilometers on the rubber track at a steady pace of 5:35 per kilometer. After the run, did 3 sets of planks, 2 sets of crunches, and 3 sets of back bridges in the park fitness area, sweat dripping onto the grass.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, Songjiang District, Shanghai (intersection of Xingang Road and Kungang Road)

name: Stretching, rinsing off, and breakfast
description: Jogged home and did 10 minutes of targeted stretching downstairs, especially for the calves and quadriceps. After entering the house, he took a cold shower. When he came out, his mother Wang Xiuying had already served breakfast: mung bean porridge, boiled eggs, and small meat buns. While eating, he briefly discussed the day's plans with his mother and reminded her to take photos when the repairman arrived.
location: Room 303, No. 19, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-departure confirmation and commute
description: After breakfast, I put on my commuting backpack. While changing shoes at the entrance, I reminded my mother again that the repairman would arrive at 9 o'clock and asked her to send a video, take clear photos of the parts, and get an official receipt. Mother smiled and agreed. I grabbed the car keys, went out, and drove along Xingang Road and Kungang Highway, arriving at the company parking lot in 15 minutes.
location: From Xingang Community to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai)

name: Pre-shift preparation
description: After parking the car, walked quickly into the workshop changing room, put on the dark blue work uniform and safety shoes, and checked the calipers and marker pen in his pocket. Then walked to CNC machine tools No. 3 and No. 4, performed startup preheating and lubricating oil line inspection, confirmed that the oil level was normal and the spindle was running smoothly.
location: Workshop changing room and machine tool area of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai)

name: Morning workshop production tasks and first-piece inspection
description: At 8:30 in the morning, Liu Zhiqiang came to you with the new batch of drawings. You performed first-article inspection on the first batch of 20 wind power equipment components on Machine No. 3, using calipers and a surface roughness tester to check key dimensions such as hole diameter, flatness, and roughness, confirming that all tolerances were within requirements. After that, you returned to Machine No. 4 and began machining a complex valve body for an urgent order. Fully focused, you strictly followed the program for tool changes and tool offset settings. After machining each piece, you blew off the chips with an air gun and visually inspected it, avoiding any mistakes.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai).

name: Lunch break and doing practice problems.
description: He went alone to the company cafeteria, got a serving of braised pork chop, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and rice, and finished within ten minutes. Then he found a corner seat, took out his phone, opened the “Technician Question Bank” app, and within 15 minutes answered 22 questions about spindle accuracy and hydraulic systems, taking screenshots of the wrong answers and saving them.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai)

name: Afternoon workshop operations
description: The workshop was a little quieter in the afternoon, and I continued to keep an eye on two machine tools. During processing, I found slight chatter marks at one tool position on Machine No. 4 during fine boring. I stopped the machine immediately, manually made micron-level tool compensation and speed adjustments based on experience, re-set the tool, and only resumed after confirming that the machined dimensions and surface finish were fine. During the automatic tool change interval, I organized an abnormal spindle thermal deformation parameter found in yesterday's data comparison, wrote it down in a notebook, and prepared to raise it at the meeting.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai).

name: Digitalization team meeting
description: Arrived at the meeting room on time with a notebook and the printed data comparison report. At the meeting, I briefly reported on the tool compensation data comparison work completed before the typhoon, and pointed out several potential baseline differences, especially the thermal compensation parameter drift of Machine No. 4 under high temperature. After listening, Master Sun took off his glasses, wiped them, and patted your shoulder, saying, 'Haozi, this time before the typhoon you proactively sorted out the data. It was very timely and avoided many problems after resuming work. You have a clear head and keen observation; this performance deserves recognition.' After receiving Master's affirmation, I felt much more at ease.
location: Small conference room on the first floor of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai)

name: Workshop wrap-up.
description: After the meeting, return to the workshop, perform the final inspection on today's machined parts, fill in the Processing Flow Card, and place qualified and pending-inspection products in separate areas. Carefully clean the iron filings and oil stains around the machine tools, add new cutting fluid to the cutting fluid tank, turn off the machine power, and confirm all tools are back in place.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai).

name: Shopping on the way home after work
description: Punched out at 17:00 and got off work. Driving past Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket, parked the car, walked to the nearby Zhangji Pastry Shop, spent 30 yuan to buy half a jin each of mung bean cakes and glutinous rice cakes, asked the owner to wrap them in oil paper, and planned to take them home for my mother.
location: Zhangji Snack Shop, near No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Arrived home to learn about the repair details
description: Carrying pastries home, mother was trimming vegetables in the kitchen. Before you could put down the bag, she pulled you to sit on the sofa, took out her phone and flipped through photos, saying that Master Chen arrived on time at 9 o'clock today, replaced the entry valve and a section of aging PPR pipe, and pressure-tested twice; the water pipe no longer leaks at all. Together you carefully checked the before-and-after repair photos, the 350 yuan material receipt, and the handwritten receipt from Master Chen; everything was fine.
location: Room 303, No. 19, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Updated the landlord on the repair progress.
description: You took your mother's phone and transferred all the photos and receipts to your own phone. Sitting at the desk, you wrote a message: "Sister Li, hello. The technician came today and confirmed the leak was caused by a ruptured old pipe. The valve and pipe have been replaced at a cost of 350 yuan, and all receipts are available. To completely eliminate this hazard and avoid future trouble, please contact me as soon as possible to discuss compensation for this repair and the subsequent rent reduction." Then you sent the message and all the images to the landlord Li Xiuying's WeChat.
location: Room 303, No. 19, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Plan mother's itinerary for tomorrow and family video call
description: After taking care of business, you chatted with your mother about tomorrow's schedule. Your mother took out the train ticket and confirmed the departure from Shanghai Songjiang Station at 10:23 tomorrow morning. You immediately set an alarm on your phone and said, "I'll take you to the station tomorrow morning. Leaving at 9 is fine; we'll make it." Then you made a video call to your father back in your hometown. On the screen, your father showed a simple, honest smile. You reported that you were safe and told him Mom would be home tomorrow. Your mother chimed in, saying you had bought Songjiang pastries for your father to taste. The whole family chatted happily for ten-odd minutes before hanging up.
location: Room 303, No. 19, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner
description: Mother had prepared dinner: steamed sea bass, garlic water spinach, and tomato egg soup. The two of you ate and chatted. You told her that Master Sun had praised you during the day. She was happy to hear it and urged you to eat well while living alone there and not to push yourself too hard. You ate until full and helped your mother clear the dishes.
location: Room 303, No. 19, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Free time and study preparation
description: Returned to his room, checked his phone, and found that the landlord Li Xiuying still hadn't replied on WeChat, but he wasn't anxious. He replied to messages from several running group chats and friends. Then he took out the textbook and notebook for CNC Machine Tool Senior Technician (Theory), spread them out on the desk, and prepared the evening's study.
location: Room 303, No. 19, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Study senior technician textbook
description: He opened the chapter “Spindle Accuracy and Vibration Analysis” and, combining the chatter mark problem discovered in the afternoon with what Master Sun had explained, carefully read and underlined key points. When he saw the formula for calculating the “spindle dynamic balancing grade,” he took out a calculator and worked through it. After confirming it was correct, he wrote down his insights in his notebook. The 40-minute study session felt very fulfilling, and he gained a bit more confidence in next week’s practical assessment.
location: Room 303, No. 19, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and relaxing.
description: Closing the textbook, he went to the bathroom to wash up. While brushing his teeth, he double-checked the alarm clock for the next morning (5:50). After washing up, he lay in bed, did 5 minutes of abdominal breathing to completely empty his mind, and then turned off the light.
location: Room 303, No. 19, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: On this sultry summer night, you sink into a deep sleep. Today, you did your duty as a worker, dealt with a family problem, and received recognition from your master. You have a clearer vision of the road ahead, and that is the best state to be in. Tomorrow is another new day.
location: Room 303, No. 19, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning activities and breakfast
description: The alarm went off. After getting up, Yin Hao did core training in the living room, used a foam roller to relax his back and the backs of his thighs, and completed three sets of planks and resistance band glute activation exercises, working up a light sweat. After a warm shower, he changed into light clothes and went to the kitchen to have breakfast with his mother, Wang Xiuying, eating hot congee and poached eggs. Yin Hao reminded his mother to check the luggage again, confirmed that the train ticket, ID card, and spare cash were all packed, and agreed to leave on time at 9:20 for Songjiang Station.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organize the typhoon damage list and receipts (Part 1)
description: After breakfast, while his mind was fresh, Yin Hao organized the evidence of the damage caused by the typhoon water leakage two days ago in the living room. He took photos of soaked book pages, moldy sheets, and other items out of the document envelope, zoomed in to verify each one on his phone, and put the 350 yuan receipt from the repairman, Master Chen, into a separate category. His mother, Wang Xiuying, helped him recall details on the side, mentioning that the moldy sheets were newly bought last year and cost nearly 300 yuan. Yin Hao recorded this verbal information on his phone to prepare for compiling a full list in the evening.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute to work and morning MES joint debugging.
description: Yin Hao drove to the factory, playing yesterday's audio course on metal materials along the way to study in fragmented time. After arriving at the company, he changed into work clothes and checked the status of the CNC machine tools. At 8:30, he participated in the joint commissioning of the new MES module and worked with Liu Zhiqiang to collect real-time valve body machining data and import it into the system. When the communication parameters did not match, he used what he had learned to measure the signal line voltage with a multimeter, found a port configuration error, and successfully solved the problem.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Take mother to Shanghai Songjiang Station.
description: Yin Hao asked Liu Zhiqiang for half an hour off, drove home from the factory to pick up his mother, who was already waiting downstairs, and headed to Songjiang Station. On the way, his mother reminded him to watch his diet and get along with colleagues. After arriving, Yin Hao carried her luggage to the station entrance, reminded her to keep an eye on the waiting information, and watched her go through security before leaving.
location: Shanghai Songjiang Station, Songxian Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Continued integrated debugging of MES and daily machining.
description: After returning to the factory, Yin Hao continued to work with Liu Zhiqiang to complete the remaining MES data integration testing, and found time to finish the final processing of an urgent valve body order. Around 11 a.m., Master Sun Jianguo passed by his workstation, looked at the key technical points of the integration testing that Yin Hao had recorded, and praised and encouraged him, saying that this experience would be very helpful for the senior technician exam.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At noon, Yin Hao had lunch with Sun Jianguo and Wang Lei in the factory canteen. Because the weather was sultry, he ordered cold noodles with toppings and seaweed egg drop soup. During the meal, they chatted about funny family stories in a relaxed atmosphere. After lunch, Yin Hao returned to his workstation and, during the lunch break, organized the key technical points from the morning's integrated debugging into his exam-prep notes.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon part machining and equipment inspection
description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao operated two machine tools for parts processing, strictly following the specifications, checking tool wear and machining accuracy every half hour. During a break he drank herbal tea, and used the spare time to check the lubrication and coolant levels of the main workshop equipment, which is his daily habit of preventing breakdowns.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home after work, buy groceries, and organize the typhoon damage list (Part 2)
description: After work, Yin Hao drove first to Xingang New Village fresh supermarket and bought scallions, cilantro, and a bottle of light soy sauce, then went home. He immediately continued organizing evidence of the typhoon damage, backed up the photos, recordings, and repair receipts from his phone to the cloud drive, and used Excel to list details: about 200 yuan for books soaked and ruined, about 300 yuan for a set of moldy bedding, and 350 yuan for repair costs. He filed them into three folders by category, preparing for the negotiation with the landlord the next day.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening swim training
description: Yin Hao changed into swim trunks and drove to Songjiang Swimming Pool. After getting into the water, he warmed up with a few laps of breaststroke, then did freestyle endurance training, keeping steady breathing and stroke rate, swimming 700–800 meters continuously. Along the way he watched and learned technique tips from other swimmers. The 45-minute workout effectively dispelled the fatigue of work.
location: Songjiang Swimming Pool, No. 143 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Barbecue gathering with colleagues
description: After swimming, Yin Hao quickly showered and changed, then drove 34 minutes to Brothers Barbecue on Huajiang Road, Jiading. After meeting Sun Jianguo and Wang Lei, the table was already full of ice-cold beer and skewers. Yin Hao proactively proposed a toast to thank Master Sun for his technical guidance and help on the typhoon night. Master Sun shared his experience in taking the senior technician exam and revealed that the workshop leaders were considering promoting Yin Hao. They also discussed a programming problem Wang Lei had encountered and agreed to go fishing at Dianshan Lake together on the last Sunday of the month. Yin Hao told them he had signed up for the company blood donation event on the 25th, and his colleagues reminded him to rest well over the next few days.
location: Brothers BBQ (Huajiang Road Branch), 894 Huajiang Road, Jiading District, Shanghai

name: Went home and video-called his mother
description: After the gathering ended, Yin Hao drove home, enjoying the pleasant cool night breeze. Once home, he figured his mother had already arrived in her hometown, so he made a video call. He learned that she had gotten home safely a little after 3 p.m., picked up at the station by his father. Yin Hao reported on the progress of sorting out the typhoon damage list and said all the evidence was ready, reassuring her. His mother still reminded him to pay attention to his diet.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening study, contacting girlfriend, and bedtime preparations
description: Yin Hao opened the advanced CNC machine tool textbook and focused on studying the chapter on spindle accuracy inspection and calibration for about half an hour. After that, he sent a message to his girlfriend Lin Yue to ask how her day was, but didn't receive a reply after waiting a while. Then he washed up for the evening, stood by the window and did 5 minutes of abdominal breathing relaxation, used a budgeting app to record the day's expenses, checked the USB drive and notebook needed for the next day, and set the alarm for 5:50 a.m. Once everything was ready, he saw Lin Yue's good-night reply, and turned off the light with peace of mind to go to sleep.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning running exercise
description: At 6 a.m., Yin Hao got up on time, washed up, changed into sportswear, and walked to Xiaokunshan Health Park. Because of the high temperature that day, he hurried to finish his workout before the sun became too strong. He jogged 5 km along the riverside path in the park, taking about 38 minutes, then stretched his leg muscles in a pavilion, paying attention to intensity control, preparing for blood donation the next day.
location: 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, Xiaokunshan Health Park

name: Going home for a shower and breakfast
description: After finishing his morning run, Yin Hao walked back home to Xingang Community. After washing off the sweat, he changed into loungewear and cooked himself a bowl of plain noodle soup with two fried eggs. While eating breakfast, he browsed the news on his phone. Since his blood donation was coming up soon, he kept breakfast light with little oil and salt.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Review negotiation materials and contact mother.
description: After breakfast, Yin Hao took out the document folder, checked the original maintenance receipt, the photos of the water-damaged books and moldy bedding, and the screenshots of WeChat chat records with the landlord. After confirming everything was correct, he put them into his crossbody bag. Then he sent a voice message to his mother, Wang Xiuying, telling her about the afternoon negotiation arrangement and agreeing to have a video call around two o'clock. His mother replied that she would give him full support.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning workshop work and MES wrap-up
description: Yin Hao drove about 15 minutes to arrive at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. After changing into his work clothes, he started the CNC lathe to machine valve body parts, and carefully verified the MES system data transmission. He rechecked the three critical dimensions one by one to ensure they matched the system records. During a work break, he read the PLC programming cases shared by Liu Jianjun and took notes. Team leader Wang Lei asked about the re-inspection results, and Yin Hao reported promptly, earning his approval.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Company cafeteria lunch
description: After the morning work ended, Yin Hao went to the factory cafeteria for lunch. To prepare for the next day's blood donation, he deliberately chose light dishes: stir-fried vegetables, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and half a bowl of rice, eating until 70% full. While eating, he replied to friends' messages on his phone.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Plant, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Requesting leave, handing over work, and returning home
description: After the meal, Yin Hao found team leader Wang Lei to fill out a leave request form, explaining that he needed to take leave for personal matters in the afternoon. Then he wrote handover notes on sticky notes and posted them on the machine control panel, and verbally handed over to a colleague. After completing the formalities, he drove about 15 minutes back to his home in Xingang Community to pick up the negotiation materials and the voice recorder.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video-called mother to discuss negotiation strategy.
description: After arriving home, Yin Hao called his mother, Wang Xiuying, on a video call. He showed her the evidence one by one and repeated the compensation plan: full coverage of repair costs, compensation for damaged items, and rent reduction. His mother added key points, stressing that he should maintain a firm attitude; the bottom line for rent was a reduction of half a month, and if the landlord shifted responsibility, he could mention legal consultation. The mother and son communicated for about 40 minutes, until Yin Hao knew exactly where he stood.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Meet the landlord to negotiate compensation for the water leak.
description: At 1:10 p.m., Yin Hao walked to the meeting room of the residential property management office carrying a document folder and a voice recorder. At 1:30, the landlord Li Xiuying arrived. At first, the landlord shifted blame by citing the typhoon as force majeure. Yin Hao calmly showed repair receipts, photos of damaged items, and chat records, and put forward reasonable demands. Seeing the landlord hesitate, he called his mother on video, and Wang Xiuying gently intervened as an elder. After mediation by the property management staff and nearly two hours of negotiation, the two parties reached an agreement: the landlord transferred 350 yuan for repair costs and 500 yuan for item compensation on the spot, and reduced the month's rent by 800 yuan (original rent 2,500 yuan, actual payment 1,700 yuan). The three parties signed a written supplementary agreement, and Yin Hao kept the original.
location: Meeting room of the property management office, Xingang Community, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home to rest and back up files
description: After the negotiation succeeded, Yin Hao returned home. He first sent his mother a voice message with the good news, then backed up the signed page of the agreement and screenshots of the transfer records to his phone and computer. Afterwards, with a relieved feeling, he slumped onto the sofa, drank plain water to rest, and set a 30-minute alarm to close his eyes and practice diaphragmatic breathing to help relax his body and mind.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-ride preparations.
description: After the break, Yin Hao changed into professional cycling gear, put on his helmet and cycling glasses. He wheeled out his Giant road bike, carefully checked the tire pressure, brakes, and gears, and oiled the chain to ensure the bike was in good condition.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening cycling workout
description: At 5 PM, Yin Hao set off from Xingang Residential Community, entered the dedicated greenway of Songjiang University Town along Wenxiang Road. In the evening the temperature dropped slightly. He kept a steady pedal at about 26 km/h, and after riding about 21 km continuously, he turned back along Longyuan Road. After arriving home, he took a hot shower, changed into a clean cotton T-shirt and shorts, and felt refreshed all over.
location: University City Greenway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Wenxiang Road-Longyuan Road-Guangfulin Road area)

name: Dinner
description: After cycling and showering, Yin Hao prepared dinner. Continuing to follow the light, high-protein principle before blood donation, he steamed a sea bass, stir-fried celery, and had a bowl of multigrain rice, eating quietly alone.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organized the agreement and sent it to my mother.
description: After dinner, Yin Hao took photos of the tripartite supplementary agreement and receipt signed that day, organized them into a clear document, and sent it to his mother Wang Xiuying via WeChat, with a message thanking her for her remote support. His mother quickly replied and told him to get some rest early.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Study senior technician textbook
description: After completing daily tasks, Yin Hao took out the “Senior Technician Vocational Skill Assessment Textbook (CNC Lathe Operator)” and focused on studying the chapter on spindle accuracy testing. He carefully studied the testing methods for spindle radial runout and axial movement, error analysis, and adjustment measures, and neatly copied the key formulas and data into his notebook to deepen his understanding.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Had a voice chat with my girlfriend
description: After a study session came to an end, Yin Hao sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend Lin Yue, excitedly sharing the day's successful negotiation and the evening cycling experience. The two then had a voice call for more than ten minutes, catching up on recent news in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening wash-up and relaxation before bed.
description: After saying goodnight to his girlfriend, Yin Hao brushed his teeth and washed his face carefully, then leaned back against the headboard for 5 minutes of diaphragmatic breathing, focusing on the rise and fall of each inhale and exhale, helping his excited mood gradually calm down in preparation for sleep.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Recording expenses and preparing for bed
description: After breathing relaxation, Yin Hao used a mobile expense-tracking app to record the day's expenses (breakfast ingredients about 5 yuan). He then put his ID card and the printed list of blood donation precautions into the backpack for the next day, and wrote "Blood donation, light breakfast" in the memo of his phone alarm. Finally, he turned off the main light, put on earphones, listened to soft music, thought over the day's progress, and fell asleep naturally around 22:30.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning preparations and pre-blood-donation activities
location: Room 302, Building 5, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Went to the blood station to take part in voluntary blood donation and stayed for observation.
description: He took the car keys, went out, and drove his own car to the Songjiang Blood Station. The weather was clear and the sunlight was dazzling; the car's air conditioning was set to 26. On the way, the traffic radio played Jay Chou's Qilixiang. After arriving at the Songjiang Blood Station at No. 168 Renmin North Road, he filled out a health questionnaire at the guide desk, completed a quick physical examination on an empty stomach (blood pressure and blood count), and after waiting 10 minutes passed. He entered the blood collection area and donated 200 ml of whole blood. The nurse told him his blood type was O-positive. After the donation, he rested for 15 minutes in the observation area, drank warm sugar water, and ate two compressed biscuits. After confirming he felt no discomfort, he received a new Voluntary Blood Donation Certificate and a voucher for a commemorative shirt.
location: Songjiang Blood Station, No. 168 Renmin North Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Return to the company to complete the work handover and take compensatory leave
description: After leaving the blood donation station, drove back to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. While waiting at a red light, notified shift leader Wang Lei via WeChat. After arriving at the company, went to the workshop first to briefly hand over work with Wang Lei and explained the morning compensatory leave request. Then went to the union office on the second floor, registered with the blood donation certificate, and received the nutritional gift box distributed by the company union (a carton of milk, a bag of red dates, and a box of oatmeal). Union clerk Xiao Chen informed him that the half-day compensatory leave for the afternoon had been approved in the system.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Went to the supermarket shopping on the way home.
description: Drove back from the company to Xingang Residential Community, parked in the assigned parking space, then walked about 2 minutes to Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket. He quickly bought ingredients for dinner: one sea bass, two tomatoes, a bunch of scallions, one jin of broccoli, and a piece of ginger, spending about 65 yuan in total. Then he walked home, put the ingredients in the fridge, refrigerated the milk from the nutrition gift box, and stored the red dates and oatmeal in the cabinet.
location: Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: Preparing lunch, having lunch, and taking a lunch break
description: He made himself a light tomato and egg noodle soup, added a few green vegetable leaves, and heated a carton of milk for nutrition. After eating lunch alone, he felt a bit tired from blood donation. He set an alarm for 1:30 PM, drew the curtains, set the air conditioner to 26 degrees, and went back to the bedroom for a nap. He slept fairly deeply and recovered his energy.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Video call with mother and clean up items soaked by the typhoon.
description: After waking from a nap, he felt much refreshed. He started a WeChat video call with his mother, Wang Xiuying, back in his hometown. The two remotely collaborated to clean up items that had been soaked by the typhoon a few days earlier: books that were still usable were wiped with a dry cloth and put back neatly, while water-damaged books, moldy clothes, and the deformed simple shoe rack were photographed for the record and then sorted into two large garbage bags. On the other end of the video, his mother directed and fussed over the phone, while Yin Hao said he would contact the property management over the weekend for disposal.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Tidy up the room and check the drone
description: After finishing the cleaning, he mopped the floor with a mop. Then he took the drone out of the bedroom cabinet and put it on the dining table, checked that the battery had 30% remaining and plugged in the charger, cleared old files from the memory card, used a mobile map app to plan the next day's flight route to Guangfulin Ruins in advance, and noted down iconic shooting spots such as "Underwater Museum" and "Zhiye Zen Temple" in his memo.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Preparing dinner ingredients
description: He began preparing dinner ingredients: cleaned the sea bass and scored both sides, rubbed with salt and cooking wine to marinate; cut the broccoli into small florets and blanched them; cut tomatoes into chunks and minced scallion, ginger, and garlic. He planned to make tomato fish soup, garlic broccoli, and scallion-oil noodles to host Master Sun Jianguo.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Master Sun Jianguo visited, chatted, and had dinner together
description: In the evening, Master Sun Jianguo arrived on time after work on his electric bike. Seeing the packed garbage bags at the door, he sighed about how hard renting was and advised Yin Hao to think long-term and own his own house. The two sat in the living room drinking tea and chatting. After listening, Yin Hao fell into thought and began to seriously consider a home purchase plan. Then Yin Hao served tomato fish soup, garlic broccoli, and scallion oil noodles, and the two had dinner together. Master Sun shared his own experience and pressure of buying a house back then, encouraging him to save more while young. After the meal, he helped clear the dishes and left around 19:15 on his bike.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Check the drone and prepare for the aerial photography flight.
description: After seeing off Master Sun, he carefully checked the drone again: confirmed the battery was fully charged, formatted the memory card to FAT32, updated the GPS ephemeris, and re-confirmed the flight route on his phone to ensure tomorrow's aerial photography plan was foolproof.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Chat online with colleagues and friends.
description: During free time, he made a cup of tea and opened WeChat. In the 'King Factory' group chat, Wang Lei posted about his blood donation; Zhang Jianguo and others gave likes and asked about his blood type. Yin Hao replied, 'Type O, universal donor!' and shared his blood donation experience and precautions, chatting with friends for about half an hour.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Evening washing up, bookkeeping, and relaxation.
description: Turned off his phone and went to the bathroom to wash up. A hot shower helped him relax. Then he took out his expense notebook and recorded today's spending: about 65 yuan on groceries at the supermarket. He lay still in bed for 5 minutes doing deep abdominal breathing to calm his mind.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Prepare items for tomorrow and go to bed.
description: Thinking that tomorrow he would take his mother to Guangfulin, he packed the drone, remote controller, and spare batteries into his backpack in advance, and sent his mother a WeChat voice message: “Mom, wear something bright tomorrow; I'll fly the drone and take pictures of us!” At 22:00 he turned off the lights on time and got ready for sleep. Slightly tired from donating blood during the day and with thoughts about buying a house, he soon fell asleep.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Get up, wash up, and check physical condition after blood donation
description: On Saturday morning, he got up at exactly 7 o'clock. He had slept well the night before, but still felt slightly tired because of the blood donation the previous day. He first drank a large glass of warm water to replenish fluids, then washed up, checked in the mirror that his complexion was acceptable, examined the needle site on his arm from the blood donation, which had basically healed, and the hemostatic bandage had been removed.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Having breakfast with mother
description: Mother had already gotten up early and was busy in the kitchen. Yin Hao took over, cooking white rice porridge, heating up meat buns, and preparing assorted pickled vegetables. Mother and son sat at the table to eat. Yin Hao reminded his mother to bring more water when going out in the hot weather and to wear the newly bought rose-pink T-shirt so that she could take photos. She happily agreed.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Checked travel gear and set off with a backpack
description: After breakfast, I cleaned up the dishes, then carefully checked the contents of the backpack: the drone body, remote controller, three fully charged batteries, a formatted memory card, a power bank, two bottles of water per person, wet wipes, a sun umbrella, and a folding stool. After confirming everything was correct, I grabbed the car keys and called to my mother to set off.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to Guangfulin and parked the car
description: He drove from Xingang Community, went along Xingang Road, turned onto Jiasong South Road, and then onto Guangfulin Road. The route was smooth, and he reached the lake-bottom parking garage of the Guangfulin Cultural Relics Site in about 21 minutes. After parking, he took the elevator to the ground level, passed through Zhuque Gate, and looked for an area suitable for taking off a drone near the lawn on the north side.
location: Songjiang District, Shanghai: from Xingang Road to the under-lake parking garage of the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site at Lane 3260, Guangfulin Road, and outside Zhuque Gate.

name: Drone aerial photography and group photo.
description: On the lawn north of Zhuque Gate, he piloted the drone into the air and streamed the floating roof of the Underwater Museum to his mother's phone screen in real time; she was amazed. He operated the drone to shoot several orbit panoramas, and asked a nearby young person to take a mother-and-son photo with the Underwater Museum as the background. Then, in the shade of a tree, he took several half-length close-ups of his mother, who was wearing a rose-red T-shirt, with sunlight filtering through the leaves highlighting her happy smile.
location: Lawn on the north side of Zhuque Gate Square, Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site, Lane 3260, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Accompanying mother on a visit to historical ruins and ancient sites
description: He packed up the drone and walked along a shady path to Zhiye Zen Temple, where he visited the ancient stone bridge and the release pond, and his mother tossed in a coin to make a wish. Then they climbed Fulin Tower to overlook the whole site. At Bone Needle Square, he explained to his mother the history of the excavation of the pottery and bone needles of the Guangfulin ancestors, and she listened with great interest.
location: The area around Zhiye Zen Temple, Fulin Tower, and Bone Needle Square at the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site, Lane 3260, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and rest at the lake-bottom restaurant
description: Because the weather was hot and my mother was tired, we went to the “Shanghai Xiaolong” restaurant in the underground dining area. We ordered fresh pork soup dumplings, braised pork, Indian aster with dried tofu, and chicken and duck blood soup. My mother was full of praise for the soup dumplings and braised pork. The meal took about an hour, and then we rested for half an hour in the air-conditioned public rest area, where my mother recovered her strength.
location: Shanghai Xiaolong Restaurant and public rest area in the lake-bottom dining zone of Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site, 3260 Lane, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove back home and rested
description: In the afternoon, when the temperature was at its highest, he drove back to Xingang Community along the same route. His mother rested with her eyes closed in the passenger seat, and Yin Hao turned down the music volume. After arriving home, he let his mother rest and drink water in the living room, and put his backpack and drone equipment back in the study, ready for the follow-up photo processing.
location: Songjiang District, Shanghai, from Guangfulin Road to home at Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road

name: Photo Organization, Editing, and Backup
description: Opened the laptop, imported all the data from the drone's memory card. His mother sat beside him wearing reading glasses and watched together. Yin Hao organized the photos and videos in chronological order, selected the best-composed group photos and solo shots, used software to adjust brightness and colors, and slightly retouched the wrinkles on his mother's face. His mother laughed and said he had made her look younger. Yin Hao promised to send them to her phone so she could post them on WeChat Moments, and agreed to print a 12-inch photo with a frame in a couple of days. Finally, he packaged all the files and uploaded them to cloud storage as a backup.
location: Home study at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Rested and called the property management to have the clutter removed
description: After finishing the photo processing, he felt drowsy. He made tea for his mother and let her take a nap on the sofa. He then remembered that the water-damaged items cleared out yesterday were still piled on the corridor windowsill, so he called the property duty manager and arranged for a cleaning worker to help move them at 9 a.m. the next morning, and also contacted the community bulky-waste collection truck for disposal. After that, he made tea and scrolled through the news to relax.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare dinner
description: After resting, his spirits recovered. He put on an apron and cooked by himself while his mother watched TV in the living room. He steamed the bass bought yesterday, made scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and smashed cucumber salad. He also blanched the pre-soaked wood ear mushrooms and bean curd sticks to make a cold dish. One after another, four light dishes with a good mix of meat and vegetables were finished.
location: Home kitchen, Xingang Xiaoqu, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Had dinner with mother.
description: After bringing the dishes to the table, his mother praised his improved cooking skills. The steamed sea bass was tender, and the scrambled eggs with tomatoes were deliciously sweet and sour. The two chatted about neighbors back home while eating. As his mother talked about whose son was getting married and who had a new grandson, the simple dinner time made Yin Hao feel very grounded.
location: Dining room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Casting photos to the screen and interacting with family.
description: After clearing away the dishes, he used a data cable to connect his laptop to the living room TV and cast the day's aerial photos and videos to the screen. Mother and son sat together on the sofa reminiscing. Yin Hao selected nine representative photos and sent them to the "Yin Family Father and Sons" WeChat group. His father replied with a voice message praising them, and his brother liked and commented. He then posted on WeChat Moments with the caption, "A 'flying' view of Guangfulin with Mom! Today is a great day!" His mother beamed with joy at the likes and comments.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Video call with girlfriend Lin Yue
description: While his mother was washing up, Yin Hao went back to the bedroom and sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend Lin Yue, and soon received a video call. He showed her the aerial video clips from the day; she admired the beauty of Guangfulin and said she wanted to go there too after she returned. The two talked about Lin Yue’s recent preparation for the postgraduate entrance exam. Yin Hao encouraged her and shared how fulfilled he felt about donating blood and spending the weekend with his mother. The call ended after about half an hour.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wash up and prepare tomorrow's fishing gear.
description: After the video call ended, I went to the balcony to enjoy the summer night breeze, then took a shower and changed into pajamas. I quickly jotted down today's expenses on my phone (tickets and lunch totaled about 200 yuan), then took the fishing gear bag out of the cabinet and checked the rod case, fish keepnet, floats, and other small accessories. All that was left was to mix the bait tomorrow morning, ready for the fishing outing with Master Sun and Wang Lei.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: After lying in bed, he did not immediately look at his phone. Instead, he picked up the training textbook for CNC machine tool senior technician and read for more than twenty minutes, maintaining a habit of learning-minded thinking. At 22:00 he turned off the light and put down the book, thinking that he needed to get enough rest for fishing tomorrow. Reviewing the perfect weekend spent with his mother, he fell asleep before he knew it.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Early-morning washing up and morning greetings
description: On Sunday morning, I woke up right at 7:30, and the sunlight outside the window was just perfect. I picked up my phone and sent a good-morning greeting to my mother Wang Xiuying, who is far away in Rudong, expressing my longing for her. Then I got up, washed up, and refreshed myself with cold water, physically preparing for the new day.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run and stretching
description: He changed into running shoes and walked to Xiaokunshan Health Park, where he did a 30-minute jog along the park's tree-lined path to relieve stress. After the run, he stretched for 10 minutes in the exercise equipment area. Although he didn't run into his running buddy Chen Jie, he felt calm and physically refreshed.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home for breakfast and handle social affairs
description: Back at the rental, he first took a cold shower, then fried a fried egg, heated milk with whole wheat bread for breakfast. While eating, he proactively sent messages to Master Sun and Wang Lei in the fishing group, explaining that he could not go fishing at Dianshan Lake because of cleaning the room, video-calling with family, and handling the home purchase loan matters. He apologized and promised to treat them another day. After handling social matters, he felt at ease.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Helped remove flood-soaked debris.
description: Went downstairs right at 9:15, and together with Property Master Zhang, carried the rotten wood boards, moldy clothes, and damaged books soaked by the typhoon the day before yesterday from the stairwell to the garbage truck, spent 20 minutes at the downstairs garbage collection point, and finished clearing the leftover clutter.
location: Central waste collection point in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Called to consult about home purchase loan policies.
description: Back inside, he sat down at the desk and called the loan consultation hotline of the Bank of China Shanghai Songjiang Sub-branch. Following the outline he had prepared the night before, he asked in detail about the down payment ratio, the interest rate after adding basis points to the LPR, the housing provident fund loan limit, and the requirements for a combined loan.
