The customer manager answered patiently and specifically reminded him to check his credit report first. The key information was recorded in the memo.

participant.relation: Credit Manager at Bank of China Songjiang Sub-branch

location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Check and verify personal credit report online.
description: He opened his laptop, logged in to the official website of the People's Bank of China Credit Reference Center, and submitted a credit inquiry request through bank card verification. A few minutes later, the report was generated. He carefully checked the credit records and public records, confirmed that there were no overdue payments and that his credit score was good, which added to his confidence in taking out a loan to buy a house.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Study and fragmented leisure time
description: After completing the core tasks, he studied the chapter 'Spindle Accuracy Inspection' in the advanced technician exam textbook for half an hour, then habitually logged into 'Xuexi Qiangguo' to watch videos and answer quiz questions. Around 11 o'clock, he sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend Lin Yue, telling her that his credit record was clear and sharing how he felt.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: For lunch, he made a bowl of noodles with toppings using the tomato and egg stir-fry and greens from the fridge. While eating, he watched CNC macro programming tutorial videos on his tablet to prepare for obtaining the senior technician qualification.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Noon break
description: Drowsiness hit after the meal. After setting an alarm for 13:15, I lay down and napped for nearly an hour to recharge for the afternoon's activities.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Thoroughly clean and tidy the room
description: After the alarm went off, he officially started the big cleaning: first vacuuming, then mopping twice, organizing the wardrobe and folding clothes by category, and focusing on checking the repaired ceiling and electrical circuits and wiping them clean. The desk and guitar were tidied up neatly, and the entire rented apartment looked brand new, ready for the video call with his father in the evening.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Rest and personal tidying
description: After cleaning, he washed off the sweat, changed into a clean T-shirt and sports shorts, and sat on the sofa drinking plain water. He took a photo of the tidy room and sent it to the family group chat, getting likes from his parents; his heart felt warm.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: KTV gathering with friends and round-trip travel
description: He booked a parking space at the KTV in advance using the mobile app and checked the car, then drove to Baoledi KTV at Songjiang Jiuting Plaza. On the way, he called his running buddy Gao Zhiyuan and confirmed that he and Ma Xiaofeng were about to arrive. After the three met up, they sang in the private room to relieve stress, taking turns singing several songs and shouting out the pressure of buying a house and clearing out clutter. The brothers encouraged each other. During the break, they talked about the typhoon flooding and plans to buy a house, and Gao Zhiyuan comforted him warmly. At about 19:40, he paid the room fee with a Douyin coupon and split the snacks and drinks, about 200 yuan. Afterward, he drove smoothly back to Xingang Community, feeling happy all the way.
location: Baoledi KTV, Jiuting Plaza, 168 Huting North Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with father.
description: After getting home, he immediately made a video call to his father, Yin Jianguo, and gave him a full view of the spotlessly clean room he had cleaned that day, especially the repaired ceiling and tidy desk. Then he reported in detail on the loan consultation and credit check. His father patiently gave advice on the down payment ratio and repayment plan, and reminded him that buying a house is a major matter and should be handled carefully. The conversation made him feel more grounded.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and pre-sleep relaxation
description: After hanging up the video call, I washed up, then lay in bed and did a few rounds of abdominal breathing to let the excitement and relaxation settle, creating the conditions for a sound sleep.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Account records and today's review
description: Before going to bed, opened the mobile accounting app to record the day's expenses: about 15 yuan for breakfast ingredients, 200 yuan for KTV, and 10 yuan for parking, 225 yuan in total. At the same time, updated loan policy key points in the memo and created a to-do item for the bank face-to-face signing next week.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Confirm tomorrow's schedule and go to bed.
description: Set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning and put the phone on Do Not Disturb mode. Quickly went through Monday's work plan in his mind, and after confirming everything was correct, turned off the light and went to sleep. Satisfied with the day's shift from tension to calm, he looked forward to the start of a new day.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning Run and Contemplation
description: Early Sunday morning, Yin Hao woke up early thanks to his biological clock, changed into quick-dry clothes and running shoes, and headed to Xiaokunshan Health Park for a morning run. The summer heat made him breathe heavily, but it also gave him a chance to sort out his thoughts. He repeatedly wondered what answer his father would give today about selling the house, his heart a mix of expectation and anxiety.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home, take a shower, and prepare for the video call.
description: After the morning run, Yin Hao returned to his rented room, Room 302, Building 15, Xingang Community. He quickly took a cold shower and changed into a clean T-shirt and shorts. Knowing he was about to have a video call with his father, he tidied up the parts drawings and snack bags piled on the desk and checked his phone battery and signal to ensure a smooth call.
location: Room 302, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and financial verification.
description: Yin Hao simply ate two boiled eggs and made a cup of milk oatmeal as breakfast. He planned to stay at home all morning waiting for his father's call. After eating, he opened mobile banking, carefully checked the balances of his demand deposit and fund accounts, and silently calculated the gap for the down payment on the house.
location: Room 302, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Housework and financial ledger organization
description: While waiting, Yin Hao scrubbed and cleaned the slippers he had worn dirty the previous day and hung them on the balcony to dry. Then he sat down at his desk, took out his ledger, and carefully transcribed July's income and all expenses, including rent, food expenses, and the money he had spent the previous night treating friends to karaoke, so that he would have a clear picture when discussing with his father.
location: Room 302, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Browsing online property listings and waiting for father to contact.
description: Yin Hao opened the Beike Zhaofang app and began browsing small-unit listings under 1,000,000 yuan in the old town of Songjiang and the Jiuting area. He favorited some relatively new communities and old public housing listings. He knew his father's call was crucial, but doing his homework in advance would help with later decisions.
location: Room 302, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Father informs him of the decision to sell the house
description: Father Yin Jianguo called on time and said that he had signed an exclusive agency agreement with a real estate agent in his hometown of Rudong. The house was officially listed that day, and an interested buyer had already scheduled a viewing. He promised to give Yin Hao 150,000 to 200,000 yuan as support for his home purchase once the sale proceeds arrived, but repeatedly urged him to act within his means and not be impulsive.
location: Room 302, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Father-son video call and initial discussion of home purchase plans
description: After hanging up, Yin Hao immediately called his father back via WeChat video. In the frame, his father was sitting in the courtyard of their hometown home smoking. Yin Hao used his phone to show his neatly tidied room, specially displaying the corner of the wall that had been repaired after leaking during a typhoon, proving that although the place was old, he took good care of it. Then he sat down at the desk and held up to the camera the journal recording 80,000 yuan in savings and 15,000 yuan in funds. His father nodded in approval, and the two began discussing the total price, monthly mortgage payment, and area of the apartment. His father advised prioritizing a small unit under a total price of 1 million yuan to avoid excessive pressure.
location: Room 302, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Record call key points and set reminders
description: After the video call, Yin Hao immediately noted down key information his father had mentioned in the memo app on his phone: 150,000-200,000 yuan, within one's means, total price within 1 million yuan. He set a recurring weekly video call alarm with his father for 8 PM every Sunday, and organized the key points of the conversation into a new memo titled 2025 Home Purchase Plan, feeling that the future direction was clearer.
location: Room 302, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and brief social sharing.
description: Yin Hao quickly dealt with lunch using the leftover braised pork from the previous day and freshly stir-fried water spinach. While eating, he sent a WeChat message to his colleague Gao Zhiyuan, telling him that his father had confirmed he would contribute part of the funds for buying the house. The other party quickly replied with a voice message, excitedly congratulating him and suggesting a drink to celebrate next time.
location: Room 302, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and online apartment search.
description: After the meal, Yin Hao drew the curtains and took a half-hour nap. Once refreshed, he used his iPad to carefully filter listings on Beike, setting a budget of 800,000 to 1.1 million yuan. He mainly looked at Rongle Residential Community and Fangzhou Garden in the old town of Songjiang, as well as elevator apartments near the metro station in Huaqiao, Kunshan. He favorited three or four preferred layouts and saved screenshots.
location: Room 302, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Studied mortgage and commuting costs in detail.
description: Yin Hao opened Baidu Maps and calculated the commuting time, fuel costs, and tolls from Xingang Residential Community to Huaqiao and several target communities in Songjiang Old Town. Then, using a mortgage calculator, he assumed a total price of 950,000 yuan, a down payment of 300,000 yuan (80,000 yuan in personal savings, 15,000 yuan in funds, and about 180,000 yuan in support from his father), a loan of 650,000 yuan, and a 30-year term, and calculated a monthly payment of about 3,500 yuan, concluding that the pressure is manageable under his current income.
location: Room 302, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Trying a new option for dinner
description: After researching mortgage loans, Yin Hao went out to get some fresh air. He had originally planned to go to the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road, but seeing it was packed and would require a long wait, he switched to Ah Qiang Beef Noodle Shop on the next street instead. He ordered a bowl of the signature braised beef noodles and a fried egg, spending 18 yuan in total. He ate contentedly, and the owner was very warm.
location: A Qiang Beef Noodle Restaurant, No. 232 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening walk and sorting out home-purchase plans
description: After dinner, Yin Hao walked east along Guangfulin Road until he reached the trail along Sijingtang Creek. As the sun was setting and a cool breeze came up, he sorted out his home-buying logic while walking: the down payment would mainly rely on his father's support; keeping the monthly payment under 3500 yuan was no problem; Huaqiao was cheap, but the commute was too far, so a small apartment in Songjiang Old Town might be a more realistic choice. His thinking gradually became clearer.
location: Greenway along the Sijingtang River near Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Review and reflection, and building a house-viewing checklist.
description: After returning from his walk, Yin Hao washed his face, sat down at his desk, and created a new note titled "Apartment Viewing Checklist" in his phone's notes app. He recorded two initial targets: a 65-square-meter old public housing apartment in Songjiang Old Town with a total price of 980,000 yuan, and an elevator apartment in Huaqiao that was a bit farther from the metro station but reasonably priced. He also added follow-up items such as "confirm first-home buyer eligibility details" and "ask about provident fund policy during the next video call with Dad."
location: Room 302, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Family care and communication with girlfriend
description: Just as Yin Hao was sorting the list, his mother Wang Xiuying called via voice call. She already knew the father and son had discussed buying a house and repeatedly told Yin Hao not to work too hard, to let things take their course, and that health was the most important. After reassuring his mother, Yin Hao noticed that his girlfriend Lin Yue had sent a WeChat message half an hour ago asking how things were going. He replied with a voice message, briefly explaining the progress, and shared his initial thoughts comparing Huaqiao and Songjiang Old Town.
location: Room 302, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Playing games with war buddies to relax
description: Yin Hao logged into Honor of Kings and saw his friend Zhang Jianguo online, so he invited him to duo queue. The two discussed tactics and reviewed the gains and losses of team fights over voice chat. Zhang Jianguo also made an appointment to continue next week. Some games were won and some lost; joking and teasing with his friend let Yin Hao temporarily set aside the pressure of buying a house, and he felt much lighter.
location: Room 302, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Doing laundry and getting ready for bed.
description: After the gaming session, Yin Hao put the quick-dry shirt from his morning run and a few vests into the washing machine. While waiting for the laundry, he flipped through his notebook of MES system study notes and reviewed the tooling debugging techniques he had tackled at the factory last week. After the clothes were washed, he mopped the living room floor. Looking at the tidy room, he felt his life was full and well-organized.
location: Room 302, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Fell asleep peacefully
description: Yin Hao turned off the main light in the room, leaving only a small bedside night light. In the dark, he confirmed the next day's work alarm and project schedule one last time, then placed his phone on the nightstand. Today he had gained his father's strongest support and clarified his specific ideas for buying a house. Although challenges still lay ahead, he felt an unprecedented sense of groundedness and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at Room 302, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: Woke up before the alarm went off, thinking about last night's video call with my father about selling the house to support me, and felt a warmth in my heart. Lying in bed, I stretched, then rolled over and got up. Went to the bathroom and washed my face with cold water, feeling more refreshed. Then went to the living room, poured a glass of warm water, and drank it slowly. By the window, I stretched my legs, rolled my shoulders, and did 5 minutes of static stretching.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing and eating breakfast
description: Took two eggs out of the fridge and put them in a small pot. While the water was heating, made a cup of instant black coffee with hot water and grabbed two slices of buckwheat bread from the shelf. Once the eggs were boiled, cooled them in cold water and peeled them. Took a bite of bread and a sip of coffee, eating the eggs alongside. Breakfast was done in five minutes. Then I washed the dishes and bowls.
location: Home kitchen, Xingang Xiaoqu, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Changing clothes and preparing for commute
description: Put on the clean dark blue work pants and light gray short-sleeved work uniform, and clip the factory badge to the chest. Check the commuter bag: keys, wallet, phone, factory access card, a pack of wet wipes, and a safety helmet. After confirming everything, put on sun-protection arm sleeves, grab the car keys and water bottle, lock the door, and go downstairs.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute by car
description: Drove out of Xingang Community, headed west along Guangfulin Road, then turned onto Huatianjing Highway. Traffic in the Songjiang Industrial Zone during morning rush hour wasn't too congested; with normal traffic lights all the way, it took about 15 minutes to arrive. Parked the car in the open-air parking space at the factory gate.
location: From Xingang Road to Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-shift preparation and equipment inspection
description: After arriving at the workshop, I first changed into safety shoes, put on earplugs and safety glasses. I went to the tool room to get the special inserts and calipers needed for today's new batch of flange machining. Returning to the two CNC machine tools I was responsible for, I turned on the power, listened to the sound of the spindle spinning idle, checked the coolant level, pulled up today's machining program from the server, and checked the G-code. Wang Lei happened to pass by, patted me on the shoulder, and said, “Hey, you're in good form today. This batch has high requirements; keep a close eye on it.”
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Core work tasks: machining and mentoring
description: Officially started work. He clamped the workpiece blank, entered the program, and let the machine start automatic machining. He moved back and forth between the two machines, keeping an eye on tool compensation and real-time measured dimensions, confirming that the accuracy of the first piece was completely within tolerance. Around 10 o'clock, Wang Lei came over with a young guy, saying this was the new intern Xiao Zhao, and asked him to help get him familiar with things. He stopped what he was doing and explained the functions of the key buttons on the operator panel to Xiao Zhao, especially emphasizing that he must never reach his hand through the safety door, and also taught him a little trick for judging blade wear by sound.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and practice questions
description: After the machining was stable, I greeted Old Liu at the next workstation and asked him to keep an eye on it, then walked to the Sun Island Ancient Village farmhouse restaurant next to the factory. I ordered noodles with preserved mustard greens and shredded pork, plus a fried egg. While waiting, I took out my phone, opened the “Exam Treasure” app, and calmly worked through 15 multiple-choice questions on CNC technician theory. After finishing the noodles, I sipped the soup and went through the explanations for the questions I had answered incorrectly.
location: Sun Island Ancient Village Farm Stay, beside the East Gate of Sun Island Tourist Resort, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Noon break
description: Returned to the workshop break room, found a chair in the corner, sat down, and put on an eye mask and earplugs. Although his coworkers were still chatting, his mind had already gone blank, and he soon dozed off and recharged.
location: Workshop break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work tasks
description: Continued working. The machine tool alarmed a few times in the middle; I found that a set of blades had reached the end of its lifespan, so I stopped immediately, replaced them, and re-set the tool. Engineer Liu came over to debug a new program, and I confirmed a few parameters with him. At a little past three, Master Sun came around on inspection, picked up a batch of just-machined parts, carefully measured them with calipers, and nodded, saying, "Well, the precision control is good, but it would be even better if you cleaned up the burrs more thoroughly." I felt pleased and took his advice to heart. Half an hour before end of shift, I started cleaning the iron chips off the machine, oiled the guide rails, tidied the workstation, and wrote up the day's shift handover log, noting clearly the unfinished drawings and tool conditions.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-work drive and a simple replenishment
description: He clocked out and walked out of the workshop gate, hit by a wave of heat. On the way driving home, he remembered that the vegetables in the fridge were almost gone, so he stopped at the entrance of the "Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket" he passed. He went in and bought a small bunch of greens, two cucumbers, and a bottle of unsweetened soy milk, the whole errand taking less than ten minutes. Then he drove the car back to the underground garage of Xingang Community.
location: From Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Lane 213, Xingang Road, then to Xingang Residential Community

name: Recovery jog after blood donation (first day)
description: After returning home, changed into a quick-dry T-shirt and sports shorts, put on running shoes, and started jogging on the tree-lined path downstairs in the neighborhood. This was the first run after donating blood, so I deliberately kept the pace very slow, around 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. I didn't chase distance and only ran 3 kilometers. My breathing was steady, my heart rate was normal, and I felt no dizziness or discomfort. After finishing, I broke a light sweat and felt very comfortable.
location: Internal road, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Taking a shower and preparing dinner
description: When I got home, my T-shirt was soaked through. I hurried to the bathroom for a quick shower, then changed into loose home shorts and a tank top. I washed the freshly bought greens and cucumber, boiled a pot of water, and put in about half a handful of buckwheat noodles. When the noodles were almost cooked, I added the greens and an extra boiled egg from the morning to blanch them. After scooping them out, I drizzled on some light soy sauce and black vinegar—simple and healthy.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening main task: thoroughly screen Huaqiao housing listings.
description: After dinner, he sat down at his desk, opened his laptop, and launched the Lianjia app. He firmly locked the filter to 'Kunshan-Huaqiao' and total price between 1.2 and 1.5 million yuan, looking only at two-bedroom units. He carefully browsed listings in the well-known residential complexes of Vanke, Greenland, and Xinyuan, taking screenshots of the floor plans, total prices, orientation, whether the property met the 'five-year sole ownership' condition, and the distance to Huaqiao Station on Metro Line 11. He paid special attention to nearly new second-hand homes built after 2015, and finally narrowed the shortlist to 5 units, briefly recording their pros and cons in a newly created Excel spreadsheet.
location: In front of the desk at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Online consultation and appointment for house viewing
description: Opened the online chat on the Lianjia app and sent messages to the agents of the two listings I was quite interested in. I asked: 'What is the actual interior area of this unit? How much is the property management fee per square meter? Is the house held by the landlord for over five years and is it the landlord's only home?' Both agents replied very quickly. The agent for one of the listings said it was finely decorated and well maintained by the landlord, and agreed to schedule a viewing for Saturday afternoon (August 2). The agent for the other listing said he would send a detailed VR viewing link tomorrow.
location: In front of the desk at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: WeChat discussion with Master Sun.
description: He sent the floor plan, community name, and a screenshot of the building for his favorite apartment to Master Sun Jianguo via WeChat. Master Sun quickly replied, telling him to pay special attention to the total height and floor level of the building, and reminding him that if it was not the top floor, he should also ask what kind of people lived upstairs and whether there was any risk of leaks or noise. He also told him to search online for the property management reputation of the community, and to include renovation costs in the total budget. He wrote down all the key points in his notebook.
location: In front of the desk at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Relaxation and forum learning
description: He organized the information he had filtered through today into the notebook at hand and drew a simple comparison table. Then he leaned back in his chair and browsed the industry forums 'Mechanical Community' and 'CNC Home' to see if there were any posts about five-axis machining or new cutting tools, hoping to learn something new.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Tidying up and exercising before bed
description: There was still half an hour before bed, so I couldn't just lie down. I laid out the yoga mat on the floor and did three sets of push-ups (15 per set) and three sets of crunches (20 per set), loosening up my body a bit. Then I found and set out the clothes to change into tomorrow, and plugged in my phone to charge.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Turned off the lights and went to bed
description: He set the alarm for 6:30 tomorrow morning, turned off the main light, and left only the bedside lamp on. Lying in bed, he ran through today's plan in his mind: work went smoothly, the recovery run felt good, several properties had been shortlisted, and a house viewing was arranged for Saturday. Feeling confident, he soon closed his eyes.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run and morning.
description: Yin Hao woke up naturally before the alarm went off, and sunlight outside the window was already bringing in waves of heat. He drank a glass of warm water and changed into quick-dry clothes. He left at 06:45 and ran 5 km at a slow pace on the tree-shaded paths in the residential community, controlling the pace at 6'20"/km. After the run, his heart and lungs felt comfortable, and the effects of the blood donation had completely disappeared. Then he stretched for 10 minutes in the community fitness area, and went home to take a shower after working up a full sweat. By then, his mother Wang Xiuying was already busy in the kitchen, kneading dough and chopping meat filling, and she had left him plain congee and pickled vegetables. Yin Hao ate with a sense of security.
location: Inside Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to work
description: After changing into his dark blue work uniform, grabbing his lunch box and thermos, and habitually checking his work badge and phone, Yin Hao left at 07:58. He drove along Xingang Road, took Guangfulin Road, and turned onto Huatianjing Highway, arriving at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory about 12 minutes later, parking in the factory lot.
location: From Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Worked in the morning.
description: Yin Hao arrived at his post at 08:10, changed into safety shoes and put on goggles, and checked the day's production schedule and process drawings. The key task was a batch of high-precision flanges. At 08:30, he started CNC machine No. 2 on time. Half an hour later, intern Xiao Zhao arrived. Yin Hao had him stand by the operating station and guided him in adjusting the finish turning tool parameters, reminding him to slow the feed rate by another 0.02 to avoid tool chipping. At about 10:00, his master Sun Jianguo came by on a patrol, patted him on the shoulder, and asked if he could ramp up production. Yin Hao said he was in good shape. Sun Jianguo gave an approving look at the workpiece, and Yin Hao felt very pleased.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and practice questions
description: At 11:55, after finishing up his current work, Yin Hao walked to the Sun Island Ancient Village farmhouse restaurant and ordered braised beef noodles with a poached egg to replenish his energy. While waiting, he took out his phone, opened the 'CNC Technician Question Bank' app, and answered 12 questions about CNC milling machine tool-change commands. He pondered them while eating noodles and almost got two questions wrong.
location: Sun Island Ancient Village Farm Stay, beside the East Gate of the Sun Island Tourist Resort.

name: Noon break
description: At 12:50, Yin Hao returned to the factory break room, lay down on the folding bed, turned on the air conditioning, set an alarm for 13:20, put in earplugs, and closed his eyes. He got half an hour of deep sleep, which ensured efficient work in the afternoon.
location: Break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon work and equipment maintenance
description: Back at his workstation at 13:20 on time, Yin Hao continued machining flanges and watched intern Xiao Zhao operate for half an hour, pointing out that he hadn't cleaned the metal chips promptly after changing the cutting tool. Around 16:00, the production task was basically finished, so he took the initiative to pick up an air gun and a rag to perform routine maintenance on the old No. 3 machine tool: checking the lubricating oil level, cleaning the chip conveyor, tightening loose bolts. As he worked, he told team leader Wang Lei that machines, like people, need regular maintenance, otherwise they'll let you down at critical moments.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-Work Commute and Jogging in the Neighborhood
description: Clocked out on time at 17:00. Yin Hao drove directly back to Xingang Community. He got home at 17:15, changed into sportswear, and drank some water, then went for his second 5 km jog of the day on the community's tree-lined path at a 6'20" pace. After jogging, he stretched for 10 minutes and returned home at 18:05.
location: Inside Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Taking a shower, helping in the kitchen, and tasting dumplings
description: After finishing his run and taking a shower, Yin Hao walked into the kitchen at 18:10. Seeing that his mother had already wrapped several trays of dumplings, he washed his hands, rinsed the cherry tomatoes he had bought yesterday and put them on the table, then helped his mother turn the dumplings over and arrange them on the trays. His mother turned on the stove to boil water, and Yin Hao was responsible for cooking the first batch of dumplings. Steam fogged up the window. When the dumplings were done, his mother handed him a vinegar dish. Yin Hao took a bite of the pork and shepherd's purse filling—it was savory and delicious—and ate a whole batch first to take the edge off his hunger.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Mother taught mending and tidying up.
description: At 18:45, his mother took out a sewing kit, vacuum compression bags, and mothballs. She sat on the sofa and taught Yin Hao how to sew on a button, demonstrating how to insert the needle and hide the thread knot, and had him try sewing up a seam that had come open on his work clothes. Then she demonstrated how to roll a thick quilt tightly, stuff it into a compression bag, and suck out the air with a vacuum cleaner. Finally, she had Yin Hao organize the T-shirts in the wardrobe by himself. His mother muttered that he needed to know how to do all these things and couldn't rely on others for everything. Yin Hao carefully noted every step and felt a little sad inside.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and a heart-to-heart talk
description: At 19:45, cooked the second pot of dumplings. On the table were steaming dumplings, cherry tomatoes, and eight-treasure pickled vegetables. Mother and son ate and chatted about things at the factory, including the recklessness of the intern Xiao Zhao. After the meal, at 20:15, they sat on the sofa. Mother held Yin Hao's hand and encouraged him, saying that it was not easy for him to save 80,000 yuan, and that the family would help with the down payment, so he should not feel too much pressure. Yin Hao also told her about the house-viewing plan he had discussed with Master Sun, including looking at a house in Huaqiao on Saturday and the total budget. Mother nodded with relief. They agreed to video call at least twice a week, and she told Yin Hao to remind his father to measure his blood pressure regularly.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with father and evening study.
description: At 21:00, his father Yin Jianguo called via video, saying he had repaired a tractor that day and asking if Shanghai was hot. Yin Hao chatted briefly and reminded his father to take care of his health. After hanging up, at 21:10 Yin Hao opened the Lianjia app to check the VR tour and floor plan of another property in Huaqiao. At 21:30, he started half an hour of practice questions for the intermediate CNC technician exam, working through 25 mock questions on process planning, sketching simple diagrams on scratch paper, and writing down common pitfalls.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Tidying up and preparing for bed
description: At 22:00, Yin Hao cleared the dishes and chopsticks into the kitchen and washed them, then checked his mother's suitcase for her return trip tomorrow, confirming the charger and ID card were both there. He then washed up, went back to the bedroom, and set the 06:10 alarm for taking her to the station in the morning. At 22:25 he lay down and turned off the light. Thinking of the dumplings his mother had made in the fridge, he felt at ease and soon fell asleep.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting up, breakfast, and preparing to leave home.
description: The alarm rang at 6:00 in the morning. Yin Hao got up, washed up, and went to the kitchen to pour warm water. He heard movement in his mother Wang Xiuying's room and knocked to confirm she was awake. His mother had already cooked buckwheat noodles and fried two fried eggs. The two quickly had breakfast. His mother, with concern, added another fried egg to his bowl and urged him to eat more so he'd have energy at work. Yin Hao responded and finished eating, then did a final check of his mother's backpack to make sure her ID card, train ticket, and seaweed fried dough twists were all inside.
location: Room 201, No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Drove mother to Shanghai Railway Station
description: Yin Hao drove, with his mother in the passenger seat. Along the way they passed Xingang Road, Jiasong South Road, G50 Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway, and Yan'an Elevated Road; the drive took about 48 minutes. His mother looked out the window and kept murmuring that Songjiang had good greenery. Yin Hao responded while driving safely, keeping pace in the busy elevated-road traffic.
location: Along the way from Songjiang District to Jing'an District, Shanghai, via the G50 Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway and the Yan'an Elevated Road

name: Farewell at Shanghai Railway Station and Mother's Gift of a Card
description: Arriving at the South Square of Shanghai Railway Station, Yin Hao helped his mother carry her backpack at the station entrance. Amid the noisy crowd, his mother took out a bank card from her inner pocket and pressed it into his hand, saying in a trembling voice that there was 30,000 yuan of her nest egg in the card to help him with the down payment. Yin Hao took the card and hugged his mother tightly, tears rolling down his face. His mother patted his back, wiped her own eyes, urged him to hurry back, then turned and merged into the crowd to enter the station. Yin Hao stood there watching until her figure disappeared, then went to the parking lot to calm his emotions.
location: South Square entrance and parking lot of Shanghai Railway Station, 303 Moling Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai.

name: Drove home alone
description: Returned the same way from Shanghai Railway Station, driving along Yan'an Elevated Road, G50 Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway, and Jiasong South Road for about 48 minutes. Yin Hao drove alone, recalling the tidy room his mother had left behind and the smell of cooking oil. He turned on traffic radio and forced himself to pull his thoughts back to work, realizing that although his mother had returned to Nantong, he had to work even harder to fight for buying a house.
location: Along the way from Jing'an District, Shanghai to Songjiang District, passing the Yan'an Elevated Road and the G50 Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway.

name: Arrive home, tidy up, and report that I'm safe
description: Returning to Xingang Community, Yin Hao went upstairs and faced the empty living room. He first put the bank card his mother gave him into a drawer, took a photo of the note reading “Mom’s backing,” and tucked it into the book CNC Machine Tool Programming and Operation (Advanced). Then he sent WeChat messages to his father and his girlfriend Lin Yue, telling them that his mother had boarded safely and that he was going to work as usual in the afternoon.
location: Room 201, No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Commute to the factory and pre-shift preparation
description: Yin Hao changed into his work uniform, picked up his factory badge and keys, and drove 15 minutes to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. After swiping his card into the workshop, he walked to his workstation to check the day's air duct part drawings and production schedule, confirmed that the cutting tools and blanks were in place, and got ready to start work.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning CNC machining and mentoring apprentices
description: Yin Hao put on noise-canceling earplugs, started two CNC machine tools, and focused on the control panel parameters. He used calipers and gauges to measure the first piece to ensure accuracy, then proceeded with batch machining. Team leader Wang Lei came over to ask how the morning errands went, and Yin Hao said everything was handled. Intern Xiao Zhao brought drawings and asked about arc chamfer programming commands. Yin Hao stopped what he was doing and patiently explained three programming approaches against the drawings.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch commute and meal
description: During the lunch break, Yin Hao drove about 9 minutes to the Sun Island Ancient Village Farmhouse Restaurant, sat down in a corner, and ordered a shredded pork with green peppers rice bowl. He ate it quickly, thinking that in the afternoon he needed to keep a close eye on the intern Xiao Zhao to avoid defective products.
location: Sun Island Ancient Village Farm Stay, beside the East Gate of Sun Island Tourist Resort, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Workshop lunch break.
description: Yin Hao returned to the workshop rest room, folded his coat into a pillow, leaned against the back of the chair, and rested with his eyes closed. The image of his mother giving him a card that morning flashed through his mind, and he silently told himself to work hard and not let her down.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon high-intensity work and equipment maintenance
description: The afternoon task was intense. Yin Hao monitored two machine tools at the same time and squeezed in time to guide Xiao Zhao on changing and aligning tools, repeatedly emphasizing safety operating procedures. When the coolant nozzle of one machine blocked and triggered an alarm light, he cleared it with a wire and restored normal operation. Master Sun Jianguo spot-checked the finished parts' chamfer dimensions, nodded, and praised him for his progress and steady demeanor. Before leaving work, Yin Hao cleaned and lubricated the machine tools and carefully filled out the daily production record.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Shopping after work and going home
description: He turned off the machine tool, changed out of his work clothes, and clocked out. Yin Hao drove for about 15 minutes to the Xingang New Village fresh food supermarket, selected a bunch of baby bok choy and a few tomatoes, and planned to have them with the dumplings his mother had made. After shopping, he walked for less than 5 minutes back to his home in Xingang Community.
location: Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, then walk to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road.

name: Dinner preparation and commemorative photos
description: After returning home, Yin Hao boiled water and cooked frozen dumplings, while washing and stir-frying some bok choy. When the meal was served, he took a photo of the steaming dumplings and sent it to his father with the message, “Mom’s dumplings are delicious.” After eating, he washed the dishes and wiped down the stove, keeping things tidy even when alone.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 201, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Resting in the living room and processing emotions.
description: Yin Hao leaned back on the sofa, opened his phone's photo album, and repeatedly looked at the photo he took that morning of the note reading “The confidence Mom gives me.” His heart felt both bittersweet and warm. He did not act immediately; he sat quietly and let the emotions flow. In his mind, he began to formulate a home-buying action plan, realizing that what his mother had given him was not just money, but trust and love.
location: Living room, Room 201, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Online apartment viewing and financial calculations
description: Yin Hao opened the Lianjia app, reviewed the listings in Huaqiao that he was going to see on Saturday, and recorded the floor plans, total price, and monthly mortgage into his memo. Then he searched for other listings in the same complex to compare listing prices, used a mortgage calculator, and repeatedly calculated his mother's 30,000 yuan together with his own savings and the support his father had promised, confirming that the down payment gap was narrowing.
location: Living room, Room 201, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Create a home purchase sprint log
description: Sitting at the desk, Yin Hao created a new note titled 'Home-Buying Sprint' in his phone's memo app. He recorded in detail the scene and emotion of his mother giving him her card that morning, organized his currently available funds by category, estimated the down payment and taxes for a property in Huaqiao, calculated the exact shortfall, and listed a target list of viewings for August. He pinned the property to be viewed on Saturday with notes on details that needed to be confirmed.
location: At the desk in Room 201, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with mother to stay connected with family
description: Yin Hao made a video call to his mother, Wang Xiuying, and asked whether she had had a smooth trip and whether she felt carsick. Seeing that he was in good spirits, she felt relieved. He reported that work went well that day and the dumplings were delicious. His mother smiled, gave a few words of advice, and told him to rest early. After hanging up, he also sent his father a message briefly updating him on the day's progress and the Saturday house-viewing arrangement.
location: Bedroom, Room 201, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Yin Hao went to the bathroom to take a hot shower, washing away the day's sweat and dust. After washing up, he changed into clean home clothes and prepared and placed tomorrow's work clothes and keys on the nightstand in the bedroom.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 201, Building 15, Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reading before bed and thinking until falling asleep
description: Leaning against the headboard, Yin Hao browsed the local forum for the Huaqiao New Town area on his phone, reading netizens' comments on the future community, and silently calculated the down payment and monthly mortgage. At 23:00, he turned off his phone, turned off the light, lay down, and fell asleep under the starlight with confidence in the future. Today is a new beginning.
location: On the bed, Room 201, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning core training and stretching
description: Got up early in the morning; since the weather was hot, I chose to do 15 minutes of core strength training and full-body stretching in the bedroom to prepare for the day's work and life.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 7, Xingang Residential Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Took a shower, had a simple breakfast, and contacted family.
description: After a quick shower, he cooked the pork and shepherd's purse dumplings his mother had left as breakfast and made a glass of milk. Before eating, he took a photo and sent it to the family group chat. He received a caring voice message from his mother, and after replying, he felt warm inside.
location: Room 302, Building 7, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute by car and call Mom back
description: After clearing the dishes, he drove to work, called his mother via car Bluetooth, told her about today's plans, and chatted about his father's condition. He hung up as he approached the factory.
location: Xingang Road to Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (in the car)

name: Arrived at the factory and did pre-shift preparations
description: Arrived at the parking lot of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory at exactly 7:00. After entering the workshop, he changed into work clothes, put on safety equipment, checked the coolant and lubricating oil of the CNC machine tools, and verified the processing drawings and tool preparation.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning workshop operations
description: At 8 o'clock, I started the machine tool on time and focused intensely on high-precision part machining. Midway, I checked the blade wear and replaced it in time. My colleague Master Sun measured the finished parts with calipers and gave his approval, which boosted my confidence at work.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and a quick look at rental listings.
description: After work, drove to Sun Island Ancient Village Farmhouse Restaurant, ordered a braised pork rice and seaweed egg drop soup. While waiting for the food, used the Lianjia app to search for two-bedroom listings in Songjiang, focusing on old residential neighborhood layouts near the university town with a total price within 1.5 million yuan.
location: Sun Island Ancient Village Farm Stay, beside the East Gate of Sun Island Tourist Resort, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Noon break
description: After lunch, he drove back to the factory rest area and rested with his eyes closed on a recliner for 20 minutes to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: Rest area of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

After finishing, I was exhausted, but the pent-up frustration in my heart had been relieved a lot.

name: Purchased a sports drink at a convenience store
description: After the run, I walked into the Lawson convenience store at the entrance of the sports center to buy a sports drink to replenish electrolytes. Just as I picked up the drink and turned around, I ran into Liu Zhiqiang, who was also wearing running gear. We both froze for a moment, and the atmosphere was awkward. In the end, we nodded at each other and paid separately. With that, the little bit of relief from the run disappeared.
location: Lawson convenience store at the gate of Songjiang Sports Center, 145 Middle Rongle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

While eating the simple meal, he checked the evening weather forecast on his phone and confirmed that it wouldn't rain that night.
location: No. 15, Xingang Residential Area, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening study of PLC programming
description: I opened GX Works2 software and a PLC tutorial on my computer. Today's goal was to learn to write a material handling program using SFC (Sequential Function Chart). I gradually understood the concepts of 'step', 'transition condition', and 'action', and wrote simulation code following the tutorial. Watching the states on the ladder diagram switch one by one according to the logic I had set, the agitation in my heart was temporarily shut out.
location: Study, Building 15, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Stretching and preparing items for tomorrow
description: Closed the laptop and did post-run stretching in the living room, focusing on relaxing the front thighs and calf muscles. Returned to the bedroom, hung up the work clothes to wear tomorrow, and made sure the phone charging cable and keys were in their usual places.
location: Living room and bedroom, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep review and calming emotions.
description: Lying in bed, my mind began to uncontrollably think back to everything that had happened during the day. Took out my phone and opened the chat history with Lin Yue; the screen was still on the message from three days ago: 'Let's both calm down.' My finger hovered over the input box, hesitated for a moment, but in the end I put down the phone and didn't send a message.
location: Bedroom 15, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Set the alarm and prepare for sleep
description: He set the alarm for 6:15 tomorrow morning. Closing his eyes, his mind was still going over the structure of that SFC program. Physical fatigue and mental drowsiness intertwined, and his awareness gradually faded. That's enough for today; I'll deal with it tomorrow.
location: Bedroom 15, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wash-up and weighing
description: The 6:00 alarm went off right on time. Yin Hao rolled out of bed and stepped on the scale first, which showed 73.2 kg. He hadn't drunk much water after yesterday's run, so his weight was unchanged. After washing his face and brushing his teeth, he looked at his calm eyes in the mirror and decided to perk up today and finish the MES interface verification.
location: Bedroom and bathroom of the rented apartment, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run 5 kilometers.
description: When he went out, he found the sky overcast but the air humid and stuffy, which was suitable for running. Yin Hao jogged to Xiaokunshan Health Park and started at his normal pace. A few elderly people were doing tai chi in the park. He ran two laps and completed 5 kilometers in 27 minutes. Sweat soaked his T-shirt, but after the run he felt less tight in the chest.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Shower, breakfast, and commute preparation.
description: After running, he went home and immediately took a shower, then changed into clean work clothes. For breakfast, he cooked the four leftover frozen dumplings from last night and ate them with plain boiled water. He checked the USB drive and notebook he had brought home from the factory yesterday and put them in his work bag, ready to start testing directly in the workshop in a little while.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Residential Area, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Commute by car
description: Driving on the road, there was no traffic jam. He listened to the morning news while mentally planning how to arrange the testing and machining tasks for the day. He arrived at the factory in a bit over fifteen minutes and parked the car in his usual spot.
location: On the way from Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway.

name: Pre-shift independent testing of the conservative MES interface plan.
description: After changing into his work clothes, Yin Hao walked straight to the test bench, plugged in the USB drive, and launched the conservative MES interface test program that had been backed up yesterday. Taking advantage of the quiet workshop with machines not yet fully on, it was the perfect time to run a round of baseline data. The program started smoothly, and the data on the monitoring panel fluctuated within a normal range, making him feel more at ease.
location: Workshop test bench, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Focused on machining gears in the morning.
description: At the 8:30 pre-shift meeting, Wang Lei assigned the machining tasks for two specifications of gears, with slightly higher precision requirements than before. After the meeting, Yin Hao immediately returned to the No. 3 milling machine, clamped the workpiece according to the drawing, aligned the tool, and started the machining program. He put on earplugs and safety goggles and watched the tool cutting path with full concentration, keeping his usual pace. After every few workpieces were machined, he carefully measured and recorded the data with a vernier caliper. The workshop was filled only with the sounds of metal cutting and machine operation.
location: Milling Machine No. 3, workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and data verification.
description: At 11:30 the lunch break bell rang. Wang Lei called everyone to eat, and Yin Hao said he had brought his own. Once most people had left, he walked to the test station in the corner of the workshop. The MES interface program was still running stably; he pulled up the operation logs from the previous two hours and found no packet loss or delays. He took out his homemade yuxiang shredded pork rice bowl and ate quickly while keeping an eye on the real-time curves on the screen to make sure everything was normal.
location: Workshop test bench, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break
description: After eating, the program continued running in the background. Yin Hao lay down on the hard bed in the break room, covered his face with his coat, and closed his eyes to rest. He stopped thinking about yesterday's argument and only focused on finishing the remaining workpieces in the afternoon and organizing the test data into a report. He slept for about forty minutes, woke up and washed his face, and felt much more refreshed.
location: Workshop break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon machining and data monitoring
description: In the afternoon, he continued machining the second batch of gears. The feel was steady, and he made no mistakes at all. Every hour, Yin Hao went to the test bench to glance at the program log, and the data still looked great. In the afternoon, Wang Lei came over for an inspection and asked about the test situation. Yin Hao answered briefly: "Stable. The data ran two rounds, no problems." Wang Lei nodded, patted him on the shoulder, and walked away.
location: No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai - Milling Machine No. 3 and test bench at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory.

name: Wrapping up and filling in the shift log.
description: At 17:00, all machining tasks were completed. Yin Hao carefully cleaned the chips off the milling machine, oiled the guide rails, and put the tools back in place. Then he filled in the shift log book in detail with the day's machining quantities and measurement data, and specifically noted the MES interface test results: 'Conservative approach; after continuous operation for more than 4 hours, the interface transmission is stable and the data shows no anomalies.'
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting Off Work and Buying Dinner
description: He drove away from the factory; he didn't want to cook today. He turned onto Xingang Road and stopped in front of the Sichuan restaurant he often visited. He went in, greeted the owner, and ordered the usual: a takeout yuxiang shredded pork over rice. The owner was quick and had it done in a few minutes. He carried the food container back to the car and drove back to the community in two minutes.
location: Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, 232 Xingang Road, Dagang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the trip to and from Xingang Community

I poured the takeout rice dish onto a plate, heated it in the microwave, and opened a can of iced Coke, eating while scrolling through my phone. Seeing that my older brother Yin Tao had sent another message, still the same old "be more proactive" talk, I frowned and swiped the notification away, too lazy to reply.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Residential Area, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Search online for PLC study materials
description: After dinner, Yin Hao did not start hands-on practice immediately. Instead, he turned on his computer and searched online for practical cases involving Mitsubishi FX-series PLC timer and counter instructions. He browsed debugging experience shared by veteran engineers on forums and felt he had a deeper understanding of the real-world application scenarios of basic instructions. It took him nearly an hour.
location: Study room, rental apartment, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Systematically studied PLC basic instructions and simulation practice.
description: After getting ready, Yin Hao opened 'PLC Programming: From Beginner to Mastery' and launched the GX Works2 simulation software. Starting from the most basic self-locking circuit, he gradually built control circuits with delayed start and timed counting functions. In the ladder diagram, he wrote a program simulating material handling, using timers to control the start and stop of the conveyor belt and counters to tally the number of workpieces moved. The program was downloaded to the simulation software and ran successfully. Watching the values on the monitoring screen change as expected, a sense of fulfillment temporarily outweighed all his other unhappiness.
location: Study room, rental apartment, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: WeChat chat with running friend Chen Jie
description: Just as I was about to close my laptop, my phone lit up. It was a message from my running buddy Chen Jie: 'Haozi, why haven't I seen you out running the past two mornings?' Yin Hao typed back: 'Lots of work at the factory, and I've been in a bad mood.' Chen Jie quickly replied: 'Then come out for a run this weekend. Let's log a long run over near East China Normal University to clear your head!' Seeing that, I did feel a warmth in my heart, and I replied, 'OK, we'll see then.'
location: Study room, rental apartment, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Stretching before bed and getting ready for tomorrow

Then he walked into the bedroom, hung up the work clothes for tomorrow, plugged in his phone to charge, and checked his work bag to make sure the USB drive and notepad were both there.
location: Living room and bedroom of the rental apartment, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xingang Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Nighttime sleep

The MES interface test went well, and he learned something new about PLC. Although a corner of his heart still felt a faint emptiness, at least the day had been solid. He set the alarm for 6:00 the next morning, adjusted his sleeping position, and slowly drifted off to sleep amid the plainness and a hint of fatigue.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment at Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

location: Room 305, Building 5, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

location: Room 305, Building 5, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

Wang Lei made the final decision and confirmed it.

Wang Lei asked about the operation of the mixing plan, and Yin Hao replied that the data was okay, with a few points fluctuating, and he would keep an eye on and adjust tomorrow.

description: Solo reflection and the decision to buy a home

Zhang Wei comforted him while controlling his hero, advising him to take the initiative to buy a small gift to make things up with her and not to be stubborn. After talking, Yin Hao felt a bit better.
