location: Bedroom, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pick up packages and share local specialties with neighbors.
description: After answering the courier's call, I went downstairs and took out the large styrofoam box my mother had sent from the Hive Box locker. Inside were vacuum-packed dried clams and hometown pickled vegetables. I opened it in the hallway, packed a small bag of pickled vegetables, and knocked on Aunt Chen's door across the hall. Aunt Chen took the pickles and thanked me repeatedly, and gave me a box of homemade mung bean cakes in return.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: PLC ladder diagrams and SFC program writing
description: After returning to the study, he felt full of energy. Following the flow chart drawn in the morning, he inserted contacts, coils, and timers one by one in GX Works2, and wrote the signal switching logic for the main road and branch roads module by module. After writing it, he added function modules for the emergency stop button and fault alarm light to the program. The whole process was very focused.
location: Study room, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon rain shower, balcony rest, and contacting Lin Yue
description: I had just finished writing the emergency stop function when a sudden shower started outside the window. I walked to the balcony, and the drizzle blown by the wind felt cool on my face. Leaning against the railing, I watched raindrops hit the leaves and spaced out for a few minutes. I took out my phone, hesitated, then sent Lin Yue a message: 'It's raining in Shanghai today. How did your weekend go?' After sending it, I put the phone back in my pocket.
location: Balcony, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: PLC simulation debugging and project backup
description: The rain was still falling, but my mind had already returned fully to the project. I started the simulation function and ran the program. On the first run, I found that the switching time between the green light and the yellow light was off, so I immediately checked and corrected the timer parameters. On the second run, the program looped stably, and the emergency stop and fault alarm functions passed the test. I captured the waveform graphs and variable monitoring screens and saved them. Finally, I compressed the entire project file and backed it up to the computer's D drive and a USB flash drive.
location: Study room, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner: reheated tomato and egg soup noodles
description: After finishing work, I got hungry right on time. I took out the leftover half pot of tomato egg noodle soup from yesterday, washed a few greens, and threw them in to heat up. While eating the noodles, I glanced at my phone. Lin Yue still hadn't replied. I sighed inwardly but didn't think more about it.
location: Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai - Kitchen

name: Browsing industrial control forums and chatting with friends in a group.
description: After dinner, he leaned back in his chair and browsed the 'Industrial Control Home' forum, bookmarking several posts about structured design of PLC programs. Later, the 'Songjiang Three Brothers' group chat became lively. Lao Gao posted photos of his catch from fishing at Dianshan Lake, and Xiao Ma started teasing. Yin Hao also chimed in, talking about how he had gotten the traffic light program working today. Lao Gao and Xiao Ma both sent 'awesome' sticker packs. They chatted until 8 o'clock, and then the group gradually quieted down.
location: Study room, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organize PLC study notes
description: Opened a Word document and used a table to consolidate recent learning: ladder diagrams, SFC instructions, common timer/counter functions, data transfer instructions, and insights from today's project. He also added key points from earlier simulations of motor forward/reverse rotation and material handling cases, marking common pitfalls and precautions. Finally, he saved the document to a USB drive and renamed it "PLC_Final_Exam_Prep_Summary_Yin_Hao_20250809".
location: Study room, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening washing up, stretching, and tomorrow's plan
description: Took a hot shower and blow-dried hair. Did ten minutes of stretching on the bedroom floor, focusing on neck and lower back. Then wrote tomorrow's plan in phone memo: review today's project and run the simulation again in the morning, go to Xingang New Village fresh market in the afternoon to restock, and study the half-marathon manual borrowed from Chen Jie in the evening.
location: Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai - Bathroom/Bedroom

name: Preparing for sleep
description: After stretching, I felt my body sending a signal that it wanted to rest. I glanced at my phone; Lin Yue's chat window still had no activity. I put down the phone and turned off the main light. I reviewed in my mind the project that had gone smoothly today and felt a strong sense of accomplishment. Maybe because my brain had been working too hard during the day, drowsiness came over me within a few minutes, and I officially fell asleep at 23:00.
location: Bedroom, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: He woke up naturally before the alarm went off. The rental room was a bit stuffy, and outside the window the sky was just beginning to lighten. He decided to set off for fishing. After a quick wash, he changed into a quick-dry T-shirt and sports shorts and did 5 minutes of stretching in the living room to loosen up. Then he picked up his fishing gear bag, tackle box, and the bait he had mixed last night from the balcony, checked them one by one, carried them downstairs, and loaded them into the car.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Drive to Dianshan Lake
description: He drove a white Volkswagen Lavida from Xingang Community to Dianshan Lake in Qingpu District. Early in the morning, there was little traffic on the road. He rolled down the window, and the morning breeze carried moisture. The navigation guided him along the G50 Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway, which would take about 30 minutes. He was thinking about today's fishing tactics, with Lin Yue occasionally flashing through his mind, but he soon shook his head and refocused.
location: On the drive from Xingang Residential Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to the west bank of Dianshan Lake, Zhujiajiao Town, Qingpu District

name: Early morning fishing at Dianshan Lake.
description: Arriving at the lake, the warm morning light spread across the water. He deftly set up the tackle box, prepared the bait, and cast the rod into the water. Fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang was not far away; he smiled and nodded, and they tacitly stayed quiet. All morning he watched the float and successfully caught 5 wild crucian carp, quite large ones. The lake breeze carried the smell of waterweed and fish, and the gloom in his heart seemed to dissolve.
location: West shore of Dianshan Lake, Zhujiajiao Town, Qingpu District, Shanghai (old fishing spot)

name: Drove back to Xingang Community
description: The sun was starting to get strong. I packed up the fishing gear, said goodbye to Brother Wu, and drove back. The car stereo played old songs, and I hummed along, feeling much lighter than when I came. Exiting the highway, at the ramp I glanced in the rearview mirror at the Dianshan Lake guide sign growing smaller.
location: During the drive from Dianshan Lake in Qingpu District to Xingang Community in Songjiang District

name: Handling the catch and organizing fishing gear
description: At the public faucet downstairs, he gutted and scaled 5 crucian carp, packed them separately in fresh-keeping bags, and froze them. He kept two for steaming tomorrow and gave the rest away. Then he brought out all the fishing gear, carefully rinsed the fishing rods and reels to make sure no sand or mud remained, dried them one by one, and left them on the balcony to air. He did this process meticulously; tools are partners, so they must be taken care of.
location: Beside the public faucet outside Building 5 of Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the balcony of his home.

name: Lunchtime
description: At noon he kept it simple: made a bowl of plain noodles, poached an egg, and blanched a few baby bok choy. While eating, he scrolled through his phone and saw Chen Jie in the running group inviting people for a night run after work tomorrow. He replied '+1', but knew in his heart that tomorrow would depend on the team's workload.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon nap
description: After lunch, drowsiness set in, so he dozed half an hour curled up on the living room sofa, with the air conditioner on and a thin blanket over him. This was the standard recovery pose for a fisherman back in the world of the living.
location: Living room, Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Rest and meeting preparation
description: After waking up, he washed his face. Remembering the owners' committee meeting in the afternoon, he found an old notebook and pen, recalled the hottest topics in the owners' group recently—the disorderly parking of non-motorized vehicles and the garbage collection schedule—and silently drafted his remarks. He grabbed a bottle of ice water from the fridge on the way.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Invited to run as a tenant representative on the owners' committee
description: When I went downstairs to buy water, I met my neighbor Auntie Chen Xiuying in the community garden. She warmly stopped me and said she had heard that I am warm-hearted and capable, and that the homeowners' committee happens to need a tenant representative, so she wanted to recommend me as a candidate. I was a bit surprised, but seeing the expectant look in Auntie Chen's eyes and thinking that I really do have a responsibility to speak up for tenants, I nodded in agreement. Auntie Chen happily said yes again and again and told me to go directly to the property management office at 4:30 p.m.
location: Pavilion in the central garden of Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Field research on community issues
description: I walked around the residential community in advance, specifically going to the garbage room in Area B and the main road parking area to check. I quietly noted in my notebook the sanitary dead corners and the spot of a long-occupied 'zombie car' I found, ready to raise them at the meeting.
location: Garbage room and main road, Zone B, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: First owners' committee tenant representative meeting.
description: The meeting began. After a simple voting process, I was unanimously elected as the tenant representative. During the discussion session, I opened my notebook and clearly raised several practical issues raised by tenants, including 'insufficient charging piles for non-motor vehicles', 'weekend renovation noise control', and 'odor from the garbage room'. The property manager promised on the spot to follow up. I received recognition from several other committee members and felt that I was genuinely participating in community management.
location: Meeting room of the Property Service Center, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (1st floor, Building 2).

name: Helped Aunt Chen repair the faucet.
description: As soon as the meeting ended, Aunt Chen pulled you aside and said the kitchen faucet was dripping and asked if you could take a look. Without saying a word, you went home and grabbed your toolbox. After arriving at Aunt Chen's house, you removed the old faucet and found that the valve core was worn. Luckily, you had prepared a universal valve core in advance. You skillfully replaced it, sealed it, and tested the water, finishing the whole job in twenty minutes. Aunt Chen poured water and offered fruit, but you politely declined and went home.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Aunt Chen's home)

name: Dinner preparation and dining.
description: After returning home, he steamed the crucian carp he had caught in the morning, adding shredded ginger and scallion segments to remove the fishy smell. He also made a tomato-scrambled egg dish and cooked a pot of rice. Although he was eating alone, the food was warm and satisfying. He paid attention to portion control, keeping in mind his target weight of 73.3 kg.
location: Kitchen and Dining Room, Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening leisure and interaction with running buddies.
description: After dinner, washed the dishes and sat down at the computer. First sorted out the key points from today's owners' committee meeting and listed a few items to follow up on. Midway, WeChat buzzed; running buddy Chen Jie started a three-person group chat and asked if we could go run 10 kilometers together at Sijing Sports Center tomorrow morning. I confirmed I could join.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Made up with Lin Yue over the phone
description: I picked up my phone and saw a new message pop up from Lin Yue's WeChat avatar. She had sent a long message, sincerely apologizing for the hurtful words in the last argument, saying she understood the pressure and persistence I was under. After reading it, I was silent for a while, then made a voice call. We talked for nearly fifty minutes. She went from the specific conflict to her worries about the future, and I also talked about my plans for buying a house and my career. She asked if I wanted to go to Hangzhou to see her this weekend. I said I had just been elected as a representative of the owners' committee this week and might have some things to handle, but I would definitely go next week. After hanging up, the weight in my heart was lifted, but I also clearly knew that some fundamental differences cannot be bridged by a single apology, and life still has to be lived slowly.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, online call

name: Pre-sleep review and decision
description: After chatting with Lin Yue, he lay on the bed and sent a message to his childhood friend Zhang Wei, briefly describing the day's situation. He didn't reply, probably playing games. He scrolled through the morning photos of Dianshan Lake in his phone album and silently made a decision: starting tomorrow, no matter how busy, he would set aside fixed time each week for fishing or running; stress needed an outlet.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: He got up and took a shower, washing away his fatigue. He changed into clean pajamas, set the alarm for 6:00 the next morning, and placed his workout clothes by the bedside.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going to bed
description: He turned off the light and lay down. His mind reviewed the few crucian carp he had caught today, the problems in the residential community that urgently needed solving, and Lin Yue's choking voice when she apologized. It's no big deal; there has to be something to look forward to in life. He turned over and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning core training.
description: Woke up to the sound of the alarm; outside the window the sky was gray and the air was muggy. After drinking the warm water on the nightstand, he went to the balcony and laid out a yoga mat. Since the morning run with his friend Chen Jie was canceled at the last minute, he switched to a 12-minute efficient bodyweight core workout, including three sets of planks, crunches, and incline push-ups. Sweat soaked his vest, and his body was quickly activated.
location: Balcony of Room 503, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Shower and simple breakfast
description: After exercising, I took a cold shower and felt completely awake. In the kitchen, I boiled two eggs in an electric cooker, made a bowl of instant oatmeal, and hastily ate breakfast standing by the window. Meanwhile, I soaked the work clothes I had changed out of last night in a plastic basin, getting ready to wash them in the evening.
location: Room 503, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the factory by car
description: Changed into clean work clothes, took the car keys, and went downstairs. He started the silver-gray sedan, connected via Bluetooth, and listened to Shanghai Traffic Radio. There was more and more traffic on the road, and after about 15 minutes of steady driving, he arrived at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory.
location: Road section from Xingang Road to Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Pre-shift preparation and morning briefing
description: After parking the car, clocking in, and changing into safety shoes, he entered Workshop No. 1 to check the oil levels and coolant of two CNC lathes. At 7:30, shift leader Wang Lei organized a pre-shift meeting; master worker Sun Jianguo assigned tasks, emphasizing the key points of the interface for joint debugging of the hybrid solution with Liu Zhiqiang, and reminded everyone to note equipment heat dissipation in the muggy weather. He made brief eye contact with Liu Zhiqiang and then both looked away.
location: No. 1 Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Joint debugging of the project interface with Liu Zhiqiang
description: After the morning meeting, he met Liu Zhiqiang at the test bench and immediately got to work. Liu adjusted the program, and Yin Hao operated the machine tool and recorded data. Yin Hao noticed that the feed rate setting might affect interface latency and proactively proposed a modification. After the other party accepted it, the atmosphere relaxed. The whole morning focused on technical communication; key checkpoint tests passed, and the interface latency became stable.
location: Test bench area, Workshop No. 1, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with father during the lunch break
description: Alone in a corner of the factory cafeteria, he ate lunch: a set meal of braised pork, stir-fried greens, and rice. After the meal, he made a WeChat video call to his father, who was seen in the yard of the old house. He reported on his work and told his father that he had sent the repayment commitment letter by email. His father nodded, then turned to ask about his relationship with Lin Yue. Yin Hao gave a vague answer, and his father did not press further, only telling him to take care of his health. The call lasted about 12 minutes.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunchtime relaxation and browsing property information.
description: After hanging up the phone, he went to the factory lounge and sat down, opened the Lianjia app to browse newly listed properties recommended by the system, and noticed a two-bedroom unit near Songjiang University Town Metro Station with a total price of 1.55 million yuan. The floor plan looked good, so he took a screenshot and saved it, but did not contact the agent immediately.
location: Break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon: joint debugging wrap-up and data organization
description: In the afternoon, I continued to work with Liu Zhiqiang on the final stage of joint debugging. The machine ran stably for nearly two hours, and we successfully completed three cycle tests. I recorded more than 200 key parameters on the inspection form and, before 4 p.m., sent the compiled commissioning data report by email to Master Sun, copying the shift leader. Before leaving work, I checked the equipment status and cleaned my workstation.
location: No. 1 Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-work commute
description: Punched out, walked back to the parking lot, and started the car. Because he wanted a light evening meal, he gave up the idea of going to a Sichuan restaurant. On the way home, the radio broadcast said there might be thunderstorms in the evening, so he kept an eye on the road all the way.
location: The section of Huatiangjing Road to Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Went home to take care of household chores.
description: He returned to the rental apartment in Xingang Community and changed into loose loungewear. On the balcony, he took out the work clothes that had been soaking, carefully scrubbed the collars and cuffs with soap, wrung them dry, and hung them up. Then he took eggs and baby bok choy out of the fridge to prepare dinner.
location: Room 503, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Simple dinner
description: He boiled a small pot of dried noodles, poached two eggs in it, blanched baby bok choy, and seasoned it with a little salt and sesame oil. The dinner was light and healthy. While eating, he used his phone to play a Bilibili tutorial video about the Siemens S7-1200 PLC as background audio.
location: Kitchen-cum-dining area, Room 503, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Evening PLC programming study.
description: After tidying up, I sat down at my desk, opened my laptop, and continued tackling the bottleneck of “counter reset” in advanced PLC learning. In the TIA Portal software, I built an SFC sequential function chart containing timers, counters, and auxiliary relays to simulate the conveyor-positioning-drilling production line logic. After repeated modifications and simulation runs, and eliminating two logic conflicts, I finally saw the expected result and felt a surge of satisfaction.
location: Desk at Room 503, No. 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Consult a real estate agent online
description: After studying for an hour and a half, he stretched his neck. As planned, he opened the Lianjia app and clicked the online consultation button for the property he had saved in the afternoon. The agent "Xiao Zhu" replied quickly. Yin Hao asked in detail about the specific floor, elevator-to-household ratio, and value-added tax situation of the listing. After answering, Xiao Zhu also sent links to two other listings with similar total prices. Yin Hao said he would look at the floor plans and then get in touch.
location: Desk at Room 503, No. 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening stroll
description: Turned off the computer, changed into running shoes, and went downstairs. It was already dark outside, and the air was humid and stuffy. I walked about 20 minutes along the main road of the residential complex and the tree-lined path outside the wall. Passing the central small garden, I saw several neighbors playing cards under the streetlights. I didn't join them, quietly relaxed my mind, and enjoyed the sounds of insects and traffic.
location: Main road and surrounding tree-lined avenues of Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: After returning home, he did some light stretching and recorded the day's walking exercise data. After showering and changing into pajamas, he checked his phone: replied to his friend Chen Jie's confirmation WeChat message about "running tomorrow," and browsed the homeowners' group discussion about the placement of fitness equipment without commenting.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 503, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep reading and heart rate monitoring
description: He turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside night light, picked up his sports watch, and synced the day's data. The heart-rate curve showed that it peaked at 135 beats/min during afternoon work and was very stable during evening study. Then he flipped through a popular science article about improving deep sleep and read about two pages.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at Room 503, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep.
description: Drowsiness set in. He set the phone alarm to 5:50 the next morning, ran through tomorrow's core training plan and the running route with Chen Jie in his mind, then turned off the light, turned over, and soon fell asleep. Outside the window came the first dull rumble of summer thunder.
location: Bedroom, Room 503, No. 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning adaptive training and breakfast preparation
description: Woke up at 6:10 a.m. Because the forecast high was 36°C, he skipped the outdoor morning run and laid out a yoga mat in the living room to complete a 12-minute core workout (crunches, plank, mountain climbers), recording heart rate data with the Huawei Health app. After the strength training, he took a quick shower. Then he cooked oatmeal in the kitchen, paired with a boiled egg and half a cucumber. While eating, he sent a WeChat message to his running buddy Chen Jie to cancel this morning's run and reschedule it for tomorrow. He packed his commuter bag: work badge, keys, a water bottle filled with warm water, and put the CNC Parameter Quick-Reference Manual in the side pocket.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive to work and workshop inspection
description: He drove his own car steadily along Huatianjing Highway, playing the Tech Knows First podcast via Bluetooth. After arriving at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, he changed into oil-proof work clothes and went to the workshop to check the morning status records of the two CNC machine tools. Everything was normal.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Interface debugging report and FAQ writing
description: Sat at the office desk, opened the laptop, organized the interface debugging report for the hybrid solution completed with colleague Liu Zhiqiang the day before, recorded the data showing latency reduced to 2.1 milliseconds, and drew the wiring diagram and parameter settings table. After confirming the key technical descriptions with Liu Zhiqiang, independently wrote the first draft of FAQ and Common Problem Troubleshooting. Around 11 o'clock, handed the printed copy to Master Sun Jianguo for review, and Master Sun approved the report's detail and logical structure.
location: Office of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Weekly maintenance of the first CNC machine
description: Taking advantage of the quiet workshop before the lunch break, started weekly maintenance on the first CNC machine tool. Put on gloves, picked up a wrench and special tools, followed the procedure to power off and tag out, cleaned the coolant tank and chip tray, replaced the coolant, checked and tightened the oil line fittings, doing the entire process meticulously.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Having lunch in the cafeteria and chatting with coworkers.
description: After washing your hands with soap, you walk to the cafeteria. Today's menu includes braised pork chops, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and stir-fried bean sprouts. You take your tray and sit next to Master Sun and shift leader Wang Lei. Shift Leader Wang asks about the morning maintenance, and you say it's progressing well; Master Sun reminds you to keep the afternoon maintenance data records for the end-of-month equipment ledger check.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and final draft of the document.
description: After lunch, I rested with my eyes closed in the rest area for 20 minutes to regain energy. Then, during the lunch break, I entered Master Sun's suggested revisions into the computer, finalized the interface debugging report, converted it to PDF, saved it in the shared folder, and sent an email to Master Sun and the project manager. At 14:00, I changed into work clothes and got ready for the maintenance of the second machine tool.
location: Office/Rest Area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Maintenance and troubleshooting of the second CNC machine tool.
description: Continue the machine tool maintenance tasks in the afternoon, repeating the fine operations. While inspecting the second machine tool, I noticed a slight fluctuation in the oil pressure gauge reading, so I immediately checked the return oil filter, found it slightly clogged, and thoroughly cleaned it with an ultrasonic cleaner. After finishing the maintenance, I poured the waste cutting fluid into the designated recycling barrel, and recorded in detail in the workshop's Equipment Maintenance Log the maintenance time, replaced materials, and issues found for both machine tools, then signed to confirm.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After work, supermarket shopping and unexpected encounter with the landlord.
description: Changed out of my work clothes, put on a T-shirt and trousers, locked the locker, took a shopping bag from the car, and drove away from the factory. After about 25 minutes, I arrived at Tesco Wang (Songjiang Center Store). Inside the supermarket, I went straight to the grain, oil, and fresh produce sections. After comparing prices, I chose the 5kg promotional rice, picked up a tray of eggs, a bunch of Shanghai bok choy, two loofahs, and a pack of discounted dried noodles. While queuing to check out, I ran into the landlady, Ms. Li Xiuying, greeted her proactively, and briefly talked about renewing the lease. Sister Li agreed to renew month-to-month at the original price and we set a time to sign a new contract early next month. Actual spending was 58.4 yuan, within the 60 yuan budget.
location: Tesco Wang (Songjiang Central Store), No. 6, Lane 500, Wencheng Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returned home and cooked dinner.
description: After driving about 19 minutes, he returned to the rented apartment in Xingang Community. He put the purchased items away in their proper places: rice into the container, vegetables into the fridge, and dirty work clothes into the washing machine to soak. He tied on an apron and started making dinner, cooking rice while also making steamed egg with minced pork and stir-fried loofah. About half an hour later, the meal was on the table. He enjoyed the home-style dinner while checking his exercise data on the Huawei Health app on his phone.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Household cleaning and organizing technical notes
description: After dinner, he immediately washed the dishes and utensils and put them away. Sitting at the desk, he took out his work notebook and spent 20 minutes recording the abnormal oil pressure gauge found during today's machine maintenance and the solution, as technical accumulation. After that, he mopped the floor and folded yesterday's clothes that had been drying on the balcony, putting them into the wardrobe.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: CNC Forum and Video Learning
description: I leaned back on the sofa and used my phone to browse CNC forums and technical lecture videos on Bilibili. I saw a video explaining the RTCP function of a five-axis linkage machine tool, found it useful, and saved the link. Then I opened the Modern CNC magazine I had borrowed last week and carefully read the five-axis machining case article I had marked last time, underlining the key passages with a pen.
location: Living room, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Video call with good friend Lin Yue.
description: Received Lin Yue's video call invitation and answered politely. We asked each other about the day's work; you mentioned machine tool maintenance and supermarket shopping, and she shared her company's new project. When she said she might come to Shanghai at the end of the month, you calmly replied that you would pick her up and reminded her to watch out for heatstroke. The conversation lasted about 10 minutes, with a warm atmosphere.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

description: Carrying a crossbody bag with a laptop, water, a power bank, and a folding umbrella, and wearing sneakers, he walked 3 minutes from home to the bus stop, took the Songqing Line bus for about 12 minutes to Songjiang University Town Metro Station, and arrived 3 minutes earlier than the agreed time.
location: Xingang Road Bus Stop, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Guangfulin Road Songjiang University Town Metro Station

name: House viewing: Greenland Rose Nine Li
description: Lianjia real estate agent Xiao Li was already waiting at the exit. The two walked about 15 minutes to Greenland Rose Jiuli Community. Yin Hao carefully inspected an 85-square-meter two-bedroom apartment; the total price was within budget. Following habits he had developed in the military and at the factory, he checked the natural light in every room, tapped the kitchen and balcony walls to detect hollow areas, turned on the taps to check water pressure, used his phone flashlight to inspect the corners, and asked about property management fees, the elevator-to-unit ratio, and school district zoning. On the listing sheet Xiao Li handed him, he wrote down: "8th floor, good light, but close to the road; noise needs to be considered."
location: Building X, Greenland Rose Nine Li Villa Area, Lane 1518, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: House viewing: Sanxiang Siji Huacheng
description: Xiao Li drove about 7 minutes to take Yin Hao to Sanxiang Four Seasons Flower City. They viewed an apartment with a square layout of about 78 square meters on a low floor. Yin Hao focused on checking the effect of the second-floor lighting, asked about the parking space ratio in the community, noticed some signs of dampness on the wall outside the kitchen window, and took photos with his phone. He noted: '2nd floor, limited lighting, old decoration that needs a full redo; the low total price is an advantage.'
location: Building X, Peony Garden, Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Lane 1500, Meijiabang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: House viewing: Poly Xizi Bay
description: Xiao Li drove for about 8 minutes to reach Poly Xizi Bay. This 82-square-meter two-bedroom unit was newly listed, and quite a few people were viewing it. The apartment was well decorated and maintained, with a bright layout in every room. Yin Hao spent more time checking the cabinet panels and sanitary ware brands, and had a good impression of the unit. He asked the owner in detail about the reason for selling and the bottom price, and noted down: "Fresh renovation, worry-free, good layout, can consider as first choice."
location: Building X, Poly Xizi Bay, No. 102, Lane 1188, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning house-viewing summary, transition, and lunch
description: After viewing the three apartments in the morning, Yin Hao said goodbye to Xiao Li at the entrance of Poly Xizi Bay, thanked him for accompanying, and said he would discuss it with his family. Then he walked about 20 minutes to Songjiang Wanda Plaza. On the way, he sent a message to Xiao Wang, an agent from I Love My Home, confirming a meeting at Longfor Haowangshan at 2 p.m. Arriving at the "Benjia Noodle House" on the third floor of Wanda Plaza, he ordered a signature pork chop noodles with a fried egg. While waiting for the food, he used his phone memo to organize the morning's property information and rated the three properties: Poly Xizi Bay 9 points, Greenland Qiangwei Jiuli 7 points, and Sanxiang Siji Huacheng 5 points. After eating, he scrolled through his phone and replied to messages in the running group, then leaned back in his chair and rested with his eyes closed for 15 minutes.

participant.relation: I Love My Home Real Estate Agency

name: Heading to the afternoon apartment-viewing meeting point.
description: After the break, Yin Hao decided to ride a shared bike to Longhu Haowangshan. He rode west along Guangfulin Road for about 15 minutes, arrived at the meeting point early, parked under a tree's shade, drank some water, and took out his notebook to review the housing information for the afternoon.

name: House viewing: Longfor Haowangshan.
description: At 2 PM, Xiao Wang, the agent from I Love My Home Realty, arrived on time. The 80-square-meter unit had a regular layout, with the living room and bedroom facing south and excellent natural light. Yin Hao really liked the layout. But when Xiao Wang told him the total price and taxes, he realized it was over budget. When he asked about room for negotiation, Xiao Wang said there wasn't much. Yin Hao recorded: "Perfect layout! Over budget, need to focus on bargaining room."

description: Xiao Wang drove about 10 minutes to Vanke Dream Pie. The apartment was a 77-square-meter well-decorated unit, move-in ready, but the daylight on the low floor was severely blocked by the building in front, and the window faced the community garbage collection point. Yin Hao frowned and noted that the floor was too low, natural lighting had a major flaw, the renovation condition was acceptable, and the factors needed to be weighed together. He asked about room for negotiation, and Xiao Wang said the owner was selling urgently and the price was still negotiable.

participant.name: Xiao Wang
participant.relation: I Love My Home Real Estate Agency

name: House Viewing Analysis and Return Trip
description: After saying goodbye to Xiao Wang, Yin Hao got on the bus home, put on earphones, and used his phone's memo app to create a simple comparison table of the five apartments by total price, floor area, layout, natural light, decoration, property management, school district, commuting distance, and other dimensions, and gave preliminary ratings. By the time he got off and arrived home, a clear ranking had formed.

description: After getting home, Yin Hao opened his laptop, created a new Excel spreadsheet, entered the information sorted out on the bus, and added each apartment's community green coverage rate and school district information. After checking repeatedly to make sure nothing was missing, he saved the spreadsheet and sent it to his WeChat File Transfer Assistant.

name: Walked around downstairs and relaxed.
description: After looking at houses all day, his eyes and mind were a bit tired, so Yin Hao went downstairs and took a half-hour walk in the community garden. Seeing a woman walking her dog and children chasing each other, he felt relaxed. He took a photo of the pothos on the balcony and posted it on Moments: 'Ran 6K today, saw 5 apartments, a fulfilling day.'
location: Garden downstairs of Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner
description: After walking home, washed my face, took last night's packaged braised pork chop and tomato scrambled eggs out of the fridge and heated them up, cooked a small pot of rice in the rice cooker, and efficiently had dinner alone while watching CNC technology short videos.
location: Room X, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening review and exhibition information search
description: After the meal, he cleared the table and washed the dishes, made a cup of tea, and sat down at the desk. First he used his phone to search for information about the industrial design exhibition at the Power Station of Art, and found that the next afternoon was the last day. He planned the metro route - "depart at 2 p.m., take Metro Line 9 and transfer to Line 8" - and added it to his phone calendar. Then he opened the CNC Machining Technology textbook and his notes, reviewed the first four chapters, and focused on the weak points he had discussed with Master Sun the previous day. While reading, he drew concept framework diagrams to consolidate formulas and definitions. After each chapter, he did practice questions on his phone, and the accuracy was quite good, which boosted his confidence.
location: Room X, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening leisure and relaxation
description: After reading, Yin Hao put on his earphones and listened to his favorite music, completely clearing his mind and giving his brain a fresh direction.
location: Room X, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Chatting with his girlfriend and going to bed.
description: After showering, he lay on the bed and sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend Lin Yue, reporting the day's house-viewing results and sharing funny stories from the running group and details of the house visits. Lin Yue reminded him to watch out for heatstroke and asked to see the comparison table. Yin Hao smiled and sent her a screenshot of the table. After chatting, he set his phone to silent, turned off the light, and drew the curtains. In his mind, he compared Poly Xizi Bay and Longfor Good Hope Mountain, adjusted his sleeping position with a sense of reassurance, and soon fell asleep.
location: Room X, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning preparation and pre-ride check.
description: At 5:30 in the morning, my body clock woke me right on time. First I drank a glass of warm water, then did dynamic stretching and core activation on the living room floor to get my body moving. Next, I went to the balcony to check the mountain bike's tire pressure, brakes, and gear system, and confirmed everything was normal. I put on cycling clothes, a helmet, and gloves, packed two bottles of water, three energy gels, a power bank, and drone batteries into my cycling backpack, and got ready to set off.
location: Room 1502, Building 9, Poly Xizi Bay, Lane 1188, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning cycling challenge (including gathering and cycling).
description: At 6:10, I wheeled my bike out on time and rode about 15 minutes to the square next to Songjiang University Town Metro Station, where I gathered with cycling buddies Yin Hao, Zhang Wei, and Liu Na. We checked each other's equipment and emphasized safety precautions. At 7:00, we officially set off from the university town and rode 50 kilometers on the loop route along Guangfulin Country Park, Chenshan Botanical Garden, and Thames Town. By the lake in Guangfulin Country Park, I used a DJI drone to shoot aerial video of the group riding through the tree-lined avenue and the lake in the morning light, then shared it to the cycling group, which drew an enthusiastic response. Near Chenshan Botanical Garden, we challenged a long gentle slope and everyone made it to the top. At 11:00, we returned safely to the starting point and completed our first 50-kilometer challenge.
location: Jiufengyuan Calligraphy Plaza, 1651 Jiasong South Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (the plaza next to Songjiang University Town Metro Station) and the cycling route around Songjiang

name: Return home to rest, lunch, and aerial video editing
description: At 11:00, after saying goodbye to his cycling friends, he rode home. On the way, he stopped at Lawson convenience store on Guangfulin Road to buy an iced Mizone to rehydrate. After arriving home at 11:30, he took a hot shower and did 15 minutes of serious stretching to relax his body. Not wanting to cook for lunch, he rode his electric scooter to the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road near the neighborhood and brought home a takeout of Kung Pao Chicken and rice. While eating, he used the CapCut app to edit the aerial footage into a 2-minute short video, added rousing background music, and posted it to the cycling group, receiving likes.
location: Room 1502, Building 9, Poly Xizi Bay, Lane 1188, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Visit the Shanghai Contemporary Art Museum (round trip included).
description: At 13:30, changed into a clean T-shirt and shorts, took a power bank and earphones, and walked to Songjiang University Town Metro Station. Took Line 9 to Century Avenue Station, transferred to Line 4, then switched to Line 13 to World Expo Museum Station; the whole journey took about 1.5 hours. At 15:30, exited the station and walked to the Power Station of Art, paid 50 yuan for an all-access ticket. In the installation art area, he was attracted by an interactive installation named "Waves", which triggered light, shadow, and sound through body movements. He stayed and experienced it for nearly 20 minutes and shot a short video. Although some abstract paintings were hard to understand, the visit broadened his horizons. At 17:30, after finishing the visit, he bought a refrigerator magnet shaped like a mechanical gear at the souvenir shop as a keepsake, then took the metro back the same way and walked out of Songjiang University Town Station around 19:00.
location: Power Station of Art, 678 Miaojiang Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and online socializing
description: At 19:00, feeling hungry, I went straight to the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road and ordered boiled fish and egg fried rice, eating with gusto. While eating, I shared the short video of the interactive installation I had taken at the museum during the day in the Songjiang Three Brothers WeChat group with Lao Gao and Xiao Ma. Lao Gao said he also wanted to visit, while Xiao Ma was more interested in cycling. The three of us agreed to go to the Shanghai Science and Technology Museum together next week when the weather is good, and also invited another friend, Chen Jie.
location: Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, 232 Xingang Road, Dagang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reviewing skills and taking a short break
description: At 20:00, although my body was sore, I thought of the senior technician exam at the end of the month and still persisted in sitting at the desk. I took out the "Mechanical Drawing" mistake notebook and focused on reviewing the difficult chapters "Sectional Views" and "Dimensioning," where I often lost points. After studying for an hour, I felt my brain couldn't turn anymore, so I decisively closed the book and played a song on my phone to clear my mind and take a short break.
location: Room 1502, Building 9, Poly Xizi Bay, Lane 1188, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and planning for tomorrow
description: At 21:30, brushed teeth and washed face, applied a soothing eye patch to relieve the day's fatigue. Lying in bed, used the phone memo app to sort out tomorrow's work schedule: 8:00 workshop morning meeting, check the oil pressure gauge of Machine No. 2, and verify the newly received fixture drawings in the afternoon. Confirmed the 7:20 alarm, reviewed the cycling challenge and museum visit completed that day, and felt tired yet fulfilled.
location: Bedroom, Room 1502, Building 9, Poly Xizi Bay, Lane 1188, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going to bed
description: At 22:30, turned off the lights and lay down. He was extremely tired but mentally satisfied, reviewed the day's gains, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 1502, Building 9, Poly Xizi Bay, Lane 1188, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The phone alarm went off on time. Yin Hao turned it off, got out of bed, and did some simple stretches for his leg muscles, which were sore from yesterday's bike ride. He went to the bathroom to wash up. While brushing his teeth, he noticed through the window that it was cloudy and quite humid. After washing up, he weighed himself: 73.0 kg, slightly lighter than yesterday. He then changed into work pants and a T-shirt and stuffed the power bank he had charged the night before into his commuting bag.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and getting ready to go out.
description: Yin Hao took two boiled eggs cooked last night and a carton of milk out of the fridge, and made a bowl of instant oatmeal with hot water for breakfast. While eating, he checked the weather forecast on his phone: cloudy, high 33°C, isolated showers in the afternoon. He took a folding umbrella from the shoe cabinet and put it into his commuter bag, then checked his work badge, notebook, pen, and power bank, confirming everything was in order.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive to work
description: Yin Hao went downstairs with his bag and umbrella, then started the silver-gray Volkswagen Lavida on the roadside at the community gate. He set the navigation destination to Shanghai Jiangnan Pharmaceutical Machinery Co., Ltd., departing from Xingang Road, turning from Huatianjing Highway onto Xinzhuan Highway, about 8 km in total. On the way, he listened to local traffic radio and learned about the road conditions and the day's schedule.
location: En route from Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to No. 3966 Xinzhuan Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning shift preparation and equipment inspection
description: After swiping his card to enter the factory, Yin Hao went to the locker room, changed into his navy-blue work uniform, and put on his safety helmet and goggles. At CNC machine tool workstation No. 1, he checked the power supply, spindle sound, oil pressure gauge, and air pressure gauge item by item according to the Equipment Inspection Checklist, and signed off after confirming everything was normal. Then he studied the drawings of today's new parts and checked the fixture installation dimensions to prepare for the morning commissioning.
location: CNC machine tool workstation No. 1, Shanghai Jiangnan Pharmaceutical Machinery Co., Ltd., 3966 Xinzhuan Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Team morning meeting
description: Team leader Wang Lei hosted the morning meeting, reviewed last week's production situation, and praised Yin Hao for winning second place in the workshop in the skills competition. Wang Lei stressed that the digital transformation project needed to be tackled hard that day, especially the unstable MES interface signal, and asked everyone to concentrate and prepare for tomorrow's acceptance. After the meeting, Master Sun Jianguo patted Yin Hao on the shoulder and said he would help look into the signal problem during the morning inspection.
location: In front of the workshop team board at Shanghai Jiangnan Pharmaceutical Machinery Co., Ltd., No. 3966 Xinzhuan Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Project: breaking through the MES signal bit error bottleneck
description: After the morning meeting, Yin Hao and the programmer Liu Zhiqiang immediately threw themselves into troubleshooting the MES signal bit error problem. The two disagreed over the cause of the fault and argued. Around 9:30, Master Sun Jianguo arrived on an inspection round. Instead of taking sides, he asked them to reproduce the fault and observe the signal waveform. Sun Jianguo pointed out that the tiny glitches on the waveform were current interference, and determined that the problem was likely caused by poor grounding of the shield layer of the newly added cable, which had produced induced interference. He suggested installing a ferrite core and adding a check bit to the communication protocol. Yin Hao installed the ferrite core next to the cabinet and re-treated the shield layer grounding, while Liu Zhiqiang modified the PLC program to add a CRC check. After several rounds of tests, the signal bit error rate dropped significantly.
location: CNC machine tool station No. 1 and MES control cabinet area, Shanghai Jiangnan Pharmaceutical Machinery Co., Ltd., 3966 Xinzhuan Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch
description: At lunchtime, Sun Jianguo called Yin Hao and Wang Lei to go to the cafeteria, saying there was braised pork chop on the menu. The three went together to the second floor of the company cafeteria. After queuing, Yin Hao ordered a braised pork chop set meal and a bowl of tomato and egg soup. They sat by the window and chatted while eating. Wang Lei asked about the project progress. Yin Hao told him about the plan Sun Jianguo had suggested. Wang Lei remarked that Sun Jianguo was experienced and astute, and encouraged Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang to learn well.
location: Second floor of the cafeteria at Shanghai Jiangnan Pharmaceutical Machinery Co., Ltd., 3966 Xinzhuang Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Fragmented run at noon
description: After lunch, Yin Hao rested for 15 minutes, then put on his lightweight running shoes and sports watch and started running from the back gate of the company. The afternoon temperature was about 30 degrees and it was a bit muggy. He maintained a pace of 6:30 per kilometer, ran south along the auxiliary road of Xinzhuan Highway, then turned into an internal park road, passed the courier pickup point, and turned back. The total distance was about 3 kilometers. Back in the workshop changing room, he wiped off sweat with a wet towel.
location: Xinzhuan Highway service road and internal roads of the company campus, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Project commissioning and joint acceptance
description: After starting work in the afternoon, Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang made the final adjustments according to the new plan. Yin Hao re-confirmed the installation of the shielding layer, Liu Zhiqiang uploaded the modified program, and the equipment began a no-load test run. Half an hour later, the monitoring software showed that the MES interface communication indicator light was flashing steadily with no bit errors. They continued to increase the load and test repeatedly for over an hour, and the system remained stable throughout. At 15:00, the technical director and the quality department supervisor arrived on site for acceptance, and the project passed smoothly. The technical director praised the team on the spot, announced a 2,000 yuan bonus for each person, and specifically mentioned Yin Hao's second place finish in the workshop at last week's skills competition.
location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - 3966 Xinzhuan Highway, Shanghai Jiangnan Pharmaceutical Machinery Co., Ltd., No. 1 CNC machine workstation, beside the MES control cabinet, and central control room

name: Home buying consultation
description: After the acceptance inspection, Yin Hao used his phone to handle personal matters. He sent WeChat messages to several agents from Lianjia, Woaiwojia, and Beike, asking for the latest minimum prices and loan policies for three candidate properties in the Sijing area of Songjiang, and asked them to send the transaction prices for the same layout over the past three months for reference.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Jiangnan Pharmaceutical Machinery Co., Ltd., 3966 Xinzhuan Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Ordered flowers for Qixi Festival
description: After finishing the home-buying consultation, Yin Hao opened the Flowerplus app, ordered a bouquet of "Heartbeat" roses and a preserved flower music box, set the delivery address to the Songjiang Wanda Office Building where his girlfriend Lin Yue works, chose the delivery date as August 22, and left a message: "Happy Qixi Festival in advance, wait for me to get off work."
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Jiangnan Pharmaceutical Machinery Co., Ltd., 3966 Xinzhuan Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Follow-up work and wrap-up
description: After dealing with personal matters, Yin Hao returned to work. At the request of the technical director, he wrote a brief summary report on the project's technical breakthrough and acceptance, organizing the troubleshooting approach, solutions, and verification results into a document for archiving. He then performed the daily routine maintenance and cleaning on CNC machine tool No. 1, and noted down the list of tools needed for tomorrow. At 17:30 the end-of-work bell rang; he turned off the power, packed up his tools, and said goodbye to Liu Zhiqiang.
location: CNC machine tool workstation No. 1, Shanghai Jiangnan Pharmaceutical Machinery Co., Ltd., 3966 Xinzhuan Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going out with colleagues after work to celebrate
description: After work, Yin Hao, Wang Lei, and Liu Zhiqiang walked to Gan Xiang Xiao Chu on Gaoji Road near the company for dinner. Wang Lei took the lead and ordered signature dishes such as stir-fried beef with peppers and chopped pepper fish head. The three toasted with drinks instead of alcohol to celebrate the project's success. During the meal, the conversation moved from work to life. Wang Lei teased Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang about their argument in the morning, and Liu Zhiqiang laughingly admitted that he had not thought it through. Yin Hao shared the pressure of studying for the mechanical drawing exam, and Wang Lei encouraged him that he would definitely be fine.
location: Jiangxi-Hunan Kitchen, 75 Gaoji Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening review: mechanical drawing exam sprint.
description: After the dinner gathering, Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang left first. Yin Hao walked back to the company alone and went to the self-study area on the second floor of the employee library. He found a quiet corner, sat down, and took out the Machine Drawing Exercise Book and drawing tools from his bag. Based on last Sunday's review notes, he focused on three-view drawings of combined solids, full sectional views, and screw thread drawing. He carefully drew several typical three-view drawings, paying attention to line types and positions, then drew a sectional view of a stepped shaft and practiced hatching. Whenever he was unsure about a thread callout, he immediately looked up the national standard, took notes, and jotted down his understanding and common pitfalls next to it.
location: Shanghai Jiangnan Pharmaceutical Machinery Co., Ltd. Employee Library, 2F Self-Study Area, 3966 Xinzhuang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Walked back to the rented apartment.
description: The library closed at 21:00. Yin Hao packed up his things, put on his backpack, and walked out of the company. The night breeze was cool and very pleasant. He strolled slowly along his familiar route and returned to Xingang Community about 20 minutes later.
location: On the way from Shanghai Jiangnan Pharmaceutical Machinery Co., Ltd., 3966 Xinzhuan Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Residential Community

name: Evening tidying and washing up
description: After entering the room, Yin Hao first drank a glass of plain boiled water, then sat at the desk and took out his notebook to organize the day's gains. He wrote down the knowledge about signal interference shielding that Master Sun pointed out, and drew a schematic diagram; then he copied the mechanical drawing exercises he got wrong tonight into his mistake notebook and redrew the correct drawing method; finally, he sent the drafted project summary report from his phone to the company's public email. After finishing this, it was already 22:00, so he went to the bathroom to take a shower and changed into clean loungewear.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedroom relaxation and preparation for bed
description: After getting into bed, Yin Hao turned on the bedside lamp and sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend Lin Yue, sharing the good news that the project had passed acceptance and the 2,000 yuan bonus. Lin Yue was very happy and told him not to work too hard. They chatted for more than ten minutes, said a few sweet nothings, and then said goodnight. Afterward, Yin Hao scrolled through news and industry updates for a while. Feeling sleepy, he set the alarm for 6:10 the next morning, turned off the light, and got ready for bed.
location: Bedroom, Room 501, Unit 3, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going to bed
description: Yin Hao closed his eyes and quickly reviewed the day's important moments in his mind: the success of the project, the bonus in hand, and progress in drawing practice. He felt a sense of relief. Adjusting his sleeping position, he soon drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 501, Unit 3, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up, indoor exercise, and washing up
description: At 06:10 the alarm went off right on time. Outside, the sky was gloomy and a fine rain was falling, so he canceled his outdoor run and laid out his yoga mat in the living room, completing 15 minutes of core strength training and 10 minutes of full-body stretching. Afterward, he took a quick shower, weighed 72.9 kg, changed into a blue work shirt and dark casual pants, checked his phone weather alert showing showers turning overcast and 30°C, and decided to bring an umbrella.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and pre-exam review preparation
description: For breakfast, he had oatmeal soaked in milk and two boiled eggs. At the same time, he spread the first five chapters of the textbook CNC Principles on the dining table and spent about 10 minutes reviewing the core diagrams of coordinate systems and interpolation logic, and hand-drew a simplified logic block diagram on scratch paper. Afterward, he put away the notes and textbook and quickly browsed the knowledge points about tool radius compensation stored on his phone.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute by car
description: Drove from Xingang Community along Huatianjing Road to the company, playing the local morning news broadcast along the way to learn about city updates. The road was slippery, and he kept his speed within 50 km/h.
location: Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (commuting section)

name: Reported to work, performed the morning equipment inspection, and attended the team morning meeting.
description: Arriving at the workshop early, he changed into his work clothes, checked the lubricant levels and air pressure gauge readings of the two CNC machine tools as usual, and reviewed the night shift handover log to confirm nothing was abnormal. He then attended the morning meeting led by shift leader Wang Lei to learn about the day's production tasks and safety precautions. After the meeting, he discussed the programming plan with colleague Liu Zhiqiang and told Master Sun that he would ask for advice during the lunch break.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organize project materials and draft the summary report for the digital transformation project.
description: At the office workstation, he retrieved 15 technical logs, 4 meeting minutes, and 3 sets of key test data for the digital transformation project from the project file server, and reclassified and archived them by time and type. He then wrote an initial summary report of about 1,800 words, focusing on the process of solving bit error issues during MES interface debugging by adding ferrite rings, grounding the shielding layer, and using CRC check, as well as the optimization approach for the tool compensation algorithm and the comparative test results. He also organized his personal lessons learned into a personal growth chapter.
location: Workshop office area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Noon preparation, lunch at the cafeteria seeking advice, and fragmented review.
description: Before the lunch break, he wrote down the specific questions he wanted to ask on a sticky note. He went to the cafeteria for the braised pork chop set meal. During the meal, he called his master, Sun Jianguo, to ask about determining the direction of tool radius compensation and choosing between left and right tool compensation for machining internal and external contours. Master Sun explained in depth with project examples, and he jotted down the key points on a napkin. After eating, he returned to his workstation and used the CNC learning app on his phone to quickly browse explanations of spindle orientation control logic and special M codes, marking three easily confused knowledge points.
location: Canteen and workshop office area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Plant, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Consulted Master Sun and revised and submitted the project report.
description: He printed the report draft in advance and asked Master Sun to review it. Master Sun suggested adding a comparison table of three common compensation algorithms (B tool compensation, C tool compensation, and basic tool compensation) in the technical implementation section. After accepting the suggestion, he opened Excel, made a concise comparison table, and embedded it in the report. He read through the full text, adjusted the wording and logical order, formally submitted the report through the company's internal document management system, and copied Manager Zhang from the technical department and Team Leader Wang.
location: Workshop and office area at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Work break and transferring project bonus to the home-buying fund
description: After submitting the report, he took a short break, took out his phone, logged into the China Construction Bank app, and transferred the 2,000 yuan project bonus he had just received in full into a dedicated savings account called the Home Purchase Special Fund.
location: Workshop office area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: After-work in-depth review and workshop machine tool inspection
description: During the intervals when the machine tools were automatically processing parts, he went back to his workstation, took out the textbook Numerical Control Principles and his notebook, and focused on tackling two weak areas: the ladder diagram pitfalls of PLC step instructions and the interlocking logic of special M codes. Every half hour, he got up to make routine inspections of the two running machine tools and confirmed that the machining status was normal.
location: Workshop and office area at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Routine task processing and shift handover
description: Completed routine tasks such as filling in the daily report and tool presetting. Before leaving work, communicated with colleague Liu Zhiqiang about the programming plan for the new batch of parts for tomorrow, briefed him in person on today's equipment operation status, and signed the shift handover log to confirm.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive home from work.
description: After work, I drove away from the company along Huatianjing Road. The rain had cleared and the air was fresh, so I made a spontaneous decision to go fishing by the Tongbotang River for an hour as a reward for completing today's challenge.
location: Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (commuting section)

name: Evening night fishing by the riverside to unwind.
description: He parked the car at a safe spot by the Tongbotang River, took his portable fishing gear out of the trunk, set up the rod, and enjoyed some quiet time. During this time he caught two small crucian carp, took photos as keepsakes, and released them. In the evening, the river breeze on his face soothed his fatigue.
location: Tongbotang Riverbank, Songjiang District, Shanghai (near the intersection of Zhongshan Second Road / Songhui East Road)

name: Returning to accommodation and a simple dinner
description: Packed up the fishing gear and drove back to Xingang Community. I picked up the newly bought review notebook at the Cainiao station downstairs, then at home quickly made noodles with a poached egg to get dinner done.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with father to discuss the home purchase
description: Sent the materials for three key properties—Poly Xizi Bay, Sanxiang Four Seasons Flower City, and Greenland Rose Nine Li—to my father via WeChat, and made a video call to report in detail on last Saturday's house-viewing experience and the various data. Father suggested giving priority to elevator apartments built after 2015, focusing on the community property management and the distance to the subway station, and reminded me to verify the use of the housing maintenance fund. We agreed that next time we would do an online virtual viewing or Yin Hao would do another key review.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (at the desk)

name: Evening focused study to conquer weak knowledge points.
description: Opened the textbook and notes and focused all energy on conquering two major difficulties: the troubleshooting approach for the spindle orientation control system and the interlocking application of special M codes in ladder diagrams. Following the example problems, he worked through the ladder diagram logic on scrap paper, verbally repeated the M-code execution order, and when stuck, posted a help request on the CNC learning forum.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (at the desk)

name: Before bed, organize notes, relax with games, and turn off the lights to sleep.
description: He put away the study materials, organized that day's project report and the new knowledge points from his review into his electronic study notes, checked tomorrow's weather and main work arrangements, and listed two key tasks in his memo. After washing up, he lay in bed, opened "Honor of Kings," played two quick matches with his older brother Yin Tao to relax, and turned off the lights at 23:40 sharp, ending a fulfilling day.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run and breakfast.
description: The alarm woke me on time. I changed into workout clothes, warmed up downstairs in the residential complex, then jogged 800 meters to Xiaokunshan Health Park, where I completed a 3-kilometer run on the rubber track at a pace of 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer. After the run, I stretched for 15 minutes in the park's fitness area, then jogged home. After taking a cold shower, I had whole-wheat bread, hot milk, and hard-boiled eggs for breakfast, while scrolling through my phone to browse Songjiang local housing information and mortgage rates.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and Xiaokunshan Health Park

name: Commuting to work
description: He changed into work clothes, took his commuter bag and notebook, and drove the gray old-model Polo to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. There was little traffic, and he arrived in 15 minutes. In the car, he once again reviewed the key points he wanted to discuss with Manager Zhang today.
location: From Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning work and interview preparation.
description: After arriving at the factory, he first checked the hydraulic pressure, coolant, and tool wear of the two CNC machines; everything was normal. At 8 o'clock he attended the team morning meeting, where squad leader Wang assigned the day's tasks. After the meeting, he went over the part drawings and program parameters with colleague Liu Zhiqiang, and handled the parts left over from yesterday. At 9:30, he returned to his workstation and opened his notebook to organize his thoughts for the afternoon interview: he summarized the case of participating in the digital transformation project to troubleshoot MES signal bit errors, the PLC-to-host computer communication knowledge he had learned, listed his shortcomings (such as management skills to improve), and prepared question angles around the application for the senior technician certificate and the team leader selection. In the meantime, he briefly mentioned to Master Sun Jianguo his plan to talk with Manager Zhang in the afternoon, testing the waters.
location: Workshop and workstation of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch-break gathering and factory-area run
description: I had lunch at the factory canteen with Master Sun Jianguo and colleagues Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang. I ordered braised pork chop noodles and listened to them chat about everyday things while eating. At 12:20, I changed into running shoes and ran 3 km on the back factory road, at a pace of 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. After the run, I wet my face with cold water in the restroom to refresh myself.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory canteen and rear factory yard road, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon work and equipment inspection
description: In the afternoon, the equipment in the workshop ran smoothly. I spot-checked the parts processed in the morning and kept records. Around 14:00, I performed the routine inspection of the two CNC machine tools as planned, paying special attention to the MES communication cable interface that was handled yesterday, and confirmed that the contact was good and secure.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Discuss career development with Manager Zhang.
description: Seeing that Manager Zhang Ming's office door was open, he knocked and entered with his notebook. He briefly reported what he had gained from participating in the digital transformation project. Manager Zhang affirmed his technical ability and asked about his future plans. Taking the opportunity, he asked about the senior technician certification and the team leader competition. Manager Zhang clearly said the company encourages moving from technical to management roles, and suggested first obtaining the senior technician certificate, then accumulating management experience in subsequent small projects to prepare for the competition. The conversation lasted about 25 minutes.
location: Manager Zhang Ming's office, office building, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Record interview key points and make a plan.
description: After returning to my workstation in the workshop, I immediately opened my notebook and wrote down Manager Zhang's key suggestions: obtain a senior technician certificate, and participate in or lead small projects to accumulate management experience. Then I added a reminder in my phone's memo: check the registration requirements for the senior technician certification this weekend, and formulate a study plan within a week.
location: Workshop work station at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wrap-up work and night-shift handover
description: After adjusting his state, he completed the machining and self-inspection of the last batch of parts with Liu Zhiqiang. Before leaving work, he submitted the daily report and gave a detailed handover to the evening shift colleague, noting that the equipment was running stably but the MES module needed attention.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute after work and preparation for apartment viewing
description: Left work promptly at 17:00 and drove toward Songjiang University Town to view an apartment. On the way, he stopped at a FamilyMart on Wenhui Road, bought a bottle of water and a notebook to record details during the viewing, then continued navigating to the address provided by the agent.
location: From Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, via FamilyMart to Longfor Haowangshan, Lane 2908, Renmin North Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Viewing an apartment in the evening
description: Accompanied by the agent Xiao Wu, he visited a 69 sqm two-bedroom apartment in Longhu Haowangshan, located on the 15th floor facing south, with decent lighting and layout. He took out a tape measure to measure the width and depth of the living room and master bedroom, calculating whether a treadmill and fishing gear could fit. He asked about the property management fee, parking space rent, surrounding amenities, and the distance to the subway station. Xiao Wu revealed that the owner's total price was 1,620,000 yuan but there was still room for negotiation. He said the apartment was okay but needed further consideration.
location: Building 15, Longfor Haowangshan Community, Lane 2908, Renmin North Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai
