name: Return Trip and Dinner Expense Calculation
description: After viewing the house, he drove back to Xingang Community, walked to his usual Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road, and ordered a fish-flavored shredded pork over rice. While waiting for the meal, he opened the mortgage calculator app on his phone and calculated based on a total price of 1,620,000 yuan, a down payment of 480,000 yuan, a loan of 1,140,000 yuan, a 30-year term, and an annual interest rate of 4.2%, getting a monthly payment of about 8,100 yuan. Facing savings that had just crossed five figures and his monthly fixed expenses, he felt heavy-hearted, and even his movement of picking up food slowed down.
location: Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, No. 232 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Hesitated to speak to his father
description: After the meal, he walked to the restaurant entrance and the roadside near the residential community. He took a screenshot of the mortgage calculation result, opened his father's WeChat chat, typed 'Dad, I looked at a house...' and then deleted it all. After hesitating for a long time, he finally exited WeChat. Thinking that his father was still busy transferring the old house, he decided not to add to his worries for the time being and to bear this anxiety alone.
location: The entrance of Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, No. 232 Xingang Road, and the roadside of Xingang Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening study and coping with anxiety.
description: Returning to the rental apartment, I forced myself to study and opened the "Three Views of Composite Solids" chapter of the Mechanical Drawing textbook, but the mortgage payment and savings figures kept distracting me. When drawing, I drew dashed lines as solid lines and threw down my pen in frustration. I opened the Tide app and listened to a 15-minute deep relaxation track, but still couldn't stop my mind from racing.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Social relaxation before bed.
description: Gave up forcing himself to study. After taking a shower, he lay in bed and sent a message in the "Songjiang Three Brothers" WeChat group venting about the pressure of the monthly mortgage payment. He received teasing and comfort from Chen Jie, Gao Zhiyuan, and Ma Xiaofeng. After chatting for 20 minutes, he felt a bit better and decided to put the house-buying matter aside for the time being.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep preparation and insomnia.
description: Set the alarm for 6:20 the next day, turned off the overhead light and kept only the bedside lamp. My body was tired but my mind was wide awake; I tried abdominal breathing but couldn't calm down. I got stuck in a cycle of repeatedly calculating the pressure and risks of buying a house and unconsciously scrolled through loan forums on my phone, feeling more anxious the more I read. It wasn't until after 2 a.m. that I fell into a deep sleep from extreme exhaustion. This was the first night of anxiety-induced insomnia.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Late-night insomnia and searching
description: After waking up at 1 a.m. and being unable to fall back asleep, thoughts of the mortgage, review progress, and work stress kept running through his mind. He picked up his phone, looked at Beike, browsed the VR panoramic view of Longhu Haowangshan, calculated the down payment of 480,000 yuan and monthly payment of 8,100 yuan, and searched for information on early loan repayment and Shanghai housing price trends. He did not fall into a dazed sleep until 2:30 a.m.
location: Bedroom at No. X, Room X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Intermittent shallow sleep.
description: After falling asleep, the sleep quality was extremely poor. He spent the whole night dreaming about making mistakes in exams and the pressure of repaying the loan, waking up several times in between, each time only about an hour had passed. When the alarm went off, he still felt extremely exhausted.
location: Bedroom at No. X, Room X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Early Morning Wake-Up and Simple Breakfast
description: After the alarm went off, he struggled to get up. Since he didn't have the energy for a morning run, he took a cold shower to refresh himself. After drying off, he took eggs and milk from the fridge, fried a couple of fried eggs, and quickly finished breakfast with milk.
location: Room X, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute to work.
description: Drove from the rented residential community along Xingang Road and Huatianjing Highway to the factory, listening to the 103.7 morning rush radio on the way, and arrived at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory at exactly 7:42.
location: Along the route from Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai to No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town

name: Morning work: arrival inspection and precision valve body machining
description: After arriving at the factory, changed into work clothes and first checked the coolant, hydraulic pressure, and guideway lubrication of the CNC milling machine. Met Master Sun Jianguo, who asked about my sleep and reminded me to be careful with the operation. Then started machining the precision valve body, checked the machining program and tool compensation, started the machine, and kept a close eye on parameter changes throughout. When changing tools, I nearly entered the wrong tool number, but paused and corrected it in time. After that I was even more cautious, barely even drinking water to avoid distraction.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and midday walk
description: Alone in a corner of the workshop, he ate the two bread rolls and a box of yogurt he had brought, while scrolling on his phone to check housing price trends, growing increasingly irritable. After eating, he leaned against the wall, closed his eyes, and rested for a while, then walked along the main road of the factory park to try to relax his mind, but his thoughts still revolved around the afternoon's work and the evening's review.
location: Workshop rest area and main road of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work, program optimization, and wrapping up.
description: In the afternoon, continued CNC machining. During the machine's automatic operation, used the spare time to study ladder diagram logic. Master Sun pointed out an incorrectly drawn contact connection, and it was corrected in time. Agreed with Engineer Liu Zhiqiang to discuss the new project plan on Friday. Near the end of the shift, stopped the machine to spot-check the key dimensions of three products, and they all passed. Then cleaned up the metal chips, put the coolant hose back in place, filled in the equipment operation log and daily production report, and noted in the shift handover log that the oil pressure gauge needs attention.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute home from work
description: After changing out of his work clothes, he drove back to his residence. He hesitated briefly as he passed the Xingang Xincun fresh-food supermarket, but ultimately drove straight back into the residential area.
location: Along the route from 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: After returning to the rental, I boiled water to cook noodles, added greens and eggs, and in five minutes made vegetable and egg noodles. I sat alone at the small dining table and ate them quickly, finishing even the soup.
location: Kitchen and dining table at a certain room in Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Fragmented relaxation and study preparation
description: After dinner, I first flopped onto the sofa to watch a replay of a nature documentary while scrolling through short videos to relax. After watering the money tree on the balcony, I opened TIA Portal simulation software on my laptop and placed the Senior Technician Certification theory question bank and my notebook on the desk to prepare for the evening review.
location: Living room and desk, Room X, Building X, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening review: PLC programming and mock exam papers
description: He first practiced basic ladder diagrams, then attempted a traffic light program with time relays. Figuring out the sequential logic took a long time; after debugging, he saved it. After a ten-minute break, he started a comprehensive mock exam covering PLC and mechanical drawing. He made many mistakes on the questions about completing missing lines in three-view drawings and communication troubleshooting, felt frustrated, copied the correct steps into his notebook with a red pen, and ended the study session.
location: At the desk in Room Y, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Socialize with friends before bed.
description: Feeling that his study wasn't going well, he picked up his phone and vented about tonight's studying in the "Songjiang Three Brothers" group chat. Gao Zhiyuan replied with encouragement, and Ma Xiaofeng sent a game team-up invitation. He shared recent updates and the questions he got wrong with them, and ultimately did not accept the game invite, avoiding staying up late.
location: Sofa or bed, Building No. X, Room No. X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Went to the bathroom to brush my teeth and wash my face, then soaked my feet in hot water to relieve the day's fatigue and anxiety. Then I got into bed, turned off the main light, and left only the bedside night light.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room X, Unit X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Tossing and turning late at night with anxiety.
description: After lying down for nearly an hour, he still couldn't fall asleep, so he picked up his phone again and opened Beike to repeatedly browse housing listings, calculating down payments and monthly payments, knowing it was useless but unable to stop. Near midnight, he forced himself to put the phone away, closed his eyes and counted sheep, trying to fall asleep, but the night was destined to remain broken, light sleep.
location: Bedroom at No. X, Room X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Startled awake in the early morning and had intermittent light sleep.
description: At 2 a.m., he woke with a start from light sleep again. Lying on the bed in the second bedroom, Room 603, Building 2, Xingang Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai, he felt suffocated by the mortgage, monthly payments, and income figures. Fumbling for his phone in the dark, he opened the calculator and mortgage app and repeatedly calculated the 8,000 yuan monthly mortgage payment, the monthly salary of just over 7,000 yuan, and the unstable part-time income. The deficit he saw made fear surge like a tide. Afterward, although his body was utterly exhausted, his mind could not stop racing. From the exam questions being off-topic to the reliability of weekend part-time work, he drifted in and out of many short dreams about machine alarms and being late for the exam, and his sleep was very restless.
location: Room 603, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (secondary bedroom)

name: Early rising, weighing, and breakfast prep
description: The alarm went off for the third time at 6 before I struggled out of bed, my head still groggy. I weighed myself first: 72.7 kg, my weight hadn't blown up. I washed my face with cold water, looked at my slightly red eyes in the mirror, and silently encouraged myself. Then I boiled two soft-boiled eggs, made a cup of instant coffee, and tore off two slices of whole-wheat bread. Even though I had no appetite, I forced myself to eat. While eating, I opened the “Huadian Shijian” app and confirmed that the Qixi Festival gift order for Lin Yue showed “Confirmed, expected delivery to the front desk of Lin Yue - Shanghai XX Technology Co., Ltd. between 9 and 10.” I also left a message for the delivery driver: “Just leave it at the front desk, thanks,” and felt a little relieved.
location: Room 603, Building 2, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting by car and equipment inspection upon arrival
description: He put on his work pants, pocketed his phone, keys, and cigarettes, went downstairs, and got into the already somewhat warm Lavida. After starting it, he turned the air conditioning to maximum. Along the usual route, he listened to morning financial news, trying to ease the morning anxiety. There were not many cars on the road, and he arrived at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory in about 15 minutes. He greeted the security guard, Old Zhang, changed into his work clothes, and went straight to the CNC-03 workstation. He checked the coolant, lubricating oil level, and air pressure according to the procedures, wiped the operation panel and guide rails clean with a cotton cloth, and saw the place where he had almost entered wrong parameters the day before. He firmly drew a red circle on the desk calendar as a warning to himself.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Focused on work in the morning and received thanks from my girlfriend.
description: After the morning meeting, he started machining two batches of small valve bodies. Around 9:30, a wave of dizziness hit him, and his finger visibly paused while entering tool offset. Team leader Wang Lei happened to pass by and tapped the control console, reminding him: "Bro, your eyes are all red. Take it easy — a miss is as good as a mile." He quickly drank some strong tea and forced himself to slow down. At 10:20, his phone vibrated with a WeChat voice message from Lin Yue. Her voice was pleasantly surprised and slightly choked up: "Yin Hao! When did you order this? A colleague just received it for me! How did you know I had a little dream for my desk? And this music box — it sounds amazing!" She also sent a photo of the roses and a preserved-flower music box placed beside her workstation. Yin Hao smiled and typed back: "Glad you like it. Get back to work now, don't let the boss catch you." His mood improved afterwards, and he continued machining the third batch of stepped shafts. After completing each one, he measured it carefully with a vernier caliper and recorded it in the self-inspection sheet. Progress was normal, and all pieces passed quality inspection.
location: CNC-03 workstation, CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break: venting to a childhood friend over the phone.
description: After the lunch break bell rang, he didn't go to the cafeteria. First he went to the convenience store in the factory area and bought a pack of Liqun cigarettes, which he barely smoked. He walked to the smoking area on the shady east side of the workshop, lit one, and coughed for a while. He called his childhood friend Zhang Wei and poured out all the pressure: the fear of calculating the mortgage in the early hours, the near mistake in the morning, etc. Zhang Wei was still in his usual carefree tone: "You're just scaring yourself! Talk about it after the exam tomorrow! If you really can't handle it, come back and I'll treat you to drinks and clams!" After talking for fifteen minutes, he stubbed out the cigarette and felt the tightness in his chest ease quite a bit.
location: No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai: the convenience store in the factory area of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory and the smoking area on the east side of the workshop.

name: Steadily machining complex contoured parts in the afternoon
description: By the afternoon, his energy had recovered, and he started machining a complex contoured part with curves. The programmer Liu Zhiqiang sent over the revised program. After verifying it was correct, Yin Hao calmly called up the program, set the tool, and started the machine. During the machine's automatic tool change, he mentally recited the troubleshooting flowchart for spindle positioning faults from CNC Machine Tool Installation, Adjustment, and Maintenance (Advanced), making sure everything would go smoothly. He stayed focused on the operation all afternoon, and quality remained stable.
location: CNC-03 workstation, CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wrap-up, handover, and mentor's encouragement
description: The last batch of parts was completed and passed self-inspection. Then he cleaned the machine tool, swept up the iron chips, and oiled the guide rails. After finishing the Equipment Operation Log and the Daily Production Report, he handed them to his master, Sun Jianguo, for review. Master Sun looked them over carefully, patted Yin Hao on the shoulder, and said, "You did well this afternoon and held it together. Do well in tomorrow's exam and don't embarrass our team." Yin Hao nodded seriously, then turned off the main power and ended the day's work.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Shopping after work and preparing dinner at home.
description: He drove away from the factory and stopped by the Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket near the residential community. He bought spinach, three tomatoes, a box of free-range eggs, and a small piece of pork tenderloin, planning to make scrambled eggs with tomatoes and spinach and pork slice soup. After getting home, he took a cold shower to wash away fatigue, then put on an apron, washed and cut the vegetables, and beat the eggs. For the tomato and egg dish, he added a bit more sugar. He ate everything cleanly with rice, along with the two dishes and one soup. After cleaning up, he glanced at his phone. Lin Yue had posted a photo of herself with the gift at around 5:00, captioned "Seeing them every day makes me feel great." Yin Hao replied with a smiley face, then put his phone on silent and got ready to review.
location: Room 603, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road

name: Final review and item preparation before the exam
description: Yin Hao spread the CNC Machine Tool Setup and Maintenance Worker textbook and practice questions out on the desk. First, he used a mind map to reorganize the key points of two major modules: spindle orientation fault troubleshooting and ladder diagram analysis. Then he did the short-answer section of the last practice test, and after checking it, circled the easily confused M codes in red (M03/M04 forward/reverse rotation, M06 tool change) and wrote down a mnemonic. Next, he packed his exam supplies one by one into a transparent document bag: ID card, admission ticket, three black gel pens, 2B pencil, eraser, non-programmable calculator, and drawing ruler. Before zipping it up, he checked again. Then he opened the map app, entered the exam location Songjiang District Xinqiao Vocational Technical School, and the navigation showed about 30 minutes by car. Considering the morning rush hour, he decided to leave at 6:50 the next morning, set the alarm for 6:10, and took a screenshot of the nearby parking location.
location: Room 603, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai: desk and living room

name: Video call with girlfriend
description: He made the video call on time. On the other side of the screen was the desk lamp in Lin Yue's dorm room. She placed the roses she had received and the music box that played 'Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star' in front of the camera. Her eyes were slightly red, and she said in a choked voice, 'I really, really love it. My roommates all say it looks beautiful. Next year I will definitely get a job at a company in Shanghai and go with you.' Yin Hao felt both bittersweet and warm, and clumsily hummed the opening of 'Confession Balloon' through the screen. Lin Yue broke into a smile through her tears and said, 'Okay, okay, straight-man romance. Do well on your exam tomorrow!' After a brief conversation, they hung up.
location: On the sofa in the living room, Room 603, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Deep review and mindset adjustment
description: After hanging up the phone, he copied all the key points and wrong questions he had just marked onto a 'Ten-Page Sheet Before the Exam' and stuck it on the front of the file folder. Then he closed his eyes and mentally went through the entire sequence of powering on the CNC machine, returning to zero, calling up the program, and setting parameters. By 10 p.m., after integrating and putting away the books, he felt his mind was no longer a muddle but clearly organized, and his mood had become much calmer.
location: At the desk, Room 603, Building 2, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime washing and nighttime insomnia.
description: After brushing teeth and washing his face, he changed into pajamas and lay down on the bed, turned off the main light, and turned on night mode on his phone. He couldn't resist opening the part-time job group again. The message about an auto repair shop in Songjiang Industrial Zone urgently recruiting weekend night repair helpers at 300 yuan per day made him hesitate for a while. He sent the link to himself, agonizing over whether it would affect his condition on Monday. After turning off the light, the darkness amplified every sound: the occasional passing cars outside the window, his own heartbeat. His mind involuntarily began running through the fault scenario questions for tomorrow's exam, next month's repayment date, and whether the part-time job information was reliable. His heart raced. It was not until late at night that his body finally succumbed to exhaustion, and he drifted into a light sleep amid the chaotic thoughts.
location: On the bed in the secondary bedroom, Room 603, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning insomnia and financial anxiety
description: Waking up to sunlight on Saturday morning, Yin Hao felt groggy from the aftereffects of insomnia. Recalling last night's mortgage calculation, the nearly 8,000 yuan monthly loan payment made him anxious. Staring at the cracks on the ceiling, he once again calculated the repayment pressure after his father's financial help, and finally calmed down by recalling the warm moment of making up with Lin Yue the day before.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: WeChat chat with Lin Yue in the early morning
description: After waking up, Yin Hao picked up his phone and sent Lin Yue a good-morning message, telling her he had a theory exam today. Lin Yue quickly replied, asking about his sleep and encouraging him. The two chatted casually for a few minutes about the exam and the afternoon house viewing. She had completely come out of yesterday's mood, which made Yin Hao feel much more at ease.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Setting out for the exam and roadside breakfast
description: After washing up, Yin Hao changed into a white T-shirt and dark casual pants, checked his exam admission documents, and left. At the usual Subei-style breakfast stall at the community gate, he bought two pork buns and a cup of soy milk, finished them quickly, then started his gray Volkswagen Lavida, set the navigation to Shanghai Vocational Skills Appraisal Center, and departed on time at 7:00.
location: Subei-style breakfast stall near the intersection of Xingang Road and Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Arriving at the exam venue and preparing before the exam
description: At about 7:40, Yin Hao drove to the Shanghai Vocational Skills Appraisal Center at No. 4899 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, parked in the parking lot, and walked into the teaching building. He checked his information at the exam room door, then sat on a chair in the corridor, went over his PLC ladder diagram notes one last time, silently memorized key instructions, and waited for the exam to begin.
location: Shanghai Vocational Skills Appraisal Center, No. 4899, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Took the vocational skill theory exam
description: At the 8:30 exam bell, Yin Hao received the paper and quickly skimmed it. The numerical control principles and mechanical drawing modules were relatively easy, so he answered at a steady pace. When he got to the PLC programming questions, two comprehensive problems were quite tricky. Drawing on his Python experience, he did his best to write the ladder diagram programs. Although he was not sure they were completely correct, his thinking was clear. He handed in the paper at 11:30, feeling that his overall performance was normal, but the PLC section still worried him.
location: Examination Room 5, Shanghai Vocational Skills Appraisal Center, 4899 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Ran into colleague Wang Lei at the exam site.
description: After handing in the exam paper, Yin Hao ran into Wang Lei, his colleague and team leader, in the exit hall. They smiled at each other, went to a corner to exchange thoughts on the exam, and both felt that the PLC programming questions were tricky and took a lot of time. They were fairly confident about the digital measurement and drawing sections. After wishing each other good luck on the practical exam, they left separately.
location: Examination Site Exit Hall, Shanghai Vocational Skills Appraisal Center, 4899 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Lunch and mortgage information inquiry
description: To save time, Yin Hao drove to the Niudawan Lanzhou Hand-Pulled Noodle Restaurant on Guangfulin Road and ordered a beef pulled noodle with extra portions. While waiting and eating, he opened the mortgage calculator app to recalculate the monthly payment, and searched for information on housing provident fund loan procedures and second-hand home loan appraisal fees, doing last-minute homework for the afternoon house viewing.
location: Niu Da Wan Lanzhou Hand-Pulled Noodle Restaurant near the intersection of Guangfulin Road and Longteng Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Rush to the old town to meet the agent.
description: After eating the noodles, Yin Hao drove to the old town of Songjiang. On the way, he told Xiao Zhang, the agent from Pacific Real Estate, the meeting point via WeChat. At about 13:50, he arrived at the gate of Tongji City Yazhu, No. 886 Huancheng Road. Xiao Zhang was already waiting with a folder and property brochures.
location: Entrance of Tongji City Yazhu Community, 886 Huancheng Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Viewed two second-hand residential properties in the old city
description: Xiao Zhang showed Yin Hao two apartments. The first was an 83 m² two-bedroom at Tongji City Yazhu; the total price was attractive but the decoration was old and the ground-floor shops below were noisy. The second was an 85 m² two-bedroom at Fangzhouyuan Sancun with a lower unit price, but parking was difficult, the stairwell was dark, and the facilities were outdated. Yin Hao became more firm in his decision to choose the university town area. He also discussed loan policies and property survey details with Xiao Zhang and asked him to send the floor plans.
location: Tongji City Yazhu Community, No. 886 Huancheng Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai; Fangzhouyuan Third Village, Lane 30, Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home to rest and record house-viewing notes
description: Yin Hao politely declined the agent's invitation to continue viewing properties and drove back to his rented apartment in Xingang Community. After showering, he changed into loose clothing, made a cup of tea, sat at his desk, took out his house-viewing notebook, and recorded in detail the pros and cons, surrounding transportation, and amenities of today's two apartments, and gave preliminary scores.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Comprehensively analyzed and ranked housing listings, then shared the results with Lin Yue
description: Yin Hao turned on his computer and created a home-buying screening spreadsheet. He scored and ranked the eight listings, including those from today, across five dimensions: total price, commuting time, layout squareness, community environment, and surrounding amenities. The two apartments near University Town took the lead in overall score. He sent a screenshot of the spreadsheet to Lin Yue and explained the logic, and Lin Yue expressed approval and support.
location: At the desk in the rented room, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Simple dinner and tidying up around the house.
description: After sorting out the housing listings, Yin Hao cooked a bowl of vegetable and egg noodles using the greens and eggs from the fridge, adding some homemade chili sauce. After the meal, he quickly washed the dishes and tidied up the kitchen, and hung up the work clothes he would wear to work the next day in advance.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Consulting Teacher Liu online and planning practical exam preparation
description: Yin Hao asked Instructor Liu Jianjun from the training class via WeChat about key topics such as FANUC system tool magazine troubleshooting and CNC parameter settings. Teacher Liu gave detailed suggestions and recommended two practical exercise video links. After thanking him, Yin Hao listed a to-do list for the practical exam in his phone's memo app and planned to practice on the recommended simulation platform next Saturday.
location: At the desk in the rented room, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Teamed up with old comrades to relax playing Honor of Kings
description: Feeling mentally drained, Yin Hao logged into Honor of Kings and, in the WeChat group, gathered his old comrades Zhang Jianguo, Qiangzi, and Xiaoma for a four-person ranked match. In voice chat, they talked about how they were doing: Old Zhang was running marathons, and Qiangzi complained that his project was being pushed hard. Although they lost the promotion match, the game diluted the tension of the day and maintained the bonds of comradely friendship.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Try meditation to aid sleep and fall asleep
description: After the game and washing up, Yin Hao changed into pajamas and turned off the main light. Under the warm yellow lamp, he played white noise rain sounds on his phone and tried breathing meditation, focusing his attention on his breath, letting thoughts about housing prices, monthly mortgage payments, and exam answers gradually drift away. Although his mind wasn't completely empty, his tension eased, and he fell into a deep sleep around 3 a.m.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting up and light activity
description: The sky was gloomy and the air was humid and stuffy. My shoulders were sore from holding the same posture for a long time during yesterday's exam. I massaged my shoulders, drank a big glass of plain water, and did a few stretching movements to slowly wake my body up.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run.
description: He put on his running shoes, set out from the north gate of the community, jogged east along Xingang Road, passed the entrance of Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket, and then turned back along the perimeter of Xiaokunshan Health Park. He ran for about 25 minutes, worked up a light sweat, and his shoulders felt much looser.
location: Sidewalks around Xingang Road and Xingang Residential Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Shower and breakfast
description: After going home and taking a shower, he took frozen dumplings out of the refrigerator and cooked them. While eating, he browsed the workshop WeChat group, saw the game screenshot Liu Zhiqiang had posted last night, and casually liked it. After finishing the dumplings, he felt refreshed.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Review the key points for the practical exam.
description: He sat down at the old desk, opened WeChat on his phone to check the document on key points for the practical exam that Teacher Liu Jianjun had sent the previous night, and, together with his notes, rehearsed in his mind the steps for spindle orientation stop and automatic tool changer adjustment, silently reciting the key parameters twice.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: While eating dumplings, I browsed my phone. I saw a message from fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang asking about today's cycling; I replied and shared aerial photos. Wu Zhiqiang invited me to go fishing on Chongming Island next week. I also noticed Wang Lei reminding everyone in the group about the materials to bring for next Monday's training, and I jotted down a memo.
description: Riding an electric bike from Xingang Community along Guangfulin Road westward for about 10 minutes, he arrived at Lao Chen Convenience Repair Shop, No. 107 Longyuan Road. Master Chen Jianguo was worrying over a microwave oven that would not heat. Yin Hao took the multimeter, and based on his knowledge of circuits, tested the high-voltage diode and high-voltage capacitor. He found the fuse tube charred black and the capacitor leaking. He skillfully removed the old parts and, together with Master Chen, replaced them with new ones. After power-on testing, the microwave worked normally. Master Chen patted Yin Hao on the shoulder and said, "Boy, you're quick on the uptake. If you have free time on weekends, come and help me out here, and I'll pay you!" Yin Hao was tempted and replied, "Thanks, Uncle Chen! But I have to prioritize my regular job and certification exam. If I'm free, I'll definitely come." Then he took out his phone to show a picture of a shoe cabinet and asked Master Chen for advice on painting. Master Chen suggested sanding it smooth first and applying two coats of wood wax oil, which was effective and environmentally friendly.
location: Old Chen's Convenience Repair Shop, 107 Longyuan Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Buying groceries, making lunch, and taking a lunch break
description: Braving light rain, he rode his bike to the Xingang New Village fresh food supermarket and bought greens, tomatoes, a box of tofu, and frozen Nantong clams. After returning home, he made a delicious seafood noodle soup with tomatoes and clams. After eating and cleaning up, he lay on the bed, set an alarm, closed his eyes and rested for 25 minutes, listening to the rain outside the window.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai; and Room 402, Xingang Residential Community.

name: Bought a capacitor for an electric fan and helped a neighbor repair a fan, receiving dumplings as a thank-you gift.
description: After the rain let up, I put on a raincoat, rode my electric bike straight to the Electronic Appliance Market at 268 Zhongshan Middle Road, and bought a 1.5F/450V starting capacitor at the second-floor counter specializing in home appliance parts. After returning home, I knocked on the door of Aunt Chen Xiuying, who lives across the hall, and found that the starting capacitor of her old floor fan was bulging. After replacing it with a soldering iron, the fan resumed strong airflow, and Aunt Chen was so happy that she beamed from ear to ear. Afterward, she insisted on giving me a box of hand-made celery and pork dumplings. We chatted for a while in the hallway. She mentioned that the new breakfast stall in the community sells good fried dough sticks, and also complained a bit about the property management.
location: No. 268 Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai: Songjiang Electronic & Electrical Market, and Room 301, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community

name: Sorting out finances and calculating the monthly payment shortfall.
description: He went home, put away the dumplings, sat down at the desk, opened his laptop, checked the bank statements, and used a mortgage calculator and a bookkeeping app to sum up the monthly payment and recent income and expenses. He found that as long as he limited milk tea and dining out, plus the weekend part-time income, the monthly payment gap had narrowed to an affordable range. Relieved, he saved a screenshot of the calculation.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with parents
description: He propped his phone against the headboard and made a video call to his hometown. His mother answered, asked about his diet, and told him not to work too hard. His father took over the conversation and calmly said that a buyer had been found for the old house. Once the procedures are completed next month, they would get 600,000 yuan. They would first transfer 400,000 yuan for the down payment, and keep the remaining 200,000 yuan at home as reserve. If he had trouble with the monthly mortgage payment, he could tell them anytime. Yin Hao felt a surge of warmth in his chest, nodded firmly, and his throat tightened.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing ingredients, dinner, and post-dinner cleanup
description: I adjusted my mood and got ready to make dinner, washed vegetables, cut meat, and made shredded pork with green peppers and a green vegetable and tofu soup. I enjoyed it alone with relish, and the whole house smelled delicious. After eating, I quickly washed the dishes, wiped down the stove, and tidied up.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Free-time games and relaxation.
description: After washing the dishes, I leaned against the headboard and scrolled through my phone. My battle buddy Old Zhang called in the group chat to play Honor of Kings, so I teamed up with Qiangzi, Xiaoma, and others for a few rounds. There were wins and losses, and I stayed calm. Afterward, I watched League of Legends Pro League highlights to relax.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Showering and doing laundry.
description: After game time, took a shower, soaked and washed the changed clothes together with the morning running clothes, and hung them on the balcony. Smiled at himself in the mirror with satisfaction.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepared for meditation practice before bed
description: Turned off the main light, kept the bedside lamp on, set the alarm, put on earphones to play white noise and a guided meditation audio, and concentrated. Images of the repaired machine, Aunt Chen's dumplings, and his father's promise came to mind, and the anxiety clearly eased.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: After meditation, my eyelids felt very heavy. Around 22:00, I took off my headphones, turned off the lights, and quickly relaxed and fell asleep to the sound of pattering night rain. The subsequent sleep lasted until about 1:30 a.m. the next day, much earlier than in previous days.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waking up in the early morning, stretching indoors, and washing up
description: Woke up naturally at exactly 6:00, no alarm needed. I felt refreshed. Last night I slept from 23:00 to 6:00, 7 hours of high-quality sleep. I didn't get up immediately; I lay still in bed for two minutes, moving my ankles and wrists to let my body fully wake up. Then I sat up and did about 5 minutes of static stretching, mainly for the back of my thighs and my back, to prepare for the morning run. After that, I got up, went to the bathroom, quickly brushed my teeth and washed my face, and changed into the quick-dry running T-shirt, shorts, and running shoes I had laid out the night before.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go to the park for a morning run and exercise
description: To save time, he chose to ride an e-bike from Xingang Residential Area to Xiaokunshan Health Park. The morning air was cool and the road was clear; he arrived at the north gate of the park in about 5 minutes and parked the bike. Then he started a 5 km morning run along the rubber track in the park, with a steady pace of about 5 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer and even breathing. He began to sweat at the third kilometer and felt his body open up again. In the last kilometer, he did a slight speed-up to test his cardiorespiratory function. After running, he did about 5 minutes of stretching in the fitness area to loosen his joints.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After the morning run, went home to shower and have breakfast.
description: After a brief rest, he rode his electric bike back along the same route to his home in Xingang Community, taking about 5 minutes. Back home, he took a warm shower to wash off the stickiness, and changed into today's work clothes: a gray T-shirt and dark blue work pants. Breakfast was simple but efficient: two slices of whole wheat bread with a fried egg, plus a glass of hot milk, finished in 5 minutes. Meanwhile, he threw the dirty clothes from last night into the washing machine and set the pre-wash mode.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to work and morning tasks at the factory
description: At 7:35, you left home and rode your e-bike to Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. at No. 360 Huatianjing Road. On the way, you passed a breakfast stall near Xingang Road. Although you had eaten at home, out of habit you spent 3 yuan on two steamed buns (one pork, one vegetable) to eat as a mid-morning snack around 10 a.m. About 20 minutes later, you arrived at the factory, parked the e-bike in the designated shed, and locked it. You swiped your work ID to enter the factory area, went to the locker room to change into safety shoes and protective goggles, and then attended the daily pre-shift meeting in the workshop meeting room. Team leader Wang Lei emphasized today's key task of machining valve body parts and reminded everyone to watch for tool wear. After the meeting, you went straight to the programming office and found Liu Zhiqiang studying a program. You said, “Zhiqiang, last night I saw the program screenshot you posted in the group. Isn't the BUG in that tool-path optimization caused by the arc transition parameter?” The two of you analyzed it together in front of the computer screen for five minutes. You pointed out that the I and J parameters after the G02/G03 commands might have numerical deviations. Liu Zhiqiang suddenly saw the light and thanked you repeatedly.
location: Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning workshop machining tasks
description: Back at your workstation—a three-axis machining center. First you checked the lubricant and coolant levels of the equipment, then warmed up the machine, and carefully verified the dimensions of the first piece. In the morning, you focused strictly on the process card while operating the valve body parts. The roar of the machine made you feel grounded. During the break, shift leader Wang Lei came over and patted your shoulder: "Haozi, I heard you solved another problem for Zhiqiang? Good job."
location: Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break activities: lunch, practice questions, and seeking advice from Master Sun
description: At 11:30, the machine tool stopped running. You went to the canteen and got lunch: one braised pork chop, scallion-braised tofu, and rice. While eating, you didn't chat with your colleagues. You put on earphones, opened the question bank app for the senior technician exam on your phone, and answered 30 multiple-choice questions on CNC machine tool fault diagnosis while you ate. After lunch, you arrived on time at the office of technical consultant Sun Jianguo. Master Sun was looking at drawings. You came straight to the point: 'Master Sun, sorry to disturb you. I'd like to ask you about taking the senior technician exam later.' You reported in detail on your progress in preparing according to the plan and asked about the career development path in the factory after obtaining the certificate. Master Sun advised: 'The certificate is a hard threshold, but you also need to strengthen your ability to solve problems on site. When you have time, come by more often to look at the process improvement cases here.' You nodded earnestly and jotted down the key points in your phone's memo.
location: Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Midday nap
description: After talking with Master Sun, he returned to the workshop rest area, leaned back on the sofa, and closed his eyes to rest for 15 minutes. He didn't fall asleep, just let his mind briefly go blank and relaxed his eyes and neck.
location: Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon: workshop machining and equipment inspection wrap-up
description: In the afternoon, he continued machining valve body parts. The work pace was steady, and he quickly changed the fixture once mid-process. As planned, he completed all of the day's machining tasks before 16:30; after self-inspection, the yield rate was 100%. Then, as usual, he performed the routine daily inspection of the machine tool, checking air pressure, guideway oil, and cutting fluid concentration, and carefully filled in the “Equipment Daily Inspection Record Sheet”. After confirming everything was normal, he cleaned the machine surface and turned off the equipment power.
location: Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Leaving work, preparing for a run, and going to the sports center
description: After clocking out, he rode his electric bike back home to Xingang Residential Community, quickly changed into running shorts and a tank top, and brought a clean towel and a spare T-shirt. Then he got back on the electric bike and navigated to Songjiang Sports Center. On the way, he sent a voice message on WeChat to Chen Jie: "I'll be at the north gate of the Sports Center in 3 minutes."
location: Songjiang Sports Center (North Gate), 256 Ledu Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: 5 km run with Chen Jie
description: At the north gate of Songjiang Sports Center, I met Chen Jie. After a simple warm-up, the two of us ran 5 kilometers on the track at a pace of 6 minutes per kilometer. While running and chatting, Chen Jie said, "You look much better today. It didn't torment you last night, did it?" You smiled and said, "I slept through till dawn and feel completely revived. I'm going to make a final push for the senior technician certificate at the end of the year—go all out!" Chen Jie also shared the recent progress of his work projects. After the run, they stretched by the track, wished each other good luck, and went home.
location: Songjiang Sports Center, No. 256 Ledu Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home, prepare dinner, and video chat with family.
description: You rode home, still a bit sweaty. First you rinsed the rice and put it in the rice cooker, then took out the celery and pork dumplings Aunt Chen gave you yesterday from the fridge, started a pot of water, and planned to cook 15 for dinner. At the same time, you picked and washed a handful of greens to make a simple vegetable and egg drop soup. While waiting for the water to boil, you figured your parents should have finished dinner, so you made a video call. Your mother, Wang Xiuying, answered. She was very happy to see you in good spirits. You reported that work had gone smoothly that day, and you also talked about helping Aunt Chen fix her fan on Sunday. Mom reminded you not to get heatstroke in the hot weather. Then you asked about the remaining stomach medicine for your father and only felt relieved after confirming he still had some. After talking for about 8 minutes, the water boiled, so you ended the call and started cooking the dumplings. After they were cooked, you had them with the vegetable and egg drop soup, feeling comfortable and satisfied. While eating, you opened the tablet and watched a documentary about German Industry 4.0 that you had watched the beginning of before.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Create next month's budget.
description: After clearing away the dishes and chopsticks, he sat down at the desk and opened the bookkeeping app "Suishouji" on his phone. Starting from the beginning of August, he went through the entries one by one and found that buying a Qixi Festival gift for Lin Yue, treating friends to dinner on the weekend, and buying running shoes were several large expenses. After calculating, he determined the actual balance for the month. Then he created a new budget table for September, classifying expenses into categories (rent, utilities, commuting, dining, shopping, savings), and specifically lowered the two items "snacks and drinks" and "takeout", with the goal of cutting 500 yuan of non-essential spending and transferring it into the "home purchase fund" account. After completing the budget adjustment, he felt very grounded.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Free time and fishing appointment confirmation.
description: Budget sorted. I got up and stretched my limbs. I picked up my phone and sent a WeChat message to my fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang: "Brother Wu, are you free this Saturday (August 30)? I want to go fishing at Dianshan Lake. Autumn is here, so the fish should be biting well." After sending it, I scrolled through Bilibili for a while. I watched a few induction cooker repair videos shared by repair masters and found them quite interesting. They could serve as technical knowledge reserves for helping out at Old Chen's shop later.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening housekeeping and washing up.
description: The clothes in the washing machine had been washed and dried. I went to the balcony, took them in, folded them, and put them in the wardrobe. Then I went to the bathroom to shower and wash my hair. After washing, I tidied up the room, hung tomorrow's work clothes by the bed, and put the power bank, keys, and work badge on the shoe cabinet by the door.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Relaxation and meditation before bed.
description: At 21:10, I turned off the main lights, leaving only the small bedside night light. Lying in bed, I put on earphones and played soft white noise (the sound of rain and a faint crackling fire). Following the experience of the past few days, I focused on my breathing and felt the nerves that had been tense all day gradually relax. My thoughts occasionally drifted to house viewing and exams, but I quickly brought my attention back to the rise and fall of my abdomen.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep.
description: After meditation, drowsiness had not yet fully set in. He picked up a book on CNC machine tool fault diagnosis from the bedside and read for a dozen or so minutes to consolidate knowledge before sleep. Then he put the book down, got ready for bed, and turned off the light at exactly 23:00. He silently said to himself: today was fulfilling; keep it up tomorrow.
location: Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waking up, washing up, breakfast, and preparation
description: Yin Hao was woken by his phone alarm at 06:30 and felt in good spirits. Last night's sleep had been deep, and the insomnia trouble seemed to have gone away. Opening the curtain, he saw cloudy and windy weather. After washing up, he made a simple fried egg sandwich with hot milk. While doing so, he went over today's machining tasks in his head and confirmed that the fishing line prepared for Wu Ge was on the bedside table.
location: Room 302, Unit 1, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Rode an electric bike to work and bought breakfast
description: At 07:10, Yin Hao put on his work clothes, checked his belongings, put on a helmet, and rode his electric bike to work. Passing a breakfast stall at the intersection of Xingang Road and Nanle Road, he stopped and bought one pork bun and one vegetable bun, hung them on the handlebar, and continued riding about 15 minutes to the factory.
location: No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to No. 360, Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-shift preparation at the post
description: Arrived at the factory at 07:40, first went to the changing room to change into work shoes, then at the machine turned on the CNC milling machine power, checked the coolant and lubricant levels, started the spindle to idle at low speed for warm-up, called up the valve body part drawings and program, and printed the process card.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Attend the team morning meeting
description: At 07:55, team leader Wang Lei held a morning meeting, summarized yesterday's work, praised Liu Zhiqiang, and assigned today's tasks: focus on machining the new batch of valve bodies, and in the afternoon assist Liu Zhiqiang in debugging the new product fixture. Yin Hao agreed, and after the meeting confirmed the debugging workstation with Wang Lei.
location: Workshop pre-shift meeting board area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Focused on machining valve body parts in the morning.
description: Starting at 08:20, Yin Hao brought over the workpieces, clamped them, aligned them, and set the tool, machining the valve body parts with full concentration. During this time, Liu Zhiqiang came over to discuss the details of the afternoon debugging, and Yin Hao answered while looking at the program. In the whole morning, he finished machining 32 pieces, all of which passed spot checks, and recorded them in the machining log.

name: Summary of lunch and meditation results.
description: At 11:50, I turned off the machine tool, went to the locker room to wash my face, and got a bowl of braised pork chop noodles at the cafeteria. While eating the noodles alone in a corner, I reviewed the sleep changes over the past few days and confirmed that after meditation practice, both sleep onset speed and depth had improved significantly, so I decided to stick with the meditation habit.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Set a meditation reminder and download the audio.
description: After the meal, on a shady bench outside the workshop, Yin Hao took out his phone, opened the Health app, and created a new “Bedtime Meditation” reminder for 22:45 every day. Then he opened the music app, searched for and downloaded a free “rainforest birdsong white noise” audio, then leaned against a pillar with his eyes closed to rest.
location: Outdoor rest area of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon pre-shift preparation
description: At nearly 13:00, returned to my workstation, drank some water, stretched my wrists, and prepared to start the afternoon work.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

description: At 13:00, first finished machining the remaining 3 valve bodies from the morning. At 14:00, proactively found Liu Zhiqiang and together moved the new product fixture to the debugging workstation. Yin Hao was responsible for adjusting the locating pins and clamping plates, while Liu Zhiqiang wrote the program. Master Sun came over twice to guide, pointing out the parallelism deviation of the locating pins. Yin Hao used a dial indicator to re-align and fine-tune. At 16:30, a trial cut was made and the dimension was within tolerance. After that, cleaned up the site, performed equipment inspection, filled in records, and left work on time at 17:15.

name: Commute to the electronics market after work

name: Purchase electronic components
description: At 17:35 he arrived at Songjiang Electronic Market and went straight to a familiar stall. Following the list on his phone, he bought: 10 1.5F/450V starter capacitors, a box of assorted fuse tubes, 3 meters of heat-shrink tubing (half 6mm and half 10mm), and two 1.5-meter extension cords with independent switches and fuse holders, for a total of 28 yuan. Yin Hao carefully checked the capacitors' appearance and date before paying, then put the parts into the trunk of his electric bike.
location: Stall 3, Zone A, 2nd Floor, Songjiang Electronic Market, No. 188 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After returning home in the evening, Lu Mingqiang excitedly took out his treasured liquor bottle collection notebook in the study, wanting to record some distillery history that came to mind from his thoughts after listening to Industrial Memory. His wife Wang Lijuan pushed the door open, saw that he was not reading but fiddling with his liquor bottle notes, and her face fell. She said, “There are only a few days left before the intensive training. It’s not too late to play with these bottles after the exam. Isn’t doing it now a waste of time?” These words were like a bucket of cold water poured over his head. Lu Mingqiang felt a surge of grievance and irritation, but looking at his wife’s figure toiling over household chores, he forcibly swallowed the words he wanted to argue. Feeling suffocated at home, he said to his wife, “I’m going out for a walk,” then went downstairs alone and strolled aimlessly along the street. Before he knew it, he arrived at a Cantonese teahouse on Bo’ai South Road that he often visited. Pushing the door open, he was surprised to see his father Lu Jianguo sitting alone in a corner, staring blankly at a cup of hot tea.
description: At 18:20, cycled back to Xingang Community from the electronics market. After entering, he placed the newly bought parts on the desk, took out green peppers and frozen shredded lean meat from the refrigerator to thaw and cut, rinsed the rice, and cooked.
location: Room 302, Unit 1, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and household chores

He brought the food to the small dining table in the living room and watched Bilibili outdoor camping videos while eating. After eating, he washed the dishes, dried them, and put them away, then wiped clean the kitchen stove and floor.
location: Room 302, Unit 1, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening wrong-question review and socializing
description: At 20:00, he sat down at his desk and quickly flipped through the mistake notebook for the technician practical exam, marking the error-prone points in spindle orientation stop and tool changer adjustment. Then he sent a WeChat voice message to his childhood friend Lao Zhang to ask about the fishing rod repair, and sent a message to his friend Qiangzi to vent about Wang Lei's bragging.
location: In front of the desk in Room 302, Unit 1, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

description: After chatting, he opened the weather app on his phone to check Saturday's weather at Dianshan Lake. It showed cloudy with a light breeze and pleasant temperatures. He took new fishing line from the bedside table and practiced tying a few rigs to test the feel.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Unit 1, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

location: Bathroom, Room 302, Unit 1, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

description: While the washing machine was still running, Yin Hao lay in bed in his pajamas, jotted down today's spending on parts in his phone memos, then scrolled Bilibili, watched a video about small apartment balcony renovation, and saved two renovation plans using preserved wood and flower stands.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Unit 1, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Hanging laundry and getting ready for bed
description: At 22:30 the washing machine buzzed. He got up and hung the clothes, returned to the bedroom, turned off the main light leaving only the small desk lamp, and adjusted the pillow and quilt.
location: Room 302, Unit 1, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

description: At 22:45, the phone reminder went off on time. I put on Bluetooth earphones and played the newly downloaded white noise "Rainforest Birds." Lying in bed with my eyes closed, I focused on deep breathing, gradually relaxing with the sound of rain and birds, and distracting thoughts faded away.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Unit 1, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: After meditation, I took off my earphones, turned off the desk lamp, relaxed my whole body, felt calm and content, and fell deeply asleep around 23:30.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Unit 1, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting up and indoor stretching
description: The phone alarm went off on time. Yin Hao turned it off and got up. Outside the window it was gloomy and muggy, so he decisively gave up his morning run, pulled the yoga mat out from under the bed, and did 15 minutes of static stretching on the living room floor, focusing on his shoulders, neck, and hip joints to prepare for the physical work the day might require.
location: Room 502, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Washing up and breakfast
description: After stretching, he quickly washed up. In the kitchen, he boiled water on the gas stove, cooked the small handful of dried noodles left from last night, poached an egg, added two drops of sesame oil and soy sauce, and ate it quickly with half a cucumber. At the same time, he checked the weather app on his phone and confirmed it would be overcast turning to light rain, 29°C, and stuffed the electric bike rain poncho into the side pocket of his backpack.
location: Room 502, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Commuting by electric bike
description: After putting on his helmet, gloves, and a thin jacket, he wheeled the electric bike downstairs. On the way, a light drizzle began to fall, so he put on the raincoat he had brought. He rode along Xingang Road, turned onto Huatianjing Highway, and arrived at the factory area in about 20 minutes. He locked the bike in the shed, shook the water droplets off his raincoat, and walked toward the workshop carrying his bag.
location: Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xingang Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai to No. 360 Huatianjing Road

name: Pre-shift preparation and morning meeting
description: He swiped his card to clock in and changed into dark blue work clothes in the locker room. Walking to the team area, team leader Wang Lei held a morning meeting with the production schedule in hand, briefly announcing that today's top priority was for Master Sun to take Yin Hao to repair a CNC lathe in Workshop No. 3 with a noisy spindle; other work orders would go through normal scheduling. After receiving their tasks, everyone checked their tools and drawings.
location: Locker room and team area of Workshop No. 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Repaired the spindle fault on the CNC lathe.
description: Yin Hao followed Master Sun Jianguo to the faulty machine tool. Master Sun used a listening rod to diagnose the abnormal noise in the headstock and inferred that the speed encoder signal was unstable. Yin Hao, following the instructions, pulled up the PLC diagnostic page to monitor the encoder feedback signal and found that it was intermittently lost at low speed. The two worked together to perform a safe power-off, remove the protective cover, replace the encoder, and recalibrate the zero position and eccentricity parameters. After powering on and test-running, all speed ranges ran smoothly without abnormal noise, and the signal was stable again. After troubleshooting, they also carried out preventive inspections on nearby machine tools of the same model.
location: CNC machining area, Workshop No. 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Company cafeteria lunch
description: After the off-work bell, Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang went to the cafeteria together. Today's menu included braised pork chop, stir-fried tomatoes and eggs, and stir-fried spinach. Each got a serving and sat by the window. Liu Zhiqiang praised the morning's troubleshooting approach; Yin Hao modestly credited Master Sun, then they chatted about last night's game. In half an hour, they cleaned their plates.
location: Second-floor staff cafeteria, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reading machinery manual during lunch break
description: After dinner, Yin Hao walked to a bench in a quiet corner of the workshop's rest area, took a Kindle out of the inner pocket of his work clothes, opened the e-book version of Mechanical Design Handbook, and focused on reading the chapters on spindle-bearing systems, preloading, and precision inspection. After about half an hour, his eyes felt sore, so he closed them and rested for 5 minutes.
location: Rest area of Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon production tasks
description: Back at the post in the afternoon, the workshop returned to its normal production rhythm. Yin Hao was in charge of two machine tools machining a batch of hydraulic valve bodies. He carefully compared the drawings with the machining programs, completed clamping and tool setting, and started the first piece. After measuring and confirming it was qualified, batch production began, with one sampling inspection every 5 pieces. He used a vernier caliper and an inside dial indicator to confirm key dimensions. Near the end of the shift, he confirmed with Master Sun that the lathe repaired in the morning had run continuously for 8 hours with all data qualified. Finally, he cleaned the workstation, counted tools, and filled in the operation log.
location: CNC machining area, Workshop No. 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Shopping on the way home after work
description: Clocked out after work; the rain had stopped, and the ground was slightly wet. Yin Hao rode his electric bike, first detouring to Xingang New Village fresh supermarket, where he picked out three Red Fuji apples, a bunch of bananas, and a cluster of seedless red grapes for his brother's family's weekend visit, spending 22.5 yuan. After shopping he rode directly back to the community.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and after-meal cleanup
description: After getting home, I changed into loungewear, made a simple dish of potato slices with green peppers, heated two frozen meat buns, and had a bowl of plain rice porridge as dinner. After finishing, I washed the dishes and chopsticks, wiped down the stove and the range hood panel, tied up the garbage bag tightly, and placed it by the door to take down the next day.
location: Room 502, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Tidied up the study to welcome my brother and his family.
description: After dinner, Yin Hao began tidying the study to prepare for the visit of his older brother Yin Tao's family. He first organized the spare drawings, network cable, and router on the desk and wiped the desk clean, then pulled out the sofa bed frame, spread a mattress, sheet, and thin quilt, and put out spare pillows. He emptied a shelf in the wardrobe for his brother's family to hang coats, cleaned the air conditioner filter, and put it back. Finally, he put the bought fruit on a plate and placed it on the living room coffee table.
location: Room 502, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Video call with girlfriend
description: Just as he finished his work and sat down, Yin Hao made a WeChat video call to his girlfriend Lin Yue right at eight o'clock. On the screen, Lin Yue, her hair slightly damp, complained about the heavy rain in Hangzhou that afternoon and said her shoes and socks were soaked through. Yin Hao told her to take a hot shower and change into dry socks right away to avoid catching a cold. The two chatted for half an hour. Yin Hao shared how he had repaired the spindle encoder that day, and Lin Yue was happy for him. Before hanging up, he reminded her again to bring an umbrella tomorrow.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Inviting colleagues via WeChat to a dinner gathering
description: After the video ended, Yin Hao sent a voice message in the 'Three Musketeers of the Workshop' WeChat group, inviting Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang to have dinner at the Sichuan Restaurant at 232 Xingang Road at 7:00 tomorrow evening to celebrate the successful repair of the spindle. Wang Lei instantly agreed, Liu Zhiqiang confirmed the time, and the group chat was lively.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening free time.
description: After finishing the gathering, Yin Hao first called his father Yin Jianguo to ask about going to the town health center for a checkup the next day. His father told him not to worry about it. Then he opened Honor of Kings and played two ranked matches in solo queue, winning one and losing one. Afterward, he browsed a fishing forum to look at weekend posts about catches at Dianshan Lake. Around 10 p.m., he checked the September team duty schedule on his phone and confirmed there was no conflict on the weekend.
location: Room 502, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Showering and doing laundry
description: Put down the phone and take a shower, enjoying a hot rinse to wash away the day’s sweat and the smell of machine oil. While at it, hand-wash the work T-shirt and socks changed out in the afternoon with soap, rinse them clean in clear water, wring them dry, and hang them on the balcony clothes rack.
location: Bathroom and balcony, Room 502, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime meditation
description: Lying in bed, he dimmed the desk lamp, opened the meditation app, chose the 'Rain on Banana Leaves' white noise, put on earphones, and did 15 minutes of abdominal-breathing meditation. The details of repairing the machine tool during the day and the scene of his older brother's family visiting surfaced in his mind, gradually soothed by the rain, and his breathing grew long and slow.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: By the end of the meditation, he was already drowsy. He set his phone to Do Not Disturb mode and placed it on the nightstand, turned over to find a comfortable position, and with the gentle breeze and rustling leaves outside the window, he quickly fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning core training.
description: Woken by the sound of rain pattering against the window, I stayed in bed for two minutes before getting up. Unable to run in the morning because of the rain, I did a 20-minute home core workout on the yoga mat, including planks, crunches, and squats, substituting strength training for cardio to keep my body active.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and breakfast
description: After training I took a warm shower and felt refreshed. In the kitchen I cooked a bowl of yangchun noodles, poached an egg on top, and sprinkled chopped scallions—simple and filling. While eating the noodles, I watched the rain outside gradually lighten and the road glistening wet.
location: Bathroom and kitchen of the rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving to work and listening to the news
description: Put on a work jacket, took the commuter bag and folding umbrella, and went downstairs. Because it had just rained and the roads were slippery, he allowed an extra 10 minutes for the drive. On the way, he turned on traffic radio to catch up on Songjiang news and road conditions.
location: Songjiang District, Shanghai (drive: from Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road to No. 360, Huatianjing Highway)

name: Pre-shift preparation and morning meeting

At 7:50 he arrived on time at the activity room for the team morning meeting. Team leader Wang Lei assigned the day's batch machining task for valve bodies and emphasized the precision requirements.
location: Workshop and team activity room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning valve body machining
description: I started the CNC machine to machine valve bodies, and the equipment ran smoothly. Midway through, I had a question about double-checking the machining allowance. I asked Master Sun Jianguo, and he helped confirm the program was correct. In the morning, I completed a batch of tasks smoothly and in an orderly manner.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and weekend ticket booking.
description: In a corner of the cafeteria, while eating, I used my phone to check and book tickets for Guangfulin and Chenshan Botanical Garden. My nephew Xiao Yu is 8 years old. Chenshan Botanical Garden offers free admission to children under 1.3 meters, and Guangfulin has a similar policy, so I decided to book 3 adult tickets for each. I successfully booked 3 Guangfulin tickets for August 30 (48 yuan each) and 3 Chenshan Botanical Garden tickets for August 31 (60 yuan each), and saved the electronic vouchers.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break walk
description: After the meal, I went for a walk in the small garden downstairs, admiring the fresh green leaves after the rain. Since the ground was slippery, I didn't jog; instead, I went back under the workshop eaves and walked briskly for a few laps to stretch my limbs, help digestion, and refresh myself for the afternoon's work.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

In the meantime, he exchanged technical thoughts with colleagues.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

He sent the screenshots of the e-tickets for Guangfulin and Chenshan Botanical Garden to his brother Yin Tao via WeChat, told him by voice message that the tickets were booked, asked his brother to notify him when setting out, and discussed meeting details. His brother quickly replied, "Okay, thanks for the effort, bro."
location: Living room of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime meditation

location: Bedroom of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
