name: Morning wake-up, washing up, breakfast, and preparation
description: At 6:30 in the morning, the alarm went off. After getting up, Yin Hao quickly washed up and put on his gray-blue work uniform. He drank half a glass of warm water and did five minutes of stretching. Then he went to the kitchen, took out whole wheat bread and milk from the refrigerator, and had a simple quick meal. Meanwhile, he checked the day's to-do list on the whiteboard in the living room and checked the power bank, phone, and work badge in his backpack.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute and pre-work preparation
description: Yin Hao drove his silver-gray Volkswagen Lavida from Xingang Community to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. On the way, he listened to FM105.7 Shanghai Traffic Radio and mentally planned the key processes and tolerance requirements for today's valve body machining. After arriving at the factory, he changed into safety shoes, goggles, and a safety helmet, started the CNC machine to warm up, and checked the cutting fluid level and cooling system.
location: Songjiang District, Shanghai, from Lane 224, Xingang Road to No. 360, Huatianjing Highway, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, along the route and in the workshop.

At about 10 o'clock, he took the initiative to go to the programming room to assist Liu Zhiqiang in handwriting the maintenance records, filling in detailed data based on the equipment inspection checklist and actual operating conditions, and signed.

He went to the office, found the clerk Xiao Zhou, filled out a personal leave request form for 4 hours of leave from 13:00 to 17:00, and had it signed and confirmed by Wang Lei. Then he went to the factory canteen for lunch with Master Sun and Wang Lei, eating braised pork chop, green vegetables, and seaweed egg drop soup. During the meal, he asked Wang Lei for the best route to Suzhou tomorrow, and Wang Lei suggested taking the Shanghai-Changzhou Expressway and getting off at Dushu Lake Avenue.
location: Office and Canteen, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

First, he changed the bedroom sheets to the plaid pure cotton sheets bought yesterday, then thoroughly mopped the bedroom and study floors, and finally wiped the dust off the living room coffee table, TV cabinet, and bedroom windowsill. He put the newly purchased milk, mineral water, and fruit into the refrigerator. The room was filled with the scent of lemon cleaner.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner, tidying up afterward, and a short break
description: After being busy, Yin Hao felt hungry. He took frozen dumplings from the fridge, cooked 15, mixed a dipping sauce with light soy sauce, vinegar, and chili oil, and ate them standing in the kitchen. After the meal, he washed the dishes and hung up the dishcloth, then slumped on the living room sofa to scroll through Bilibili, watched and bookmarked two videos about flexible tapping techniques for CNC milling machines.
location: Kitchen and living room, Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening: outing gear check and family video call.
description: Yin Hao took out his travel backpack and packed tissues, wet wipes, duck neck, melon seeds and other snacks. Then he carefully packed the drone, spare batteries, remote controller, power bank and data cable in the study. Afterwards he made a video call on his phone to his parents in his hometown Rudong. His mother told him to eat well, and his father reminded him to drive safely. After hanging up, he sent a WeChat message to his older brother Yin Tao to confirm departure at 8 a.m. tomorrow and received an OK reply. Soon his girlfriend Lin Yue video-called him, and the two reported in detail on today's car washing and thorough cleaning results, and discussed decorating ideas for the study in the new house, planning light oak bookshelves and a window-side tatami.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai: living room and study.

name: Nighttime relaxation, bookkeeping, and final checks.
description: After hanging up the video call with Lin Yue, Yin Hao opened the expense tracking app and recorded the 40 yuan car wash fee, the 126 yuan supermarket purchase, and the hourly wage deducted for taking leave. Then he leaned back on the sofa, used a music app to play Beyond's 'Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies,' and sang along. Afterward, he went downstairs to check the fuel level in his car, confirmed that there was more than half a tank, enough for the round trip to Suzhou tomorrow. Back home, he took in the dried clothes, folded them, and put them in the wardrobe. Finally, he used Amap to preview the estimated arrival time for leaving at 8 o'clock tomorrow morning for his brother's home in Suzhou.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the parking space downstairs

name: Washing up, pre-sleep journaling, and falling asleep
description: Yin Hao went to the bathroom to take a shower, changed into a loose pure cotton T-shirt and shorts, and turned on the bedside lamp with dimmed light. After writing down the last expenses in his account book, he turned off the light, closed his eyes, and quickly fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting up and morning preparation.
description: At 6:00 in the morning, he woke up naturally due to his biological clock. Lying in bed, he took two deep breaths to let his body transition smoothly from deep sleep. Then he washed up, changed into the running group's quick-dry short-sleeve shirt and shorts, checked the contents of his backpack in the living room: ID card, power bank, drone and two spare batteries, mineral water, tissues, and some snacks prepared for his nephew. He also quickly went through today's timeline in his phone memo and confirmed everything was correct.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run activity
description: After leaving home, I walked to Xingang Road bus stop, took Bus Songjiang 16, got off at Rongle Road / Renmin North Road stop, then walked to the east gate of Songjiang Sports Center. At the gathering point at the northeast corner of the stadium, I met up with Chen Jie and other running buddies. After a brief stretch, more than 20 of us started running together. I ran 8 km at my own pace, with a steady pace of about 5:50 per kilometer. After the run, I talked with Chen Jie in the cool-down area. He suggested doing interval training (400 m x 8 sets) next Wednesday evening. I readily agreed and we arranged to meet at the Sports Center at 5:30 p.m. on Wednesday.
location: Songjiang Sports Center, No. 145 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returning home, shower, breakfast, and departure preparations.
description: Took Songjiang Bus No. 16 back to Xingang Community. After arriving home, took a quick shower and changed into a black polo shirt and dark blue casual pants. Breakfast was reheated meat buns and soy milk, finished in five minutes. Then went downstairs to check the car, confirmed that the tire pressure, lights, and fuel level were normal, put the backpack, the milk and fruit for my brother's family, and a plastic bag full of snacks into the trunk, set the navigation destination to Suzhou City Toll Station (G1522 Changtai Expressway exit), and got ready to depart.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive to Suzhou to pick someone up
description: Starting from Xingang Community, he took Guangfulin Road onto the Shenhai Expressway, listening to traffic radio all the way. The speed was steady, and the pre-downloaded offline maps ensured smooth navigation. After about 1 hour and 25 minutes of driving, he arrived at the temporary parking strip near the Suzhou urban toll station (G1522 Changtai Expressway exit) at 09:48, slightly later than planned but overall smooth.
location: Jiangsu Province, Suzhou City, Huqiu District, G1522 Changtai Expressway, Suzhou urban area toll station exit

name: Meet up with my brother's family and return to Guangfulin
description: A white SUV drove out of the exit—it was his older brother Yin Tao's car. He got out to greet them, and his nephew Yin Zixuan shouted excitedly from the car window, "Second Uncle!" After exchanging pleasantries with his brother and sister-in-law, he loaded the prepared milk and fruit into the back seat of their car. Then the two cars drove one after another, with Yin Hao leading the way back to the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park. About 40 minutes later, they arrived at the Zhuque Gate parking lot of the Guangfulin Relics Park. After parking, they walked to the ticket office, and he successfully redeemed the three pre-booked tickets using the QR code on his phone. Then he launched the drone, took an aerial panoramic photo of Guangfulin, and sent it to Lin Yue with the message: "The tour guide is in position, ready to start!"
location: Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site, Lane 3260, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Zhuque Gate Parking Lot).

name: In-depth tour of the Guangfulin Ruins and discussion about buying a house
description: Starting from Bone Needle Square, I explained the life of the ancient 'Shanghai people' to my nephew using the materials I had looked up in advance on my phone. Then we visited the underwater museum. My nephew clapped excitedly at the fish under the glass and the simulated ancient water surface. Midway through the tour, my elder brother Yin Tao sat down with Yin Hao by the lake and asked about his progress on buying a house. Yin Hao truthfully told him about the several apartments he had seen and the pressure of the monthly mortgage payment. His brother said he had 50,000 yuan available for emergencies. Yin Hao was touched but said he wanted to try to rely on himself and would only ask his brother for help if he really couldn't handle it. The whole visit took about 4 hours, and at 3 p.m. the family left through the East Gate.
location: Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site (Underwater Museum, ancient building complex, etc.), Lane 3260, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and hotel check-in
description: After the tour, the family went to the Wuyue Renjia noodle restaurant inside the heritage site for lunch, ordering braised pork noodle soup, fried fish noodle soup, and two glasses of sour plum juice. After eating, the nephew was a little sleepy, so they decided to check into the hotel first. Yin Hao drove them to the reserved Ji Hotel (Shanghai Songjiang University Town branch), helped carry the luggage into the room, and his sister-in-law settled the nephew down for a nap. Yin Hao and his brother chatted over tea on the room balcony, with the conversation shifting from work to their parents' health, and they agreed to return to their hometown in Rudong together during the National Day holiday to eat crabs.
location: Ji Hotel (Shanghai Songjiang University City Branch), Lane 888, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving through the city and having a family dinner
description: His older brother and sister-in-law wanted to see where Yin Hao usually lived, so the family walked to the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road. On the way, Yin Hao pointed to the plane trees on the roadside and the university town, describing the lively everyday atmosphere. He also called ahead to confirm the private room and dishes. After arriving, they ordered a table full of dishes: braised pork, steamed sea bass, oil-braised shrimp, xiaolongbao, and more. His nephew was full of energy and imitated the waiters by pouring tea for everyone, making the whole table laugh. His brother praised Yin Hao for keeping his life in good order, and his sister-in-law reminded him to take care of his health. Yin Hao sent Lin Yue a WeChat message: "I'm happy today; my nephew is a real live wire." Amid the laughter and joy, he felt the warmth of home, and all his stress was temporarily replaced by affection.
location: Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, No. 232, Xingang Road, Dagang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai (private room).

name: Farewell and the Journey Home
description: After dinner, elder brother's family insisted on walking back to the hotel by themselves. Yin Hao walked them to the hotel entrance, said goodbye with hugs, and then drove alone back to his rented apartment in Xingang Residential Community. Soft music played in the car, and his heart was filled with warmth and contentment.
location: Ji Hotel (Shanghai Songjiang University Town Branch), Lane 888, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Community

name: Review sharing and financial bookkeeping
description: After returning to the rental apartment, he washed up, lay on the bed, sent Lin Yue the photos of Guangfulin taken today and the funny video of his nephew, and the two chatted on WeChat for 15 minutes. Lin Yue replied, “So adorable! You worked hard today!” and expressed her concern. Then he opened the expense-tracking app to record today's spending: about 70 yuan for highway tolls, 30 yuan for parking, 120 yuan for snacks, 90 yuan for lunch, and 400 yuan for dinner, totaling about 710 yuan. Although it was over budget, he felt it was worth spending on family. Afterward, he browsed the photo album on his phone, briefly categorized the photos, and planned to make a digital album in a couple of days.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Meditation practice and preparing for bed.
description: He put on earphones and did a 15-minute white noise meditation to calm his mind. Then, instead of playing games, he opened Bilibili and watched three teaching videos about macro programming for CNC machine tools, and took notes. He planned to ask Master Sun about a technical point from one of the videos next Monday at work. Finally, he checked the purchase receipts for tomorrow's (August 31) tickets to Chenshan Botanical Garden, confirmed all three tickets were there, and set the alarm for 7:30 the next morning. Before turning off the light, he glanced at his phone: he had walked 17,000 steps and run 8 kilometers today. Feeling calm and satisfied, he fell asleep on time at 23:00.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run and preparations for going out.
description: I woke up naturally at 6:15 in the morning, following the biological clock developed during military service. After a quick wash, I put on my running shoes and went out for a 5-kilometer recovery jog along Xingang Road toward Xiaokunshan Health Park, keeping a pace of about 6 minutes 10 seconds per kilometer. After the run, I went home, took a shower, and cooked noodles with a fried egg and pickled mustard stems for breakfast. Then I checked my gear, packed the drone, remote controller, power bank, mineral water, snacks, and a folding umbrella into my backpack, confirmed the navigation, and set the destination to the Ji Hotel (Shanghai Songjiang New City Branch) where my brother was staying. Finally, I checked my ID card, phone, and car keys, and got ready to leave.
location: Xingang Community and surrounding areas, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pick up my brother and his family and head to Chenshan Botanical Garden
description: At 8 o'clock sharp, he drove out of Xingang Community, turned from Xingang Road onto Jiasong South Road, and arrived at Ji Hotel (Shanghai Songjiang New City) in about 12 minutes. After notifying his elder brother via WeChat, he picked up his brother Yin Tao, sister-in-law Wang Li, and nephew Yin Zixuan. The nephew greeted him excitedly, and his sister-in-law handed over some fruit. Then they drove together to Shanghai Chenshan Botanical Garden, chatting with his brother on the way while his nephew kept asking questions from the back seat. The whole trip took about 28 minutes and they arrived before 9.
location: En route from Ji Hotel (Shanghai Songjiang New Town Branch), 1292 Xinsongjiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Chenshan Botanical Garden, 3888 Chenhua Road, Songjiang District.

name: Chenshan Botanical Garden visit and lunch
description: After entering Shanghai Chenshan Botanical Garden, they headed straight for the tropical greenhouse near Gate 3. His nephew was curious about all kinds of giant cacti and pitcher plants, asking questions nonstop. Yin Hao did his best to explain while his older brother took photos nearby. Around 10:30, they came to the central lawn. Taking advantage of the clear weather, Yin Hao took out his drone and flew it up, directing his brother's family to stand in the middle of the lawn, and shot an aerial top-down family photo. His nephew excitedly shouted at the sky, and they also recorded a video flying around the lawn. At noon, they had lunch at a fast-food restaurant in the park, ordering noodles and a Western-style sandwich. While eating, Yin Hao talked with his brother about plans for September, including contacting Teacher Liu Jianjun to prepare for the hands-on exam and scheduling a health checkup for his mother. His brother reminded him to be cautious and look around more before buying a house.
location: Shanghai Chenshan Botanical Garden, 3888 Chenhua Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Saw off his elder brother's family and drove back to Shanghai
description: After taking a group photo outside the botanical garden, they set off at 1 p.m. Yin Hao drove to take his brother's family toward Suzhou. On the way, his nephew fell asleep in the back seat and his sister-in-law also dozed off. Yin Hao and his brother chatted quietly in the front, about work and their parents' health. After about 1 hour and 20 minutes, they arrived at Yangcheng Lake Service Area on the G15 Shenhai Expressway. At the service area, he helped them carry their luggage to the shuttle point. His brother patted him on the shoulder and told him to take care of himself. His nephew, still sleepy, said, 'Second Uncle, fly the plane again next time.' Yin Hao smiled and watched them board the shuttle back to Suzhou. After saying goodbye, Yin Hao drove back to Shanghai alone, turned on some old songs, took the G1503 Shanghai Ring Expressway, exited at Songjiang New City, and returned home at Xingang Residential Community around 4:10 p.m.
location: G15 Shenhai Expressway Yangcheng Lake Service Area (Xiangcheng District, Suzhou) to Xingang Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organizing photos, sharing, and dinner
description: After returning home, I connected my phone and drone to the computer and imported all the photos and video footage. I selected 8 photos and color-graded them with photo editing software, then used the CapCut app to edit the aerial and phone clips into a 2-minute-15-second family video with cheerful, relaxing background music. After finishing, I shared the video and photos to the family WeChat group with the caption “Family Day, so happy!” Soon after, my mother sent a voice message saying, “Zixuan has grown taller again,” and my father commented praising the professional aerial shots. I then replied to each message in the group chat. While chatting, I stir-fried shredded pork with green peppers and cooked rice using ingredients from the fridge, making a simple dinner.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the swimming pool for recovery swimming training
description: After dinner, I rested for 10 minutes, changed into my swim trunks, took my goggles and bath towel, and drove to the swimming pool at Songjiang Sports Center, about a 10-minute drive. I entered with my annual pass and did a 45-minute swim workout, mainly alternating breaststroke and freestyle, focusing on proper form and muscle stretching.
location: Songjiang Sports Center Swimming Pool, No. 555 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Walk home and contact family
description: After swimming, Yin Hao felt refreshed all over and decided to walk home. Along the way, he called his mother, who was far away in his hometown of Rudong, and indirectly asked about her recent health and whether she had any discomfort such as dizziness. His mother said lightly that it might be fatigue from the change of season and told him not to worry, but Yin Hao secretly resolved to arrange a physical examination as soon as possible. After walking home, he dried his hair, sat in the living room and had a video call with his girlfriend Lin Yue, sharing that day's aerial photos and Vlog. Lin Yue showed interest in the drone and said she wanted to learn, and the two happily talked about their respective work and plans for the next meeting.
location: On the way from Guangfulin Road Sports Center in Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Community, and at home

name: Plan September to-do items
description: After the video call, Yin Hao sat at his desk, opened the notes app on his phone, and carefully planned his September to-do list: arrange an interval run with running buddy Chen Jie next Wednesday; contact Teacher Liu Jianjun on Monday to confirm the time and place for the practical exam tutoring; call this week to book a comprehensive physical examination for his mother at the hospital in her hometown of Nantong; and organize the home-buying documents and contact the Sanxiang Siji Huacheng listing to try for a second viewing. He wrote them all down one by one.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation, meditation, and falling asleep.
description: After finishing the planning, Yin Hao took a hot shower in the bathroom and reviewed his fulfilling day while the water ran over him. He then changed into pajamas and lay down on the bed, set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, put on his earphones to play the white noise “Rainforest Wind,” closed his eyes, and did a 15-minute meditation, focusing on his breathing and letting his thoughts settle. After the meditation, he turned off the bedside lamp and his phone, and fell into a deep sleep in the quiet night.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run and training plan adjustment
description: After the alarm went off, he got up quickly, drank a glass of warm water, and changed into running gear. At 6:05 he set out from Xingang Community (Lane 123, Guangfulin Road), ran east along Guangfulin Road to Renmin North Road and turned back, jogging about 4.2 kilometers at a pace of 5 minutes 25 seconds per kilometer, taking 22 minutes. After the run, he stretched by the roadside and thought about recent changes in the rhythm of work and life. He decided to change the weekend Dianshan Lake road cycling from once a week to once a month, and instead do 2-3 short morning rides (about 10 kilometers) on weekday mornings using a shared bike or a folding bike as cross-training.
location: Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (section from Xingang Community to Renmin North Road)

name: Morning core workout and breakfast
description: After returning home, he spread out the yoga mat and completed 15 minutes of core training (plank, mountain climbers, supine leg raises) and yoga stretching. After showering, he cooked frozen small wontons, added a boiled egg, and after eating, changed into work clothes.
location: Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting by car and handling tasks along the way
date: Yin Hao sent Lin Yue a WeChat message, mentioning that he had talked about housing with colleagues at an after-work gathering and that he was feeling better, then said goodnight. When he didn't receive an immediate reply, he put down his phone and reviewed the day's gains: he had a new idea for the training manual, Master Sun's case-based teaching was very helpful, he had a hearty dinner and gaming session with the guys, and he had also sorted out a preliminary plan for buying a home. He decided to get up early for a run the next morning, turned off the bedside lamp, closed his eyes, and went to rest.
description: At 7:25, took the keys and work card and left. Drove from Xingang Community via Chenta Road and Xinzhuang Highway to No. 360 Huatianjing Road, the company. On the way, connected the phone via Bluetooth, used voice input to write down in the memo 'Contact Lao Gao this week to confirm the new cycling route around Dianshan Lake', and used AMap to roughly check the real-time traffic on the Qingpu Dianshan Lake lakeside road.
location: On the way from Guangfulin Road to No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning workshop work and accepting two new tasks.
description: Arrived at the factory at 7:45. After changing into work clothes, he first went to the workshop office. Master Sun and Liu Zhiqiang were already discussing the new machine program. Master Sun suggested that I join the district trade union's "Craftsman Spirit Into Campus" publicity team, and told me the registration deadline and application process. Then the workshop director arrived and announced that I would be the internal training instructor for the newly introduced five-axis linkage CNC machine tool, and handed over the complete set of technical manuals on the spot. At 8:10, I officially started machining the shift parts (valve body finish machining). By 11:20, the morning batch was completed with a 100% pass rate. During the machine's automatic operation, I took time to write down several key operating notes by hand.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360, Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Studying propaganda team materials at noon
description: First returned to the workshop office, scanned the QR code on the lecture team registration form given by Master Sun with his phone, carefully read the application requirements and presentation directions, and noted key information in his memo such as "need to prepare personal achievement materials and give a 15-minute trial lecture." Then, using 10 minutes, he quickly flipped through the "Safety Operation Regulations" chapter of the new machine tool manual and dog-eared several key safety interlock devices.
location: Workshop office, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and socializing with colleagues
description: At 12:00 I went to the cafeteria and queued up, getting braised pork chop, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and rice. Carrying my tray, I found Liu Zhiqiang and Wang Lei and sat with them. The three of us chatted while eating. Liu Zhiqiang was very interested in the new machine tool's operation interface, and I agreed to study the UI manual together with him during Wednesday's lunch break. Wang Lei reminded me that the pressure of being a training instructor was considerable and that I needed to prepare in advance. I nodded in agreement. At 12:35 we finished eating and returned to the workshop together.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Workshop lunch break.
description: Back in the workshop rest area, he leaned back in a work chair and rested with his eyes closed for 10 minutes to recharge for the afternoon's work. He woke up on time at 13:00 and washed his face.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon workshop work interspersed with lesson preparation.
description: Started work at 13:10 and continued to complete the afternoon part machining tasks. At 15:00, while the machine tool was automatically running a large part program, I used this 20-minute window to take out a paper copy of the new machine tool manual and made detailed annotations in red pen next to the operation flowcharts, initially outlining the framework for the first section of next week's training syllabus. At 16:45, I completed all of the day's machining tasks and carried out routine equipment inspection and 5S organization.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360, Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Commutted from work and bought dinner ingredients.
description: After work, I first went to the parking lot to get the car, then on the way swung by the Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket. As planned, I bought baby bok choy, free-range eggs, a bunch of scallions, and two boxes of soft tofu, totaling 22.5 yuan. After checking out at 17:10, I walked to the convenience store next door and, following the habit I've recently developed, bought two Double Color Ball lottery tickets before heading home.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket at Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and nearby convenience store

name: Prepare dinner and record expenses.
description: After arriving home, changed into lounge clothes and started cooking. Using the leftover green peppers and pork tenderloin from last night, I stir-fried shredded pork with green peppers, then quickly stir-fried a small portion of greens and cooked a pot of rice. While waiting for the rice to cook, I opened the expense-tracking app on my phone and recorded the supermarket and lottery expenses under 'September Daily Expenses'.
location: Kitchen of the rental apartment in Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and video call with mother
description: While eating, I used the tablet to play a teaching video on Bilibili about five-axis simultaneous post-processing programming. I finished eating at 18:25. While clearing the dishes, I made a WeChat video call to my mother. We chatted about everyday things; I asked how her knees were and reminded her to keep warm as the weather turned colder. She laughed and said she knew, telling me to take care of myself too.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Xingang Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening in-depth lesson preparation and study
description: Evening study officially began at 18:40. I spread out the new machine tool's technical specifications, operation manual, and process cards, and used red, blue, and black pens to draw operation flowcharts and parameter setting tables in my notebook. At 19:40 I started drafting the 'Training Outline for Internal Operation of the New Five-Axis CNC Machine Tool (First Draft)', listing the training objectives, class schedule, and key and difficult points one by one, and noting that machining simulation software needed to be prepared. Midway, Lin Yue called me on a voice call. When I answered, I said in advance, 'I'm revising the courseware now.' We talked for 5 minutes and hung up, agreeing to talk in detail on the weekend. At 21:00 I completed the first three sections of the training outline.
location: At the desk in the rental apartment, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Evening financial planning and family group interaction
description: He opened the banking app on his phone, checked the salary card balance and the mortgage calculator, and, based on recent savings, updated the 'Home Purchase Budget Table' in his notes, noting the down payment gap and the monthly payment ceiling. He then sent the family portrait taken yesterday to the family group chat named 'Happy Family,' with the caption: 'This weekend was so fulfilling, happy Monday, everyone!'
location: At the desk in the rental apartment, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Evening core training and personal care.
description: Unrolled the yoga mat and followed an app for 15 minutes of core training (focusing on the transverse abdominis and glutes). After training, used a foam roller to relax the calves and the front of the thighs. Took a hot shower, brushed my teeth, washed my face with facial cleanser, and applied moisturizer.
location: Living room and bathroom of the rental apartment at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Xingang Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Evening reading and winding down for sleep
description: After getting into bed, he picked up his Kindle and opened the chapter on servo motor selection in Mechanical Design Handbook (6th Edition), reading two chapters. At 22:45 he set the alarm for 6:00 the next day, turned off the bedside lamp, adjusted his sleeping position, and reviewed the key points of today's work and study in his mind. He fell asleep peacefully a few minutes later.
location: Bedroom in the rental apartment at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Xingang Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning cycling and relaxation
description: After the alarm went off, got up quickly and changed into cycling gear. Starting from Xingang Community, rode west along Guangfulin Road for about 3 kilometers and then turned back, covering about 6 kilometers in total at a relaxed pace. After returning home, did a quick leg stretch on the balcony.
location: Starting from Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, cycle 3 km west along Guangfulin Road and then turn back.

name: Washing up and breakfast
description: After a hot shower, he changed into clean work clothes. In the kitchen, he cooked plain noodles, poached an egg, and made a glass of milk. He ate breakfast standing up and noticed the weather was cloudy with a gentle breeze.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute and mental preparation.
description: Drove to the company, turned off the music, and mentally reviewed the machining process for the valve body parts and the framework of the new machine tool lesson plan. After arriving at the parking lot, he turned off the engine, quickly checked the rearview mirror, and got out.
location: From Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-shift preparation
description: Swiped into the factory area and changed into work clothes in the locker room. Went to the machine station, checked the cutting fluid, tool inventory, and micrometer, and confirmed everything was ready.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning workshop work and task progress.
description: Attended the 5-minute team morning meeting, then worked on machining valve body parts, which required high precision. During the machine's automatic operation intervals, I used a notebook to jot down questions about the new machine tool's programming interface, planning to ask Master Sun. Team leader Wang Lei was present, and I might run into Master Sun Jianguo.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Writing the first draft of the lesson plan during lunch break
description: After quickly finishing lunch in the cafeteria, he went straight back to his workstation in the workshop, spread out the technical manual and operation manual for the new machine tool, and used a red pen to sketch the training lesson plan outline in his notebook, highlighting safety operating procedures and the core differences between five-axis linkage and three-axis machining.
location: Workshop work station at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Midday digestion and adjustment
description: Closed his notebook, walked out of the workshop, and paced back and forth on the factory path for over ten minutes. After returning, he checked and replaced the cutting tools needed for the afternoon to make sure everything was in order.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon workshop work and contacting the labor union.
description: Continue focusing on parts processing. After washing his face with cold water, he changed into his work clothes and confirmed the admission ticket number and score-checking process in his phone memo. He simply fried two eggs and made a bowl of oatmeal as breakfast. Then he went to the study, turned on the old desktop computer, and entered his admission ticket number and password to check the senior technician theory exam score. His heart raced while the page was loading. When he saw that he had passed with 82 points, he checked the information repeatedly, and after confirming it was correct, he clenched his fist with a low shout and saved a screenshot. He immediately sent the score screenshot to the comrades-in-arms group and the Yin Family One Family family group, then called his mentor Sun Jianguo and excitedly told him the good news that he had passed the theory exam. After hanging up, he sent the score screenshot to his training teacher Liu Jianjun and thanked him. Then he found the WeChat contact Zhao Min from the Federation of Trade Unions, wrote a long message formally confirming that he would join the lecture team, and said he would prepare the relevant materials as soon as possible. At the same time, he replied to the interval running invitation from his running buddy Chen Jie, saying they would meet tomorrow.

name: Evening hands-on practice and review
description: After the break, Yin Hao drove back to the workshop and changed into his work clothes. He went to the spare CNC lathe that Teacher Liu had suggested using, carefully checked the machine's oil circuit, air circuit, and coolant, then took out the required cutting tools, fixtures, and bar stock to be machined from the tool cabinet. The workshop was very quiet. He devoted himself fully to practice and, strictly following the assessment standards for senior technicians, performed workpiece clamping, tool setting, writing and manually entering the program, and starting the machine. He focused on tackling thin-walled part machining and, by adjusting cutting parameters multiple times (spindle speed 2,200 rpm, feed rate 0.08 mm/rev), successfully found a way to reduce tool chatter. He then repeatedly practiced the precise setting and modification of tool compensation parameters, recording in detail in his notebook the influence of data changes on workpiece diameter accuracy. Midway he stopped to drink water, rubbed his sore eyes, and continued with the next workpiece. After practicing until 22:30, he shut down the machine, carefully cleaned the metal chips, wiped the operation panel, and put all tools back in place. He took out his phone to photograph the successfully machined thin-walled part and the key parameters on the operation panel, then opened his notes app and used voice input to record tonight's summary of key parameter combinations and insights.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return trip and rest at home
description: Yin Hao drove home. The night wind felt a little cool on his face. On the way, he felt physically tired but mentally excited, because he had solved another technical difficulty. After returning to his place, he took off his work clothes reeking of cutting fluid, took a hot shower, and felt his whole body relax.
location: Rental unit No. 15, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-bed socializing and getting ready for sleep
description: After washing up, Yin Hao lay on the sofa and posted to his WeChat Moments the photos he had just taken of his hands-on practice notes and a photo of the quiet workshop at night, with the caption, "Seven parts theory, three parts honing. The workshop is very quiet tonight; I solved the chatter problem with thin-walled parts and gained a lot." Soon he saw that Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, and his childhood friend Zhang Wei had all liked it and left comments like "Keep going!" and "Brother Hao, you're solid!" He replied to each of them with a few words of encouragement and felt a warmth. Then he set his alarm for 6:00 the next morning, put his phone on the nightstand, and got ready for bed.
location: Rental unit No. 15, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Sleep
description: Yin Hao turned off the bedside lamp and, with a sense of fulfillment from improving his skills, quickly fell asleep.
location: Rental unit No. 15, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting up in the early morning, exercising, preparing, and setting out.
description: Woke up naturally at 5:50 in the morning, ten minutes earlier than the alarm. Lying in bed, he moved his neck, shoulders, and ankles to wake up his body. After weighing 73.0 kg, he changed into running shorts and a T-shirt and jogged for 15 minutes, about 2.5 km, on the walking path in the community garden, controlling his breathing and working up a light sweat. Back home, he took a quick warm shower and changed into clean underwear and a casual T-shirt. He carefully put the prepared dark blue best-man suit into a garment bag, and stuffed the car keys, driver's license, phone charging cable, wallet, and spare tie into his backpack. He checked the car to make sure the oil and coolant levels were normal. At 6:40 he woke up his girlfriend Lin Yue. While she washed up and put on makeup, he warmed milk and made sandwiches with bread and ham slices. The two finished breakfast together before 7:00. After Lin Yue finished her light makeup, he carried her small suitcase downstairs, put it in the trunk of their car, and got ready to go.
location: Room 401, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, as well as the community garden walkway and the parking lot downstairs

name: Drove back to his hometown in Rudong, Nantong, and took a break at a highway service area along the way.
description: At exactly 7:00, he started the car and drove from Xingang Residential Community onto the Shanghai-Kunming Expressway; weekend traffic was good. Lin Yue played music in the passenger seat, and the two occasionally talked about the wedding arrangements that day. At 7:57, they pulled into Jiaxing Service Area for a short stop. Lin Yue bought milk tea, Yin Hao used the restroom, then took out his phone and sent WeChat messages to Master Sun Jianguo, telling him that he was going back to his hometown today and wouldn't return until Sunday evening, and that he would find time to look at Monday's training materials. Master Sun replied, "OK, have fun." After the break, they continued on the road and arrived at his parents' home in Juegang Town, Rudong County, around 9:30.
location: Jiaxing Service Area on the Shanghai-Kunming Expressway, Xiuzhou District, Jiaxing City, Zhejiang Province (Kunming direction)

name: Arrived at his parents' home and headed to the wedding village
description: The car stopped at the courtyard gate. His mother, Wang Xiuying, smiled and came out to take things. His father, Yin Jianguo, wearing a washed-out work jacket, nodded at the door. Yin Hao went inside to change into his groomsman suit, and Lin Yue helped adjust his tie and collar. His mother repeatedly reminded him that as a groomsman he should help Zhang Wei deflect drinks, hold the rings, and liven up the atmosphere—he should be sharp, not drink too much, and mind his manners. Then the family of four drove in his father's car to Zhang Wei's home in Shiqiao Village. On the way, his mother talked about Zhang Wei's childhood. When they arrived at the village, colorful flags were fluttering, firecracker debris covered the ground, and the atmosphere was lively.
location: No. 88 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Participated in the childhood friend's wedding from start to finish.
description: As a groomsman, he participated fully from the bridal pickup stage. The groomsmen, plus two other friends of Zhang Wei, totaled four people, accompanying Zhang Wei to pick up the bride. They banged on the door, handed out red envelopes, and the atmosphere was very lively. At noon, a grand wedding banquet was held in the banquet hall of Xingcheng Hotel. The bride's side gave a new car as dowry, parked at the hotel entrance, and relatives at the banquet were buzzing with discussion. Yin Hao pulled Zhang Wei to toast at every table, greeting old classmates, relatives and friends, and village elders; the scene was lively.
location: Banquet Hall, Xingcheng Hotel (Qingyuan Road Branch), South Qingyuan Road, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province.

name: Mother's private financial worries
description: After the wedding luncheon, as the guests were chatting and resting, Yin Hao had just found a seat and was about to eat when his mother, Wang Xiuying, came over and pulled him to a corridor corner. She lowered her voice and said, "Look at the bride's family — how much did they give as a dowry? We can't give that much... what will you do when you get married in the future?" Her eyes were anxious. Yin Hao's heart tightened, but he said lightly, "Mom, that's their business. I can save up on my own." He patted his mother's shoulder and turned back to the table.
location: Corner of the second-floor corridor of Xingcheng Hotel (Qingyuan Road Branch), Qingyuan South Road, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Helped entertain guests and caught up with old classmates.
description: During free time after the luncheon, Yin Hao helped Zhang Wei seat old classmates who had traveled from afar in the hotel lounge to drink tea and chat, and at the door greeted relatives and friends as they left one after another, helping distribute wedding candy and return gifts. Afterward, he sat with a few high school classmates and talked about their recent lives and jobs, mentioning housing in Shanghai and changes in their hometown. The atmosphere became much more relaxed.
location: Entrance and first-floor lounge of Xingcheng Hotel (Qingyuan Road Branch), Qingyuan South Road, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Serious discussion with girlfriend by the river
description: After the afternoon ceremony, he took a walk with Lin Yue along the Rengang River near the hotel. The setting sun was slanting west, and the river surface shimmered with golden-red light. Lin Yue suddenly spoke: 'I heard what your mother said to you today. I'm serious—we must have a house before we get married. I don't want to keep living apart in two places and drifting from rental to rental anymore.' Yin Hao was silent for a long time, then forced out the words: 'With my current ability, buying a house in Shanghai is not realistic in the short term.' After a silence, Lin Yue asked in a low voice, 'Then what do we do?' Her tone was disappointed. The two said no more, walked along the river for a while, and the sky darkened.
location: Riverside walkway along the Rengang River, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: With your background, you can take home appliance cleaning/repair orders (air conditioners, washing machines) on 58.com, earning 50-150 yuan per job. Or register for Fengniao Crowdsourcing and Meituan Errand to do evening part-time work; there are many orders around Songjiang University City. Also don't forget second-hand resale: list old phones and unused renovation materials (such as extra flooring) on Xianyu. If you stick with the austerity plan, I suggest recording your savings amount every day; seeing the cumulative effect at the end of the month will boost your confidence.
description: The two of them walked silently along the river embankment for about 32 minutes back to Xingcheng Hotel, said goodbye to Zhang Wei and his wife, and helped them gather the scattered wedding candy and decorations. Then the two drove back to their parents' home. The mood in the car was dull; Yin Hao focused on driving, while Lin Yue looked out the window.
location: Xingcheng Hotel (Qingyuan Road Branch), Qingyuan South Road, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: Back at his parents' home, his mother had prepared a table of dishes: Shanghai-style braised pork, steamed sea bass, and clam soup. His father rarely asked about his work in Shanghai, and his mother again mentioned how lively Zhang Wei's wedding was. Yin Hao responded while trying to keep the atmosphere normal; Lin Yue joined in the conversation but was noticeably quieter.
location: Dining room at my parents' home, No. 88 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Washing up, resting, and feeling low
description: After dinner, he helped his mother clear the table, then took turns washing up with Lin Yue. After washing up, the two lay on the small bed in the guest room. Yin Hao wanted to find a topic to talk about but didn't know what to say; Lin Yue faced away from him playing on her phone. Yin Hao closed his eyes, but his mind was a mess: Lin Yue's demands, his mother's words, the new car at Zhang Wei's wedding, and the 600,000 yuan transferred by his parents kept swirling in his head.
location: Guest room of parents' home, No. 88 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Late at night, lying awake with insomnia, repeatedly thinking about financial pressure.
description: Lying in bed, tossing and turning, my mind was extremely alert. I kept doing the math: a down payment in Shanghai would be over two million yuan, while my salary and savings were a drop in the bucket. Thinking of Lin Yue's disappointed look and my mother's words, 'What will you do about getting married in the future?' irritation, frustration, and confusion welled up. Several times I wanted to open my phone but put it down again; it was not until after 1 a.m. that I drifted off to sleep in exhaustion.
location: Guest room of parents' home, No. 88 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Cycling along the seawall in the early morning to clear his mind.
description: Woke up at exactly 5:00 a.m., changed into sportswear, pushed out my father's old bicycle, set off from home at No. 88 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, rode east along Provincial Highway S225 onto the Rudong Seawall Road, and headed north all the way to near Yangkou Fishing Port. The morning breeze smelled of the sea; wind turbines turned slowly in the distance, and the fishing port was already busy. On the way, he stopped near Yangkou Fishing Port for about 5 minutes, looked at the sea view, and thought about yesterday's disagreement with Lin Yue. Then he returned and got home at 7:20.
location: From No. 88 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province to the seawall along Yangkou Fishing Port, Rudong County

name: Went home, washed up, and had breakfast
description: After returning from the ride, he put the bicycle back in the yard, took a shower, and changed into a clean T-shirt and shorts. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared breakfast: white congee, pickled dried radish, and freshly fried youtiao. Yin Hao chatted with his father, Yin Jianguo, about what he saw on the ride while eating. His father simply reminded him that the sea breeze was strong and he should not catch cold. The atmosphere was plain but warm.
location: No. 88 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Help father tidy up the courtyard
description: After breakfast, seeing his father repairing a small gap in the courtyard wall, Yin Hao took the initiative to help carry bricks and mix cement. The father and son chatted while working. His father mentioned that the old house next door was listed for sale, hinting that if the pressure in Shanghai was too great, he could consider going back to Rudong to develop. Yin Hao did not want his father to worry, so he changed the subject and mentioned that he needed to submit training materials for the internal trainer course next week. His father only said, 'Work steadily.'
location: No. 88 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Free time and packing luggage
description: After finishing the yard work for now, Yin Hao brushed the dust off his clothes and went inside to wash his hands. Meanwhile, Lin Yue was alone in the guest room looking at her phone, and the two barely talked. Yin Hao went back to his own room, packed his toiletries and the clothes he had changed out of into his backpack, checked his phone and car keys, and prepared for the return trip.
location: No. 88 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Lunch with parents and farewell
description: The lunch atmosphere was even more subdued than yesterday. Mother made Nantong clams and braised pork, which Yin Hao loved, but Lin Yue only picked a few bites of greens and barely spoke. Mother kept serving food to both of them, and her voice stood out sharply in the silence. After the meal, Mother packed the Rudong Langshan chicken and sun-dried radish into the trunk. Yin Hao exchanged a simple hug with his father and told them to take care of their health.
location: No. 88 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Drove back to Shanghai and took Lin Yue home.
description: At 12:15, Yin Hao set out from his parents' home and drove onto the expressway near Juegang South Market, heading toward Shanghai via the Shenhai Expressway, Hujia Expressway, and others. Midway, he stopped at the Jiaxing Service Area, went to the restroom to wash his face and refresh himself, and handed water to Lin Yue, but all he got was “Just put it there.” After that, the two had almost zero communication for the rest of the trip, only the sound of the car radio. After exiting the expressway, he drove to the entrance of the Zhujiang New City residential community in Songjiang New City. Yin Hao said softly, “We're here.” Lin Yue silently picked up her bag, got out of the car, walked straight in, and didn't look back. Yin Hao sat in the car for a moment, watching her figure disappear.
location: Departing from 88 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province, via the Shenhai Expressway, Hujia Expressway, etc., arriving at Zhujiang New City, 888 Wencheng Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returned to the rented apartment to rest
description: Drove 19 minutes from Zhujiang New Town back to Xingang Community and parked the car downstairs. Went upstairs, opened the door, and a stuffy heat hit my face. Opened the windows for ventilation and boiled some water. After a quick shower, changed into loose loungewear and rested a bit.
location: Room 403, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: In the afternoon, walked to the fishing tackle shop to shop, wandered along the street, and got takeout dinner.
description: Went out for some fresh air, walked 15 minutes to Shihudang Fishing Tackle Shop, greeted the owner, picked out two packs each of No. 0.8 and No. 1.0 fishhooks, replenished some lead strips and rubber line stops, and spent over 30 yuan. After buying, I didn't rush home. I walked along the river beside Dongzha Road, watching the passing boats, and felt a sense of peace. Then I continued strolling along the street, soaking in the weekend market atmosphere, and finally walked to the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road and brought back a takeout of yuxiang shredded pork over rice.
location: Along the route from No. 30, Dongzha Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to No. 232, Xingang Road, Dagang Town

name: Ate dinner at home and browsed real estate listings
description: Walked two minutes from the Sichuan restaurant to home, put the rice with toppings onto a plate, and while eating, opened the Beike Zhaofang app to carefully browse new and second-hand small units with a total price under 1.5 million yuan in surrounding Shanghai areas such as Jiashan and Taicang. Compared the layouts, average prices, and locations of several developments and took screenshots of the pages he was interested in.
location: Room 403, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organized internal trainer training materials.
description: After the meal, he cleared the table, sat down at his desk, opened his laptop, and began organizing the PPT training materials for the internal trainer. Following Teacher Liu Jianjun's revision comments from last week, he adjusted the logical structure point by point, and added more specific operation cases and troubleshooting procedures to key pages, making them as close as possible to the actual needs of frontline operators.
location: Room 403, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Asked Master Sun a technical question via WeChat.
description: After organizing the material framework, he picked up his phone and sent a WeChat message to his mentor Sun Jianguo, first asking about the precautions for tool compensation and spindle speed matching when machining stainless steel thin-walled parts in the practical simulation for the senior technician exam. He then added praise for the operating guide Sun had previously provided, saying it was very helpful for the PPT case section, and expressed his thanks. While waiting for a reply, he relaxed by browsing a few fishing and machining videos on Bilibili.
location: Room 403, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening free time, washing up
description: After continuing to watch short videos on his phone for a while, he went to the bathroom to wash up carefully, brushing his teeth and washing his face, gradually letting his body and mind relax from the day's hustle and bustle.
location: Room 403, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After turning off the light, he lay in bed watching short videos on his phone for a while, with tomorrow's tasks — submitting training materials and contacting the real estate agent — still lingering in his mind. He set the alarm for 6:10 the next day for his morning run, put down his phone at 22:30, and fell into a deep sleep in exhaustion.
location: Bedroom, Room 403, Building 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting up, washing up, and adjusting mental state
description: The alarm went off on time. Yin Hao got up quickly and opened the window to feel the cool autumn morning air. He brushed his teeth quickly and washed his face with cold water to fully wake up. He checked his hair in the mirror, patted his face, and encouraged himself: “New week, let’s go.” He changed into a gray quick-dry T-shirt and black sports shorts, weighed himself (72.8 kg, the same as yesterday), then checked his backpack to confirm the work badge, noise-canceling headphones, and power bank were all ready.
location: Inside the rental apartment in Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning exercise preparation and pre-ride inspection
description: Yin Hao carried his cleaned black mountain bike downstairs, bent down at the entrance to check the tire pressure, pressed the front and rear tires to confirm they were elastic, and saw that the chain was shiny and well-lubricated. He decided to use this time to briskly walk and stretch on the community path, completing a low-intensity mini morning workout. After several sets of shoulder circles and leg stretches, he put on his earphones, opened the audio course "Advanced CNC Programming Theory" on his phone, and prepared for the ride.
location: Walking trail inside Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycling to work and eating breakfast on the move.
description: Yin Hao rode onto Xingang Road, heading toward Huatianjing Highway. Traffic was light in the early morning, and the air carried a faint scent of grass and trees. When passing the archway of Dagang Town, he stopped at a breakfast cart by the roadside and said to the vendor, "Boss, one tea egg and one pork bun." The total came to 4 yuan. To save time, he held the handlebar with one hand and quickly ate the bun while pushing the bike; the egg was left in the basket and eaten while waiting at a red light. His earphones happened to be explaining the Q value setting for the G83 deep-hole drilling cycle. After eating, he increased his pedaling cadence and arrived at the factory gate on time 35 minutes later, then locked the bike.
location: From the breakfast cart at Pailou, Dagang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road.

name: Changing clothes, preparing for work, and pre-shift meeting
description: Yin Hao pushed open the door and entered the workshop changing room, put on his dark blue work clothes, and donned his safety helmet. In front of CNC milling machine No. 3, he first carried out the routine checks: the coolant level was normal, the hydraulic oil pressure met the standard, and the spindle rotated without noise; he then signed the equipment inspection sheet. While he was checking the tool chuck, Team Leader Wang Lei walked over with a teacup and patted his shoulder. "Xiao Yin, you're in good spirits today! New week, let's give it your all." Yin Hao smiled knowingly. "Sure thing, Team Leader."
location: No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory workshop locker room and No. 3 CNC milling machine workstation

name: Morning: workpiece machining and training manual optimization
description: Yin Hao took out 10 stainless steel valve body blanks from the warehouse, loaded the program machined last Friday, clamped and set the tools, and the machine began cutting. During the 15-minute intervals between process steps, he opened the training manual Word document on his laptop, recalled Master Sun's advice from last week, redrew a spindle orientation fault troubleshooting flowchart, and added three diagrams of the practical application of tool radius compensation. Engineer Liu Zhiqiang came over during his inspection, nodded slightly, and said, "Impressive, Xiao Yin. This flowchart is clearer than the textbook. The trial lecture at the end of the month looks promising." Yin Hao's heart warmed, and he worked with even more energy.
location: CNC milling machine workstation No. 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break, packed lunch, and trial lecture practice
description: After finishing the workpieces in the morning, Yin Hao shut down the machine tool. Instead of going to a restaurant with his colleagues, he went straight to the company cafeteria and got a takeout box of shredded pork with green peppers over rice and a bottle of water (12 yuan total). Carrying the lunch box, he walked to the less crowded material storage area on the south side of the workshop, pulled up a stool, and sat down. After quickly finishing lunch, he took out the printed manual chapter, cleared his throat, and began to quietly rehearse the section 'Machining Difficulties and Solutions for Stainless Steel Thin-Walled Parts'. He took out his phone and recorded a 5-minute audio clip. Playing it back, he found his speaking pace was a bit fast and his nasal tone was slightly heavy, and made a mental note: when he returned home in the evening, he needed to improve his speaking pace and ensure clearer enunciation.
location: Material storage room on the south side of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon first batch machining and program debugging
description: Back at his workstation, Yin Hao started processing the new batch of 5 valve bodies. This time the program used a new rigid tapping cycle. He operated very carefully and manually adjusted the feed rate twice to ensure the thread surface finish. While the machine was cutting automatically, he stood beside it watching, silently reviewing the trial lecture just given, thinking about how to make the part about 'solving tool chatter' more vivid and easy to understand.
location: CNC milling machine workstation No. 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Routine workshop inspection and cooperation with inspection
description: Following factory rules, Yin Hao put on his gloves and, together with Squad Leader Wang and the safety officer, conducted a safety inspection of the five spindles running in the workshop. The air pressure gauge pointer on Lathe No. 3, which he was responsible for recording, showed slight fluctuations, so he immediately raised his hand to report it. The safety officer verified it on site, recorded it in the manual, and contacted the maintenance department. Squad Leader Wang cast an approving glance and said, "Xiao Yin, you have sharp eyes." Yin Hao felt the reminder was well worth it.
location: At each key equipment location in Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon: main workpiece machining and finishing work
description: Yin Hao finished machining the remaining 5 workpieces. After each one, he self-checked with a vernier caliper and a roughness tester to ensure the tolerances were within range. After all machining was done, he carefully cleaned the iron chips inside the machine tool, wiped the workbench, and put the cutting tools and measuring instruments back in place. At 17:20, he completed all production tasks, and the qualified workpieces were neatly placed on the designated pallet.
location: CNC milling machine workstation No. 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Light Evening Meal and Energy Replenishment
description: After clocking out of work, Yin Hao rode his bike to the Wangjincun convenience store at the factory gate. Without browsing inside, he directly told the clerk, "A sports drink, a pack of whole-wheat bread, and a ham sausage." The total was 11.5 yuan. Sitting on the small stool by the store entrance, he quickly ate the bread and ham sausage and drank most of the beverage. With his stomach full, he thought to himself: tonight I must crack that macro program.
location: Wangjin Village Convenience Store, Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening hands-on macro program practice in the workshop and remote consultation
description: Yin Hao returned to the empty workshop, turned on the simulation machine tool used for testing, and loaded the macro program that had failed the night before. He tried to debug it himself by modifying a few parameters, but as soon as it ran, the machine tool alarmed again. He took a screenshot of the error screen and wrote down his self-check approach. Around 8:00 PM, he gathered his courage and made a WeChat video call to Teacher Liu Jianjun. When the signal connected, he described the problem clearly and sincerely: "Teacher Liu, on the Huazhong system, when assigning macro variable #521, the simulation reported a 'divide by zero' error." Teacher Liu remotely guided him to check the arithmetic logic of global variables #520 and #521. He found that in a loop, when #520 was 0, #521 appeared as the denominator and caused the error. Teacher Liu told him to break up the calculation steps. It suddenly dawned on him. After the modification, the program ran normally, and he excitedly thanked him again and again.
location: Simulation test machine tool workstation, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycled back to the rented apartment.
description: Yin Hao turned off the machine tool and locked the workshop gate. The night wind grew chillier. He got on his bicycle, put on his earphones—but this time he didn't play a lesson; he played soothing instrumental music. He rode back along Huatianjing Road, replaying the entire process of debugging the macro program that evening—from being overwhelmed to suddenly seeing things clearly—and felt a strong sense of accomplishment. Facing the cool night breeze, he rode the 8-kilometer distance in about 35 minutes.
location: Huatianjing Highway to Xingang Community, Nos. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home, wash up, organize notes, and plan for tomorrow
description: Back in the room, slightly sweaty. Yin Hao took a shower first and changed into clean pajamas. Then he sat down at the desk, took out his hardcover notebook, and carefully wrote down the core points of the macro program modifications that Teacher Liu had guided him through this evening and how to avoid division-by-zero errors. After that, he opened the training manual and wrote under “To-do items”: “Based on the recording, optimize the speaking pace and rhythm of the trial lecture and reduce pauses.”
location: Inside the rental apartment in Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Texting with Lin Yue before bed
description: After hesitating for a moment, Yin Hao took out his phone, tapped on Lin Yue's WeChat avatar, and typed: "It's Monday today, work has been too busy. I just finished practicing macro programs and came back. What about you? Are you okay?" After sending it, he felt nervous and anxious. About ten-plus minutes later, the screen lit up: "I'm preparing lessons and just finished. You should also rest early." Although the reply was still brief, at least she did not deliberately avoid him. He felt a little more at ease and replied: "Got it. You've worked hard too. Good night." Then he put down his phone.
location: On the bed in the rental room, Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep
description: Yin Hao set the alarm for 6:10 the next morning and turned off the light. In the darkness, he clearly reviewed the day: all the work was done, and he had made a breakthrough in programming. Although the future with Lin Yue was still unclear, he knew that action is always the best way to solve problems. With this calm, he closed his eyes and soon fell asleep.
location: On the bed in the rental room, Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Early morning run and weight check
description: The phone alarm rang exactly at 6:00. Yin Hao got up and first stepped on the scale. Seeing 73.0 kg, he thought that skipping last night's run had indeed added a little weight. He quickly washed his face, changed into his workout clothes, and walked five minutes to Xiaokunshan Health Park across from the residential complex. He planned to run 5 km this morning. He adjusted his breathing, letting the morning air fill his lungs, and felt refreshed after the run.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Went home, washed up, and had breakfast
description: After returning home, he took a warm shower to wash off the sweat. Time was tight, so he spent 8 minutes eating whole wheat bread and drinking milk. He then packed the macro-program error notebook and training manual he had organized the night before into his backpack, and resumed the CNC machining audio recommended by Teacher Liu on his phone, planning to listen during the commute.
location: Rental apartment at Xinguang Community, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycled to work while listening to exam preparation audio
description: Left at 7 o'clock, unlocked a shared bike downstairs, and rode along Xingang Road, Kungang Road, and Huatianjing Road, about 5.5 kilometers, taking half an hour. Wearing Bluetooth earphones, I listened to an explanation of non-circular curve fitting for macro programs, silently noting the key points. When I heard about the ellipse parametric equation driving the tool path, I visualized it in my mind and found it interesting.
location: Along the route from Xingang Road to Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Arrive at the company and warm up for the workday
description: At 7:28, he rode to the factory area, parked the bike, swiped his work badge to enter the workshop, and clocked in at 07:32. In the locker room he changed into work clothes and safety shoes, then went to the rest area for a drink of water. He took out the #521 divide-by-zero error he had gotten wrong last night and worked through it again on scratch paper, confirming he had truly mastered it, and got ready for the day's work.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Machining stainless steel valve bodies in the morning
description: Team leader Wang Lei held the morning meeting and confirmed that today's task was to machine a batch of stainless steel valve bodies. The material was hard and caused significant tool wear. Yin Hao returned to No. 3 CNC milling machine and started it up. For the first piece, he was especially careful in calibrating the workpiece coordinate system, checking the parameters one by one. During the machine's automatic cutting interval, he opened his laptop and, combining the knowledge point about non-circular curves from the morning and the elliptical macro program logic he had learned the night before, tried to optimize the section on special-shaped part machining in the training manual and drew a simple program flowchart.
location: In front of No. 3 CNC milling machine at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: During the lunch break, asked Master Sun for training tips.
description: When the lunch break bell rang, Yin Hao took his training manual to the cafeteria and found Master Sun Jianguo. They got food together, ordering shredded pork with green peppers and tomato scrambled eggs. While eating, he asked how to explain macro program variables more clearly, saying the manual felt too abstract and he was worried the new colleagues wouldn't understand. Master Sun used a leftover toothpick to gesture on the plate, explaining that the edge of the plate should be treated as the workpiece contour, the toothpick as the tool, and the variables as the instructions given to the tool. The key was to use a tool collision case to show that the instructions could change, so people would remember after hearing it once. Yin Hao suddenly understood, and after the meal he discussed it with Master Sun for a few more minutes.
location: Canteen and the area beside No. 3 machine tool at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Continued machining in the afternoon and assisted with safety inspections
description: He was in good condition in the afternoon. Yin Hao used the idea discussed at noon and wrote a simplified multi-layer milling macro program when machining the step surface, improving efficiency. Around 4 o'clock, team leader Wang Lei received a notice from the safety officer that a batch of old air pressure gauges in the workshop had fluctuating readings and required focused inspection. Yin Hao proactively cooperated, took the inspection form, and checked the pneumatic and hydraulic systems of the machine tools he was responsible for one by one, recorded one abnormal data point, and reported it in a timely manner. Before leaving work, he completed the rough machining of all valve bodies and polished the chapter on CNC system parameters in the training manual again.
location: In front of the No. 3 CNC milling machine and in the workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Walked home after work and helped Aunt Chen fix her fan.
description: After clocking out, Yin Hao walked to the convenience store in Wangjin Village. Just as he left the factory gate, he ran into Aunt Chen, who was walking with an old floor fan. She said the fan made a clattering noise when it spun. Yin Hao smiled and agreed to fix it tomorrow, telling her to leave the fan at his door. At the convenience store at the entrance to Wangjin Village, he bought a bottle of iced sports drink and a pack of whole wheat bread as provisions.
location: Factory gate at No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and Wangjincun Convenience Store, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Walked to Old Jesse Restaurant.
description: Walking from Wangjin Village to Zhongshan Middle Road in Songjiang's old city takes about 30 minutes or more. Taking advantage of this walk to digest, Yin Hao listened to some music as he passed through several old streets. Watching the streetlights come on along the road, he felt the exhaustion of a workday gradually fade.
location: Along the route from Wangjin Village, Qingpu District, Shanghai to Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Having dinner with colleagues at Lao Jishi Restaurant
description: By the time Yin Hao arrived at Lao Jishi Restaurant, Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang were already there. The three decided to eat something light and ordered steamed sea bass, white-cut chicken, and stir-fried water spinach with garlic. During the meal, Wang Lei complained about the strict new safety officer in the workshop, Liu Zhiqiang talked about the latest football news, and Yin Hao mentioned that he planned to go to the bank to consult about a loan on the weekend. After three bottles of beer, their nerves relaxed entirely.
location: Lao Jishi Restaurant, Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Team up to play Honor of Kings
description: After the meal, Wang Lei wanted to sing karaoke, but Yin Hao felt tired and suggested playing games online together. The three found a nearby Wanyu Internet Cafe, booked three connected seats, and played ranked matches. Yin Hao used his signature jungler to make several good plays, winning more than losing. Everyone cheered when winning and joked around blaming each other when losing, completely setting aside the pressure of housing and salary.
location: Wanyoo Internet Cafe (Songjiang Ark Square Branch), Lane 12, Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Took a taxi back to the rented apartment.
