description: Got off the plane at 9:30, said goodbye to Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang at the internet cafe entrance, and Yin Hao took a taxi back to Xingang Residential Community, arriving 16 minutes later. The night breeze blew along the way, and he felt relaxed in a slight buzz.
location: Along Rongle Middle Road Lane 12 to Xingang Road Lane 224, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home to adjust his mindset and make a financial plan
description: Back in the rented apartment, he first took a comfortable hot shower. Sitting on the edge of the bed, the pressure of buying an apartment faintly surfaced. Yin Hao first poured himself a glass of warm water, calmed down with deep breaths, then opened the memo on his phone and carefully wrote: 1. Go to China Construction Bank Songjiang Zhongshan Sub-branch this weekend to consult about the combined loan policy; 2. Prepare a detailed income and expense statement; 3. Confirm with Dad roughly how much he can support. After writing it down, he felt much more at ease.
location: Rental apartment at Xinguang Community, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-bed preparation and rest.
description: At 6 p.m., when he got off work and returned to the entrance of the community, he saw Auntie Chen from across the hall looking around anxiously at the unit entrance. The hand-cranked drying rack on her balcony was stuck halfway and wouldn't come down, so she couldn't get the clothes. Without a word, Yin Hao brought out a screwdriver and lubricating oil from his own apartment and followed Auntie Chen inside. Inspection revealed that the steel cable was stuck at the pulley. He loosened the positioning screw with the screwdriver, reset the steel cable, then applied lubricating oil to the pulley and track. After raising and lowering it several times, the drying rack moved smoothly again. Auntie Chen was extremely grateful and kept saying that she was lucky to have him. She then offered to treat him to dinner on the weekend. Yin Hao smiled and said she was too kind, but since Auntie's cooking was really delicious, he agreed.
location: On the bed in the rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and jog around the neighborhood.
description: After the alarm rang, lingered in bed for a while, feeling conflicted thinking about last night's all-night review and Lin Yue's message. After moving around a bit, turned over and got up, washed up, changed into sportswear, and jogged 4 kilometers on the tree-lined path in the community at a pace of 6:30 per kilometer. Felt the body warmed up, but the mind was still a bit heavy.
location: Inside and around the tree-lined paths of Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up, breakfast, and preparation before the commute.
description: Went home, took a shower, and changed into blue work clothes. Breakfast was a pork bun and soy milk bought from the convenience store downstairs. He checked his commuter bag: work ID card, gloves, earplugs, notebook, and pen. He glanced at Lin Yue's profile picture on his phone and sighed.
location: In the rented apartment at Room 101, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Bike commuting and exam preparation study
description: Left with the bike at 07:10 on time and rode south along Songzheng Highway. Used the phone speaker to play the audio of the CNC technician exam course Complex Surface Machining Technology. Rode for about 40 minutes, sweat soaked my back, and also went through the key knowledge points again.
location: Along the way from Xingang Community, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning work: machining stainless steel bases.
description: At 07:50, he arrived, changed into shoe covers, and attended the morning meeting. Team leader Wang Lei emphasized the rushed production of the stainless steel base order. Yin Hao picked up the drawings, checked the tolerances, then debugged the machine tool. Using the 'assign variables first' technique taught by Master Sun, he optimized the tool path program, and the four workpieces he machined all achieved a surface roughness of Ra1.6. During the tool change interval, he recorded new machining parameters.
location: No. 3 CNC milling machine workstation, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Lunch with colleagues
description: After the lunch break bell rang, Master Sun called Yin Hao to go eat at the Sun Island Ancient Village Farmhouse Restaurant. The three of them walked about 10 minutes to get there. Yin Hao ordered the braised pork ribs set meal. While eating, he listened to Squad Leader Wang talk about amusing stories of his son starting elementary school. He tried hard to join the conversation, ate somewhat hurriedly, and thought about needing to run in the afternoon to refresh himself.
location: Sun Island Ancient Village Farm Stay, beside the east gate of Sun Island Tourist Resort, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Fragmented run during lunch break
description: After leaving the farmhouse restaurant, Yin Hao told his master that he wanted to move around to aid digestion. He took off his jacket, changed into running shoes, and ran 3 km along the tree-lined Huatianjing Road at a pace of 6 min/km. The sun was a bit strong; after the run he was sweating profusely but felt more refreshed, and returned to the workshop rest area for water.
location: On Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai (the out-and-back section from the back gate of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory to Sun Island Farmhouse Restaurant)

name: Afternoon work and being criticized for dozing off
description: In the afternoon, he continued machining. While waiting for the automatic tool changer, drowsiness from staying up late studying for days hit him, and Yin Hao fell asleep leaning against the tool box. His master Sun Jianguo woke him up and sternly criticized the dangerous behavior of dozing in the workshop. Yin Hao's face turned red instantly; feeling guilty and frightened, he apologized immediately and drew up a new mandatory schedule on the spot: 18:00-20:00 practical workshop practice after work, and lights out before 23:00. Only then did his master's expression soften, and he told him to put safety first.
location: No. 3 CNC milling machine workstation, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Wrapped up work and completed the handover before leaving.
description: Near the end of the shift, Yin Hao sent the five machined bases to the quality inspection area and confirmed the blank allowance data with quality inspector Zhang Fan. He returned to his workstation, cleaned up the metal chips, and put the tools back in place. At 17:15 he went to the changing room, took off his work clothes, and threw his oily work jacket into the laundry basket.
location: Workshop and quality inspection area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Nighttime hands-on practice
description: After work, the workshop was quiet. Yin Hao stayed behind according to his new plan, using scrap 45# steel to repeatedly test and optimize the parameter compensation program for thin-walled parts. He kept adjusting spindle speed and tool feed rate, measured with calipers, and recorded 8 sets of valid data in his notebook, feeling that he now had a deeper understanding of macro programs.
location: No. 3 CNC milling machine workstation, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Bought groceries and cycled home.
description: At 20:00, I packed up my tools, locked the workshop, and rode away on my bike. I stopped by the Xingang New Village fresh food supermarket and bought eggs, green vegetables, dried noodles, and pickled mustard tuber. At 20:25, I returned to the community, locked the bike, and went upstairs.
location: From 360 Huatianjing Highway, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and then to Room 101, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Video call with Lin Yue and arranging to meet
description: He put away the dishes and poured water, took a deep breath, then used the phone stand to make a WeChat video call to Lin Yue. After chatting about daily life, Yin Hao took the initiative to apologize for last week's argument at the wedding. Lin Yue said she wanted to see a direction; she had saved money from tutoring and was also worried he was too tired. The two communicated candidly for nearly 40 minutes and the atmosphere eased. At the end of the call, Yin Hao proposed meeting at a café downtown at 12:00 on Saturday, September 27, and Lin Yue agreed. After hanging up, Yin Hao let out a long sigh of relief and created a new schedule entry in his memo.
location: Living room of the rented apartment, Room 101, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cooking noodles, organizing notes, and making plans
description: I entered today's practical operation records into my phone's notepad. I opened the calculator and, using last month's payslip, estimated how much money I could save by the end of the month, and wrote down the to-do item 'consult bank about loan pre-approval.' Afterwards, I cooked a bowl of noodles with greens and egg, ate it with pickled mustard, and felt completely at ease.
location: In the rented apartment at Room 101, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Evening wind-down and going to bed
description: After eating noodles and washing dishes, did some simple stretching. At 22:40 turned off the main light and dimmed the bedside lamp, sent Lin Yue a goodnight message, and at 22:50 turned off the light and went to sleep on time, silently telling myself to follow the new routine tomorrow.
location: In the rental apartment and on the bed, Room 101, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wake up, indoor stretching, wash up
description: At exactly 6 o'clock, the phone alarm went off on time. I opened my eyes and felt refreshed; I had slept fairly soundly last night. The sky outside the window was a bit gloomy, and the phone showed 'light rain turning cloudy, 21°C to 26°C, with a force 4 north wind.' Since it was raining, I canceled the morning jog plan, letting my body get a full day of rest. I stood by the window and did a simple five-minute stretch, feeling my cervical and lumbar spine loosen up. Then I went into the bathroom and took a hot shower to wash away the remaining drowsiness. After drying my hair, I changed into clean work clothes and felt much fresher.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast, cycling commute.
description: It is raining today, and driving would likely be congested, so I decided to cycle to work. Before leaving, I put on a light softshell jacket. I stopped at Wangjincun Convenience Store at the community gate and bought four xiaolongbao and a cup of hot soy milk for 8 yuan. I carefully placed the breakfast box in the bike basket, cycled about 25 minutes to the company, and locked the bike in the bike shed. After arriving at the workshop, I first finished my breakfast in the changing room, then changed into work clothes and put on a safety helmet.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Attend the pre-shift morning meeting and confirm processing tasks.
description: At 7:30, the pre-shift morning meeting started on time. Team Leader Wang conveyed today's production task: continue machining a batch of stainless steel bases with very high precision requirements; they are key components for precision instruments. Master Sun specifically emphasized safety operating procedures and asked about the first-piece inspection results of yesterday's new program. I reported, "The first batch of three workpieces all passed quality inspection, and the dimensions are within tolerance." Master Sun nodded in approval.
location: Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning workpiece machining and monitoring, exchanging technical details with Engineer Liu.
description: After the morning meeting, I returned to the CNC milling machine workstation, first carefully reviewed yesterday's machining records and today's drawings, and confirmed all machining parameters. Then I started clamping the workpiece and called up the optimized program that had been debugged yesterday. During machining, I kept a close eye on the various data on the control panel, and during the tool change gap I asked Engineer Liu, who was passing by, about the vibration issue of thin-walled parts. Engineer Liu provided a reference parameter combination. I immediately recorded it in my work notebook and verified it with a trial cut on a small piece of scrap. Master Sun also came around for an inspection, glanced at the machining status, and his eyes showed satisfaction. The whole morning, I continuously monitored the machining status to ensure smooth production.
location: CNC milling machine workstation, Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch, signing up for the friendly tournament in the fishing-buddies group, and a lunch break
description: At 12 noon, I walked with Master Sun and Squad Leader Wang to Sun Island Ancient Village Farmhouse Restaurant for lunch. We arrived after about ten minutes' walk and found seats by the window. I ordered a braised pork ribs set meal. While eating, I took out my phone to check the fishing buddies group and saw that the group leader Old Huang had posted the registration notice for the friendly match on Saturday at the fish farm in Maogang Town, Songjiang. I immediately clicked the link, filled in the information, paid the 100 yuan registration fee, and sent the successful registration screenshot to the group. Squad Leader Wang teased, "Xiao Yin, you've been unlucky in love but lucky in fishing lately, huh? Going to show off your skills on Saturday?" I smiled and didn't explain much. After lunch, I walked back to the factory alone. The air was fresh after the rain. I smoked a cigarette at the workshop entrance to relax, then went back to my workstation and rested with my eyes closed for ten minutes to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: Sun Island Ancient Village Farm Stay, beside the East Gate of Sun Island Tourist Resort, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon workpiece machining and workshop inspection.
description: The afternoon work continued. According to the weekly plan, I worked with Team Leader Wang and the safety officer to conduct a routine inspection of the three CNC machine tools and auxiliary equipment in the workshop, focusing on checking the air pressure gauges and oil pressure gauges, and recorded all the data. After that, I returned to my own machine, imported the new rigid tapping cycle program debugged by Engineer Liu into the equipment, and ran a small-batch verification on several test pieces; everything went smoothly. I marked the workpieces with serial numbers using a marker pen, ready to send them for quality inspection later. I continued machining until the end of the shift.
location: Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycled home after work.
description: At 16:30, it was time to get off work. I turned off the machine, cleaned the iron filings off the workbench, and sent the last batch of workpieces processed today for quality inspection. After clocking out, I went to the bike shed and got on my bicycle. The road was a bit damp after the rain. I rode steadily along the familiar Huatianjing Road, passed several intersections, and arrived at Xingang Residential Complex about 25 minutes later.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organize fishing gear, prepare dinner, and have dinner
description: After returning home, I changed into loungewear and the first thing I did was go to the balcony to organize my fishing gear. I carefully inspected every line guide on the rock rod and hand rod to confirm they were intact and undamaged; checked the main line and leader of the rigs, pulling them by hand to make sure the strength was sufficient; and verified the float and hook models—no problems. I found a pack of brand-new commercial bait and a box of earthworms from the cabinet and put them into the bait box. Finally, I put everything back in place, neatly placed the fishing bag and fishing box in the corner of the living room, and put the rod bag in the car trunk in advance, ready to leave early Saturday morning. After that, I started preparing dinner. I took eggs, greens, and dried noodles from the fridge and boiled a steaming pot of green vegetable and egg noodle soup, served with pickled mustard. While eating, I watched a Bilibili tutorial video on CNC macro programs on my phone, preparing for writing the training manual in the evening.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Revise the unit's outreach speech draft and interact with Lin Yue online to ease the relationship.
description: After washing the dishes, I sat down at the desk and opened my laptop. Several sheets of manuscript paper covered with technical key points were spread out on the desk. I began polishing the presentation draft for the company's technical exchange meeting, focusing on improving the wording of the section on difficulties in machining stainless steel thin-walled parts, and drew a few simple process flowcharts to present at next week's meeting. At that moment, my phone gave a ding—it was a photo from Lin Yue of the succulent on her office windowsill. I smiled, casually took a photo of the messy manuscript paper on my desk, the coffee cup beside it, and the small electronic multimeter, captioned it a messy desk in battle-preparation mode, and sent it to her. She quickly replied with a smiley emoji, and we chatted a bit about daily life. The atmosphere was relaxed and natural, and the relationship had eased somewhat.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Completed the main chapters of the new machine tool training manual and sent them to Master Sun.
description: After finishing the chat with Lin Yue, I continued to focus on the work at hand. I created a new document and began writing the main chapters of the training manual for the new machine tool, covering the hardware operation procedures, the software interface introduction, and the troubleshooting diagrams I had accumulated from daily practice. I referred to the framework Master Sun had provided earlier and some technical materials from Engineer Liu, so the writing went smoothly. After nearly an hour and a half, I basically completed the main body containing text, diagrams, and operation screenshots, leaving only the appendix with the common fault table to be added tomorrow. I carefully checked the whole text for typos and formatting, then sent it by email with the subject line 'Training Manual (Main Body) - Please review, Master Sun' and clicked send.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation, review, and going to bed
description: After finishing the important tasks, I felt a little drowsy. I turned off the computer, went to the bathroom, washed my face, brushed my teeth, and changed into pajamas. I set my phone to silent mode and put it on the nightstand to charge. Lying in bed, I briefly reviewed today's work and the smooth trial cutting of the new program. I also thought about the registered fishing competition and the relaxing chat with Lin Yue, and felt grounded and calm. I picked up my phone and checked tomorrow's weather forecast: sunny, 18–27 degrees, perfect for a morning run. I took a deep breath, turned off the light, closed my eyes, and soon fell asleep.
location: Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning Preparation and Jogging Warm-Up
description: After the alarm rang, he got up, weighed 73.1 kg, changed into a quick-dry running T-shirt, shorts, and running shoes, drank most of a glass of warm water, and grabbed his keys and phone. Starting from his rented room in Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, he jogged along Xingang Road toward Guangfulin Road as a warm-up. About 15 minutes later, he arrived at the bus stop next to Songjiang Sports Center and met his running buddy Chen Jie.
location: Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning 8 km run and catching up with running friends.
description: After fist-bumping Chen Jie, he jogged 8 kilometers along the outer trail of Guangfulin Cultural Relics Park, with a steady pace of 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. During the run, Chen Jie noticed that he had been missing weekend long runs recently. He explained that he was under pressure preparing for the technician certification exam and rushing the training manual. Chen Jie shared stress-relief tips, and they agreed to meet up Saturday night after the fishing competition for crayfish. After the run, his body felt loose and his mood was light.
location: Perimeter trail of the Guangfulin Cultural Relics Site, Songjiang District, Shanghai (starting point: Songjiang Sports Center)

name: Post-run stretching and running into a neighbor at breakfast
description: Did stretching with Chen Jie by the roadside flowerbed, then went to the unnamed breakfast stall at the Xingang Road intersection. Each had a bowl of soy milk, two fried dough sticks, and a tea egg. While there, ran into Aunt Chen, a neighbor walking her dog. She asked about your running and mentioned that her grandson is coming back next week, so she was planning to buy pork ribs and make soup. You promised to help over the weekend. Chen Jie teased you about being popular.
location: Unnamed breakfast stall opposite the entrance of Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home, wash up, and organize loan documents.
description: Returned to the rented apartment in Xingang Community, took a warm shower, and changed into clean work clothes. Took out the prepared document folder, checked the salary flow statement, ID card copy, and other loan materials, and after confirming everything was correct, put them into the commuter bag.
location: Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycling to work and pre-shift meeting.
description: Rode an electric bike to work from Xingang Community, passed by Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket without stopping, and went directly to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. Clocked in at the workshop, changed into safety shoes and helmet. Attended pre-shift meeting at 8:30, Squad Leader Wang assigned the processing task for Y-shaped three-way pipe fittings. After the meeting, you asked Master Sun for leave to go to the bank at noon and were approved.
location: Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning machining work and self-study programming.
description: He operated the No. 2 CNC milling machine to process a Y-type tee fitting. First he made a trial cut to check the dimensions and fine-tuned the tool compensation. During a break in production, he studied the macro-program nesting PDF sent by Teacher Liu Jianjun on the workshop computer and tried to write a macro program to improve the surface finish of the arc surface. He encountered a logic problem with jump instructions and triggered the alarm twice. He took a screenshot and sent a WeChat message to Teacher Liu for guidance.
location: No. 2 CNC milling machine, Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing lunch and reporting leave for going out.
description: Approaching the lunch break, he took off his gloves and went to the workshop office to report a short outing. Shift leader Wang asked about it, and he told him he was going to the bank to inquire about something. Wang patted him on the shoulder, encouraged him, and agreed. Then he washed his hands at the sink and prepared to go out.
location: Workshop Office, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving to the bank to inquire about mortgage pre-approval
description: Drove his own car for about 15 minutes to reach China Construction Bank, Shanghai Songjiang New City Sub-branch. After taking a number, he met face-to-face with account manager Li Qiang. He provided his salary statements, credit report, and ID card copy, and learned that the preliminary mortgage amount for the second-hand house was 900,000 to 1,000,000 yuan. He was also told that he needed to supplement materials such as proof of income, source-of-down-payment fund flow statements, and property title search reports. At the same time, he consulted about the interest-rate advantages of a combined provident fund and commercial loan, and recorded everything one by one.
location: China Construction Bank (Shanghai Songjiang New City Sub-branch), Xinsongjiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: In the car, communicated with his girlfriend and worked out the plan.
description: After leaving the bank and returning to the car, he sent a photo of the supplemental loan materials list to his girlfriend Lin Yue via WeChat, told her the preliminary credit line was about 1 million yuan, and said they would need to pool the down payment and prepare the materials together, adding a message telling her not to worry. She replied with a Go for it emoji. Then he used the calculator on his phone to roughly estimate the monthly payment range and felt confident.
location: Parking lot in front of China Construction Bank on Xinsongjiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returned to the factory for lunch and received technical guidance.
description: Drove back to the factory and had shredded pork with green peppers over rice and seaweed egg drop soup in the cafeteria. While eating, he saw a WeChat reply from Teacher Liu Jianjun, pointing out that the macro program error was because the GOTO statement address number did not match the IF condition, possibly a typo. He was delighted and planned to verify it in the afternoon.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work and overcoming program difficulties
description: In the afternoon, he continued machining the Y-type tee. During a break in processing, following Teacher Liu's suggestion, he checked the macro program variable jump logic in the simulation software and found an address numbering error. After correction, the simulation passed. He sent a screenshot to Teacher Liu and received praise. He saved the successful program to a USB drive. The three Y-type tees machined in the afternoon all passed quality inspection.
location: No. 2 CNC milling machine, Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cleaning the machine tool and working overtime to verify the program.
description: Before leaving work, I cleaned the iron chips around the machine tool, blew the guide rails clean with compressed air, and performed lubrication maintenance. After work, once my colleagues had left, I changed into spare work clothes, applied to use the idle old CNC milling machine, entered the debugged macro program, and used scrap material to trial-cut a curved-surface test piece. Measurements with a vernier caliper and roughness tester showed the dimensions were within tolerance and the surface finish was improved. I wrote the date and parameters on the bottom of the test piece with a marker, planning to show it to Master Sun tomorrow.
location: Idle old machine area, Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycled home from work and bought dinner ingredients.
description: He packed up his things, put the test piece and notes into his commuter bag, and rode his electric bike away from the factory. Passing by Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, he went in and bought a tray of fresh free-range eggs (10 eggs), a bundle of Shanghai bok choy, a pack of wide dried noodles, and a bottle of Lao Gan Ma chili sauce, spending about 38 yuan.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home, dinner, and evening tidying up
description: Back at the rented apartment, I put the vegetables and eggs in the fridge. I washed the vegetables, boiled water, cooked noodles with greens and eggs, and poached two eggs, then drizzled Lao Gan Ma chili sauce on top. While eating, I thought back over the day's experiences. After the meal, I washed the dishes, sat down at the desk, and carefully recorded the key points for the macro program modification and the loan consultation material process. I confirmed the meeting time and place for tomorrow's fishing competition at the fish farm in Maogang Town, Songjiang, and checked that the rock rod, hand rod, line sets, and float in the tackle bag were all in good condition, with enough bait.
location: Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with girlfriend Lin Yue
description: After tidying up, you called Lin Yue on WeChat video. She was reading at home. You shared the progress of the loan consultation and photos of the macro program test piece. She praised you, sounding relaxed, and took the initiative to ask about the fishing competition. You chatted for nearly half an hour. The atmosphere was warm, and the rift caused by the house seemed to be dissolving. She reminded you to get up early tomorrow and not stay up too late.
location: Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Free time and washing up.
description: After hanging up the video call, you felt relieved. You checked the WeChat runners' group; Chen Jie invited everyone to have crayfish on Saturday night, and you replied with a sticker to confirm. Then you browsed Bilibili videos on fishing tips and CNC machine maintenance. When the time came, you went to wash up.
location: Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep.
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, he placed the sportswear, sun hat, and fishing gear bag for the next day by the door, and put the car keys and a fully charged power bank on the shoe cabinet. He set the alarm for 5:40, lay down in bed, sent Lin Yue a 'good night' message, turned off the light, and quickly fell asleep to rest for the next day's fishing competition.
location: Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-race warm-up and morning run.
description: After waking up on time thanks to his biological clock, he jogged 2 kilometers on the community path as a warm-up. The community was very quiet, with a few elderly morning exercisers doing tai chi. He adjusted his breathing and felt the coolness of the early morning and his body gradually waking up.
location: Circular walking path inside Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Guangfulin Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Competition preparation and simple meals
description: After the morning run, I went home for a quick shower and had a carton of plain milk and two pork buns for breakfast, while checking my backpack to make sure the sunscreen jacket, two bottles of Nongfu Spring, lunchbox (shredded pork with pickled cabbage fried rice), and power bank were all ready.
location: Rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Guangfulin Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the fishing spot in the early morning
description: He drove from Xingang Community, passing along Shenzhuan Highway, to Maogang Leisure Fishing Center. The drive took about 40 minutes, and there was little traffic on Saturday. On the way, he called his fishing buddy Brother Wu via Bluetooth to confirm he had arrived and saved a spot.
location: Driving route: No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Maogang Leisure Fishing Center, East side of Zhongshe Road, Maogang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Check-in and pre-race preparation
description: After arriving at the fishing ground, met up with Wu Ge, signed in together and collected the competition number plate, and learned that there were more than 50 participants. After finding the fishing spot, started preparing gear, checking the line rig, adjusting the float, and mixing bait, getting ready for the competition starting at 8 o'clock.
location: Maogang Leisure Fishing Center, east side of Zhongshe Road, Maogang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning hand-rod fishing competition.
description: The competition officially began, focusing on bottom fishing with a hand rod. The fish were wary and bites were light; only a few small crucian carp and white stripe fish were caught. Brother Wu also did not get many. The two occasionally exchanged observations about float movements, guessed it was due to air pressure, and patiently adjusted bait and casting frequency.
location: Hand-rod competition area, Maogang Leisure Fishing Center, east side of Zhongshe Road, Maogang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break
description: After the morning competition, we ate the boxed lunch of fried rice with pickled cabbage and shredded pork in the shade. Brother Wu shared his cold noodles and braised beef. During the conversation, Brother Wu suggested going to the deep-water area in the afternoon to observe raft fishing and learn.
location: Under the shade of the rest area of Maogang Leisure Fishing Center, east side of Zhongshe Road, Maogang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon raft fishing learning and practice
description: Moving to the deep-water raft fishing area, Brother Wu introduced the experienced angler Lao Xu. Lao Xu enthusiastically explained raft fishing techniques: finding the bottom, twitching the bait, and judging fish bites. Yin Hao took out his rock fishing rod, switched to a raft fishing rig, and tried it. He soon caught a yellow catfish with excellent feel, and became very interested in the new fishing method.
location: Deep-water raft fishing area of Maogang Leisure Fishing Center, east side of Zhongshe Road, Maogang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Packing up after the competition and heading back
description: The competition ended at 3 p.m. Although he didn't win a prize, he learned a new fishing technique. He packed up his gear, said goodbye to Brother Wu and Old Xu, and they added each other on WeChat, agreeing to go raft fishing next time. Then he drove back along the same route to Xingang Community in the Songjiang urban area.
location: Driving route: from Maogang Leisure Fishing Center, east side of Zhongshe Road, Maogang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Guangfulin Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Processing the fish catch and personal cleaning
description: After arriving home, he processed the catch in the kitchen sink. He kept a few yellow catfish and palm-sized crucian carp for soup, and released the small yellow catfish and topmouth gudgeon into the community's landscaped river. Then he took a hot shower and changed into clean loungewear.
location: Rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Guangfulin Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cleaning fishing gear and contacting friends
description: Wipe clean the rock fishing rod and hand rod with a damp cloth and leave them to dry on the balcony, and refrigerate the fish. Contact friend Chen Jie via WeChat to confirm the time and place for the evening crayfish dinner.
location: Rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Guangfulin Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going out for late-night snacks: crayfish and good conversation
description: Walked to Zhu's Xuyi Crayfish Restaurant on the commercial street near the neighborhood and met Chen Jie. The two ordered garlic-flavored and thirteen-spice crayfish with draft beer, eating and chatting. Yin Hao shared funny fishing stories, Chen Jie talked about running club activities, and they also discussed housing prices and future plans. The atmosphere was relaxed and slightly tipsy.
location: Zhu Ji Xuyi Lobster (Songjiang Branch), 1222 Xinsongjiang Road, Guangfulin Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Walk home
description: After saying goodbye to Chen Jie, walked home along Xinsongjiang Road. The night breeze was cool, and he felt relaxed with a slight buzz. On the way, he bought a bottle of electrolyte water at a 24-hour convenience store.
location: From Xinsongjiang Road, Guangfulin Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road.

name: Video call with Lin Yue
description: After washing his face, he called his girlfriend Lin Yue on video on time, showed her the fishing photos, and told interesting stories about learning raft fishing. Lin Yue laughed and said he was like a child. The two talked about weekend plans. Lin Yue mentioned sorting out the moving checklist, and they agreed to meet at the end of the month to discuss in detail, finally saying goodnight to each other.
location: Rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Guangfulin Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Record today's reflections
description: Sat down at the desk, opened the fishing memo, and recorded today's competition experience in detail, focusing on the raft fishing lift-and-jig technique, bait condition, and the changes in water conditions in the deep-water area of Maogang Fish Farm.
location: Study room in the rental apartment, Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Guangfulin Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep preparation and relaxation
description: After washing up, watched Bilibili raft fishing tutorial videos on my phone to reinforce what I had learned. Set the alarm for 7:30 the next morning, planning to sleep in.
location: Rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Guangfulin Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Lights off, soon fell asleep, looking forward to the new day.
location: On the bed in the rented room at Xingang Community, No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Guangfulin Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting up, morning wash-up, and simple breakfast
description: At 7:30 in the morning, his biological clock woke him up on time and he felt energetic. After a simple wash, he made a cup of oatmeal, paired it with two slices of whole wheat bread, and stood on the balcony eating while observing the weather. He judged that today would be sunny turning cloudy, suitable for outdoor activities.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Comprehensive cleaning and deep cleaning
description: Changed into an old T-shirt and started a thorough cleaning. First, swept the entire floor, then carefully mopped it twice with a wet mop, then wiped down the desk, windowsill, and computer monitor, and cleaned the air conditioner cover and electric fan cover with a damp cloth. Next, sorted the clothes by season: folded the summer clothes and put them in the wardrobe, hung up the autumn clothes; tidied odds and ends such as screwdrivers, wrenches, and earphone cords, and put them all into the toolbox. When going out to take out the trash, he ran into the neighbor Aunt Chen in the hallway. She said with a smile, "Xiao Yin, you're really hardworking today!" After some small talk, he continued the deep cleaning, wiping all the baseboards and the tops of door frames with a rag, using an old toothbrush to clean the dust in the keyboard gaps, and finally removed the electric fan's protective grille and blades, rinsed them clean, dried them, and reinstalled them. He also counted the professional books and novels on the desk—23 in total—and planned the dimensions for buying a bookshelf in the afternoon.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Simple lunch and midday rest
description: After finishing the deep cleaning, I felt hungry and used the leftover greens and two eggs from the fridge to cook a bowl of vegetable and egg noodles, flavored with Lao Gan Ma. After eating, I lay on the sofa for half an hour and scrolled through Bilibili videos explaining CNC machine tool macro programs.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-departure preparation and driving to IKEA.
description: After resting, changed into a clean white T-shirt and dark sweatpants, topped up the windshield washer fluid in the white Volkswagen Lavida and checked the tire pressure. At 11:50, drove from Xingang Community via the G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway and then the S4 Shanghai-Jinshan Expressway to the IKEA Xuhui store. location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

description: Arrived at IKEA Xuhui store shortly before 1 p.m., headed straight to the home storage section, found the KALLAX shelving unit on sale and confirmed the size was suitable, then picked up three white SAMLA storage boxes. Passing the plant section, he chose a mint-green potted parlour palm. At checkout, he used WeChat Pay, spending 216.9 yuan in total, and also bought a new hot dog at the IKEA Swedish Restaurant as an afternoon snack. During the visit, he briefly consulted a sales assistant.
location: 126 Caoxi Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai

name: Drove back home
description: After putting the purchased items into the trunk, I drove back to Songjiang. On the way back, I sent my girlfriend Lin Yue a voice message about buying the bookshelf, and she quickly replied with an expectant emoji. The return traffic was just as smooth, taking about 55 minutes.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Assemble bookshelf and renew storage organization.
description: After getting home, he could not wait to open the package. Sitting on the floor, he followed the instructions and assembled the bookshelf using the included hex wrench and screwdriver, patiently installing each shelf board and side panel and adding non-slip foot pads. Once the bookshelf was stable, he moved it next to his desk and neatly arranged the 23 books he had sorted earlier: professional reference books on the middle shelf, and novels and magazines on the bottom shelf. He put masks, charging cables, medicines, and other odds and ends into three storage boxes and placed them at the bottom of the wardrobe. When everything was done, the room was neat and organized.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Taking photos, sharing, and leisure time.
description: He used his phone to take photos of the refreshed room from three angles: a panorama of the desk and bookshelf, the clean floor, and a close-up of the desktop with the new potted plant. He sent the photos to his girlfriend Lin Yue with the message: 'My little nest is transformed! Report on my labor results.' Lin Yue soon called via video, and they chatted for over ten minutes. She praised the room for looking much tidier, and they agreed that she would come next weekend for a surprise cleanliness check. After hanging up, he sat at his desk and enjoyed half an hour of quiet, eating the hot dog he had bought that afternoon as a snack.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Went out for a walk and bought ingredients for tomorrow morning.
description: Feeling a bit stuffy indoors, he changed into running shoes and strolled slowly along Xingang Road. The evening breeze was gentle. When he reached Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, he went in and bought ingredients for tomorrow's sandwiches: a loaf of toast bread, two slices of cheese, and a box of lettuce.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dine out.
description: Feeling hungry after leaving the supermarket, he decided not to cook and walked to the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road that he often went to near the neighborhood, ordering a shredded pork in garlic sauce rice bowl and a hot and sour soup. While waiting for the food, he browsed a tech forum, saw a technical post about five-axis post-processing, and bookmarked it.
location: Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, No. 232 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Walking to digest and returning home
description: After eating, he continued strolling slowly along Xingang Road for about 20 minutes to aid digestion. The evening breeze was comfortable, and recalling that today had been quite productive, he was in a good mood. Then he walked back home.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Handled work emails and work plans
description: After returning home, he washed his face, sat at the desk, opened his laptop, and logged into his company email to check the "Draft for Comments on the New Machine Tool Training Manual (Second Edition)" sent by the technical department. After carefully reading colleagues' feedback, he drew on his frontline operating experience and wrote detailed revision suggestions of more than 500 words in four sections (safety, programming logic, maintenance, and common problems) in an email. At the end of the email, he asked Engineer Liu, the technical lead, for a 5-minute brief oral report at tomorrow's morning meeting, and suggested sending the new macro program application cases from the training manual to everyone in advance for preview. After the email was sent successfully, he found that Engineer Liu had already replied "Received."
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Leisure, entertainment, and washing up
description: After finishing work, he fully relaxed, used WeChat to send a message to his running buddy Chen Jie, telling him that he didn't go running today but did a lot of physical work. Chen Jie replied with a smiley face and arranged a long-distance run next Saturday morning. The two chatted for a while about running plans. Feeling sleepy, he went to the bathroom, carefully brushed his teeth with an electric toothbrush, and took a comfortable hot shower.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After coming out of the bathroom, I dried my hair, hung the blue coveralls I would wear tomorrow behind the door, and put my car keys and work badge on the entryway tray. I checked my phone and confirmed that Engineer Liu had received and replied to the morning meeting report email. I turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside lamp on, lay in bed, put on earphones, and listened to light music to relax. After going over tomorrow's work plan in my mind, I looked at the refreshed room with a sense of accomplishment, turned off the bedside lamp, and quickly fell asleep.
location: No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The alarm went off at 06:20 sharp. Yin Hao turned it off and rolled over briefly. Thinking that he had only gone to bed at 23:30 last night, he still felt a little sleepy, but he quickly got up. First he stepped on the scale and saw the number showed 73.0 kg. This data strengthened his determination to adjust his diet starting today. After a quick wash, he changed into his company work clothes. Using the extra few minutes, he put the toast and cheese slices prepared the night before into the microwave to heat, ate a simple meal standing in the kitchen, while browsing a few industry news articles on his phone.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute and attend the morning meeting.
description: Yin Hao checked his backpack to make sure it contained the draft with suggested revisions to the training manual. He put on his earphones, got on his bicycle, and rode to the factory. On the way, he rehearsed the key points for the morning meeting in his head, organizing the logical structure. After arriving at the factory, he first went to the locker room to change into safety shoes and a hard hat, then entered the workshop and checked the drawings and blanks for the parts to be machined that day. Only after confirming everything was correct did he enter the meeting room with the draft. At the morning meeting, he stood up and presented his suggested revisions to the “New Machine Tool Training Manual,” highlighting several expressions that could easily be misunderstood in practice and proposing clearer alternatives, which won approval from the supervisor and colleagues. His mentor, Master Sun Jianguo, also nodded in approval.
location: From Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to No. 360, Huatianjing Highway (cycling commute).

name: Morning work: machining and proposal preparation
description: After the morning meeting, he returned to his workstation. The main task was to machine a batch of 304 stainless steel flanges with high precision requirements. Yin Hao operated the machine with full concentration, clamping workpieces, setting tools, and monitoring the screen, meticulous in every detail. During the gaps while waiting for automatic tool changes and machining, he took out his sticky note pad to sketch a simple diagram of the community fitness equipment, and wrote down approximate dimensions and estimated cost (about 3,500 yuan) from memory. He also used the memo on his phone to list the healthy ingredients he needed to buy after work today: chicken breast, broccoli, and multigrain rice.
location: Production workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and discussing the meal-prep plan with colleagues.
description: After the morning's work came to an end, Yin Hao confirmed the final flange was the right size, shut down the machine, quickly washed his hands, changed out of his work clothes, and walked with Master Sun and Shift Leader Wang to the Sun Island Ancient Village Farmhouse Restaurant near the factory. Yin Hao ordered a braised pork ribs set meal and, while eating, talked about his troubles with weight gain and lack of energy, and announced his plan to start bringing a healthy homemade lunch from tomorrow. Shift Leader Wang teased him for "finally catching on," and Master Sun expressed support, saying that the canteen food is too greasy and that bringing his own food is healthier. This lunch strengthened Yin Hao's determination to adjust his diet.
location: Sun Island Ancient Village Farm Stay, No. 200 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and bank materials inquiry
description: After lunch, he walked back to the factory. Yin Hao did not join his colleagues' small talk. Instead, he went to the break room alone and used his phone to contact the bank account manager to confirm the specific format requirements for the supplemental home loan materials. When he learned that an electronic scanned copy would be sufficient, he felt a bit more relieved and immediately updated his to-do list in his phone memo: be sure to prepare the down payment source statement and the new income certificate in the evening.
location: Break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon work: programming breakthrough and routine tasks
description: The afternoon work went smoothly. After finishing several routine flange machining jobs, Yin Hao remembered the macro program debugging problem he had encountered last Friday. He reloaded the program on an idle machine tool and, following the hints Liu Jianjun had replied with yesterday, corrected the erroneous toe variable #521. The program then passed the simulation run successfully. This small breakthrough cheered him up, making him feel one step closer to his goal of becoming a "technical expert".
location: Production workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Purchase healthy ingredients
description: After work, Yin Hao cycled directly to Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket. Pushing a shopping cart, he precisely selected the target items: two fresh chicken breasts, a head of broccoli, a bag of mixed multigrain rice, plus a carton of eggs and a bag of lettuce, planning to make a salad in the evening. At the checkout, looking at the healthy and simple ingredients in the cart, he seemed to see a future version of himself becoming slimmer and more energetic.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home to prepare for and attend the owners' committee meeting
description: After cycling home from the supermarket, Yin Hao first put the groceries in the fridge, then took out from the study the fitness equipment proposal and schematic diagrams printed over the weekend, along with the copy of the house purchase contract needed by the bank. He carefully placed the proposal and diagrams into a folder, checked everything, and went to the community owners' committee office for the monthly meeting. At the meeting, Yin Hao stood up and concisely explained the proposal to install simple horizontal bars, parallel bars, and air walkers on the idle open space on the east side of the community. He showed the hand-drawn diagrams and stressed that the equipment would take up little space and have low maintenance costs, benefiting the elderly and children. His remarks were well-reasoned; after a brief discussion, the proposal gained majority support. Director Zhang arranged for Manager Zhao from property management to follow up on implementation and promised to report progress at the next monthly meeting. Walking out of the meeting room, Yin Hao felt a sense of accomplishment from contributing to the community.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (residence and owners' committee office)

name: Video call with family and celebrating mother's birthday
description: After the meeting ended, Yin Hao hurried home, turned on the living room light, and dialed his mother via WeChat video on his phone. When the call connected, his parents on the other end of the screen were all smiles. Yin Hao offered birthday wishes, and his mother happily said the neck massager he had sent last week worked very well. During the chat, his mother casually mentioned that she had been feeling dizzy occasionally recently. Yin Hao immediately became alert, thinking of the risk of high blood pressure, and in a serious tone repeatedly urged his father to take his mother to the community hospital for a check-up as soon as possible. Then his father told him some news: the old house in their hometown Rudong had been sold smoothly, the down payment had arrived, and the transfer of ownership was being processed. The news left Yin Hao with mixed feelings—relieved that his parents' later years would soon improve, yet also a little wistful that the old house carrying his childhood memories had officially changed hands.
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Sharing feelings with my girlfriend
description: After hanging up the video call, Yin Hao sat on the sofa in a daze for a while, then picked up his phone and sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend Lin Yue, thanking her for helping him choose the massage device and frankly mentioning that the old house had been sold, leaving him feeling a little empty. Lin Yue replied quickly and gently comforted him: “Your childhood is still there—it has just taken a different form to keep you company. We'll have a home of our own someday.” These words were like a warm current, calming the waves in Yin Hao's heart.
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Handling bank materials and meal planning
description: After calming down, Yin Hao took out documents such as income proof from the document folder and began filling out the down payment source explanation on his laptop, choosing his words carefully to ensure every funding source was traceable. After completing it, he packaged it with scanned copies and sent them to the bank manager's email. With the important matter handled, he felt mentally drained, but still opened his phone to search for high-protein low-fat bento recipes, set boiled broccoli, pan-seared chicken breast, and multigrain rice as his lunch plan for tomorrow and the day after, and set an alarm for 23:00.
location: Room 402, No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (living room / desk area)

name: Washing up and bedtime review
description: Yin Hao took a hot shower, changed into pajamas, and lay in bed. Habitually, he quickly reviewed the day in his mind: the proposal passed, family troubles, bank materials done, health plan started. After sorting it out, he turned off the light and told himself to face work and life in a better state tomorrow.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Transition to bed
description: To make up for having gone to bed late the previous night, Yin Hao turned off his phone and put it on the nightstand, closed his eyes, regulated his breathing, cleared his mind, and gradually eased into a state of readiness for sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 402, No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning activities: morning run, washing up, and breakfast.
date: Independent commissioning of new equipment to resolve machining deviations
description: The alarm went off at 6:15. Although Yin Hao's body felt heavy, he still got up on time. After a quick weigh-in, he recorded 73 kg, then did a recovery jog on the internal roads of the community, covering 2 km at a pace of 6:30/km. After working up a slight sweat, his fatigue eased a bit. After the run, he went home, took a hot shower, and changed into his work uniform. For breakfast, he had hot milk with the sliced bread bought yesterday. While eating, he checked his phone memo to confirm the day's to-do items.
location: Xingang Residential Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (internal roads and home)

name: Delivering the fitness equipment installation application plan in person
description: Around 7:40, Yin Hao took the revised "Xingang Community Fitness Equipment Installation Application Plan" to the property management office at the community entrance and personally submitted it to Property Manager Zhao. The plan included the equipment models, construction drawings of the installation location, and a detailed budget. The two discussed the installation location (green space on the east side of the community), construction schedule (weekdays during daytime), and cost-sharing ratio (70% owners' committee, 30% property management) for about 15 minutes. Manager Zhao said the content was detailed and promised to arrange a site survey and provide a formal quote before next week. After urging Zhao to keep him informed of progress, Yin Hao left.
location: Xingang Community Property Management Office, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute and focus on machining 304 stainless steel flanges
description: After leaving the property management office, Yin Hao rode a shared bike to Songjiang University Town Station on Line 9, took the metro to Sheshan Station, then rode to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. He arrived at the factory before 8:55, changed into his work clothes, went to his workstation in Workshop No. 3, and began precision machining 304 stainless steel flanges. These workpieces had extremely high tolerance requirements. He carefully checked the drawings, adjusted the machine parameters, and monitored the cutting process, conducting CMM spot checks in batches to ensure quality.
