name: Lunch and CNC programming training for new employees
description: At noon, Yin Hao ate his own healthy bento in the workshop rest area (chicken breast stir-fried with broccoli served with mixed-grain rice). After the meal, he used the last half hour to give CNC programming training to the newcomers Liu Yang and Li Hao, breaking down variable and loop logic using a typical case from his own macro program debugging, and guided them to operate on an iPad simulator. The two newcomers listened attentively and asked questions actively.
location: No. 3 Workshop Rest Area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon: flange machining and preparing talking points for the video call.
description: After the afternoon shift began, Yin Hao continued machining the flange, completing all planned work hours by 16:45 and cleaning the machine. In the last 15 minutes before leaving work, he wrote down in his phone memo the key points for the evening video call with his parents: thanking his parents for supporting the 150,000 yuan down payment, suggesting that the remaining payment from the house sale must be made by bank transfer, and asking about his mother's dizziness and physical examination.
location: Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute after work, buy healthy ingredients, and return home
description: After clocking out at 17:15, Yin Hao rode a shared bike to the Walmart on Guangfulin Road. In the fresh food section, he selected individually frozen chicken breast, broccoli, multigrain rice, apples, and bananas according to the shopping list, checked the production dates, and quickly checked out at a self-checkout machine. After shopping, he cycled back to Xingang Community and arrived home before 18:45; the whole trip took about 8 minutes.
location: Walmart, No. 1, Lane 1788, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Household tidying and exam review.
description: After arriving home, Yin Hao portioned the meat and put it in the freezer, sorted the vegetables and fruits into the refrigerator, and then sat down at his desk to review for the technician certificate practical exam. He focused on reviewing Chapter 5 of 'CNC Machining Technology' on controlling machining deformation of thin-walled parts, and re-derived the parameter setting formulas on A4 paper.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video-called parents to emphasize the security of the final payment from the house sale.
description: During a break in his review, Yin Hao made a WeChat video call to his father. His parents, at their hometown in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu, told him that part of the proceeds from the house sale had arrived and they decided to transfer 150,000 yuan first to support his down payment for a house in Shanghai. Moved, Yin Hao seriously urged his parents: the remaining balance must go through bank transfer, and they must not accept cash. He also asked with concern about his mother’s dizziness and felt a little relieved after learning that she had already made a hospital appointment for the day after tomorrow.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Record down-payment plan and browse home listings
description: After the call, Yin Hao wrote in detail in his memo about his father's promised 150,000 yuan down payment support and noted, "The balance must be paid via bank transfer." Then he opened the Lianjia app, set the location to Songjiang New City, filtered for two-bedroom second-hand apartments near Metro Line 9 with total prices under 3 million yuan, saved 3 potential listings, and planned to visit them in person on the weekend.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Continue reviewing for the technician certificate exam
description: After putting away his phone, Yin Hao returned to review. He opened the practical simulation problems (special-shaped valve body machining) on his computer, reprogrammed them in the offline tool path simulation software, and simulated the tool movements, focusing on verifying the correctness of helical hole milling and threading commands until all simulations passed.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Relaxing and using a diet tracking app to plan tomorrow's lunchbox
description: After the intense study session, Yin Hao felt tired, so he stood up and stretched his limbs. He then registered for and set up a diet tracking app, entered the information about the ingredients he had bought tonight, and planned tomorrow's healthy bento: teriyaki chicken breast with mixed grain rice and blanched broccoli. After that, he went to the bathroom to wash up and towel off.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing for bed and falling asleep
description: After washing up, Yin Hao sent his parents a goodnight emoji and replied to his girlfriend Lin Yue's goodnight confirmation message. He checked the next day's commuter bag (lunchbox, work badge, review notes), set the alarm for 6:10, turned off the light, and went to bed. Reviewing that all the day's plans had been completed, he fell asleep around 22:55.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wake-up and weigh-in
description: The alarm went off, and Yin Hao opened his eyes. The sky outside was cloudy, just as the forecast had said. Sitting on the edge of the bed, he habitually weighed himself on the electronic scale: 72.9kg, down 0.1kg from yesterday, which made him feel a little reassured. He took a deep breath; today would begin with a homemade healthy breakfast and a packed lunch.
location: Home bedroom, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing healthy bento boxes and breakfast.
description: Walking into the kitchen, Yin Hao took out the chicken breast, broccoli, and multigrain rice he had bought at Walmart the night before. He quickly cut the chicken breast, marinated it with a little salt and black pepper, and pan-fried it in a non-stick pan without oil. He blanched the broccoli; the multigrain rice had been cooked on a timer the night before. He packed them into separate compartments of an insulated lunch box to make a healthy bento. Then he simply boiled two eggs and had them with a glass of warm milk as breakfast.
location: Home kitchen, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Community)

name: Morning run of 5 kilometers at Xiaokunshan Health Park
description: After breakfast, Yin Hao changed into running shoes and sportswear, went out, and jogged to Xiaokunshan Health Park, completing the planned 5-kilometer run along the park trail. His pace stayed steady at around 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer, and his breathing was even. The morning breeze blew against his sweaty cheeks, and he thought that, with the half-marathon goal in mind, both his diet and training had started to get on track. After the run, he did 10 minutes of static stretching in the park's stretching area to relieve muscle fatigue.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Xiaokunshan Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home, take a shower, change clothes, and prepare for the commute.
description: After finishing the run, he went home. Yin Hao took a quick shower and changed into a clean dark-blue work uniform. He checked his work badge, keys, and phone, and carefully put the prepared insulated lunch box into his canvas commuter bag. Before leaving, he glanced out the window, confirmed it wouldn't rain, and didn't take an umbrella.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute: cycling + subway + walking
description: Yin Hao went downstairs, scanned a shared bike, rode for 8 minutes to Songjiang New Town Metro Station, transferred to Metro Line 9 to Songjiang Industrial Zone Station, and then walked about 10 minutes after exiting the station, arriving on time at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory at 8:50.
location: Xingang Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Songjiang New Town Metro Station (cycling); Metro Line 9 to Songjiang Industrial Zone Station; Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway

name: Morning work: focus on machining tasks
description: After arriving at the post, Yin Hao first went to the changing room to put on safety shoes, earplugs, and goggles. Today's task was to batch machine a batch of 304 stainless steel flanges. Based on the drawings, he retrieved the program left by the previous shift, carefully checked the tool compensation data, and then started the machine. Amid the roar of the machine, he focused on observing the flow of cutting fluid on the workpiece and listening for any abnormal sound in the spindle rotation.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, Workshop 2, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch: Enjoy a healthy bento box.
description: The lunch break bell rang. Instead of going to the cafeteria to get food as usual, Yin Hao took out his own insulated lunch box. When he opened the lid, the savory aroma of chicken breast and the fresh scent of broccoli mixed with the smell of multigrain rice whetted his appetite. He sat in a corner by the window, eating his healthy lunch while scrolling on his phone for a while. His girlfriend Lin Yue sent a message asking how the bento tasted. He took a photo, sent it to her, and captioned it: "Healthy first meal, feels good."
location: Employee cafeteria, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break: answering questions for new employees.
description: After finishing lunch and washing his lunchbox, Yin Hao remembered that during yesterday's new employee training, Liu Yang and Li Hao had looked confused about G-code optimization. He took the initiative to call them via WeChat to the factory rest area and took out his training notes. Using a pen to draw a path diagram on paper, he explained in detail, using examples from the previous day, the simplification methods for fixed cycle instructions and variable substitution techniques. The two suddenly understood and thanked him repeatedly.
location: Rest area of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work: handling the parts on hand.
description: After the lunch break, he returned to the machine. The flanges processed that morning were mostly done; he finished the remaining pieces and completed self-inspection. He took out an inside micrometer and measured the key bore dimensions one by one to ensure tolerances were kept within plus or minus 0.02 mm. Around 4:30 he completed all planned tasks, neatly stacked the parts on the material cart, and cleaned up the metal shavings around the machine.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, Workshop 2, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing to leave work
description: After clocking out, Yin Hao changed out of his work clothes in the locker room, put on loose sports shorts and a T-shirt, and changed into running shoes. He locked his work clothes and commuter bag in the locker, ready to go running.
location: Changing room of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening jog, 3 kilometers.
description: Walking out of the factory gate, Yin Hao started jogging along the greenway on Huatianjing Road on the south side of the company. Today's plan was to run 3 km, with the pace controlled at around 6:10 per kilometer. Being out of practice, his thigh muscles felt sore and aching, but he kept adjusting his breathing and cadence. Along the way, the river sparkled in the sunset, and the fatigue of work was gradually washed away. After completing the 3 km, he did nearly 10 minutes of stretching beside a bench by the river.
location: Riverside greenway along Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (near Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory)

name: Left work and went home.
description: After stretching, Yin Hao walked to Songjiang Industrial Zone Metro Station and took the subway back. After getting out of the station, he bought two apples at a roadside fruit shop, planning to eat them as a late-night snack.
location: Shanghai, Songjiang District, Huatianjing Road riverside greenway, Songjiang Industrial Zone Metro Station, Xingang Residential Quarter

name: Go home for a shower and a simple dinner
description: Back home, Yin Hao took off his sweat-soaked clothes and took a comfortable hot shower. Then he made a simple dinner: a bowl of yangchun noodles with a fried egg and a few leafy greens, eaten with the leftover half chicken breast from lunch.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare tomorrow's bento lunch.
description: After washing the dishes, Yin Hao took out a new piece of chicken breast from the fridge to defrost, washed the lettuce and cherry tomatoes needed for tomorrow, and put them in a draining basket for later. It was preparation for tomorrow's lunchbox, a new rule he had set for himself.
location: Home kitchen, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Community)

name: Evening practical preparation for the technician exam
description: After washing up, Yin Hao sat at his desk and opened the textbook "CNC Machine Tool Fault Diagnosis and Maintenance" and his notebook. Tonight's focus was the fault diagnosis process for "spindle overheating and abnormal noise." He picked up a pen, drew the electrical diagram and mechanical transmission diagram on draft paper, and reasoned step by step through possible causes: insufficient lubrication, bearing wear, or incorrect inverter parameter settings. He imagined different fault symptoms and wrote down corresponding inspection steps and troubleshooting plans. After studying continuously for 1 hour and 45 minutes, he got up and made a cup of tea, rested for 5 minutes, and did neck and wrist exercises.
location: Home study at Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Chat with girlfriend Lin Yue on WeChat.
description: After finishing a study session, Yin Hao went to the balcony and called his girlfriend Lin Yue on WeChat video. She looked a little tired on the screen, but smiled when she saw him. He shared the funny story of bringing a bento box today, saying his colleagues were quite curious. Lin Yue asked about his exam preparation, and he said lightly, "Still working on the hard part." They chatted for about 20 minutes. She told him not to get too tired. A warmth rose in his heart, and they made plans to talk again on the weekend.
location: Balcony of the home in Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Bedtime preparation and check reminders
description: After saying goodbye to his girlfriend, Yin Hao returned to his desk and set out the tools, notes, and phone charging cable he would need for the next day. Then he opened his phone memo and confirmed that the reminder for his mother Wang Xiuying's physical exam appointment the next day (September 18) was correct before locking the screen with peace of mind.
location: Home bedroom, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going to bed
description: He turned off the main bedroom light and left only a small night light on. Lying in bed, he quickly ran through tomorrow's plan in his mind: Friday afternoon there was an important part to deliver, and on the weekend he would go fishing with colleagues at Dianshan Lake... Closing his eyes, he gradually fell asleep with a sense of fulfillment and a hint of anticipation for tomorrow.
location: Home bedroom, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting up, washing up, and making a packed lunch
description: The alarm went off at six in the morning. Yin Hao got up and washed up. Since he had prepared green peppers, chicken breast, and leftover rice the night before, he quickly fried a portion of egg fried rice and packed it into a lunch box. Because he had stayed up late last night, his lower back was a bit sore and stiff, so he did some simple stretches.
location: Room 203, Building 1, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Went out to buy breakfast.
description: Yin Hao took his lunch box and car keys and went out. A fine drizzle was falling outside, and the air carried the chill of autumn. He walked briskly to the breakfast stall at the entrance of the community, bought two meat buns and a cup of hot soy milk, and ate one bun on his way back to stave off hunger.
location: Breakfast stall at the entrance of Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Drive to work
description: After getting into the car, Yin Hao put the bento box and another steamed bun on the passenger seat. He turned on the wipers and drove to the factory. Traffic was normal on the way. Listening to the car radio, he felt fairly calm.
location: Section of Xingang Road to Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: Report to work, change into work clothes, and check the production schedule.
description: Yin Hao arrived at the factory, clocked in, and changed into his work clothes. He first went to the workshop bulletin board to check today's production schedule, confirmed that the batch to be machined was flange parts, and also checked the measuring tools in the toolbox, such as vernier calipers and dial bore gauges.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: In the morning, focus on machine tool operation and inspection.
description: Yin Hao immersed himself in the day's machining tasks. He entered parameters according to the program sheet, clamped the workpiece, and pressed the start button. The machine ran at high speed, with chips flying. He wore safety goggles throughout and strictly followed safety regulations. During this time, programmer Liu Zhiqiang came over and discussed the program optimization points for machining a new part in the afternoon, suggesting modifying the tool path to improve efficiency.
location: Workshop CNC machine tool Area No. 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Before the lunch break: heat up the lunchbox and organize the training materials.
description: After the morning work came to a pause, Yin Hao took his lunch box to the break room and heated it in the microwave. At the same time, he quickly browsed the PPT outline for the noon training session for new employees on his phone, focusing on the two sections 'Macro Program Application Tips' and 'Troubleshooting Approaches.'
location: Rest room in the workshop at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and the newcomer's last lesson.
description: While eating reheated egg fried rice, Yin Hao gave the last intensive training session to four newly hired employees. He summarized the core points of advanced programming, emphasized details that are easy to get wrong in real operations, then assigned a self-study task to search for cases online and opened the floor for questions. The atmosphere was good; two new employees proactively asked questions about CNC system alarms.
location: Workshop conference room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Plant, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Short nap during lunch break
description: After the training ended, there were a little over ten minutes before the afternoon shift. Yin Hao leaned back in a chair in the break room and rested with his eyes closed. The soreness in his lower back became more obvious in the quiet, and he thought he must apply a hot compress in the evening as his mentor had instructed.
location: Rest room in the workshop at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Normal afternoon work and preparation for getting off work
description: The afternoon work went on as usual. Around 3 p.m., team leader Wang Lei came by to assign the urgent tasks for the next day. Just after 4 p.m., mentor Sun Jianguo passed by, briefly asked about the day's situation, and reminded him again to call at 8 p.m. sharp to discuss exam preparation. Yin Hao started tidying his workstation at 17:20, cleaning the iron chips from the machine tool, putting tools back in place, and writing a brief work summary and machine status in the shift handover log.
location: Workshop CNC machine tool Area No. 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Drove home after work in the light rain.
description: He left work on time at 17:30, and the drizzle outside continued. Yin Hao walked to the parking space holding a spare umbrella, started the car, turned on the music, and listened to a few old songs by Jay Chou, which made him feel much more relaxed. Then he drove home.
location: Section from Huatingjing Highway to Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Return home for dinner and a brief rest
description: After Yin Hao got home, he took off his slightly damp coat, cooked a pot of hot noodle soup, poached an egg, added some greens, and had a simple meal with the pickled mustard he had bought a few days earlier. After eating, he leaned back on the sofa and scrolled on his phone for a few minutes. Seeing the photos Brother Wu had posted in the fishing buddies group about scouting fishing spots at Dianshan Lake on the weekend, he couldn't help feeling a little envious.
location: Room 203, Building 1, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Applied a hot compress to my lower back to relax it.
description: Remembering his mentor's advice, Yin Hao found a hot water bottle, filled it with hot water, and applied it to the sore, swollen area of his lower back. The warmth gradually relaxed his tense muscles, and he felt much more comfortable.
location: Room 203, Building 1, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Preparing exam materials and marking difficult points
description: While applying a hot compress, I took out the practical-exam key point notes for the senior technician certificate, turned to the PLC control module chapter, and circled with a red pen several confusing points about converting ladder diagrams into instruction lists, planning to ask my master for guidance in the evening.
location: Room 203, Building 1, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Chat with girlfriend Lin Yue on WeChat.
description: While waiting for the 8 o'clock call with the master, Yin Hao proactively sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend Lin Yue in Hangzhou, sharing his relief at having completed the training course smoothly that day and asking whether it was raining on her side too. The two chatted for about twenty minutes, topics ranging from daily trivia to weekend plans. The atmosphere was warm and the conversation flowed smoothly.
location: Room 203, Building 1, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Had a phone call with Master Sun Jianguo to ask for guidance.
description: At exactly 8 o'clock, Master Sun Jianguo called on time. He first reminded Yin Hao to take care of himself and not get too tired. Yin Hao seized the opportunity and brought up the difficulties he had prepared about PLC ladder diagram conversion. Master Sun patiently explained on the other end of the line, using examples from his own experience to clarify the logic in a simple and accessible way. The call lasted 25 minutes, and Yin Hao felt suddenly enlightened. At the end, Master Sun again urged him to maintain a balance between work and rest.
location: Room 203, Building 1, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Continue reviewing and sorting out incorrect questions.
description: After hanging up, Yin Hao felt even more energized. He seized the moment and wrote down the ideas his master had just explained in his notes, then continued reviewing the chapter on fault diagnosis procedures and organized his recent collection of wrong answers.
location: Room 203, Building 1, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Relaxing with games and group chat with friends
description: After a review session, Yin Hao opened Honor of Kings and played two ranked matches. He was in good form, winning one and losing one. During a break in the game, he sent a message in the 'Songjiang Three Brothers' WeChat group, complaining about the rainy day and the grind of exam preparation. A Jie (Chen Jie) and Lao Gao (Gao Zhiyuan) responded actively, and A Jie invited him to go for a morning run at Xiaokunshan Health Park on the weekend if the weather cleared up.
location: Room 203, Building 1, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Shower, skincare, and getting ready for bed
description: Yin Hao put down his phone and took a hot shower in the bathroom, washing away the day's fatigue. After the shower, he applied some men's lotion. He placed the clean work uniform he would wear to work tomorrow and the car keys on the shoe cabinet by the door, and set the alarm for 06:00 tomorrow.
location: Room 203, Building 1, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: Lying in bed, his body was a bit tired, but his mind was still active. Yin Hao picked up his phone to look at the latest news about new housing developments in Songjiang, and calculated his savings and monthly mortgage payments again, feeling a faint sense of pressure creeping in. Around 11:45, he turned off his phone, closed his eyes, and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room 203, Building 1, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Sleep and rest.
description: The previous night he studied very late; after lying down, his lower back was still a bit sore, but he fell into a deep sleep and had no dreams until the morning alarm rang.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wake-up, morning preparation, and breakfast
description: The alarm went off on time, and pulling open the curtains revealed a clear sunny day. While washing up, I splashed cold water on my face and felt refreshed; the soreness in my lower back from yesterday had eased considerably. For breakfast, I steamed some soup dumplings, drank a glass of warm milk, and finished quickly. I checked my work badge, phone, and keys, then put the sports bag with running shoes, a quick-dry T-shirt, and shorts into the car, preparing to go running after work.
location: Home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive to work
description: He drove out of Xingang Community, turned from Chenta Road onto Rongle West Road, then onto Huatianjing Highway. The traffic was smooth along the way. Listening to the morning news on the radio, he arrived at the factory parking lot before 7:30 to prepare for the day's work.
location: Along the route from Xingang Road to Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-shift preparation and morning meeting.
description: Changed into work clothes, clocked in, and went to my machine station to check the equipment status. At 8:00 sharp, team leader Wang Lei held a pre-shift meeting, communicated the day's production tasks, and emphasized the urgent task: a batch of flanges for a new type of air duct connector needed to be processed first, with a tight schedule and high precision requirements.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Focus on work in the morning
description: After the morning meeting he immediately got to work, clamped the workpiece onto the machine, and started machining the flange. Meanwhile, Liu Zhiqiang came over to discuss the optimization of the inner chamfer process for the flange, which had been left from before leaving work yesterday. After discussion, they adopted a new tool path to improve surface finish. He was fully focused all morning and finished the first workpiece at 11:30. Using a vernier caliper and a roughness tester, he measured repeatedly, and all data were within tolerance, which made him satisfied.
location: CNC machine workstation C-2, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Midday work meal
description: After the lunch break bell rang, he went with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang to a small roadside restaurant called “Fast Food King” outside the factory, ordered a green pepper shredded pork rice bowl, and chatted while eating about the afternoon training arrangements and weekend plans. Wang Lei said he was going back to his hometown for the weekend and couldn't go fishing together.
location: Kuaican Wang Small Restaurant near Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Last centralized training lecture.
description: After lunch, he walked quickly back to the workshop meeting room, where the four new trainees were already seated. He opened the PPT and systematically reviewed the key points of the week on advanced programming, tool selection, and common troubleshooting. After the 35-minute presentation, he left 20 minutes for questions. Trainee Xiao Li asked a question about G-code macro programs, and he answered it in detail with an actual machining case. After class, he organized the printed training manuals into booklets and personally handed them to Workshop Supervisor Director Xu, thanking him for the opportunity to practice.
location: Workshop meeting room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work and final tidying up
description: Returned to the workstation and continued machining that batch of flanges. At around 3 o'clock, encountered a workpiece positioning deviation problem. Relying on experience, he adjusted the clamping force of the fixture, and the problem was smoothly resolved. Half an hour before getting off work, he began tidying up the workstation: cleaning the iron shavings from the machine tool, adding lubricating oil to the guide rails, putting tools back in place, and carefully filling in the Equipment Inspection Record Sheet and the Daily Production Report. The wrap-up work was orderly.
location: CNC machine workstation C-2, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: 5 km road run after work
description: After work, he quickly changed into running shoes and sportswear, then drove to Xiaokunshan Health Park. In the autumn evening, a gentle breeze was blowing and the sky was still bright. He turned on his sports watch and set a 5 km goal. He warmed up during the first kilometer at a pace of about 6 minutes per kilometer, then gradually accelerated and stabilized at a 5:50 pace. Sweat soaked his vest, and he felt the fatigue and stress of the week being released with every step. After finishing 5 km, he did a few minutes of stretching beside a park bench.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home, shop, and have a simple dinner.
description: After the run, he felt refreshed. He drove home and on the way stopped by the fresh food supermarket in Xingang New Village to buy greens and eggs. Once home, he took a quick shower, changed into clean clothes, and deftly cooked a pot of hot noodle soup with greens and eggs. The steaming bowl of noodles not only replenished his energy but also made him feel comfortable and satisfied.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, and home in Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Intensive exam preparation and relaxation
description: After dinner and putting away the dishes, I sat at the desk and began preparing for the senior technician certificate exam. Set the phone to silent mode, keeping only WeChat message notifications. Starting with the mistake notebook, I tackled PLC ladder diagrams and complex mechanical schematic diagrams one by one. Midway, fishing buddy Gao Zhiyuan messaged about weekend weather and fish conditions in Dianshan Lake. We confirmed that if the weather was good on Saturday, we'd go fishing in the afternoon, but to avoid disrupting my study rhythm, we just agreed to finalize the specific time later. Then I mixed in a review of practical operation notes and used a mind map to sort out several key program logic flows. When I felt my brain couldn't take any more, I played a round of Honor of Kings with my childhood friend Zhang Wei to relax for 15 minutes.
location: At the desk in the living room at home, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-bed relaxation, hot compress, and washing up before sleep
description: After finishing a round of review, he felt tired but fulfilled. He took out a hot water bottle, filled it with hot water, and placed it on his lower back to relieve the soreness from sitting for a long time. At the same time, he browsed the latest information on a Songjiang New City housing development he had been following on his phone, silently calculated the down payment gap, and felt more planned for the future. Then he removed the hot water bottle, went to the bathroom to wash up quickly, and looking in the mirror felt his complexion was much better than last night. He turned off the bedside lamp, got into bed, and ran through tomorrow's plan in his mind: sleep in naturally, then decide based on the weather whether to go fishing at Dianshan Lake or study with full focus. With that anticipation, he fell into a deep sleep.
location: Home bedroom, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

In the fishing buddies group, I saw a photo of a big crucian carp from Dianshan Lake posted by Gao Zhiyuan and liked it. After getting up, I opened the curtains, then prepared brunch: boiled frozen wontons, fried two sunny-side-up eggs, and made a glass of milk. After eating, I lay on the sofa on my stomach with a hot water bottle on my lower back to ease the discomfort, while silently rehearsing the script for the afternoon trial lecture and sorting out the logic from military discipline to part precision.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

I set up my phone on the coffee table, started recording, told my story to the camera, deliberately adjusting my speaking pace and pauses, and vividly described my journey from military field training to machining flanges on CNC machine tools. When I rewatched the video, I noticed that the natural fist-pump when mentioning the first qualified part looked very authentic, so I decided to keep it, and finally polished the summary about the craftsman spirit.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

Setting out from Xingang Community, he passed Xingang Road and Songhui East Road, and arrived at the public parking lot near Songhui Middle Road about 20 minutes later. After parking, he walked about 13 minutes to Ludu International Shopping Plaza, ordered a signature beef noodle bowl with a fried egg at Ma Jiyong Lanzhou Beef Noodle Restaurant, and read the electronic version of his trial lecture script while eating. After the meal, he walked back to the Federation of Trade Unions building, sat for a while on the bench downstairs with his eyes closed to rest, and confirmed the location of the venue.
location: Ma Jiyong Lanzhou Beef Noodles, F1, Ludu International Shopping Plaza, No. 568 Songhui Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai; and Yueyang Subdistrict General Trade Union, No. 258 Songhui Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Check-in waiting, trial lecture, and pass feedback.

Showed the notification text message, received the agenda and the list of judges, and sat by the window to familiarize myself with the environment. At 2 p.m., the trial lecture officially began. I was the third to take the stage according to the draw order. Using my military experience and frontline factory work as the main thread, I vividly told the growth story from being confused by precision blueprints to processing qualified parts under the guidance of Master Sun Jianguo, especially mentioning the detail of repeatedly adjusting the machine tool late into the night for a 0.01 mm tolerance. The 8-minute trial lecture had a good rhythm and sincere emotion, and won praise from the judges. After all the trial speakers finished, the head judge praised the vivid examples, then announced that Yin Hao had officially become a member of the Craftsman Spirit on Campus lecture group, and told him that the first campus lecture would be arranged soon.

In a serious tone, he insisted that they go to Rudong County People's Hospital as soon as possible for a comprehensive checkup, especially recommending a head CT and a color Doppler ultrasound of the blood vessels. His father initially made excuses that his mother had already improved, but was eventually persuaded and agreed to make an appointment over the weekend. During the call, Yin Hao also told his parents the good news that he had passed the trial lecture, so they could rest assured.
location: Parking lot of Yueyang Subdistrict Federation of Trade Unions, 258 Songhui Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

Then, in the WeChat group 'Songjiang Three Brothers,' I sent a voice message inviting Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang to dinner that evening to celebrate, and proposed playing games together after dinner at home. Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang quickly responded, and we settled on meeting at 7 p.m. at the university town food stalls.

After changing into a going-out T-shirt, he went downstairs, scanned the code to unlock the bike, and rode along the familiar route for about 20 minutes. As night fell, he arrived at Wenhui Road Food Street and stopped at his regular spot, Brothers BBQ & Lobster King food stall, to wait. Soon he met up with his two colleagues.

Yin Hao ordered three jin of thirteen-spice crayfish, a bunch of lamb skewers, ten chicken wing skewers, a peanuts and edamame platter, and three bottles of ice-cold beer. As they ate and chatted, Wang Lei complained about the new intern in the workshop, Liu Zhiqiang shared an optimized programming algorithm, and Yin Hao excitedly recounted amusing stories from his trial lecture and the judges' comments. As night deepened, the sounds of clinking glasses and laughter continued.

They turned on the air conditioner, each grabbed a soft drink from the fridge, and curled up on the sofa to play Honor of Kings together online. Wang Lei (jungle), Liu Zhiqiang (support), and Yin Hao formed an iron triangle. Their hands were in good form tonight; Wang Lei's Han Xin had excellent rhythm, and the three cooperated seamlessly. Apart from two games that were thrown away due to mistakes, their win rate was very high, and they played until nearly 11 PM.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

After returning home, he cleaned up the snack wrappers and empty bottles, then washed up, changed into pajamas, and plugged in his phone to charge. Lying in bed in the dark, he planned to contact Gao Zhiyuan the next day to make up for the previously missed fishing outing. With a sense of fulfillment and contentment, he soon fell asleep, bringing the smooth Saturday to an end.

Then he washed up, made a cup of protein powder, and ate a simple breakfast with the Toly Bread bought last night and a boiled egg.

After greeting him, Yin Hao took over the work with practiced ease and helped him disassemble a non-heating induction cooker, replacing the blown fuse and IGBT. He listened attentively as Master Chen explained how to determine the fault point based on the circuit board traces. This kind of learning made him feel grounded.

Yin Hao ordered a bowl of noodles with pickled mustard greens and shredded pork plus a fried egg, 14 yuan in total, affordable and just right. While eating, they chatted about trivial matters at the shop. Master Chen mentioned his experience repairing machine tools in a large state-owned factory when he was young, which gave Yin Hao a lot to think about.

An old customer, Mr. Wang, came in carrying a set of malfunctioning component stereo, said he was moving and didn't want it anymore, and asked Master Chen if he would take it. Master Chen put on his reading glasses, looked at it, and judged it was a problem with the amplifier board. He guided Yin Hao to open the back cover, and indeed several electrolytic capacitors were bulging. Yin Hao found capacitors of the same specifications from the store's box of used parts, replaced them, and resoldered the circuit with a soldering iron. After powering on, the stereo worked again. Mr. Wang was very happy. In the end Yin Hao bought it for 100 yuan, and Master Chen also gave him some spare audio cables and a few speaker binding posts.
location: Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, 1298 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

The sound was much better than expected, and he felt a sense of satisfaction.

He ate quickly at the window seat in the convenience store, feeling refreshed and not greasy. The round trip took about 20 minutes, and the lunch break totaled 45 minutes.

Colleagues including Liu Zhiqiang were busy at their own stations; the whole afternoon's work was intense and orderly.

The doctor had prescribed medication and required a low-salt diet and daily monitoring. Yin Hao steadied his emotions, urged his father to make sure his mother took her medication on time and switch to low-sodium salt, and said he would follow up every day. The call lasted nearly 25 minutes. After hanging up, he felt heavy and worried.

During the session, his thoughts occasionally drifted to his mother and work, but he tried to pull his attention back. When it was over, he felt much calmer inside, and his worries had eased.

As the faint chirping of insects drifted in through the window, he gradually fell asleep.

She said, “I measured it this morning: 135/88. I've started taking the medicine the doctor prescribed, and I've cut back on salt.” You felt a bit relieved, but still reminded her to buy an electronic blood pressure monitor, measure twice a day, morning and evening, write it down in a notebook, and have father supervise. name: Meditate during study breaks
description: After two hours of continuous study, his eyes were sore and his mind was scattered. Following the meditation method he learned last night, he turned off the desk lamp, sat up straight, closed his eyes, adjusted his breathing, and focused on the breath going in and out for 10 minutes. Afterward, he massaged his temples and felt his thoughts become steady and clear again.
location: Room 302, Building 11, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Continue reviewing: reinforce memory
description: Turned the desk lamp back on, went through the 10 memory cards just sorted in order, marked the places where he got stuck, and added reminder notes on the back of the cards with a red pen. Then took out the textbook and silently drew the fault tree diagram of the hardest case, "tool changer arm stuck", on scratch paper until fully memorized.
location: At the desk in Room 302, Building 11, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Relaxing before bed: teaming up with comrades to play games
description: Logged into Honor of Kings, saw my friend Zhang Fei online, so I invited him and Gao Zhiyuan from the "Songjiang Three Brothers" to form a three-person queue. I chose my best role, support, and casually played two matches in match mode. Although we lost the second game due to small mistakes, everyone laughed and blamed each other in voice chat. At 22:25 I said, "I'm off now, gotta work tomorrow," and quit the game.
location: Room 302, Building 11, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and skincare.
description: He took a quick shower, washing away the day's sweat and fatigue. After brushing his teeth, he looked in the mirror and squeezed some men's moisturizing lotion onto his face—autumn is dry, and this was left by Lin Yue when she came to visit last time.
location: Bathroom, Room 302, Building 11, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Turning off the lights, going to bed, and reviewing the day before sleep.
description: Lying in bed, he habitually did a quick review in his mind: work went smoothly, his mother's health had been taken care of, and tonight's review had been very efficient. He mentally planned to go to the library to borrow books the day after tomorrow. After adjusting his sleeping position, he murmured to himself, "Alright, today was worth it," and gradually fell asleep to the white noise of the light rain tapping against the window.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 11, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: 4 km morning run
description: The alarm went off. He quickly washed up, changed into his running shoes, and walked about five minutes to Xiaokunshan Health Park. The sky was already bright and the air was fresh. He ran 4 km at a pace of 5:55 per kilometer, breathing steadily and feeling much easier than last time. Along the way he saw many residents exercising in the morning.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Xiaokunshan Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Core training and stretching
description: After the morning run, I returned home and did core training on the yoga mat on the balcony: three sets of 1-minute planks and two sets of crunches, 30 in total. After that, I carefully stretched my legs, shoulders, and back to prevent muscle soreness. My sweat soaked my clothes, and I felt full of energy.
location: Balcony at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Take a shower, have breakfast, and greet my mother
description: He took a warm shower and changed into work clothes. For breakfast, he had whole wheat toast with a boiled egg and a glass of warm water. While eating breakfast, he opened WeChat and sent a voice message to his mother: “Mom, how are you feeling today? Remember to take your medicine on time, and don't forget to buy an electronic blood pressure monitor. Record your readings every day and I'll take a look.” Then he added: “If you're free on the weekend, I can come back for a visit too.”
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute by car
description: He grabbed his lunch bag and drove to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. On the way, he listened to the podcast "Frontiers of CNC Technology" about tool compensation algorithms for five-axis machining centers, preparing for the technician exam. The drive took about 15 minutes, and he arrived at the factory before 8 o'clock.
location: During the commute from Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to No. 360 Huatianjing Road.

name: Morning production tasks
description: After attending the morning meeting, he learned that there was a batch of urgent flange orders today. Following procedures, he checked the machine tool's coolant and lubrication systems, then began clamping the blank workpieces. During machining, he stopped three times to measure the bore diameters with vernier calipers to ensure tolerances were within 0.02 mm. Midway, team leader Wang Lei came over to discuss the afternoon production schedule adjustment, and Master Sun also took a look at the quality of the first piece of the morning and nodded with satisfaction.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Machining fault handling
description: When the machine tool made an abnormal sound during deep-hole machining, he immediately pressed the pause button and found that the inner bore tool holder's tightening screw was slightly loose. After retightening it with a hex wrench, he asked Master Sun how to identify the chatter marks caused by such looseness. Master Sun pointed out the key characteristics on the actual part, and he took out his pocket notepad and wrote them down. After troubleshooting, the machine resumed smooth operation.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and property management matters
description: After finishing his homemade multigrain rice and broccoli chicken breast bento in the break room, he walked to the property management office in the factory's living area. Manager Zhao was already waiting for him and took out the project detail list. Yin Hao carefully checked the project contents: four installation points, including shock-absorbing pads and expansion bolts, and the quote was consistent with the one from the beginning of the month. He agreed to the plan, but asked that a layer of anti-slip floor matting be added under each piece of equipment. Manager Zhao said that was possible, but the material cost would need a slight adjustment. Yin Hao agreed, and they scheduled to sign the formal agreement next Wednesday (October 1).
location: Property Management Office, Living Area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon production and process discussion
description: In the afternoon, he continued machining the flange. During this time, programmer Liu Zhiqiang came over with his computer and discussed a clamping solution for an irregular part with him. The two gestured over the drawings for a few minutes. Yin Hao suggested the idea of modifying the existing chuck. Liu Zhiqiang thought it was feasible and said he would first simulate the path on his computer.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-work cleanup and record-keeping
description: The flange order task was completed. According to procedure, I shut down the machine tool, cleaned up the iron chips, wiped the guide rails, and recorded the quality control data of all today's machined parts in the work log. Looking at the tidy workstation and the finished workpieces, I felt at ease.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Purchase ingredients
description: After work, he drove home and on the way stopped by Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket. He bought half a jin of small yellow croaker, two baby bok choy, and a small bag of enoki mushrooms, planning to make steamed yellow croaker and garlic baby bok choy for tomorrow's lunchbox. He also bought some tomatoes and eggs to have on hand.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with mother during dinner
description: When he got home, Yin Hao first made a video call to his mother. She was cooking and happily said that she had bought an electronic blood pressure monitor at the pharmacy today and had just taken a measurement of 132/84; the diastolic reading was a little better than yesterday. Yin Hao told her to record it every morning and evening. After hanging up, he cooked a pot of light buckwheat noodles, poached an egg, and served it with stir-fried baby bok choy. While eating, he browsed the featured posts on a fishing forum on his phone.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Simulated hands-on practice for the technician exam preparation
description: I cleared the dining table and took out the prepared tools, a scrap circuit board, a multimeter, a soldering iron, and other items to simulate diagnosing a spindle servo unit fault in a CNC system. First, I used the multimeter to measure the voltage at several key test points on the circuit board. Comparing with the parameters I remembered, I judged that one voltage was unstable, probably because a capacitor in the circuit had aged. I carefully removed the suspicious capacitor with the soldering iron and desoldering pump, then measured it with the multimeter's capacitance setting and found that its capacitance had dropped significantly. I found a capacitor with similar parameters from the spare parts box, replaced it, and measured the voltage again; the readings returned to normal. I recorded the whole process with my phone, planning to review it and summarize the key points before bed. In the middle, I took a 10-minute break and drank some water.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Playing online games with comrades.
description: After finishing exam prep, I collapsed onto the sofa and opened Honor of Kings. Called out in the 'Iron Triangle' WeChat group, and Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng came online immediately. The three of us queued for three ranked matches, winning two and losing one. In voice chat, Zhang Jianguo complained about the overtime culture at his new company, Zhou Xiaofeng shared about his newly purchased fishing rod, and Yin Hao chatted about fixing the machine and talking with property management. Laughter never stopped, and the day's fatigue melted away in the game.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Wash up, review the day, and go to sleep.
description: After turning off the game, I went to wash up. Lying in bed, I quickly reviewed the key points of today's exam-preparation videos in my phone memo: capacitor aging detection and desoldering techniques. Remembering that I needed to go to the library to borrow books tomorrow, I set the alarm for 7 o'clock. Then I turned off the light, listened to the faint sound of insects outside the window, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting up and assessing lower back
description: The alarm went off right at 06:15. Yin Hao felt a noticeable soreness in his right lower back, an aftereffect of yesterday's increased core training intensity, so he decided to skip high-intensity exercise this morning and lie in bed for another five minutes. He got up at 06:25, did 5 minutes of light stretching, focusing on warming the area with his palms and slowly twisting his waist. After confirming that his range of motion was acceptable but still uncomfortable, he decided to avoid any bending or forceful movements for the rest of the day.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment at Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and commute
description: After washing up briefly, Yin Hao put on dark gray work pants and a blue work jacket, checked his work badge, keys, and phone, and transferred the electronic version of the common-mistakes summary he planned to share during lunch to the memo on his phone. At 06:50 he left and walked to Henan Braised Noodles (Dagang Branch), ordered a bowl of lamb braised noodles, and thought about today's production schedule as he ate. At 07:15 he finished, walked back to Xingang Community to get his car, and drove the gray Wuling Hongguang PLUS along Xingang Road, turning onto Huatianjing Highway. On the way he played an English course on machining terminology. At 07:35 he arrived at the factory and parked in the employee parking area.
location: Starting from Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, having breakfast at Henan Huimian (Dagang Branch), 109 Dagang Xingang Road, Xiaokunshan Town, then arriving at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning meeting and pre-shift preparation
description: Attended the pre-shift morning meeting. Team leader Wang Lei stressed today's production tasks: give priority to completing a batch of urgent flanges, and unload the new machine tool parts in the afternoon. Yin Hao rehearsed the morning machining steps in his mind. After the meeting, he returned to his workstation, checked the coolant and lubricating oil levels, and started the CNC machine for a 5-minute warm-up.
location: Processing Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Focus on machining the urgent flange part.
description: Yin Hao was fully focused on the urgent production of the flange, strictly following the programmed tool path and repeatedly measuring the outer diameter, inner hole, and thickness with a vernier caliper and micrometer to ensure the error was within 0.02 mm. Because of lower back discomfort, he placed a high stool beside his workstation and sat down to rest during automatic operation. During the 10:00 break, he went outside in the factory area to do chest expansion exercises and slow lateral waist bends, occasionally exchanging words with programmer Liu Zhiqiang.
location: Workstation at the processing workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Cafeteria lunch and review preparation
description: Yin Hao got potato chicken stew, stir-fried greens, and rice at the staff cafeteria. He sat alone in a corner, eating while quickly skimming the high-frequency exam questions from last night's mistake notebook on his phone, clarifying key points for the lunchtime sharing session. He noticed the cafeteria TV news mentioning that the Intelligent Manufacturing Expo would be held in Shanghai this weekend. His heart stirred, and he thought maybe he could go see it.
location: Employee cafeteria, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break training for reviewing key exam points
description: Yin Hao gathered about 6 colleagues from the workshop who were preparing for the exam. In the workshop break room, he used a whiteboard to explain commonly missed questions and a review framework, focusing on memory methods for CNC machine fault diagnosis flowcharts and easily confused points in PLC ladder diagram logic signal transmission paths. He also used his phone to mirror a video clip of Teacher Liu Jianjun's analysis of typical cutting chatter cases. Everyone discussed enthusiastically, and Yin Hao also consolidated his knowledge through the session.

participant.name: About 6 colleagues in the workshop are preparing for the exam

location: Workshop break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Continue production in the afternoon.
description: After the lunch break, Yin Hao returned to his workstation and continued the morning's flange machining task. While the machine tool ran automatically, he organized the cutting tools and pulled up the drawings and program for the next workpiece in advance to check them. He sat with his lower back supported, trying to avoid unnecessary movement as much as possible.
location: Workstation at the processing workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Sudden lifting of heavy objects caused a right lumbar muscle strain.
description: New machine tool parts arrived, and Yin Hao and Wang Lei helped unload them. After the parts were set down, Yin Hao squatted to adjust his lifting stance. Because the ground was uneven and his lower back was already sore, he twisted his waist suddenly, and a lightning-like sharp pain erupted in his right lower back, leaving him unable to move. Wang Lei immediately supported him, the driver found a chair with a backrest for him to sit on, and the workshop supervisor determined it was an acute lumbar sprain, approved him to stop work and leave early to rest. Wang Lei ran to the clinic to get an ice pack for cold compress.
location: Entrance of Warehouse 7, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cold compress and waiting in the break room
description: Yin Hao leaned sideways in a chair in the workshop break room, with a cushion behind his lower back and an ice pack on the injured area. Wang Lei poured a cup of warm water and told him not to worry. Yin Hao sent a WeChat message to Liu Zhiqiang asking him to put away the unfinished drawings at his workstation. A colleague from company administration came over and briefly recorded what had happened.
location: Workshop break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Shopping and return on the way home.
description: At 15:00, Yin Hao felt the pain had eased slightly. He slowly turned sideways and sat into the driver's seat, then drove for about 14 minutes to the Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, keeping his body straight on the way. In the supermarket, he bent over and moved in small steps, buying light ingredients such as chicken breast, broccoli, and whole wheat noodles. He also bought Yunnan Baiyao plaster and diclofenac sodium sustained-release tablets from the medicine shelf area. After checking out, he slowly walked back to the car with a shopping bag in one hand and the other hand supporting his waist. He then drove ten minutes back to Xingang Community, carried his things and shuffled up to the second floor, put the ingredients in the refrigerator, found a hard chair, sat down, and let out a long breath.
location: Starting from Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory at No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, he went to Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket at Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road to shop, and finally returned to the rental apartment in Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road.

name: Cold compress and rest at home.
description: Yin Hao changed into loose athletic loungewear, lay on his side in bed, put a small pillow under his lower back, and applied the ice pack wrapped in a towel to his waist again. He replied to Wang Lei's caring WeChat message, telling him he had arrived home safely and taken leave for tomorrow. While scrolling on his phone, he saw a short video about a hypertension diet shared by his mother in the family group chat and tapped a like.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment at Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Called my mother to report that I was safe.
description: Yin Hao made a video call to his mother, Wang Xiuying, hiding the fact that he had a strain, and only said that he was a bit tired from work today and wanted to rest early. He asked about his mother's blood pressure, and she said she had measured it on an empty stomach in the morning and it was 132/85, telling him not to worry so much. The call lasted about 20 minutes.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment at Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and light activity
description: Yin Hao, enduring lower back pain, slowly cooked a bowl of buckwheat noodles and blanched two baby bok choy and a poached egg. After eating, he held the edge of the dining table and slowly did a few squats to gently move his joints, avoiding stiffness caused by staying in bed for a long time.
location: Kitchen of the rental house in Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Agreed with running friends to arrange a morning run after he recovered
description: Running buddy Chen Jie sent a WeChat message asking if he would go running the next morning. Yin Hao took a photo of the ice pack and pain patch on his bed and sent it over, saying that he had strained his lower back carrying a workpiece and couldn't run for the next few days. Chen Jie instantly replied with a shocked emoji, repeatedly told him not to push through the pain and to rest well, and they agreed to finalize the next run time next week depending on how his recovery was going.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment at Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening review for exam preparation.
description: Yin Hao adjusted his posture and lay on his side in bed, fixed his phone with a phone stand, opened the WeChat mini program for senior technician exam sprint review, and repeatedly reviewed 30 wrong questions. Then he pulled up the practical operation video of three-phase asynchronous motor winding insulation testing recorded yesterday, listened carefully to Teacher Liu Jianjun's explanation, and took key notes in his phone memo. Despite back pain, he persisted in reviewing for 1.5 hours and completed today's review task.
location: On the bed in the rental room, Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Washing up and applying a medicated patch to the lower back
description: Yin Hao slowly moved into the bathroom and wiped his body with hot water, avoiding bending over to take a shower. Then he struggled to remove the medicinal patch and applied it to the most painful spot on his right waist. The cool sensation from the medicine made him feel a bit better.
location: Bathroom of the rental unit, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Relaxation and browsing news before sleep
description: Yin Hao lay back in bed, used his tablet to browse fishing forums, and checked the weekend weather at Dianshan Lake. Remembering the smart manufacturing expo information he had seen at noon, he clicked in and found that registration was free. He saved the registration link and planned to consider whether to attend after his waist recovered. Gradually feeling sleepy, he turned off the light.
location: On the bed in the rental room, Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep
description: Yin Hao lay on his side in bed, thinking back on the day. Although an accident had happened, the noon break training had gone well, the exam preparation tasks were completed, and the communication with his mother had put his mind at ease. He comforted himself that health is the foundation of everything. This lesson reminded him to strengthen personal protection at work in the future. With a trace of pain and a sense of reassurance, he slowly fell asleep.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment at Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning lower back rehabilitation and preparation.
description: The alarm went off. He did about 5 minutes of lower back rehabilitation stretches in bed, including knee hugs, leg raises, and cat-cow stretches, then washed up, changed into work clothes, checked his commuter bag, packed a multi-grain rice lunch box, work ID, and keys, and also put first-aid knowledge cards, a multimeter, and a screwdriver into his backpack, making advance preparations for tomorrow's nursing home service.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting by car and buying breakfast.
description: Drove off, first stopping at the Anhui-style soup dumpling shop on Xingang Road, bought two pork buns and a cup of freshly ground soy milk, ate quickly in the car, then drove along Huatianjing Highway for about 15 minutes to reach the factory.
location: Anhui-Style Xiaolongbao on Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road

name: Arrival check-in and task communication
description: After arriving at the factory, I found Master Sun Jianguo and team leader Wang Lei, took the initiative to explain that I had strained my lower back moving heavy objects yesterday afternoon, showed the medicated patch, and asked to avoid heavy-duty positions. Wang Lei understood and arranged for me to focus on operating the machine tool, while Master Sun advised me to balance work and rest.
location: Workshop break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning machine tool production and fault handling.
description: Focused on machining a batch of cast iron bases, keeping a correct standing posture, and checking dimensions with a vernier caliper every 3 pieces. During the break, he did lower back stretches in the break room. When machining resumed, a machine tool's coolant flow was abnormal; he investigated with programmer Liu Zhiqiang and found the nozzle was blocked by iron chips. After clearing it, everything returned to normal.
location: CNC machine operation area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and training Q&A
description: In the break room, he heated up the mixed-grain rice and broccoli stir-fried chicken breast he had brought, ate quickly, and rested with his eyes closed for 10 minutes. Then he called the three new colleagues into the break room and used sticky notes and a manual to explain non-circular curve parameter settings and tool compensation calculations. He let the newcomers take turns simulating the operation and corrected their technique, and finally announced that the two-week training was officially over. After that, he drank some water, organized his notes, and browsed the afternoon production schedule.
location: Workshop break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Efficient afternoon production
description: He machined a batch of No. 45 steel flanges, operated two machine tools, performed intermittent dimensional spot checks, and exchanged tool selection insights with Master Sun, who passed by to guide. He followed safety procedures throughout and used a cart instead of bending over to move workpieces, avoiding a secondary injury to his lower back.
location: CNC machine operation area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-work cleanup and wrap-up
description: Shut down the machine tool in advance, clean up the cutting chips, blow clean the guide rails and fixtures, sort finished and defective products into separate places, fill in the production log and record sheets, put tools back in place, and keep the workstation tidy.
location: Workshop and workstation of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the swimming pool.
description: Changed into casual clothes and sports shoes, drove off from the factory, played light music to relax his tense nerves, and navigated to Kaiyuan Xindu Swimming Pool.
location: No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Lane 926, Xinsongjiang Road

name: Breaststroke to relax the lower back.
description: After buying a ticket and entering, take a shower first, then walk slowly and stretch in the heated pool for about 10 minutes to warm up your muscles. Then swim breaststroke leisurely for 30 minutes without pursuing speed, using the buoyancy of the water to stretch your waist and relieve tension. After swimming, shower, dry your hair, and change into clean clothes.
location: Kaiyuan Xindu Swimming Pool, Lane 926, Xinsongjiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Buy fishing gear on the way and go home.
description: On the way home, I made a detour to Shihudang Fishing Tackle Shop to buy fishhooks and lead sleeves for the weekend fishing, then drove back to Xingang Community.
location: From the fishing tackle shop at No. 30 Dongzha Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Lane 224, Xingang Road.

name: Simple dinner
description: After boiling water, I cooked a bowl of hot noodle soup with a poached egg, lettuce, and a little dried shrimp, and quickly finished dinner to replenish energy.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with mother.
description: Video-called my mother Wang Xiuying, asked about her blood pressure, and urged her to buy an upper-arm electronic blood pressure monitor as soon as possible and record her readings daily. She agreed to buy it the next day, but didn't mention her back injury at all.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organize technical exam preparation notes.
description: He took out the mistake notebook, hands-on fault cards, and past exam papers. Spending about 45 minutes, he used different colored highlighters to re-mark the priority of the wrong questions by categories such as high-frequency exam points, easily confused points, and calculation mistakes, and sorted the fault cards by electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical categories, preparing for a focused weekend study session.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Game entertainment and confirmation of tomorrow's volunteer itinerary.
description: Logged into the game and teamed up with Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng for ranked matches. During voice chat, they finalized the time and place to meet for tomorrow afternoon's volunteer service at the nursing home.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After washing up, he checked the medicated patch stock and put the first aid knowledge cards, a fully charged multimeter, and an intact screwdriver into his backpack for the next day. Lying in bed, he scrolled through a fishing forum for 10 minutes, then turned off the light, confirmed the alarm was set for 06:30, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning preparation and exercise.
description: Got up at 6:40 in the morning, first doing cat stretch and child's pose to warm up and relieve soreness in the right lower back muscles, then completed 15 minutes of core training: 2 sets of supine crunches (15 reps each), 10 reps of bird dog on each side, and glute bridges, taking care to avoid sudden force on the lower back throughout. Then did 10 minutes of meditation with deep breathing, stretching the back of the thighs and hips. After washing up, applied a Yunnan Baiyao patch to the lower back, changed into dark casual clothes that hide dirt, and carefully checked the backpack: confirmed that the multimeter, screwdriver set, electrical tape, spare start capacitor and light bulbs, and simple first-aid illustrated cards were all packed.
location: Room 404, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and route planning
description: At home, ate whole-wheat bread and drank hot soy milk, while using phone navigation to check traffic conditions, planned the fastest driving route to the Songjiang District Nursing Home, and noted common circuit fault points in the memo app to prepare for the day's repair work.
location: Room 404, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go to the nursing home and meet up.
description: Drove from Xingang Residential Community, first to Xianfeng Fruit (Xingang Road Store) near Lane 213, Xingang Road to buy bananas and apples, spending 47 yuan. Then drove along Kungang Highway to the Songjiang District Nursing Home, arriving at the gate around 8:35. Met up with colleague Wang Lei and other members of a volunteer service team from a Songjiang company (about 12 people in total), and after a brief exchange with the nursing home staff, confirmed the morning service schedule: 9:00-11:00 home appliance repair and first aid knowledge explanation, 11:00-12:00 chat with the elderly and assist in setting up the Mid-Autumn Festival party venue.
location: At the entrance of Songjiang District Nursing Home, No. 1100, Middle Songhui Road, Yongfeng Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Repair small household appliances.
description: Guided by the staff into the elderly man's room, he repaired the non-spinning standing fan and two desk lamps for Grandpa Wang. He skillfully opened the fan's back cover, used a multimeter to find that the start capacitor was aged and bulging, found a capacitor of the same specification in his own parts box and replaced it, and the fan returned to normal. When repairing the desk lamps, he directly replaced the bulb in one; in the other, the wires inside the lamp holder had a cold solder joint, so he re-soldered them and wrapped them with electrical tape. Wang Lei assisted by steadying the fan and organizing the tools.

participant.name: Elderly residents of the nursing home

location: Elderly residents' rooms and activity rooms at the Songjiang District Nursing Home, Yongfeng Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Explaining first aid knowledge
description: In the public activity room on the second floor, using the replaced old capacitors and light bulbs as teaching aids, he explained first-aid principles for falls to more than a dozen elderly residents and three caregivers sitting around him, emphasizing that "when an elderly person falls, you should not help them up immediately; first check their consciousness, breathing, and whether there are fractures." He demonstrated the log-roll method to protect the cervical spine and the Heimlich maneuver.
