A young caregiver stepped forward to practice CPR compressions on a yoga mat, and he corrected the pressure and hand position from the side.

participant.name: Elderly residents of the nursing home

location: Public activity room on the second floor of the Songjiang District Nursing Home, Yongfeng Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Clean the room and keep the elderly company
description: Together with other volunteers, cleaned the rooms for three elderly residents with limited mobility on the third floor, wiping the windowsills and bedside tables, and arranging water cups and medications neatly. Then sat by Grandpa Wang's bedside, listening to him talk about his past working at the Songjiang Shipyard in his youth while flipping through old photos. Noted the elderly man's report that the TV signal occasionally cuts out in the phone memo, ready to give feedback to the nursing home.

participant.name: Grandpa Wang
participant.relation: Elderly residents of the nursing home

location: Room on the third floor of Songjiang District Nursing Home, Yongfeng Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Had lunch with the elderly
description: Had lunch with volunteers and the elderly in the nursing home cafeteria, enjoying braised pork, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, seasonal vegetables, and seaweed egg drop soup. He sat next to 80-year-old Grandma Chen, who warmly urged him to take more food. The atmosphere was harmonious.

participant.name: Grandma Chen
participant.relation: Elderly residents of the nursing home

location: Canteen of Songjiang District Nursing Home, Yongfeng Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Decorate the venue for the Mid-Autumn Festival party
description: After lunch, he set up the party venue together with Wang Lei and the staff. They moved a dozen or so folding chairs out of the warehouse and arranged them in two curved rows in the multi-function hall, climbed up a stepladder to hang and secure the red banner reading “The Mid-Autumn Moon Is Full, Warmth Fills the Nursing Home,” and checked and adjusted the old sound system to ensure the microphone and music playback worked properly.
location: Multi-function Hall, Songjiang District Nursing Home, Yongfeng Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Mid-Autumn Festival celebration performance and service
description: During the party, he was responsible for playing background music. During the free performance segment, Wang Lei pulled him onto the stage, and he sang “Strong Army Battle Song” a cappella, which he had learned in the army. His voice was full and powerful, and the elderly applauded warmly. At the end of the party, at the request of the nursing assistant, he went on stage again and, together with another volunteer, gave a complete demonstration of the standard CPR procedure on a mannequin, and once again emphasized the importance of fall prevention.
location: Multi-function Hall, Songjiang District Nursing Home, Yongfeng Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cleaning up the venue and taking a group photo as a memento
description: After the party ended, he cleaned up trash with the other volunteers, folded tables and chairs, and moved them back to the storage room. Around 15:20, all the volunteers, elderly representatives, and staff took a group photo at the main entrance of the nursing home; the atmosphere was warm.

participant.name: Elderly representative
participant.relation: Elderly residents of the nursing home

location: In front of the main gate of Songjiang District Nursing Home, Yongfeng Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove back to the rented apartment
description: After saying goodbye to Wang Lei, he drove back alone to Xingang Residential Community. On the way, he stopped at a gas station and put 200 yuan of No. 92 gasoline into the car.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home to rest and prepare
description: After getting home, he took a shower, changed into a clean gray cotton T-shirt and dark blue jeans, sat down to rest, and drank some cold boiled water. He opened the mobile banking app to confirm the screenshot of the 600,000 yuan loan pre-approval from the bank on September 12, flipped through several photos of old-town Songjiang second-hand homes saved in his album that fit the 1.35–1.45 million yuan budget, and organized his thoughts on how to clearly explain the home-buying plan and family support situation to his girlfriend Lin Yue.
location: Room 404, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Met with girlfriend to talk in detail.
description: Rode a shared bike to Biancheng Coffee on Wenhui Road in Songjiang University City, and ordered a latte with his girlfriend Lin Yue at a window-side corner. First asked about her recent job transfer situation, then proactively showed the bank pre-approved credit limit screenshot, chat records of his parents' promise of 150,000 yuan in down-payment support, and screenshots of several property listings. He frankly explained his home-buying plan and his idea of settling in Songjiang after marriage. Lin Yue expressed her wish to be transferred back to the Shanghai headquarters. After nearly an hour and a half of conversation, they reached a consensus and agreed to go see houses together after National Day.
location: Biancheng Coffee (Songjiang University City Branch), Wenhui Road, Guangfulin Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Shopping on the way back.
description: After saying goodbye to Lin Yue, Yin Hao rode a shared bike back to Xingang Community. On the way, he stopped at the Xingang New Village fresh food supermarket near the community and bought a loaf of whole-wheat bread, a carton of fresh milk, and two tomatoes for the next morning's breakfast, costing 24 yuan. He also bought a new tube of toothpaste for 16 yuan, preparing supplies for the morning run with his running friend Chen Jie at Xiaokunshan Park.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening relaxation
description: After returning home, he connected his phone to the Bluetooth speaker and played a folk song playlist. While relaxing, he opened the fishing forum Diao Duoduo to browse the latest fishing reports for several spots in Qingpu District, and replied to Brother Wu's invitation to night fish at Dianshan Lake on the weekend. At the same time, he sent a WeChat message to his running buddy Chen Jie, agreeing to meet at the usual place in Xiaokunshan Park at 6 a.m. tomorrow.
location: Room 404, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and lower back care before bed.
description: Went to the bathroom to wash up, then changed into loose pajamas. On the bed, he did 10 minutes of cat stretch and child's pose relaxation movements to relieve the day's fatigue in his lower back. Then he removed the old medicated patch and applied a new Yunnan Baiyao patch.
location: Bedroom, Room 404, Building 2, Xingang Residential Complex, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep review and going to bed.
description: Lying in bed, reviewed the day's activities: the nursing home event was fulfilling, and communication with Lin Yue made substantial progress, leaving him feeling at ease. Scrolled through short videos for a while, turned off the light at 22:30 and set the phone to silent, then quickly fell asleep with a full and calm mind.
location: Bedroom, Room 404, Building 2, Xingang Residential Complex, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Get up, wash up, and prepare for the morning run
description: After the alarm went off, Yin Hao slowly sat up and felt that the soreness on the right side of his waist had eased significantly. After getting up, he did some simple stretches, washed his face with cold water to wake up, changed into a quick-dry sports T-shirt, shorts, and running shoes, checked his phone, keys, and car key, and went out after confirming everything was in order.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Drive to the Guangfulin Ruins and meet up for a warm-up.
description: Yin Hao drove his white Volkswagen Lavida from Xingang Community, following Xingang Road onto Jiasong South Road, then turning onto Guangfulin Road, heading to the Guangfulin Cultural Ruins. Traffic was light. On the way, he confirmed with Chen Jie via WeChat that they would meet at the south gate. Fifteen minutes later, he arrived at the south gate of Guangfulin Ruins Park, where Chen Jie, already wearing black compression tights, was stretching on the steps of the plaza. After a quick greeting, they jogged 400 meters around the plaza to warm up, then did dynamic stretches (high knees, lunge twists). Chen Jie asked about his lower back, and Yin Hao said it was much better.
location: South Gate Entrance Plaza, Shanghai Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site, 3260 Lane, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: 6 km recovery morning run and stretching chat
description: The two started their morning run along the park trail, with an initial pace of about 6 minutes 10 seconds per kilometer. Yin Hao maintained his breathing rhythm and kept his running form steady. At the 3rd kilometer, he felt a slight pulling sensation in his lower back, so he proactively adjusted his arm swing and slowed to a 6 minutes 20 seconds pace. Chen Jie matched his pace and stayed with him. After the 5th kilometer, his condition improved, and on the last kilometer he returned to a 5 minutes 50 seconds pace, finishing the total run in about 35 minutes. After the run, they did static stretches for legs and hips in the lakeside corridor, and Yin Hao massaged his right lower back muscles. They chatted about recent life. Chen Jie mentioned he was preparing for the Songjiang Half Marathon, and Yin Hao also wanted to participate. They agreed to train together at least twice a week starting in October (Wednesday evening and Saturday early morning). Chen Jie also mentioned that next week he could take Yin Hao to the gym where he has a membership to try the newly arrived stretching rack.
location: Internal footpaths and lakeside corridor of the Shanghai Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site, Lane 3260, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Drove back home
description: After wiping off sweat with a tissue, he drove back to Xingang Community, turned down the air conditioning, and opened the windows to cool down. Along the way, he sent his mother a WeChat voice message, telling her that he went for a run today and felt good, and urged her to measure her blood pressure. The whole trip took about 15 minutes.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Shower, core rehabilitation training, and breakfast
description: After getting home, first take a warm shower to wash off the sweat, then quickly rinse the legs and knees with cool water to cool them down. After drying off, apply a Yunnan Baiyao patch to the right lower back muscles. Then lay a yoga mat on the floor and do 15 minutes of low-intensity core training: cat-cow, dead bug, and bird dog, 3 sets of 12 reps each, moving slowly to avoid engaging the lower back. After training, finish with 5 minutes of meditative stretching (supine knee-to-chest, seated forward fold). Then take whole-wheat bread and milk out of the fridge, toast two slices until slightly browned, pour a glass of warm milk, and eat slowly. Wash yesterday's dishes and put them away, brew a cup of instant coffee to refresh, and get ready for a nap later.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Catching up on sleep and resting
description: Pull the bedroom curtains, put on an eye mask, set the 10:45 alarm, and lie on the bed to relax the whole body. At first, the heartbeat after the morning run was still audible, and fell asleep naturally after about 10 minutes. Sleep quality was high, and didn't wake up during the night. After the alarm rang, slowly opened eyes, feeling the waist completely relaxed and most of energy restored.
location: Bedroom, Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Morning review for exam preparation.
description: After getting up, drink a glass of warm water first, and eat the remaining slice of toasted bread with a small carton of yogurt as a breakfast supplement. Then go to the desk, take out the Senior Technician exam error notebook and a pencil, spend 30 minutes reviewing the mistakes, circle the error-prone points in red for CNC machine tool fault diagnosis (main drive Mitsubishi system alarm, cooling pump circuit issues), and write the mnemonic beside them: “First check the power, then test the circuits, then look at the program.” In the remaining time, look through the post-National Day plan, write the PLC programming questions that need to be asked of Master Sun on a sticky note, and tuck it into the error notebook.
location: Study, Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and a short break.
description: Cooked a bowl of tomato and egg buckwheat noodles with tomatoes, eggs, and buckwheat noodles, adding a little salt and sesame oil, served with a plate of leftover cucumber salad from yesterday. After the meal, I leaned back on the sofa for a 10-minute nap and chatted briefly with my mother over WeChat voice. I learned that she has started recording her blood pressure daily, and reminded her to measure it once in the morning and once in the evening.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Organizing work plans and deepening exam preparation.
description: He opened his laptop and loose-leaf notebook to sort out the work for next Monday (September 29): next week's production schedule includes 3 valve body flanges and 2 hydraulic cylinder bases. He confirmed the dimensional tolerances on the drawings one by one and wrote down the debugging steps (tool setting, selecting tool compensation, test cutting the first piece, first-piece inspection). Then he flipped through the textbook "Advanced CNC Programming and Operation", focusing on reviewing the two chapters "Macro Program Parameter Settings" and "Cutting Parameter Optimization", and drew strategy flowcharts for rough machining and finish machining in his notebook. Midway, at 14:15, he got up and moved around for 5 minutes, using a tennis ball to gently roll and relax his lower back.
location: Study, Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Stereo system test and room tidying
description: He took out the broken component stereo that he had bought cheaply the day before yesterday and repaired, used his phone to play 'Wangxiang' to test the sound quality, and after confirming the sound was clean with full bass, wiped the stereo clean and pushed it into the corner. Then he tidied the living room: put a few fishing magazines from the floor into the bookshelf, wiped the dust off the desk, and threw the sportswear waiting to be washed into the washing machine.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Honor of Kings ranked matches and going out to shop
description: He lay on the sofa and logged into Honor of Kings. Seeing a message in the team group from Wang Lei saying they needed players, he joined. He teamed up with Wang Lei (jungle), Liu Zhiqiang (mid), his childhood friend Zhang Wei (marksman), and a random support player, and played three ranked matches. In the first match, he used Xiahou Dun on the solo lane, but the team's coordination failed and their economy was suppressed, so they lost. In the second, he switched to Li Xin and focused on split pushing and flanking to turn the game around and win. In the third, both teams fought for 20 minutes, but they ultimately lost narrowly because their formation fell apart. After playing, he chatted briefly with Zhang Wei on WeChat and agreed to play again next week. Then he changed into a gray T-shirt, sports shorts, and flip-flops, and walked to the Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket. He browsed around and bought: two boxes of chicken breast, 500 grams of lean pork, broccoli, carrots, spring onions, whole wheat flour, and olive oil, spending a total of 68.5 yuan. After checking out, he took two promotional flyers, walked home, sorted the ingredients into the fridge, drank a glass of water and rested. Browsing WeChat Moments, he saw that Chen Jie had posted a photo of the two of them running. He liked it and left a comment to schedule a ten-kilometer run next week.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China; and the Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road.

name: Dinner preparation and dining.
description: He cut half an onion and half a chicken breast, marinated them for 10 minutes with cooking wine, light soy sauce, and black pepper, then stir-fried them with multigrain rice to make fried rice, and also boiled a seaweed egg drop soup. While eating, he watched a video on Bilibili by a machinery blogger about "CNC milling machine fault diagnosis cases" and took some notes. After the meal, he took one multivitamin.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Browsed fishing forums and participated in discussions.
description: He opened the fishing forum app on his phone and browsed the “Shanghai Wild Fishing Exchange Circle” section. He saw a new post by Wu Zhiqiang titled “Today's Catch at Dianshan Lake: Caught a 3-jin Bream”, carefully looked at the photos and learned the chumming technique, and replied, “Brother Wu, awesome! Take me out to cast a few lines next week to learn.” Then he browsed other hot posts to learn about reservoir fishing spots around Shanghai and bookmarked two posts titled “Early Autumn Crucian Carp Fishing Guide”.
location: Study, Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Check work backpack and prepare for work
description: Walked to the entryway to check the work backpack: put on new protective gloves, confirmed the vernier caliper and steel rule were in the side pocket, the multimeter had enough battery, and placed two pairs of new cotton socks. Rolled up the phone charger and cable and put them in the compartment. Wrote a note "Monday morning meeting: need to confirm the tolerance range of the hydraulic cylinder drawing with Master Sun" and stuck it on the backpack zipper.
location: Entrance, Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Evening washing up and lower back relaxation care
description: Went to the bathroom and washed away the dust and sweat with warm water, then alternated cold water over both legs and knees to promote recovery. After drying off, I took a piece of Yunnan Baiyao plaster and applied it to the right lumbar muscle, pressing and rubbing with my palm for a few minutes to aid absorption. I changed into loose cotton pajamas, sat quietly by the bed for two minutes, and dimmed the desk lamp.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Read exam preparation notes before bed.
description: Leaning against the headboard, he took out his error notebook and flipped through the key points he had marked that day, silently memorizing several key parameters (tool compensation rules, cutting fluid concentration). After 10 minutes he put down the notebook, put on his Bluetooth earphones, listened to a white noise track of a forest stream, and closed his eyes to relax for 5 minutes.
location: Bedroom, Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Browsing phone before bed and falling asleep
description: I opened my phone to check tomorrow's weather (forecast: sunny and clear), and in my memo wrote down 'Bring food tomorrow: chicken breast + broccoli.' I replied to Chen Jie's WeChat message about going to practice on the stretching rack tomorrow afternoon, set the alarm for 6:20 the next morning, silenced my phone, and placed it on the bedside table. I turned off the desk lamp and lay flat, feeling the warmth of the medicated patch on my lower back. As I reviewed the day's recovery, study, and leisure, I felt relaxed and calm. My breathing gradually became steady, and after a while I fell into a deep sleep and did not wake again throughout the night.
location: Bedroom, Room 503, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Morning core workout and diet tracking
description: Yin Hao, wearing a quick-dry T-shirt and athletic shorts, did low-intensity core training on the yoga mat in his rented apartment's living room, including plank variations and side bridges, with gentle movements to avoid hurting his recently troublesome lower back. After training, he weighed himself with a body fat scale and recorded the data as 72.6 kg, then took a shower. After breakfast, he packed pre-marinated chicken breast and broccoli into a bento box, took a photo, and uploaded it to the diet management app, making a good start to the day's health management.
location: Yin Hao's rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Prepare for commute and confirm schedule
description: Yin Hao changed into clean dark blue work clothes and checked his commuter bag to confirm his work badge, meal card, and bus card were all there. Then he checked today's work plan on his phone: he needed to follow up on a batch of flange orders. At the same time, he saw the WeChat message his mother Wang Xiuying sent last night, saying she would start using the blood pressure monitor today. He replied, “OK, don't forget to have Dad keep an eye on it,” and set a reminder for the evening video call.
location: Yin Hao's rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Driving to work and thinking during the commute
description: Yin Hao drove his silver-gray used SUV, departing from Xingang Community and entering the main road along Xingang Road. On the way, he listened to the local traffic radio while organizing in his mind how to talk to his mentor Sun Jianguo at noon about competing for the position, thinking about how to broach the subject respectfully without being abrupt, and drafting the preliminary framework of the application report. About 25 minutes later, he arrived at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Focused on production tasks in the morning
description: Yin Hao changed into safety shoes, put on goggles and a safety helmet. After arriving at his post, he first checked the day's production schedule and confirmed the technical drawings and tolerance requirements for the flanges. Then he started the CNC machine and focused on machining parts. After every 3 to 5 workpieces, he used a vernier caliper and a micrometer to measure precisely and ensure conformity with the standards. Around 11:00, he had a brief technical discussion with programmer Liu Zhiqiang about a chamfering program, then continued working. Meanwhile, his colleague Wang Lei was also working in the same workshop.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Ask about canteen lunch and the competitive recruitment process.
description: Yin Hao arrived at the factory cafeteria a few minutes early to get his meal and deliberately chose a quiet seat by the window. Before long, his mentor Sun Jianguo came over with a tray and sat down. Yin Hao got straight to the point, mentioning his intention to apply for the team leader position that he had brought up last month, and asked his mentor for advice on how to prepare the application report. Sun Jianguo put down his chopsticks and seriously suggested that he focus on summarizing the complex part cases he had handled over the past six months, the results of the training he had participated in, and some suggestions for optimizing processes, and encouraged him to have the materials ready before the end of the year. The two talked about the report structure for nearly half an hour, and Yin Hao silently noted the key points.
location: Employee cafeteria, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Noon break in the car and online house viewing
description: After the meal, Yin Hao did not go to the crowded break room. Instead, he walked straight to his SUV in the parking lot, got into the driver's seat, and reclined the seat to take a nap. He set a 25-minute alarm. Before sleeping, he opened the real estate app on his phone, pulled up the two small elevator apartments in Songjiang's old city area that he had saved the previous day (total price 1,350,000 to 1,450,000 yuan), carefully browsed the floor plans and community environment, and took screenshots saved to the "After National Day House Viewing" album.
location: Parking lot, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon production and between-work learning.
description: Continued the afternoon production tasks. During the 15:00 work break, Yin Hao did not go to the smoking area with his colleagues; instead, he walked alone to the water dispenser in the corner of the workshop, and while drinking water, he looked again at the detail screenshots of the two properties on his phone and opened the calculator app to carefully calculate the down payment ratio and monthly payment amount, feeling even more pressure and motivation. Then he continued working. At 17:30, he finished inspecting the last part, cleaned the machine and workstation, and clocked out. During this period, he worked collaboratively with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Detour to the library after work to borrow books.
description: After briefly saying goodbye to Wang Lei at the factory gate, Yin Hao turned right and, instead of taking his usual route home, made a detour toward Rongle Middle Road. Following the navigation, it took about 27 minutes to arrive at Songjiang District Library (Rongle Middle Road Branch). He swiped his library card to enter the Natural Science Reading Room on the second floor, found two professional books by call number: "Typical Application Cases of Hydraulic Transmission Systems" and "Electrical Control and Programmable Controllers". He also spotted a copy of "Practical Fault Diagnosis and Maintenance of CNC Machine Tools" on the "New Book Recommendations" shelf and checked it out as well.
location: Rongle Middle Road Branch of Songjiang District Library, Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Came home and cooked a simple meal
description: Drove from the library back to Xingang Community, taking about 16 minutes. After arriving home, Yin Hao put the borrowed books on the desk and quickly handled the dinner ingredients: put the pre-thawed sea bass into the steamer, and at the same time rinsed the mixed-grain rice and put it into the rice cooker. While waiting, he took the running shoes he had changed out of that morning to the balcony to air them out. Dinner was steamed sea bass, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and mixed-grain rice, light and healthy.
location: Yin Hao's rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Evening systematic exam preparation and review.
description: After a short rest, Yin Hao sat at his desk and opened the newly borrowed Typical Application Cases of Hydraulic Transmission Systems. Using the textbook as well, he focused on tackling the troubleshooting approach and elimination process for the hydraulic cylinder crawling fault. As he read, he drew a fault tree in his notebook with different colored pens and wrote down key parameters and diagnostic steps. When he came across the obscure closed-loop control principle, he opened several explanation videos collected on his phone from Bilibili and watched them twice until he understood.
location: Yin Hao's rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Video call with mother to check on her health
description: Yin Hao called his mother via WeChat video. On the other end of the screen, his mother Wang Xiuying was watching TV in the living room. Yin Hao asked with concern about how the blood pressure monitor had been used that day. His mother flipped through the notebook beside her and said she measured 130 systolic and 85 diastolic in the morning. Yin Hao urged her to keep recording regularly, then turned the camera to his father and again told him to keep an eye on his mother's low-salt diet. His father nodded in agreement. The call lasted about 10 minutes.
location: Yin Hao's rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Lower back relaxation and body care
description: After hanging up the phone, Yin Hao returned to the living room, took off his coat, lay on the yoga mat, and used a foam roller to slowly roll and relax the muscles in his lower back and the back of his thighs, feeling the soreness in his fascia. Then he put on a new medicated patch to relieve the pulling discomfort in his lower back muscles. After finishing the relaxation, he poured himself a glass of warm water and sat on the sofa to rest for a while.
location: Yin Hao's rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Meditation and relaxing music before bed
description: Yin Hao turned on the component stereo on his desk and played forest white noise from the Tide app. He sat cross-legged on the floor mat in the bedroom, closed his eyes, and followed the guidance for a 15-minute breathing meditation, letting his thoughts drift and focusing on each breath, completely relaxing the nerves that had been tense all day. After the meditation, he switched to a soft instrumental piece and turned the volume down as background sound for sleep.
location: Yin Hao's rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Before-bed relaxation and social arrangements
description: With music playing, Yin Hao first scrolled through a fishing forum for a while, focusing on a post by fishing buddy Brother Wu posted yesterday about “crucian carp biting in Dianshan Lake,” and replied below to arrange a weekend fishing trip. At 22:15, he got up and went to the bathroom to wash up, brushed his teeth, and applied skincare products. At 22:30, he lay back in bed, turned off the main light, leaving only a bedside night light, opened today's Honor of Kings team group, and saw colleague Wang Lei inviting everyone to team up tomorrow night. He replied “1” to acknowledge. Then he sent his girlfriend Lin Yue a “Good night” message, set the alarm for 6:20 the next morning, and turned off the lights at 23:00 to go to sleep.
location: Yin Hao's rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning preparation and exercise.
description: At 6:20 in the morning, Yin Hao got up and went to the bathroom, then stepped on the scale, which showed 72.8 kg, and recorded it in the diet diary app. Then he spread out a yoga mat in the living room, opened the Tide app and selected the forest meditation mode. He first did 15 minutes of core training, including plank variations, side bridges, and glute bridges, then completed 15 minutes of meditative stretching, focusing on relaxing the lower back, shoulders, and neck. After training, he showered and washed up. For breakfast, he had toasted whole wheat bread and hot milk. Then he saw the vehicle annual inspection reminder on his phone, and booked the October 14 annual inspection through the Traffic Management 12123 app, and prepared the vehicle license, ID card, and other documents. Finally, he changed into dark blue work pants and a gray polo shirt, took his car keys and work badge, and got ready to go out.
location: Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Drive to work
description: Yin Hao set off from Xingang Community in his white Buick Excelle, drove west along Guangfulin Road, then turned onto Huatianjing Highway. Morning rush-hour traffic was manageable, and he arrived at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory about 15 minutes later, parking in the employee lot.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Morning factory work (morning meeting, leave request, and machining).
description: After Yin Hao arrived at his post, he changed into work safety shoes and a work cap, checked the machine tool's coolant and lubricant oil levels, and wiped down the control panel. At 8:15, team leader Wang Lei held a brief morning meeting to arrange the urgent flange order. After the meeting, Yin Hao told Wang Lei that he needed to attend a public memorial ceremony at the Martyrs' Cemetery in the morning and was granted leave. He then returned to the machine, focused on machining two flanges, confirmed that the equipment was running stably, tidied his workstation, and left the workshop at 10:00.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Drove to the Martyrs' Cemetery in Songjiang District
description: Yin Hao changed out of his work clothes, drove out of the factory, and headed to the Martyrs' Cemetery in Chedun Town, Songjiang District. On the way, he put on a small white flower in advance, feeling solemn and respectful.
location: Songjiang District Martyrs' Cemetery, Shenniu Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Participated in a public memorial ceremony at the Martyrs' Cemetery
description: After arriving at the cemetery, Yin Hao gathered with other veterans' representatives. At 10:45 the memorial ceremony began: the national anthem was played and sung, all observed a moment of silence, and then together with the representatives he laid flower baskets at the Martyrs' Monument and reviewed the enlistment oath. After the ceremony, he wrote in the guestbook: 'Retired but never faded; building new achievements in my post. Yin Hao, September 30, 2025.' The entire activity made him feel the sense of mission as a soldier again.
location: Songjiang District Martyrs' Cemetery, Shenniu Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Drive back to the factory
description: After the public memorial ceremony, Yin Hao said goodbye to his companions and drove back to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. He quietly resolved to do his work well and not let this experience be wasted.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Midday work and lunch
description: After returning to the workshop, Yin Hao changed into his work clothes and immediately started on flange production, operating the CNC machine and measuring part dimensions with a vernier caliper. He worked until 12:40, then went to the factory cafeteria to get braised pork, stir-fried vegetables, and rice. While eating, he scrolled through tech news about a new CNC system on his phone.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Noon break
description: After lunch, Yin Hao returned to the workshop rest room, leaned back in his chair and rested with his eyes closed for half an hour, and set an alarm for 13:40 to ensure his energy for the afternoon.
location: Rest room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Afternoon work and study
description: The afternoon production tasks continued. During processing, Yin Hao encountered a tool compensation parameter problem and asked his programming colleague Liu Zhiqiang for advice. After a discussion, the two solved it smoothly. Then, during a break in workpiece machining, he used his phone in the break room to review the past two weeks' weight-control results from his packed lunches, confirmed that a light diet had improved his morning drowsiness, and decided to switch the main dish to steamed basa fish after National Day. Next, he took out Typical Application Cases of Hydraulic Transmission Systems from his bag, reviewed a hydraulic pump failure case, and jotted down the key fault diagnosis logic in his small notebook.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Continued working until the end of the workday
description: The afternoon production schedule was full. Yin Hao focused on operating the machine tool and completed the remaining flange processing with guaranteed quality and quantity. After the end-of-shift bell rang, he carefully cleaned the iron chips from the machine, oiled the guide rails, and neatly placed the finished parts on the shelf.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: After-work commute and shopping
description: Yin Hao drove away from the factory, stopped by Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket on the way, bought sliced toast, cherry tomatoes, a large bottle of mineral water, and a box of Band-Aids for tomorrow's camping trip to Mogan Mountain, and then drove back to Xingang Community.
location: Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Dinner
description: Yin Hao returned home, simply boiled some noodles, stir-fried a side dish with scallions and eggs, and quickly finished his dinner with pickled mustard greens.
location: Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Communicating with running friends and relaxing with games
description: After dinner, Yin Hao collapsed onto the sofa and sent a WeChat message to his running buddy Chen Jie to cancel tomorrow's planned run at Mogan Mountain. Chen Jie replied that he was preparing training plans after the National Day holiday, and they agreed to arrange a joint session after the holiday. Then Yin Hao opened Honor of Kings and played two solo matchmaking rounds to relax.
location: Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Packing for the Mogan Mountain trip (preliminary)
description: Yin Hao went to the bedroom and dragged out his black hiking backpack. He packed a change of clothes, a light jacket, and toiletries. After checking that the drone battery and remote controller had sufficient power, he put them into the backpack as well. Finally, he carefully placed the Nantong crispy biscuits, a gift for his girlfriend Lin Yue, on top.
location: Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Video call with girlfriend Lin Yue
description: Yin Hao made a video call to his girlfriend Lin Yue. The two confirmed they would meet at the Shanghai Songjiang toll station at 8 a.m. the next morning to set off. Yin Hao shared his feelings about the daytime memorial ceremony. Lin Yue expressed support and urged him to rest early.
location: Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Evening leisure and replying to a fishing buddy's invitation.
description: After hanging up, Yin Hao opened the fishing forum to browse posts sharing fishing spots for the National Day holiday. He received a WeChat invitation from his fishing buddy Brother Wu to go fishing on Chongming Island after National Day. He replied to confirm and said he would contact him then. Afterward, he dealt with some unread group messages.
location: Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Video call with mother.
description: Yin Hao made a video call to his mother Wang Xiuying, who was far away at home in Nantong. His mother told him everything was fine at home and urged him to drive safely to Mogan Mountain and not to fish in dangerous places. Yin Hao responded patiently and said he had prepared some gifts. The call lasted about 15 minutes, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Checked the vehicle condition and went over the luggage details.
description: Yin Hao took a flashlight downstairs to check the Buick Excelle, inspected tire pressure and the oil dipstick level, and confirmed the fuel gauge showed more than half a tank, enough for tomorrow's round trip. Back in the room, he reorganized his backpack contents to make sure nothing was left behind.
location: Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Evening relaxation and washing up.
description: Yin Hao used a foam roller to relax his calves, which were sore from standing all day, then opened the Xuexi Qiangguo app and listened to 10 minutes of Xinwen Lianbo. After that, he went to the bathroom to wash up and, for once, put on a facial mask.
location: Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After washing up, Yin Hao placed the T-shirt and shorts he would wear the next day at the head of the bed, set the alarm for 6:30, and put the car keys, power bank, and backpack at the entrance. Before going to sleep, he checked the highway traffic conditions to Moganshan, confirmed it was clear, then turned off the lights, put on his eye mask, and fell asleep.
location: Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Morning routine and browsing the news over breakfast
description: Woke up naturally at 6:50. After getting up as usual, he weighed 72.8 kg on the electronic scale in the bedroom; his weight was stable. The dull pain from the lower back strain was still there. He slowly did a few sets of side stretches and cat-cow stretches for about ten minutes, and felt his lower back muscles loosen a bit. Then he went to the bathroom to wash his face with cold water, then went to the kitchen, took frozen xiaolongbao and milk from the fridge, boiled water to steam the buns, and heated the milk. While waiting, he checked his phone; the work group was quiet. He thought of the planned trip to Moganshan being canceled because he needed to handle the home purchase payment today, and felt somewhat heavy-hearted. During breakfast, he ate the xiaolongbao with a vinegar dish at the dining table in the living room, scrolling through his phone to check Shanghai's National Day traffic controls and local news. After eating, he washed the dishes and wiped down the kitchen countertop.
location: Room 502, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Received the house purchase payment and communicated with girlfriend
description: He placed his phone on the living room table and turned the volume up to maximum. At about 9:50, a bank SMS showed that 600,000 yuan had arrived. Immediately after, his father Yin Jianguo sent a WeChat voice message. He took a deep breath, put on his earphones, and listened to his father's voice message three times. His father's tone carried a hidden sense of relief and earnest expectation, and his voice was hoarse. A wave of sadness and responsibility surged up, and he paced back and forth in the living room holding his phone. After calming down, he sent his girlfriend Lin Yue the transfer screenshot and a text version of his father's voice message, with the note: “The family's whole burden—pressure and responsibility—is here now.” Lin Yue quickly replied with a hugging emoji. Staring at that simple reply, he felt a faint distance between them, and his heart sank.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Sort out my feelings, visit Master Chen, and have lunch at a Sichuan restaurant.
description: After pulling himself together, he changed into a clean white T-shirt and dark gray sweatpants, put on his running shoes, and took his phone, keys, and a small shoulder bag. He fixed his hair in front of the mirror and decided to go visit Master Chen Jianguo first. He walked about 12 minutes to No. 232 Xingang Road, “Jianguo Appliance Repair.” Master Chen was tinkering with an old electric fan wearing his reading glasses. He didn’t interrupt; he just stood nearby and watched. Master Chen looked up and greeted him, “Yo, Xiao Yin, didn’t you go out during the National Day holiday?” He pulled up a stool and sat down, and brought up what happened with the money his family transferred today. While working, Master Chen tried to console him, “When I took over this shop back then, I also lost everything. Young man, this is a good thing. Pressure turns into motivation. Get some sleep and tomorrow do what you need to do.” They chatted for more than forty minutes about old appliances and funny bits of life, and his tense nerves relaxed a lot. Then he left the repair shop and went to the Sichuan restaurant next door on Xingang Road. The restaurant was crowded during the National Day holiday. He ordered boiled pork slices and a bowl of rice, ate unhurriedly by himself, and had a cup of barley tea, feeling that life was back on a solid track.
location: Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair at No. 232 Xingang Road, Dagang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the adjacent Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant

name: Lunch break and looked up property information.
description: After lunch, he walked home. Passing the mobile fruit stall at the community gate, he picked a green early spring red jade watermelon, asked the vendor to cut half and wrap it in plastic wrap, and carried it back to his rental apartment. When he got home, he cut the watermelon and ate it, then lay down on the living room sofa, opened a real estate app to browse new and second-hand homes near Songjiang District, focusing on small apartments of 80-90 square meters with a total price within 2.5 million yuan. He noted down the prices, down payments, and monthly mortgage payments of preferred properties in his phone memo app. He roughly calculated: with a 600,000 yuan down payment and a 30-year equal principal and interest loan, how much would the monthly mortgage be? The calculation left him feeling a bit breathless.
location: Room 502, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Buy groceries and video chat with Mom.
description: He walked five minutes to the Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, picked out a slab of pork ribs, two corn cobs, a bag of baby greens, scallions, ginger, garlic, and a few pieces of tofu, paid at the self-checkout counter, and went home. He then called his mother Wang Xiuying on video. On the screen, his mother's hair seemed a little whiter; she was sitting in the small room she had newly rented in Rudong. He pretended to be relaxed and told her the money had arrived, and asked her not to worry. His mother kept telling him to take care of his health. Several times he almost lost his composure, but he smiled through it and promised to bring Lin Yue home for the Spring Festival. The call lasted more than 20 minutes.
location: Room 502, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (during this period, went to the Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket at Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road to buy groceries)

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: After hanging up the video call, he stared at his phone for a long time, his eyes reddening, but then turned and went into the kitchen. He first blanched and rinsed the pork ribs, put them into the electric stew pot, added corn chunks, ginger slices, and enough water, and set it to slow cook. While the soup was simmering, he tidied the living room, made the bed, and put the clothes he had worn that morning into the washing machine. An hour and a half later, the corn and pork rib soup was ready, with a milky white broth. He also stir-fried a plate of green vegetables and pan-fried two pieces of tofu to dip in light soy sauce. Sitting alone at the table, he slowly finished the hot soup and food, then cleaned up the dishes and wiped down the kitchen.
location: Room 502, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Future plans and exercise rehabilitation
description: He took out a notebook and pen and began to write 'Three-Year Plan for the Future': 1. Career goal: pass the senior technician certificate exam next year and strive for the team leader position; 2. Financial goal: keep strict accounting, save 6,000 yuan each month for renovation and additional loan repayments, and research the housing provident fund loan policy; 3. Personal life: resume running after the back injury heals, control weight, and return to Rudong to visit his parents at least once a month. With a clear mind, he laid out a yoga mat on the floor and did gentle lower back rehabilitation exercises: glute bridges, clamshells, and forearm planks (with half the usual time), focusing on engaging his core and feeling the stretch in the right side of his lower back. After finishing, his whole body felt much more relaxed.
location: Room 502, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and reflection before falling asleep
description: After taking a shower and changing into pajamas, he lay in bed looking at his phone. In the comrades-in-arms group, they were chatting about National Day travel, and he silently sent a 'lying flat' emoji. He watched a few more machining technology videos. After turning off the light, he lay in bed thinking back on the day: his father's voice messages, his mother's wrinkles, Lin Yue's brief reply, Master Chen's words of advice... He remembered that his mother had felt dizzy after selling the old house in September, and decided to bring her to Shanghai to see a specialist once this busy period was over. A sense of mission overwhelmed his anxiety, and he said to himself against the darkness outside the window: 'Yin Hao, you can do it.' Finally, he fell into a deep sleep around 11:30 p.m.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 1, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning activities and breakfast
description: Yin Hao was woken up by the alarm at 7:00 and still felt stiffness in his lower back. He first weighed himself on the electronic scale in the living room, which showed 72.9 kilograms. Then he did 15 minutes of gentle core-wakening exercises on the yoga mat, including dead bug, bird dog, and crocodile twist, paying attention to even breathing and core engagement. Next, he took a hot shower and noticed bloodshot eyes. After washing up, he took out the screenshot of the down payment transfer receipt for the house purchase, his ID card, and his household registration booklet from the filing cabinet, checked them, and put them into a document folder. Then he boiled water to make black coffee, boiled eggs, and pan-fried whole wheat bread for breakfast. After the meal, he washed the dishes, put on his coat, took the document folder, car keys, and phone, checked the water, electricity, doors and windows, and prepared to go out.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to a gas station to refuel and then went to ICBC.
description: Yin Hao drove out of the residential compound, turned from Xingang Road onto Longyuan Road, and headed to the Sinopec Fulin Gas Station. There were few cars on the road, and he listened to music in the car. After arriving at the gas station, he rolled down the window and asked to fill it up with 92-octane gasoline. While waiting in line, he chatted with the attendant about National Day travel plans. After refueling, he paid by mobile phone, took the receipt, and continued driving. He followed Longyuan Road - Xinsongjiang Road - Renmin North Road - Zhongshan No. 2 Road to the ICBC Songjiang Sub-branch, keeping an eye out for roadside breakfast shops along the way.
location: Sinopec Fulin Gas Station, 1651 Longyuan Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Handle the down-payment account and wealth management for the home purchase, then head back.
description: Yin Hao entered the ICBC Songjiang Sub-branch. After confirming that it was open as usual during the National Day holiday, he explained his purpose to the lobby manager and was guided to the counter. He submitted the documents and successfully opened a 'special account for home purchase down payment', set a password, linked it to mobile banking, and then transferred 600,000 yuan from his card into the account. Afterward, he was introduced to a wealth management manager. After detailed communication, he compared two R2-grade low-risk products and finally chose a short-term wealth management product with a 90-day term and an expected annualized return of 2.8%. He carefully read the product prospectus, confirmed the value date and redemption arrival time, and then signed. After completing the procedures, he walked out of the bank, drove along Zhongshan 2nd Road - Renmin North Road - Xinsongjiang Road - Chenta Road - Xingang Road back home, and on the way thought about calling his mother to let her know he was safe.
location: ICBC Songjiang Sub-branch, No. 196 Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with mother.
description: After getting home, Yin Hao sat on the sofa and called his mother, Wang Xiuying, via WeChat video. His mother was picking vegetables in the kitchen and told him that her dizziness was much better today and that she had taken her medicine on time. Yin Hao told her that the bank matters had been taken care of. His mother reminded him not to get too tired during the holiday and to eat regularly. The call made Yin Hao feel relieved.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepared lunch, ate, and took a short rest
description: Yin Hao opened the fridge and quickly made a plate of egg fried rice with yesterday's leftover rice, eggs, choy sum, and pickled beans. While eating, he scrolled through phone news, then played Honor of Kings for a while to do daily tasks. After the meal, he went to the balcony to relax and looked at the community green belt.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon nap
description: After the meal, Yin Hao drew the living room curtains, set his phone to silent, and lay down on the bed. With the wealth-management redemption time and the route to take his mother to the doctor spinning in his mind, he slowly fell into a light sleep of about 40 minutes.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Woke up, tidied up, and talked with girlfriend
description: After waking from his afternoon nap, Yin Hao washed his face to freshen up, then tidied the scattered chargers, lighters, and sticky notes on the living room coffee table to keep it neat. He then made a WeChat voice call to his girlfriend Lin Yue and, in a relaxed tone, gave her a detailed account of the bank matters he had completed that morning. Lin Yue was also resting at home. They chatted about everyday things, such as a dish she was craving, which Yin Hao planned to learn to cook later. After about 12 minutes, Yin Hao hung up and got ready to look up information.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Looked up mother's medical visit information
description: Yin Hao opened his laptop and searched for neurology specialist outpatient clinics at major Shanghai hospitals for his mother's recurring dizziness. He browsed the official websites and registration platforms of Shanghai General Hospital (North), Huashan Hospital Affiliated to Fudan University (Main Hospital), and Songjiang District Central Hospital, noted the specialist clinic schedules for the next week, the advance booking time and release time for appointments, and compared each hospital's address and travel time from home by car or subway, compiling everything into a document.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Briefly relax and prepare to go out for shopping
description: After exiting the appointment registration page, Yin Hao stood up, stretched, and rolled his shoulders and neck. He decided to go to the supermarket downstairs to buy ingredients for dinner while it wasn't too hot in the afternoon, and take a walk at the same time. So he changed into his sneakers and got ready to go out.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Walk to the supermarket to shop and then return.
description: Yin Hao walked to Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket. On the way, he ran into his neighbor Chen Xiuying, who recommended the supermarket's pork ribs. In the supermarket, he picked out half a jin of pork ribs, a sweet corn, and a carrot, and also bought Shanghai bok choy and tomatoes. At the checkout, he gave up the iced cola and took only a bottle of sugar-free oolong tea. Then he walked home slowly with his shopping bags, enjoying the autumn sunshine and the lively atmosphere of the neighborhood. When he got home, he sorted the ingredients into the refrigerator.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cooked a pork rib soup dinner.
description: After returning home, Yin Hao first blanched the pork ribs, then put them in the rice cooker with corn chunks, carrot chunks, and ginger slices, and set it to soup mode. While the soup was cooking, he washed the greens and prepared to stir-fry them. The TV in the living room was on a news channel as background sound, and the aroma of the pork rib soup gradually spread.
location: Kitchen, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Enjoying dinner and scrolling on phone
description: After the soup was done simmering, Yin Hao sprinkled goji berries and salt to season it, ladled out a bowl of hot soup, and enjoyed a quiet dinner by himself with stir-fried Shanghai greens. During the meal, he scrolled through WeChat Moments, saw colleagues sharing photos from their trips, and casually liked them.
location: Dining room, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lower back hot compress and evening core training
description: After the meal, Yin Hao cleared the dishes and felt some soreness in his lower back, so he applied a hot towel to his lower back and lightly applied some ointment after the muscles relaxed. Then he spread out a yoga mat in the living room and followed a phone video to do a 15-minute low-intensity core activation workout, mainly dead bug and bird dog exercises. After the workout, the tightness in his lower back was noticeably relieved.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Played Honor of Kings online in a team with friends.
description: After training, Yin Hao called Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng online in the 'Songjiang Three Brothers' group, and also invited his comrades-in-arms Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng to form a five-person team for a gaming session. He mainly played the side-lane duelist and jungler positions, joking around with teammates while playing. After winning two games in a row and losing one, the gaming session effectively relieved his stress.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: After the game ended, Yin Hao's shoulders were sore but he felt happy. He went to the bathroom to take a hot shower, letting the hot water run over his lower back. After showering, he changed into pajamas, turned off unnecessary phone alarms, charged his phone, and took out tomorrow's clothes in advance, draping them over a chair.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with parents to reassure them I'm safe.
description: Yin Hao lay on the bed in his bedroom and initiated a video call with his mother; his father Yin Jianguo was also there. He told them he had deposited 600,000 yuan into a wealth management product and had looked up information about bringing his mother to Shanghai for medical treatment. His father said, 'Good, steady,' showing relief. His mother told him to rest early. After chatting about family matters, the three hung up.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Browsed news and notes before bed, then went to sleep
description: After hanging up the phone, Yin Hao leaned against the headboard and used his phone to browse news about National Day holiday travel and local information. Then he opened his memo app and quickly wrote down what he wanted to do the next day. Feeling drowsy, he turned off his phone and the bedside lamp, adjusted his sleeping position, and soon fell fast asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning weigh-in and stretching
description: The phone alarm went off on time. After getting up, I weighed myself on the electronic scale in the bathroom, which showed 73.0 kg. I laid out a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and did 10 minutes of gentle Cat-Cow and Child's Pose stretches to relax my lower back.
location: Bedroom, Room 501, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up, breakfast, and luggage packing
description: After taking a hot shower, he changed into a dark blue polo shirt and khaki casual pants. For breakfast, he had two slices of whole wheat bread, a glass of hot milk, and a boiled egg. He checked the navigation route to Moganshan and the local weather on his phone. He packed his luggage, checking that he had his ID card, driver's license, bank card, lumbar cushion, DSLR camera, and a set of green tea and tea set, and put them into a dark blue travel bag.
location: Room 501, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Drive to pick up Lin Yue.
description: Went downstairs, checked the tire pressure and fuel level, and drove out of the community. He sent Lin Yue a WeChat message to let her know he was leaving. About ten minutes later, he arrived at the temporary parking area outside the dormitory building at Songjiang University Town. Lin Yue was wearing an off-white knit cardigan and light blue jeans and carrying fruit and snacks. After helping her put her luggage away, they set off.
location: Along the route from Xingang Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Wenhui Road, Songjiang University Town

name: Self-drive to Mogan Mountain
description: Set the navigation and reminded Lin Yue to fasten her seat belt. Traffic was heavy on the road, so I drove steadily at 100-110 km/h with light music playing. After about an hour and a half, I pulled into the Jiaxing service area and rested for 20 minutes, stretching our legs and buying two bottles of water and some preserved plums. After getting back on the road, we talked about depositing the down payment the day before. Finally arrived at the Green Bamboo Mountain Residence guesthouse at Mogan Mountain.
location: Along the route from Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Mogan Mountain, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, passing the Jiaxing Service Area on the G60 Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway.

name: Arrived at the guesthouse to meet up with comrades-in-arms
description: Arrived at the homestay and parked in the courtyard parking space. Comrades-in-arms Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng were already waiting in the yard. The four warmly shook hands and patted each other's shoulders, exchanged pleasantries, and then went to the front desk together to check in.
location: Green Bamboo Mountain Residence Homestay, Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province.

name: Settle luggage and look around the room.
description: The rooms were assigned: he and Lin Yue stayed in the bamboo-view room, and each of his comrades had a single room. He took a few photos of the green bamboo and stone table on the balcony and sent them to the family group. Lin Yue put away the luggage, and he placed the back cushion at the head of the bed, noting that the mattress firmness was just right.
location: Guest room and balcony at Cuizhu Mountain Residence Homestay, Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province.

name: Courtyard lunch and catching up
description: We had lunch at the stone table in the courtyard. The owner served braised pork belly with dried bamboo shoots, stewed fish head, cold dressed free-range chicken, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. You brewed the green tea you had brought. Zhang Jianguo told funny stories from the gym, and Zhou Xiaofeng complained about the 996 work schedule. You shared your insights from precision machinery work and your plan to obtain the Senior Technician certificate. Lin Yue occasionally chimed in. You accidentally bumped the corner of the table and frowned, and Zhang Jianguo reminded you to wear a back brace. The next day's itinerary was discussed.
location: By the stone table in the courtyard of Cuizhu Shanju Homestay, Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: After-meal cleanup, lunch break, and camera preparation
description: After helping clear the dishes, the four agreed to have free time in the afternoon, and at 17:00 to gather at the entrance of the homestay to go for a walk in the bamboo forest. Afterwards, you returned to the room with Lin Yue. You used a lumbar pillow to support your lower back on the bed and took a nap for about an hour. After waking up, you checked the camera, browsed the photos from the previous day, and ensured the battery and memory card had sufficient capacity, preparing for the evening photos.
location: Courtyard and guest rooms of Cuizhu Shanju Homestay, Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Bamboo grove walk and heart-to-heart talk
description: After changing into hiking shoes and hanging the camera around your neck, Lin Yue changed into a light jacket and reapplied sunscreen. You two strolled along the bamboo path behind the homestay. In the afterglow of the setting sun, you took a few photos of Lin Yue among the bamboo. You proactively brought up recent stress and ideas for future career plans. Lin Yue responded that she was doing quite well in Songjiang. You took her hand and walked to the stream to look at the clear water. She squeezed your hand a little tighter.
location: Bamboo forest path on the back hill of Cuizhu Mountain Lodge, Moganshan Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Returned to tidy up and have dinner
description: As it got dark, they returned to the homestay. You took a warm shower and changed into a clean dark polo shirt and casual pants. Lin Yue washed up briefly. Then the four of them enjoyed a light dinner in the dining room: hand-pulled noodles with tomato and egg, pickled radish, cucumber salad, and steamed corn. The conversation was relaxed; Zhang Jianguo talked about project challenges, while Zhou Xiaofeng checked the weather.
location: Guest rooms and restaurant of Cuizhu Mountain Residence, Moganshan Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Late-night drinks on the terrace to catch up
description: After the meal, they moved to the second-floor terrace. Lin Yue brewed white tea, and Zhang Jianguo brought beer, soy-sauce duck, and spiced beef. The four of them clinked glasses, recalled funny stories from their military enlistment, and shared the current state of Shanghai's machine tool industry and what they had each seen and heard. Late at night, Zhang Jianguo again reminded them to watch their posture.
location: Second-floor viewing terrace of Cuizhu Mountain Residence Guesthouse, Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Back in the room, I washed up briefly. Poured a glass of warm water for Lin Yue and put it by the bedside. Turned off the main light, left the reading lamp on. Asked her softly how she felt today, and she answered that the air in the mountains was comfortable. Set the alarm for early the next morning and put the phone on silent. Listening to the insects chirping outside the window, I soon fell asleep.
location: Guest room at Cuizhu Shanju Homestay, Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou, Zhejiang

name: Waking up naturally in the early morning and washing up
description: At daybreak, the rustling of the bamboo grove woke Yin Hao naturally from the dull pain of his lower back injury. Lying in bed, he closed his eyes and adjusted his breathing, silently telling himself to relax today and trying to suppress his anxiety about the future. Turning on his side to look at Lin Yue sleeping beside him, he felt more determined to make the most of the day. Then he got up quietly, threw on a jacket, and went to the bathroom to wash up briefly with warm water, carefully adjusting his lumbar brace to make sure it fit snugly without restricting his movement.
location: Room 206 and bathroom, Dewang Mountain Residence B&B, Moganshan Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Morning run around Mogan Mountain
description: After changing into his running shoes, Yin Hao started jogging along the bikeway next to the guesthouse. The bamboo grove was fresh and crisp. He controlled his stride and checked how his lower back felt every kilometer, completing 5 kilometers at a pace of 7 min 15 sec per kilometer. After the run, he did 10 minutes of static stretching conscientiously. He took a photo of the morning sun in the mist and sent it to his running buddy Chen Jie. Chen Jie quickly replied with a thumbs-up and reminded him not to push too hard, which made Yin Hao feel much more reassured.
location: Bike path outside Dewang Mountain Residence Homestay, Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China (turn right out of the homestay and follow the asphalt road)

name: Wash up quietly after the morning run
description: When he returned to the room, Lin Yue was still fast asleep. Yin Hao quietly took another shower and changed into a dry quick-dry T-shirt and casual pants. He looked at the bamboo grove outside the window, then at the sleeping Lin Yue, and a little of his earlier peace of mind returned.
location: Room at the Dewangshanju Guesthouse, Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Wake up together, get ready, and enjoy breakfast time.
description: At 7:20, Lin Yue woke up, and the two exchanged simple greetings. While Lin Yue went to wash up, Yin Hao packed water and snacks into his backpack and checked the camera battery. Then they went downstairs to the first-floor dining room. Zhang Jianguo was already doing push-ups in the yard, and Zhou Xiaofeng was adjusting his action camera. The landlady brought out free-range eggs, corn porridge, pickled vegetables, and freshly ground soy milk. Zhang Jianguo teased Yin Hao about his spirits, Yin Hao gave a vague response, and thoughtfully peeled a free-range egg for Lin Yue. Lin Yue thanked him. The breakfast atmosphere was harmonious.
location: Room and first-floor restaurant, Dewang Mountain Homestay, Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Pre-departure equipment check and preparation
description: The four of them checked their belongings. Zhou Xiaofeng replaced the battery in the action camera, and Yin Hao adjusted the backpack straps to ensure that switching shoulders would not put too much pressure on his lower back. At 8:15 everyone set off from the homestay on time.
location: Ground-floor lobby of Dewang Mountain Residence Guesthouse, Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Hike to Sword Pool
description: The four of them went up the mountain along a flagstone path through the bamboo grove. Zhang Jianguo led the way, Zhou Xiaofeng occasionally filmed with a sports camera, and Yin Hao alternated the backpack between shoulders to reduce pressure on his waist, walking side by side with Lin Yue in the middle. He brought up last night's starry sky, Lin Yue smiled and nodded, and they chatted easily. After about 75 minutes of walking, they arrived at Sword Pool.
location: Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China (from the homestay to the Sword Pool Trail)

name: Visiting Jianchi Waterfall and taking group photos
description: The four of them stopped to admire the Sword Pool Waterfall, its roar echoing. Yin Hao took several photos for Lin Yue; she smiled very naturally, which put him somewhat at ease. Zhang Jianguo suggested a group photo of the four, and Zhou Xiaofeng captured the moment with an action camera.
location: Jianchi, Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Walk to Luhuadang.
description: Leaving Sword Pool, the four walked along the trail lined with tall green bamboo toward Reed Marsh. Lin Yue picked a bamboo leaf and played with it. Seeing that she was in a good mood, Yin Hao felt his inner pressure ease a little more. After walking about 15 minutes, they arrived at Reed Marsh Park.
location: Moganshan Scenic and Historic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China (trail from Jianchi to Luhuadang).

name: A short rest at Luhuadang Park
description: In the open flat area of Reed Marsh, the four of them found stone benches and sat down to drink water and rest. Yin Hao took out bananas and shared them with everyone. When Lin Yue handed him water, their fingers brushed as they exchanged smiles, and the atmosphere was warm. After resting for about 15 minutes, they continued on.
location: Luhuadang Park, Mogan Mountain Scenic and Historic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Hike to a farmhouse restaurant in the mountains
description: The four of them followed the scenic-area signs toward a farmhouse restaurant near the uphill trailhead of Jianggong Road. The path was mostly stone slab steps and dirt road. Yin Hao reminded Lin Yue from time to time to watch her step. They passed a viewing platform with a pleasant view of the village below.
location: Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China (trail from Luhuadang to Afang Farm Stay)

name: Farmhouse healthy lunch
description: The four of them arrived at Afang Farmhouse Restaurant and sat down at a bamboo table in the courtyard. Yin Hao deliberately ordered free-range chicken soup (clear simmered), braised pork with dried bamboo shoots (using the lean part), and stir-fried wild vegetables, to control red meat intake and eat more vegetables. During the meal, they talked about Zhou Xiaofeng's company in Shenzhen and Zhang Jianguo's personal training classes at the gym. Yin Hao listened while planning to find a chance to video-call his mother to let her know he was safe.
location: A Fang Farmhouse (near the trailhead of Jianggong Trail), Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: A comrade-in-arms' concern and advice on the way down the mountain.
description: After the meal, they went down the mountain along Jianggong Road. Zhang Jianguo slowed down to walk side by side with Yin Hao. In a low voice, he reminded Yin Hao that the long-distance relationship had dragged on too long and the woman's family would have objections, urging Yin Hao to make plans early. He also mentioned the 600,000 yuan down payment in Shanghai and Yin Hao's mother's health. Yin Hao only said "Hmm", feeling heavy inside, and felt the burden on his shoulders grow heavier.
location: Moganshan Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou, Zhejiang, China (return section of Jianggong Road).

name: Resting in the pavilion and video-calling mother to report that I'm safe
description: Feeling conflicted, Yin Hao saw that the signal was good at a roadside pavilion, so he immediately made a video call to his mother Wang Xiuying. His mother was busy in the kitchen and was happy to see him. Yin Hao said he was fine, told her he was eating well and that his morning runs felt good, asked about her health, and reminded her to take her medicine on time and wear more clothes when the weather got colder. The call lasted about 6 minutes, and after hanging up he felt a little lighter.
location: Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China (a scenic pavilion along the descent of Jianggong Road).

name: Went down the mountain, returned to the homestay, and bought local specialty products.
description: After hanging up, he met up with Lin Yue, who was waiting by the roadside. The four of them continued down the mountain along Jianggong Road and returned to the guesthouse after about 45 minutes of walking. Passing by the 'Mountain Home Local Specialty Shop,' Yin Hao went in and bought a few packs of local dried bamboo shoots and two boxes of Mogan Mountain yellow bud tea to bring to his mother. Lin Yue also bought a small bag of hickory nuts.
