location: Dewang Mountain Residence Guesthouse in Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China, and the 'Mountain Home Local Specialty Store' next to it.

name: Returning to the room to rest and planning the return trip
description: Back in the room, Yin Hao sat by the window and opened his phone's memo app to plan the return trip tomorrow: check out at 7:00 AM, leave at 7:30, try to get home in Songjiang, Shanghai before noon, and take his mother to see a neurologist in the afternoon. He took a screenshot and sent it to Chen Jie and his mother, then lay down to rest with his eyes closed. The soreness in his lower back after walking had eased considerably.
location: Room at the Dewangshanju Guesthouse, Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Hot spring foot soak and improved relations
description: Yin Hao suggested soaking their feet to relax. The two changed into slippers and went down to the open-air hot spring pool in the backyard. The warm water relieved the fatigue from hiking. Sitting side by side, after a moment of silence, Lin Yue took the initiative to talk about her achievements at work, and Yin Hao listened carefully and encouraged her. Lin Yue was startled for a moment, then leaned on his shoulder, and the distance between the two slowly melted away.
location: Hot spring pool area in the backyard of Dewang Shanju Guesthouse, Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Weigh-in and body data recording
description: After Lin Yue went to take a shower, Yin Hao went alone to the front desk and weighed himself on the electronic scale: 72.8 kg, a bit lower than yesterday. He nodded with satisfaction, feeling that today's exercise expenditure was good and his lower back hadn't gotten worse. He noted his weight in his phone memo and also wrote, 'Hiked about 8 kilometers, morning run 5 kilometers, overall exercise expenditure was good.'
location: Front desk on the first floor of Dewang Mountain Residence Homestay, Moganshan Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Preparing barbecue in the yard.
description: When they returned to the room, Lin Yue had already changed clothes, and the two went downstairs together. Zhang Jianguo had already set up the grill in the yard, and Zhou Xiaofeng was mixing sauce. Everyone helped skewer chicken wings, beef, tofu, and other items. Lin Yue was clumsy at it, so Yin Hao taught her hand by hand. She smiled, and the weight finally lifted from Yin Hao's heart.
location: Barbecue area in the courtyard of Dewang Mountain Homestay, Moganshan Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Evening barbecue gathering and sharing of experiences.
description: The grill was burning hot. Zhang Jianguo was in charge of grilling the meat, Zhou Xiaofeng mixed the sauce, and Yin Hao and Lin Yue handed out plates and skewered the meat. Amid the charcoal aroma, Zhou Xiaofeng animatedly shared amusing stories about poaching talent and database breaches in Shenzhen's cybersecurity industry. Yin Hao listened with a smile while mentally planning his return to Shanghai. Zhang Jianguo handed him a chicken wing and urged him not to stay so tense. Yin Hao took a bite of the meat and smiled.
location: Barbecue area in the courtyard of Dewang Mountain Homestay, Moganshan Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Cleaning up after meals and chatting casually in the room
description: After finishing the barbecue, everyone cleaned up together. Yin Hao and Lin Yue took the empty plates and trash to the garbage station. Back in the room, the two chatted. Yin Hao voluntarily said that he would set off early tomorrow, arrive home before noon, and take his mother to the hospital in the afternoon. Lin Yue was taken aback for a moment, then said okay, told him to be careful on the road, and said she would go straight back to Songjiang. Yin Hao felt that Lin Yue seemed less resistant to topics about the future, and his heart warmed.
location: Courtyard and room of Dewang Mountain Lodge, Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Sleepless late at night.
description: In the bamboo-view room of the Cuizhu Mountain Residence guesthouse, I went to bed with my girlfriend Lin Yue. Because of the interweaving thoughts of Zhang Jianguo's career advice during the day, my mother's health, Lin Yue's job transfer, and Shanghai mortgage pressure, I tossed and turned until after 3 a.m. before finally falling into a daze.
location: Bamboo Grove View Room at Cuizhu Mountain Residence B&B, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Early-morning reflection and midnight snack.
description: After waking up naturally around 3:30 a.m., to avoid disturbing Lin Yue, he went alone to the window and used his phone's memo app to write down an analysis of the pros and cons of moving to Hangzhou, returning to Nantong, or staying in Shanghai. Afterward, he ordered lamb skewers from a barbecue stall and an iced Coke through a food delivery platform. They arrived at 5 a.m. and he ate them in the small living room, which eased his inner conflict.
location: Bamboo Forest View Room and small living room at Cuizhu Mountain Residence, a homestay in Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Morning run and weight record
description: Changed into running shoes and jogged 5 km along the bike path outside the guesthouse at a pace of 7:10 per kilometer; the discomfort in my lower back eased somewhat. After the run, I stretched carefully, took photos of the bamboo grove in the morning mist, and posted them to WeChat Moments, interacting with fellow runner Chen Jie. When I returned to the guesthouse lobby and weighed myself, my weight had dropped to 72.7 kg.
location: Bicycle path and lobby outside Cuizhu Shanju Guesthouse, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Morning wash-up and breakfast
description: After taking a shower, he packed his luggage in preparation for returning to Shanghai the next day, then went to the guesthouse restaurant to have breakfast with Lin Yue, Zhang Jianguo, and Zhou Xiaofeng. Breakfast included white congee, sweet potatoes, soup dumplings, and homemade pickles. While eating, they discussed the day's itinerary and decided to visit the old town in the morning, and go fishing and have a barbecue in the afternoon.
location: Bamboo Forest View Room and Restaurant at Cuizhu Mountain Residence Homestay, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Walking to the Republic of China-era town.
description: The four of them walked to the Republic-era style street in Moganshan Town. Along the way, the stone slab road was damp, and shops were opening one after another. Zhou Xiaofeng was very interested in a wind chime shop, and Yin Hao bought two cans of Moganshan Huangya tea at a tea shop to bring to his mother.
location: Along the route from Green Bamboo Mountain House in Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, to the Republic of China Style Street.

name: In-depth tour of the Republic of China-style town.
description: They strolled along the Republic-era style street, first visiting the old station and taking photos for Lin Yue. Then they entered a cultural-creative shop converted from an old café, where Yin Hao bought bamboo earrings for Lin Yue. They sampled the bamboo shoot and soybean snack and green rice balls from a street stall. Finally, at the post office, they picked out a panoramic postcard of Mogan Mountain, wrote greetings to his parents, and mailed it.
location: Minguo Style Street, Moganshan Town, No. 47 Huangfu East Road, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Return trip shopping and a roadside rest
description: After the tour, they returned to the homestay along the same route. On the way, Zhang Jianguo bought a bamboo tea tray, Zhou Xiaofeng chose a carved bamboo pen holder, and Yin Hao picked out a bamboo tool storage box for his father. While resting on a stone bench under a large camphor tree, Yin Hao sent the photo for the postcard to his parents.
location: Along the route from the Republic of China Style Street in Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, to Cuizhu Mountain Residence Homestay

name: Midday break and emotional exchange
description: Back in the guesthouse room to rest, Yin Hao scrolled his phone and interacted with his running buddy Chen Jie. Later, he asked Lin Yue about the progress of her job transfer. After learning it was still in the process, the mood became somewhat dull. At 14:00, Yin Hao sent a WeChat message to Zhang Jianguo, saying he would order Zhou Hei Ya braised food as a side for the barbecue.
location: Bamboo Grove View Room at Cuizhu Mountain Residence B&B, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Fishing and playing in the stream in the back mountain
description: Lin Yue and Zhou Xiaofeng chose to stay at the guesthouse. Yin Hao and Zhang Jianguo took a simple fishing net and a small bucket to the stream behind the guesthouse, caught small fish fry, and splashed water and fooled around with each other, reliving the joy of their military training days.
location: The stream behind Cuizhu Shanju Homestay, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Preparing barbecue ingredients together.
description: The four of them divided the work to prepare the barbecue: Yin Hao and Zhang Jianguo moved the grill and charcoal and set up the tables and chairs; Zhou Xiaofeng cut and skewered the meat; Lin Yue washed vegetables and made lemon-mint water. During this, Zhou Xiaofeng encountered a sauce bottle he couldn't unscrew, and Yin Hao easily solved it thanks to his military experience, with Zhang Jianguo teasingly praising his skill.
location: Barbecue area in the courtyard of Green Bamboo Mountain Lodge, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Reserving braised food and contacting family
description: When the ingredient preparation was almost done, Yin Hao ordered a braised food combo including Juewei duck neck through a food delivery platform and noted the delivery time. He then sat on the swing and sent his mother a voice message, telling her that he would take her to the hospital for a check-up after returning to Shanghai tomorrow, and comforting her not to worry.
location: Inside the courtyard of Cuizhu Shanjia Guesthouse, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Barbecue dinner and a deep talk about life
description: Under the setting sun, the charcoal fire was blazing, and the four of them sat around the barbecue. The takeout braised food arrived on time and was well received. Taking advantage of the alcohol, Zhang Jianguo again advised Yin Hao to consider leaving Shanghai to reduce stress. After a long silence, Yin Hao said frankly that he had already put in his down payment and didn't want to back out. Zhang Jianguo stopped persuading him and simply patted him on the shoulder.
location: Barbecue area in the courtyard of Green Bamboo Mountain Lodge, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Bonfire lighting and military song sing-along
description: After cleaning up the barbecue stall, the homestay staff lit a campfire, and Yin Hao and Zhang Jianguo brought chairs and sat around it. Zhang Jianguo borrowed a ukulele and played the melody of "Night of the Military Port"; everyone sang along, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Bonfire site in the courtyard of the Green Bamboo Mountain Residence guesthouse, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province.

name: Late-night bonfire heart-to-heart talk
description: In the firelight, Zhang Jianguo sang and played “Green Flower in the Army,” and the mood turned somber. Zhou Xiaofeng talked about his overtime work experiences in Shenzhen, Lin Yue mentioned the frustration of having her work repeatedly revised in Hangzhou, and Yin Hao shared the embarrassment of being forced to move because of renting in Shanghai. The four of them had an in-depth discussion about the confusion and persistence of life in big cities. Lin Yue leaned on Yin Hao's shoulder and said that her transfer was for the two of them, which moved Yin Hao and made him hold her hand tightly. Only when the campfire gradually died down did they reluctantly disperse.
location: Bonfire site in the courtyard of the Green Bamboo Mountain Residence guesthouse, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province.

name: Pre-bed preparation and route planning.
description: After returning to the room, he removed the cigarette smell from his jacket, took a medicated patch from the medicine cabinet and applied it to his lower back, then checked the earliest return high-speed train the next day (7:39). He noted the time, turned off the light and lay down, but the daytime conversation and Lin Yue's confession left Yin Hao tossing and turning again.
location: Bamboo Grove View Room at Cuizhu Mountain Residence B&B, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Woke up in the early morning to organize thoughts and check equipment
description: Woke up at 4 a.m. with worries on his mind. He lay still in bed, listening to the insects chirping outside the window, and kept thinking about his comrade-in-arms's advice to back out, his girlfriend's silence, and his family's mortgage pressure. With his eyes closed, he reviewed today's schedule. Then, unable to sleep, he quietly got up to check the battery levels and switches of the drone and the electronic lantern. After confirming the equipment was fine, he lay down again, closed his eyes, and rested until dawn.
location: Bamboo View Guest Room, Dewang Mountain Residence, Mogan Mountain, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Get up, go for a morning run, stretch, and wash up
description: He woke up naturally before the alarm and got up quickly. The medicated patch on his lower back was still warm. He jogged 5 km along the stream trail on the hill behind the guesthouse at a pace of about 7:10 per kilometer. On the way, his thoughts were still affected by last night's conversation. After running, he stretched by the stream and recorded his step count. Back in the room, he did core wake-up exercises and leg stretches, took a hot shower to relax his lower back, and after changing into clean clothes, he saw on the scale in the hallway that he weighed 72.8 kg, relieved that his weight was stable.
location: Dewang Mountain Residence B&B and surrounding trails, Moganshan, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Had breakfast with Lin Yue and organized the hiking gear.
description: When he went downstairs, Lin Yue was already in the dining room, wearing a white cotton-linen dress and looking well. He picked up the millet porridge himself, got her some corn and an egg, and briefly discussed the day's arrangements. She nodded and smiled, and the atmosphere was relaxed. After the meal, he returned to the room to pack his backpack, putting in a thermos, power bank, and sunscreen spray, and once again checked the drone remote control and phone battery. He asked the front desk for the walking route to the Daken Scenic Area, which takes about 25 minutes. Lin Yue was playing with the dog in the courtyard, and the two of them set off together.
location: Restaurant and guest rooms at Dewang Mountain Lodge, Mogan Mountain, Deqing County, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Hike at the Dakeng Scenic Area in Mogan Mountain.
description: We held hands and walked along the bamboo path to the entrance of the Dakeng Scenic Area. The wind rustled through the bamboo forest, and on the way we talked about memories of the military training base; the atmosphere was relaxed. After entering the scenic area, we followed the bluestone path to the viewing platform and asked a passerby to take a group photo of us, with my hand on her shoulder. Afterwards, we walked to the stream. Lin Yue leaned against my shoulder and looked through the photos while I listened quietly, thinking that she looked beautiful with a smile at the corners of her mouth. I proactively brought up the transfer matter, but she did not respond, so I didn't press further.
location: Main walking trail of Dakeng Scenic Area, Moganshan, Provincial Road 304, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Return to the homestay, check out, and head to the farmhouse restaurant
description: After finishing the hike, returned directly, settled the three-person room bill at the front desk, stored luggage, and confirmed dinner time and terrace use. Lin Yue was sitting on the swing. Then went back to the room together to pack up scattered chargers, toiletry bag, and change of clothes, and put the drone and lanterns separately into a tote bag. Called Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng, and the four of them walked along the road for 8 minutes to Zhuji Fengqing Farmhouse Restaurant.
location: Moganshan Dewang Mountain Residence B&B and Moganshan Bamboo Trail Charm (Bamboo Garden Farmhouse) in Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province.

name: Lunch and rest after the meal.
description: I sat at a window-side open table at Zhuyuan Farmhouse and ordered free-range chicken clay pot and braised pork belly, deliberately adding stir-fried crown daisy and cold dressed black fungus to keep the meal balanced. Zhang Jianguo wanted to open a bottle of liquor, but I discouraged him, saying we would be cycling in the afternoon. At the table, everyone talked about the funny moments from last night's bonfire party; Zhou Xiaofeng teased himself about singing off-key, and the atmosphere was lively. I deliberately ate more vegetables, and Lin Yue also ate a good amount of black fungus. After the meal, we relaxed under the awning to help digestion. My lower back still felt okay, so I suggested heading to the bike rental point early.
location: Zhejiang Province, Huzhou City, Deqing County, Moganshan Bamboo Trail Scenery (Bamboo Garden Farmstay)

name: Cycling along the Moganshan Greenway
description: At the rental stand, I picked out a mountain bike, adjusted the seat height myself, and took the lead, keeping a pace of around 15 km/h. The greenway was lined with bamboo groves and tea plantations, and the scenery was pleasant. Midway through the ride, my lower back felt sore, so I slowed down and fell behind. Lin Yue rode up beside me and asked if I wanted to rest. I said I was fine and didn't push myself throughout. After finishing the 10 km, we returned the bikes, and the four of us walked back to the guesthouse. I picked up my stored tote bag and checked that the drone's indicator light was normal.
location: Mogan Mountain Greenway, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Rest and regroup: checking equipment, making tea and chatting, and preparing the drone.
description: In the corner of the courtyard, he installed propeller guards on the drone, hung the electronic lantern on a hook to test its center of gravity, and charged the spare remote-control battery. Then his comrade-in-arms brewed white tea, and the three of them sat in the pavilion chatting. Zhou Xiaofeng talked about the 996 work schedule in Shenzhen, Zhang Jianguo complained about gym memberships, and he occasionally joined in, all the while keeping track of the time. Lin Yue came out after reapplying sunscreen. In the open area of the courtyard, he confirmed that the drone's GPS signal was full and the self-check was complete, then sent a message to his parents in Nantong to let them know a video call was coming, and his mother replied instantly. As it grew dark, the B&B owner turned on the courtyard lights, and everyone placed mooncakes and tea snacks on the wooden table to wait.
location: Courtyard and pavilion of Dewang Mountain Guesthouse, Mogan Mountain, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province.

name: Mid-Autumn Festival drone lantern call with parents
description: After dark, he took a deep breath and launched the drone. The red electronic lantern rose steadily with the spinning rotor blades to over 20 meters, emitting a soft light. He dialed his mother on video and pointed the phone at the lantern in the sky to convey Mid-Autumn wishes. His mother was stunned at first, then covered her mouth and burst into tears. His father, wearing an old jacket, smiled and told him to be careful. Lin Yue also leaned into the camera to say hello. He noticed the tiredness at the corners of his mother's eyes, and his heart tightened. He decided to bring her to Shanghai for a checkup after the holiday. The call lasted 15 minutes and then ended. He held the remote steady and slowly landed the lantern on the grass, letting out a long sigh of relief.
location: Courtyard of Dewang Mountain Residence Homestay, Moganshan, Deqing County, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Shared a Mid-Autumn Festival dinner
description: The homestay owner served Mid-Autumn Festival special farmhouse dishes: dried bamboo shoot and old duck stew, edamame chicken, stir-fried pumpkin vine, and fermented rice balls. Zhang Jianguo opened a bottle of rice wine, and the four of them clinked glasses. I looked up at the sky where the clouds were gradually dispersing, then glanced at Lin Yue's profile beside me. The atmosphere at the table was much more relaxed than around the campfire. Everyone chatted about cycling and the drone connection, and the tension in my heart loosened a bit.
location: Wooden table in the courtyard of Dewang Mountain Residence, a guesthouse at Moganshan, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Night talk on the terrace watching the moon
description: Lin Yue felt cold and went back to her room first, while he moved to the second-floor terrace with Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng and toasted the moon with rice wine. Zhang Jianguo lowered his voice and again reminded him of the pressure Lin Yue's family might bring, and Zhou Xiaofeng advised him not to rush. He gripped his wine glass, feeling both bitter and warm inside. He understood his comrades' good intentions and nodded in agreement. They talked until nearly 11 p.m., then parted ways. He felt heavy but determined.
location: Second-floor terrace at Dewang Mountain Residence, Moganshan, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Packing luggage, having a heart-to-heart talk, and going to bed
description: Back in the room, Lin Yue was looking at her phone. He silently packed his suitcase, put away the drone and the lantern, and told her that he would take the high-speed train back to Shanghai the next day; she softly agreed. After lying down, Lin Yue turned on her side and rested her head on his arm. He softly said he hoped the two of them would be all right, and she buried her head in his chest and gave a nasal "mm" in response. After Lin Yue's breathing became even and she fell asleep, he slipped his arm out, set an alarm for 6:30 the next morning, and noted down the matter of buying train tickets in his memo. After the phone screen went dark, he stared at the moonlight on the ceiling, repeatedly telling himself to hold on. Listening to her breathing, drowsiness finally came over him.
location: Bamboo View Guest Room, Dewang Mountain Residence, Mogan Mountain, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Morning run and morning preparations at Mogan Mountain
description: Got up promptly at 6:00 in the morning, put on quick-dry clothes and running shoes, and went for a morning run along the flagstone trail behind the Mogan Mountain guesthouse, keeping a steady pace of 7 minutes per kilometer. After running 5.2 km, he stretched at the viewing platform and took photos of the mountain scenery. After the run, he returned to the room at Dewang Mountain Guesthouse, took a hot shower, and had a brief conversation with Lin Yue, who had just woken up, telling her the plan of breakfast at 8:30 and departure before 10:00. Then the two packed chargers, toiletry bags, cosmetics, and other items into the suitcase, getting ready to leave.
location: Dewang Mountain Residence homestay and surrounding trails, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Breakfast at Moganshan and farewell to comrades-in-arms
description: At the guesthouse's courtyard restaurant, he had breakfast with his comrades-in-arms Zhang Jianguo, Zhou Xiaofeng, and Lin Yue, enjoying rice porridge, side dishes, boiled eggs, handmade steamed buns, and noodles with dried bamboo shoots. During the meal, Zhang Jianguo teased about the drone lantern incident from the previous night, and Zhou Xiaofeng mentioned that the two of them planned to go to Lingyin Temple in Hangzhou. After breakfast, in the guesthouse courtyard, he asked the owner to take a group photo of the four of them leaning against a bamboo fence. Then Yin Hao went to the front desk to check out and added the owner on WeChat. At the parking lot, he said goodbye to his comrades. Zhang Jianguo patted him on the shoulder and said he would come to Shanghai for drinks in the future, while Zhou Xiaofeng and Lin Yue wished each other well. Yin Hao then put his suitcase and drone case into the trunk, confirmed his belongings, and drove off.
location: Dewang Mountain Residence courtyard, restaurant, and parking lot, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Drive back to Shanghai and stop for lunch and rest on the way.
description: At exactly 10 a.m., they left Mogan Mountain and drove along National Highway G104, then onto the Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway toward Shanghai. On the way, Yin Hao and Lin Yue had an in-depth conversation about Lin Yue’s job transfer. They learned that the group’s HR process was slow and approval was expected by the end of the month. Yin Hao mentioned his plan to switch to a small two-bedroom apartment after the lease expired. At noon, they arrived at Jiaxing Service Area and ate at a fast-food restaurant. Yin Hao ordered a meat zongzi set meal, and Lin Yue had small wontons and shaomai. Meanwhile, Yin Hao sent a WeChat message to his mother to let her know they were safe. After eating, they bought water at a convenience store, rested in the car for ten minutes, then continued on the road. After entering Shanghai, traffic increased, and Yin Hao turned on navigation to Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District. During this leg of the trip, they each rested by scrolling through their phones. Yin Hao was thinking about going home to do laundry and taking his mother to see a doctor.
location: Set out from Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, via G104 National Highway and the Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway, stopped at Jiaxing Service Area (Shanghai direction of the Shanghai-Kunming Expressway) in Xiuzhou District, Jiaxing City, Zhejiang Province, then continued driving to Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Took Lin Yue to pick up something and then sent her to Songjiang South Station, before returning to the residence alone.
description: At 2 p.m., he drove to the entrance of Zhujiang New City Community, Lane 1188, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District. Lin Yue went upstairs to get a bag she had left behind, while Yin Hao waited in the car for about 5 minutes. He then drove to the south entrance of Shanghai Songjiang Station. On the way, Lin Yue found a high-speed train at 14:50. After arriving at the drop-off platform, Yin Hao got out of the car and helped take down the suitcase. The two hugged tightly. Yin Hao urged Lin Yue to let him know she had arrived safely in Hangzhou and to be careful; Lin Yue replied that she would see him at the end of the month, then dragged her suitcase into the station. Yin Hao watched until her figure disappeared before returning to the car. He then drove 15 minutes back to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, parked in his rented parking space, and sat quietly in the driver's seat for a moment after turning off the engine. Then he carried the luggage up to the fourth floor and opened the door to his long-missed home.
location: Gate of Zhujiang New Town Community, Lane 1188, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai   Shanghai Songjiang Station (South Area Entrance)   Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going home to unpack and take care of daily housework
description: After returning to the rented apartment, he entered organizing mode. First, he separated clean clothes from worn clothes in the suitcase, put the dirty T-shirts and shorts into the washing machine; then wiped down the drone, camera bag, chargers, and other electronic devices, and put them into storage bins. Next, he imported the camera photos to his laptop. Meanwhile, he picked up his phone, sent a voice message to the Iron Triangle WeChat group to report he was safe, and searched online for information and schedules of the chief physician of the Neurology Department at Shanghai Ruijin Hospital, planning to register for a visit next week. After the photos were imported, he stood up, cleaned the living room and bedroom, mopped the floor, tidied the sofa, magazines, and desk, and restored the room to tidiness.
location: Rental apartment on the 4th floor of Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Simple dinner
description: Feeling hungry, he opened the fridge and found there were still eggs, greens, and frozen chive-and-egg dumplings, so he decided to cook the dumplings. He boiled water, put in the dumplings, and made a side soup with egg drop and greens. In the end, he enjoyed a simple hot dinner, feeling more satisfied than with service-area fast food. After the meal, he washed the dishes and chopsticks.
location: Kitchen and living room on the fourth floor, Xingang Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Body relaxation and family video call
description: After the meal, he used a hot water bottle on his lower back, leaned on the sofa in the living room, and watched a Bilibili video about operating techniques for five-axis simultaneous machining centers, noting key parameters. After 20 minutes of hot compress, he did a few simple stretches and felt his muscles and joints loosen up. Then, on the computer, he chose 9 travel photos for editing, including the morning run through the bamboo forest, a group photo of the four of them, a drone aerial view, and Jiaxing meat zongzi. After color grading, he posted them on WeChat Moments with a caption saying goodbye to the holiday. Right after, he made a video call to his mother. After reassuring her that he was safe, he seriously suggested taking her to Shanghai Ruijin Hospital to check her long-term headaches. His mother agreed after a brief hesitation, and they agreed that he would first register for the appointment and then notify her to take the high-speed rail to Shanghai. The call lasted nearly 20 minutes in a warm atmosphere.
location: Living room and bedroom on the fourth floor of Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up before bed and recording weight
description: He went into the bathroom to brush his teeth, wash his face, and apply skincare. After washing up, he stood barefoot on the scale, which showed 72.7 kg, almost the same as before he set out. He recorded the data on his phone.
location: Bathroom on the 4th floor of Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Technical study before bed, then sleep.
description: Back in the bedroom, I lay down on the bed with only a small night light on, picked up my phone and browsed a CNC machining technology forum, saving a few posts about optimizing surface finish in curved-surface machining. Then I checked the next day's weather forecast and confirmed it would be sunny, and set the alarm for 6:30 in the morning. After that I turned off my phone, thought back on the fulfilling day, felt at ease, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom on the fourth floor, Xingang Residential Community, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and stretching
description: The phone alarm went off, and he turned over and sat up, feeling that his lower back was in good condition. He stood barefoot on the digital scale, which showed 72.6 kg, 0.1 kg lighter than yesterday. He did simple stretches for his shoulders, neck, and lower back in front of the mirror and felt his body was well stretched out.
location: Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run 5 kilometers.
description: Changed into running shoes and sportswear, and rode a shared bike for 12 minutes to Xiaokunshan Health Park. It was cloudy and cool. He ran 5 kilometers along the park trail, with a steady pace of about 7 minutes per kilometer. After the run, he stretched for a few minutes and felt his mind and body fully awaken.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going home for a shower and breakfast
description: Cycled back home and took a 15-minute shower to wash off the sweat. He took frozen shepherd's purse and pork dumplings and milk from the fridge, cooked the dumplings, and had them with milk for breakfast. After eating, he browsed news and industry forums on his phone.
location: Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Packing luggage and searching for rental housing
description: First thoroughly cleaned the backpack brought back from Moganshan, put the bamboo carving ornaments and postcards back in place, charged the drone and camera, and sorted the worn clothes into the washing machine. Then sat down at the desk, searched for rental information in Songjiang District on the laptop, focusing on studios or small two-bedroom apartments near Guangfulin Road and Songjiang University Town, and noted down a few neighborhoods with good value for money and their rents, preparing for the future life together with Lin Yue.
location: Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Check the vehicle condition
description: He went downstairs with the car keys, walked around the car to check the tires' appearance and pressure, and measured the pressure with his own tire pressure gauge; it was normal. He opened the hood and checked the oil dipstick, coolant, and washer fluid levels, confirming everything was normal. He pressed the brake to verify the response was sensitive, which made him feel much more reassured.
location: Marked parking space downstairs in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Simple lunch
description: Returned home and cooked a bowl of noodles with tomatoes and eggs. While boiling the noodles, received a WeChat message from Lin Yue, learning that she had departed from Hangzhou East Railway Station and would arrive at Songjiang South Railway Station at 12:40. Replied agreeing to arrive at the station before 1:30 to pick her up, meeting at the usual place.
location: Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and drove to pick up Lin Yue.
description: After eating noodles, I leaned back on the sofa and dozed for 15 minutes to refresh myself. After waking up, I changed into a light blue shirt and dark casual pants, and tidied my hair and appearance. At 13:15 I drove out of Xingang Community. On the way, I sent Lin Yue a voice message via Bluetooth saying I had left, and arrived at the P2 parking lot of Songjiang South Railway Station around 13:45.
location: Drive from Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Songjiang Railway Station on Jinyu Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Picked up Lin Yue and had an in-depth discussion about the transfer at a café.
description: At the arrival exit of Songjiang South Railway Station, he picked up Lin Yue. After hugging, he took her luggage and drove to Miss Dong's Café on Wenhui Road. The café was quiet and elegant. The two ordered lattes and sat in a corner by the window. Lin Yue described in detail the progress of her internal transfer application, saying the competition was fierce and she was not confident. Yin Hao held her hand and firmly encouraged her not to be afraid, saying they would face it together. They agreed that no matter the outcome, they would meet at least twice a month and return to Nantong together at the end of the year to meet their parents. The conversation lasted two hours, giving Lin Yue great support and a sense of security.
location: Lane 652, Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, Miss Dong's Café (Songjiang University Town Branch)

name: Drop Lin Yue off at Songjiang South Station
description: Drove Lin Yue to Songjiang South Railway Station, helped her take down her suitcase, hugged and said goodbye at the entrance, and told her to text once she arrived. Lin Yue turned and walked into the station, and Yin Hao watched her leave.
location: Shanghai Songjiang Station, Jinyu Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going home to reflect, tidying up, and preparing dinner
description: After driving home from the station, he did not turn on the lights immediately and sat alone on the sofa reflecting. Then he opened the memo on his phone and created a new to-do list: update the Songjiang rental market weekly, save an extra 3,000 yuan after next month's salary arrives, and ask Liu Zhiqiang about taking on private CNC programming work. Then he got up and tidied the room: hung the laundry from the washing machine, cleared off the desk and coffee table and wiped away dust, swept and mopped the floor. After changing into loungewear, he steamed the chilled sea bass, stir-fried a plate of baby greens with minced garlic, and served it with rice for a simple home-cooked dinner.
location: Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with mother.
description: After clearing the dishes and chopsticks, he sat on the sofa and made a video call to his mother, Wang Xiuying. After chatting about everyday things for more than ten minutes, he confirmed the plan to take her to Shanghai Ruijin Hospital next Tuesday (October 14) for her headache. He would book a neurology appointment in advance and return to Nantong that day to pick her up.
location: Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Hot compress and core training
description: I applied a hot water bottle to my lower back for 15 minutes, then did core activation exercises such as plank and bird-dog on the yoga mat. My form was correct and there was no discomfort in the lower back, and I was satisfied with the recovery.
location: Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Study programming notes
description: At my desk, I studied Liu Zhiqiang's programming notes, focusing on a macro program optimization case. While reading, I ran tests on the computer using simulation software and finally understood several logical relationships that had been stuck before. It felt very rewarding.
location: Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening leisure and preparing items for tomorrow's work
description: Leaning on the sofa and scrolling on my phone, I browsed technical forums and read posts about CNC machine troubleshooting. Afterward, I got up, placed the work uniform and ID badge I needed for tomorrow on the chair by the door, and checked the car keys and phone charger to make sure everything was ready.
location: Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and writing in his diary before bed
description: He brushed his teeth, washed his face, changed into pajamas, and encouraged himself in front of the mirror. Then he took out his diary and briefly recorded today's weight and mood: 'After talking with Lin Yue, I feel a bit more at ease. The road must be walked step by step. I start work tomorrow, so I need to focus.' After writing, he turned off the light, set his phone to Do Not Disturb mode, got into bed, and slowly fell asleep.
location: Room 401, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning ritual and core workout
description: Yin Hao woke up naturally at 06:30. Lying flat, he savored the moments spent with his girlfriend Lin Yue during the holiday. After adjusting his mood, he got up and weighed himself: 72.5 kg. Then he did core training on the living room floor, including planks and bird-dog, for 15 minutes, ending with a light sweat.
location: Room 403, Building 15, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Community)

name: Washing up and getting ready for the commute
description: Yin Hao took a quick warm shower, changed into his dark blue work uniform, and checked his belongings: phone, work badge, room key, and mint candies. He put on his black sneakers, locked the door, and went downstairs.
location: Room 403, Building 15, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Community)

name: Bike commuting and buying breakfast
description: Yin Hao rode a shared bike along Xingang Road north to Songhui West Road, then turned onto Huatianjing Highway. On the way, he bought a pork bun and freshly ground soy milk at Wangjincun Convenience Store, continued cycling for about 13 minutes, and arrived at the company at 07:38.
location: Wangjincun Convenience Store (near the intersection of Huatianjing Road and Songzheng Road, Qingpu District, Shanghai) to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai)

name: Arrived early to carry out the machine tool inspection
description: Before work, Yin Hao went to the workshop and performed an item-by-item inspection on the five-axis CNC machine tool: coolant, lubricating oil, spindle coaxiality, and cutting tools. He checked the drawings and programs, then picked up the blanks for precision medical device parts, getting ready for production.
location: Five-axis CNC machining area, workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai).

name: High-precision parts machining in the morning
description: Yin Hao operated the machine with full concentration, completing clamping, tool setting, and program startup, while continuously monitoring cutting parameters and the spindle sound. When machining the third piece, he found that the end mill made a dull cutting sound, so he decisively paused and replaced it with a spare tool to ensure subsequent machining. In the morning, he completed rough and semi-finish machining of 8 blanks.
location: Five-axis CNC machining area, workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai).

name: Passed quality inspection and received praise.
description: Yin Hao sent the first batch of three parts to the quality inspection station. Inspector Zhang Jianguo measured the key dimensions with a vernier caliper and micrometer. The bore tolerances were all within 0.01 mm, and all parts met the standard. Zhang Jianguo praised him with satisfaction. Yin Hao responded modestly, while inwardly confirming that his decision had been right.
location: Quality inspection work area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai).

name: Midday rest and lunch
description: Yin Hao got braised pork chop, tomato scrambled eggs, and stir-fried greens at the company cafeteria, 13 yuan in total. While eating, he checked group messages on his phone, liked his buddies' game posts, and replied to his girlfriend Lin Yue on WeChat; the two shared photos of the sunny weather.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory staff cafeteria (No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai)

name: Sorted machining notes during the lunch break.
description: In the lounge, Yin Hao used the knowledge note app on his tablet to record the morning's machining parameters, tool replacement experience, and dimension data, and annotated key points for tool noise warnings, accumulating reusable knowledge assets for the vocational skills competition.
location: Rest area on the second floor of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai)

name: Continue machining and fitting in the afternoon
description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao finished the remaining parts. Due to tool wear and changes in room temperature, he fine-tuned the compensation values twice, bringing all 10 parts to perfectly meet the dimensional requirements. During this period, he reported the morning's quality inspection results to team leader Wang Lei and confirmed tomorrow's trial production plan for the new part. Before leaving work, he cleaned the machine tool and put the cutting tools back in place.
location: Five-axis CNC machining area, workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai).

name: Talking with colleagues before leaving work
description: After work, at the workshop entrance, discussed the next day's plan with team leader Wang Lei and engineer Liu Zhiqiang. Yin Hao said he had already taken an initial look at the new part program and had a few details he wanted to ask about. Liu Zhiqiang teased him and asked him to share his notes; Yin Hao readily agreed. The three said goodbye.
location: Main entrance of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai)

name: Checking rental listings along the way
description: Yin Hao rode a shared bike to the Lianjia Real Estate Shouchuang Jinyue store to check the rental listings in the window, focusing on one-bedroom or small two-bedroom apartments near Guangfulin Road and Guangxuan Road. He took photos of two listings and sent them to his girlfriend Lin Yue, marking them for a weekend viewing.
location: Lianjia Real Estate Shouchuang Jinyue Branch (northwest corner of the intersection of Guangxuan Road and Longyuan Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai)

name: Go home and buy groceries along the way.
description: Yin Hao cycled along Guangxuan Road and turned onto Xingang Road. About 8 minutes later, he arrived at Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket, where he bought green peppers, pork tenderloin, tomatoes, and spring onions, spending 19 yuan in total, then returned to Xingang Residential Area.
location: Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket (Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai)

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: After returning to his rental apartment, Yin Hao took a shower and changed clothes, then cooked shredded pork with green peppers and tomato egg drop soup. When it was ready, he ate while browsing a CNC technology forum, and after eating he washed the dishes and chopsticks.
location: Room 403, Building 15, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Community)

name: Evening gaming and socializing.
description: Yin Hao teamed up with comrades Zhang Jianguo, Zhou Xiaofeng, and colleague Wang Lei, five people in total, to play Honor of Kings ranked matches. He mainly played marksman. During the games, they talked about Mogan Mountain anecdotes, work achievements, and future study plans. The atmosphere was relaxed and lively.
location: Room 403, Building 15, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Community)

name: Evening study and browsing house listings
description: Yin Hao first opened his computer to study the macro program optimization case shared by Liu Zhiqiang, simulated the operation, and recorded application ideas; then he opened his phone album to look at the photos of the house taken in the afternoon, discussed with Lin Yue on WeChat and recorded priorities, and organized the information into the home-buying plan memo.
location: Room 403, Building 15, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Community)

name: Video call with mother.
description: Yin Hao video chatted with his mother, Wang Xiuying. He reported that he had been praised at work today and asked about his father's health. His mother urged him not to work too hard. The call ended after 15 minutes.
location: Room 403, Building 15, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Community)

name: Nighttime review and washing up
description: Yin Hao turned off the computer, recorded the day's gains, housing progress, and tomorrow's plan in his diary, then turned off the lights and finished his wash-up.
location: Room 403, Building 15, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Community)

name: Bedtime preparations
description: Yin Hao lay down on the bed, set the alarm for the next day, silently planned tomorrow's trial production plan, thought about Lin Yue's care and his mother's advice, and fell asleep peacefully with a sense of accomplishment.
location: Room 403, Building 15, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Community)

name: Morning weigh-in and core training.
description: After the alarm went off, Yin Hao got out of bed and weighed himself. The scale showed 72.4 kg, and he was satisfied with his continuously declining weight. Then he spread out the yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of core strength training including planks, bird-dogs, and supine leg raises, with standard and precise movements. After training, he drank warm water and washed up simply, laying the foundation for a full day of work performance.
location: Rental house, Building 15, Lane 224, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting by shared bicycle and having a roadside breakfast.
description: Yin Hao changed into his long-sleeved work uniform, grabbed his commuter bag and power bank, and rode a shared bike to work. Passing the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road, he stopped to buy two pork buns, one boiled egg, and a cup of hot soy milk for breakfast, spending 8 yuan. He ate quickly while riding, mentally reviewing the registration process and document list for the skills competition.
location: On the way from Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant at 232 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory.

name: Workshop pre-shift preparation and equipment preheating and inspection
description: After arriving at the company, Yin Hao changed into anti-impact safety shoes, clocked in, and entered Workshop No. 3. He organized the cutting tools and measuring instruments needed for the day, started the No. 3 CNC machine tool for idle warm-up according to procedures, carefully checked the coolant and lubricant levels, and confirmed the equipment was normal. Team leader Wang Lei exchanged insights with him about yesterday's medical parts machining and told him there was a new job today with Grade 5 precision, saying he trusted Yin Hao's craftsmanship.
location: Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Online registration for the skills competition
description: Yin Hao requested a 15-minute break, and on the shared computer in the workshop office opened the official website of the Shanghai Vocational Skills Competition. He carefully checked the registration guide, filled in personal information item by item, uploaded scanned copies of the required materials, and clicked submit after confirming everything was correct. The system showed successful registration. He solemnly saved a screenshot of the confirmation page, feeling both nervous and excited.
location: Office of Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Contacted Master via WeChat to report the good news and accept guidance.
description: Immediately after the registration succeeded, Yin Hao sent a WeChat message to his mentor Sun Jianguo at the workshop entrance to share the good news, attaching a screenshot of the successful registration. His mentor quickly replied, praising him for acting fast, and told him to first get familiar with the five-axis programming manual. He also said he would set aside time during next Monday's lunch break to explain the key practical points to him individually. Yin Hao replied that he got it and thanked his mentor, and a clear learning direction now took shape in his mind.
location: Entrance of Workshop No. 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Precision housing bracket machining.
description: Yin Hao returned to his workstation and received the drawing for a new part, a precision instrument housing bracket, which required grade 5 precision. He carefully analyzed the tolerances and technical requirements on the drawing, then calibrated the cutting tools, clamped the blank, and entered the pre-programmed machining program. After starting the machine, he stood in front of the control panel the whole time, fully focused on monitoring the machining path and parameters. At 10:45 he completed the first piece and self-checked it with a micrometer and calipers. The key dimensions were all within the allowable tolerance, and he felt reassured.
location: Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cafeteria lunch
description: After the workshop paused, Yin Hao went to the company cafeteria for lunch with colleagues Liu Zhiqiang, Wang Lei, and others. Lunch included braised pork chop, chive scrambled eggs, and seaweed egg drop soup. Yin Hao got a serving, and everyone discussed the afternoon machining plan while eating.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: None (resting due to knee injury)
description: Yin Hao quickly finished lunch and, without resting, went straight back to the workshop office and turned on his computer. He downloaded advanced five-axis machining technical documents and sample problems from the past two years from the CNC technology forum and the competition's official website, and copied them to a USB drive. Then he placed an order on a shopping app for the third edition of "Five-Axis CNC Programming and Operation" with cash on delivery. After that, he walked to Liu Zhiqiang's workstation and successfully borrowed his macro programming notebook, promising to treat him to milk tea next week as thanks.
location: Office of Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Precision machining and tapping of parts
description: Returning to his workstation on time in the afternoon, Yin Hao carried out finishing and surface treatment on the parts that had passed self-inspection in the morning. He remained meticulous, and whenever he encountered an uncertain parameter, he would stop the machine and consult the manual. Team leader Wang Lei handed him a bottle of water and reminded him to pay attention to the cutting fluid concentration. Yin Hao focused his main effort on tapping two high-precision threaded holes, and after manually adjusting the tapping parameters twice, he completed them perfectly. At 16:20, all three precision parts scheduled for that day were successfully removed from the machine.
location: Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Sending parts for inspection and tidying up after work.
description: Yin Hao carefully placed the three parts neatly on a tray and personally delivered them to the quality inspection area. Inspector Zhang used precision instruments to test each one. More than ten minutes later, he confirmed that all parts were qualified and especially praised the tolerance control of the two threaded holes. Yin Hao felt relieved. After returning to his workstation, he carefully cleaned the iron chips from the machine, wiped the control panel, applied lubricating oil to the guide rails, and tidied the workstation according to 5S standards before leaving work.
location: Workshop 3 and quality inspection area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute home and apartment viewing confirmation
description: After clocking out, Yin Hao left the company on a shared bike. While waiting at a red light, he sent a voice message to his girlfriend Lin Yue, telling her that he had successfully registered and confirming that they would meet at the Lianjia Real Estate Songjiang University Town store at 10 a.m. on Saturday to view apartments. Lin Yue quickly replied with congratulations and confirmed the time, also saying she would bring the organized documents. After hearing this, Yin Hao felt more at ease and pedaled faster.
location: On the way from No. 360, Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Xingang Community

name: Invite colleagues for evening games.
description: After returning to the downstairs of his building and locking his car, Yin Hao sent a message in the WeChat group named Songjiang Three Brothers, inviting Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang to play Honor of Kings together at 8 p.m. to celebrate his successful registration, with the goal of three consecutive wins. The two quickly responded; Wang Lei reserved the marksman position, and Liu Zhiqiang said it was also a good chance to relax. Yin Hao went upstairs smiling.
location: Entrance of Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Homemade dinner and browsing technical documentation
description: After returning to the rented apartment and changing out of his work clothes, Yin Hao quickly made a bowl of braised pork and green pepper mixed noodles using the green peppers in the fridge and the leftover braised pork from the day before. At 18:00 he sat down and, while eating the noodles heartily, scrolled through the five-axis machining technical documents he had downloaded during the lunch break to get into a learning mindset. After finishing, he washed the dishes and rested briefly.
location: Rental house, Building 15, Lane 224, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with parents
description: Yin Hao made a video call home, and his mother Wang Xiuying answered. He shared the news that he had successfully registered for the skills competition and that a part he made was praised by the quality inspector; his parents were very happy. His father Yin Jianguo told him to work steadily. Yin Hao also asked about taking his mother to Ruijin Hospital next Tuesday to have her headaches checked. His mother told him not to worry and to focus on preparing for the competition. After talking for about 20 minutes, Yin Hao hung up happily.
location: Rental house, Building 15, Lane 224, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Study colleague's programming notes
description: Taking advantage of the gap before the game started, Yin Hao sat at the table and looked through the programming notebook he had borrowed from Liu Zhiqiang, focusing on cases of optimizing complex surface machining paths with macro programs, and made brief notes in his own small notebook. He decided to clarify several questions he hadn't fully understood when discussing with his master next week. At 19:45 he closed the notebook, did some simple exercises, and got his charging cable and water bottle ready.
location: Rental house, Building 15, Lane 224, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Three colleagues teamed up to play games
description: Yin Hao logged into Honor of Kings, formed a voice room with his online friends Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang, and started a three-player ranked match. He played the hero “Lü Bu” and performed excellently in the side lane, coordinating with Wang Lei's marksman and Liu Zhiqiang's jungler to win three games in a row. During gaps between games, the three chatted: Yin Hao shared his nervousness and excitement about signing up, Wang Lei mentioned that he wanted to borrow Yin Hao's machining methods next week, and Liu Zhiqiang joked that if they won the championship, Yin Hao would have to treat everyone to a big meal. The whole process was full of laughter.
location: Rental house, Building 15, Lane 224, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Gaming ended, washed up, and relaxed
description: After the game ended, he left the voice chat, and the day's work and registration pressure were almost completely released through a few rounds of gaming. Yin Hao sent “Good night” to his girlfriend Lin Yue, then did his bedtime washing: washing his face, brushing his teeth, and soaking his feet, while briefly reviewing the fulfilling day.
location: Rental house, Building 15, Lane 224, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime review and next week's plan
description: After lying in bed, Yin Hao did not scroll through his phone. Instead, he closed his eyes and sorted out his plans for the coming week: learn from his master at noon on Monday, view a house on Saturday morning, keep up daily core training, and continue studying Liu Zhiqiang's notes. With a clear direction for the weekend and the training camp, he turned off the light and fell asleep with a sense of satisfaction.
location: Rental house, Building 15, Lane 224, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting up, washing up, weighing in, morning exercise, and a simple breakfast
description: The phone alarm rang on time at 06:30. Although he had stayed up late playing games the night before, the biological clock developed during military service made Yin Hao get up quickly. After drinking a glass of warm water, he stepped on the digital scale and saw 72.6 kg, 0.2 kg heavier than yesterday. He knew it was because of last night's braised pork noodles, so he decided to eat more vegetarian at lunch. While washing up, he applied a medicated patch to the strained lower back and felt it was recovering well. Then he spread out the yoga mat in the living room and completed 15 minutes of core training, including planks, bird dogs, and crunches, waking up his body. After training, he went to the kitchen and made a simple breakfast with toast and milk bought the day before, plus a fried egg. As he ate, he scrolled through industry news on his phone.
location: Rented apartment, Room 401, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuted to the factory on a shared bike
description: At 7:40, Yin Hao locked the door, took his work bag, walked to the community entrance, and unlocked a Hellobike. Facing the cool autumn north wind, he rode along the familiar non-motorized lane toward the factory. Along the way, the edges of the ginkgo leaves had turned yellow. He took a deep breath and was in a good mood.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road

name: Morning workshop work (flange trial production) and scheduling a health checkup for mother.
description: After arriving at the workshop and changing into work clothes, Yin Hao inspected and preheated the five-axis machine according to procedure. At 8:00, he began machining the first batch of flange test pieces according to the drawings. As new part first pieces, every step was especially careful; after each cutting pass, he stopped the machine and carefully measured with a vernier caliper and an air gauge. Around 10:00, during a tool change gap, he called the physical examination center at the Rudong County People's Hospital in his hometown to book a comprehensive physical exam for his mother Wang Xiuying the next morning. After confirming the precautions, he hung up, set a reminder in his phone memo, and sent it to the family group. Then he went to the water room to get water and stretched his stiff neck. Near 11:00, programmer Liu Zhiqiang brought over the afternoon machining program to check details. Yin Hao explained that he needed to leave work at 4:30 p.m. early. Engineer Liu agreed to help keep an eye on the final process wrap-up. After a brief discussion of key parameters, Yin Hao continued focusing on operating the machine until lunch break.
location: No. 3 Machining Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Quick lunch during the lunch break
description: When the lunch break bell rang, Yin Hao stopped what he was doing, tidied his workstation, and went to the factory canteen. The set meal of the day was braised pork ribs, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. He got his food, quickly found a corner seat, and finished eating within 15 minutes, mentally planning the apartment viewing later, without chatting much with colleagues.
location: Canteen, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Print the health record form and prepare to view apartments with my girlfriend.
date: After tidying up the room, I sat down at the desk and opened my laptop. I first logged into the 12306 app to search for high-speed rail departures from Shanghai Hongqiao to Hangzhou East around mid-February (the weekend of February 15 and 16), and screenshotted several trains departing between 8:00 and 10:00 with a travel time of about one hour. Then I opened Amap and created a new list called Hangzhou Appointment in my favorites, marking West Lake, Lingyin Temple, Longjing Village, and the approximate location of Lin Yue's company that she mentioned on WeChat last night. With that, I had a preliminary plan for the trip.
description: After returning from the cafeteria to the workshop office, Yin Hao did not take a nap. He opened the laptop on his desk, downloaded a simple health record form template from the internet, and printed it using the office printer. While printing, he sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend Lin Yue to confirm the apartment viewing schedule: "Are you there? I'm done here, I'll bike over right away."
location: Workshop Office, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Looking at houses with girlfriend Lin Yue.
description: After the video call, Yin Hao lay in bed and opened the Beike app to compare several one-bedroom, one-living-room apartments in Songjiang Old Town and the Xinqiao area, with total prices around 1.5 million yuan. He chose three, favorited them, and screenshotted them to send to his older brother Yin Tao with a note: help me take a look. Thinking about the gap between his savings and the down payment, he locked the screen and sighed softly, but his resolve grew stronger.
location: Lianjia Real Estate (Songjiang New Town Branch), 925 Xinsongjiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the surrounding residential areas.

name: Afternoon workshop work and wrap-up
description: At 1:10 in the afternoon, Yin Hao hurried back to the workshop to continue machining the remaining parts, strictly following the process flow. The rhythmic cutting sound of the machine tools calmed his mind. At 3:20, he finished machining all trial pieces and immediately sent them for quality inspection. Quality inspector Zhang carefully measured and confirmed that all three pieces were qualified, then patted him on the shoulder and said, "The dimensions are well controlled, much steadier than last month." Yin Hao felt reassured. He then completed the final process as planned, and performed machine maintenance and workstation cleanup ahead of schedule.
location: No. 3 Machining Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Get off work, change clothes, and prepare before cycling.
description: At 16:20, Yin Hao tidied up his workstation, clocked out, and returned to his rented apartment in Xingang Community after a 10-minute shared-bike ride. After entering, he quickly changed into professional cycling clothes, put on his helmet and cleated cycling shoes, checked the tire pressure of his road bike, and filled two water bottles with electrolyte water, making sure everything was ready.
location: Rented apartment, Room 401, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Long-distance cycling to Dianshan Lake (outbound)
description: At 4:45 p.m., Yin Hao wheeled his road bike out and set off from Songjiang New City via Shenzhuan Highway onto Qingpu Avenue, heading toward Dianshan Lake. With the help of a tailwind, he kept a cruising speed of 25-28 km/h. His knees felt good, and the rice paddies and farmhouses along the way added to the autumn rural scenery. After riding about 30 kilometers, he stopped by the roadside to drink water and took a photo of the straight country road to post in the "Songjiang Three Brothers" group chat with the caption: "Going to make a big move today." His friend Gao Zhiyuan instantly replied "Beast!", and Ma Xiaofeng followed with a thumbs-up emoji.
location: Along the way from Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to the Dianshan Lake Greenway, Qingpu District

name: Resting by Dianshan Lake and meeting a fishing buddy by chance
description: At 6:10, Yin Hao arrived near Jinshang Road on the greenway around Dianshan Lake and stopped to rest by a bench by the lake. A wind carrying a slightly fishy moisture blew off the lake, and the setting sun dyed the reed marshes golden. As he was lost in thought, he heard someone call "Xiao Yin?" Turning around, he saw Wu Zhiqiang, an older buddy he had met while fishing before. Brother Wu was sitting on a small folding stool fishing with a hand rod. The two chatted about recent fishing conditions. Brother Wu said the big crucian carp were starting to bite and invited Yin Hao to come next week if he had time, saying he could help save a good spot if contacted in advance.
location: Dianshan Lake Greenway, Qingpu District, Shanghai (near Jinshang Road)

name: Long-distance cycling back to Xingang Community (return trip)
description: After taking a rest, it was getting dark. Yin Hao did not dare stay long and immediately set off on the way back. The return trip was against the wind, the cycling resistance increased noticeably, his strength began to decline, and his knees felt slightly sore. He skillfully adjusted the gear ratio to reduce pedaling resistance, lowered his pace to about 22 km/h, and kept a steady rhythm. At around 8:10 p.m., he finally rode back to Xingang Community. The cyclocomputer showed 75.3 km in total, taking 3 hours 25 minutes (including rest), with an average heart rate of 145 bpm.
location: Along the route from the Dianshan Lake lakeside greenway in Qingpu District, Shanghai, to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District

name: Shower and simple dinner
description: When he got home, his legs felt a little weak, but he was in a cheerful mood. Yin Hao quickly took a hot shower and changed into loose lounge pants and a short-sleeved T-shirt. Then he took the leftover braised pork from the previous night out of the fridge, cooked a bowl of noodles, poured the braised pork and its sauce over the noodles, and wolfed it down to quickly replenish carbohydrates and energy.
location: Rented apartment, Room 401, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Learning five-axis programming technology in the evening
description: After finishing dinner and putting away the dishes, Yin Hao sat down at his desk and opened his laptop. Beside him were the five-axis programming notes Liu Zhiqiang had lent him, and he focused on the chapters on “coordinate system transformation” and “five-axis simultaneous machining G-code commands.” As he read, he carefully recorded key points. When he came across something he didn’t understand (such as “the specific use of G43.4 dynamic compensation in simultaneous machining”), he marked it with a highlighter, took a screenshot, and sent it to Engineer Liu on WeChat for help. Liu replied, “I’ll explain it when I’m at work tomorrow,” so Yin Hao noted that and continued studying.
location: At the desk in the rental apartment at Room 401, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video-called mother to confirm the physical examination and organized the examination supplies.
description: At exactly 10 p.m., Yin Hao called his mother on WeChat video. His mother was sitting on the sofa in the living room of their hometown home, cracking sunflower seeds, while his father watched TV beside her. He seriously reminded her again about the physical exam the next morning: "Mom, don't eat anything after 10 o'clock tonight, and don't drink water either. Arrive at the hospital fasting tomorrow morning, got it?" His mother smiled and said she remembered. After confirming she had prepared her medical insurance card and ID card, he also sent an electronic reminder to the family group as a backup. After hanging up the video call, he took a household electronic blood pressure monitor out of the storage cabinet, put in two new batteries, and tested it to make sure it worked. Then he put the printed health record form, the blood pressure monitor, a pen, and a small sticky note pad into a drawstring backpack and placed it on the shoe cabinet by the door, making sure he wouldn't forget it the next morning.
location: Rental apartment (living room and entryway) at Room 401, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Relaxing online, reviewing the day, and preparing for bed.
description: Lying in bed, feeling his whole body relax, Yin Hao opened his phone gallery, selected a sunset photo by Dianshan Lake, and posted it to Moments along with a screenshot of his cycling computer data: “75km check-in, the wind is full of the taste of freedom. Tomorrow there is an important task: accompany Mom for her health check-up.” After posting, he browsed the tech forum and the “Songjiang Three Brothers” group chat and replied to messages. He turned off his phone, closed his eyes, and silently reviewed the fulfilling day, feeling very at ease.
location: On the bed in the bedroom of the rented apartment, Room 401, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going to bed
description: In the quiet of the autumn night, with his body relaxed and his mind at peace, Yin Hao soon drifted into sleep.
location: Bedroom of the rented apartment, Room 401, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning preparation and departure
description: Woke up at 5:30 in the morning, worried about my mother's medical checkup. After washing up quickly, I changed into a casual outfit. I rechecked the already-packed backpack, confirmed that I had brought the car keys, phone, wallet, power bank, electronic blood pressure monitor, and the printed health record form, and added two bottles of mineral water and sliced bread. Going downstairs to the ground-level parking space in the residential complex, I got in the car, powered on for a self-check, warmed up the engine for half a minute, confirmed sufficient fuel and normal tire pressure, and drove out of the complex right at 6:10.
location: Room 504, No. 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China, plus a ground-level parking space

name: Drive back to hometown in Rudong.
description: Setting out from the city into the morning sun, he took G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway, then transferred to G15 Shenyang-Haikou Expressway and headed north. Along the way, he listened to the morning news, made a brief 5-minute stop at Rugao Service Area to stretch, ate two slices of bread, and drank some water. The whole trip took about 2 hours and 40 minutes, and he arrived downstairs at his parents' home in Juegang Town, Rudong County at 8:50.
location: G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway, G15 Shenyang-Haikou Expressway (on the way from Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province)

name: Pick up Mother and take her to the hospital.
description: I knocked and entered; my mother had already changed into a red coat and was waiting on the sofa, while my father reminded me from the doorway to drive carefully. I took my mother's medical insurance card, helped her downstairs, and drove for 5 minutes to the parking lot of Rudong County People's Hospital.
location: On the way from parents' home at 88 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province, to No. 2 Jianghai West Road, Rudong County

name: Accompanied my mother to complete her physical examination
description: Holding the appointment voucher, I went to the physical examination center on the second floor of the outpatient building of Rudong County People's Hospital. When the nurse arranged the blood draw (blood routine, liver function, and blood lipid panel), seeing my mother nervous, I held her arm and comforted her. Then we completed urinalysis, internal medicine auscultation, electrocardiogram, and abdominal ultrasound in turn. At 11:30, the nurse told us that except for a few reports that needed to be picked up in the afternoon, the rest of the results were already out.
location: Health Examination Center, 2nd Floor, Outpatient Department, Rudong County People's Hospital, No. 2, Jianghai West Road, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Lunch and short break.
description: I took my mother to the Baixing Renjia Home-Style Restaurant across from the hospital for lunch, ordering stir-fried seasonal vegetables, tomato and egg soup, and two steamed small yellow croakers. My mother had a poor appetite, so I kept serving her dishes and urging her to eat more. After the meal, I asked her to go back to the hospital lobby to rest, and I went to the pharmacy across the street to buy a portable pill box for backup.
location: No. 35 Jianghai Middle Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province, Baixing Renjia Home-Style Restaurant and hospital lobby

name: Accompany mother and communicate with father.
description: Accompanied his mother to rest on the seats in the hospital lobby, letting her lean back and close her eyes. Called his father to let him know the morning check-up went smoothly and that they would go back after picking up the report in the afternoon. After his mother woke up, she asked with concern whether he was tired, and he replied, 'Not tired, it's just a two-hour drive home.'
