location: Outpatient Hall, Rudong County People's Hospital, No. 2 Jianghai West Road, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Pick up the physical examination report and doctor's diagnosis.
description: At 13:20, I swiped my mother's medical insurance card at the self-service report machine and printed all the reports. I went to the internal medicine clinic on the second floor and queued. When my turn came at 13:40, Director Wang reviewed the reports and asked about her daily symptoms, then diagnosed mild essential hypertension (145/95) and prescribed nifedipine extended-release tablets and aspirin enteric-coated tablets. He instructed a long-term low-salt, low-fat diet and walks after dinner, and carefully confirmed the drug names and usage.
location: Internal Medicine Outpatient Clinic, Rudong County People's Hospital, No. 2 Jianghai West Road, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Pick up medicine and go home, and establish a family health monitoring system
description: He went to the pharmacy on the first floor to pick up the medicine, checked the names and dosages of the nifedipine sustained-release tablets and aspirin enteric-coated tablets, then drove his mother home. After arriving home at 14:30, he called his parents into the living room, took out the electronic blood pressure monitor and health record form, and told his father to measure and record his mother's blood pressure every morning from that day on. He taught his father hands-on how to wrap the cuff correctly, press the buttons, and read the data, correcting the problem of the cuff being too loose. He explained each item on the record form and wrote in the remarks column: "October 12: mild hypertension; take one nifedipine tablet daily; low-salt diet and moderate exercise." He also emphasized a video check every Saturday. Finally, he helped his mother sort and pack the medication and placed it on the bedside table.
location: Living room of parents' home, No. 88 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Saying goodbye to parents and preparing for the return trip
description: After packing his backpack, his mother held his hand and told him to be careful on the way, and his father reminded him to send a WeChat message when he arrived. He patted his father on the shoulder and said, 'Dad, please take good care of Mom's affairs. I'll be back at the end of next month.' Then he hugged his mother and went downstairs.
location: Parents' home, No. 88 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Driving back to Songjiang, Shanghai.
description: Starting from Rudong, take G15 Shenhai Expressway then transfer to G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway heading west. Along the way, listened to music, stopped at Taicang Shaxi Service Area to use the restroom and buy water. There was a small five-minute traffic jam at the Shanghai-Jiangsu border; otherwise smooth, and entered Songjiang urban area at 19:40.
location: G15 Shenyang–Haikou Expressway, G60 Shanghai–Kunming Expressway (en route from Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province to Songjiang District, Shanghai)

name: Arrived at the rented apartment, had dinner, and had a video call with his father.
description: Returned to the rented apartment at Room 504, No. 15, Xingang Community, Songjiang District. First, he ordered a takeout bowl of shredded pork noodles with preserved mustard greens from the noodle shop at the community entrance. After getting home, he took a shower to wash away the fatigue, sat at the coffee table to eat the noodles, and sent a video call to his father. Seeing his mother watching TV and in good spirits, he asked about her medication and reminded her to measure her blood pressure at seven the next morning. After hanging up, he felt reassured.
location: Room 504, No. 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Video call with girlfriend Lin Yue
description: After clearing the dishes, he video-called his girlfriend Lin Yue; she had just taken a shower. He shared the results of taking his mother for a medical checkup that day. She comforted him, “The important thing is it’s under control.” They also chatted about their own activities that day, in a relaxed atmosphere, for about 20 minutes.
location: Room 504, No. 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Playing games in a team with comrades-in-arms
description: Opened Honor of Kings, saw many people in the battle buddies group calling to get online, and formed a five-person team with Zhang Jianguo, Zhou Xiaofeng, Liu Zhiqiang, and Wang Lei. Chose Zhao Yun for the jungle position, set the pace, and went two wins and one loss in a row. Everyone chatted while playing. At 21:40, quit the game on the grounds of having to work the next day.
location: Room 504, No. 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Evening washing up and going to bed
description: He put down his phone and went to brush his teeth, wash his face, and wash his feet, then hung up the clothes that had been washed earlier that day. He set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning and weighed himself at 72.5 kg. He turned off the light and lay down, reviewing the whole day: the physical exam was done, the medicine had been prescribed, the record sheet was put up, his girlfriend was informed, and he had enjoyed his games. He felt relaxed, then pulled up the quilt and fell asleep.
location: Room 504, No. 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Getting up and adjusting state
description: The alarm went off on time, and Yin Hao got up immediately without lingering in bed. Out of habit, he drank a glass of warm water, did some simple neck and wrist exercises by the bed, and pressed his lower back with his hand, confirming that there was no discomfort after carrying things in Nantong yesterday. Then he picked up his phone and checked the day's weather forecast, which showed cloudy and a temperature of 21–27, and confirmed no rain. He was still concerned about his mother's blood pressure and planned to video-call her at noon to say hello.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning jog and weigh-in
description: Yin Hao changed into shorts and running shoes and went out. He jogged west along Xingang Road, entered Xiaokunshan Health Park, and ran 3 kilometers on the park trail, maintaining a steady pace of 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. Throughout the run, he felt no soreness or swelling in his lower back, and he was satisfied with the results of his recent core training. After the run, he bought a bottle of mineral water at the edge of the park and then walked slowly home. Once home, he weighed himself on the digital scale; it showed 72.6 kg, the same as yesterday, and his physical condition was stable.
location: Xiaokunshan Health Park, Songjiang District, Shanghai (40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Highway) and surrounding routes

name: Core training and morning preparations.
description: Yin Hao completed a 15-minute core workout on the yoga mat in the living room, including 3 sets of planks (1 minute each), 3 sets of bird-dog exercise (15 reps per side), and side planks (30 seconds per side). After the workout, he took a warm shower, changed into work pants and a blue T-shirt, then carefully checked the ID card, admission ticket, calculator, gel pen, and drawing pencil needed for today's exam. He confirmed everything was in order, and after checking the tip of the pencil he had sharpened the night before once more, he put it into his crossbody bag.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: On Wednesday, a workday, Yin Hao started his day with a morning run and strictly followed his fat-loss plan. At work, he steadily operated the machine tool. During the lunch break, he took the initiative to ask his mentor for advice on preparing for the senior technician exam, and revised his weekly study plan, taking the first step to catch up on his exam preparation.
description: Yin Hao drove his own car from home, left Xingang Community, entered the G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway via Xingang Road, then turned onto the Middle Ring Road, heading to the Vocational Skill Appraisal Center at No. 100 Guiping Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai. Morning rush hour traffic was heavy but not severely congested. On the way, he mentally rehearsed key steps such as tool compensation and coordinate system offset for five-axis simultaneous machining. After about 40 minutes, he arrived at the destination and parked in the parking lot behind the appraisal center.
location: No. 100 Guiping Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai (Shanghai Vocational Skills Appraisal Center)

name: Sign-in and pre-exam preparation
description: Yin Hao presented his ID card and admission ticket to complete the waiting check-in. A staff member led him into a spacious waiting room, where more than ten candidates were already waiting quietly. He found a seat by the window, took out his notebook, and silently wrote out the day's part machining sequence and clamping points one last time, making final preparations for the upcoming practical exam.
location: Exam waiting room at the Vocational Skill Appraisal Center, 100 Guiping Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai

name: Entering the exam room and equipment check
description: Under the examiner's guidance, Yin Hao entered the practical workshop and found the No. 5 five-axis linkage machining center assigned to him. He changed into work clothes and carefully inspected the machine: confirmed that the lubricating oil level, coolant, air pressure, and other indicators were normal, turned the spindle by hand and felt smooth rotation, checked the standard tools and tool setting bar, confirmed that the vise clamping surface was clean and free of burrs, and then signed the Exam Station Status Confirmation Form to confirm.
location: Station 5, CNC Practical Operation Workshop, Vocational Skills Certification Center, No. 100 Guiping Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai

name: Five-axis simultaneous machining practical exam
description: The exam officially began. Yin Hao carefully read the drawing; it was a medical part model with a complex impeller surface. He skillfully completed tool magazine setup, workpiece clamping, program import, and tool setting. During automatic machining, he kept a close eye on the spindle load on the screen and the machining sound, and judged from experience that the cutting state was normal. Midway, he manually paused, used an internal dial gauge to check a critical hole dimension, and only after confirming the tolerance was within 0.01 mm did he continue the program. He finished all cutting and self-inspection about 5 minutes early and placed the finished part on the designated tray.
location: Station 5, CNC Practical Operation Workshop, Vocational Skills Certification Center, No. 100 Guiping Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai

name: Post-exam cleanup and work summary.
description: After the exam, Yin Hao carefully cleaned the chips from the machine tool according to procedure, wiped down the workbench, and put the cutting tools back in place. He briefly exchanged a few words with the proctor about a slight vibration issue encountered during the machining process; the proctor said it might have been caused by the tool overhang being too long and advised him to pay attention next time. Yin Hao nodded and thanked him. Then he walked out of the workshop, sat down on a bench in the corridor, and sent a WeChat message to Master Sun Jianguo, telling him the exam was over and it felt normal, and expressing that he wanted to ask for advice about the competition. Sun Jianguo quickly replied and agreed.
location: Workshop and corridor of the Vocational Skill Appraisal Center, No. 100 Guiping Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai

name: Drove back and had lunch on the way
description: Yin Hao drove away from the appraisal center, turned from the Humin Elevated Road onto the G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway, and returned to Songjiang. After exiting the expressway, he drove into Shulin Road in Songjiang District, stopped at the entrance of Lao Shandong Handmade Dumpling Shop, and ordered a takeout meal of pork and cabbage dumplings (15 pieces) and a bowl of zhajiang noodles to bring home for lunch.
location: Old Shandong Handmade Dumplings (Shulin Road Store), Shulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Arrived home and had lunch
description: Yin Hao returned home, put the packaged lunch into his own bowl, and while eating opened his laptop to look through the programming notes his colleague Liu Zhiqiang had lent him. At the same time, he noted down in his phone memo two competition questions he planned to ask his mentor, involving machining strategies for complex thin-walled aluminum alloy parts and the selection of post-processing software.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Discussed competition preparation with Master Sun Jianguo.
description: Yin Hao had just finished clearing the dishes and chopsticks when his mentor Sun Jianguo called right on time. The two talked for about half an hour. Yin Hao reported his exam performance, and Master Sun affirmed his steadiness and gave specific advice on the competition questions he raised: prioritize mastering continuous-trajectory machining, use UG's built-in module for post-processing for now, and also recommended two technical papers. After the call, Yin Hao wrote down the key points in detail in his notebook.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Catching up on sleep and resting
description: Due to continuous intense concentration, his body was fatigued. Yin Hao drew the bedroom curtains, lay on the bed, and rested with his eyes closed. Although he didn't fully fall asleep, the half-hour of full rest made his mind much clearer.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reviewing materials and meditating to relax
description: Yin Hao came out of the bedroom, splashed cold water on his face, and sat down on the living room sofa. He first took out the notes from his discussion with his mentor, spent 10 minutes quietly reviewing them, and marked new insights with a red pen. Then he lit a scented candle his friend had given him, sat cross-legged, and did 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation, focusing on each breath and temporarily clearing his mind of exam and competition thoughts. His mental state recovered noticeably.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Free time and light recharging.
description: Yin Hao opened his phone and browsed a tech forum for a while, then watched a video about five-axis machine tool maintenance. He sent a WeChat message to his running buddy Chen Jie, telling him that today's exam was over and suggesting they schedule a night run another day. Chen Jie replied with a thumbs-up emoji. After that, he turned on his smart speaker to play a few old songs and, while listening, hand-washed the sports shorts he had changed out of in the morning and hung them up to dry.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing dinner and contacting family.
description: Yin Hao went to the kitchen, washed the greens, and took out half a bag of frozen shrimp dumplings from the fridge to start preparing dinner. While the dumplings were boiling, he made a video call to his mother and asked with concern about her blood pressure reading today and how she felt after taking her medication. His mother smiled and told him her blood pressure was normal, she had taken the medicine, and she felt fine. Relieved, he reminded her not to forget to take her medicine tomorrow and to get plenty of rest.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner, browsing the news, and tidying up after the meal
description: Yin Hao brought the boiled dumplings and blanched greens to the table, played the replay of that day's CCTV News on his phone, and ate slowly, chewing carefully. He noticed in the news an advertisement for a new housing development near Guangfulin Road, silently noted the name of the development, and calculated that he could save up enough for a down payment by the end of the year before looking into it further. After the meal, he washed, dried, and put away the dishes and chopsticks, then paced around the house for a few minutes to stretch the muscles that had been sitting all day.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with girlfriend Lin Yue
description: Yin Hao made a video call to his girlfriend Lin Yue, who was reading in her rented apartment in Hangzhou. He shared in detail about today's exam process and feelings, and Lin Yue was happy for him. They chatted for about 25 minutes; the topic shifted from work to plans for their next meeting, set for the weekend at the end of October, and also discussed the progress of Lin Yue's internal transfer at her company. The atmosphere was relaxed and sweet.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Immersive organizing and light leisure.
description: After hanging up the video, Yin Hao opened his laptop and organized all of today's exam drawings, the machining program he had written, and the discussion notes with his mentor into a folder named "2025 Competition Preparation". Then he put on his headphones and listened to review commentary of two Honor of Kings matches, analyzing the jungle strategy, but he did not log into the game himself so as not to affect his sleep.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Yin Hao started washing up early, carefully washing his face and brushing his teeth with hot water. Back in the bedroom, he dimmed the desk lamp, placed a glass of water on the nightstand, and plugged in his phone and sports watch to charge. He deliberately changed the alarm from the usual 6:00 to 6:30, deciding to sleep half an hour longer tomorrow to give himself some buffer.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reading and bedtime
description: Yin Hao leaned against the headboard, opened Five-Axis CNC Programming and Operation, and focused on reading the turbine machining chapter recommended by his master. He read for about 20 minutes. At around 22:10 he turned off the reading lamp and lay down, feeling a sense of calm relief. He felt confident and hopeful about today's results and the plan for the coming month. After adjusting his sleeping position, he soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and running
description: At 06:30 the alarm went off and I got up on time. The scale showed 72.5 kg, and my weight was stable. After drinking a glass of warm water, I changed into quick-dry short sleeves and running shoes and went to Xiaokunshan Health Park for a morning run. I ran 2 km along the park trail, keeping the pace at 6 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer, as a recovery run after yesterday's advanced exam. My knees felt good. After finishing, I stretched and relaxed for 5 minutes in the park fitness area, breathing the fresh morning air.
location: 40 meters southwest of the intersection of Qinghe Street and Kungang Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xiaokunshan Health Park)

name: Breakfast and departure preparation
description: After returning home, he took a shower and blow-dried his hair. Breakfast was the usual: two slices of whole wheat bread, a cup of hot milk, and a boiled egg, which he ate quickly. He checked the documents needed for the vehicle annual inspection: vehicle license, ID card, and a copy of the compulsory traffic accident liability insurance policy. After confirming they were correct, he put them into the driver's license holder. He watered the pothos on the windowsill, grabbed his keys and phone, and went out.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuted to the inspection station
description: He set off in his white Chevrolet, passing through Xingang Road and Songhui East Road. Traffic was normal during the morning rush hour, and the roads were clear, so he arrived in about 15 minutes. On the way, he listened to the local traffic radio for a while and kept an eye on road conditions.
location: 337 Songdong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Shanghai No. 19 Motor Vehicle Safety Inspection Station)

name: Vehicle annual inspection and online insurance renewal
description: Arrived at the inspection station and followed the signs to drive the car into the inspection waiting area. After handing the keys and vehicle license to the staff, he waited in the lounge. The entire inspection process (headlights, brakes, exhaust emissions) took about 1 hour, and the car passed all checks smoothly. During the wait, he logged into the insurance company's app on his phone and renewed the compulsory traffic insurance and vehicle and vessel tax online, totaling 1,486 yuan, and saved a screenshot of the electronic policy. Then he opened the Beike App to browse newly listed second-hand homes in the old town of Songjiang, focusing on comparing total prices and down payments. He saved two small units near the university town, each with a total price of about 1.38 million yuan; the idea of buying a house grew stronger.
location: 337 Songdong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Shanghai No. 19 Motor Vehicle Safety Inspection Station)

name: Returned to the factory and refueled
description: After getting the annual inspection qualification sticker, he drove to the factory. On the way, he passed a Sinopec gas station on Xingang Road and filled up with 200 yuan worth of No. 92 gasoline. He arrived at the factory around 10:25, parked in the employee parking area, and swiped his card to enter the workshop.
location: No. 360, Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory)

name: Morning work and drawing confirmation
description: Changed into work clothes and went to the tool room to collect the cutting tools and measuring instruments needed for today's machining work order. He went over the drawing of a complex flange to be machined in the afternoon with team leader Wang Lei and confirmed several key dimensions and tolerance requirements. Then he returned to his three-axis machining center, clamped the batch workpiece left over from yesterday, adjusted the feed rate in the machining program, and monitored the machining process. He also found time to check the precision of several finished parts, and they were all within tolerance.
location: No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory workshop)

name: Lunch conversation
description: The end-of-work bell rang, and he went to the cafeteria with his colleague Liu Zhiqiang. Today's cafeteria menu included braised pork chop, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and stir-fried greens. As usual, he ordered a pork chop rice. While eating, he chatted with Liu Zhiqiang about yesterday's senior technician exam and the upcoming skills competition next month; both felt time was tight and they needed to get in more practice.
location: 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory Canteen)

name: Lunch break and technical study
description: After eating, he didn't go back to his workstation. He leaned on a bench in the rest area, took out his phone, and scrolled for 10 minutes through videos on Bilibili about post-processing practice on five-axis machining centers. Then he closed his eyes and dozed for 20 minutes to store up energy for the afternoon's work.
location: No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (workshop rest area of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory)

name: Afternoon precision machining and self-inspection
description: Started work on time in the afternoon, focusing mainly on machining the complex flange. Manually changed the cutting tool and wrote a new macro program according to the drawings to machine the special-shaped groove. During machining, stayed extremely focused and repeatedly measured key dimensions with calipers and a depth gauge. At 16:45, completed the workpiece smoothly and waited for the quality inspector to check it.
location: No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory workshop)

name: End-of-shift finishing and handover
description: Before leaving work, cleaned the machine table surface, swept the work area, and put all tools back into the tool cabinet. Wrote the shift record in the handover log, then changed out of work clothes.
location: No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory workshop)

name: Specialized practice in five-axis programming
description: After his co-workers had all left, he turned on the old computer connected to the engraving machine in the workshop office and launched the UG software. He took out a worn notebook and began targeted practice on the five-axis post-processing algorithm problem he was not confident about in yesterday's practical exam. He attempted to modify the parameters of two link instructions in the tool path and ran a simulation. Although he did not fully solve it, he wrote down the sticking points in detail with a red pen in the notebook and planned to consult the master on the weekend.
location: No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Workshop Office of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory)

name: Dine out.
description: Drove home from the factory, parked the car, and since he didn't feel like cooking, went straight to the noodle shop at the entrance of the neighborhood. He ordered a bowl of the signature beef knife-cut noodles and added a fried egg. He ate quickly and didn't order any drinks, saving time and effort.
location: No. 227 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Laodifang Knife-Cut Noodle Restaurant)

name: Evening study and household chores
description: After returning home, he took a shower first. Wearing a vest and shorts, he sat down at his desk and continued studying the last two chapters of the textbook Five-Axis CNC Programming and Operation. As he read, he marked key points in his notebook. He did not quite understand the "RTCP" compensation part, so he made a note and planned to look up more information later. At 20:00, he got up, hand-washed the workout clothes and socks he had changed out of that morning, and hung them on the balcony.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Discussion in the homeowners' group
description: He opened WeChat and saw that the community homeowners' group was lively at the moment. The deputy director of the owners' committee posted a video of the newly arrived fitness equipment being unboxed and said it would be installed and opened for use on Saturday. Scrolling back through the earlier messages, he learned that the equipment area was planned under Building 6, so he left a message asking: what time exactly can residents try it on the weekend? Is there a usage agreement? A neighbor in the group replied to him.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with mother.
description: Called his mother via WeChat video and asked whether she had measured her blood pressure on time today and what blood pressure medication she was taking. His mother said her blood pressure this morning was 128/82 and was well controlled. He also reminded his father not to forget to use the blood pressure monitor. They chatted about everyday family matters for about 10 minutes, his tone calm and caring.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening technical study and relaxation
description: Leaning against the headboard, he put on earphones and searched Bilibili for a few practical videos on five-axis programming for the Heidenhain system, simulating the operation process in his head while watching. After that, he casually browsed local Songjiang news and real estate forums for a while to understand the latest market trends. He didn't play games today; he felt his mind was quieter and better suited for thinking about technical issues.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: Turned off my phone, went to the bathroom, brushed my teeth carefully, and washed my face with hot water. I took out my work clothes for tomorrow from the wardrobe and hung them on the hook behind the door. I set the alarm for 6:30 tomorrow morning.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Turned off the bedside lamp and lay down. Recalling the day, the vehicle passed the annual inspection on the first try, work progressed normally, and although the programming practice got stuck, there was now a direction—everything was handled solidly. Although buying a house weighed on his mind, he had a plan and wasn't worried. Within a few seconds, he fell into a deep sleep.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Get up, wash up, and have breakfast
description: The alarm went off at 6:20 a.m., and it was still drizzling outside the window. Yin Hao got up quickly without lingering in bed and habitually weighed himself (72.5 kg, the same as yesterday). After washing up, he prepared a simple breakfast for himself: a glass of hot milk, two boiled eggs, and two slices of whole-wheat bread. Since the rain prevented a morning run, he browsed the day's weather forecast and industry news on his phone while eating breakfast, warming up for the day's work.
location: Room 301, Unit 4, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive to the company
description: He put on his work jacket, took the folding umbrella and the training materials he had organized the night before, locked the door, and went downstairs. The roads were slippery due to rain, so Yin Hao drove more carefully than usual. He turned from Xingang Road onto Huatianjing Highway and reached the company in about 15 minutes. He liked arriving early, which made him feel at ease all day.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing to start work and reviewing materials for the skills competition
description: He arrived twenty minutes earlier than the scheduled time. Yin Hao changed into his work clothes, first checked the machine tool he would operate that day, and confirmed that lubricating oil and coolant were sufficient. Then he took out his notes on "Five-Axis CNC Programming and Operation" and the skills competition materials, focused on reviewing the core concepts of RTCP compensation, and used a red pen to make detailed annotations next to the points he had been stuck on, fully preparing to consult his mentor at noon.
location: Workshop work station at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Batch machining of workpieces in the morning
description: After the pre-shift meeting, Yin Hao officially began the batch workpiece machining task. He skillfully set the parameters according to the drawings, clamped the workpieces, and started the program. During machining gaps, he had a brief technical discussion with the programming colleague Liu Zhiqiang about optimizing a machining path. The two worked in sync, and the roar of the machine tools in the workshop was the most familiar background sound.
location: Workshop work station at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Purchased health supplements for parents and mailed them.
description: During a short break at work, Yin Hao walked to the material storage area, opened the JD Health app on his phone, and, given his mother's mild high blood pressure, chose a bottle of high-calcium tablets and a bottle of high-purity fish oil. After confirming the delivery address was his hometown in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu, he entered a note: “Please put in a note saying: ‘Mom and Dad, take them on time, one of each every day. Your son.’” He completed the payment and sent it, feeling more at ease.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Continue the morning production and coordinate production scheduling
description: Continued focusing on the machining task at hand. Midway, team leader Wang Lei came over to notify me that a batch of urgent valve bodies needed priority processing in the afternoon. We briefly and efficiently discussed the production scheduling order. The work pace was intense, but everything was under control.
location: Workshop work station at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Company cafeteria lunch
description: The cafeteria offered braised pork, stir-fried greens, and seaweed egg drop soup. Yin Hao got his meal, habitually found a corner seat, and quickly finished lunch. While eating, he glanced at his phone and saw that his mother had replied in the family group confirming she received the photos he had sent earlier. A faint smile curled at the corner of his mouth.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: During the lunch break, ask the master for advice and prepare for the work ahead.
description: Yin Hao took the intensive training materials and his notes on questions to the workshop rest area and asked his master Sun Jianguo about parameter settings for RTCP compensation. Master Sun explained with his own cases, in simple terms, how to anticipate and adjust compensation values at different machining angles. Yin Hao focused on taking notes until everything became clear. He then took the opportunity to invite Master Sun to do a full five-axis hands-on practice session on Saturday morning, focusing on compensation application, and the master nodded in agreement. After thanking his master, Yin Hao returned to his workstation, quickly organized the key points into his computer notes, set a reminder for Saturday's practice session, drank a few sips of water, changed to the cutting tools needed for the afternoon, and prepared for the upcoming work.
location: Workshop rest area and workstation, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Urgent valve body machining in the afternoon.
description: In the afternoon, he devoted himself fully to the urgent valve body machining task assigned by team leader Wang Lei. These workpieces required high precision and a long machining cycle. Yin Hao focused completely, operated strictly according to the parameters, and fine-tuned the feed speed twice based on the machine tool feedback, completing the task with both quality and quantity assured. Midway, he used a 10-minute break to stretch his cervical spine and relax his shoulders and neck.
location: Workshop work station at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Tool inventory and work log after work.
description: After completing the inspection and warehousing of the last workpiece, Yin Hao carefully cleaned the chips around the machine tool and workstation, added lubricating oil to the guide rails, and filled in the handover logbook in detail with the day's work content, machine status, and items to be handed over. After packing up his personal belongings, he clocked out and left work.
location: Workshop work station at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Stop by the fresh food supermarket on the way to buy groceries and walk home.
description: On the way home by car, Yin Hao stopped by the Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket near the company. Holding an umbrella, he went in and picked out four tomatoes, a bunch of scallions, a piece of pork tenderloin, a bag of dried noodles, and also a carton of fresh milk, spending less than 40 yuan in total. After checkout, the rain had mostly stopped. He carried the shopping bags and walked for a little over 2 minutes back to Xingang Community, enjoying the fresh air after the rain.
location: Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai — Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket, and on the way home

name: Went home, made dinner, and enjoyed it.
description: After arriving home, Yin Hao changed into loungewear. In the kitchen, he skillfully washed vegetables and cut meat, making tomato and egg noodle soup and shredded pork with green peppers. While cooking the noodles, he played light music on his phone. After the food was served, he ate alone at the dining table and felt that the home-cooked dinner was much more comfortable than takeout. After the meal, he neatly washed the dishes and cleaned up the kitchen.
location: Room 301, Unit 4, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Screen rental listings in the evening.
description: Yin Hao poured himself a glass of water, sat down at his desk, opened his laptop, and logged on to the Anjuke and Lianjia websites. He set the area to near Songjiang University Town and filtered for two-bedroom, one-living-room apartments, rent of 3,000-4,000 yuan, and not on the top floor. After nearly two hours of careful filtering, he clicked through photos and VR tours of newly listed apartments one by one, checking layouts, natural light, and decoration. He finally saved five promising listings and created a new favorites folder named "Backup Rentals."
location: Room 301, Unit 4, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: WeChat chat with girlfriend Lin Yue
description: Yin Hao picked up his phone and sent his girlfriend Lin Yue links to five rental listings he had saved near Songjiang University Town, with the message: "Hey, I looked at a few apartments near the university town today. Two bedrooms and one living room, prices are okay. Saving them for now, just in case." Lin Yue quickly replied with a "[Go for it]" emoji. Yin Hao then asked about the progress of the weekend transfer news. Lin Yue said the management department might meet this weekend to decide, and she would let him know as soon as there was news. Yin Hao replied with an "OK" gesture.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, Unit 4, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Personal hygiene and pre-bed preparation.
description: Yin Hao got up and went to the bathroom to carefully brush his teeth, wash his face, and wash his feet. After returning to the bedroom, he opened the curtains and took a look at the night sky, from which the rain had completely stopped, and then lay down on the bed. Habitually, he opened the to-do list app on his phone and checked off all the items such as “buy health products and mail them”, “ask Master Sun for advice”, and “screen rental listings”. Reviewing the day, he felt that everything had been completed as planned and was very at ease. Afterward, he put on earphones and listened to a soothing piano piece to relax his body and mind.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 301, Unit 4, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Read a technical article and go to bed.
description: It was still early before bed, so Yin Hao opened the “Five-Axis CNC Technology” official account on his phone and read an article about an RTCP application case for the Heidenhain system. Combined with his master's explanation during the day, he gained a deeper understanding of the part where he had been stuck. At 23:00, he put down his phone on time, turned off the desk lamp, and quickly fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, Unit 4, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning core training.
description: The phone alarm rang at 6:15 a.m., five minutes earlier than usual. Pulled open the curtains; today was cloudy turning clear, and Shanghai at 6:30 felt fresh and crisp. Spread out the camouflage yoga mat in the living room and completed 15 minutes of core training: 1-minute plank x 2 sets, 20 lying leg raises x 2 sets, and cat stretch to relax the lower back. Heart rate rose to 110, and he was slightly sweating.
location: Room 503, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China (Living Room)

name: Washing up, breakfast, and getting ready to go out
description: Took a quick shower and changed into clean work clothes, then checked the hair he had styled the night before in the mirror. In the kitchen, he put two slices of whole wheat bread into the toaster and heated a glass of milk, finishing breakfast in less than 7 minutes. Checked and brought his phone, work badge, and keys. Today he brought a thermos and filled it with warm water. The weather had turned cooler, so he put on a light soft-shell jacket when going out.
location: Room 503, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China (bathroom/kitchen).

name: Cycled to the factory for work
description: At 07:00 he pushed his bike out the door on time. Heading east along Xingang Road, he turned onto Huatianjing Highway via Zhongjing Road. There were not many cars on the road today, so he kept a steady speed of about 20 km/h in the non-motorized lane. The morning breeze felt pleasant on his face. At 07:17 he arrived at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory and locked up his mountain bike in the designated area.
location: Songjiang District, Shanghai, China (Route: Xingang Road, Zhongjing Road, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway).

name: Pre-work preparation and pre-shift morning meeting
description: Swiped card to enter the factory, then changed into dark blue work clothes and anti-impact safety shoes in the locker room. After arriving at the workstation, he checked the lubricating oil level and air pressure of Machine No. 1 as usual and added cutting fluid. Then he attended the pre-shift morning meeting; shift leader Wang Lei briefly assigned the tasks: continue finishing the valve body inner wall from last week in the morning (requiring high surface finish), and rough-mill a batch of urgent flange parts in the afternoon.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China (changing room, workshop)

name: Precision machining of the valve body inner wall in the morning
description: After the morning meeting, returned to the workstation and took out the valve body workpiece that had been clamped last Friday. Called up the five-axis machining program written last time and rechecked the machining coordinate system. Started the machine and monitored the machining process with full concentration. Midway, colleague Liu Zhiqiang came over to discuss the effect of coolant pressure on chip evacuation; the two briefly exchanged experiences. Around 11:30, took a 10-minute break, drank water, and stretched.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (workshop), 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Cafeteria lunch and programming study.
description: Went to the cafeteria with workshop colleagues and queued up. Today's menu was braised pork chop, tomato scrambled eggs, and stir-fried Hangzhou cabbage. After getting the food, I habitually sat in a corner seat against the wall and opened the advanced five-axis programming notes Master Sun had sent on my phone while eating, thinking about the calling logic of several macro programs. I ate fairly quickly and finished at 12:25.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (employee cafeteria), 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch break and preparation for afternoon work.
description: Back in the workshop rest area, he folded his jacket into a simple pillow and lay face down on the table to rest for 20 minutes. At 12:50 the alarm went off, so he went to the sink and washed his face with cold water to refresh himself. Walking back to his workstation, he first checked the process drawing for the afternoon's flange rough milling, mentally reviewed the clamping method and tool path, and prepared the required face milling cutters.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China (workshop rest area)

name: Afternoon rough milling of the flange
description: The afternoon task was rough milling a batch of flanges. It was hard work with loud machines, but he still had to keep a close eye on the cutting conditions. Yin Hao switched to the rough milling cutter head, adjusted the spindle speed and feed rate according to the material, and began formal machining. During an inspection, he found chips wound around the tool holder once, so he paused immediately and cleaned it out with a hook. Everything went smoothly, and by the end of the shift he had completed 50% of the planned amount, to be continued tomorrow morning.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory (workshop), 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: End-of-work wrap-up and cycling home
description: At 16:45, shut down the machine tool, use an air gun to clean the iron chips inside and outside as required, apply lubricating oil to the guide rails, fill in the Equipment Daily Maintenance Record and complete the Production Daily Report. At 17:00, go to the changing room to change back into casual clothes, clock out. Get on the bike and return along the same route. While waiting at a red light, replied to fellow runner Chen Jie's WeChat, confirming they'll run 10 km together on Saturday morning. Arrived home at 17:13.
location: Songjiang District, Shanghai, China (factory on Xingang Road)

name: Homemade tomato and egg noodle dinner
description: After getting home, I changed into loungewear and washed my hands. I boiled a pot of water for the noodles, and meanwhile heated oil in another wok to stir-fry a simple tomato-and-egg sauce. There were two stalks of leafy greens left in the fridge; I washed them, blanched them, and scooped them into a bowl. Once the noodles were done, I poured the sauce over them. A steaming bowl of tomato-egg noodles with greens warmed my stomach.
location: Room 503, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China (kitchen/dining room).

name: Video call with mother.
description: After finishing the meal and cleaning up the dishes, it was exactly six o'clock. Remembering that the calcium tablets and fish oil sent yesterday should arrive today, I called Mom on WeChat video. Mom had just finished dinner and said the delivery had arrived at noon, and she was taking them according to the note I wrote. Yin Hao asked about Mom's blood pressure again and urged her to take her medicine on time. Mom reminded him that Shanghai had cooled down, and he should wear more clothes in the morning and evening. They chatted about everyday things for half an hour, and the atmosphere was relaxed and warm.
location: Room 503, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China (living room sofa)

name: Organized the weekend house-viewing list and contacted the agent
description: After hanging up, I opened my laptop and started making a “Weekend House-Viewing Checklist.” Based on running buddy Chen Jie’s reminder to “pay attention to natural lighting and floor level” and former comrade Zhou Xiaofeng’s emphasis on “checking whether the community has fiber-optic internet,” I listed detailed checkpoints in a table, covering backup listings in several communities such as Sanxiang Four Seasons Flower City and Poly Xizi Bay. Then, on WeChat, I left messages for Manager Zhao at Lianjia and Supervisor Qian at I Love My Home, and clearly arranged a centralized house-viewing session from 2 to 4 p.m. on Saturday. After dealing with work, it was almost 8 o'clock.

participant.name: Supervisor Qian
participant.relation: I Love My Home real estate agency

location: Room 503, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China (study, in front of laptop)

name: Discussed the details of the weekend vocational school presentation.
description: At exactly 8 o'clock, he proactively called Teacher Li, the contact teacher at Songjiang No. 1 Vocational School. They discussed the arrangements for Saturday morning's sharing session at the school and confirmed that about 120 students would attend. Teacher Li suggested adding more interactive segments. Yin Hao took the suggestion and volunteered to bring a workpiece to demonstrate tool setting and basic operations on site. After hanging up, he opened his laptop, fine-tuned the prepared speech outline, and added a short story about "the spirit of craftsmanship lies in holding fast to every dimension."

participant.name: Teacher Li
participant.relation: Teacher at Songjiang No. 1 Vocational School

location: Study, Room 503, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Gaming and entertainment, and group-chat socializing
description: After finishing what he needed to do, he leaned back on the sofa to relax. He opened Honor of Kings and teamed up with his battle buddy "Zhang Fei" for two ranked matches, winning one and losing one; his hands still felt decent. After exiting the game, he sent a voice message in the "Songjiang Three Brothers" WeChat group: "Brothers, I've scheduled a house viewing for Saturday afternoon. Anyone free to join? After we're done, I'll treat everyone to late-night snacks." Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang quickly replied and set the time.
location: Room 503, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China (living room sofa)

name: Evening washing up and body relaxation.
description: Seeing that the time was about right, he got up and went to the bathroom to take a shower, and washed today's work clothes by hand and hung them to dry. After washing up, he sat on the edge of the bed, took out a foam roller, and focused on rolling the lower back and hip muscles that were sore from standing for a long time during the day. Then he opened the "Tide" app on his phone, set a 15-minute meditation, and gradually emptied his mind following the guided instructions.
location: Room 503, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China (bathroom, bedroom)

name: Bedtime technical reading and house-viewing memo
description: After the meditation ended, both mind and body felt much more relaxed. I turned off the main light and left only a warm bedside lamp on. Leaning against the headboard, I opened my phone and first read a technical article about Heidenhain system 3+2 positioning machining. Combined with the afternoon's rough milling experience, I understood it more deeply. Then, in my memos, I wrote down a few things to pay special attention to during Saturday's house viewing, to make sure nothing went wrong.
location: Room 503, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China (on the bed in the bedroom)

name: Lights Out, Went to Sleep
description: At 23:00, he put down his phone and turned off the computer on time. He confirmed the alarm for 6:20 the next morning, then set his phone to Do Not Disturb mode. Mentally planning for tomorrow Friday, he thought he would work normally and could rest a bit earlier in the evening, saving energy for Saturday's house viewing, presentation, and scheduled run. He ran through tomorrow's schedule in his mind and, with a little anticipation and some fatigue, quickly fell asleep.
location: Room 503, Building 6, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China (on the bed in the bedroom)

name: Wake-up and simplified core training
description: I woke up because of a dull pain in my right molar. I laid a yoga mat directly on the bedroom floor and did a 10-minute simplified routine, including cat stretches, supine leg raises, and shoulder-and-neck stretches, deliberately avoiding movements that required clenching my teeth. Afterward, I washed up with warm water.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Requesting time off and preparing to depart
description: Looked at his teeth in the mirror and confirmed the swelling and pain had not subsided. He called team leader Wang Lei to ask for leave, explaining that he needed to go to the hospital for his toothache. After getting approval, he took his medical insurance card and car keys from the shoe cabinet, put on his coat, and got ready to go out.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the dental clinic.
description: Drove a Kia K3, following the route set by the navigation system, from Xingang Community to Weile Dental (Songjiang University Town Branch). The roads were clear before the morning rush hour, so he opened the window for air to relieve the soreness in his gums, and arrived about 18 minutes later.
location: Along the route from Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Weile Dental (Songjiang University City Branch), 718 Wenhui Road, Songjiang District.

name: Registering and preparing to wait for the doctor.
description: After parking in the ground-level parking lot under Weile Dental, he successfully registered and waited in the waiting area. Meanwhile, he searched for "moderate tooth decay filling procedure" to learn about the upcoming treatment, and then was called into the consultation room.
location: Vello Dental (Songjiang University City Branch), 718 Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai - lobby and waiting area

name: Cavity diagnosis and filling treatment.
description: Dr. Zhang Ming used a probe and ice-cotton balls to test tooth sensitivity and took dental X-rays. He diagnosed moderate interproximal caries on the lower right 6th and 7th teeth, requiring fillings. Under local anesthesia, treatment took about 40 minutes, including decay removal, glass ionomer filling, and bite adjustment. I stayed calm and cooperative throughout, only feeling a brief sting from the anesthetic needle.
location: Treatment room, Weile Dental (Songjiang University Town Branch), No. 718, Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Settle the fees and collect the medical instructions.
description: After the treatment, he went to the front desk to settle the bill. The total cost was 800 yuan, medical insurance paid 500 yuan, and he paid 300 yuan out of pocket. Dr. Zhang advised him to fast for two hours and not to chew on the affected side for 24 hours. He also prescribed anti-inflammatory medication, reminding him to take it on time, and said he could speak normally the next morning.
location: Front Desk, Well Dental (Songjiang University Town Branch), 718 Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove home and went shopping on the way.
description: Drove back before the anesthetic had worn off. On the way, passing by Feichang Mobile (Songjiang University City store), I went in to look at the latest models and picked up a price quote. Then I drove to Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, bought millet, pumpkin, and salted duck eggs, planning to cook porridge. Finally, I parked the car, walked about 2.6 minutes carrying the shopping bags, and returned to the rental apartment in Xingang Community.
location: Feichang Mobile (Songjiang University Town Store), No. 718-11, Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai; Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road; Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District

name: Rest and polish the presentation slides
description: After arriving home, he first took anti-inflammatory medication and rested propped up against the headboard. After sending his mother a WeChat message to let her know he was safe, he opened his laptop to polish the PPT for tomorrow's vocational high school presentation. Based on the previous day's communication with Teacher Li, he focused on adjusting the logical relationship between the two slides on "The Spirit of Craftsmanship and Five-Axis Programming Technology," trimmed overly detailed technical parameters, mentally rehearsed the key points, and closed the computer after confirming the pacing was accurate.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: In the kitchen, I slowly cooked pumpkin and millet porridge over low heat. After letting it cool, I ate it slowly with half a salted duck egg. After the meal, the anesthesia had completely worn off, and the soreness at the tooth root was obvious, so I drew the curtains, lay down in bed, and rested with my eyes closed until 1:30 pm.
location: Kitchen and bedroom of the rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Light activity and watching vehicle condition videos
description: After the lunch break, got up to stretch and used my phone to watch two videos about second-hand car pitfall avoidance guides while sitting on the living room sofa, to build up knowledge for future vehicle maintenance or replacement.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organize the materials for tomorrow's house viewing and presentation.
description: Systematic tidying: he wiped clean the valve body workpiece for tomorrow's demonstration and put it in the toolbox, hung up the suit and trousers, polished the leather shoes, and confirmed in advance the ID documents and printed income records needed for the property viewing.
location: Every corner of the rental apartment in Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Online socializing and leisure
description: In the bedroom, he used the Beike App to repeatedly check the floor plans and surrounding amenities of the five saved house listings, then sent a screenshot of the Saturday house-viewing plan to the "Songjiang Three Brothers" group and suggested having a late-night snack. Liu Zhiqiang replied first. location: Bedroom and living room of the rental apartment, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Preparing and eating dinner
description: Heated up the leftover pumpkin porridge from noon and steamed a bowl of egg custard. Even though he had no taste in his mouth, he forced himself to finish it slowly to replenish energy. After the meal, he washed the dishes and cleaned the kitchen.
location: Kitchen and living room of the rental apartment in Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with mother.
description: Initiated a video call with his mother, Wang Xiuying, via WeChat, so she could see her own face and told her that her teeth were no longer a problem, urged her to measure her blood pressure on time, and also asked about his father's recent work. The call lasted about 20 minutes and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening study and organizing notes
description: Sitting at the desk, I took out my five-axis programming notes. Combining the key points I had asked my master about in the previous two days and my practice questions from October 14, I made supplementary marks with a red pen at key places. Using the calm state of mind after the tooth filling, I sorted through the knowledge again and felt at ease.
location: Desk in the rented apartment, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Free Time and Personal Care
description: He turned on the speaker to play light music, used a foam roller to thoroughly relax his neck, shoulders, and leg muscles, then took a hot shower (deliberately avoiding the affected tooth), followed by a hydrating mask, completing a soothing self-recharging time.
location: Every corner of the rental apartment in Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Meditation and stretching before bed.
description: Turned off electronic devices, left only a bedside lamp on, sat cross-legged on a yoga mat, and did 20 minutes of meditation and stretching, deliberately relaxing the jaw and facial muscles and using deep breaths to calm the day's tension.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and reading to fall asleep
description: After meditation, he set the alarm for 6:20 the next day and quickly checked tomorrow's schedule. Then he leaned against the headboard and read a professional book on CNC machine tool maintenance for 15 minutes. Feeling drowsy, he turned off the light and lay down, falling asleep quickly in the cool autumn night.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning exercise and breakfast
description: At 6:20 a.m., he got up on time in the gray light of the cloudy weather without lingering in bed. He quickly reviewed the day's schedule: a craftsman spirit presentation in the morning and apartment viewings in the afternoon. Then he completed a 15-minute core workout on the living room yoga mat, including 3 sets of planks (1 minute each) and 3 sets of side bridges on each side (40 seconds each), using physical fatigue to ease his nervousness about the presentation. After the workout, he took a shower and felt refreshed. While brushing his teeth, he deliberately brushed lightly on the right side to avoid the tooth that was filled yesterday, and bit with the left side. Breakfast was leftover pumpkin millet porridge from last night, reheated, with a boiled egg, and he chewed on the left side throughout. While eating, he packed the PPT for the presentation and the ID card, bank statements, tape measure, flashlight, etc., needed for apartment viewing into his backpack.
location: Room 403, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Before setting out, called the master to ask for advice
description: Five minutes before leaving, he made a video call to his master, Sun Jianguo. He had just come back from morning exercise and was having breakfast. The two quickly reviewed two key points in five-axis programming: RTCP compensation and tool axis control. The master dipped his chopsticks in water and drew on the table while explaining, and Yin Hao recorded with his phone, confirming several error-prone parameters. After hanging up, he felt more confident about the morning presentation and could handle student questions with ease.
location: Room 403, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Drive to Songjiang No. 1 Vocational School
description: Leaving the residential complex, the streets were clear and traffic was smooth; the drive took about 25 minutes. His driving style was steady. Instead of listening to music, he used voice memos to silently recite the opening remarks of his speech, making sure the logic and emotion were in place. As he neared the school gate, he contacted Teacher Li from the school to confirm the parking spot.
location: Songjiang District, Shanghai, on the drive from Xingang Community to Songjiang First Vocational School.

name: Craftsman spirit presentation and exchange with teachers and students
description: Arrived at Songjiang No. 1 Vocational School, where Teacher Li was already waiting at the gate and led him to a lecture hall that could seat 120 people. Yin Hao quickly set up his laptop and PPT, checked the presentation clicker, placed the machined valve body workpiece he had brought on one side of the podium, and tested the room's audio with his phone. At exactly 9:00, the presentation officially began. He took a deep breath and opened with a resounding "Attention!" before moving into his military experience: "In the army, we are the people's shield; in the workshop, the CNC machine tool is my steel rifle." He then showed several precision machining cases. When he got to the dry theory, he turned and drew a five-axis linkage principle diagram on the blackboard. The students all looked up, and some began taking notes. The presentation was kept to 40 minutes, with 5 minutes reserved for questions. Two students asked about RTCP and tool interference. Yin Hao answered crisply, drawing on his master's guidance that morning. After the session, a dozen or so students gathered around to ask follow-up questions about operational details. He pulled up workshop videos on his phone, squatted in the corridor, and drew the coordinate system again with chalk, and also added several students on WeChat. Then Teacher Li kept him for lunch in the staff cafeteria. While eating, he looked through the feedback questionnaires just collected; 90% of students gave high ratings and suggested showing more machining videos in the future. Yin Hao recorded the suggestion in his memo and replied that next time he could bring metal teaching aids. Before leaving, he also annotated the paper questionnaires with directions for improving the video demonstrations.
location: Songjiang First Vocational School, No. 925 North Renmin Road, Zhongshan Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Focused house viewing: five listings
description: After leaving school, he drove to the apartment-viewing area. On the way, he called Manager Zhao of Lianjia in advance and told him he would arrive in about 15 minutes. The first stop was the 4th floor of Leiden Town (Room 402, No. 17, Lane 1166, Guangfulin Road), hosted by Manager Zhao. As soon as Yin Hao entered, he turned on the tap to test water pressure, crouched down to check the drainage, inspected the window weatherstripping, and stepped on the balcony tiles to test for hollow spots, taking photos as records. Then he went to the 2nd floor of Poly Xiziwan (Room 201, No. 8, Lane 1599, Guangfulin Road), hosted by Supervisor Qian from 5i5j. He focused on looking up at water stains on the ceiling, using a flashlight to check the baseboards for mold, measuring the kitchen exhaust duct with a tape measure, and also observing the underground garage entrance and the spacing between buildings. After that, he went to the 3rd floor of Sanxiang Four Seasons Flower City (Room 302, No. 12, Lane 1501, Meijiabang Road). The unit had a regular layout and good daylight. He used a flashlight to check the kitchen and bathroom suspended ceilings for mold stains, tested the sink drainage speed, and asked Manager Zhao about property management fees and elevator maintenance. Next, he viewed the ground floor of Sanxiang Four Seasons Flower City (Room 101, No. 3). As soon as he entered, he touched the wall corners to check for dampness. After opening the window, he asked Manager Zhao to walk downstairs to test light obstruction, and video-called his cousin to ask her to evaluate the sunlight outside the window. She said the lighting was average, especially with a large shadow in the living room in the afternoon. Finally, he viewed the ground floor of Poly Xiziwan (Room 102, No. 3). Again, he first checked the walls for dampness, tried the bathroom exhaust fan, and stepped on the floor to check for looseness. He video-called his cousin once more. After comparing, she thought the lighting was slightly better than Sanxiang's, but pointed out that the slope in front of the building could easily accumulate water. Yin Hao went downstairs and walked around, found that the manhole cover was a bit high, and noted "water accumulation hazard" in his memo. Throughout, he remained calm, scored the properties mentally, and did not easily reveal his stance.
location: Guangfulin Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai: Leighton Town, Poly Xizi Bay, Sanxiang Four Seasons Flower City, and other residential communities.

name: Bought groceries on the way home
description: After seeing the apartment, I drove around Songjiang New City and finally stopped in front of the fresh supermarket at Xingang New Village. Inside, I bought soft tofu, a bunch of greens, a pack of dried noodles, and a few scallions. Since I still needed soft food after the tooth filling, I planned to make vegetable and tofu noodles. I also grabbed a bottle of fresh milk for breakfast the next day. After shopping, I drove back to Xingang Community, listening to a radio storytelling program on the way.
location: Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Rest and cook dinner
description: After arriving home, I washed my hands and face first, then lay on the sofa for about 20 minutes to recover. Then I went into the kitchen to boil water and cook noodles: first blanched the greens and tofu, then boiled the dried noodles, made a bowl of broth, arranged the greens and tofu on top, and poached an egg. While eating, I deliberately chewed slowly using the left side of my teeth. After the meal, I washed the dishes and wiped the stove clean.
location: Room 403, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Organizing house-viewing records and discussing in the group
description: Opened his laptop and created a new Excel spreadsheet, entering the 5 properties viewed today in 8 columns: "Property Name", "Floor", "Area", "Daylight Rating", "Dampness Risk", "Water Pressure/Drainage", "Surroundings", and "Overall Rating (1-5)". In the remarks column he noted: "Sanxiang Four Seasons ground floor (cousin said daylight is average)" and "Poly Xizi Bay ground floor (water accumulation risk)", and marked the ground-floor properties with high dampness risk in red. He also marked the second-floor unit at Poly Xizi Bay in green with the note "north-south through unit, clean parking space". He then took a screenshot and sent it to the "Songjiang Three Brothers" WeChat group. The group members quickly responded: Gao Zhiyuan praised the spreadsheet as professional, Wang Lei asked whether his father could accept the ground floor, and Ma Xiaofeng thought the second floor was worth considering if parking was not an issue. Yin Hao admitted that besides price, he was most worried about dampness on the ground floor. The group chat had a relaxed atmosphere.
location: Room 403, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

description: He played Honor of Kings for a while, using his usual Clash Lane hero. In a break after taking a shower, he sent a voice message to his running buddy Chen Jie, suggesting a morning run at Sijing Sports Center at 6 a.m. tomorrow, and Chen Jie readily agreed.
location: Room 403, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Video call with mother.
description: He called his mother over WeChat video and chatted for nearly half an hour. While talking, he showed her the photos of the apartments he had viewed that afternoon, explaining in detail that the ground floor might be damp, while the second-floor unit was relatively more suitable. His mother asked about his treated tooth; Yin Hao said it didn't hurt and that he had been eating soft noodles. He then reminded her to measure her blood pressure and remember to take calcium tablets. She told him not to worry, saying she remembered everything. The conversation made both of them feel much more at ease.
location: Room 403, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Evening study and physical relaxation.

Then took out a foam roller and spent 15 minutes on the living room floor relaxing the lower back and leg muscles to relieve the soreness from all the walking that day. After that, took a hot shower and changed into pajamas.
location: Room 403, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

description: When brushing his teeth, he was gentle, deliberately avoiding the filled tooth surface on the right side, rinsed with warm water, and in front of the mirror bit down with the right side to confirm there was no discomfort. Back in the bedroom, he left the window cracked open for air, opened the Tide app, and set rain sounds as white noise. Leaning against the headboard, he did 15 minutes of breathing meditation and static neck-and-shoulder stretches; the tension from the day's presentation and house viewing gradually faded. Finally, he lay down gently, did not set an alarm, put his phone into the bedside pouch, wrapped the quilt tightly around himself, and soon fell asleep, ready for the next morning's run.
location: Room 403, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Morning wake-up and core training
description: On Sunday morning, the internal clock woke Yin Hao promptly at 5:50. He glanced at his phone; the morning light was already filtering through the curtains. He got up briskly, drank a glass of warm water, and changed into a sports T-shirt, shorts, and running shoes. He then laid out a yoga mat on the living room floor and started a 15-minute core workout: three sets of planks (1 minute each), three sets of 20 lying leg raises, and three sets of cat-cow stretches with 10 breaths each, fully activating his body.
location: Room XXX, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning run and trying out new fitness equipment

When he reached the central garden, he met fellow runner Chen Jie, and the two ran side by side for about 3 kilometers before stretching together. Then he noticed the newly installed exercise equipment on the east side of the garden. Yin Hao tested the stability of the pull-up bar and did 10 consecutive pull-ups; Chen Jie also gave it a try. He then spent 5 minutes on the air walker. After confirming the equipment was stable, he took several close-up photos and a short video, planning to share them with his neighbors.

Then he boiled eggs and heated milk, while sending the previously taken photos and videos of the fitness equipment to the Xingang Community Owners Group, with a caption saying the equipment was now available. This drew likes from neighbors and praise from Aunt Chen. After breakfast, he contacted Chen Jie on WeChat and praised the pull-up bar for being sturdy, inviting him to do pull-ups together after a morning run in the middle of next week. Chen Jie happily agreed. Afterwards, he checked the backpack for the apartment viewing: ID card, cash, notebook, pen, and tape measure, making sure nothing was missing.
location: Room XXX, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

Sunday traffic was smooth, and he arrived at the community gate about 20 minutes later to meet the real estate agent. He entered the small two-bedroom unit on the top floor with the agent and immediately checked the ceiling and roof seams, finding multiple yellow water stains and peeling paint. The bedroom walls also had large areas of damp marks. He called his female cousin via video call on the spot and showed her the leakage in real time. His cousin clearly said the leaks were serious and the unit could not be bought. Yin Hao wrote “not recommended” in his notebook, thanked the agent, and ended the viewing.
location: Top-floor unit, No. X, Poly Xizi Bay, Lane 1188, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

After entering, he went straight to the meat section with a clear goal, picked a fine piece of pork belly with alternating lean and fat layers to make braised pork for dinner, and also bought eggs, baby bok choy, cucumbers, and seasonings such as scallions, ginger, and garlic. Then he drove home.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

I entered the detailed house-viewing information (including the location of the water stains and my cousin's opinion) into the "Shanghai Second-Hand House Inspection Comparison Table.xlsx". After updating the comprehensive evaluation, I sent it to the "Songjiang Three Brothers" family group, noting that the top-floor listing was rejected because of the water leakage issue. Just after sending it, my colleague Wang Lei responded in the group and initiated a WeChat voice call. The two of us discussed the several apartments recently viewed and the pros and cons of top-floor units for about half an hour. Wang Lei favored the second-floor unit at Poly Xiziwan, while Yin Hao felt the daylight needed further consideration.
location: Room XXX, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

At 12 o'clock he sat at the dining table and ate quietly. After washing the dishes and chopsticks, he paced in the living room for ten minutes to aid digestion. At 12:45 he set an alarm and went to bed for a nap, falling into light sleep to build up energy for the afternoon.
location: Room XXX, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai
