description: After the 14:00 alarm went off, Yin Hao got up, washed his face, sat back at the desk, and took out his five-axis programming notebook. He focused on resolving questions about RTCP (Rotating Tool Center Point) compensation, drawing diagrams on scrap paper while reviewing his notes to work through the coordinate transformation logic. After a full hour of study, he switched things up and used his tablet to play a HEIDENHAIN system troubleshooting maintenance video, while using a foam roller on the yoga mat to roll out the front and sides of his thighs and his calves, combining learning with physical relaxation.
location: Room XXX, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cook dinner and have a video call with mother.
description: At 15:30, Yin Hao went into the kitchen, washed the pork belly, cut it into pieces, and blanched it. Then he heated the wok to caramelize sugar, added the pork and stir-fried it to color, then added scallions, ginger, star anise, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and boiling water. He brought it to a boil over high heat, then turned to low heat and simmered slowly. At 16:30, during the simmering break, he called his mother Wang Xiuying via video in the living room, pointed the camera at the stove to show the braised pork, and his mother praised his cooking. He talked about his house-hunting situation. His mother told him not to rush such a big matter as buying a home. Taking the opportunity, Yin Hao reminded her to take her blood pressure medicine on time and to wear more clothes as the weather turned colder. After hanging up, he returned to the kitchen, turned up the heat to reduce the sauce for the braised pork, quickly stir-fried a plate of greens, and put both the meat and vegetables on the table.
location: Room XXX, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and kitchen cleanup.
description: Sitting at the dining table, Yin Hao enjoyed his homemade braised pork and greens. The meat was tender and succulent, with a balanced salty-sweet flavor, and it was very satisfying with rice. After the meal, he briskly cleared the dishes, chopsticks, and pots; following his military habit, he washed, dried, and put them back in place, and wiped the stove and countertop clean.
location: Room XXX, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

description: After tidying up, he opened Honor of Kings on the living room sofa and, seeing his colleague Wang Lei online, invited him to a duo queue. He got MVP with Lü Bu in the first game and narrowly lost the second. Afterwards, he spent some time watching Bilibili videos on CNC machine repair. At 19:30 he went to take a shower, cleaned his whole body carefully, then hand-washed the day's work jacket and sports T-shirt and hung them on the balcony to dry. At 20:30, back in the bathroom, he did his oral care routine: first flossing between his teeth, then brushing carefully with his electric toothbrush for 3 minutes, and finally swishing for 30 seconds with the doctor-recommended mouthwash to make sure there was no food residue around the filling.
location: Room XXX, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Meditation and relaxation, bedtime reading, and falling asleep
description: At 9 PM, Yin Hao turned off the living room main light and kept only the desk lamp on. He sat cross-legged on the yoga mat and meditated for 15 minutes, closing his eyes, regulating his breath, and emptying his mind. Then he used a few yoga poses to stretch his shoulders, neck, and spine. At 9:30 PM he returned to the bedroom, set the alarm for Monday, the next day, at 6:10 AM, and leaned against the headboard to browse WeChat official account articles about car maintenance and Shanghai real estate forums on his phone, getting a sense of the average prices by area. At 10 PM, drowsiness set in. He turned off the desk lamp and, in the darkness, reviewed the fullness of the day: avoiding house-viewing traps, completing his studies, enjoying good food, and interacting with family and friends. Feeling content, he soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room XXX, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning preparation at home
description: At 05:50 in the morning, the alarm went off on time. Yin Hao got up immediately, took deep breaths to wake up his body, then went to the bathroom to wash up, splashing cold water on his face to quickly refresh himself. After that, he spread out a yoga mat in the living room and started a 15-minute core workout, including three sets of side planks (45 seconds each) and four sets of bird-dog exercises (12 reps each), feeling his waist and abdominal muscles engage, paying special attention to the stability of the old injury in his lower back. After training, he did a full-body stretch, focusing on the hip flexors and hamstrings. After wiping off sweat, he changed into clean blue work clothes and checked the work ID and access card in his pockets. Then he prepared a simple breakfast in the kitchen: boiled two eggs, heated a glass of milk, and ate two slices of whole wheat bread. Meanwhile, he opened the 'CNC Programming Assistant' app on his phone to browse key points of five-axis programming macro commands, preparing for the day's work.
location: Room XX, No. XX, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

He kept a steady pace the whole way, avoiding sudden acceleration and bumps to protect his lower back. The morning air was fresh, and he ran through today's work tasks in his mind.

First he checked the HEIDENHAIN-system five-axis machining center he was responsible for, inspected the oil level and coolant, and confirmed the equipment was in normal condition. After nodding and greeting Wang Lei, the team leader who was holding the morning meeting, he reviewed the day's workpiece drawings and program sheets. He then began machining a batch of aluminum alloy valve bodies, carefully calibrating the tool compensation data according to the process cards before starting the machine. During machining, he concentrated on observing the cutting state and spindle sound, and used a micrometer to spot-check the dimensions of the first and second pieces at regular intervals to ensure precision.
location: Machining workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

He clearly stated his name and needs, successfully booked a follow-up teeth cleaning for 2 p.m. this Thursday (October 24), and confirmed with the nurse the precautions to follow after the filling from the previous day.

name: In the morning, focused on the second phase of work.

During a break in the work, the difficulties of five-axis programming flashed through Yin Hao's mind again, and he secretly decided to ask his mentor Sun Jianguo for leave at noon.
location: Machining workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and a heart-to-heart talk with the master
description: Yin Hao went to the canteen a few minutes early, got braised pork, stir-fried greens and rice, and found a corner seat to wait for his mentor, Master Sun Jianguo. When Master Sun sat down with his tray, Yin Hao cut straight to the point, candidly saying that he was not proficient in five-axis macro programs (especially macro-command nesting for complex surface machining) and was worried about the skills competition next month. Master Sun shared his experience from more than ten years ago, when he stayed up for three consecutive nights before a municipal competition to crack irregular thread programming, and agreed to take time on Saturday afternoon to run a five-axis tool path for impeller machining with him in the software. After hearing this, Yin Hao felt reassured and his appetite improved.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Post-meal walk and afternoon nap
description: After lunch, Yin Hao did not immediately return to the workshop. Instead, he walked slowly for about ten minutes on the factory grounds to digest his food while reflecting on Master Sun's words. Then he returned to the workshop break area, leaned back in a chair, and rested with his eyes closed for 15 minutes to store up energy for the afternoon.
location: Factory area and rest area of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Efficient work in the afternoon
description: In the afternoon, feeling energized, Yin Hao continued processing the remaining valve bodies from the morning. Because he felt at ease, his operations were smoother, and the entire machining process went very smoothly. He also took time to jot down a few new programming ideas in his notebook, planning to discuss them with Master Sun on the weekend.
location: Machining workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

The two chatted briefly about the post-processing of the new five-axis machine tool. Liu Zhiqiang complained that the new post-processing program sometimes triggered alarms, and Yin Hao suggested he check the starting safe plane parameters.
location: Rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360, Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

location: Machining workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

He rode his mountain bike back the same way and stopped at the Xingang Xincun fresh food supermarket not far from home. He pushed a cart in and, as planned, bought 2 yuan of green vegetables, 4 eggs, 500 grams of pork shank bones (for soup on the weekend), and a pack of dried noodles, spending less than 40 yuan in total.
location: Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

While eating the noodles, he scrolled through the 'Metalworking' official account on his phone and read a technical article about cutting parameters for new titanium alloys. Feeling it was helpful for his work, he saved it as a favorite. After eating, he washed the dishes, wiped down the stove, packed all the kitchen waste in a bag, and put it by the door, ready to take downstairs and throw away the next day.

After training, he walked on the striding machine for 10 minutes, stretched the front and back of his thighs, then walked another slow lap for a full-body cool-down, shaking his arms and back to ease the muscles.

name: House-viewing activity after work
description: At 16:45, turned off the machine, filled in the machining records, changed back into casual clothes in the locker room, wiped my face, and packed my backpack. At 17:00, set off on a mountain bike, riding along Guangfulin Road for 35 minutes to reach Sanxiang Four Seasons Flower City. After entering the apartment, I focused on checking the water pressure and drainage in the kitchen and bathroom, used a flashlight to check the pipe connections under the sink for leaks, confirmed the network cable in the low-voltage electrical box was "CAT6" (a Category 6 cable), checked the ceiling for water stains, took photos as records, and concluded the place was bright and airy. I listed it as the first candidate and called Manager Zhao, the agent, to let him know. At 18:25, rode 15 minutes to Greenland Triumph Palace, and at 18:40 entered the third-floor unit. I checked the pipes and ceiling similarly, but found the wiring in the low-voltage electrical box was messy and the living room was a bit shallow in depth. I took photos and contacted Manager Zhao to report the comparison.
location: Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Lane 1599, Guangfulin Road, and Greenland Triumph Palace, Lane 999, Canghua Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bought groceries and went home.
description: After viewing the apartment, he stopped by the Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket on the way to buy pork belly, scallions, and eggs, spending 28 yuan. Then he rode his bike for 5 minutes back to his home in Xingang Community.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road

name: Preparing and eating dinner.
description: After getting home, he first cooked rice, then prepared the pork belly: cutting it into pieces, blanching, caramelizing sugar, adding ginger slices, star anise and other seasonings, and simmering slowly. While the meat was stewing, he made the dipping sauce. Once the rice was done, he served it with the tender braised pork belly and enjoyed a hearty meal.
location: Kitchen and dining table at home, Xingang Community, Nos. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Community exercise and bathing
description: After a short rest following the meal, he went downstairs to the community fitness equipment area to exercise. First he did 3 sets of pull-ups (6, 5, 5 reps), then 3 sets of push-ups (15 reps each), and finally relaxed on the air walker for 5 minutes. After exercising, he went home, took a hot shower, hand-washed the work T-shirt and socks he had changed out of, and hung them on the balcony.
location: Community fitness equipment area of Xingang Community and home, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Documenting the house viewing and relaxing with games
description: After drying his hair, he turned on his computer and entered today's inspection details of the two listings into the “Shanghai Second-Hand Home Inspection Comparison Table,” giving Sanxiang Four Seasons Flower City a five-star recommendation. Then he teamed up with Wang Lei and Zhang Fei for two games of Honor of Kings, winning one and losing one.
location: Home bedroom, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Make a video call to his mother.
description: After the game, he made a WeChat video call to his mother in his hometown of Rudong, shared the apartment viewing situation of the day, and basically locked in a good apartment. He asked about his mother's blood pressure, felt reassured after learning she took her medicine on time, and reminded her to keep warm.
location: Home bedroom, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Stretching and preparation before sleep
description: Turned off the main light and left only the bedside lamp on, did 10 minutes of shoulder, back, and leg stretches on the yoga mat to relieve soreness from cycling and training. Then set the alarm, turned off the light, and lay down.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Meditation and review
description: Meditated for 15 minutes in the dark to calm my thoughts, mentally reviewing the key inspection points for apartment viewing. My breathing gradually steadied, and I felt completely calm.
location: Home bedroom, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: After meditation, I turned over and found the most comfortable position. The last thought that flashed through my mind was practicing the knife routine with my master on the weekend, and then I fell into a deep sleep.
location: Home bedroom, Xingang Community, 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning activities at home
description: At 6:20 he was woken by his phone alarm. He got up and weighed himself; it showed 72.1 kg, 0.1 kg lighter than yesterday. After a quick wash, he splashed his face with cold water to wake up. He laid out the yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of core training, including plank, side plank, and bird-dog exercises; he felt good. After training, he made breakfast: two slices of whole-wheat bread, a fried egg, and a glass of hot milk. While eating, he checked the weather forecast on his phone and confirmed it would be sunny today. After the meal, he washed the dishes, changed into a dark work jacket, and packed his notebook, pen, high-intensity flashlight, tape measure, power bank, and bottled water into his shoulder bag to prepare for the apartment viewing.
location: Xingang New Village, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycling commute and errands on the way
description: At 7:15 a.m. I left home by bike, rode along Xingang Road and then Canghua Road to Greenland Triumph Palace; the autumn morning wind was cool, and I arrived in about 25 minutes. After finishing the apartment viewing at 11:30 a.m., I rode from Greenland Triumph Palace along Canghua Road and Huatianjing Road to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, arriving in about half an hour. After viewing another apartment at 6:00 p.m., I rode home. On the way, I turned into the Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket on Lane 213, Xingang Road to buy dinner ingredients—green peppers, pork tenderloin, and scallions—spending 18.5 yuan, then rode back to Xingang New Village.
location: Along the route in Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Inspected two housing units at Greenland Triumph Palace.
description: At 7:40 am, he entered the third-floor unit of Greenland Kaixuan Palace. The unit ran north-south, with sunlight already filling the living room and excellent natural lighting. He stood quietly on the balcony and in front of the master bedroom window to feel the unobstructed sunlight and quiet surroundings; the sound insulation was good. He used a high-intensity flashlight to inspect the kitchen and bathroom pipes, confirming no leakage. He opened the low-voltage electrical box and recorded a detailed video, focusing on the cable layout. Then he shot and narrated a full-unit video tour with his phone. At 5:10 pm, he viewed a fourth-floor west-facing unit in the same community for comparison, and found that the afternoon western sun made the room dim and stuffy, the master bedroom's daylight was clearly inferior to the morning unit's, and the low-voltage box had only two ports, leaving little room for upgrades. He video-called his older female cousin to show her the situation, and she also said she would not recommend it. After the comparison, he was even more certain that the third-floor unit in the morning was his first choice.
location: Greenland Triumphal Palace, Lane 999, Canghua Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Remotely evaluate and finalize the preferred property listing
description: After finishing the morning house viewing, I sat on a bench in the central garden of the Greenland Triumphal Palace community and sent the videos and photos I had taken to the family group and to a private chat with my friend Zhou Xiaofeng. My cousin pointed out that I should pay attention to the kitchen smoke flue. Zhou Xiaofeng thought that although the low-voltage electrical box was messy, a low-voltage rack could be installed to enable smart home features, so it was not a big problem. After taking their advice, I took out my notebook Shanghai Second-hand House Inspection Comparison Table from my backpack, drew small stars next to the 4th-floor unit in Sanxiang Four Seasons Flower City and the 3rd-floor unit in Greenland Triumphal Palace, and finally drew a large five-pointed star next to the record for the 3rd-floor unit in Greenland Triumphal Palace, marking it as the first choice.
location: Central Garden, Greenland Kaixuan Palace Community, Lane 999, Canghua Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Company cafeteria lunch
description: At the factory canteen, he got braised pork, stir-fried vegetables, and tomato and egg soup, and ate quietly in a corner by the window. Shift leader Lao Wang came over to chat and asked about the reason for the morning leave. Yin Hao briefly shared his house-viewing progress. Lao Wang was surprised at how efficient he was and said he also wanted to view houses on the weekend; they agreed to talk again.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reviewed five-axis programming notes during the lunch break.
description: After the meal, I returned to the factory rest room, took out my five-axis programming notes, and reviewed in advance the content for tomorrow's hands-on impeller machining session with my master Sun Jianguo. I focused on reading 'swing angle control' and 'cutting parameters' in Chapter 5, 'Five-axis simultaneous machining tool path optimization,' marked key points with a pen, and simulated the operation process in my mind.
location: Break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon workshop work and end-of-day preparation
description: After the 1 p.m. work bell, he processed a batch of flanges according to the workshop director's arrangement. Following the procedure, he checked the machine tool, clamped the workpieces, called up the program, and started batch machining. Throughout the process he monitored the screen parameters and the sound of the cutting tool. Midway, he used an inside micrometer to check the first-piece dimensions and, after confirming the precision met the standard, continued production. At 5 p.m. he finished the machining task, cleaned the machine tool, and made the maintenance record. Then he changed shoes, grabbed his backpack, said goodbye to the shift leader, and got ready to leave.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing and eating dinner.
description: After going home, I first cooked rice, then washed and cut the green peppers and pork tenderloin. I heated oil in a wok, sautéed scallions and ginger, stir-fried the shredded pork, then added shredded green pepper, seasoned with soy sauce, salt, and sugar, and stir-fried quickly to make a green pepper pork rice bowl. In the living room, I ate while scrolling through news on my phone.
location: Xingang New Village, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organizing property viewing records and comparison table.
description: After dinner, he opened his laptop at his desk and updated the Shanghai Second-hand Housing Inspection Comparison Table. He entered the information for the two apartments he had viewed today, marked the 3rd floor unit at Greenland Triumph Palace as his top choice, and added a note: "Excellent natural light from 8–9 a.m., low noise, and good potential for upgrading the weak current box." He also planned to contact Manager Zhao tomorrow to arrange a meeting with the owner.
location: Xingang New Village, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with mother.
description: Contacted his mother Wang Xiuying, who was far away in Nantong, through a WeChat video call, and gave a detailed account of his house-viewing progress and reasons for his selection. His mother reminded him to inspect carefully. He asked about her recent blood pressure and learned that it had been stable at around 130/85, then reminded her to take calcium tablets on time and hung up.
location: Xingang New Village, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Relaxing by playing online games.
description: While resting on the sofa and scrolling through short videos, he saw an invitation from Wang Lei in the Songjiang Three Brothers group chat, so he went online and played two rounds of Honor of Kings with Wang Lei and Zhang Fei. He was in good form and won both.
location: Xingang New Village, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wash up and prepare for bed
description: After gaming, went to the bathroom to take a hot shower, used body wash to wash away the fatigue, then washed up and changed into loose pajamas.
location: Xingang New Village, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime meditation, stretching, and reading.
description: At 21:30, he started a 15-minute meditation on the living room floor, sitting cross-legged with eyes closed and focusing on his breath, reviewing the key moments of the day and feeling calm inside. He then did cat stretch and child's pose to relax his lower back. At 21:45, he got into bed and read the impeller machining case in CNC Machining Center Programming and Operation to prepare for the next day's study. At 23:00, he set his alarm, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: Xingang New Village, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up, core training, and breakfast
description: The alarm went off, and Yin Hao got up immediately. He weighed himself at 72.0 kg, drank warm water, and completed a 15-minute core workout on the yoga mat in the living room, including planks, side planks, and bird-dog exercises; his abdomen felt sore. After the workout he took a quick shower, changed into a blue work uniform, and for breakfast ate two multigrain steamed buns with hot milk. He put last night's stir-fried shredded pork with green peppers into an insulated lunch box as lunch, then checked his phone, keys, and work badge, put on a black softshell jacket, and got ready to go out.
location: Room 403, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycling commute to the factory
description: Yin Hao set off from home on his old Giant mountain bike, rode south along Xingang Road, turned onto Sichen Highway, then Huatianjing Highway, and after about 6 kilometers in 15 minutes arrived at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. He locked the bike in the innermost spot in the bike shed.
location: From Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-shift preparation and morning meeting
description: After arriving at the factory, Yin Hao changed into work shoes and clocked in. In the locker room, he put on cut-resistant gloves and checked the coolant, lubricating oil, and tool magazine of the Mazak vertical machining center. At 7:45, team leader Wang Lei held the morning meeting and assigned the task of machining 16 flanges in the morning (drawing CF-2025-014). Yin Hao verbally requested leave for the afternoon to see the dentist and look at a house, and Wang Lei agreed.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, Workshop 2, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning: machining flanges.
description: Yin Hao referred to the drawing to load the machining program, checked the parameters, clamped the blank, started the machine to process flanges, monitored the process, and measured key dimensions every 20 minutes, keeping tolerances within 0.02 mm. He completed 10 pieces in the morning, and progress was on schedule.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, Workshop 2, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Factory lunch and lunch break
description: Yin Hao ate the shredded pork with green peppers and rice he brought from home in the cafeteria while watching a Bilibili tutorial on five-axis tool path optimization on his phone. After eating, he rinsed out his lunch box, went back to the break room and rested with his eyes closed for 15 minutes. When he woke up, he used his phone to watch the video of Kaixuangong he had taken yesterday, reviewing the key points from the house viewing (low-voltage box jumper wires, exterior wall construction), and checked the battery level of his tape measure.
location: Employee cafeteria and rest room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Took leave and cycled to the dental clinic.
description: At 12:30 Yin Hao clocked out and left work, told Wang Lei via WeChat, then after getting his bike rode along Jiasong South Road and Wenhui Road for about 25 minutes to Weile Dental Clinic (No. 928 Wenhui Road), locked his bike, and went upstairs.
location: From Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Weile Dental, No. 928 Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dental filling follow-up, cleaning, and payment.
description: Yin Hao checked in at the front desk of Weile Dental and entered Treatment Room 2. Dr. Zhang Ming examined the right lower molar filled last week, confirming the filling was intact, the edges were sealed, and the bite was good. The dental hygienist then performed full-mouth ultrasonic scaling and polishing. His teeth felt sore but tolerable, and after it was done they felt very smooth. Afterward, he went to the first-floor cashier and paid 200 yuan out of pocket (the part covered by medical insurance). Dr. Zhang passed by and reminded him again to switch to an electric toothbrush and use dental floss every day. Yin Hao took careful notes.
location: Weile Dental Clinic, 2F Examination Room 2 and 1F front desk, 928 Wenhui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Buy electric toothbrush and dental floss
description: After leaving the clinic, Yin Hao entered the adjacent Lianhua Supermarket, went to the oral care section, selected a domestic entry-level rechargeable electric toothbrush (99 yuan) and two rolls of waxed dental floss, paid, and left.
location: Lianhua Supermarket, Lane 1292, Xinsongjiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycled to Greenland Triumph Palace and contacted the real estate agent.
description: Yin Hao rode his bike for about 20 minutes to Greenland Triumph Palace. On the way, he sent a WeChat message to Manager Zhao of Lianjia, agreeing to revisit the third-floor listing he had seen yesterday at 5 p.m. Manager Zhao replied to confirm.
location: From Lianhua Supermarket on Xinsongjiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Greenland Kaixuan Palace on the southwest side of the intersection of Wenxiang Road and Longyuan Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Arrive early to evaluate the property and the surrounding area
description: After arriving at Greenland Kaixuan Palace, Yin Hao first observed the surrounding area, including the Cainiao Station, a fruit shop, and a Lanzhou Lamian restaurant, to assess convenience. Then he entered the residential complex, sat down on the bench downstairs from Building 3, and used the comparison table on his phone to re-evaluate the apartment's daylighting, noise, and other factors, confirming that there was no obstruction outside the window, good daylighting, and low noise. Meanwhile, he also went to the community service center to learn about the temporary residence permit application process.
location: Greenland Triumph Palace residential complex and the surrounding area on the southwest side of the intersection of Wenxiang Road and Longyuan Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Re-view the property and confirm intent to purchase
description: At 16:55, Manager Zhao arrived. Yin Hao went inside for another look, measured the living room width at 3.8 meters and the master bedroom depth at 4.5 meters with a tape measure, matching yesterday's estimate. He video-called his cousin Yin Ting to show her the interior and the view from the window, and she approved that there was no obstruction. Yin Hao clearly told Manager Zhao that he would take this apartment and sign the contract on the weekend. Manager Zhao promised to contact the landlord immediately.
location: 3rd Floor, a unit, Building 3, Greenland Triumph Palace, southwest side of the intersection of Wenxiang Road and Longyuan Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycling back and purchasing ingredients
description: Yin Hao said goodbye to Manager Zhao and cycled back with a light heart. Passing Xingang Road, he turned into Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket and bought baby bok choy, pork belly (2 yuan cheaper than yesterday), scallions, and silken tofu.
location: From Greenland Triumph Palace, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner, oral care, and evening tidy-up
description: After arriving home, Yin Hao blanched the pork belly, caramelized sugar with rock sugar, added seasonings and slowly braised it, while washing the leafy greens. When it was done, he enjoyed it with rice and stir-fried greens. After the meal, he opened the electric toothbrush, brushed for two minutes according to the instructions, and then used dental floss to clean between his teeth. Though still unskilled at it, he felt fresh. He set an alarm on his phone for 9 p.m. every day: "floss reminder, brushing check-in." Then he tidied the kitchen, updated the house-buying Excel spreadsheet, and recorded the decision to buy Room 301 and the cost of the electric toothbrush and dental floss. Excitedly, he sent a voice message to his fellow veteran Zhang Jianguo. They talked for more than ten minutes, and Zhang Jianguo demanded to be treated to a meal later. Afterwards, he browsed the CNC technology forum and bookmarked posts.
location: Room 403, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Yin Hao put his work clothes and underwear into the washing machine for a quick wash and took a hot shower himself; then he did 10 minutes of full-body stretching on the bedroom floor to relax his legs; he sat cross-legged on the bed for 5 minutes of mindfulness meditation to calm down. When the alarm went off at 21:05, he went to the bathroom and used dental floss again to clean between his teeth. Before going to sleep, he set the alarm for 6:20 the next morning, turned off the phone screen, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Room 403, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning exercise and strength training
description: After the alarm went off at 6:20 a.m., Yin Hao got up, turned off the alarm, and washed up briefly. He weighed himself on the electronic scale, measuring 72.0 kg—his weight was stable. He changed into a quick-dry T-shirt, shorts, and running shoes, put his phone in an armband, drank half a glass of warm water, grabbed an energy gel, checked the handwritten “Supplementary Terms” note in his pocket, and went out. After walking about 5 minutes, he arrived at the intersection of Guangfulin Road and Longyuan Road at 6:45 and met up with his running partner Chen Jie. The two started running along the greenway around the Guangfulin Ruins Park, maintaining a steady pace of 5 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer, covering the full 5 km in about 28 minutes, finishing at 7:13. Along the way, they talked about the newly installed pull-up bar equipment in the community, and Yin Hao strongly recommended the equipment in the residential complex's fitness area. After the run, they jogged 600 meters back to Xingang Community, arriving at 7:18. In the community fitness area, Yin Hao did 3 sets of pull-ups on the pull-up bar (8, 6, and 6 respectively) with proper form. Chen Jie also tried it and praised the equipment's sturdiness. The strength training ended at 7:25.
location: Intersection of Guangfulin Road and Longyuan Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai; the greenway around Guangfulin Heritage Park; the fitness area of Xingang Residential Community (inside Xingang Residential Community, No. 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai)

name: Breakfast, checking exam results, and sharing the good news
description: After exercising, Yin Hao went home, took a shower, and changed into loungewear. He prepared breakfast, including two boiled eggs, a glass of hot milk, and two slices of whole-wheat bread. At 8:15, he opened his laptop, logged in to the Shanghai Vocational Skills Appraisal Center website, and checked his results. After entering his information, the page showed "Pass." He immediately took a screenshot and saved it, then sent it to his master Sun Jianguo and his father Yin Jianguo via WeChat. His master quickly replied with a thumbs-up emoji. At 8:18, his father made a voice call and praised and encouraged him with a smile in his voice. They chatted happily until hanging up at 8:45.
location: Room 502, Building 8, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Document check and game relaxation before contract signing
description: After checking his results, Yin Hao was in a very good mood. He took out a transparent document folder and carefully checked the materials needed for contract signing: ID card, household register, bank statement, and personal credit report. After confirming that everything was correct, he arranged them in order. He then took out the handwritten sticky note with supplementary clauses about loan disbursement delays from his notebook and transcribed it onto an A4 sheet. After finishing, he leaned back on the sofa and played a few games on his phone to relax and ease the tension before signing. He played until around 10:35.
location: Room 502, Building 8, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch, contacting girlfriend, and heading to the contract signing
description: At noon, Yin Hao cooked himself a bowl of vegetable and egg noodles for lunch, then cleaned up the dishes after eating. He changed into a clean white shirt and dark casual trousers and tidied himself up in the mirror. Before leaving at 11:40, he sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend Lin Yue to let her know he was about to go sign the contract, and received an encouraging sticker from her. He double-checked that he had his handbag (documents, keys) and car keys, then went out and drove along Xingang Road and Jiasong South Road, arriving at the Lianjia store on Guangfulin Road around 12:10. After parking, he took a deep breath and got out of the car with the documents and handwritten terms.
location: Room 502, Building 8, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to the Lianjia store on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Formal signing of the house purchase contract
description: Yin Hao met with Manager Zhao from Lianjia and the property owner. After a brief greeting, they entered the signing room. He laid out all the materials one by one and checked the contract clause by clause and word by word, focusing on confirming the unit number, the total price of 1.78 million yuan, the payment method, and the delivery date of December 31, 2025. After confirming everything was correct, he took out the supplementary clause he had handwritten and stored in his phone's memo, which read: If the bank loan disbursement is delayed until mid-January 2026, the final delivery date will be postponed accordingly to January 20, 2026. The owner reviewed it and agreed, and Manager Zhao transcribed the clause onto the appendix of the contract. At 14:20, Yin Hao solemnly signed the five contracts with clear and forceful handwriting.
location: Signing room at the Lianjia store on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Contact the bank to confirm the loan disbursement and the return trip.
description: After signing, Yin Hao called the loan manager, Lin Da, from the corridor outside the signing room to inform him that the contract had been signed and to confirm the follow-up loan process. Manager Lin said he would handle it as soon as possible, but because of the tight year-end quota, the loan disbursement was expected to be delayed until January 2026, which was in line with his forecast. Yin Hao acknowledged this and thanked him, then hung up at 15:55. Afterwards, he shook hands with Manager Zhao and the property owner to say goodbye, drove back home, and played light music along the way to relax his nerves, arriving home at about 16:35.
location: Lianjia store on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home to rest and review the data
description: Back home, Yin Hao collapsed onto the sofa to rest. He opened his laptop, updated the “Shanghai Second-hand Housing Inspection Comparison Table”, created a new worksheet named “2025-10-25 Greenland Kaixuan Palace Contract Signing”, and entered in detail the contract date, unit number, total price, down payment ratio, expected loan disbursement time (January 2026), and supplementary terms. At 17:10, he sent a message in the “Songjiang Three Brothers” WeChat group, telling his friends that the contract had been signed today and mentioning that he still had to go to the factory the next day to process impellers, so there was no need to invite him to play games at night. The group immediately became lively.
location: Room 502, Building 8, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and celebration
description: In the evening, Yin Hao cooked a bowl of tomato egg noodles as dinner using one tomato, two eggs, and a handful of dried noodles. He sat at the dining table and enjoyed it quietly, celebrating today's achievement in this simple way, feeling happy.
location: Room 502, Building 8, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call to parents to share good news
description: After dinner and cleanup, at 18:35 Yin Hao initiated a video call with his mother, Wang Xiuying. His mother answered quickly, beaming. He pointed the phone camera at the contract and the score screenshot, telling her both major things had been done: he passed the professional qualification exam and signed the house purchase contract. On the other end of the video, his mother's eyes turned slightly red and she said good repeatedly. His father, Yin Jianguo, also leaned in, speaking with relief and telling him not to work too hard. Yin Hao nodded repeatedly and told them not to worry. The video call lasted nearly forty minutes and ended at 19:15.
location: Room 502, Building 8, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Call with a comrade-in-arms and research on home renovation
description: After hanging up the video call with his mother, Yin Hao leaned back on the sofa and called his comrade-in-arms Zhang Jianguo to share the day's joy. Zhang Jianguo was very happy; the two chatted for over ten minutes and agreed to meet up for drinks next time in Shanghai. After hanging up at 19:35, Yin Hao used his mobile browser to search for "first-time renovation process for a rough-finished house" and "small apartment renovation inspiration." He browsed several home renovation apps and saved some practical renovation checklist images for preliminary research on decorating his new home.
location: Room 502, Building 8, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Oral care and preparation for tomorrow's work.
description: Following the dental advice from before, Yin Hao carefully cleaned between his teeth with dental floss, then brushed for two minutes with an electric toothbrush, feeling his mouth fresh and clean. He then showered and changed into pajamas. He made preparations for the factory the next day: took out his work clothes and toolkit, confirmed his phone was charged and brought his work badge, and also took out the impeller drawing to be machined tomorrow from the document folder and carefully reviewed it.
location: Room 502, Building 8, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening reading and music relaxation
description: Lying in bed, Yin Hao scrolled through the industry official accounts he follows and read a short article about five-axis programming, picking up some new knowledge. At 22:00, he opened his music app and played his favorite folk song playlist as relaxing background sound, enjoying a moment of peace.
location: Room 502, Building 8, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Meditation and stretching before bed.
description: At 22:00, Yin Hao turned off the music, put on earphones, opened the meditation app, and followed the guide through a 15-minute meditation session, letting the excitement of the day gradually settle. Then he did 10 minutes of stretching on the bed to loosen his back and waist, finishing at 22:30.
location: Room 502, Building 8, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going to bed
description: After turning off the light and lying down, Yin Hao felt a little excitement in his mind, but his body was already tired. name: After-dinner walk, shopping, and household tidying
