location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket at Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road.

name: Video call with parents on the Double Ninth Festival.
description: At the desk, he had a video call with his parents via WeChat and received confirmation that the gift had arrived. He asked about his mother's blood pressure and patiently taught his father how to use WeChat's voice-to-text and red envelope features. His father successfully sent 'Son, you're great.' His father again offered to help but was politely declined, and they agreed that next year he would bring his parents to live in the new house.
location: At the desk in the rented room, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Community fitness and shower.
description: Do strength training in the residential community's fitness equipment area: 3 sets of pull-ups, 3 sets of wide-grip push-ups, and 5 minutes of relaxation on the air walker. Afterward, go home, take a hot shower, and use mouthwash to care for your oral hygiene.
location: Fitness area of the central square of Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the bathroom of the rental apartment

name: Organize renovation memo.
description: Turned on the laptop, created a new Word document Sanxiang Siji Huacheng Renovation Plan (v1.2), entered the kitchen budget of 20,000 yuan, the balcony window sealing plan, and other items, and noted the Saturday IKEA research.
location: At the desk in the rented room, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Team gaming in Honor of Kings
description: At the invitation of colleagues Wang Lei and Zhang Jianguo, he played Honor of Kings on his phone with them online while sitting on the sofa. He chose the tank hero Lian Po to absorb damage and provide crowd control, and narrowly lost the ranked match, enjoying the relaxing time.
location: Sofa in the rented apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening reading and bookkeeping
description: Lying in bed, read Chapter 5 of 'Mechatronic System Design', marked key points and took notes. Then used the Suishouji app to record today's expenses (express delivery 15 yuan, groceries 31.5 yuan), checked tomorrow's weather as cloudy, and set the morning run alarm to 5:50.
location: On the bed in the rented room, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep meditation and falling asleep
description: After turning off the lights, he began to meditate, focusing on his breathing and recalling the warm phone call with his parents, feeling grounded and peaceful. After meditation, he stretched, checked the alarm clock, adjusted his sleeping position, and slowly fell asleep.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning core training and body monitoring.
description: The alarm rang at 6:20 in the morning; after briefly lying in, he got up. Without turning on the lights, he spread a yoga mat on the carpet with the faint light from outside, and did 15 minutes of high-intensity core training: 3 sets of 60-second planks, 3 sets of 50 mountain climbers, and 3 sets of 20 glute bridges. During the session he deliberately slowed his breathing and focused on engaging his core. After finishing, he wiped off sweat with a towel and stepped on the scale. Seeing his weight steady at 72.0 kg, he felt pleased and sensed he would have plenty of energy today.
location: Living room, Room 203, No. 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning grooming and nutritious breakfast.
description: After training, he took a warm shower and changed into his work clothes, carefully flossed, then brushed with his electric toothbrush for two minutes. In the kitchen, he took out the pre-scheduled black bean and multigrain porridge and ate it with two slices of whole wheat toast and a boiled egg as breakfast. While eating, he checked the weather on his phone: Songjiang District, Shanghai, sunny turning cloudy, 15–22°C, suitable for cycling, so he decided to commute on his mountain bike after all.
location: Kitchen and living room, Room 203, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycling commute to the factory
description: After the meal, he checked the power bank, folding multi-tool pliers, workshop gloves, and notebook in his backpack, put on his windproof jacket, and went downstairs. Passing by the newly opened Xingang Xincun fresh food supermarket at the community gate, he did not stop, directly got on his mountain bike, rode south along Xingang Road and turned onto Huatianjing Highway. The morning breeze was cool, carrying the smell of grass and trees, and the road was clear. After riding at a steady pace for 25 minutes, he arrived at the underground garage of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory and locked the bike.
location: From Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District

name: Pre-shift handover and machine tool warm-up
description: After swiping his card to enter the factory, he changed into anti-smash protective shoes and work clothes in the locker room and went straight to the No. 3 CNC machine workstation. He first reviewed the processing log left by the night shift colleague to confirm that the previous batch of medical connectors was completed and materials were in place. Then he powered on the machine for system self-test and warm-up. During that time, he took out his pocket notebook and reviewed the tool radius compensation question he planned to ask Master Sun that day, ensuring his thoughts were organized.
location: In front of the workshop changing room and No. 3 CNC machine, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning precision machining of medical connectors
description: In the morning, he devoted himself to CNC machining of medical connectors. This batch of parts required a tolerance of 0.005 mm. After clamping, tool setting, and starting the program, he kept a close eye on the dimensional changes on the display and the coolant flow. Every half hour, he manually checked a sample with a micrometer and recorded the data. Team leader Wang Lei, while patrolling the line, tapped Yin Hao on the shoulder and reminded him to pay attention to the wear of the newly replaced coated inserts. Yin Hao nodded and made a mark in his notebook. At 11:30, he paused the equipment and again sorted out the key points he wanted to ask Master Sun.
location: No. 3 CNC machine workstation at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Had lunch and asked Master Sun Jianguo about macro programs
description: After the machine stopped, he went to the cafeteria on time, got a serving of braised pork chop, stir-fried greens, and rice. Seeing the experienced master Sun Jianguo sitting alone in the corner, he carried his tray over. While eating, he asked several questions about G41/G42 cutter radius compensation in macro programs. Master Sun put down his chopsticks, used a spoon to draw a circle on the table, and vividly explained how to determine the compensation direction and the order of code. The two exchanged insights for more than ten minutes, and Yin Hao listened attentively, nodding and taking notes frequently.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon rest and family contact
description: After lunch, he did not return to his workstation, but sat for a while on the bench in the workshop break area. First he used his phone to reply to his mother on WeChat, telling her, 'Shanghai is sunny, don't worry.' Then, after checking that there were no new messages in the family renovation group, he sent a voice message to his brother Yin Tao: 'Bro, has the time for Saturday's trip to IKEA been set? If you're free, let's video call and browse together.' After sending the voice message, he leaned back against the chair backrest and rested with his eyes closed for a few minutes, storing up energy for the afternoon work.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon production tasks and completion records
description: In the afternoon, he continued CNC machining of another small batch of parts, strictly following operating procedures and using a vernier caliper and profilometer to check precision. After completing the last workpiece at 16:15, he carefully cleaned the machine tool, removed the chips, and added lubricating oil, then carefully filled in the "Machining Log," recording in detail data such as the number of completed parts, yield rate, tool changes, and equipment operating status.
location: No. 3 CNC machine workstation at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After work, intensive practice on five-axis machining simulation.
description: After clocking out, he went straight to the workshop training room and opened the CNC simulation software on the dedicated computer. He imported the five-axis blade model, set the blank, tool, and coordinate system according to the competition notes, and ran a tool path simulation. On the first run, the cutting amount was too large, so he asked Liu Zhiqiang, a programmer who was still working overtime, for advice. Liu Zhiqiang leaned in and looked, then pointed out that an arc transition tool path should be added at the corners. Yin Hao followed the suggestion, modified the parameters, and reran the simulation; the tool path was much smoother. At 17:35, he saved the file, packed up his personal belongings, and left.
location: Training Room of the Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycle home and buy groceries on the way.
description: After leaving the office, he directly got on his mountain bike and rode home, arriving at the entrance of Xingang Community in about 20 minutes. Remembering that the fridge was low on vegetables, he parked the bike by the roadside, walked into the Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket, quickly picked a bunch of baby bok choy, two tomatoes, and a box of eggs, and paid 12.5 yuan at checkout. Then he pushed the bike and walked about 3 minutes, entered the community, locked the mountain bike in the parking shed downstairs, carried the groceries upstairs, and returned to Room 203.
location: From No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, passing by Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road

name: Dinner at home and brief relaxation
description: After getting home, put the groceries away and boil water to cook noodles. When the water boils, add the noodles, tomato chunks, and greens, and poach an egg. Mix soy sauce, vinegar, and chili oil to make the broth. Carry a large bowl of hot noodle soup to the coffee table in the living room, eating while scrolling through several short video case studies about WHILE loops in CNC programming on his phone. After finishing, quickly wash the dishes and clean up the kitchen, then change clothes and prepare for evening study.
location: Kitchen and living room, Room 203, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: In-depth review of CNC competition theory at home.
description: He spread the training camp notebook and the printed copy of Teacher Liu Jianjun's latest 'CNC Programming Standards' on the desk. First he circled the formulas and diagrams of 'macro program nesting' that he had not yet fully grasped with a red pen, then marked the key error-prone points against the printed copy. Regarding his question about the nesting depth of WHILE loops, he sent a WeChat message directly to Teacher Liu for advice. Teacher Liu quickly replied with a voice message: 'Yin Hao, at most 4 levels; more than that will trigger an alarm.' He immediately wrote the annotation 'WHILE nested 4 levels (confirmed by Teacher Liu Jianjun)' in the relevant place in the notebook, and studied that chapter in depth.
location: Study room, Room 203, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Outdoor strength training in the residential community
description: After closing his notebook, he changed into a dry T-shirt, took his phone and keys, and went downstairs to the fitness area in the center of the community. In the cool evening breeze, he first warmed up his wrists under the pull-up bar, then completed three sets of pull-ups (8, 7, 6 reps), then moved to the parallel bars and did three sets of push-ups of 15 reps each. The whole process took about 20 minutes. His breathing was a little rapid, his body was slightly sweaty, and he felt very refreshed.
location: Community fitness equipment area, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening shower and oral care
description: Returned home, went straight to the bathroom, rinsed off the sweat from exercising with a hot shower, and changed into pajamas. Then stood at the sink and strictly followed the oral care routine: first flossed between each pair of teeth one by one, then applied toothpaste and used the electric toothbrush with the two-minute timer. After brushing, bared my teeth in the mirror to inspect them and felt they were exceptionally clean.
location: Bathroom, Room 203, Building 2, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Pre-sleep meditation and full-body stretching
description: After leaving the bathroom, he turned off the living room ceiling light and left only a floor lamp on. He sat cross-legged on the carpet, adjusted his breathing, and meditated for 15 minutes. During the meditation, distracting thoughts surfaced (the day's machining data, Teacher Liu's mention of '4 layers'), so he deliberately brought his attention back to his breath. After the meditation, he did a few stretching exercises to relax his leg and back muscles, and his body gradually entered a relaxed state.
location: Living room, Room 203, No. 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Browsing renovation ideas before bedtime and sleeping well
description: After lying in bed, he picked up his phone. Instead of scrolling through short videos, he opened several posts on small-apartment balcony renovation from his favorites and carefully compared the design plans. Feeling sleepy, he turned off the phone and placed it on the nightstand, then reset the alarm to 6:20. He turned over and pulled up the quilt, reflecting on the day's gains: he had consulted Master Sun at work, practiced his skills, and made solid review progress. Filled with a sense of steady fulfillment, he silently recited the tools he would need the next day and fell asleep peacefully with his eyes closed.
location: Bedroom, Room 203, Building 2, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning core workout and browsing IKEA.
description: After the alarm went off on time, he completed 15 minutes of core training on the living room floor, including four sets each of planks and glute bridges. After exercising, he leaned back on the sofa, opened the IKEA app, and looked at the interior fitting diagrams for the PAX wardrobe and the BESTÅ TV unit, preparing for the IKEA trip with his brother tomorrow.
location: Room 501, No. 3, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up, cooking noodle breakfast, and organizing gear
description: Took a quick warm shower to wash away fatigue, then changed into a navy blue factory uniform. In the kitchen, cooked the baby bok choy and egg noodles bought last night, and ate all the noodles and soup. Afterward, checked the mountain bike tire pressure and brakes, and put my phone, work badge, keys, and folding umbrella into the commuter bag.
location: Room 501, No. 3, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycling commute to the factory
date: [Didi Chuxing] You have successfully booked a ride. License plate: Zhe AT1234. Driver: Wang. Estimated arrival at the pickup point: 08:48. Destination: Broken Bridge and Remnant Snow. Please wait in advance.
description: Starting from the north gate of the residential complex, I rode south on Xingang Road and turned onto Huatianjing Highway, cycling about 6 kilometers to the factory. Along the way, I listened to a podcast with earphones. It felt slightly cool. The ride took 25 minutes and I arrived at the factory gate at 7:30.
location: The road section from Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to No. 360, Huatianjing Highway.

name: Arrival preparation and pre-shift meeting
description: After clocking in, he changed into safety shoes and work clothes and went to the workshop office for the pre-shift meeting. Team leader Wang Lei assigned tasks: finish milling the high-precision aluminum alloy connectors in the morning, and support the MES system test in the afternoon. Yin Hao received the task sheet and drawings.
location: Inside Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Aluminum part milling
description: According to the drawings, set the CNC machine parameters and started batch machining of aluminum alloy connectors with a tolerance requirement of 0.01 mm. Stayed focused throughout, and periodically used a vernier caliper and roughness tester for spot checks. Around 10 o'clock, programmer Liu Zhiqiang came to discuss MES interface test samples. Yin Hao assisted in adjusting the clamping method of three workpieces to ensure stable data collection.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cafeteria lunch and theory-question self-test
description: In the factory canteen, queued up for a meal and chose braised pork chop and stir-fried greens. Sat down by the window, and while eating, used my phone to browse the theory question bank for "CNC Machine Tool Installation, Adjustment and Maintenance Worker", focusing on the wrong questions about servo motor encoder fault diagnosis, and saved relevant screenshots to the photo album.
location: Cafeteria, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break recharge
description: After the meal, he returned to the factory rest area, leaned back in a folding chair, and rested with his eyes closed for 20 minutes to regain energy for the afternoon's work.
location: Break room, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: First-article inspection and program optimization.
description: In the afternoon at work, Master Sun Jianguo came to check the first-piece results of the aluminum parts processed in the morning. He spot-checked three key dimensions with a coordinate measuring machine; the surface finish met the standard, and he praised Yin Hao for the way he consulted him yesterday about compensation parameters. The two discussed reducing air-cut travel, and Master Sun suggested optimizing the G-code feed rate.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Follow up on property management matters for the new home.
description: Taking advantage of the tool change gap, he walked to a quiet corner of the workshop and called the Greenland Kaixuan Palace property management office. He asked the customer service representative, Miss Zhang, for the specific list of documents required for the property name-change process, confirmed the property fee was 1.65 yuan per square meter per month, noted down the water account number and gas account number, and saved them in his phone memo.
location: Workshop office of Shanghai Jingong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Continue processing and end-of-shift wrap-up.
description: Continued milling and inspecting the remaining aluminum parts; around 16:20 the machining was completed. Finished self-inspection and placed the finished products on the designated pallets. Then cleaned up the machine chips, filled in the machining log and shift handover records, and turned off the computer and machine power.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Went shopping after work and walked home.
description: Changed out of work clothes and walked out of the factory, heading north along Huatianjing Road, turning onto Xingang Road, and walking to the Xingang Xincun fresh supermarket. In the store, he quickly picked out tomorrow's toast bread, eggs, and frozen dumplings, and bought pork belly and pork ribs at the butcher counter. After paying, he packed them into his own canvas bag, then walked another 5 minutes back home in Xingang Community.
location: Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket) and surrounding road sections

name: Arrived home, organized things, and communicated about tomorrow's schedule
description: After returning home, he sorted the meat and put it in the refrigerator. He made a voice call to his older brother Yin Tao, confirmed they would meet at the main entrance of IKEA Songjiang Store at 9:30 tomorrow morning, and also discussed the property name-change process, and settled on the list of ID photocopies to bring.
location: Room 501, No. 3, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare dinner by myself
description: Boiled about a dozen freshly bought frozen dumplings, and stir-fried a plate of greens as dinner. After eating, I washed the dishes and took out toast for tomorrow's breakfast.
location: Kitchen, Room 501, Building 3, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening review and monthly summary
description: Turned on the desk lamp and spent 40 minutes reviewing this week's intensive training notes, using a red pen to mark categories on the notebook index tabs (macro programs, fault diagnosis, electrical diagrams). Then he opened the expense-tracking app on his phone to review October expenses, including rent, insurance, dental cleaning, daily necessities, and meals, confirming that the expenses were under control. In his phone memo, he created a new 'November To-Do List': preliminary round of the competition, coordinating the measurement of the new apartment, and bringing Lin Yue to Shanghai.
location: Study, Room 501, Building 3, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Community fitness equipment training
description: Changed into a sport T-shirt and went downstairs, completed 3 sets of pull-ups (8, 7, 6) at the community pull-up bar, 3 sets of push-ups on the parallel bars (12 per set), and did simple leg stretches with a resistance band to wrap up October's strength training.
location: Community fitness area in Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and oral care
description: After returning home, he took a shower to wash off the sweat, and carefully cleaned his teeth and the gaps between them with an electric toothbrush and dental floss. He changed into clean underwear and folded the clothes for the next day, placing them at the head of the bed.
location: Bathroom, Room 501, No. 3, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Meditation and stretching before bed.
description: Sat cross-legged on the mattress with eyes closed and did a 10-minute deep-breathing meditation to relax thoughts about machine tool parameters and the renovation budget. Then did several sets of pre-sleep stretches, including cat-cow pose and leg stretches.
location: Bedroom, Room 501, No. 3, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-bed planning and relaxation
description: He looked through the IKEA app again, saved the product article numbers he had photographed and the planned route, and set an alarm for 7:30 tomorrow. After lying down, he had trouble falling asleep, so he put on earphones and listened to two saxophone instrumental pieces, adjusting his breathing. As sleepiness came around 23:00, he turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 501, No. 3, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning core training and weighing.
description: The alarm rang on time. After getting up, he first drank a glass of warm water, then unrolled the yoga mat in the living room and began a 15-minute morning core workout, including planks and yoga stretching, as his body gradually woke up. He then stepped on the scale and recorded a weight of 72.0 kg. Body fat was well controlled, giving him confidence for the half marathon tomorrow.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and pre-competition equipment check
description: After a quick wash, he fried two eggs in the kitchen, toasted two slices of bread, and made a cup of hot milk. While eating breakfast, he did a final check of the going-out list: running shoes, race jersey, race bib, ID card, car key, and power bank. Once everything was ready, he took the pack of dried clams his mother had sent from the refrigerator and put it into his handbag.
location: Home kitchen, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Community)

name: Drive to IKEA.
description: I changed into a casual jacket, grabbed my briefcase and gift bag, and went downstairs. I started the car and set the navigation to IKEA (Shanghai Xuhui Store). I drove along the G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway, with light morning traffic, and arrived at the mall parking lot about 40 minutes later.
location: From Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to IKEA (Shanghai Xuhui Store), 126 Caoxi Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai, via G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway

name: IKEA cabinet dimension research.
description: The mall had just opened, and there were few customers. He went straight to the kitchen and bedroom furniture exhibition area on the second floor, took out a tape measure and notebook, and carefully measured the depth, height, and internal shelf spacing of five key cabinets. He took more than a dozen detail photos, especially of a light oak-colored modern TV cabinet and wall-mounted cabinet. Then he sent these photos and dimension data to his older brother Yin Tao via WeChat in separate messages, with a voice note. While waiting for a reply, he also looked at a few storage boxes and desktop bookshelves and took photos. After receiving his brother's reply approving the oak color, he felt more confident.
location: Kitchen and bedroom furniture exhibition area, second floor, IKEA (Shanghai Xuhui Store), No. 126 Caoxi Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai

name: Drive to Suzhou
description: After receiving my brother's reply, I walked out of the mall, drove for a few minutes onto the G50 Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway, and headed toward Suzhou. It was a sunny day, and traffic on the expressway was good. I maintained a speed of 110 km/h and turned on the radio to listen to music. An hour later, I stopped for 10 minutes at the Yangcheng Lake Service Area, got out to stretch my limbs, breathe the outdoor air, and filled up the tank. Back on the road, the scenery outside the window gradually shifted from open fields to the city skyline, and the destination grew closer. Finally, I drove into downtown Suzhou and prepared to go to the hotel.
location: G50 Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway / G15 Shenyang-Haikou Expressway and Yangcheng Lake Service Area, destination: Magnolia Hotel, No. 268 Dongwu North Road, Wuzhong District, Suzhou.

name: Checked into the hotel.
description: Arrived at the pre-booked Magnolia Hotel (Suzhou Tuanjieqiao Metro Station branch). Checked in smoothly; the front desk clerk was a young woman wearing glasses. After getting the room card, he entered the south-facing room on the 7th floor, with a window overlooking the low-rise buildings of the old city. He took out his running shoes and race outfit and placed them neatly by the bed.
location: Room on the 7th floor of Magnolia Hotel (Suzhou Tuanjieqiao Metro Station Branch), No. 268 Dongwu North Road, Wuzhong District, Suzhou

name: Scouting the half marathon course and heading to older brother's home
description: After lunch, drove to the starting point of tomorrow's half marathon—Moonlight Pier at Jinji Lake. Walked around the start arch to familiarize myself with the assembly area layout and the bag drop location, and got a feel for the venue. The lakeside breeze carried moisture and felt pleasant. I sat on a bench by the lake for a while, watching the sparkling water, and my mood shifted from slightly nervous anticipation to calm. After the site visit, I drove to my brother Yin Tao's home in Wuzhong District, about 30 minutes away. I sent my brother a WeChat message to let him know.
location: Moonlight Pier, Jinji Lake Scenic Area, Suzhou Industrial Park (half marathon starting area) and No. 318 Longxi Road, Wuzhong District, Suzhou

name: Visited brother's family and interacted with nephew.
description: Arrived at the downstairs entrance of my brother's building and carried the dried clams upstairs. The door was opened by my sister-in-law Zhou Min, who greeted me with a smile. Xiaobao was watching cartoons and shouted happily when he saw his uncle. I handed the dried clams to my sister-in-law. She took them, smelled them, and said that Mom's homemade ones were the most fragrant and would be perfect for steamed eggs with clams. I played with Xiaobao with Lego bricks for a while, then sat on the sofa chatting with my brother. I showed him the cabinet photos I had taken in the morning. He nodded repeatedly in approval of the dimensions and color, and we discussed going together after returning on Sunday to invite Tubatu Decoration Company to measure the house and finalize the plan. We talked about the renovation budget and style details in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
location: At Yin Tao's home, No. 318 Longxi Road, Wuzhong District, Suzhou

name: Prepared dinner with his elder brother and his family.
description: My sister-in-law went into the kitchen and began cooking, and I offered to help. I washed the green vegetables while my brother chopped scallions, ginger, and garlic nearby. The two brothers chatted about everyday things while working. My brother asked how work was going, and I shared that the high-precision parts processed last week had been praised by Master Sun. My brother also shared the latest news from the car dealership. My sister-in-law stewed a soup from her home-raised chicken, stir-fried pork with peppers and seasonal vegetables, and finally served steamed egg made with dried clams; the aroma filled the room. Xiaobao was playing with toy cars nearby and occasionally interjected, making everyone laugh.
location: Kitchen and living room of Yin Tao's home at 318 Longxi Road, Wuzhong District, Suzhou.

name: Had dinner with my older brother's family
description: The dishes were served, a table full of hometown flavors. I picked up some steamed egg; it was smooth, tender, and delicious, and I praised my sister-in-law's cooking. My brother poured juice and raised a toast, wishing me good results in tomorrow's race, encouraging me to run at my own pace and enjoy the process. My sister-in-law chimed in, saying she'd take me out for a nice meal after the race. Little Bao curiously asked how far I was going to run and whether I'd get tired; I smiled, patted his head, and said I would persevere. After the meal, I helped clear the dishes, feeling a strong sense of belonging.
location: Dining room at Yin Tao's home, No. 318 Longxi Road, Wuzhong District, Suzhou

name: Return to the hotel and prepare to relax before the race
description: Said goodbye to his brother's family. His brother walked him downstairs, patted him on the shoulder, and said the whole family would cheer for him at the finish line. Drove back to the hotel, and on the way the city's neon lights gradually lit up, making him feel fulfilled and energized. After returning to the hotel, he changed into loose loungewear and used a foam roller to relax his thigh and calf muscles, carefully rolling the front, sides, and back for about 30 minutes. The tingling soreness effectively released tension from his muscles. Then he took a hot shower. After that, he arranged tomorrow morning's race clothes, socks, running shoes, bib number, energy gels, and ID card neatly on the bedside table, and fully charged his phone and sports watch.
location: Inside the room at Magnolia Hotel (Suzhou Tuanjieqiao Metro Station Branch), No. 268 Dongwu North Road, Wuzhong District, Suzhou.

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and going to bed early
description: Set an alarm for 4:30 a.m. tomorrow in the phone memo app, and send a WeChat message to my brother to meet at the starting point at 6 a.m. tomorrow. Adjust the room air conditioner to a comfortable temperature and check the curtains' light-blocking to ensure a good night's sleep. Turn off the main light, keep the bedside lamp on, lean against the headboard, and listen to light music with eyes closed for 15 minutes to relax. Briefly review tomorrow's route. At exactly 10 p.m., turn off the phone and place it on the nightstand, take a deep breath, and gradually fall asleep with a calm and confident mood, knowing that tomorrow is a battle of my own and that I am ready.
location: On the bed in the room at Magnolia Hotel (Suzhou Tuanjieqiao Metro Station Branch), No. 268 Dongwu North Road, Wuzhong District, Suzhou

name: Morning washing up and simple breakfast.
description: His biological clock woke Yin Hao at exactly 5:30. Morning light spilled into the room through the gap in the curtains. Lying in bed, he felt the unique calm and excitement before a race. After a quick wash, he prepared a pre-race energy meal for himself: a banana, a slice of whole-wheat toast with peanut butter, and a glass of warm water. He chewed slowly, storing up energy for the upcoming Suzhou Jinji Lake Half Marathon.
location: Guest room at Magnolia Hotel, No. 170 Dongwu North Road, Gusu District, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China

name: Checked out and drove to the Jinji Lake competition venue
description: After packing his luggage, Yin Hao checked out at the hotel front desk. He then drove along Nanhuan Road and Xinggang Street, and about 20 minutes later arrived at the parking lot of Moonlight Wharf in Suzhou Industrial Park, preparing for the upcoming marathon.
location: From Magnolia Hotel, Gusu District, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province to Moonlight Wharf Parking Lot, Wuzhong District, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province

name: Pre-competition warm-up and preparation
description: After parking the car, Yin Hao changed into his running shoes and race gear. On the open ground near the parking lot at Moonlight Pier, he did a 10-minute dynamic stretching routine, including high knees, butt kicks, and lunge stretches, then jogged 1 kilometer to warm up his body slightly and steadily raise his heart rate.
location: Open area near the parking lot of Moonlight Dock, Wuzhong District, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China

name: Drop off my bag and head to the start assembly area.
description: Yin Hao found the bag storage vehicle, stored his backpack containing his car keys, phone, and clothes, and carried only a waist pack with energy gels and salt tablets. Following the crowd, he walked from Suzhou Wenbo Plaza Commercial Center to the starting area at Zone E of Suzhou Culture and Arts Center Plaza. He took a deep breath, steadied his breathing, and waited for the starting gun.
location: Starting area, Zone E, Suzhou Culture & Expo Square and Suzhou Culture and Arts Center Plaza, No. 1 Guanfeng Street, Suzhou Industrial Park, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China.

name: Waiting for the starting signal and making final pre-race adjustments.
description: The atmosphere grew increasingly lively. The host led everyone through final preparations. Yin Hao took his first energy gel, took a small sip of water, and put his phone into his waist pack. His heartbeat was a little fast—it was excitement, not nervousness. He said quietly to himself: follow your own pace and enjoy the race.
location: Start area, Zone E, Suzhou Culture and Arts Centre Plaza, No. 1 Guanfeng Street, Suzhou Industrial Park, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China

name: Participated in the 2025 Suzhou Jinji Lake Half Marathon.
description: At the sound of the starting gun, Yin Hao crossed the start timing mat steadily. He strictly followed his plan, maintaining a steady pace of 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer for the first 5 kilometers. At Ligongdi near the 8-kilometer mark, he saw his older brother Yin Tao, sister-in-law Zhou Min, and nephew Yin Xiaobao in the distance holding a handwritten sign that read "Go, Yin Hao!" His heart warmed, and he gave a thumbs-up. At the 15-kilometer mark, across from the Ferris Wheel Park, his brother's family had moved to another spot to cheer for him. His nephew shouted "Go, Uncle!", injecting renewed energy into his fatigue. As planned, he took water and energy gels at the aid stations at 7.5 and 15 kilometers. In the last 2 kilometers, he slightly increased his pace and sprinted hard across the finish line. The timer showed 2 hours 04 minutes 58 seconds, and he clenched his fist and let out a low, excited roar.
location: Jinji Lake round-the-lake marathon course (start: Moonlight Wharf, finish: Suzhou Cultural Expo Square), Suzhou Industrial Park, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China

name: Immediate recovery and good news sharing right after crossing the finish line
description: After crossing the finish line, Yin Hao walked slowly under the guidance of volunteers to cool down and collected his finisher medal and refreshment pack, including bottled water, a banana, and a towel. He immediately took out his phone and sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend Lin Yue: "I finished! 2 hours 04 minutes 58 seconds! Good luck to you and your interview!" Then he called his older brother Yin Tao, his voice breathless and excited after the run: "Brother! I finished! A new record!"
location: Finish area at Suzhou Culture & Expo Plaza, No. 1 Guanfeng Street, Suzhou Industrial Park, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China

name: Reunion with family at the finish area and remote celebration
description: Yin Hao found his brother's family at the finish-line meeting point. He scooped up his nephew Yin Xiaobao, who curiously touched the finisher medal. His sister-in-law Zhou Min handed him warm water from a thermos and asked with concern whether he was tired. At that moment, his girlfriend Lin Yue's video call came in. Her face was full of a bright smile: "Yin Hao, you're amazing! I've finished my interview too, and it felt good!" They congratulated each other across the screen and agreed to talk more in the evening.
location: Finish meeting point at Suzhou Culture and Expo Plaza, No. 1 Guanfeng Street, Suzhou Industrial Park, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China

name: Drove to my brother's house
description: Yin Hao returned to the bag storage truck to pick up his luggage and changed into a dry T-shirt. Leaving the racecourse noise behind, he drove with a full sense of accomplishment and a hint of fatigue from the park to Mudu Town in Wuzhong District. He rolled down the window to let the early winter wind soothe his tense muscles. The road was clear, and he arrived at his older brother's home in about 25 minutes.
location: From Moonlight Wharf Parking Lot, Wuzhong District, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, to Huayuan Residential Quarter, Mudu Town, Wuzhong District, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province

name: Noon family dinner and celebration at the elder brother's home.
description: As soon as he entered, the aroma of food wafted over. His sister-in-law had prepared a feast for Yin Hao: braised pork ribs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and steaming hot chicken soup. At the dining table, his elder brother Yin Tao brought out a bottle of treasured baijiu, and the two brothers drank a little together. He first congratulated Yin Hao on setting a new personal best in the marathon, then naturally turned the conversation to the decoration of the new house. After the meal, his brother, just as in his memory, pressed a thick red envelope into Yin Hao's hand, saying it was 2,000 yuan, a little token for the new house decoration. Unable to refuse, Yin Hao felt a warmth in his heart and accepted this weighty brotherly affection. Afterward, he accompanied his nephew Yin Xiaobao in the living room to build LEGO, enjoying a leisurely afternoon.
location: My brother's home, Huayuan Community, Mudu Town, Wuzhong District, Suzhou, Jiangsu, China

name: Midday rest and farewell
description: Yin Hao lay on the living room sofa and napped for about half an hour, recovering some energy. At 14:45, he got up and took his leave, thanking his brother's family for their hospitality and support. His brother and sister-in-law told him to rest well after returning to Shanghai. He hugged his nephew and said he would invite him to Shanghai to play next time.
location: My brother's home, Huayuan Community, Mudu Town, Wuzhong District, Suzhou, Jiangsu, China

name: Drive from Suzhou back to Songjiang, Shanghai.
description: Yin Hao drove alone onto the G15 Shenhai Expressway, with soothing classical music playing on the car stereo. He kept his speed controlled; his leg muscles were a bit sore after running the marathon but not painful. After about a two-hour drive, he entered Xingang Community in Songjiang District, Shanghai, and parked in his rented underground parking space.
location: From Huayuan Residential Community, Mudu Town, Wuzhong District, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province to Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After returning home: walking, stretching, and body log
description: Carrying his luggage and finisher's bag through the front door, and after changing into slippers, Yin Hao felt both his physical fatigue and sense of accomplishment settle. Instead of sitting down immediately, he walked slowly in the living room for 5 minutes to let his heart rate calm down. Then he took out a yoga mat and did 20 minutes of targeted stretching, focusing on relaxing his calf and thigh muscles. After stretching, he stepped on the scale, which showed 71.5 kg (due to dehydration from heavy sweating). He took a photo to record this weight and today's race data.
location: Home, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Post-race energy replenishment and shower
description: Yin Hao took the pre-prepared iced cola and a banana out of the refrigerator, directly replenishing electrolytes and energy. Sipping the cola, he felt completely refreshed. Then he went into the bathroom and took a good shower with warm water and body wash, washing away all the sweat and fatigue.
location: Home, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Video call with parents to share the good news
date: Afternoon: finish precision parts processing and wrap up work
description: After taking a shower, Yin Hao felt refreshed and called his parents on WeChat video. His mother, Wang Xiuying, answered and asked with concern, “Done running? Are you tired?” He smiled, pointed the phone camera at the finisher medal hanging in the corner of the wall, and reported his new record of 2 hours, 4 minutes, and 58 seconds today. His father, Yin Jianguo, listened from the side, a proud smile at the corner of his mouth. Yin Hao also mentioned having lunch at his elder brother’s house and the renovation red envelope his brother gave him. The call was filled with ease and joy.
location: Home, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Leisurely relaxation and a simple dinner
description: After hanging up the video call, the world finally quieted down. Yin Hao leaned back on the sofa and scrolled through the marathon runners' chat group. Someone @'d him to praise his result, and he picked a few track photos to post on his Moments. On WeChat, his girlfriend Lin Yue sent a voice message saying her interview went smoothly today, along with a celebratory sticker. They agreed to video chat on Wednesday evening. After finishing all this, he felt a little hungry, went into the kitchen, boiled water, cooked half a pack of dried noodles, added a poached egg and a few leafy greens, and had a bowl of light hot noodle soup.
location: Home, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Recording post-race thoughts and preparing before bed.
description: Sitting at his desk, Yin Hao took out his phone, opened the notes app, and quickly wrote down today's race insights: "Pace control was good, heart rate drift on the Garmin watch was normal, my core felt strong after the aid station at 15 km, and next time I can try to sprint at 18 km. The support from my brother and sister-in-law was crucial." After writing this, he charged his phone and sports watch and set an alarm for 7:30 the next morning.
location: At the desk at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Meditation and bedtime
description: Yin Hao turned off the main light, leaving only a small bedside nightlight. Lying in bed, he did another set of simple bed stretches, such as child's pose and legs-up-the-wall. At 10 o'clock he turned off the nightlight and closed his eyes. Scenes from today flashed through his mind: the nervousness at the starting line, the smiles of his family, the excitement of crossing the finish line... He took a deep breath, set those images aside, and soon fell into a deep sleep, recharging for the new week ahead.
location: Bedroom at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Morning recovery and commute preparation
description: The alarm went off. Despite obvious soreness in the front of his thighs and calves, he still forced himself to get up. On the scale in the living room, he weighed in at 71.6 kg, a slight rebound from yesterday's post-race weight. He took an ice pack out of the refrigerator, wrapped it in a towel, and applied it to the front of his thighs and calves while doing deep breathing and ankle rotations. Then he did 15 minutes of targeted stretching on the yoga mat on the floor, focusing on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and gastrocnemius, holding each stretch for 30 seconds to relieve muscle tightness. After a quick warm shower, he changed into work clothes and prepared breakfast: hot milk, two slices of whole-wheat bread, and a boiled egg. He checked his phone, wallet, and work badge, picked up his car keys, and got ready to head out.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving commute and breakfast pick-up
description: He started the silver-gray family sedan and drove out of the residential complex. At the gate he made a brief stop at the Good Morning Bun Shop and bought two pork buns and a cup of soy milk. While waiting at a red light, he took a few bites of the buns. While driving, his thighs ached when he pressed the clutch and brake, and he moved more cautiously than usual. After about 20 minutes, he drove into the parking lot of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory.
location: Songjiang District, Shanghai: starting from Xingang Residential Community at Lane 224, Xingang Road, passing by the Good Morning Bun Shop on Xingang Road, and arriving at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway.

name: Morning workshop work and communication with colleagues
description: Walking into Workshop No. 1, Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang said with grins, "Congrats on the PB," and together they talked about the feeling of crossing the finish line and the scene of his brother bringing his nephew to cheer. After Master Sun Jianguo patted him on the shoulder to encourage him, he put on work safety gear, checked the shift handover record, mounted a high-precision aluminum alloy connector blank on the machine, loaded the program, and started operating. After completing the first batch of self-inspection, he went to the break room to drink water. Wang Lei followed to chat about race details and invited him to go fishing at Dianshan Lake in Qingpu over the weekend. He agreed to wait until his leg recovered and depending on the weather. After returning, he focused intently on machining parts with a tolerance of 0.01 mm. Midway, programmer Liu Zhiqiang came to discuss because the client modified the arc parameters. His suggestion to optimize the feed speed was adopted, and the program was adjusted smoothly.
location: Workshop 1, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and Midday Relaxation Guidance
description: At the factory cafeteria, he got his meal and specially asked for extra stir-fried vegetables and a piece of pork chop, chatting with colleagues while eating. After eating, he returned to the break room, took a foam roller from the trunk, spread out a yoga mat, and pressed his thighs and calves to relax. Other curious colleagues gathered around; while rolling, he explained how to use the foam roller and even taught them hands-on how to relax their shoulders, neck, and back.
location: Employee cafeteria and rest room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon parts machining and work wrap-up
description: In the afternoon, I switched to another batch of parts. According to the program modified in the morning, I performed first-piece trial cutting, carefully measured with a vernier caliper, and after confirming the dimensions were acceptable, proceeded with batch machining. During breaks, I stood up and moved from time to time to avoid stiffness. After machining was done, I turned off the machine, cleaned the iron chips from the machine bed, blew the guide rails and spindle clean with compressed air, and added lubricating oil to the lubrication points. I filled in the production log for the day, recorded the processing parameters and problems encountered, turned off the main power, and took off my work gloves.
location: Workshop 1, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-work commute and shopping
description: He drove out of the factory area, first went to the Sinopec Dagang gas station on Xingang Road, skillfully filled up until the nozzle clicked, and paid 282 yuan. Then he drove to Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, pushed a shopping cart, and bought eggs, a box of tomatoes, a bunch of greens, a piece of pork tenderloin, as well as bananas and apples to supplement vitamins. Finally, he returned to Xingang Community.
location: Songjiang District, Shanghai: departing from the factory at 360 Huatianjing Road, passing through Sinopec Dagang Gas Station on Songzheng Road, then to Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, and finally arriving at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road.

name: Returning home to tidy up and have dinner.
description: Carrying groceries home, he sorted the meat and vegetables into the fridge. He changed out of his work clothes into a loose home T-shirt and sports shorts. From the fridge, he took out the free-range eggs and leftover rice brought back from Suzhou and decided to make egg fried rice, served with stir-fried vegetables and the half bowl of braised pork ribs left over from yesterday. Once the meal was ready, he placed the dishes on the table and opened his phone to watch a video by Old Song the car repair master, a content creator he often follows, explaining how to diagnose abnormal engine noise; he watched with great interest. After eating, he quickly cleared the dishes and wiped down the kitchen counter.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening deep relaxation using a foam roller
description: He laid out the yoga mat on the living room floor, took out the foam roller, and began 30 minutes of deep relaxation. He not only rolled his thighs and calves but also focused on releasing the gluteus maximus in his buttocks, combined with longer static stretches. He felt the lactic acid accumulated from yesterday's competition being worked away bit by bit.
location: Living room, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Community strength training and socializing with neighbors
description: Changed into sports shoes and went downstairs to the community fitness area. First did 3 sets of pull-ups (8 reps per set with maximum effort), then 3 sets of push-ups (20 reps per set). While exercising on the air walker, Uncle Zhang, a neighbor returning from his stroll, greeted him and asked why he hadn't been seen running for a while. He smiled and replied that he had run a half marathon yesterday and his legs were still sore today, so he was just loosening up.
location: Community fitness area, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Showering, adjusting training plan, and communicating with family
description: After getting home, took a comfortable hot shower and felt all my pores open up. Sat down on the sofa, opened the memo on my phone, and adjusted this week's training plan based on how my body felt: changed the original Tuesday and Thursday interval runs to an easy 30-minute jog on Wednesday and Friday, and added two stretching sessions on Tuesday and Thursday. Screenshotted the plan and sent it to my running buddy Chen Jie, with a voice message saying my legs were satisfyingly sore and I needed to take it easy this week. Chen Jie quickly replied in agreement. Then I saw a message sent an hour earlier by my older brother Yin Tao asking whether the estimates for electrical and water outlet positions and tiles in the renovation budget were too low. After thinking it over carefully, I replied that the table was estimated based on assembly-line worker labor costs, and the specifics still needed to depend on the decoration company's quote. I suggested that he first sketch the plumbing and electrical circuits himself over the weekend. My brother agreed and said we'd discuss it later.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organized competition equipment and recorded data
description: He took out the running shoes, race bib, and finisher medal from yesterday's race. He wiped the mud off the shoes with a damp cloth and put the bib and medal into a dedicated collection box. He opened the training log app and carefully entered yesterday's course data, split paces, final time of 2 hours 4 minutes 58 seconds, and today's weight and physical feelings. Finally, in the 2025 goals section of his notes app, he changed the progress bar for "Set a new half-marathon PB" from "Task in progress" to "Completed", and couldn't help but smile.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening theory study
description: I remembered the advanced CNC technician theory exam next month, took out my notes for CNC Machine Tool Fault Diagnosis and Maintenance, turned to the servo motor overload alarm chapter I hadn't finished yesterday, and read it carefully for 40 minutes. When I felt I had almost got it, I closed the book, checked tomorrow's weather and road conditions, put tomorrow's clothes by the bedside, and charged my phone.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Meditation and stretching before bed.
description: Turned off the main light, leaving only the small bedside night light, and lay in bed doing a 10-minute guided meditation, letting his thoughts gradually drift away from the busy day. After the meditation, he did a simple set of static pre-sleep stretches, focusing on the neck and lower back to help the body relax.
location: Bedroom in Xingang Community, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep.
description: He set the alarm for 6:20 the next morning and put his phone on the nightstand. The last image flashing through his mind was of his brother and nephew waving as he crossed the finish line yesterday, and he soon fell into a deep sleep, recharging for the next day's work.
location: Bedroom in Xingang Community, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up, core training, and a simple breakfast
description: Woke up naturally before the 6:20 a.m. alarm, feeling light and agile, with muscle soreness gradually fading. After getting up, weighed himself and stayed stable at 71.5 kg. Laid out the yoga mat and did 15 minutes of recovery core training: plank (3 sets, 45 seconds each), glute bridge (4 sets, 20 reps each), and bird-dog (3 sets, 10 reps per side). After training, washed up briefly and changed into work clothes. Then took two slices of whole wheat bread and 200 ml of fresh milk from the fridge, heated them in the microwave for 1 minute, and checked the phone memo while eating breakfast to confirm the key items for the day: milling parts, asking about PLC problems, buying and sending medicine, and calling his mother. At 6:55, put on the commuting backpack, took the thermos and an energy bar, and got ready to go out.
location: Room 501, Building No. 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycling commute and pre-shift preparation
description: At 6:55 he got on his silver-gray Giant bicycle, rode east along Xingang Road through Songhui Middle Road, then turned north along Huatianjing Road. About 20 minutes later, he arrived at the company at 7:15. After locking the bike and clocking in, he changed into dark blue work clothes and safety shoes and entered the workshop. He first greeted team leader Wang Lei, who said today's tasks were not light. He then checked the CNC machine tool shift handover records, lubricating oil levels, and coolant to ensure the equipment was in normal condition.
location: Workshop at the factory of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: High-precision part milling in the morning
description: Started rough milling and finish milling on a batch of high-precision connectors. After mounting the drawings, aligning the edge finder, and setting the workpiece coordinate system, I started the program. While the machine was processing automatically, I used the downtime to review example problems combining macro programs and trigonometric functions from the Skills Competition Theory Question Bank. At 10:30, I noticed poor surface finish on a batch of aluminum alloy parts. I stopped the machine and found tool wear. After replacing the insert and resetting the feed rate, the problem was solved. My master Sun Jianguo passed by and nodded approvingly.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360, Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Midday rest, cafeteria lunch, and practice problems for competition preparation
description: After the morning machining was done, he shut down the machine, tidied up the workstation, and went to the changing room to wash the oil off his hands and change into a shirt. While on his phone, he scrolled through the running group and liked and replied to Chen Jie's running update at Xiaokunshan. At 12:00 he went to the cafeteria alone and got braised pork ribs, stir-fried vegetables, and rice. While eating, he went through about 30 theoretical questions for the "National Intelligent Manufacturing Application Technology Skills Competition" on his phone. He encountered several difficult PLC multi-level conveyor belt control problems; after getting them wrong, he took screenshots and saved them to his mistake collection. After the meal, he returned to the workshop rest area, brewed Gaoshan oolong tea, put on earphones to listen to instrumental music, and rested with his eyes closed for 10 minutes, emptying his mind to recharge for the afternoon.
location: Employee cafeteria and workshop rest area, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon parts machining, consulting the mentor, and after-work cleanup and maintenance.
description: In the afternoon, he continued machining the remaining high-precision parts, and progress went smoothly. During the 15:00 break, he saw Master Sun Jianguo organizing cutting tools and went over to ask about the PLC ladder logic problem he had encountered at noon. Master Sun drew a flowchart on paper and explained the key timers and interlock logic in detail. Yin Hao suddenly understood and took careful notes. At 16:30, he finished the last batch of parts, and spot checks with a coordinate measuring machine confirmed the dimensions were qualified. He then cleaned the machine chips, applied lubricating oil to the guide rails, and filled in the machining log according to 6S standards, then changed out of his work clothes after turning off the power.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360, Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: After work, buy medicine for my mother, send it at the parcel station, and buy groceries at the supermarket on the way.
description: After getting off work at 17:00, he rode his bicycle south along Huatianjing Road, turned onto Zhongshan Middle Road via Songhui Middle Road, and arrived at the Laobaixing Pharmacy (Songjiang Zhongshan Middle Road store) about 20 minutes later. Inside, he showed the clerk Chen Qian a photo of his mother Wang Xiuying's prescription, bought 3 boxes of Norvasc amlodipine besylate tablets (5 mg/tablet, 14 tablets/box), checked the brand, dosage, and expiration date, paid by medical insurance, and printed the medical insurance purchase receipt. Then he cycled via Guyang North Road to the Cainiao Station at 808 Guangfulin Road, bought a cardboard box and bubble wrap, carefully wrapped the medicine boxes, filled the gaps with newspaper, and sealed the box. He filled in his hometown address: 88 Renmin Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province, and sent it via ZTO Express, paying 12 yuan in shipping. Next, he cycled west across Jiasong South Road to the Xingang Xincun Fresh Food Supermarket at Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, and selected a bunch of Shanghai bok choy, two tomatoes, a pack of dragon whisker noodles, and a box of fresh eggs.
location: Went successively to Laobaixing Pharmacy at 186 Zhongshan Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai; Cainiao Station (Guangfulin Branch) at 808 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai; and Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket at Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Returning home to put things away, making dinner, and watching study videos
description: At 18:20, after a 5-minute bike ride home, I put the greens, tomatoes, noodles, and eggs in the fridge. Using WeChat on my phone, I took a photo of the tracking number and sent it to my mother, and sent a voice message telling her the medicine had been shipped and would arrive the day after tomorrow, asking her to take it on time. Then I boiled water for the noodles, cooked them, and drained them after 2 minutes 30 seconds. In another pan, I sautéed minced garlic in oil, stir-fried tomato chunks until juicy, then added Shanghai greens, salt, and light soy sauce, and poured in beaten egg to make a tomato-egg drop soup, which I poured over the noodles. While eating the soupy noodles, I played Bilibili creator 'Industrial Automation Old K''s 'S7-1200 Sequential Function Chart Example Explanation' on my iPad Pro to review the knowledge points Master Sun had explained in the afternoon.
location: Room 501, Building No. 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening theoretical study for the skills competition
description: After clearing the dishes, he sat down at the desk and spread open the Skills Competition Theoretical Question Bank and a notebook. He re-derived the PLC logic problems Master Sun had explained in the afternoon, drew complete ladder diagrams and instruction lists, and tried to understand them using the start-hold-stop circuit. Then he did 25 similar PLC problems, achieving an accuracy rate of over 90%, and recorded them systematically.
location: Room 501, Building No. 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with mother to say hello
description: Near 8 p.m., he put down his book, poured a glass of warm water, and sat on the sofa to make a WeChat video call to his mother, Wang Xiuying. His mother was wiping the table in the kitchen. Yin Hao asked about her blood pressure, and she said it was 135/85 in the morning and stable, telling him not to worry. He reminded her again to take her medicine on time and go to the park more often. Then he asked about the progress of his father repairing the roof of the old house, and learned that the tiler had been found and the materials were ready, with work starting the day after tomorrow. They also talked about his older brother Yin Tao's new house renovation in Suzhou — the plumbing and electrical work was done, and the tiles had been chosen over the weekend. The call lasted about 15 minutes in a warm atmosphere, and his mother told him to dress warmly and take care of himself.
location: Room 501, Building No. 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Room tidying, leisure gaming, and body stretching
description: After hanging up, he prepared a clean T-shirt and jacket for work the next day and charged his phone. Then he lay on the sofa, opened Honor of Kings, completed the daily quests, and played a ranked match, earning MVP. Seeing his battle buddy Zhang Jianguo online, he sent a WeChat message inviting him to get together at a Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road on the weekend. Zhang Jianguo replied that Friday evening was fine.
