After breakfast, he carefully checked the volunteer service toolkit: confirmed the multimeter battery was fully charged, the screwdriver set was complete, and the soldering iron, solder wire, capacitors and other small accessories were all in good condition. At the same time, he fully charged his phone and brought a power bank, making final preparations for the morning repair service at the nursing home.
location: Kitchen and dining room, home, Xingang Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to Songjiang District Social Welfare Home
description: Took the tool bag and thermos, went downstairs and started the car, drove along Xingang Road and turned onto Songhui East Road, about 5 km in total and a 15-minute drive. The traffic was good, and I arrived at the destination on time.
location: Driving route from Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to the Shanghai Songjiang District Social Welfare Institute, No. 1000 Songhui East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Volunteer home appliance repair service at the nursing home
description: He arrived at the Songjiang District Social Welfare Institute on time, registered at the staff office, and was led to the activity room. First, he repaired two floor fans. After disassembling them, he found the start capacitors were bulged and the speed control switches had poor contact. Using spare capacitors and a screwdriver, he skillfully replaced the parts, and the fans started spinning again, delighting the elderly. Next, he repaired Grandpa Zhang's silent radio. Using a multimeter, he detected a cold solder joint on the audio wire, re-soldered it with a soldering iron, and restored it to working order. He also cleaned the potentiometer on Grandma Li's radio to fix the issue of noisy sound. During breaks in the repairs, he chatted with the elderly and asked about their health, creating a warm atmosphere. Meanwhile, he met up with Li Ming, a technician from the company's production department, and Zhao Li, an HR specialist. The three of them exchanged technical insights while repairing.

participant.name: Uncle Zhang
participant.relation: Elderly residents of the nursing home

participant.name: Grandma Li.
participant.relation: Elderly residents of the nursing home

location: Activity Room, Shanghai Songjiang District Social Welfare Institute, No. 1000 Songhui East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Meet like-minded people and establish a public welfare group.
description: The three of them had basically finished the repair work and gathered together to drink some water and rest. During the chat, they all expressed the shared desire to continue doing volunteer work. Zhao Li suggested setting up a WeChat group to organize activities in the future. They created a group chat on the spot named 'Public Welfare Trio' and agreed to go to another nursing home to volunteer together next month.
location: Activity Room, Shanghai Songjiang District Social Welfare Institute, No. 1000 Songhui East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove back home
description: After bidding farewell to everyone, I drove along Songhui East Road, turned onto Xingang Road, and returned the same way to Xingang Community, feeling pleased.
location: Driving route from Shanghai Songjiang District Social Welfare Institute, 1000 Songhui East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and another weigh-in
description: After returning home, he simply washed his hands and feet, made egg fried rice with leftover rice from the fridge, and had it with a bowl of seaweed egg drop soup for lunch. After eating, he stepped on the scale, which showed he still weighed 71.3 kg.
location: Kitchen and dining room, home, Xingang Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch Break and Cycling Gear Check
description: After setting the alarm for 13:30, he drew the curtains and lay down for a nap to make up for the sleep deficit from the previous night. When the alarm rang, he felt much more refreshed. He got up, changed into cycling clothes, checked the drone battery, remote controller, and memory card again, and brought a few bottles of water and Snickers bars to prepare for the afternoon cycling and aerial photography.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycling to Sheshan
description: He took out his road bike, set off from Xingang Residential Area, rode south along Xingang Road to Kungang Highway, then turned west onto Guangfulin Road. The autumn sky was clear and the sunshine was just right. After riding about 10 kilometers, he arrived at the foot of Sheshan.
location: Cycling route from Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, along Xingang Road, Kungang Highway, and Guangfulin Road to Linyin New Road.

name: Sheshan autumn cycling and drone aerial photography
description: After arriving at Sheshan National Tourist Resort, they cycled along Linyin New Road to enjoy the autumn scenery. Midway, they stopped to rest at an observation deck at the foot of Sheshan Mountain, where fellow runner Chen Jie arrived on a mountain bike to join them. After drinking water and taking photos together, Yin Hao launched a drone to capture the autumn-colored mountains and forests and the outline of Songjiang University Town in the distance. Chen Jie operated a drone for the first time; under guidance, he test-flew for a few minutes and captured an aerial view of himself cycling, and was very excited.
location: Sheshan National Tourism Resort, No. 1999, Linyin New Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the observation deck at the foot of Sheshan

name: Cycling home and stretching to relax.
description: After saying goodbye to Chen Jie, cycled back along the same route to Xingang Residential Area. After getting home, did systematic leg stretches on the balcony, focusing on relaxing the calves and hamstrings to prevent the next day's soreness.
location: Balcony at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Shower and dinner preparation.
description: Took a hot shower and changed into clean clothes. Took frozen dumplings out of the fridge and prepared to boil them for dinner.
location: Bathroom and kitchen at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and interacting with phone messages
description: After 21:00, Yin Hao washed up, brushed his teeth, and applied moisturizer. He took out the next day's work clothes and a change of underwear and folded them at the head of the bed. In bed, he did a few sets of gentle straight-leg raises to relax his thigh muscles. At 22:00 he turned off the room light, leaving the bedside lamp on, and lay down, adjusting his sleeping position to relax his right knee. At 22:30 he turned off the bedside lamp, closed his eyes and fell asleep, listening to the occasional sound of cars outside the window as he drifted off.
location: Dining room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Organized aerial photos and posted them on Moments.
description: Insert the drone's memory card into the old computer, select 9 autumn scenery photos with the best angles and rich colors, and do simple color adjustment with software. Open WeChat Moments, carefully arrange the layout, and post an update with the caption: “Autumn in Sheshan, a fulfilling day of volunteering and cycling. Measure the city with footsteps, and capture beauty with the lens.”
location: Home study at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-study for the skills competition.
description: He pulled out the review materials for next Monday's skills competition training session in advance, quickly browsed the five-axis programming cases, and marked two macro-program commands he was unfamiliar with, planning to ask Liu Zhiqiang during the training. Meanwhile, he took out his sportswear and training shoes from the wardrobe and placed them on a chair to prepare for tomorrow morning.
location: Home study at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening free time and pre-bed preparation
description: Browsed technical forum posts on my phone and replied to several questions about machine tool alarm codes. Sent a WeChat message to my older brother Yin Tao, telling him I had done quite a few meaningful things today. At 21:00, I turned off my phone and started washing up: brushing my teeth, washing my face, and applying moisturizer to prepare for bed.
location: Living room and bathroom of the home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Go to bed and rest
description: At 21:30 he lay down in bed on time and pulled up the quilt. Recalling the day's volunteer activities, cycling, and aerial photography, he felt fulfilled and satisfied. With a smile, he gradually fell asleep, storing up energy for next week's work and intensive training.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning weigh-in and core training
description: After the alarm went off, he got up and first went to the bathroom to weigh himself. The scale showed 71.4 kg, and keeping his weight steady put his mind at ease. Then he did 15 minutes of core training in the living room, including planks and crunches. After stretching, he took a shower. Once he had washed up, he fried two eggs for himself, along with a glass of hot milk and two slices of whole-wheat bread. While eating breakfast, he opened his phone and glanced at group chat messages.
location: Room 401, Building 5, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing at home for the theory test of the skills competition
description: After breakfast, he cleared the table and washed the dishes, then sat down at the desk and opened his laptop. First, he imported the aerial photos taken at the nursing home yesterday from the camera to the computer. He picked a few with good composition and posted them to the “Charity Trio” WeChat group with the message: “The photos from yesterday are exported. Take a look. We can make a digital album for the next event.” Then he opened the theory sprint video for the skills competition, put on his earphones, and focused on reviewing the fault diagnosis section of servo systems, noting key points and common fault codes in his notebook as he watched. Occasionally he paused the video and closed his eyes to mentally simulate the troubleshooting process.
location: Room 401, Building 5, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Household tidying and houseplant care
description: After watching videos for nearly two hours, his eyes felt a bit sore, so he stood up and stretched his shoulders, wiped down the living room coffee table and TV cabinet, and watered the several pots of pothos on the balcony. After tidying the room, seeing there was still some time before the appointment with Aunt Chen, he picked up his phone and browsed the renovation notes he had just taken, running through the key points about the floor and walls in his mind a few times.
location: Room 401, Building 5, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Aunt Chen across the hall's family dinner and seeking renovation tips.
description: At exactly 11:00, Yin Hao washed his hands, picked up a carton of milk bought at the supermarket yesterday, and knocked on the door of Aunt Chen Xiuying's apartment across the hall. Aunt Chen had prepared four dishes and a soup: Shanghai-style braised pork with rich sauce, steamed sea bass, garlic stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup. At the dinner table, Aunt Chen brought up the renovation matter on her own, took out her phone and flipped through photos of her own home's renovation back then, pointing at a cracked corner of the wall, saying the base layer hadn't been scraped clean, which caused the paint to blister later. Yin Hao listened attentively and used the memo app on his phone to jot down reminders about flooring materials, hardware brands, and painting procedures one by one. After the meal, he took the initiative to help clear the dishes and rinse them in the kitchen, and Aunt Chen praised him for being diligent.
location: Room 402, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home to get something and drive to the woodworking workshop
description: He left Aunt Chen's house and returned to his own home, picked up his phone charger and car keys, then went downstairs and walked to the white car parked in a surface parking space in the community. He started the car, set the navigation to 'Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop', turned onto the main road from Xinggang Road. The traffic at noon on Sunday was not too bad. After about 25 minutes, he arrived at the repair shop on Rongping Road in Songjiang District.
location: On the way from Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop at 558 Rongping Road.

name: Learned carpentry from Master Chen Jianguo and made a shoe cabinet by hand.
description: When he arrived at the shop, Master Chen was tinkering with an old electric fan. After greeting, Master Chen Jianguo pointed to the pre-cut boards and carpentry tools along the wall, including a handsaw, square, sandpaper, wood glue, and screws. Yin Hao, following Master Chen's instructions, first carefully marked lines on the board with a pencil and square, then used the handsaw to cut carefully along the lines. At first the saw blade wandered a bit; Master Chen hand-guided him to correct his grip and the angle of force. Next came assembly: first applying wood glue to the joints, then using an electric screw gun to tighten screws for reinforcement, with Master Chen guiding from the side and occasionally mentioning how carpentry and electrical work share structural thinking. Finally, he sanded all edges and cut faces smooth. The finished shoe cabinet was about 80 cm tall and 60 cm wide with a stable structure. Master Chen teased him for biting off more than he could chew, wanting to learn electrician skills and be a carpenter at the same time. Yin Hao smiled and replied that before taking possession of the new house, he wanted to make as many things as possible for the new home by hand; even if rough, they'd be nice to display. The shoe cabinet was left at the shop temporarily to wait for the paint to dry before picking it up.
location: Jianguo Appliance Repair Shop, 558 Rongping Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove home in the evening
description: After tidying up the woodworking area and saying goodbye to Master Chen, Yin Hao drove back to Xingang Community. On Sunday evening the sun was already low in the west, and the temperature had dropped a bit from the afternoon. Radio music played in the car, and he felt relaxed; the absorption he had just felt while making the shoe cabinet left him with a sense of fulfillment.
location: On the way from Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, No. 558 Rongping Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road.

name: Simple dinner and organizing renovation notes
description: After getting home, he changed out of his sawdust-stained jacket and washed his hands. Because he didn't want to do much cooking, he boiled a pot of plain noodles in the kitchen, poached an egg on top, added a few drops of soy sauce and sesame oil, and paired it with two pieces of braised pork that Aunt Chen had packed for him at noon. He ate simply. After the meal, he sat at his desk, opened the memo app on his phone, reorganized and categorized the renovation points Aunt Chen had mentioned at noon — flooring, walls, bathroom hardware, and other key experience — and transcribed them into the "New Home Renovation Notes" document on his computer and saved it.
location: Room 401, Building 5, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with parents and contact with public welfare group
description: Resting until nearly 8 pm, Yin Hao made a WeChat video call to his mother. His mother, Wang Xiuying, said the blood pressure medication had arrived the day before yesterday in the afternoon and the packaging was good, so he could rest assured. His father, Yin Jianguo, got on the phone and talked about the progress of the kitchen plumbing and electrical renovation in their hometown. Yin Hao urged his father not to rush the schedule and to take care of his health. They chatted for about fifteen minutes and hung up. He then switched to the "Charity Trio" group, saw that Li Ming and Zhao Li were both online, and sent a few messages sharing the fun of making the shoe cabinet that day. The three of them had a preliminary discussion about the time for next week's charity activity.
location: Room 401, Building 5, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening free time and getting ready for bed
description: After putting down his phone, he opened the wardrobe and laid out the work uniform and employee badge for tomorrow, then checked the items in his commuter bag. Next, he sat on the sofa and browsed a tech forum for half an hour, reading several posts about debugging new equipment. Then he went to the bathroom to wash up, brushing his teeth and washing his face. Back in the bedroom, he set the alarm for 5:50 and lay down. He turned off the bedside lamp on time, reviewed the day—study, socializing, hands-on practice, and contacting family had all been completed as planned—and, feeling reassured, soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room 401, Building 5, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning preparation and core exercise
description: Woken by the alarm at 6:20 in the morning, he was in good spirits. After getting up, he weighed himself first; it showed 71.4 kilograms, and he nodded with satisfaction. After a simple wash, he changed into a sports T-shirt and shorts, spread a yoga mat on the living room floor, and began core strength training. The workout included 4 sets of 45-second planks, supine alternating leg raises, and Russian twists with 15 reps per set. His heart rate rose steadily, his body was lightly sweating, and he felt more awake, ready for the day's work and life.
location: Room 304, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Breakfast and commute preparation
description: After exercising, he took a quick shower and then prepared breakfast. He made a sandwich with toast, fried egg, and lettuce, and paired it with a glass of hot milk. While eating breakfast, he checked the day's workshop shift schedule on his phone. After finishing, he checked his commuting items, confirmed that his work badge, notebook, and several pens were in his bag, and finally checked his car keys before driving to the factory.
location: Room 304, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Drove to work and listened to a CNC technology podcast.
description: He went down to the underground garage, started the car, and drove to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. On the way, he put on earphones and played a pre-downloaded CNC technology podcast titled 'Practical Applications of FANUC System Macro Programs.' While listening, he simulated the programming logic in his mind; although some content was quite profound, he firmly remembered the core ideas. The car drove out of Xingang Road, turned onto Huatianjing Road, and the factory was right ahead.
location: On the way from Xingang Road to Huatianjing Highway

name: Arrival preparation and team morning meeting
description: After arriving at the factory, he parked the car and went to the locker room to change into blue work clothes, put on protective gloves and a safety helmet. When he entered the workshop, team leader Wang Lei was already checking the day's production plan ledger. After a brief exchange of greetings, they prepared for the morning meeting together. At exactly 8 o'clock, the team morning meeting began on time in front of the workshop whiteboard. Team leader Wang Lei announced the day's production tasks: finish the shaft parts left over from last week and a batch of new flange blanks, with emphasis on machining accuracy and safe production. Master Sun Jianguo added a reminder for the whole team to pay attention to tool wear compensation. Yin Hao took careful notes and clarified his main task for the day.
location: Machining Workshop 2, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Inspect the machine tool and collect materials.
description: After the morning meeting, he walked to the CNC lathe numbered MT-08 and, following the procedure, checked the coolant level and lubricating oil amount in turn. He then started the machine to run a low-speed spindle warm-up and automatic leadscrew lubrication cycle, confirming the operation had no abnormal noise. He then went to the central tool crib and, using the material requisition form, received the cemented carbide turning tools and precision measuring instruments needed for the day's work from the storeroom clerk Sister Li, getting ready to start.
location: Machining Workshop No. 2 and Central Tool Storage, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Morning production: completed shaft parts machining.
description: This was the focus of the whole day's work. He clamped the unfinished stepped shaft blank from last week into the three-jaw chuck, carefully corrected the coaxiality, then called up the machining program according to the drawing and started the first roughing pass. The machine roared and chips flew. He stared intently at the feed rate and spindle speed on the screen, occasionally measuring key dimensions with a vernier caliper to make sure the tolerance was strictly controlled within 0.02 mm. During the machining, Master Sun Jianguo came over to check the progress and praised him with a 'pretty steady' comment, which made him even more motivated.
location: Workstation MT-08, Machining Workshop No. 2, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: Morning wrap-up and lunch
description: After all the shaft parts had been machined, he cleaned the iron chips off the machine tool, blew out the guide rails with compressed air, and measured the dimensions of the last part—all within tolerance, his satisfaction obvious. After putting away the measuring tools, he headed to the factory cafeteria for lunch. Today the cafeteria served braised chicken pieces, stir-fried greens, and seaweed egg drop soup. He sat at the same table as shift leader Wang Lei, chatting while eating about the afternoon skills training arrangements. Wang Lei mentioned that the focus would be a demonstration of the G71/G70 compound cycle commands and told him to bring paper and pen. Yin Hao nodded and ate faster to prepare for the upcoming training.
location: Machining Workshop 2 and Factory Canteen, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Internal training for the skills competition
description: After lunch, he arrived at the workshop training corner on time. Team leader Wang Lei drew diagrams at the whiteboard while explaining the logic of compound cycle commands for CNC lathes. Yin Hao sat in the front row, taking careful notes. After the theoretical explanation, Wang Lei demonstrated the tool path of the G71 and G70 commands on an idle CNC lathe, comparing the parameter settings between rough turning and finish turning. The discussion was lively, and Yin Hao proactively raised a question about allowance allocation, further deepening his understanding.

participant.name: Workshop colleagues participating in the competition.

location: Training Corner, Machining Workshop 2, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Afternoon production and hands-on practice
description: After returning to his workstation, he did not immediately start production on the new batch of flanges. Instead, using scrap from shaft parts, he called up the compound cycle command he had just learned and ran a complete tool-path simulation, adjusting load parameters and recording the optimal cutting feel. Then he switched to the flange drawing and began formally machining the new part. He strictly followed the allowance allocation principle learned in the intensive training: leaving sufficient allowance during rough turning and precisely controlling the feed rate during finish turning. After the first piece was completed, inspection showed all dimensions were within tolerance, confirming the method was effective.
location: Workstation MT-08, Machining Workshop No. 2, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: End-of-shift cleaning and work handover
description: Near the end of the shift, he turned off the machine tool power, returned the tool holder to a safe position, carefully wiped the machine control panel and guide rails with cotton yarn, and returned the used measuring tools to the warehouse. Then he wrote down the day's completed quantity and precautions in the shift handover record, specifically noting, "The MT-08 machine tool lead screw has a slight gap; compensation is needed when machining long shafts." After a brief verbal handover with the next-shift colleague Liu Zhiqiang, he packed up his belongings and got ready to leave.
location: Machining Workshop 2, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Commuting after work, buying groceries, and walking home.
description: When he walked out of the factory gate, the sky had grown somewhat overcast. He drove to the Xingang New Village fresh food supermarket, listening to light music on the way to relieve the fatigue of the day. After arriving, he bought two tomatoes, a small bunch of spinach, a box of eggs, and a bundle of dried noodles, planning to make simple tomato and egg noodles for dinner. After shopping, he carried the shopping bag and walked a few minutes back to his home in Xingang Community.
location: From Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory to Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, then walked to Xingang Community.

name: Prepared ingredients and had a video call with parents.
description: After getting home, he took off his coat and washed his hands, then immediately made a WeChat video call to his mother. In the video, his mother smiled and said she had not even finished half of her blood pressure medication, told him not to worry so much, and asked how he liked the shoe cabinet he had made. His father chimed in from the side, saying the kitchen wall cabinet had already been installed. Yin Hao propped the phone against the sideboard and, while chatting casually with his parents, deftly washed vegetables and cut tomatoes to prepare noodles.
location: Room 304, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Dinner
description: A steaming bowl of tomato-egg noodles was brought to the table, with a few drops of sesame oil, fragrant and appetizing. While eating the noodles, he quickly browsed the interview materials and scoring criteria sent by his girlfriend Lin Yue, silently thinking about the questions she might be asked and how she could answer them. After finishing, he cleaned up the dishes himself and prepared for the evening's mock interview.
location: Room 304, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Assist Lin Yue with a mock interview.
description: Spread the interview materials out on the desk, quickly skimmed the 8 behavioral interview questions Lin Yue had sent, then sent her a WeChat message saying he was ready. The two started a mock interview via WeChat video, with Yin Hao strictly asking each question in order according to the scoring criteria. When she was answering "Describe an experience where you resolved a team conflict," he interrupted at the right moment to guide Lin Yue to add specific details and the proactive communication role she played; when asked "Why are you participating in this internal selection," he reminded her to emphasize the actual achievements in her current position and her understanding of the new position. The mock session lasted about 40 minutes. Lin Yue's nervousness was noticeably reduced, and she said she had gained a lot of insight. After the interview, he edited a message of encouragement and sent it to Lin Yue, wishing her to speak freely tomorrow and that she would definitely succeed. Then he packed up the materials, feeling pleased.
location: Room 304, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China (video call with Lin Yue in Wuzhong District, Suzhou)

name: Community strength training.
description: He changed into his running shoes and quick-dry clothes, went downstairs to the community fitness area. Taking a deep breath of the cool air and loosening his shoulders, he started working out: first, 3 sets of pull-ups, each set until failure, with shoulder circles during the rest breaks; then 3 sets of standard push-ups, 20 reps per set, combined with a plank to strengthen his core. The whole strength session lasted about 25 minutes, and the stiffness from sitting for a long time was clearly relieved. After finishing, he did some stretches on the bench at the community entrance, felt relaxed all over, and slowly walked home.
location: Fitness Area, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Intensive theory review for the skills competition
description: After washing his face, he sat down at the desk and opened his laptop, then entered the online question bank for the CNC system parameter setting module to practice. He set a goal of completing 20 past exam questions within 25 minutes, focusing on parameter setting principles and troubleshooting approaches. Forest white noise played through his earphones to help him concentrate. He actually finished the questions in 12 minutes, and his accuracy after checking the answers reached 87%, exceeding the 85% target. He noted down the knowledge tags and key points for the wrong questions in his notebook, leaving a reference for later review.
location: Room 304, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Tidying Up and Preparing for Tomorrow
description: He turned off the computer, organized today's training notes, wrong answers from real exam questions, and key points from the mock interview into electronic notes. He checked the items needed for tomorrow and placed his work clothes and thermos on the stool by the door. After everything was ready, he felt very reassured.
location: Room 304, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Washing up, relaxing, and going to bed
description: He took a relaxing hot shower, dried his hair, and lay down on the bed. He checked tomorrow's weather forecast on his phone, which showed sunny. He set the alarm for 5:50 the next morning and put the phone into Do Not Disturb mode. Before turning off the light, he took a few deep breaths and reviewed the fulfilling experiences of the day: the work had been completed with quality, he had gained valuable insights from the skills competition, he had successfully helped his girlfriend with a mock interview, and he had not neglected exercise or theoretical study. Feeling very satisfied, he soon fell asleep.
location: Room 304, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Double 11 early-morning shopping spree
description: As soon as midnight hit, Yin Hao sat at his computer and placed orders in a flash. He first ordered a Lenovo Legion Y7000 gaming laptop from JD.com's self-operated store using Baitiao's 12 interest-free installments and a 200-yuan-off coupon for orders over 5,000 yuan, paying 6,500 yuan in total. Then he went to the Xiaomi flagship store and bought an air fryer with matching meal containers for 269 yuan, and got another discount of more than ten yuan when paying with his China Construction Bank credit card. After ordering, he screenshotted the orders. Seeing that delivery was expected by November 13, he felt somewhat relieved, then drowsily turned off the computer and went to sleep.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wash-up and breakfast
description: After the alarm went off, Yin Hao stayed in bed for five minutes before struggling to get up. Having only slept five hours, his head felt very heavy. He took a hot shower to wake himself up, saw his bloodshot eyes in the mirror while shaving, and changed into his work clothes. Then he took out the boiled eggs and bread from the night before, heated a glass of milk, forced it down despite his poor appetite, and made himself a large cup of instant black coffee to bring to the factory.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Contact running partner Chen Jie to ask for leave.
description: After breakfast, Yin Hao sent a WeChat voice message to his running buddy Chen Jie: “Jie, I really can't run today. I stayed up until 12 last night grabbing those 'Double 11' deals, and now my legs are like jelly. I'll make it up next time.” Then he grabbed his coffee and car keys and went out.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving to work
description: Yin Hao drove his white car out of Xingang Residential Community and turned onto Chenta Road. Morning rush-hour traffic was heavier than usual, so he turned up the stereo to play rock music to stay alert and sipped coffee while driving. The navigation showed he would arrive at the factory on Huatianjing Road in about 15 minutes.
location: From Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Plant, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Workshop work: machining urgently needed transmission gears

He called up the transmission gear machining program and checked the tool offset parameters for the third carbide end mill. After confirming they were correct, he loaded the workpiece, positioned it, clamped it, and started the machine. Drowsiness made him keep drinking coffee. His master Sun Jianguo walked over, observed the blank, then patted him on the shoulder and reminded him: "This has high precision requirements, keep a close watch." Yin Hao nodded in agreement, staring at the cutting fluid and iron chips without daring to be distracted.

That day they served braised chicken pieces, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and stir-fried vegetables. As soon as he sat down, his colleague Wang Lei excitedly said that the mechanical keyboard he had snapped up had been shipped, and Liu Zhiqiang also shared that he had snagged an entry-level projector. Yin Hao took a sip of seaweed egg drop soup and told everyone he had grabbed a gaming laptop and an air fryer. Wang Lei teased him about finally being willing to upgrade his gear. His mentor Sun Jianguo came over with his meal and said: The computer was a good buy; now that you are learning programming, you need good equipment.

In the afternoon, he processed the remaining two blanks as planned. When changing tools, he deliberately spent an extra two minutes using the tool presetter to carefully calibrate the length and radius of the new tool. Around 17:00, all roughing and finishing machining was completed. He measured the key dimensions piece by piece with calipers and a micrometer, and all passed. Then he cleaned the iron chips off the machine, wiped down the workbench, turned off the power, and signed the handover log.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

After shopping, he put the items on the passenger seat and continued driving home.

Then he pulled up the renovation tips memo shared by Aunt Chen Xiuying, searched the browser for "Nippon Paint wall paint price" and "Power Dekor laminate flooring price", and wrote down the parameters and reference prices.

name: Check camping gear and pack chargers
description: First, carry the barbecue supplies upstairs, sort them, and put them away. Change into a dry old T-shirt. Move the tent, canopy, sleeping bags, ground pads, folding table and chairs, etc. out from the balcony, and inspect them thoroughly in the living room: the tent poles are not deformed, the canopy attachment points are not torn, and the sleeping bag zippers are smooth. Then repack and organize them in order of use. Next, charge the drone and format the memory card; check the fishing rod guides and re-tie the figure-eight swivels, and prepare earthworms and commercial bait; connect the portable speaker to the phone and confirm it works. Finally, put the hardshell jacket, hiking shoes, and backpack for the next day on the living room sofa.
location: Home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Guangfulin Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: Shower, simple dinner, and preparation for interview mock.
description: After taking a hot shower, I changed into home clothes, drank some cold water, and rested. Then I heated up the braised chicken feet and tomato and egg soup, made egg fried rice, and had a simple meal while watching the news. After clearing the dishes, I set up my phone, adjusted the lighting, prepared for the upcoming mock interview coaching session, and reviewed again the interview questions and answering angles I had helped Lin Yue organize.
location: Home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Guangfulin Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: Interview coaching, group messages, and core training
description: Lin Yue initiated a video call and they had a one-hour mock interview. I asked questions as the mock interviewer, and Lin Yue's fluency and logic improved noticeably. I gave three key suggestions: slow down the pace, look at the camera and keep smiling, and emphasize the value she can bring to the company at the end. Lin Yue said she was 80% confident about the interview on Monday, and the two encouraged each other. After hanging up, I sent a message in the "Songjiang Three Brothers" group chat about meeting at 7 a.m. the next morning; Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng responded enthusiastically. Then I unrolled a yoga mat and followed Keep to complete a 15-minute core strength workout, including planks, side planks, and crunches.
location: Living room, home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Guangfulin Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Bedtime review and rest
description: Weighed 71.4kg, did some simple stretching. Checked tomorrow's backpack items: ID card, driver's license, phone, power bank, earphones, keys, all confirmed. Moved the living room gear to the doorway for easy loading tomorrow morning. Lying in bed, listening to the soft rustle of rain outside, picturing tomorrow's camping scene, feeling reassured. Turned off the lights and fell asleep at 22:50.
location: Home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Guangfulin Subdistrict, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: Morning preparation, breakfast, and loading equipment into the car before departure.
description: After the alarm went off, I weighed myself on an empty stomach: 71.5 kg. Then I did 15 minutes of core training in the living room, including supine leg raises and planks. After washing my face with cold water, I put on a black softshell jacket and army-green work pants. For breakfast, I heated milk in the microwave and ate it with whole wheat bread and boiled eggs. Meanwhile, I sent Lin Yue a WeChat message to ask about preparations. After the meal, I washed the dishes, checked and loaded supplies into the car: tent, awning, sleeping bags, folding table and chairs, barbecue grill, cooler, and hiking backpack. I locked the trunk, walked around the car to check tire pressure and fuel gauge, then drove out of Xingang Residential Community.
location: Room 402, No. 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the community parking lot

name: Pick up Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng and head to the campsite.
description: Drove first to the Tuhu Car Care workshop on Songdong Road to pick up Gao Zhiyuan, who was waiting by the roadside with an old military backpack. Then went to Liye Apartment on Hongmei Road in Minhang to pick up Ma Xiaofeng, who got into the car carrying homemade marinated duck necks and edamame. The three chatted and laughed in the car. After setting the navigation, they got onto the G50 Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway. The scenery outside the window changed from city to fields. The song Green Flowers in the Army was playing in the car. After getting off the expressway, they took country roads and arrived at the campsite at the west end of Dianshan Lake Avenue at 8:35.
location: Tuhu Car Care Factory Store (Songdong Road) at 301 Songdong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai; Liye Apartment (Hongmei Road Laowai Street branch) at 2000 Hongmei Road, Minhang District, Shanghai; and along the way to Dianshan Lake Avenue, Qingpu District.

name: Campsite selection and setup
description: After parking, the three of us surveyed the lakeshore. I chose a flat area that was slightly higher, sheltered from the wind, and thick with grass, then reversed the car closer to the campsite. We divided the work: I took out the tent and canopy, Gao Zhiyuan studied the pole structure, and Ma Xiaofeng went to the lakeside to fetch water and collect dry firewood. The three of us raised the poles and tied the ropes, taking half an hour to set up two tents and the canopy, set up folding tables and chairs, and planned the cooking area, forming the beginnings of a lakeside base.
location: Lakeside of Dianshan Lake Avenue Park Campground, west end of Dianshan Lake Avenue, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Morning lakeside fishing.
description: He took out three fishing rods and handed out commercial bait and earthworms. I chose a spot with fish bubbles on the water, set up my fishing chair, adjusted the float, baited the hook with an earthworm, and cast. In less than 20 minutes, I caught a crucian carp the size of a palm. Gao Zhiyuan came over to ask about float-adjusting techniques, and I demonstrated and explained. Ma Xiaofeng also tried casting his line, and everyone chatted while fishing.
location: Lakeside at Dianshanhu Avenue Park Campground, west end of Dianshanhu Avenue, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Simple Lakeside Lunch
description: After putting away the fishing rods, I took out braised chicken feet, fruit, and egg fried rice from the cooler. Together with the braised duck necks and edamame brought by Ma Xiaofeng, the three of us sat on folding chairs and had lunch with mineral water. After the meal, I placed the tuned drone on the table, ready.
location: Under the canopy at the campsite of Dianshan Lake Avenue Park, western end of Dianshan Lake Avenue, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon fishing and beginner instruction
description: After the meal, I cast the line again and taught Gao Zhiyuan hand by hand how to bait the hook and read the float, distinguishing crucian carp bites from small fish disturbing the nest. Gao Zhiyuan was very excited when he successfully caught a small crucian carp, and I also caught a few topmouth culter in succession. The afternoon sun was warm, and the three of us sat by our rods chatting freely about our experiences from military service to the present.
location: Lakeside at Dianshanhu Avenue Park Campground, west end of Dianshanhu Avenue, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Drone aerial photography and teaching
description: The afternoon light was soft. I took out the DJI drone, installed the battery, and after one-tap takeoff, shot an aerial panorama of the campsite and the lake. Then I taught Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng basic takeoff, landing, and directional control. Gao Zhiyuan was bold and flew back and forth on his own, while Ma Xiaofeng carefully completed takeoffs and landings. Both had a great time.
location: Dianshan Lake Avenue Park campsite, west end of Dianshan Lake Avenue, Qingpu District, Shanghai.

name: Prepare the bonfire and barbecue ingredients
description: The sun was setting. Ma Xiaofeng and I started a fire with solid alcohol and charcoal, using scrap newspaper as tinder. Gao Zhiyuan took out frozen lamb skewers, chicken wings, potatoes, and eggplants. He sliced the potatoes and scored the eggplants to absorb the flavor. As the campfire grew stronger, the grill preheated.
location: Dianshan Lake Avenue Park campsite, west end of Dianshan Lake Avenue, Qingpu District, Shanghai.

name: Campfire barbecue dinner and late-night chat
description: Night fell, and the bonfire lit up our faces. I grilled chicken wings marinated with an air-fryer recipe; the dripping oil sizzled and the aroma filled the air. Everyone sat around eating meat skewers, eggplant, and braised food, toasting with cola instead of alcohol. Gao Zhiyuan shared stories of bizarre car owners he had encountered at Tuhu, and I talked about my new house handover and renovation ideas, with Ma Xiaofeng giving advice. A portable speaker played old songs. After we were full, we added firewood to the fire, and under the starry sky we talked about confusion over career changes, work troubles, and future plans. At emotional moments, we listened quietly to the lake water lapping the shore, feeling calm inside.
location: At the campfire at the Dianshan Lake Avenue Park campsite, west end of Dianshan Lake Avenue, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Tidying the campsite, washing up, and preparing for rest
description: The three of them cleaned up together, packing the leftover bones and tin foil, pouring water on the campfire and covering it with soil to ensure safety, then brushing their teeth and washing their faces simply with mineral water. Afterward, I crawled into the tent, changed into a dry T-shirt, and lay down in my sleeping bag, with the sound of lake water and insects in my ears. In the neighboring tent, Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng quietly chatted and then gradually fell silent.
location: Dianshan Lake Avenue Park campsite, west end of Dianshan Lake Avenue, Qingpu District, Shanghai.

name: Falling asleep
description: I set the alarm for 7 a.m. the next morning on my phone and turned it off, the light from the screen casting a glow on the tent. Closing my eyes, I breathed in the moisture and the scent of grass and trees, emptied my mind, and fell into a deep sleep to the hypnotic sound of the lake water.
location: Inside a tent at the Dianshanhu Avenue Park campsite, west end of Dianshanhu Avenue, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Morning camping and breakfast by the lake
description: At 7 a.m., at the campsite on the west bank of Dianshan Lake, Yin Hao was naturally awakened by the sounds of his friends Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng outside the tent. He quickly put on his shell jacket, crawled out of the tent, and breathed in the cool lakeside air. Using a portable stove, he boiled water and brewed three cups of coffee. The three of them sat on a picnic mat and ate breakfast with bread and the leftover braised food from yesterday. Gao Zhiyuan brought up the plan to go to Anji Reservoir next spring for a comprehensive 'water, land, and air' camping trip. Yin Hao smiled and replied that he would wait for his year-end bonus and save up for renovation costs first. Yin Hao asked Gao Zhiyuan to take a photo of him from behind drinking coffee in the morning light, planning to send it to Lin Yue.
location: Campsite on the west bank of Dianshan Lake, Jinze Town, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Breaking camp and bidding farewell to the brothers.
description: After breakfast, the three divided the work: Yin Hao and Gao Zhiyuan took down the tent and tarp, while Ma Xiaofeng was responsible for cleaning up trash and making sure the campfire was out. By 8:45 all gear was packed into the car. Yin Hao drove south along Huqingping Highway, then took the G50 Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway toward Songjiang. On the way, Ma Xiaofeng played a playlist while Gao Zhiyuan caught up on sleep in the back seat. At 10:00 they exited the expressway at Songjiang New City, first dropping Gao Zhiyuan off downstairs at his residence in Songjiang Old Town, then turning around and dropping Ma Xiaofeng off at the entrance of Liye Apartments in Minhang District at 10:25. They agreed to meet again next week.
location: G50 Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway (Qingpu to Songjiang section) and surrounding roads

name: Returning home to unload and inventory supplies
description: At 10:30, Yin Hao drove alone back to Xingang Community, located at Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District. After parking, he carried equipment such as a tent bag, a fishing box, and folding table and chairs from the trunk to the elevator in several trips. When he reached his door, he saw the packages he had ordered online—an air fryer and a pair of tool pliers—piled at the entrance. He opened the door, went inside, piled everything in the living room, caught his breath, checked the time, and prepared for the next arrangements.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Equipment cleaning and core training
description: After getting home, Yin Hao first threw his dirty camping clothes into the washing machine. Then he spread newspapers on the living room floor, carefully wiped the mud and sand off the tent with a damp cloth, and disassembled the fishing rod section by section to apply protective oil. At 11:30, he stepped on the digital scale, which showed 71.5 kg. Then he did about 15 minutes of core training on a yoga mat, including slow planks, side planks, and glute bridges, focusing on relieving lower back pressure.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Tried out the air fryer and exchanged cooking tips via video.
description: After training, Yin Hao washed his hands, unboxed the air fryer, and cleaned the basket and rack according to the instructions. He took out the purple eggplant and garlic from the fridge, made a garlic sauce and brushed it on the eggplant, then put it in the air fryer at 200 degrees for 15 minutes. The aroma of garlic filled the air, and the eggplant came out soft, golden and tender. He took a photo and sent it to his girlfriend Lin Yue. Lin Yue immediately called via video, and when she saw the finished dish she laughed and said, "Nice one, Chef Yin! It looks even healthier than the ones sold in restaurants!" She encouraged him to try more new dishes and said she would come to taste them next time. Meanwhile, Yin Hao washed the breakfast dishes while he was at it.
location: Home kitchen, Xingang Xiaoqu, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Simple lunch and browsing renovation information.
description: After the call with Lin Yue ended, Yin Hao cooked a bowl of dried noodles and served it with the freshly grilled garlic eggplant as lunch. After eating, he washed the dishes and sealed the leftover eggplant before putting it in the fridge. Then he sat on a chair on the balcony to bask in the sun and browsed a few posts on decoration forums on his phone, focusing on range hood and stove brands and ceiling material prices.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Midday rest and studying plumbing and electrical renovation
description: Feeling sleepy, Yin Hao set an alarm and took a 40-minute nap on the living room sofa. After waking up, he opened his tablet to watch the Bilibili video 'Complete Tutorial on Running Water and Electricity Along the Ceiling' from his favorites, while using his phone's memo app to jot down keywords such as 'wall-mounted drain' and 'trap' to build knowledge for renovating his new home.
location: Living room at home, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Hanging laundry and exchanging greetings with neighbors
description: Yin Hao got up to stretch, went to the balcony to hang up the laundry from the washing machine, and took his camping work boots to the hallway to air out. The neighbor across the hall, Aunt Chen, returned from grocery shopping and asked about the camping trip. Yin Hao answered with a smile, exchanged a few pleasantries, and went back inside.
location: Home and hallway, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Fresh grocery shopping.
description: After checking the fridge and finding it short on vegetables, Yin Hao decided to buy ingredients for dinner. Carrying a reusable bag, he walked to the Xingang Xincun fresh food supermarket across from the residential area and bought two tomatoes, a bunch of Shanghai greens, a box of soft tofu, and a bag of dried noodles. Seeing that the spare ribs were pricey, he decided to keep it simple and cook a meal.
location: Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket (next to Northwest Gate 1 of Xingang Xincun), Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner prep and photo sorting
description: After getting home, Yin Hao put the ingredients into the refrigerator by category, and pre-washed the tomatoes and Shanghai greens. Then he turned on his computer, imported the morning light photos he took in the morning, and did some simple editing, planning to set one as his phone wallpaper. He put on earphones and listened to a few old songs to relax.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Discussed the camping video editing with Ma Xiaofeng over a video call.
description: Ma Xiaofeng sent a video call; he was working on editing a camping short video. Yin Hao gave music suggestions, and the two chatted for about ten minutes. Ma Xiaofeng said he would send it to the "Songjiang Three Brothers" group once it was edited. After hanging up, Yin Hao saw the high school friends group inviting him to play games, and replied that he would be online in the evening.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Mobile game competition and work discussion.
description: After making tea, Yin Hao opened Honor of Kings and teamed up with his online friends Zhang Fei and Wang Lei for two Peak matches. He chose Lian Po as support, and they played in sync, winning one and losing one. During the games, Wang Lei asked about machining parameters for work the next day, and Yin Hao told him to check the new program at the factory. After two matches, he felt tired, quit the game, and agreed with his fishing buddy Old Wu to meet again next week.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner cooking: tomato and egg soup and garlic eggplant
description: At dinner time, Yin Hao put on an apron. He reheated the leftover garlic eggplant from lunch in the air fryer, while heating oil in a cold pan to fry an egg. Then he used the remaining oil to stir-fry tomatoes until fragrant, added water, and made tomato egg drop soup. After the soup boiled, he blanched Shanghai bok choy in it, and served it with plain noodles in clear soup. The simple, healthy dinner left him very satisfied.
location: Home kitchen, Xingang Xiaoqu, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with father to discuss the renovation plan
description: At 7 p.m., Yin Hao called his father, Yin Jianguo, on WeChat video at the scheduled time. He showed his father photos of the new house’s bare concrete structure and explained in detail his idea of connecting the kitchen and the utility balcony. His father suggested installing a P-trap to prevent odors and stressed that water and electrical lines should be routed through the ceiling rather than the floor, and promised to help find an electrician he knew. After the call, Yin Hao jotted down the key points in his phone’s memo app.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening review and work preparation
description: Yin Hao sat at his desk and confirmed that the work badge and work clothes needed for tomorrow morning were ready. He sent a WeChat message to his colleague Engineer Liu to confirm the part program version and felt reassured after receiving an affirmative reply. Then he took out his ledger to record supermarket expenses and camping fuel costs. Afterward, he stood on the balcony, stretched, and felt the satisfaction of a day well ended.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening reading and podcast learning
description: Yin Hao returned to the bedroom and read CNC Machining Technology for about half an hour. Then he turned off the main light, left a small night light on, and opened a podcast to listen to audio about kitchen renovation, gaining inspiration. Around 9:30, he went to the bathroom, washed his face carefully, and applied moisturizing lotion as part of his skincare routine.
location: Home at Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Relaxation and meditation before falling asleep
description: Yin Hao turned off the podcast, lay in bed doing deep breathing, and relaxed his whole body. He recalled the next day's new part operation procedure at the factory and silently ran through it. Before 11 o'clock, he turned off the night light, covered himself with the quilt, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning core training and weighing.
description: After getting up at 6:30 in the morning, he weighed himself on an empty stomach at 71.3 kg, then did a 15-minute core workout, including planks, dead bugs, and Russian twists, striving for standard form on every set.
location: In the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Washing up, breakfast, and getting ready to leave
description: After a quick rinse, he changed into work clothes and a windbreaker, and enjoyed a quick breakfast: toasted whole-wheat bread, fried eggs, and hot milk. After checking the contents of his commuter bag, he put on windproof gloves and a headscarf and left on time at 7:30.
location: In the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Bike commuting to work.
description: Rode a mountain bike along Xingang Road to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, about 15 minutes in total. The temperature was low, but the windproof gear was effective, and I arrived at the factory bike shed on time and locked the bike.
location: Cycling route from Xingang Community to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: Pre-work preparation
description: After entering the workshop, changed into work clothes and put on a safety helmet and goggles. Walked to the operating area, turned on the equipment power, checked the coolant, oil level, and air pressure, and preheated and inspected the CNC machine tool according to procedures.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Morning production work: program check and first-piece trial cutting
description: He called up the SK-433 machining program, carefully checked parameters such as the coordinate system, tool number, spindle speed, and feed rate, and after confirming everything was correct, performed a first-piece trial cut. He watched the cutting process with full concentration, then measured the result with calipers and a micrometer. The dimensions were qualified, laying the foundation for batch machining.
location: Production Area No. 3, workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Received the training notice for five-axis machining technology
description: At exactly 10 o'clock, the workshop broadcast system and the company group chat simultaneously announced that a special lecture on five-axis machining technology would be held at 2 p.m. in the Craftsman Innovation Studio on the second floor. I confirmed my attendance and noted it in my notebook.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Morning batch machining and cutting efficiency optimization
description: After confirming that the program was correct, he started batch machining of SK-433 parts. He tried applying the 'small depth of cut, fast feed' strategy learned from Master Sun, which shortened the cutting time per part by about 5%. At the same time, he observed the cutting sound and chip evacuation, and adjusted the cutting fluid flow to ensure machining quality.
location: Production Area No. 3, workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and review of technical knowledge
description: After pausing the machine tool, he ate his packed lunch in the workshop break room (scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried Shanghai bok choy, and mixed grain rice), while using his phone to review notes on basic five-axis machining concepts and consolidate the technical knowledge related to the morning's work.
location: Rest room in the workshop at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch break and sorting renovation materials
description: After finishing lunch, I rested briefly for 20 minutes. Then I took out my phone and entered in detail into my memo the renovation points discussed with my father by video last night (open up the kitchen, run water and electricity through the ceiling, find an electrician), combined with my own ideas (separate strong and weak current, reserve space for a water purifier), and drew a sketch. I also browsed the "Decoration Home" forum and bookmarked 2 posts about avoiding pitfalls in old-house water and electrical renovation, accumulating materials for the old-house renovation.
location: Workshop rest area at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Go to the Craftsman Innovation Studio.
description: Paused the machine's automatic operation mode in advance to ensure machining safety. Took a notebook and pen and walked from the workshop to the Craftsman Innovation Studio on the second floor to attend the afternoon training lecture.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Attend a lecture on five-axis high-speed cutting technology.
description: At 2 PM, Senior Engineer Xu from a mechatronics research institute in Shanghai shared “New Generation Five-Axis High-Speed Cutting and Intelligent Compensation Technology.” I carefully recorded the key technical parameters and application cases. During the interaction session, I asked about thermal deformation and tool deflection in SK-433 thin-walled part machining and received a detailed answer. I benefited a lot.
location: Craftsman Innovation Studio, 2nd Floor, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: Post-training technical review and discussion
description: After the training, immediately organized and archived the key points of the intelligent compensation technology. Then discussed with Liu Zhiqiang and Wang Lei in the rest area how to apply the 'high-speed cutting + minimum quantity lubrication' technology to next week's SK-433 project. I suggested first doing a trial cut to reduce cutting depth and observe surface roughness, forming a preliminary optimization plan.
location: Workshop rest area at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: After-work commute and grocery shopping along the way
description: After finishing work, he tidied up his workstation, turned off the main power of the machine tool, and clocked out. He rode his mountain bike home, and on the way bought tomatoes, Shanghai bok choy, tofu, and dried noodles at Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket, spending 14.5 yuan, then returned to Xingang Community.
location: Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China.

name: Going home to relax and preparing dinner
description: After arriving home, he changed clothes and rinsed off to get rid of the smell of machine oil, then turned on the stereo to play light music. He marinated the tofu and set the air fryer to 200°C for 15 minutes, while washing vegetables and boiling water to prepare dinner.
location: In the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Dinner: air-fryer roasted tofu and tomato and greens noodles
description: Enjoy homemade air-fryer baked tofu (crispy outside, tender inside) with a tomato and Shanghai greens thin noodle soup. While eating, I browsed camping short videos on my tablet, especially the edited clips sent by Ma Xiaofeng, spending a relaxing dinner time.
location: In the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Organizing renovation notes and in-depth forum learning
description: After cleaning up after the meal, I integrated the scattered renovation points in my phone memo into a structured Old-House Renovation Memo (Kitchen), and then focused on learning about the construction technique of running water and electrical lines along the ceiling, the pros and cons of an open kitchen, and other topics on the Renovation Home forum and the Haohaozhu app. I took screenshots of useful suggestions and annotated them.
location: In the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Video call with girlfriend Lin Yue
description: After finishing the renovation study, he called his long-distance girlfriend Lin Yue via video and asked about her interview that day. Learning that she felt good, the two chatted about everyday fun topics such as baking tofu in an air fryer. The call lasted 23 minutes. He encouraged her to wait patiently for the result, and they agreed to celebrate together once it came out.
location: In the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Playing online games with colleagues.
description: In response to Wang Lei's call in the 'Songjiang Three Brothers' group, the three of us teamed up for Honor of Kings ranked matches. I played Mulan on the top lane and won the first game together with Wang Lei as jungler; in the second game we lost because the enemy lineup countered us and Liu Zhiqiang in the mid lane was ganked frequently. Near the end of work time, I proactively ended the gaming session to ensure energy for the next day.
location: In the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Washing, meditation, and stretching.
description: After exiting the game, washed up carefully and changed into pajamas. At 22:00, opened the Tide app for a 10-minute body scan and relaxation meditation, lying flat and guided to relax all muscles. After meditation, did 5 minutes of basic stretching, moving the neck, shoulders and waist to relieve the day's work fatigue.
location: In the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Professional reading and organizing belongings before bed
description: After stretching, he didn't go to bed immediately. He took out the book CNC Machining Process Technology and looked through the intelligent compensation chapter mentioned in the lecture, marking key points with a red pen. He checked the keys, work badge, and other items needed for work the next day, and at 23:00 sharp turned off the light and fell asleep, ending a fulfilling day.
location: In the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, China

name: Getting up, morning exercise, breakfast, and preparation for work.
description: The alarm went off at 6 a.m. Yin Hao got up immediately, walked to the living room in his vest, and weighed himself on the electronic scale, which showed 71.1 kg. He then recorded the data in his phone's memo. Next, he spread out a yoga mat in the living room and did 3 sets of planks (45 seconds each) and a full-body stretching routine, including Cat-Cow, Downward Dog, and Butterfly poses. After his body was warmed up, he felt it was enough. Then he boiled two eggs with an egg cooker, heated a glass of milk in the microwave, and put two slices of whole-wheat bread into the toaster during the break. After washing up, he changed into his work clothes and quickly finished the eggs, bread, and milk. Finally, he packed his phone, work badge, keys, and laptop into his commuter bag, ready to leave for work.
location: Building 6, Room 503, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to work by car
description: Went downstairs at 6:40 on time and started the car parked in the ground-level parking space in the residential community. Connected his phone via Bluetooth and played the podcast course Five-Axis Linkage Machining Technology. After the meeting, Yin Hao conducted a routine check on the MT-08 CNC milling machine he was responsible for, checked the coolant and lubricating oil levels, preheated the spindle, and set up the BT40 tool holders and carbide end mills needed for the day.

While machining the first workpiece, Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang came over to convey the company technical department's suggestion: reduce the feed rate in the finishing stage by 15% to better control thin-wall deformation. Yin Hao thought it was feasible and directly modified the program parameters on the machine. The three discussed follow-up tool selection for about ten minutes. Yin Hao then focused on machining. After the first piece was completed, he self-checked it with a coordinate measuring machine, confirming that all key dimensions were within tolerance.

Instead of looking at his phone, he took out his pocket notebook and reviewed the key servo parameters he had jotted down the night before while previewing the CNC System Parameter Setting Manual, silently memorizing them to warm up for the evening's focused review.

name: Batch processing and delivery
description: Returning to the machine tool, I started batch machining the remaining SK-433 fixture workpieces. Strictly following Wang Lei's advice, I lowered the finishing feed rate by 15% while closely monitoring the cutting sound and chip evacuation; everything was normal. At 11:40, I finished rough and finish machining of all 3 workpieces. After inspection, I filled out the production flow card and handed it to the next process.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Maogang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

After the meal, instead of going out for a smoke, Yin Hao returned to his workstation, put on earphones, and used his phone to browse the classic alarm cases from Fault Diagnosis Case Analysis he had photographed the night before, mentally simulating the troubleshooting process.

During the machine's automatic tool change interval, Yin Hao opened Siemens NX software on his laptop to review the five-axis positioning machining programming commands he had studied the night before, and tried to write a simple drilling program for an inclined plane. When he had a question about post-processing settings, he took a photo of the screen and sent it via WeChat to Liu Zhiqiang in the programming office, and quickly received a reply with solution steps.

After handing over the next day's work tasks to Wang Lei, he went to the changing room and changed back into casual clothes.

description: After putting away the dishes, Yin Hao walked into the study, cleared the clutter on the desk to one side, opened his newly bought Lenovo Legion gaming laptop and plugged it in. He took the CNC System Parameter Setting Manual and Fault Diagnosis Case Analysis from the bookshelf and placed them next to the laptop, then took out several highlighters, black pens, and a brand-new draft notebook from the drawer for drawing diagnostic flowcharts. Finally, he opened the CNC simulation software shortcut on the desktop and confirmed it ran normally.
location: Home study, Room 503, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Helping a neighbor set up a stall
description: Left at 17:50 and helped Aunt Chen Xiuying across the hall move her reading glasses stall to the entrance of the residential complex. After retirement, Aunt Chen runs a small business. Today she had more stock than usual, so she asked Yin Hao to help watch the stall for half an hour. He helped organize the goods, attended to customers for a while, and also helped solve a customer's problem with reading glasses prescription. At 18:25 Aunt Chen urged him to go home and study. Yin Hao thanked her and went upstairs.
location: Near the entrance of Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: In-depth review: CNC system parameter settings
description: He officially began focused review. Starting with the CNC System Parameter Setting Manual, Yin Hao carefully studied core exam points such as servo drives (position loop gain, velocity loop gain), spindle parameters (acceleration/deceleration time constants), and reference point establishment, while jotting down key value ranges and setting principles in a draft notebook. To deepen his memory, he opened simulation software and manually changed the servo position loop gain parameter (from 3500 to 4000) on a virtual machine tool, ran a program to observe changes in the motor's simulated response curve, and wrote a conclusion in his notebook: excessive gain can easily cause resonance and overshoot. He remained very focused throughout the process.
location: Home study, Room 503, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Focused Topic: Fault Diagnosis Methodology
description: After resting for 5 minutes and stretching his neck, Yin Hao opened Fault Diagnosis Case Analysis and focused on reviewing common alarm codes. For the two high-frequency exam points, servo drive overload alarms and spindle encoder hardware faults, he used a red pen to draw troubleshooting flowcharts in the margins of the textbook, covering steps such as checking the load, mechanical jamming, and using a multimeter to test the continuity of the encoder wiring. When he came across the difficult point of how to quickly distinguish between a motor problem and a drive problem, he sent a WeChat voice message to Master Sun Jianguo for advice. Master Sun quickly replied and explained simple diagnostic techniques such as observing waveforms with an oscilloscope and manually rotating the shaft by hand. Yin Hao quickly jotted everything down in his draft notebook.
location: Home study, Room 503, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Comprehensive hands-on practice with simulation software
description: Putting theory into practice. Yin Hao opened the CNC simulation software and simulated a fault scenario in which improper servo parameter settings caused a following error over-limit alarm when the machine tool moved rapidly. Based on the diagnostic approach he had just reviewed, he first checked the alarm number, then opened the parameter page and manually increased the maximum following error threshold, but the alarm did not clear. He then checked the servo gain parameters and found that the position loop gain of one axis had been artificially set very low. After adjusting it to the normal range, the alarm cleared. He recorded the complete fault-diagnosis-solution process in detail in text. After that, he simulated the troubleshooting of a stuck tool-changing manipulator. After 1.5 hours of repeated practice, his theoretical knowledge was more firmly consolidated.
location: Home study, Room 503, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Study wrap-up and questions

Then he organized today's review notes into an electronic version and saved them in the CNC competition preparation folder on his computer.
location: Home study, Room 503, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

After gently stretching his neck and adjusting his sleeping position, his consciousness gradually faded, and he fell into a deep sleep with steady breathing.
