As he listened, he silently memorized a few key parameters.
location: Roads along the route from Xingang Road to Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Getting ready for work and team morning meeting.
description: Arrived at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, parked in the factory parking space, swiped his card to enter the workshop, and first went to the changing room to put on blue work clothes and a safety helmet. In the workshop he met his colleague Liu Zhiqiang, who was doing pre-start-up checks, and walked up to greet him, saying: "Zhiqiang, morning. About that simulation software we talked about yesterday, I'll run through it with you this morning." Then he saw on the shift whiteboard that today's team leader was Wang Lei. At 7:50, Wang Lei presided over the morning meeting in the pre-shift meeting area and assigned the day's production tasks: focus on completing the first-piece trial cut for the SK-433 project and batch machining of Q235 flanges, and stressed that machine tools must be operated according to procedures, especially stopping the machine when changing tools and cleaning chips.
location: Workshop and pre-shift meeting area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Trial-cut simulation for the SK-433 project
description: He and Liu Zhiqiang came to the computer in the workshop office area, opened the UG simulation software, and called up the already built SK-433 part model and tool path. As he was operating, he said to Liu Zhiqiang: "Yesterday I checked with my mentor, and I think this feed rate can be further optimized at the corners to reduce machining vibration." The two spent nearly two hours repeatedly adjusting the spindle speed, feed rate, and cutting depth. They ran a complete simulation and confirmed the plan was feasible, requiring only fine-tuning during actual machining according to the material conditions.
location: Technical Office and Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Check preliminary contest results during a work break.
description: After the break bell rang, he went to the break room to get a cup of hot water, took out his phone, and logged in to the official website of the Shanghai Vocational Skills Competition. He entered his admission ticket number and ID card number, and a few seconds later the score popped up: total score 86 points, ranking in the top 18% of the preliminary round, successfully advancing to the finals. Staring at the screen, he showed a satisfied smile, then took a screenshot and sent it to the family group chat "Home" (with the message "Mom, Dad, I passed!") and to the brothers' group chat "Songjiang Three Brothers" (with the message "Brothers, see you at the finals!"). Soon he received a thumbs-up from his father, a rose emoji from his mother, and congratulatory messages from his brothers. At that moment, team leader Wang Lei walked over, smiled, and patted his shoulder: "Great job, Yin Hao! I knew you could do it! I'll treat you to milk tea in the cafeteria at noon!" Liu Zhiqiang also chimed in beside him.
location: Workshop corridor and tea room of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Workshop hands-on practice and asking the master for advice.
description: After adjusting his mood, he put on safety goggles and gloves, started the horizontal machining center, and began the first-piece trial cut of the SK-433 part according to the plan set in the morning. After loading the program and installing the tools, he pressed the start button. The machine tool emitted a low cutting rumble, and metal chips flew. He observed the screen data and tool wear throughout the process. During the break, he took the printed plan to Master Sun Jianguo, who was setting up another machine tool, and pointed at the key points to ask for advice. Master Sun put on his reading glasses, examined it closely, and said, "The roughing feed rate can be increased by another 10%, no problem. Leave enough allowance for finishing. The overall plan is good — it shows creative thinking." After receiving Master Sun's affirmation, he felt more confident.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Midday celebration and group meal.
description: After the lunch break, he first weighed himself on the workshop scale: still 71.0 kg. It seemed yesterday's indulgence had been fairly restrained. When he headed to the cafeteria, Wang Lei had already saved a table by the window, with four cups of milk tea and a few packs of snacks on it. Lunch was braised pork chop, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and rice. During the meal, everyone celebrated the preliminary results. Wang Lei said there were no urgent tasks in the afternoon, so they could plan the finals training properly. Liu Zhiqiang suggested practicing more hands-on operations and troubleshooting. Master Sun Jianguo said calmly, "Not bad. For the finals, you need to practice the hands-on part well, stay calm, and put your mind into every part." Yin Hao drank his milk tea and kept his master's words in his heart.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon flange machining and finals planning
description: After the lunch break, he returned to his workstation and began batch-machining Q235 steel flanges according to the work order. The task was not complicated, but the quantity was large, so he needed to ensure dimensional consistency. He called up the program, clamped the blanks, and after each part was machined, carefully measured the key dimensions with a vernier caliper and a micrometer. During the intervals of automatic tool changes or measurements, he quietly planned his finals training: first, memorize the troubleshooting procedures for several classic fault cases given by Master Sun; second, try to spend one hour after work every day practicing cutting path planning on an idle workshop machine; third, find a few CNC system maintenance manuals and focus on studying parameter settings and PLC signals. He recorded this preliminary training plan in his phone memo.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Shihudang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-work shopping and tidying up upon arriving home
description: At 5:30 p.m., he finished the final batch of flange quality inspections and signed off. After cleaning the machine tool and workbench, he clocked out. On the way, he stopped by Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket, took a shopping cart, grabbed a bag of frozen xiaolongbao (his usual late-night snack), and picked out a bunch of fresh baby bok choy and two scallions. After paying, he carried the bags back to his car. He drove into the community, parked in his designated spot, went upstairs into his apartment, changed out of his work jacket and shoes, and put the groceries into the fridge by category, feeling a wave of relief.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Food Supermarket, Room 106, No. 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and Room XX, No. XX, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Simple dinner and WeChat replies.
description: Decided to heat up last night's leftovers and cook noodles. Poured the tomato scrambled eggs and Shanghai bok choy into the pot to heat, and boiled water on the stove to cook the dried noodles. In less than ten minutes, made a steaming bowl of noodles with toppings. Carrying the bowl to the living room sofa, I ate while replying on my phone to several WeChat messages congratulating me on my results, including a voice message from my older brother Yin Tao, replying: "Hehe, it's solid. Next up is hard work on hands-on practice."
location: Kitchen and living room, Room XX, Building XX, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Evening core training and shower
description: After resting for twenty minutes, he spread out the yoga mat again and did the second core workout of the day. The movements were the same as in the morning, but he did them with more focus, feeling the burn in his core muscles, using this to maintain physical stability and mental state. After the workout, he went into the bathroom and took a hot shower to wash away the sweat, then changed into comfortable loungewear. Feeling refreshed, he was full of energy for the evening presentation.
location: Living room and bathroom, Room XX, Building XX, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Refine the weekend presentation slides and speech script.
description: He opened his laptop and created a new folder named "Weekend Presentation PPT - Session 2", then began to work deeply based on the experience from the first session. He spent a lot of time polishing the "Machine Tool Operation Safety Regulations" section, adding two small accident cases caused by rule violations that he had personally witnessed, along with illustrations. Then he added a digital transformation case, using a schematic to show how optimizing the path improved the machining efficiency of an old machine tool by 12%. At the end of each PPT page, he designed small interactive questions to improve engagement during the presentation. By 9 p.m., the first draft of the PPT was basically complete, and the speech notes had filled three pages.
location: At the desk in Room XX, No. XX, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Testing presentation equipment and organizing materials
description: Took out a brand-new wireless presentation remote, plugged in the receiver, and carefully tested the page up/down, black screen, and laser pointer functions, confirming everything worked normally. Then turned on the presenter mode on the computer to check whether it would display properly on the classroom screen the next day, and copied the PPT file and PDF version of the speech to both a USB drive and the desktop as backup. Finally, took out a briefcase, placed the laptop, presentation remote, charger, USB drive, and printed speech inside one by one, zipped it up, and put it by the door.
location: At the desk in Room XX, No. XX, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Late-night snack and relaxing with short videos.
description: All preparations were done, and he felt a sense of satisfaction and relief. He took frozen soup dumplings out of the fridge, put six into the air fryer, and set it to heat at 180°C for 10 minutes. When they came out, the bottoms were golden and crispy. He poured a small dish of vinegar, curled up on the sofa with the plate, opened Bilibili, and watched a few short videos about automated production lines related to the day's work, enjoying a rare moment of tranquility.
location: Kitchen and living room, Room XX, Building XX, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Evening washing up and daily review.
description: After putting the kitchen in order, he went to the bathroom and washed up carefully. While brushing his teeth, he looked at himself in the mirror and briefly reviewed the day: he had performed excellently in the preliminary round, work was progressing as planned, and the PPT for the evening had been prepared with confidence; today was in good shape. He picked up his phone and sent a goodnight message to his girlfriend Lin Yue: “Everything went smoothly today, and the PPT for the weekend presentation is ready. Get some rest, talk tomorrow~”
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room XX, Building XX, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: He turned off the lights and lay down, putting his phone on the nightstand to charge. It was very quiet outside the window. Closing his eyes, he ran through the flow of tomorrow's presentation in his mind, then took a deep breath to relax. Everything that had happened today made Yin Hao more confident about the coming month, and he soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room XX, No. XX, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Xinqiao Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning exercise and preparation
description: The alarm went off at 7 sharp. I stood on the scale on an empty stomach, showing 70.7 kg, which was consistent with expectations. Then I spread out the yoga mat and completed 15 minutes of core training, including planks, crunches, and squats, and used a foam roller on my calves and the backs of my thighs to relieve stiffness from sitting for long periods. After showering, I quickly ate two slices of whole wheat toast and a glass of warm milk, changed into a neatly ironed dark blue jacket, casual trousers, and polished leather shoes, storing up energy for the morning presentation.
location: Room 302, Building 4, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go to Minhang Vocational and Technical College to give a talk on the spirit of craftsmanship.
description: Left home by car at 7:45, drove along Xinzhuan Highway onto the Humin Elevated Road. Traffic was smooth on Saturday morning, and the whole trip took about 33 minutes, arriving at the Yuanjiang Road Campus of Shanghai Minhang Vocational and Technical College at 8:18. Teacher Wang, the contact person, was waiting at the school gate and guided me to park in the visitor parking space beside the Administration Building. At 8:20 I took the stage in the academic lecture hall, facing about 200 teachers and students. First I shared how my military career shaped a rigorous work attitude, then, drawing on my experience of scoring 86 and advancing to the finals the previous day, I talked about my transition from soldier to CNC machine operator, focusing on how the spirit of craftsmanship and the pursuit of perfection is reflected in parts processing. I also used the company's digital transformation as an example to show the efficiency gains brought by intelligent machine tools, and gave a live demonstration of techniques for avoiding common mistakes in CNC programming. After the presentation ended at 9:30, a 40-minute interactive session followed, with students enthusiastically asking about career planning, skills certification, and industry prospects, and I gave advice based on my own experience. Finally, Director Wang of the Academic Affairs Office presented a letter of appreciation, and the event concluded successfully at 11:00.

participant.name: Director Wang
participant.relation: Director of the school's academic affairs office.

location: Academic Lecture Hall, Yuanjiang Road Campus, Shanghai Minhang Vocational and Technical College, 4080 Yuanjiang Road, Minhang District, Shanghai

name: Returned to the factory office to handle work and take a lunch break
description: At 11:00, after saying goodbye to Director Wang, he drove back to Songjiang. Because some materials were in the office, he decided to first return to the Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory. The Humin Elevated Road was still smooth, and he arrived at the factory on Huatianjing Road at 11:35. After reaching the office, he archived the presentation PPT, site photos, and electronic thank-you letters into the "Social Activities" folder, replied to several emails about next week's production schedule, and recorded the highlights and points for improvement of the presentation in his work log. Then he leaned back in his office chair and rested with his eyes closed for 20 minutes until 12:30.
location: Office of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Farmhouse lunch
description: Taking advantage of the lunch break, he drove to the Sun Island Ancient Village farmhouse restaurant near his company, a regular spot for a better meal. He ordered a bowl of braised lamb noodles with two side dishes and ate to his satisfaction. The restaurant is next to the east gate of Sun Island Tourism Resort, with a leisurely environment and a good choice for a short break.
location: Sun Island Ancient Village Farm Stay, beside the East Gate of Sun Island Tourist Resort, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Write a summary log of the presentation
description: After lunch, I returned to the office, opened my laptop, and wrote today's presentation summary log. I recorded in detail the progress in the opening remarks and the interactive session, and reflected on my lack of knowledge when answering questions about career planning. Finally, I organized the photos and PPT into a compressed archive for future reuse.
location: Office of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Accurate measurement of the new house.
description: At 2:00 PM sharp, I rode an electric bike to the new apartment in Yulanwan Community on Guangfulin Road, carrying a tape measure, a notebook, and a laser distance meter. Since I signed the contract in October, I have come here every weekend to plan. I first used the laser distance meter to quickly scan the overall dimensions of the living room and master bedroom, then used the tape measure to precisely measure the height and width of each windowsill, as well as the positions and widths of beams and columns. In the kitchen, I focused on measuring the water and electrical pipe connections and the load-bearing condition of the walls. After each room, I drew a simple sketch in my notebook and labeled the measurements, took more than ten photos, and marked the walls and electrical panel locations that need to be modified. Throughout, I kept thinking through future layout plans in my head.
location: Room 1602, Building 12, Yulan Bay Community, Lane 999, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home to shower and contact Zhang Fei
description: Returned home from the new house. Because he was covered in dust from taking measurements, he took a quick shower and changed into a clean black T-shirt and casual pants. Then he sat on the sofa and contacted his gaming friend Zhang Fei via WeChat, told him he had arrived at the restaurant, and asked about his schedule. Zhang Fei replied that he would set out from the hotel and arrive around 6:30.
location: Room 302, Building 4, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: In-person dinner with new friend Zhang Fei.
description: At 17:45, walked ahead to the familiar Xingang Road Sichuan restaurant at the entrance of the residential area, and ordered the signature local-style braised pork, pan-fried xiaolongbao, and two cold dishes. Zhang Fei looked thinner than expected, but as soon as he started talking, their in-game chemistry reappeared. The two felt completely at ease, chatting from ranked-match strategies in Honor of Kings to the 996 culture at his company in Shenzhen. Yin Hao, in turn, shared the growing pains of factory digital transformation and the workshop's coping methods, and taught the communication skill he learned in the military of reporting work by highlighting key points. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant. They drank two bottles of beer, eating and chatting, and the meal lasted until nearly 8 p.m.
location: Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, 232 Xingang Road, Dagang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Follow-up on the gathering with Zhang Fei: tour, aerial photography, and farewell.
description: After settling the bill, he invited Zhang Fei to visit Building 4 where he lived. Remembering the drone, he went upstairs, took it out, and flew it in the community square, filming the night view of Xingang Community and taking a group photo of the two of them. Zhang Fei used his phone to shoot a short video and posted it on WeChat Moments with the caption: “Game buddies finally met in person!” At around 8:30, the ride-hailing car arrived and took Zhang Fei to the east gate of the community. They agreed to meet again next time in Shanghai or Shenzhen. When he got back inside, Yin Hao imported the selected drone photos to his computer, picked the best-angle community panorama and group photo, and sent them to Zhang Fei via WeChat.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening free relaxation and rest.
description: After washing up, I lay down on the sofa and reviewed the fulfilling day from the briefing to the new house measurement to meeting old friends, feeling grounded. I opened my phone and browsed a home renovation case app, saving a creative TV background wall design, but did not open any games again because I felt offline friendship is truly precious. At 22:50 I turned off the bedside lamp and ended a rich day.
location: Room 302, Building 4, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning exercise and fishing gear check after getting up
description: At 06:30 the alarm went off. Yin Hao got up, changed into sportswear, and weighed himself on an empty stomach: 70.9 kg. He then did 10 minutes of core training (planks, crunches) and 5 minutes of stretching to wake up his body. After training, he checked and inspected his fishing gear: he checked whether the guides on each section of the fishing rod were intact, wiped and re-spooled the line, confirmed that the small floats and the lead sheet box were complete with accessories, and wrapped the red worms in wet tissue to keep the bait active. At 07:10, he made a cup of hot tea in a thermos and had two slices of whole wheat bread and a banana for breakfast. At 07:25, he sent a voice message via WeChat to his fishing buddy Brother Wu, confirming that today's meeting point at the west end intersection of Dianshanhu Avenue in Qingpu was unchanged, and telling him that he planned to leave at 07:45.
location: Room 305, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparation before departure and driving to the fishing spot
description: Bring all the gear: fishing tackle bag, thermos cup, folding stool, and a small bag (power bank, tissues). Put on a windproof jacket and non-slip shoes, go downstairs at 07:45 on time, drive his own SUV, turn on navigation, set the destination to the west end of Dianshan Lake Avenue, Qingpu District, and set off.
location: Along the way from Xingang Community, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Dianshan Lake Avenue, Qingpu District.

name: Fishing at a wild pond near Dianshan Lake and learning about winter float adjustment
description: At 08:25, he arrived at the agreed intersection. After meeting up with Brother Wu, the two cars arrived at the wild pond fishing spot one after another. They quickly assembled the fishing gear, and Brother Wu began hands-on teaching of fine winter float tuning. The core was to use a small float with a lead-carrying capacity of about 0.8g; by trimming the lead and adjusting the rubber stops, the two hooks were made to present a state of one hook lightly touching the bottom and one hook lying on the bottom, to suit fish with light bites in winter. Yin Hao studied seriously and adjusted twice, finally achieving the ideal float signal at around 09:15. Then the two baited with bloodworms and officially started fishing. The wind was bitingly cold, but Yin Hao was completely immersed in watching the float and enjoying the tranquility. Occasionally he lifted the rod and caught a few small crucian carp. During this period, he took out his phone and shared with Brother Wu an article about a new fishing spot from the "Shanghai Wild Fishing Guide" official account that Zhang Fei had recommended yesterday. Brother Wu said he knew that place and analyzed that the fishing would probably be mediocre in winter, but after the start of spring they could go and try it. At 11:30 they stopped fishing, and all the catches were released.
location: Unnamed wild pond about 5 km west on Dianshan Lake Avenue, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Shared lamb noodles with Brother Wu and exchanged insights
description: After packing up his fishing rods at 12:15, he drove to follow Brother Wu to his Zhiqiang Auto Care Center in the Qingpu urban area. After arriving, Brother Wu skillfully cooked two large bowls of mutton noodles in the kitchen, adding extra chili oil and cilantro. The two sat by the coffee table in the rest area, slurping the noodles while reviewing the morning's fishing tips. Brother Wu encouraged Yin Hao to come out more with him in winter to practice, and they agreed to try another sluice gate next week if the weather was good. Yin Hao carefully noted the key points and thanked Brother Wu for his guidance.
location: Zhiqiang Auto Care Center, No. 588 Huaqing South Road, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Drive back home and rest at midday
description: At 13:15, he said goodbye to Brother Wu and drove back to Songjiang alone. He got home at 14:00. After entering, he changed into loungewear, filled a thermos cup with warm water, and sat on the sofa to rest for half an hour. During that time, he opened his phone album, selected the several photos of fishing spots and catches he had taken today, and did some simple color adjustment. Then he sent a message to the "Iron Triangle" WeChat group with his army buddies Zhang Jianguo (Hangzhou) and Zhou Xiaofeng (Shenzhen): "Old Zhang, Little Zhou, as we said last night, online at 8 PM? No problem on my end." Soon he got "OK" replies from both.
location: Room 305, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: New home renovation planning and sketch drawing
description: After resting, Yin Hao spread out the draft paper with yesterday's measurements of the new Yulanwan home and the laser rangefinder manual on the small table in the living room. He opened the Zhuxiaobang and Kujiale apps on his phone and searched mainly for 'sunken entryway dimensions,' 'U-shaped kitchen layout for a small apartment,' and 'tatami for a small bedroom.' Based on the reference dimensions of the new home, he marked several layout plans that suited him, for example, writing '1000mm*1200mm sunken area' at the entryway and 'refrigerator 600mm wide, sink by the window' next to the kitchen sketch. As he looked through them, he used a ruler and pencil to draw preliminary layout sketches of the living/dining room and the master bedroom on the draft paper. He stopped at 16:30 and put the drawings away.
location: Room 305, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Sharing on Moments and browsing news
description: After putting away the drawings, Yin Hao opened WeChat Moments and selected three photos: today's sunrise at the wild pond, a close-up of Brother Wu's hand gesture adjusting the float, and a steaming bowl of lamb noodles. He captioned it: 'Weekend recharge: learned fine winter float adjustment from Brother Wu + a bowl of lamb noodles warming me to the heart. Keep working hard next week.' After posting, he scrolled through the news for a while and saw a push notification of outstanding works from a domestic drone aerial photography contest. He thought about the aerial group photo he took with Zhang Fei yesterday and felt he should learn video editing too.
location: Room 305, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare dinner
description: For dinner, he decided to cook for himself. From the fridge, he took out the wontons and a few Shanghai greens he had bought yesterday, boiled water and cooked them, and made a simple soup base with seaweed and dried shrimp. He also sliced a cucumber and dressed it with minced garlic, vinegar, and a little chili oil. He started eating at 18:00, replying to a few friends' likes and comments on his Moments while eating.
location: Room 305, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparations before online gaming
description: After eating, he washed the dishes and wiped the table. Back in his room, he put on earphones, connected to Wi-Fi, and opened the Honor of Kings game client. He first updated the resource pack and checked the skins and rune pages of his commonly used heroes. He charged both his phone and Bluetooth earphones at the same time. At 19:25, he sent a message in the 'Iron Triangle' group chat: 'Brothers, I'm ready. Standing by quietly.'
location: Room 305, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: “Iron Triangle” online gaming session
description: At exactly 20:00, the three formed a team and started playing games online. After turning on the mic, Zhang Jianguo (Hangzhou, driving-school instructor) immediately boomed: “Haozi, don't play Zhang Fei today. Pick a tank support, and I'll carry you!” Zhou Xiaofeng (Shenzhen, network security engineer) responded politely: “Lao Zhang, stop bragging. Haozi, don't listen to him. Pick someone you're good at.” Yin Hao smiled and chose his specialty, Xiahou Dun, for the solo lane. After several rounds, they had wins and losses, but the important thing was teasing and chatting in voice. Zhang Jianguo complained about a student who touched the line three times during reverse parking. Zhou Xiaofeng shared the functions of the anti-fraud software his company had newly developed. Yin Hao talked about this weekend's plans of fishing and drawing. The three ended the game on time at 22:00 amid laughter and cheerful chatter.
location: Room 305, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep tidying and relaxation meditation
description: After quitting the game, Yin Hao did not rest right away. He opened the memo app on his phone and recorded two key points: the “winter fishing precise float-tuning mnemonic” that Brother Wu had taught him today, and the thought he had had while drawing the renovation plans — “the balcony needs a floor drain to drain water.” Then he put on his earphones, played a soothing instrumental piece, leaned against the headboard, and did five minutes of deep-breathing meditation. At 23:15, he turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Room 305, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waking up, weighing in, and indoor core training
description: The alarm went off, and Yin Hao got up on time. The scale showed 70.8kg. It was drizzling outside the window, so he decisively gave up the morning run and completed 15 minutes of core training on the yoga mat in the bedroom (plank, crunches, and lying leg raises) to maintain his fitness. After stretching, he took a hot shower to refresh himself.
location: Room 403, Unit 2, Building 24, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and getting ready for the driving commute.
description: He heated the fresh milk bought last night, paired it with two slices of whole wheat bread and a boiled egg, and quickly finished breakfast. To cope with the rainy road conditions, he decided to drive to work, checked his car keys, umbrella, and work badge, set the navigation on his phone to the company address, and left early.
location: Room 403, Unit 2, Building 24, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute (by car)
description: At 07:40, he went downstairs to get the car, turned on the windshield wipers and defogger, and drove out of the community skillfully. He drove along Xingang Road and Songhui West Road, then turned onto Huatianjing Highway, driving steadily through the morning rush-hour traffic, and arrived at the company on time at 08:00.
location: From the underground garage of Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-start inspection and morning meeting
description: After changing into work clothes and donning his safety helmet, Yin Hao first checked the coolant level and tool magazine of the five-axis machining center he was responsible for, confirming that everything was normal. Then team leader Wang Lei gathered everyone for a morning meeting, stressing that a batch of precision valve body parts needed to be rushed, with machining accuracy required to reach 0.01 mm, so they had to be extremely focused. After the meeting, he briefly exchanged notes with Master Sun on today's key process points.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Workshop work (focused machining)
description: Yin Hao was fully focused on operating the machine tool. He imported the program sent by the programmer Liu Zhiqiang into the system, checked the workpiece clamping and tool condition, and then began machining the first valve body. When it came to the finishing stage, he deliberately called up the multi-axis simultaneous high-speed cutting program to build up feel for the finals of the skills competition. He repeatedly fine-tuned the feed rate and spindle speed, and carefully recorded the surface finish corresponding to each set of parameters.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Canteen lunch and final exam preparation discussion
description: In the cafeteria, the three sat together with their trays. Wang Lei gave advice while eating: In the final, with that multi-axis linkage, you need to practice switching between different tool paths until it becomes instinct—don't just watch the demo. Soon after, my father sent several long voice messages. I sat up straight, put on earphones, and listened to each one carefully: he first said the list was well done, then gave specific advice—the wires must be national-standard copper-core wire, and the ground wire should be 1.5 mm²; for pipes, he recommended a certain brand of green antibacterial pipe, which wouldn't cost much more but would be more reassuring; he also told me to buy materials only at regular building materials markets and to check several stores to compare prices. As I listened, I quickly made notes beside the list, and finally typed back: 'Dad, I've noted it down. I'll go to the markets this weekend to have a look.'

At exactly 21:10, I reached out and turned off the desk lamp, forced myself not to think about anything else, concentrated on my breathing, and soon fell asleep.

Around 11 o'clock, I caught an abnormal cutting sound, immediately paused the program, and based on experience judged it to be cutting vibration. Opening the protective door, I found that the shim under the workpiece clamping plate had shifted slightly. I decisively adjusted the clamping plate position and tightening torque; after restarting the program, the vibration disappeared. The subsequent semi-finishing and finishing passed smoothly. Finally, I cleaned the part and solemnly submitted it to the judge.
location: Five-axis machining competition venue, third floor, Shanghai Workers' Skills Competition Center, 100 Huadong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

Teacher Zhang pointed out that the feed rate could be reduced by another 10% and recommended a smaller-diameter ball nose end mill. He recorded the key points in his phone memo. Then he exchanged WeChat contacts with Wang Hai from Baosteel and Chen Hua from Shanghai Electric, and was invited into an industry exchange group. He also found Senior Technician Li Guodong and National Technical Expert Teacher Zhao Wei to ask for advice on developing toward digital manufacturing and process design, and received pertinent suggestions.

After the meeting, he first went to the quality inspection office, got the inspection report for yesterday's batch of flanges from inspector Xiao Liu; all 40 pieces passed, and he breathed a sigh of relief. Midway through, chips got wrapped around once; I calmly stopped the machine and cleaned it up with a chip hook. When Liu Zhiqiang passed by, the two of us also discussed a recent programming optimization tip.

name: Lunch and lunch break.

Today the cafeteria had braised pork chops and stir-fried greens, so he got a serving and added a fried egg. He sat at the same table as Master Sun and Wang Lei and chatted while eating. Wang Lei complained that his son's grades had dropped in the recent midterm exams, and Master Sun shared an amusing story about repairing machine tools in his youth. After finishing his meal, he returned to the recliner in the workshop break area, put on an eye mask, and dozed for twenty minutes. When he woke up from his noon break, he pulled out his phone. First he opened Taobao to check the shipping status for Double 12; the paint he bought the day before yesterday was still in transit and was expected to arrive tomorrow. Then he opened WeChat and replied to his girlfriend Lin Yue. She said she would be moving over this Sunday and was packing her luggage. He told her not to leave anything behind and said he would pick her up. Then he scrolled through the running group chat for a while. Chen Jie had posted a photo of his fitness trainer certificate, and everyone started teasing him again.

name: Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province - home and the pharmacy of the County People's Hospital

At around 3 p.m., I finished the rough turning of all the workpieces and switched to a finishing tool for the final machining. At 16:20, the last part was finished. I measured each workpiece one by one and confirmed that all were up to standard, then carefully cleaned the iron chips and oil stains from the machine and applied lubricating oil to the guideways. I signed the work order to confirm completion and briefly handed over the machine's operating status that day to the evening-shift colleague. Then I changed out of my work clothes, picked up my car keys and phone, and walked out of the workshop.

When the rice was almost done, he put a pot of water on to boil, blanched the garlic sprouts, drained them, and drizzled with steamed fish soy sauce and hot oil. Next he put the yellow croaker into a steamer and steamed it over high heat for 8 minutes. After taking it out, he poured off the water on the plate, laid scallion and ginger strips on top, and poured sizzling hot oil over it — it crackled and the aroma came out. Finally, he quickly stir-fried a tomato and egg dish.

I focused on finishing the meal and soaked the dishes and chopsticks in the sink. Then I leaned back on the sofa and rested for about ten minutes, sent a WeChat message to my older brother Yin Tao in Suzhou, asking if he would return to our hometown in Rudong on the weekend. He replied that he had to work overtime this weekend and wouldn't come back. After resting, I got up, changed into running shorts, a long-sleeve compression top, and a windbreaker, and checked the laces of my running shoes. I put my phone, keys, and some change into an arm pouch, and also brought an extra pair of thermal gloves. Then I went downstairs, drove, and navigated to Songjiang Sports Center.
location: From Room 603, No. 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Songjiang Sports Center, No. 145 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Running group 10K training and coaching newcomers.
description: Parked the car in the sports center parking lot and walked to the familiar track meeting point. Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang had already arrived and were stretching. Chen Jie also came, and next to him stood Zhang Wei, a runner who had recently joined. I walked over to greet them, patted Chen Jie on the shoulder and said, "I heard you passed the certification, awesome!" Everyone chatted briefly, then started the warm-up: high knees, jumping jacks, and joint circles. I noticed the temperature was low today, so I specifically reminded everyone to thoroughly warm up their ankles and wrists. The training run officially started. I led the group and kept the pace steady at around 5:40. I ran at the front, deliberately controlling my cadence and breathing rhythm so the people behind me could follow. After three kilometers, the group's rhythm got a little messy, so I slowed down, ran over to Chen Jie and Zhang Wei, and gave them pointers: "Chen Jie, your cadence is dropping a bit, keep it at 180! Zhang Wei, don't let your arms swing sideways; push them forward, imagine your hands cutting through the air!" As I ran, I used my own rhythm to help Zhang Wei correct his form. Throughout the whole run, I kept an eye on the team's condition, especially the technique of the two newcomers. The 10 km run finished in exactly one hour. Everyone was breathing heavily, but in good spirits. I led the group through a full set of stretches, focusing on calves and quads. While stretching, Chen Jie said his cadence felt much steadier today, and Zhang Wei also said that after correcting his arm swing, it felt more efficient. I nodded and reminded everyone: "It's cold now, go change your clothes as soon as you get back, don't catch a cold. You should still wear gloves; poor peripheral circulation can easily lead to frostbite."
location: Track and Field at Songjiang Sports Center, No. 145 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home and learn about waterproof coatings
description: After saying goodbye to my running buddies, I drove home. On the way, the warm air from the engine slowly dried the sweat on my body. Back home, I took a quick rinse with warm water and changed into dry loungewear. Sitting down at my desk, I opened my iPad and tapped the Bilibili video I had cached during the day, and began seriously studying a tutorial on how to avoid pitfalls when applying waterproof coatings. As I watched, I noted key points in my notebook: fillet arcs at inside corners, a reinforcement layer at pipe roots, and the cross-coating method. At critical moments, I paused the video and used a pencil to sketch a cross-section of a bathroom pipe root on scratch paper, marking the coating height and layers. Before I knew it, I had been studying until 22:40.
location: Room 603, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Contacting his girlfriend before bed and going to sleep

Lin Yue sounded a bit excited and said she was bringing a lot of things. I smiled and reassured her, telling her not to worry. After hanging up, I checked tomorrow morning's alarm to make sure it was set. Then I turned off the living room light, and before getting into bed, I stretched the back of my thighs repeatedly, which were a bit sore. I turned off the light and lay down, my mind still on the painting diagram I had just drawn and the plan to pick up Lin Yue on Sunday. I turned over, adjusted my sleeping position, and slowly closed my eyes. Although I fell asleep 40 minutes later than planned, I felt that today was fulfilling—leading the team, working, and studying, none were neglected. With that sense of contentment, my breathing gradually steadied.

description: After arriving home, he changed into loungewear, thawed the fish, washed rice and cooked it, washed vegetables, and cut tomatoes. He steamed the yellow croaker with shredded scallion and ginger for 8 minutes, and also made tomato egg drop soup. The meal was served at 18:00. While eating dinner, he used his phone to cache wall construction videos on Bilibili for future renovation learning. After the meal, he washed the dishes and chopsticks, wiped the stove, brewed a cup of tea to rest, replied to WeChat messages from his parents and girlfriend, and shared photos of dinner.
location: Kitchen and living room, Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Double 12 flash-sale preparation and execution.
description: After dinner, I watched TV news for a while, but my mind was on my phone. I took out my notebook and repeatedly checked the items in my shopping cart and the coupon rules. At 19:45 I turned off the TV, connected to the Wi-Fi with the best signal, and brightened the screen to get ready for the flash sale. At 20:00 I opened Taobao and JD.com on time, selected 2 buckets of Nippon Paint Odorless 120 latex paint, Davco flexible waterproof coating, a paint applicator kit, and floor protective film. After confirming the address was correct, I used the category coupon for 300 yuan off purchases over 2,000 yuan, successfully paid 2,270 yuan, saving nearly 300 yuan compared with the original price. I felt very pleased.
location: Living room, Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Discussed renovation details with his father via video call
description: I immediately sent the payment success screenshot to my father. After my father replied with a voice message, I made a video call directly. My father carefully looked at the order details, reminded me to verify the anti-counterfeiting code after delivery, and especially taught me precautions for waterproofing in winter, such as the ground must not have standing water and the coating should be applied in a crosshatch pattern. The chat lasted nearly half an hour.
location: Living room, Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Free time and designing the living room layout.
description: After hanging up the video call, he replied to messages in the running group and to Wang Lei's inquiry, and did a few stretching moves on the sofa to relieve fatigue. Excited by the successful purchase and imagining the new home, he sat down at the desk, opened his laptop, and used online home decoration design software to draw a furniture layout for the living room. He imagined the sofa against the wall, dining table by the window, added his favorite sideboard model, and felt full of anticipation.
location: Living room and desk at Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Nighttime: staying calm, reading, and falling asleep
description: Realizing it was past 10 p.m., he reminded himself that even though tomorrow was a day off, he should not stay up late, and he still had to pick up his girlfriend on Sunday. He quickly turned off the computer, tidied the desk, washed up, and soaked his feet to calm down. Lying in bed still somewhat excited, he picked up CNC Machining Technology and flipped through it, trying to lull himself to sleep with theory. When drowsiness gradually set in, he turned off the light and forced his eyes closed. It took about half an hour before he fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wake up and weigh in
description: The alarm clock rang on time. Yin Hao sat straight up, habitually stepped onto the electronic scale, which showed 70.2 kg. He muttered to himself that last night's insomnia had made him half a jin heavier than yesterday, probably due to water retention.
location: Bedroom, Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Core strength training
description: Spread out the yoga mat in the living room and started my unshakable morning exercise routine. Instead of running today, I did core training, including three sets each of planks, crunches, and glute bridges, 15 reps per set. Finally, I used a foam roller to relax my lower back and the backs of my thighs. After breaking a sweat, I felt completely clear-headed.
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Breakfast and presentation equipment preparation
description: After showering, I felt refreshed. I heated milk in the microwave, made oatmeal, and boiled two eggs. While eating breakfast, I went over the presentation flow one last time in my head, from serving in the military to learning CNC machining to mentoring apprentices. I checked my briefcase to make sure my ID card, driver's license, volunteer certificate, and USB drive were all there, hung up the dark blue jacket, and took out the windbreaker I would need for the afternoon bike ride in advance.
location: Kitchen/dining room, Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive to the presentation venue
description: Folding the thermal inner layer and windproof jacket for cycling and stuffing them into a sports backpack placed on the passenger seat, he drove out of the residential complex, turned from Xingang Road onto Kungang Highway and then onto Wenxiang Road. There were not many cars on the road, and sunlight streamed through the car window. In a good mood, he arrived at the Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions ahead of time.
location: En route from Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions, No. 6001 Wenxiang Road

name: Arriving at the venue and final preparations
description: Parked the car in the ground parking lot of the Federation of Trade Unions, found the meeting room 45 minutes early, confirmed with the staff that the PPT computer and projector were working, plugged in the USB drive to copy the files to the desktop, then sat down in a corner seat, closed his eyes, and took deep breaths to calm himself.
location: Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions Meeting Hall, No. 6001 Wenxiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Craftsmanship Spirit Lecture
description: Took the stage on time, speaking from military discipline to machine tool precision, to the frustration of failing to debug equipment on his first independent attempt, and then to the sense of achievement when watching the finished flange on the drawing come out of the machine. The audience was very quiet, and he could feel their eyes on him. When he said that a craft is the bowl you eat from, the audience spontaneously applauded twice. Afterward, the leader of the trade union came on stage to present the 2025 Outstanding Volunteer Service Certificate, which he accepted with a solemn handshake.
location: Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions Meeting Hall, No. 6001 Wenxiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Presentation Summary Exchange Meeting
description: The trade union organized a brief exchange meeting. I had a very congenial conversation with Zhao Jianguo, senior technician at the shipyard, and Qian Wei, senior technician in precision machining. We shared processing difficulties and solutions, especially discussing new methods for thin-wall part deformation, which broadened our horizons. In the end, we added each other on WeChat and agreed to communicate more online in the future.
location: Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions Meeting Hall, No. 6001 Wenxiang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive to the lunch spot and take a rest.
description: After the exchange meeting ended, he moved the sports backpack from the trunk to the back seat, then drove to Zhaocai Guanguan Wonton and Chicken Soup Rice (Shanghai Store 2). The drive took about 15 minutes. He took a short rest on the way, preparing to enjoy lunch.
location: On the way from the Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions to Zhaocai Guanguan Wonton and Chicken Soup Rice (Shanghai Branch 2).

name: Enjoying lunch
description: Parked, went into the shop, and ordered the signature chicken soup wontons and a roujiamo. The hot soup warmed him up and made him feel great. While eating, he opened the map app on his phone to plan the afternoon cycling route, deciding to turn onto Songhui West Road near the shop, ride south all the way to the Songpu Bridge area on the Huangpu River, and then return along the riverside greenway. The distance and scenery were both suitable.
location: Fortune Pot Wonton Chicken Soup Rice (Shanghai Branch 2), Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home to change into cycling gear.
description: After dinner, drove home. Once home, changed into the pre-prepared thermal cycling base layer and fleece cycling jersey, put on the windproof jacket, helmet, and gloves, then went downstairs to the community bike shed and carefully checked the road bike's tire pressure, chain, and brakes, confirming everything was OK.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the bicycle shed

name: Long-distance cycling
description: In the afternoon, the sun was just right and the temperature was about 8°C. Starting from Xingang Community, I rode south along Songhui West Road; traffic was light and the road was smooth. When I reached Songpu Bridge, I got off and walked the bike up the bridge. At the midpoint of the bridge, I stopped to look at the wide Huangpu River and the distant boats, and felt especially open and free. After crossing the bridge, I rode slowly along the riverside greenway of the Huangpu River. Against the river wind, all the pressure melted away. On the way, I took out my phone and snapped a few photos of the river view under the warm winter sun as keepsakes. Around 4:20 p.m. I started back the same way and arrived home at exactly 5:00, covering about 35–40 km in total.
location: Starting from Xingang Residential Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai, follow Songhui West Road to the Huangpu River waterfront greenway at Songpu Bridge, then return to Xingang Residential Community along the same route.

name: Recovery and washing up after exercise
description: After getting home, his legs and buttocks felt a bit sore. He took off his gear and first used a foam roller on his thighs and calves to relieve fatigue, then took a hot shower, changed into comfortable loungewear, poured a glass of warm honey water in the kitchen and drank it in one gulp, feeling as if his cells had come back to life.
location: Living room/bathroom, Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: Cycling burned a lot of energy, so I decided to make myself something hearty. I took out tomatoes, eggs, and flour from the fridge, made my signature tomato-egg dough drop soup, and sliced some braised beef. After eating the hot meal, I broke into a light sweat and felt warm inside and completely comfortable.
location: Kitchen, Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Check the logistics of renovation materials purchased online.
description: Sat on the sofa, opened my phone, and checked the Taobao and JD order pages one by one. The four orders for latex paint, waterproof coating, tools, and protective film all showed different couriers had picked up the packages, with expected arrival on December 15. Opened the phone memo and carefully noted down the four tracking numbers and expected delivery times for easy verification upon receipt.
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Organize documents for picking up the keys tomorrow.
description: Took a kraft paper document envelope out of the bedroom drawer, sorted the ID card, house purchase contract, bank loan disbursement certificate, down payment invoice and other documents in order, put them in, and carefully checked them again to make sure everything was correct. Then he opened the phone notes app, entered the phone number of the agent Brother Zhang and the address of Songjiang District Real Estate Trading Center, and set it as the navigation destination for early tomorrow morning.
location: Study/Bedroom, Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with parents
description: He made a video call to his hometown. As soon as his mother, Wang Xiuying, answered, she asked with a smile how the lecture went. Yin Hao briefly reported the situation and showed them the certificate he had just received. His father, Yin Jianguo, took over the conversation and reminded him that when picking up the keys tomorrow, he must double-check the floor area and the electricity meter reading. He also specifically warned that because the temperature is low in winter, attention should be paid to the temperature when applying waterproof coating, and it should be done at a warm noon. Yin Hao nodded in agreement again and again, and they talked for more than half an hour before hanging up.
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Confirm tomorrow's pickup plan
description: Made a voice call to his girlfriend Lin Yue. She said she would arrive at Shanghai Hongqiao Station at 15:30 tomorrow afternoon and also sent a screenshot of the train number. Yin Hao promised to check the metro route in advance and leave home at 2 p.m., so there would definitely be enough time. The two chatted about this and that and agreed to meet tomorrow.
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Personal relaxation and preparation for the next day's shift.
description: After hanging up, I opened my phone's photo album and looked through the river-view photos I took during today's ride. I picked one and posted it on Moments with the caption: This year's last ride, a perfect finish. Then I used the foam roller to briefly roll my thighs, thinking that I had to pick up the key and pick up Lin Yue tomorrow, so I had to stay in good shape today.
location: Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Brushed teeth, washed face, soaked feet in hot water. Lying in bed, went through tomorrow's to-do list in my head: picking up the person at the station, getting the keys, and all materials were ready—nothing was missed.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Turned off the lights and went to bed
description: Turning off the bedside lamp, he felt excited at the thought of Lin Yue arriving at the station the next day, and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 402, Building 15, Xingang Residential Community, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up, morning run, and breakfast
description: At 7 a.m., the phone alarm went off on time. Yin Hao got up immediately, stood barefoot on the electronic scale, and his weight read 70.3 kg. He glanced out the window — cloudy, with a temperature forecast of 4–12°C — then took out a fleece-lined dark blue tracksuit from the wardrobe. After warming up for 5 minutes, he jogged along Xingang Road to the rubber track at Xiaokunshan Health Park, easily completing 5 km at a 6:15 pace with a steady heart rate. He then cooled down in the park's stretching area. Back home, he took a warm shower, changed into loungewear, and had breakfast: two slices of whole wheat toast, one boiled egg, and a warm glass of milk. Meanwhile, he saw Wang Lei in the running group chat asking whether he wanted to do half-marathon training together next week, and replied that it was no problem.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Urged his mother via video to get a follow-up check and learn housework
description: At 8:20, Yin Hao sat on the sofa and made a video call to his mother Wang Xiuying, asking about his father's condition and his mother's own blood pressure. His mother said she felt fine, but he insisted that she go to the community hospital today to have her blood pressure measured, and she agreed. After hanging up, he quickly wiped the table, swept the floor, and tidied the room. He then opened the logistics app and checked one by one the four renovation material orders he had tracked yesterday, confirming that all had been sent out from the sorting center and were expected to arrive at the Songjiang sorting center tomorrow. He took screenshots and saved them. Next, he sat in front of the computer, opened Bilibili, and studied a tutorial on bathroom waterproof coating, taking notes while watching. In the middle, he also got up to look at his phone, waiting for the bank's loan disbursement text message.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Received the loan disbursement notice and shared the joy.
description: At 10:30, his phone received a bank text confirming the disbursement of his personal housing loan. Yin Hao took a deep breath, confirmed the amount was correct, and immediately called Manager Li, the real estate agent. In a steady voice, he agreed to meet at the entrance of the real estate transaction center at 9:00 the next morning to pick up the keys. After hanging up, he clenched his fist and excitedly whispered, "Done!" He then sent a WeChat message to share the news with his brother Yin Tao in Suzhou, who instantly replied with a thumbs-up. He considered calling his mother but, thinking she might be on her way to the hospital, decided to wait until she sent her results.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Simple lunch and browsing information
description: At 11 o'clock, Yin Hao took eggs, dried noodles, and greens from the fridge and quickly cooked a bowl of clear soup egg noodles. At 12 o'clock he sat down to eat the noodles while browsing local news and next week's weather forecast on his phone. He noticed it would start getting colder on Tuesday and reminded himself to remember to close the new house's windows after picking up the keys tomorrow. After eating, he washed the dishes and chopsticks himself.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and preparations before departure
description: At 12:40, Yin Hao set an alarm for 13:15, put on an eye mask, and took a light nap. When the alarm rang, he got up, washed his face with cold water, changed into a gray hoodie and black cargo pants, grabbed his car keys and phone, and went downstairs. In the parking lot, he walked around his white Volkswagen Gran Lavida to check the tires and exterior, opened the hood to check the dipstick, and confirmed that more than half a tank of gas was enough for the round trip to Hongqiao Airport. Then he got ready to leave.
location: Xingang Community Parking Lot, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to Hongqiao Station.
description: At 13:40, Yin Hao set off by car, taking Xingang Road - Huatianjing Highway - Husong Highway - Jiamin Elevated Road to Hongqiao Hub. The roads were clear all the way, and he played a folk music playlist. He changed to the rightmost lane early on the Jiamin Elevated Road and saw the Hongqiao Station sign in less than 45 minutes, preparing to enter the parking lot.
location: Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station, 1500 Shengui Road, Minhang District, Shanghai

name: Pick up girlfriend Lin Yue at Hongqiao Station and return to Songjiang
description: At 14:25, Yin Hao parked the car in the P9 parking lot at Hongqiao Station and took a photo, then walked to the south exit of the arrival level, by which time Train G7312 had already arrived. Soon he spotted Lin Yue pulling a suitcase in the crowd. He smiled, walked over, and took her luggage, saying, 'You must have had a tiring journey.' Lin Yue replied happily, 'Good news is more refreshing than anything.' The two retrieved the car and headed back around 15:40, returning to Songjiang via the Jiamin Elevated Road-Husong Highway. On the way, Yin Hao explained in detail the loan disbursement and the key-pickup process for tomorrow. Lin Yue was also happy that he was about to take possession of his house and said that as soon as her project ended next week, she would start looking at soft furnishing plans. They arrived at Xingang Community at 16:20.
location: Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station, 1500 Shengui Road, Minhang District, Shanghai

name: Take girlfriend to visit and test renovation tools
description: After getting home, Yin Hao showed Lin Yue around his tidy rental apartment. He specially went to the balcony, pointed at the newly bought decoration materials and tools, and said they were the "reserve team" for the new house. He picked up a scraper and a sandpaper holder and gestured at the wall coating he would scrape off later. Lin Yue also gave some suggestions on flooring and lighting. Then he let Lin Yue rest, put on gloves, and practiced scraping old putty in the balcony corner with a scraper. Because he used too much force, a blister formed on the webbing between his thumb and index finger. He disinfected it with alcohol and put on a band-aid. Afterward, he sorted all the tools into storage boxes, then checked the ID card, purchase contract, and other materials to bring the next day from the document folder, and took photos for backup. Watching from the side, Lin Yue thought he was really efficient.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Sharing good news in the family group and checking on mother's health.
description: At 18:00 Yin Hao opened the family WeChat group and posted: Mom, Dad, Brother, official report! The loan was disbursed at noon today, and I'll pick up the keys to the new house tomorrow morning! He attached a screenshot of the disbursement text. His father quickly replied with a voice message telling him to carefully check the water, electricity, doors, and windows and survey the place first after getting the keys. His brother replied with a thumbs-up. Then he separately video-called his mother, saw her check-up report showing blood pressure 128/82, confirmed the values were normal, told her to take her medicine on time, and said he would buy and mail her the medicine next month. His mother told him not to worry.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner out with girlfriend
description: After confirming everything was in order, Yin Hao and Lin Yue decided to eat at the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road next to the residential complex, a two-minute walk away. They ordered Sichuan boiled fish, dry-pot cauliflower, and two bowls of rice, and chatted casually as they ate. Lin Yue asked about the injury on his hand. Yin Hao waved his hand and said it was no big deal; getting the keys tomorrow was what really mattered.
location: Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, 232 Xingang Road, Dagang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Leisure at home and discussion about soft furnishings
description: After dinner, they strolled home. Yin Hao connected his phone to a Bluetooth speaker and played old songs. The two sat side by side on the sofa and watched some variety shows for a while. Lin Yue took out her phone and shared photos of Nordic-style lamps and sofas. Yin Hao also opened Taobao to show the renovation tools he had saved. They chatted animatedly about the soft furnishing plan for their new home.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Accompanying girlfriend to the subway station
description: At 20:45, Yin Hao put on his jacket and walked Lin Yue to the nearby Songjiang University Town Metro Station. They briefly said goodbye at the station entrance and agreed to contact each other tomorrow afternoon. Only after watching Lin Yue swipe her card and enter the station did he turn and go home.
location: Songjiang University Town Metro Station, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After returning home and washing up, Yin Hao placed the folder with all the materials for picking up the keys tomorrow in the most prominent place on the shoe cabinet, and put his phone, car key, and power bank together. He glanced at the gauze on his right hand and planned to go to Shihudang Fishing Tackle Shop tomorrow to buy a thicker pair of gloves. At 21:45, lying in bed, he reviewed the day: his mother's health was confirmed, the loan disbursement and key pickup were a done deal, his girlfriend had been brought over smoothly, and the first step in preparing the new home was taken. Though his hand was a little sore, he felt solid and full of energy inside, and after turning off the light, he soon fell asleep.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waking up, washing up, weighing in, and applying skincare
description: Woke up naturally at 6 am as usual, washed my face with cold water to refresh, and stepped on the scale: 70.5 kg, the same as the previous two days. Since the blisters from scraping putty yesterday had not healed, I applied aloe vera gel and changed the Band-Aid, reminding myself to wear gloves at work today.
location: Room 303, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Recovery jog around the neighborhood.
description: Changed into running shoes and quick-dry clothing, did a 5 km recovery jog along the riverside trail next to Xiaokunshan Health Park at a pace of about 6:30/km, temperature 3°C. After the run, did stretching and push-ups by the river to maintain fitness.
location: Riverside trail of Xiaokunshan Health Park, near Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast, document check, and reminding mother to take medication
description: After the morning run, I took a quick shower and had whole-wheat bread, hot milk, and boiled eggs for breakfast. While eating, I checked the document folder for the key handover and confirmed that my ID, purchase contract, and bank loan disbursement voucher were all there. Then I called my mother, Wang Xiuying, to remind her to take her blood pressure medication on time. Finally, I placed the folder in a conspicuous spot by the door so it wouldn't be forgotten.
location: Room 303, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the factory.
date: At 19:30 on the evening of December 4, 2025, Yin Hao continued his 10 km running training with Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, and Chen Jie at Songjiang Sports Center. Considering there was an important competition the next day, Yin Hao lowered his pace to 5 minutes 45 seconds per kilometer and focused more on breathing rhythm training. After the run, he also specifically reminded everyone of the key points for keeping warm when running in winter, and shared the warm ginger tea he had brought.
description: Changed into work clothes, took his thermos cup, and drove from Xingang Community to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory via Huatianjing Road. The traffic was smooth all the way, and he arrived in about 20 minutes, just in time for the morning meeting.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning workshop production tasks
description: After attending the morning meeting, I was responsible for machining a batch of urgent export flanges. While operating the machine tool, I noticed surface finish defects on the workpiece, proactively checked and adjusted the tool and cutting fluid concentration, and restored normal operation. Master Sun Jianguo passed by and gave guidance, recommending new blades on the market. Being focused on work made the time pass quickly.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Canteen lunch and leave request
description: He ate lunch at the factory canteen, getting a braised pork chop and stir-fried greens. After eating quickly, he found team leader Wang Lei to sign the leave request form. Wang Lei readily approved and congratulated him on soon getting the keys to his new house.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home to collect the Double 12 express deliveries.
description: Leaving the factory, he drove back to Xingang Community. At the entrance, a Double 12 online shopping delivery was already piled up: Nippon Paint latex paint, Davco waterproof coating, painting tools, and protective film. He opened the boxes, confirmed the packaging was intact, verified the anti-counterfeiting codes to ensure authenticity, signed for the delivery, and moved the materials into the living room for the time being.
location: Room 303, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Packing up belongings in preparation to go pick up the keys
description: Changed into a clean casual jacket, checked the document folder again, put the keys into his trouser pocket, and took a canvas bag to hold the key-receiving documents and the property management manual. Adjusted his mindset and prepared to head to the real estate transaction center.
location: Room 303, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go to the property transaction center to pick up the keys to the new house
description: Drove to the Songjiang District Real Estate Transaction Center and met up with the agent, Manager Li. With his help, he completed the final procedures using the purchase contract, ID card, and bank loan disbursement voucher, received the keys and access card for the new house, and signed the handover documents. He was excited when he got the keys.
location: Shanghai Songjiang District Real Estate Transaction Center, No. 1788 Wencheng Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Completed property management registration for the new house.
description: After leaving the transaction center, he drove alone to Lvbo Jingyuan, checked in at the property management office, verified the owner's information, and received the access card and utility card. The staff explained the precautions.
location: Property Management Office of Lübo Jingyuan, Lane 1999, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: View the new house and share it with the family via video call
description: He used the key to open Room 303, Building 15, Lübo Jingyuan. Standing in the living room of the unfinished house, he checked the water supply and drainage pipes in the kitchen and bathroom, the distribution box, and the sockets, confirming no leaks. He then video-called his mother Wang Xiuying, showed her every room, and she was moved to tears. He sent the original-state photos to the family group. His father Yin Jianguo said he would help draw the water and electricity diagrams, and his older brother Yin Tao sent red envelopes to celebrate.
location: Room 303, Building 15, Lübo Jingyuan, Lane 1999, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Purchasing renovation tools at the building materials market.
description: After planning, he drove to the Songjiang New City Building Materials and Home Furnishing Market and bought a scraper, sandpaper holder, mixing bucket, brush, roller, protective film, and a bucket of Davco Leak Repair King. He also rented an industrial vacuum cleaner to clean the walls over the weekend. The boss threw in two extra pairs of gloves.
location: Songjiang New City Building Materials and Home Furnishings Market, No. 1100 Ronghui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Transporting renovation materials back and forth
description: From the rental apartment in Xingang Community, he moved the latex paint, waterproof coating, and tools to the new home in Lübo Jingyuan in two trips. The first trip carried the latex paint and tools, and the second trip carried the remaining materials. All of them were neatly stacked in the living room of the new home and covered with protective film. After the move, he took photos for the record and felt full of energy looking at the materials in the new home.
location: Room 303, Building 15, Lübo Jingyuan, Lane 1999, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returned to the rented apartment for a quick rest
description: After closing the new house's windows and doors, drove back to the rental apartment, washed face and hands with soap, changed into clean loungewear, and prepared dinner.
location: Room 303, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner
description: He made himself a bowl of vegetable and egg noodles, poached two eggs in it, and paired it with last night's takeout Sichuan food. It was a simple but satisfying meal.
location: Room 303, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video chat with girlfriend Lin Yue
description: After clearing the dishes, his girlfriend Lin Yue called via video. He shared the key handover process, photos of the new apartment, and the status of moving materials. Lin Yue reminded him to take care of the blisters on his hands. They discussed the soft furnishing plan, agreed to go to IKEA on the weekend after New Year's Day to choose a sofa and bed, and confirmed his leave dates for Spring Festival so they could return to Nantong together.
location: Room 303, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Record milestones and plan tomorrow's start.
description: After hanging up the video call, he opened the calendar app on his phone and entered Lin Yue's compensatory rest day, the IKEA shopping weekend, and the date for returning to Nantong for Spring Festival (January 27, 2026), setting reminders for each. He also looked through photos of the new apartment and briefly planned in his memo the steps for scraping the wall coating and applying protective covering tomorrow evening.
location: Room 303, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Relaxed by playing online games with comrades
description: In the WeChat group, he invited his comrades-in-arms Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng to play ranked matches in Honor of Kings together; they won two out of three games. During the game, they talked about Zhou Xiaofeng being discharged from the army next month and agreed to pick him up at the train station. After the game, he also browsed a renovation forum for a while, reading posts about wall treatment.
location: Room 303, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and checking equipment before bed.
description: He soaked his sore, swollen arm in hot water, put a new band-aid on the blister on his right hand, and applied aloe vera gel. Then he checked the work clothes and tools for tomorrow's shift to make sure everything was ready.
