location: Room 303, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Turned off the lights and went to bed
description: Turned off the lights and went to bed at 22:00 sharp. In the dark, touched the new house key on the bedside table and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Room 303, Building 15, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning core training and weighing.
description: Yin Hao woke up exactly at 06:15 and did not stay in bed. He spread a yoga mat on the living room floor and did a 15-minute morning core activation workout, including 3 sets of planks (75 seconds each), 3 sets of side planks on each side, and supine alternating leg raises. After the workout, his muscles were slightly sore. He used an electronic scale to weigh himself on an empty stomach: 70.2 kg. Then he took a multivitamin tablet from the pillbox on the bedside table.
location: Room XXX, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and pre-commute preparation
description: Yin Hao took a warm shower to wash away the sleepiness, then prepared a simple breakfast: two slices of whole wheat toast with a fried egg and a glass of hot milk. While eating, he checked JD Logistics on his phone, which showed "Expected delivery today". He checked and took the lunch box he had prepared the night before, making sure it was tightly sealed. Finally, he put his work jacket, keys, phone, and wallet into his commuter bag and left for work.
location: Room XXX, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commuting by car to the factory
description: Yin Hao went downstairs to the parking space, started the car, habitually turned on traffic radio to listen to morning rush-hour traffic reports and music, drove along Huatianjing Road for about 20 minutes, and arrived at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory at No. 360 Huatianjing Road.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning meeting and work preparation
description: Yin Hao changed into his work clothes and clocked in. Team leader Wang Lei held a morning meeting with today's production schedule, emphasizing the precision requirements for flange machining. After the meeting, Yin Hao returned to his workstation, carefully checked the cutting fluid and lubricating oil on the equipment, and reviewed yesterday's quality inspection records to prepare for efficient work.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Focused on flange machining
description: Yin Hao devoted himself fully to the flange machining work. He clamped the workpiece, entered the program, and started the machine, watching intently as the cutting tool precisely machined the metal. To complete the main machining workload before 3 p.m. so he could leave early, he was especially focused. Midway, his mentor Sun Jianguo passed by, inspected the sample, and praised him with "Quite steady."
location: Workshop work station at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At lunchtime, after heating up the homemade lunch he had brought, Yin Hao carried his lunchbox to the table where Wang Lei and Master Sun were sitting. Wang Lei brought up picking up the keys yesterday and joked, 'Yin Hao, you've got the house now — aren't you going to treat us guys to a meal?' Yin Hao smiled and agreed, saying that once the hard renovation was finished he would definitely invite everyone to hotpot. During the meal, he also confirmed tonight's run club training time with Wang Lei — gather at 7 PM at Songjiang Sports Center. After lunch, he went back to the workshop rest area and sat with his eyes closed for 20 minutes to relax his eyes and lower back.
location: Canteen and rest area of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wrapping up work and reporting in advance
description: After recovering his energy, Yin Hao continued working. Before 3 p.m., he completed the rough machining and finishing of all the flanges, and in between, he self-inspected and recorded the last few pieces—all passed. He walked to team leader Wang Lei's workstation and said, 'Brother Lei, I've finished my work. I'd like to leave half an hour early to go back and receive a package; tonight I still have to apply waterproofing at the new house.' Wang Lei looked at the records and readily agreed.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Leave work early and return to the rental apartment
description: Yin Hao changed out of his work clothes, drove away from the factory, and returned to his rental apartment. He was in a good mood on the way, feeling that today had been efficient and everything went smoothly.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Signed for renovation auxiliary materials and took a short rest to prepare for running.
description: Shortly after getting home, the JD delivery courier called. Yin Hao went downstairs to the main gate and saw the courier pushing a cart of packages. He checked the order: two buckets of waterproof coating, one bag of latex paint, and a set of free painting tools. He helped carry them upstairs and carefully checked that the buckets had no leaks, the seals were intact, and the number of tools was accurate. After confirming everything was correct, he signed for the delivery. Then he neatly stacked the materials in the corner of the living room, together with the tools he had brought back the day before. After unloading, he sat down and drank a large glass of water, then prepared his running gear for the evening: he changed into dry athletic short sleeves and shorts, and put his running belt, quick-dry headband, phone, and keys into his waist pack. He checked the time and, since there was still time before the 7:00 meet-up, decided to take the newly arrived materials to the new house first.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Transported renovation materials to the new house and checked them into storage.
description: Yin Hao picked out the painting tools he needed for today (roller, paintbrush, stirring stick) and two buckets of waterproof coating, carrying them downstairs in two trips and loading them into the trunk. Then he drove to Lübo Jingyuan Community, Lane 2972, Husong Highway, Songjiang District. After arriving, he moved the materials into the new house's storage room and stacked them neatly. Using a flashlight, he carefully inspected the floor substrate in the kitchen and bathroom, used a putty knife to scrape off the several lumps of cement mortar that had not been scraped clean yesterday, and swept away the loose dust with a broom. He now had a clear idea of which areas would need focused cleaning when he came back in the evening.
location: Lübo Jingyuan, No. 22, Lane 2972, Husong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go to Songjiang Sports Center to warm up and wait for running partners.
description: Starting from the new house, Yin Hao drove to Songjiang Sports Center at 145 Rongle Middle Road. In the car he played upbeat running music to mentally prepare. After arriving and parking, he did dynamic stretching and jogging on the open ground beside the track to fully activate his body. While warming up, he kept checking his watch waiting for Wang Lei and the others; a few minutes later they arrived one after another, and everyone exchanged a few greetings.
location: Track and Field at Songjiang Sports Center, No. 145 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Running group 10km interval training and post-run stretching and exchange
description: Core training began, the content was a 10-kilometer interval run. Yin Hao suggested first jogging 2 kilometers to warm up, then interspersing 4 sets of 800-meter interval runs (pace 5 minutes 10 seconds per kilometer). He felt that the renovation over the past two weeks had drained his energy, so he struggled a bit during the intervals, but he gritted his teeth and persisted, recording each kilometer's pace one by one, and finally achieved an average pace of 5 minutes 38 seconds, completing the goal. After the run, Yin Hao led everyone through systematic post-run stretching. During stretching, they exchanged training experiences, and he shared tips on keeping warm and hydrating for winter running. Wang Lei has rest tomorrow and suggested going to an internet cafe tomorrow evening for a gaming session of Honor of Kings together. Yin Hao smiled and agreed: "Okay, if the waterproofing application goes smoothly tomorrow night, I'll go."
location: Track and Field at Songjiang Sports Center, No. 145 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the new house, cleaned the floor base, and applied the first coat of waterproofing.
description: After saying goodbye to his buddies, Yin Hao wiped off sweat with a towel and drove to the new house. On the way, he bought a bottle of electrolyte drink and a bottle of mineral water at a convenience store. After arriving at the new house in Lübo Jingyuan, he changed into an old T-shirt he was going to throw away as work clothes. Then he got down to business: first he used a scraper to further remove mortar residue from the floor and corners, swept with a broom, then mopped the floor with a wet mop to ensure there was no loose dust. Next, he opened the bucket of waterproof coating and stirred it thoroughly. He first used a brush to carefully coat weak spots such as pipe roots and corners, then used a roller for large-area application, making sure nothing was missed. After finishing, he cleaned up the tools, closed the windows, and waited for the coating to dry naturally.
location: Lübo Jingyuan, No. 22, Lane 2972, Husong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returned to the rental apartment and did pre-bed data recording and body stretching.
description: After locking up the new house, Yin Hao drove back to Xingang Community. He was a little tired on the way but felt at ease, thinking that the renovation had advanced another step. Back at the rental apartment, before getting into bed, he opened the mobile bookkeeping app and carefully entered the day's expenses on waterproofing materials. Then he turned off the overhead light, turned on the bedside lamp, sat cross-legged on the floor, and did a 5-minute meditative stretch, focusing on relaxing his calves and lower back.
location: Room XXX, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Chat with girlfriend on WeChat and go to sleep
description: After lying down, Yin Hao sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend Lin Yue, briefly telling her about picking up the package, his running training, and applying the waterproofing. Lin Yue said they would go to IKEA together after New Year's Day to look at furniture, which made him feel life was more promising. After chatting for a bit, they said goodnight. He set tomorrow's alarm and, in the comfortable room temperature, quickly fell asleep, physically tired but inwardly fulfilled.
location: Room XXX, Building X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning core training and weighing.
description: After the alarm went off, he got up immediately, spread a yoga mat in the living room and did core training: 3 sets of planks, 2 sets of dead bugs, and 2 sets of glute bridges. After training, he took off his clothes and weighed himself; the digital scale showed 70.0 kg, and he recorded his weight in the memo app on his phone. Then he took a warm shower, got dressed, drank warm water on an empty stomach, and took a multivitamin.
location: Room XX, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (rented apartment)

name: Preparing lunch boxes and breakfast.
description: He took the bento box prepared last night (shredded pork with green peppers, stir-fried Shanghai bok choy) out of the fridge and put it into an insulated bag. Then he fried a sunny-side-up egg, toasted whole wheat bread, and warmed milk for breakfast. While eating breakfast, he browsed a renovation forum post about techniques for applying wall putty, and confirmed that the Xianyu seller would deliver the item after 17:00 today.
location: Room XX, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (rented apartment)

name: Biking to work
description: Put on winter cycling clothes, gloves, and knee pads, and unlocked a shared bike by scanning the QR code at the entrance of the residential community. Rode along Guangfulin Road for about 15 minutes, arriving at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, at around 7:35, and parked the bike in the designated area.
location: Along the route from Xingang Road to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-shift preparation and morning meeting.
description: In the changing room, changed into work clothes and safety shoes, then entered the workshop to check equipment operating status. At 8:00, attended the morning meeting. Shift leader Wang Lei assigned the day's production tasks: process the second batch of export flanges, 120 pieces in total, with high precision requirements. Master Sun Jianguo specifically reminded us of key points for several critical dimensions. The meeting was short and efficient.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning: machining flanges.
description: Back at the machine tool he was responsible for, he checked the drawings and process cards, and after confirming the tool compensation data was correct, he started the machine at 8:15. During machining, he kept a close eye on display parameters and periodically measured key dimensions with a vernier caliper. During a break, he chatted with Wang Lei, who joked that "renovating is more important than gaming." By 11:40 he had completed 58 pieces, all dimensions qualified. He then shut down the machine, cleaned the chips, and performed equipment inspections.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Had lunch and chatted with coworkers
description: In the second-floor cafeteria at the factory, he picked up braised pork chops and greens and sat at the same table with Wang Lei, Sun Jianguo, and Liu Zhiqiang. While eating, he reported the morning's machining progress to Master Sun and asked him for ways to stabilize the flange face roughness. Wang Lei, sitting nearby, suggested going fishing in Qingpu over the weekend, but Yin Hao politely declined because he needed to apply putty. After the meal, he went alone to the convenience store to buy water.
location: Canteen on the second floor of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Rest and study during a work break
description: In the workshop rest area, he used the renovation calculator on his phone to estimate the required amount of putty powder based on the wall areas of the living room and master bedroom, took a screenshot and saved it. He then read the precision machining section of “NC Machining Technology” to prepare for the senior technician exam.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Machined flange parts in the afternoon.
description: At 13:00 I returned to the machine promptly and optimized the cutting parameters to improve efficiency while ensuring precision. Staying highly focused, I meticulously completed the remaining 62 flanges; all passed self-inspection and I filled out the work order. At 16:15 I neatly stacked the finished parts on a pallet, cleaned the machine and surrounding floor, and confirmed that the equipment was powered off.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Shift handover and wrap-up
description: Went to the process room to enter today's 120 flange data into the system, and gave a brief handover to the day-shift colleague about the machine status and precautions. Afterward, returned to the locker room, changed back into casual clothes, and packed up personal belongings.
location: Process Room and Changing Room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After work, pick up the package and return to the rented apartment
description: At 17:00, rode a shared bike away from the factory, returned to Xingang Residential Community along Guangfulin Road, and picked up two packages at the parcel locker and the security booth downstairs: a second-hand handheld grinder from a Xianyu seller and a dust-proof protective film purchased on Taobao. After entering the house, placed the packages in the living room, changed into old clothes and work safety shoes for renovation, and took the tool bag and protective film, ready to head to the new apartment.
location: Xingang Community and surrounding areas, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepare the second coat of waterproof coating
description: Walked about 10 minutes to the new apartment in Lübo Jingyuan, checked the first coat of waterproof coating applied to the kitchen and bathroom yesterday, and confirmed it had completely dried with no bubbles or cracks. Mixed the waterproof coating with the curing agent according to the instructions, stirred thoroughly with an electric mixer, and let it sit for 5 minutes to cure.
location: Room XX, Building 22, Lübo Jingyuan, Lane 2972, Husong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (new house)

name: Apply the second coat of waterproof coating.
description: Wearing rubber gloves, he applied the waterproof coating to the kitchen and bathroom floors using vertical brush strokes, forming a cross-pattern waterproof layer with the first horizontal coat. For key areas such as corners, pipe roots under the drains, and edges of floor drains, he carefully brushed with a small brush, leaving no dead corners. After finishing, he cleaned the tools and waited for the coating to dry on the surface.
location: Room XX, Building 22, Lübo Jingyuan, Lane 2972, Husong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (new-house kitchen and bathroom)

name: Watertightness test and video setup.
description: He checked that the waterproof coating was surface-dry and not sticky. After blocking the floor drains with plastic bags, he slowly poured water onto the kitchen and bathroom floors, keeping the depth at 2–3 cm, marked the initial water level line on the wall with a marker, and took photos. Then he set up a phone stand in the living room, connected a power bank, and adjusted the camera to an angle that could capture both walls at the same time, preparing for a video call with his mother.
location: Room XX, Building 22, Lübo Jingyuan, Lane 2972, Husong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (new house)

name: Video-called his mother to show the renovation progress
description: At exactly 20:00, he initiated a WeChat video call with his mother, Wang Xiuying. He pointed the phone camera at the living room and master bedroom walls where the old paint had been scraped off, and as he moved around, he explained the wall-scraping results and his plan to apply putty on the weekend. His mother asked with concern whether he was tired; he said he wasn't, and reminded her to take her blood pressure medication on time. After about ten minutes of small talk, they said goodnight and hung up.
location: Room XX, Building 22, Lübo Jingyuan, Lane 2972, Husong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (living room of the new house)

name: Remove old paint from the wall
description: After hanging up the video call, I put on a dust mask and safety goggles. First, I used a scraper to remove the large areas of loose old paint from the living room wall, used a second-hand sander for stubborn spots, and swept the fallen paint chips into a pile as I scraped. After about an hour, I moved to the master bedroom and used the same method. By 22:10, the old paint layer in both rooms had been largely removed, and the walls showed the bare concrete underneath.
location: Room XX, Building 22, Lübo Jingyuan, Lane 2972, Husong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (new apartment living room and master bedroom)

name: Fine polishing and cleaning.
description: Put on new sandpaper and carefully hand-sanded the internal and external wall corners, the areas around switch and socket boxes, and other places that are difficult for machines to handle. Then, using an industrial vacuum cleaner with a flat nozzle, I thoroughly vacuumed the walls, floors, and windowsills of both rooms, removing all dust and debris. After finishing, I took panoramic photos and sent them to the Brothers United family group.
location: Room XX, Building 22, Lübo Jingyuan, Lane 2972, Husong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (new house)

name: Returned to the rental apartment to organize the accounts
description: Put all tools back in place, checked that the water level in the kitchen and bathroom water-retention test was normal, then turned off the lights, locked the door, and walked back to the rented apartment in Xingang Community. After entering, he wiped his face with a wet towel, opened the expense tracker on his phone, and recorded today’s spending: shared bike 1.5 yuan, Xianyu polishing machine 80 yuan, protective film 15 yuan. Then he updated the renovation progress sheet in his memo, noting that the second waterproofing coat was finished, the water-retention test had begun, and wall scraping in the living room and master bedroom was complete, and planned the subsequent putty application schedule.
location: Room XX, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (rented apartment)

name: Nightly routine and falling asleep
description: Took a hot shower to wash off sweat and dust, then did 5 minutes of leg stretches on the yoga mat in the living room, focusing on relaxing the lower back and legs that were tense from scraping walls and standing work. Drank a large glass of warm water before getting into bed, and briefly browsed putty application videos on a renovation forum. Turned off the bedside lamp at 23:45 and quickly fell asleep, feeling satisfied with the renovation progress and with plans for tomorrow's weigh-in and run.
location: Room XX, Building 1, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (rented apartment)

name: Morning core training and weighing.
description: In the early morning, he laid out the exercise mat on the living room floor and completed 15 minutes of core training: 3 sets of planks (75 seconds each), 4 sets of crunches (20 reps each), and 3 sets of Russian twists (30 reps each). After training, he weighed himself naked and weighed 69.9 kg. Then he took a multivitamin, took out the marinated chicken breast and cold rice from the fridge, and quickly prepared the day's lunch box: low-oil soy sauce fried rice and pan-seared chicken breast.
location: Room 203, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Verify mortgage repayment and set a reminder.
description: At the dining table in the rental apartment, I opened the China Merchants Bank app, switched to the dedicated loan repayment account, and carefully checked the first monthly mortgage payment of 6,237.42 yuan (principal 2,773.15 yuan, interest 3,464.27 yuan). The current account balance was 15,012.58 yuan. After confirming the loan contract number and the loan disbursement information of December 14, 2025, I set a recurring reminder for the 18th of each month as 'Mortgage Deduction Day' in the app's reminder manager, with a note to ensure the account balance is no less than 6,500 yuan. In the remaining time, I quickly checked last month's payslip.
location: Room 203, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute and work preparation
description: Wearing a work jacket and carrying a lunch bag and insulated thermos, he went downstairs, rode the NIU electric bike to the company along Xinche Highway–Huatianjing Road, about 6.8 km in total, taking 20 minutes. After clocking in at 7:40, he entered the workshop and preheated the DMG five-axis vertical machining center he was in charge of (low-speed idle rotation of the spindle for 5 minutes), and checked the tool presetter and tool magazine to ensure everything was ready.
location: Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning work and preparation of review materials
description: Team leader Wang Lei assigned the day's production task: machining a batch of stainless steel valve bodies with precision tolerance within 0.005 mm. During the machine setup break from 9:40 to 10:10, he opened his laptop at the workstation, retrieved the OPC UA data collection logs from the past week (about 4,000 sampling points), and recorded in detail two bottlenecks: sensor packet loss caused by cutting fluid splash interference, and data collection frequency limited by the industrial PC's I/O performance, stable at only 8 Hz, and drafted three optimization suggestions. During the work break, he did 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches in the workshop safety passage to loosen his back.
location: Workshop Station 2, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and meeting details confirmation
description: At 11:30 I went to the staff cafeteria on the first floor for lunch. Today's menu included braised pork chops, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and hot and sour soup. I sat by the window with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang, chatting about year-end bonus payouts and home renovation details. After lunch, I returned to my desk around 12:00 and rested with my head down for 15 minutes. At 12:10 I sent a WeChat message to the tech department assistant to confirm the screen casting test in Conference Room 3 at 2 PM. In the spare time, I quickly browsed the Mid-term Evaluation Manual for Digital Transformation, benchmarked the three suggestions I had organized in the morning against the KPIs in the manual, and marked them to make sure my remarks were well grounded.
location: Employee cafeteria and workshop workstation, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Attended the digital transformation project review meeting
description: The meeting started on time in Conference Room 3 on the third floor of the Administration Building. Technical Department Manager Li Desheng first reviewed the overall progress of Phase I of the project (May to November). Then, during the 15-minute 'Experience Sharing from the Operator Level' session, Yin Hao took out his notebook and pre-printed A4 charts and systematically put forward three suggestions: adjust the sensor installation angle in the cutting area to a 45-degree incline to avoid chip splashing; increase the data collection frequency from 10Hz to 20Hz and demonstrate the feasibility of CPU load redundancy in the main controller; introduce a ring buffer queue to solve the problem of instantaneous backlog and packet loss of high-frequency data. Li Desheng immediately asked the technical assistant to take notes and said he would evaluate the implementation cost of the second suggestion. The meeting ended at 15:35.
location: Meeting Room 3, 3rd Floor, Administration Building, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Discussed next year's technical plan with mentor Sun Jianguo
description: After the review meeting ended, he met his master Sun Jianguo in the workshop corridor near the raw material warehouse door, and brought up the idea of introducing an offline programming system to handle complex curved surface work in order to improve efficiency. Master Sun nodded in approval of the idea, but reminded him to consider software compatibility and the matching of the post-processor with the FANUC system. He asked Yin Hao to first gather information, and they agreed to discuss in detail in the break room at 12:30 noon next Wednesday (December 24), and jointly list a framework to seek project approval from the technical department.
location: Workshop corridor, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (near the raw material warehouse entrance)

name: Complete the day's production tasks and organize the review notes.
description: I took over the afternoon valve body finishing process, completed machining and self-inspection of 28 parts in 3 batches before 17:00, and the sampling data met tolerance requirements. Five minutes before leaving work, I sent the electronic version of the digital project proposal compiled in the morning to the technical department email, and printed a hard copy to insert into the "Senior Technician Certificate Exam Preparation Binder" for reference.
location: Workshop Station 2, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute after work and 10 km training with the running group
description: After clocking off at 17:00, he rode an electric bike along Huatanjing Highway–Guangxing Road–Ledu Road to Songjiang Sports Center, about 5.2 km in 18 minutes. On the way, he bought a bottle of Pocari Sweat and an energy gel at the Lawson convenience store at the entrance of the sports center. After arriving at the track, he quickly changed into running shoes and running shorts. At 17:30, Wang Lei, the running group leader, organized a warm-up. The training theme that day was 'gradually accelerating run.' Wearing a heart rate strap and a Garmin watch, he started at a pace of 5:32/km, then sped up to 5:20/km for the last 2 kilometers. He completed the 10 km in 55 minutes 21 seconds, with an average heart rate of 157 bpm. After the run, he led everyone in a 15-minute group stretch in the rest area using a fascia ball, focusing on the iliotibial band and the calf gastrocnemius muscles, and made plans with Zhang Wei and others for the next gathering.
location: Track and Field at Songjiang Sports Center, No. 145 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Post-run return and quick cleanup
description: Rode the electric bike back from the sports center to Xingang Community, arriving home at 19:50. On the floor, used a foam roller to press and relax the front and outer thighs for 5 minutes each to relieve post-run muscle tightness, then took a shower to wash away the fatigue.
location: Room 203, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and daily expense bookkeeping
description: For dinner, heated up the bento prepared in the morning (soy sauce fried rice and pan-fried chicken breast) in the microwave, and had a glass of zero-calorie sparkling water. After the meal, opened the "Suishouji" app on my phone to record the day's cash expenses: transportation 0 yuan, convenience store supplies 5 yuan, total expenses only 5 yuan. The mortgage was automatically deducted as a special payment and not included in the daily accounts. In the mood notes, I wrote: "The weekly meeting went smoothly, and my career confidence increased; the mortgage was deducted successfully, so I feel settled. A bit tired, but fulfilled."
location: Kitchen/dining table, Room 203, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with girlfriend and new-home decoration plans
description: Girlfriend Lin Yue called via WeChat video from Hangzhou and asked with concern whether the meeting went smoothly. Yin Hao told her about how he had been affirmed by the technical department manager during the review meeting. The two discussed the timing and materials for applying putty to the walls of the new house. Lin Yue suggested buying mildew-proof, alkali-resistant interior primer online, and together they added two buckets of "Nippon Paint Odor-Free 120 Alkali-Resistant Primer" to the Taobao cart. They planned to place the order on the weekend and decided to go to the new house to work after work tomorrow. The call lasted about 35 minutes, with a relaxed atmosphere and full of anticipation for their future life.
location: Room 203, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Skill certification study and preparation for tomorrow.
description: After hanging up the video call, he opened the video courseware for the Mechanical Design and Manufacturing course at the Open University of China and studied Chapter 15, "Electrical Control and PLC Basics," taking notes on key points while watching. At 22:20, he paused his studies, hung tomorrow's work jacket and rain poncho on the hook behind the door in advance (the weather forecast predicted possible light rain on Friday), and created a new event in his phone calendar: "December 19 (Friday) 19:00: apply putty in the new house," to prepare for the next day.
location: Room 203, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep stretching and preparing for bed
description: He used a fascia ball to relax the iliotibial band and gluteus medius for 10 minutes, then stretched his calf muscles. He went to bed at 23:00, set the bedside alarm for 6:30 the next day, and before turning off the light quickly reviewed the next day's plan: work during the day, go to the new house to apply wall putty in the evening, and video chat with Lin Yue on the weekend. Feeling reassured, he soon fell asleep.
location: Room 203, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning core training and weight monitoring
description: At 5:55 in the morning, the "Strong Army Battle Song" alarm rang and he turned it off immediately. After getting out of bed, he did 20 standard push-ups by the window as a warm-up, then did a 15-minute core workout on the yoga mat: including 4 sets of 1-minute planks, 50 crunches, and 100 bicycle crunches. After training, he stepped on the scale, which showed 69.8 kg, down 0.1 kg from yesterday, reaching his weight-loss goal.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up, changing clothes, and preparing lunch box and tools
description: After quickly washing up, he changed into dark blue work clothes and safety shoes. He took out the bento of rice with shredded pork and green peppers that he had prepared the previous night from the fridge and put it into an insulated bag. He carefully checked the tool bag to make sure the tape measure, utility knife, spare scraper, and the newly bought 6-inch trowel from the day before were all complete.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycled to work and observed the fallen leaves by the roadside.
description: He put on his gloves and helmet, took out his mountain bike, and left Xingang Community at 6:50. He rode along Xingang Road, turned right onto Guangfulin Road, and headed west. The sky was already bright. In late autumn, plane tree leaves covered the bicycle lane, rustling under his wheels. He slowed down to take a look and thought that by next week it would probably be full winter.
location: Cycling route from Xingang Road to Guangfulin Road to Huatianjing Highway in Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Clock in at the factory and do a pre-shift inspection.
description: Pushed the mountain bike into the designated bike shed and locked it, and completed the fingerprint clock-in at 7:12. Entered the workshop changing room, put on a safety helmet and noise-reducing earplugs, then walked to the No. 3 milling machining center, carefully checked the machine tool and worktable that had been cleaned before leaving work yesterday, and after confirming no abnormalities, added lubricating oil to the guide rails.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Precision parts machining in the morning
description: The morning task was to machine a batch of export flanges with extremely strict tolerance requirements. After setting parameters according to the process card, he started the machine, monitored each cutting cycle through the observation window, and used an inside micrometer for precise measurement to ensure a tolerance of 0.015 mm. During this time, colleague Wang Lei came over to ask what to have for lunch; after replying that he would have the canteen's braised pork chop, he continued focusing on work. At 11:30, the first batch of 20 pieces was completed and all passed inspection. Master Sun Jianguo provided guidance on site, and colleague Liu Zhiqiang also worked alongside in the workshop.
location: Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and course registration contact
description: While queuing in the cafeteria, he chose braised pork chop, tomato scrambled eggs, and stir-fried vegetables, costing 12 yuan. While eating, he checked his phone and saw that Teacher Liu from the Open University of China had accepted the friend request and replied with the course schedule for the Electrical Control and PLC Application spring class. The class is planned to start at the end of February, and he needs to prepare a copy of his ID card, proof of education, and a blue-background photo. He immediately saved the course schedule.
location: Canteen of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: During the lunch break, I checked the family group chat messages.
description: After the meal, he leaned back on the bench in the rest area and opened WeChat to check the family group. His mother sent a message saying her blood pressure was stable today, telling the family not to worry, and reminding everyone to dress warmly in the cold weather. Relieved, he replied, “Okay Mom, got it,” and a hug emoji. He then swiped past the health and wellness articles posted by relatives.
location: Rest area of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon: finishing parts machining and organizing community activities.
description: In the afternoon, continued the rough turning process for the remaining 10 flanges. At 15:00, during the 20-minute break, used the time to edit and post a notice in the Guangfulin Road Community Owners' Group about the winter solstice dumpling-making event: it will be held at 9 a.m. this Saturday (the 21st) in the community activity room. Neighbors are invited to bring their own rolling pins and fillings, while I will be responsible for buying flour, meat, and vegetables. I also asked Aunt Chen Xiuying from across the hall to talk about old Shanghai winter solstice customs. Right after that, I called Aunt Chen on WeChat voice to confirm that she would talk about the customs and serve as a judge on site, with me hosting and purchasing the ingredients. Aunt Chen readily agreed.
location: Workshop 3, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bought a quick deli meal on the way home from work
description: After clocking out at 17:00, he cycled away from the company, followed Huatianjing Road onto Pingyuan Street, and reached Yuxin Delicatessen five minutes later. He bought half a jin of braised pork head meat and two scallion pancakes, packed them in plastic bags to take away, and planned to have a simple meal so he would have energy to apply putty at the new house in the evening.
location: Yuxin Deli, Lane 922, Pingyuan Street, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Quick dinner in the rental apartment
description: He rode for 15 minutes back to the rented room, spread out the braised pork head meat, wolfed it down in a few quick bites, and drank a large glass of water. After the meal, he carried his tool bag, took the newly bought scraper and putty powder samples, and checked the e-bike battery to make sure it had enough charge for the round trip.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Rode an electric bike to the new home in Sanxiang Four Seasons Flower City.
description: Hopped on my electric scooter and headed straight along Xingang Road, then turned onto Guangfulin Road toward Ziwei Court at Sanxiang Four Seasons Flower City. Along the way, I thought through the evening's renovation plan: first apply the base leveling putty on the east and north walls of the living room, and after it dries tomorrow, apply the top coat.
location: Along the route from Xingang Road to Lane 1599, Guangfulin Road, Ziwei Garden, Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Apply base putty to the living room walls of the new house
description: After arriving at Room 202, Building 8 of the new house, he changed into an old T-shirt and played the song "Fortunate Son" on his phone to boost his spirits. First, he used a scraper to check the flatness of the wall where the mesh was laid, then mixed the base-leveling putty according to the ratio. Using a large trowel, he started from the east wall of the living room, pushing hard, focusing on filling the corner lines and uneven areas. Over three hours, he alternated between bending over and climbing an A-frame ladder; his arms were sore, but seeing the wall gradually smooth out made him feel reassured.
location: Room 202, No. 8, Ziwei Yuan, Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Lane 1599 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Completion check and close off water, electricity, doors, and windows.
description: After scraping the last patch of filler on the east wall, I stood in the center of the room and shone a flashlight at an angle to check the flatness of the wall, then lightly touched the corner lines with my fingers to confirm the hardness and adhesion were satisfactory. Satisfied, I turned off all water and power switches, locked the doors and windows, and got ready to leave.
location: Room 202, No. 8, Ziwei Yuan, Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Lane 1599 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Rode his bike back to his rental apartment at night.
description: The night was late, the cold wind howling. Pulling his work jacket tighter, he hurried on his e-bike to Xingang Community. Although he was exhausted after the day, seeing the renovation progress on schedule made him feel at ease.
location: Along the route from Ziwei Garden, Sanxiang Four Seasons Flower City, Lane 1599, Guangfulin Road, to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Before bed: record expenses, shower, and stretch to relax
description: After returning to the rental apartment, he first wiped his face with a towel, took out his account book, and recorded the day's expenses: braised pork for dinner, 12 yuan; scallion pancake, 4 yuan. Then he took a hot shower to wash off the dust and sweat. After changing into pajamas, he did a 10-minute full-body stretch on the yoga mat, focusing on relaxing his shoulders, back, and arm muscles. The soreness was noticeably relieved.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep phone browsing, family interaction, and falling asleep
description: After turning off the light, I lay in bed and opened my phone. In the owners' group, five neighbors had already joined the chain for the dumpling-making activity. Then I saw that my mother had sent a photo of dinner in the family group. I smiled and replied with a thumbs-up emoji. After that, I scrolled through review videos of wall sanding machines for a while to prepare for tomorrow's sanding session. At 23:00, I turned off the screen and put my phone on the nightstand. A few dog barks came from outside the window. I adjusted my sleeping position, silently recited tomorrow's tasks—'sand the walls in the morning, apply primer in the afternoon'—and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Xingang Community, No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and core training
description: The alarm went off on time. He folded the quilt and stepped barefoot on the cold floor tiles to wake up quickly. He did 15 minutes of core training: 3 sets of planks, 4 sets of crunches, and 3 sets of mountain climbers. Sweat flowed, and he felt his lung capacity fully opened. After training, he weighed himself: 69.7 kg, and took a multivitamin tablet.
location: Room 402, Building 8, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Mortgage and automatic investment deduction confirmation
description: He picked up his phone to check bank text messages. At 06:23, he received a repayment notice and confirmed that the savings card ending in 8876 had automatically deducted 6,200 yuan for the mortgage and 500 yuan for the recurring fund investment. He used the mobile banking app to verify the statement, and created a new entry in the bookkeeping software, noting: "First month's mortgage, responsibility on my shoulders."
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 8, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning market trip to buy pork ribs and vegetables
description: He put on his old jacket and walked to the vegetable market on Guangfulin Road. Songjiang was quiet on the weekend morning. At familiar Old Zhang's meat stall, he selected two fresh pork ribs and also bought winter melon and goji berries. Old Zhang asked with a smile, 'Making soup again?' He replied, 'The renovation is tiring; I need some nourishment.' He paid 42 yuan and bought salt at the grocery store on the way.
location: Guangfulin Road vegetable market, southwest side of the intersection of Guangfulin Road and Guangxing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Buy healthy ingredients at the supermarket
description: Returning to near the community, he went into the Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket and, according to his healthy meal plan, quickly picked up 10 kilograms of multigrain rice, a dozen eggs, two pieces of chicken breast, one broccoli, two carrots, and two pieces of soft tofu, spending about 60 yuan. While waiting in line to pay, he looked at his phone; it was 07:25. He carried the groceries and walked back to his rented apartment.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Putting away groceries and organizing renovation equipment.
description: After entering, he portioned the pork ribs: one bag to freeze for the weekend, one bag to refrigerate for tonight's soup. Put eggs and vegetables into the refrigerator in categories. Changed into old military pants and a camouflage T-shirt for painting, pulled the toolbox out from under the bed, checked the electric screwdriver, sandpaper, roller, and paint bucket, and moved the vacuum cleaner to the door.
location: Room 402, Building 8, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycled to the new home
description: He rode an electric bike from the rental apartment, turned from Xingang Road onto Guangfulin Road, and headed west. It was an early weekend morning with few cars and good road conditions; the whole trip was about 3.5 kilometers and took 15 minutes. After arriving, he parked the bike in the community's dedicated non-motor vehicle shed and locked it.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Ziwei Court, Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Lane 1599, Guangfulin Road

name: Fine sanding of walls and inspection of the watertightness test
description: Entering the new house, he first opened the windows for ventilation and put on a protective mask and goggles. He used 120-grit sandpaper to sand the base putty applied yesterday, focusing on trowel marks and raised joints; then used 360-grit fine sandpaper to polish the entire surface. After an hour, he promptly checked the kitchen and bathroom waterproofing test, confirming the water level was normal and there was no leakage downstairs. Finally, he used a vacuum cleaner and wet cloth to clean the dust throughout the house.
location: Room 701, Building 16, Ziwei Garden, Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Lane 1599 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Apply primer throughout the house
description: Opened the primer bucket, fully soaked the roller, then started rolling from the living room TV feature wall, strictly following a "Z"-shaped pattern to ensure an even paint film. During the intervals between painting, he used the drying time to take photos of every corner of the new home with his phone. The whole process was quiet, with only the sound of the roller rolling.
location: Room 701, Building 16, Ziwei Garden, Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Lane 1599 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break
description: The primer needs two hours to dry. I rode the electric bike to the braised beef noodle shop at the nearby life plaza, ordered a large bowl of braised beef noodles with an extra egg for 18 yuan. The noodles were chewy and the broth rich. I slurped them down and regained a lot of energy.
location: Braised Beef Noodles (Life Plaza), No. 45-50, Lane 1500, Meijiabang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Applying the first coat of finish paint
description: Returned to the new house and started the most important finishing paint work. Starting from the master bedroom, dipped a high-quality roller in latex paint and rolled from the corners toward the center of the ceiling, aiming for even coverage. Over more than four hours, I mainly crouched at corners and on a ladder, carefully painting interior corners, around lamp holders, and near switch panels, drinking water twice during that time.
location: Room 701, Building 16, Ziwei Garden, Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Lane 1599 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Apply the second coat of topcoat and finishing touches.
description: After a short rest, I stretched my sore shoulder and directly began the second coat, focusing on the uneven areas that might have been left from the first coat, especially the junction between the ceiling and the wall. I stopped work at 6 p.m. and stepped back a few steps, looking at the soft, even, milky-white glossy wall, and felt especially at ease.
location: Room 701, Building 16, Ziwei Garden, Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Lane 1599 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cleaning and organizing tools.
description: While the wall naturally air-dried, did the finishing work. Sorted waste like waste paint buckets and old gloves into bags and took them to the residential area's waste sorting station for disposal. Used thinner to clean the roller, tray, and scraper, dried them, and put them back in the toolbox. Used a wet mop to clean paint spots and dust from the floor, and finally opened the windows for ventilation.
location: Ziwei Garden, Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Lane 1599, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return trip and personal hygiene
description: He rode the electric scooter back to the rented apartment. After getting home, he took a shower in the bathroom; the hot water washed away the dust and paint smell from his body. He changed into clean cotton T-shirt and shorts for home and felt completely revived.
location: From Ziwei Court, Sanxiang Four Seasons Garden, Lane 1599 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, and finally to Room 402, Building 8, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Video call with father.
description: Initiated a WeChat video call to father Yin Jianguo, slowly panned the phone camera around the walls of the new house, and said, 'Dad, the painting is done. How does it look?' After looking carefully, his father rarely praised him: 'Not bad, kid! Neater than I imagined! Better than your old man back in the day!' He also reminded him to pay attention to putty drying. After reporting his painting experience, he confirmed the plan for his father to take leave after the Spring Festival to help lay the floor. The call lasted about 40 minutes.
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 8, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Simmered winter melon and pork rib soup for dinner
description: After hanging up, he took the pork ribs bought that morning out of the fridge, blanched them to remove the blood foam, and put them into the electric slow cooker with cut winter melon chunks, goji berries, and ginger slices, adding water to simmer. An hour later, the room was filled with a light sweet fragrance. He ladled out a large bowl of soup, ate it with the rice from lunch, and felt warm all over.
location: Kitchen and living room, Room 402, Building 8, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Body fat measurement and sharing with family group.
description: After the meal, he stood on the body fat scale: weight 69.7 kg, body fat percentage 18.2%, muscle mass maintained well, slightly lower than at the beginning of the month. Satisfied. He selected a few close-ups of the wall and a panoramic view of the room, sent them to the "Loving Family" family group with the caption "Done!", and his father and brother soon liked and commented, "Not bad, it really looks the part."
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 8, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Daily bookkeeping and community affairs communication
description: In front of the desk, opened the bookkeeping app and entered today's expenses: ribs and vegetables 42 yuan, noodles 18 yuan, grains, eggs, etc. about 60 yuan, totaling 120 yuan. Also recorded the mortgage deduction of 6,200 yuan and fund investment of 500 yuan. Then opened the 'Songjiang Sanxiang Four Seasons Owners Group' to confirm that tomorrow's winter solstice dumpling-making event sign-up was still in order, and privately messaged neighbor Aunt Chen: 'Auntie, tomorrow morning I'll buy flour and meat filling, and I'll be at the activity room at 9 sharp.' Aunt Chen replied instantly: 'Okay, Xiao Yin, see you tomorrow!'
location: At the desk, Room 402, Building 8, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Stretching before bed and mulling over plans
description: Routine stretching before bed, focusing on relaxing the right shoulder and upper-arm triceps that were sore from a day of lifting and roller painting. While stretching, I looked out at the night view of Songjiang and pondered using the remaining two weekends of this month to finish the balcony edge treatment and buy a clothes-drying rack, so that after my father comes for the Spring Festival, we can lay the flooring directly.
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 8, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Turned off the lights and went to bed
description: Turning off the light and lying in bed, the creamy white luster of the new apartment's walls flashed through his mind, and he soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 402, Building 8, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning core training and morning preparation.
description: On the morning of the winter solstice, he woke up naturally at 6 a.m. and did core training in the living room (crunches, planks, glute bridges, etc.). He weighed 70kg, took a multivitamin, then showered and changed.
location: Room 503, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and checking items before leaving home
description: Heated pork rib soup with whole wheat bread for breakfast, checked the homeowner group's Winter Solstice activity sign-up list, and counted the items to take out, including the shopping list, car keys, power bank, and thermos cup.
location: Room 503, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Went to the vegetable market to buy ingredients for making dumplings
description: Drove to Guangfulin Road vegetable market to buy ingredients such as ground pork, chives, napa cabbage, eggs, dumpling wrappers, as well as cooking oil. During the trip, answered Aunt Chen's call to confirm event arrangements.
location: Guangfulin Road Market, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Move ingredients and set up the activity venue.
description: Carried the purchased ingredients into the community center activity room with Aunt Chen, set up tables, chairs, induction cookers, cooking pots, etc., checked equipment safety, and refrigerated the minced meat and vegetables.
location: Central activity room of Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (stilt floor of Building 5).

name: Host the community Winter Solstice dumpling-making activity.
description: The event officially began, with more than 20 residents taking part. I was responsible for sign-in, distributing gloves, guiding dumpling-wrapping techniques, boiling water to cook dumplings, taking photos and posting them in the owners' group, and tasting the dumplings. The event was warm and harmonious.
location: Central activity room of Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (stilt floor of Building 5).

name: Delivered dumplings to Grandpa Wang, an elderly person living alone
description: At the end of the event, I packed up the hot dumplings and vinegar and delivered them to Grandpa Wang Jianguo, an elderly man living alone. He was very moved, chatted about old times, and left his contact number, telling us to call him anytime if needed.
location: Room 304, Building 4, Xingang Residential Area, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Clean up the event venue and distribute leftover ingredients
description: Together with neighbors including Aunt Chen and Xiao Li, she washed cooking utensils, wiped down tables, mopped and disinfected the floor, shared leftover dumpling wrappers and filling with neighbors, and posted a thank-you message and group photo in the owners' group.
location: Central activity room of Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (stilt floor of Building 5).

name: Brief rest and replying to messages
description: Returned to the rented apartment to drink water and change clothes, replied to messages from friend Gao Zhiyuan and gaming friend Zhang Fei, and interacted with his mother in the family group chat.
location: Room 503, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go to the supermarket to buy celebration supplies.
description: Drove to Xingang Xincun Fresh Supermarket, quickly selected barbecue ingredients (beef, chicken wings, vegetables, etc.), drinks, disposable tableware, and apples, and checked out for 187 yuan.
location: Xingang New Village Fresh Supermarket, Room 106, Building 1, Lane 213, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Carry supplies to the new house and set up the barbecue area.
description: Drove to the new apartment at Sanxiang Siji Huacheng Ziwei Garden, carried supplies upstairs in several trips, cleaned the living room, set up the barbecue grill and charcoal on the balcony, adjusted the projector and speakers, and put the dumplings in the refrigerator.
location: Room 701, Building 16, Ziwei Garden, Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Lane 1599 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Waited for friends to arrive and did a final tidy-up
description: Gao Zhiyuan called to say he was about to arrive. While waiting, I chilled the drinks, skewered the barbecue ingredients, opened the windows for ventilation, and opened the door early to welcome my friends.
location: Room 701, Building 16, Ziwei Garden, Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Lane 1599 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Key celebration round one: barbecue and chatting.
description: Friends arrived one after another, bringing pickled vegetables, red wine, and other things. Music played, and they had a barbecue on the balcony. Yin Hao was the main grill cook. Master Chen Jianguo brought a refurbished small refrigerator and an old sound system as housewarming gifts. Zhang Fei joined via video call. Everyone raised their glasses to celebrate the Winter Solstice.
location: Room 701, Building 16, Ziwei Garden, Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Lane 1599 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Celebration Round 2: Aerial Photography Sharing and Side-Hustle Discussion
description: He played a collection of aerial footage on the projector; his friends were impressed. Gao Zhiyuan suggested taking wedding aerial photography orders, Zhang Fei proposed making a demo reel and posting it on Xiaohongshu, Yin Hao noted down the budget for buying a gimbal and learning video editing, and Ma Xiaofeng offered to help contact wedding planning companies.
location: Room 701, Building 16, Ziwei Garden, Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Lane 1599 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: The end of the celebration and seeing friends off
description: The friends said goodbye one after another. Gao Zhiyuan helped clean the barbecue grill, Ma Xiaofeng helped take out the trash, and they reminded each other to take care. Yin Hao escorted everyone to the elevator and watched them leave.
location: Room 701, Building 16, Ziwei Garden, Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Lane 1599 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cleaning the new house by himself
description: Yin Hao cleaned the balcony and living room alone, clearing the charcoal ash, scrubbing the grill grate, and taking out the trash. He put the mini fridge and old stereo away, checked the water and electricity, then locked up and left.
location: Room 701, Building 16, Ziwei Garden, Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Lane 1599 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Drive back to the rental apartment and wash up briefly
description: Drove back to Xingang Residential Community, froze the leftover dumplings, took a shower, changed into pajamas, and prepared to video call his mother.
location: Room 503, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with mother.
description: Video connected, reported the Winter Solstice event to mother, asked about her blood pressure and health. Mother mentioned that during the Spring Festival she would have father come to Shanghai to lay the flooring, and I promised to pick him up at the station.
location: Room 503, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Keeping accounts and stretching before bed.
description: Confirmed the savings automatically transferred to Yu'ebao, recorded total daily expenses of 342 yuan, archived event photos, completed evening stretching, and finished with a plank.
location: Room 503, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing for tomorrow's commute and going to bed
description: He prepared his work clothes, checked the e-bike keys, set the alarm clock, turned off the lights and went to sleep, full of anticipation for the side project plan.
location: Room 503, Building 3, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning core training and weighing.
description: After waking up, I completed a 15-minute core workout in bed, including crunches, mountain climbers, glute bridges, and other exercises. Then I got up and weighed myself, which showed 70.1 kg. I drank a glass of warm water and took a multivitamin.
location: Room 404, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Prepare breakfast and lunch boxes.
description: In the kitchen, I heated up yesterday's leftover pork and cabbage dumplings in the microwave for breakfast, and at the same time packed another portion of dumplings and roasted vegetables into an insulated bento box to take to the company for lunch. After eating, I rinsed the dishes.
location: Room 404, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning preparation and leaving home
description: Changed into work clothes and checked the e-bike keys, work badge, and windproof gloves. Checked the weather forecast: cloudy, 5-9°C, no rain. After locking the door, he went downstairs.
location: Room 404, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Commute by bicycle.
description: Rode the electric bike from Xingang Road, along Guangfulin Road to Huatianjing Highway, heading to the company. There was little traffic in the early morning, the weather was cold, but the thickened gloves provided warmth.
location: Along Xingang Road, Guangfulin Road, and Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-job preparation
description: After arriving at the company, he clocked in and changed into anti-smashing safety shoes in the locker room. He entered the workshop, started the CNC machine to warm it up, and brewed a cup of strong tea. He checked the cleaning status from the previous day to prepare for the morning work.
location: Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360, Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning workshop operations
description: Officially started the day's work, with the task of machining a batch of precision parts. Set the machine tool parameters according to the process card, and continuously spot-checked product dimensions during the process to ensure quality met standards. Team leader Wang Lei and programmer Liu Zhiqiang were in the workshop discussing yesterday's celebration. During the tool change break at 10:00, I stood up and stretched my lower back and shoulders for 5 minutes.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and work-break chat.
description: Ate at the employee cafeteria, at the same table with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang. The two brought up the aerial video again and praised the filming quality. Yin Hao responded politely, and the conversation then turned to winter specialties from their respective hometowns, in a relaxed atmosphere.
location: Employee cafeteria, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and side hustle planning
description: Leaning back on a folding chair in the workshop rest area with his eyes closed to rest, not fully asleep. In his mind, he sorted through the wedding aerial photography side business plan suggested by his friend Chen Jie, then recorded action steps in his phone memo: learn PR editing tutorials in early January and research prices for used gimbal stabilizers.
location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon workshop work and rental renewal
description: In the afternoon, continued CNC machine tool operations. During the 15:00 work break, contacted the landlord Li Xiuying by phone to discuss renewing the lease. Because the renovation of the new house was not finished, asked to extend the lease for one month. The landlord agreed to keep the original rent and sent an electronic contract. After carefully reviewing the terms, completed the e-signature and transferred 6,300 yuan via Alipay. Then returned to the workstation and continued working until 16:30. Before leaving work, swept up iron filings around the machine, performed routine maintenance, filled in the shift log, and put measuring tools back in place.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Off work and commuting to Wanda Plaza
description: In the locker room, change back into casual clothes, put on helmet and gloves, and clock out. After checking navigation, decide to go to Wanda Plaza first to buy packing supplies. Ride the e-bike from the company, head north along Huatianjing Road to Guangfulin Road, turn right at Guangxing Road intersection, and arrive at Songjiang Wanda Plaza. Traffic is heavy during rush hour; the trip takes about 15 minutes.
location: Huatianjing Highway, Guangfulin Road, and Guangxing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Purchasing packing materials and dinner at Wanda Plaza
description: First went to Yonghui Supermarket on Level B1 of Wanda Plaza, picked 10 standard moving cartons and a full roll of bubble wrap. Then went to the M&G Stationery store on the second floor, bought 5 rolls of wide tape, 3 markers, and a roll of garbage bags, totaling 155 yuan. After shopping, ate at the “Old Shanghai Taste” local noodle shop on the west side of the plaza, ordering a bowl of noodles with shredded pork and pickled mustard greens plus a fried egg, and finished quickly. After the meal, charged the electric scooter for 10 minutes.
location: Yonghui Supermarket (B1), M&G Stationery Store (2F), and the noodle shop on the west side at Wanda Plaza, 658 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Return to the rental apartment
description: Rode the electric bike from Wanda Plaza, turned from Guangxing Road onto Xingang Road, and returned to Xingang Residential Community. Carried the purchased packaged supplies upstairs.
location: Xingang Community, Guangxing Road and Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Sorting and initial packing.
description: Inside the living room of the rented apartment, he opened a cardboard box and wrote "Winter clothes and bedding" on the side with a marker. He sorted out down jackets, thick sweaters, and out-of-season cotton quilts from the wardrobe, wrapped them in bubble wrap, and neatly packed them into the box. In an hour and a half, he successfully packed 3 standard boxes.
location: Room 404, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Video call with father.
description: Cleaned up the packing site and temporarily stacked the cardboard boxes on the balcony. Set up the phone stand in the bedroom, opened WeChat, and waited for my father's video call. During the call, I showed photos of the new house's paint finish, and my father praised the workmanship. I told him that the first month's mortgage payment of 6,200 yuan had been deducted successfully. When discussing the plan to return to Rudong for the Spring Festival, my father said he would take leave after the Spring Festival to come to Shanghai and help lay the flooring. Yin Hao felt warmed. The call lasted about 35 minutes.
location: Room 404, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Bookkeeping and organizing
description: After the call, opened the expense-tracking app and entered today's expenses: rent renewal 6,300 yuan, packing materials 155 yuan, dinner 22 yuan, totaling 6,477 yuan, with the note "Renewed lease for one month." Saved the photos of the new apartment's paint finish and packing progress into the "Renovation Progress" and "Moving Preparation" albums respectively.
location: Room 404, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Evening relaxation and sleep
description: After washing up, he changed into pajamas and lay in bed, wearing Bluetooth earphones to listen to light music and white noise to relax. After 22:00, he took off the earphones, turned off the light, and did some pre-sleep stretching to loosen his lower back. Reviewing the day's affairs — work went smoothly, the lease renewal was completed, packing made progress, and he talked with his father — he felt at ease and soon fell asleep.
location: Room 404, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Natural wake-up and status check
description: My biological clock is more reliable than the alarm—I woke up naturally at 05:50. I grabbed my phone and checked the weather: cloudy in Shanghai today, 7-12. I assessed my body: I didn't stay up late last night, so I feel energetic. I weighed 70.1kg yesterday; I'll measure again today.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning core exercises and washing up
description: Made the bed and opened the window for ventilation. Changed into athletic shorts and an old T-shirt, unrolled the yoga mat, and started a 15-minute core workout: 3 sets of planks, 4 sets of crunches, and 3 sets of Russian twists. After training, I washed up, shaved, applied Dabao moisturizer, and took a multivitamin.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning weigh-in.
description: After training, he stepped on the electronic scale and it showed 69.9 kg. It seemed that controlling the meal at the canteen at noon yesterday had not been in vain; his weight was stable, and he felt quite satisfied.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cooking breakfast and preparing lunchbox meal
description: Nimbly reheated the leftover pork and scallion dumplings from yesterday while pouring the soybeans that had been soaked overnight into the soymilk maker. In 10 minutes, I finished 20 dumplings and drank a cup of hot soy milk. Then I stir-fried the diced ham, corn kernels, and green peas cut last night together with rice and packed it into a lunchbox—that was today's lunch.
location: Kitchen of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Check belongings before going out.
description: Pack up the work jacket, employee badge, and insulated lunch bag; put gloves, a notebook, and a pen into the backpack as well. Check the keys, phone, and power bank. Oh, the lamp link my older brother sent last night—I'll look at it carefully at noon. Finally, he glanced out the window and tucked a folding umbrella into the side pocket.
location: Entrance to the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute to work by e-bike
description: I got on the gray electric bike and headed west along Xingang Road and Huatianjing Highway. The morning rush hadn't fully arrived, so traffic wasn't congested. I arrived at the company 15 minutes later, parked the bike in the charging shed, and plugged it in.
location: From Xingang Road to Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Changing in the workshop and getting ready for work.
description: I walked into the changing room, changed into a one-piece anti-static work suit, and put on safety goggles and earplugs. I greeted the coworker who had arrived early, then took out today's drawings from the locker and silently reviewed the key parameters for the first trial cut.
location: Workshop changing room at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: First-piece precision part trial cutting and offline programming plan submission
description: He arrived at the workstation a few minutes early, started the machine tool, warmed up the spindle, and checked the coolant level and tool magazine. At 8:30 he officially began machining the first piece of this batch of precision parts. He repeatedly double-checked the feed rate and spindle speed in the program, and manually measured the tool length every time he changed a tool. During the machining break, he organized the offline programming optimization ideas Master Sun had mentioned yesterday into a simple proposal and resource pack, sent it to colleagues in the technical department via internal company email, and CC'd Master Sun, with the note "For reference, let's discuss in detail at noon." In the middle, he did some stretching and drank some water.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch at the cafeteria and a video call with his older brother.
description: Today the cafeteria had braised pork chops and tomato scrambled eggs. I got a serving, found a corner seat by the window, and called my older brother Yin Tao via video. He was eating a boxed meal at a 4S store in Suzhou. We chatted a bit about work, then he pulled up his phone gallery and showed me several light fixtures he had chosen for the living room and bedroom. I looked carefully and asked about color temperature and brightness; he said warm white light 3000K, and I nodded saying it was fine. I thanked him for his trouble, and we agreed to go together to Suzhou Furniture City next time so I could help him choose. The call lasted 15 minutes; after hanging up, I focused on finishing my lunch.
location: Employee cafeteria, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon production and processing with master-apprentice exchange
description: In the afternoon, I continued completing the remaining machining tasks. The first piece passed quality inspection, and the subsequent production went smoothly. During the 3 p.m. work break, I ran into my master Sun Jianguo in the workshop pantry. I mentioned the offline programming materials I had sent to the technical department in the morning. He said he had seen them and the content was good, and we agreed that he would bring lunch tomorrow noon and we would finalize the details in the workshop meeting room. At 4:30, I finished all the work, cleaned the machine tool and workbench, confirmed that tomorrow's materials were ready, and only then clocked out with peace of mind.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Shopping after work and heading home
description: Riding the electric bike out of the company, he did not go straight home.
