He stopped at a bakery on Xingang Road and bought a whole-wheat nut bread for tomorrow's breakfast (17 yuan), then bought a case of mineral water and two bottles of sports drinks at the convenience store next door (14 yuan), preparing for tonight's 10-kilometer tempo run. The shopping took 15 minutes.
location: A street-facing shop on Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returning home to rest and having a light meal before running.
description: When I got home, I first put away the things I had bought. I changed out of my work clothes, took a warm shower, and put on loose running T-shirt and shorts. Feeling hungry but not wanting to eat too much, I cooked a small pot of buckwheat noodles in clear broth, poached an egg in it, and blanched a few lettuce leaves. While eating the noodles, I stood by the window and looked at the sky outside, confirming it hadn't rained. I felt relieved.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-run dynamic stretching and equipment check
description: After eating, I rested briefly for 15 minutes. Then I did a dynamic stretching routine on the yoga mat before running: jumping jacks, high knees, forward lunges, and ankle circles, to warm up the body. I checked the laces of my running shoes, the GPS and music app on my phone, and put my keys and phone into the running waist pack. I poured half a bottle of cool boiled water into the newly bought running water bottle.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycled to the Sports Center
description: Rode the bike to the Sports Center and locked it in the bike shed at the entrance. Tonight's feels-like temperature is around 7, a bit chilly. Saw in the running group's chat that Wang Lei and the others were already spamming messages, saying they were almost there. The cycling distance was about 4 kilometers and took 15 minutes.
location: Xingang Road to Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Running group 10 km tempo run training
description: Warmed up with teammates who arrived one after another. At exactly 7:00, everyone gathered at the starting line on their own. Today's theme was a tempo run, with Wang Lei as the pace leader. We set a target pace of 5:35/km. For the first kilometer, everyone ran steadily with even breathing. By the fifth kilometer, some started to slow down. Zhang Wei at the back of the group shouted, "My legs feel a bit heavy," and I turned back and called out, "Keep your cadence and adjust your breathing," then slowed down a bit to lead him. In the last two kilometers, everyone accelerated and sprinted under Wang Lei's lead, finishing the workout. During the group cooldown stretch, I used my phone to tally everyone's running mileage and announced, "Wang Lei is close to 75 kilometers this month, Liu Zhiqiang has 72, and Chen Jie and I are also nearing 70. Next week, let's all push for 80 kilometers together!" Everyone's morale was high.
location: Running track at Songjiang Sports Center Stadium, No. 145 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Post-run relaxation and return trip
description: Said goodbye to his teammates and didn't rush home. Wearing clothes soaked with sweat, he sat on the bench by the field for a while to cool off, and drank the remaining water in his bottle. He took a screenshot of today's running record on his phone and sent it to the running group. Only after doing these things did he get up and go to the bike shed to get his bike.
location: Bench area next to the sports field at Songjiang Sports Center, No. 145 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go home to shower and change clothes
description: Cycled back to the residential community and parked the e-bike. The first thing after entering the house was to take a hot shower to wash off the smell of sweat. He changed into an old pair of athletic shorts and a faded old-man undershirt. From the old camphor wood chest on the balcony, he dug out an old screwdriver and a pair of scissors.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Decluttering and organizing the room items
description: He gathered all the items from the bedroom and living room—things in the cabinets, under the bed, and on the bay window—and piled them on the living room floor. Then, following the six categories he had already planned out in his mind: clothing, tools/parts, books and documents, electronics, kitchenware, and keepsakes/miscellaneous items, he began sorting. He weighed each item in his hand: the faded work pants were worn thin at the knees but could still serve as spare work clothes; the old wrench with a worn, deformed handle was thrown decisively into the 'discard' bag; he dug out the bright red epaulettes from his military discharge and the rental contract from his first days in Shanghai. He paused for a moment, rubbed the stiff epaulette fringes, and put them into the 'keepsakes' pile. He sorted until 11 o'clock, and also put away the tools and items he would need to take to the company the next day. After two hours of battle, the room was finally tidy again. He took a few photos and sent a WeChat message to his mother: 'Mom, the room is tidied up. Decluttered.'
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Expense tracking and bedtime relaxation.
description: In the bookkeeping app, recorded today's expenses: breakfast 0 yuan (leftovers from yesterday), bread 17 yuan, water and drinks 14 yuan, dinner 0 yuan (food already at home), total 31 yuan. Then sat down on the edge of the bed, did some stretching before bed, used a massage gun on the sore calves and lower back, and let out a sigh toward the ceiling.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going to bed and falling asleep.
description: Turned off the desk lamp and lay down. Glanced at messages showing nothing major today. Closed my eyes and recalled the day: work went steadily, the 10 km pace hit the target, and the room was tidy. Thoughts gradually faded, sinking into sleep on a winter night in Songjiang.
location: Bedroom of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning core training and commute preparation.
description: The sky outside the window was gloomy and it was raining. Yin Hao was woken by the alarm at 6:25. After turning off the alarm, he first stepped on the scale, which read 69.7 kg, 0.1 kg lighter than yesterday. Then he turned on his phone and played instrumental music, spread a yoga mat on the floor, and began a 10-minute core workout: 2 minutes of plank, 3 sets of crunches with 15 reps each, and 2 sets of push-ups with 12 reps each. After training, he felt slightly warm, went to the bathroom to wash his face with cold water and brush his teeth, but did not shave. He took a vitamin tablet from the cabinet and swallowed it with warm water. He changed into his dark blue work clothes, put on a waterproof jacket, and picked up his helmet and keys from the shoe cabinet by the door, ready for his commute in the rain.
location: Room 403, Building 14, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cycling commute on a rainy day
description: At 7:25, Yin Hao pushed open the iron door of the stairwell. A fine rain drifted onto his face. He hunched his neck and walked quickly to the e-bike shed, inserted the key, and put on his helmet. There were few pedestrians on the road, so he slowed down and rode steadily. Raindrops made a soft patter on his helmet visor. Because of the rain, it took 5 minutes longer than usual. He arrived at the Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory at about 7:55, parked the e-bike in the shed, stamped his feet at the door to shake water droplets off his coat, then pushed open the workshop door.
location: From Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Plant, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Pre-work preparation and morning meeting
description: After clocking in with facial recognition, Yin Hao changed into workshop slippers, walked to his machine tool, wiped the control panel with a rag, checked the coolant and lubricating oil levels, and confirmed that the parts processed the previous day had been taken off the machine. In the break room, shift leader Wang Lei, holding a thermos cup, greeted him with Merry Christmas Eve. Yin Hao joked that his date was the trash can downstairs, making Wang Lei laugh. Then, at a brief morning meeting, Wang Lei announced that the focus of the day was to complete the annual equipment inspection and asked everyone to check item by item according to the procedure.
location: Workshop operation area and rest room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning CNC machining and equipment inspection
description: After the morning meeting, the workshop resumed operations. Yin Hao started the production task on the machine, machining a batch of disc flanges with a tolerance of 0.02 mm. He focused on entering the program, adjusting tool compensation, and confirming the first piece passed inspection before starting batch production. Around 10 a.m., Wang Lei handed over the equipment inspection checklist, and the two conducted annual inspections on CNC machine tools No. 2 and No. 3, checking spindle speed, turret positioning accuracy, hydraulic system pressure, coolant pump status, guideway lubrication, and so on, carefully recording the data. While operating, Wang Lei lamented that the rain affected his weekend fishing plan; Yin Hao thought to himself that he would definitely go regardless.
location: CNC machine tools No. 2 and No. 3 in the workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and discussion on the offline programming system
description: At 11:30 the end-of-shift bell rang. Yin Hao washed his hands and went to the cafeteria to get lunch. The menu was braised pork chop, tomato and egg stir-fry, and stir-fried greens. Shortly after he sat down, Master Sun Jianguo came over with his bowl. Yin Hao immediately brought up business and asked Master Sun for his opinion on the offline programming system materials he had sent previously. Master Sun thought the software was convenient for modeling, but doubted whether the post-processing code was compatible with the old machine tools. The two talked in depth about system compatibility and code verification while eating. Master Sun finally asked Yin Hao to send over actual case files for further study. Yin Hao secretly resolved to master this system to improve workshop efficiency by 20 percent.
location: Company cafeteria, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Midday light strength training
description: At about 12:30 after lunch, Yin Hao walked to the pull-up bar in the corner of the workshop. After taking off his watch and loosening up his wrists and shoulders, he jumped up, grabbed the bar, and did pull-ups. He barely managed 6 reps in the first set before his arms turned sore. He got off the bar, shook his hands, rested for half a minute, then continued two more sets of 6 reps each. After finishing all three sets, he felt a clear pump in his forearms and back. Satisfied, he wiped the sweat from his hands with his work clothes, went back to the break room, drank some water, and sat for a while.
location: Pull-up bar area in the workshop corner, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon routine machining and equipment inspection wrap-up
description: At 13:10, Yin Hao returned to his workstation. He first checked the quality of the parts processed in the morning and, finding no issues, continued machining the remaining workpieces. During this time, Xiao Liu from the technical department came to ask about the logic of tool compensation data adjustment. Yin Hao walked over to his machine and demonstrated the parameter modification steps. At 2:30 p.m., he and Wang Lei spent nearly an hour completing the remaining items of the morning equipment inspection, including checking the sensitivity of the safety door switch and the operation of the electrical cabinet cooling fan. Wang Lei signed the inspection sheet. Amid the low hum of the machines and the sound of cutting tools, the afternoon passed quietly.
location: CNC machine tools No. 2 and No. 3 in the workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After-work commute
description: At noon, he returned to the shade under the trees by the shore and took out his packed lunch. I shared sandwiches, and Wu Zhiqiang brought out braised beef and hot tea. After the meal, Wu Zhiqiang took out his newly purchased drone, skillfully flew it up, and looked down at the magnificent scenery of Dianshan Lake from high above. He zoomed in to take an aerial close-up of me and the big carp I had just caught. Seeing myself from an aerial perspective on the remote controller screen for the first time, I was deeply impressed and developed a strong interest in aerial photography.
location: From Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Discard old belongings and say goodbye to the past.
description: Going upstairs back to Room 403, Yin Hao looked at the tidy room from last night's cleanup and drank a glass of water. Then he sorted the garbage: blue bags held recyclables such as cardboard boxes and plastic bottles, while black bags held broken old wrenches, deformed screwdrivers, small-size T-shirts, faded work pants, and empty boxes and expired promotional flyers. He took a deep breath and carried the garbage bags down four flights of stairs in three trips, then walked to the community's sorted waste drop-off point and disposed of them one by one. As the last bag fell into the bin, raindrops pattered against the bag. He stood still for a few seconds and let out a long breath, as if formally saying goodbye to his past wandering rental life; the drizzle on his face felt especially refreshing.
location: Room 403, Building 14, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the waste sorting drop-off point downstairs

name: Simple dinner and relaxation.
description: After taking out the trash and washing his hands, Yin Hao took out the tomato-and-egg noodles and leftover greens he had cooked the night before, heated them up, and sat at the small dining table eating while looking at his phone, checking the weekend weather forecast which predicted the rain would stop next week. After eating, he washed the pots and bowls and wiped down the stovetop. Then he sat leaning against the bedside, connected his Bluetooth speaker to play quiet instrumental music, and closed his eyes to rest for about ten minutes, letting his tense nerves slowly relax.
location: Room 403, Building 14, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening free time and study.
description: After resting, his energy recovered. Yin Hao opened the expense-tracking app and jotted down an estimated lunch expense of 15 yuan. Then he scrolled through short videos and watched a few popular-science videos about mechanical principles, and sent a message in the running group chat: “It’s raining today, so I’ll rest for a day. This week I’ll try to run another 10 kilometers to reach 80.” Since it was still early before the scheduled video call, he took out the Python introductory book borrowed from the district library, turned to the dog-eared page, and read attentively, thinking that after Lin Yue moved in, they could go together to return the book on the weekend.
location: Room 403, Building 14, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with Lin Yue on Christmas Eve
description: At 21:20, Lin Yue's video call request rang right on time. On the screen, in her half-packed room, she smiled and wished him a Merry Christmas Eve, told him she would move in next week and had already started packing that day, and asked whether he had lost anything of sentimental value. Yin Hao turned the camera toward the faded red shoulder badge he had deliberately kept and a photo of their first trip to Disneyland; Lin Yue curved her eyes in satisfaction. They chatted for a few minutes. She told him to keep warm, and Yin Hao said he would help her move at any time. After about 20 minutes, Lin Yue hung up to continue packing, and the room fell quiet again. Yin Hao felt warm inside.
location: Room 403, Building 14, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening bookkeeping, stretching, and going to bed.
description: After the call, Yin Hao opened the expense tracking app and formally recorded today's expenses: lunch 15 yuan, commuter e-bike charging 1 yuan, totaling 16 yuan. After checking the balance, he closed it with satisfaction. Then he spread out a yoga mat and did 10 minutes of systematic stretching, from neck and shoulders to waist and legs, gradually loosening the muscles tight from training. Then he took a hot shower, put on pajamas, and blow-dried his hair. He sat down and glanced at the hazy rainy night outside the window, checked tomorrow morning's alarm and confirmed it was a workday. He turned off the main light, left the night light on, and lay down with a relieved and fresh feeling. Listening to the drizzle outside, he soon fell asleep. At 23:15, only the sound of rain and regular breathing remained in the room.
location: Room 403, Building 14, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wrap-up and bedtime
description: After stretching, Yin Hao brushed his teeth and washed his face with facial cleanser. Before getting into bed, he took one last look at the 11 neatly stacked boxes and confirmed the doors and windows were locked and the desk lamp was off. Once he lay down, he quickly drifted off and fell asleep.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Residential Area, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning routine and core training.
description: Yin Hao woke up on time to the alarm, stood barefoot on the body fat scale, which showed 69.7 kg, the same as yesterday, and was satisfied with that. Then he spread a yoga mat on the living room floor and did a 15-minute core workout, including planks, crunches, and Russian twists, feeling the soreness in his abdominal and lower back muscles. After the workout, he drank a glass of warm water and took a multivitamin. Next, he quickly reheated the lunch he had prepared last night—broccoli stir-fried with chicken breast and mixed grain rice—put it in an insulated bag, and checked his commuter backpack to make sure his work badge, power bank, and folding umbrella were all packed. Everything was in order.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Residential Area, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Commute: rode an electric bike to the factory.
description: Yin Hao put on his work jacket, helmet and gloves, and rode his e-bike parked downstairs to work. The weather was clear but the temperature was only 5 degrees Celsius, with a biting cold wind. On the way, he passed the morning market on Xingang Road, bought two hot meat buns from a roadside stall, and ate them quickly while waiting at a red light. He arrived at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory at about 7:45, parked the bike, swiped his card to enter the workshop, and clocked in 10 minutes early.
location: The route from Lane 224, Xingang Road to No. 360, Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning work: year-end production data review and file archiving.
description: After arriving, Yin Hao first used compressed air to clean the control panel and ball screw guides of Equipment #03 he was responsible for, and performed a routine warm-up check. Then he and production statistician Xiao Chen began to verify the annual machine tool operating data in the CNC workshop office. He pulled up Equipment #03's annual maintenance records, fault handling sheets, and operation logs from the digital collection platform, and checked them item by item against Xiao Chen's summary table. He specifically pointed out that the machine had no unplanned downtime all year, with an annual availability rate as high as 99.87%, which surprised Xiao Chen and prompted her to add this data. After verifying everything was correct, he named and packaged the electronic files by month and type, and backed them up to an external hard drive.
location: CNC workshop office, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and call with family
description: At lunchtime, Yin Hao went to the company cafeteria, heated up his homemade bento in the microwave, and sat down in a corner seat by the window. He made a WeChat video call to his mother, Wang Xiuying. His mother was frying meatballs in the kitchen, steaming hot, and said she was frying shepherd's purse meatballs for the New Year, all of which Yin Hao loved. Yin Hao smiled and responded, first asking whether her blood pressure had been stable recently and urging her to dress warmly as the temperature had dropped. His mother agreed to everything and, in turn, nagged him not to work too hard and to be sure to come home for the New Year. Yin Hao readily agreed, saying he would definitely come back to eat the meatballs his mother fried. Before hanging up, he heard his mother's laughter and felt warm inside.
location: Company cafeteria, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Work break chat: confirm the New Year's Day shift schedule
description: After eating, Yin Hao did not go back to the office to rest. Instead, he went directly to the workshop and found Wang Lei, the team leader, who was inspecting equipment. He came straight to the point and asked about the New Year’s Day shift schedule, explaining that the move was urgent and he wanted to set the time in advance. Wang Lei checked the shift schedule on his phone and told him that December 30 and 31 were two consecutive days off, and the whole factory would be off on New Year’s Day, so there should be enough time. Yin Hao did a quick mental calculation, felt reassured, thanked the team leader, and casually said he’d see him at the running group in the evening.
location: Beside the production line in the workshop of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work: pre-holiday wrap-up and handover.
description: In the afternoon, the main task was to print out the summary data that had been verified in the morning, ask Xiao Chen to sign for confirmation, and then file it. Yin Hao returned to his workstation, cleaned the computer desktop and drawers, and shredded unnecessary files. He also sorted a few old operation manuals and expired process drawings next to his workstation into a cardboard box, planning to dispose of them all on the weekend. At 4 p.m., he changed into his own jacket, clocked out, and left work.
location: Workstation at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going home to change clothes and replenish supplies
description: Yin Hao rode his e-bike for about 15 minutes back to his rental in Xingang Community. Moving quickly, he changed into black tight running pants and a yellow vest, and stuffed the red Christmas hat he bought last time into his running club backpack. Considering he couldn't eat too much before the run, he broke off half a banana and drank a spoonful of protein powder mixed with water to replenish energy. Carrying a thermos and checking his gear, he set off on the bike again.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Residential Area, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Heading to Songjiang Sports Center
description: Yin Hao rode an electric bike for about 25 minutes and arrived at Songjiang Sports Center. It was already getting dark, and the lights inside the stadium were on. He parked the bike, did some simple stretches by the track for his calves and shoulder blades, and waited for the running group members.
location: Along the way from No. 224 Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to No. 145 Rongle Middle Road.

name: Special Christmas training session with the running group
description: After Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, and Zhang Wei arrived one after another, Yin Hao took three Santa hats out of his backpack and handed them over, saying with a smile, 'It's a holiday, after all — we need a sense of ritual!' Everyone laughed and put them on, drawing kind looks from the runners around them. The plan that evening was an easy 10-kilometer run at a pace of about 5 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer. They chatted as they ran, and the atmosphere was relaxed. Wang Lei complained that the workshop was cold, and Zhang Wei shared about his newly bought running shoes. Yin Hao kept up with the rhythm and occasionally told jokes to make them laugh. At the 5th kilometer, he felt in great shape and picked up the pace a little. After 8 kilometers, they started to slow down and adjust their breathing. In the end, they finished the 10 kilometers in a bit over 56 minutes, with an average pace of 5:42 per kilometer — a perfect wrap-up.
location: Track and Field at Songjiang Sports Center, No. 145 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Post-run replenishment: hot ginger tea closes out the year.
description: After stretching following the run, Yin Hao called everyone over to the Haode Convenience Store next to the entrance of the Sports Center and bought four cups of hot ginger tea at his own expense. Raising his cup, he said, "Come on, guys, my treat, to warm your stomachs. This year our running club exceeded its training goals, so this is the official wrap-up! We'll continue next year, keep it up together!" Everyone clinked cups while sitting on the steps outside the convenience store, and the hot drinks dispelled the winter chill.
location: Haode Convenience Store, beside the entrance to Songjiang Sports Center, No. 145 Middle Rongle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return trip
description: After saying goodbye to his brothers, Yin Hao rode his bike home. The cold wind blowing on his sweat-soaked sportswear was a little chilly, but the ginger tea he had just drunk made his stomach warm.
location: Along the route from No. 145 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai to Lane 224, Xingang Road

name: Systematically pack and keep items
description: After arriving home, Yin Hao took a shower and changed into dry loungewear. Under the lamp, he began the most important packing operation. He took out the cardboard boxes he had bought earlier (5 large, 3 medium), tape, newspapers, and foam cushioning, and worked according to plan: in the kitchenware area, he wrapped all bowls and plates tightly in newspaper, wrapped the knives and forks in plastic wrap, placed the frying pan and lid vertically in a cardboard box, and filled the gaps with newspaper; in the fishing gear area, he put the fishing rods into the rod bag and placed them in a medium cardboard box together with the camping stove and gas canister, labeling the box 'Fishing gear - heavy'; in the valuables area, he carefully put the mechanical watch Lin Yue had given him into a foam inner box, then into a small cardboard box, wrapped the laptop in three layers of foam cushioning, put it in another small box, and added soft clothes as buffer. He put 'Fragile' stickers on all six sides of both small boxes; in the clothing and books area, he folded clothes by season, arranged books by height, and filled gaps with newspaper; in the miscellaneous and tools area, he sorted old exercise equipment, tool kits, etc. into large boxes and filled them with newspaper. After each box was packed, he used a marker to note the contents and sequence number on the box (e.g., 'Kitchenware - Box 1/3'). By 23:45, 5 large boxes, 3 medium boxes, and 3 small boxes were neatly stacked on the floor, 11 boxes in total, containing all his belongings, which finally gave him the real feeling of moving.
location: Living room of the rental apartment, Xingang Community, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Before-bed tasks and stretching
description: Yin Hao stood up and stretched his sore lower back, took out his ledger and phone, and recorded the 16 yuan spent on hot ginger tea tonight. Then he sat on the floor and did 10 minutes of lower back stretches, focusing on the lower back and hips to relieve the soreness from bending over while packing for a long time. After stretching, his body felt looser and his mind was calm.
location: Rental apartment in Xingang Residential Area, 1-246 Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning core training and weighing.
description: After the alarm went off, Yin Hao did a 15-minute core workout on the exercise mat, following a fitness program to complete planks, crunches, Russian twists, and other moves. After the workout, he weighed himself on a body fat scale, which showed 69.9 kg. Then he took a multivitamin tablet with warm water.
location: Room 402, Building 9, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and commute preparation
description: After a quick shower, Yin Hao changed into his work clothes, packed the washed apples and bananas into his backpack, and took whole-wheat bread and milk from the fridge for a simple breakfast. He checked his backpack: meeting agenda, phone, power bank, keys, and wallet, making sure everything was in order.
location: Room 402, Building 9, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: On the commute
description: Yin Hao rode his electric bike from Xingang Community, heading along Xingang Road to the factory on Huatianjing Road. While waiting at a red light, he checked messages in the WeChat veterans group and the childhood friends group, but chose to focus on riding and didn't reply. He arrived at the factory 25 minutes later and parked the bike in the shed.
location: Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (on the way from Xingang Residential Community at Lane 224, Xingang Road to No. 360, Huatianjing Highway, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory).

name: Check in at work and communicate with colleagues
description: Yin Hao arrived at the workshop changing room early, put on his work clothes, and walked to the outer hall of the auditorium to chat with colleagues Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, and others. Wang Lei teased him about the award he was about to receive, and the atmosphere was relaxed. Then he signed in and received the meeting agenda and a commemorative company thermos cup.
location: Outer Hall and Changing Room of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Annual summary meeting and technology contribution award ceremony.
description: At 9:00, the meeting officially began. Yin Hao sat in a front seat near the edge with his phone on silent, listening carefully to the company leaders' annual report. At 10:15, Manager Zhang from the production department announced the list of annual outstanding employees, and Yin Hao received the Annual Technical Contribution Award. He went on stage to accept the honorary certificate and a 2,000 yuan bonus red envelope, and gave a brief speech thanking the company and his mentor Sun Jianguo for their training. As he stepped off the stage, he saw Master Sun nod in approval and felt reassured.
location: Auditorium of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cafeteria lunch and award celebration
description: After the meeting, Yin Hao and colleagues including Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang went to the employee cafeteria. Today it served braised pork, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. Wang Lei egged him on to treat everyone, so Yin Hao agreed to arrange KTV in the evening and celebrated in advance at the cafeteria, deliberately getting an extra serving of braised pork as a reward for himself.
location: Employee cafeteria, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and document sorting
description: After lunch, Yin Hao returned to the workshop office, leaned back in his chair, and rested with his eyes closed for 20 minutes. When he woke up, he turned on the computer to organize the year-end summary data documents, checked the workpiece drawings to be handed over the next day, and noted in his phone memo that the evening KTV cost was about 60 yuan per person, then bought a group-buying coupon.
location: Workshop Office, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Workshop equipment inspection.
description: Taking advantage of the free time in the afternoon, Yin Hao made a routine inspection of his #03 machine in the CNC workshop, checking the oil circuit and coolant to ensure the equipment was in good condition, and briefly explained the precautions to the evening shift colleague.
location: CNC workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Confirm next week's moving arrangements.
description: Back at the office, Yin Hao found Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang and carefully finalized the specific arrangements for the move early on the 30th of next month, with them bringing people to Xingang Community to help move the large items. Wang Lei promised that he had already contacted Xiao Ma. Yin Hao then marked the location of the new home on a map and shared it with them.
location: Workshop Office, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Process discussion and work handover records
description: Master worker Sun Jianguo called Yin Hao to the technical office to discuss the machining process for the complex parts next week, spending half an hour on detailed discussion about the clamping plan and tool selection. After returning to his workstation, Yin Hao recorded the discussion points and tomorrow's handover items in detail in his work log to ensure everything was foolproof.
location: Technical office and workshop office, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Got changed after work and prepared for the appointment.
description: At 16:30 he clocked out and left work. Yin Hao went to the locker room, changed out of his work clothes into a sports hoodie and long pants, getting ready for the evening KTV activity.
location: Changing room of Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Community strength training.
description: After riding his e-bike back to Xingang Community, Yin Hao went directly to the community fitness area for strength recovery training: he completed 3 sets of pull-ups on the pull-up bar (6 reps per set), 2 sets of push-ups (15 reps per set), and 2 sets of squats (20 reps per set). He hadn't trained in half a month, so his muscles felt slightly sore, but he still completed all exercises with proper form. Afterwards, he bought Pocari Sweat at the convenience store to replenish electrolytes.
location: Community fitness area, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Going home to rest and preparing for KTV
description: After returning home, Yin Hao took a shower, changed into a clean T-shirt and jeans, and carried his wallet, phone, and power bank. He confirmed that the KTV group-buy voucher on Meituan had been purchased successfully, and sent a WeChat message to Wang Lei to arrange to meet at the usual place at 6 o'clock.
location: Room 402, Building 9, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Heading to Wanda Haoledi KTV.
description: Yin Hao rode his electric bike to Haoledi KTV at Songjiang Wanda Plaza, about a 15-minute ride. He parked the electric bike in the electric bike parking area at Wanda Plaza.
location: On the way from Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Haoledi KTV, Wanda Plaza (Shanghai Songjiang Store), 658 Guangfulin Road

name: KTV celebration party.
description: When Yin Hao entered the private room, Wang Lei and others were already selecting songs. He first sang Returning from Target Practice and Song of the Strong Army to warm up the crowd, then Gao Zhiyuan and others took turns singing. Everyone clinked their drinks to celebrate Yin Hao's award, and the atmosphere was lively. Yin Hao ended with Xu Wei's The Past You and completely relaxed.
location: Partyworld KTV small private room, Wanda Plaza (Shanghai Songjiang Store), No. 658 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Master Sun called to offer career planning guidance.
description: During KTV, Master Sun Jianguo called; Yin Hao went out to the corridor outside the private room to answer. Master Sun affirmed his performance that day and reminded him that competing for team leader next year requires both solid technical skills and management knowledge. Yin Hao solemnly replied that he would keep it in mind and immediately recorded the goal of "competing for team leader" in his phone memo.
location: Corridor outside Haoledi KTV private room, Wanda Plaza (Songjiang, Shanghai), No. 658 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Returning after the KTV session ended.
description: Returned to the private room and finished the last song with everyone, and agreed on the time for the next gathering. After saying goodbye at the door, Yin Hao called a ride-hailing car through a taxi app and returned to Xingang Residential Area; the ride was smooth.
location: From Wanda Plaza (Shanghai Songjiang Store) at 658 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Room 402, Building 9, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road (during ride-hailing trip)

name: Award reflections and next year's plan
description: After returning home, Yin Hao carefully placed the award certificate and the red envelope in a folder. In his notebook, he wrote: "The company values practical work, and support from my mentor is very important." Then he drafted a plan for the first half of next year, highlighting "competing for team leader" and "obtaining the Senior Technician Certificate (enrolling in the OUC PLC course)". After that, he shared the good news in his veteran buddies' group, childhood friends' group, and colleagues' group, attaching a photo of the certificate, which drew a wave of congratulations.
location: Room 402, Building 9, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Packing and organizing for the move.
description: Yin Hao began the final packing work: he sorted the tools on the workbench by size into a dedicated toolbox, wrapped the figurine and the photo with his comrades on the nightstand in bubble wrap and put them into a storage box, then packed half a box of fishing bait and camping stove from the balcony into woven bags and labeled them. He stacked the packed boxes in a corner of the living room, together with the previously packed 8 large and 3 small boxes, and felt reassured as the room gradually became emptier.
location: Room 402, Building 9, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Keeping accounts and stretching before bed.
description: Opened the expense-tracking app and recorded the day's expenses: KTV group-buy voucher 120 yuan, Pocari Sweat 4 yuan, taxi 25 yuan, total 149 yuan; bonus 2,000 yuan, net savings 1,851 yuan. Then did 10 minutes of lower back and leg stretches on the floor to relieve tension from training and prolonged sitting. Set the alarm for 6:15 the next morning and fell asleep at exactly 00:00.
location: Room 402, Building 9, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and core training
description: Yin Hao woke up naturally before the alarm. After a quick wash-up, he did core training in the living room, including planks, crunches, and supine leg raises. After training, he weighed himself, took vitamins, drank water, and his body was fully awake.
location: Room X, No. X, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Contact the landlord and enjoy breakfast.
description: Yin Hao contacted the landlord Li Xiuying via WeChat to confirm the time to return the keys and how to handle the remaining items. After that, he heated up the previous day's dumplings for breakfast, paired with honey water.
location: Room X, No. X, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Driving to Yonghui Supermarket for shopping
description: The day after receiving the rent increase notice from the landlady, Sister Li, in January, what promotional item did Yin Hao use when making dinner?
location: Yonghui Supermarket (Shanghai Songjiang Wanda Plaza store), Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bulk grocery shopping
description: Yin Hao made precise purchases according to the list at Yonghui Supermarket: chicken breast, eggs, multigrain rice, vegetables, and live bass. At checkout he used his membership card, spending about 192 yuan, then drove back to the rental apartment.
location: Yonghui Supermarket (Shanghai Songjiang Wanda Plaza store), Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Ingredient preparation and storage
description: Yin Hao portioned and marinated the purchased chicken breasts, washed and cut the vegetables and packed them separately, cleaned the sea bass and wrapped it in plastic wrap, and put all the ingredients into the freezer in categories, making the coming week more convenient.
location: Kitchen, Room X, Building X, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and afternoon plan
description: Yin Hao cooked a bowl of yangchun noodles with a fried egg for lunch. While eating, he checked the afternoon maintenance and cleaning plan. After the meal, he rested on the sofa for a while watching machinery maintenance videos.
location: Room X, No. X, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Repairing the old sound system
description: The floor-standing speaker Yin Hao brought back from Master Chen Jianguo's shop had a buzzing current sound. He used a multimeter to check and found the capacitor had aged and bulged. He replaced it with a capacitor of the same specification using a soldering iron and successfully fixed it. He then connected his phone to play music and the test passed.
location: Living room, Room X, Building X, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Deep cleaning of the rental apartment
description: Yin Hao did a thorough cleaning before the move: swept the whole house, mopped the floors, cleaned the grime in the kitchen and bathroom, took down and washed the curtains and duvet covers, tidied the drawers and wardrobe, and packed his clothes into boxes. The rooms were restored to tidiness.
location: Room X, No. X, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Walk to the dinner venue
description: Yin Hao changed into a casual jacket, took his small notebook for recording running data, and walked about 10 minutes to the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road to attend the running group's year-end dinner.
location: Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, 232 Xingang Road, Dagang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: First half of the running group's year-end dinner.
description: Yin Hao arrived early and chatted with running friends. The team leader announced the start of the dinner gathering. Yin Hao exchanged training insights with running buddy Chen Jie and reported the day's situation to his mother via video call.
location: Private room on the 2nd floor, Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, No. 232 Xingang Road, Dagang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Won the Best Team Leader Award and formulated the winter training plan
description: The team leader awarded Yin Hao the "Best Team Leader of the Year" trophy, recognizing his annual running volume of 1,100 kilometers and organizational contributions. Yin Hao gave a speech and discussed winter core strength training plans with Chen Jie and Wang Lei, agreeing that each person would increase their monthly running volume by 20 kilometers next year.
location: Private room on the 2nd floor, Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant, No. 232 Xingang Road, Dagang Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Walk home and have a call with girlfriend
description: After the dinner gathering, Yin Hao walked home along Guangfulin Road. On the way, he sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend Lin Yue to share the good news of his award. They had a brief call and said goodnight to each other. He arrived home at 21:25.
location: Room X, No. X, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and financial organization
description: After arriving home, Yin Hao used a mobile expense-tracking app to record the 120 yuan shared meal cost, then took a shower and did leg stretches in the living room to relax.
location: Room X, No. X, Xingang Residential Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Confirm the next day's plan and go to sleep
description: After stretching, Yin Hao confirmed tomorrow's KTV plan with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang, set his phone alarm, recalled the fulfilling day, and fell asleep in anticipation.
location: Bedroom, No. X, Room X, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning exercise and moving preparations
description: Got up at 6:45 in the morning and did core training on the balcony of the rental apartment: 3 sets of planks and 3 sets of crunches. Then he stepped on the electronic scale, saw his weight was 70.0 kg, and took a multivitamin tablet. After that, he checked off the 12 cardboard boxes stacked in the living room one by one against the item list on his phone, wrote the numbers and contents on the sides of the boxes with a thick marker, put the loose items into his carry-on backpack, and took a few photos of the empty room as a memento. After a simple meal of whole wheat bread and warm water, he placed an order on the Huolala app to schedule a freight service for 9:30, and carried valuables such as his ID card, bank card, and keys with him.
location: Rental apartment, 4th floor, Building 5, Xingang Residential Quarter, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Move belongings to the new home
description: At 9:30 Lalamove arrived on time. Together with the driver, Master Li, I loaded the first batch of 6 lighter cardboard boxes onto the truck and drove about 15 minutes to the new home on Floor 2, Building 5, Lane 208, Rongledong Road. I carried the boxes up to the second floor one by one. Then I returned to the rental apartment, loaded the remaining 6 boxes, the suitcase, and the old electric bike I had been riding for two years onto the Lalamove truck, and transported them to the ground floor of the new building. After the two trips it was already 11:30. I was a bit out of breath but in a good mood.
location: New home at 2nd floor, Building 5, Lane 208, Rongle East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (moved from Xingang Community)

name: Strength training in the community fitness area
description: After the move, instead of resting right away, he went to the public fitness area in the residential complex and completed the planned recovery strength training: 4 sets of pull-ups, 5 reps each; 3 sets of push-ups, 12 reps each; 3 sets of squats, 15 reps each. He felt that his upper-body endurance still needed improvement, but the fulfillment from regular exercise was satisfying.
location: Community fitness area, Lane 208, Rongle East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Have lunch and video-call my brother to report progress.
description: After exercising, I changed into a dry T-shirt, rode my e-bike to the Shaxian Snacks near the community, and ordered a chicken leg rice and a bottle of mineral water. While eating, I opened a WeChat video call with my elder brother Yin Tao, who is far away in Suzhou, and told him that I had picked up the ceiling lamp, completed the key handover, and the house was now completely mine. I reported that all was well. My brother gave a few reminders about installation precautions before hanging up.
location: Shaxian Snacks (Songjiang Renmin North Road Branch), No. 66 Renmin North Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Ceiling lamp installation and leisure time
description: After lunch, he returned to the new house and neatly stacked the packed luggage against the wall for the time being. He checked the toolbox and confirmed that the electric drill, spirit level, screwdrivers and other tools were all there. He opened the pendant light package sent by his brother, checked the parts list against the contents, and read the instructions carefully. At 13:20 he started the installation: first he used a tape measure to find the center point of the ceiling and marked the drilling positions, then used the electric drill to make four holes for expansion bolts. It was hard to hold up the lamp base alone, so he propped it up on a cardboard box, then tightened the screws one by one, connected the live wire, neutral wire and ground wire, and finally installed the bulbs and the lampshade. The moment the lamp lit up during the test, milky-white light spread evenly over the freshly painted walls, and the room instantly felt much more like home. Then he moved the old stereo, repaired the day before at Chen Jianguo's shop, into the living room and plugged it in. He connected his phone via Bluetooth and played the live version of Hotel California. The speaker delivered a hoarse yet magnetic melody, and the effect was unexpectedly good. He brewed a cup of Tieguanyin brought from his hometown, sat on a cardboard box in the empty living room, and quietly listened to half an album, enjoying the fruits of his labor and the tranquility of the new home.
location: Living room, 2nd floor, Building 5, Lane 208, Rongle East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Go to Partyworld KTV.
description: Changed into clean going-out clothes, confirmed the location of Ledi KTV on the phone map, and set off from the new home on an electric scooter, arriving about 25 minutes later. At a roadside convenience store, I bought a bottle of mineral water and a box of throat lozenges just in case.
location: From Lane 208, Rongle East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Haoledi KTV (Songjiang Branch), No. 64 Renmin North Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Attend Wang Lei's KTV celebration party.
description: When he arrived, Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, and a few others were already there, and the atmosphere in the VIP private room was lively. Everyone took turns picking songs: Liu Zhiqiang belted out Love Until Death, Wang Lei sang Zhou Jielun's Rice Field, and Yin Hao requested Zhang Zhenyue's Goodbye, which served both as a transition to his move tonight and as a footnote to this fulfilling day. Everyone drank, chatted about work and amusing stories from the running group, and the mood was relaxed and pleasant. Before the gathering ended, Yin Hao transferred the 120-yuan shared expense to Wang Lei via his phone.
location: VIP room, Haoledi KTV (Songjiang Branch), No. 64 North Renmin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Return to the new home for evening activities
description: After the KTV session, he rode his e-bike back to the new apartment. Opening the door, he smelled a faint woody scent and the fresh white walls, and felt pleased. He sat down at the desk in the bedroom, opened his Lenovo laptop, searched Bilibili, and bookmarked three of the most-viewed collections of "zero-basic video editing tutorials" (covering CapCut Pro basic operations, color grading tips, and transition effects). He downloaded and installed CapCut Pro, imported the aerial drone footage he had taken when fishing at Dianshan Lake, tried cutting and splicing clips by dragging with the mouse, and set a recurring alarm for learning the software at 9 PM every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday. He then opened the mobile banking app to confirm the plan for the system to automatically transfer 500 yuan into Yu'ebao every Sunday. He stepped onto the body fat scale connected to his phone and synced the data: weight 70.0 kg, body fat 18.1%, slightly down from mid-month. Next, he opened the expense tracking app and recorded today's spending: Lalamove fee 48 yuan, Shaxian lunch 15 yuan, Haoledi KTV share 120 yuan, totaling 183 yuan. Afterward, he did 10 minutes of full-body stretching on the floor, focusing on relaxing his lower back, shoulders, and neck. Before bed, he set the alarm and confirmed Monday's work schedule. After turning off the light, he quickly fell asleep in the quiet, brand-new room.
location: Bedroom, 2nd Floor, Building 5, Lane 208, Rongle East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and core training
description: The phone alarm rang on time. After getting up, I washed my face with cold water to fully wake up. Then I spread out a yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of core training, including planks, crunches, and lying leg raises. After training, I weighed myself on the body fat scale and felt a little relieved to see 69.7kg, as my weight had not rebounded too much from last night's celebration dinner. Finally, I took a multivitamin tablet and felt in good shape.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and getting ready to go out
description: Took whole wheat bread and milk out of the refrigerator, heated them briefly, and had them for breakfast. While eating, I flattened the cardboard boxes from yesterday's deliveries, stacked them, and tied them up with tape to take downstairs for recycling. Then I checked my commuting backpack and confirmed that my work badge, notebook, keys, and power bank were all there. Finally, I used the map app on my phone to check the cycling route and time from the new home to the factory, estimating about 20-plus minutes.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Bike commuting and getting familiar with a new route
description: Left on time, put on his helmet and gloves, and rode the electric bike to the factory following the navigation. The weather was overcast and windy, so he zipped up his windbreaker and sped up a bit. The road conditions along the way were smoother than expected. After about 18 minutes, he saw the factory building and arrived smoothly.
location: Along Xingang Road to Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Pre-work preparations
description: After parking his electric bike, he swiped his card to enter the factory, changed into clean work clothes in the locker room, and put on safety goggles and earplugs. He went to his CNC machine, powered it on to preheat the main unit, wiped the control panel and surrounding metal chips with a rag, and confirmed that the turning tools and drill bits in the tool magazine were all in place.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Team stand-up meeting and first-piece bushing machining
description: Team leader Wang Lei called a brief stand-up meeting, assigning priorities to finish non-urgent bushing orders this week to leave buffer for the major equipment overhaul after New Year's Day. After the meeting, he immediately returned to the machine tool and started machining parts according to the drawings. This batch had tight tolerance requirements (0.015 mm). He kept a close eye on the screen and cutting tools throughout and completed the first-piece machining.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Technical consultation and programming optimization.
description: Right after the first piece was finished, he brought the machining parameter records to Liu Zhiqiang's programming workstation and asked him about how to handle large variations in roughing allowance in the tool compensation optimization logic. Liu Zhiqiang demonstrated the variable settings and conditional judgments on the computer, and Yin Hao recorded the key lines of code in his phone memo.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Precision machining of shaft sleeves and stretching during the work break
description: Returned to the machine tool and continued finishing the remaining shaft sleeves. For each piece, used vernier calipers and micrometers to measure the outer diameter and inner bore dimensions to ensure tolerances. Around 11:00, paused the machine and did a set of work-break stretching exercises in the workshop corner—chest expansions, waist twists, and leg presses—to relieve fatigue. Then resumed machining until the end of the morning shift.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break, lunch, and a call with father.
description: Went to the cafeteria on time for lunch and ordered the braised lion's head meatball set meal. Around 12:00, I carried my tray to the quiet rest area outside the workshop and made a WeChat video call to my father. He asked about the wall-hung boiler connection in the new house, and I promised to check it when I got home in the evening. After about half an hour of casual family chat, the call ended.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory canteen and rest area, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Lunch break
description: Returning to the workshop rest room, I put on earphones and listened to light music, leaned back in the chair and rested my eyes, without using the phone, allowing my brain and eyes to fully relax from the intense morning work.
location: Break room, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Assist the Equipment Department in organizing the maintenance plan
description: In the afternoon, I took last week's daily machine tool inspection records and proactively went to the Equipment Department to find Engineer Wang. Together, the two used Excel to list the three machine tools that needed key maintenance after the New Year's Day holiday. Based on the inspection records and the service life of wearing parts, they came up with a list of bearings, seals, and belts that should be replaced first, and organized the draft into a formal schedule.
location: Equipment Department Office and Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Wrap-up work and equipment cleaning.
description: Back at his machine tool, he cleaned each of the day's finished shaft sleeves, applied rust-preventive oil, and arranged them neatly on the parts rack. Then he removed the metal chips from inside the machine, blew out the guide rails and lead screws with an air gun, filled in the Production Log and Equipment Maintenance Record, and after confirming the machine was in good condition, turned off the power.
location: Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute after work and supermarket shopping
description: Left work on time, rode the electric bike with navigation, and went to the Yonghui Supermarket at Songjiang Wanda Plaza along the way. In the supermarket, he bought garbage bags, plastic wrap, and hangers that the new home still lacked, as well as sliced bread and milk for the next day, spending 48 yuan in total.
location: Yonghui Superstore (Songjiang Wanda Plaza), Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Return home and clean up scrap
description: He cycled back from the supermarket to Xingang Residential Community, went upstairs to put away the purchased items, placed the milk and bread in the refrigerator, and put the garbage bags and plastic wrap in the kitchen drawer. Then he went downstairs, took the bundled cardboard boxes from the morning to the construction waste recycling point downstairs, and on the way removed the empty milk crates from the hallway.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Xingang Residential Quarter, 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and the area downstairs

name: Home inspection and wall-hung boiler confirmation
description: After returning home, I drank some water and rested first. Then I squatted down and carefully checked the pipe connections of the wall-hung boiler in the kitchen and bathroom. Using a flashlight, I confirmed there were no leaks or loose connections, and took close-up photos of the connections to send to my father. I also tidied up the tools and odds and ends left scattered after the move.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner
description: Since the frozen ingredients had not thawed yet, he decided to order takeout. He opened the food delivery app and ordered a well-reviewed braised chicken rice from a nearby restaurant, eating while scrolling through short videos as a short break.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Learning CapCut video editing and creating the first project.
description: After dinner, he sat at the desk, opened his laptop, launched CapCut Pro, and followed a saved Bilibili tutorial to learn video splitting and basic transition functions. Then he imported the Dianshan Lake aerial footage for practice, removed the shaky and overexposed parts, stitched together steady shots, and added transitions and light background music. Finally, he successfully exported a 30-second aerial short video and felt a strong sense of accomplishment after watching it repeatedly.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Making a study plan and keeping accounts
description: Write the CapCut study schedule on a sticky note (Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from 8 PM to 9 PM) and stick it on the monitor bezel. Then open the mobile expense-tracking app, enter the 22 yuan lunch expense and the 48 yuan supermarket purchase, check the monthly budget, and confirm that the total expenditure is within a reasonable range.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reading before bedtime and contacting father
description: After washing up, I leaned against the headboard and continued reading “The Biography of Zeng Guofan” on Kindle for about half an hour. Near nine o'clock, I remembered the wall-hung boiler photo and sent it to my father via WeChat with the message: “Dad, I looked at it. All the connections are fine. Don't worry. Everything is going well, nothing to be concerned about.”
location: Room 301, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep stretching and bedtime preparation
description: Putting down electronic devices, he did 10 minutes of stretching and relaxation on the floor, focusing on easing the back of his thighs and lower back. Then he hung the next day's work uniform and pants on the clothes rack, charged his phone, set the alarm for 6:15, checked that the windows were closed, turned off the light at 21:30, and went to bed feeling fulfilled.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Morning training, contacting the landlord, and breakfast preparation
description: After the alarm went off, he got up on time and first did 15 minutes of core training on the yoga mat in the living room (plank, crunches, squats), then weighed himself at 68.8 kg. He took a multivitamin and drank warm water. At the same time, he sent a WeChat message to the landlady, Sister Li, arranging to hand over the keys at the entrance of Xingang Residential Quarter in the morning. While washing up, he played the piano piece 'Moonlight' on his phone. For breakfast, he ate frozen steamed buns and boiled eggs and drank milk, then checked his work clothes, work badge, and phone battery.
location: Own home, Lane 208, Rongle East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Go to the old residential community to return the keys
description: Riding the electric bike from his new home to Xingang Community, he arrived on time at 7:32. He met and exchanged pleasantries with the landlord, Sister Li, and they went upstairs together to inspect the old residence, confirming that the main water, electricity, and gas valves were turned off and taking photos as records. After signing the handover form and returning the keys, Sister Li gave him a bag of tangerines and wished him a happy New Year; Yin Hao thanked her and accepted them.
location: Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Commute to the factory and make pre-shift preparations.
description: He rode the electric bike for 20 minutes to arrive at Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory and parked the bike in the shed. In the locker room, he changed into work clothes, entered the workshop to wipe dust off machine #03, then went to the tool room to get the spare parts needed for year-end maintenance (new coolant filter, special cleaning agent, lubricating oil), and placed them together with the maintenance record checklist that had been verified with team leader Wang Lei.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Year-end maintenance wrap-up for machine tools
description: At 8:30, shift leader Wang Lei blew the whistle and assigned tasks. Yin Hao, Liu Zhiqiang, and another colleague were responsible for the maintenance of CNC machine tool #03. The three divided the work: Yin Hao was the lead operator. First, he cut off power and drained the old coolant; then he and Liu Zhiqiang changed the filter cartridge together; next they cleaned the guide rail lubrication system and added new lubricating oil; finally, they cleaned out the chip bin and tightened screws. At 11:40, the maintenance was completed and the machine looked brand new. Yin Hao signed the maintenance record form and pasted a green "Sealed for the 2026 holiday" label next to the main control panel. After checking each other's work, they finished contentedly.
location: Workshop, Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and chatting with coworkers
description: In the factory workshop cafeteria, I had lunch (braised pork chop, garlic greens, rice). Wang Lei teased that Yin Hao had moved into a new home and should treat everyone after New Year's Day. Yin Hao smiled and said that once his family affairs were sorted out, he would invite everyone over for hot pot on the weekend. The atmosphere was lively.
location: Factory canteen, 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon drawing review and family communication
description: After the lunch break, he reviewed the drawings for parts to be processed after New Year's Day. Sitting at the workbench, he compared tolerances and process requirements page by page and marked them with a pencil. During the 15:20 break, he received renderings of the new home decoration from his brother Yin Tao. After looking at them carefully, he replied with suggestions (choose a dark coffee table for the living room, re-measure the kitchen shelf dimensions), and they agreed to go to IKEA together on the weekend. He then continued reviewing the drawings until the end of the workday.
location: Beside the workbench in the factory workshop, No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After work, went supermarket shopping and went home to organize
description: Punched out at 16:30 and rode an electric bike to Yonghui Superstores Songjiang Wanda Store. I quickly bought bananas, plain yogurt, whole wheat bread, and ready-to-eat chicken breast, spending 47.2 yuan in total. Then I rode back to my new home at Lane 208, Rongle East Road, sorted the items into the refrigerator and cupboard, and took out the yogurt and bananas to eat after the run.
location: Yonghui Supermarket (Songjiang Wanda Plaza Store) on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, then returned home at Lane 208, Rongle East Road.

name: Pre-run preparation and heading to the sports center
description: At home, he changed into quick-dry running clothes, running shoes, and a windproof jacket, ate a banana and drank a little water as pre-run fuel, and checked his sports watch and bone-conduction headphones. At 17:50 he rode his e-bike to Songjiang Sports Center. The cold wind hit his face, but he felt excited.
location: At home, Lane 208, Rongle East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai; en route to Songjiang Sports Center.

name: Run club gathering and December finale run
description: Arrived at the Songjiang Sports Center track and field, met up with running group members Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, Chen Jie, Zhang Wei, and others, and greeted each other. Wang Lei patted him on the shoulder and joked about his weight. Yin Hao led everyone in dynamic warm-ups (high knees, butt kicks, joint circles). At 18:30, they started a 10-kilometer run at a 5:30 pace. Yin Hao led the first 5 kilometers and encouraged Liu Zhiqiang to adjust his breathing. In the second half, he slowed down a bit to run side by side with everyone and feel the team atmosphere, and the last kilometer was a group sprint. During post-run stretching, Yin Hao took a screenshot of the running mileage: 80.5 kilometers in December, 1,100 kilometers for the year. Zhang Wei was impressed, and Yin Hao chuckled that his goal for next year was 1,500 kilometers. Everyone took a group photo and exchanged New Year wishes.
location: Track and field at Songjiang Sports Center, No. 145 Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Post-run cool-down, return trip, and buying drinks
description: After walking a slow lap to calm my heart rate, I rode the electric bike home. On the way, I passed Zengyu Convenience Store (the community store at Lane 115, Rongle Middle Road), and bought two bottles of sports drinks for 6 yuan to drink tomorrow. The evening breeze brushed my face, and dopamine made my mind especially clear.
location: Zengyu Convenience Store in the community at Lane 115, Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and on the way home

name: Cleaning sports gear and writing postcards
description: After arriving home, he scrubbed his running shoes in the bathroom, stuffed them with newspaper, and left them to dry in the shade. He hand-washed his quick-dry clothes with special detergent and hung them out to dry. Then he went to the living room, took out four Shanghai scenic postcards (the Bund, City God Temple, Lujiazui, and Qibao Ancient Town), wrote blessings to his parents and his older brother and sister-in-law, saying that the new home had been settled and looking forward to a Spring Festival reunion, and put stamps on the envelopes.
location: Own home, Lane 208, Rongle East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Washing up and a simple dinner
description: Took a hot shower to relax my whole body. Then in the kitchen, boiled water to cook buckwheat noodles, poached an egg, added lettuce leaves, drizzled with light soy sauce and sesame oil, and ate it with a glass of warm milk to replenish the energy lost from running.
location: Lane 208, Rongle East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, kitchen and bathroom at home

name: Relax and log expenses before bed
description: Opened the repaired Tecsun R308 audio player and played the piano piece 'Clair de Lune.' He did 15 minutes of full-body stretching on the yoga mat, focusing on relaxing the leg and glute muscles. After stretching, he drank water and used his phone to record the day's expenses: breakfast about 5 yuan, dinner ingredients about 10 yuan, supermarket 47.2 yuan, sports drink 6 yuan, total 68.2 yuan, and entered them into the expense-tracking app.
location: Home living room, Lane 208, Rongle East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Reading and bedtime
description: After checking the alarm clock, I leaned against the headboard and read The Biography of Zeng Guofan on my Kindle until 22:30. Reading the insight about building strong camps and fighting to the death, I felt grounded, thinking of my work and running. Then I turned off the light and soon fell asleep amid the occasional sound of cars outside the window.
location: Bedroom at home, Lane 208, Rongle East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Falling asleep
description: The whole day ended with a strong sense of accomplishment. I welcomed the New Year with the running group and quickly fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Lane 208, Rongle East Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Morning core training and health monitoring
description: The alarm went off right on time. You woke up on the floor mattress, quickly got up and laid out the yoga mat, opened the Tide app to play white noise, and started 15 minutes of core training, including planks, crunches, and squats. After finishing, you stepped onto the body fat scale. It showed 69.8 kg, and you noted the number with satisfaction. Then you ate two slices of whole wheat bread, drank a glass of warm water, and swallowed a multivitamin to store up energy for the day.
location: Room 601, Building 2, Lane 1518, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (new house living room)

name: Commute preparation and cycling to the former rental community.
description: You checked your commuter bag, confirmed that you had a power bank, a charging cable, the written thank-you letter, and a postcard, put on a dark jacket and helmet, got on your electric scooter, and set out from your new home on Guangfulin Road, riding along Guangfulin Road and Songhui Middle Road for about 25 minutes to Xingang Community. The winter morning wind was a bit cold, but the sun was bright. You went through the day's timeline once more.
location: Along the route from Room 601, Building 2, Lane 1518, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Community).

name: Picked up documents from the former rental apartment and had a farewell breakfast in the neighborhood.
description: You return to the familiar rented room in Xingang Community. The room is mostly emptied. You take out a few documents from the drawer, including a handwritten draft resignation letter, and after looking around the empty room, lock the door. You walk to the Sichuan restaurant on Xingang Road at the entrance of the community and order a bowl of small wontons and two pan-fried buns. The owner, Sister Li, hears that you bought a house and warmly congratulates you. You smile in reply, feeling warm inside.

participant.name: Sister Li
participant.relation: The proprietress of the Sichuan restaurant

location: No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (former rental), and 232 Xingang Road, Dagang Town (Xingang Road Sichuan Restaurant)

name: Commuted to the company by bike.
description: After breakfast, you rode your e-bike along Xingang Road and Huatianjing Highway for about 10 minutes to the company, parked it in the designated bike shed, locked it, and walked quickly to the workshop.
location: No. 360, Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Shanghai Liandong Air Duct Processing Factory)

name: Year-end workshop wrap-up meeting and lunch with workmates.
description: You walked into the workshop and gathered around the small table with Master Sun and Team Leader Wang to confirm the process and delivery schedule for the last batch of parts to be processed. Team Leader Wang patted you on the shoulder and said that another day he would come to your new home for a housewarming meal. Liu Zhiqiang also came over to talk about plans to learn programming for the new equipment next year. Around 10 o'clock, taking advantage of a trip to the break room, you contacted Director Zhang of the owners' committee via WeChat and arranged to hand in your resignation in person at 3 PM. After wrapping up the work, the four of you went to the cafeteria together for lunch.
location: No. 360 Huatianjing Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (company workshop and canteen)

name: Mailed postcards at noon
description: After lunch, you take the two postcards you've written (one for your parents, one for your elder brother and his wife) to the company mailroom. Sister Liu from logistics readily agrees to mail them for you. After thanking her, you save the trip to the post office, leaving more time for the afternoon.
location: No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai (company mailroom)

name: Cycled back to Xingang Community.
description: You ride your bike back to Xingang Community. The sunlight is pleasant and a gentle breeze brushes your face. Arriving early, you mentally prepare for the afternoon resignation.
location: From No. 360 Huatianjing Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Community)

name: Formally resigned from the position of tenant representative.
description: You arrived early at the owners' committee office. Seeing Director Zhang was already there, you knocked and went in ahead of time. You solemnly handed in your written resignation, briefly reported on the work over the past six months such as organizing the Neighborhood Festival and coordinating pipe repairs, and recommended Aunt Chen Xiuying across the hall. Director Zhang expressed great appreciation and, on behalf of the owners' committee and the property management, presented you with a joint letter of thanks, praising you as "the most responsible tenant representative." The handover process was sincere and harmonious.
location: 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Xingang Community Owners' Committee Office)
