name: Saying a warm goodbye to neighbor Aunt Chen
description: After leaving the office, you deliberately walked slowly in the community garden and met Aunt Chen, who was basking in the sun, under a camphor tree. When she learned you were moving away, Aunt Chen's eyes reddened. She held your hand and urged you to come back often, and offered to make braised pork for you. You kept nodding and asked her to look after Grandpa Wang downstairs. You chatted for a long time on the bench, and the sunlight stretched your shadows long.
location: No. 1-246, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Central Garden, Xingang Community)

name: Return to the new house and set up the projector.
description: After saying goodbye to Aunt Chen, you rode the electric bike back to your new home on Guangfulin Road. The first thing you did upon arriving was to find the newly delivered portable projector from the pile of packages, unpack it, plug it in according to the manual, connect to your phone's hotspot, and successfully project the image onto the white wall of the living room, already planning to use it to stream the New Year's Eve show in the evening.
location: Room 601, Building 2, Lane 1518, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Prepared a simple New Year's Eve meal on his own
description: You went downstairs to the Lianhua Supermarket across from the residential complex and bought frozen dumplings and a bag of tangyuan. Back at the new apartment, you boiled water with the newly bought induction cooker, cooked 10 dumplings as dinner, and also cooked 6 black sesame tangyuan. Setting out the bowls and chopsticks, you ate quietly by yourself, savoring the ritual of a special day, then quickly cleaned up the kitchen.
location: No. 625, Lane 1518, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Lianhua Supermarket) and the kitchen of Room 601, Building 2

name: Video call with girlfriend Lin Yue to confirm New Year's Eve plans
description: You called your girlfriend Lin Yue on video. She was packing in her rented apartment in Suzhou, with a New Year's Eve gala preview in the background. You smiled and told her the projector was already set up and you would live-stream the new home to her. Lin Yue responded, confirming again her plan to come to Shanghai and report for work after New Year's Day. You agreed to make a video call at 11:50 p.m. sharp and ring in the New Year together in front of the screens.
location: Room 601, Building 2, Lane 1518, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (living room)

name: Evening ambience setting and solitary rest
description: After hanging up, you turned on the heating in the living room, connected your phone to the repaired speaker, and played soothing instrumental music. You took out a notebook to write down today's important notes, then browsed phone news and messages from the running group. As it got dark, you deliberately turned off the main living room light, leaving only the projector's standby screen, filling the new house with a quiet sense of technology.
location: Room 601, Building 2, Lane 1518, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (living room and bedroom)

name: Video-call my parents to show them the new home and welcome the New Year together.
description: You turned on the projector in advance and mirrored your phone screen, then called your parents via video at exactly 8 o'clock. Holding your phone excitedly, you slowly panned across the living room, bedroom, and kitchen, telling them the second bedroom was reserved for them. When your mother Wang Xiuying saw the pure white walls, she couldn't help wiping away tears. Your father Yin Jianguo carefully asked about the wall-mounted boiler usage. You repeatedly promised to bring Lin Yue home for the Spring Festival reunion.
location: Room 601, Building 2, Lane 1518, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (living room)

name: Shared the joy of buying a home with my older brother Yin Tao.
description: After hanging up the call with your parents, you immediately connected with your older brother Yin Tao via video and again showed him every corner of the new home. Your brother teased you as a "renovation worker," and you asked about the logistics information for the lamps he had helped you buy earlier. The two brothers talked about plans to return to Nantong for the Spring Festival, and your brother shared a few tips for installing bathroom shelves. Finally, he said earnestly: "Little brother, you've made it in Shanghai, and I'm happy for you."
location: Room 601, Building 2, Lane 1518, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (living room)

name: Late-night solitude and writing the annual plan
description: After finishing phone calls with all family members, the room fell quiet. You turned off the projector, leaving only a rechargeable desk lamp on, sat cross-legged on the floor bed, took out the black-covered notebook, and solemnly wrote down the 2026 Annual Plan: compete for team leader, learn drone editing and aerial photography, run 1,500 kilometers per year, give parents 5,000 yuan each month, and strive together with Lin Yue. Finally, you wrote the sentence: Start from debt, but build the future yourself. After writing the plan, you opened the memo on your phone and reviewed the December diet records: no late-night snacks, homemade lunch, pork rib soup three times, body fat down from 18.5% to 18.0%. You checked it with satisfaction and set the first small goal of the new year: maintain a healthy diet and make soup at least four times a month.
location: Room 601, Building 2, Lane 1518, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (on the floor mattress in the living room)

name: New Year countdown video call with Lin Yue
description: At 11:50, you made a video call to Lin Yue right on time. On the screen, she was wrapped in a blanket, with the New Year's Eve gala countdown in the background. You exchanged "Happy New Year", and you said with emotion: "Lin Yue, in the new year, our wish is to pay back the money we owe Mom and Dad as soon as possible, and then bring you here, and we'll live well together." As the midnight bell rang, you each gently kissed the screen, completing the ritual of welcoming 2026.
location: Room 601, Building 2, Lane 1518, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (on the floor mattress in the living room)

name: Relax before bed and drift off to sleep
description: After the call ended, you drank a glass of warm milk, ate two pieces of whole-wheat crackers (your weight rose slightly to 70.0kg), and then lay on the floor futon and used the Tide app for a 15-minute bedtime meditation and stretching session. Then you turned off the lamp and lay quietly in the dark for a while, listening to the faint sound of fireworks in the distance outside the window, feeling an unprecedented sense of groundedness and peace. Silently repeating '2026, I'm ready,' you fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room 601, Building 2, Lane 1518, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (on the floor mattress in the living room)
